# Outlands Discord knowledge base

## Skills & training

- **golden belt boxing tournament skill lock**: Skills must be set correctly before the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament begins, because they cannot be changed once the event starts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **afk skill training policy**: AFK training of skills is allowed on Outlands (nearly all skills can be trained AFK), but killing monsters or gathering resources while AFK is not allowed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555873620868210699)
- **afk taming skill training**: Train Animal Taming to 120 by repeatedly taming and releasing three pets in sequence: a cave bear up to 80, a forest ostard up to 100, and a frenzy ostard up to 120; a script can automate this, or you can record a macro using the context menu to release. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380155657682995)
- **alchemy benefits for dexxers**: Alchemy gives stronger explosion potions, improved heals, an instant cure for bleed and disease, an instant cleanse of hinder effects, and a 3.75 reduction in heal potion cooldown, and it unlocks the alchemy codex, whose parts work in PvP and benefit dexxers. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **alchemy for dex tamers**: Alchemy (around 80) is a good, commonly recommended skill for a dex tamer, since it improves survivability, damage and resistance, though it is expensive to level and can be swapped for Tactics. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554434011365904525)
- **alchemy potion duration bonus**: Alchemy skill lengthens potion buff durations, scaling linearly with skill, so stat potions last about 20 minutes with Alchemy versus about 2 minutes without; the Potion Codex further extends elixir duration, adds defensive benefits, improves healing and reduces potion cooldown. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553785079380320359)
- **alchemy skill benefits**: Alchemy skill strengthens potions: bigger heals, longer buffs, more explosion damage, added resists and reduced bleed/disease, and a shorter potion cooldown (about 7 seconds), which helps make up for losing Healing. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896266612604979)
- **animal taming training location**: Animal Taming skill does not increase inside a player house, guild house or rented inn room, so train it outside such buildings, for example in a quiet spot in a city or town. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554948137603305483)
- **arcane mage mana and meditation**: Arcane mages have mana problems early and use Meditation (plus Cooking, Void aspect or arcane crystals) to cope, and can drop Meditation around Arcane aspect tier 10+ with enough spell aspect special chance links, since platemail eventually blocks it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555289832643629057)
- **artisan aspect leveling**: The Artisan aspect gains experience from crafting and from PvM (killing blows struck while artful), and societies can also level it; it is great for PvM but rarely worth it for crafters unless they craft huge volumes. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555847036455231620)
- **avararite map mining skill requirement**: Decoding or mining avararite maps requires 110 effective Mining skill, which can be reached by combining base Mining with Harvest aspect bonus and harvest links; the item need not be printed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547455923021418598)
- **backstabber skill template**: A backstabber build centers on about 100 in Hiding, Stealth, Stealing and a melee weapon skill (Mace or Fencing), with Snooping and Tactics early on; remaining points go to utility skills such as Tracking, Camping, Forensic Evaluation, Item ID, Anatomy and Healing, and exact templates vary by player. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550142627335372862)
- **bard codex perk self taught**: The Bard Codex perk Self Taught uses the lowest of Discordance, Peacemaking and Provocation in place of Musicianship, so a bard with all three trained can drop Musicianship and free up to 100 skill points. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551928919207313539)
- **bard codex self taught**: In the Bard Codex, the Self Taught ability lets your lowest printed skill among Discordance, Peacemaking and Provocation replace Musicianship, so you can use those skills without an instrument; 3 points (tiers 1-2) cover up to 80 skill, 5 points (tier 3) cover 80.1-120, and the codex requires 80+ in two barding skills to work. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936214447358003)
- **bard codex self taught requirements**: The Bard Codex Self Taught ability lets a bard drop Musicianship, but it only works if Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance are all trained, because the lowest of the three acts as effective Musicianship. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 14 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555238569340178465)
- **bard tamer aspect choice**: The Command aspect is the recommended aspect for bard tamers; it is more expensive to level but considered much better than Lyric, though some bard tamers may still prefer Lyric armor. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552378351732269068)
- **camping skill benefits**: Raising Camping increases carry weight (about 40 extra at 120 skill, which helps miners) and gives a damage boost against most targets, though not follower damage; at 80 skill with an Atlas it also allows hiking for fast travel. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 12 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554537713728884889)
- **cartography requirement for treasure map chests**: Digging up a treasure map chest now requires Cartography instead of Lockpicking, with minimum skill scaling by level: L1 85, L2 90, L3 95, L4 100, L5 105, L6 110, L7 115, L8 (Lore Map) 120. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549127064135934105)
- **cartography requirement for treasure maps**: Cartography is required to run treasure maps: about 100 is needed for levels up to 4, 105 is needed for level 5 maps, and 80 is not enough; at high skill it can be added to almost any build for level 6/7 maps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541530759884705792)
- **cartography value**: Cartography is very useful for boaters thanks to a strong multiplier buff, and is also used by tamers to read treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361119974498338)
- **chivalry 120 cap requirements**: Chivalry can be trained to 120 with a battle trainer once 20 chivalry skill scrolls have raised its cap from 100 to 120, and 20 skill orbs have raised the 700 total skill cap to 720. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457332115578881)
- **dexxer skill template**: A common dexxer template is about 120 Chivalry, 100 Tactics, a 80-100 weapon skill (Wrestling is currently considered best for PvM), and 80 each in Healing, Anatomy, Parrying and Arms Lore, with the remaining points on Focus, Resisting Spells or Alchemy; PvP variants use Resist, Swords and Archery. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554567179255676959)
- **dull copper resource maps for mining skill**: Dull copper resource maps can train Mining all the way to 120, because resource maps bypass the normal dull copper gain cutoff and keep giving gain chances, though it takes many maps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **dungeon chest requirements**: Opening trapped dungeon and paragon chests requires Lockpicking to unlock and Detect Hidden to remove traps, plus lockpicks and trap removal tools. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554688892056248351)
- **echo creation copying template**: Creating an echo copies the currently active template's skills and stats into a new separate template, which can be adjusted independently and switched to at any time without affecting the original, so no retraining from scratch is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541793433037836378)
- **echo system**: An echo is an extra skill/stat template on the same character that you can switch to, like dual spec; it keeps character-specific progression such as aspects and codices, has a long cooldown until you buy all the buffs for it, and lets you rework skills, for example into a lumberjack or miner to gather other resources. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367608470507621)
- **fishing skill gain bonus in new player dungeon**: Fishing is a gathering skill, so it receives no extra skill gain bonus in the new player (Shelter) dungeon or from fighting mobs, even with a harpoon or trident, and there is no practice weapon for it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552050023540203634)
- **follower slots for pets**: A character has 5 follower slots in total, and each tame takes 1 to 4 slots, with some pets taking 2-3, and when over the limit tames only obey follow commands. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555615062171975831)
- **forensic evaluation benefits**: Forensic Evaluation gives a damage bonus and lets the player carve or skin corpses for leather, with higher skill increasing the amount and quality of leather and meat obtained. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552765959939424347)
- **forensic evaluation training speed**: Forensic Evaluation can be raised to 120 within a day by active play such as skinning, but cannot be trained AFK and gives no weapon speed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538878475937644594)
- **frenzied ostard taming training**: Frenzied ostards can be used to train Animal Taming from about 100 up to 120, so a tame-and-release routine can level taming past 100. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493891923714241)
- **harvest aspect for dungeon lockpickers**: Dungeon lockpickers and tmappers should use the Harvest aspect, which improves loot and helps picking, with a weapon or spellbook carrying it equipped to avoid losing half the experience; Fortune is an alternative that gives good XP for unlocking links. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554001480598552617)
- **harvesting skill gain rates**: Mining skill gain is very slow, and after about 100 skill gains come mainly from colored ore, so resource maps are best saved for that range; lumberjacking levels noticeably faster than mining, with estimates ranging from 2-3x to 10x. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555544324207419453)
- **healers codex skill requirements**: The Healers Codex perks unlock at 80 Veterinary and 80 Animal Lore for tamers and summoners, while a Healing-based path requires 80 Healing and 80 Anatomy. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545750807415361546)
- **hiding training in inn rooms and houses**: Hiding cannot gain skill inside inn rooms or houses because it always succeeds there, so it must be trained in a public location; Stealth does not have this restriction. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554905675610718331)
- **inscription spell damage bonus**: Inscription increases supplemental damage of spells cast from scrolls by 40% times (Inscription skill / 100), about 48% at skill 120, with lower-level scrolls having a chance not to be consumed; it only applies to scroll-cast spells. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552784161906102323)
- **item identification**: Items are identified with the Item Identification skill (success chance equals skill level, and at 120 skill whole containers can be identified at once), with a craftable item ID wand, or by another player. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551077936436617277)
- **item identification bonus**: Item Identification amplifies the bonuses of magical items, such as the Protection property on armor, so it is mainly useful to players who use magic weapons and armor, and the bonus is better with higher quality magic equipment. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552452571703283725)
- **item identification for backstabber builds**: Item Identification benefits backstabber builds because it boosts magic weapon properties and damage, though a high Shadow aspect tier can make it unnecessary, and a Magic Hammer can identify magic items for free. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088301224071262)
- **item identification skill at 120**: Item Identification skill level equals the success chance for identifying individual items, and at 120 skill (reachable beyond 100 with about 20 skill scrolls) a player can identify an entire container at once, including another player's backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551257377175642213)
- **leveling harvest aspect**: Harvest aspect is leveled per character. Lumberjacking is faster than mining, fishing from a boat can be faster still if enough spawn is available, and treasure maps and dungeon picking rank higher; many players level it by gathering and then move to maps, chests and MiBs. The aspect only needs to be on armor. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537620678319145050)
- **leveling the bard codex**: To level the Bard Codex, keep Musicianship (about 80) while killing mobs with enough skill for codex access, because Musicianship is needed until you have points in Self Taught; once Self Taught points are earned, Musicianship can be replaced by another bard skill, and a higher tier is needed for higher caps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189403081248809)
- **lowering a skill**: To lower a skill, set its arrow to down, lock the others as needed, and train another skill; the lowered skill only loses points when you are at the total skill cap and those points are needed. To lower by a set amount, train a placeholder skill by NPC for that many points and set it to go down. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553284351674818642)
- **lyric aspect benefits for bards**: The Lyric aspect benefits bards by improving reset chance and effective barding skill for discordance and peacemaking, adding a damage bonus against barded targets, and giving a chance to ignore bard break. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549865646769180763)
- **magery training 80 to 100**: From 80 Magery up to 100, train by casting Flamestrike at Prevalia Zoo creatures or a dummy. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550695509558038630)
- **magery training 80 to 100 with elementals**: Most players train Magery from about 80 to 100 by scripting a cast-and-release of a reagent elemental summon (earth, water, or air, but not fire), which can run AFK and can be done in an inn room with a restock agent pulling reagents from a bank box or secure container. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586641098604597)
- **maxing all skills on one character**: A single character cannot have every skill maxed at once because of the total skill cap. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386855575556137)
- **mining and lumberjacking template setup**: Mining and Lumberjacking are pure gathering skills that fit together on one harvester character (Forensic Evaluation is added for leather), while Blacksmithing belongs on a separate crafter, and some players split gathering and crafting onto separate echoes. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549354240139329648)
- **mining skill gain above 100**: After 100 Mining skill, the fastest way to keep gaining is mining ore maps (including dull copper maps), though progress is very slow, with one player needing roughly 700+ maps to go from 102 to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555542430286086145)
- **mining skill gain from colored ore**: From 100 Mining skill onward, skill gain chances only occur when mining colored (non-iron) ore, which is random and rarer than iron, so gain is much slower; resource maps can be used to push it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **necromancer summoner build focus**: A necromancer summoner build works best when committed to a single damage type, either pets (Necromancy, Spirit Speak, Herding, Magery, with Veterinary possible) or spellcasting (Evaluating Intelligence), rather than both. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535501906645094491)
- **new player dungeon skill gain boost**: The New Player Dungeon gives a boosted skill gain chance (about 6x) up to 80 skill for all characters and all skills except gathering and crafting skills. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554160966801948855)
- **npc skill trainer cap**: NPC trainers in town train a skill only up to 50, costing about 500 gold per skill (10 gold per point, payable with a skill deed or cash), while trainers you can attack work up to 100. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555040785957789707)
- **outlands butler template planner**: Outlands Butler (outlandsbutler.com) provides a template planner for planning skill templates, comparing the effect of skill choices and checking crafting bonuses, and builds can be tested on the test server by maxing a character there. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555429029635428352)
- **paragon chest skill requirements**: Regular paragon chests need about 100 Lockpicking and 100 Detect Hidden, and Remove Trap is not a skill on this server. Greater Paragon chests may need more, up to 150+ effective skill. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546287813350400060)
- **passive taming skill gain**: Passive Animal Taming and Animal Lore gains no longer bank points; instead, when a player kills a creature, each tamed follower whose Min Taming is within 10 points of the player's printed Animal Taming gives a chance for passive gains while used in combat (Herding has also been listed). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555413701509775466)
- **poisoning skill level for poison dexxer**: A poison dexxer does not need 120 poisoning; 105 is commonly used for convenience, since poisoning skill above 100 only raises the chance of successfully applying poison to the weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538344528661057556)
- **poisoning training**: Train Poisoning with Greater Poison until 80 skill, Deadly Poison from 80 to 100 (about 1,100 potions), and Lethal Poison beyond 100; skill gain is random, so potion counts are approximate. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551706952751386757)
- **potion codex requirement**: The Potion Codex requires 80 Alchemy; once eligible, you earn codex progress from PvM kills and gain defensive utility and some damage from sticky explosion potions. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552283305473347587)
- **release and retame skill gain**: Releasing and retaming a pet can raise Animal Taming, Animal Lore and Herding, and is faster than passive gain, but only within certain skill breakpoints; retaming the same animal has the same gain chance as taming it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553403005271932928)
- **removing traps from dungeon chests**: Remove Trap no longer exists as a separate skill; it was merged into Detect Hidden, so untrapping dungeon chests requires Detect Hidden in addition to Lockpicking, while treasure maps do not need it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554845620806623383)
- **resisting spells benefits**: Resisting Spells makes a character less squishy against mobs and player killers by giving some resistance to non-spell PvM damage and interrupt avoidance, and it boosts swing speed, which makes it easy for PvM dexxers to add but of little PvM benefit to mages. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555288781387464767)
- **resisting spells swing speed benefit**: Resisting Spells grants swing speed along with mana refund and some defense against spells, though it adds less swing speed than Focus, so it is worth taking mainly when you still need swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540229061404659743)
- **resisting spells training from 90 to 100**: Resisting Spells from about 90 to 100 is slow, taking roughly an hour or more, and is best trained by being hit by sufficiently strong spell-casting monsters rather than self-casting, which may stop gaining at 90. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547526260714901524)
- **resource map skill requirement**: Resource maps do not require Cartography; only the matching harvesting skill is needed, while Cartography is needed only for treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549747234437070929)
- **resource maps for mining**: Resource (ore) maps remain faster than regular mining for skill gains and leaderboard progress, and the fastest approach combines maps with Tracking and an anti-PK recall script. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **self taught effective skill cap**: Self Taught uses the lowest of Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance as effective Musicianship, so a skill at 0 makes it 0. Each Self Taught point adds 20 effective skill, so 2 points cap at 80 and 3 points are needed to reach 100 or more. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551638370772328542)
- **shelter dungeon skill boost**: In the Shelter dungeon, skills other than crafting and gathering (including healing) gain faster, and fighting mobs there can raise them, until the skill reaches 80; the boost persists after leaving and returning, and does not apply in town. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539600800450486363)
- **shelter island crafting and gathering**: Shelter Island gives no skill gain bonus for crafting or gathering skills, and gathering there has reduced harvest success (reported as 50% lower). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544174002753511575)
- **shelter island dungeon skill gain bonus**: The Shelter Island dungeon gives a large skill gain bonus for most skills (excluding gathering and crafting) up to 80 skill, available to any player, after which gain drops to the regular rate outside it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553357770210672671)
- **shelter island pickpocket dips**: Pickpocket dips on the roof of the battle trainer building in the southwest corner of Shelter Island train Snooping and Stealing up to 80; after that, other publicly accessible dip locations (listed by the !dips command) train them to GM+. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555926697306624111)
- **shelter island skill gain**: Harvesting and crafting skills do not gain faster on Shelter Island; harvesting there is safe from PKs, whereas harvesting in the main lands makes you a prime PK target. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533185122227196095)
- **showing skill gain chances**: Single-click your character and choose 'Show Skill Gain Chances' from the context menu (also under general options, miscellaneous); using a skill then prints the gain chance percentage in system messages, and 0% or no gain at cap means the action will not raise the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555031633042874458)
- **skill mastery orbs and skill cap**: Each Skill Mastery Orb raises the total skill cap by 1 point, so consuming 20 orbs raises it from 700 to 720; orbs drop from hunting, from lockpicking dungeon chests, or can be bought from vendors (about 9k-10k gold each), while skill scrolls separately raise a single skill's cap from 100 to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556003370777448560)
- **skill orbs and scrolls caps**: Skill mastery orbs raise the total skill cap from 700 to 720 at 1 point each (20 orbs), while skill mastery scrolls raise an individual skill's cap from 100 to 120 at 1 point each (20 scrolls per skill), and both are needed to take a skill to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 12 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555255804356075583)
- **skill scrolls above 100**: Raising a skill above 100 requires skill scrolls, about 20 for each skill to reach the 120 cap; not all skills can go above 100. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553728523997544560)
- **skinning and forensic evaluation**: Skinning uses the Forensic Evaluation skill, which improves the resources gained; it works at 0 skill but yields little, and it can gain skill on every use on any corpse regardless of creature, unlike mining or lumberjacking. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **spirit speak afk training**: Spirit Speak can be trained by using the skill repeatedly, such as with a macro on a roughly 2 second delay, and left running AFK overnight; the gain chance per use is low (about 1%), so it takes a long time, and it may also rise while casting. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537856580299657298)
- **spirit speak effects**: Spirit Speak raises the base stats of your summoned creatures, and links can push it above 120, while for a caster without summons it only adds spell charge chance and does not increase spell damage, so it is mainly useful in summoner builds (roughly 80 points needed). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149217996243036)
- **stealing and pickpocketing**: Players can steal from monsters, but a steal can only succeed once on a given monster; players can be pickpocketed in towns, and monsters do not steal items from a player's corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478886532718735)
- **tamer animal taming and lore training**: Tamers need both Animal Taming and Animal Lore, typically aiming for 120 each (110 each is considered better than Taming alone at 120), since new creatures unlock about every 5 levels and require Lore to use, and skill gains come from fighting with a pet whose minimum taming is within 10 points of your current Taming. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554297267517915168)
- **tamer mastery link priority**: Follower Damage is the safest first link choice for a tamer (around 10 links), followed by Follower Attack Speed (around 3 links, or until capped), then situational accuracy/defense follower links. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543460542432280716)
- **tamer skill template**: The standard tamer template is 120 Animal Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding, with the remaining points on a flexible set such as 80 each of Provocation, Discordance and Peacemaking for bards, Magery for mages, or archery, Forensic Evaluation, Camping or Cartography. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 20 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552224849886322692)
- **tamer treasure map build**: A tamer can be used as a treasure-map build instead of a trapper, typically with four 120 tamer-related skills (Taming, Animal Lore, Herding, Veterinary) plus Lockpicking and support skills such as Fencing, Magery, Cartography or Tracking, adjusted to map level. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541897479048396830)
- **taming skill gain in houses**: Taming skill does not gain inside a player house, guild house, or rented inn room; train in an empty room in town or elsewhere outside housing instead. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542247220940636241)
- **taming training pets source**: Pets for taming skill training can be bought from the pet or creature broker at town stables. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549742702919155773)
- **thieves codex and snooping**: Snooping (and Tactics for backstabbers) must be on the build to initially level the Thieves Codex; once codex points are earned, they can replace Snooping and Tactics and free those skill slots. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544623453645181008)
- **thieves codex skill substitution**: The Thieves Codex has 20 total points; Ruffian lets you use up to 33/66/100 Stealth in place of Tactics for Mugging and 10 seconds afterwards, and Shadow Hands lets you use up to 33/66/100 Hiding in place of Snooping when Pilfering or Mugging, but substitution needs at least 5 points (preferably 10) in the codex, so keep Tactics and Snooping until then. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547246460578439239)
- **total skill cap**: The total skill cap starts at 700 points, with extra points (up to 720) unlocked by consuming skill balls, each of which adds 1 point. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550250558487666801)
- **total skill cap**: The base total skill cap is 700 points, and eating 20 skill mastery orbs raises it by 1 each to a maximum of 720. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971275167015056)
- **total skill cap**: The total skill cap starts at 700 points and can be raised to a maximum of 720 by consuming skill balls or orbs (20 of them); skills cannot gain without available points, so skills set to lower should be used to free points once capped. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **total skill point cap**: Each character has a total skill cap of 700 points, raisable to a maximum of 720 with 20 skill mastery orbs; at the cap you must set other skills to down to lower them before another skill can rise or be trained by NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589345241600153)
- **tracking skill combat effects**: Tracking adds weapon and spell damage (about Base Weapon Damage * 25% * Tracking/100), tracks red and grey players, and combined with a combat skill grants Harmstring, though the damage boost is often weaker than using another skill. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339561496772631)
- **training parrying**: Parrying trains by letting monsters hit you while you have a shield or two-handed weapon equipped and keep yourself healed; weak mobs such as birds, cats or skeletons work, more mobs give more chances to gain, and Shelter dungeon works before 80 skill. A training weapon can train weapon skill at the same time. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554579111173816482)
- **training resisting spells**: To train Resisting Spells, get to about 50 from a mage NPC, then stand near caster monsters (Shelter dungeon ghouls, necromancers or mages, a gazer in the New Player Dungeon, or Banshees for higher levels) and keep yourself healed with a heal loop until you reach 80 or more. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299819568627885)
- **tribard tamer build**: The common tribard tamer build is 120 in Animal Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding plus 80 in three barding skills (Discordance, Peacemaking, Provocation), with the pets doing the damage and the bard skills used for songs; some players use 100 Herding and 80 Veterinary to give barding more room. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189469422559233)
- **water aspect builds**: The Water aspect supports healer builds, with good mana, an AoE chivalry heal and an instant rez, and is also used for cheap tamer or ocean builds. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532972870893712)
- **wrestler build aspect choices**: Commonly recommended aspects for a wrestling build are Air, Discipline and Madness, with Discord, Earth, Lightning, Frost and Void also suggested; Air is often called the best. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529470402202697841)
- **afk taming skill training**: Train Animal Taming by taming the creature suited to your skill level (see the wiki Animal Taming page) and repeatedly releasing and re-taming it, which can be done AFK or scripted overnight; gains stop around 20-25 points above the animal's minimum requirement when tame chance hits 100%, so move on to the next creature (reportedly ostard to 100, then frenzy ostard to 120). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528874610471342080)
- **alchemy for arcane mage**: Alchemy, especially at 80 with its strengthened codex, is considered a much better skill than Inscription for an Arcane mage, helping sustain via fewer heals, better potion use, damage resistance, Panacea, Freedom and AoE Flamestrikes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547283207148273765)
- **alchemy leveling cost**: Leveling alchemy to 80 costs a fair amount of money, so new players are advised to take parry first and swap alchemy in later, though 50-80 is reportedly quick, taking only a couple of hours. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553014536565432391)
- **alchemy on backstabber builds**: Alchemy (often around 80) is a popular and valuable addition to a backstabber build once the damage cap is reached, commonly chosen instead of Tracking. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554998161104445522)
- **arcane mage skill template**: A typical arcane mage build uses 100 Magery and 100 Evaluating Intelligence, plus 100 Resisting Spells and 100 Focus, with 80 each of Arcane, Wrestling and Alchemy, and the remaining points in Meditation or Cooking; exact allocations vary by player and by PvM versus PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546226010712711320)
- **arcane mage without necromancy**: An arcane mage without Necromancy loses much damage; it can use player-damage links as the second link slot after aspect chance, but Necromancy should replace Cooking once leveled. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536222576551141376)
- **arcane skill cap**: Arcane skill is capped by Wrestling (the lower of Magery and Wrestling), so Arcane builds need Wrestling, commonly with both Arcane and Wrestling at 80, or you trade resist for 100 wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551406794100973600)
- **aspect xp split between armor and weapon**: Aspect XP is split 50/50 between armor and weapon/spellbook aspects; two different aspects each get 50%, the same aspect on both gets 100%, and an aspect on only one gets only 50%. A capped aspect does not push extra XP to the other. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550561027786145903)
- **backstabber build codex requirements**: A Backstabber build (Thieves' Codex Ruffian) uses the Thieves' Codex plus a weapon codex such as Macing, which still enables abilities like Wild Swing even with Tactics replaced by Ruffian. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548580926320156764)
- **backstabber template resources**: The Outlands wiki TemplatesMisc page lists Backstabber and Mugger templates including a Basic Backstabber, and players say 120 Camping is right while 80 Healing and Anatomy are not forbidden skills on it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545571500252200972)
- **bard codex perks for tamer**: A common Bard Codex setup for a discordance/trebard tamer is Self Taught, Sing Your Own Praises, Perfect Pitch, and Refrain. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541912899977744385)
- **bard codex replacing musicianship**: Musicianship can be dropped to 0 once the Bard Codex is leveled enough to replace it, but the codex uses the lowest of the three barding skills and applies it to all three, so all three should be kept at the same level (e.g. 80 each). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541964586683600996)
- **bard template skill allocations**: Bard templates vary widely: the bard codex requires at least 80 in each barding skill, and many builds use 80/80/80 barding with the remaining points spent on preferred skills (e.g. Necromancy, Magery, Tactics, a weapon skill). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555521499413225546)
- **begging skill uses**: Begging can be used on NPC ship crewmembers in towns and wilderness housing to acquire them as a Ship Crewmember deed for a ship deed, and on crew aboard a ship to motivate them for a limited time; it can be trained on any town NPC, though recruitable crew are found at docks or inns, and it can also yield some gold, though many players consider it not worth the effort. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534592723053580461)
- **bless duration**: Bless duration scales with Inscription and related improvements and links; Inscription alone gives about 12 minutes, while a 15-minute Bless needs Eldritch plus many links (around tier 14-15). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541926915093565532)
- **camping skill damage bonus**: Camping gives a passive spellcast damage bonus of up to 25% of base damage scaled by skill, applying just by having the skill, but because scaling is additive it is worth only about 10-12% extra spell damage in practice. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548943699486969867)
- **cartography bonus and pets**: The cartography bonus does not apply to a tamer's pets; cartography is only needed for treasure map purposes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538692237486198894)
- **casting spells from scrolls skill boost**: Casting a spell from a scroll gives a 20 point Magery boost, capped at 100, so spells like Mark, Reflect and Invisibility cast reliably at 60 Magery and can be attempted at 40. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544096873386614865)
- **crafting skill gain chance**: Crafting skill gains are a percentage-based chance determined by item difficulty and cannot be improved by food, clothing or other methods, and crafting and gathering skills lack the inherent gain boost other skills have. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533208318502240479)
- **detect hidden for trapper build**: Detect Hidden is required on a trapper-style treasure mapper, as it is needed for the trapping codex, handles hidden traps, and reduces trap cooldown. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538092986137575475)
- **dual wield skill requirements**: Dual Wield is its own weapon skill, like Macing or Fencing, and it is the only weapon skill required to dual wield; Swordsmanship, Fencing, Macing and Parrying are not required, though Parrying may be useful depending on the build. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553934113810030669)
- **dungeon lockpicker build**: A typical dungeon lockpicker build uses about 100-120 Lockpicking, 100-120 Detect Hidden, 100 Hiding, 100-120 Stealth, plus optional Forensic Evaluation, Camping (60-100), Magery (60-100) and Tracking. Higher harvest levels or the Harvest aspect let Lockpicking and Detect Hidden sit near 100. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **first codex for tamer dexxer**: The Taming Bestiary is the recommended first codex for tamers, including dexxer tamers, with Healers Codex and then a weapon codex suggested afterwards; mage tamers may also want the mage codex for mushrooms. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542484611597336616)
- **focus skill benefits**: The Focus skill increases swing speed, accuracy, and defense, and also improves mana refund chance, charged spell chance, and meditation rate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555426919657250867)
- **follower damage summoner build**: A follower-damage summoner build raises Herding and Veterinary (about 100-120) to boost summon damage, typically alongside Necromancy 120, Spirit Speak 120, Magery 100 and Meditation 80, using the Command aspect with follower damage links; Veterinary is optional. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531771256905404479)
- **forensic evaluation training by skinning**: Forensic Evaluation is a gathering skill trained by skinning corpses; it gets no faster in the new player dungeon, and skinning creatures killed by other players in dungeons speeds gain. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539117680735293470)
- **gathering skill gain speed**: Gathering skills such as lumberjacking and mining train slowly, and gain becomes very slow past 100, where gains only come from colored materials or resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544628826288562206)
- **healer codex skill compatibility**: The Healer Codex works with Animal Lore and Veterinary in place of Anatomy, as reported by players after a change. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533021839998324926)
- **healers codex for tamers**: Tamers and bard tamers can use the healers codex, and the taming bestiary codex is also useful; both must be bought or obtained from a guild. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556092481131647100)
- **healing codex at 80 veterinary**: Reaching 80 Veterinary (with 80+ Animal Lore for pets) unlocks the healing codex, which lets you heal yourself and pets and includes a triage bonus of about 15%; it can heal a tank from about 30% HP in one heal. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549866402318516294)
- **healing codex requirements**: The Healing Codex requires 80 Healing and 80 Anatomy. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545859998767128617)
- **horseshoe bay pickpocket dips**: The pickpocket dip location at the house just north of Horseshoe Bay lets you train Hiding and Stealth together with Snooping and Stealing, because you can stand 2 tiles outside the home, hidden, and still reach the dips. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555742076564406323)
- **inscription for necro summoner**: Inscription benefits a necro summoner by adding spell damage and enabling bless on followers, but the amount needed depends on the build: about 50 for bless, while a spell-damage summoner build needs far more (around 125 scribe skill, or roughly 90 base with tier 15 of the relevant aspect). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556069261766692895)
- **inscription scroll refund**: With 125 effective Inscription (raised with links or Eldritch armor), circle 7-8 scrolls are refunded 100% of the time, and circle 6 and below have a 50% refund chance, followed by a second Wizard's Satchel roll. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549153176593109005)
- **leveling harvest aspect by ocean fishing**: Ocean fishing, including net fishing, is the best way to level Harvest aspect once past the learning curve, and harvest aspect is nearly required to reach the effective fishing skill soft-cap of 205; on land, treasure maps and lumberjacking are best. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555344193294041121)
- **leveling thieves codex by pilfering**: Pilfering from mobs levels the Thieves Codex and does not require Tactics; you can steal from each mob only once, so harder mobs, such as those in harder dungeons where you can pilfer from an engaged mob at low risk, give better gains. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531521298537123841)
- **lumberjacking skill gain and colored nodes**: Higher Lumberjacking skill does not increase the number of coloured nodes, only success chances; at 100.0-119.9 only attempts that harvest a coloured log can gain skill, which is why lumberjacking maps help since every attempt yields that colour. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531309388663361558)
- **mage healing methods**: The Healing skill only improves bandages and does not boost healing spells, so mages should heal with spells and heal potions rather than train Healing; arcane mages should use heal potions instead of Greater Heal. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540742704609099867)
- **outlands butler build planner**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com) provides a template/build planner that shows the numbers and effects of a build, highlights available abilities when skills are entered, and lets players browse builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546511161468657714)
- **paragon chest lockpicking**: Paragon chests must be opened with Lockpicking; a lockpicker alt is easy to make or you can ask others for help in the guild or services channel, and a character with T9 harvest and 120 Lockpicking/Detect Hidden can open Greater Paragon chests without failure using Gold+ tools. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553661864032870461)
- **parry skill requirement**: Parry should be at least 80, which is also the requirement for Taunt; 80 is sufficient except for PvP or niche tank builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549385257831366657)
- **parrying with two-handed weapons**: Parrying works with two-handed weapons without a shield, Parry Codex benefits also apply, and paired weapons such as martial manual weapons count as two-handed for parrying. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380658655137913)
- **passive taming skill gain**: Passive taming gains still exist but were updated so they are no longer banked from active taming, and the gain chance from followers is reported to fall as their Min Taming moves further from a 10-point window of your skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555401356775522366)
- **pet leveling requirements**: Pets level up only through active combat, and you need Animal Taming and Animal Lore at least as high as the pet's requirement; if the pet's required taming is within 10 levels of your skill, you can also gain Taming, Lore and Herding from fighting with it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546709391267340299)
- **scroll casting success chance**: Casting from a scroll has a higher chance to succeed than casting normally, because scrolls are treated like a spell two circles lower for skill requirements, so you can stay near the minimum skill (circle x 10) and still reach 100% success; scrolls still use mana and are consumed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543038339836411955)
- **shadow hands thieves codex**: The Shadow Hands upgrade in the Thieves Codex lets a player use up to 100 points of Hiding in place of Snooping when pilfering or mugging creatures (not when stealing from players), so Snooping can be dropped once the upgrade is earned, though the first 5 points need printed Snooping. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546984220461629531)
- **shelter dungeon skill gain**: Skill gain is greatly increased (reportedly around 400%) in the Shelter dungeon up to 80 skill for all skills except crafting and gathering skills. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541147029902983238)
- **skill arrows for unused skills**: If a skill stops gaining, set the skill arrows to down on skills you do not plan to use, which frees up skill points and keeps those skills from gaining by mistake; existing points in them gradually shift to the skills you want, and a typical build uses 6-8 skills. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525593079208476933)
- **skill gain blocked by skill cap**: If a skill is not increasing, you are likely at the total skill cap or the skill is not set to rise; set an unused skill to 'down' (check with [skillmastery) and make sure the trained skill is set to up, since gain messages can still appear while capped. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546259928262385815)
- **skill gain chance display at cap**: The chance-to-gain percentage is still displayed when a skill is at its cap, even though it cannot actually gain. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538883774430060584)
- **skill lock down arrow behavior**: A skill set to the down arrow only loses points once the character is at the skill cap and gains another skill; the lowering skill does not need to be used, and the loss rate is limited by how fast other skills are gained. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530943041412665554)
- **skill lock settings**: Each skill can be set to Up, Down or Locked: Up skills gain points, Down skills are reduced to let Up skills gain once at the skill cap, and Locked skills do not change, so skills you don't need should be set to Down. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525882674256809984)
- **skill point caps**: Outlands limits characters to 700 total skill points, with each skill capping at 120 naturally; once at the total cap, you must set other skills' arrows to decrease so they lose points before training new ones, and new characters may start with many skills at 80 and already be near the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546159822339047485)
- **skill training speed**: Skills in Outlands are quick to train to 100 or 120, with most combat skills fast and 80 to 100 often done in one overnight AFK session, while crafting and gathering skills are slower; the long-term grind lies in the advanced progression systems. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550142836660240517)
- **swing speed skill contributions**: Anatomy and Arms Lore give about 1:1 swing speed, Magic Resist about 2x and Focus about 3x per skill point, and Focus also adds accuracy. Moving 20 points from Focus to Arms Lore costs only about 1% swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555526675024973915)
- **swordsmanship level on swords build**: A swords build can keep Swordsmanship at 100 for a long time and push Chivalry toward 120, and Swordsmanship can be dropped to 80 once accuracy reaches 100%. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545664328710098984)
- **tamer pet slots**: A character has 5 control slots, pets take 1 to 5 slots each, and a mount is separate, so a tamer can run 5 one-slot pets plus a mount; filling all 5 slots is best for fighting and gaining experience. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538121805745885275)
- **tamer skill point build**: Tamer builds commonly invest 120 in each of Animal Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding (480 points), leaving about 240 points for weapon, Tactics, Chivalry or other skills, and points can be taken from Herding or Veterinary if short. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553205182601367674)
- **tracking skill benefits**: Tracking helps a bard survive and evade PK/red attacks by locating them, and also grants bonus damage and bonus effective barding power. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555520844460073111)
- **trapper tmapper build after patch**: After the patch, the trapper treasure mapper build no longer needs Lockpicking for skinning downtime, so Lockpicking can be removed in favor of Cartography and Forensic Evaluation can be dropped. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542360904094720092)
- **treasure map skill requirement**: A patch (tested on the test shard) removes the Lockpicking requirement for treasure maps and replaces it with 120 Cartography to decode, dig up and unlock levels 1-8, and players will no longer see the map location before hiking to it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536702358950772796)
- **treasure map skill requirements**: Treasure maps no longer require Lockpicking or lockpicks; they require Cartography (level depends on map level) and explorer's packs, while dungeon maps and paragons still require Lockpicking and Detect Hidden. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553336588107382785)
- **veterinary self healing**: Veterinary can be used to heal yourself, at 50% effectiveness on yourself, and veterinary supplies provide an AoE heal. It counts as a valid skill for the healer's codex, and Veterinary plus Animal Lore fills the Healing plus Anatomy role for tamers. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539711806828843069)
- **viewing skill gain chance**: Click on your character and enable the Show Skill Gain Chances option to see percentage values when you use a skill, which also reveals when an activity will not raise a skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530271581807579176)
- **wrestler skill template**: A common wrestler template is about 100 Wrestling, 100 Tactics and 100-110 Chivalry, with 80 each in Anatomy, Healing and Arms Lore (110 in some builds), and the remaining points spent on Parry, Alchemy, Focus or Item ID as preferred; swing-speed links can replace Focus. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550759534358695998)
- **activating shepherd's crook**: Double-click a shepherd's crook with the Herds Followers ability to activate it; it must show [Activated] for your pets to receive its bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533896420724310076)
- **alchemy codex benefits**: The Alchemy codex provides damage resist buffs, evasion, poison/disease nullification and big potion heals, largely negating many of the game's negative mechanics, and 80 Alchemy also grants explosion potions. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546347971053092885)
- **alchemy on bard template**: Alchemy is considered a near-mandatory skill on any template that can fit it, including bard templates, and in the tri-bard template 20 Alchemy gives a slight increase to heals and potion buff durations. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936139930931342)
- **alchemy on pvm builds**: Alchemy is a great skill to include on most PvM builds, even without its PvP benefits, and can be paired with Magic Resist. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586650599985245)
- **alchemy skill value and training speed**: Alchemy is a very strong skill with great codex bonuses, but as a crafting skill it is not fast to train. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545558551437779036)
- **alchemy training**: Train alchemy by crafting potions: make Lesser Magic Resist potions from 50 to about 70-75, then from 75 to 90 craft greater potions such as heal, cure, strength or agility; alternatively, after 70 do profitable society jobs weekly, which took about 5 weeks to reach 100. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554287200148131922)
- **alchemy versus parry for wrestlers**: Alchemy is commonly recommended for wrestler builds over Parry; with Alchemy, Parry is generally not needed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524269160304082996)
- **animal taming passive skill gain**: Animal Taming skill can be gained slowly by fighting with tamed pets that are within about 10 levels of your current Taming skill; more pets in range increases the gain chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535229735981023292)
- **animal taming training**: To train Animal Taming, open the skill menu near an animal, press the blue button next to Animal Taming, target the animal, then tame and release it repeatedly, using cave bears to about 80, forest ostards to 100, and frenzy ostards to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532255821365379234)
- **applying poison to a weapon**: To poison a weapon, click the weapon and choose the apply poison option from the menu; the poison goes on an eligible weapon rather than the Poisoning skill being used on yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525167857950920705)
- **arcane mage skill point flexibility**: An arcane mage can free skill points by lowering Wrestling and Arcane to 80 and trimming Magic Resist, and can spend them on another mana skill such as Focus, or on Wrestling, Parry, or Magic Resist in place of Necromancy. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327463356432464)
- **archer swing speed cap versus alchemy**: On an archer template, you must choose between reaching the capped swing speed increase (SSI) and keeping 80 alchemy, since alchemy points can be reduced to hit the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527846494638575647)
- **archer tamer build**: Archer tamer is a viable build: a Command Dex Archer Tamer uses 120 Taming, Animal Lore, Herding and Veterinary, 80 Weapon skill, Tactics and Alchemy, with a flex slot such as Camping or Arms Lore, and pets do the actual killing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528402881575780453)
- **arms lore benefits**: Arms Lore provides ability cooldown reduction (about 30 seconds), roughly 10% special chance, about 5% attack speed, and a disarm damage multiplier (about 25% at 50% uptime). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542556540794445875)
- **arms lore effects**: Arms Lore increases weapon special attack chance (10% * Arms Lore skill / 100 for Arcane, Archery, Fencing, Fishing, Mace Fighting, Swordsmanship and Wrestling) and may also affect swing speed, but it is not required to use weapon specials, which are built into the weapon skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545890429885743216)
- **arms lore for wrestling**: Arms Lore at 120 adds noticeable damage for wrestlers but is not required, and it can be dropped to pick up Parry, which makes level 4 dungeons easier. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523487015843135681)
- **artisan aspect training**: Artisan aspect experience can be gained by killing monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1556000937066110977)
- **bard codex musicianship drop**: With the bard Codex perk you can drop Musicianship from a bard tamer build, but you still need the three other bard skills. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541501173356433488)
- **bard codex reverb perk scope**: The Reverb perk in the Bard Codex, which adds about 20% damage against a recently barded target, is a character-only buff and does not increase follower damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541908286796996632)
- **bard codex self taught perk**: In the bard codex, the Self Taught perk lets you drop Musicianship and replace it with Provocation (or Peacemaking), and the perk that boosts bard song buffs is a good next pick. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186642658238516)
- **bard provocation via self taught**: Keep Musicianship until you have enough Bard Codex points to put into Self Taught, then spec Self Taught, down-arrow Musicianship and train Provocation with the freed points. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553893610829774869)
- **bard skill levels and the bard codex**: The Bard Codex requires two bard skills at 80, so most bards run either full 80s or full 120s in bard skills for codex efficiency, and 80s are very viable with Lyric Aspect and the codex. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555520172331114497)
- **bard tamer build**: A bard tamer buffs pets and uses peacemaking, discordance and provocation on mobs while pets do the killing. Discordance is often enough, and a common template is 120 taming/lore, 100 herding/discordance/peacemaking/provocation and 80 veterinary, with 100 wrestling and resist for escaping PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552223304360788060)
- **bard tamer link priorities**: On a Bard Tamer, EBS (effective barding) links are a common first or second priority because they reduce failed barding attempts on mobs and raise Discordance and Provocation/Peacemaking success, alongside follower damage and attack speed; EBS can be dropped for attack speed if content is easy and a lower success rate is acceptable. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545545081090613278)
- **beginner summoner gatherer builds**: Players commonly run a miner/lumberjack mage-summoner build for gathering, for example 100 Spirit Speak, Necromancy, Herding, Meditation, Evaluating Intelligence and Magery plus a free skill, or a Lumberjacking/Forensic Evaluation/Magery/Spirit Speak/Wrestling/Resisting Spells/Tracking spread with the Summoner's Tome leveled. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547355574121791518)
- **best weapon skill for dps**: Wrestling is currently regarded as the highest-DPS weapon skill and the usual meta choice, with other weapon skills roughly comparable and viable. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534511648285397002)
- **camping pvm damage bonus**: High Camping skill gives a PvM damage bonus, which one player puts at 25%, and the skill is easy to train while AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538613668613459988)
- **camping skill carry capacity**: The Camping skill lets a character hike to locations and carry more gear. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **camping skill gain near campfire**: Standing near a lit campfire raises Camping skill, with no further gains once the fire goes out; stat gain near a campfire also needs Camping set to UP. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547044624487678063)
- **cartography skill benefits**: Cartography increases spyglass viewing distance, helps locate fishing spots, and also grants additional damage and resistance bonuses. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539470799889768479)
- **cartography skill needed for treasure maps**: Cartography below 120 is sufficient depending on the treasure map level: 100 decodes level 4 and below, 105 is needed for level 5, and 110 for level 7. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546080974197096469)
- **checking skill mastery caps**: Type [skillmastery in game (or use Razor > Skills) to see your maximum skill caps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576026817429515)
- **chivalry 100-120 benefits**: Raising Chivalry from 100 to 120 gives extra holy symbols (12/12 instead of 10/10) for rechargeable abilities, and Chivalry abilities scale with skill, so 100 gives fewer symbols and weaker effects. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528985535073353759)
- **chivalry on tri-bard dexxer build**: Chivalry can be used on a tri-bard dexxer build and works with archery, but adding it to the tri-bard archer build means dropping healing and anatomy. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896009619218434)
- **codex limit**: There is no cap on the number of codices you can have and train; the only limit is the number of skill points your character has. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553553767490912339)
- **codex skill requirement**: A skill level of 80 is required to use a codex, so many builds keep some skills at exactly 80, which still gives a large power boost. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529502201976717403)
- **crafting training location**: Crafting skills can be trained in your rented inn room, or in town if you place a bag or box in your bank box to hold the materials. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528954211058974750)
- **detect hidden for treasure maps**: Treasure maps do not require Detect Hidden, but dungeon chests do, and dungeons still have lockpickable and trapped chests, so a character without Detect Hidden cannot pick them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537086596589813770)
