- **dull copper mining skill gain cap**: When mining directly rather than through resource maps, dull copper ore stops giving Mining skill gains at 105, so at higher skill only rarer ore such as bronze and beyond offers gain chances. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851501669613662)
- **dullwood lumber maps for lumberjacking**: Dullwood lumber maps can be used to train Lumberjacking from 100 all the way to 120, so progressively harvesting higher colored woods is not required, although natural harvesting past about 115 may only give gains from copperwood and higher. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531320012399185971)
- **earth dragon taming requirement**: The Earth Dragon/Drake requires 105 taming skill and can be used to train taming up to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083574855237715)
- **effective barding links at 120 skills**: Effective Barding mastery links still have an effect even with 120 Discordance and 120 Peacemaking. A build with 9 silver links works fairly well, and another link could help until higher lyric. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553059123849863219)
- **effective barding skill boosts**: Effective barding skill can be raised by Lyric Armour, a good magical instrument, and the Effective Barding mastery chain link, which helps against harder creatures and gives better songs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526661433641664654)
- **effective barding skill calculation**: Effective barding skill is based on the lowest of Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance (plus bonuses), so points above the lowest are wasted. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532064013335400660)
- **effective barding skill targets**: With all three bard skills at 100 and 5 points in self taught, effective barding skill is 100, since the skill uses 'up to 120' rather than strict breakpoints; a good overall target is about 180-185, from 16 lyric aspect plus 30-45 from the link chain. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550932180899987527)
- **effective skill cap for mining and lumberjacking**: For Mining and Lumberjacking, effective skill affects only the success chance of gathering, not the quantity gathered, and gives no benefit beyond 139.1. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530466568922988716)
- **evaluating intelligence training**: Evaluating Intelligence can be raised by casting spells, since every spell has the same chance to raise it, so the fastest method is a spell that casts quickly and is safe; using the skill repeatedly on an NPC (for example overnight with a macro) also works, though more slowly. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546677556466425892)
- **expensive crafting skills**: Blacksmithing, Tinkering and Carpentry are expensive to train in Outlands and earn little gold from selling crafted items, so they are not beginner friendly, though they can be leveled later. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586486804029494)
- **failed steal flagging and steal messages**: A failed steal attempt does not necessarily flag the thief, and the game gives no distinct system message for a successful steal versus an unnoticed successful steal. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535722826303021076)
- **fencing for poison dexxer**: Fencing is generally poor except on a poison dexxer build, and a poison dexxer with low Fencing suffers accuracy problems; for lower-tier play, 100 Fencing and 80 Tactics is recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544729501144060014)
- **fishing resource maps for skill gain**: From about 65 Fishing skill, fishing up resource maps (dullscale at 65 up to avarscale at 110) is much faster for skill gain than other methods, and dullscale maps remain usable for gains up to 120 Fishing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549167843193389078)
- **fishing skill training**: To train Fishing, get a regular harpoon (a trident may also work) and hit or throw it at a training dummy or battletrainer. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548464821437988965)
- **fishing skill training**: Fishing can now be trained up to 100 by hitting a trainer dummy, while training from 100 to 120 reportedly still requires fishing from a ship on the ocean. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533069669378818159)
- **focus for melee swing speed**: Melee builds should take 100 Focus, because lower Focus leaves swing speed too low; Focus raises swing speed toward the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554613128317370449)
- **focus on wrestling builds**: Focus is useful on a wrestling build for its accuracy bonus, so it remains worthwhile even when swing speed is already over the cap with air aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550757656103489587)
- **forensic evaluation gain chance by creature**: Forensic Evaluation has an on-use gain chance that is the same for every corpse, so a bird gives the same chance as a dragon, and using the skinning knife is identical to using the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532151404095865084)
- **harvest aspect uses**: The Harvest aspect increases harvest amount and gives a PvM buff, and it is useful beyond traditional harvesting, including for treasure maps, dungeon lockpicking, ocean fishing and MiBs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550617182461886579)
- **harvesting skill cap and gains**: Lumberjacking and Mining can be raised to 120; after 100 skill, gains come only from colored resource nodes, and skill beyond the 100% chance cap does not yield more wood or ore. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **healer's codex and veterinary**: The Healer's Codex works with the Veterinary skill, and the combination makes mage healing almost never miss except when many people mess up at once. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555732595080175668)
- **healing codex bandage speed**: The Healing Codex can reduce bandage time from 10s to about 6.25-7s (about 7s self-bandaging at 100 Healing), increase healing, grant some damage reduction, and offers an offensive perk, Pressure Points; the self-bandage speed perk works whether unlocked via Healing plus Anatomy or Veterinary plus Animal Lore. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541397744231645235)
- **herding for tamers**: Herding is typically recommended for tamers because it gives a large pet damage increase, and some advise raising Herding and Veterinary to 120, though a tamer with many links may get by with less Herding. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556091801113333862)
- **herding skill gain and active crook**: Herding requires an active crook; with one you gain skill passively, you can macro a double-click of the crook for on-use gains, and an activated crook stays active until it is lost. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541316688241229845)
- **hiding skill gain inside houses**: Hiding inside a house always succeeds, so it cannot fail and does not raise the Hiding skill; train Hiding outside houses. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542273291224350750)
- **identifying items**: To identify items, train Item Identification on an alt character (about 100-120 skill, possibly on a second account and kept in your inn room), or use a container ID wand bought from a player vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551078219669835888)
- **inscription buff duration**: Inscription increases the duration of many buffs, including those on followers, and this also works on other players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535921563889569812)
- **item identification success chance**: Item Identification success chance equals your skill level, so you stop failing at 100 and identify one item at a time, and at 120 skill you can identify entire containers at once. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054416489480203)
- **leveling an arcane mage with meditation**: An Arcane Mage can be leveled from tier 1 using a Meditation and leather build with some kiting; with low arcane aspect, Cooking should be swapped for Meditation. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546170445999374446)
- **leveling codexes with backstabbing**: Backstabbing as a secondary skill (as well as sailing) is a great way to level extra weapon skill codexes, including healing and parry codexes, and a leveled Thieves codex lets you take an extra weapon skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543141655325184000)
- **leveling the thieves codex**: Start by leveling the Thieves Codex with Snooping and Stealing, pilfering monsters in a crowded dungeon (high-level monsters others are killing, then their respawn; no stabbing needed), then put points in Shadow Hands to replace Snooping with Hiding. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541478911148556408)
- **locking skills in the skill window**: In the skill window, click the arrow to the right of a skill to cycle it between up (raise), down (lower) and lock; locking prevents the skill from changing, so lock skills you do not want to raise. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538251830046359552)
- **lowering an exact amount of skill**: To lower a skill by an exact amount, buy that amount in a dump skill, set the skill to be lowered to decrease and the dump skill to increase or lock accordingly, then lower the dump skill; Razor can make checking and doing this easier. Alternatively, buy the points in a throwaway skill set to decrease and give the NPC fewer coins (e.g. 200 instead of 500) so it drops exactly 20 points. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554188251114377297)
- **mage tamer build**: A mage tamer is the standard tamer base plus 100 Magery and 80-100 Meditation, with remaining points going to skills like Alchemy, Focus, Inscription, Detect Hidden or Evaluating Intelligence; Veterinary also adds damage for followers. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542925769959809074)
- **magery cast chance formula**: A spell can be attempted from circle x 10 Magery and reaches 100% success at (circle x 10) + 20; for 8th circle spells this means attempts begin at 80 with a low chance and reach 100% at 100 Magery, though casts can still be interrupted. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553456791004774451)
- **magery on dexxers**: Magery is useful but not required on a dexxer: 75 magery gives access to utility such as walls, teleport and greater heal, while 50 magery allows Magic Reflect from scrolls, a major boost since mages often assume dexxers lack reflect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **magery training from 80 to 100**: From 80 Magery, players commonly train to 100 by summoning Earth Elementals in an inn room or by casting Flamestrike at the Prevalia zoo, and there is no other notably fast method. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537777080295751680)
- **magery training methods**: Magery can be trained AFK by casting Air Elemental from home or by AFK scripting with stocked reagents, while casting Flamestrike (with summons doing the fighting) is better for active play but cannot be done from home. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526334811248001266)
- **magery training to 80**: To train Magery to 80, repeatedly cast Invisibility on yourself, for example in the new player cave, using a Razor script that meditates when mana is low and runs AFK once you have 60 Magery; from 80 to 100 use a different method such as the Shelter dungeon or elemental summon scripts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340871939948605)
- **magery training with invisibility**: Magery can be trained from 60 to 80 by casting Invisibility on yourself, for example in the Shelter dungeon, and only Invisibility is needed; the scrolls are sold by the Mage NPC. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547415341452365924)
- **making a campfire**: To make a campfire, double click a dagger and target a tree to get kindling, then double click the kindling in your backpack; no Camping skill is required, the fire is made if there is room, and standing near it grants Camping skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541970827577139270)
- **message in a bottle salvage crate xp**: Message in a Bottle salvage crates give roughly 5,000 XP each, a bottle can yield 1 to 3 crates (3 being very rare), and killing the mobs carrying them gives extra XP. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553463332558606457)
- **mining to 120**: Reaching 120 Mining is a very long grind with ordinary mining, which stops giving gains on dull copper; it is possible by ordinary mining, but ore maps are a faster route. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **necromancer summoner build**: A follower-damage necromancer summoner build uses 120 Necromancy, 120 Spirit Speak, 120 Herding and 120 Veterinary with no Inscription, plus follower damage links. A spell-damage build has no follower damage links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556069587831754896)
- **necromancy in arcane mage builds**: Necromancy is not mandatory for an Arcane mage build; it mainly adds disease stacks via offensive spells and solid damage-over-time in prolonged fights like bosses, while skipping it trades that for resist, damage reduction, and maxed Evaluating Intelligence. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554545888884555827)
- **new player dungeon skill cap**: The New Player Dungeon gives vastly increased skill gain but skills cannot be raised past 80 there, and it has no training dummies, so training cannot be done AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274468800987339)
- **parrying skill gain equipment requirement**: Parrying skill gains require a shield or a two-handed weapon to be equipped, and which of the two is used makes no difference to gain. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542183371546042398)
- **parrying training with alt character**: Train Parrying by having a second character or account attack you with a training weapon in a safe private spot such as an inn room, your house, or a guild house while you run a bandage macro or script. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538168271197446185)
- **pickpocket dip**: A pickpocket dip is a training dummy used to train thief skills such as Stealing and Snooping, separate from the combat dummy used for hitting. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549111728174792727)
- **pilfering mobs**: Pilfering means stealing from mobs, and it can be done on a mob in combat or before killing and looting it, though mugging is better if you plan to kill it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413957498408971)
- **resisting spells training locations**: Common places to train Resisting Spells from about 80 to 100 are Ossuary floor 1, the pyramids southwest of Ossuary, the small caster building next to the mountain east of Andaria, and Telescope Island. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101170590388267)
- **resource maps for gathering gains**: Resource maps guarantee some skill gain chances and make training gathering skills above 100 much faster, so save them for post-100 gathering. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544630564533833749)
- **rune marking requirement**: Marking a rune requires Magery, reported as 60 Magery, though a friendly mage can mark for you. Dropping marked runes into a runebook does not require Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552882084882808954)
- **scavenger build skills**: Lockpicking and Forensic Evaluation are good scavenger skills, and a scavenger can pick chests when no mobs are available; a cook scavenger build of Hiding, Stealth, Forensic Evaluation, Cooking, Lockpicking and Detect Hidden is considered good. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554363371262836811)
- **scroll casting magery requirement**: Casting from a scroll gives roughly +20 effective Magery (about 2 circles easier), so Gate Travel needs about 70 Magery from a scroll versus 90 without; scrolls do not bypass the requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550412595544981576)
- **self taught codex ability**: The Self Taught bard codex ability lets a tribard function without Musicianship. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553169408086638634)
- **self taught music skill**: Self Taught does not substitute Musicianship for Music; it uses the lowest of your Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance skills, so one skill at 0 makes your music skill 0. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551666308347732002)
- **setting skill gain direction in razor**: In Razor > Skills, set every skill to down (or locked), then set only the skills you want to train to up; clicking the arrow next to a skill cycles it between up, down and locked, and locked skills neither gain nor lose. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918164141150329)
- **skill cap above 100**: Not all skills can be raised past 100: combat skills stay capped at 100, while supplementary skills can exceed it using skill scrolls, after which the skill must still be trained. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542836182378086462)
- **skill lock arrows**: The skill lock arrows next to each skill control gain: pointing up raises the skill, pointing down lowers it, and the lock holds it; a skill can only gain if another skill is set to decrease. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567801336733797)
- **skill mastery scroll cap increase**: Each skill mastery scroll consumed raises that skill's cap by 1, so 20 scrolls raise mining from 100 to 120, and a cap of 101 means only one scroll was consumed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535071849686245426)
- **skinning blue corpses**: Skinning a blue corpse does not turn you grey; targeting self with the skinning knife only skins nearby non-blue corpses, so for a blue corpse you must target the corpse itself, for example via its name plate. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555531394447310943)
- **smoke bomb stealth**: A smoke bomb puts you directly into stealth without waiting for the Hiding skill cooldown, and the smoke bomb's own cooldown appears when you hide or stealth. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540681309368877147)
- **summon spell circles**: Summons come from normal Magery spells: Summon Creature is a 5th circle spell costing 14 mana per cast with no mana refund for summons, and the other summon spells are 8th circle. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532560983606821046)
- **summoner mastery chain links**: Summoners should prioritize Spirit Speak and Follower Damage links. Inscription or necromancy links can fill slots until 10 redline unlocks +5 max links, after which only Spirit Speak and Follower Damage are needed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538281904594358283)
- **summoner support skills**: For a pet-focused summoner, Herding and Veterinary improve pet performance while Evaluate Intelligence does not, so current consensus favors dropping Evaluate Intelligence for Herding and Veterinary. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552345101974376450)
- **summoner's tome requirements**: Using a Summoner's Tome requires at least 80 Magery and 80 Spirit Speaking; 100 Magery is a common build choice. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553409142633402512)
- **tactics and weapon codex**: Tactics grants access to the weapons codex and Arms Lore provides additional weapon skills; weapon skills cannot be used without a codex, so Tactics is useful even on a tamer. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541529127515979776)
- **tactics below 100**: Tactics caps at 100, and running less than 100 Tactics is a straight penalty to melee damage dealt, not merely a smaller bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544892304379215914)
- **tactics for dexxers**: Anyone dealing weapon damage, including red-damage dexxers, should run 100 Tactics; on a poison dexxer most damage comes from poison, so some players accept 80 Tactics, though others still recommend 100 for extra boss DPS. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530604548597743686)
- **tactics requirement for archery codex**: Tactics skill is required to use or level an Archery codex, which lets a dex tamer use it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554413259862577283)
- **tactics requirement for melee builds**: Melee-damage builds such as dexxers generally want 100 Tactics since it directly determines damage, while Tamers or Trappers relying on the Codex can get by with about 80 Tactics. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544542862824177766)
- **tactics requirements for paladin-style abilities**: Sacred Journey requires 90 Tactics and Holy Light requires 95 Tactics; Divine Fury and Sacred Journey need matching Tactics skill (without a weapon) to be usable. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521644714854711349)
- **tactics skill and accuracy**: The Tactics skill does not affect accuracy, and Tactics bonuses granted by a weapon do not raise the skill cap. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540761732925104188)
- **tame-release-retame training**: Releasing and re-taming a recently tamed creature can train taming without a long wait, but it only works until you need a creature with a higher minimum taming skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553404650848522345)
- **tamer codex and aspect leveling**: A tamer is an easy way to level aspects and codexes because pets do the real work, so any aspect or codex can be used while leveling, with two skills at 80 plus Tactics, Anatomy, Alchemy or Healing at 80. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535679605753647265)
- **taming bestiary category points**: In the Taming Bestiary, each class (attack, utility, tank) has its own points, about 20 per class, and points affect only pets of that class, though some points can go to crossover skills from another category. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552410910327447566)
- **taming script interruptions**: A taming script can pause or stop when the pet wanders out of range or runs away, or when you already have more than one follower, and another player can claim a pet that wanders too far from you. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549755154226610307)
- **taming skill training**: Taming is much easier to train since a patch, because you can repeatedly tame and release creatures instead of taming, killing, and waiting for a new mob. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532256545503576115)
- **taming training progression**: For Animal Taming training, tame cave bears up to skill 80, forest ostards up to 100, and frenzied ostards up to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549742702919155773)
- **taste identification for poison builds**: Taste Identification controls poison damage, so poison builds should raise it to 120, with Tactics around 80 as a trade-off. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543605640277135430)
- **thieves codex xp gain**: Thieves Codex XP is gained from successful steals (pilfers) from monsters, and harder monsters that drop more gold give more XP because the XP is based on the monster's gold value. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524857327101018254)
- **tinkering training with gems**: Buying bulk gems to train tinkering is a cheaper way to level it, and selling the resulting jewelry makes the training cost almost no gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524184878516801667)
- **tracking skill detection chance and range**: Tracking skill gives a chance to warn of approaching players roughly equal to the skill value and a detection range roughly equal to the skill value in tiles, so low Tracking is weak. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542041718654898226)
- **tracking skill reliability**: Taking the Tracking skill reduces the risk from PvP, but below 100 skill it is unreliable and can fail to detect threats (e.g. at 80). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **training magery with scrolls**: Casting spells from scrolls levels up Magery, and reagents, a spell stone, or scrolls all work equally for training, though you still need Magery skill to cast from scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551145880810291281)
- **training magery with the spellstone**: The spell stone in the dungeon takes Magery up to 80, and its remaining free casts are usually enough to continue to 85 in the previous zoo; Magery to 80 can also be trained at Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210556034977915)
- **training snooping and stealing on a dip**: Snooping and Stealing can be trained on a dip by double-clicking it, but progress is slow and can take overnight or longer to level. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529542767942828092)
- **training stealing and snooping on pickpocket dip**: To train stealing and snooping on a pickpocket dip, do not activate the skill first; stand next to the dip and double click it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555734712192995481)
- **training tracking skill**: Train Tracking by starting the skill, selecting Hunting mode in its gump and leaving it running (set to always get closest, restarting after each login); it ticks up on its own without a macro, what you hunt does not matter, and the new player dungeon is faster but it works anywhere. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531931744071192748)
- **training veterinary**: To train Veterinary to 80, take a dead bonded horse into the Shelter dungeon and bandage it (manually or with a looped bandage script); the resurrection fails but the skill gains until 80; past 80, use two pets with one attacking the other and bandage the victim (about 5k bandages). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555941824290361355)
- **trapper build skills**: A trapper build typically uses Alchemy (for its bonus to trap damage percent), Tinkering and Detecting Hidden, with Cartography sometimes included. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550068332751749182)
- **trapping skill requirements**: Trapping requires Tinkering, with 120 needed for full effect, and Detect Hidden is the other trapping skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550068281740763177)
- **treasure map summoner and necromancer builds**: Several skill builds are used for running treasure maps, including a summoner build (about 110 Spirit Speak, 120 Necromancy, 100 Evaluating Intelligence, 105 Cartography, 100 Magery, 85 Focus, 100 Meditation), a tamer-style build (120 Taming, Lore, Veterinary, Herding, Cartography, 100 Magery) and a necromancer build (120 Necromancy, Herding, Spirit Speak, Cartography, 100 Magery, 100 Meditation). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546072519960821811)
- **tri bard skill cap**: A tri bard uses all three bard skills (provocation, discordance and peacemaking), and effective musicianship is limited by the lowest of the three, so they should be kept at the same level (e.g. 80), with 2 levels in Self Taught. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548699199107891295)
- **veterinary healing and resurrection**: Veterinary lets a tamer heal pets strongly, heal themselves and other players, and resurrect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552283305473347587)
- **veterinary skill benefits**: Veterinary lets you heal, cure and resurrect pets, increases healing from bandages and vet supplies, and still adds bonus damage to pets, though the exact amount is unknown; the old stable slot bonus no longer applies. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525545897851752690)
- **veterinary training above 80**: Reach 80 Veterinary in Shelter first, then train further outside Shelter Island by bandaging a low-level tank pet that is being attacked by a weaker pet or healed by a spell pet, either actively or as an AFK loop macro. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530271689332756616)
- **weapon codex leveling requirement**: A weapon skill codex only gains once the matching weapon skill (e.g. Mace Fighting for the macing codex) is at 80. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555025835491201065)
- **weapon durability and quality effect on skill gain**: Low weapon durability and better weapon quality do not appear to affect melee skill gain, though a lower weapon skill does cause you to be hit more. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531930501722669157)
- **weapon skill target for pvm and pvp**: 80 weapon skill is generally enough for PvM, while 100 is preferred for PvP or very high difficulty monsters where accuracy won't reach 100%, since it lowers the chance of being hit and raises the chance to hit. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537447081344770171)
- **wiki tameables list**: The Outlands wiki has a Tameables List page cataloging tameable creatures with their taming skill requirements, sortable by taming skill, useful for choosing pets to farm. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555404513920159834)
- **wizard's grimoire poison skill bonus**: The Wizard's Grimoire grants 35 Poison skill, which lets a caster apply Deadly Poison directly, and because effective skills can exceed 100 and 120 the bonus still adds to effective Poisoning even at high base skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540457025312526469)
- **wrestling for mages**: Wrestling is not strictly required for mages unless they are arcane mages, but it gives melee defense, spell disruption protection and a mana refund chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553520623618232415)
- **100 throwing versus 80 throwing**: 100 Throwing has nearly the same swing speed and DPS as 80 Throwing but gives better accuracy and defense, making it more survivable against PKs and the better choice for new players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537442180946198578)
- **4th circle spell magery requirement**: A 4th circle spell needs 60 Magery for guaranteed success, or 40 Magery plus a scroll. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526915476817711174)
- **700 point skill cap and skill gain**: When a character is at the 700 total skill point cap, a skill will not rise until another skill is set to down (lowered), so points can transfer to the skill set to up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546159664666771647)
- **700 skill point cap**: At the 700 total skill point cap, you must set another skill to 'down' so points can transfer to the skill you want to raise, which must be set to 'up'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260388025339925)
- **80 alchemy in mage builds**: 80 Alchemy is regarded as a must-have skill in arcane mage templates and is considered by some players to be the best skill in the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524833214760488970)
- **80 weapon skill accuracy penalty**: Running 80 weapon skill costs too much accuracy, which is especially bad when starting at tier 1 arcane aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552041033628520619)
- **afk animal taming training to 120**: To train Animal Taming AFK up to 120, use the 'Flu AFK Tamer to 120' Razor script, which requires 3 different ostards (details are in the script). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533574234939326634)
- **afk combat training at prevalia**: Battle trainers and invulnerable monsters in Prevalia (the zoo and near the moongate) let players train combat skills AFK within the rules; going naked is recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531521026809139201)
- **afk fishing training**: Fishing can be trained AFK by throwing harpoons at a battle trainer, but this caps at 100 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552050075562147892)
- **afk melee training on battle trainer**: Melee, tactics and weapon skills can be trained AFK, for example overnight, by hitting a battle trainer, ideally with a cheap weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533448717586399362)
- **afk skill training**: Skills can be trained AFK, though some must be trained differently; combat skills such as swords, macing, tactics and magery can be trained AFK on battle trainers on and off Shelter Island, and training dummies with training weapons may exist in the south west of Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526194717182660820)
- **afk taming training setup**: For AFK taming training, stay inside a closed room in a building (not a rented inn room or house) so the animal cannot run off. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452745956925612)
- **air aspect and dexxer skill gain**: Training dexxer skills with Air Aspect active increases swing speed, so skill gain chances occur more often even though the displayed gain percentage does not show the bonus; only the equipped weapon's speed is normalized. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530211638114779239)
- **alchemy 20 points potion bonus**: Putting 20 points into Alchemy gives a small buff to potions, making heal potions somewhat better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545608369736523897)
- **alchemy and tinkering trap damage bonus**: Alchemy increases trap damage and Tinkering also boosts trap damage, while Detect Hidden affects trap cooldown; both crafting skills have their own additional bonuses and help with society jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298979841609748)
- **alchemy benefits against aoe and bleeds**: Alchemy provides longer lasting buff potions, 7.5% damage resistance, and bleed/disease mitigation, which helps counter AOE damage, especially bleeds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552374696534876333)
- **alchemy codex at 80 alchemy**: At 80 Alchemy the alchemy codex provides Freedom and Panacea, which are strong reactive tools. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531344310820274267)
- **alchemy codex picks**: Recommended Alchemy codex picks are max Bandolier, Freedom, Mixed Results and Panacea, with max Panacea considered the best and a single point in Freedom enough to grab some elixir; Bandolier and Panacea are especially recommended for a dexxer, depending on where you farm. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531100135306690632)
- **alchemy codex potion benefits**: The Alchemy codex provides 25 minute potions and a 3.75 second reduction to potion timers, both useful for survival and low-effort setups. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528951793512616118)
- **alchemy codex upgrades for nox dexxer**: Players suggest differing Alchemy Codex upgrade sets for a nox dexxer, such as Acrid, Bandolier, Mixed Results and Volatile, or Bandolier, Mixed Results, Freedom and Panacea; Bandolier and Mixed Results appear in both. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547008152522727535)
- **alchemy for poison builds**: Poison-focused builds, such as a poison aspect build or a Poison Backstabber, need the Alchemy skill for poison to be relevant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555166223732314143)
- **alchemy for poisoner**: A poisoner needs 80 Alchemy to use the potion codex, which is very strong for a poison dexxer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225868734922753)
- **alchemy on summoner builds**: Alchemy is a viable skill on a summoner build, where about 80 Alchemy provides damage resist while the summons act as tanks and the player does the damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538282455445012540)
- **alchemy skill for potions**: Alchemy needs to be around 70-80 to get useful, longer-lasting potions (80 for 20-minute potions), which is costly to raise for a starting character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553785705354764299)
- **alchemy skill level for dexxer builds**: 80 Alchemy is enough for a dexxer build, since the point of the skill is accessing the alchemy codex, and it fits especially easily on wrestler or dual-wielder dexxer builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524023095046701136)
- **alchemy training cost to 80**: Training Alchemy to 80 costs roughly 100k-130k gold, with greater heal potions as a usable byproduct; the wiki's first method is reported to cost around 330k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546348516081668167)
- **alchemy training crafting queue**: If an alchemy training script keeps crafting regular Poison instead of Greater Poison after 75 skill, use a crafting queue to control which potions are made, and queue potions you will actually use, such as Greater Heal and Greater Cure, to avoid a large unused stock of Poison potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546550334736826599)
- **alchemy uses**: Alchemy provides potions such as heal, strength and explosion potions, and for melee builds the potion codex adds heals, longer elixirs and extra damage resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553984171767238748)
- **alteration kits for artisan leveling**: Crafting clothing or cloth alteration kits with tailoring is an efficient way to level the Artisan aspect, because aspect XP is based on resources consumed and these kits have a high leather requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535041029516955749)
- **anatomy and healing on backstabber builds**: Healing and Anatomy work well on a backstabber build and reduce damage from disease and bleeds. Anatomy gives the same damage increase as other skill damage bonuses and pairs with pressure points, but most players prefer skills with more utility, such as camping, forensic evaluation or tracking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553308537357209702)
- **anatomy skill effects**: Anatomy increases weapon base damage and provides damage reduction, and it also boosts the effectiveness of bandage healing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539823881311887370)
- **animal lore leveling**: Animal Lore is leveled mainly while taming new creatures, and passively by killing mobs with a tame whose minimum taming requirement is within about 10 points of your Taming skill. Taming and releasing repeatedly also works, and music skills do not level this way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553271049842597950)
- **animal taming training to 120**: Animal Taming can be trained to 120 by repeatedly re-taming the same pet (even AFK or via Razor script), provided the pet's taming requirement is high enough. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554082039517679689)
- **arcane interrupt resistance requirements**: The arcane variant of interrupt resistance requires Arcane, Wrestling and Magery, and Arcane's interrupt resistance is capped by both Wrestling and Magery, so all three must be at 100. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550244225315115110)
- **arcane mage meditation**: Arcane mages do best without Meditation in a PvP build and do not meditate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542191047248187494)
- **arcane mage meditation versus cooking**: Early on, an arcane mage should run 80 Meditation instead of Cooking to sustain mana, and can swap Meditation for Cooking or a swing-speed skill at around tier 10-11 arcane aspect or once some links are obtained. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683406624694385)
- **arcane skill in skill list**: The Arcane skill is listed under new skills in the skill list, and you may need to press reset groups for it to show up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550592642151350485)
- **arcane skill training**: Arcane is a skill for mages who cast spell after spell rather than using followers, and it increases simply by casting spells, even without the staff equipped, so summons can protect you while training. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587315318464553)
- **arcane staves and arcane mages**: Arcane staves are used by petless mages with the Arcane skill; they fire a projectile that does minor ranged/melee damage, and spells can still be cast while one is equipped with the right skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526173146720239687)
- **archer tamer stat distribution**: An archer tamer build uses 100 strength, 100 dexterity and 25 intelligence, since only mage builds use 100 intelligence with 25 dexterity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555389742374461601)
- **archer-summoner build viability**: A magery, spirit speaking, archery, tactics, focus, arms lore, resist and meditation build is not good because it lacks damage; an alternative of 100 magery, 80 spirit speaking, 80 archery, 100 chivalry, 100 focus, 80 healing, 100 resist and 80 anatomy gives about 49% SSI but requires at least tier 9 blood aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545427439625441400)
- **archery power leveling**: Archery can be power leveled to 80 in about 20-30 minutes in the Shelter dungeon by buying to 50 and then killing monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533208138864525553)
- **arms lore for disarm**: Arms Lore is mainly worth keeping at around 80 if you plan to use Disarm on players; otherwise it can be sacrificed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552066792443215923)
- **arms lore swing speed bonus**: Arms Lore grants a Swing Speed bonus against creatures of 5% * (Effective Arms Lore / 100), so 100 Arms Lore gives only a 5% swing speed increase. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554621195809325137)
- **artisan xp sources**: Artisan XP is gained from society quests and from every craft performed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547993692303007985)
- **aspect leveling**: Experience is shared between the armor aspect and the weapon/book aspect, so using a single aspect on both levels it about twice as fast, while two different aspects can be leveled at once at a shared, slower rate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554563325155606591)
- **aspect on pickaxe and harvest xp**: A pickaxe with no aspect or a Harvest aspect gives full harvest XP, while a different non-harvest aspect splits XP to 50% harvest while gathering and 50% weapon XP from killing mobs, so any non-harvest activity needs the weapon aspected too or XP is only 50%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529972265557557248)
- **aspect skill bonuses display**: Aspect skill bonuses are not shown on the Skills gump or skill scroll. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523014670649397423)
- **backstab learning curve**: Backstab takes a while to train before it becomes fast and fun to use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531623663374438592)
- **backstabber build template**: Most backstabbers run a shared template with variants, such as Item Identification in place of Tracking or Forensic Evaluation, or added Healing and Anatomy, and use shadow aspect armor and shadow weapon aspect until they progress further; thieves codex points change the template. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530428045322879087)
- **backstabber hiding methods**: A backstabber can hide using the Hiding skill, which must be trained like any other skill, or with smoke bombs when they are not on cooldown. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554874773597851800)
- **backstabber macing skill requirement**: 80 Macing is generally enough for a backstabber build from the start because of the accuracy bonuses available. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526975140313829376)
- **backstabber spare skill points**: Once a backstabber's core skills are set, spare skill points commonly go to Tracking for safety, Healing and Anatomy, Forensic Evaluation for harvesting leather, Camping for extra carry weight, or Alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541900101742755852)
- **backstabber tactics and stealing requirements**: A backstabber without Stealing and the Thieves Codex needs Tactics at 100, and dropping Stealing from 100 to 80 lowers mugging success chance by about 20%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554898648440111246)
- **backstabber template skill choices**: Backstabber templates can include Healing and Anatomy, typically at 80/80, by dropping skills such as Tracking or Camping or by using the FE option, and Snooping and Tactics can be dropped later because backstabbers rarely get hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539825912160198727)
- **backstabber training difficulty**: Backstabbers are among the most annoying templates to train: scripts must be used in awkward spots compared to other templates, and initial progression goes through the thieves codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521642518981247097)
- **bandage resurrection and healing skill**: Bandages can resurrect players when using a healing build, and bandage healing depends on the Healing skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539823840731865192)
- **bard buff strength**: At around 90 Barding skill, bard buffs give roughly 17-18% more damage, healing and damage resistance at best, though typical buffs handed out are around 12%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542264700773994496)
- **bard build skill reductions with codex**: With the Bard codex, a bard can run about 80 in Discordance, Peacemaking and Provocation and drop Musicianship, spending freed points elsewhere in the codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551928919207313539)
- **bard codex pitch perfect**: The Pitch Perfect bard codex point increases barding success chance, which makes Discord attempts succeed more often and so indirectly helps a bard tamer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541960811990224897)
- **bard codex point cap**: The bard codex has a cap of 20 total points, with a maximum of 5 points per perk, so you can max four perks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610404484685914)
- **bard codex sing your own praises**: The bard codex offers 'Sing Your Own Praises', which removes the ability to buff others and makes songs stronger by buffing only yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541759988119109673)
- **bard dexxer weapon skills**: Swords and Wrestling are good melee skills to pair with Bard for a bard dexxer, while Archery or Throwing is recommended for group play. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550845773623595072)
- **bard healing via alchemy and chivalry**: Alchemy is sufficient healing for a bard build using break links, and combined with Chivalry it covers all the healing a potion-reliant bard needs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535160296811790377)
- **bard melee weapon skill choice**: Wrestling is the baseline melee skill for a bard in the current meta, though swords can be used on a non-Lyric bard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542553796310474782)
- **bard peacemaking skill**: A Bard's Peacemaking skill lets a player keep singing so that mobs do not attack them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529077821690089583)
- **bard song requirements without musicianship**: Without bard codex points you need Musicianship skill to use bard songs, but codex points can be gained easily by using the bard skills, so leveling Music is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542480550512824351)
- **bard starting skill setup**: Start with 80 musicianship, 80 peacemaking and 80 discordance until you have points in Self Taught, then drop musicianship and replace it with provocation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551189403081248809)
- **bard tamer discordance setup**: A bard tamer who only wants Discordance does not need full tribard; 120 Discordance and 120 Musicianship gives a 25% discord debuff on the target and a better chance of success. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544682297196937247)
- **bard tamer skill levels**: Bard tamers commonly run 80 Peacemaking, 80 Provocation and 80 Discordance rather than 120, which gives the highest damage but requires points in the bard codex to function. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541914011249942580)
- **bard tamer stat allocation**: A bard tamer can put full points into intelligence instead of dexterity because dexterity has no effect on barding, which allows recall travel and better mana regeneration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524175240417247353)
- **bard weapon choice**: Bards take very little damage from peacemaking and provocation, so the main challenge is dealing damage; wrestling, swords, or dual wielding are currently the best weapon choices, with wrestling now preferred over swords. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542552729744838816)
- **barding codex**: A Barding Codex helps against creature resistance to Barding and is considered necessary to be an effective bard; bard skill can be raised to 120 with a scroll. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555523494064689153)
- **battle skill training sources**: Battletrainer NPCs can raise battle skills, but a literal inanimate training dummy placed in a home cannot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547780818519334996)
- **battle trainer skill and stat gains**: Hitting a Battle Trainer trains skills only up to 100, but it can still be used after skills are capped to raise stats. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551101082346983535)
- **best early skill investment**: Alchemy is widely considered the best use of the first 80 skill points in Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526351846657097748)
- **best tamer template**: Bard tamer is currently considered the best tamer template, since it can be started early and use a cheap kit, with dex tamer as the other main option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529288776676016229)
- **blacksmithing training speed**: Blacksmithing levels very slowly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538871509358088253)
- **blacksmithy training wiki section**: The Outlands wiki has a Blacksmithy training section at wiki.uooutlands.com/Blacksmithy_#Training, which the !train Blacksmithy Discord command links to. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538716413756178482)
- **butler skill benefits**: Butler provides extra carry weight and better colored leather skinning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541914827163705394)
- **buying skills at shelter**: Non-Young players can still buy skills at the Shelter, located under the inn. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541456016703750265)
- **campfire duration**: A campfire lasts about 10 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525598477252559040)
- **campfire lighting and duration**: Lighting a campfire needs only kindling; a successful ignite consumes one kindling, a failed attempt consumes none, and a lit campfire lasts 10 minutes so it does not need constant relighting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548224617485967462)
- **camping and sticky hands overweight**: Camping helps with becoming overweight when grabbing loot (sticky hands situations). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543141453977624606)
- **camping damage bonus**: The damage bonus from 100 Camping is passive and always active, requiring no campfire to be set or burning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536174656417959978)
- **camping on two characters**: You cannot raise camping on two characters by grouping them and having only one light a campfire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521995971033169950)
- **camping skill and campfire lighting**: Camping skill directly determines the chance to light a campfire, and a campfire can be lit with as little as 7.5 camping, though low skill requires many attempts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528069123534225479)
- **camping skill for lumberjacks**: Camping is mostly useless for a lumberjack, including a lumberjack summoner, because boards weigh nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530273007195656425)
- **camping skill purpose**: Camping is taken for increased carry capacity, which lets a character bring home more skins, rather than for a damage bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554971006328905890)
- **camping skill training**: Camping can be trained AFK by lighting a campfire in the newbie dungeon and waiting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521931589695701233)
- **cartography and treasure maps**: Cartography is a popular skill, and treasure maps are among the best sources of loot and gold, making it currently meta for most ocean content. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541528451742179473)
- **cartography for spyglass in boating**: Cartography is now used instead of Tracking to get more spyglasses in boating; Cartography gives a spyglass and damage on a fisherman, while Tracking is better for focusing on fishing spots with castaways. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549750417397780521)
- **cartography map disposal**: When training cartography, target a trash can as the destination for crafted maps so they are disposed of instead of filling your backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540782132826143)
- **cartography training difficulty**: Cartography is cheap and easy to raise, whereas the Echo skill is harder to raise. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531096547419492363)
- **challenger ossuary 4 xp**: One-hour Challenger Ossuary 4 runs give a large amount of XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531391946218799137)
- **checking barding success chance**: To see your chance of successfully barding monsters, open Help, then player stats, then barding; the chances are based on monster difficulty and you can set the bard difficulty (around 500) to see the minimum chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554927558091472928)
- **checking follower stats with animal lore**: Using Animal Lore on a follower shows its stats, including attack speed and damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526885548994596895)
- **chivalry allocation in templates**: A template should either fully commit to Chivalry at 120 or skip it, since an 80 Chivalry split is considered a poor skill allocation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524946178196766791)
- **chivalry and wrestling synergy**: Chivalry works together with Wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555150858482614343)
- **chivalry emergency heal**: Chivalry provides an emergency heal, but healing is only a bonus and not the main reason to take the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526148163356856422)
- **chivalry on outlands**: Chivalry exists on the Outlands server. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555285145035219019)
- **chivalry requirement for wrestling and dual wield builds**: Wrestling and dual-wield builds may get by with less than 120 Chivalry, but if a wrestler can only pick one of 120 Chivalry or 120 Arms Lore, 120 Chivalry is preferred, though many builds use both. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524459614450745542)
- **chivalry spell requirements**: Chivalry spells have a minimum Chivalry skill requirement (95 for the spell discussed), and Tactics should be raised to match Chivalry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524983603552063660)
- **codex per leveled skill**: You should carry a codex for each skill your template can level; a mage tamer carries the Healers codex, the taming codex, and the wizard book. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522726728810631270)
- **codex points tactics requirement**: Earning Weapon and Parry Codex points requires Tactics skill, unless backstabbing and the thief codex are supplying the Tactics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523779902535499806)
- **codex unlock skill requirement**: A codex (including the parry codex) requires only 80 skill in the relevant skill to unlock before xp can be gained in it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553148630305865881)
- **combined miner lumberjack skill build**: A single character has enough skill points to be both a miner and a lumberjack, with Magery, Spirit Speak, Tracking, Lumberjacking, Mining and Camping fitting roughly, though fewer combat skills fit for self-defense. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521704094505369632)
- **cooking and meditation for leather build**: On the leather non-proc mage build, raising temporal and water aspects from tier 0 to 10 did not work without both cooking and meditation, so both are preferred. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525691206284087417)
- **cooking for arcane mage mana**: Cooking is a good substitute for Alchemy on a blood arcane mage still struggling with mana, giving another mushroom plus swing speed and regeneration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526342750549573772)
- **cooking skill benefits**: The Cooking skill allows a player to 'snack' and increases the buffs gained from consuming good food. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538614434535186663)
- **cooking skill build placement**: Cooking is typically placed on an alternate character on a 2nd or 3rd account alongside other crafting skills; skinner, cook and leatherworker is a complementary combination. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538614228389339291)
- **core tamer skills**: The core tamer skills are Taming, Lore and Veterinary, with Herding also useful, and Taming and Lore need to be kept matched. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525545622852341810)
- **corrupted scribe link value**: A corrupted scribe link provides 4.06, which is not enough on its own to reach the circle 7-8 free-scroll threshold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524563304809365616)
- **crafting skill training costs**: Crafting skills such as Alchemy gain slowly and consume many reagents, and they do not receive the newbie dungeon bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522998443524751531)
- **crook storage while active**: An activated shepherd's crook need not be held; it can stay in your pack or a trapped pouch (to avoid thieves) and still gives its bonus if it was activated before storing, with no need to cast herding. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530036923513700382)
- **dexxer healing skill level**: A dexxer should have at least 80 Healing, since 80 is workable, while 100 Healing is also viable because it gives bigger heals. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **dexxer miner build**: A dexxer mining build runs 120 mining (optionally 120 lumberjacking too), 100 tracking, 100 weapon skill and tactics, and 80 anatomy and healing; one variant adds chivalry and 60 camping, the other has no camping or magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553334609637277838)
- **dexxer skill retraining**: Dexxer skills are neither hard nor expensive to train, so changing a character's skills is a viable alternative to making a new character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553813703835516950)
- **discipline aspect accuracy**: The Discipline aspect provides a large amount of accuracy, so weapon quality matters little and Arms Lore points can be reduced. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545607638480461954)
