- **dull copper skill gain cap**: Ordinary mining stops giving skill gain on dull copper at a certain skill level, as the Outlands wiki states, while resource maps are an exception. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554851069245394995)
- **dullhide maps for leveling**: Dullhide maps can be used to level a harvester to 120 FE quickly, making low-tier maps useful for new players to train skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534387937113018570)
- **dungeon picker builds**: Picker builds travel through dungeons from chest to chest to lockpick, untrap and loot them, and some also steal from mobs along the way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554836556001575044)
- **dungeon scavenger build**: A scavenger build commonly uses 120 Camping and 120 Forensic Evaluation, either as a 4x tamer or with a supporting set like 100 Magery, Wrestling, Resisting Spells, and 80 Parrying and Alchemy for skinning weight and tankiness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849083381063760)
- **echo character skills**: After buying an Echo to play a different character, the new character's skills must be raised again from scratch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533420917026328657)
- **echo for arcane mage build**: Players are advised to use an unlocked echo (character rebuild) for an arcane mage rather than dropping their current build, since Inscription and Necromancy hurt the build, though Inscription is nearly free to retrain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553426640531497001)
- **echo template storage**: Echoes store a player's whole template, and there is no way to store individual skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524224560017444964)
- **eldritch aspect spirit speak bonus**: Eldritch aspect armor grants bonus effective Spirit Speak and Inscription skill (one player reports about +27). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545899938452344842)
- **eldritch mage summoner build**: A common Eldritch aspect mage summoner build runs about 120 Necromancy, 120 Inscription, 100 Magery, 100 Evaluating Intelligence, and 100 Spirit Speaking and Meditation, with 80 Focus. Variants include 120 Spirit Speaking with 60 Focus, or one with 80 Meditation and Alchemy using Avar satchels and scrolls to cast with almost no scrolls or reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552902248546304081)
- **ensemble effect on pet damage**: The Ensemble bard perk does not increase pet damage; a bard tamer's damage boosts for pets come only from the Discordance debuff, the Discordance buff and the Provocation buff, so Refrain is a better use of those points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552103986138718301)
- **evaluating intelligence effect on spells**: Evaluating Intelligence affects spell damage only, with a -25% penalty at no skill and +5% at 40 skill, and it does not change the effectiveness of Greater Heal or other non-damage spells. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543246678314713248)
- **evaluating intelligence for necromancer summoner**: A necromancer summoner build takes Evaluating Intelligence because it increases spell damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527130784325046394)
- **evaluating intelligence need**: Evaluating Intelligence is needed only to do decent damage with your own spells; it is not needed for fishing with a harpoon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543605640277135430)
- **evaluating intelligence on mage tamer**: Evaluating Intelligence on a mage tamer is mainly useful as an anti-PK tool, letting you sic pets on a PK while blasting with eval-supported spells; otherwise those points can go to Herding, Veterinary, Alchemy, Scribe, Tracking, Camping or Forensic Evaluation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552227228371394583)
- **evaluating intelligence value**: Evaluating Intelligence matters if you do significant offensive spell damage; pet-damage builds are better served by other skills that boost pet damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554504398691106838)
- **evaluating tameable pets**: To evaluate a tameable, use Animal Lore on it and read the green and red percentage bonuses shown on the right; the base value is the same for all pets of that type, so only the percentages differ. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555662558092853340)
- **explorer pack crafting and hiking at inn campfire**: A player with the required skill can craft an explorer pack for another player, and hiking can be used at a campfire in an inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531098391868608662)
- **fast fishing training**: Throwing nets at fishing spots at sea, and possibly doing fishing maps, trains Fishing skill far faster than fishing with a regular fishing pole. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548464821437988965)
- **fe abbreviation in fishing build**: In the fishing build, FE stands for forensic evaluation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539460981577490553)
- **filling skill cap with camping and forensic evaluation**: To fill the skill cap efficiently, train Camping to 20 on an NPC, then set Forensic Evaluation to up and Camping to down, and play normally so Forensic Evaluation rises. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532461384879706132)
- **finding blue players with tracking**: To find blue players with Tracking, track manually and choose to show all players, since that option does not filter by notoriety. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535330634271035442)
- **finding creature stats**: Open the wiki Creatures List sorted by HP to find suitable targets, and use Animal Lore on a creature in game to see its stats. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531757334622113973)
- **fishing as harpoon weapon skill**: Fishing is the weapon skill for harpoons, so higher Fishing skill gives more accuracy with them, and it has its own codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542224113311944714)
- **fishing codex**: Fishing has its own Codex, and fishing also works as a combat skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529654863431209120)
- **fishing skill training**: To train Fishing, sail a small or medium boat around and throw nets at fishing spots; this reportedly reaches 80 in an hour or two and 120 in about a day, and yields special nets as profit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536159275599274086)
- **fishing skill training**: Train Fishing to 120 using fishing maps (quickest), hitting a battle trainer with a fishing weapon (free but slow, e.g. at the Prevalia moongate dummy, usable from 50 to 100 and can be left running), or fishing frenzy spots (effectively a free fishing map). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540207814008508489)
- **fishing training weapon**: There is no dedicated training weapon for Fishing; a standard harpoon or trident must be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538734478606999654)
- **fishing without a boat**: A boat is not needed to fish, including training Fishing to 100. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554358723105787916)
- **focus and arms lore for dexers**: For a dexer, Focus (more special attack procs, higher accuracy early on) and Arms Lore (attack speed, accuracy and damage) are more useful than Camping. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549313937755869215)
- **focus effects on speed and accuracy**: Focus increases both swing speed and accuracy, so adding it can help fill an accuracy gap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543653951122182204)
- **focus versus tracking for mage/tamer**: For a mage/tamer, Focus is the better choice for mana regeneration, refund and damage output, while Tracking provides PK detection and helps find creatures; the choice is flexible. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526556195039744021)
- **follower skill gain**: Followers (pets) raise their skills by gaining levels from killing mobs, not from combat alone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541893986124431380)
- **forensic evaluation barding bonus**: Forensic Evaluation gives an effective Barding skill bonus, with a maximum of about 12 per the formula 10 * (skill / 100); Tracking also gives a Barding bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554927763020976229)
- **forensic evaluation leather bonus**: Forensic Evaluation increases the amount of leather and the chance of better leather when skinning corpses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542363865218682940)
- **forensic evaluation requirement for avarhide**: Forensic Evaluation needs 110 skill, not 110.1, to meet the Avarhide requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549796798032257157)
- **forensic evaluation skill gain chance**: Forensic Evaluation skill gain chance is the same in Sanctuary Dungeons as elsewhere, and is likely the same across all mobs, so a mongbat gives the same chance as a dragon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535445076455596063)
- **forensic evaluation training**: Some players recommend Forensic Evaluation at 110 rather than 120 for a dungeon picker, and the New Player Dungeon is a good place to train it to 80 even without a bonus because mobs respawn quickly and are easy to kill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545085772699406476)
- **forensic evaluation training with skinning maps**: Forensic Evaluation trains much faster when using cheap skinning maps, and blue corpses can be skinned for this purpose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524790734010581043)
- **forensic evaluation uses**: Forensic Evaluation is commonly included in many builds, such as Backstabber, tamer and necromancer summoner builds, and its main benefit is allowing creatures to be skinned; it may also increase spell damage, which is unconfirmed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554970757698691174)
- **forensics in arcane mage template**: Forensic Evaluation and Tracking do not fit well in an arcane mage template; managing forensics requires a high Arcane aspect and about 20 links to avoid it feeling bad. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539377361496051712)
- **forensics training**: To train Forensics, carry a knife and run around the +spawn or +xp dungeons (sneaking if needed), skinning every corpse including other players' dead mobs, in addition to skinning monsters you kill yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552790217432367268)
- **frenzied ostard for taming training**: At around 100 Animal Taming, a frenzied ostard is a recommended tame for training toward 120, and the climb from about 102 should take a good few hours. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534000485651058748)
- **funding alchemy on a dexxer build**: A dexxer without alchemy can fund about 40 Alchemy for long-lasting potions by dropping Magery or by taking points from Magic Resist, Focus, Arms Lore or Chivalry, and swing speed impact can be tested on the Outlands butler. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554453479311802390)
- **gold for npc skill training**: Training skills from an NPC requires the gold to be in your backpack, while other purchases pull gold from your bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019236609630280)
- **greater heal and paralyze magery requirements**: Greater Heal reaches 100% cast success at 60 Magery and needs about 11 mana, while Paralyze needs 70 Magery for 100% success; casting from a scroll may work at around 40 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551146383011086417)
- **green skill orbs**: Using 20 green skill orbs raises a character's total skill points up to 720; they reportedly cost around 8k each. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553728428044320810)
- **harvest aspect experience from maps versus normal harvesting**: Normal harvesting gives harvest aspect experience based on how many resources are extracted, whereas resource maps give a fixed value of about 1 experience per swing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522342627276620047)
- **harvest aspect experience rates by resource**: Unaspected ore gives 0.2 harvest aspect experience per hit; resource maps give more per hit than ore and less than lumberjacking, at roughly 0.5 per second for maps, 0.2 for ore and 0.4 for lumber (approximate). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522354275844489246)
- **harvest aspect for fishing**: Harvest aspect is the best aspect for fishing because it grants effective fishing skill, reducing failures and yielding more sea serpents, and without it reaching the 205 effective fishing soft-cap and maximizing profit and message-in-a-bottle chances is very hard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536025672890318908)
- **harvest aspect uses**: Harvest aspect is a good choice for lockpicking and treasure maps, and a harvest aspect character can be echoed to a dungeon picker (using links for chests) or a treasure map build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553337447947968545)
- **harvest success chance formula**: Harvest success chance is calculated as ((effective harvest skill - resource skill requirement) / 0.8) x (1 + total tool bonus), as used by the Outlands harvesting calculator and wiki chart; the wiki lists 65 as the requirement for Avarite. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538654640718090302)
- **harvest xp from killing mobs**: Killing mobs does not give harvest XP, and a Harvest aspect on a weapon gives no extra XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543544685845545032)
- **harvesting experience gains**: Harvesting grants only Harvest aspect XP and no mastery chain, Codex, or Redline progress, so harvesters cannot advance those through harvesting alone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553430663678664705)
- **harvesting skill gain and harvest aspect**: Harvesting skill gain slows dramatically after 100, though Harvest aspect experience and yield rise by then, and the Harvest aspect's effective skill bonus only applies after 60 seconds of activation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551100641168850946)
- **healer's codex node priorities**: Pressure Points and Self Treatment are the most important Healer's Codex nodes to max, while Specialist, Triage, Combat Medic, Overheal and Immunize are largely personal preference. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535635631626264626)
- **healing skill training**: Healing skill can be trained by healing a battle trainer, the same trainers used for combat skills, provided the trainer is not at max HP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535719571405803540)
- **herding crook in pouch**: A herding crook still works while stored in a pouch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541323429473423453)
- **herding crook sources**: Herding crooks are sold by the tinkerer and/or provisioner NPCs, the stable NPC also sells a crook but it is not good, and crooks can also be bought from player vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553406435289989313)
- **hiding and stealth skill cooldown**: After using Hiding or Stealth, a roughly 10 second global skill cooldown must pass before the next skill, such as Stealth after Hiding, can be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526655770278498517)
- **hiding requirement for stealth**: Stealth cannot be used until the Hiding skill reaches 80. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525622695708856452)
- **hiding versus invisibility spell**: Hiding and the Invisibility spell both make you invisible in place; the difference is whether you can stealth afterwards, and Invisibility has a timer and wears off on its own. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528406314798288926)
- **high barding skill levels**: A bard can run 120 Musicianship plus 120 in one barding skill such as Provocation or Discordance, while 120 in all three barding skills is usually seen only in group-play support builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544893079205707837)
- **horse taming skill requirement**: Taming a horse requires Animal Taming skill, and a horse needs only 50 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552108164122677339)
- **i am planted message**: The 'I am planted' message is related to the throwing skill line. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525095022335361166)
- **inscription and eldritch for evaluating intelligence training**: Inscription and Eldritch also help train Evaluating Intelligence when casting from scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546685994147905576)
- **inscription for full summoner**: Inscription is not worth 120 skill points on a full summoner, since a summoner relies on pets for damage and only gains longer bless/protect buff durations for pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547634242417336341)
- **inscription for scroll consumption**: With 125 effective Inscription skill, casting Flame Strike from a scroll never consumes the scroll, and mages using Inscription commonly aim for 125 effective for this reason. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554515694324944997)
- **inscription free scroll thresholds**: Around 120 Inscription plus about 5 from links gives 100% free scrolls for circle 7 and 8 spells, and 125 Inscription reaches 100% for circles 7-8 and 50% for lower circles; casting 7th and 8th circle from scrolls without Inscription gets expensive quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526915886315737098)
- **inscription link slots**: Inscription requires 2 inscription link slots to be useful, unlike other skills that do not need link slots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530563878042206228)
- **inscription spell interruption protection**: Inscription gives players an (Effective Inscription Skill / 100%) chance to avoid spell interruption from creature or environment damage, in addition to a damage boost and longer buffs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554945852319993897)
- **inscription training 100 to 120**: Training Inscription from 100 to 120 uses magic wizard's hats, which require cloth, and the crafting tool does not recycle the hats, so they must be cut up with scissors, typically via a script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552974392282316883)
- **instrument modifiers and bard skills**: Effective barding and modifiers on instruments improve the chance to succeed with bard skills and make song buffs better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531746128016703549)
- **item id effect on bard**: Item ID multiplies an instrument's effective barding (EFB) without the cap that applies to EFB links, so 120 Item ID acts like roughly an extra 30 to each bard skill with a Supremely Melodious instrument, and it also boosts magic weapons and armor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542554878629515275)
- **item id versus weapon skill accuracy**: Having 40 real weapon skill is always better for accuracy than a mix of weapon skill plus Item ID totaling 40, and Item ID gives no accuracy if base weapon skill is 0. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523677002748530878)
- **item identification afk training**: Train Item Identification AFK with a Razor script that loops: find an item such as a dagger in the backpack, use the Item Identification skill, target the item, and wait about 2000 ms between uses; a container ID wand and a mass-ID script can also work on a new character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538097987346235452)
- **item identification methods**: There is no spell to identify magic items; they must be identified with the Item ID skill or an Item ID wand, and Item ID bonuses apply only to magical items, not crafted exceptional items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555330277570650213)
- **item identification skill**: Item Identification identifies individual items with your current skill as the success chance, and at 120 skill it identifies an entire container at once at no cost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542216511450648627)
- **item identification skill thresholds**: At 100 Item Identification skill, items must be identified one at a time, which can be trained AFK with a script; at 120 skill, a character can identify all items in a container at once, though reaching 120 is costly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543223962836672553)
- **item identification versus arms lore**: If you use Item Identification instead of Arms Lore, you must use magic weapons and armor, though even cheap magic sets can give very high armor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536892446812807259)
- **item identification wands vs skill**: Identifying an item with an ID wand or with the Item Identification skill gives the same information, though wands are more convenient to use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532961758136766556)
- **joke melee summoner build stats**: A joke melee summoner build in leather using Magery only for summoning can run 100 STR, 75 DEX and 50 INT; lowering INT to 41 and casting Bless reaches 50 INT, and a dex potion raises DEX to 104. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529512360212168926)
- **journeyman naturalist title**: The Journeyman Naturalist title corresponds to the Animal Lore skill, which is associated with tamers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526576799855673374)
- **kindling needed for camping training**: Only a small amount of kindling is needed to train camping; the leveling script uses about 6 kindling per hour. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537765397498036245)
- **land fishing skill gain**: Land fishing can reach GM fishing but is slow; attacking a battle trainer with a fishing weapon is faster, though still slow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524183062013935626)
- **lesser poison and poisoning training**: Lesser poison does not train Poisoning skill at 50. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549871980881121422)
- **leveling and riding horses**: Leveling a horse requires being able to issue it the attack command, which needs minimum taming/lore skill (50 for a horse), whereas riding a horse does not require those skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532372066387366073)
- **locked chest opening**: Opening a locked chest requires a character with lockpicking, and a lockpicking character is easy to make. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541871998303604946)
- **lockpick training box**: A lockpick practice box can be bought and used to train Lockpicking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550331442599301205)
- **lockpicking and detect hidden training boxes**: Training boxes train Lockpicking by picking the lock (removing the trap does not raise it, and only one can be worked at a time), and Detect Hidden can be trained by keeping a stock of NPC remove trap tools and ticking the box to continue working the trap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554861638941671488)
- **lockpicking character pairing**: Detect Hidden and Lockpicking should be on the same character so you need not wait to unlock a chest after disarming it, and Lockpicking is commonly paired with hiding, stealth, snooping and stealing, so it should only go on characters meant for lockpicking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690693002166275)
- **lockpicking damage bonus**: Lockpicking no longer provides any added damage and is considered a useless skill, whereas Cartography gives added damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537481187772338176)
- **lockpicking skill uses**: Characters with the Lockpicking skill can unlock locked chests and boxes and craft lockboxes, so a thief with Lockpicking can also pick open a locked box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544043417791762483)
- **lockpicking tool requirement for chests**: Chest success or progress links are not needed for lockpicking; a Gold Lockpick/Tool is sufficient for most chests, including all up to level 6. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316410117300245)
- **lockpicking training**: To train lockpicking from 0, buy 50 skill from a trainer, buy about 100 lockpicks from a tinker and a training box from the NPC, then click the chest and use the auto open option; once at 80 skill, training must be done off the starting island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538881122266521621)
- **lockpicking training box**: A lockpicking training box at the provisioner can train Lockpicking up to 120, but the skill may first need to be raised manually to roughly 40-50 before the box gives gains. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525228448346538086)
- **low resisting spells investment**: Investing only 20-40 points in Resisting Spells does very little. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524952505698750634)
- **low-skill weapon for aspect procs on tamers**: Some tamers keep a low-skill weapon equipped to fish for rare Aspect procs; around 40 Throwing skill procs often enough, and Throwing uses no ammo and works at range. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542160309832122378)
- **lowering skills at skill cap**: When at the total skill cap, lower skills your build does not need so that the skills it does need can increase. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528024252014526584)
- **lowering skills on an echo**: To lower skills on an echo, buy a throwaway skill (e.g., Begging) for the amount you want to subtract, lock the skill you want to lower, and point the throwaway skill down. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520533498035703929)
- **lumberjacker templates**: Recommended lumberjacker templates are about 110-120 Lumberjacking with 100 Magery, Wrestling, Tracking and Resist Spells, plus Spirit Speak and Alchemy or Meditation depending on the goal; pure PvP versions need no Camping. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545149946422894642)
- **mace fighting training on battle trainer**: Training mace fighting on the battle trainer NPC with a training mace raises the skill quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529277793223835740)
- **macing training**: Mace Fighting can be trained AFK on a battle trainer NPC with a regular training weapon, while active players should use the best weapon available while killing monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666762885308477)
- **mage tamer veterinary tradeoff**: A tamer or bard with a mage skill can drop Veterinary (at the cost of some pet damage) and relies on blessing pets and greater heal procs, while a build without mage skill needs Veterinary to heal pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549921193128230985)
- **magery leveling difficulty**: Leveling Magery is considerably harder than leveling melee skills, though not literally 20 times harder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260698433192056)
- **magery skill gain rate**: Magery training at around a 14-17% gain chance yields roughly 0.1 skill every 7-9 attempts on average, though in practice it can be slower. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260337869987921)
- **magery skill required for spell success**: The minimum Magery to attempt a spell is its circle times 10, and adding 20 gives the skill for 100% cast success, so Recall (4th circle) needs 60 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552425507465855107)
- **magery training casts**: New players reportedly get a free allotment of roughly 500-1000 spell casts to train magery to 80, while training from 80 to 100 reportedly takes around 1.5-2k casts per attempt (about 20k gold) without an Avarhide satchel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544133859208069121)
- **magery training in shelter**: Train Magery in the Shelter new player dungeon, which gives boosted gains up to 80 skill; a Razor script for this is listed on uorazorscripts and the Outlands wiki Magery page. After 80, train with a higher circle spell such as Flamestrike in the zoo. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529378420339900466)
- **magery training spell circle**: Raising Magery requires casting spells of a spell circle appropriate to your current skill, so you must move up to higher circles periodically as the skill increases; the circle matters, not which specific spell is cast. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522074993117364296)
- **magery training spells**: Magery training needs higher-tier spells as skill rises: at 60-80 cast spells like Invisibility, Explosion and Energy Bolt, and above 80 cast higher-tier spells such as Flame Strike, so the spellbook must contain them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546582908679102556)
- **magic item identification**: Magic items are identified with the Item Identification skill, where success chance equals your skill and at 120 skill a whole container can be identified at once; it is free to use but takes skill points on a PvM main, so training it on an alt is recommended, and tinker-crafted Item Identification or Container Identification Wands are an alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539710966625734817)
- **magic resist benefits**: Magic Resist contributes to swing speed (and thus damage output) and also provides global mitigation and PvP readiness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525720206343802992)
- **magic resist training at telescope island**: To train Magic Resist (Resisting Spells) from about 80 to 100, go to Telescope Island (witcher number 4), let the roughly 9 low-tier caster mobs cast on you, and keep yourself healed, for example with a healing script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554479807499341869)
- **mana use when casting from scrolls**: Casting a spell uses mana whether you cast from scrolls or from reagents; a scroll is consumed in place of reagents, and spellstone is an option only for a brand new character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531749097470427266)
- **mass item identification**: Magic items in a container can be identified all at once by using a Container Item Identification Wand or by having 120 Item Identification skill, which allows identifying entire containers; below 120, your skill value is the success chance for identifying individual items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543784275353018410)
- **meditation book mana bonus**: The meditation book gives a 30% mana bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548961826707087384)
- **meditation for mage pvm**: A mage PvM character needs Meditation; without it the mage must wait for mana to regenerate and for the mushroom cooldown, and if other measures fail Meditation can be put back on the build until the character levels up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **meditation requirement for wizard's grimoire**: Keeping Meditation at 80 is needed to maintain the Wizard's Grimoire codex benefit, and it also frees up follower points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526509285100752926)
- **melee special links without arms lore**: Melee special chance and special damage links work on a wrestler even without Arms Lore. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524391209328709632)
- **mining and lumberjacking combat bonuses**: Mining skill adds damage with maces and Lumberjacking skill adds damage with axes, and both still give PvM bonuses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543394970789085294)
- **mining location and skill gain**: The location where you mine does not affect mining skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535764497321435310)
- **mining skill gain from ore**: As Mining skill rises, common ores such as iron stop giving skill gains, so higher-level miners must mine colored ore to keep gaining. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545656855164882985)
- **mount bonding and control skill**: Bonding and controlling a mount does not require Animal Taming skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257521035354203)
- **multi-skill link bonus**: A link listing two skills grants the full stated percentage to both skills, though the stated number is lower than that of a dedicated single-skill link. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551645677032046668)
- **multiple weapon skills on one character**: Training two different weapon skills (e.g. sword and archery) on one character is usually not viable for PvM in Outlands, though weapon-using mages are workable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529606744274112543)
- **mummy as necromancy earth elemental equivalent**: The Necromancy equivalent of the Earth Elemental summon is the Mummy, and Summoner's Tome upgrades for Earth Elemental also apply to the Mummy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527583942046384179)
- **necro mage summoner build**: A necro mage summoner raises Necromancy to 120 first and adds Inscription later; a spell damage necro summoner build uses 120 Necromancy, 120 Inscription, 100 Magery, 100 Meditation, 100 Evaluating Intelligence, 100 Spirit Speak and 80 Focus (preferred over Alchemy). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556066555786305557)
- **necromancer summoner link choices**: Link choice for a necromancer summoner depends on the build: a vet/herding build uses summoner links, while a spell-damage or turbo meditation build uses damage-to-diseased links (player damage) plus meditation links; necromancy skill links were good in the past. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545295134235824279)
- **necromancer template viability**: Necromancy exists in Outlands and a necromancer summoner template is viable, though tamer is considered stronger. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547976745574072422)
- **necromancy skill investment**: Necromancy is not worth 120 skill points if you only want it for the disease effect, but may be worth 120 for bossing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524832411488096397)
- **new player dungeon combat training**: Combat skills train faster in the new player dungeon, and raising tactics or arms lore to 80 there reportedly takes under 30 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541538226005737583)
- **non-lyric bard requirements**: A non-lyric bard needs about 120 skills plus roughly 10 gold EBS links to be reliable; with 80/80/80 skills and gold EBS links the chance to successfully use bard abilities is only about 64%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538688419591360654)
- **noxcro poisoning skill requirement**: After the patch, a Noxcro template needs 120 Poisoning skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544379065736372365)
- **npc mage spell scroll availability**: NPC mages sell spell scrolls for circles 1 to 6, so Invisibility, a 6th Circle spell, is purchasable from them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532444669810839603)
- **ocean fishing skill requirement**: 120 fishing skill is effectively required for ocean fishing; the best spots need 205 effective fishing skill, reached with 120 fishing plus bonuses such as harvest aspect, links, and ship upgrades. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553102046562099403)
- **overall skill cap**: The overall skill cap is 720 points, and raising individual skill caps does not increase it; once reached, skills stop gaining. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542183143547600938)
- **parry and alchemy on dexxer builds**: Parry and Alchemy are recommended on dexxer builds that do not use Item Identification, though an Archer does not really need Parry and may use Alchemy instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547637195190308995)
- **parry training at shelter island**: Parry can be trained at Shelter Island by fighting sheep, and skill gain is faster when more creatures are nearby. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537944473361973380)
- **parry with wrestling weapon**: A character using a wrestling weapon in Ultima Online: Outlands can use the Parry skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521617513488715909)
- **parrying for dungeon thieves**: Dungeon thieves do not need Parrying; few thief builds use it, though some take it for survivability. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526868750245298197)
- **parrying on archers**: Parrying is generally not recommended for archers, with a possible exception for Time Dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540222710632939550)
- **parrying training from battle trainers**: Parrying cannot be trained from battle trainers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529242078381477889)
- **parrying training on shelter island**: To train Parrying on Shelter Island, stand in the skeleton area and let 3-4 skeletons hit you while you heal yourself with bandages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535268877183885343)
- **passive taming points**: To earn passive taming points, farm with a pet within 10 points of your taming cap, switching to higher pets as needed, and spend a point by taking the pet to a dungeon (not Shelter) and having it tag a mob someone is killing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532256888761356320)
- **per-mob skill gain cap**: The cap on skill gains from each mob has been removed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550231771168112651)
- **pet control requirements**: Controlling a pet requires both Animal Taming and Animal Lore skill, with the amount needed depending on the specific pet. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257447798607925)
- **pilfering hidden bonus**: Pilfering while hidden grants about a 25% bonus chance to succeed, success also depends on mob difficulty, and failure causes no retaliation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546631449573195806)
- **pilfering requirements**: Pilfering from mobs requires 80 Stealing and 80 Snooping, and a Snooping skill check must succeed, but 5 points in the Thieves Codex Shadow Hands upgrade removes the Snooping requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546631385618456606)
- **poison dexxer weapon skill**: A poison dexxer uses the Fencing skill, because of the Assassinate finisher and the Bane ability, and pairs it with Poisoning and Alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225255196201002)
- **poison mage link priorities**: A poison (nox/necro) mage should prioritize poison damage links, then damage to poisoned links, then damage dealt by player links (used instead of damage to poisoned if enemies are not poisoned), plus damage to diseased if also diseasing enemies with necromancy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526940418153906388)
- **poison necro mage template**: A poison necro/mage build must choose between Evaluating Intelligence (for damage spells) and Alchemy (for the Poison sting mechanic with Poison spell casting); one suggested template is Alchemy 80, Magery 100, Meditation 80, Necromancy 100, Poisoning 120, Spirit Speak, Taste Identification. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548354613567168686)
- **poisoning and alchemy effects**: Higher poisoning skill increases the chance on hit to apply poison, while alchemy increases alchemy effectiveness, boosts poison damage and strengthens exp potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547072400179335218)
- **poisoning skill training cost**: Raising the poisoning skill and/or poison aspect is more expensive than other builds, largely due to the poison kegs required, so players need a way to finance it, especially on a first character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522075622195855361)
- **poisoning skill training poison type**: Applying greater or lesser poison to weapons does not train Poisoning; only the regular poison, named just 'Poison', which is a different poison, works. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535061264869367869)
- **poisoning training**: Poisoning is trained with potions in order: Regular poison at 50-60, Greater at 55-80, Deadly at 75-100, and Lethal at 95-120; past 100 skill, 20 poison skill scrolls are needed, which are double-clicked and targeted on yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549871677901373441)
- **potion codex point allocation**: On the potion codex, Bandolier is almost always taken with remaining points, Volatile is generally not worth it (though it raises explosion potion damage), and Freedom serves as the flex points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529002476907401327)
- **pressure points target scope**: The Pressure Points ability from the Healer's Codex likely applies only to the player's own character and not to pets or followers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538991725052436572)
- **prevalia pickpocket dip**: A pickpocket dip exists in Prevalia at the training house next to the moongate, but it is likely not possible to stand 2 tiles away from it, so it probably cannot train Hiding, Stealth, Snooping and Stealing together. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554490967158030387)
- **prevalia training dummy pk risk**: The training dummy near the Prevalia moongate is a common place for players to be killed, so most players avoid using it unless they have to. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529298633147682856)
- **pure gatherer harvest level cap**: A pure gatherer can only raise Harvest to level 15 by gathering, because level 16 and above requires redline points that gathering cannot provide. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530899546563940503)
- **raising intelligence while fighting a trainer**: Intelligence rises quickly by hitting a battle trainer as long as skills sharing int as a stat (such as anatomy or arms lore) are below 100; lighting a campfire and using Evaluating Intelligence while beating a dummy can help further. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532415786604302477)
- **raising melee weapon skill to 100 for pvm**: Raising weapon skill to 100 is worthwhile for PvM if you stand and trade blows with monsters, though as aspect leveling increases accuracy the full 100 may be needed less later. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542150712807391304)
- **rebuilding character skills**: To fix a character's skills, buy 50 skill from an NPC and train to 80 in the new player dungeon, which takes roughly an hour or two; harvesting skills above 100 and crafting skills are harder to rebuild. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525165991020068915)
- **recommended harvester skills**: Besides lumberjacking, mining and forensics, a harvester should also level Tracking and Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531172327461490688)
- **recommended stat distribution**: Spellcasters are advised to use 100 Strength, 100 Intelligence and 25 Dexterity, while non-casters are advised to use 100 Strength, 100 Dexterity and 25 Intelligence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554371518446960672)
- **reduced cartography treasure map levels**: A character with a reduced cartography setup can run level 1 to 4 treasure maps, and limiting to level 1-3 maps saves cartography skill points for other skills in a trapper build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538698106558873642)
- **remaining skill points in 120x4 melee build**: In a build with four skills at 120 and 80 in Fencing/Tactics, players commonly spend the remaining 80 skill points on Arms Lore or Alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528573055809359932)
- **remove trap merged into detect hidden**: The Remove Trap skill has been merged into Detect Hidden, so only Detect Hidden and Lockpicking are needed for chests, although remove trap tools are still used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554862337918238902)
- **removing traps on bomb boxes while snooping**: A thief snooping another player's bag can lockpick containers inside it but cannot use Remove Trap on a bomb box there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522370053738336366)
- **resisting spells on gathering characters**: A mining or resource-gathering character does not need Resisting Spells, Evaluating Intelligence or Meditation, since Magery and Spirit Speak summons can distract mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526815784695759009)
- **resisting spells training in shelter dungeon**: In the Shelter dungeon, the Familiar (which casts about four spells) and the room with two mages on level 2 raise Resisting Spells quickly, for example from 50 to 80 in a few minutes, but you need a way to heal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550231198578511944)
- **resource maps skill gain**: Resource maps give harvesting skill gains at all skill levels and can be used from around 50 skill; in one test of 587 maps, skills reached 63.1 Mining, 87.0 Lumberjacking, 81.0 Fishing and 97.4 Forensic Evaluation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529114803273809)
- **resurrection magery requirement**: The minimum Magery requirement for resurrection is 80, so a player at exactly 80 Magery fails every attempt and will still fail often just above 80. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541925909454389280)
- **retaming released tames in town**: To retame for skill gain in town, release the tame in a town where monsters will not aggro and the released tame is non-aggressive, then retame it inside an inn with the door shut or near the stables; your own inn room cannot be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526201833624830003)
- **risks of telescope island resist training**: Training Magic Resist at Telescope Island risks death from a banshee and occasional PKs, but it is considered one of the best spots for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667307830251591)
- **safe afk skill training**: When AFK training, use a vendor weapon, basic clothes (or nothing), and an empty backpack except for blessed items, because PKs and thieves can take your gear in public areas. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532853507726770186)
- **scavenger template requirements**: The only skill requirement for scavenging is Camping; 120 Camping plus offensive and defensive skills suffices, 120 Forensics is a bonus, and a scavenger should have 100 Strength with Dexterity and Intelligence depending on the rest of the template. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530561218501152889)
- **scribe casting with scrolls**: Scribes cast using scrolls instead of reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535406365437067465)
- **scroll non-consumption with satchel**: With two bronze Inscription links giving 125 effective Inscription, Circle 7 and 8 spell scrolls such as Flamestrike are never consumed when casting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554550259563233402)
- **scroll recall magery requirement**: Casting Recall from a scroll while using a runebook requires 0 magery, whereas casting Recall without a scroll requires 60 magery for 100% success. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529865833008988271)
- **self taught bard skill requirement**: Self Taught requires investing in all three bard skills, for example putting 3 levels in it when running 100/100/100. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186784551796768)
- **self taught barding talent**: Self Taught in the bard codex affects base barding skill and is required to use barding skills without a musical instrument; links and aspect bonuses apply on top of it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543380397889556561)
- **self taught perk for tribard**: Self Taught is not used by default unless you are playing a tribard, and it is required for a tribard build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541924140062216312)
- **self-cast telekinesis buff**: Self-cast Telekinesis does not apply a buff to the buff bar. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536898390376456283)
- **shadow aspect proc interrupting training**: When Shadow Aspect procs from a weapon, the character goes invisible and drops out of war mode, interrupting attacks such as during skill training. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533448523838656543)
- **shelter dungeon forensic evaluation gain**: The Shelter dungeon does not boost Forensic Evaluation gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532458726357860636)
- **shelter dungeon parry training**: Shelter dungeon is a quick place to train Parrying up to about 80 skill: taunt Cats and Dogs with an area-of-effect taunt near Terran and let them attack you while you hold a shield. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544321026358509648)
- **shelter dungeon resist training**: The Shelter dungeon trains Resisting Spells up to 80, and level 2 has a room with two mages that works in a few minutes if you can heal through it, but the dungeon admits only one character at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299911667154965)
- **shelter island skill training limit**: Skills can be trained only up to 80 on Shelter Island; training from 80 to 100 must be done elsewhere, and some locations are easier depending on the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533187772461093074)
- **showing skill gain**: Single click on your own character and select the Show Skill Gain option from the menu to display skill gain details. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541726936055812167)
- **sing your own praises skill requirement**: The Sing Your Own Praises ability requires all 3 bard skills; with only two you would need Musicianship. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546620763870597290)
- **skill cap increase for taming and lore**: Players can raise their skill cap for a gold cost, and skill scrolls are also required to bring Taming and Lore up to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528232826489667654)
- **skill cap total display**: The total skill cap value is shown at the bottom right of the Skills menu; if your skills sum to 700 you are at the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525881899363340540)
- **skill caps above 100**: Skills can be raised above 100 (many but not all can reach 120) only by unlocking the skill with a skill scroll; each scroll unlocks 1.0 more skill cap, which must then be trained. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536373414133104680)
- **skill changing and build flexibility**: Changing skills in Outlands is easy because progression is easy, and regular patches shift which skills are strong, so build mistakes are rarely costly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553439934923145439)
- **skill gain chance command**: Use the [ShowSkillGain command to display the percent chance to increase messages when using a skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553271246282690651)
- **skill gain mechanics**: Skill gain is chance based on the chance to succeed; there is no hidden threshold, stalls are bad RNG while gain chance messages appear, and at 100% success chance there are no gains. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489642299465782)
- **skill gain versus xp**: Skills do not earn XP or levels; they gain directly, and skill gain chance is a separate mechanic from XP gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413563221377055)
- **skill lowering to a set level**: Outlands has no built-in way to set a skill so that it only goes down to a chosen level. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525366326900686898)
- **skill mastery scrolls**: Skill mastery scrolls from the achievement points shop raise a skill's cap by 1 point each, up to 120; they do not grant skill points directly, which must still be earned. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528803981420396755)
- **skill orb cap and max skill points**: Up to 20 skill orbs can be used, reaching a maximum of 720 skill points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540570998049611907)
- **skill point reallocation for alchemy**: Anatomy, Healing, Fencing and Parry can be lowered to 80 each to free skill points for Alchemy, but Fencing should not be lowered until the aspect tier is higher. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523070914474938408)
- **skill rework and camping**: Most skills were reworked on Outlands, so skills that were useless in classic UO, such as camping, are now useful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534592478135451749)
- **skill scroll and orb drops**: Skill scrolls and skill orbs are random drops from monsters that drop gold, with tougher monsters having better loot pools; they cannot be target farmed but can be bought from players or their vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529429702270517390)
- **skill template flexibility**: Once a character reaches the maximum skill points, skills can be raised and others lowered at any time, so players are not locked into a fixed template. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529173703823200286)
- **skinning harvest aspect gain**: Skinning raises Harvest Aspect only by a negligible amount, so it is a very slow way to level it, including in dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521356898723696662)
- **skinning hotkey via macro**: Make a skinning hotkey by creating a macro that uses a skinning knife on yourself, or by dragging the skinning knife onto a counter and hotkeying it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530555986618748948)
- **skinning usefulness**: Skinning is useful early for society jobs, but leather is plentiful and cheap, so the skill can be dropped once a character is a few months old. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545188192934830191)
- **smelting skill gain**: Smelting ore does not give skill gains. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528414271363354665)
- **smoke bomb cooldown duration**: The Smoke Bomb cooldown duration varies based on thief codex upgrades. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544056157436645491)
- **snooping requirement for pilfering**: Pilfering requires the Snooping skill at first, until you level the Thieves Codex enough to unlock a perk that removes that requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549440052839448687)
- **spell cast times**: Spell cast times are listed in the grimoire description and on the Magery wiki page below each circle's table. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523064812010213386)
- **spellbook types for casters**: A basic spellbook containing your spells is always required to cast and gives no bonus; separate crafted material or magic spellbooks act as held weapons for casters, with material books increasing mana regeneration and magic books increasing spell damage or mana refund chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550029827808043081)
- **spirit speak 80 for summoner**: Running only 80 Spirit Speak for shield summons suits a mage-damage or trapper build, and extra points can be put into summons in the summoner tome. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536701853272899584)
- **spirit speak and summon duration**: Spirit Speak is needed for summons to last longer than 2 minutes, which helps keep you safe during long activities such as fishing maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536701577455476836)
- **spirit speak in trapper build**: A Trapper build uses Spirit Speak, which is needed for it to be good and is used for elementals. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538092986137575475)
- **spirit speak summon duration**: Casting Spirit Speak extends the duration of summons beyond the default 2 minutes, reportedly up to a maximum of 30 minutes, and also grants some buffs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551556400457580546)
- **spirit speak training method**: Spirit Speak can be trained by using the Spirit Speak skill itself; Magery is not needed to train it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531825604435902505)
- **stampede talent requirements**: The Stampede talent buffs the player when 4 or more summons are active, and using it with summoned creatures requires the Spirit Speak skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532556433248227428)
- **starting skill limits on newbie island**: On the starting island, skills can be bought from NPCs up to 50, while character creation allows starting skills up to 60 (this figure is uncertain). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529241188945760286)
- **stat arrow icons**: The arrow icons next to each stat work like skill locks, so a stat can be set to rise, fall, or be locked so it no longer changes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526230807776202964)
- **stat distribution**: A typical stat distribution is 100/100/25, with INT 100 for mages and DEX 100 for dexxers, while crafters need 100 STR plus 100 INT if they want Mana, otherwise STR and DEX, with 100 STR being the most important. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549635937326338129)
- **stat rebuilding speed**: Rebuilding stats takes hours, but getting a stat to cap is much faster than getting a skill to cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523053838574157864)
- **stationary penalty effect**: The stationary penalty reduces your damage to -1 but does not stop skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533448284515991623)
- **stealing difficulty and locations**: Stealing in dungeons is harder than in the overworld or towns, and player theft mostly happens in major towns, dungeons and player vendor hubs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525619048413401178)
- **stealing from creatures requirements**: Stealing from creatures requires the Snooping skill until a Thieves Guild codex perk allows you to drop that requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530450680467427409)
- **stealing skill requirement for grey hand thief**: A player needs 80 Stealing skill to become a grey hand thief and be allowed to steal, and switching from Red Hand to Grey Hand also requires 80 Stealing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536813557046575114)
- **stealing skill requirements**: Using the Stealing skill on monsters or players requires membership in the Red Hand Thieves, while Stealing is trained by clicking pickpocket dips. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525951512826740777)
- **stealing training from 80 to 100**: For Stealing from about 80 to 100, use a private house with dips north of Horseshoe Bay, outside city limits by the coast; you can stay outside the house and remain hidden, which also allows Hiding training. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521241491845021727)
- **stealing weight limit**: An item may fail to be stolen because it weighs over 10 stones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542471805145583656)
