- **stealth delay after hiding**: On Outlands you must wait about 10 seconds after hiding before you can stealth, though this is stated with some uncertainty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527298193279287357)
- **stealth dungeon lockpicking**: A stealthy lockpicker with hiding can pick much higher-level dungeon chests and loot what others leave behind, and scavenging and skinning on the side works well. It is best done on a main account character so an aspect such as harvest or shadow can be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551004324115644448)
- **stealth skill backstab damage**: Higher Stealth skill, up to 120, gives more stealth steps and an extra damage multiplier on backstabs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546983896124629002)
- **stealth while mounted**: A character mounted on a horse cannot use stealth or move while stealthed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527301716486393867)
- **summoner meditation level**: A summoner who does not use spell damage rarely has mana problems and can keep Meditation low (around 60-80), since Focus and a crafted book already provide enough regeneration, putting the saved points into 100 Veterinary. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547165337101934692)
- **summoner necro skill allocation**: Spirit Speak 120 with Evaluating Intelligence 100 splits a summoner build between summon-focused and spell-focused play and works poorly; a summoner necro can instead use 80 Wrestling and 20 more Spirit Speak, and for pet damage and survivability 120 Spirit Speak is likely more important than 120 Necromancy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532508901910647024)
- **summoning undead variants**: Activate the first ability in the Book of Necromancy, then cast a normal Magery summon spell, and the resulting creature is the undead version of the normal summon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526334142050996255)
- **summons and spirit speak**: Summoned creatures benefit from Spirit Speak (and Herding), which makes them noticeably stronger. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553465169189937245)
- **supremely instruments for bard skills**: Supremely instruments are the best choice for actively using bard skills, and with Item Identification they grant +30 effective bard skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553527133337551051)
- **swing speed and accuracy calculator**: Use the Outlands Butler tool to calculate swing speed and accuracy for skill combinations; it has a separate swing speed calculator page at outlandsbutler.com/swingspeed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553088649019785378)
- **swords codex requirements**: The Swords Codex requires 80 Swordsmanship and 80 Tactics, counted as printed skill without weapon bonuses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537244142848184392)
- **tactics requirement for chivalry**: Chivalry requires Tactics: Chivalry skill is capped by your Tactics, and Tactics is also needed for the codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552345357986439260)
- **tactics skill bonus**: The Tactics skill bonus in Outlands is not a percentage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524530390210052096)
- **tailoring for society jobs**: Tailoring is a good skill to level, including on a couple of alts, for completing society weekly jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531177735706116157)
- **tailoring training cost and profitability**: Tailoring is cheap to train because you use your own low-priced leather, and it has good societies, so even a 100 skill tailor is profitable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544308179821920316)
- **tamer alchemy and optional skills**: Alchemy is solid on a tamer for heals and throwable explosive potions, archery is safe but optional, and 40 throwing for aspect procs plus camping, tracking or forensic is another option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526216588548640900)
- **tamer beast codex priority**: For tamers, the Beast (Bestiary) Codex is a single cost that starts codex XP toward the codex used long-term, so it is prioritized over raising skill cap and skills, which can be macroed AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523562556885696594)
- **tamer cost**: Tamer is cheaper than it used to be: a core costs about 35k, down from 50k and originally 200k, tamer is much easier to train now, and frost can be used on a budget. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545383707731566694)
- **tamer skill allocation**: A tamer build takes four 120 taming skills, leaving 240 points to spend freely; tamers who use a weapon usually put 80 into Tactics and 80 into the weapon skill to use the weapon codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778129301012513)
- **tamer skill build with forensic evaluation**: A tamer who kills and skins creatures personally can run 120 in all four taming skills plus 110-120 Forensic Evaluation, spending the remaining points on other skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554971006328905890)
- **tamer skill cap progression**: Until 20 skill orbs raise the cap to 720, a tamer has only 20 free points after maxing Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding at 120 each; after reaching 720, tamers raise Taming and Lore to 110, lower weapon skill to 80, and raise Herding and Vet to 120 while lowering Tactics and Chivalry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556086086323937431)
- **tamer treasure map skill allocation**: A tamer treasure-map build has limited skill points, so Herding can be dropped to boost Lockpicking or Cartography, and Veterinary can also be dropped for more Cartography, though Veterinary is slow to retrain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540740155441156156)
- **tamer weapon skill choice**: A tamer can use any weapon skill; a dex tamer commonly uses macing, archery, or fencing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534968964759814388)
- **taming and lore requirement**: Taming and Animal Lore skill are required to control pets, including taming them and issuing commands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525545897851752690)
- **taming bestiary primal passive effect**: The taming bestiary Primal effect that increases passive ability trigger chance only affects abilities listed as passive on the abilities tab of a creature's lore page, so it likely does not affect poison chance unless the pet has a passive that poisons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541816999447896227)
- **taming skill gain method**: Taming skill no longer requires the old loop of taming 5 points and spending them repeatedly; players can gain skill passively by farming with appropriate-level pets or by retaming the same pet repeatedly, which can reach max taming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526200045383319654)
- **taming skill training**: Taming is fairly easy to skill up in Outlands, and leveling it was made easier in a past update. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547616147233316886)
- **taming training location restriction**: Tame-and-release taming training cannot be done in your inn room or in a house you have access to; do it in town, for example at a stable or town inn. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554300474100809832)
- **taming training pets**: For the tame-and-release script, a typical progression is cave bear to 80 skill, forest ostard to 100, and frenzied ostard to 120; other pets with the same taming requirements can be substituted, and the scripts cannot be used inside a house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553404822928236630)
- **taste identification skill effects**: Taste Identification boosts applied poison effectiveness and the Food Satisfaction buff, helps identify ideal plant-growing conditions, and reduces damage taken from bleeds, poisons and diseases. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554356657981628497)
- **taste identification training**: Taste Identification can be trained to 80 on Shelter, then by tasting cheese anywhere. A macro that repeatedly tastes items such as cheese can automate the training. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532830405420646402)
- **teleport spell magery requirement**: Teleport for anti-kite is usable at low Magery: one author says 30-50 Magery suffices, and a newer author says it works with just 10 Magery when cast from scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541928990497833170)
- **thief stealable stack size**: Thieves have a stealable stack size cap, and may be able to steal a full stack depending on its size, weight and storage location. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530280592212754492)
- **thieves codex leveling**: The Thieves Codex levels faster when hunting hard, busy areas with survival skills like healing and plenty of potions, and leveling it makes pilfering smoother and more profitable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542029753190580234)
- **thieves codex pilfering hide protection**: The thieving codex helps prevent pilfering from unhiding the player, and it has a maximum of 20 points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550598485831848098)
- **thieves codex requirements**: Using a Thieves Codex requires at least 80 Stealing and at least 80 in one of Snooping, Hiding or Stealth. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547246460578439239)
- **thieves codex skill substitution**: With Stealing and Snooping at 80 or higher you can obtain a thieves codex, whose abilities let Hiding act as effective Snooping and Stealth stand in for Tactics once codex points are invested (about 5 points each), so those skills can be dropped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **thieving training on shelter island**: On Shelter Island, use the thief training dummies in the building above the trainer dummies to train Stealing and Snooping simultaneously up to 80. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529447980099440680)
- **tinkering for gatherer characters**: Having 120 Tinkering helps a gatherer character deal with thieves, and Tinkering allows crafting exceptional trap tools and lockpicks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552042311821688904)
- **tinkering training cost**: Leveling Tinkering is very expensive, even when using gems, and is difficult for a new player to afford early on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551216275269619813)
- **tracking and detect hidden**: Tracking and Detect Hidden are used together to find PKs, thieves and other hidden players, with Detect Hidden extending the distance at which hidden players can be detected. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **tracking arrow colors**: Tracking arrows now use different colors to distinguish different sources of tracking arrows, since not all arrows come from the Tracking skill; the arrow color does not identify the target type, so reds, blues and oranges can all be tracked with a green arrow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537226652214497300)
- **tracking criminals and pks with begin hunting**: In the Tracking menu, choose the option that tracks criminals and PKs and click 'Begin Hunting'; it keeps running continuously without needing a loop. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549668597935378472)
- **tracking failure chance below 100 skill**: Tracking below 100 skill can fail, with about a 20% failure chance at 80 Tracking, so builds should run either 100 Tracking or none. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543673468527190027)
- **tracking hostile-only filter and hidden blue players**: Tracking set to hostile players only cannot detect hidden blue players, even with Detect Hidden 100 and Tracking 100. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535328780623544470)
- **tracking skill bonuses**: The Tracking skill always grants its bonuses to damage and Barding skill, even when the player is not currently Hunting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544154142262558810)
- **tracking skill for detecting murderers**: The Tracking skill finds animals, monsters, and players, and can be used to hunt murderers for an early warning when one is nearby, though PKs can still Recall in on top of you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532603862350037162)
- **tracking skill for tamers**: Tamers are recommended to take Tracking at 100 skill if their build has room, because it lets them track murderers (PKers). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520244943703117968)
- **tracking skill for wilderness farming**: 80 Tracking is plenty for wilderness farming, though actively tracking a specific monster, animal or human is harder at 80. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536746182502518804)
- **tracking skill level**: Tracking is only worth running at 100; going to 120 is not worthwhile. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539311066075369599)
- **training animal skills in houses**: Animal Lore and Herding can be trained inside a player house, while Animal Taming cannot be trained inside an inn or player house but can be trained in town. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533965305259233381)
- **training arms lore to 120**: To train Arms Lore to 120, repeatedly use Arms Lore on a dagger in a loop, though gain chances are very low at high skill levels. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523101700645191861)
- **training camping**: To train Camping, make kindling and double-click it to light a campfire; each lit campfire gives skill gain opportunities for 10 minutes, after which a new campfire is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659233887191092)
- **training chivalry**: Buy chivalry from a trainer up to 50, train it to 80 in Shelter, then above 80 train by attacking the battler trainer dummy, which can be done AFK but is slow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539954949096734742)
- **training detect hidden**: Detect Hidden gains by using the skill repeatedly; to train it hands-free, make a Razor macro that uses Detect Hidden, targets the ground near you, pauses about 11 seconds, and loops, standing in a public area with no loot on you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550336982767640639)
- **training lockbox continuous lockpicking option**: The training lockbox has a checkbox option to continuously keep picking the lock, so a looping lockpicking script is unnecessary. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540484441640804463)
- **training parrying to 80**: To train Parrying to 80, fight weak mobs such as birds, or an earth elemental in the Shelter dungeon, while running a macro that heals you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551305045327224865)
- **training with npcs when skill-capped**: When skill-capped, NPCs will not teach a skill unless another skill is locked down (lowered) and the skill you want to train is locked up in the skill lock settings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544724470080610365)
- **trap detonator for trappers**: A trapper needs to carry only one trap detonator, as it is not consumed and is lost only if you die and do not recover your body. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217080106356908)
- **trapper build alchemy levels**: Dex trapper builds typically run 80 Alchemy because they lack room for more skill points, while summon trapper builds can afford 120 Alchemy; Alchemy boosts trap damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529161403238322339)
- **trapper dexxer template**: A trapper template centers on 120 Tinkering and 120 Detect Hidden, with 80 in supporting skills such as Parrying, Alchemy, Healing and Anatomy, plus either 100 Wrestling or 80 Throwing and Tactics depending on the variant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524367353729777664)
- **trapper summoner build**: Trapper Summoner is a summoner build that does not use Necromancy, though it is expensive to train up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540229611290366062)
- **trapper treasure map build**: The trapper treasure map build is still used by top treasure-map players; the second lifetime tmap variant uses the same build with +20 Detect and -20 Meditation. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540455810801344644)
- **treasure mapper skill template**: A common treasure mapper template is 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 120 Cartography, 100 Tracking, 100 Magery, 80 Spirit Speak and 80 Meditation; a trapper variant uses 120 Alchemy for trap damage and 120 Cartography for creature damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541775867737542797)
- **tribard 120 with self-taught**: Reaching 120 Tribard with Self-Taught does not require the Musicianship skill to also have 20x scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550163349176590447)
- **tribard skill requirements**: A tribard build needs Herding and Peacemaking at 80, plus 3/5 points in the Self Taught Bard codex skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523301300295700611)
- **using a pickpocket dip**: To train with a pickpocket dip, double click it; the weapon-skill training dummy is a different item and gives the 'My skill can not be improved with a dummy' message. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530422872710053949)
- **veterinary damage bonus for followers**: Veterinary at 100 skill gives followers a 10% damage bonus, which is a decent boost to pet damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549848337367437353)
- **weapon codex points from treasure mapping**: How fast treasure mapping yields weapon codex points compared with dungeon grinding depends on the map level, the mobs that spawn, and the player's own habits and completion speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539330815413063780)
- **weapon skill value beyond 80**: Weapon skills are not worth much beyond 80, but 100 weapon skill is tankier than 80 in higher level content because fewer enemy hits land. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529571553967210657)
- **wiki weapon special attack listings**: The wiki page for each skill lists the relevant weapons and their special attacks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526220655719092284)
- **wrestler dexxer with alchemy**: A wrestler dexxer template can use Alchemy in place of Magic Resist and slightly less Focus while staying near max swing speed and 100% accuracy, which other dexxers cannot do. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523776478917955634)
- **wrestler swing speed cap with alchemy**: A wrestling-based template can cap swing speed and reach 100% accuracy against 120-skill mobs while also running Alchemy, though focus points must be tuned to fit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527856497634054306)
- **wrestler swing speed with arms lore**: A wrestler with 120 Arms Lore and 100 Chivalry has 42% swing speed increase, compared with 44% for one with 120 Chivalry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554700518306091099)
- **wrestling as best pvm weapon skill**: Wrestling is currently regarded as the top melee skill for PvM dexxers, and players using it may be able to drop their weapon skill to 80, though some caveats such as a wizard hat or playing drunk were mentioned. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555428454235775138)
- **wrestling training and accuracy**: Wrestling gain from 90 to 100 is slower than for other weapon skills, and accuracy relative to 100 wrestling should be checked when lowering combat skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541721913817174016)
- **wrestling training on battle trainer**: Wrestling can be trained by punching a battle trainer instead of fighting mobs, with the same skillgain chance as on mobs but with less risk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542926461751664640)
- **zoo anaconda**: The zoo anaconda is notorious for escaping its cage and chasing players, has caused deaths for AFK trainers, and cannot be killed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524520437089042514)
- **100 anatomy for dexxers**: Spending link slots to reach 100 Anatomy is not recommended in the current era, especially since the best dexxer build recently gained 10% extra swing speed for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523439478700642406)
- **100 tracking with 120 detect hidden**: With 100 Tracking and 120 Detect Hidden, approaching PKs show up on Tracking before they head toward the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542270226215862282)
- **12-link chivalry wrestler codex links**: For a 12-link chivalry wrestler, the first 10 links go to melee special chance/damage and the second 10 to damage dealt by player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543042672455843920)
- **120 chivalry value**: Reaching 120 Chivalry is considered one of the best uses of skill points because Divine Fury and other Chivalry abilities grant a large swing speed bonus and other boosts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526148387324301323)
- **120 stealth travel benefit**: 120 Stealth reduces travel times while stealthed, but 100 Stealth is acceptable on a budget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526878007854366850)
- **120 tinkering value for treasure maps**: 120 Tinkering is an expensive skill and saves only roughly 10-20 seconds per treasure map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538206961630187631)
- **120 veterinary for tamers**: 120 Veterinary gives a defensive benefit and adds follower damage, and is considered better for a tamer than having Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546620704873644203)
- **20 alchemy with 60 focus**: With 60 Focus a player can have 20 Alchemy, which gives a small potion buff but does not grant access to the Alchemy codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553898305593806879)
- **3x80 barding tradeoff**: Running 3x80 barding means occasional failures but frees skill points for more fighting skills, whereas 100 or 120 barding is safer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551004175041826897)
- **4x120 tamer plus 3x80 bard build**: A build with four 120 Tamer skills and three 80 Bard skills is popular but cannot do treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539708663126565027)
- **5x mage definition**: A 5x mage in PvP is a mage with Magery, Meditation, Resisting Spells, Evaluating Intelligence, and Wrestling, each at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527274790149292195)
- **70 tracking effectiveness**: Tracking at 70 skill is only marginally better than 0 Tracking, fails often, and detected enemies will likely reach the tracker quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555044317263831172)
- **700 total skill cap**: Skills cannot gain once the 700 total skill cap is reached; to keep gaining, set other skills to down arrow (lock down) so points are freed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540783843357884487)
- **720 tamer build skill split**: A 720 tamer build with 100 Barding uses 90 Herding and 90 Veterinary; with 90 Barding it uses 105 Veterinary and Herding, or becomes a 710 build with 100 in each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549921625884065825)
- **80 alchemy for treasure map builds**: 80 Alchemy is preferred by one author for treasure map builds because it enables experience potions and better heals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546236236979634238)
- **80 archery on bard archer**: A bard archer can run 80 Archery if accuracy from other sources is sufficient to support it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544333431624966174)
- **80 tactics damage cap**: Using 80 Tactics caps melee damage output compared with higher Tactics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544994777315942480)
- **8th circle scroll consumption**: 8th circle scrolls are expensive and will most likely be consumed when cast; satchels give a chance to keep them from being consumed, and Inscription can make that chance 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543038339836411955)
- **8th circle spells at 80 magery**: With 80 Magery you cannot cast 8th circle spells, most of which are summons that a tamer does not need, and Earthquake sees little use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552283305473347587)
- **8x8 skill training method**: The old 8x8 skill training method of moving 8 steps and retrying the skill is not needed in UO Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378503564132434)
- **activating aspect without a weapon**: To activate an aspect without wielding a weapon, equip a spellbook and then activate the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528958349201117356)
- **advanced mugger skinner template**: The Advanced Mugger (Skinner) 720-skillpoint template on the Outlands wiki TemplatesMisc page is a fairly standard backstabber/mugger template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532473639885082756)
- **afk camping training**: For AFK camping training, kindling is cheap, so start a new campfire about every 10 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533231442987974736)
- **afk gatherer skill build**: For an AFK mining and lumberjacking gatherer, a suggested build is 120 Mining and Lumberjacking with Camping; Meditation, Magic Resist and Tracking are overkill, and Meditation is useless if using Hiking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550580351984865383)
- **afk melee training on dummies**: After reaching 80 in the shelter, hitting a target dummy or combat trainer is a good way to level melee skills while AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529585678126678037)
- **afk overnight training precautions**: When going AFK to train overnight, carry an empty inventory and be prepared for a possible mishap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532991280668348609)
- **afk skill gain legality**: AFK skill gain, such as hitting a training dummy while away, is legal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534351673755963443)
- **afk skill gain on moongate target dummy**: Skills can be gained AFK on the moongate target dummy above skill 100 when orbed and scrolled up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541185468023177306)
- **afk skill training**: Regular skill points may be trained while AFK macroing, though how long and how easy it is depends on the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524983919760511037)
- **afk skill training**: Some skill training can be done while AFK, unlike gathering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525868373374664764)
- **afk skill training on npc trainers**: Players commonly AFK train their main skills to 100 on an NPC trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533187772461093074)
- **afk skill training to 100**: Skills can be raised AFK up to 100, and gain up to that point is considered essentially a tutorial phase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534351806782771412)
- **afk skill training to 120**: Almost all skills can be trained to 120 while AFK, though it takes a while. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539593239366078515)
- **afk taming location restrictions**: AFK taming training with the tamer script cannot be done in an inn room or in a house you are added to or have access to; it must be done in town after completing the shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539433080039931914)
- **afk taming macro to grandmaster**: Taming can now be macroed AFK up to grandmaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552716573490413669)
- **afk taming script follower counting**: The AFK taming script reportedly does not count a pet you are riding as a follower but does count a pet you are not riding, so two pets while mounted on one may count as two followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551183672479064176)
- **afk taming script pet limit**: To keep the AFK taming script working, keep only one pet with you and stable or get rid of any other pet, since extra followers can stop the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551183532980707379)
- **afk taming skill gain targets**: For AFK taming gains, tame a creature whose required taming level is as close to your taming skill as possible; only the creature's level matters, not its stats, and gains may still occur within roughly 20 points of your skill (unconfirmed). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528876905518989482)
- **afk taming targets**: Forest ostard and frenzied ostard are reportedly suitable for the 80-100 and 100-120 AFK taming ranges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520275537333981196)
- **afk taming training**: Taming can be trained to maximum by going AFK with three different types of ostards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552848347285561485)
- **afk tracking training**: Tracking can be trained AFK by setting it to 'always get closest' and starting to hunt, which performs a check every 5 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540507165234565181)
- **afk training from 80 to 100**: To AFK train from 80 to 100, leave Shelter Island and use a trainer elsewhere, probably the one next to Prevalia's Moongate (location uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534185099489443870)
- **afk training limits**: Skills can be trained with AFK macros, but harvesting and gaining codex, mastery or aspect XP cannot be done AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526044053722890320)
- **afk training location safety**: Training AFK at the zoo risks thieves stealing your reagents, so training in your inn room is safer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532990916413882478)
- **afk training of lumberjacking and mining**: Lumberjacking and Mining are easy to train AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659842732621875)
- **afk wrestling training**: To train wrestling AFK, put on cheap clothes, fight the battle trainer, and leave the character training, keeping in mind that AFK trainers outside town are PK and thief targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526304956171161710)
- **afk wrestling training in shelter dungeon**: Wrestling cannot be trained AFK in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669266272550984)
- **aggroing ghouls for faster skill leveling**: Aggroing all four ghouls in the New Player Dungeon speeds up skill leveling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522076699943108779)
- **air armor build skill choice**: A build that sticks to Air Armor can take Forensic Evaluation instead of Chivalry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538880176589504532)
- **air armor versus focus**: Air armor provides the same effect as focus but better, so focus can be dropped when running air armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538632739081953331)
- **air aspect accuracy and focus**: Accuracy with the Air aspect is poor without Focus even at tier 13 Air, but 80 Focus with an avarite fist weapon reaches the accuracy cap for non-time content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526779187656917012)
- **air aspect and divine fury**: The air aspect removes the need to depend on Divine Fury. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524492995406336120)
- **air aspect build defensive skill choice**: For an air aspect build, the player can choose between Magic Resistance and Parrying as the defensive skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524116055444815952)
- **air aspect build overcap**: Using Divine Fury on Air aspect with an exceedingly accurate vanquishing weapon, 80 item ID and 80 alchemy overcaps swing speed by 6.7% and accuracy by 2.4%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521579287533326528)
- **air aspect swords arms lore alternative**: In the air aspect swords template, Arms Lore can be reduced to 80 and the freed 80 points put into Tracking (adds damage) or Alchemy (adds survival). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536339787127062649)
- **air aspect wrestling template**: An air aspect wrestling template uses Arms Lore and Chivalry, can run with less Focus, and can include Alchemy because of the swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524173049493061803)
- **air elemental summon**: Air elementals are a melee cleave summon and can be summoned anywhere for training, and standing in a safe place makes being overweight acceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550342421546668123)
- **air wrestler build efficiency**: An air wrestler is very efficient to build and can easily leave about 80 skill points free for other skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524492333326794924)
- **air wrestler skill allocation**: An air wrestler should have Wrestling at 100, which means dropping Anatomy to 80, and can raise Focus to 100 and drop Chivalry to 100 until much higher level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552089950022008964)
- **alchemy 80 breakpoint**: 80 Alchemy gives the potion kit, purple potions, and duration buffs on white, blue and black potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962607046398043)
- **alchemy and archery pairing**: Alchemy pairs well with Archery, though a player must decide which other skill to cut. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552041227061428368)
- **alchemy and buff potions**: Alchemy skill is not strictly necessary, and you should maintain the three buff potions regardless of your Alchemy skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523036083904970844)
- **alchemy and parry swap in template**: In this template, the alchemy skill can be swapped for the parry skill if the player prefers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535795840851902524)
- **alchemy and parrying for tmap melee builds**: Alchemy and Parrying are not necessary for treasure map melee builds unless soloing level 8 maps; moving away when mobs spawn is enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537440407359586344)
- **alchemy and scribe benefits**: Alchemy protects against disease, poison and bleed, while Scribe gives quality-of-life benefits plus a solid damage boost in PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533189863526891670)
- **alchemy and taste identification for dexxer tamer**: A dexxer tamer could use 20 Alchemy for a small potion buff and 20 Taste Identification for a possible food buff, though the food buff is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543227018106249250)
- **alchemy and tinkering pairing**: Alchemy and Tinkering are both expensive to level, so they are best paired on the same template, for example for a trapper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555037957348524192)
- **alchemy as healing skill**: Alchemy is considered a strong healing skill on its own. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543653951122182204)
- **alchemy as parrying alternative**: Alchemy has damage reduction built in and provides lots of recovery, making it a viable alternative to Parrying on a dual wielder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528780108872286218)
- **alchemy benefits**: Alchemy provides some damage resistance, strong heals, and utility such as escaping hinders or stopping bleeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541843175096721408)
- **alchemy benefits for mages**: Alchemy gives a mage damage reduction, hinder protection, bleed and disease protection, bigger heals and bigger explosions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526328645847875676)
- **alchemy codex bandolier**: Bandolier is a worthwhile alchemy codex talent and is recommended to max out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523468823871750334)
- **alchemy codex bonus skill requirement**: Lowering Resist, Anatomy and Parry to 80 would reportedly grant the full Alchemy codex bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548204544251666484)
- **alchemy codex on backstabber**: With Ruffian/Shadow Hands, a backstabber template can raise Alchemy to 80 to get the alchemy (potion) codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554898648440111246)
- **alchemy codex talent for bleeding**: An Alchemy codex talent reportedly lets players remove bleeding through cure potions once every 30 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538911695135834217)
- **alchemy crafting time estimate**: The website and wiki estimate about 13 hours of crafting to max the alchemy skill using the first listed training option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524323994353008731)
- **alchemy for heals and dot removal**: Alchemy can be used on a template for on-demand heals or for removing damage-over-time effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **alchemy for hybrid templates**: A PvM/PvP hybrid template should have around 80 alchemy because the codex and most codex items work while PvP flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538577758953930762)
- **alchemy for pvm builds**: No build focuses specifically on Alchemy for PvM, but Alchemy pairs well with most builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527716476486946967)
- **alchemy for thief template**: Adding 50 alchemy to a thief template provides boosted healing potions, which one player recommends as an easy option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521552411536392353)
- **alchemy in mugger template**: Most players run 80 Alchemy instead of Tracking in the Advanced Mugger (Skinner) template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532473639885082756)
- **alchemy instead of tracking for tmapper**: If a second character provides tracking (and possibly a bard buff), a summoner or trapper tmapper can take Alchemy instead of Tracking for more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538228754969661481)
- **alchemy level for societies**: Players eventually want 100-120 Alchemy on their main account to do societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553897828286206036)
- **alchemy leveling cost and qol items**: Leveling alchemy is cumbersome without quality-of-life items in your home; roughly 1 million gold should cover those items and leveling alchemy to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522367865058103487)
- **alchemy on backstabber**: Alchemy has use cases on a backstabber if the player makes mistakes often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543139047591903293)
- **alchemy on stabber builds**: Alchemy is only worth taking at 80 on a stabber, for cleansing bleed, making healing potions, or throwing explosion potions at low-health mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555333432492429373)
- **alchemy on tri-bard dexxer**: Alchemy is worthwhile on a tri-bard dexxer for survivability, replacing item identification, and bard skills can be lowered to 80 as Lyric tier increases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526280557942542486)
- **alchemy or scribe secondary skill**: Alchemy or Scribe can be taken as a secondary skill for the Potion Codex or for longer buffs, and Scribe also helps avoid interruption in PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533245101336301669)
- **alchemy point for potion uptime**: Having 1 point of Alchemy in a build is claimed to give uptime on potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551816197144707073)
- **alchemy potion benefits**: Alchemy gives access to 30-minute buff potions as well as freedom and panacea potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537790112279171112)
- **alchemy potion healing and panacea**: Alchemy gives almost twice the potion healing of Elixir and Bandolier together, and Panacea is very useful on lower dungeon levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552030910591934507)
- **alchemy potion scaling**: A player reports that adding a few points of Alchemy boosts potion strength, but the claim that scaling is linear is unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527111797671460937)
- **alchemy potion skill gain chance**: In the alchemy craft menu, all potions highlighted green give the same 2% chance of skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524335758591135814)
- **alchemy potions on summons**: With 80 Alchemy, Strength/Agility/Resist potions can be applied to summons so the buffs last indefinitely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528449773403902154)
- **alchemy removing bleeds**: Alchemy lets a player remove bleeds and similar effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534720362632183808)
- **alchemy requirement for 120 hp**: Alchemy is not required to reach 120 hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **alchemy requirement for poison dexxer**: A poison dexxer does not need 120 Alchemy; 80 Alchemy is sufficient, and it was still 80 on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534910425626579107)
- **alchemy resist training ranges**: The wiki lists two alchemy training routes using resist potions, one from about 55 to 75 and another from 50 to 70, so the exact ranges are inconsistent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524328049506779216)
- **alchemy role for dexxer builds**: Alchemy is not a main damage source but serves as a support skill for trap or poison dexxer builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523362251808182463)
- **alchemy skill and potion cooldown**: Alchemy skill level does not reduce the potion cooldown timer; a test at 120 skill gave the same timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522670097095721042)
- **alchemy skill requirement for pvm**: PvM content only requires 80 in the Alchemy skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522252205674201129)
- **alchemy swap in mace chivalry template**: Replacing arms lore with alchemy in the mace/chivalry template is said to improve survival and unlock the alchemy codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539923251034329128)
- **alchemy talent level 3 bleeding reduction**: At level 3, the Alchemy talent description states it reduces bleeding damage by 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538912604091719721)
- **alchemy versus arms lore value**: Point for point, Alchemy is almost certainly better than Arms Lore, though results may vary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554963254755729419)
- **alchemy versus magery for stealing retaliation**: At 80 Alchemy, a thief may find retaliation damage while stealing safer to handle than with Magery, though this is a tentative impression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546794718157873192)
- **alchemy with potion codex**: Alchemy combined with the potion codex is very strong for survival; a player lacking gold to raise Alchemy can start with Focus instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553173559918993514)
- **all patrol pet command**: The 'All patrol' pet command lets a tamer move pets to a chosen location, though only approximately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540900589804724264)
- **alternate training house location**: If the training house at the previous moongate does not work, a house on the beach at Horse Shoe Bay on the way to town can be used for the same training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531782132203257967)
- **alternative archer templates**: Alternative archer templates include 80 Archery with 120 Arms Lore for more special moves, and 20 Resisting Spells, 100 Focus, 80 Archery and 120 Arms Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527857485136924834)
- **alternative backstabber build**: An alternative backstabber build uses Wrestling 100, Forensic 120 and Camping 100 with only one weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532013344184205464)
- **alternative interrupt resistance sources**: Interrupt resistance can be obtained through Magic Resist or Inscription instead of the Arcane/Wrestling/Magery combination. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550251175457325087)
- **anatomy bandage healing bonus**: Raising Anatomy from 80 to 100 adds 4 healing to a bandage plus 1 to each of three heal-over-time ticks, about 7 extra hp per bandage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523403009181356122)
- **anatomy effects**: Anatomy provides swing speed and finisher chance in addition to survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523430746881134642)
- **anatomy finisher chance**: 100 Anatomy is thought to increase finisher chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523419592729559090)
- **anatomy for archers**: Some players keep Anatomy at 100 on an archer because of the Ricochet ability, though this is a personal preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **anatomy requirement for healing**: Anatomy is needed to make effective use of the Healing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362038690516993)
- **anatomy requirement for healing**: Anatomy is not strictly required for healing, but without it you cannot cure, resurrect or use the Healer's Codex, and you heal for somewhat less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537429736169406584)
- **anatomy swing speed bonus**: Anatomy gives a base swing speed increase to melee weapons and their auto attacks, including bow ammo and projectiles, but not to spell casting speed; speed caps apply and stacking aspects makes it redundant in PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527108450469810278)
- **anatomy versus chivalry in backstabber build**: Anatomy would require also running Healing, which leaves too few skill points, so the backstabber build uses Chivalry instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531526956389105726)
- **anatomy weapon damage bonus**: Anatomy raises the minimum base damage of weapons (e.g. 12-24 becomes 14-24), which applies to weapon auto attacks and projectiles but not to cast spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527107660070256670)
- **anatomy, healing and veterinary skill pairing**: Anatomy pairs with Healing, so if you have Veterinary you do not need Anatomy; you need Veterinary or Healing but not both, and tamers want Veterinary rather than Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528402509666713711)
- **animal lore and tracking training**: Animal Lore and Tracking are easy to train back up AFK later, so they can be temporarily dropped in a template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477205342425214)
- **animal lore for pet health**: Animal lore can be used to check a pet's health, but it is not really worth the effort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522376191091146773)
- **animal lore skill category**: The Animal Lore skill is listed under the Wilderness category of skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145144006283378)
- **animal lore skill gain**: Animal lore skill gain chance is reportedly the same regardless of the target, and the skill also raises while taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542351687040245791)
- **animal lore training**: Animal Lore is trained by using it on a mob, or by training Animal Taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555616760265310270)
- **animal lore training method**: Animal Lore can be trained by using the skill repeatedly in a loop while targeting one of your own followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555410574878445599)
- **animal taming training**: To train Animal Taming, repeatedly re-tame the same pet in a quiet spot where it cannot walk away quickly, such as in front of your house or in rooms at the edge of cities, possibly AFK overnight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533963318392389734)
- **applying barding buff songs**: To apply a barding buff song, use the barding skill and target the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521955054255607848)
- **arcane aspect grinding on another echo**: Grinding the Arcane aspect on another echo may be faster, but it forgoes codex XP gained by using the codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553832952360869979)
- **arcane aspect leveling**: To level arcane aspect, run leech until level 5, then switch to training on shield, meditating between bouts and using crystals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539411099751809164)
- **arcane aspect leveling after patch**: After the last patch, leveling the Arcane aspect is comparable to strong builds and consistent, since the added mana leech is reliable when killing high armor mobs in Fracture stance, and the aspect is very tanky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539390672287694899)
- **arcane blood t1-t15 leveling links**: To level a T1-T15 Arcane/Blood build, start with 10 gold spell aspect special chance links, then buy damage to bleeding links for the next 10, then damage dealt by player links, reaching T15 on both aspects around link 22. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536201110753251348)
- **arcane build skill setup**: Arcane builds commonly run Magery and Evaluating Intelligence at 100 and do not run Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528137989945823243)
- **arcane codex and barding restriction**: A character with Barding cannot use the Arcane codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524527219949703241)
- **arcane effective skill cap for interrupts**: Arcane's effective skill for interrupt avoidance cannot exceed the character's wrestling skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660770111037592)
- **arcane grimoire setting for faster arcane gain**: Running arcane/arcane in the grimoire may raise Arcane faster, but this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524837645652594901)
- **arcane interrupt avoidance**: Arcane provides additive interrupt avoidance per skill point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660733725708318)
- **arcane mage armor and dex choice**: On an arcane mage, blood armor at 40 dex likely gives the most uptime, while lightning armor is more fun and works with about 25 dex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333832870072452)
- **arcane mage dungeon farmer build**: A build of 80 Camping and 80 Arcane/Wrestling is a good dungeon farmer setup for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524172554011541644)
- **arcane mage flex skill slot**: On the arcane mage (cooking) build, the 80 Cooking slot is a flex slot that can be swapped for Camping, Tracking, Parry, Alchemy or Necromancy (for bosses), and from about tier 14 Focus can be lowered to 60 or 70 to fit a 110-120 skill such as Forensics, Tracking, Camping or Necromancy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545456055511683132)
- **arcane mage skill allocation**: Many players run 120 scribe plus six skills at 100, while arcane mage builds more commonly use eight skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525910481057878047)
- **arcane mage skill progression**: Early on, run a swing speed build with 80 Meditation and bone armor; once mana sustain feels good, around Arcane tier 10-12 (some say 6-8), swap Meditation for 80 Cooking, then drop Cooking later for any other skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540738532039983224)
- **arcane mage starting build**: A recommended arcane mage starting build is 100 Evaluating Intelligence, 100 Focus, 100 Magery, 100 Magic Resist, 80 Wrestling, 80 Arcane, 80 Alchemy and 80 Cooking, as the newer recommendation uses Wrestling for accuracy to land more arcane mana thief hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545554680912941206)
- **arcane mage stat allocation**: An arcane mage can run 100 int and 25 dex if they do not use fast flamestrike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545456538414747759)
- **arcane mage template flexibility**: Alchemy can be added to arcane mage templates, and parrying can be swapped for necromancy if you are not tanking level 4 content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525706612248023040)
- **arcane mage template parry swap**: If you miss Parry on the arcane mage template, swap it for 80 Cooking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537790613066350642)
- **arcane mage treasure map template**: An arcane mage with about 120 Cartography and 70 Focus using Chain Lightning and the grimoire works well for treasure maps, and can do roughly 25-30 T4 maps per hour; Cartography can be reduced for more Focus at lower map tiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544401583427551284)
- **arcane mage wiki builds**: The wiki arcane mage builds are a solid starting point, and Alchemy is run on all stickmage echoes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527736143263695089)
- **arcane scavenger mage template**: One recommended arcane loot-pinata/scavenger mage template is 120 Camping, 100 Evaluate Intelligence, Magery and Resisting Spells, 80 Alchemy and Wrestling, with the remainder in Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524839972019114145)
- **arcane skill in pvp**: The Arcane skill is designed for PvM and is weak in PvP, where an arcane mage is essentially an unoptimized mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527393834781380641)
- **arcane skill training**: Raise Wrestling to 100 before training Arcane, then script an arcane staff equip at Wrestling 100 and let it run overnight; Arcane can also be leveled while playing with a slight interrupt chance that shrinks as Arcane rises, and Evaluate Intelligence can also be scripted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524835666205085697)
- **arcane template gear progression**: On an arcane template, use arcane weapon and armor until tier 10, then add blood or void armor together with the arcane staff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530023040191041689)
- **arcane weapon special requirements for mages**: To benefit from the Arcane weapon special chance bonus from Arms Lore, a mage needs the Arcane skill and must use an Arcane Staff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527084085921448016)
- **arcane wrestling noxcro variant**: An alternative Noxcro variant takes Arcane and Wrestling to unlock the Arcane codex and uses Shield stance so the player tanks damage themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521860948703580331)
- **arcane, barding and taming pairing**: Arcane users cannot use Barding or Taming, while Taming and Barding pair well together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524534226907828244)
- **arcanist aspect requirements**: To play an arcanist you need to level the arcane and blood aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545301251074297906)
- **archer alchemy skill allocation**: An archer who wants Alchemy can run 80 Focus and 80 Arms Lore and keep Disarm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552071847263080539)
- **archer alchemy versus parry**: An archer should always choose Alchemy over Parry; including either costs some DPS but is worthwhile with 4 SSI links added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529487085545984061)
- **archer and wrestler shared links**: Archer and Wrestler templates share links, so one echo can serve both. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552473977975480422)
- **archer aspect accuracy threshold**: Around aspect tier 11 or 12, an archer gets enough accuracy bonus from the aspect to begin shifting skill points around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543676912973385789)
- **archer backstabber build skill fit**: An archer backstabber build that already uses Tactics can fit both Chivalry and Camping, but Tracking has to be dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520857626085167247)
- **archer bard build**: For an archer bard, one suggested build uses chivalry plus 80 alchemy instead of healing and anatomy, since alchemy offers a healing alternative along with damage and utility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552028366369062973)
- **archer dexxer hunter build**: A suggested archer dexxer hunter build is 100 archery, 100 tactics, 100 tracking, 120 forensic, 100 camping, 80 anatomy, 80 healing and 40 each of magic resist, focus and alchemy; air aspected armor maximizes swing speed, while harvest aspected armor yields more leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542173400061976606)
- **archer focus and accuracy target**: Focus at 80 is sufficient for archers; the goal is to raise accuracy to 100% against the mobs being fought, which changes as aspects level, and swing speed is capped at 50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525541876562661588)
- **archer mage pvp build**: A standard archer mage PvP build uses 100 each of Magery, Evaluating Intelligence, Meditation, Wrestling, Resisting Spells, Archery and Tactics, with spare points and the extra +20 cap going to skills like Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528352127288741899)
