- **archer skill choices without healing**: Some archers drop the Healing skill and max Anatomy, Arms Lore and Archery instead, since bandages are considered overrated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527869145100714115)
- **archer tamer skill split**: The standard approach for an archer tamer is 80 Archery, 80 Tactics and 80 Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554433364860080170)
- **archery for bards**: Keeping Archery at 100 is useful for bards because hinders from archery help during bard breaks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555517590724681779)
- **archery for leveling codex aspects**: Archery is among the easiest ways to level whichever Codex aspect a player wants to try, and its hinder effect is useful for bard tamers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521529873233875316)
- **archery requirement for level 4 areas**: Level 4 difficulty areas generally need about 100 Archery, though this is a rough estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537114398672298074)
- **archery skill cap and archery codex**: Archery cannot go above 100, and the archery codex cannot be used without Archery skill at 80 or 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524039714913648853)
- **archery solo training**: Archery is slow for solo play and takes a long time to reach enough damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534918436608671887)
- **archery training ammunition savings**: When training Archery, using a heavy crossbow and a quiver reduces the amount of bolts you use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528728279836786849)
- **armor and mana regeneration**: Wearing armor reduces mana regeneration for spellcasters; details are on the Outlands wiki Meditation page and the Outlands Butler mana regen tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532144137443348491)
- **armor effect on dexxers**: Armor affects a dexxer mainly through the meditation penalty, which impedes mana regeneration, while other effects are not noticeable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537086116950179980)
- **arms lore and hinder**: Higher Arms Lore increases the strength of Hinder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537120554887151656)
- **arms lore armor durability check**: Arms Lore on Outlands may be usable to check armor durability, but this is unconfirmed and the required skill level is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **arms lore breakpoint for dexxers**: 100 arms lore is a good breakpoint for a dexxer build, giving 30% specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529677475217539122)
- **arms lore for arcane mages**: Arms Lore is not an efficient skill choice for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891319019339776)
- **arms lore for bard archer**: Arms Lore is likely not required for a bard archer template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544333280126439485)
- **arms lore for chivalry mace fighters**: Arms Lore is the best skill for damage output for a Chivalry mace fighter, and it should be at 80 to allow disarming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531325888963153981)
- **arms lore for full pvm builds**: A full PvM build without tracking benefits from maxed arms lore, and once accuracy exceeds 100%, skill points can be moved from focus and/or archery into arms lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543674347418427402)
- **arms lore for poison dexxers**: Arms Lore provides more cripples that raise poison tick damage and reduce enemy defenses, which raises accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544673277342126151)
- **arms lore proc substitution**: Arms lore can be used in place of one of the 80-point skills required for proccing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531406433894006946)
- **arms lore special chance bonus**: Arms Lore increases weapon special chance by roughly 1% per 10 skill, giving +10% at 100 skill, +5% at 50 and +1% at 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527087321264947220)
- **arms lore training level for disarm**: Most players who take Arms Lore for Disarm train it to at least 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527086380247683083)
- **arms lore value after tending nerf**: Arms Lore is less valuable for bards after the tending nerf than it was before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538690289307488287)
- **arms lore with blood armor**: With blood armor, Arms Lore lets the player use the Seeking ability more often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522992875904696430)
- **artisan 0 to 15 leather cost**: Leveling artisan from 0 to 15 without an aspect costs just over 2 million leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525581444486008933)
- **artisan aspect experience rate**: Experience per minute while leveling the Artisan aspect is very predictable, so one can estimate when enough experience for a level-up will be reached. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555983663559217235)
- **artisan bard booster aspect requirement**: The artisan bard booster build only works with the artisan aspect, because artisan boosts the carpentry-made instrument and item identification also boosts the effect of a Supremely instrument. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545425142669115394)
- **artisan bard booster template**: The Artisan Bard Booster template for omni and boss content is 120 peacemaking, 120 discordance, 120 provocation, 120 carpentry, 120 item identification and 120 tracking, with forensic evaluation, or 80 alchemy plus 40 archery (or 80 archery plus 40 alchemy/anatomy/focus) for active play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545425142669115394)
- **artisan exceptional chance for jewel crafting**: The Artisan exceptional-craft chance raises the value of crafted jewels but does not increase tinkering skill gain rate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525525603061596371)
- **artisan experience from materials used**: Artisan experience is based on materials used, and alteration kits give the same experience per leather as repair kits while using fewer tool charges and less time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522535836216856697)
- **artisan skill value**: A crafting character on the primary account allows slowly raising Artisan to 15, and Artisan is not considered worth pursuing otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531386236390871270)
- **aspect essence drain on training dummies**: Aspect procs on training dummies do not drain essence, because an old bug that caused this was fixed at least a couple of years ago. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539993371458932746)
- **aspect kit requirement**: Starting aspect training from scratch requires an aspect kit, which can be found through Outlands Portal vendor search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549695198186176585)
- **aspect procs on training dummies**: Aspects can proc on training dummies, so players are advised not to have an aspect active while training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539993133742301254)
- **aspect tier progression speed**: Tier 10 of an aspect takes very little time on most aspects and tier 13 is also fairly fast, but progress slows significantly from tier 13 to 14 to 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531064774035505313)
- **aspect xp for treasure map digging**: For treasure map digging, full aspect XP likely requires both armor and weapon aspects to be active, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528951493426941983)
- **aspect xp source**: Aspect XP from a creature is based on the creature's difficulty rather than the gold it drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529505413790437570)
- **aspect xp while ocean fishing**: While ocean fishing, throwing nets gives 100% Harvest aspect XP when it is on armor and killing spawned mobs gives 50% XP to the weapon aspect, so put Harvest on armor and another aspect on the weapon; in dungeons harvest XP is 50% lower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546642998455042058)
- **attacking a trainer npc**: To attack a trainer NPC, switch to WAR mode with TAB, double-click his nameplate, and stand on a tile directly adjacent to him. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549671041750540381)
- **automatic skill gain and gain chances**: Skill points are gained automatically from your actions when the skill is set to increase in the skill menu, and enabling "show skill gain chances" (via left click on your sprite) shows which actions raise which skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547568111648112811)
- **avarwood lumberjacking requirement**: A minimum of 110 Lumberjacking skill is needed before you can start finding avarwood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539153238547365989)
- **backstab build skill requirements**: A Backstab build does not need Arms Lore or Tactics, but should have at least 80 Stealing to use the Thieves Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546983879552933968)
- **backstab damage bonus scaling**: The Outlands wiki states that the damage bonus to Backstab is directly determined by the Stealth skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534982468082466956)
- **backstab steal attempt from stealth**: Backstabbing a monster from stealth automatically attempts a steal if the attacker has Stealing skill, and a system message is shown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523862845379448993)
- **backstabber build forensics requirement**: The backstabber build shown requires 110 Forensics, which can be taken from Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532275710755082372)
- **backstabber camping focus template**: A backstabber template can run 120 Camping plus Focus with 0 Tracking if healing is not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541912941333319750)
- **backstabber chill factor and tracking**: Backstabbers have a good chill factor, which makes Tracking less valuable for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541913042613174323)
- **backstabber item id versus alchemy**: For a backstabber build, Item ID provides more damage while Alchemy provides more utility and survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555328435524476931)
- **backstabber starting skill set**: A backstabber needs a base set of starting skills including Snooping and Tactics, which can later be swapped for other skills using codex points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523861920791269516)
- **backstabber template for mastery chain grinding**: A backstabber template requires little investment and is a low-effort option for grinding mastery chain links on an alt account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538941334335922258)
- **backstabber thieves codex abilities**: For a Backstabber build, the recommended Thieves Codex abilities to level are smoke bomb and, probably, the extra-steps-to-stealth conversion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533445228948750347)
- **backstabbing weapon skills**: Any weapon skill works with backstabbing, so a wrestling backstabber is possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543143460226207754)
- **bandage cure and resurrection skill minimums**: Curing with bandages requires at least 60 Anatomy and 60 Healing, and resurrecting with bandages requires at least 80 Anatomy and 80 Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527107294125490216)
- **bandage healing scaling**: Bandage healing amount depends on Healing and Anatomy skill, so a character with 0 Healing and 31 Anatomy heals very little with bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525868713436385454)
- **bandage resurrection success rate**: With 120 Veterinary and Animal Lore plus specialist points, resurrecting a player with bandages reportedly succeeds more often than it fails. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101942782857278)
- **bandageself verbal command**: A BandageSelf verbal command exists that instantly starts a bandage on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536865419242242209)
- **bard archer item identification vs carpentry**: On a bard archer, taking item identification is better than taking carpentry, though both can be taken for meta bard buffs in a niche build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545407533320118302)
- **bard archer provocation discordance peacemaking levels**: A bard archer is advised to take Provocation, Discordance and Peacemaking to 120 rather than 80, because frequent failures of peace or provo are a major problem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544332880929493003)
- **bard aspect choice**: Lyric aspect is recommended for an 80 tri bard template, while a non-lyric aspect is recommended for a 120 tri template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538690909611237426)
- **bard buffs as gold links**: Bard buffs work like free gold links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544686814420537354)
- **bard build skill choices**: A bard can drop healing and anatomy for alchemy and arms lore for more utility and DPS, and chivalry at 120 is important. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538687063153451110)
- **bard build template links**: Bard build templates reportedly use the links Effective Barding, Damage to Barded, and Dungeon Slayer, with 10 of each of the barding-related ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549960338483712112)
- **bard build templates**: Sample bard templates are: Chivalry Peacemaking (120 Chiv, 120 Forensic Eval, 100 Tactics, 100 weapon, 80 Healing/Anatomy/Parrying, 40 Camping or Focus); solo tri bard (120 Chiv, 100 Tactics, 80 each Provocation/Peacemaking/Discordance/weapon/Healing/Anatomy, 20 Camping); group tri bard (120 Chiv, 100 Tactics, 90 each Provo/Peace/Disco, 85 weapon, 85 Focus, 60 Camping). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548702180024786976)
- **bard build without herding**: A bard build without Herding loses pet damage and has no source of a small chance to proc the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542463894046384188)
- **bard codex benefits**: The bard codex can increase song buffs, raise the success chance of barding a mob, and increase the damage provoked mobs do to one another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610137252986950)
- **bard codex musicianship requirement**: Musicianship must be kept at 80 or higher to keep using the bard codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553820570519474237)
- **bard codex recommendations**: A bard should use a Bard Codex and a weapons codex, and possibly a Healer's Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534305824938397806)
- **bard codex requirement for buffing others**: A bard codex is not required to buff other players with bard songs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541759907156459591)
- **bard codex setup dropping to 3x80 skills**: An established bard codex setup can eventually drop to 3x80 skills and will then need fewer power points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543583019921711175)
- **bard codex skill scaling**: With the Bard Codex, if one barding skill is lower than the others, all three barding skills function at the lowest value, wasting the extra points in the higher skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541966128341979176)
- **bard codex success chance at 80 skill**: With a bard codex and only 80 skill, the lowest bard success chance is about 53%, because the codex's 120 skill bonus does not apply at that skill level and the codex goes off the lowest printed skill of the three bard skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522363246856638635)
- **bard command summoner build**: A bard version of the command summoner build would likely drop Veterinary and Inscription in favor of Discordance and Musicianship, and Evaluating Intelligence variants are probably better with Eldritch or Death aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547218859084226691)
- **bard dexxer archery template**: The bard dexxer archery template is not damage optimized and is meant as group support; the solo version uses chivalry and alchemy instead of healing and anatomy, and provocation instead of musicianship (unlocked via the bard codex). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534918019237806220)
- **bard dexxer leveling method**: A bard dexxer levels by peacing monsters and hitting them with a staff while leveling the lyric aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521077664746569779)
- **bard difficulty**: Bard is easy as long as the player can successfully keep a target barded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547970588583272550)
- **bard focus chivalry silver links**: With the Focus chivalry setup on a bard build, a player likely needs 2 silver links to cap out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524518503212646454)
- **bard instrument choice**: A bard does not need to equip an instrument; magic instruments are preferred over crafted ones, using Supremely tier or one tier lower if unaffordable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527982565594632273)
- **bard link priority after efb**: After the first few EFB links, bards should prioritize links that add lightning damage to barded targets or damage dealt by the player, which is considered solid multiplicative damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538693348288626798)
- **bard mage summoner mana regen**: A bard mage summoner template has 0 mana regeneration and refund, so it cannot actively cast spells and can only be played as a passive summoner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532716159961534545)
- **bard musicianship and provocation**: Once the bard codex is up and running, a bard can drop Musicianship in favor of Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531119883314794737)
- **bard npc training cap**: Bard NPCs only train Musicianship/Barding up to 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530431210986279064)
- **bard passive buffs value**: The passive buffs from bard skills are strong enough on their own to justify taking the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522367865058103487)
- **bard self taught buff requirements**: The bard Self Taught buff appears on the buff bar only when all three bard skills (provocation, discordance, peacemaking) have sufficient skill, for example all three set to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547672288973951016)
- **bard skill and group size overkill thresholds**: Barding skill beyond about 240-250 total is overkill except for Omni and Time content, and song buffs for groups beyond 10 to 12 are overkill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542597951673729136)
- **bard skill and melee compatibility**: The skill under discussion is a bard skill requiring Musicianship; a melee fighter can also be a bard, and a bard summoner build reportedly works, though the speaker is not fully certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526183118514421760)
- **bard skill buffs**: Each bard skill can give you and your followers a significant buff in addition to its effects on monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552186642658238516)
- **bard skill builds**: Bard builds are 120/120/120 or 80/80/80 in the bard skills; both use 100 Tactics, 80 weapon skill and 80 Alchemy, leaving about 100 flex points for 120 (often Chivalry for utility and resurrection in groups) or about 220 for 80 (Item ID, Chivalry, Arms Lore; default 120 Chivalry and 100 Arms Lore). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542551841303437494)
- **bard skill dual effects**: Each bard skill has two effects: using it on a mob applies a debuff or crowd control, while using it on the ground or an object produces a buff or bard song. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541542426533953627)
- **bard skill spread for solo vs group**: A 3x80 bard (80 in each bard skill) is better for soloing because it leaves room for enough combat skills, while a 3x120 bard is best for group play where support matters more than personal damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542551787125350503)
- **bard skill swapping**: After bard skills have been used as supplementals to raise codex, aspect or chain levels, those skills can be swapped out for other skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526150456764534864)
- **bard skill training**: To train the bard skills, macro them at the previous zoo until each skill is at least 80, then turn on Self-Taught. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553802181889757298)
- **bard skills and explosion potions**: Bard skills strongly increase the damage of explosion potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523536158162685993)
- **bard skills not working**: If bard skills stop working, say [stats and check the durability of your instrument, since a worn-out instrument can stop them from working. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544961333261377646)
- **bard skills on the ocean**: Bard skills may not work on the ocean, with only discordance mentioned as usable, but this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539231635655106682)
- **bard skills training time**: Training all four bard skills to 100 reportedly takes at least a couple of days, possibly around three full days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544651823174914059)
- **bard skills with self taught**: When Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance are used together with Self Taught, they all need to be at the same level; if one is at 100 the others at 120 work as if they are at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522967160639459649)
- **bard song damage scaling**: Bard songs and Discordance are said to provide multiplicative damage, similar to Herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542480814191812709)
- **bard song macroing with codex**: With the Bard codex and the Lyric aspect, a bard can macro all three songs directly without needing the Musicianship skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528520398407209011)
- **bard song range limit**: Bard songs have a maximum range of 50 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541761035059331102)
- **bard summoner template**: For a bard summoner, put bard codex points into Self Taught and replace Musicianship with Peacemaking, giving 80 each in Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530688469117177896)
- **bard syop before virtuoso when soloing**: When playing a Bard solo, the SYOP tier should be taken before Virtuoso; SYOP is preferred for solo play and not SYOP for group content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549826958656016457)
- **bard syop usage**: Most bard players max out SYOP unless they are always in a group. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552104276673957979)
- **bard tamer 100/100/100 build with command aspect**: A bard tamer using the Command aspect can run 100/100/100 barding skills with 12 silver effective barding and a supreme instrument, which lands most of the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546286541620650167)
- **bard tamer skill mixing**: Mixing a bard tamer with melee or mage skills is discouraged because it gives up follower damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546620423397965935)
- **bard tamer song failure mitigation**: A bard tamer reduces failed songs by using Effective Barding Chance and Follower Damage links together with the bard book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527941457070133258)
- **bard tamer template**: A common bard tamer template uses peacemaking, discordance, and provocation as its barding skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521954197367423106)
- **bard targeting difficulty**: If bard songs are failing on mobs, targeting lower difficulty mobs helps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544991308454699009)
- **bard training instruments**: Basic instruments for training bard can be bought from NPC vendors and are cheaper than crafted ones, which are unnecessary for training alone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538895945381454004)
- **bard-heavy character build role**: A character with many skill points in Bard skills is built as a support rather than a damage dealer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533498742223802430)
- **bardic skills in kill speed**: Bardic skills do not speed up kills because they are gated by a skill timer; barding only buffs and provokes while pets do the killing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546230285992198155)
- **barding codex point order**: Spend Barding Codex points first on Self Taught until an instrument is no longer needed, then max Perfect Pitch for more barding chance, then invest in the damage options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555524081879617569)
- **barding ground versus enemy targeting**: Barding skills targeted on the ground apply buff songs, while barding skills targeted on an enemy make you do more damage and crowd-control that enemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521957974791422103)
- **barding skill cap and lyric aspect**: The Barding skill can be raised to 120 with a scroll, and the Lyric Aspect gives a bonus to Barding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554924348865904681)
- **barding skill links for bard abilities**: Skill-heavy builds need effective barding skill links to make good use of bard skill abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551614936218869771)
- **barding skill requirement by dungeon depth**: Lower barding skill is acceptable for newer players, but deeper dungeons generally require more barding, and the difference between high and low barding is mainly how tolerant you are of failures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550910645908672655)
- **barding skill requirements with lyric aspect**: As Lyric aspect levels and mastery chain links are gained, the barding skills (Provocation, Peacemaking, Discordance) can be lowered from 100 to 80 each without losing effectiveness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **barding skill synergy**: Successfully applied barding skills raise the chance that other barding skills land; peace plus discordance is typical for soloing a mob, and provocation plus discordance for multiple mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522815075713290400)
- **barding skills on party members**: For barding skills to apply to party members, the Sing Your Own Praises perk must be maxed out and the party option ticked in the Bard Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552511438411530292)
- **barding song range**: A player benefits from a Barding song (Provocation, Peacemaking, Discordance) only when within 50 tiles of the bard who created it; if multiple bards are in range, the highest valued version is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529595392776208566)
- **bartender template**: The Bartender Template consists of Alchemy, Cooking, Evaluating Intelligence, Peacemaking, Poisoning, Spirit Speak and Taste Identification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526966867061772530)
- **basic dex tamer template**: A basic low-link dex tamer template is 120 in all four tamer skills plus 80 in a dex weapon skill, tactics and arms lore, or two 80 weapon skills to level codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526377134854115488)
- **battle trainer dummy healing training**: You can heal the battle trainer dummy with bandages to train healing-related skills, and double-clicking bandages and targeting the trainer shows your skill gain chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529787055238807582)
- **battle trainer npc locations**: Several battle trainer NPCs are placed around the world, with the one at the Prevalia moongate being the main public one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529277254314623117)
- **battle trainer skill gain**: Attacking a battle trainer raises the same combat skills as hitting regular mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530534316168187944)
- **battle trainers above 80 skill**: There are no safe-zone battle trainers for skills above 80; trainers outside Shelter are located in or on the lawn of players' homes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526223672161992804)
- **battletrainer dummy aggro**: Aggro behavior on the battletrainer dummy is erratic, especially when other players are nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539427763105042512)
- **beach stealth hiding spot**: A spot two tiles from the house on the beach is used for hiding to raise stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521557430830497822)
- **bedroll logout requirement**: Using a bedroll to log out requires the Camping skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528670286839287839)
- **begging among boaters**: Most boaters do not have begging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528025039805350028)
- **begging for boat crew**: Using the begging skill to obtain boat crew members is very poor and not worth considering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534333358883078174)
- **begging skill training**: Train begging on a small boat on water, where it trains very fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529274608463773828)
- **best fishing build**: After the last patch, the best fishing build is 120 cartography, 120 fishing, 120 focus/forensic evaluation, 100 chivalry, 100 tactics, 80 anatomy and 80 healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540980034460975144)
- **best pvm template for skinning**: Backstabbers are the best pick for a PvM character that can optimally run skinning, with a spell-damage based summoner as an alternative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532714238781427732)
- **best tamer build for treasure maps**: A mage tamer with cartography is considered better for treasure maps than a bard tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538293091302244393)
- **best way to level harvesting skills**: Regular harvesting has always been considered the best way to level harvesting skills, because it also earns gold, unlike resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528212023228370966)
- **blacksmithing 120 iron ingot cost**: Raising Blacksmithing to 120 requires roughly 7.2 million gold worth of iron ingots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527271330964307978)
- **blacksmithing and carpentry training value**: Blacksmithing and carpentry are considered not worth training by one player, except possibly for the free ingots and boards gained from breaking down magic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531388668097593402)
- **blacksmithing value for pvm**: Blacksmithing is considered a mostly useless skill for PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542224599805337652)
- **blank map vendor in prev**: The shop next to the bank in Prev sells blank maps, which can be used to train cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527257906490245151)
- **blood and air aspects**: Blood aspect or air aspect may slightly improve stats and speed up skill training, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541722238070292511)
- **blood armor at 45 dex**: Running blood armor at 45 dex on an arcane build prevents swapping armors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531334290862903348)
- **blood wrestler build**: A blood wrestler build can use 120 arms lore, 120 chivalry, 80 wrestling, 100 tactics, 40 focus, 80 parry, 80 healing and 100 anatomy with damage-to-bleed links; it is tanky with testudo and 120 arms lore gives the finisher at 35% almost every time with 50% SSI, and a variant with alchemy and parry needs 5 gold SS links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535855765842043000)
- **boat crew begging motivation**: Begging on a boat's crew can be macroed, and the motivation buff does not need to wear off before the crew can be motivated again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539305718220324894)
- **boating fishing skill reduction**: Once accuracy is high enough, a boating character can lower Fishing to 80 and spend the freed 20 skill points elsewhere, such as Chivalry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545480820977041498)
- **bonus skill gain for gathering and crafting**: There is no bonus skill gain chance for gathering and crafting skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543784149968486583)
- **break barriers bonuses**: Break Barriers grant a damage bonus and a damage resistance bonus against the creature, each equal to 20% times the highest printed Barding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525179472519626872)
- **buffing others with bard songs**: To buff other players with bard songs, target the ground when casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541759581938647102)
- **build skill synergy**: Trying to do too much with one build generally makes a character bad at everything, so builds need skill synergy to be effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554284810816458847)
- **bushido availability**: Bushido does not exist in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527782596518482031)
- **butler accuracy and swing speed check**: Check the butler for accuracy and swing speed calculations and get as close to max on both as possible while still fitting in defensive skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527005262651719853)
- **butler barding page discord first toggle**: The Outlands Butler barding page has a 'Discord first' toggle in the top right that shows your Peacemaking and Provocation success chance against a discorded target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541963377667080193)
- **butler tool lockpicking info**: The Butler tool lists lockpicking information, including chest levels and required skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532131197009002707)
- **buying starting skill points from alchemist**: A player does not need to level a skill from 0; the first 50 points can be bought from an alchemist for 500 gold coin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522743441157521559)
- **camouflage for pilfering**: Camouflage from the thieves codex helps avoid being revealed while pilfering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552080767838855309)
- **camping after 120 and carry capacity**: After 120 Camping, players can get effective camping links and unlock redline for more carry capacity, with the carry limit possibly around 1000 stones before further increases become unrealistic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535704335634407544)
- **camping and forensic evaluation on hidden build**: On a hidden-style build, players recommend raising Camping and Forensic Evaluation to 120 instead of Tracking, and Camping also helps with looting dead players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555043531142201395)
- **camping and spirit speak bonuses**: Camping provides extra carry weight, and Spirit Speak gives a small buff to your summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550334799951040523)
- **camping and stealth combined training script**: To train Camping and Stealth together, stay near a campfire while training Stealth; a script can double-click kindling from the backpack to create a campfire whenever none is nearby and Camping skill is below 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554912034225659905)
- **camping and stealth training together**: Camping and Stealth can be trained at the same time as long as the character is near a campfire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554912034225659905)
- **camping custom atlas spots**: With Camping you can set up to 3 custom spots in your Atlas and hike to them; the Atlas also lists every city, gate, point of interest and dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537135454586146898)
- **camping on thief build**: Camping is not needed on a thief build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543138026987851816)
- **camping requirement for hiking**: At least 60 Camping is needed on a template to use Hiking, which is recommended for wilderness play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542211316163412079)
- **camping skill and poison**: The Camping skill does not boost poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547058238640365691)
- **camping skill for heavy loot runs**: Camping skill is beneficial for players running harvest and T4-5 maps because it lets them carry more loot without hitting the weight limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542354237290315816)
- **camping skill for resource mappers**: Resource mappers do not need the Camping skill, since they can recall out or find a nearby forge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531432212703215697)
- **camping skill hiking ability**: The Camping skill includes the hiking ability, which is why it is often mistaken as a requirement for treasure map hiking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538226703069880330)
- **camping skill requirement**: Only 60 Camping skill is needed to access all elements of the skill, including locations and custom spots; older requirements that scaled up to 120 no longer apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527322597459496991)
- **camping skill training**: Train Camping by making campfires in the shelter dungeon up to 80 skill, then make campfires and stand near them outside of shelter island to progress beyond 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541969973780549752)
- **camping skill usage**: Camping is only used in some tamer and backstabber templates that have spare skill room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523286118387159060)
- **camping training in inn**: Camping skill can be trained AFK inside your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539593562411372654)
- **camping versus bleed and disease**: Camping helps mitigate bleed and disease damage-over-time effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541912954537115780)
- **camping versus meditation on gatherers**: Camping can be a better skill choice than Meditation on a gatherer, and 120 in the harvest skill is often unnecessary with a decent harvest aspect or a few harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550584292357443626)
- **camping vs forensics dungeon time**: Running Camping fills the player with gold quickly so they leave the dungeon early, while running Forensics lets them take leather instead of gold and stay in the dungeon longer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524840431433814118)
- **carpentry training automation**: Carpentry training does not need to be scripted because automated crafting with material restocking is built into the Outlands crafting queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525500001894269038)
- **cartography 120 for resource maps**: 120 Cartography may be needed to execute all Resource Maps, depending on how upcoming patches play out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **cartography alt for map decoding**: Most players put Cartography on an alt character for decoding maps, and a fishing character would not want Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521387397936316526)
- **cartography alternative in seafaring build**: If you don't want cartography in a seafaring or fishing build, you can swap it out for arms lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539458464311418921)
- **cartography and chivalry skill split**: With the upcoming cartography changes, a recommended split is 120 cartography and 100 chivalry rather than the reverse, though this is speculative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533727021329416334)
- **cartography and spirit speak tradeoff**: If you are not doing tier 8 treasure maps, you can lower Cartography to make room for Spirit Speak. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536975694008164432)
- **cartography buff**: Cartography was buffed and is now worth having on the character who actually does the treasure mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549793341846323221)
- **cartography damage bonus**: Cartography gives the player a large damage boost but does not add damage to pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542193754100736100)
- **cartography echo for treasure maps**: Cartography can be placed in an echo slot (such as the Forensic Evaluation/skinning slot) so the character can skin in dungeons and then use the cartography echo when doing treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552417646019084299)
- **cartography for fishing competition**: During peak hours with many fishers on the ocean, running 100 cartography helps compete for fishing spots; off-peak, competition is low and those skill points are better spent on a damage-increasing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527654040736104550)
- **cartography for resource maps**: Cartography is easy to macro to 100, and with 100 Cartography and a good spyglass (e.g. valorite) a player can decipher most needed resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530178520045588581)
- **cartography forensics treasure map template**: An upcoming treasure map update is expected to allow a cartography forensics template for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530578580508114955)
- **cartography full backpack behavior**: When training Cartography with a full backpack, crafted maps fall at your feet instead of stopping the crafting queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540782132826143)
- **cartography hiking ability**: Cartography is said to have the same Hiking ability as Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540030110001012768)
- **cartography needs for tamers on treasure maps**: Tamers running treasure maps with pets only need enough Cartography to read the map, because 120 Cartography does not boost pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542193754100736100)
- **cartography training cost to 120**: Reaching 120 cartography takes about 15,000 blank maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539458464311418921)
- **cartography treasure chest solo handling**: With Cartography, one character can bring up a treasure chest, kill its guardians, then open and loot the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541795230859141220)
- **cartography usefulness**: Cartography is mainly useful only for treasure maps and boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552402912708137083)
- **carving another player's monster corpse**: To carve another player's monster corpse, for example to train Forensic Evaluation, target the corpse with the carve instead of using self-targeting; you cannot open the corpse but the carve still happens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544141356706832395)
- **casting summon spells in inn room**: Summoning spells used for training can be cast inside your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526975029122961408)
- **cave bears as starter tames**: Cave bears can be found on Shelter Island and are considered among the best tame options for a new tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552855138073448529)
- **cave bears training spot**: Cave bears on the second floor of the new player dungeon can be used to train a skill up to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535398734400069694)
- **chain link skill bonuses and skill cap**: Skill bonuses from chain links are not affected by the skill cap, but they do not enable codexes because a printed skill is required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531608764325826620)
- **chain upgrade method**: To upgrade chains, train Forensic Evaluation and Camping scavenging until you get silver links on your command chain first, then on your mage chain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531669646120325210)
- **changing active character skills**: You can change your Active Character skills at any point; to raise a skill on a snapshotted echo, switch to that template (for example a 100 alchemy template) and increase the skill without needing to snapshot again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521843436913819689)
- **changing class**: Players can change class at any time by manually retraining skills or by purchasing an echo to flip between builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545711828267565057)
- **changing skills**: Skills and stats are easy and fast to change at any time, and retraining can be done AFK over a night or two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550387661972316295)
- **changing skills in outlands**: Once the appropriate codex and aspects are leveled, skills are easy to move around in Outlands, though raising a skill such as Inscription to 120 has a cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524783419907899513)
- **changing stats**: To change stats, set the stat locks (up, down, locked) to the desired configuration and then use any skill so stats shift accordingly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523053838574157864)
- **cheap aspect core templates**: Templates using cheap aspect cores, such as the discipline aspect, make aspects easier to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554431582063038505)
- **checking skill mastery scroll consumption**: Use the [skillmastery command to view skill mastery status, which can be used to verify how many scrolls were consumed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535072194617548822)
- **checking skill total against cap**: To deduct any tactics bonus when checking skill totals against the cap, press 'show real' on the skill scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534843577807536260)
- **cheesing scavenger template**: The Cheesing Scavenger template uses Hiding, Stealth and Camping at 100, with optional Magery and Resisting Spells, Thieve's Codex, Shadow Aspect, and a 2x Strongbox upgrade (5M total) that doubles the gold you can carry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866523044024390)
- **cheesy scavenger as mule**: Adding Magery to the Cheesy Scavenger character makes it a fine mule character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521202299702214787)
- **cheesy scavenger optional additions**: The Cheesy Scavenger character can add Frost Aspect Tier 0 and some defensive skills, and a Thieves codex increases stealth steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521201916900671510)
- **chest picking progress percentage**: The progress percentage shown while picking a chest is the progress on the chest, not the character's skill level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525880842855907399)
- **chest picking thief build**: To build a chest-picking thief, level Stealing and Snooping to join the Thieves Guild, level the Thieves Codex and take the perk that substitutes Hiding for Snooping so Snooping can be dropped, then train the chest picking skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547332435815956602)
- **chivalry auto-cast on training dummies**: Chivalry codex abilities auto-cast only when hitting mobs, not when hitting a battle trainer dummy, so nothing in the Chivalry codex needs to be used on the dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528368738867351695)
- **chivalry buff icon behavior**: The Chivalry buff icon disappears whenever you gain skill in Chivalry, which stops mattering once training is finished. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546146207141732413)
- **chivalry for backstabber healing**: Chivalry is acceptable for healing early on, but it becomes useless once you progress the Thieves Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522016165386522735)
- **chivalry for poisoning builds**: Poisoning builds typically do not need Chivalry, which provides paladin-style spell effects that can buff swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544543923983224953)
- **chivalry gain from battle trainer**: A Book of Chivalry must be in your inventory for chivalry to gain when hitting a battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537785285365071902)
- **chivalry gain from punching colossal frog**: Chivalry can be gained by punching a colossal frog without killing it; a tamer who tames and releases the frog stops it attacking back, or a second-account tamer can leave a pet in Shelter after 'all stay' for the main character to punch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539955381982199899)
- **chivalry in archery builds**: Archery builds include Chivalry for Divine Fury, which grants swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525541876562661588)
- **chivalry on aspect builds**: Chivalry is optional on an Air build but desirable on every other aspect build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529177896692879531)
- **chivalry on poison dexxer**: Chivalry is nearly worthless on a poison dexxer because chivalry (red) damage is only about 2% of total damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522041726011707582)
- **chivalry pairing with holy aspect**: Holy aspect melee builds should be paired with 120 Chivalry for extra symbols and more swing speed and damage buff output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522957446727991378)
- **chivalry skill set**: Chivalry in Outlands consists almost entirely of support-type skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536552264028655822)
- **chivalry to 120**: Chivalry should eventually be raised to 120, but only once aspect level provides enough accuracy that focus or swords skill points can be sacrificed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543665630954131598)
- **chivalry training method**: Chivalry levels like tactics and weapon skills, simply by attacking things; healing is not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522366267577733205)
- **chivalry training on shelter**: To train Chivalry, find the paladin NPC; on Shelter the paladin is in the room east of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526563809609781371)
- **closed-door building for taming training**: Training taming in a closed-door building in a less popular town keeps the tame target from wandering and lowers the chance other players interfere with your script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533918349950582814)
- **codex bard skill drop order**: A codex bard with pets should drop Peacemaking before Provocation, because the provocation song is quite good while the peace song is mediocre and rarely lands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526577729221296300)
- **codex completion skill requirements**: Running 80/80/80 in two weapon skills and tactics is reported as sufficient to complete codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531406408145309947)
- **codex experience gain speed**: Except for archer tamers, there is effectively no way to speed up codex experience gain; the codex must be used to gain it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553855150601408723)
- **codex nerf effect on arcanist**: After the codex nerf, arcanist can no longer run 80/80 skill splits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528141416084013307)
- **codex on gathering characters**: A codex is not recommended on a miner or lumberjack character because it will not be killing mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537751459137982474)
- **codex priority**: When choosing a codex, your offensive skill, such as swordsmanship or wrestling, should typically take first priority. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524476111516340415)
- **codex skill requirements**: Codices require certain skills, usually 80 Tactics, and possibly 80 in a related skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891821018939503)
- **codex xp from bard skills**: Raise all three bard skills to 80 and let pets carry you there quickly; once two skills are at 80, the codex gains XP regardless of whether you use the music skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535679338140278804)
- **colored materials skill gain**: Colored materials have the same skill gain chance as iron, and after 100 harvest skill you can only gain from colored nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545831570710204527)
- **combat skill gain location**: After leaving Shelter Island, combat skill gain is likely the same wherever you fight, so a training dummy with 100% combat engagement would likely be the fastest option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543624847010177134)
- **combat skill improvement**: Combat skills improve through use, such as hitting a monster with a sword to raise Swords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547899728887291925)
- **combat skill training path to 100**: Train a combat skill such as swords or wrestling to 80 by fighting in the Shelter dungeon, then use a battle trainer to leave it hitting the trainer until 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526219378843062464)
- **combined wrestling tracking and spirit speak training**: To train Wrestling, Tracking and Spirit Speak together on Shelter Island, start Tracking (which repeats automatically), run a loop for Spirit Speak, and attack the wrestling trainer NPC in the south west of the island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667682721202208)
- **command aspect experience from pet damage**: Command aspect experience is reportedly gained from pet damage even if the player does not hit the monster with the crook, though this is stated as a question and not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522374512132358304)
- **command weapon aspect for poison tamer**: A poison tamer can use a command weapon aspect as an alternative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542308092447039538)
- **commodity boards for carpentry training**: Commodity boards can be used to level carpenters up to 120 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529852835775123657)
- **common build skill requirements**: Many builds only need 80 arms lore, healing and anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529268060907765790)
- **container wands for identification**: Container wands remove the tedium of identifying items one by one and can identify a whole full container of 125 items at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451740733677640)
- **container wands with 120 item id**: Container wands can also be used with 120 Item ID, which requires obtaining the 20 skill scrolls for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451996414255226)
- **content requiring 40 magery**: Some things cannot be done without 40 Magery, so a build with no Magery will hit limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541794674912657488)
- **continuous chest picking**: To pick chests continuously, double-click the chest rather than using lockpicks or the trap removal tool directly; the gump offers continuous remove trap or lockpick, and you should run remove trap first, then lockpick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550335876608032901)
- **continuous lockpicking option**: The lockpicking window has a Continuous Lockpicking checkbox that makes the character keep trying automatically until it succeeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525879667586764860)
- **converting a character to a new build**: To convert an existing character to a different build, set the old skills to lower and raise the new build's skills; as new skills are trained, the old ones go down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527390809115070625)
- **converting archer backstabber to thieves codex**: Drop Arms Lore for 80 Stealing and Tracking for 100 Snooping, then do 1-tile archery backstabs until 15 codex points; at 5 points drop Tactics or Snooping, at 10 drop the other, and at 15 get Ransack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546986640973758625)
- **converting tamer to mapper**: If you already have a tamer character, you can convert it to a mapper easily by using an echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541897479048396830)
