- **cooking artisan experience**: Cooking gives low Artisan experience and will not noticeably advance it, though an achievement exists for reaching 120 cooking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522536343446753381)
- **cooking buffs**: Cooking gives a swing speed buff, an additional mushroom use, and a snack that restores health, stamina and mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545558831814418505)
- **cooking for mage mana potions**: Cooking can provide an additional minor mana potion for mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522910988855152690)
- **cooking for pvm and endgame**: Cooking is a fine side skill for regular PvM but is not a good option for endgame content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539225514613538827)
- **cooking in arcane mage build**: Cooking is a preference or alternative option for an Arcane Mage build rather than the meta choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536198760705818686)
- **cooking snacking bonus for arcane mage**: Cooking has a snacking bonus, which is a reason to choose it over Taste Identification for an Arcane Mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536412425086046238)
- **copying 120 forensics echo character**: Copying a 120 forensics echo character saves several tens of hours of farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537913800177491979)
- **cost of 120 skill with two link skills**: A 120 skill that also requires 2 link skills is expensive; it is fine for high-tier arcane builds but a trap otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550492539377950880)
- **crafter skill priority**: For a crafting and item identification character, the suggested skill order is tailoring, item identification, then alchemy, with tinkering last because it is far more expensive; 80 magery and inscription can be added later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634527851323496)
- **crafter template skill caps**: A crafter template can have 6 skills at 120 without Magery, or 5 skills at 120 with 100 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533031597119508583)
- **crafter training order on extra accounts**: Players generally train tailoring and alchemy again on a second and third account before training skills like smithing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542449018234212404)
- **crafting from bank box at outpost**: At the outpost behind the bank by the pole, a tinker can reportedly craft directly from the bank box and sell the results to an NPC; Horse Shoe Bay's bank may offer the same, which is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549905163894923295)
- **crafting jobs in shelter**: Doing crafting jobs for other players in Shelter grants Artisan experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522536310055764019)
- **crafting skill gain in sanctuary**: Crafting skills such as Carpentry do not get a skill gain bonus in the Sanctuary dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530619792174747810)
- **crafting skills with 80 magery skill cap**: A single character cannot fit 120 in every crafting skill together with 80 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523734825868197958)
- **crafting starting skill level savings**: Starting a crafting skill at 60 instead of 50 saves a few thousand resources when training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533030995086020768)
- **create food for evaluating intelligence training**: Casting Create Food, which makes many mushrooms, is a good way to train Evaluating Intelligence, and casting it from scrolls is the best method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546678486692003911)
- **create food mana cost**: Create Food with 3 points in the Codex costs about 25 mana, and the cost may scale with Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529562622104440945)
- **creature catalog summons list**: The summons covered by the Creature Catalog upgrades are listed on the Spirit Speak and Necromancy wiki pages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523459098148868108)
- **crew buffs for boaters**: Boaters can push their effective skill beyond the normal range by using crew buffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526795418787385355)
- **crook macefighting training**: Hitting things with a crook equipped raises Macefighting skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524892538828488836)
- **cross healing with veterinary**: You can bandage yourself using the Veterinary skill (cross healing), though it is less effective than using Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522205515239788666)
- **crossover skill requirements for cure and resurrection**: Using crossover skills to cure requires 60 or higher in both skills, and resurrection requires 80 or higher in both skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538887350271344691)
- **cuo skinning hotkey macro**: In the CUO options from the paperdoll, a skinning hotkey can be built with the macro steps: useskillforensic, waitfortarget, targetself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530556464773726239)
- **dagger as training weapon**: A dagger is treated more as a tool than a weapon, so players should train weapon skills with an actual weapon matching the skill they want to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531190207355818007)
- **damage increase options besides alchemy**: Besides Alchemy, damage can be increased by adding a second weapon skill, using Camping, Tracking or Forensics for additive damage bonuses, or using Item ID with magic weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524951804318584832)
- **damaged town critters**: Town critters like cats are often below full health because players or their scripts attack them, sometimes aggroing many to train Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551605839695970466)
- **death dexxer dex links**: A death dexxer uses standard dex links: melee special, swing speed, damage to diseased, and damage by player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532109667541712936)
- **death knight build skills**: A true Death Knight build requires Magery, Necromancy, Fencing, Tactics, Parry, Poisoning, Taste Identification and Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534582662776492284)
- **death knight template magery requirement**: The Death Knight template still requires Magery, which makes it a hard sell for players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531080741570609162)
- **default skill gain settings**: New characters have every skill set to increase by default, so with a 700 cap you must set unwanted skills to decrease or lock so wanted skills can go up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918564781072425)
- **default skill lock state on new characters**: A newly created character has every skill set to increase (up), so skills the build does not need must be set down manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549591418916446361)
- **defensive mage scavenger build**: A mage scavenger focused on defense and speed can use Magery, Parry and Resisting Spells, and a paralyze spell or a wall resolves most dangerous situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524838539550920806)
- **defensive skills in scavenger builds**: A scavenger build without Lockpicking has room for defensive skills; scavenging is still doable without them if you move well, and they matter most when a red player tries to PvP you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530542172041117747)
- **delectable food meditation bonus**: Eating delectable food grants a 5% meditation rate bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526656256914489374)
- **deleting skills**: A skill cannot be deleted; it can only be set to 0 and ignored. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553257198979776573)
- **desirable tamed dragon stats**: Desirable stats on a tamed dragon are 4%+ speed, 8%+ damage and 8%+ wrestling; if not all can be had, speed and damage matter most. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487900019269743)
- **detect hidden and trap cooldown**: Detect Hidden affects trap cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250969782681780)
- **detect hidden and trap disarming**: Detect Hidden disarms traps, so a lockpicker will want it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523743135849644113)
- **detect hidden bonus for revealing players**: Detecting Hidden gives no bonus for revealing hidden players unless the skill is GM, so 80 Detect Hidden is useless for that purpose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533883527958102268)
- **detect hidden effect on trap cooldown**: Detect Hidden shortens the player's trap cooldown, which is (40 - (0.5 * (Detect Hidden skill - 80))) seconds, so higher Detect Hidden means a lower cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538779666264096778)
- **detect hidden success rate**: Detect Hidden at 80 skill has an 80% success rate within 8 tiles, and tracking increases the detection distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521434874517393538)
- **detect hidden training 80 to 100**: To train Detect Hidden from 80 to 100, use a locksmith training box and remove trap tools from a provisioner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546499753360105593)
- **detect hidden usefulness**: Detect Hidden is useful for revealing very sneaky hidden players that a tracking script may not pick up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543052329656254604)
- **detecting hidden training**: Detecting Hidden can be trained by keeping it running with a looping macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522959510241673326)
- **dex tamer codex leveling**: A dex tamer is a great way to level codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541533884586664066)
- **dex tamer dual wield option**: A dex tamer can take dual wield instead of one of the three weapon skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534969486283768099)
- **dex tamer filler skills**: Spare points on a dex tamer template can be filled with arms lore, parrying, extra weapon skill or camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522365431405350913)
- **dex tamer hinder and alchemy requirement**: Hinder is why dex tamer is stronger on the hardest timed-level content, and Alchemy is required for that build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546622404435120248)
- **dex tamer viability**: A dex tamer is possible under the skill cap but is not nearly as tanky as a pure dex build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532568474776375356)
- **dexterity and archery gain chance**: Lower dexterity, which gives a slower swing speed, may give a higher chance to gain Archery skill per shot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523022630616305817)
- **dexxer chivalry skill level**: Most players expect a dexxer to have 120 chivalry, which is very useful especially in group play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521107923428835438)
- **dexxer magery vs alchemy allocation**: A dexxer is better off putting 10 points into Alchemy for longer-lasting buff potions than taking 40 Magery, though this is a tentative personal preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **dexxer minimum magery**: A dexxer needs at least 30 Magery to cast wall, teleport, magic arrow and telekinesis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **dexxer parrying skill points**: On a dexxer, dropping Arms Lore is the simplest way to free skill points for Parrying, and staying in crab stance is an alternative to picking up Parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548456541974167603)
- **dexxer pk chasing build**: To chase PKs, a dexxer should drop Arms Lore and take 100 Tracking with 20 Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554566555130396733)
- **dexxer pk skill adjustment**: A suggested dexxer PK adjustment is to lower arms lore to 80, drop alchemy to 20, and raise archery to 100, using both a bow and a mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529660398452736020)
- **dexxer recall and heal without magery**: A dexxer can recall and heal fine using dexxer skills without having Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541793964615671918)
- **dexxer skill gain**: Almost all dexxer skills (tactics, anatomy, parry, arms lore, focus, etc.) raise naturally while fighting, but Healing is reactive and only raises when you heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529182964083200121)
- **dexxer skill gains**: When a dexxer hits something, potential gains show for Chivalry, Weapon Skill, Anatomy, Tactics, Focus and Arms Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540066288628662292)
- **dexxer skinner skill points**: A dexxer who is also a skinner is tight on skill points because both builds compete for the same skill budget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535770034645901492)
- **dexxer spare skill points**: A dexxer can spend spare skill points on tracking, or shift points from tracking into magery to scroll-cast spells such as telekinesis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535497308349923348)
- **dexxer survivability with alchemy and chivalry**: Between alchemy and chivalry heals a dexxer can stay alive, so the healing skill can be dropped for arms lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521107923428835438)
- **dexxer template progression**: As a dexxer gets orbs and scrolls, raise Chivalry to 120, and when the aspect reaches level 10-12 move 20 points from weapon skill to arms lore, or do so sooner with the Discipline aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553775013813952523)
- **dexxer treasure map skill choice**: A dexxer treasure map build may be able to drop Arms Lore to make room for Cartography, though this is a guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538961493008326837)
- **direwolf taming**: Direwolves can be tamed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528457753511592007)
- **disarming magic trapped pouches**: Thieves likely cannot disarm a magic trapped pouch without setting it off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545799237525049425)
- **discipline wrestler arms lore tradeoff**: On a discipline wrestler, the tankier build that drops Arms Lore is preferred over the higher-damage build, since the damage loss from lacking Arms Lore is barely noticeable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536899821636554874)
- **disco bard skill requirements**: A disco bard build needs Musicianship to function, or alternatively both of the other bard skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542784415992774677)
- **discordance before peacemaking**: Use Discordance on the target first; once it succeeds, Peacemaking and Provocation have a higher chance to succeed on that target, so Peace it afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541962598160007179)
- **discordance debuff strength**: A successful Discordance applies a debuff of about 17% to the target, and the Reverb and Ensemble perks increase it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544678024337825803)
- **discordance success chance example**: Against a Vampiric Consort with 80 tribard, no links, no aspect, a supremely accurate instrument and 5 points in Perfect Pitch, the Buttler tool gives a Discordance success chance of 45%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544677643796877332)
- **discordance training enemy difficulty**: Training Discordance does not depend on the difficulty of the enemies used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537829820996788317)
- **discordance-only bard skills**: A bard who only wants to use Discordance must keep both Music and Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539575471417729095)
- **disposing of alchemy training potions**: Pour training potions into empty kegs and throw the kegs in the trash to get rid of them, unless this has changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532826788143697970)
- **divine fury macro while training at a dummy**: To keep Divine Fury active while training at a dummy, a looping macro can cast [DivineFury roughly every 30 seconds, though this is an untested suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539426041674600570)
- **divine fury versus enemy of one**: Divine Fury is a better choice than Enemy of One for a melee build because swing speed can only act as a multiplier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521560551879348234)
- **dockmaster tracking trainer**: The dockmaster on the dock down from the inn on Shelter Island may also teach Tracking, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555560179448283218)
- **downside of lower weapon skill**: The only downside of lower weapon skill is being hit by melee slightly more often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551407056064348191)
- **dragon vs monkey at low aspect**: At low aspect levels, Dragon may be preferable to Monkey because Monkey has accuracy issues and needs accuracy more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541116120013086760)
- **dropping healing and anatomy**: A character that relies on potions and Chivalry instead of bandages can drop Healing and Anatomy from its skill set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362117405282305)
- **dropping music via self taught**: Dropping Music requires 3 levels of Self Taught, which costs 5 codex points in total. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535161618512478239)
- **dropping parry for alchemy**: Dropping parry for alchemy is an endgame option for very experienced players who avoid mob special attacks, trading parry stance damage reduction for extra damage from purple potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543738795143204884)
- **dropping tracking for inscription**: Tracking can be dropped in favor of a crafting skill like Inscription once you no longer rely on tracking for survival and can afford the training costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544543983982743562)
- **dual wield and swords skill overlap**: Dual wielding and swords are both weapon skills, so a template should drop one and focus on the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544542785426821261)
- **dual wield bard template**: A dual wield bard template can use Alchemy at 80 and Focus at 70, with the swing speed gap filled by a couple of links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524887791266431088)
- **dual wield build skill**: A dual wield build should use Wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536157442944143392)
- **dual wielder swing speed requirement**: A dual wielder requires 10% less swing speed, which gives room to add Alchemy instead of Resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524491901594501362)
- **dual wielding chivalry gain**: Dual wielding may increase Chivalry through combat, with the related weapon skills (e.g. Tactics) reportedly needing to be at 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544744134496227368)
- **dull resource maps for lumberjacking gains**: Dull resource maps are better for pure lumberjacking skill gains because they contain more lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529114803273809)
- **dungeon chests for harvest aspect**: Opening dungeon chests raises Harvest Aspect quickly, but it is poorly suited to tamers because it requires stealthing around or acting as a teleport/rope ninja. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521056035584868412)
- **dungeon lockpicker carry capacity links**: A dungeon lockpicker build can use the Special Loot and Effective Camping links to gain extra carry capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550315938635718746)
- **dungeon lockpicker codex**: A dungeon lockpicker does not necessarily need a codex if the template has hide/stealth, though Thief's Codex may be useful if the character also backstabs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542212540292010136)
- **dungeon mining dexxer build play style**: A dungeon mining dexxer kills mobs with a pickaxe and mines ore while waiting for the mobs to respawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521386825095315486)
- **dungeon picking for harvesting**: Dungeon picking is not a fast way to level the Harvesting skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **dungeon picking xp for fortune echo**: Dungeon picking does not give enough XP to level the Fortune echo to T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529127777125793846)
- **dungeon stealth lockpicker dexterity**: A dungeon stealth lockpicker does not need much stamina; 25 dex is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527864464773349517)
- **dungeon versus battle trainer skill gain**: Skills gain faster when training in a dungeon than on a battle trainer because the chance to gain per hit is higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533448465072259182)
- **early backstab effectiveness**: Early in training, backstabbing cannot one-shot even easier mobs; Ettins take around 3 to 5 attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549616480683950151)
- **early mana recovery**: Meditation is the best option for restoring mana early on, since mana potions do not exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526008756746326078)
- **early stealing and hiding training location**: For early Stealing, Snooping and Hiding/Stealth training, use the dips on top of the trainer building on Shelter Island in the south west. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521241337377329153)
- **early summoner summon rotation**: A summoner should initially run double earth elementals while unlocking points in the summoner tome, then mix up summons to gain more tome points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521327835929772102)
- **earth aspect cost**: Earth Aspect is rather cheap, and a character does not have to take it all the way up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532111994239320134)
- **earth elemental purge impurities special resistance**: In the summoner tome's Earth Elemental Purge Impurities ability, 'Special Resistance' refers to bleed and disease resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523892366761791598)
- **easy skills to macro**: Easy skills like Spirit Speak and Tracking always gain and are good to macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340620403347507)
- **ebs links for bard farming**: To set EBS links for bard farming, first ensure there are enough EBS links for the intended farming area, checking mob difficulty against the barding calculator on Outlands Butler and aiming for as close to 100% as possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541840798126182510)
- **echo alchemy training shortcut**: Using an echo for another build that has 120 Alchemy lets a player avoid training Alchemy to 80 twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553898267232960613)
- **echo for forensic evaluation**: An echo is useful for keeping a high Forensic Evaluation skill without grinding it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555522129116794891)
- **echo gathering skill split**: Unlocking an echo lets a player easily split gathering skills, such as mining and lumberjacking, across separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535305372238221414)
- **echo harvesting skill builds**: Proposed Echo harvesting builds are Ore Maps: 120 Mining, 120 Camping, 100 Magery, 100 Spirit Speak, 100 Wrestling, 100 Alchemy, 80 Resist; and Lumber Maps: 120 Lumberjacking, 120 Spirit Speak, 100 Magery, 100 Wrestling, 100 Alchemy, 80 Healing, 80 Anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532959316833996901)
- **echo retraining time**: Retraining on an echo reportedly takes a few days at most, and a stronger PvM template can be used to boost low-level aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521641177043177615)
- **efb links for 120 non-lyric bard**: A 120 non-lyric bard may not need Enemy of Fire Bard links; some run none, 1 or 2 may feel more comfortable, and 2 to 4 is roughly the maximum. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538692189792772119)
- **effective barding links to reach cap**: Running 10 gold effective barding links is reportedly enough to reach the barding cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553532643830661284)
- **effective barding with tri-bard**: A 110 tri-bard with maxed self taught and bronze links reaches roughly 180 effective barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550932673772388485)
- **effective fishing skill for sea serpents**: An effective fishing skill of 205 gives the best chance of a sea serpent spawn, and anything above 205 is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540255302408999052)
- **effective skill above 120 cap**: Effective skill from items or aspects can exceed the 120 skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545901742523416708)
- **effective skill and harvest success**: Per the Outlands wiki, effective skill only increases the success chance for harvesting specific materials, and 120 skill plus an avar nearly caps it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526279551683133693)
- **efficient backstab leveling**: To level backstab efficiently, pick a monster you can barely kill in one backstab, meaning its HP is roughly your average backstab damage (e.g. 4-5k HP for about 5k damage), preferably with low armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531756741715558420)
- **efficient crafting skill leveling**: To level a crafting skill efficiently, collect the full amount of resources needed to reach 100 first, then craft in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520497489994715259)
- **eldritch scroll keeping skill threshold**: A player in the Eldritch template needs well above 125 skill to keep scrolls, so a character already above that does not need the spirit speak or inscription links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541621938831495209)
- **elemental summon reagent costs**: Air, earth and water elemental summons are each 3-reagent casts, while fire elemental costs more, so water is not cheaper than the other non-fire elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549989221266227233)
- **escaped zoo anaconda fix**: If the zoo anaconda escapes its cage, lure it away from the cage area until it snaps back into its cage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524521170223894759)
- **evaluating intelligence and forensic evaluation cap**: Only one of Evaluating Intelligence or Forensic Evaluation can be run to 120 at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539377962309386241)
- **evaluating intelligence and greater heal**: Evaluating Intelligence does not boost the effectiveness of Greater Heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538393687174815754)
- **evaluating intelligence for beginning poison necromancer**: Evaluating Intelligence is worthwhile for a beginning poison necromancer because it is free and early poison damage is very low; Alchemy can become pretty good as poison damage increases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524418797380042903)
- **evaluating intelligence grimoire use**: Having 80 Evaluating Intelligence lets a player use the grimoire without Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526008063947964496)
- **example stealth scavenger skill build**: One example stealth scavenger build is 100 Camping, 100 Tracking, 100 Magery, 100 Meditation, 100 Hiding, 100 Stealth and 120 Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849981767163924)
- **exceptional instrument bonus**: An exceptional instrument gives +20 effective barding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522666152546013276)
- **exceptional iron lockpicks for level 6 chests**: Exceptional Iron lockpicks can handle level 6 chests easily, so the Gold tool can be saved for level 7-8 chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316727642886235)
- **extra skills for tamers in busy dungeons**: Skinning plus Camping, or Lockpicking and Thieving, are good extra skills for tamers who want to get value from busy dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543252428437200926)
- **faction spawn farming template**: A template of Lumberjacking 120, Swordsmanship 100, Tactics 100, Healing 80, Anatomy 80, Parrying 80, Resisting Spells 80 and Arms Lore 80 is suggested as sufficient if you only kill faction spawn mobs in faction dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552493140316004446)
- **farming level 7 and 8 spells**: Level 7 and level 8 spells cannot be farmed for skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554417794731348031)
- **fast fishing skill training**: To train fishing fast, buy fishing skill to 50 from an NPC, get a small or medium boat, and fish on the ocean to reach 120 in about 5-6 hours (some report 1-2 hours); alternatively AFK train with a harpoon on a battle trainer to 100 and from shore to 120, though shore fishing is not worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527310732163678249)
- **fast fishing skill training**: Train fishing quickly by fishing with fishing nets from a boat, especially where fishing spots spawn well; one player reports about 2 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540251494970818610)
- **fast fishing training**: Reach 80 Fishing at Shelter, then get a boat and fish at fishing spots using fishing nets for very quick skill gains; AFK macro fishing is much slower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527063403795841155)
- **fast meditation builds**: Fast meditation builds deal low damage, kill slowly and burn through many reagents or scrolls, so they end up slower overall than damage-focused builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526309389768720535)
- **fast parrying training in new player dungeon**: A fast way to train Parrying is to let mobs hit you; if under 80 skill, do this in the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527050762193080400)
- **fast skill training at shelter**: Skills such as Chivalry can be brought to 80 quickly at Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314411653496924)
- **faster veterinary training via poison**: A faster veterinary training method may exist that involves poisoning your pet and curing it with bandages, but details are unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550121133083197453)
- **fastest forensics training method**: Dullhide maps are reported as the fastest way to raise Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535797478463377499)
- **fastest harvesting skill training**: Fishing is much faster than any other method for raising Harvesting once the player gets past the large ocean learning curve; after fishing, the next fastest are treasure mapping and then lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **fastest necromancy training**: Casting a circle 1 Necromancy spell is the fastest way to gain Necromancy skill, either in the newplayer dungeon or at home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523738224164601986)
- **fastest way to raise dexterity**: Snooping is claimed to be the fastest way to raise Dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552428248464363632)
- **fe skill gain on pvm dexxer**: Gaining fe skill on a fully grown PvM dexxer is relatively easy but feels like a grind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552846080855515218)
- **fencer paladin build codex**: A fencer paladin build uses the Parry codex alongside the Chivalry book, with Alchemy as a possible later addition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523069599581737052)
- **fencing codex bonus requirement**: The Fencing codex bonus requires Tactics skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528796307563745444)
- **fencing focus pairing**: Fencing/Focus (FE) is best paired with bard, tamer or stabber for the best synergy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534460870640537620)
- **fencing skill level and accuracy**: Raising Fencing to 90% gives better hit accuracy than 80%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548228302806978651)
- **finisher unlock requirements**: Reaching Rank 5 in any Stance for a skill unlocks the first tier finisher, and each additional stance at Rank 5 unlocks an additional finisher tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **first fishing boat upgrades**: The first boat upgrades to buy for fishing are the fisherman outfitting and mariner's fortune, which give the best +fishing bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527083312655630586)
- **fisher echo chain experience**: Fishing on a fisher echo character with the harvest aspect gives decent chain experience, especially during guild boss and omni runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534202062001279036)
- **fisherman skill template**: A fisherman template can be 120 Fishing, 120 Forensic Evaluation, 100 Chivalry, 120 Tracking or Cartography, 100 Tactics, 80 Anatomy and 80 Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549750417397780521)
- **fishing as weapon skill**: Fishing already functions as a weapon skill, so adding mace or swords to a fisher template is unnecessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535321888321048587)
- **fishing from shore versus boat**: Fishing from shore is much slower than fishing from a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524183478974025820)
- **fishing skill and harvest aspect progression**: Fishing skill rises quickly while Harvest aspect levels slowly; Harvest aspect adds effective fishing skill, which raises spawn chances and yields more special fishing nets in the long run, and gaining Harvest by fishing is slow until the player learns the method, then becomes very fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550915330929598530)
- **fishing skill for land resource maps**: Fishing resource maps on land can be done without 120 fishing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553101282347319383)
- **fishing skill for special nets**: Fishing skill matters when casting special nets for MIB spawns, and the fishing calculator on Outlands Butler can be used to check the effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536479630855372901)
- **fishing skill for special nets and messages in a bottle**: Special fishing nets and messages in a bottle require a high adjusted fishing skill (roughly 180 for nets and roughly 203 for messages in a bottle), so skill 100 is too low and yields poor results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541276091665350707)
- **fishing skill gain from fighting**: Fishing skill can be raised by fighting, but only very slowly, and it does not raise while in sanctuary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362464760762409)
- **fishing skill in tamer tmap build**: In a tamer treasure map build the Fishing skill level is flexible, but it helps slightly with hitting command procs on the weapon, and fishing is ranged and needs no ammo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524365055125094611)
- **fishing skill range**: Fishing counts as a combat skill up to 100, and the range from 100 to 120 applies only to fishing and is mostly beneficial for MIBs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554360957260533861)
- **fishing skill requirement for codex**: 80 Fishing is reportedly enough to use the Fishing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542223841881751654)
- **fishing skill requirement for mibs**: Fishing up messages in bottles (MIBs) requires a high level of the Fishing skill, not just Tidings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553382823275143179)
- **fishing skill soft-cap**: The fishing soft-cap is 205 effective fishing skill, which is very hard to reach without the harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534240670171004978)
- **fishing skill training speed**: Fishing is a harvest skill that takes a very long time to raise without a boat and nets or many fishing maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554360957260533861)
- **fishing skill training with harvest aspect**: Harvest aspect combined with harvest links is likely sufficient for training fishing skill, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521687308565348402)
- **fishing template**: Dexxer is the most common template for fishing because fishing is treated as a melee combat skill and requires the fishing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539247955377127435)
- **fishing training to 120**: Fishing can reportedly be raised to 120 overnight by fishing at sea. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536154240546898014)
- **fishing training to grandmaster**: To train Fishing to GM, practice on a dummy up to 100 with a harpoon, then use fishing maps or special fishing spots depending on how fast you want to progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533184103292338286)
- **fishing xp rewards**: Fishing gives chain/redline XP, unlike most other harvesting, and much better harvest XP than mining, though sinking NPC ships gives more chain XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **fishing-only character skills**: A character that only fishes can run 120 Fishing and fill the remaining skills freely; most players use the harpooner template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539470799889768479)
- **fitting spirit speak into trapper build**: To fit Spirit Speak into a Trapper build, drop Lockpicking if you are not doing dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536509057311973507)
- **fixing failing bard skills without codex**: If you are ineligible for the codex and your bard skills are failing, train Discordance and Provocation up to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936550847447203)
- **fizzling at 100 magery**: A character with 100 Magery cannot fizzle a spell; failed casts at that skill are caused by being interrupted or lacking enough reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543435286334279680)
- **flame strike mana limit at 80 magery**: At around 80 Magery a mage can cast Flame Strike only about 3 times before needing to regenerate mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546260640996532235)
- **focus allocation on hybrid template**: On a hybrid PvM/PvP template, putting the 20 spare points into Magic Resist instead of Focus is a reasonable allocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522082448610037860)
- **focus and anatomy point tradeoffs**: Lowering Resist to 80 to raise Focus gains only about 1% swing speed but loses a lot of PvP resist, and lowering Anatomy to 80 gains about 2% swing speed but loses a lot of damage in PvM and PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543989128776122508)
- **focus and swing speed cap**: Focus should be lowered as swing speed becomes overcapped, since the excess provides no benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538638584343699587)
- **focus and swing speed for dual wield bards**: A dual wield bard can increase swing speed by putting more points into Focus and fewer into bard skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524888006559924345)
- **focus and swords accuracy**: Focus and swords both give accuracy, which is very important, so skill points should not be taken from them when 720 skill points are available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543665630954131598)
- **focus and taste identification relevance**: Focus is one of the most versatile skills now, while Taste Identification is basically only useful in poison templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523286934053458061)
- **focus effect on chance to hit**: The wiki states that Focus affects chance to hit, though this is a single player's report of the wiki and is unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529235141858164908)
- **focus for 50% swing speed on discipline build**: A Focus value of 48.7 is what a Discipline armor build needs to reach 50% swing speed without links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535802128201814146)
- **focus for necromancy casters**: For a Necromancy caster, Focus mainly boosts mana regeneration, stacking with crafted book bonuses, Meditation and meditation rate for 'turbo med', and also raises charged spell chance when running Spell Strike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544378693911060621)
- **focus in zedd's wrestler build**: The 30 Focus in Zedd's wrestler/madness build is used to reach the swing speed cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536907624191365130)
- **focus mana refund with material book**: 100 Focus with a T12 material book gives a 49% mana refund, which is enough for void aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526875282647154688)
- **focus skill for damage dealers**: Focus is a good modifier skill for a dexer or mage who is the main damage dealer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521327012415803524)
- **focus skill for new players**: The Focus skill is handy for rounding out a new player template and is likely to be dropped later as other skills become stronger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525933747265077369)
- **focus skill gain**: Focus skill rises on its own as you play, without dedicated training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524835837634674728)
- **focus skill in pvp**: The Focus skill is not needed for PvP on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547631491612155916)
- **focus skill training**: To train Focus, fight monsters in the Shelter dungeon until 80, then use a training dummy outside Shelter or let it rise naturally while fighting; it gains quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539681900531155066)
- **focus stat while leveling first aspect**: Focus is useful while leveling your first aspect, but it can be reduced later once you have leveled up and optimised your build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521111589699457055)
- **focus training time**: Focus trains quickly, roughly one night AFK on a trainer, so it can be skipped initially and added back later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528699597403324426)
- **follower-damage tamer build for t-maps**: A follower-damage tamer build for T-maps could drop Evaluating Intelligence and use those points for Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524357659321434264)
- **following wiki skill templates**: Players advise following a wiki skill template exactly and leaving skills alone once they reach their template values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527792697505484872)
- **food satisfaction bonus calculation**: The Food Satisfaction bonus from cooked food is calculated from the higher of the Taste Identification and Cooking skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554357172765204581)
- **forensic evaluation appeal**: Forensic Evaluation has lost much of its appeal because scavenger farming is now so big. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524789795253911705)
- **forensic evaluation corpse carving**: Forensic Evaluation allows carving corpses for extra gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **forensic evaluation corpse carving**: Forensic Evaluation builds, whether mage or dexxer, let you carve up corpses and take home everything from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528782299867512952)
- **forensic evaluation effect on disease damage**: Forensic Evaluation has no direct interaction with diseases, so its effect on disease damage is tiny. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534556273838788628)
- **forensic evaluation for rare drops**: A player says Forensic Evaluation should be raised to 120 to improve rare consumable drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527114867427770388)
- **forensic evaluation for tamers**: One player recommends running Forensic Evaluation as a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542361059560783993)
- **forensic evaluation for top avatar benefit**: 110 Forensic Evaluation is all that is needed to get the top avatar (aspect-related) benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521324795344719933)
- **forensic evaluation gain chance**: Forensic Evaluation gains skill on each use with the same gain chance regardless of the corpse, so a bird gives the same chance as a dragon and easy-to-kill creatures are efficient to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535796141264867328)
- **forensic evaluation in bard templates**: Forensic Evaluation is recommended in Bard templates because it helps make up for low aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528698302978068591)
- **forensic evaluation in dexxer templates**: Forensic Evaluation gives no Swing Speed Increase, so it is hard to fit into a dexxer template unless you run something like the Air aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528782217931919380)
- **forensic evaluation macroing**: Forensic Evaluation cannot be macroed because it is not treated as a harvesting skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523698209791414292)
- **forensic evaluation on bards**: Forensic Evaluation grants Effective Barding, making it a reasonable skill to carry on a Bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554976277599883345)
- **forensic evaluation on builds**: Forensic Evaluation is recommended on any build that has spare skill points to absorb it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527454237758455888)
- **forensic evaluation on dexxer**: There is little room for Forensic Evaluation on a dexxer; better options are a dedicated scavenger character, FE on a backstabber, or FE on a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526294697683980549)
- **forensic evaluation requirement for skinning**: For skinning kills, forensic evaluation should be 110, and lower values are not worth bothering with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529841559808376935)
- **forensic evaluation skill gain setup**: To gain Forensic Evaluation, set it to 'up' and either have available skill points or set another skill to 'down'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525517840134967397)
- **forensic evaluation skill levels by template**: A Backstabber template can carry Forensic Evaluation at 120, while a Chivalry Peacemaking bard fit only about 80 in one player's build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528782637064257536)
- **forensic evaluation trainer**: A tanner or a healer NPC can train Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530636029525098657)
- **forensic evaluation training at npd**: NPD is a good place to train forensic evaluation up to 80, with quick, easy-to-kill spawns, though it gives no extra gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526701843298914405)
- **forensic evaluation training at shelter dungeon**: The Shelter dungeon is suitable for training Forensic Evaluation up to 80; it has no extra gain chances, but has many easy-to-kill mobs that respawn quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532152019568169000)
- **forensic evaluation training method**: Forensic Evaluation rises quickly enough through normal play and skinning creatures, so dedicated training is not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532458775494000891)
- **forensic evaluation wiki page**: The Forensic Evaluation skill page is on the Outlands wiki at wiki.uooutlands.com/Forensic_Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532113209379524699)
- **forensics for learning dungeons and earning money**: Forensics is a good skill for learning the dungeons while making money, as an alternative to mining or lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537620417794277498)
- **forensics in wrestler builds**: Running forensics in a wrestler build costs chivalry, which forces air armor for the swing speed cap; air is a worse armor than lightning, but this frees room to run alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535760767448653894)
- **forensics requirement for wrestling**: Forensics is not required for a wrestling build; it is only useful for a player who wants to be melee and skin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535755441454321714)
- **forgetting skills**: A skill cannot be forgotten outright; it can only be reduced by setting it to decrease while another skill gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530251899251724379)
- **fortitude experience from opening chests**: Opening chests for other players in Shelter may grant Fortitude aspect experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522536892002996245)
- **fortune aspect and skill gain**: Fortune aspect's experience gain does not affect skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543338695824773120)
- **fortune expertise and barding**: Fortune Expertise gives effective barding skill, so barding builds use it well, and backstabbers also benefit from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537615466611089538)
- **fortune expertise skill**: Outlands has a Fortune Expertise (FE) skill, and a PvM character can run 120 FE without Harvest if the build supports it, making it a good moneymaker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537615466611089538)
- **fortune farming template**: A fortune farming template is 100 Dual Wield, 100 Tactics, 100 Anatomy, 100 Chivalry, 80 Arms Lore, 80 Healing, 80 Resist and 80 Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538965089334464595)
- **freedom alchemy codex points for dexxers**: A dexxer should put about 3 points into Freedom in the alchemy codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531118611698290800)
- **freedom and refresh potions after stun**: Refresh potions help a stunned player get moving again, and even a single point in Freedom is enough to enable this occasional save. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526513516490526720)
- **freedom skill against stunning monsters**: Freedom skill provides an escape option against a few specific monsters that can stun the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526510624916508743)
- **freeing skill points**: To free skill points, left click the arrow next to a skill in the skill menu and set it to down on skills you do not want to raise; for one skill to go up, another must go down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532661697037471835)
- **frenzied ostard behavior**: Frenzied Ostards were aggressive on OSI but are believed to be passive on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493765914370140)
- **frenzy ostards for taming training**: Frenzy ostards are easy to find, can be ridden, and can be used for taming training, though they may need to be found on the map rather than in the creature bazaar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532531871236362402)
- **frost wrestler leveling**: A wrestler running a high-accuracy Frost aspect (tier 14 to 15) is a viable way to level most of the wrestling codex on a new character before switching to a tier 0 Air aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545168322423689316)
- **full book mage pets**: A full book mage can drop herding and rely on spirit speak for minions, using earth elementals instead of other pets to soak damage while casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535504059740463226)
- **full swing speed arcane mage build**: A full swing speed arcane mage build uses no necromancy, no inscription, and lightning armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333687415803934)
- **gaining command as a tamer**: A tamer can gain Command by running a character with 4x tamer, 120 Camping and 120 Forensic Evaluation: loot everything, get out, and repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532111976065405048)
- **gatherer miner template**: A gatherer miner template is 100 Mining, 100 Camping, 100 Wrestling, 100 Tracking, 100 Magery, 80 Parrying, 80 Resisting Spells and 60 Spirit Speak, and Spirit Speak can be dropped for more Mining and Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544362280144343061)
- **gatherer stat distribution**: Unless the character has Meditation, a gatherer should use 100/100/25 for STR/DEX/INT. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546774767267352596)
- **gathering gains after 80**: After 80 gathering skill, you need to leave safe areas and go into the dangerous world for gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629650599186433)
- **gemstone uses**: Gemstones are used for Tinkering training and are expected to be important for upcoming Golems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547328675580739754)
- **gold-based codex leveling targets**: For leveling codexes via gold, good targets are monsters that drop lots of gold without taking minutes to wear down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539695435256430692)
- **great bow tactics requirement**: Great bow no longer requires the Tactics skill and can be used at up to 6 range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522659189019770941)
- **greater heal cost**: Greater Heal is reported to cost 1.5 seconds, though the wording is unclear and may mean cast time rather than mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364004172271726)
- **greater paragon chest lockpicking requirement**: A player with 110 Lockpicking, 110 Detect Hidden, 10 Harvest and exceptional Agapi tools has 139 effective skill, which is enough to open greater paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546290270667018320)
- **greater paragon chest requirement**: A greater paragon chest needs 150 effective skill to open, per Outlands Butler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546290270667018320)
- **grey hand build speed**: A grey hand build (hiding, stealth, snooping, stealing, backstab) may be slower to progress than other builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543139017208373301)
- **guild private trainers**: Most guilds keep trainers in a private place to avoid reds killing people at public trainers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530109983524651018)
- **hamstring ability requirements**: Tracking combined with a weapon skill is said to give access to the Hamstring ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535613541250375731)
- **hamstring special move requirements**: Anatomy and Arms Lore are reportedly the skills that enable a character to use the Hamstring special move, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **hardest skills to level**: Forensic Evaluation is likely one of the hardest skills to level, along with mining and lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529169328237449286)
- **harpooner fishing template**: A harpooner template for fishing maps and nets can use chivalry, fishing, cartography, forensic evaluation, healing, anatomy and tactics, though the exact skill split is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539884561888976896)
- **harvest armor with frost weapon**: Wear harvest-aspected armor with a frost-aspected weapon to get 100% harvest XP while harvesting and 50% frost XP when killing something. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529972502875607121)
- **harvest aspect equipment slot for avararite maps**: Harvest aspect is only needed on armor, not on the weapon, for mining avararite maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935389215457453)
