- **harvest aspect leveling**: Carving skin from killed mobs levels the harvest aspect, whereas simply killing mobs in dungeons does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536195856234053632)
- **harvest aspect leveling graphic**: The circulating graphic for leveling the harvest aspect is outdated because the maps have changed since it was made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555344193294041121)
- **harvest aspect skill reduction**: Harvest aspect allows reducing detecting hidden and lockpicking skill levels to push skinning higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538855024409714718)
- **harvest level 16 requirement**: Reaching Harvest level 16 requires redline points, which can be earned by backstabbing (15 redline points). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530954393526993066)
- **harvest level uses beyond gathering**: Harvest level is useful beyond pure gathering, including T-maps, dungeon chest lockpicking, ocean fishing and MiBs, so XP from gathering benefits those activities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540257199748808714)
- **harvest leveling via dungeon chests**: Players can level the harvesting skill by picking dungeon chests inside dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552120738897469482)
- **harvest skill bonus for cartography**: The harvest skill bonus does not apply to Cartography when decoding maps, though the developer Luthius reportedly is considering adding it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536832302217437204)
- **harvest skill vs aspect leveling**: Leveling a harvesting skill is easy and quick compared to leveling the harvest aspect up to 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526291498465890324)
- **harvester build strength**: A harvester build should not use 70 STR; starting with the traditional harvester build and chopping is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547357834474422333)
- **harvesting skill above 100**: Harvesting skill above 100 does not improve money flow; income is the same as at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535422228194394132)
- **harvesting skill cap in builds**: Many builds stop harvesting skills at 110 and spend the extra 10 skill points elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536927785396736092)
- **harvesting skill needed for treasure maps**: On a treasure map harvest, swings cannot fail, so there is no need to raise harvesting skill above 110 effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547770495863226450)
- **harvesting skill redline**: Harvesting skills have no redline experience system because there is nothing for them to redline to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898527852073083)
- **harvesting skill training time**: Training a harvesting skill to Grandmaster takes roughly 10 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521280733040082965)
- **harvesting skill training time**: Harvesting skills are the longest skills to raise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548975879760117903)
- **healer codex and veterinary at 80**: Skipping Veterinary at 80 forgoes the Healer codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549847727096205363)
- **healer's codex template**: Some players put Anatomy and Healing on a template so they can use a healer's codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **healer's codex without borders trait**: The Healer's Codex lets you use the Without Borders trait, which allows you to heal targets from up to 5 tiles away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539764668619427881)
- **healers codex first unlock for throwing dexxer**: For a throwing dexxer, the faster bandage usage skill in the Healers Codex is a solid choice to unlock first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539021671690666055)
- **healers codex unlock order**: The best order for unlocking Healers Codex skills depends on the character's build; a tamer benefits from different unlocks than a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539021060261945364)
- **healing among pure dexxers**: Almost all pure dexxers of any flavour, including archers, have Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552730254311690412)
- **healing and anatomy benefits**: Anatomy provides more weapon damage, more damage resistance, more bandage healing and fewer interrupts, while the Healing codex adds melee damage and damage/bleed/disease resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553147078702534697)
- **healing and anatomy for early backstabber**: Going Healing/Anatomy is a smart early choice for a backstabber while the shadow aspect is still low. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541912785145954464)
- **healing and anatomy for survivability**: Pairing the Healing and Anatomy skills is a player-recommended way to stay alive when a character has survivability problems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526589511503577208)
- **healing codex point total**: The Healing Codex has only 20 points, so it is faster to max than other codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541398090458603650)
- **healing codex qualification for tamers**: A tamer can qualify for the healing codex with Veterinary and Animal Lore, so Anatomy is not required to bandage followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531003653383786679)
- **healing codex raising**: A build can lower Camping to about 20 and take 80 Healing purely to raise the Healing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543140313571528744)
- **healing codex setup for wrestle parry**: A suggested healing codex setup for a wrestle build with parry is Triage, Immunize (if no alchemy), Self Treat, and Pressure Points; with alchemy, Combat Medic is probably used instead of Immunize. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527367144038203623)
- **healing resurrection requirement**: Healing resurrection attempts can begin with 80 Healing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538892126975168532)
- **healing skill cap with healing codex**: With the healing codex there is no need to raise Healing above 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **healing skill category**: The Healing skill is listed under the combat category on the skill page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524981055629819965)
- **healing skill for magery meditation builds**: A character with Magery and Meditation does not need the Healing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849645329457232)
- **healing skill training**: Healing skill is raised by using bandages on yourself or others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525869243558662164)
- **healing skill versus chivalry**: The Healing skill covers bandages only, while Chivalry provides spell-based healing along with other abilities such as quick travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524983277247529091)
- **healing training in shelter dungeon**: To train Healing in the Shelter dungeon, tag one weak mob, stand in a corner so it keeps hitting you, and spam bandages via script or macro; players report it reaches 80 quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554938707344097281)
- **healing training with wizard hat**: Healing can be trained by repeatedly equipping and unequipping a magic wizard hat, which changes strength/HP so you keep your starting bandages; this is a single player's tip and is unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530447271315898559)
- **herding and veterinary follower dps**: The Herding and Veterinary skills add damage per second to your followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524781990778241124)
- **herding and veterinary training**: Herding and Veterinary can be trained to 80 in the shelter with a crook, a horse and bandages: have pet A kill pet B, tell pet B to stay, then run a script that bandages the pet and double-clicks the crook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529801946582618153)
- **herding crook activation**: A herding crook does not need to be equipped; it is active whenever it shows [activated] when clicked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554169009560101005)
- **herding crook as aspect item**: A herding crook can serve as the aspect-carrying item for raising an aspect if the character has taken the Herding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522353126383026237)
- **herding in builds**: Most builds include Herding; generally only PvP or hybrid PvP builds skip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552245864645398570)
- **herding necromancer aspect**: Command aspect is recommended over death aspect for a herding necromancer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555909870362951725)
- **herding training**: Herding can be trained to 80 in the shelter dungeon, but training is slow, so it is easiest to let it rise passively while playing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522436508009631926)
- **hider corpse looting in dungeons**: Raise hiding and stealth to 100 and Forensic Evaluation a bit, then loot leather, gems and gold from gray corpses in dungeons, hiding whenever you hear crows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556006037482377267)
- **hiding and stealth benefits**: 100 Hiding and 100+ Stealth help avoid PKs, who can be waited out until they leave, and help avoid the 60 second timer each time you recall home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **hiding and stealth for scavenger builds**: Hiding and stealth are not recommended for a pure scavenger because they are too slow; Magery and Spirit Speak do much more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552468002170081351)
- **hiding failure from line of sight**: Failing to hide because of line of sight does not put the Hiding skill on cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527298561606291596)
- **hiding for thieving skill training**: Being able to hide matters mainly when combining all of the thieving skills in a single training session. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520893827152482376)
- **hiding requirement for stealth**: A character needs 100 Hiding to avoid constantly failing stealth attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541478797923188807)
- **hiding restrictions**: A single successful Hiding attempt hides you, but you cannot hide if a monster is aggroed on you and has line of sight; you can still hide if monsters are aggroed only on your pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521358784373456906)
- **hiding training**: To train Hiding, stand at the entrance to the newbie dungeon and use the skill in a loop every 10 seconds with a Razor script or macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525941391790702684)
- **hiding training**: Train Hiding in the Shelter dungeon until 80, then leave and use Hiding on a loop in any town to continue training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527801477618340102)
- **hiding training in towns**: You can hide in any town, such as outside your inn room, to train hiding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489685509050531)
- **high-level skill gain penalty**: At higher skill levels a skill gain penalty (shown as -1% skill gain) applies, so players often train overnight naked on a public battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541727015005065237)
- **hiking skill without camping**: The Hiking skill cannot be used without camping, even when using the explorer's pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530311478656110734)
- **holy dexxer to boating conversion**: To convert a holy dexxer into a boating character, swap Swordsmanship for Fishing and Parrying for Cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545475738562461697)
- **horseshoe bay training spot safety**: At the Horseshoe Bay training spot, players reportedly need no gear to train and risk no item loss while hidden, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520894787622928585)
- **hunter skinner archer template**: A backstabber is the only template that can reasonably fit a hunter/skinner/archer concept on a single character; it is not ideal as an archer but works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542168976476344481)
- **hunting mode check interval**: While in Hunting mode, Tracking makes a skill check every 5 seconds, giving a skill gain chance every 5 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531017006705283152)
- **hybrid builds**: Hybrid builds are common in Outlands but are not great at either of their functions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093812779458641)
- **hybrid farmer scavenger society mule tamer variant**: A hybrid farmer, scavenger or society mule tamer variant uses 120 Camping and 120 Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525232387611557929)
- **hybrid r-map echo build**: For a hybrid resource-map build, one Echo can cover mining and lumberjacking and a second Echo can cover fishing and Fishing Expertise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532872864200654919)
- **hyper defensive mule build**: A hyper defensive mule character on an alt account is useful, with skills such as Magery, Hiding, Camping and Magic Resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521722210199273502)
- **identifying starting skills**: To see which skills a character started with, open the skills gump and look for skills with a value above 0 in the 'real' column. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525885343155617832)
- **infrequent skill gains**: Some skills gain seldom, so players should look at gain chance percentages rather than actual gains to judge progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549672678137397301)
- **ingot cost of training tinkering and blacksmithing**: Training tinkering and blacksmithing takes a large number of ingots, and tinkering is somewhat cheaper if gems are used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549596054498975755)
- **inn room magery training safety**: An inn room is a safe location for training magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537777513609166951)
- **inscription 100 to 120 scroll cost**: Going from 100 to 120 Inscription reportedly used about 28 to 30 scroll commodities, roughly 75k scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546616971444092928)
- **inscription and agorawave fire field damage**: Inscription increases the damage of Agorawave Fire Fields when the spell is cast from a scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538450962635821057)
- **inscription and bless on followers**: Inscription skill gives followers a longer Bless duration, and casting Bless on followers increases their speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522726375583252551)
- **inscription as supplementary skill**: Inscription is considered a good supplementary skill for Magery characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210179642466366)
- **inscription bless and protection duration**: With Inscription, Bless and Protection last 12 minutes before they need to be recast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552788764261224471)
- **inscription bless on pets**: Inscription for bless on pets is a decent quality-of-life option, but bless is not as needed now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525960079357251604)
- **inscription for arcane mage**: Inscription adds a bit of damage for an arcane mage but costs 120 skill points, and the author is unsure it is worth it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333546302509136)
- **inscription for mage tamer bless uptime**: A mage tamer can take 40 Inscription to bless pets for longer bless uptime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543190595399454760)
- **inscription for pvm**: Inscription is a good PvM skill when casting offensively but not when focusing on pet damage, and Item Identification is best kept on another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554513962895155222)
- **inscription for treasure maps**: Inscription is not needed for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534128211451969707)
- **inscription interrupt avoidance**: At 100 skill, inscription gives the same interrupt avoidance as 100 arcane plus 100 wrestling and prevents PvE spell interrupts; it does not help in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546660801862180886)
- **inscription leveling via crafting queue**: Instead of writing an inscription script, make a crafting queue that crafts the scrolls needed at each level and set it to recycle them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535813735271112714)
- **inscription on tamer for buffs**: On a tamer, 40 to 60 Inscription is useful for buffs, and Camping is also a decent choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543225473193091101)
- **inscription pet buffs**: Inscription gives access to bless and protect buffs that provide a speed bonus on pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556091693605060659)
- **inscription skill boosts**: Mastery links combined with the eldritch aspect can raise inscription skill up to the required level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545381051403075654)
- **inscription society job magery requirement**: Some inscription society jobs require 100 Magery rather than 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529401904092680343)
- **inscription training hats disposal**: Hats produced from Inscription training can be cut up with scissors instead of being recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540865283625852928)
- **inscription training mana use**: Training the Inscription skill does not use mana, so meditation is not required for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535573538562637926)
- **instruments for bardic skills**: Crafted instruments are not used for bardic skills; players buy exceptional instruments cheaply and upgrade to supreme instruments later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522666050041151628)
- **intelligence stat for non-casters**: Characters that do not cast spells do not need Intelligence, while casters want maximum Intelligence and gain less from Dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554371723523133481)
- **invisibility macro skill gain**: Repeatedly casting Invisibility on a new character is reported to raise skills such as Magery, Spirit Speak and Focus, reaching the 700 total skill cap in roughly 20 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546160006246699019)
- **invisibility replacing hiding and stealth for scavenger build**: Magery's Invisibility spell, or rope invisibility, can replace Hiding and Stealth for a scavenger build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524838322189631640)
- **invisibility vs hiding for pk engagement**: A character with 100 Magery can cast Invisibility instead of using Hiding, so 100 Meditation is preferable to 100 Hiding for engaging PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528454602536517792)
- **item id air build weapon requirement**: The item identification air build (120 chivalry, 120 arms lore, 120 item id, 100 tactics, 100 anatomy, 80 wrestling, 80 healing) requires a surpassingly accurate vanquishing weapon at T15 or an eminently accurate vanquishing weapon at T12. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529885575300251830)
- **item id character skill setup**: An item ID character is best equipped with a way to open gates (Magery or Chivalry/Tactics), Detect Hidden, and Lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528262696523272263)
- **item id on items in other players' bags**: Item ID skill can identify items inside other players' bags, so a thief can check whether an item is worth stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522386380028772452)
- **item identification 120 risk**: Item Identification at 120 is probably only worth using in sanctuary dungeons, since it depends on good magic weapons that may be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522779241740242944)
- **item identification afk training**: Item Identification can gain skill even when used on an already identified item such as starter pants, so it can be looped AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551257806886404108)
- **item identification bonus to magical instruments**: Item Identification skill gives a 20% increase to magical instruments, which raises effective bard skill and is reportedly needed at 80 base bard skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553526995701338195)
- **item identification for omnis on wrestler**: A wrestler with a Vanquishing Daemon Slaying fistblade uses 80 Item Identification for Omnis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544425855093178468)
- **item identification in sanctuary build**: Running Item Identification in a sanctuary build makes it easier to meet accuracy and swing speed requirements while leaving extra skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523405505790480484)
- **item identification macro training**: Item Identification can be macro-trained by repeatedly using it on an already identified item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530593338598625414)
- **item identification result**: Using Item Identification on a magical item changes its name from 'unidentified <item>' to its actual magical name, e.g. 'unidentified parrying dagger' becomes 'durable parrying dagger'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551761726632890392)
- **item identification skill synergy**: According to the wiki, the Item Identification skill synergizes only with crafting skills, and its buffs are worth considering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530664307380064326)
- **item identification training**: Once Item Identification reaches 50, repeatedly using Item ID on any item (for example via a Razor macro) slowly raises the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763296447627265)
- **jackal summoner herding requirement**: A jackal summoner build also needs the Herding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544039574576037919)
- **kindling needed to max camping**: About 50 kindling is enough to max out Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548214185937215529)
- **last stand parry finisher**: Last Stand is a recommended Parrying finisher for swords, and the selected finisher in the Parry codex can be changed at any time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532951421316759603)
- **learning lockpicking in starter town**: Buy Lockpicking and Detect Hidden up to 50 from the thief NPC under the Shelter inn, buy the training box, remove trap tools and lock picks, then train in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547915931286642729)
- **learning spells from scrolls**: You learn spells by having a spellbook containing them; scrolls for spells missing from your book can be dropped onto the book to add them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550689245864136749)
- **learning spells from scrolls**: Spells from scrolls are learned by dragging the scroll onto your blessed spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543547279611396167)
- **leather farming and forensic evaluation for backstabbers**: A pure backstabber should farm as much leather as possible, and Forensic Evaluation increases backstabber damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543139205008592947)
- **leather harvesting for 100 tailoring**: Harvesting all the leather needed to reach 100 tailoring yourself takes weeks to months, while buying the materials is much quicker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526041642149089391)
- **lemura as melee tank pet**: Lemura is a decent choice as a melee tank pet in a pet setup, though tank pets are not strictly required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535402695374938214)
- **lethal poison application on weapons at high poisoning**: With around 95 poisoning, applying lethal poison to a weapon reportedly takes roughly 10 to 15 tries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538356422020956171)
- **lethal poison for dexxers**: With 100 Poisoning, a dexxer can live well using lethal poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544673277342126151)
- **level 1 treasure map cartography requirement**: A player with only 80 cartography cannot do a level 1 treasure map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553342209149902849)
- **level 7 and 8 spell acquisition**: Level 7 and 8 spells must be bought from player vendors or by buying a full spellbook, and 100 Magery is needed to use them; many builds run grandmaster Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522392036937039935)
- **leveling a healing codex**: To level a healing codex easily, join a guild and leech experience while in a party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551301412212711475)
- **leveling air aspect with a tamer**: With a tamer, wear command armor and use an air-aspected weapon to level air aspect to 10 within roughly one to three days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521906757746819182)
- **leveling artisan skills by stocking shelves**: Crafters can level artisan skills cheaply by stocking guild or other players' shelves with potions, armor, weapons and other needed items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553100695895281784)
- **leveling lumberjacking and mining past 100**: To level Lumberjacking or Mining past about 100 in reasonable time, use lumberjacking or ore maps; the lower quality maps are not expensive, whereas normal gathering takes many months. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537623669839241217)
- **leveling lyric aspect in kraul hive**: Lyric aspect can be leveled in Kraul Hive level 2, but at the cost of a large loss of follower attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527942305959379017)
- **leveling newly tamed pets**: Many tamers take newly tamed pets to the Shelter dungeon to get them to level one, and a pet that dies there can be resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538507862144327731)
- **leveling parrying and healing by tanking mobs**: To level Parrying and Healing quickly, raise weapon skill, Focus, Tactics and Chivalry to 80, then let a few mobs hit you without hitting back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529236486833176727)
- **leveling parrying by sparring two characters**: Parrying can be trained by logging in two characters and sparring each other in your room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529242215900250274)
- **leveling parrying with mongbats**: Parrying can be leveled by getting a group of mongbats to attack you while you sit in a corner healing yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529242203103432755)
- **leveling skill through fishing**: Fishing can be used to level a skill, though it is somewhat monotonous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549690701808148510)
- **leveling void aspect**: To level void aspect fastest, play a tamer who hits mobs with a void-aspect stick or swaps to void armor while farming, or alternatively play a void mage summoner and grind it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555341921587564575)
- **lightning archer skill setup**: A Lightning Archer wants Magic Resist, and swing speed may be maximized by lowering Healing, Anatomy, and possibly Arms Lore and Focus to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537174848382570546)
- **lightning for magery training**: Lightning works for training Magery at the start, but players eventually need to switch to other spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544917614008999987)
- **locked skills**: A skill set to locked will not gain, so it must be set to up before it can be trained (for example Lumberjacking). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531231763546898523)
- **locking non-template skills**: Lock all skills in the skills gump that are not part of your chosen template to avoid hitting the skill cap as quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554678412717723810)
- **locking unneeded skills for builds**: Set every skill not needed for your build to down (lock) so that the skills your build needs can gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535614688048717875)
- **lockpick color effect**: The color of a lockpick does not speed up picking; it only affects trap removal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538730478272520302)
- **lockpick scavenger build popularity**: Lockpick scavenger is a popular build with a good amount of competition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532128800526303324)
- **lockpicker gold maximizing build**: A lockpicker build for maximizing gold brought out uses wrestling, resist and parry, with stealing reserved for the thief codex rather than stealing from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540812405586657340)
- **lockpicking chest run chain experience**: Doing lockpicking chest runs grants chain experience, which eventually gives a small boost to link amount or redlines. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544660612900978740)
- **lockpicking chest sharing**: Multiple lockpickers can be in the same dungeon, and anyone can click a chest to see whether someone is already unlocking it; an empty chest means another picker is nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548965007772090442)
- **lockpicking leveling on alt accounts**: Lockpicking is very easy to level on an alt account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530817812690501653)
- **lockpicking mastery chain contribution**: Lockpicking contributes to the Mastery Chain when harvesting from chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550849903159414905)
- **lockpicking mastery xp**: Picking locks gives mastery xp, but it may not be good xp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553337863033192479)
- **lockpicking skill gain in shelter dungeon**: Lockpicking may benefit from the increased skill gain in the Shelter dungeon, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554906494833795093)
- **lockpicking skill links**: Effective Skill on Chests links are better than effective harvest links for dungeon lockpicking, because effective harvest links give far less skill there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540269481241084034)
- **lockpicking skill needed for chest levels**: A lockpicker with only 80 skill would max out on level 5 chests and struggle with level 6-7 chests, while level 1 dungeon chests need about 90 effective skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533886820062859365)
- **lockpicking training**: Training lockpicking is easy and cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531043404568465558)
- **lockpicking training and scroll cost**: Lockpicking is easy to train, and 20 lockpicking scrolls cost roughly 100K gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534750482608816320)
- **lockpicking training box afk in inn**: The lockpicking training box can be used AFK inside an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538882613627068506)
- **lockpicking training box durability**: The lockpicking training box is not consumable and can be kept permanently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554842876268126260)
- **lockpicking training box use**: To use the lockpicking training box, double click it, tick the box to keep working the lock, then click the gem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547916559803097101)
- **lockpicking training lockbox**: A training lockbox for practicing lockpicking can likely be bought from a tinker vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526674766084440235)
- **lockpicking training path**: Train Lockpicking to 80 in the Shelter dungeon, then continue training outside Shelter to raise it beyond 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554906596805709956)
- **lockpicking training supplies**: Lockpicks and a training box for training Lockpicking can be bought at a provisioner shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525874798788345988)
- **lockpicking window percentage**: The percentage shown in the lockpicking window is the chance to gain Lockpicking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525881508316053535)
- **lockpicking with harvest ability**: With the Harvest armor ability active and a decent lockpick, lockpicking works without needing valorite picks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538730478272520302)
- **locksmith training box**: The Locksmith training box can be used to train Lockpicking at any skill level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540838140573515937)
- **low barding template instrument**: A low barding template needs a supreme (exceptional) instrument, which is cheap to obtain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539674426449199115)
- **low ping hiding after failed stealing**: Low ping lets a player cast Hiding right after a failed steal next to a mob, before the mob aggroes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547332977506385961)
- **low-level scavenger build skill allocation**: At low levels a scavenger/picker build can run 120 detecting hidden and lockpicking with forensic evaluation at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538855156542607392)
- **lowering a skill to a target level**: To lower a skill to a specific level, buy points into a dummy skill, which immediately sets the skill you want to lower to its appropriate level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525371864426217472)
- **lowering a stat with stat lock**: To lower a stat such as intelligence, set it to the lock (down) state and then do activities like hitting a training dummy or lighting a campfire; the stat will drop gradually, but intelligence will not fall below 24. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525535503473053726)
- **lowering skills to free skill cap**: To free up skill points under the cap, set skills you no longer need to go down so other skills can be raised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971820438855782)
- **lumberjacking forensic evaluation skinner builds**: A lumberjacking 120 / forensic evaluation 120 character can run skinning dungeons by adding some magery, magic resist, alchemy and parrying and using teleport and rope around skinning spots, or alternatively by using magery and spirit speak with defensive skills and summons to take aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531381838776500394)
- **lumberjacking skill cap and training**: Lumberjacking can be trained to 120 through normal chopping without resource maps, though the 120 cap rests on a single player report and an uncertain question. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546284094189608983)
- **lumberjacking skill training**: Lumberjacking cannot be raised AFK because the skill only increases as you actively chop, making it harder to train than AFK-trainable skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537597864715354133)
- **lumberjacking trainers**: Bowyer, Carpenter, and Lumberjack NPCs can all train Lumberjacking; Bowyers and Carpenters are easier to find in towns, while Lumberjack NPCs are found out in the wild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532404849080144094)
- **lumberjacking xp per log**: When lumberjacking, XP is fixed at 0.2 XP per log harvested regardless of log color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540966627695267880)
- **lyric aspect for bards**: Getting the Lyric aspect makes playing a bard much easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535160381406969958)
- **lyric vs poison aspect**: Lyric aspect is more comfortable and gains more skill than Poison aspect, which only gains from Taste Identification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542952813196222476)
- **mace backstabber freed skill points**: On a Mace backstabber that skips Tactics via Ruffian, the freed 80 skill points can go to a secondary weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528773839658418227)
- **mace build weapon skill requirement**: A mace-focused build only needs the Mace skill as its weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554393785830604842)
- **mace chivalry template**: An optimized mace/chivalry template is 120 chivalry, 100 tactics, 80 meditation, 80 healing, 80 anatomy, 80 arms lore and 80 focus, giving about 51% swing speed and good accuracy, and it needs the swing speed, accuracy and healing codex benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539923251034329128)
- **mace skill training**: Mace skill trains quickly by hitting training dummies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529269554486706408)
- **macefighting codex stance**: Macefighting is one of the only skills without a beginner-friendly, accuracy-boosting codex stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532412998059163699)
- **macing training method**: To train Macing, use the slowest weapon and boost swing speed with Divine Fury. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530969632838778970)
- **macing training time**: Training macing from 85 to GM takes about one, maybe two, overnight AFK sessions on the trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531436740307452024)
- **macro-training an echo build**: Before macro-training an echo build, unlock your skills and set the other skills to point down so only the intended skills gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530417688826876224)
- **macroing skill gain in inn rooms**: Most skills probably gain while macroing in an inn room, but hiding and taming probably do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528434994626826371)
- **madness aspect and alchemy**: The Madness aspect levels up quickly and deals substantial damage early, so dropping Alchemy in favor of it may be a mistake. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522094381388267611)
- **madness lightning archer build**: A madness/lightning archer build uses 120 Chivalry, 100 Resisting Spells, 100 Tactics, 100 Archery, 80 Arms Lore, 80 Anatomy, 80 Healing and 60 Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541941491964846211)
- **madness wrestler swing speed requirement**: A madness wrestler needs 5% swing speed increase to run both Parrying and Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530281629602283571)
- **mage and weapon skill point budget**: There are not enough skill points to be both an effective mage and an effective weapon wielder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536542750457995346)
- **mage bard skill setup**: A mage bard would need Music instead of one of the bard skills at first, until they have a bard codex with enough points for Self Taught. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548195397829402625)
- **mage codex leveling method**: The Mage codex can be leveled using the Ruffian-counts-as-Tactics method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528799383016046754)
- **mage skill roles**: Resisting Spells is for resisting spells and spell siphon, Alchemy is for the potion codex, and Cooking is for mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524830789836214412)
- **mage tamer utility**: Mage tamers get utility from many non-combat spells, and archery and magery can both eventually be used via echoes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538672911236472943)
- **mage template skills to lower**: On a mage template, Anatomy, Arms Lore, Tactics and Parry are the skills to lower in order to free up points at the skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925004930744360)
- **mage wrestling skill in pvp**: Nearly all mages who PvP reportedly take 100 Wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555039039499931780)
- **mage-thief stat distribution**: A mage-thief should probably set 100 strength, 100 intelligence, and 25 dexterity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520886033904832543)
- **magery 100 for gatherers**: Gatherers should eventually raise Magery to 100, since it is needed for recall and mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533250793594163240)
- **magery 60 support usefulness**: Magery at 60 is only really useful for walls, teleports, and possibly Bless, making its support value very limited. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528789858343194646)
- **magery and mana refund**: Magery is a good early skill for increasing Mana Refund chance, though a higher aspect tier, a good spellbook and a grimoire can also provide it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526227600521826484)
- **magery and necromancy skill gain competition**: Magery and Necromancy do not compete with each other for skill gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554148159813460111)
- **magery below 100 for summoners**: Dropping Magery below 100 weakens Bless and Greater Heal and causes summon spells to fizzle, so summoner builds generally keep Magery at grandmaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547226646774415470)
- **magery cast chance factors**: Chance to cast Magery spells is strictly tied to the Magery skill; Evaluating Intelligence and Inscription have no effect on cast chance, with or without scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543038493800931348)
- **magery for harvesters**: Magery lets a harvester heal, escape from PKs, and summon pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531172700368666675)
- **magery for thief characters**: Magery provides a lot of utility for a thief character; some thieves run it, while others use the Camping skill instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540085922471616784)
- **magery level for dungeon build**: A dungeon build is not recommended at 60 Magery, but 80 Magery works well even without Anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526928067300167781)
- **magery level for stealth scavenger**: 100 Magery is not strictly needed for a stealth scavenger but is useful for resurrecting other players; 80 Magery is probably sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544850230586122281)
- **magery leveling cost for new players**: Leveling Magery is not cheap for a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555982197926666373)
- **magery minimum for purple potions in pvp**: A minimum of 30 Magery is required to use purple potions in PvP; there is no zero-magery way to do it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528826769057124515)
- **magery reduction with scrolls**: Magery can be lowered to 80 to save skill points if summon spells are cast from scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529549082945916939)
- **magery skill cap**: Magery cannot go past 100 because there is no skill scroll for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530692491731271852)
- **magery skill gain at 60**: At 60 Magery, merely attempting a spell gives a chance of skill gain; the cast does not need to succeed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537241679839633528)
- **magery skill gain mechanics**: Magery skill gain may depend only on the circle of the spell cast, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524520026479132803)
- **magery skill requirement**: You rarely need more than 80 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542922073482072234)
- **magery skill role**: Magery is the spellcasting skill; without it you cannot cast spells, and its level determines which spells you can cast, spell success chance, and spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527397418809692172)
- **magery training at 71 skill**: At 71 magery, a player should cast Invisibility to continue gaining skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553409978587414590)
- **magery training cost 80 to 100**: Training Magery from 80 to 100 costs about 5k, according to a script's stated estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533025745050407025)
- **magery training location**: To train Magery, buy the required spells from a mage NPC or player scribe, go to the new player dungeon, and cast them there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522391693008306177)
- **magery training location**: Magery can be trained in the Shelter dungeon by going inside to the left, behind the player guard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553410074121076777)
- **magery training past 62**: At about 62 Magery, casting Lightning no longer gives skill gain, so switch to casting Invisibility to train Magery up to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533458037270909048)
- **magery training path**: Train Magery from 50 to 80 in the newbie dungeon, which is faster; after 80, sit at the zoo casting Flamestrike on mobs or summon elementals in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529375375417806859)
- **magery training reagent restocking**: When training magery at the bank, use Razor to restock reagents automatically, carrying only about 2 of each needed reagent so thieves cannot steal many. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537777454285070416)
- **magery training spells**: To keep gaining magery you must cast spells of increasingly difficult circles; energy bolt and invisibility are good choices for the 60-80 range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525108198586187908)
- **magery training spot in shelter**: To train Magery in Shelter, stand behind Lord Warner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660260266934377)
- **magic arrow at zero magery**: Magic Arrow can be cast successfully at 0 Magery skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526916373492797571)
- **magic mushroom stockpile for skill training**: A stockpile of magic mushrooms is a good way to raise skills like focus and necromancy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583571384672257)
- **magic mushrooms for skill gain**: Making and eating magic mushrooms for mana helps casters gain skills such as meditation and focus faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551004378503061595)
- **magic resist against reds**: Magic Resist helps against red (murderer) players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525720206343802992)
- **magic resist bonuses**: Magic Resist grants damage reduction (DR) and swing speed increase (SSI). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524777968361013408)
- **magic resist farming**: Magic Resist gives buffs through spell siphon, and you can start farming by hitting yourself with a few Magic Arrow scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523777741655248938)
- **magic resist for arcane mage swing speed**: Magic Resist gives swing speed, damage reduction and less damage from spells, and is the best swing-speed swap for an arcane mage, followed by Cooking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551369604800970894)
- **magic resist on gatherer template**: Magic Resist on a gathering character is recommended because it significantly improves survival when a red (PK) appears nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542210709205553152)
- **magic resist potion and resisting spells**: Drinking a Magic Resist potion provides extra spell resistance, making it generally unnecessary to run both Parry and Resisting Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536027308891185282)
- **magic resist training**: To train Magic Resist from about 50 to 80, go to the newbie dungeon on the starter island, get one or two caster mobs to cast on you, and heal yourself while they do; it takes roughly 20 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542091921285971969)
- **magic resist training after 80**: After 80 skill, Magic Resist can be trained by being targeted by spell-casting monsters such as Reapers or Gazers, with a bandage/heal script making it easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530977525553954816)
- **magic resist training in shelter**: To train Magic Resist in Shelter, let a casting monster cast spells on you while you heal yourself; the necro mob is preferred because it does not come down to you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546982098336743454)
- **magic resist training locations**: Witcher 44 tower and a Witcher observatory (possibly Witcher 4 or 6) are reported places to train Magic Resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332322888089732)
- **magic resist training via creature casting**: Having creatures cast spells on you to train magic resist takes about 20-30 minutes, depending on quantity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522074918832050186)
- **magic resist versus parrying for rangers**: Rangers stay at a distance and are mostly attacked by ranged spells rather than melee swords, so Magic Resist is more useful to them than Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525720161078743110)
- **main public battle trainer location**: The main public battle trainer NPC, used to train combat skills such as mace fighting, is located at the Prevalia moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529277178917949633)
- **main trapper builds**: The three main trapper builds are dexxer, summoner and bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536709032880898098)
- **mana refund cap without wrestling**: Mana refund can be capped without Wrestling, for example with Mana Drain or a book, so book mages likely do not need Wrestling for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552800225176068218)
- **mana regeneration in camping build**: A build with Camping and Fishing/Cooking-type skills has weak mana regeneration, and swapping Camping for Focus is suggested to improve it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547957486185611425)
- **mana thief requirements**: The Mana Thief build requires an aspect and 80+ in two skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540044734146543688)
- **manual skill training time**: Raising a skill such as taming fully by hand can take about a year, so scripting gains up to 100 and then raising the remainder manually is suggested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552858574202343616)
- **manual vs automated barding**: Manually using Barding skills gives better results than an auto-barding script, which is hard to make effective but can help in a pinch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539312443422150758)
- **mastery codex requirements**: Mastery Chain experience is gained without a chain, and all codices are supposed to work if you have the appropriate skills and the codex with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551294168293179405)
- **mastery tier stale bonus display**: After upgrading a Mastery tier, the skill list may show a stale bonus such as 100 Tactics instead of 116; lowering and raising the tier again refreshes the display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551931042653409322)
- **max efb party bard build**: A maximum-EFB party bard build is 120 Peacemaking, 120 Discordance, 120 Provocation, 120 Carpentry, 120 Item ID, and 120 Tracking or Forensic Evaluation, with T15 Artisan and Effective Barding and Barding Break links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542560961343262740)
- **max melee damage skill setup**: To maximize melee damage, take 100 Tactics and 100 Anatomy plus the supplemental 20%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **maximum spell circle**: 8th circle is the maximum circle for magic spells in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527417327363166308)
- **maximum total skill cap**: The maximum total skill cap reachable is 720, and exceeding the base cap is possible only through skill scrolls dropped by mobs or bought from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526958800739766304)
- **maxing skills to redline**: To max skills to the redline, go to Prevalia, use the yellow statue, go to its second page, and choose the max redline option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534435577561219204)
- **meat cooking and collection skills**: Cooking skill is needed to cook meat, and Forensic Evaluation is used to collect large amounts of meat from corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525593472952963213)
- **meditation codex for summoner**: A full summoner can use 80 Meditation to get the codex, which lets the bless buff be applied to all summons at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547635008649437235)
- **meditation for caster builds**: A caster build without the Meditation skill is likely to be very hard to play because of mana limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550787753896054815)
- **meditation for inscription**: Inscription society work needs Magery but does not require Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553668363396456511)
- **meditation for poison tamer without veterinary**: A poison tamer build without Veterinary needs mana, so Meditation is suggested instead of Evaluating Intelligence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542293025600839702)
- **meditation for wizard grimoire**: Meditation is recommended when using the wizard grimoire in Outlands, since it helps with arch protection and heals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526007310634455160)
- **meditation interruption by mob hits**: Being hit by a mob breaks meditation even if you do not auto attack back, so meditating within aggro range of mobs is unreliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542201685080805376)
- **meditation level without 720 skill cap**: If the 720 skill cap is not unlocked, Meditation can be reduced to 80 in the stealth scavenger build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544850230586122281)
- **meditation reduction for pet-focused mage tamer**: A pet-focused mage tamer can free 20 skill points by lowering Meditation to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552351653049667726)
- **meditation requirement for wizard's grimoire**: Dropping Meditation below 80 means losing access to the Wizard's Grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536732591812640869)
- **meditation training alongside magery**: Meditation levels up alongside Magery as you train Magery, so it generally does not need separate training, as long as you have not hit the skill cap that halts progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526984121178525850)
- **medium grind weapon category**: Double axe, two-handed, large battle axe, hatchet, and executioner axe are in the medium grind weapon category. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532798419075072122)
- **melee bard weapon skill**: A melee bard build can use mace fighting or wrestling as its weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543138682113097730)
- **melee skill leveling**: Fighting with melee weapons levels all the relevant combat skills while you fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525606996823248966)
- **melee skill training path**: Train melee skills to 80 in the newbie dungeon, then hit a battle trainer until they reach 100 or 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527752345302335701)
- **melee skills and bows**: Bows are classified as melee, so a character generally needs only one melee skill, which sets core accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555274705584398407)
