- **melee template healing anatomy**: On a melee template, Healing and Anatomy can be reduced to 80, freeing points for either Resisting Spells for more damage or Parrying for more tankiness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530183754323066922)
- **melee template tactics chivalry focus**: A melee character needs Tactics and Chivalry at 100 and the Focus skill on the template, otherwise accuracy is very low. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530183190340178062)
- **melee tmap build skill allocation**: In a melee treasure map build, Cartography can be at 100 alongside Chivalry at 100 if Parrying is dropped to 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537453703093813298)
- **melee wrestler build with alchemy**: A melee wrestling build with alchemy needs air armor to reach the swing speed cap; start by lowering arms lore and anatomy to 80 and raising focus to 100, and use links for melee special and damage by player along with a madness weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535683961710182492)
- **metabolism buff**: Metabolism is being buffed in the upcoming patch notes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528795152334716968)
- **mind rot dexxer template**: To enable Mind Rot on a dexxer, remove 150 points from the standard dexxer template for 75 magery and 75 necromancy, dropping Chivalry and some Focus, and use dual wield/fencing to offset lost swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532109667541712936)
- **minimum effective skill level**: A skill generally needs at least 80 to be effective, and many skills need 100 or 120 for full use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526190551278424154)
- **mining and lumberjacking skill requirements**: Mining and lumberjacking may not need to reach 120 because of harvest level, but 110 may be needed; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548976825978458203)
- **mining and magery resource needs**: Mining is an active skill requiring attention, while Magery consumes reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666638985437239)
- **mining in hollow hills for grimoire and redline**: Mining inside the Hollow Hills while summons kill spiders, harpies and drakes can level the Wizard Grimoire and Summoner's Tome and earn Redline points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529945032671494255)
- **mining mace fighting bonus**: Mining reportedly gives a buff to Mace Fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665291754012703)
- **mining skill cap from rocks**: Mining rocks alone can raise mining skill to 105.3, though it takes a long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528361489335844934)
- **mining xp per ore**: Mining grants about 0.2 XP per ore mined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541093808530530374)
- **missing skill gain chance**: A skill may stop showing a gain chance if a skill scroll was not consumed and the cap was not raised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553575945330229370)
- **missing skill gain chance display**: If skill gain chance does not display after a map, a skill arrow may be pointing the wrong way; click 'show real' and check every skill for a 1.0 gain setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546283753033170984)
- **mixed results alchemy codex node**: The Mixed Results alchemy codex node is poor; only 1 point for longer potion duration is worthwhile, and Elixir and Volatile are better places for points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531201993866219634)
- **mount breeding**: Mount breeding is possibly a Tamer-only feature, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532971729029169152)
- **mugger build skills**: A mugger build can start with 100 each of Hiding, Stealth, Tactics, Maces, Stealing and Snooping, and with the thieves codex unlocked can aim for 120 Stealth, 100 Hiding, 100 Stealing and 80-100 Maces. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **multiple codex benefits**: Players with several relevant skills benefit from owning more than one codex, because each codex benefits its own skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528429664077615146)
- **multiple weapon skills for backstabbers**: Having multiple weapon skills can be useful for backstabbers who are considering levelling codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536391123558469744)
- **musicianship requirement with partial bard skills**: If you use only two of Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance, you still need Musicianship, and points in Self Taught do not help in that case. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553895114584105063)
- **musicianship skill cap and self taught**: Musicianship is capped at 80 unless the Self Taught ability is maxed; with Self Taught maxed, 100/100/100 barding builds are possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546286709757714542)
- **musicianship skill dropping**: If you have Discordance, Peacemaking and Provocation, you can drop Musicianship, and your effective Musicianship equals the lowest of those three skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524038738026692808)
- **necro poison mage template**: One suggested Necro Poison Mage template is Necromancy 120, Poisoning 110/120, Taste Identification 120, Meditation 80, Alchemy 80 and Spirit Speak 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548375001181454357)
- **necro vet herd mastery link grinding**: On a necro vet herd summoner build, earning XP to raise mastery links is what increases damage, and the same build can be used to grind aspects for other echoes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545300401614626846)
- **necromancer herder template**: A necromancer summoner with herding does not need Inscription since herding is a separate damage source and one main damage source should be chosen; a suggested template is 120 Necromancy/Herding/Spirit Speak, 100 Magery/Veterinary, 80 Meditation/Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529035140964290700)
- **necromancer summon duration**: Necromancer summons last long enough that they are not a bother to resummon once the points in the tome are unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521328423161565337)
- **necromancer summoner skill requirements**: A necromancer summoner needs Magery to cast summons and Necromancy for the ability that turns summons undead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526334362013012059)
- **necromancer-swordsman template viability**: A Necromancer-Swordsman template is generally subpar for PvM, Necromancy adds little unless the build is a full hybrid with Magery and summoning, and it has no Magic Resist so it dies quickly to players in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528779302345375765)
- **necromancy and chivalry books**: Necromancy and Chivalry books are not codices like the Magery grimoire, and they are required to train the Necromancy and Chivalry skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544749833955581983)
- **necromancy and inscription for fast-killing arcane mage**: On a fast-killing arcane mage, necromancy is unnecessary because mobs die too quickly, and 120 inscription is a waste of points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531361544439595099)
- **necromancy as complementary skill**: Necromancy is a versatile complementary skill that fits poison builds, summoner builds and arcane builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338460756480051)
- **necromancy book and codex progression**: The necromancy book is required to train the Necromancy skill and earns no experience, with its abilities unlocking as Necromancy skill increases, whereas the grimoire is a Codex, the first of the post-skill XP progression systems, which earns XP from kills to unlock bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919281572118559)
- **necromancy dependence on magery**: Necromancy is not intended to be used standalone; it enhances Magery spells in various ways, so you need Magery skill and a normal spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554283736445624351)
- **necromancy gain from non-attack spells**: Necromancy skill gain works with non-attack spells as well, including Nightsight, which has no effect but still trains the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523744652941852776)
- **necromancy magery requirement**: Necromancy in Outlands requires Magery as a prerequisite skill, though a player thinks that requirement should be removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532531446214823998)
- **necromancy nerf for spellcasters**: Necromancy was significantly nerfed for spellcasters, so spellcaster-focused builds can play without it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540258323616632872)
- **necromancy skill cap dependency on magery**: Necromancy is capped by Magery until Magery reaches 100, after which Necromancy can be raised to 120 without Magery going higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541109544959086724)
- **necromancy skill effect on damage**: The Necromancy skill is reported to increase only the damage of minions (summoned pets) and not other damage sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532199087460585706)
- **necromancy skill lock value**: Necromancy can be locked at 75 or 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523002624088215562)
- **necromancy spell choices**: For Necromancy, Corpse Skin is the main reason to take the skill and Mind Rot is the best place to spend remaining points; Strangle may help against bosses but keeping both active may cause symbol generation issues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525988182674509895)
- **necromancy starting book**: A starting necromancy book is required before you can train the Necromancy skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544947706441633812)
- **necromancy summon undead mappings**: With the Necromancy ability active, an Earth Elemental summon becomes a Mummy and a Daemon summon becomes a Vampire; a Fire Elemental summon may become a Lich, which is less certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526334539767480350)
- **necromancy training cap from npcs**: NPC trainers only train Necromancy up to a limit; to reach 80 you must train in Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545652507295088792)
- **necromancy vampire thrall summon**: Adding Necromancy to a summoner build replaces the daemon summon with a vampire thrall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548026883906609333)
- **new archer dexterity progression**: Dexterity progression is slow for a new player archer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533009194343731292)
- **new player poisoning template**: A suggested new-player poisoning template uses 120 Poisoning so poison needs reapplying less often, and 100 Fencing because accuracy matters more for newer players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544723271612764280)
- **nightstalker pet taming requirement**: The Nightstalker pet requires 110 Taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549642441647460412)
- **nine skills at 80 farming build**: A build of nine skills at 80 can still farm without issue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524040367312343082)
- **non-hiding speed pilfering viability**: Non-hiding speed pilfering is the only way to make pilfering reasonably decent, yet almost every other form of PvM still outperforms it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546631622043111484)
- **normal stabber skill choices**: A normal stabber build usually takes Camping and Forensic Evaluation instead of Item ID, as this yields more overall gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555333432492429373)
- **nox mage poison kit perks**: For a nox (poison) mage, the poison kit is mainly used to pump single-target damage perks, unless you want to AoE farm, in which case you pump Airborne. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525133333275742278)
- **nox summoner template**: A suggested Nox summoner template is 120 Poisoning, Taste Identification and Necromancy, 100 Magery and Spell Shielding, and 80 Alchemy and Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523303525965103235)
- **noxcro arcane build**: A Noxcro (nox necromancer) build can use both the Arcane skill and the Arcane aspect, alongside Alchemy, Taste Identification and Poisoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524832912758018068)
- **noxcro codex types**: A Noxcro uses the Summoner Tome, Wizard's Grimoire and Poison Kit codex types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521862665176088577)
- **noxcro grim spell disease build**: A Noxcro build can use the grim spells to spread disease, swapping Evaluating Intelligence for Camping, with the aim of staying above 50% mana to run through SSC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534438360393711687)
- **noxcro skill setup**: A poison necro mage (Noxcro) typically takes Spirit Speak and Meditation (about 100 meditation) so that summoned earth elementals or mummies tank while the player casts, and can skip Eval Int because poison provides the damage, though Eval Int allows casting all damage spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527559056670199818)
- **npc item identification training**: An NPC trainer can instantly raise Item Identification to 50 for 500 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763161957408769)
- **npc mining training**: You can pay an NPC to train mining to 50, and the resources gathered at 50 mining are still very lucrative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603219024650253)
- **npc skill trainers**: According to the wiki's Trainable Skills from NPCs section, Butcher, Healer, and Tanner NPCs can train skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526594956125278350)
- **npc skill training**: Trainable skills can be learned from NPCs, as listed in the Trainable Skills from NPCs section of the Skills & Stats page on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533396791691579453)
- **npc trainer skill purchase limit**: Skills already at 50 or higher cannot be bought up from NPC trainers, which only train skills up to 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547918053365387265)
- **npc trainers at skill cap**: NPC trainers will not teach skills once you are at the skill cap, but you can turn skills down to make room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531365576063062036)
- **npc training credit deed**: A training credit deed trains skills at 1 gold per 0.1 skill and NPCs can train a single skill only up to 50; stand within 2 tiles of the NPC, select the train option, drag the deed onto the NPC and choose how much to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612942008745984)
- **npd skill gain bonus**: In the NPD, Herding gets a bonus skill gain chance, while gathering and crafting skills do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552535820605587477)
- **npd training dummies**: The training dummies outside the New Player Dungeon only protect from thieves up to skill 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536168153074368612)
- **ocean fishing rewards**: In ocean fishing, gold, XP and skill gains come from fishing spots fished with a fishing net rather than from fishing with a pole. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527311426245628035)
- **old fire tailor wrestling build**: The old fire tailor wrestling build is not good, and was not good before either. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524162805115257023)
- **open nearby corpses option**: An 'open nearby corpses' option exists, letting players skin without using a skinning knife on each corpse, though few players use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677858633285693)
- **optional backstabber skills and damage cap**: Of the optional backstabber skills Camping, Tracking, Item Identification and Alchemy, only Alchemy requires waiting until the damage cap is reached; the others are close in damage output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541914594602127360)
- **outlands butler barding tool**: Outlands Butler offers a barding tool where you enter your aspect level and codex setup (number of links) to see which mobs you can bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543380126522155009)
- **outlands butler societies optimiser**: The Outlands Butler societies optimiser page shows potential skill-ups from society jobs when its columns are expanded, so you can pick jobs that also raise your skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528582812096270527)
- **outlands butler taming levelling page**: The Outlands Butler taming levelling page shows which creatures to tame for your current skill level as you progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552408653850480684)
- **outlands wiki tailoring leather requirements**: The Outlands wiki lists how much leather is needed to train Tailoring to 100 and 120, with and without recycling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042971178438787)
- **outpost moongate training alternative**: The outpost moongate is an alternative place to train when the training dummy area is crowded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535252060642222203)
- **overhead messages for barding results**: Overhead messages can be set up to show when a barding attempt succeeds or fails, making manual barding easier to track. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525639474334273576)
- **overlooked skill in thieves codex**: The Overlooked skill in the thieves codex is considered useless and unreliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545802906752524358)
- **paladin chivalry template**: A common paladin template is about 100 chivalry, 100 tactics, 100 weapon skill, and 80 each of healing, anatomy, parrying and arms lore, with the last slot going to focus or another utility skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553014447134482614)
- **paladin codex choice**: Paladins are advised to take the Healers Codex over the Parry Codex, though a Paladin who also uses Parry wants the Parry Codex as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535761443667058720)
- **paladin holy symbol cap and tactics**: A Paladin's maximum number of holy symbols drops (for example from 12 to 9) if Tactics falls below 100, because 100 Tactics is needed for the +10 bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543836166250565732)
- **paladin pvm and dungeon picker combination**: A paladin template has no spare skill slots for Lockpicking and Detect Hidden, so a dungeon picker cannot be combined with a paladin PvM character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547921524747407400)
- **paladin skill drop for 700 cap**: A paladin who must drop a skill to fit the 700 cap can drop parry or resist, with resist probably the better one to drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553013591400124518)
- **panacea alchemy codex upgrade**: The Panacea Alchemy Codex upgrade is a good option when frequently fighting enemies that inflict bleeds and disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547007284075307088)
- **panacea need for chivalry dexxers**: A dexxer with Chivalry likely needs Panacea in the alchemy codex less than one without it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531123540823244963)
- **parry armor bonus requirement**: The armor bonus from the Parry skill only works while a shield is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381196671098951)
- **parry build mana regen**: 80 Focus plus Freedom is more than enough mana regeneration for a Parry build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529944460329222364)
- **parry codex**: The Parry codex is versatile and gives high survivability at the cost of DPS, and includes Warding and Barrier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531348287159013598)
- **parry on air aspect wrestler**: Parry is not worth running on an air aspect wrestler because the air aspect already provides built-in damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524469609862922270)
- **parry replacement on discipline armor build**: On a Discipline armor build, Parry can be replaced with Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535802013949108326)
- **parry skill above 80**: Nearly all the benefit of Parry comes from the codex, which is enabled at 80 Parry, so raising Parry above 80 is rarely wanted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520800584792543252)
- **parry without wrestling in noxcro build**: Parry is considered to have little point without Wrestling in a noxcro build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541832979490414752)
- **parrying and focus skill cap**: Parrying and Focus have a skill cap of 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552417084628271145)
- **parrying on pure backstabber**: A pure backstabber does not need Parrying because backstabbers should rarely get hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543138669676863618)
- **parrying skill gain**: Skills in Outlands are not XP based, but having more mobs hitting you gives a better chance to gain Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539963817595773010)
- **parrying skill power**: The Parrying skill is considered extremely powerful, comparable in strength to alchemy with a codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522699958216822907)
- **party invite green flag resist training**: Reportedly, inviting a character to your party and flagging green lets you attack that member without becoming a criminal, allowing a tamer to train a PvP character's resist spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528917342422175886)
- **passive summoner barding skills**: 80 in each of three barding skills is enough for a passive summoner; you get passive buffs from barding songs even though many active barding attempts will fail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532719751648907368)
- **passive tracking training in city**: Tracking can reportedly be trained passively in a city by setting the hunting/tracking agent to 'always get closest' instead of 'new when no target', though this comes from a single unconfirmed player report. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546491330358677585)
- **peacedin bard skill requirements**: A peacedin (peacemaking bard) build wants both Discordance and Peacemaking skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531927491592065064)
- **peacemaking and provocation training prerequisite**: Until you have points in the Self Taught ability, you may need Musicianship before you can work up Peacemaking or Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549961387428810843)
- **peacemaking success**: Peacemaking success depends on effective barding skill versus the target creature's difficulty, with no fixed skill requirement, so peacing a Daemon is harder than peacing an Orc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526192711722598420)
- **pet animal lore requirement**: Pets do not drop Animal Lore, so you need both Animal Lore and Taming to have pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477246136488047)
- **pet bless bonus at 80 magery**: With 80 Magery instead of 100, the bless bonus for pets is 4% instead of 5%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542938176451256430)
- **pet composition spreadsheet location**: Vin's spreadsheet of pet compositions, including warpigs and faery wyrm bestiary, is in the sticky/pinned comment in the taming channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522982444683362476)
- **pet experience when fighting together**: Tamed pets do not receive reduced experience when they fight together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524874813540143175)
- **pet resurrection via healing and veterinary**: A player with 80 Healing and 80 Anatomy can resurrect a pet by bandaging it, and a player with 80 Veterinary can resurrect a pet using vet supplies or bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533258237623668767)
- **pet training bricking**: A pet's training cannot really be bricked, since a pet can still reach level 15 by grinding XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547442795038642317)
- **pet wrestle stat tolerance vs minimum taming**: As a pet's minimum taming requirement increases, its base wrestling rises too, so a player can be more lenient about its wrestle stat when choosing a pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487894067286058)
- **pets attacking their owner**: Pets can attack their owner, which players can use to take damage for training Healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554938962051862700)
- **pets for taming training**: Players should not use pets they care about to train taming, because other players may kill them or drag them away; cheap ostards are the better choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532533341692231681)
- **pets without herding and veterinary**: Pets without Herding and Veterinary skills are fairly ineffective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528788773372956763)
- **pickpocket dip training house**: Go to the training house at the previous moongate and use the pickpocket dip on its right side; standing within 2 tiles of the house lets you train Hiding, Stealth, Snooping and Stealing at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531782132203257967)
- **pickpocket dips training**: To train pickpocket dips, talk to a thief NPC and join the Grayhand thieves guild, which reportedly costs roughly 5k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553265910389932114)
- **pilfering abilities**: For pilfering, the Extortion and Overlooked abilities increase profits and survivability, and Without a Trace (used with smoke bombs) is also good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542030515299819521)
- **pilfering and stealing from players**: Pilfering requires a different template than the backstabber mugging build, and stealing from other players is not very worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530428575470321825)
- **pilfering attempt count**: Pilfering sometimes requires up to 3 attempts before it succeeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546631625071136778)
- **pilfering baseline success chance**: Pilfering has a baseline success chance of 75% before creature difficulty is factored in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552081064237863006)
- **pilfering codex for backstabbers**: A backstabber can obtain the full Pilfering codex before finishing the backstab build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541883441857957941)
- **pilfering codex point template**: For a pilfering template, put the first 10 codex points into the early upgrades, then points 11-15 into Camo, then the last 5 into Shadow Hands, and drop Snooping for Hiding only after finishing the Thieves Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546633567864365128)
- **pilfering item drop chance**: The chance to get an item, such as a treasure map, while pilfering is quite low, and the range of possible items is wide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550574103746838639)
- **pilfering monsters as a tamer**: To pilfer a monster with the Stealing skill as a tamer, run up to the monster, use a hotkey to target it, and use the Stealing skill on it while your pets are attacking it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549968054325084313)
- **pilfering while invisible**: You can pilfer while invisible from Magery, though mugging is the better option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549715139438055505)
- **pilfering with stealing**: With 100 Stealing you can pilfer by going up to mobs to receive money and occasionally rare items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530541173884719175)
- **pitchfork skill**: Pitchforks use the Fencing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547771916096380929)
- **plain leather for tailoring society training**: Plain leather gathered from skinning can be used to train Tailoring for the society. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536647717366005831)
- **plate armor when stealing**: Plate armor can be worn while stealing unless you have Meditation, according to a single player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530602465387614249)
- **platemail and stealth**: Wearing platemail does not affect stealthing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529224032203964488)
- **player resurrection method**: Players can be resurrected only with bandages; veterinary supplies and kits do not work on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552101942782857278)
- **playing with low spirit speak**: You can play with Spirit Speak at about 80 and let it rise naturally as you play rather than training it to 100 first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531826095576584282)
- **poison arcane mage skill allocation**: A poison arcane mage build has no spare skill room: arcane and wrestling are required, leaving only magery and either meditation or evaluate intelligence for the grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525649416046772274)
- **poison bard aspect choice**: A poison bard template is better served by the Lyric aspect than by the Poison aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554899674178134057)
- **poison build skill point cost**: Poison builds require a lot of skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529114374298402928)
- **poison dexxer alchemy use**: On a poison dexxer, Alchemy points go toward stronger explosion potions and stronger heal potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521752135128059915)
- **poison dexxer boss killer skill setup**: A poison dexxer boss killer uses fencing, with parry for omni bosses to help stay alive and arms lore replacing parry for regular bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528029343010521238)
- **poison dexxer skill choice**: Taste Identification is the skill to add to make a poison dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528450362011553882)
- **poison fencing backstabber variant**: A poison fencing backstabber variant exists but requires a lot of progression before it is worth using. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530428782895173684)
- **poison kegs for training**: Poison kegs can be found through the Outlands portal vendor search, and one keg of poison should be enough to train Poisoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529352153603375114)
- **poison kit damage reduction spec**: Players should not spec into the poison kit damage reduction under current balance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530661817855115265)
- **poison mage evaluating intelligence**: A poison mage does not need Evaluating Intelligence; it can summon earth elementals to tank and spam Poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544385903253000364)
- **poison necro poisoning requirement**: A poison necro may get away with 100 Poisoning instead of 120, and Taste Identification could be set to the same level as Poisoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538301838170918994)
- **poison necromancer aspect choice**: For the poison necromancer template, the Poison aspect should be used at least on the armor, and ideally on both armor and book to level it faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527678956126474260)
- **poison potions in alchemy training**: Making poison potions is not needed for alchemy training unless you plan to work up the poisoning skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524326208576163910)
- **poison pvm dexer skill split**: A poison PvM dexer uses 120 Poisoning and 80 Fencing, which may require dropping Fencing to fit Poisoning if no other poisoner is in the group. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527140853146063034)
- **poison shelf storage limits**: Only Greater poison and higher can be stored in the shelf, so the keg of poison used to train poisoning up to 60 skill does not go into the shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522732164314169415)
- **poison spell skill and poison upgrade chance**: Skilling the Poison spell in the Wizard tome influences the chance of a poison upgrade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554426984472379403)
- **poison summoner build**: A Poison Summoner build (e.g. Noxcro) can be made by swapping Wrestling for Spirit Speak. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528797284706553886)
- **poison summoner codexes**: The codexes for a poison summoner build are Wizard's Grimoire, Summoner's Tome and Poison Kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527559748424040539)
- **poison tamer codex choices**: For a poison tamer, the Fencing codex uses Aggressive (17.6% swing speed increase), Bane and Flurry; the Healers codex uses Without Borders, Pressure Points, Specialist and Triage; the bestiary choice depends on the pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542308395686695052)
- **poison tick damage and evaluating intelligence**: Poison tick damage does not require Evaluating Intelligence; Eval Int only matters if you also want to cast damage spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527579836716028059)
- **poison trapper template strength**: Poison Trapper is still a strong template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547629846778351717)
- **poisoner build choice**: The Agorawave aspect is weak, and a normal poisoner using the Poison aspect is much stronger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545921708467290213)
- **poisoning alchemy template cost**: An 80 alchemy / 120 poisoning template is cheaper than a 100 poisoning / 100 alchemy template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538345726919049226)
- **poisoning in trap/summon builds**: Poisoning cannot be fully leaned into as a build focus, so some players consider dropping 80 Poisoning from a trap/summon build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298979841609748)
- **poisoning requirement for poison links**: Spellcasters need about 80 Poisoning to make damage to poison links work, because Poisoning is required to apply Greater poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533748525631012996)
- **poisoning skill effect**: Poisoning skill only determines the chance to upgrade poison, so raising it from 100 to 120 adds very little; Taste Identification controls poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543605640277135430)
- **poisoning skill type**: Poisoning is a crafting-style skill that players typically raise gradually in the background when not otherwise playing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527786534609096906)
- **poisoning training location**: Poisoning does not gain quickly in Shelter Island, and it can be trained in the player's inn instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522213424967188481)
- **poisoning training scripts and healing requirements**: The 'Training Poisoning with no shelf' script works best with someone healing you on a loop because training damages you, while the 'Train Poisoning using a Shelf' script pulls poison from your shelf based on skill, requires a kryss, and does not require healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522732164314169415)
- **popular wrestling template**: A madness wrestler with alchemy is likely the template most players are running for wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535778458636914720)
- **post-cap progression**: Codices are the next progression step after a player has capped their baseline skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522012065529856071)
- **prevalia afk training area**: The AFK training area in Prevalia is at the Prevalia Moongate, top left. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553860190577623041)
- **prevalia chivalry trainer**: The chivalry trainer in Prevalia is the Paladin, located mid right. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526725773036097687)
- **prevalia sewers skill gain**: Prevalia sewers is a skill gain option after the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524740634999656630)
- **prevalia zoo fire strike training**: At the Prevalia zoo there is no healing while training Fire Strike; if you cast heal on yourself you can train near the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537777718546923652)
- **prevalia zoo musicianship training script**: A Razor script named 'Prevalia Zoo Training - Peace/Disco/Provo' exists on outlands.uorazorscripts.com for training Musicianship at the Prevalia zoo and resets when the Bard cooldown reset occurs for faster gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552151670975369308)
- **provocation and bard codex**: Provocation is mostly used as crowd control, and the bard codex incentivizes using all three bard skills because of the Self Taught ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527546985144385657)
- **provocation strength**: Provocation has been buffed multiple times recently but is still not strong enough to stand on its own, so pairing it with a combat skill is recommended because monsters do not damage each other much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609126358745258)
- **provocation training**: To train Provocation, run around provoking mobs onto each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551670892419874959)
- **provocation training at battlemaster**: Musicianship is not required to raise Provocation at the battlemaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553821818312466493)
- **provocation training locations**: Provocation can be trained to 80 in the shelter dungeon, or in the prev zoo if you want to AFK it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555239469475565712)
- **public battle trainer training**: Combat skills can be trained up to 100 by grinding at any public battle trainer, including leaving the character running overnight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525612170253959188)
- **public dip outside prevalia**: A public dip for training backstabber stealing is located just outside Prevalia, at the back of the building by the weapons training dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545960381850058784)
- **public pickpocket dip location**: A public Pickpocket dip for training thief skills from 75 to 100 is on the 2nd floor of The Cloak and Dagger Inn shop at coordinates 1755,2347. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554489609977860167)
- **pure alchemy mage template**: The pure alchemy mage template is 120 Alchemy, 100 Magery, 100 Meditation, 100 Wrestling, 100 Evaluating Intelligence and 100 Resisting Spells, and it gives high burst damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530399280651829248)
- **pure pvm discipline wrestler skill swaps**: For pure PvM, a discipline wrestler can swap Resist for Focus and Alchemy, preferring Alchemy over Parry, with enough Focus to reach the swing speed increase cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544425496283062282)
- **pure thief training path**: A pure thief trains hiding for a few hours, then stealth and hiding together up to 100 for a few hours, then snooping and stealing on a dip for a few hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525622881596211202)
- **pvm dexxer tank build advice**: For a tankier, harder-hitting PvM dexxer, one player suggests 80 Alchemy, dropping Archery, raising Arms Lore up to 120, and putting the rest into Focus while keeping swing speed near the cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554569068714139761)
- **pvm parry and resist choice**: A PvM character does not need both Parry and Resist, and most PvMers choose Alchemy instead of either. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523776402137026600)
- **pvp lumberjacker build**: The pvp lumberjacker build focuses on chopping trees for resources rather than killing mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545149946422894642)
- **pvp mage template wiki page**: The Outlands wiki has a PvP mage template page (TemplatesPvPMage) that includes an alchemy build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527766226561007790)
- **quiver bolt savings**: Even a cheap to mid-quality quiver reduces the amount of bolts you use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523022835692474419)
- **raising a codex**: To raise a codex, take only the minimum skill levels required for that codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543140313571528744)
- **raising herding on the trainer**: With a good Veterinary skill, you can have your followers attack the Herding trainer to raise Herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529805794454016211)
- **raising skills from 100 to 120**: To raise a skill from 100 to 120, buy Skill Mastery Scrolls (for example from player vendors), use them, and then train the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536295488301568050)
- **raising vet healing pets in a house**: It is possible to raise vet healing pets inside a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531611226063245433)
- **raising veterinary before animal lore**: Before raising Animal Lore, kill a bonded pet and try to resurrect it; without lore the resurrection fails but Veterinary skill still raises. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541530162846244984)
- **ranged backstab and tactics**: Backstabbing from range used to require tactics, but with the codex mug-from-range ability tactics can theoretically be dropped if you stay in range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525542771132334080)
- **raw meat uses**: Raw meat from mobs is useful for Cooking training and sells to a butcher NPC for very little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531042243039989930)
- **recall failure at low magery**: Recall can fail at low Magery skill, so relying on it to escape can get you killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533252994584547418)
- **recall interrupt mitigation skills**: Some skills, such as Wrestling and Resisting Spells, mitigate the interruption of Recall casting when you are hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535386861894373406)
- **recall spell reagent cost**: One Recall spell cast by a mage requires 1 black pearl, 1 blood moss and 1 mandrake root. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554807216014630955)
- **recommended links for 120 barding**: With 120 Barding, the recommended links are Melee Dmg/Ignore Armor, Dmg Dealt By Player, and Bard Reset/Break Ignore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540752480214974506)
- **redline point gaining methods**: Message in a Bottle (MIB) content is the best way to gain redline points, with pits or ocean also good, while treasure maps are currently among the worst for xp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531368826178900048)
- **releasing and retaming creatures**: A released tamed creature can be tamed again, and released creatures do not turn hostile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528232585678032997)
- **removing box traps**: Use Detect Hidden with remove trap tools to remove a trap from a box; the trap stays gone until a tinker re-traps the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550977402648141839)
- **removing shadow aspect from weapon**: To remove the Shadow Aspect from a weapon while training, drop the weapon on the ground and pick it back up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533449049179688982)
- **removing traps from dungeon chests**: To remove traps from locked dungeon chests, you need the Detecting Hidden skill and trap removal tools; double-click the chest to open a gump with the remove-trap option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042217725395045)
- **replacing meditation with evaluating intelligence**: Replacing Meditation with Evaluating Intelligence on a mage tamer boosts spell damage and still allows mushrooms and the full wizard grimoire, but mana must be waited on, so it is not recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552226025201598517)
- **replacing one skill with another**: To replace a skill, set the skill to keep to go up and the skill to replace to go down, then pay 500 gold to train the new skill to 50; as it gains those 50 points, the skill set to decrease drops by 50 automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530251749804343347)
- **requirements to receive a transferred horse**: To receive a transferred horse from another player, you must have no current horse and 0 followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532371543957704787)
- **resist benefits for mage tamers**: Resist gives some damage resistance and spell damage resistance, some PK defense, and a refund chance that lets you retain crafted books at high aspect tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **resistance cap overcapping**: If a build is overcapped on resistances, the excess points can be reallocated, for example from Focus to Arms Lore and Anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535387140555407381)
- **resisting spells on archer build**: Resisting Spells is pretty much a must-have skill on an archer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543673468527190027)
- **resisting spells on melee template**: Players who want Resisting Spells on the sword-and-shield template can drop Focus to make room for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457563825709149)
- **resisting spells training above 80**: Above 80 Resisting Spells you must do similar training against casters in the wilderness or let it rise naturally, and the POI Telescope Island is a great spot for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551299911667154965)
- **resisting spells training deaths**: Dying to summoned elementals while training Resisting Spells may be caused by running out of mana, and summoning only one elemental may help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533580527519535154)
- **resisting spells training in sanctuary dungeon**: Train Resisting Spells in the weekly Sanctuary dungeon by finding the weakest caster mob and auto-healing, which avoids the risk of PK interruption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495732323459073)
- **resisting spells training location andaria ruined tower**: Andaria Ruined Tower is another place to train Resisting Spells, though Telescope Island is preferred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554480174584692737)
- **resisting spells training method**: To train Resisting Spells, a player can cast damage spells on themselves and then heal, but if mobs cast on the player instead, the player only needs to heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532911388853403719)
- **resisting spells training past 80**: Resisting Spells can be trained past 80 at the evil mage spots in the wilderness, such as telescope island, except the daemon spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537598003819446302)
- **resisting spells training with banshees**: Banshees are good enemies for training Resisting Spells; one player maxed it in a few hours starting from 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547406189351145554)
- **resource map build direction**: Resource map builds will likely become a hybrid of harvesting and PvM skills, since going in blind requires combat skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531409988340416724)
- **resource map cartography requirements**: Resource maps likely have the same cartography deciphering requirements as treasure maps; a success-chance chart based on Witcher's testing exists on the forums, but there is no official statement of the values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529165771500945459)
- **resource map skill**: Under the new system, resource map handling uses the Cartography skill in place of Lock Picking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528170156445143143)
- **resource recovery while training crafting**: While training crafting skills, you should recover as many resources as possible so you can keep crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098464857038890)
- **respec by lowering skill locks**: To respec, set the skill lock arrows to down on the skills you are willing to lose so that points can be taken from them when raising other skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525341211483701368)
- **resurrect chance skill thresholds**: Healing gives a 100% resurrect chance at 100 Healing and 80 Anatomy; Veterinary likely gives 100% at 100 Veterinary and 80 Animal Lore, but this is an unconfirmed analogy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538891479462846476)
- **resurrecting players with veterinary**: To resurrect another player with the Veterinary skill, double click bandages and target the player; double clicking vet supplies might also work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532637467616743564)
- **resurrecting tamed pets via shelter dungeon**: Pets you tame yourself can be taken to the Shelter dungeon to bring them to level 1, which allows them to be resurrected when they die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529422379321921567)
- **resurrection skills**: Both Chivalry and Magery can resurrect players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528262963088326838)
- **retaming inside player houses**: Retaming for skill gain cannot be done inside a player house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526201655551332443)
- **retaming location for taming skill gain**: To retame animals for taming skill gain, stand inside a building with small rooms in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553575595777065031)
- **retaming same pet change**: The ability to retame the same pet for training is a recent change, so many older taming guides are out of date. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083318901772380)
- **retrieving abandoned pets**: If you show 0/5 followers, no pets on the stats gump followers tab, and did not stable them, visit an Animal Wrangler to attempt to retrieve Abandoned Pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554099641199497307)
- **reusing existing echo skills in a new build**: To reuse skills from an existing echo in a new build, activate that echo and overwrite an available echo slot with it, then train the other desired skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541795474712035348)
- **revolution song effect**: Revolution song buffs the damage mobs deal to each other when provoked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541834639214120970)
- **ruffian and shadow hands leveling**: Only about 12 points must be ground up front to max out Ruffian and Shadow Hands; the rest can be leveled while backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524861973202862241)
- **ruffian tactics during ability**: With the Ruffian (thief) ability active, Tactics counts as 100 plus the weapon bonus and aspect weapon bonus for about 10 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548353973910765690)
- **s-tier tameable animal spawns**: S-tier tameable animals spawn randomly and rarely, and may be killed by farming players before they can be tamed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520356396254625803)
- **sacred journey buff and chivalry**: The Sacred Journey buff disappears whenever your displayed Chivalry skill value changes, such as while still training the skill; this stops once skills are finalized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555659377577566350)
- **sacred journey requirements**: Using Sacred Journey via the '[SacredJourney' command requires a Chivalry skill of at least 95, and it has a cooldown after use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549741554057613367)
- **safe parry training**: To train parry safely, go to Terran, double click your shield and target yourself so the aoe-taunted cats and dogs attack you, then heal; if they don't come, attack them and tab out of war. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536314303483748403)
- **safer pilfering method**: To pilfer more safely, stay in populated dungeons and pilfer from a mob that is already aggroed on someone else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552081446183764111)
- **safest afk magery method**: For AFK Magery training, summoning elementals at home is considered safer than risking an expensive satchel and many reagents AFK at the zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524520304813281401)
- **sample backstabber template**: A sample new backstabber template is 120 forensics, 120 stealth, 100 hiding, 100 stealing, 100 camping, 100 tracking and 80 mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541883172743282852)
- **sample madness archer skill set**: A sample madness archer build uses Tactics 100, Chivalry 120, Archery 100, Anatomy 80, Arms Lore 80, Healing 80, Resisting Spells 80, Focus 75 and Alchemy 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534620686197456897)
- **sanctuary xp rates with item identification**: One player reports better xp rates in sanctuary with 120 Item Identification and a supremely vanquishing weapon than in a normal dungeon with a crafted weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552721172607664158)
- **scavenger benefits**: A scavenger produces loot, lets you learn the dungeons, and yields practically endless meats, reagents and leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554365194560610326)
- **scavenger build**: A scavenger build can use any skill combination, commonly with Forensic Evaluation and Camping plus other skills of choice, to skin and loot other players' leftover kills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525176225558040617)
- **scavenger chest level limits**: A scavenger will likely not open chests above level 6, and adding the harvest aspect makes the build work well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364957674577992)
- **scavenger role activities**: A scavenger hides and skins monster kills made by other players and lockpicks dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364920877813863)
- **scavenger survival skills**: Camping adds carry weight, parrying improves survivability, and spirit speak provides summons and extra survivability, which together make scavenging mostly safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535749847112744960)
- **scribe 125 inscription requirement**: A scribe who does not run eld armor needs to run 2 bronze spirit links to reach 125 inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545982189710090320)
- **scribe benefits for tamers**: Scribe gives longer bless and protection duration for you and your pets and reduces scroll consumption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **scribe damage bonus versus filler skills**: The scribe damage bonus may be stronger than other damage bonuses for filler skills such as Forensic Evaluation and Tracking, though this may be outdated after recent changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545982628866555904)
- **scribe inscription benefits**: Extra inscription (scribe) points give a decent damage bonus, longer buff duration, a better chance to reflect twice, a second Evaluate Intelligence and effectively endless Flamestrikes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550256109854400694)
- **scribe turbo meditation build**: Scribe is a viable choice for a hybrid turbo meditation build, and a PvMP version works better with high links and aspect bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548961659073339423)
- **scroll crafting to gm tailoring**: Making scrolls will not skill you up all the way to GM Tailoring, despite a claim that it would. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526985995604590772)
- **seafaring fisherman build**: A seafaring fisherman build takes 120 Fishing and optionally 120 Forensic Evaluation for cutting hides, plus any other desired combat skills, since Fishing is not demanding on the PvM side. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528886485313519676)
