- **searing imp pet for low taming**: Searing Imp is a decent pet choice for a tamer who has only 85 Taming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555979756342612181)
- **self taught codex point requirement**: Self Taught needs only two codex points, assuming the character stays at 80 skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936891072483559)
- **self taught codex requirements**: The Self Taught codex ability requires Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance together; Peacemaking plus Discordance alone is not enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539575388458582066)
- **self taught damage buff**: The Self Taught codex provides a free damage buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535161449721233469)
- **self taught musicianship**: Self Taught sets your Musicianship to match 80/100/120, limited to the lowest of Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541503521533202512)
- **self taught points with 80 printed skills**: If your printed skills are 80, 3 points in Self Taught should be enough rather than 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521147792373055619)
- **self-healing for dungeon chest lockpicker build**: A dungeon chest lockpicker build needs some form of self-healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545810532135600200)
- **selling alchemy training potions**: No NPC buys potions made while training Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532826633331933285)
- **setting skills down**: Open the paperdoll, click skills, and click the arrow next to a skill once to set it down, which drains points into skills marked up; click again to lock it so it neither gains nor loses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589539205681235)
- **shadow hands tier 3 snooping**: With Shadow Hands Tier 3, a player can have 0 printed Snooping and use 100 Hiding skill to get an effective Snooping of 100 for Pilfering and Mugging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549480003320815617)
- **shared skills before echo creation**: If two templates share skills, it is better to max those shared skills before creating the echo; otherwise they must be raised twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534765966431490088)
- **shelter chivalry trainer**: A chivalry trainer in Shelter is located next to the bank and can train chivalry up to 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539947070058926131)
- **shelter dungeon and crafting skills**: The Shelter dungeon is not useful for training crafting skills such as alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524327313846571048)
- **shelter dungeon parry spot**: To train Parrying in Shelter dungeon, bring one mob to the stairs going down from inside the cave under the moongate and keep a shield equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544321026358509648)
- **shelter dungeon training speed bonus**: The Shelter dungeon applies an x6 training speed bonus, but the battle trainer dummy is outside the dungeon, so training on it is slower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536145780232949871)
- **shelter inn thief npc stealing training**: In Andaria, a thief NPC at the Shelter inn sells Stealing skill training up to 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521699640590864446)
- **shelter weaponmaster throwing training**: The Weaponmaster NPC in Shelter trains the throwing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521193023961038918)
- **shepherd's crook herding bonus**: The Shepherd's Crook bonus is limited by the Herding skill you have, so with zero Herding you get no bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523674121005699112)
- **shield benefit for parrying training**: Using a shield may level Parrying faster because you can tank more skeletons, since good shields add substantial armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535281625481617438)
- **shield in bard builds**: A shield does not fit easily into a bard build, but an 80 tribard could drop arms lore for parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538688565616050196)
- **showing skill gain chances**: To display skill gain chance messages, click your own character and select 'Show Skill Gain Chances' from the menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531231546034618490)
- **simultaneous bard songs**: All three bard songs can be active at once: the discordance song gives damage resist, the provocation song gives damage, and the peacemaking song increases healing received. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541542426533953627)
- **simultaneous codex training**: Multiple codices can be trained at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541398603430371429)
- **simultaneous magery and resist training**: A single character cannot train Magery and Resisting Spells at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532910224409891066)
- **single-target trapper build**: A Trapper can be built for single-target damage, but it is not as fun as the group-oriented build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547578592576409650)
- **skeletal dragon taming location**: Skeletal dragons may be tamed on level 2 of the Ossuary outside the mini boss room, with a gate right next to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486654562377771)
- **skill and harvest bonus needed for avar map**: A character with 13 Harvest from harvest armor and 102.5 Lumberjacking skill is reported to be enough to harvest an avar map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535707720500514907)
- **skill and stat gain by use**: Skills and stats in Ultima Online are gained by using them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554372782941413408)
- **skill availability**: All skills are available to a character from the start, so what matters is how you train them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525618119291441272)
- **skill bonus stacking**: A character with 100 skill who has a +3 skill bonus effectively has 103 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529513945294045265)
- **skill build room**: A skill will not increase if the build has no room for it, so skills the build does not need should be set down to free room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531821956133818543)
- **skill cap affordability**: A character can only afford about 7 skills at 100, though they can be improved slightly later, so some initial skills must eventually be dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531193778092638278)
- **skill cap and mastery scrolls**: When a skill reaches its skill cap (such as Camping), it cannot gain further and a skill mastery scroll is needed to raise it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531248259681484841)
- **skill cap display values**: The skill cap values shown in the skills interface include bonuses in the displayed value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540762527737053264)
- **skill cap management**: When the total skill cap is reached, lower certain skills using the arrows next to them to free up points for raising other skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526214211728969829)
- **skill cap progression**: Players reach the skill cap quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524892469320224900)
- **skill caps**: Every skill caps at 100 by default on Outlands, and raising it from 100 up to 120 requires skill scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536117739888967710)
- **skill caps above 100**: Skill levels of 100 and 120 give more damage and skill chance, and some skills must reach 100 before other skills can go beyond 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544740151278698597)
- **skill chain bonus display**: If a skill chain's percentage bonus is not showing, the chain may not be activated and needs to be reactivated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522278959402844241)
- **skill choices for wrestling dexxer**: Focus and Arms Lore are worth considering for a wrestling dexxer, and Chivalry is an option as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532851658529444052)
- **skill gain and lowering**: Using a skill gives a chance to raise it, and skills can also be set to go down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531195196937736202)
- **skill gain chance and weapon speed**: Skill gain chance depends on current skill level, the skill's own scalar, and swing speed; faster weapons have a lower gain chance per swing but swing more often, while slower weapons have a higher chance per swing but swing less, so gains balance out over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528727580188868649)
- **skill gain chance per harvest swing**: Each pickaxe or hatchet hit (harvest swing) is a separate chance to gain skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529120078933528747)
- **skill gain conditions**: A skill should gain as long as you are not inside a house and have skill points available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522959374690160700)
- **skill gain from recycling**: Recycling does not grant any skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524921758157770874)
- **skill gain in rented rooms and homes**: Magery can be trained in a rented room, but Hiding and Stealth do not gain skill inside homes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528233505061081151)
- **skill gain location after level 80**: After level 80, the location where you train a skill does not matter for skill gain chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526555398516248637)
- **skill gain percentage message**: The skill gain percentage shown in the message is only the chance to gain skill, not a guarantee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524891840946503770)
- **skill gain rate and total skill cap**: Skill gain is slower outside the new player zone, and a total skill cap (such as 700) can stop gains on a skill unless other skills are lowered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532808864926535681)
- **skill gain settings for new characters**: A new character has all skills set to gain by default, so set the skills your build does not need to lower (or lock) so the skills your build needs can increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526060991094456452)
- **skill gain speed**: There is no power hour or skill gain window on the server; most combat skills can be GM'd in a day or two of AFK training, while gathering and crafting skills are the hard ones to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526823207766593586)
- **skill gains in towns**: Skills can be raised in towns in Outlands; the only town where gains stop is Shelter Island after 80 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553150673116336302)
- **skill gates**: Some skills have threshold gates rather than scaling linearly; for example, 60 Camping is needed to scroll around (Hike). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527111797671460937)
- **skill lock changes**: Skill lock changes sometimes only take effect after logging out and back in, so relog if a skill does not gain after changing its lock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532574844556673214)
- **skill lock management**: To manage skill locks, set all skills to 'down' first, then set the skills you want to keep training long term back to 'up'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550391268213784617)
- **skill mastery above 100**: Skills above 100 up to 120 require skill mastery scrolls, and not all skills can reach 120; the [skillmastery command shows which skills can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553358883521691684)
- **skill mastery command**: Type [skillmastery in game to see which skills can be raised to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526878873550061578)
- **skill not advancing**: If a skill will not advance, a common cause is that total skills are at the 700 skill cap, unless another skill is set to decrease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542273235792568330)
- **skill not gaining at skill cap**: If a skill will not rise, say '[skillmastery' in game to check whether you have hit the 700 total skill cap; if so, set another skill to 'down' so points can shift to the skill you want to raise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548184508426231862)
- **skill orb cap increase**: A skill orb only raises the 700 skill cap by up to 720. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542836325319843911)
- **skill overhaul and usefulness**: All skills on Outlands have been overhauled so none are useless; every skill helps with something and most help in battle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534589849011617902)
- **skill point budget for gathering build**: The build is capped at 700 total skill points, so reducing Spirit Speak to 80 frees points for 100 Camping while keeping a 700 total. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526816147813568542)
- **skill point transfer from down skills**: Points in skills set to 'down' eventually trade over to skills set to 'up' as those skills gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548188628738383925)
- **skill progression after 80 and skill cap**: Skill progression is slow after 80, and skills do not progress beyond the 700 point skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534843577807536260)
- **skill purchase cost**: Buying skill costs 1 gold per 0.1 skill point, i.e. 10 gold per 1.0 skill, 100 gold per 10.0, and 500 gold per 50.0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520545167587672155)
- **skill reductions with air armor**: Running air armor allows reducing chivalry to 0, alchemy to 80 and magic resistance to 80 while probably still capping swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538643600450261197)
- **skill restrictions in homes and inns**: A few skills do not work or gain in homes or inn rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489489345646716)
- **skill scroll effect**: Using skill scrolls does not raise the skill itself; the skill still has to be trained up afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533636804467626147)
- **skill scrolls for casting skills**: There are no skill scrolls for Magery, Evaluating Intelligence, Meditation or Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545901589863342100)
- **skill set flexibility and strong builds**: Chivalry and the bard skills are very powerful, summoner is popular but more complex, and players can pivot their skill set very easily if they dislike one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529077472501436467)
- **skill synergies wiki page**: The Outlands wiki page at https://wiki.uooutlands.com/Skill_Synergies lists skill synergies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523434368394199122)
- **skill synergies wiki page**: The Skill Synergies wiki page is incomplete: it omits Magery, the new skills, and secondary weapon damage sources, though the weapon skills pages list them as beneficial skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526590822336827533)
- **skill training difficulty**: Most skills are easy to level on Outlands, while harvesting and crafting skills are the hardest to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531172048850784377)
- **skill training difficulty by category**: Normal combat skills are fast and easy to train, gathering skills take a long time, and crafting skills are mostly expensive luxuries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524494332026159215)
- **skill training locations wiki**: The wiki page Skills & Stats lists where skills can be trained, at the bottom of the page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526385150252945408)
- **skill training method**: Skills are trained by using them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524983872050171904)
- **skill unlocks at 80**: Many skills unlock features at 80 skill points on this shard, making builds that mix 120s, 100s and 80s viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527665185911865466)
- **skills at 120**: A character can raise multiple skills to 120 in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534588656835100744)
- **skills below 80**: Skills below 80 generally accomplish nothing useful, though small leftover points in skills like camping (which raises carry weight capacity) can still be worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690313396944987)
- **skills list real and caps columns**: In the skills list, 'real' shows the point allotment while 'caps' shows the individual skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540763464874729514)
- **skills that do not proc aspects**: Tame lore, provocation, discordance, peacemaking, veterinary and herding do not proc an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523307287341436958)
- **skills that help barding**: Tracking and Forensic Evaluation both help with Barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549963382180941916)
- **skills window show real button**: The skills window may show a higher total and per-skill cap than the Skill Mastery display because it includes temporary boosts, and the Show Real button reveals the true values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534419065601523822)
- **skinner tamer camping setup**: Camping at 120 together with Death Echo is a good setup for a skinner tamer, since mule pets are being removed from the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534369927270498344)
- **skinning effect on forensic evaluation**: Skinning mobs killed during resource map runs may be why Forensic Evaluation rose much faster than the other harvesting skills, though this is only a suspicion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544402378625908849)
- **skinning for fishers**: Fishers benefit from also training skinning because skinning yields double procs of leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533644285205811351)
- **skinning on dexxer template**: Skinning does not fit well on a traditional dexxer template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532713133989171230)
- **skinning skill gain by creature type**: Skinning a bird gives the same skill gain chance as skinning a dragon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542606408745357352)
- **slowest skill to train**: Fishing is the slowest skill to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543632073661620304)
- **smoke bombs for pilfering thieves**: Smoke bombs can be a life saver for thieves when pilfering, so carry some. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552085247363907627)
- **snooping and shadow hands**: Snooping is needed until enough points have been put into Shadow Hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555942107187781734)
- **snooping replacement in template**: In the character template, snooping can only be replaced with hiding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537924798632562718)
- **societies skill requirements**: Carpentry, Blacksmithing and Tinkering are not needed to do societies well, and Tinkering can instead be used later for a trapper echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523745393748349048)
- **society crafter setup**: Get tailoring, alchemy and inscription to 100 on three crafting characters, one per account, training tailoring first, then alchemy as funds allow, then inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529946654378164265)
- **solo bard skill reduction with ebs links**: A solo bard with suitable links can drop bard skills to 100 or even 80 and supplement them with EBS links, freeing points for skills like focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552030925628514356)
- **solo pk tracking and faction dexxer template**: Tracking is wanted for solo PK builds in open-world PvP, and a faction dungeon dexxer template is GM Archery, Swords, Tactics and Resist plus 80 Healing, Anatomy, Arms Lore and Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524346674875596811)
- **spare skill points on poison dexxer**: On a poison dexxer, red weapon damage is small compared to poison damage, so spare skill points are better spent on Arms Lore, and Parrying is also a very good option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530648781534793900)
- **spear build adaptation**: For a spear build, take a sword-based build and swap Swordsmanship for Fencing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550014139223511062)
- **special loot container opening requirements**: A special loot item container requires the Lockpicking skill, and possibly Remove Trap, to open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525752572198125631)
- **speeding up resisting spells gain**: To speed up Resisting Spells gain, drink black potions and run the Andy mage tower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547526212103184404)
- **spell ball magery training**: Save the spell ball until you are ready to train magery, because the dungeon gives increased skill gain and players protect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544129349228437565)
- **spell sting and poison skill value**: Spells can now sting (apply poison effects), which makes 120 poison skill more worth taking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545305422930518139)
- **spell sustenance for summons**: Spell Sustenance is reportedly taken for summons that last longer than 2 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521549872443035791)
- **spellbook casting at 60 magery**: With 60 Magery you can cast from the spellbook without fail, and only one Recall or Mark scroll is needed to add that spell to your spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549623684677767260)
- **spellbook for dungeon lockpicker**: A player's existing spellbook can be used on a dungeon lockpicker because it is already blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543808818323005481)
- **spells needed to train magery**: A full spellbook is worth acquiring eventually, but training Magery to 100 only requires a few spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524904110845853817)
- **spellstone magery grinding path**: Grind magery to 80 with the spellstone on Shelter Island, then keep farming in sanctuary-type areas like Urukton or the Prevalia sewers until its charges run out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522080376938434661)
- **sphinx pet taming requirement**: The Sphinx pet is considered about as good as the Lemura but requires 110 taming skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521630170803605585)
- **spirit speak and ghost speech**: Spirit Speak likely still allows you to understand ghost speech. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287349802045602)
- **spirit speak and meditation for noxcro**: For a noxcro, 80 Spirit Speak is enough for summons to tank while casting, and 80 Meditation is fine when using a material book and capped refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544378502680281158)
- **spirit speak for mage-summoner bard necro template**: A mage-summoner bard/necro template needs Spirit Speak, so Veterinary should be dropped in its favor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526529630989975695)
- **spirit speak for meat shield summoners**: 80 Spirit Speak is common among summoners who use meat shield followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521324647826853918)
- **spirit speak for resource maps**: Spirit Speak is useful for doing resource maps, so it should be kept on a harvester template if you plan to do them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521187885083136081)
- **spirit speak gain chance**: Spirit Speak training depends only on the displayed gain percentage chance; there is no evidence that nearby mobs are required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531828175020101682)
- **spirit speak magery requirement**: A player reportedly needs 100 Magery to run Spirit Speak. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524838747722612870)
- **spirit speak spell damage bonus**: Spirit Speak likely no longer increases spell damage in Outlands, although the wiki may still list that effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527099779283423272)
- **spirit speak training script**: A community Spirit Speak training script claims about 5 hours to go from 80 to 120, assuming the player has all the required extras such as reagents and items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531826579536347206)
- **spirit speak versus magic resist**: Spirit Speak is mainly an offensive skill; unless you intend to fight back, Magic Resist is the better choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664979446145075)
- **spirit speaking offensive spell bonus**: Spirit Speaking gives a chance for offensive spells to do slightly more damage on the cast it triggers on, essentially a critical hit shown as charged spell chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538950412663652504)
- **stamina drain training bonus**: Draining the target's stamina makes skill training even better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528741550564184085)
- **standard throwing build**: A standard throwing build capped for swing speed is 100 Throwing, 100 Tactics, 80 Arms Lore, 100 Resisting Spells, 80 Healing, 80 Anatomy, 60 Focus and 120 Chivalry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537440723211788338)
- **starting aspects for dexxer**: The Temporal aspect is currently weak and lacks identity, while earth or holy are solid, inexpensive starting aspects for a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538619971872231524)
- **starting lockpicking**: Click the Pick Lock button in the lockpicking menu to start picking; you do not need to click the lockpick itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525880399975153814)
- **starting summoner stats and skills**: A starting summoner should have Str 100 and Dex 25, and eventually 120 Spirit Speak and 120 Necromancy to maximize pet damage, then choose between full pet damage and a hybrid spellcaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544031286375612426)
- **stat allocation choice**: Stat allocation is typically about which stat to leave at 25: choose STR/INT if you need mana, otherwise STR/DEX. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524519542712434728)
- **stat gain from skill use**: Stats rise as a side effect of using skills, and attacking a trainer NPC also raises them without needing a skill change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547896603942191205)
- **stat gain independent of skills**: Stats (Str, Dex, Int) can be raised independently of skills by setting the stat arrows up or down, so a character with maxed skills can still raise strength, for example by punching a training dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547044243787485246)
- **stat priority for sneaky lockpicker**: For a sneaky lockpicker who does not melee mobs, Intelligence is generally more valuable than Dexterity because the extra mana supports heals and emergency invisibility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550369468809482261)
- **stat requirements for skill training**: Stats are not a requirement for training skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525229086518280420)
- **stationary penalty during auto-training**: A character that stands still too long while auto-training receives a stationary penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533448084607074376)
- **stats effect on skills**: Stats have no effect on current skill points, skill gain, or skill caps; stats and skills raise independently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526955750361137285)
- **staying hidden after hide spell expires**: Casting the hide mage spell and then using the Hiding skill might keep you hidden after the spell's timer runs out, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521382874056757308)
- **stealing from mobs requirement**: A player must reportedly join the thieves guild as a grayhand before they can steal from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529543555264024676)
- **stealing from mobs while lockpicking**: The stealing skill lets you pilfer from mobs while moving between chests when lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553264717143867433)
- **stealing from players**: Players can steal from other players with the stealing skill, but not on Shelter Island and not with very low skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525618857249607841)
- **stealing from players versus dummies**: Training Stealing on real players rather than dummies from 80 skill requires a lot of stealing and many failed attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520894335300665415)
- **stealing from stacks**: The wiki has a formula for how much can be stolen from a stack, and potions weigh very little (about 0.1 each), so a large number can be stolen at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542589024571498576)
- **stealing gold from players**: Stealing gold from players is generally not worth it; thieves should look for valuable items instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523868377481744444)
- **stealing skill and black goods yield**: Stealing skill does not raise black goods yield unless the player is in the Red Hand guild; otherwise the amount is random, though black goods quality rises with mob difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522727657421144181)
- **stealing skill for backstabbers**: Backstabbers want at least 80 Stealing because it is the minimum needed for the thieves codex, and gold stolen while mugging or backstabbing also grants free experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531524273842290708)
- **stealing training near prevalia**: A location just north of Prevalia offers accessible dips for training Stealing, but it does not allow training Hiding or Stealth at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522032421598531624)
- **stealing unhidden penalty**: There is no longer a penalty for stealing while unhidden; the former -25% penalty was removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545626952738676826)
- **stealing weights wiki section**: The Outlands wiki Stealing page includes a Stealing Weights section describing steal weighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523867962124275742)
- **stealth armor restrictions**: The Stealth skill can be used while wearing any armor, with no armor restrictions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531319559762739290)
- **stealth failure in town**: Stealth can fail in town when another nearby player is revealing, and a system message tells you this happened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521827611464962206)
- **stealth line of sight requirement**: Stealth requires a clear line of sight with no monsters looking at you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521826207530877089)
- **stealth lockpicking skinning skill fit**: A single character likely cannot fit Stealth, Lockpicking and Skinning together within the skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532711000111976508)
- **stealth loss from stepping on mobiles**: Stealth may be lost without a backstab if you step onto another mobile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542847561155747962)
- **stealth pets at 80 animal lore**: Some stealth-suited pets can reportedly be tamed and used with 80 Animal Lore (tame lore), though the author is unsure which ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549641868868849780)
- **stealth skill failure and defense**: A stealth character at 100 skill should not fail stealth checks, and running without defensive skills raises death risk, with Magery being one of the better defensive options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532711000111976508)
- **stealth skill training**: Stealth can be used and trained like other skills without moving, so movement is not required to train it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526074264288104469)
- **stealthy scavenger build**: A stealthy scavenger build can use Forensic Evaluation, Magery, Parry, Magic Resist, Hiding, Stealth and Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849455378075680)
- **stickmage low-level skill setup**: For early stickmage sustain, run arcane/arcane, drop parry/necro, and lower focus to 80 to take 80 meditation and cooking; once arcane reaches about 10, swap meditation for alchemy, and later swap cooking for parry, resist or necro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549581789796769814)
- **suggested skill groupings**: One suggested skill set groups Carpentry, Blacksmithing, Inscription, Tailoring, Magery and Cooking, and another groups Tinkering, Lockpicking, Detect Hidden, Alchemy, Item Id and Cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523750130493427935)
- **suggested t-map template**: A suggested treasure map template is 120 Cartography, 120 Alchemy, 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 100 Magery, 80 Spirit Speak and 60 Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541533158845980683)
- **summon creature magery training limit**: Summon Creature casts at 100% success from 70 Magery, so it cannot raise Magery past about 80; use spells that can still fizzle to keep leveling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532990381539590234)
- **summon mana refund and meditation**: Summons cannot be refunded in Outlands, so a summoner benefits from Meditation to recover mana in dangerous situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526007464565149746)
- **summon spell experience gain**: Experience gain for summon spells scales with the number of pet slots a summon type occupies, so summoning multiples of a type progresses faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522735711789387846)
- **summon spell focus strategy**: Whether to focus on one summon spell or split among several is situational, and using 2 of the same summon type may be impractical depending on your template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522735711789387846)
- **summoner archer aspect and mana requirement**: A summoner archer running the blood aspect might work with meditation removed and spirit speaking lowered to 80, but with any other aspect about 50 mana is needed, which forces lowering dex and reduces swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545427439625441400)
- **summoner as early mage development**: Starting as a summoner forces a player to develop as a mage sooner, which has many benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529288776676016229)
- **summoner build skill choices with necromancy**: For a summoner focused on own spell damage, Spirit Speak can be dropped; to keep followers doing heavy damage, Focus can be replaced with Herding; Focus can replace Necromancy only if the pet model change is acceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548037456907993099)
- **summoner build without spirit speak**: A summoner build can drop Spirit Speak entirely and go arcane, but it will have no tank followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521327534795526204)
- **summoner evaluating intelligence and mana**: A summoner build does not need Evaluating Intelligence for the summoner's codex, and without Cooking or Meditation it will struggle for mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545423051309715541)
- **summoner harvester magery requirement**: The summoner harvester build requires 100 Magery, which a new player must train by macroing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531174108451176459)
- **summoner herding variant**: A summoner can take the pet route by dropping Focus and Evaluating Intelligence and adding Herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539607464775786537)
- **summoner inscription alternatives**: Some summoner players take Forensic Evaluation or Camping in place of Inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524782211524595853)
- **summoner mage upfront cost**: The summoner mage template has the downside of a small upfront cost to train Magery to 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **summoner meditation and grimoire use**: With 80 Meditation, a summoner can use the grimoire, particularly mushrooms, to help resummon elementals; spare skill points can go to Alchemy for more damage or Spirit Speaking for stronger elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545439833735037038)
- **summoner on gatherer character**: Playing a summoner on a gatherer character is not advised because the 700 skill point cap means 100 points go to the gathering skill instead of supplementing summoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531194525199106230)
- **summoner reagent upkeep**: A Summoner must source reagents for casting once the initial spell stone runs out of charges or is lost, which adds to loadout upkeep costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **summoner resummoning with spirit speak**: With Spirit Speak, a summoner rarely needs to resummon creatures except during back-to-back caldera maps, since meditation regenerates mana before another summon is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550583437369540609)
- **summoner skill swaps for forensics**: In summoner builds, players suggest dropping Forensics for Inscription in the spell damage build and for barding skills in the follower damage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523285102338117652)
- **summoner template**: A summoner template can use 120 Focus/Evaluating Intelligence, 100 Spirit Speak, 100 Herding, 100 Magery, 100 Meditation, 100 Evaluating Intelligence and 100 Wrestling, with Wrestling providing mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553673944647733249)
- **summoner third line without redline**: If you have no redline, a summoner's third line can be Necromancy, and you can double-click it to switch it to Follower Damage as you unlock that link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527468467698270228)
- **summoner trapper t-hunter meditation requirement**: A Summoner/Trapper T-Hunter does not need the Meditation skill, because a material spellbook is enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530570419869061140)
- **support tamer without magery**: For a pure support tamer without Magery, Discord is the single bard skill to take, and the suggested swap is Magery to Tactics and Meditation to a weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541488138080362667)
- **supporting skills for combat builds**: Item Identification boosts use of magic weapons and armor, Arms Lore gives combat bonuses, Alchemy boosts explosion potion damage and heal potion healing, and Healing, Anatomy and Magic Resist add survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548573398500646924)
- **swapping musicianship to provocation with self taught**: After committing to Self Taught, swapping Musicianship points to Provocation leaves the character essentially unplayable during the switch, so do it at a convenient time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531124482209747035)
- **swapping skills at the skill cap**: At the skill cap, set unwanted skills to decrease and keep training the skills you want, so the gains in the wanted skills replace the points lost in the unwanted ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551633658945736745)
- **swapping skills with npc trainer**: To swap skills using an NPC trainer, set the skill you want to train to UP and the skill you want to lose to DOWN; the message saying you must lose skills first usually appears when the arrows are not set correctly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543966048133586974)
- **swapping weapon skill for dexxer tamer**: A dexxer tamer can swap the weapon skill within about 20 minutes starting from Shelter Dungeon to try different builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530248260541747261)
- **switching weapon skill and codex**: Switching to a different weapon skill and codex is time consuming, more so the higher the existing weapon skill, but not difficult, and most builds can retrain in a few days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529261767023267881)
- **swords aggressive stance leveling**: The swords stance 'aggressive' must be leveled up to reach 50, and leveling it that high takes a busy day of play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540908184326111232)
- **swords codex leveling via thieves codex**: A player reportedly leveled the swords codex while backstabbing with zero printed tactics because the Thieves codex swapped in for tactics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543141476475740241)
- **swordsman lumberjacking build suggestion**: A swordsman build that includes Lumberjacking is suggested for exploring and harvesting resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929281656950926)
- **swordsman ship build**: To make a swordsman ship build for PvM or PvP, take 20 points from Chivalry and put them into Swords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543941460108255232)
- **syop effect on bard abilities**: SYOP increases the effects of Discordance and Provocation by improving their efficiency. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544686484198789120)
- **tactics damage bonus**: Tactics is to melee what Evaluating Intelligence is to mages, and at 100 it provides roughly a 20% damage increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529943846417596426)
- **tactics for alchemy dexxer**: Tactics should be at 100 on an alchemy dexxer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524023459057893386)
- **tactics for spell damage**: Putting 100 points into tactics is a poor way to increase spell damage; those points are better spent on other spell damage boosts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527092425238118440)
- **tactics gain chance observations**: Tactics gain chance was observed at 1.043% with a training sword and 2.607% with a heavy crossbow at the Prevalia trainer dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528717732256940102)
- **tactics or chivalry 80 to 100 training time**: Training Tactics or Chivalry from 80 to 100 is believed to take longer than a couple of hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533488395861491777)
- **tactics requirement for melee skills**: Tactics is required for any melee skill build, including throwing and archery, because it determines damage while the melee skills themselves determine accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552175754337583115)
- **tactics skill role**: Tactics determines melee damage and grants access to the codexes that supplement a build and function like a talent tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544542785426821261)
- **tactics training with weapon skill**: Tactics levels up alongside the weapon skill being used, so training a weapon skill such as Swordsmanship and Tactics together on a dummy is an efficient method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528720060913291285)
- **tactics versus item id for staff damage**: For staff damage, 20 points in Tactics should be worth more than 20 points in Item ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535341426848571393)
- **tailoring 60-100 sewing kit usage**: Training Tailoring from 60 to 100 may need around 20k sewing kit uses, which is about 200 kits at 100 uses each, though this figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532076356156784711)
- **tailoring gorget skill gain expectation**: Making over 100 leather gorgets at Tailoring 60 without a skill gain would be abnormal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520497489994715259)
- **tailoring training leather cost**: Training Tailoring to 100 takes about 125K leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532064431100526713)
- **tame and release training**: When tame-and-releasing pets to level Taming, do it in an enclosed space, because released pets can wander off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520275457445069074)
- **tamer 4x taming echoes build**: A tamer build using 4x taming echoes is used for treasure maps and dungeons, and lacking enough echoes forces compromises such as dropping forensic evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539659879151566931)
- **tamer archer final skill build**: A tamer archer's final skills are about Taming 120, Animal Lore 120, Veterinary 120, Herding 120, Archery 80, Arms Lore 80 and Tactics 80, and 100 in each is enough until skill orbs and scrolls are affordable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529429017483284551)
- **tamer bard codex build**: A tamer bard uses an 80x3 bard codex, with Peacemaking, Discordance and Provocation each at 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529459489734918325)
- **tamer build speed versus summoners**: Tamer is a very slow character to build, while summoner builds such as Necromancers, Nox summoners and Herding summoners get going quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551743193597612145)
- **tamer build switching after codex**: Players commonly switch their tamer build after finishing leveling the taming codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541830841179709552)
- **tamer cartography requirement for treasure maps**: A Tamer doing treasure maps still has to fit Cartography in its template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541866021940498524)
- **tamer codex aspect links**: Tamers reportedly use Spell Aspect Chance links if they are a mage and Melee Aspect Special Chance links if they are a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543460927146430475)
- **tamer codex leveling build**: A tamer can level the arcane codex and spell grimoire with 120 in each of the four taming skills plus 80 Arcane, 80 Magery and 80 Wrestling by auto-attacking, without needing Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530863809458208778)
- **tamer codex priorities**: A tamer should seek whichever codices they meet the skill requirements for based on their template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159899532787763)
- **tamer creature acquisition**: Tamers do not summon creatures; they must tame creatures to use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526117267450892389)
- **tamer dexxer template flexibility**: Focus can be omitted from a tamer dexxer template, and the extra slot (such as fishing) can be swapped for any dex skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522716065904197734)
- **tamer double harvesting build**: A Tamer with 120 Taming, Animal Lore, Herding, Veterinary, Mining and Lumberjacking works well for double harvesting skills and avoids needing a separate echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536918480983425065)
- **tamer farming readiness**: Most tamers wait until they have 100 in Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding before they start farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529423319265448028)
- **tamer forensics template variation**: In the tamer forensics template, Camping can be swapped for Macing or another weapon skill at 80, with Focus at 40. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530575807997677670)
- **tamer herding skill requirement**: A tamer needs the Herding skill, so Tracking should not be picked in its place. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530733882201341963)
- **tamer lockpicking chance on treasure chests**: At level 10 Harvest with a verite lockpick, a T-map tamer with 80 Lockpicking has about a 75% chance on level 5 chests and about 25% on level 6 chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524382030559707210)
- **tamer long-term goals**: Tamers have long-term stretch goals of obtaining pets with perfect stat rolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529287619761148038)
- **tamer lore requirement for treasure maps**: Tamers reportedly no longer need to fit Lore (LP) in their template to do treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541830277641543851)
- **tamer mage skill training**: A tamer mage should train animal lore, taming, herding and veterinary to 80 in the new player dungeon and keep training magery, because the bonus from bless is tied to magery skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525108198586187908)
- **tamer melee skill**: A Tamer can use melee skills to help their pets fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525866138255360202)
- **tamer miner lumberjack build**: A tamer miner/lumberjack build can be 120 lumberjacking, 120 mining, 100 tracking, 80 taming, 80 animal lore, 80 veterinary, 60 magery and 60 camping, walking around with pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553334609637277838)
- **tamer pet choice by secondary skill**: Tamer pet choice depends on secondary skills: fencing tamers use 1-slot attack pets like swarm or menagerie, magery tamers use five caster pets, and bard tamers may use azure wyrms, which reportedly get bonuses against barded creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530276640536527009)
- **tamer pet leveling**: A tamer's pets level up by causing at least 1 HP of damage to each enemy you fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531022263741059132)
- **tamer provocation discordance dungeon capability**: A tamer with 80 Provocation, 80 Musicianship and 80 Discordance can handle level 3 and level 4 dungeon mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533074481050943579)
- **tamer skill allocation for tracking reds and skinning**: A tamer can run 110 veterinary and herding with either 100 tracking to track reds or 100 forensic evaluation to skin kills, while keeping some camping (20-40). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529816736264618115)
- **tamer skill build options**: A Tamer can use 120 Fencing/Evaluating (FE) and 120 Camping, and can take Throwing instead of Archery to avoid needing arrows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528284664962220092)
- **tamer skill setup**: A tamer's damage comes from its pets, so Evaluating Intelligence is unnecessary and Veterinary and Animal Lore/Herding should stay at 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537021460445532214)
- **tamer skill training effort**: For a tamer, Veterinary takes the most effort to raise, while Taming, Animal Lore and Herding take about one night of AFK training each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541529916959367270)
- **tamer skills for commanding pets**: To command tamed pets, a tamer needs Animal Taming and Animal Lore at a minimum, and ideally also Herding and Veterinary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569693047521402)
- **tamer skills value**: The four taming-related skills (Taming, Lore, Herding, Veterinary) at 120 are widely regarded as the most powerful 480 skill points available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542163238723125398)
- **tamer survival without eval**: A tamer can survive without Eval by using Magery heals, Veterinary pet supplies and potions; Veterinary supplies can also heal pets, and Veterinary gives pets a damage boost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541456033468121271)
- **tamer template strength**: The tamer template is currently very strong and can take any additional skills, though it is not optimal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532714238781427732)
- **tamer trapper veterinary requirement**: A tamer trapper build with less than 120 Veterinary is possible, but 100+ Veterinary helps with level 4a content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546590990867898368)
- **tamer veterinary skill level**: 100 Veterinary works very well for a tamer, and 80 Veterinary also worked when paired with an actual tank pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524042606877741186)
- **taming 120 underdog bonuses**: Having 120 Animal Taming gives more Underdog bonuses when taming creatures with lower taming requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546177189312073889)
- **taming and animal lore requirements**: Taming and Animal Lore go together for a tamer: without 120 in each skill, you cannot control pets that require 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548284806066995212)
- **taming and lore gain from pets in combat**: On UO Outlands, players can gain Animal Taming and Animal Lore skill by using pets in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547367778267168920)
- **taming bestiary metabolism for pet healing**: Metabolism in the Utility category of the Taming Bestiary is what enables pets to heal, so attack-focused pets without points in it will not heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529157757054222447)
- **taming bestiary point resets**: Points in the Taming Bestiary can be reset as many times as you want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533161568886325338)
- **taming bestiary setup resource**: Suggested taming bestiary setups are listed in the bestiary library on the Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com/bestiary-library). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528870338191167588)
- **taming cap for miner lumberjack tamer**: A tamer miner/lumberjack should not raise taming above 100 because that character will not be farming with the tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553335958428975125)
- **taming health requirements**: Neither the player's health nor the creature's health affects whether it can be tamed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552397465817190441)
- **taming requirements for certain creatures**: Taming certain creatures requires animal taming and animal lore to both be at a certain equal level, and the Butler has a list of tamable creatures and their required levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529996585482719262)
- **taming skill gain at 50**: At 50 Taming a cave bear cannot be tamed yet; players reportedly train on a colossal frog up to 60, or may be able to set skill via the statue, but this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539643450658660422)
- **taming skill training**: To train taming, buy the cheapest tamable creature in the 95-105 skill range from the Broker and tame it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493921812455445)
- **taming skill training**: Train taming by taming and releasing animals, but not in your inn room or in a house you have access to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528535759064268970)
- **taming skill training to 80 in shelter**: Raising taming to 80 in Shelter is considered easy, and a script can quickly take a character to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526200144624615524)
- **taming training in shelter**: Taming skill cannot be trained in Shelter once the character's taming skill has reached 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531121726132322324)
- **taming training location**: The new player dungeon is a good place to train taming until 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523356945572954112)
- **taming training location in town**: Taming can be trained in any lockable room inside a town, but griefers can still attack you there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532518717215211590)
- **taming training method**: To train taming, pick a pet close to your current taming skill, go to a quiet room in a corner of town, and run a tame/release script, which also trains animal lore and herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533871319597453403)
- **taming training on shelter island**: Taming up to 80 should be possible on Shelter Island, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539617824623038645)
