- **taming training spot south prevalia inn**: Taming can be trained to 120 at the South Prevalia Inn, which has low foot traffic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532519930044481648)
- **taming training targets**: Any creature close to your current taming skill level works for gaining skill; the wiki recommends various Ostards as targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553027974981484565)
- **taming-related skills**: Animal taming and animal lore are the skills used for taming, veterinary is used for healing pets, and herding increases pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529996402069999627)
- **tank dexxer skill choices**: Parry, Alchemy, and Focus are probably better skills for a tank dexxer to have, though this is a tentative suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554209060151369769)
- **tank mage archer pk build**: A tank mage archer PK build uses Magery, a weapon skill, Tactics, Meditation, Resist, Wrestling and Evaluating Intelligence all at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524320430482260101)
- **tank pets and healing codex**: Tank pets are not really needed because the healing codex now works with Veterinary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535402779160346676)
- **tanking pets at 80 taming and lore**: With only 80 Taming and Animal Lore, only about two pets are usable as tanks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528790165110390788)
- **taste identification activation**: Taste Identification used to be activated by targeting the ground, like a bard song, to grant a damage-over-time resist buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528682885660545146)
- **taste identification and cooking stacking**: Having both Taste Identification and Cooking does not give a better food buff than having just one of the two skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554357246454923326)
- **taste identification for poisoning**: Taste Identification is needed alongside Poisoning to get meaningful poison damage; without it, casting the poison spell is not worth it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542997548938166272)
- **taste identification skill gain**: Taste Identification training works as long as Skill Gain Chance is above 0, and the skill's wiki page has a training section recommending items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527718706774278287)
- **taste identification versus cooking**: Taste Identification is better than Cooking for poisoners, while Cooking is better for every other build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536425183810818078)
- **taunt skill requirement**: The game does not allow Taunt to be used until the skill reaches 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554578618217275504)
- **telescope island resist training**: Telescope Island, reached via Witcher rune 4, has low-level caster mobs good for training Magic Resist and Healing; fighting from a boat limits their damage and a healer is nearby, while Mausoleum level 1 previously had weak casters too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530981237223719095)
- **template build speed**: Any template build can be completed in a few days in Outlands, while the custom content that advances a character is practically endless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560617472335883)
- **template skill limit**: A template can only have 7 or 8 skills maximum. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539002490320593029)
- **template stat targets**: The 100+100+25 stat values in a template are target values that characters normally reach on their own over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533033910953443358)
- **template statue skill limit**: At first you can only set your 7 main skills to 60 using the template statue, though you can add a few temporary utility skills such as Magic Resist and drop them later when you need the points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548185869075226756)
- **terran stables for taming training**: The stables in Terran are good for taming training because they are small enclosed areas where the animal cannot run off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452748754395278)
- **test patch treasure map changes and camping**: Treasure map changes on the test patch are expected to push players toward taking the Camping skill, though this is speculation and the changes may not go live as tested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529134667805233272)
- **theft risk at training area**: Thieves can steal from players at the training area, so valuable items should not be carried while training there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534351913330671676)
- **thief build**: A thief most likely needs a back stabber build, which is complicated to start but safer, though kills are often stolen if you do not deal enough damage and others may think you stole their kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553851707891388569)
- **thief build skill caps**: For a player thief build, hiding, snooping and stealing stay at 100 while stealth is the only skill worth raising to 120, which gives more stealth steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521548622565609674)
- **thief codex experience requirement**: Thief Codex experience is only gained from a successful steal, either a pilfer or a mug. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523855894775992532)
- **thief codex setup**: A thief codex setup should keep snoop and steal, with max overlook suggested, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521550713870614628)
- **thief log steal maximum**: A thief can steal roughly 400-450 logs in a single attempt, though the exact maximum is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530280958857580544)
- **thief playstyles**: Thieves can play as a backstabber who steals (mugs) from monsters on the first backstab hit, a pilferer who sneaks past and steals from mobs without combat, a dungeon chest picker, or a player thief, and all benefit from hiding plus stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711164686311494)
- **thief playstyles**: Thief templates split into PvM and PvP playstyles; PvM thieves either backstab or lockpick (the lockpicker avoids combat and loots chests), while a PvP thief is an entirely different template that can be more lucrative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526654389656354816)
- **thief skill leveling and shelter island cap**: Thief skills are generally leveled AFK via scripts; on Shelter Island they can only be trained to 80, after which players move on to a public dip and hiding/stealthing in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525622440129200269)
- **thief skill training script**: Thief skills can be trained with a script running overnight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477070403543121)
- **thief skills training 0-50**: Snooping, Stealing, Hiding and Stealth can be trained from 0 to 50 by training from a thief vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554489609977860167)
- **thief stealing requirements**: Stealing from monsters in PvM requires either enough Thief Codex points in Shadow Hands or the Snooping skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550334432425283706)
- **thief tamer skill slot requirements**: A thief tamer build needs 4 skill slots for taming-related skills and 4 slots for thieving skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478380167237764)
- **thief tamer training order**: A thief tamer can train Taming to 100 with Animal Lore 100 and Veterinary 100 first, then train the thief skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477524894126203)
- **thief viability**: Thieves are a viable build, whether grayhand stealing from monsters or redhand stealing from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546710675475271710)
- **thieves codex double black goods**: The Thieves Codex may give a chance to get double black goods when spam stealing, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546765265000210542)
- **thieves codex for backstabbers**: A new backstabber should grind a quest that gives a codex, obtain the thieves codex and level it up, which dramatically increases backstab damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531520153756504165)
- **thieves codex for lockpickers**: After the change to Overlooked, the Thieves Codex is not worth taking for lockpickers apart from Pilfering, which is not great without reliable heals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524804011830673580)
- **thieves codex rework**: After the codex rework, the Overlooked ability in the thieves codex changed significantly, while the rest of the thieves codex is equally good or much improved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545452116955496520)
- **thieves codex usage**: Only members of the Thieves Guild can use a Thieves Codex, and it supplements thievery against creatures, not players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547246460578439239)
- **throwing skill ammo requirement**: The Throwing skill does not require a quiver or arrows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545095230951399554)
- **throwing skill weapon**: The Throwing skill provides a thrown weapon with an 8 tile range that uses no ammunition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527105102857638119)
- **tidal 3 experience rate**: Tidal 3 gives very fast experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531332421620862987)
- **time to master crafting skills**: Mastering tailoring, tinkering, carpentry and blacksmithy took one player about 70 days, and harvesting all the boards and ingots required 111 lumberjacking and 108 mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545844015101124729)
- **time to reach t15 harvest aspect via lumberjacking**: One player reached T15 Harvest aspect through lumberjacking in about 60 days by chopping roughly 3 hours per day, so the time required varies with playtime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525907079217418270)
- **timing of replacing musicianship with self taught**: A bard should wait until all 20 codex points are spent before removing Musicianship in favor of Self Taught. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553936771056926842)
- **tinkering bead gem cost**: Beads crafted while training Tinkering require gems as a material, which makes this training method expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217633708220442)
- **tinkering first for miner pickaxes**: Raising Tinkering first to craft pickaxes for a miner makes little difference, and if you earn gold anyway, keeping the ingots may be financially better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533834639704064090)
- **tinkering leveling order for trappers**: For a trapper build, the preferred tinkering leveling order is lanterns, then lockpicks, then trap detonators, then candelabras. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551216353560633385)
- **tinkering on a main character**: Tinkering is a decent skill to have on a main character, possibly for trapping later or for golems when they are released. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531388608273973268)
- **tool quality effect on harvesting**: A higher-quality (exceptional or colored) tool gives only a very small increase in the chance of harvesting quality material, so a normal iron or copper tool is fine for training Mining and Lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544394198881542237)
- **tool quality effect on skill gain**: It is unconfirmed whether higher-quality tools or harvested materials speed up harvesting skill gain, and any effect is likely very small. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544396950898606130)
- **total chivalry calculation**: Total Chivalry equals your base Chivalry skill plus the Chivalry bonus listed on your armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523017876552810670)
- **tracking 100 for gatherers**: Tracking at 100 is essential for a gatherer and opens up many flexible gathering spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533249853050720356)
- **tracking against hidden targets**: Tracking still works against hidden targets, but its range is greatly reduced without Detect Hidden, to about 10 tiles in the wilderness and 5 in dungeons at 100 tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538974178672382003)
- **tracking arrow**: If the tracking arrow disappears, stop tracking and start tracking again to restore it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551699261190570005)
- **tracking arrow height**: The tracking arrow points to the target's location at height 0 on the map, so if the target is at height 64 or 128 the arrow location can be significantly skewed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538978873990053929)
- **tracking at 100 skill**: At 100 Tracking, failed checks are eliminated, which avoids a false sense of security; the extra tracking tiles are a secondary benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552285142775500882)
- **tracking at 120 skill**: At 120 Tracking a player can recall around to locate targets easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533027434268459018)
- **tracking at 80 skill**: Tracking at 80 skill performs poorly inside dungeons but is good enough for use in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552284035387228195)
- **tracking detect hidden target filter**: To make Tracking or Detect Hidden detect all players (blue, gray, red), click the left/right arrow next to the three figures icon until it shows three white figures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555581064075018344)
- **tracking for backstabbers by farming location**: Tracking is a must for a backstabber farming mostly in the Overwold, but is not really needed for dungeon stabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541913155976830976)
- **tracking for gatherers**: Gatherers use Tracking to detect red (hostile) players, and Spirit Speak summons serve mainly as a distraction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526586659313811527)
- **tracking for single resource maps**: Tracking is not needed for single resource maps because summons can tank anything in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **tracking for stealth scavenger build**: Tracking is not required for a stealthing scavenger build, though some players run it for peace of mind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849739067957300)
- **tracking for wilderness bard dexxer**: For wilderness farming on a bard dexxer, a player may consider dropping Item Identification in favor of Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555193780410388511)
- **tracking gump hide in house option**: In the tracking gump, put a checkmark in the box next to the 'hide in house' option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531016548905390241)
- **tracking gump setup for hunting players**: In the tracking gump, cycle the player type shown above the 'Begin Hunting' button until it displays a gray person, an orange person, and a red person, then press 'Begin Hunting'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531016832918622209)
- **tracking in mage tamer build**: Until skill scrolls are obtained, 100 Tracking from the basic build in the wiki templates can be worked into a mage tamer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552224849886322692)
- **tracking or forensics damage bonus for mages**: Tracking or Forensics at 120 skill gives mages about a 30% damage bonus, similar to but smaller than the bonus from Inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522597802935586920)
- **tracking people inside houses**: Tracking can be turned on to detect people inside houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533091159981953217)
- **tracking skill criminal warning**: The Tracking skill gives a warning when a criminal enters the area, and the player must start hunting for red humans again after each login. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524140134348492800)
- **tracking skill effectiveness against pks**: At 60 Tracking, a PK can cover about 55 tiles between tracking ticks while Tracking extends detection only about 42 tiles beyond the 18-tile sight distance and fails 40% of the time, so for survival against PKs 100+ Tracking is great, 90 is okay, and 80 or less is about as useful as none. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **tracking skill for miners**: Tracking is considered the most important skill for a mining build because it detects nearby PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664819060146226)
- **tracking skill for red non-stealthers**: 80 Tracking is not top-tier but is good enough for picking up red non-stealthers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542922073482072234)
- **tracking skill for treasure maps**: Tracking is not required for treasure maps; it is only useful as an alert for red players nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538124845043425380)
- **tracking skill in two-harvesting-skill template**: When running two harvesting skills, Tracking does not fit in the skill template, but treasure maps can still be done without Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536828371403546784)
- **tracking skill mechanics**: Tracking checks run once every 5 seconds, and the Tracking skill value sets both the chance to detect players and the range in tiles (for example 60 skill gives a 60% chance at up to 60 tiles). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **tracking skill targets**: The Tracking skill tracks monsters in general, including ratmen if you are in their area, rather than a specific monster type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531051454016524477)
- **tracking skill usage**: Tracking is not passive; it must be actively used, and a player can switch between tracking blue players and red players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533091159981953217)
- **tracking skill usage**: To use tracking, open the skill scroll, go to the wilderness category and drag Tracking onto the viewport to create a tracking bubble; double click it and turn on hunting mode, then use the slider to track red, orange or grey players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570328400830477)
- **tracking skill usage**: Tracking is normally used only on PvP and gathering templates, or by players who are cautious when doing PvE. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527094029207081140)
- **tracking skill vendor search**: The Tracking skill can be used to look for vendors and place a marker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543693913481678988)
- **tracking system message**: A player running Tracking receives a system message when it sees the thing being looked for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523108946028527638)
- **tracking target setting system message**: A system message tells you what you are tracking whenever you change the tracking target setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555582288543219783)
- **tracking trainer on shelter island**: On Shelter Island, the Ranger near the moongate teaches Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559951382872175)
- **tracking training npcs**: Tracking can be trained with any dockmaster or ranger NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526385196457529474)
- **tracking training requirement**: Tracking can only be trained when there is something to track, so it cannot be trained in an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523187960823021692)
- **tracking versus detect hidden**: Tracking detects hidden players when they are nearby, while Detect Hidden only increases the range at which they are detected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521200154911309935)
- **trade skill training speed**: Trade skills level slowly overall, but crafting skills raise faster than gathering skills, especially gathering past 100 without resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538893640040972390)
- **training at the town zoo**: Players commonly raise Magery, Evaluating Intelligence, Necromancy and similar skills by hanging out at the zoo in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553150673116336302)
- **training bard skills with self-taught**: With Self-Taught, macro-train Peacemaking, Provocation and Discordance to at least 80 each before farming again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551666723797860484)
- **training barding to 80**: To train Barding from 50 to 80, go into the Shelter dungeon, where barding scripts (e.g. from uorazorscripts.com) can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530431821966348409)
- **training crafting skills with recycling**: To train a crafting skill such as tailoring, craft items and recycle everything you make, using a Crafting Queue set to recycle the items so it automatically makes the next item appropriate to your skill level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042572790861964)
- **training credits deed amount prompt**: The training credits deed may prompt for how much to use when applied to a trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521332847426670762)
- **training dummy magic resist**: Training dummies in houses have a configurable magic resist setting, while the dummies at Shelter are static, and their value can be checked with Animal Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541563489515212860)
- **training forensic evaluation in shelter dungeon**: Forensic Evaluation can be trained to 80 by farming mobs in the Shelter dungeon; there is no skill gain bonus there, but the mobs are easy to kill and respawn quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534180907198447777)
- **training forensic evaluation with missing skill points**: If you lack skill points, train skills like Tracking or Camping on NPC stuff, set them to down, and slowly raise Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532458926300336158)
- **training forensics by skinning in dungeons**: To train forensics and gain skinning use in dungeons, skin everything around you including blue corpses using Smart Harvest; skinning is not a crime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549805966378275059)
- **training from an npc**: Stand within two tiles of the NPC you want to train from, then drop either your training credits deed or a stack of gold onto the NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526807140675751956)
- **training harvest aspect**: Train the Harvest aspect early alongside gathering skills, since mining and other gathering activities give Harvest aspect skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537614356966019123)
- **training healing and anatomy in shelter**: Healing and Anatomy are easy to raise to 80 in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527787192124965000)
- **training herding afk**: Herding can be trained AFK by repeatedly using a shepherd's crook, and it is about as easy to AFK as Animal Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478172813299834)
- **training hiding afk**: The Hiding skill can be trained AFK, but not inside a house or rental room; it must be done somewhere with a chance to fail hiding, such as in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539347479722729472)
- **training hiding to 80**: Hiding can be trained to 80 quickly inside NPD. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452222079828100)
- **training hiding, stealth and animal lore in shelter**: Skills such as hiding and stealth can be trained to 80 in the Shelter dungeon, and lore on your mount there can raise Animal Lore to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549594674501652521)
- **training inscription**: To train Inscription, set up a crafting queue; no script is needed for training alone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535814352882634874)
- **training magery and magic resist together**: To train magery and magic resist together, cast Explosion (a level 6 spell) on nearby creatures while a gazer casts on you, taking care not to kill the gazer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522075760842641469)
- **training magery to 80 and 100**: Use a max spell charge stone to get magery to 80 for free; reaching 100 magery then requires spending gold on reagents and a full spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555708144737591417)
- **training magic resist**: To train Magic Resist, find a spot with caster mobs and let them cast spells at you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544550134048620554)
- **training magic resist at ossuary**: Magic Resist can be trained quickly in the Ossuary lich magus room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551371211877908651)
- **training pets and lore**: To train pets and Animal Lore, make your pets attack a battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549478663169515541)
- **training poisoning safely**: When training poisoning, use an alt with Healing and Anatomy to heal yourself, and keep a stock of greater cure potions on hand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527787080305082400)
- **training poisoning without a shelf**: To train Poisoning without a shelf using the Razor script, place four bags in a secure chest, each holding a keg (poison, greater, deadly, lethal), target each bag when prompted so the script knows where to restock each level, and have empty bottles and a weapon to poison; it works from 50 to 120 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556065271104405525)
- **training provocation quickly**: To train Provocation quickly, drop music, train Provocation to 50, then provoke mobs in the shelter dungeon up to 80 before farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553894549607153705)
- **training remove trap**: Train Remove Trap by getting a training box from the thief NPC and repeatedly using remove trap tools on it; this can be done in your room or house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522971488955924600)
- **training snooping and stealing past 80**: After reaching 80 in Snooping and Stealing, train to GM and beyond at publicly accessible pickpocket dip locations; the Horseshoe Bay location also lets you train Hiding and Stealth simultaneously by standing 2 tiles outside the home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555742076564406323)
- **training tactics**: Tactics can be trained easily by standing AFK at a battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521644906249060455)
- **training taming to 120**: A nightmare or a wisp can be used to train Animal Taming up to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549493862777626756)
- **training to 50 before shelter island**: Train skills to 50 from NPC trainers in other towns, then go to Shelter Island to continue leveling, since NPC training on the island is not available after you leave. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526968646172278904)
- **training tracking skill**: Train tracking by tracking mobs in the Shelter dungeon until 80 skill, then track anything in a town afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546116620676505611)
- **training tracking without a macro**: To train Tracking without a macro, use the skill to open the tracking gump and press the blue gems at the bottom right until the option reads 'Always Get Closest'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531016362833608785)
- **transferring leveled horses**: A leveled or bonded horse can be transferred to a player without taming skill, so buying or receiving one from another player is an effective way to obtain one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532371802565775431)
- **trap avoidance on chests**: With 120 Lockpicking, 120 Detect Hidden, Level 1 Harvester Aspect and a Mastercrafted Agapite remove trap tool, there is a 100% chance not to set off a trap on chests up to level 6. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553979848253251708)
- **trap kit**: The Trap Kit gives bonuses to ground traps, and using it effectively requires Tinkering and Detect Hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547024047873986620)
- **trap removal tool**: A trap removal tool is the equivalent item to lockpicks for trap removal, and using it raises Detect Hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540840147434602557)
- **trapper alchemist farming build**: A trapper alchemist farming build is 120 alchemy, 120 tinkering, 120 detect hidden, 100 magery and 80 spirit speak, with remaining skill points allocated freely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525553166656212993)
- **trapper alchemist meditation option**: With lower alchemy, a trapper alchemist can take 80 meditation to use all of the Thieves' Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525553289058586744)
- **trapper class solo xp**: The Trapper class is reported to be very strong for solo XP gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555654280306888735)
- **trapper farming power versus tamer**: A Trapper can out-farm a Tamer, but the build is also very expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547429743471763536)
- **trapper template**: One possible trapper template is 120 Tinkering, 120 Detect Hidden, 100 Magery, 100 Poisoning, 100 Taste Identification, 100 Meditation or Evaluating Intelligence, and 80 Spirit Speak, leaving no room for Necromancy if Detect Hidden is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545583699012091956)
- **trapper tinkering skill above 100**: A trapper's Tinkering skill above 100 adds trap damage, and the Floor Traps and Tinkering wiki pages explain the difference between 100 and 120 Tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551987223669252136)
- **trapper tmapper with cartography build**: A trapper tmapper build with Cartography is considered reasonable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521410946218725428)
- **trapping entry cost and tinkering**: Trapping is better suited to veteran players because of its cost to entry, and leveling Tinkering without links is hard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527407517573845052)
- **trapping kit requirements**: You need at least 80 Tinkering and 80 Detect Hidden to start using the trapping kit and gain XP for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521707767985864765)
- **trash skill for skill point management**: Players can buy a trash skill using exact amounts of gold to lower their roughly 80-level skills while managing skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544015614195138630)
- **treasure hunter template change**: After the patch, the treasure hunter template replaces lockpicking with cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538564543418998884)
- **treasure hunting requirements**: After the latest patch, treasure hunters do not need detect hidden on their template and do not need a remove trap tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541324834875904011)
- **treasure map decoding and looting setup**: Treasure maps are decoded by a character with Cartography, while a second character with Hiding, Stealth, Tracking and Camping can track the red players and loot what the tamer cannot take. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534129430371504209)
- **treasure map hunter skill requirements**: A treasure map hunter needs only Cartography and not Lockpicking, while the dungeon picker role requires Lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539722632528793710)
- **treasure map location for chain xp**: Treasure maps should be done in Fort Aspect if you care about chain experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522394169157488780)
- **treasure map skill requirements**: Treasure maps need the Cartography skill, with a reported minimum of 20 and 100% success at 40, though higher map levels may require much more, possibly up to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546285793356808273)
- **treasure map solo requirements**: Lockpicking and Camping are not required to solo treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549132518559584318)
- **treasure map xp history**: Treasure maps were very good for xp until the Wildlands expansion, after which xp shifted to other activities unless you mass rush tier 8 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531369146405621961)
- **tri bard alternative build**: Some players skip the full tri bard and take just one bard skill plus musicianship instead, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548697123019690085)
- **tri bard at 80 skill**: A tri bard running 80 bard skills is frustrating to play until you have plenty of silver links for effective barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547710385086271580)
- **tri bard codex abilities**: A tri bard using the Bard Codex has peace, provocation and discord available without needing the music skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555015006209187862)
- **tri bard skill training**: Tri bard skills can be trained by scripting at the training dummies, or by running around the dungeon using peacemaking, provocation and discordance on mobs, which reaches 80 quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530907576223404183)
- **tri-bard dexxer cost and multipliers**: A tri-bard dexxer setup reportedly costs 240 skill points and 10 links to gain a 16.67% damage multiplier and a 5% multiplier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553175149170270319)
- **tri-bard peace build tracking or fencing excellence**: In a tri-bard peace build with barding at 100, either tracking or Fencing Excellence can fill the remaining slot because both help barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543506972253618348)
- **tri-bard tamer skill reliance**: A tri-bard tamer relies mainly on Discord, which has a very high success chance, together with the bard codex, while Peacemaking and Provocation may take a couple of tries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522712483041775847)
- **tri-bard wrestling build skills**: A tri-bard wrestling build can be run with 100 Musicianship and 80 Alchemy, or alternatively with 60 Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549959374020149291)
- **tribard bard swordsman skill priorities**: For a tribard/bard swordsman build, raising chivalry to 120 is recommended for PvM security, while bard skills remain important too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540570342114721975)
- **tribard definition**: A tribard is a character with all three barding skills; it runs Self Taught from the Bard Codex so it does not need Musicianship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526534550061322321)
- **tribard definition**: A tribard is a bard with 80 Peacemaking, 80 Provocation and 80 Discordance plus the Self Taught ability in the codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542944319646990487)
- **tribard instrument choice**: Tribards should use the best magical instrument they can afford to lose, because they fail often at first but the song buffs make it worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523307156374294579)
- **tribard poisoner build**: A working build is 80 tribard, 80 Fencing, 80 Alchemy, 100 Tactics, 120 Taste Identification and 100 Poisoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542942440590147615)
- **tribard skill point cost**: Going tribard (80 each in the three bard skills) costs only 40 more skill points than having 100 Musicianship and 100 Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541925315243147356)
- **tribard tamer aspect raising**: A tribard tamer can raise an aspect by activating it on an empty spell book and still receive the full experience per kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522352937966506115)
- **tribard tamer bard codex skills**: Perfect Pitch, Refrain and SYOP are all good bard codex skills for a tribard tamer, and Revolution Song is acceptable to fill gaps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540022328312860692)
- **tribard tamer stat distribution**: Stat distribution matters little for a tribard tamer; intelligence helps with recalls, while dexterity gives more melee attacks, and even at 0 weapon skill a hit can land for an occasional proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539981134639661066)
- **trispec bard training**: To train a trispec bard, use Musicianship until two of the other skills are capped, then drop Musicianship and train the third skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528516433108144329)
- **typical build skill count**: Most builds focus on 6 to 8 skills and leave all other skills at zero. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551632810706600028)
- **typical pvm defensive build**: A typical PvM build that can defend itself includes 100 weapon skill and 80-100 Resisting Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553450035700834406)
- **ultimate thief trainer script usage**: With the 'Ultimate Thief Trainer' script, set only line 4 to 1 until hiding is 80, then set line 7 to 1 to train stealth up to 80 in the shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538866262384451604)
- **unattended fishing**: Fishing unattended is allowed from land but not from a ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524182869944041572)
- **upgrading poison strength by recasting**: Recast the poison spell on a monster to try to upgrade the poison strength until lethal or deadly poison lands, since the highest tier is the one to reach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524405462936584304)
- **using a training credits deed**: To use a training credits deed, click the vendor to see the training cost, then drag and drop the deed onto the vendor to pay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521332227135377479)
- **using animal lore at zero skill**: Animal Lore can be used even at 0 skill, either by clicking the skill on the paperdoll or by single-clicking the creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145071742484605)
- **utility character for item identification**: Putting Item Identification on a utility character on another account works well for identifying items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553527042010521611)
- **utility skill build at 120**: A 120 Cartography/Poisoning/Taste Identification/Item Identification/Lockpicking/Detect Hidden build can decode maps, poison weapons, handle plant-related tasks, pick chests and identify items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521367022816985180)
- **utility toon build**: A utility toon build is useful for tasks such as unlocking boxes and decoding maps rather than for combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522735944078463218)
- **vendor house buying mule skills**: A suggested mule for buying from vendor houses has 100 Hiding, 100 Stealth, 100 Tracking, 100 Detect Hidden and 60 Magery for Recall (or a runebook with charges), leaving 240 free skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521718442628219051)
- **vengeful spirit ability for daemon summoners**: A summoner who wants to keep daemons can ignore the Vengeful Spirit necromancy ability and still benefit from Necromancy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548028228898127917)
- **verifying gathering skill gain**: To confirm a gathering skill is working, click yourself and turn on show skill gain; system messages then appear whenever an action could result in skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543784478932209785)
- **verifying purchased skill mastery scrolls**: To verify how many skill mastery scrolls were actually bought, check the portal's purchase records. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535074878657536182)
- **veterinary and animal lore self-healing**: Veterinary combined with Animal Lore lets a character heal themselves with bandages or vet kits without needing Healing or Anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525546074624888903)
- **veterinary and herding 100 to 120 gain**: Raising Veterinary and Herding from 100 to 120 is reported to give only about 4.4% more damage for 20 skill points, a poor return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522289083253129306)
- **veterinary boost to pet healing spells**: Veterinary reportedly boosts healing spells cast on pets even without Animal Lore, by 50% * Veterinary/100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530271364701884428)
- **veterinary cure and resurrection**: Veterinary can also cure poison and resurrect with sufficient Veterinary and Animal Lore, and it is more effective on followers than on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532929305972047972)
- **veterinary for necromancers**: Veterinary works for Necromancers by giving their summons damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526508007070892052)
- **veterinary for tribard tamer**: A tribard tamer should take Veterinary, since without it the player must leave the fight if a pet dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549847050621820931)
- **veterinary resurrection requirement**: Veterinary requires at least 80 Animal Lore to begin resurrection attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538892126975168532)
- **veterinary self-healing**: Veterinary can be used to heal yourself, with bandages for single-target healing or vet supplies for area-of-effect healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532928481317359738)
- **veterinary skill and follower damage**: Veterinary skill adds follower damage, which is why it is trained to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545709112229232711)
- **veterinary skill bandage use on self**: The Veterinary skill lets a player apply a bandage or pet supply to themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524782457608605806)
- **veterinary skill level and resurrection reliability**: Veterinary at 80 feels poor, while at 120 Veterinary resurrections never fail, including player resurrections. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548284806066995212)
- **veterinary skill trainer**: The Stablemaster can teach the Veterinary skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521267459943043182)
- **veterinary skill training**: Veterinary skill is trained by bandaging pets or using vet supplies, while casting Greater Heal on pets does not raise it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521322236500512809)
- **veterinary skill training speed**: Veterinary skill is slow to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524271612663173210)
- **veterinary training and pet cure requirement**: The Outlands wiki says Veterinary is trained by healing pets, and a minimum Animal Lore of 60 is required for successful bandage cure attempts on pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530271157314523207)
- **veterinary training from 80 to 120**: From 80 to 120 Veterinary, loop heal a pet, and if you cannot deal enough damage by punching, have a weaker pet attack it to create damage to heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521267696463773716)
- **veterinary training location**: Veterinary can likely be trained inside an inn or house, as healing can, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538882728273907712)
- **veterinary training method**: To train Veterinary, use a tank pet and a low-damage 1-slot pet, have the 1-slotter attack the tank pet, and bandage the tank pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549462317882802362)
- **veterinary training method**: Training Veterinary by AFK bandaging is slow, but it can also be leveled while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549972971236495391)
- **veterinary training to 80 in shelter**: A summoner can raise Veterinary to 80 in Shelter by dismounting the horse, walking it into Shelter, punching it, telling it to all stop, and then bandaging it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521322417363095553)
- **veterinary training with bonded horse**: Veterinary can be trained by attacking your own bonded horse or having it attack another bonded horse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529423061106036859)
- **veterinary training with looped bandages**: To train Veterinary, tell your pet to stay, then run a script that loops bandage use on the pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521267413541454046)
- **veterinary training with magical wizard hat**: Training Veterinary with a magical wizard hat would be a waste of veterinary supplies, because bandages are plentiful, cheap and easier to get in bulk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549471366623793155)
- **veterinary training without pets**: Veterinary skill can be trained without pets by running a script that trains it using a magical wizard hat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544387862928040047)
- **viewing skill gain chances while crafting**: To see skill gain information while crafting, enable the green names for skill increase and the show skill gain chances option in the crafting gump; chances appear as blue system messages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520496121494110372)
- **virtuoso strength at 80 barding**: Virtuoso is weak for a bard at 80 barding because it uses the printed skill rather than the effective skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543548041070641303)
- **volatile alchemy codex value**: Volatile alchemy codex rank-ups are mainly useful when consistently pulling about 5 mobs in a clump, and matter little otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531123689947533342)
- **water mage tamer healer build**: A water mage tamer can heal for boss and group content while pets add damage, using a cheap aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520292110740361287)
- **weapon codex targets**: Weapon codexes should be raised to at least 5/5 for the weapons the character uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555492500557275167)
- **weapon skill above 80 bonuses**: Weapon skill above 80, such as archery, grants accuracy and melee defense bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553523965962489937)
- **weapon skill and arms lore effect on damage**: Increasing weapon skill raises accuracy but not damage output, whereas Arms Lore does increase damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529927737748226199)
- **weapon skill at 80 in builds**: Most builds lower weapon skill to 80 and put the remaining 20 skill points into other skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543652423900332074)
- **weapon skill rankings macing fencing swords**: Macing is one of the worst weapon skills and its codex is terrible; Fencing is likely worse than Macing unless the character is a poisoner; Swords is not that bad and is viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533355438907850782)
- **weapon tactics bonus**: All weapons increase Tactics, whether magic, exceptional, mastercrafted or material, and an aspect weapon does as well; Avarite weapons are cheaper to obtain than the magic equivalent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548328450547515486)
- **weapon tactics trainer location**: A trainer for Weapon Tactics is located at the previous moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531781041965240582)
- **weapon temporary skill boost**: An equipped weapon can give a temporary skill boost such as Tactics, which raises the displayed skill cap while it is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534419920660467752)
- **weaponless tamer build**: Some tamers skip weapon skills and run 120 camping, healing their pets and skinning creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553209230000005151)
- **wiki alchemy training options**: The wiki's alchemy training section describes a second, slightly costlier option that has you craft potions you actually need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532827417679237251)
- **wiki backstabber build progression**: The wiki backstabber build is still relevant: start as a Basic Backstabber and move to Advanced Mugger once the thief codex is leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531975933932605631)
- **wiki crafting training guides**: The wiki has training guides for every crafting skill at the bottom of each skill page, and these are generally the best ways to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553100377493213246)
- **wiki skill training guidelines**: The bottom of each skill's wiki page contains simple training guidelines. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537614887533154377)
- **wiki tamer link templates**: The wiki templates for mage tamer and dexxer tamer are wrong regarding the recommended links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543493935945490493)
- **without a trace codex point**: The Without a Trace codex point is popular because it greatly reduces smoke bomb timing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520270435260956793)
- **without borders trait value**: The Without Borders trait of the Healer Codex is considered a game changer for veterinary supplies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547232442115428412)
- **wizard codex skill requirement for bard build**: A bard build may be able to lower its bard skills to 100 and raise a new skill to 80 in order to use the wizard codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549174305915543583)
- **wrestler core template**: A wrestler core template is Wrestling 80 min, Tactics 100, Healing 80, Anatomy 80 and Arms Lore 80 min, with optional Chivalry, Focus, Alchemy, Parry or Resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536860544852697189)
- **wrestler paladin last skill slot**: For a wrestler/paladin's last skill slot, Parry is more useful long term once the codex is leveled, while Resisting Spells gives a more immediate return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546929626524418089)
- **wrestler skill setup advice**: Wrestlers are advised to unlock their weapon skill, set its focus to increase, and possibly lower Arms Lore and Anatomy to 80, though this advice is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532358823203963020)
- **wrestler treasure map template**: A wrestler template for treasure maps uses 120 Chivalry, 110 Cartography, 100 Tactics, and 80 each of Wrestling, Healing and Anatomy, with 7 Arms Lore and 80 free points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538988149462794261)
- **wrestling accuracy cap with vanquishing weapon**: For wrestling builds, an eminently-tier vanquishing weapon is the sweet spot for min-maxing accuracy, because more than 15% accuracy on a magic weapon overcaps accuracy when capping swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520826088413204541)
- **wrestling aspect leveling**: A wrestling character can level nearly any aspect the player wants, and its chi finisher animation is a large star explosion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521526114592362586)
- **wrestling at 80 skill**: Lowering Wrestling to 80 costs accuracy and also increases the chance enemies hit you, making a wrestler less tanky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530501396753944668)
- **wrestling build focus**: A wrestling build can be run with 0 focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550898470196486286)
- **wrestling codex ability timing**: A typical wrestling codex approach is to unlock an ability right after getting your preferred stance to level 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540564731931263117)
- **wrestling gain absence at skill cap**: If the fighting animation plays but Wrestling does not gain, the character is likely at skill cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549672088103817269)
- **wrestling gain chance**: Punching any target gives the same wrestling gain chance, so there is no advantage to hitting a summoned creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521940196873076889)
- **wrestling later progression**: Wrestling is reportedly the go-to weapon skill later in progression, once melee special chance can be maxed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532465934227472598)
- **wrestling mana refund**: Wrestling gives a chance to refund mana when casting spells, reported as 12%, while Focus gives about 15%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546226905621991575)
- **wrestling recall protection**: 100 Wrestling gives a 50% chance to prevent Recall from being interrupted by physical damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **wrestling skill and hit chance**: A wrestler at 80 Wrestling skill reportedly misses often, and raising Wrestling to 100 improves hit chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532373609715339405)
- **wrestling skill level for wrestling builds**: 80 wrestling skill is considered sufficient for a wrestling build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550805366705496075)
- **wrestling stance leveling**: For wrestling, raise the preferred stance and ability to 5, then the other stances to 5, then the preferred stance to 7; all stances at 5 are needed to increase finisher tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538636413912752199)
- **wrestling training and trainer**: Wrestling is trained by fighting with bare fists, and the Wrestling trainer NPC in Shelter is named Beaman. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669695542657025)
- **wrestling training from 80 to 100**: Fighting the battle trainer is the best way to train wrestling from 80 to 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526304747471241337)
- **wrestling training time**: Training wrestling from 80 to 100 took about 10 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531437157120479434)
- **wrestling training weapon**: No training weapon is needed for wrestling; players can train it by simply punching with bare hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533946441763131515)
- **wrestling weapon skill gain**: Using a wrestling weapon likely gives an accuracy bonus, but wrestling skill gain is probably the same as when using fists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551191287728705678)
- **wrestling with parry**: 80 Wrestling is considered fine to pair with 80 Parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524839606544105612)
- **xp dungeon farming levels**: Farming levels 1 and 2 of the XP dungeon gains experience quicker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555525006413275177)
- **zoo monsters for skill training**: The zoo monsters are unkillable, so players can train skills on them whenever they like. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341828337860659)
- **zoology completion farming**: Completing the zoology collection requires farming with each different type of follower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532596320743723208)
- **zoology stable slots**: Training Zoology appears to grant additional stable slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527007142249369754)

## Harvesting & resources

- **growing zucchini harvest crates**: Plant Zucchini Seeds in a Plant Bowl to grow them into Zucchini Harvest Crates. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550884202717650975)
- **mushroom spore drops**: Throughout October during Shroomtober, monsters across the realm drop Mushroom Spores, which can be cultivated into the new Shroomtober mushrooms. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **mushroom spore farming locations**: Mushroom Spores drop from monsters throughout the realm, but Undermountain monsters are especially infected during Shroomtober, making it the recommended place to farm them for a more bountiful harvest. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555232965460754563)
