- **mushroom spore rarity**: Mushroom Spores are rarer than the seeds of harvest season, so obtaining them requires a proper hunt. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555232965460754563)
- **resource maps stackable update**: Following the 2026-08-12 patch, a very large number of pre-patch player Resource Maps were updated to be stackable and addable to Tomes. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1537022326435221525)
- **shroomtober mushroom expiry**: The new Shroomtober mushroom species disappear at midnight on All Hallows' Eve, so they must be collected before then. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555232965460754563)
- **shroomtober new mushroom species**: The Shroomtober event features five new monstrous mushroom species for players to discover. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **shroomtober new mushroom species**: Shroomtober adds five new mushroom garden plants: Silted Gillcap, Phantom Bell, Sanguine Parasite, Patchwork Polypore, and Lunar Bristlecap. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555232965460754563)
- **stalag seeds**: Stalag Seeds drop within the Stalag Grotto region during the Survival PvM Event and can be grown into 21 new rare, exclusive desert-themed plants. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525517091384590457)
- **undermountain shroomtober harvest**: Undermountain offers an especially bountiful harvest during the Shroomtober event. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **zucchini seed sources**: Zucchini Seeds are rare drops obtained by defeating creatures, looting dungeon and treasure map chests, and searching ship holds. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550884202717650975)
- **forensic evaluation for leather**: Forensic Evaluation combined with a skinning knife is used to harvest leather from corpses of killed mobs, including pet kills and spawn from special fishing locations and MIBs; it is only worthwhile at around 110 skill because avarhide is a large part of leather's value, and harvesting links in the chain increase the yield. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546232366790615082)
- **harvest aspect armor effects**: Harvest aspect on armor adds effective harvesting skill (for example, Tier 15 lifts 120 skill to 138 effective) and gives a chance at double resource yield, though the yield gain is modest early on. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549607914853896283)
- **harvest aspect double procs**: The Harvest aspect gives double procs (shown as a green oval animation) that double the resources gained, and these work on skinning but not directly on fishing spots, so fishers should also skin. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553123105587855461)
- **harvest aspect for mining and chopping**: Harvest Aspect is regarded by players as the key investment for regular harvesting such as mining and lumberjacking, and mining players prioritize gaining it quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552567446152552480)
- **harvest chain links**: Effective Harvest Skill on harvest links adds a flat bonus to all gathering skills (e.g. one bronze link makes 120 Lumberjacking effective 121), which helps mostly with fishing and resource maps, does not increase quantity harvested except skinning, and does not affect skill gains. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552005955976437895)
- **resource map decoding after patch**: After the patch, resource maps are undecoded again: players must travel to the location and follow an arrow during a roughly 15 second base decode timer, and the recent patch also limits players to one resource map at a time with delays between maps, though maps already started may be handled differently. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544439648535842867)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Resource maps require only the matching gathering skill; neither Camping nor Cartography is needed to hike to or use them. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553116268473753722)
- **resource maps and normal harvesting**: Normal non-map harvesting is unchanged by the patch, while resource maps changed: newly generated maps now have a static default total harvestable amount instead of a randomized one, and players commonly say maps are only worthwhile for skill gain after 100 skill, though it is unclear whether the patch changed that. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544398946804170772)
- **tracking for gatherers**: Gatherers should train Tracking to 100 to see PKs and avoid them; 80 is not enough, and it is helpful but not foolproof. Detect Hidden reveals sneaky PKs and Camping adds carrying weight. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629594580328510)
- **cartography and resource maps**: Cartography is not needed for resource maps; the effective harvest skill determines decodes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537589481903751269)
- **empty bottle sources**: Empty bottles for Alchemy are sold by Alchemist NPCs, usually in mage shops, and possibly by Herbalists or Naturalists, depending on demand and often sold out; when they are sold out, smuggler NPCs sell them in unlimited bulk at a higher price. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550162551407517697)
- **fishing map resource values after patch**: After the latest patch, fishing maps were consolidated and rebalanced so they no longer carry static per-quality resources; lower-quality maps like dullscale yield far more resources than before, and stored map counts were reduced to compensate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542757612838195220)
- **gathering kindling**: Use a dagger (the blessed dagger every character starts with) on a tree to gather kindling one piece at a time; kindling is not bought from NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548214021659037707)
- **harvest aspect proc source**: The Harvest aspect's gathering bonus comes from armor, not from the weapon or tool, so crystals do not add harvest double procs, and Harvest on a weapon is a weak proc. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545834958906597386)
- **harvest skill links value**: Harvest skill links are generally not worth buying, except for fishing on the ocean; for skinning they are marginal, and for lumberjacking and mining they are not worthwhile, since leveling skill naturally is more cost-effective, and links are a separate system from the Harvest aspect even though both give effective harvesting skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538293174059929772)
- **outlands butler harvesting calculator**: The Outlands Butler website at outlandsbutler.com/harvesting is a calculator where you enter aspect level, skill, tool and harvest links to see which ores or nodes you can harvest and how close you are to never failing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536826670248497282)
- **resource map location lookup**: The new resource map system guides players to the map location, so they no longer need an external lookup tool or to search Explore Outlands, and locations can include nodes that did not exist before. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544771569962852423)
- **resource maps**: Resource maps are random loot from mobs that can drop gold, can be bought from player vendors or the portal, and can be deciphered by other characters or used for society jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554553599630123082)
- **shelter island gathering penalty**: Gathering on Shelter Island is possible but carries a 50% penalty to gathering success chance and rates, so players should train other needed skills to 80 and then leave. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554353639282180218)
- **summoner for resource maps**: A summoner harvester is well suited to resource maps because summoned creatures soak aggro and fight off monsters while the player harvests. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546222802883977327)
- **aspect xp when harvesting**: When harvesting ore, logs and leather, harvest armor alone gives full aspect XP without an aspected tool in hand; an aspected crook in the backpack does not count. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536700938679492640)
- **brain fungus in plant cultivation**: Plant cultivation includes a third pest type, brain fungus, which must be treated in addition to insects and fungi and may require repeated fungicide applications. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524363335313784912)
- **dungeon mining in nusero**: Forges were added to Nusero so mining can be done inside the dungeon; it is less profitable than harvesting or PvM alone but is a fun way to combine them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536195794842161203)
- **fishing resource map yields**: Fishing resource maps now yield the average of the old range, so higher tier maps give fewer resources and lower tier maps give more, with roughly the same total over time. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349879478980689)
- **forensic evaluation and avarhide**: Reaching 110 Forensic Evaluation is required to carve avarhide, and skill above 110 only increases the amount of leather gathered per monster. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536288826589450240)
- **harvesting captcha timeout**: Failing captchas repeatedly lengthens the gathering timeout, which can reach 6 hours or more. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527637429014499328)
- **harvesting codex availability**: There is no mining or harvesting codex in Outlands, though a Harvesting aspect exists and is recommended for harvesters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542209487006474423)
- **mining locations**: Ore can be mined along the edge of any mountain or cave outside of a town, not only inside mines, so mining spots are plentiful. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549618537822421063)
- **mining skill needed for 100% avarite**: Reaching a 100% chance on Avarite ore depends on effective Mining skill (printed skill plus harvest aspect plus tool bonus, about 139.1% needed); for example 120 Mining with Harvest aspect 15 and a Shadow Iron tier exceptional tool is reported sufficient. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536826568524038154)
- **mining while mounted**: Mining can be done while mounted on a horse. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551620569827385369)
- **monsters near resource map spots**: Resource maps do not spawn mobs themselves, and spots were moved out of mob range, but a map location can still be in or near a monster camp, so some spawn may be nearby. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554894433768570932)
- **ore and lumber respawn**: Ore and lumber nodes respawn after a random delay of 30 to 60 minutes with a random color, so colored resource locations are not fixed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537427277917327410)
- **paragon chests and aspects**: Paragon chests are not affected by the Harvest or Fortune aspects, because their loot is rolled when the paragon creature is killed, and they do not give harvest experience. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544446557925933096)
- **purpose of resource maps**: Resource maps lead to a location with a large amount of a specific ore or lumber type and are used to obtain that specific resource rather than to maximize gold, and are used mostly for ore rather than wood. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531360069688758403)
- **rare leather chance while skinning**: Rare hides from skinning are not reliable even at 120 Forensic Evaluation with an Avarite knife and usually come out as plain leather; per the wiki, only the carving knife raises rare leather chance, while higher Forensic Evaluation adds damage bonus and slightly more leather. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546251861466808381)
- **resource map timers**: The new resource map system adds waiting timers (about 15 seconds per wait, roughly 30 seconds of extra delay per run) and about 5 clicks every 2 minutes, though its loading delay is still faster than finding map locations by hand under the old system. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544493514212122635)
- **resource map types and wiki reliability**: The Outlands wiki is player-maintained and may be outdated or incomplete after the recent large update, including its Resource Maps page; the four resource map types are forensics for skinning maps, lumberjacking for lumber maps, mining for ore maps, and fishing for fishing maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543863393935556678)
- **resource node respawn time**: Resource nodes respawn after a random time of roughly 30 to 60 minutes rather than a set time. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523053943540678766)
- **skinning corpses in safe towns**: You cannot skin corpses in a safe town such as Shelter, and skinning blue (innocent) corpses is a crime. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525600225744392344)
- **smart harvesting**: To smart harvest, double click the harvesting tool and target yourself; it harvests everything in range for mining, lumberjacking, skinning and fishing, and for lumberjacking it chops all trees in range and tells you to move when they are empty. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424842977710130)
- **summoned pets for harvester defense**: Harvester builds use summoned creatures such as elementals to distract or tank wildlife and random monsters while gathering, and they are kept up only to tank, not to kill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537438114925125742)
- **tracking for harvesters against pks**: Harvesters can use Tracking, ideally 100 along with Detect Hidden and an auto recall script, to see red/PK players approaching and recall away before they arrive. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543051359354363966)
- **treasure map danger**: Treasure map destinations can be dangerous: even low-level maps can place you near strong monsters such as Birds of Paradise or Minotaur Vanquishers, and tough spawns in the area are a bigger threat than the map mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549127064135934105)
- **treasure map drops from mobs**: Treasure maps, including high-level ones such as level 5 and level 7, can drop randomly from ordinary mobs, but the high-level ones are rare. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546132792297918494)
- **afk harvesting**: Harvesting while AFK is not allowed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531198483628032132)
- **anti-afk gathering captcha**: To prevent AFK resource gathering, the game asks for a captcha roughly every 20 minutes, and failing it triggers a gathering timeout. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525492203194155169)
- **arcane scroll drops**: Arcane Scrolls drop as loot from loot-generating activities such as killing monsters and picking chests, and possibly from mobs in the Shelter dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522514574438301706)
- **auto skinning corpses macro**: Create a macro in ClassicUO options under macros with: useskill forensic, waitfortarget, targetself; it skins or harvests all nearby grey corpses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533703991421042728)
- **avar resource maps after update**: Avarite, avarscale, avarhide and avarwood maps remain worth doing one at a time by following the arrow minigame after the update. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530729892608610526)
- **avarhide skinning requirement**: Pulling avarhide with an avarite skinning knife requires 110 real skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547716493297586207)
- **avarite harvest map ore yield**: A tier 14 harvester has obtained 80+ Avar ore from a single map, and four post-patch Avarite maps are expected to yield about 240 ore plus harvest procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540473979746390038)
- **avoiding colored ore while mining**: To avoid receiving colored ore while mining, keep Mining skill below the minimum required for the next ore tier, for example by lowering it to 60 or locking the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529119587965341787)
- **beginner harvesting income**: Mining and lumberjacking both pay well for beginners, with lumberjacking reported to earn the most in the least time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **boat fishing node locations**: Boat fishing nodes have been seen spawning in rivers connected to the ocean but have not been seen in large lakes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548303038932852897)
- **bulk resource map decoding**: Resource maps can currently be decoded in bulk while the player is away, such as overnight, and each decode has a 15 second wait time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528885838673481748)
- **collecting dungeon leather with blank commodities**: Skinning mobs in dungeons yields plain leather, which can be collected as commodities by bringing blank commodities along. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677766417059981)
- **colored pickaxe effects**: A player-crafted colored pickaxe does not improve skill gains; it provides more uses before needing replacement and a higher success rate when gathering found resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740313182732470)
- **dangerous ore map destinations**: The Tarsands Tarpits and Fury's Caldera are very dangerous ore map destinations with constant PvM combat and AoE attacks, so players may need to bring a group under the new ore map system. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533488526438699079)
- **effective fishing skill**: Fishing depends on the effective skill of the Harvest aspect, which cannot be viewed in game, so players must use the Outlands Butler website's fishing calculator. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553116468193796278)
- **effective skill and 2x procs on resource maps**: Effective skill does not affect the chance of 2x procs on resource maps; only the harvest aspect determines it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540481576293507152)
- **fishing echo placement**: A fishing echo should be made on the character that has the harvester aspect, because splitting time across separate accounts costs redline and XP on the harvest suit in the long run. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549764287298277388)
- **forensic evaluation and colored leather**: Forensic Evaluation does not change the chance of obtaining colored leather such as avarhide; it only increases the amount harvested. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536921509514186934)
- **gatherer and crafter echoes on pvm characters**: Echoes on a main PvM character can serve as a gatherer benefiting from high Harvest Aspect (for Treasure Maps and Messages in a Bottle, with fishing added) or as a crafter using the high Artisan skill already leveled for PvM. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537518694220169296)
- **giant sandroaches in the ossuary**: Giant Sandroaches can be found in the Ossuary by searching for the Colossal Sandroaches. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536834072280703078)
- **guild favor harvest buffs on maps**: Guild favor harvest buffs, including the 25% chance for 2x harvest, do not affect treasure map chests or resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540907958781878404)
- **harvest aspect crystals effect**: Harvest aspect crystals do not improve resource gathering; they only affect PvM weapon procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535086015973302272)
- **harvest aspect double yield**: The harvesting aspect gives a chance for a harvest attempt to yield double resources, which can produce more materials from Resource Maps than the listed amount. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536798239909744801)
- **harvest aspect value**: Harvest aspect is worth leveling mainly for long-term self-funded crafting or if you enjoy gathering, and it pays for itself best on a lumberjack or miner (the first level is always worth it), but it will not recover its leveling cost as pure start-up gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537701707478335528)
- **harvest chain links for miners and lumberjacks**: Chain links are not needed for mining or lumberjacking; harvest links only affect harvest success chance, not colored ore discovery, and the harvest aspect already covers this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553337134411288597)
- **harvest map tier yield**: Higher-tier harvest maps have more casts and net more resources overall (roughly 30% more on Avarscale than Dullscale, an uncertain estimate), while lower resource maps were best for special fish. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534352671064981544)
- **harvest proc on gold**: Harvest can proc on gold drops, so a lockpicker with harvest can get doubled gold from level 2-3 treasure chests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537466522623148032)
- **harvest quantity per node**: The quantity of resources obtained per node on a successful harvest is determined only by a harvest proc, and effective harvest does not otherwise affect quantity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554540490085371965)
- **harvester builds with spirit speak**: Resource map harvesters commonly use Magery plus Spirit Speak so summoned elementals tank wildlife (not kill it), and add Tracking to deal with PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534941676353753221)
- **harvester pk risk**: Harvesters earn good money but are high-value targets for PKs and thieves, so carrying lots of ore or wood is risky. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553997704395235349)
- **harvesting and mastery experience**: Harvesting lumber and ore does not give experience toward the mastery chain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524812527920218162)
- **harvesting leather with forensic evaluation**: To obtain leather, use a character with Forensic Evaluation and a skinning knife to skin corpses in dungeons, including mobs you kill and grey mobs that other people kill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533044681514942584)
- **harvesting map requirements**: Using a harvesting map requires only the relevant harvesting skill and an explorer's pack, which is consumed when the map is used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **harvesting restriction after quick travel**: After using any quick travel such as a recall scroll or hiking, a player is restricted from harvesting for about a minute. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532539336271069254)
- **hatchet choice for lumberjacking**: Below 100 Lumberjacking, a cheap mastercrafted hatchet helps reduce failed swings, and failures on any tree stop only at about 138 effective skill including the hatchet; at high harvest tier and about 110-120 skill, a lower-end hatchet is cheaper and still gives the maximum chance at colored wood. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **hatchet quality effect on lumber**: A better hatchet does not give more lumber per tree; it mainly reduces failed swings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526995094455193611)
- **ingot deed capacity**: A regular ingot deed holds 5000 ingots, while colored ingot deeds hold 2500. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527297685483159603)
- **iron pick sufficiency for avarite**: With about 139.1-139.25 effective harvest skill, an exceptional master crafted iron pick (0.08 bonus) reaches 100% success on Avarite, so better picks only add charges. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **kindling from trees**: Using a dagger on a tree yields kindling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537950044718764155)
- **kindling vendors**: Kindling can be bought from provisioner NPCs, and from beggar NPCs if no one else sells it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537950480674586624)
- **lumberjack template mob defense**: A lumberjack gatherer template can defend against easy wilderness mobs such as mongbats, giant rats and basic orcs, but struggles with most other mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536744066031550646)
- **lumberjacking above 110 with harvest aspect**: Raising Lumberjacking above 110 (up to 120) with the Harvest aspect improves colored wood results, both the chance to find colored wood and the success chance on higher tier colors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539153190342107187)
- **lumberjacking nodes and trees**: Lumberjacking resource nodes are tied to actual trees, though not every tree, which makes them easier to locate than mining nodes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522715322078072903)
- **mined ore color and delivery**: Mined ore goes directly into your backpack, its color is random and not visible on the node, and nodes respawn with random ore types. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533068738390134884)
- **mining and lumberjacking optimization**: For mining and lumberjacking, skill plus the harvest aspect is sufficient, and further improvement comes from choosing better tools rather than links; lumberjacking may be a better choice than mining for leveling harvest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394045929914551)
- **mining and lumberjacking xp contribution**: Mining and Lumberjacking (chopping) do not contribute to Mastery Chain, Redline Mastery or Codex XP, whereas harvesting from chests does. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550849277813588032)
- **mining ore**: To mine ore, double click your pickaxe (or use the item in hand) and it searches for harvestable nodes nearby. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424799839551589)
- **mining script complexity**: Large mining scripts mainly benefit pro miners who run three miners in parallel, so beginners should use simple mining scripts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533326750103371817)
- **multiboxing harvesters**: Multi-boxing, such as harvesting with three characters on different accounts at the same time, is allowed on Outlands and commonly done. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544688682953351239)
- **non-stackable ore maps**: Non-stackable ore maps of a different colour are partially completed maps from the old system and can be decoded normally with cartography. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538539786044837908)
- **ocean fishing spots**: Fishing spots spawn on the ocean where nets can be tossed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668874133512225)
- **ore smelting**: Smelting ore cannot fail, so smelting a whole pile at once is as good as one piece at a time, and because ore is heavy players must periodically smelt between mining. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555006395118653553)
- **raw meat for cooking**: Meats for cooking must be obtained by hunting monsters, and Forensic Evaluation is needed to collect higher-end raw meat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554329141015486508)
- **regular leather pickup and deeding**: Regular leather is worth picking up only if you deed it, since commodity deeds can be filled with it and it becomes more valuable when used for societies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541912033866547240)
- **resource map average yield**: A resource map yields on average about 213 resources (ore or wood), and with the T15 harvest aspect the expected yield is about 1.38 times the base amount. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540485214898356305)
- **resource map changes**: The resource map changes make maps safer, with a very low knowledge requirement and trivial completion, so players can pick up and go without third-party tools. They keep maps to specific locations valuable and prevent multiboxing and stockpiling thousands of maps for scripted runs; a camping requirement seen on test was a bug believed fixed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536003805374709760)
- **resource map decoding requirement**: Decoding resource maps requires an explorer pack in the backpack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551087304486035538)
- **resource map explorer packs**: Lumberjacking and mining resource maps need two explorer's packs: one to decode the map and one to reveal the camp. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777015737979014)
- **resource map hiking dances**: Hiking to a resource map involves the character dancing twice for 15 seconds each, with a jog between the dances. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536822591833120799)
- **resource map picture lookup removal**: The resource map overhaul removes the picture-lookup step on exploreoutlands, so players no longer need an external website to decode maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536406270674739261)
- **resource map rewards**: The resource map overhaul adds no extra loot or XP; the reward is still colored ore and skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536756884642472057)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Under the new resource map system, a harvester only needs the harvesting skill related to the map type, and cartography and camping are not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534359142758613192)
- **resource map skill requirements**: Opening mining or lumberjacking resource maps requires explorer's packs and the matching harvesting skill (mining or lumberjacking), and cartography is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554894315082490078)
- **resource map steps**: Decode the map (1 Explorer Pack, 15-second wait), travel to the area (60 Camping or Cartography), follow the arrow to the location, reveal the camp (1 Explorer Pack, 15-second wait), then harvest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536752443239436378)
- **resource maps**: Resource maps cannot be crafted; they are rare loot drops from mobs, guild treasure map runs, boss runs and other game systems. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544772258126499891)
- **resource maps and colored resources**: Colored ore and logs come from random chance in normal gathering, while resource maps let you harvest a guaranteed amount of one specific color; you must meet that color's minimum requirements to use its map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544630120264900608)
- **runetome sheep spot coordinates**: The runetome entry for a sheep spot still displays its coordinates even when the spot is blocked, and those coordinates can be cross-referenced with exploreoutlands to mark a new rune nearby. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529244425748873527)
- **scavenger leather gathering**: A single scavenger character can bank enough leather for a tailor crafter and can also serve as a fund raiser for other characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367268375232553)
- **shelter island lumberjacking yield**: Lumberjacking on Shelter Island yields only half the logs compared to the open world, so more wood is gained outside Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531191439856504863)
- **skinning and carving corpses with smart harvest**: To skin or carve a corpse, make sure you have looting rights, double-click the skinning knife, then target yourself to use Smart Harvest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525505527780605983)
- **skinning blue corpses**: You can skin a blue (non-lootable) corpse without going grey, but you cannot take the leather until the corpse turns grey to you, and a corpse that has already been skinned cannot be skinned again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525210490681426141)
- **skinning leather yield**: For skinning (Forensic Evaluation harvesting), higher effective harvest skill, including from harvest links, yields more leather per skin. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **skinning skeletons and earth elementals**: Skinning a skeleton yields leather and meat, and Earth Elementals also yield leather and meat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532824687040659526)
- **smart harvesting**: Smart harvesting (auto node harvesting) applies to gathering skills such as lumberjacking and speeds up harvesting trees, but it does not apply to stealing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **sorting harvest maps by location**: To group harvest maps by location, sort them by hand into separate tomes by picture, then by zone, then by individual node. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534650830706442343)
- **special fishing net bonuses**: Special fishing nets made from valehide give a larger bonus than copper hide nets (about 16% versus 6%), and a claim of +100 charges for valehide versus +38 for copper also exists, though the two figures describe different bonus types. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524544711249887324)
- **special fishing net message in a bottle**: A special fishing net that has been fished up can be thrown back into the water while on a boat, with the chance of attracting a mob carrying a message in a bottle (MIB). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540332320345817189)
- **t8 treasure chest opening time**: Picking a T8 treasure chest can take around 10 minutes even with T15 harvest, 115 lockpicking and avarite tools, while the chest becomes publicly open after 2 minutes, so it can be blown up faster. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537952379364974704)
- **taming-based gatherer build**: A gatherer build using 4x taming skills lets pets handle combat while harvesting, and one such build survived being dropped into the middle of Fury's Caldera better than other builds tested. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532872864200654919)
- **time to mine 213 ore via resource map**: Completing a resource map for about 213 ore currently takes a little over a minute, compared with roughly 3 minutes (about 2m40s for a top Tier 15 miner) to mine the same amount the traditional way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528214152580038707)
- **tool choice for resource maps**: For resource maps, only an iron harvesting tool is needed because the coloured item is guaranteed anyway; using any other tool is a waste. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535991596552687646)
- **tracking reds while gathering**: Tracking shows red player killers as red arrows, and gatherers use it to know when to flee. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533246520504094783)
- **treasure chest locations**: Treasure chests are found only in dungeons, plus locked chests carried by brigands or orcs who block roads. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542880322629144606)
- **treasure map 2x yield chance**: After the latest update, treasure maps still grant a 2x yield chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539396264838299648)
- **unminable rare-looking ore vein**: The rare-looking ore vein that cannot be mined is related to the Ruined Lyceum Library quest and still needs to be researched. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549866878032158751)
- **unreadable captcha handling**: If a captcha is unreadable, right-click to close the window and redo the action so a new, usually easier, challenge appears. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525492457645801513)
- **wilderness harvesting risks**: Harvesters in the wilderness can be hunted by PKs and Thieves and attacked by mobs that spawn around mining and lumber locations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537844067700838492)
- **8x8 grid in caves**: In caves, the 8x8 grid can be turned on with the 'trees as stumps' option in options, but it does not always work in every cave and the nodes may not have all loaded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522989605933158460)
- **Avar/Vale node links**: Avar/Vale nodes are rare, so investing in links is not worth it while leveling skill and aspect, as they won't matter once skill and aspect are high. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521374175363596390)
- **active resource map binding**: When a resource map becomes active it is blessed and bound, so it is not lost if the player is forced out; the player must wait for the threat to clear or intentionally abandon the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528899393611370557)
- **aegis keep level 4 chests**: Aegis Keep level 4 (AK4) has about 20 level 6 chests in a relatively small dungeon level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045536842879078)
- **afk gathering rule**: AFK gathering (gathering resources while away from the keyboard) is not allowed on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525868086681538803)
- **afk harvesting rules**: AFK harvesting is not allowed; scripts may swing for you, but you must move yourself and answer a captcha periodically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535309926807900283)
- **afk mining and lumberjacking**: AFK mining or lumberjacking is not viable because staff may check in on you and you may be penalized if you do not respond. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535796189927051274)
- **announced lumberjacking spots**: Announcing a lumberjacking spot publicly invites player-killer ganking, so players should avoid spots that others announce. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547877627606339635)
- **arcane essence and harvest armor bonus**: Running out of arcane essence can stop harvest armor's bonus from working, which can prevent mining avararite maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935882629320877)
- **arcane essence stockpile on test center**: Arcane essence can be obtained from a stockpile, which on the test center is available from the same statue and can be locked down in an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555558870540091444)
- **arcane essence supply**: To stay stocked with arcane essence, buy ID wands or run a script on an alt that identifies and recycles everything; a container that automates this exists later but is expensive and mid-game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543597158727688322)
- **arcane essence sustainability**: Arcane essence is easy to sustain by looting your own kills and items others leave on corpses, then recycling them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527701636561109122)
- **aspect choice for special fishing nets**: Fortune aspect is the better choice than harvest aspect for throwing special fishing nets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536085282489639103)
- **aspect crystal quantities per session**: Roughly 50-80 aspect crystals suit a short gold fill-up farming session, about 200 for a very long dungeon stay, and about 25 for a boss run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536216231651319930)
- **auto-recall to avoid pks while harvesting**: Auto-recalling away from PKs works well for avoiding being killed while harvesting, though it is not a 100% guarantee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535311391861375036)
- **auto-skinning etiquette in groups**: When grouping, do not auto-skin if the group has a skinner with high skill and a good knife, because skinning a boss or mini boss with 0 or 100 skill can cost the group substantial gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529294572104974426)
- **automating mining and fishing**: Mining and fishing can be automated with a script, macro, or hotkey on a loop, leaving the player to move, run from reds, and fill out captchas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554258983668293726)
- **avar resource skill requirement**: Avar resources are expected to require 110 skill, counting effective skill from bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532863106223575293)
- **avarite map display in patch notes**: The patch notes show a white avarite map displaying the number of ore remaining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555888918174507018)
- **avarite map drop rate**: Avarite maps rarely drop as loot while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531063505267065062)
- **avarite mining**: Avarite is reportedly worth gathering beyond 100 mining skill, though this is stated tersely and with uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528805293746815037)
- **avarite never-fail threshold and treasure maps**: The tool-based never-fail threshold for Avarite applies only to traditional harvesting and does not help with treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **avarite pickaxe base ratio**: An avarite pickaxe has a base ratio of 0.18. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825233779069115)
- **avarite pickaxe success rates**: With 120 mining, T15 Harvest, exceptional mastercrafted tools and zero links, an iron pickaxe has a 98.6% success rate on Avarite, and Shadow Iron may be needed for 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538996139070853210)
- **avarscale fishing map yield cap**: After the new harvest map changes, the Avarscale fishing map's resource yield appears capped at 35. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534350730067050496)
- **backstabber template for harvesting while killing mobs**: A backstabber is about the only template that makes harvesting while killing mobs work well, excluding skinning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530286296793223229)
- **batch running resource maps**: Under the new resource map system, players typically collect resource maps from PvM and run them as a batch once they have enough to justify switching echos. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544387268913930382)
- **best harvesting activity for guild caravan gauge**: Lumberjacking is the most efficient harvesting activity for filling the guild caravan gauge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542914413969809531)
- **best hatchet for lumberjacking**: The best hatchet depends on your Lumberjacking skill and harvest tier; aim for as close to a 100% chance to get avarwood as possible, since any chance beyond that is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162008758681791)
- **best resource maps**: Fishing maps are considered the best resource maps because they yield all three resource types and have a high ore count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538689552699490357)
- **best value knife for leather harvesting**: A Verite knife is likely the best value knife for leather harvesting, only slightly better than an Avar knife because of a probability shift. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541910925735624734)
- **blessed traveler's lantern source**: Blessed traveler's lanterns come only from ore maps, though a player vendor might sell them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549648095179055137)
- **boat fishing setup**: Boat fishing is best done on a small boat with upgrades and crew; useful small-boat upgrades include Sea Change, Hard to Port, Sargasso, Fisherman's Outfitting, and Hookah, and Exotic Bait is also needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528316481018794096)
- **boat fishing spots**: Fishing spots on a boat have no timers and are pretty competitive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534882548260405308)
- **boat fishing with nets**: When fishing from a boat, players usually use player-crafted nets rather than fishing rods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539688608267632750)
- **boat hold leather storage**: A boat hold can store leather gathered while fishing at sea, so character weight is not a concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527453077928677407)
- **boat needed for fishing**: A small boat is all that is needed for fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539229762004852746)
- **boat speed abilities against pks while fishing**: Getting speed abilities on your boat is recommended to avoid being caught by PKs while fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539231299422781481)
- **boat stats for fishing**: Good boat stats for fishing are Speed 8-9+, Spyglass 8+, as much Wakescaler as possible, and Fishing 4+ (the Fishing stat caps at 5); Greater CD is nice but not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549751732555219065)
- **boating crew recommendation**: A crew is recommended for boating even when only fishing with nets; cheap Carpenters and possibly a Pilgrim help considerably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538991975670218772)
- **bronze links and harvest aspect success**: Using 10 bronze links together with harvest aspect level 10 gives essentially a 100% harvest success chance on all ores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538247679191294043)
- **bugged fishing treasure map spots**: If a fishing treasure map has a bugged, unreachable spot, put the map in your bank and submit a help request, after which staff give you a different map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520975397737467955)
- **caddelite ore use**: Caddelite Ore, found at the meteor impact sites, is decoration only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533927048576368701)
- **camping carry weight bonus**: Camping provides extra carry weight, which is why harvester characters commonly take it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540030377463250975)
- **camping hikes to mining pois**: A gatherer with the Camping skill can hike to points of interest (POIs) to find mining spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526909932929286274)
- **camping links for miners**: Camping links are an option for a miner because they let the harvester hold more ore, while follower defensive/offensive links are an option for a summoner route. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528480933215473776)
- **cannot produce any wood message**: The message 'you cannot produce any wood from that' means the tree was recently harvested and is out of wood, so move to a different tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525056537998004294)
- **captcha and gathering macros**: A captcha popup does not stop a running gathering macro, so a macro that keeps cycling counts as failed captcha attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525493441180471307)
- **captcha number guessing trick**: Captcha numbers are generated as dots in a straight line and then some are randomly moved, so the original number can be guessed from the remaining detail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525491979150950403)
- **captchas on gathering actions**: Gathering actions can trigger captchas, including using the Forensic skill on floor boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520828299150885168)
- **capturing ore map for explore outlands**: When capturing an ore map for Explore Outlands, include only the middle part of the map and none of the surrounding scroll, otherwise the tool finds the wrong spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533772455091376238)
- **caravan transport bar**: Gathering resources fills a caravan transport bar, which lets the guild run an escort event between two towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520287721484980325)
- **carry capacity risk while mining**: Reaching your carry capacity while mining leaves you vulnerable, and a PK can kill you and take some of your ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526218597356142592)
- **carving with zero forensic evaluation**: You can still carve leather and meat with 0 Forensic Evaluation, but you receive only a reduced amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524065710765248602)
- **carving yield formula**: Leather and meat from carving corpses equals 50% + (150% * Forensic Evaluation / 100) of the creature's base amount, so 50% at 0 skill and 65% at 10 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525517672572391504)
- **catch of the week**: Fish can be registered in the Catch of the Week, but only the fish eligible that week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532126264784322763)
- **character for collecting hides**: For collecting hides and similar materials, a dexxer (backstabber or regular) with Forensic Evaluation is recommended, since a pure dungeon-crawling harvester is less efficient after the recent gold decay nerf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550617182461886579)
- **checking for blue players while gathering**: While gathering, periodically use Tracking to check for blue (non-criminal) players nearby so you are not sneaked up on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205912015831052)
- **checking if a corpse is skinned**: To check whether a corpse has already been skinned, manually use the skinning tool on it; if nothing is produced, the corpse has already been skinned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530558762627235912)
- **chest loot and recycling**: It is worth taking everything from chests, and unidentified items can be recycled for materials including essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550870515063726195)
- **collector bar pickup**: After creating new collectors, move around so the collectors pick up bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542563792477749340)
- **colored leather rarity from scavenging**: Scavenging mostly yields dull through roughly gold-tier leather, and only occasionally; rose through avar leather is practically never found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551001475109490811)
- **colored node discovery**: Your tool, skill, and aspect have no impact on how many colored resource nodes you find; they only affect harvesting results once a node is found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored node harvesting below skill requirement**: If your effective skill is below the requirement for a colored ore node you found, harvesting from it defaults to iron ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored node swing success chance**: Once you have found a colored node, the chance of a successful swing is calculated from your skill plus your tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546179731714609162)
- **colored ore acquisition rate**: Colored ore comes in slowly unless you invest in ore maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544716281180192878)
- **colored ore chance on shelter island**: On Shelter Island the chance of finding colored ore is reduced by 50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526045512224997538)
- **colored ore gather amount**: The amount of colored ore gathered is not fixed and depends on the player's skill and the colored axe used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526777445867454474)
- **colored ore node yield mechanics**: Mining node colors spawn randomly and cannot be predicted or altered; on a colored node each swing has a 50% chance to yield colored ore and a 50% chance to yield iron, so later swings can still yield colored ore after iron swings, and at 107 Mining roughly 18% of nodes are colored (uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533142646514516188)
- **colored ores and ruleset**: Outlands has colored ores and uses Felucca-style rules with many Outlands-specific changes and additions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525473130158751754)
- **colored ores and woods**: Colored ores and woods are mostly used for society quests and are not really needed otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537428075040743454)
- **combat skills versus summons for harvesters**: Giving a harvester combat skills instead of summons costs harvesting time because the character spends it fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526693929947369544)
- **combining partially harvested maps**: Partially harvested maps placed in a tome combine into new, untouched maps once the change goes live, provided the numbers are large enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534378795556012145)
- **confined areas gatherer risk**: Gathering in confined areas such as islands is risky because the island radius is likely smaller than the tracking range, leaving less time to escape a red. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533249819710062692)
- **crafted hatchet durability**: Crafted hatchets last longer than vendor hatchets, and a mastercrafted iron axe has 1000 uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549010564766892106)
- **crafted shovel use after patch**: After the latest patch, crafted shovels reportedly have no use other than digging dirt clumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541785473666785301)
- **dagger kindling targeting**: Using a dagger to gather kindling may require targeting yourself rather than the tree, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763876937138186)
- **decoded avarite map handling**: Avarite maps decoded before the patch were supposed to revert to undecoded, and maps decoded after the patch are not supposed to be sellable or tradeable, so current behavior is likely a bug. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555895460043169825)
- **decoding fishing resource maps**: To use a fishing resource map, decode it using the fishing skill plus an explorer pack and wait for the decode to finish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **dedicated harvester character**: A dedicated harvester character on Outlands can be a pure gatherer with no fighting skills and the Harvest aspect, functioning as an income source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537435851242479706)
- **deep dungeon leather farming survival**: Players who farm leather in the deepest dungeons without summons or pets survive mostly through their link choices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524927853219676372)
- **deer skinning tool**: Skinning a deer requires a skinning knife bought from an NPC or player vendor, and a dagger cannot be used to skin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525613295581790380)
- **defensive harvester setup**: A good defensive harvester setup is 120 hit points and the resist spell, with tracking kept up to spot reds, then running or using a hike macro when a red appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535322218890797087)
- **detect hidden value while gathering**: Detect Hidden is valuable while gathering because thieves and sneaky blue PKs using Chivalry gate are nearly as dangerous as openly hostile PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554206573927337985)
- **digging up resource map nodes**: At the exact spot of a resource map, dig up the resource node, which also consumes an explorer pack, and then harvest it with the normal tool (a fishing rod for fishing maps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **discipline aspect farming rank**: Discipline is currently thought to be one of the top aspects for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537556030618083540)
- **double harvest procs**: Double harvest procs occur frequently, giving a seed together with ore in the same swing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547931043007430677)
- **drop rng and target farming**: All drops are RNG apart from region- or dungeon-specific rare decorations, and nothing other than those rare decorations can be target-farmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530177891743170560)
- **dull copper ore weight**: Carrying a large amount of dull copper ore, such as 400, is heavy, so it is better to go home and unload it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349558031585352)
- **dull copper pickaxe avarite success**: With 120 mining skill and T15 Harvest aspect, an exceptional mastercrafted dull copper pickaxe with zero links has a 100% success rate on Avarite nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **dungeon chest availability**: Dungeon chests are currently almost always available because there appear to be fewer dungeon pickers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530543650260389949)
- **dungeon chest harvesting experience**: Each dungeon chest reportedly gives a fixed amount of harvesting experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537509383095980052)
- **dungeon locked chests**: Every dungeon floor has locked chests that drop loot, and you can stealth, lockpick and disarm traps on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479704363532483)
- **dye drops from resource map digging**: Dyes found while digging on resource maps are not looted as items; they simply appear with a small audible cue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535056884799635581)
- **early ingot mining with basic pickaxes**: A new player can mine about 5k ingots using newbied or NPC-bought pickaxes instead of crafting tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537053564751581224)
- **earth aspect for skinner**: The Earth aspect is tentatively suggested for a dedicated skinner gathering character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535771032013774878)
- **earth elemental guards while harvesting**: Keep two earth elementals summoned and set to guard you at all times while harvesting so mobs attack them instead of you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542211694267207761)
- **earth elementals for map protection**: Two summoned earth elementals are enough protection against PvM threats in almost all places when running resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528897759103680692)
- **echo harvesting leather yield**: Making an echo and pushing harvesting can double leather yield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535770512427589662)
