- **echo links for SOS fishing**: When doing SOSs with the fishing skill, special rare loot links are probably the ones to want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520842297632096349)
- **echo links for harvesting**: For an echo used with harvesting skills, camping links are probably the most valuable extra links, while damage resistance is an alternative that is not really worth it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520840958395285555)
- **effective skill on harvest**: The effective skill on harvest is the same as the harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529430118768840704)
- **effective skill target for skinning**: An effective skill of about 110 is probably enough for Skinning, though going higher yields slightly more leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526795418787385355)
- **elven spellblade skinning**: The elven spellblade functions as a skinning knife. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534132104114208859)
- **empty treasure chest drop**: After the patch, destroying a treasure map chest reportedly still gives a chance to receive an empty treasure chest item, though this is secondhand and unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545550202444718131)
- **escape methods for gatherers**: Use both a hotkeyed Atlas hiking script and recalling for escapes, and keep your rune book fully charged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554208197819109528)
- **escaping weak harvester pks**: Against weak harvester PKs, you can outheal their damage, finish your harvesting, and then recall away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549832994783760385)
- **event seed growth**: Event seeds grow in a few hours with no extra steps needed, though the displayed progress may update slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075903666888747)
- **event seed growth progress**: Event seeds progress faster the closer their conditions are to optimal levels, which can be checked with a character that has Taste Identification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075739250294805)
- **exceptional tool bonus for mining**: Exceptional and master crafted mining tools give a tool bonus that increases the chance to mine colored ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554845818383503471)
- **explore outlands ore map locating**: An ore map can be placed in the Explore Outlands tool with Witcher ticked, using a Witcher rune set (e.g. the one at Horse Shoe Bay on the beach), to find the location of its red dot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533772172848267315)
- **farming location before 30 links**: Before reaching 30 links, it is reasonable to farm in the wilderness all the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524141181766996170)
- **farming skill setup**: One player farms using camping and 120 herding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539661012050116616)
- **faster gathering technique**: To gather faster, start the next gather action immediately instead of waiting for the system message confirming the previous one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534315282951311541)
- **filleting fish for cooking**: To get cooking use from a fish, double-click your dagger, target the fish, and choose the fillet option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537178208766787705)
- **filling water containers at lakes and ponds**: Water containers such as watering cans and buckets can be filled at a lake or pond outdoors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531402297542709351)
- **finding harvesting spots**: To find good harvesting spots, use the map at exploreoutlands.com and avoid locations close to towns and dungeon entrances or that are overly convenient, since those tend to be crowded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543053075239927909)
- **finding less-known harvesting spots**: To find less-known harvesting spots, get Magery, carry empty runes, take a random moongate and explore until you find a good spot, then mark a rune there and repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535610456947949579)
- **finding lumberjacking spots**: To find good lumberjacking spots, avoid popular places and use the Explore Outlands feature to discover less popular locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547878600739393547)
- **fishing and messages in bottles**: Fishing and messages in bottles (MiBs) on the ocean produce valuable finds that you do not get from mining rocks or chopping trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525618079340429352)
- **fishing aspect setup**: While fishing, put the Harvest aspect on your armor (even tier 0 is fine) and a higher-level aspect on your weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **fishing aspect setup**: When fishing, use a harvest aspect on your armor and a fortune aspect on your weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539710403427303586)
- **fishing crew composition**: Crew composition matters little for fishing; the useful crew are someone to speed-cap the boat and a carpenter to keep it repaired. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524615491203895436)
- **fishing link priorities**: For fishing, the recommended links are 10 harvest links first, then 20 special/rare loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212957315596309)
- **fishing pole on boats**: A second character on a fishing boat can fish with a pole, but it is nearly worthless compared to nets; a skinner could ride along to process catches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549702171962908725)
- **fishing rewards**: Fishing can yield fish meats as a reward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549393892497948764)
- **fishing spots and castaway routing**: Fish every fishing spot you see; when you find a castaway, head toward the town they want to go to and fish all the spots you encounter along the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540253442667446293)
- **fishing treasure map harvest timing**: Fishing treasure maps use a 1,850 millisecond harvest timing, which was not changed by the patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930709464420363)
- **forensic evaluation and corpse skinning**: Forensic Evaluation directly benefits gatherers because corpse skinning yields more leather the higher the skill is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550584435391602709)
- **forensic evaluation skinning**: A PvM character can use Forensic Evaluation for skinning while a separate gatherer character earns supplemental gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525859989317750854)
- **forges and smelting**: Forges are found in caves, out in the world, and in player or guild houses; smelting at a forge may be possible while hidden or invisible, though both points are uncertain and there is probably no reliable way to smelt ore while mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537581525569372221)
- **fortune versus harvest loot bonuses**: Running Fortune instead of Harvest still gives a 40% special rare loot bump but not the 38% chance at double loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538221296217755749)
- **free tailoring and alchemy supplies via scavenger**: To supply Tailoring and Alchemy for free, make a scavenger character and pick up skins and reagents in dungeons for about an hour a day. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523769084154744865)
- **gadget and harvest trap routine**: One treasure map routine is to switch to Gadget on dropoff, clear the area, pop one trap, then switch to Harvest and pop a second trap; the Gadget timer is usually nearly ready by the time mobs die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540476096133341287)
- **gather chance modifiers for dyes**: Colored pickaxes and ore maps do not realistically increase the chance to gather, and special loot bonuses probably do not improve the chance of finding dyes on resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535056735486873661)
- **gatherer character placement for harvest aspect**: A gatherer character on which you intend to unlock the harvest aspect should be on your primary PvM account so it counts toward the redline scalar, unless you do not plan to take the aspect to 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522999618672263358)
- **gatherer income without aspect**: Gatherers can earn around 200k gold per hour without an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525959093213200424)
- **gatherer protection from pks**: A bit of resist and a health potion or two makes a gatherer not worth the effort for PKs, who tend to move on to other targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542907439257620600)
- **gatherer templates in combat**: Gatherer templates are poor at killing mobs, and a build that tries to both gather and fight does both badly, so a PvM build should be used for killing mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536751136286056488)
- **gathering builds for dangerous resource maps**: Summoner builds, and peacing builds using barding, are popular for gathering at dangerous resource map locations because you can usually gather everything before your pets die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541818090017259550)
- **gathering captcha refresh**: When a gathering Captcha appears, you can close it and attempt to gather again to receive a new Captcha, and this does not count as a failure, so refreshing is safer than guessing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539704889289084948)
- **gathering near populated areas**: Gathering near populated areas is risky because it invites trouble from player killers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533250283919118346)
- **gathering near towns pk risk**: Gathering closer to towns reportedly increases the chance of encountering PKs and thieves, though this is anecdotal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526910314640179252)
- **gathering penalty on shelter island**: Gathering skills suffer a malus on Shelter Island, yielding roughly 50% less ore or wood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534185564843147404)
- **gathering profitability and safety**: Gathering is lucrative and much more relaxed if you know how to protect yourself against thieves and murderers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548971740959604849)
- **gathering skill codex**: There is currently no codex for gathering skills, though one may be added later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528429668959785110)
- **gathering spots without escape routes**: Young players should avoid gathering in locations that offer no means of escape other than recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533246874692223077)
- **gathering yield on shelter island**: Gatherers get less ore and wood on Shelter Island, so gatherers and crafters should leave it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533032960083628074)
- **gemstone availability**: Gemstones are very common. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545504717252206742)
- **growing plants in pots**: Players can grow plants in pots from seeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525808869446647991)
- **growing zucchini**: Grow zucchini the same way as seeds, using a pot, as described on the wiki's Plant Growing page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553171809149526100)
- **growth serum replacement in planter**: A growth serum already applied in a planter likely cannot be replaced with a better one until the weekly cycle passes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552806564220375111)
- **guild caravan event**: The guild caravan event is a guild event tied to harvesting resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541453523336568892)
- **guild favor harvest bonus roll**: Guild favor harvest bonuses grant a second roll only if the first roll fails, which raises the proc chance rather than stacking bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529046251906269285)
- **guild harvest buff and leather yield**: An active guild harvest buff can make mobs drop double leather, but it applies only to regular materials (regular leather, wood, ore), and higher effective harvest skill gives slightly more leather when skinning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535053482888011786)
- **handling fish that will dry out**: When you get a fish that will dry out, first check whether it is a [cotw fish, then chop it or add it to your fish tank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538253884521324586)
- **handling of caught fish**: Caught fish are mostly chopped up, with a few sold to players filling fish tanks, apart from the catch of the week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549701970804220027)
- **harvest and chromatic cores**: Harvest cores and chromatic cores drop from PvM and can be sold or used to unlock Harvest Aspect progressively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532815670717186181)
- **harvest and fortune aspects on tmapper**: Harvest and Fortune aspects can be run on the same character as the tmapper, so multiboxing a separate character for them is unnecessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538237089127079976)
- **harvest and fortune in dungeon chests**: Harvest gives more loot from dungeon chests, while Fortune gives more experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534738383354724383)
- **harvest and fortune on treasure maps**: Harvest still works on treasure maps and has a chance to double rare and special loot, while Fortune increases gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537463640364683405)
- **harvest armor bonus scope**: Harvest armor boosts the base harvest bonus but does not boost harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537313841560682506)
- **harvest aspect**: Harvest Aspect is not a prerequisite for harvesting, and it can get expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525853285687496896)
- **harvest aspect chest running**: A PvM account with the Harvest aspect gives a nice boost to dungeon chest running, allowing 2-3 effective chests to be run for the higher tiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544625246630584400)
- **harvest aspect delayed bonus**: The +17 bonus from the harvest aspect does not apply until the aspect has been active for over 60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537313738883866745)
- **harvest aspect progress**: Harvest aspect progress can be earned with the aspect active on a book or weapon as well as on armor, and by opening chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542166118460956846)
- **harvest aspect requirements**: Several characters can harvest at the same time, and harvesting resources (not chests) only requires the harvest aspect armor to be active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539593457331343442)
- **harvest aspect unlock requirement**: Harvest Aspect must be unlocked to have any chance at double harvest, even at tier 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532808968320188446)
- **harvest aspect usefulness**: The Harvest aspect/skill set is not very important for farming, but it is useful for fishing from a boat and for picking dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543963766029422663)
- **harvest aspect while mining**: Mining works without a harvest aspect, but wearing harvest aspect while mining is worthwhile even at tier 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539588848680439859)
- **harvest attempt rate**: A lumberjacking harvest attempt occurs about once every 4 seconds, while a mining attempt occurs about once every second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554899188632785008)
- **harvest build requirements for map types**: Harvesting requires up to four different harvest builds if you want to run all the resource map types, unlike treasure maps which use one build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531095790099890317)
- **harvest cooldown after teleporting**: Normally you cannot harvest for 1 minute after teleporting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540483945303380069)
- **harvest double yield chance at t14**: At T14 Harvest there is a 34% chance for a chest to give 2x yield, so about a 66% chance of regular loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528495258332172308)
- **harvest experience from treasure chests**: Opening a treasure chest may still proc harvest experience, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537023065068937217)
- **harvest link tiers**: Ten Bronze effective Harvest links are recommended; Silver and Gold links add little value, and effective harvest skill and effective camping links are the more useful ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949933389058119)
- **harvest links**: Harvest links are used to run lower level harvesting in order to save on essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538657099456708761)
- **harvest links for fishing**: Harvest links are required for Fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526285353923645440)
- **harvest map cast resource chance**: According to the wiki, each harvest map cast has a 20% chance of yielding a resource. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534352579717238955)
- **harvest map changes**: The patch notes say the upcoming harvest map changes will be similar to the treasure map changes, and no detailed notes for harvest maps exist yet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532898815181586663)
- **harvest map downtime**: Players must leave the area after completing each harvest map, and post-patch changes reportedly slowed the pace to roughly 15 seconds of downtime between maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536935538047848540)
- **harvest node depletion time**: A harvesting node such as ore or a tree is drained within about 10-20 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525617942883205230)
- **harvest setup swap delay during treasure map pvm**: When swapping to the Harvest setup while doing PvM in treasure maps, the player must wait 1 minute before the setup becomes active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542130003339120690)
- **harvest skill and resource map yield**: Higher effective harvest skill does not increase the resources obtained from a resource map, and whether harvest aspect plus chain links affects skill gain is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535053482888011786)
- **harvest skills and aspects leveling**: Harvest skills and aspects are slow and painful to raise, so a fisher is best made on the same echoed character as other harvesting characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362106957013136)
- **harvest tier leveling cost and bonus**: Leveling harvest from tier 0 to tier 1 costs about 90k gold once you have the XP; tier 0 gives a 6% chance for double yield, and each tier raises both the chance and the cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521146903214034994)
- **harvested items and antiquity achievements**: Harvested items do not grant antiquity achievements, as there are no harvest antiquity achievements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533486194208280779)
- **harvested log weight**: Harvested logs weigh very little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555006262834503752)
- **harvester aspect gear requirement**: For gathering skills like mining and lumberjacking, only the armor needs the Harvester aspect to earn full experience on harvest attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529584360200605847)
- **harvester aspect on secondary account**: The Harvester aspect is generally not worth getting on a secondary harvester account for a very new player; it can be added to an alt harvester later once the player is well established. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521681824970182738)
- **harvester aspect treasure hunting**: The Harvester aspect on a main character can double as a treasure hunting aid in addition to gathering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521681824970182738)
- **harvester escape routine**: Harvesters use Tracking to detect nearby enemies and a runebook to escape, and unload before carrying more than they are willing to lose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535611612843610182)
- **harvester sales and pker risk**: Harvesters generally sell in commodity deed quantities, and PKers can interrupt players while they harvest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526042606088355910)
- **harvester template tracking**: A harvester template should keep tracking always on, set to look for criminals and murderers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570036430868490)
- **harvester utility skills**: Harvesters can use many utility skills for survival, such as Camping for extra carry weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538721142406258781)
- **harvesting area blocked by mobs**: A harvester without a means of fighting enemy mobs has to flee when they appear, which can leave the area unharvestable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526693816181198949)
- **harvesting axe tier for avar maps**: The ore tier or color of the harvesting axe, such as a valorite hatchet, has no effect on harvesting an avar map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535707720500514907)
- **harvesting gameplay depth**: Outlands harvesting involves little active decision-making and is described by one player as 'Riding Lawnmower gameplay'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527357337931616386)
- **harvesting info image skill recommendations for treasure maps**: Since the latest patch, the skill recommendations on the community harvesting info image are incorrect for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539256684269019257)
- **harvesting leather with forensics**: With the Forensics skill, use a skinning knife on creatures, including other people's mobs, to harvest leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537619908110843944)
- **harvesting location tradeoffs**: Harvesting near cities lets new players run back to safety and drop off boards often, while harvesting far from cities makes PKs and thieves less likely to bother you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532229200524869692)
- **harvesting map spawn risk**: Harvesting maps can place a player at nearly any location, so the encounter depends on the spawn there, and you need a way to deal with the spawn to avoid wasting the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **harvesting node markers on world map**: Players have so far only found a way to use harvesting node markers via the world map, keeping the world map open on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522717618652319784)
- **harvesting swing delays**: The swing delay is about 1.0-1.2 seconds for mining and about 4.2 seconds for lumberjacking; maps may be about 2 seconds, but that figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522354275844489246)
- **harvesting while dungeon running**: A player can have one character harvesting while another runs a dungeon, provided the player manages it and responds to afk checks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525404133593583616)
- **harvestmaster event plant growth time**: During harvestmaster events, plants grow much faster and more easily than normal plant growing, taking about 6 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550567213314998324)
- **hatchet type thresholds for no failed swings**: At a combined 139.1 (skill plus aspect), Iron hatchets give no failed swings, and at roughly 138 (120 skill plus T15 aspect) Dull Copper hatchets are believed to give no failures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521374175363596390)
- **hides and meat value versus weight**: Hides and meat both have some value, but meat may not be worth the weight it takes up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522263809073483786)
- **high ore mined totals**: Players reach very high ore-mined totals by buying low-level ore maps and running macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545423247242297364)
- **hollow hills mining competition**: The Hollow Hills have low competition for mining because other harvesters don't usually go there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529945032671494255)
- **horseshoe bay mining training**: Horseshoe Bay is a good mining training area because it is close to town, so you can run in and call guards on PKers; any grey stone there, even small bits or along the path, is mineable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629515441930300)
- **hostile monsters at resource map locations**: Players hiking to resource maps can arrive in the middle of hostile monsters, such as a colossal strider that uses area-of-effect stomps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536830669408309288)
- **immaculate stone source**: Immaculate Stone drops during a trade caravan, which is a guild activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523043492450926635)
- **ingots to ore and node conversion**: 1,500 ingots corresponds to about 750 ore, which is roughly 50-75 mining nodes depending on aspect tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533140720515416085)
- **iron skinning knife vendors**: Iron skinning knives are sold by tinkerer NPCs and provisioners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546085853280079964)
- **iron spyglass for treasure maps**: An iron spyglass is likely enough for treasure maps up through tier 3, while tier 4 maps require a better spyglass. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520693335054880778)
- **kindling from trees**: Gathering kindling from trees is free and can be done inside town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763600494764104)
- **leather and meat uses**: Leather is useful for the three recommended Society Job tailors, selling it to NPCs pays only about 1-2 gp each, and meat is used for Cooking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528702046457303183)
- **leather commodity deeds in ossuary**: Leather can be turned into commodity deeds, and 10 commodity deeds of leather can be obtained quickly during a Challenger Ossuary 4 run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531398166048669807)
- **leather gatherer build**: A leather gatherer can be built as a PvM character or as a build using Hiding, Stealth, Camping, Magery and Forensics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533044830513528893)
- **leather left behind by forensic evaluation users**: Many players who use Forensic Evaluation leave leather on corpses, so a scavenger can accumulate large amounts of leather they did not carve themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000897902088193)
- **leather looting priority in dungeons**: When harvesting leather in a dungeon, loot leather first and deed regular leather into commodity deeds, leave dullhide behind, and only fill any remaining space with gold on the way out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541911089934106624)
- **leather value per stone with verite knife**: With a Verite knife, leather is worth about 40 gold per stone, or about 186 gold per stone when picking up all leather at 110+ skill, with the 1:1 break-even around copperhide at current Butler prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541910416710438953)
- **leather value with forensic evaluation**: With Forensic Evaluation, leather is worth a bit to sell, and it can be collected to create tailors for the Society Quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522263786436825158)
- **leather yield from skinning on level 4 oss map**: On the changed maps, leather quantities from skinning mobs in the level 4 map (Oss 4) are low enough that skinning is only worthwhile for avarhide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536807829317492737)
- **lesser paragon chest contents**: A lesser paragon chest typically contains some gold, magic items, and probably a core, skill scroll, or map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541124829447454770)
- **lightning vs madness aspect farming**: The Lightning aspect is reported to be easier to farm than the Madness aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538233504603570226)
- **locating deciphered map with exploreoutlands**: Screen snip only the map section of the deciphered map, excluding the scroll border, and paste it into exploreoutlands to find the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530607448032022830)
- **log and leather yield from lumber and leather maps**: Lumber maps yield logs at about the same rate as normal lumberjacking, while leather maps yield poorly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522360474480410735)
- **log weight**: The developers have adjusted the weight of logs, so earlier weight-based macro setups may need rechecking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526241432401350866)
- **loot links for treasure maps**: With 25+ links, running loot links plus a few damage links for treasure maps is better than swapping chains, because the cartography damage bonus makes a few damage links sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538534362721689611)
- **lootgoblin map app**: Players use the app lootgoblin to find ore locations on deciphered maps, though it can be finicky depending on video settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530606818261340230)
- **looting guild kills**: If you skin mobs killed by your own guild, you can loot the leather from those corpses instantly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525210701197738156)
- **lord glacier chill miner razor script**: Lord Glacier's Chill Miner Razor script has good overheads and options to warn when red players are nearby and to auto recall if they get too close or when manually triggered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532006771097600071)
- **low-level maps value**: Low-level maps such as tier 1 maps and low-level skinning maps are considered throwaways by at least one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528547265839370363)
- **low-tier map rewards-to-time ratio**: Maps below valor-avar tier are reported to have a poor rewards-to-time ratio after the new changes, though this is an uncertain opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534387498854125688)
- **lumberjack focus with board commissions**: Gathering leather, reagents and boards yourself suits a scavenger with lumberjacking, but focusing on Lumberjacking and using board commissions to sell boards and buy reagents and leather is faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547355574121791518)
- **lumberjack log weight**: Mined ore is heavy and must be smelted to lighten it, while lumberjacks currently have no equivalent requirement such as a sawhorse to turn logs into lighter boards; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530315807039557764)
- **lumberjack weapon skills**: Most lumberjacks do not run any weapon skill other than wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530275931422200008)
- **lumberjacking locations**: Lumberjacking can be done in any forest on the map where PKs are not a threat, and Nusero is a good spot when no PKs are around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555300072357499023)
- **lumberjacking movement**: Lumberjacking requires walking from tree to tree to harvest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521226702515081316)
- **lumberjacking nodes for adjacent trees**: If two trees are too close together, they often count as a single tree for lumberjacking nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522716745922646169)
- **lumberjacking outside andaria**: Lumberjacking outside Andaria is reportedly workable, though this comes from a single uncertain player claim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548072880766586911)
- **lumberjacking resource maps**: Lumberjacking resource maps have no fail chance, yield colored wood, and are safer than chopping trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550529591171612693)
- **lumberjacking versus fishing income**: Lumberjacking generally earns more money than fishing, unless you fish on the ocean and fight and harvest there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526589300546736169)
- **lumberjacking yield per tree**: Trees yield about 5-10 logs per swing and take about 2-4 swings to deplete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530666777561006251)
- **magery and tracking for harvester safety**: Magery and Tracking keep a harvester safe nearly all of the time as long as the player is not AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535611683064651776)
- **main fishing activity location**: The main part of fishing in Outlands is done at sea. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528886000497987739)
- **mana cost of recalling to resource maps**: Players no longer need to spend mana recalling to resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550583437369540609)
- **manual anti-harvesting captchas**: Manual anti-harvesting (MAH) captchas apply to all overworld gathering skills: lumberjacking, mining, forensic evaluation (skinning), and fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474912285364358)
- **manual node movement while mapping**: Even with scripts, mapping requires manually moving between resource nodes, and consecutive maps only chain together if the next map's location lines up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536935766490353744)
- **map decipher display**: All maps now show as deciphered by default. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536816711276167170)
- **map system player suitability**: The new treasure map and resource map system is a PvM/harvester hybrid activity that requires combat skills and is no longer suited to pure harvesters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532098400714096720)
- **meditation on gatherer characters**: A gatherer character does not really need Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550568264730681445)
- **melee damage while harvesting without tactics**: Without tactics and high dexterity, a harvester's melee damage is very low, limiting kills to roughly polar-bear-level creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530285519542554854)
- **meteor crash site quest line**: A quest line in the Lycaceum library requires harvesting a number of meteor crash sites, and it may reward a piece of rock decoration (uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524785930756558988)
- **meteor crash sites**: Meteor crash sites are organic world encounters in the wilderness that can be harvested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524785524655526050)
- **meteor site locations**: Meteor site locations are random and there is no built-in way to locate them, though players may be compiling external databases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547368700993081344)
- **miner and lumberjack aspect**: Harvest is the only aspect a miner or lumberjack needs to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553337039309635646)
- **miner camping skill and pack animals**: Miners can skip the Camping skill if they use pack animals, because ore is heavy and the animals carry it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **miner link choice**: Summoner is probably the most common link choice for a miner, because summons distract mobs while the miner keeps swinging the pickaxe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528480798662201455)
- **mining achievement ore requirement**: The mining achievement Leechy received requires 21,200,000 ore gathered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533907877956292701)
- **mining and lumberjacking fallback mechanic**: A fallback mechanic exists when mining or lumberjacking, and its code snippet was obtained from the developer Luthius by Elderstone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531094471016452106)
- **mining captcha**: Mining presents a captcha as an anti-bot measure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538454727019200612)
- **mining during sanctuary week**: Mining is reportedly not possible during Sanctuary week, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522779456094339094)
- **mining echo arrow setting**: The mining echo has an arrow setting that can be turned up, and players should check it is raised before mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533195310992457759)
- **mining effective skill boosts**: Mining success can be improved by using a higher quality pickaxe, enabling the harvest aspect, and adding harvest links, all of which raise effective skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555542430286086145)
- **mining escape recall setup**: Hotkey a recall rune with one finder on the mine key and one on the recall key, and recall immediately when an arrow appears on Tracking or a name runs on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541566526895820820)
- **mining in dungeons**: Mining is possible in some dungeons, but it is dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549596808127193099)
- **mining limitations**: Mining only works on rocks and walls, raw ore is very heavy, and forges must be nearby to keep going, so a miner gathers less than a lumberjack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549701611071213570)
- **mining node grid along mountainsides**: Along mountainsides the mining node grid is inconsistent; harvesting may depend on proximity to adjacent nodes and on the character touching the mountain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522714545238446232)
- **mining node grid inside caves**: Inside a cave the mining node grid is more accurate: standing within 2 tiles of a grid intersection lets you reach all 4 surrounding nodes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522714545238446232)
- **mining node spacing**: Mining spots (nodes) are roughly 6-10 tiles apart. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521226603869507744)
- **mining pack horse advice**: When mining, players are advised to bank often instead of bringing a pack horse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615105904484353)
- **mining safety**: There are no safe places to mine, so keep tracking up and have a recall ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534923691064950875)
- **mining speed and ingot demand**: Mining is slow, but ingots have a very large market. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **mining speed and pickaxe color**: Mining speed is the same regardless of pickaxe color, and getting only a couple of attempts at a node means it was recently harvested and has not fully refilled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740614153281587)
- **mining spot locations**: Good mining spots exist all over the world, and every town has mining spots outside of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528827747625865278)
- **mining success chance for iron ore**: At 100 Mining skill the chance to successfully harvest basic iron ore is 100%, and below 100 skill a colored pickaxe improves the success chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545740481596493844)
- **mining supplies**: Mining needs no pack animal, but a rune to mark spots and a nearby inn to bank often are useful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537130942886322336)
- **mining with no nearby resources**: If there are no resources nearby when mining, you receive a message and must move to another spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538455832960704564)
- **mining, lumberjacking and skinning character setup**: Mining and Lumberjacking are not put on the crafter; instead run a miner/lumberjack mage summoner, plus a separate character that goes into dungeons to skin, which may or may not kill mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553890762662355060)
- **mounts and gathering animations**: Mining and woodcutting can be done on foot, showing the harvesting animations, whereas mounts were not allowed for gathering in original UO. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533259508154106058)
- **mule for mining**: A character that mines should get a mule to make hauling easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537437799358136320)
- **multi-harvester efficiency**: Each additional simultaneously run harvester is less efficient than the previous, with estimated efficiency of about 90% for the first, 75% for the second and 60% for the third. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527359271044517909)
- **multi-map harvest volume per season**: Players using the old multi-map gathering style could harvest around 30k-40k resources a season. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544487515975590008)
- **multiboxing gatherer efficiency**: Running three gatherers at once yields only about 200-225% of a single gatherer's efficiency, not triple. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532816965779849397)
- **multiboxing harvesters time loss**: When running three harvesters visible on one screen, the main source of lost time is character movement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527359440515371028)
- **mushroom acquisition**: Mushrooms cannot be picked up from the ground and must be bought from NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525587271602929705)
- **necromancy and spirit speak for fishing crews**: For fishing spots, fishing nets and MIBs, having Necromancy and Spirit Speak lets you keep summons out to help crew members kill what comes aboard the boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521394475165941772)
- **new map system throughput**: Under the new map system, the theoretical maximum with no delays or interruptions is about 39 maps per hour, and one tester reaches only about 29 maps per hour in practice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544883295790301205)
- **new map system time cost**: The new map system takes about an hour to complete what took about 17 minutes under the old system, according to one player's experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544881131487363142)
- **new resource map process quality**: The new resource map process is described as safer, more streamlined and simplified, needing no external website and fewer supplemental skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536406270674739261)
- **new resource map safety**: The new resource map system is considerably safer and easier than the old one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534774412262375454)
- **node depletion and refresh start**: A resource node does not need to be fully depleted for its refresh timer to begin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523144156929720530)
- **non-stacking avarite maps**: A white avarite map that does not stack with other avarite maps was partially completed before the patch, and such a map cannot stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555886480381968505)
- **npc that opens paragon chests**: An NPC in town reportedly opens paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538399207617077299)
- **number of resource map spots**: There are reportedly about 8000 resource map spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347906029588661)
- **ocean fishing safety**: Safety while ocean fishing depends mostly on whether your boat is good enough (fast enough) to escape other players, rather than on your own skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539227353878892605)
- **ocean turbulences as a water source**: Turbulences on the ocean do not work as a water source for filling containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531402500077523177)
- **odd ores and veins in the world**: The odd ores and veins seen in the world, such as terracite veins, exist for Lyceum quests and cannot be mined by harvesters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525506421482065961)
- **opening sealed lesser paragon chest**: To open a sealed lesser paragon chest, have a character with detecting hidden and lockpicking remove its trap and unlock it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541124310738018524)
- **optimal harvesting node placement**: Finding the optimal harvesting node position is tricky on a winding z-axis and requires trial and error to reduce overlap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522716745922646169)
- **orc fort map nodes**: The orc guild fort controls 6 fishing map nodes, 3 ore map nodes, 2 lumber map nodes and a couple of treasure map nodes, and the overhaul moves all of these out of the territory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **ore found at 50 mining skill**: At 50 Mining skill a player will only ever find iron ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538706098574590013)
- **ore map storage and theft risk**: Keep ore maps stored in your inn room and take only one map at a time out with you, because maps can be stolen from you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533773556523991091)
- **ore map yield outlier**: Ore is the only resource that is significantly faster to gather with a resource map, and its map yield is out of line with other resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525667965792551023)
- **ore maps versus normal mining**: Ore is acquired much faster in an ore map than by normal mining, so ore maps are the only harvest maps that feel worth using. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522360474480410735)
- **ore per mining node**: Each ore node in Ultima Online: Outlands holds about 7-11 ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526793879351857333)
- **ore to ingot ratio**: One ore yields 2 ingots when smelted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545422663193858208)
- **origin of harvest 2x bonus bug**: The harvest aspect 2x bonus bug is believed to have been introduced when the 60-second harvest cooldown was added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540482007266500680)
- **ossuary level 4 scarab amulet drops**: Ossuary Dungeon level 4 is available, Scarab Amulets drop there exclusively as an ultra-rare loot drop, and Hieroglyphs return as rare drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528134639707881605)
- **outlands butler harvesting calculator**: To check harvest success chances, enter your mining skill, harvest aspect level and number of links into the Outlands Butler harvesting calculator. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538247238743105537)
- **overland recall-farming requirements**: The overland recall-farming strategy requires the Tracking skill and enough mana to cast Recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535388245741936720)
- **overweight while mining**: Going overweight with ore while mining leaves you unable to move effectively and vulnerable to PKs, so monitor your weight while harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527010412233625600)
- **pack animals for resource maps**: Pack animals are largely unnecessary with the new resource maps; players should only get overweight on a dull copper ore map at high harvest aspect and can otherwise carry the haul home after each map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535330320235106468)
- **pack animals when fleeing**: Pack animals cannot run with the player when fleeing, so they are a liability when escaping PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533113683150901339)
- **paragon chest traps**: Paragon chests are trapped like dungeon chests, so detect hidden is also needed to open them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530830673080750271)
- **parallel miners**: Experienced players can run up to 3 miner characters in parallel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603390110048358)
- **partially used map conversion**: The patch notes mention a conversion for partially used maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537655036824522902)
- **peacing bard harvester build**: A peacing bard harvester build uses Barding to peace monsters rather than distracting them with summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531173163722080296)
- **pickaxe quality effect on ore**: Better pickaxes only yield higher quality ore types and do not increase the amount of ore gathered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549607847401361501)
- **pickaxe quality ratio bonuses**: An exceptional pickaxe adds 0.04 to the pickaxe's ratio, and a mastercrafted pickaxe adds another 0.04. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825481813295115)
- **pks watching harvesting channel**: Player killers watch the #harvesting Discord channel and loot harvesters who go to spots suggested there, so popular suggested spots should be avoided or treated as risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543051359354363966)
- **plain iron ore share in mining**: Even with high skill, harvest aspect and good pickaxes, mining yields far more plain iron ore than colored ores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540397121109237831)
- **plain leather farming**: Plain (uncolored) leather is the easiest hide to farm, and many players leave it behind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551766763035955223)
- **plant chemicals acquisition**: Plant chemicals are monster drops, slightly less common than arcane scrolls, and can also be bought from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537897555009081344)
- **planter spade material effect**: The material a planter spade is made of probably affects only its number of charges, similar to wands, but this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550400329206468619)
- **pre-patch avarite map titles**: Avarite maps partially completed before the patch do not show the remaining amount in their item title, unlike maps created after the patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555888078466449461)
- **prevalia carpenter kindling**: The Carpenter NPC in Prevalia does not sell kindling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537765183261376533)
- **previously decoded resource maps after patch**: After the patch, previously decoded resource maps in backpacks may appear to be gone or undecoded; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536770554990690485)
- **pristine lumber source**: Pristine Lumber is obtained from trade caravans and not from harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524340228515696671)
- **purchased runespots**: Rune locations obtained from other players' runebooks or purchased as runespots can be traps, because other players may know them and track you there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533247624835109029)
- **random mobs while harvesting**: Harvesters encounter random mobs that are usually not very strong but can still kill a player who does not deal with them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531173163722080296)
- **rare cloth sources**: Rare cloths can drop from all forms of loot, though some are specific to certain dungeons or regions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524310531882750057)
- **rare hide availability**: Rare hides are not expected in quantity unless doing treasure maps for them, though killing many mobs adds up over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536641674967515136)
- **rare hide skinning chance**: The rare hide chance while skinning is deliberately low because skinning is the only gathering skill commonly run on PvM characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536647436624203786)
- **rare ore availability while mining**: Rare ore types can be found while mining anywhere, including right outside town, provided the player's mining skill is high enough for that ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538706019029360663)
- **reagent gathering from monsters**: Reagents can be obtained by killing magical creatures in large quantities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364453296799865)
- **reapplying harvest after login**: After a fresh login, reapply the harvest aspect before starting resource maps, because a bug can otherwise prevent the 2x bonus from applying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540481635445641277)
- **reason ore maps outperform other resource maps**: Resource maps were given identical yields across resources, but because 1 ore smelts into 2 ingots, ore maps end up stronger than the others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525668632666050611)
- **red encounters while tracking on resource maps**: Players running tracking during resource maps or wilderness farming rarely detect red players; one player tracked only one red in nearly 200 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539315936392118323)
- **red players on tracking while mining**: When a red-named player appears while mining, the sparkle shows, but on Tracking they appear as a green arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541564865187942420)
- **redlightning bottle drop rate**: Redlightning bottles do not drop very often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550540759760113727)
- **reducing ore weight**: The only way to reduce the weight of ore is to smelt it into ingots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539149616337920030)
- **rescuing castaways while fishing**: Rescuing castaways is worthwhile because you can fish your way to the town they want to go to, with no downside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540252742990438410)
- **resource map activity level**: Under the new resource map system, players must actively press buttons and move from map to map, so it is less AFK than the old system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544470767306276984)
- **resource map area leaving requirement**: After the resource map overhaul, players must leave the area after every map before starting the next one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map carry limit**: A player can carry as many resource maps as they want and can run them one after the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534349124508450919)
- **resource map change goal**: The stated goal of the resource map system change was to lower the barrier to entry and increase participation across the server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544060865907658823)
- **resource map character binding**: Under the new harvesting map system, a resource map is bound to a single character, so stealing another player's map gives no benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534348373086441644)
- **resource map completion speed**: After the resource map overhaul there is no knowledge barrier, so all players are expected to complete resource maps at about the same pace of roughly 90.5 seconds per map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536452621609468076)
- **resource map composition**: Each resource map contains 8 categories of tier 1 resources and one category of tier 3 resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531358660440232136)
- **resource map dance timers**: The resource map update added two separate 15 second timers during which the character stands still dancing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788223870439557)
- **resource map decoding skill requirement**: Decoding a resource map requires the minimum skill needed to harvest that map's material, for example 70 Mining for a Shadow Iron map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549166499074150472)
