- **resource map design intent**: Resource maps were redesigned to favor casual mapping over professional high-volume mapping, which one player says is what the developers intended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554557890512294009)
- **resource map destination visibility**: With the revamped resource maps, a player cannot see where a map leads before hiking, so the destination may be dangerous and a harvesting/PvM hybrid build is now preferred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536827343975350413)
- **resource map dye drops**: Resource maps drop colored dyes while you mine them; for example, an agapite resource map yields an agapite dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543852308121788466)
- **resource map efficiency for high-volume players**: The resource map changes made resource mapping less efficient for high-volume players, especially for cheaper materials such as dullwood, so many of them are expected to stop doing it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544063329415467129)
- **resource map forced delays**: After the patch, each resource map has forced delays between steps (decode and reveal timers, reportedly totaling about 90.5 seconds) during which the character dances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536929127788183623)
- **resource map gump**: Double clicking a resource map opens a gump that streamlines the whole resource map process. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **resource map harvest cooldown**: Resource maps have no harvest cooldown, so they can be used immediately even after teleporting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540483998516772976)
- **resource map harvesting requirements**: On a resource map you never fail a swing, so pickaxe or hatchet material and quality do not matter, and you only need the minimum skill required for that map's color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536849033379979366)
- **resource map hiking input restriction**: Hiking to a resource map location cannot be started with Razor macros or a keypress; the player must manually click each hiking step, as stated in the patch notes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536823438252183583)
- **resource map hiking requirement**: Resource maps require either 60 Camping or 60 Cartography to hike to the map location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536778648726798477)
- **resource map hunt timers**: The resource map overhaul adds a 15 second timer before the map-hunt minigame starts, a follow-the-arrow step to the right spot, and another 15 second stand-still timer when guessing the camp location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map island locations**: Some resource map locations are on tiny islands, and a player can die there while doing a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544839510121128057)
- **resource map location matching**: The new resource map system no longer requires matching a map image to a location, so an external map website is not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761121426505759)
- **resource map locations**: Resource map locations are more random so players cannot cycle rune libraries to find them, but a harvester can locate the spot by hiking to the map location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535329824598392843)
- **resource map loss rate without tracking**: One player reports completing 452 resource maps since the patch with no Tracking and losing only one map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542271266956910652)
- **resource map loss under new system**: Under the new resource map system a player can no longer lose their resource map, whereas under the old system the map could be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534348147009261710)
- **resource map overhaul**: The resource map overhaul is expected to make resource maps take longer to complete, add extra skill requirements, and have them completed one at a time, though this is not officially confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529563895654780968)
- **resource map overhaul**: An upcoming overhaul is expected to turn sorted resource maps back into unsorted, undecoded ones and make accumulated resource tomes useless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **resource map rewards**: Resource maps currently give zero experience and roughly one fifth of the loot that treasure maps give. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528545578156429342)
- **resource map rng destination**: The new resource map system includes an RNG element in where resource maps lead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544493514212122635)
- **resource map safety**: Resource maps remain relatively safe and take the same time after the patch: open a gate, harvest next to it, and if a red shows on tracking or something appears, go through the gate and return later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537843990458794094)
- **resource map seasonal leaderboard**: Resource map gatherers compete on the same seasonal leaderboard categories, such as lumberjacking, as natural gatherers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531360004630908928)
- **resource map stacking restriction**: Under the new resource map system, maps go through a loading system with a delay between them, so players can no longer stack maps and multi-map at one spot as they could under the old system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544495314940199004)
- **resource map throughput after patch**: The upcoming resource map changes add a timer and a follow-the-arrow step after each map, reducing throughput from roughly 61 maps per hour to about 18-20 per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532071609295437924)
- **resource map time after aspect swap**: The new resource map process adds extra time after the aspect swap, which reduces how many maps can be run per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528171616498876467)
- **resource map yield**: A resource map likely yields a set amount of resources regardless of tool type, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539673014013010001)
- **resource map yields**: Resource map yields are all standard amounts now, and the resources come with no junk, only resources and big fish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536805705938640977)
- **resource mapper requirements**: A resource mapper needs only basic gatherer skills plus explorer packs, and Cartography is not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538166431605203045)
- **resource maps**: Resource maps must be deciphered, then you go to the indicated spot and search for the location; they help raise a harvesting skill from 100 to 120 faster and are not meant for a complete beginner character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521976640035360959)
- **resource maps gameplay**: Resource maps have been overhauled, but the gameplay is the same: go to the map location in the wild, farm the resources, and recall out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544629968703852604)
- **resource maps usefulness**: Maps only make sense if you are rushing to 120 skill; income and normal wood come from normal trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526997172309065899)
- **resource maps versus treasure maps**: Resource maps and treasure maps are two different kinds of maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968915810385941)
- **resource node refresh timer**: After a resource node receives its first hit, it rolls a random 30-60 minute timer until it refreshes, with the roll random per node. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523144156929720530)
- **risk at popular mining spots**: Popular, high-yield mining spots attract PKs and thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528828206814199969)
- **running maps without ore**: When not running ore maps, a player can go from spot to spot and complete a couple of maps before backing out and unloading. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538689255302365254)
- **running two ore maps at once**: Carry two ore maps at a time; while running the first map, identify the Witcher number for the next map to save time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522436539538477153)
- **sackbut as audible notification**: To get an audible notification without a script sound command, keep a sackbut in your backpack and play it, for example when no harvestable materials are found, as a signal to move to another spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544686741590515773)
- **safe mining locations**: Caves attract PKs, so it is safer to mine at the sides of mountains, and lumberjacking has more areas available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603917200105574)
- **saving lumberjacking spots**: To save good lumberjacking spots, mark blank runes at each location and add them to your runetome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532230172596506734)
- **scavenger alt for colored leather**: To obtain colored leather by scavenging, use a scavenger alt that has Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551001475109490811)
- **scavenger profession nerf**: The scavenger harvesting profession is reportedly going to be nerfed in the next patch, but this is unconfirmed by official notes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531519273628074178)
- **scavenging loot priority**: When scavenging, it is better to loot gold than reagents because reagents weigh more than their gold value justifies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531670692502704289)
- **scavenging on a pvm main**: You can scavenge while on your PvM main character and still fill regular leather commissions, and you are better able to survive mobs that spawn on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530543134734417970)
- **sea serpent fishing leather**: Fishing sea serpents yields leather, and a double proc on one can give around 250 leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527455151948828743)
- **seed drops on treasure map harvests**: When harvesting on a treasure map, seeds can drop in addition to the normal resources, but not instead of resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547930742263390249)
- **self-targeting harvesting tools**: Targeting yourself with a harvesting tool such as a skinning knife or hatchet harvests whatever is around you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533709831238717610)
- **separate harvester and crafter characters**: It is typical to keep the harvester and crafter as separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538721084533116978)
- **shadow pick harvest bonus**: A master crafted exceptional shadow pick gives a total harvest bonus of 0.12: 0.04 for exceptional, 0.04 for master crafted, and 0.04 for the shadow material. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538655420216770561)
- **shelter island harvest aspect**: Gathering on Shelter Island may require leveling a harvest aspect there, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537467166637695058)
- **shelter island harvesting yield**: Harvesting on Shelter Island may yield reduced resources, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526967565446938704)
- **shelter island vegetables**: Vegetables such as turnips and carrots in the gardens on Shelter island simply spawn; they cannot be planted or dug up, and apples cannot be harvested from trees. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525810392243114106)
- **shield use while mining**: Wearing a shield while mining gives a small amount of extra armor and damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544441916161007738)
- **shore fishing harvest experience**: Shore fishing probably does not grant harvest experience; harvest experience from fishing likely requires fishing from a boat, which triggers a captcha. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538830802773610516)
- **shovel uses**: Shovels can be used to dig up plant soil for gardening and otherwise have little use now that T-Maps no longer require them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538980496581853309)
- **simultaneous mining and fishing maps**: The resource map update removed the ability to mine on one character while doing a fishing map on another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788725450739784)
- **single-client harvesting macros**: Single-client harvesting on Outlands commonly relies on last object macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525647727474639090)
- **skill needed for best colored resources**: 110 Mining is needed to harvest the best colored ores, and likewise 110 Lumberjacking is needed for the best colored woods used in Carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538721820352712704)
- **skinning in dungeons**: Skinning is allowed in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531730333353902150)
- **skinning knife corpse reopening**: A skinning knife can be used to re-open corpses for carving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524065982174331031)
- **skinning knife requirements**: A skinning knife does not need to be held or equipped to skin; it only needs to be in the backpack, and no aspect is needed on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530684182928425031)
- **skinning leather from robots and skeletons**: Leather can be skinned from metal robots and fleshless skeletons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553606191463141417)
- **skinning macro**: An in-game macro of 'use skill', then 'wait for target', then 'target self' can be used to skin with a skinning knife. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555528372807798855)
- **skinning requirements**: Forensic Evaluation is not required to skin corpses for leather; a skinning knife is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523468012307484752)
- **skinning template fit**: Skinning does not fit well on a classic gatherer template; it is usually done on a scavenger template that specializes in survivability and fast dungeon travel, or while fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525859297962230052)
- **skinning without forensic evaluation**: Skinning is possible without Forensic Evaluation, but you get less from the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530418925014225047)
- **smelting ore at house forges**: Ore can be smelted at any forge located in a player house, and no pet smelts ore automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553336164612706306)
- **smelting ore using forges in houses**: While mining, cast Circle of Transparency to find forges inside houses, smelt ore through the wall at those forges regularly, and go home when your pack is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549606584575983738)
- **source of valuable magic items**: Really valuable magic items with multiple high tier bonuses typically come from paragon chests rather than from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **special loot links while spot fishing**: Special/rare loot links only affect the loot dropped by mobs during spot fishing and do not affect sea serpent spawn chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **special nets and messages in a bottle**: Certain monsters can spawn that drop special nets, and using special nets can get you messages in a bottle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551669036520054886)
- **spot fishing duration**: While spot fishing you are stuck at the spot throwing nets for 35 seconds regardless of how quickly you kill the spawned mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **standardized resource map amounts**: Newly generated resource maps have a standardized resource amount, which does not apply to older maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536815423763517511)
- **starfall meteor spawns**: Starfall meteor spawns (purple) have only existed since the New Lyceum quests and are tied to them, while earlier meteors were Caddellite meteor spawns (blue). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529888054301429940)
- **stealth picker tradeoffs**: Stealth pickers sneak through dungeons; they are generally slower than summoner pickers but may evade being tracked by PKs because they are stealthed most of the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554836556001575044)
- **stealth pk ambushes at mining spots**: Stealth PKs can hide near mining locations and ambush miners, and Detect Hidden on a harvester template helps counter this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521199226749718661)
- **stored fished nets for mibs**: Fished nets can be stored instead of sold and later used to do MIBs (messages in a bottle). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534882548260405308)
- **summon strength at mining spots**: Some common mining locations have tough mobs that quickly kill summons weaker than earth elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554628837512323116)
- **summoner harvesters**: Harvesting with summoned creatures (summoner harvesters) is described by one player as the standard approach in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554604712550993983)
- **summoner hybrid harvest maps**: A Magery summoner hybrid can complete harvest maps by summoning an earth elemental to collect the goods and then recalling home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536917145617703003)
- **summoner miner/lumberjack setup**: Most players run a mage summoner miner/lumberjack with Tracking, walking with an earth elemental and a fire elemental for protection and using a script to recall away when a red appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553334609637277838)
- **summoner picker**: A summoner picker teleports through the dungeon with earth elementals that tank monsters away from the chest while the player picks it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554836556001575044)
- **summons distracting mobs while harvesting**: Summoned creatures distract mobs so a harvester can keep chopping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **summons tanking while mining**: Summoned creatures can tank mobs while you mine a spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665220572479518)
- **surviving a pk ambush while harvesting**: To survive a PK ambush while harvesting, stay on a mount, hotkey Rope to a meaningful tile, know your escape route, and keep hotkeys for heal potion, cure potion, refresh potion, bandage, and trapped pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533113683150901339)
- **swapping link chains for treasure maps**: Swapping link chains to do treasure maps and waiting on the swap timer is inefficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538537549364989972)
- **tamer farming speed**: A tamer takes a couple of hours more to set up at first but then farms significantly faster than any other build up to the 30 link endgame. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526106890210250872)
- **tamer harvester build**: A tamer harvester build works similarly to using elementals but is less annoying, and keeping a stablemaster handy helps when the pet gets lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535319069853749278)
- **tamer-style scavenging**: To scavenge as a tamer-style scavenger, kill monsters, loot grey corpses along the way, and skin everything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849347332669463)
- **telescope in ship specialty slot for fishing**: Once the harvest aspect is high enough, Telescope can be used in the ship's specialty slot, allowing Fisherman outfitting, telescope, wildgame and verehide / val nets to reach fishing cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549751175488868403)
- **teracite vein**: A teracite vein is a quest location tied to a Lyceum quest and is unrelated to regular mining, so it cannot be mined normally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541545998000721920)
- **terracite veins**: Terracite veins are not minable by players, who can only mine iron and colored ores; the veins are tied to a quest and the wiki has no information on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546276519825907925)
- **test server resource map amounts**: The new hardcoded resource map amounts on the test server are simply the old average amounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534305345432981665)
- **test server resource map node changes**: On the test server, new resource map nodes are significantly easier, problematic nodes were tweaked, many new nodes were added, and players should not randomly land on tar monsters or volcano serpents, while new timers slow progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534384275267387502)
- **testing new resource maps on test server**: On the test server, use one of the statues in Prev to change your skills and obtain a tome of maps so you can quickly try the new resource map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536407030678556742)
- **three character account setups**: Many players run three characters, one per account, including a miner and a lumberjack, and the PvM account's character can later become a dungeon picker with skinning or a tamer/necro summoner with picking if harvest aspect is unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531965717568815165)
- **three-harvester income**: Running three harvesters at once yields roughly 2.25-2.5x the income of a single harvester, not 3x. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527358301099266288)
- **tier 10 harvest arcane essence cost**: Tier 10 harvesting uses very little arcane essence: mining until 5 essence was used yielded 632 metal ore (1264 ingots). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542191260805243041)
- **tool bonus harvest chance**: A tool's bonus reportedly increases harvest chance beyond the base chance only once the player's skill is 110, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547719410553200660)
- **tool choice for avarite and avarwood**: With a 100% harvest chance for avarite or avarwood, higher mining or lumberjacking skill lets you use cheaper tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526723691562668092)
- **tool color bonus on resource maps**: The overhaul removes the tool color bonus that extended how close a player needed to be to successfully drain a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **tools for normal lumber**: For normal (non-colored) lumber, gold tools are a good choice for lumberjacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546124544975179896)
- **tracking for gatherers**: Tracking is highly recommended for gatherers because it shows approaching reds so you can escape in time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537598112518905917)
- **tracking for overland farming**: Tracking is not needed for overland farming; a rope and a horse are sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537789656752455732)
- **travel penalty after hiking to resource maps**: The travel penalty for resource gathering does not apply after hiking to a resource map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536831476648124516)
- **traveling to resource map location**: After a resource map is decoded, travel to the map's location, which drops you near the resource node, then follow the arrow to the exact spot and walk there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554319997847740510)
- **treasure chest harvest aspect requirement**: Players reportedly need to be in the Harvest aspect when opening a treasure chest, though this is recalled from memory and unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546214102509166653)
- **treasure chest harvesting links**: For treasure map chests, one suggested approach is to switch to 25x Special Loot chance links plus 5 Chest progress chain links and then harvest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537023281201418301)
- **treasure map armor and aspect**: Treasure map hunters typically wear Harvest or Fortune armor with Cartography skill and no longer switch aspects; trapper, wrestler, tamer and similar builds work for level 1-4 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540452444327383163)
- **treasure map aspect switching**: When doing treasure maps as a mage, run the Command aspect and switch to the Harvest aspect while opening the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534124798995861575)
- **treasure map drop rates by tier**: While farming, T2 treasure maps drop much more often than T3 and T4 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531108563508793394)
- **treasure map location difficulty**: Treasure map locations are likely random, so the chest mobs may be easier than the random wilderness monsters met while traveling to the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544412787852185640)
- **treasure map sources**: Killing mobs is a better way to obtain treasure maps than pilfering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550792989117251627)
- **tree harvest node counting**: Trees are not covered by the 8x8 harvest rule; separate trees count as separate harvest nodes unless their bases touch, in which case they count as one tree, and Z-axis mountains can interfere with counting, so more than 4 gathers from a cluster means it counts as more than one tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530763906346123304)
- **tree-like shrubs**: Some shrubs look like trees but cannot be harvested for wood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525056972087365783)
- **undecoded ore map yield**: Since the resource map change, every undecoded ore map gives 105 ore before harvest doubling procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540485525033713754)
- **uses of map decode and reveal timers**: The decode timer on a map can be used to check summons health and duration, mage buffs and resupply, and the reveal timer can be used to identify rope tiles, check the world map for an escape route, and position summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930986766377020)
- **walking mining macros**: Mining macros in which the character walks are not possible and not allowed in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524576473556455614)
- **well-known harvesting areas**: Well-known harvesting areas are generally not safe because red players know them and target harvesters there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535610456947949579)
- **when to switch to player-made tools**: A good time to switch to player-made tools is when you can escape most PK encounters and the tool cost doesn't drain your resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526998161573417061)
- **wild resource spot count**: There are about 350 wild resource spot locations, and Luthius has mentioned he may add a few more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533496510728372438)
- **wilderness farming with tracking**: Farming in the wilderness while using Tracking to watch for PKs is considered safer than farming in dungeons, and there are plenty of worthwhile mobs on the surface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474767340306475)
- **witcher 60 rune farming spot**: The Witcher 60 rune farming spot contains fel daemons and arboreal wisps, making it harder than the guide indicates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521286456319016980)
- **wool acquisition**: Wool cannot be bought from an NPC; it must be obtained by shearing sheep. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526637755033976892)
- **worthless seeds from mining**: Mining can sometimes yield worthless seeds in addition to ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541563915887054900)

## Crafting

- **jousting equipment crafting**: Jousting Lances and Jousting Shields are crafted by skilled Carpenters and Blacksmiths. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **circle 7 and 8 scroll crafting requirements**: Circle 7 and 8 spell scrolls are crafted by players with Inscription and need Arcane Scrolls: one for circle 7 (about 1500 gold) and two for circle 8 (about 3000 gold); an Arcane Scroll costs about 1000 gold, and crafting circle 8 reportedly needs 80 Magery plus high Inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554515244305485906)
- **container identification wand**: Player Tinkerers craft Item Identification Wands, which identify one item at a time, and Container Identification Wands, which identify every item in a targeted container at once; both can be found on some player vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548523913137627228)
- **crafting blank maps**: Blank maps can be crafted with Tailoring from leather at about 3.33 leather per map; buying leather from players makes each map cost roughly 6-7 gold, versus 5 gold from an NPC. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541860732390342776)
- **identifying magic items before recycling**: Magic items must be identified before they can be recycled, so identify them first and then recycle or hoard them. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005944578965555)
- **inscription spell scroll crafting**: Players with Inscription can craft spell scrolls (a trained Scribe can make them without already knowing the spells) and codices; roughly 100 Inscription may suffice for spell crafting, but training it costs far more than buying a full spellbook from a player. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528429540823662763)
- **item identification methods**: Magic items can be identified with the Item Identification skill (at 120 skill whole containers can be identified at once), or with Item Identification Wands (single item) and Container Identification Wands (entire container), both crafted by player Tinkerers and not requiring the skill. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054416489480203)
- **magic item recycler**: Early game, magic items are recycled with tools bought from NPCs; mid-to-late game, players buy a Magic Item Recycler from the Prevalia merchant with gold or Prevalia coins. It is also available as an inn room recycler, and guilds often have one. Items should be identified first, and a tailoring tool is used with no forge required. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054434378059807)
- **magic item recycler identification**: The Magic Item Recycler only recycles identified magic items and does not require the Item Identification skill; feeding item ID wands or container ID wands to the recycler identifies the items placed in it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549795603008061541)
- **outlands butler societies optimiser**: The Outlands Butler Societies Optimiser (outlandsbutler.com/societiesoptimiser) takes your crafting skills and Artisan level, then lists the society jobs you can do ordered by expected profit, with success rate and approximate material costs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547991020413648926)
- **rare color dyeing with clothing alteration kit**: To recolor clothing to a rare color, use a Clothing Alteration Kit together with a sufficient quantity of rare colored cloth (or rare dyes); blessed robes and fancy clothing specifically need the kit, and each piece consumes a set amount of cloth. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588542499954789)
- **scroll non-consume chance**: Scroll non-consume chance comes from Inscription skill (with scribe links adding directly) and a separate wizard's satchel roll; 100% non-consume is only reachable for circle 7 and 8 scrolls (around 125+ effective Inscription), while circles 1-6 will still sometimes consume scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552977106583953549)
- **society jobs crafting skills**: Weekly Society Jobs for crafting give points redeemable for valuable rewards such as gold links; Tailoring, Alchemy and Inscription are cheap to train and generally useful for them, though one player advises skipping Inscription as too expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586196835274943)
- **society points rewards**: Society points, which crafting is one of the easiest ways to earn, can be exchanged for gold links, mount tokens, items, cloth, chain link reforges and mastery chain links, and this is where much of the money in crafting comes from. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051103222140990)
- **arcane scroll uses**: Arcane scrolls are used to craft codices, tier 7/8 spell scrolls (usually for society jobs), and item ID wands, so a crafter character will eventually need them. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554578454941270018)
- **artisan aspect**: The Artisan aspect boosts exceptional crafting chance and makes exceptional items cheaper to craft, so crafters use Artisan while gatherers use the Harvest aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314670790180907)
- **cheapest crafting skills to level**: Tailoring, alchemy and inscription are by far the cheapest and easiest crafting skills to raise, so most crafters start with them (including on secondary accounts); other crafting skills cost far more and take a year or more to break even. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550050210623787080)
- **codex crafting cost**: Player scribes craft codexes from 1 MCD and 25 arcane scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553802191863681125)
- **crafting queue for skill leveling**: Open the crafting queue with [cq or from the crafting menu, set the materials source (secure chest, bag, or Resource Stockpile), keep crafting tools on you, and queue items to craft until a target skill level is reached (optionally with recycling to recover materials), then queue the next item for the next skill level rather than by quantity; no macros or scripts are needed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546351495660703834)
- **equipment repair**: Armor and weapons, including those at 0 durability, can be repaired, for example at a repair bench such as the one at the outpost moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534133440780439662)
- **leather cap restyle kit**: A Leather Cap Restyle Kit turns a leather cap into other NPC hats, changing only its appearance and keeping its stats, so players typically use an invulnerability leather cap; the clothing alteration kit is a separate item for coloring. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680606733115493)
- **magery requirement for scrolls and spellbooks**: Crafting spell scrolls and full spellbooks requires Magery as well as Inscription; full spellbooks need 100 Inscription, and 80 Magery is enough for Inscription society jobs, including level 7/8 scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555202002248671283)
- **outlands butler lockpicking page**: The Outlands Butler website has a lockpicking page at outlandsbutler.com/lockpicking that works as a calculator showing the skill and tools needed to open chests. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546288113309978694)
- **public magic item recyclers**: Public magic item recyclers are available to all players, including one in the Riverside vendor mall reachable by gate from Prevalia, and many player-owned shops and guilds also have recyclers anyone can use. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550673008312459275)
- **quiver availability**: Quivers are player crafted and cannot be bought from NPCs, so you must get one from another player or a player vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542549497383489546)
- **recycling magic items**: Setting the tinker tool to recycle all magic items recycles everything magical, so you cannot keep the good items, and recycling works with any tool rather than only tinker's tools, though a poorly written script may require tinker's tools. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553823609913479219)
- **recycling spell scrolls**: Recycle spell scrolls into blank scrolls: cut up two identical looted scrolls with scissors for one blank scroll (sells to an inscription NPC for 1 gold), or set the crafting queue to recycle scrolls crafted while training inscription; blank scrolls can be used to train Inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554576330186559685)
- **recycling wizard hats**: Wizard's hats made while training Inscription are not recycled by the crafting queue, but can be recycled by cutting them with scissors; a script also exists to help automate it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546612722156970035)
- **resource stockpile crafting**: To craft from a resource stockpile, use the crafting queue and target the stockpile as the resource source (or put the resources in your bag instead); this makes crafting large quantities much easier. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **smoke bombs**: Smoke bombs are crafted by players and must be bought from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549130240054399069)
- **society crafting points**: Doing weekly society crafting jobs earns society points that can be spent on mastery chain links, gold links, reforgers and other rewards, and the weekly point cap is shared across all crafting skills combined. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554834708691419248)
- **spell scroll sources**: Level 1-6 spell scrolls drop from mobs, appear in chests and are sold by the mage shop, while level 7-8 scrolls are player-crafted with Inscription (from arcane scrolls) and bought from player vendors for a few thousand gold each; scrolls are dropped into the spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552972016800505938)
- **trapped pouch sources**: Trapped pouches can be bought from Provisioner NPCs (and reportedly the mage NPC), which is faster than casting Magic Trap on a pouch. They are probably identical to spell-trapped pouches. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542879740363538492)
- **veterinary supplies source**: Veterinary supplies are not sold by NPCs; tailors craft them and players can buy them from other players, player vendors, or the vendor portal. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274768320307211)
- **accessory dye uses**: Accessory dye is used to paint shields, quivers, potion satchels and reagent satchels. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553214690895855617)
- **alchemy bonus recipient**: The Alchemy skill bonus applies to the player drinking the potion, not the crafter, so a Greater Heal from an 80 Alchemy crafter is as good as one from a 120 Alchemy crafter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553041783213002855)
- **alchemy potion buff duration**: With Mixed Mixtures Rank 3, buff potions last about 30 minutes, and Alchemy gives longer timers on strength and magic resist potions. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553480109900431432)
- **aspect mount breeding**: Breeding aspect mounts requires giving a tamer the required cores and distills, and obtaining a specific rare hue depends on luck across many breeding attempts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534602963153060071)
- **bard codex acquisition**: A Bard (Barding) Codex is player-crafted and is easiest to obtain by buying it from a player vendor, which you can find through the Outlands Portal vendor search if you cannot craft it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538084836793647125)
- **bard instrument quality**: For bards, a Supremely Melodious instrument (+25 bard skill) is better than an Avarwood instrument (+11, +5 more if exceptional), and an Exceedingly instrument is also considered better than a master-crafted Avarwood one. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551980281463054427)
- **chromatic core conversion**: An alchemist can transform a Chromatic Core into any specific Aspect Core, including a command core. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555947223731408917)
- **clothing blessing**: Clothing can be blessed using a clothing bless deed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548164313418571899)
- **codex crafting cost**: Crafting a codex requires 1 Mastercrafting Diagram and 25 Arcane Scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **crafted spellbook mana regeneration**: A crafted spellbook gives a passive mana regeneration modifier, which is currently usually more useful than the extra mana replenishment proc chances from a Potent spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553908064586047529)
- **crafting queue**: Outlands has a crafting queue system, designed so crafting skills can be trained semi-automatically while away, and it includes leveling logic to craft an item until a chosen skill level is reached. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536941007021809714)
- **crafting skill target for society crafters**: A crafting skill of 100 is enough to get a decent number of society jobs each week, while 120 is mainly useful for making items for players and is eventually wanted but takes a very long time (especially blacksmithing) and is not urgent since skills level naturally through society jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **dyeing clothing**: To dye normal clothing, buy dyes and a dye tub (two tubs is cheaper, keeping one clean to remove colors) from a tailor NPC, use a dye on the tub to set its color, then use the tub on the clothing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535032906601463990)
- **dyeing clothing to rare hues**: To give clothing such as a robe a rare hue, use a player-crafted Clothing Alteration Kit on the item with rare colored cloth, not dye; a gump shows the cloth required and a button lets you select your cloth stack. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525150442898849793)
- **inferring item stats**: Item stats can be inferred from the item's material or magical prefix (modifiers), as listed on the wiki Modifiers page. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547902746600939551)
- **item identification alt**: You can use an alt character with Item Identification skill to identify items for free, and higher skill (up to 100) works better, though about 50 skill is enough to identify items before recycling them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550666111245230101)
- **item identification wands**: Item identification wands identify unidentified items and have multiple charges rather than being single-use, but they are not free to obtain. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529239349571358822)
- **magic item recycler**: To recycle magic items, put them in the recycler chest (or have a loot chest in your inventory), use the menu to set what to recycle (e.g. recycle all magical), identify items first, then begin recycling and target yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655577544200195)
- **magic item recycler**: The Magic Item Recycler has settings to keep specific modifier types and recycles everything in the box that matches your criteria, so you only need to set it up once and can keep good gear to use or sell. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **magic item recycler usage**: In the magic item recycler, go through all sections using the buttons at the bottom and check the boxes next to modifiers you want to recycle, which show in green; red (unchecked) modifiers are the ones you keep. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533627676797960253)
- **meditation for scroll inscription**: On Outlands, making spell scrolls with Inscription does not require meditating, and casting from scrolls rather than a spellbook does not cut out experience for inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549208436892373203)
- **opening the crafting queue**: Type the text command [cq (or the long form [craftingqueue) in game to open the crafting queue. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537904727189102653)
- **pickaxe crafting**: Pickaxes are crafted by tinkerers with a tinker tool at about 50 tinkering skill, not under miner crafting items. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525152439664381963)
- **rope availability**: No NPC sells rope; it is crafted by players and must be bought from them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543906651516567583)
- **societies crafter skill template**: A Societies crafter starts with 3x100 Tailoring, then 3x100 Alchemy (the Outlands Butler Societies Optimiser tool helps); a reasonable template is 100-120 Tailoring, Alchemy and Inscription on the second and third accounts, with the main adding another skill or Blacksmithing, Tinkering, Carpentry. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524501923066019893)
- **society job crafted items**: Items crafted for a society job are consumed for that job and cannot be kept or passed on. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535749068876423298)
- **treasure map explorer pack cost**: Each treasure map chest requires at least 2 explorer packs, which are crafted with Cartography: 1 to decode the map and 1 for each attempt at digging up the chest, consumed as you work through the map steps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212626630053958)
- **wand crafting**: Players can craft wands with the Tinkering skill, and crafting mastercrafted item ID wands requires 120 Tinkering skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550564659302629389)
- **wizard satchel**: A Wizard's Satchel holds reagents, reduces their weight, and may give a chance to save reagents on cast; thieves can steal the reagents in it but not the satchel, and on death they drop to your corpse inside it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551114477796204565)
- **wizard's satchel quality**: A higher-quality Wizard's Satchel, or one made from a higher material, reduces reagent weight more and makes reagents less likely to be consumed; the same applies to potion satchels and quivers. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551673523972608082)
- **alchemy throwable items**: Alchemy can make explosive potions and smoke bombs, but there are no grenades in the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550417285007802478)
- **alteration kit cloth requirement**: The cloth needed to recolor an item varies per item, and targeting the item with a Clothing Alteration Kit tells you how much rare cloth is required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535036654732050482)
- **arcane essence from recycling**: Identify magic items looted from monsters that you won't use and recycle them in game to collect arcane essence, the fuel used to run aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054397417853010)
- **arcane essence from salvaging**: Weapons and armor found in the world can be salvaged to obtain Arcane Essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548825145861341236)
- **arcane essence source**: Arcane Essence is made by identifying and recycling magic items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533230852220387500)
- **arcane staves**: Magic and crafted arcane staves work only with the Arcane skill, so they are exclusive to mages with that skill, and a summoner mage does not use it; they allow casting while equipped, benefit from the codex and have a mana refund chance modifier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680198635589663)
- **artisan aspect experience gain toggle**: An option under Commands -> Mechanics -> [Artisan disables aspect experience gain while Artisan is active, which is useful for crafting AFK and for avoiding burning essence when not needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555877965236281401)
- **aspect cloth effects**: Aspect cloth provides only the aspect's hue and has no special effects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521505767310622760)
- **aspect effect modifier link**: The Aspect Effect Modifier link is poor for boosting fire aspect flamestrike and reflect damage, where damage dealt by player is better, and it is mostly seen in artisan buff builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540323424520380468)
- **aspect item sources**: Aspect Cores and Aspect Distillations are random drops from mobs, while the Aspect Kit is player crafted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527675870863560775)
- **aspectable bandana via restyle**: To get a bandana that counts as armor and can be aspected, use a leather cap restyle kit on an invulnerable leather cap to turn it into a bandana, and bless it afterward. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536798985887551599)
- **avarite crafted weapons**: Avarite crafted weapons are plentiful and surprisingly good, making them a solid option among crafted weapons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522780053644120125)
- **beds from tailors**: Player tailors can craft beds, while NPC tailors do not sell them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614540111708212)
- **blacksmithing tool recycling**: Recycling with the blacksmithing tool requires a nearby forge/anvil, so it cannot be used in the middle of a dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039196204601525)
- **blacksmithy queue automation requirements**: Blacksmithy crafting queue automation requires being near an anvil and forge; without one the script halts or replays after an error when it cannot find something it needs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532790494474539159)
- **blank map vendors**: Mapmaker NPCs sell blank maps and restock quickly, though players often buy out the stock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537091450855235655)
- **blessing leather body straps**: Leather body straps can be blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530931487304847441)
- **carpentry and lumberjacking**: Carpentry is the trade that uses raw wood from lumberjacking, and there are almost always buyers for wood, though it is best not to combine both on one character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547075038388420678)
- **cartography skill cap for world maps**: Making world maps with Cartography above 117 requires using the Cartography skill scroll to raise the cap to 120; otherwise the message 'no chance for skill gain' appears and the crafting queue stops. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533268587559518298)
- **cestus weapon type**: The Cestus is a wrestling weapon that uses the Wrestling codex and is crafted with the Tailoring skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541504413926031401)
- **chromatic distillation conversion**: A character with high enough alchemy skill (reportedly 100) can convert a chromatic distillation into any specific aspect distillation without other materials. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544672027712159876)
- **clothing alteration kit**: A clothing alteration kit is used to change the color of cloth items, and it is likely what changes the color of the Pegleg item. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550314129854566401)
- **clothing alteration kit crafting**: A Clothing Alteration Kit requires 50 leather and no MCD; on the test server, set Tailoring to 100 and use leather from the stockpile to craft it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543254834759864351)
- **clothing alteration kit for dyeing clothing**: A tailor-crafted clothing alteration kit used with rare cloth lets a player dye clothing, such as a mage robe, a magical color. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543210782760902788)
- **clothing alteration kit function**: A Clothing Alteration Kit merges an existing piece of clothing, mask, headgear or neckgear with a stack of colored cloth so it adopts that hue, consuming the cloth used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531464189313421384)
- **clothing alteration kit usage**: The clothing alteration kit can be used on any kind of fancy clothing, including items restyled from a leather cap, but not on just any item. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681161656311911)
- **club weapon vendor availability**: The Club, a wooden bat-looking mace weapon, is sold by weapon vendors such as weaponsmiths. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548061582607650929)
- **codex acquisition**: Codices can be crafted by players who have the materials, and most players buy them from other players who craft them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554453259295531079)
- **codex inscription requirements**: Making a codex requires 110 Inscription to attempt, and 120 Inscription gives a 100% chance to make it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533016568139612281)
- **cowl hood armor**: A cowl hood gives armor equal to an exceptional plain leather cap, and a clothing bless deed can be used on it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553372751178244147)
- **crafted spellbook bonuses**: Crafted (material) spellbooks provide real bonuses when equipped and are not merely containers for scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521320235628499057)
- **crafting bandages from cloth**: Bandages can be crafted from cloth made by shearing sheep and weaving the wool, but this is mostly done for fun since cloth or bolts can be bought from a tailor in seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529242598517117140)
- **crafting exceptional sewing kits**: Sewing kits are tools made with the Tinkering skill, so exceptional sewing kits for a storage shelf come from a tinkerer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544344695566499991)
- **crafting kindling**: Kindling can be crafted with a carpentry tool: from logs at 25 Carpentry skill (5 logs make 50 kindling), or from boards with 0 Carpentry skill (1 board makes 10 kindling); logs come from chopping with an axe. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537952473573105754)
- **crafting queue scope**: The crafting queue works for all crafting skills; scripts are only needed to recycle magic hats, sell maps you make, and sell items made from gems. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535818107178717194)
- **crafting queue skill target**: The crafting queue has an 'until x skill' option that crafts an item until a target skill level (for example 65) is reached, and it attempts the next item whenever the character can craft it at all, with no lower skill limit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537169279856672818)
- **crafting queue sources**: To use the crafting queue, put your tools and reagents in the resource stockpile, set the queue's source (the crate icon) to the stockpile, and set the shelf as the destination for finished items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550997958315606069)
- **crafting queue storage**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, crafting queue lists are stored server side. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522313465614700596)
- **crafting society quest item turn-in**: Crafting society quests take the items you make, and the recycle-all option must be enabled for regular (non-exceptional) items to be taken. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533848421683822772)
- **crafting station requirements**: Carpentry and tinkering crafting require only the tools and no nearby station, while blacksmithing requires an anvil and a forge. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532791153500487802)
- **crafting training cost**: Crafting skills are expensive to train, so new players should plan ahead, ideally starting with a money maker such as Paladin/Bard or Miner/Lumberjack and buying needed items from crafters meanwhile; a miner has room in the skill set for crafts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549659642051821590)
- **crafting your own boxes**: Players can craft their own untrapped wooden boxes with 50 Carpentry and 50 Tinkering if they have boards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524220028688404550)
- **cutting clothing for cloth with scissors**: Clothing must be unblessed before scissors can turn it back into cloth, and restyled items cannot be cut up even after being unblessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522169845570076792)
- **cutting footwear into cloth**: Footwear can be cut with scissors into 6 pieces of cloth in the same color as the footwear, including dungeon-colored and rare cloth shoes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855051953512600)
- **dyeing bags and backpacks**: Bags and backpacks can be dyed with ordinary dyeing tubs and dyes from a tailor; a tailor dye tub may also work on a potion satchel, though a backpack dye probably will not. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541379677216575559)
- **dyeing with aspect cloth**: Clothing and gear can be dyed with rare cloth or aspect cloth; the colour change is permanent and is usually done on fancy gear, and it gives no extra XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543132573520109648)
- **early crafting profitability**: Crafting is initially a money pit, and Tailoring and Blacksmithing in particular do not have great returns, though they can be very convenient. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **empty potion bottle sources**: Empty potion bottles can be bought from NPC smugglers or from player vendors as a bottle commodity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527317743676686357)
- **exceptional weapon bonuses**: An exceptional weapon gets about +10 damage and +3% accuracy from the exceptional modifier; an exceptional shadow kryss totals +20 durability, +12 damage and +5% accuracy once shadow material bonuses are added. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532811962553991309)
