- **explosion potion targeting**: Explosion potions can be thrown at other targets, whereas other alchemy potions can basically only be used on yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551293384424034338)
- **fancy helmet appearance**: A plate helmet cannot be restyled to look fancy; the Invulnerability Leather Cap is the fancy option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532126820135075901)
- **fancy hood armor rating**: The fancy hood counts as an exceptional leather helm for armor rating and can be aspected, costing only a few armor rating points compared to a plate helm. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555986613216088156)
- **finding tailoring repair kit in crafting menu**: To find the repair kit in the tailoring crafting gump, press Ctrl-F and search for 'repair kit', since it is listed as 'Tailoring Repair Kit'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543828436810989588)
- **forge and anvil crafting**: Forges and anvils are crafted via Tinkering or Blacksmithy, and are usually cheaper to have a crafter make for you than to buy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528026569883517019)
- **forge requirement for recycling tools**: Blacksmith tools require a forge and anvil to recycle items, while other recycling tools such as a sewing kit or saw work anywhere. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553527158993977506)
- **gold versus iron platemail**: Gold platemail is better than iron platemail. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553236447035916339)
- **healing codex**: Healing codexes are player-made through the Inscription skill, and Anatomy and Healing skills make them more useful when healing with a codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548072404524343347)
- **healing food and cooking skill**: Food only provides healing if the character has the Cooking skill, and the best healing food is called Delectable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526595277304369173)
- **hoods, clothing and masks sources**: Hoods are craftable by player tailors (the artisan hood), some clothing is sold at the Prev vendor, and masks are Prev shop items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521508096445251764)
- **identifying unidentified items**: To identify an unidentified item such as a dropped spellbook, use the Item Identification skill or a player-made item ID wand, then recycle any items you do not want. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528055587596664984)
- **inscribing spells into material spellbooks**: You cannot inscribe spells into the material or modifier spellbooks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528608117082947676)
- **inscription scroll reuse**: Inscription on Outlands does not require reagents, and the same scroll can be used 50 times. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535402714996015135)
- **invulnerable leather cap headwear**: Invulnerable leather caps can be turned into various headwear, and a hat that counts as an invulnerable leather cap takes on your equipped Aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547602104267313163)
- **item identification on crafted weapons**: Item Identification gives no additional bonuses on crafted weapons such as an avar weapon, even at 120 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522744537087479988)
- **magic items versus crafted items**: Items made of more advanced materials cannot be made magic; magic items are found as loot, while crafted items are player crafted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525992907830591539)
- **magical and material spellbooks**: There are magical spellbooks obtained as loot and material spellbooks that are crafted, and players tend to prefer the material ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602573299978312)
- **mastercrafted spellbook difference**: There is no difference between an exceptional mastercrafted full spellbook (64 spells) and an ordinary exceptional spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524456868150247524)
- **multi-account crafting setup for societies**: Train Tailoring, Alchemy and Inscription to 100 on all three accounts first, then raise Tailoring and Alchemy to 120 using scrolls, buy 5 more society points per account, then raise Inscription to 120; the main account may also carry a crafting echo for tinkering, carpentry and blacksmithing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553890762662355060)
- **multi-skill crafting recipes**: Most crafts require only a single trade skill, but some items require a combination of two crafting skills, so one character cannot hold every crafting skill and craft everything alone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547075818197491804)
- **near-black cloth alternatives**: The Prevalia merchant sells cloth very close to black, and Death Aspect and Shadow Aspect are cheap alternatives for black. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521503922576035962)
- **obtaining bandages and cloth**: To get more bandages, buy bolts of cloth from an NPC tailor and cut them with scissors to produce cloth for bandages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550537293008478329)
- **phylactery uses**: Phylacteries can be turned into cores, which is preferred over using their aspect proc, since one aspect proc per hour is not very helpful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **potion keg crafting requirements**: Crafting a potion keg from the tinker menu requires 100 Carpentry and 100 Tinkering skill in order to assemble it without making the other parts separately. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528118516769620079)
- **recycler item requirements**: Items must be identified, either with a skill or with a wand/charges, and also repaired before they can be recycled. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527694024968769536)
- **recycling crafted items**: Crafted items can be recycled to return some of the resources used to craft them, and an automatic recycling setting exists. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042251058380903)
- **recycling magical items**: Most magical items found, roughly 95%, are best recycled, except Supremely-quality items, which are worth keeping. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551078052308459662)
- **repair bench charges**: Any repair kit type except ship repair kits can be used to add charges to a repair bench. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521505024793116812)
- **repair benches**: Repair benches hold charges from repair kits, require no skill to use, and when double-clicked restore durability of all equipped gear and all gear in the player's inventory. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554846223096356997)
- **repairing equipment**: Repair equipment by double clicking a repair bench, found at public houses, outside player shops, and at some moongates such as Prevalia or the outpost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532656931062153428)
- **restyled invulnerable leather cap**: An invulnerable leather cap combined with a restyle deed lets you change its appearance at the cost of a little armor rating when wearing plate, and it is recommended for a PvP blessed cap restyle. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535782969883623444)
- **restyled leather cap blessing**: A cap restyled with the Leather Cap Restyle Kit should be blessed with a clothing bless deed from the Prevalia vendor, otherwise it is lost on death; players commonly restyle and bless a magic invulnerability leather cap to get the highest armor while keeping it blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548901457275658331)
- **restyled wizard hat armor**: Restyle kits turn leather headwear, including a leather hat of invulnerability, into a wizard hat, and a hat restyled from a leather cap gives 2 more armor than regular decorative hats. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542724555389407252)
- **scribe supplying 7th and 8th circle spells**: To fill the 7th and 8th circle spells of a Magery spellbook, give a player scribe Arcane Scrolls (for example 24) and ask for all level 7 to 8 spells; most scribes will make a full spellbook, which is quicker than queuing one of each scroll. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544878166605037670)
- **separate crafting characters**: Players typically make a separate character for crafting skills rather than putting them on a PvM character, and a PvM character is usually needed to fund the crafter's resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586650599985245)
- **separate gathering and crafting characters**: Crafters are best loaded with crafting skills and parked at home, with gathering and crafting done on separate characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547073856181903381)
- **shield dyeing**: Aesthetic shield covers can be dyed using accessory dye. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542354090045210707)
- **ship repair kit crafting**: Ship repair kits are crafted with the Tinkering skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549820475125796874)
- **single-character crafting with an echo**: A single character can do all crafting by using an echo, an additional skill template on the same character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527373975875883059)
- **skull lantern dyeing**: Skull lanterns can be dyed using accessory dye. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528767816189345822)
- **smoke bomb crafting**: Smoke bombs are crafted with the Tinkering skill, and crafting them requires 110 Tinkering skill according to players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527296659376308336)
- **society crafter starting priorities**: Society crafters should start by getting three characters with 100 Tailoring as the first priority, followed by 100 Alchemy and 100 Inscription characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544316376020287538)
- **spell scrolls**: Casting from a spell scroll consumes the scroll instead of reagents and adds +20 effective Magery solely to spellcast success chance (irrelevant at 100% success); scrolls are often cheaper than reagents and can be refunded for extra uses, with scribes getting this benefit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546721540186574919)
- **stats effect on crafting**: No stats, including dexterity and strength, affect crafting or the number of exceptional items produced. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525323415576379525)
- **storage shelf crafting cost**: A storage shelf is crafted from 10 Master Crafting Diagrams plus two board commodities, reported as 10k plain (not colored) boards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537959692733513848)
- **test server cloth cost for dyeing**: On the test server, dyeing an item takes a specific amount of cloth, for example 8 cloth for the lunar cloak. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541832950004449401)
- **tier 7/8 scroll crafting**: Tier 7/8 scrolls cannot be upgraded from lower scrolls and can only be crafted, which requires pink arcane scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554577173711687691)
- **tools for recycling early game**: In the early game, any crafting tool bought from NPC vendors is good enough to recycle items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547972225968111668)
- **training crafting skills with the crafting queue**: To train a crafting skill such as Inscription without a script, put materials in the secure chest, carry the crafting tools, and set the crafting queue box to the container holding the materials; the Crafting Queue pulls materials from there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553162735217418365)
- **treasure map crafting**: Treasure maps are crafted by players using the cartography skill, and the crafting queue makes leveling cartography easy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545833019544313897)
- **typical bow wood choices**: Most typical builds use bows crafted from woods between Rosewood and Valewood, with Avarwood as the pricier option, and Rosewood to Valewood is more suitable for newer players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088854687649812)
- **wizard satchel**: Wizard satchels reduce the weight of stored reagents and scrolls (making them weigh less than gold), which helps reduce Magery reagent costs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549666638985437239)
- **wooden chest recipe**: A wooden chest can be crafted with carpentry using 50 boards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535988173551960104)
- **accessories dye drops**: Accessories dye drops in packs of 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533263587727118418)
- **accuracy boosting gear**: Exceedingly weapons, or Avarhide armor if no exceedingly weapon is used, can provide additional accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522094381388267611)
- **adding items to crafting queue**: Items can be added to the currently open crafting queue by picking them from the crafting tool gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529607194692161547)
- **adornments**: Adornments are craftable decorations, and the food-related ones look like small dinner table settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846295133159555)
- **aesthetic armor slots from prevalia vendor**: Head, neck and gloves can be filled with aesthetic items from the Prevalia vendor, and the other slots can be covered with aesthetic items so the character looks unarmored. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522261679986053130)
- **alchemist and scribe shared society**: Alchemist and scribe share the same society, so points can be built up quickly for mastery chain links or reforging tools to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537690260388188191)
- **alchemist core conversion**: Alchemists can convert 4 of these items into a core of the same kind, or 8 of them into a chromatic core. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526327666146414715)
- **alchemist phylactery core combining**: An Alchemist can combine 4 phylacteries of the same type to make a core of that type, or 8 of the same type to make a chromatic core. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **alchemy inscription tailoring materials**: Materials for Alchemy, Inscription and Tailoring can be gathered while playing normally, without dedicated gathering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551586881597345944)
- **alchemy society jobs**: Alchemy society jobs consume the crafted items as they are made, so the items do not reach the storage shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538648756889853962)
- **alchemy-related perk usefulness**: Volatile is useful if you throw explosion potions, Mixed Results is handy, Refinement is somewhat of a waste, and Elixir and Bandolier at level 1 are nice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539199852376756224)
- **alteration kit leather cost**: An alteration kit takes 50 leather to craft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522533782953918565)
- **arcane essence from recycling**: Identify magic gear dropped by mobs and recycle it to obtain arcane essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533863195205439589)
- **arcane essences**: Arcane essences come from recycling identified magic items using a saw, tinker tool or magic item recycler box; double click an essence and target yourself to use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528525839401095350)
- **arcane scroll inscription society jobs**: Inscription society jobs that require arcane scrolls are generally best avoided. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529398288669741126)
- **arcane scroll uses**: Besides inscription society use and making spell books, arcane scrolls can reportedly be turned into 25 essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547706724298002463)
- **armor crate crafting from trapped pouch**: Armor crates cannot be crafted from armor pieces stored in a trapped pouch; all the pieces must be in the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537539231193370795)
- **armor crate requirements**: To put armor into an armor crate, it must be a full set of full-durability, same-type, same-quality (same ore) mastercrafted armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528456658202918912)
- **armor material choice**: Many players use base-material (iron) exceptionally crafted armor, replacing it with whatever material is affordable, and tamers rely on pets to tank most damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542067378588885033)
- **armor rating scaling**: Armor rating increases as Smithing and Artisan Aspect go up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541465982218797168)
- **armor values from cheap magic sets**: Very high armor values can be reached even with cheap magic armor sets, while the weapon is the harder piece to source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536892796605169718)
- **arms lore and leatherworking requirements**: Arms Lore is not required for blacksmithing, and tailoring covers leatherworking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523730817418006600)
- **artisan aspect crafting skill worn bonus skills**: Alchemy counts as a crafting skill for the artisan armor aspect's crafting skill worn bonus, while poisoning does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541787997941538988)
- **artisan aspect eligible items**: A random magical book or NPC vendor gear can be aspected for Artisan; it is unclear whether a smith's hammer can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537415709057884250)
- **artisan aspect exceptional crafting bonus**: The Artisan aspect reportedly adds 5% plus 1.5% per aspect tier to exceptional crafting chance, though the author is unsure of the exact numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547993023235756113)
- **artisan aspect leveling**: Players are advised to start the Artisan Aspect early, and many level cooking to advance Artisan because meats are cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527673488729440368)
- **artisan aspect priority for crafters**: Artisan Aspect is nice to have for a crafter but is not a top priority early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545165366366568509)
- **artisan booster bard setup**: For the Artisan booster, the recommended setup is the Melee aspect special effect plus the matching modifier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542634029000687657)
- **artisan clothing cosmetics**: Craftable Artisan Clothing provides cosmetic clothes that are much cheaper than the cosmetic items sold by Prevalia merchants. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540960496965001328)
- **artisan effect on ships**: Artisan reportedly has no effect on ships, and 120 carpentry is only needed to eliminate negative stats on boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527321849422282783)
- **artisan xp from crafting picks**: Crafting your own harvesting picks grants Artisan XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538657091655303280)
- **aspect cloth from death cores**: Make aspect cloth from death cores, then use a clothing alteration kit with that cloth to color a head piece. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529080517247369318)
- **aspect cloth ingredient**: Aspect cloth is crafted from distils rather than cores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529088953016254576)
- **aspect dyes on blessed clothing**: Aspect dyes appear not to work on blessed clothing such as a blessed cloak, based on a test-server trial with an uncertain result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540740092631453856)
- **aspect effect and metal type**: The aspect effect on a weapon or armor is the same regardless of the metal type; the metal only provides its own separate bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524510081809514678)
- **aspect extracts**: Aspect Extracts used to drop in place of Distillations, and an Alchemist would convert them into Distillations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540042213050941551)
- **aspect hue on clothing**: To get aspect hue on clothing, have a tailor make aspect cloth from distillations, then use a clothing alteration kit on the item and target the required cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536277422905888798)
- **aspect kit crafting**: A tailor can craft an aspect kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541102677629345842)
- **aspect on exceptional leather cap**: An exceptional leather cap that gives +5 Intelligence but reduces Strength and Dexterity by 5 can still have an aspect applied, but it should be blessed before it is worn out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523420008359661750)
- **aspect on restyled bonnet**: An aspect cannot be applied to a restyled bonnet before it is equipped, so the new bonnet must be equipped first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525066787023097957)
- **aspectable clothing-like tailor items**: Tailor items that can be aspected and look like clothing include the leather cap (turned into a hat), trilby hat, cowled hood, scarf, braced collar, neckguard and waxed leather gauntlets, and previous clothing items can be aspected if they are armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534320290400702615)
- **aspecting weapon spellbooks**: Weapon spellbooks can be aspected in the same way as armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528022912253296841)
- **aspects on armor**: Aspects can only be applied to armor, and cloth cannot be aspected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521552139636179146)
- **assassin's knife stats**: An assassin's knife has the same stats as a kryss and differs only in appearance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540797144993243236)
- **auto-recycling chest**: A chest that automatically recycles items is expected to become available eventually, and a guild may already have one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548845028883959859)
- **automatic potion crafting without a script**: To keep crafting potions automatically without a script, use the crafting queue with the resource stockpile as the source box and a restocking shelf as the destination bag; the queue moves to the next entry when resources run out or the set quantity is met. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529599344267759737)
- **avar versus magic items by build**: Many builds use avar items instead of magic items, while bard-buff builds and stabbers more commonly use magic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525992751559086133)
- **avarhide spellbook bonus mana**: An Avarhide spellbook gives a chance to grant bonus mana per regeneration tick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533933066504900811)
- **avarite item value**: Avarite items are valued mainly for convenience of acquisition rather than being the strongest option, though they still provide a good bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525994173034139658)
- **avarite mace value**: A non-exceptional avarite mace is only as effective as an exceptional dull copper weapon, so it is a poor use of resources; copper to gold ores are cost efficient for weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532412710476579117)
- **avarwood damage bonus**: Avarwood gives only about a 3% damage increase over normal wood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533895904006901921)
- **backpack recycling risk**: Recycling your backpack with a crafting tool recycles all magic items in it, so you should not carry magic items you want to keep. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677972434821262)
- **bandage crafting for healers**: Players with the Healing skill can make bandages from scratch without spending gold, using wool from sheep. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524984272610656429)
- **bandana option on leather cap restyle kit**: Bandana is one of the options available on the leather cap restyle kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536798908603170960)
- **bank bag crafting limits**: Crafting directly from a bank bag does not work for blacksmithing because it requires a forge and anvil, but it reportedly works for tinkering, tailoring and carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531495904438128811)
- **basic furniture crafting skill requirement**: A character with about 50 Carpentry (plus 50 Tinkering per one author) can craft basic furniture such as tables, chairs, chests and cabinets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533018353659150376)
- **best crafts for societies**: The main benefit of crafting is societies, since crafted goods are cheap to buy from other crafters; Tailoring, then Alchemy, then Inscription give the most value for societies, while other crafts are supplemental depending on weekly jobs and their points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **best value crafting wood**: Rosewood is considered roughly the best value-for-cost crafting wood, and valewood can sometimes be bought at a decent price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542351580119048333)
- **black dye availability**: Tailors do not sell a pure black dye; you can use a dye tub to make the darkest colour available cheaply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521509667715416096)
- **blacksmith career cost**: Becoming a Blacksmith is one of the most time-consuming and expensive paths and takes a long time to become profitable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529212814600704100)
- **blacksmith crafter build**: A suggested blacksmith crafter build is 120 Blacksmith, 100 Provocation, 100 Begging, 100 Throwing, 100 Focus, 100 Fletching and 0.01 Arms Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551762751880175704)
- **blacksmith vendor goods**: Blacksmith NPCs deal in metal goods and do not sell leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545205768050184194)
- **blacksmith weapon quality cap**: Blacksmiths cannot craft weapons with modifiers higher than master crafted, and there are no valorite hammers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521489970450137200)
- **blacksmithing codex and artisan aspect**: Blacksmiths use the Artisan aspect to raise exceptional crafting chance, and no blacksmithing codex exists, unlike alchemy and tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542224550299828234)
- **blacksmithing on pvm character**: Blacksmithing on a PvM character is still useful for the boss room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529810340726968381)
- **blacksmithy requirement for best armor**: Blacksmithy at 120 is needed to craft the best armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538721768498405447)
- **blank scroll recycling**: Blank scrolls cannot be recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535064493971873802)
- **blank scroll sources**: Blank scrolls can be crafted with Tailoring or Carpentry, or bought from Smuggler NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552816088482451478)
- **blessable fancy clothing as exceptional leather**: Blessable fancy clothing that occupies armor slots, such as a wizard hat, counts as exceptionally crafted leather, so tailoring and artisan bonuses apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525209347637121129)
- **blessable invulnerable armor**: The only invulnerable armor that can be blessed is a leather cap, while invulnerable clothing can be blessed but is not armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523284127506370742)
- **blessed item dyeing**: A blessed item can still be dyed; blessing does not affect its ability to be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526625073421746258)
- **blessed restyled helmet**: To get a blessed restyled helmet, use an Invulnerable-level leather cap with a Leather Cap Restyle Kit, then apply a clothing bless deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528195065451774075)
- **blessed status of crafted items**: Certain crafted items are believed to be blessed when crafted, but which items is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553558883451019266)
- **blessing a restyled hat**: A restyled hat can be blessed by using a clothing bless deed on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534816874796285972)
- **board commodity deed**: A commodity deed for boards requires 5000 boards; convert logs to boards first by double-clicking the logs while a hatchet is in your pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537917391202295869)
- **boat acquisition**: Boats are player crafted and cannot be bought from NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523826100738982141)
- **boat crafting skill**: A boat is best crafted with the highest possible carpentry skill, and boats have many unusual stat mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534127480909205575)
- **bone armor versus leather**: Bone armor reportedly offers more protection than leather and is cheap to make for a character who has a tailor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522384486636064899)
- **bonus ingots when smelting**: Smelting ore has a chance to yield more ingots than normal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530390248457240718)
- **boom box crafting**: Boom boxes are crafted using both Carpentry and Tinkering skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538723138961936485)
- **boombox crafting storage**: Source ingots and the crafted product can be placed in a boombox, and when non-exceptional items are recycled the recycled ingots also go into the boombox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531484569117921480)
- **bowcrafting in carpentry**: Bowcrafting was moved into the Carpentry skill, which gives combat bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534591916434391161)
- **bronze scribe links for scroll consumption**: Two bronze scribe links are needed so that casting does not consume a fire scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525909233940566059)
- **bronze tool for bronze links**: A bronze tool can be bought to turn a bronze link into the item needed for a build, but the result remains bronze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521515535232270471)
- **bulk armor crafting limits**: Armor cannot be crafted from materials in the bank, so bulk armor crafting in town requires restocking about every 10 sets because of weight limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537537376224546846)
- **bulk recycling of magic items**: Set a crafting tool such as a saw or tinker tool to recycle 'all magic' and target your backpack to recycle every magic item in it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677660945096786)
- **bulk recycling of spellbooks**: A bulk recycling tool can recycle many spellbooks at once if the bag is emptied beforehand, but the recycle-all-in-container and recycle-all-in-inventory options did not work for spellbooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549470789802135614)
- **butler for society crafting scripts**: The Butler script tool can be used to set up scripts for weekly crafting society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525627368700379237)
- **butler profit column**: The Butler's profit column is reportedly calculated as the points earned from society jobs measured against the cost of materials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529248984021991545)
- **buying spell scrolls from player scribes**: Buying spell scrolls individually from player scribes while leveling is feasible, and most scribes will craft them for free if you bring Arcane Scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522437066884124672)
- **carpenter furniture crafting for rooms**: A new character can become a carpenter and immediately start making basic furniture and chests to furnish a room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526570085681201192)
- **carpenter's saw purchase**: A carpenter's saw can be bought from the tinker NPC at any shop that has a saw on its sign post. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532970926805745704)
- **carpentry and tinkering for key boxes**: Having 60 carpentry and tinkering on a PvM character is suggested so that it can make key boxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542449222027186197)
- **carpentry-leveraging template**: A society crafter is the template that leverages carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545406692123213834)
- **chain links installation**: Chain links must be installed into a chain, and without a chain there are no slots available to install them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535745173730893824)
- **changing item color**: To change an item's color, use rare cloth or aspect cloth together with a clothing alteration deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529992360497254400)
- **cheap carpet recipe**: A cheap carpet can be made from fishing nets with dyed cloth placed underneath. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521513755362725980)
- **cheap crafting professions to level**: Tailoring, alchemy and inscription are cheap to level compared to other crafting professions, so players commonly level them on multiple alts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547990756848050197)
- **checking item modifier values**: Single click an item to see its descriptors, then look up the values on the wiki modifiers page; this only works if the item is already identified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534197413399498882)
- **chest availability**: Chests are player crafted and are not sold by NPC carpenters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526735874753036460)
- **classicmmo crafter template guide accuracy**: The classicmmo.com guide to the best UO Outlands crafter templates is inaccurate, apparently AI-generated and confused with other UO shards, for example claiming Taste Identification increases herbalism yield, and should be ignored. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553890915112853605)
- **closest cloth to true black**: Arena Cloth is the closest to true black. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521504049499865228)
- **cloth cost for clothing crafting**: Even cheap cloth can cost about 3k-5k per piece, and roughly 8 pieces of cloth are needed to craft a single clothing item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521510688449757226)
- **cloth required to dye a cloak**: Dyeing a cloak with a clothing alteration kit took 8 rare or aspect cloth, and the kit tells how much cloth an item needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543257284669345792)
- **cloth uses**: Cloth is used to dye clothing and is also needed for the animal print skirt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543439888278491146)
- **clothing alteration kit cloth requirement**: Targeting an item with a clothing alteration kit tells you how much cloth is needed to hue it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521143132320825384)
- **clothing recolor cloth cost**: Recoloring a piece of clothing with a clothing alteration kit requires the same amount of cloth as it takes to craft that item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551520493692133387)
- **codex crafting**: Codexes are crafted through a Bestiary, Healer Codex and Weapon Codex chain, and a player with the Inscription skill will craft one for a small tip if given the materials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533147883597992088)
- **codex exceptional quality**: A Codex cannot be exceptional, so exceptional quality makes no difference for a Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530151114660515840)
- **codex recipe lookup**: Codex recipes are listed on the Inscription wiki page or can be viewed in game by using a scribe's pen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553515584719822998)
- **codex types**: Player-crafted codices are skill specific, while the codex given as a quest reward is unique. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528430227812909117)
- **colored ingot armor damage reduction**: Colored ingot armor likely reduces melee damage only and not magic damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524625536717164725)
- **colored leather value**: Colored leather is more valuable than plain leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551767137650090106)
- **coloring restyled leather cap**: After restyling a leather cap, use the clothing alteration kit on it; the kit reports how many pieces of cloth are needed to color it, and its gump lets you choose the cloth and the item to apply it to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681008408891423)
- **command distillation alchemy requirement**: Making a command distillation requires roughly 5-6k alchemy skill in the current setup, although some players expected it to be only 2-3k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537534419059875890)
- **commodity deed leather capacity**: A commodity deed holds only one type of leather per deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534993985263763599)
- **commodity drop location**: Commodities drop to your inventory after creation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521900057052319967)
- **common armor tiers**: Many players use high-level armor, though not avarite; copper through valorite armor is very common. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526694553979981945)
- **container identification wands**: Container Identification wands are the recommended way to identify magic items, since training Item Identification to 120 is expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530979230546923570)
- **cooking as crafting skill**: Cooking is a good and cheap-to-train crafting skill, and levelling it on a main crafter is easy exp for the artisan aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539225100723814481)
- **cooking ingredients**: Cooking only produces useful food from special ingredients obtained by skinning mobs, though normal meats can still be used to train the Cooking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525806737851023450)
- **corrupted link reforging tool**: The Corrupted Link Reforging Tool can be crafted to turn corrupted links into the link you want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545415072061464666)
- **cost of player-made tools**: The cost of player-made tools is lower if you have your own crafters, though Tinkering is especially costly to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526999680687538258)
- **cost of training crafting skills**: Training a crafting skill such as alchemy is expensive and reportedly requires roughly 100k reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554364190871789620)
- **costume clothing sources**: Costume clothing is sold by the Prevalian Merchant and can also be crafted by Tailoring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543132272469876766)
- **cowled hood as aspect headpiece**: A tailor-crafted Cowled Hood counts as an exceptional leather helmet, so it can be worn and given an aspect like armor; bless it afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524160619467505824)
- **cowled hood aspecting**: The cowled hood can be aspected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539950708458258482)
- **craft queue container requirement**: When crafting with the craft queue, tools and materials must be in the same container as the targeted source container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529523729330081823)
- **craftable trap boxes**: On the Outlands live server, players can craft only the greater exposing trap box; poison trap boxes and arrow trap boxes cannot be made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541237097854402722)
- **crafted bandana armor status**: A crafted bandana does not count as armor (helmet) and cannot be aspected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536798671327207507)
- **crafted high-end material bows**: Crafted bows made from high-end materials are cheap, readily available, and very good in both damage and accuracy, and most builds benefit from the accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088092931002439)
- **crafted item material prefixes**: The rough strength of crafted items can be judged by memorizing material prefixes such as plain, shadow, gold and avar, plus hide, ore and wood types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532825394099654667)
- **crafted rune tome blessing**: Rune tomes crafted by players are not blessed initially. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547403549313339462)
- **crafted spellbooks and arcane staves versus magic gear**: Crafted spellbooks and arcane staves compare much better against their magic counterparts than crafted melee weapons do against high-level magic melee weapons, especially for arcane, where accuracy and other bonuses apply at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533951371043274824)
- **crafted valorite and avarite weapons versus magical weapons**: Beating a crafted valorite or avarite weapon requires a magical weapon with an eminently accurate + power roll or better, and since crafted valorite/avarite weapons are in infinite supply and cost only a few thousand gold, most players use crafted gear day to day. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534204110486634506)
- **crafter build skill coverage**: A crafter build should cover all crafting skills for artisan aspects, and some crafts also require inscription and magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535614362411343993)
- **crafter character investment**: When investing in crafter characters, keep them cheap and avoid tinkering, blacksmithing and carpentry unless it is on your main character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534393412038426774)
- **crafter placement across accounts**: Most players put crafters on their other accounts rather than the main account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549507698943332353)
- **crafters for societies**: Eventually a player wants three crafters, one on each account, for societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526293179320504502)
- **crafting a storage shelf**: A storage shelf requires 10 mastercrafting diagrams and 10k boards, crafted by a player with 120 carpentry, and the manuals need 100 smithing, tailoring and tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521519987561594981)
- **crafting blacksmith build skills**: Any skill combination that includes 120 Blacksmith works for a crafting blacksmith build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551762781882032221)
- **crafting for yourself during a society job**: To craft an item for yourself mid-job, turn off the 'turning in' option in the society jobs gump; it defaults back to crafting for the job once you finish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529327408144973884)
- **crafting from bank**: You can craft straight to and from your bank, though the bonus may not be worth the extra hassle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521123145979789402)
- **crafting from bank bag**: You can craft directly to and from a bag in your bank, so resources never enter your backpack and are fully safe from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531486147077738576)
- **crafting from stockpile without carrying resources**: To craft from the stockpile without carrying resources, put regs and empty bottles in the stockpile, set the crafting queue box to stockpile and the crafting queue bag to the shelf, so no regs or items are needed on your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551040850966880278)
- **crafting gump resource error at max weight**: The crafting gump can report that you lack the resources to craft when the crafter character is at max weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039693393629255)
- **crafting income sources**: Crafting for other players is highly competitive, low-margin and gold-intensive, while crafting for NPCs through societies is highly profitable but requires some initial investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531178273529139220)
- **crafting into a container**: Items can be crafted directly into a bin or container instead of into your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522935213515214868)
- **crafting maps from bank box**: To craft maps from your bank box at the Cambria map shop, keep a bag of blank maps in the bank, carry crafting tools, put a bag in your backpack for the finished maps, then run a script to sell what you make. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537083369886715925)
- **crafting materials chart**: The !ccs graphic shows the rough amount of materials needed per crafting skill, which can be priced against current resource market prices to estimate training cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522405563995259001)
- **crafting profit investments**: Making profit from crafted gear also requires investing in the Artisan skill and possibly exceptional chance links, and buying materials from others splits the profits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523735604641271911)
- **crafting queue afk**: A crafting queue can be set up so that crafting continues while the player is AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524331717844799540)
- **crafting queue blank scrolls**: The Crafting Queue does not appear to place blank scrolls into your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553163917230870589)
- **crafting queue limits**: A player can manually add a total of 7 crafting queues, each holding up to 4 pages of items to craft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529607194692161547)
- **crafting queue material source**: If crafting works via Create Item but the crafting queue reports missing materials, click the first bag icon at the bottom right of the crafting queue and target the container the queue should pull materials from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533206235946549268)
- **crafting queue recycling**: With the Crafting Queue you can recycle everything that you craft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553163917230870589)
- **crafting queue scripts for 100 to 120 skill**: When using the Crafting Queue to go from 100 to 120 crafting skill, the only script needed is one for cutting up wizard hats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553163085349388339)
- **crafting queue setup**: For crafting other than blacksmithing, keep materials in a bag or box inside your bank box (or a secure chest or bag), keep crafting tools in your backpack, set the crafting queue box to the materials, and set the crafting queue bag to a bag or box inside your bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528953957718950149)
- **crafting queue setup**: To set up a crafting queue, open the stockpile gump, choose a crafting tool (any works), open the crafting queue from the tool gump, then set the source box to the stockpile and the destination bag to the shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529606508797628477)
- **crafting queue source and destination icons**: In the Outlands crafting queue, the left icon sets the 'source for materials' (resource stockpile) and the right icon sets the 'destination for crafted items' (storage shelf). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525499211024433163)
- **crafting queue source container errors**: If the crafting queue gives errors, check that the source container is set correctly, such as by targeting your stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210770804449382)
- **crafting queue system**: The Crafting Queue system uses a special item kept in the bank box to craft from stored resources without carrying them, with the source and target containers set by the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521122146640986233)
- **crafting queue tool wear without stockpile**: When crafting with a queue and no resource stockpile, the queue skips to the next item whenever the tool wears out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537169393807523911)
- **crafting queue with multiple characters**: Using a crafting queue with multiple characters drawing on the same non-stockpile tool and resource source may cause the queue to misbehave. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537178494373466122)
- **crafting queue workaround without stockpile**: If the crafting queue causes problems without a resource stockpile, use a one-item queue as a workaround until the issue is resolved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537168941527470212)
- **crafting queues**: A dedicated house character can use crafting queues to craft loadout sets, and the queues keep running while you do other things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554513694556295290)
- **crafting skill requirements for utility items**: Empty potion kegs and locked boxes require Carpentry plus Tinkering, item ID wands require Item Identification plus Tinkering, and inscription crafting needs Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555710233941123113)
- **crafting skill target for best results**: Blacksmithy, Tinkering and Carpentry should be raised to 120 to get the best crafting results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538721159103905842)
- **crafting skill tools**: Carpentry uses a saw, Tinkering uses a tinker tool, Blacksmithy uses a smith hammer, and Tailoring uses a sewing kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533043985264803861)
- **crafting skill training cost**: Training crafting skills on Outlands costs quite a bit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286681711181885)
- **crafting skill training costs**: Crafting skills cost gold to train, so players commonly start with a Tailor and use Society Jobs to earn points and items to sell, and some start with three tailors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540111361319895100)
- **crafting skill worn bonus conditions**: The crafting skill worn bonus applies when you have the crafting skill and wear equipment made by that craft: tailoring with tailor-made armor, blacksmithing with smith-made weapons or armor, and carpentry with carpenter-made weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541788882243297310)
- **crafting society paired skills**: Each crafting society has two paired skills that earn points within it, and those points can only be spent within that society; Tailoring and Blacksmithing are paired in one society, and Scribe and Alchemy in another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547076543120019457)
- **crafting tool price at provisioner**: A crafting tool costs roughly 50 gp at the Provisioner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525609830428053554)
- **crafting use after training**: Once you are done training, crafting is used for soc jobs, for items you or an ally need, or for selling to a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098731040153731)
- **crafting with region bonus using stockpiles**: To craft with the region bonus, move materials to the bank and buy tools there, since tools cannot be pulled back out of a resource stockpile, then bring leftover materials back to your house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549791005144911964)
- **crook material bonus**: A regular wood crook gives a lower bonus than a colored crook such as shadowwood or goldwood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521299258634928198)
- **curio dye**: Curio dye is used to dye furniture and decorative items that were given a random hue, such as from events or the Prevalian Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543439888278491146)
- **curio dye hues**: Curio dyes are sold in a specific fixed hue and do not let you choose a color when used in a dye tub. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553862917936652350)
- **cutting blessed items**: A blessed item must be unblessed before it can be cut or recycled for cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542724377165176832)
- **cutting fish with dagger**: Cutting a fish with a dagger yields delectable fish ingredients. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794404845559870)
- **dedicated crafter character**: Many players use a separate crafter character with inscription, alchemy, and tailoring that does weekly Society jobs for society points and makes potions, scrolls, and leather or bone armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554509770197569647)
- **disposing of unwanted crafted maps**: Crafted maps can be sold to vendors, or unwanted ones can be dropped on the floor of an inn room to let them decay, though this is not fully confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390770685448203)
- **disposing of unwanted potions**: Unwanted low-level potions can be disposed of by placing them on the ground to decay or into a trash barrel, and a recorded looping macro can drink a stack to recover the bottles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532238908673359983)
- **dull copper ore uses**: Dull copper ore is cheap enough to be used to level crafting like iron ingots, to make tools or basic gear sets for newbies, or to be sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535372099689123851)
- **dye item for hats and masks**: Cloth is the item used to dye hats and masks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525461942372925480)
- **dyeable items**: Only shields and clothing can be dyed; other armor pieces cannot be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521506942063738991)
- **dyeing clothing**: To dye clothing you may need to give yourself the Tailoring skill to make a clothing kit, or you can use the purple statue, which does the same thing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522962348787368108)
- **dyeing clothing items**: Clothing items such as the rope mesh tunic can be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529991869399044117)
- **dyeing clothing versus furniture**: Dyes are for carpet, furniture and similar items; clothing uses a dye tub for basic colors, while nicer colors are applied through alterations using an alteration kit and cloth of your choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521504118903144628)
- **dyeing crafted robes**: For a standard crafted robe a dye tub is the usual choice, while blessing and using cloth for dyeing is meant for fancy clothing and is not usually worth it for generic crafted clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523067418514034849)
- **dyeing items with cloth**: To dye an item, use coloured cloth together with an alteration kit to apply the cloth's colour onto the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521510790421807134)
- **dyeing spellbooks**: It is unconfirmed whether spellbooks can be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522266374318067742)
- **echo scroll costs**: A first echo can be made cheaply with about 100 scrolls, but later echoes need 200, 300 or more scrolls, which becomes tedious to collect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528137029114920982)
- **eldritch armor and inscription links**: With Eldritch armor, links are not needed to reach 125 inscription; links are only needed to hit 125 when using armor other than Eldritch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552888342256025651)
- **eldritch inscription crafting effects**: Eldritch inscription skill likely does not count toward minimum skill requirements for crafting, though it might increase exceptional chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522700113213001738)
- **empty kegs**: Empty kegs are not sold by NPCs and must be crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539541581068242985)
- **equipment repair location**: Damaged equipment can be repaired at any repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542915926922494012)
- **exceedingly accurate power weapon bonus**: An exceedingly accurate power weapon is only +20/+20. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521491455875747900)
