- **exceedingly melodious instruments**: Exceedingly Melodious instruments are relatively cheap and give a good barding bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541964507738411129)
- **exceptional avarwood bow bonuses**: An exceptional Avarwood bow gives 12% accuracy and 19% damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552089469027622923)
- **exceptional crafted items**: Exceptional crafted items have better properties than normal crafted items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042766869958736)
- **exceptional crafting bonus location**: The exceptional crafting bonus applies only when you are in the world within city limits, not merely when your room is in that city. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520775929633443934)
- **exceptional crafting chance**: High-end crafters can use exceptional chance links and the Artisan aspect to maximize their chance of crafting exceptional items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521151515136364544)
- **exceptional item crafting**: Making exceptional items requires no special crafting station, only a skill check, and the chance is displayed in the crafting menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529583394055524557)
- **exceptional item ids**: Exceptional items share the same item ID as their non-exceptional versions, so scripts cannot distinguish them by ID alone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525985835160178911)
- **exceptional leather hat**: A hat of the type shown in Raze's picture counts as exceptional leather armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529881831544061973)
- **exceptional pickaxe durability**: Exceptional or master crafted pickaxes have more uses than regular ones, for example 4250 for a master crafted avarite pickaxe versus 3250 for a regular one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554843227796803596)
- **exceptional wood crook damage versus avarwood**: An exceptional normal wood crook does about 3% less damage than an exceptional avarwood crook, roughly the damage of one gold link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554170681967779870)
- **explorer pack crafting**: Explorer packs are crafted with Cartography at 100 skill using a mapmaker's pen, 1 blank map, 1 iron ingot, 1 leather and 1 board. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544153687906320384)
- **explorer pack crafting skill**: Explorer Packs are crafted with the Cartography skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536752292550938754)
- **explosion potion sources**: Explosion potions can be obtained from player vendors or crafted by the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537618216203980900)
- **extra crafting societies on separate account**: A separate account provides 10 more crafting societies, which is cheap and profitable for a tailor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525209861464264884)
- **fancy headwear and leather quality**: Fancy headwear, chest and leg pieces bought from Jakesh (the Prevalia Merchant), or bought from players for items he no longer sells, all count as exceptionally crafted base leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554681543811797023)
- **farmer's almanac creation**: The Farmer's Almanac is created by a scribe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524363529514389614)
- **farming level 3 mobs with lower material weapons**: Level 3 mobs can be farmed with a weapon crafted from a lower-tier material than avarite. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535796674813763734)
- **first crafters to gm for weekly societies**: The most useful crafters to GM first are alchemist, tailor, and scribe, because they let you complete weekly societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537689878056140830)
- **first crafting skill for crafters**: Tailoring is the recommended first crafting skill for a crafter, followed by alchemy, and both are needed for societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542447538064461866)
- **fistblade versus cestus**: There is no difference between the fistblade and the cestus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540066265928958002)
- **flamestrike scroll sourcing**: Flamestrike scrolls are player crafted, so they can be bought from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537712321533845544)
- **forges at player houses**: Forges located at player houses can be used for smelting and crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522778940597473451)
- **free bandage production**: You can make free bandages by getting wool from sheep, making bolts of cloth at a tailor shop using a wheel and loom, and then cutting the cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529804872784941076)
- **free trapped pouches**: To get trapped pouches for free, recycle scrolls and collect leather, craft Magic Trap scrolls, craft pouches from the leather, then trap the pouches with the scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523649130868637828)
- **gatherer supplying crafter**: A gatherer character can supply a crafter's materials, but it is slow and leaves the player poor until the grind is done unless some ingots and boards are sold along the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540111630350811317)
- **gear recycling**: Gear can be recycled into materials and arcane essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520480457647460595)
- **gear stat determination**: Gear stats come from the weapon chart for base damage plus magic or crafted modifiers, and outlandsbutler.com offers calculators to add up bonus sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553603418579271751)
- **gear stats**: Gear stats are static and determined by the material the item is crafted from or its magic modifiers, and can be checked on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538750649016254595)
- **gold mastercrafted gear value**: Gold mastercrafted gear is a good middle-of-the-road option that is not too expensive for the bonuses it provides and is easy to replace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528400416562483281)
- **goldenhide armor crafting**: Once a player has obtained one of the three goldenhide armor pieces, tailors can reportedly craft the pieces themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549753913484251158)
- **grimoire acquisition**: A grimoire can be bought with gold or crafted using skills and goods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547478851117125702)
- **guarding armor as fortune alternative**: Guarding armor is easy to stock up on and can be used as an alternative to fortune armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537851496643825734)
- **hat of the magi**: The Hat of the Magi is likely not present in Outlands and is probably an AOS-era item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546761636654751795)
- **healer's codex crafting**: Kaitlyn can craft a Healer's Codex from 25 Arcane Scrolls plus 1 MCD (Mastery Codex Dust), though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541934459824246884)
- **healing potion shattering**: Healing potions cannot be shattered on another player to heal them, reportedly because concussive damage is not in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551293574887505992)
- **hiring a crafter**: If a crafted item cannot be found on the Portal, hire a crafter in the designated crafting channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536160800362987611)
- **hood as leather cap alternative**: A hood can be made as an alternative to turning a leather cap into a hat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925218737455255)
- **house crafter skill requirements**: A house crafter needs Alchemy and Inscription, and Inscription requires at least 80 Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523734262212460736)
- **house forge weight reduction**: A forge placed in a house one tile from the wall can be used for smelting and reduces weight a lot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553985600619814944)
- **hued and aspected spellbooks**: Hued spellbooks can be obtained as slayer spellbooks, and spellbooks can also be aspected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522266405423022090)
- **hueing limited edition shimmer abyss clothing**: To hue unhued limited edition clothing shimmer abyss, obtain shimmer abyss cloth and use a clothing alteration kit on the clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521142759170510955)
- **identification wand shortcut**: Using an identification wand is the shortcut for identifying items without relying on the Item Identification skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533592571245498589)
- **identify wand types**: There are two types of identify wand, one of which is labelled 'item identification wand'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544497827873296435)
- **identifying and recycling magic items**: Identify magic items first, then recycle those whose modifiers you judge to be poor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533592816931049593)
- **identifying craft training items**: Items shown green in the crafting menu are suitable for training; click yourself and enable "Show Skill Gain Chances" to compare skill gain chances between items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531568370183573524)
- **ingot and board yield per resource**: In Outlands, one ore yields 2 ingots and one log yields 1 board. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551252642036977785)
- **ingots for blacksmith society turn-ins**: Mined ingots are needed for blacksmith society (BS Societies) turn-ins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520930297745637476)
- **inscription bulk crafting**: Inscription items cannot be made in bulk until maximum skill is reached. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524918015865393202)
- **inscription links effective skill**: Using 2 inscription links gives 125 effective Inscription. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535812241687842817)
- **inscription links from society**: Inscription links can be obtained through a society if you do not need an arcane scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535812919781228625)
- **inscription queue tool**: The game includes a crafting queue tool that makes training Inscription easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526335543158374471)
- **inscription red link scroll conservation**: A single red Inscription link reportedly gives about a 99.9% chance not to consume a scroll, though the author is unsure of the exact figure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554550607975682129)
- **inscription refund and satchel refund**: The Inscription scroll refund chance and the wizard satchel refund effect are independent rolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529895126883762236)
- **inscription scroll requirements**: Inscription-focused characters likely need large quantities of arcane scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553891909389393994)
- **inscription scroll saving chances**: Inscription's chance to not consume scrolls and the leather satchel's scroll-saving bonus are two independent chances rather than additive bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543053968215642173)
- **inscription society job requirements lookup**: The Outlands Butler societies optimiser and the Outlands wiki Inscription page list the skill level and materials each inscription society job needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529398628836442172)
- **instrument charges at zero**: An instrument that reaches 0 charges is lost like a tool, so it must be repaired before charges run out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554847920858341407)
- **instrument repair**: Musical instruments can be repaired to restore full charges, but this must be done before charges reach 0, because an instrument at 0 charges is destroyed like a tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554845345660412110)
- **iron ingots for crafting leveling**: Iron ingots can be used to level crafting skills such as tinkering and blacksmithing if you plan to have a crafter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544713592753094738)
- **item id with gm iron equipment**: Item ID does not help if you use GM-crafted Iron equipment, since it only improves magical properties. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542556134257205338)
- **item identification**: Identifying items requires either the Item Identification skill or player-crafted identification wands, which are believed to require Tinkering with Item Identification to make. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474107784429710)
- **item identification wand wood type**: The wood type of an Item Identification wand affects its number of charges, with better wood giving more charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535111378287722537)
- **item modifiers**: For crafted items the material determines the item's properties, while for magic items the modifiers chart on the wiki must be consulted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536079536649805917)
- **items with no single-click text**: An item that shows nothing when single-clicked is either an NPC-made item or a failed craft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532816248101015637)
- **katana cutlass scimitar differences**: Katana, cutlass, and scimitar appear to differ only cosmetically according to the wiki weapons chart, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525936143142943)
- **keeping recall scrolls with crafting queue**: To keep recall scrolls (if you have not yet passed that point) when using the Crafting Queue, set the crafting queue bag to a shelf if you have one, otherwise to the secure chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553167990877327471)
- **large boat quality**: Boats larger than a medium crafted so far have often turned out junk, because shipcraft is difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534128053951791205)
- **leather armor penalty**: Leather armor carries no penalty to movement or stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521551552421298216)
- **leather availability**: Leather is free, so having a tailor character on each account is worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534915487278956626)
- **leather crafting aspect experience**: Crafting with leather grants 0.1 aspect experience per leather used in a successful craft, and 0.2 per leather used when items are recycled with a 50% resource return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535059317970174004)
- **leather for tailoring society jobs**: Leather needed for tailoring society jobs costs nothing if you skin monsters and save the leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529947072642547712)
- **leather from society jobs**: Running three crafters with 15 society jobs unlocked each per week yields more leather than is needed, even without Forensic Evaluation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545188547177353379)
- **leveling artisan with boats**: Crafting boats is a good way to level the artisan aspect up to T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527326599412846682)
- **leveling crafting skills**: Crafting skills should only be leveled once you have a resource stockpile and a storage shelf in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522365431405350913)
- **lockable and trapped boxes origin**: Lockable boxes and trapped boxes are player-made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542879740363538492)
- **lockable boxes**: Lockable boxes are player-crafted using tinkering alongside carpentry, and a box comes with its own key when crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533122191934099526)
- **lockable containers**: Lockable containers such as wooden boxes, crates and chests are player crafted, not sold by NPC vendors, and can all be locked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544034428685123606)
- **log to board conversion**: One log reportedly makes one board. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537600668100071444)
- **loose armor parts from npc vendors**: Loose armor parts can be bought from NPC vendors under Npc / Armor, but NPCs do not sell colored versions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549752605171912786)
- **magic item modifier sourcing**: Magic item modifiers must be found or bought and cannot be crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525993330670833757)
- **magic item recycler echoes**: The magic item recycler can yield echoes when recycling items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413880883617934)
- **magic item recycler filter checkboxes**: In the Magic Item Recycler filter settings, green ticked boxes are recycled and unticked red boxes are kept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544764696068168)
- **magic item recycler requirements**: The magic item recycler requires at least one modifier to be selected in each column before it will work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533627756930269255)
- **magic item recycler setup**: A magic item recycler will not work unless options in its leftmost column are selected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537745423169618002)
- **magic recycler**: The Magic Recycler lets you dump everything through one context menu, identifies and recycles items in two clicks, and can filter out specific magic suffixes for the best resale value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520402812482355211)
- **magic recycler and spellbooks**: The Magic Recycler will not recycle spellbooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549470403125190710)
- **magic recycler boxes**: Magic recycler boxes can be bought later in the game or are often available in guilds, and they work like Rust scrap machines. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525608786008477798)
- **magic versus material modifiers chart**: The wiki's modifiers page has a comparison chart of magic versus material modifiers in a single sheet at the bottom of the page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523826335397449809)
- **magic weapon acquisition**: Magic weapons are obtained as loot and cannot be crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522384400757821490)
- **magic weapon modifiers worth keeping**: Magic weapons worth keeping are those with the top two modifier tiers: exceedingly and supremely for accuracy or power, and vanquishing for tactics bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524838407472156894)
- **magical shepherd's crooks bug**: Magical shepherd's crooks reportedly have a bug, so players are advised not to buy them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537474252918358137)
- **maker's mark checkbox**: The crafting menu has a per-craft checkbox for the maker's mark that toggles whether the crafter's name appears on the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546906549421604894)
- **making bandages from bolts of cloth**: Buy bolts of cloth from tailors, cut them with scissors to get cloth, then cut that cloth again with scissors to make bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549351879811665971)
- **making bolts of cloth**: To make bolts of cloth, get wool from sheep and use a spinning wheel and loom in your room; bolts are cut twice to make bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554615357594009643)
- **making commodities in a bag with forensic evaluation**: Making commodities in a bag with Forensic Evaluation has no minimum skill requirement; it needs 5,000 resources of the same type and a blank commodity crate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530959800014471380)
- **map crafting and selling automation**: Set the crafting queue to craft from the bank and run the sell script alongside it to automate map crafting and selling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538305065654423583)
- **map maker near bank**: One town has a map maker close enough to a bank that you can craft maps out of your bank and sell the maps back to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390732315959357)
- **mastercraft rune tome**: A mastercraft rune tome is functionally no different from a regular rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524103987500941332)
- **mastercrafted armor from 120 crafting skill**: Armor crafted by a player with 120 crafting skill comes out mastercrafted, and mastercrafted armor is significantly better than NPC-vendor armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527391765802389635)
- **mastercrafted avar staff**: A mastercrafted avar staff is incredibly rare and only slightly better than a normal one, so most experienced players do not care about it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527393286699094147)
- **mastercrafted blessed spellbooks**: Being mastercrafted offers no benefit to blessed spellbooks, and the mastercrafted state requires 120 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546904209641840710)
- **mastercrafted javelin quality**: A mastercrafted javelin is better than an exceptional one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531551569013772439)
- **mastercrafted runebooks and tomes**: Mastercrafted quality makes little difference for runebooks and tomes; it formerly gave about one extra scroll, and that bonus may no longer apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528239915018489947)
- **mastercrafted spellbook function**: A normal spellbook only holds spells, and whether it is mastercrafted makes no difference to that function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602232852648057)
- **mastercrafted tool and lockpick bonus**: Mastercrafted harvesting tools and lockpicks give +5, in addition to the +5 from exceptional quality, and the lockpicking chart lists both together as 'GM tools +10'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523501585685020813)
- **mastercrafted tool bonus**: All tools are affected by the mastercrafted bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538960079003455619)
- **mastercrafted tools for chests**: Mastercrafted tools help significantly when opening locked chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546288113309978694)
- **mastercrafting diagram**: A Mastercrafting Diagram is an uncommon drop used in several crafting recipes, such as the codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553467782497050687)
- **mastercrafting skill requirement**: Mastercrafting requires 120 skill, and various items receive bonuses for being mastercrafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546904542413590548)
- **matching clothing over armor to aspect**: To make clothing worn over armor on legs, chest and arms look like your aspect, dye the clothing with aspect cloth; rare cloth can be used instead for a look that does not match the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534322335945986069)
- **material cost of society jobs while training**: Doing society jobs while training a craft requires more materials, since the crafted items are consumed on turn-in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042778668269729)
- **material spellbooks on test server**: On the Test server, get a material spellbook from the storage shelf: open the magic book tab and cycle through leather types to obtain an exceptional spellbook of that material. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532385314071380118)
- **mcd abbreviation**: MCD stands for Mastercrafting Diagram, an item used in many crafts such as making codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545193480689815646)
- **meat sources for cooking**: Cooking meats can be gathered by fighting monsters, bought with gold, or obtained as fish steaks from fishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362631341608993)
- **mortar and pestle for recycling magic items**: The mortar and pestle may not work for recycling magic items in the field, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039757989679115)
- **mug crafting**: A player with sufficient Tinkering skill can craft a mug through the crafting menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526012628873379860)
- **mug crafting requirement**: Crafting a mug requires 25 Tinkering skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526169004874661898)
- **necromancer staff**: The Necromancer staff is one of the arcane staves and is only useful if you have the Arcane skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554253106525507697)
- **non-magical armored wizard hat**: To get a non-magical wizard's hat that provides armor, use a Leather Cap Restyle Kit to turn a leather cap into a wizard hat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534800629556576327)
- **non-red crafting margins**: Getting non-red crafting margins requires 10 corrupted links and crafting during the weekly town exceptional bonus, and thieves are a concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531367167130472559)
- **npc armor quality**: NPC-sold armor is the lowest grade of armor, and regular player-made armor is far better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527340842593943632)
- **npc blacksmith repairs**: NPC blacksmiths cannot repair armor or equipment; repairs are done at repair benches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539778503388434552)
- **npc vendor equipment quality**: Equipment bought from NPC vendors is low quality compared to player-crafted gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527391765802389635)
- **ordinary pitchers**: Ordinary pitchers cannot be filled with water on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541547572999626784)
- **ore to ingot smelting ratio**: Ore may smelt into ingots at a 1:2 ratio, but this is unconfirmed and the author was unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541094396668158012)
- **outlands butler crafting training script generator**: The Outlands Butler crafting-training page (outlandsbutler.com/crafting-training) has a script generator for all crafting skills that builds an in-game crafting queue to level a skill to a desired value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532118185736929472)
- **outlands hue guide**: The Official Outlands Hue Guide on the forums and a Razor hue resource page list available hues and their numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541433474848784554)
- **outlandsdrip.com dye reference**: The website outlandsdrip.com lists the required dye item for each clothing layer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525461735455330314)
- **pitcher use**: Pitchers are used for alcohol. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531408167739719730)
- **pitchers sold by waiters or cooks**: Waiters or cooks sell pitchers, and the contents of a pitcher can be drunk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531399210472312952)
- **plant chemicals craft yield**: Crafting plant chemicals likely yields 5 per craft, so about 15 crafts produce the 75 needed for the quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522724774030086355)
- **player-crafted tool bonus**: Player-crafted tools provide an exceptional or mastercrafted bonus, and their cost is made up for within a handful of swings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526997172309065899)
- **potion keg capacity**: A full potion keg holds 100 potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527787904007671829)
- **potion satchel**: A potion satchel gives a chance to not consume a potion when drunk, with higher quality or material giving a higher chance (roughly 30% for exceptional mastercrafted shadowhide and possibly about 50% for avarhide), and it is separate from the Potion Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523074030024917052)
- **pouring potions from a keg**: To pour potions from a keg, keep an empty bottle in your bag and double-click the keg or use its context menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527318044794163391)
- **power-only weapon vs crafted averite weapon**: A power-only magic weapon adding 20% damage is significantly worse than a crafted averite weapon, which gives 19% damage and also +12% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550062651332366407)
- **pre-blessed crafted progression items**: Craftable progression items and items like the adventurer's satchel are already blessed when crafted, with no extra steps needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545489586862694502)
- **prevalia armored wizard hat**: The Prevalia merchant sells an armored wizard hat that counts as an exceptional leather helmet for aspect armor purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542723999434547251)
- **previewing and recycling unidentified items**: You can hold an item in hand or equip armor and check player stats to see its effect, but items still must be identified before they can be recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532962104653516922)
- **previous merchandise bandana head pieces**: Limited-time previous merchandise head pieces in bandana styles may count as armor and be aspectable, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536799594057433108)
- **profitable crafter specialties**: Alchemy crafters make potions, inscription crafters make recall scrolls and codexes, and blacksmithing crafters make weapons and GM armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051103222140990)
- **public forges and anvils**: There are plenty of public forges and anvils available for players to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528028074501869568)
- **public repair benches**: Public repair benches exist for players without guild access. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525716566044311612)
- **quiver arrow consumption**: A quiver reduces the number of arrows an archer consumes, and it is probably only available as a player-made item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547677672145031168)
- **quiver blessing**: Quivers cannot be blessed with a clothing bless deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554328494631161860)
- **reagent bags**: Reagent bags such as the Wizards Satchel are not required, but one made with coloured leather gives increasingly lighter-weight reagents and a chance to not consume reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553569603035070476)
- **reagent requirements for crafting skills**: Among crafting skills, only alchemy requires reagents; inscription does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524330828719591495)
- **recoloring blessed robe or hood**: To recolor a blessed robe or hood, use hued cloth of the desired color together with a clothing alteration kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551520335273402369)
- **recovering cloth from dyed items**: To recover cloth from a dyed item, cut it up; if the item is blessed, first use an unbless deed, then buy a clothing bless deed again, and remake the item in a different hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552320155911065712)
- **recovering empty potion kegs**: There is no way to dump a potion keg's contents on the ground to recover the empty keg; most alchemists craft potions into bottles and drink them to get the bottles back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532234020656644187)
- **recycling a magic item**: To recycle a magic item, identify it first (for example with a player-crafted ID wand) and then use a sewing kit or saw on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550665985793728593)
- **recycling backpack requirement**: Items may fail to recycle if they are not in your main backpack rather than in a sub-container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548843042851520513)
- **recycling clothing into cloth**: Dropped clothing items can be cut up with scissors to produce cloth that can be stacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537264794149584986)
- **recycling crafted items with a saw**: To recycle crafted items with a saw, set it to recycle all of type, then recycle one item to recycle everything of that type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533848791940071645)
- **recycling hats**: Hats cannot be recycled with the crafting tool and must be cut up with scissors instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549838469491064834)
- **recycling items**: To recycle items, double click a crafting tool and press the recycle button at the bottom of its gump, then target the item to recycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525609358652739705)
- **recycling items**: Use a tool such as a saw or sewing kit, choose a mode near the bottom left corner of its menu, then click Begin Recycling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527694024968769536)
- **recycling near prevalia**: There is no public recycler near Prevalia; you can recycle with a saw or tinker tool, join a guild that has a recycler, or buy a recycler from the Prevalia shop left of the Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531087898433028197)
- **recycling npc gear**: NPC vendor gear cannot be recycled; only player-crafted or dungeon-gained (DG) items can be recycled, while NPC gear can only be sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522923193151783013)
- **recycling pouches**: A single pouch cannot be recycled by itself; the whole backpack must be recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535559980478890026)
- **recycling process**: Initially you recycle items using a tool and must identify magical items before recycling them; the process can be largely automated later on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525608445783576598)
- **recycling restyled leather cap**: Recycling with a sewing kit may be a way to deal with a restyled leather cap that cannot be cut, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545153519923761152)
- **recycling tailored items**: Crafted tailored items should be recycled to get the leather back rather than sold to NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542447916327899166)
- **recycling with crafting tools**: Most crafting tools, such as a sewing kit, can be used to recycle identified items, but not all of them can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546348663792607292)
- **recycling with crafting tools**: Any crafting tool on Outlands can be used to recycle items in addition to crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525608979068092416)
- **recycling with id wands and crafting tool**: Items can also be recycled using ID wands and a crafting tool, but this is not efficient when starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655577544200195)
- **recycling yields**: Recycling yields basic materials such as wood, ingots and leather, as well as crafting tools such as blacksmith hammers, tailoring kits, mortar and pestles and saws. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525608332335775914)
- **recycling yields and crafting skill**: Crafting skill level does not affect the resources and essence recovered when recycling items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522517899430985728)
- **reforge kit types**: There are separate reforge kits for bronze, silver, and gold chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529250970633113670)
- **reforge kits for chain links**: Reforge kits allow a player to turn one chain link into another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529250909031239680)
- **reforge tool type selection**: Reforge tools let you choose the type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520507764454199307)
- **regular poison acquisition**: Regular poison must be crafted, for example by a crafter character, or bought from other players, since the top row of vendor stock is greater poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549874247726538853)
- **remove trap tool tiers**: Better remove trap tools are made of gold or the next tier up, agapite, which is probably the equivalent of rose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544622757730320394)
- **removing aspect color from item**: To avoid the aspect color on an item, check the material box and then reapply the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549977159974522902)
- **repair bench**: A repair bench on the wall of a house behind the outpost moongate repairs items without requiring crafting skill; double-click it to repair everything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527811227391099000)
- **repair bench charges**: Repair kits are used to add charges to repair benches, which the benches then spend when repairing items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299295523217479)
- **repair bench recharging**: The repair bench is recharged with repair kits, and a kit made by a scribe, smith, carpenter or tailor will work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991590576234518)
- **repair bench skill requirements**: Repair benches require no skills to use; you just double-click them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526534652699869347)
- **repair kit charges**: Each repair kit adds 10 charges to the repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992386424315915)
- **repair kit targeting skill requirement**: A Repair Kit can target a container without any skill, but targeting a player directly with it requires skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543828347451084820)
- **repair kits and public repair benches**: Outlands has repair kits as a repair equivalent and also has public repair benches, though the details are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534589773229068308)
- **repair kits skill requirement**: Players with 95 skill in Blacksmithy, Carpentry, Tailoring or Inscription can use Repair Kits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543828013366386819)
- **repairing crafted spellbooks**: Crafted spellbooks may have charges and can possibly be repaired by double clicking the repair bench behind the outpost moongate, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531611632470331422)
- **repairing items with repair kit**: To repair an item with a repair kit, place the item in a bag (any container, not only your own backpack) and target that bag with the repair kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299669311455283)
- **repairing with crafting tools**: Any crafting tool may be used to repair items, but it is unclear whether crafting skill is required for that tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527811526222807070)
- **resource stockpile definition**: A chest of resources and tool kits placed in a room does not count as a resource stockpile for crafting purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537168186196369409)
- **restocking crafting tools via resource stockpile**: To stock vendor-bought crafting tools faster, buy as many as you can carry without becoming overweight, use the resource stockpile restock context menu option to add them all at once, then recall back to the vendor to buy more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526963670612185302)
- **restoring clothing color**: Undyed, default-hued cloth clothing can be restored to its original color with a clothing alteration kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525460625289904148)
- **restoring dyed clothing to original colour**: To return dyed clothing to its original colour, use store-bought white cloth, and the basic dye tub may also work on clothing, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528375353540870355)
- **restyle deed reuse on restyled cap**: A restyle deed cannot be used again on a cap that was already turned into a hat, and a reported bug where a restyled cap reverted and consumed the deed could not be reproduced by testers and is not intended per Ian. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525056961002082355)
- **restyle deeds for headpieces**: Restyle Deeds can transform leather caps of Invulnerability into any fashionable headpiece sold by the tailor vendor, such as a bandana, skullcap, or straw hat; artisan and Prevalia coin headpieces already come as exceptional leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524161539953655971)
- **restyled leather cap and scissors**: A blessed restyled leather cap cannot be cut with scissors, even after unblessing it; the scissors report they cannot be used on that item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545152391987470417)
- **rosehide reagent bag scroll save chance**: A rosehide reagent bag (Wizard's Satchel) gives a 31% chance not to consume a scroll when casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524561688752558322)
- **rotating town exceptional crafting bonus**: A rotating town grants higher exceptional craft chances, and the featured town changes each week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523332220440416296)
- **runebook and runetome crafting skill**: Runebooks and runetomes are crafted via the Inscription skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525681082517684254)
- **runetome crafting requirements**: Crafting a runetome requires 25 Arcane Scrolls, a few blank scrolls, and the Inscription skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525681202319589557)
- **safe crafting in inn room**: A crafter can stay safe by working in their inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537847655735234622)
- **saving dye hue on items**: An item's dye hue cannot be saved, while hair hue can be saved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552319075273937129)
- **saving money on thieves codex**: To pay less for a Thieves Codex, buy the required materials cheaply and add any you gather yourself, then hire a crafter through the crafting services channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **saw requirement with non-stockpile source container**: If you target yourself or another container as the crafting source container, you must also carry a saw on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549212008488894567)
- **scissors on boots**: Using scissors on boots produces six cloth, which makes dropped boots worth keeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160518019457144)
- **scribe's pen source**: A scribe's pen can be bought from scribe/mage NPCs in mage shops or from a tinker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524916911706603621)
- **scroll recovery chance stacking**: Inscription skill and the Valehide Wizard's Satchel each roll their scroll recovery chance separately rather than as one combined chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526317211676053606)
- **scythe restyling**: A scythe cannot be restyled or flipped until the next patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553802016139251783)
- **selling crafted maps to npc**: Crafted maps can be sold to an NPC mapmaker for a small amount of gold, which also clears them from the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549545396257292380)
- **shearing sheep for cloth**: Sheep can be sheared with scissors to obtain wool that is made into cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525816480493469826)
- **shelter anvils and society jobs**: Shelter anvils can be used to create the crafting queue but cannot be used to complete society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532790866714820743)
- **shield transmog with shield cover**: To transmog a shield, double click a shield cover and target yourself; any shield you equip then takes on the cover's appearance, and shields and covers can be dyed with accessory dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551629615506661497)
- **shimmer cloth and carpet dye sources**: For clothing, shimmer is a rare cloth; for carpets, the shimmer carpet dye can drop from a monster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527820056132587551)
- **ship crafting**: Ships are crafted by players using the Carpentry skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550974525770825778)
- **ship crafting with crafting queue**: To craft ships with the crafting queue, put loose ingots, board commodities, saws and loose cloth in a bag, set the bag as both source and target container, and keep a saw on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219102403596371)
- **ship origin**: Ships in Outlands are player made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522949347363524688)
- **ship repair**: Ship repair kits are required to repair a ship; a repair bench with the boat in the backpack does not work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531089355794546699)
- **smoke bomb crafting cost**: Crafting 25 smoke bombs requires 50 iron and silk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549141704806760681)
- **smuggler empty bottle price**: Smugglers sell empty bottles in bulk at 500 for 3k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551042079382175747)
- **societies alt crafting skill targets**: Societies alts should aim for 100 in each crafting skill first and raise them to 120 gradually with power scrolls; having 2 alts with 100 Tailoring is considered better than 1 with 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541948989639761970)
- **society crafting location**: To do society crafting quests, craft outside Shelter Island, for example in a rented inn room; when crafting in other towns, keep materials in a bag in the bank and set up a crafting queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529946117402529962)
- **society job crafting categories**: Different crafting skills complete different categories of society jobs and jobs cannot be combined, so spreading across many crafts takes longer to profit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532788547461971998)
- **society job loss calculation**: A society job shown with a loss is calculated from the cost of buying the materials; it can still be completed, and crafting at less than 100% success still gains skill while completing the job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535619298364620911)
- **society job planning tool**: Enter your skills on outlandsbutler.com and it lists the highest point value society jobs you can reliably craft within the job limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524890118224216220)
- **society job quest pickup account requirement**: Pick up society job quests on a character that is on the same account as the crafter character that will do the society jobs; a character on a different account will not work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529277898689745016)
- **society points maximization order**: To maximize society points per week, expand crafting capabilities slowly by alternating skills, for example 100 Tailoring, then 100 Alchemy, then 120 Tailoring, then 100 Carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **sources of effective inscription**: Effective Inscription can come from the Eldritch aspect, links, printed items, or a combination of these. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549153312178315275)
- **special dyes for item color**: Special dyes exist that can change the color of certain items, though the exact details are unclear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522266139302826116)
- **spell scroll sources**: Spells up to 6th level drop from caster mobs such as ghouls and necromancers in the newbie dungeon, while 7th and 8th level spells must be crafted by scribes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527276449705230456)
- **spellbook repair**: To repair a magic spellbook for free, double-click a repair bench, such as the one at the outpost moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533405099022618624)
- **spellbook requirement for scroll crafting**: According to the Outlands wiki, crafting circle 1 to 6 spell scrolls requires having the spell in your own spellbook and enough Magery to cast it, while circles 7 and 8 do not require having the spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549210179642466366)
- **stockpile commodity conversion**: The Stockpile may convert commodities into loose items when they are placed in it, which would make it unsuitable for ship crafting that needs commodity boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219788956368907)
- **stockpile for societies crafting**: A Stockpile makes Societies crafting very convenient for players who frequently do Societies with crafters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523007904859291788)
- **summoner's tome sourcing**: Scribes can craft the summoner's tome, and players can find one by searching the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540401146647154718)
- **t8 item crafting info**: Instructions for making T8 items are explained on the Lore System page of the Outlands wiki (https://wiki.uooutlands.com/Lore_System). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532005746068422668)
- **tailor society jobs**: A 100 skill tailor can perform non-coloured leather society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544315554981216346)
- **tailor society leather sourcing**: All mobs drop leather even with zero forensic evaluation, so the tailor society is easy to supply; a skinning knife is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537690398980579358)
- **tailor-crafted wrestling weapons**: Tailors craft the cestus and the fistblade, which are wrestling weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521078609949884416)
- **tailoring cost to grandmaster**: Tailoring costs roughly 200k to reach GM, which is reportedly cheap compared to other crafts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530418554980139159)
- **tailoring leveling cost**: Tailoring is much cheaper to level than the other crafting skills, so most players get all 3 accounts to 100 Tailoring first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549526146444427435)
- **tailoring repair kit cost**: A tailoring repair kit costs 10 leather to craft and can be used with a repair bench. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522533687604805703)
- **tailoring repair kit crafting**: A society crafter with 95 tailoring can make tailoring repair kits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521505446702350356)
- **tailoring skill for ship crafting**: The wiki indicates tailoring skill should not be needed to craft ships, although the author had 120 tailoring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549219102403596371)
- **tailoring society jobs**: Tailoring is the top left option of the society jobs menu, and the default society job cap can be maxed with tailoring alone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532528891950792724)
- **tailoring upgrade costs on wiki**: The wiki's tailoring upgrade costs are approximate but more or less accurate for leather, and the leather upgrade is one of the easier ones to obtain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537607902024704041)
- **tall straw hat aspect**: A Tall Straw Hat can get an aspect by using a Leather Cap Restyle Kit on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548901121316094003)
- **terran dye crafting requirement**: Crafting Terran dye has no skill requirement according to the wiki, so any character should be able to craft it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544072571304153119)
- **test server cloth dyeing at purple statue**: On the test server, a cloth alteration kit can be crafted but is not needed, because any item can be set to the desired hue at the purple statue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541832800548950057)
- **thieves codex crafting difficulty**: Many players have the skill to craft Thieves Codexes, so crafting one is not difficult, and the price mostly reflects material costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554992960469471303)
- **three crafter accounts**: A player will eventually have 3 crafters, one per account, and will unlock the customization that allows taking extra quests on all 3 accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531388496135061574)
- **tinker tools not added to resource stockpile**: If tinker tools are not being added to the resource stockpile, open the stockpile settings and tick the grab tools box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545755741770612737)
- **tinker's tools purchase**: Tinker's tools can be bought from a tinkerer NPC in any town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553836332621496351)
- **tinkered candelabras**: Candelabras crafted by Tinkering are decoration only and have no gameplay use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551217394788212737)
- **tinkering and carpentry synergy**: Tinkering is needed for carpentry only for making kegs and probably lockboxes; the synergy goes no further. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523737244245168148)
- **tinkering chain xp across accounts**: A crafter with Tinkering on a separate account from the PvM account works chain XP across two accounts, and that crafter cannot benefit from the PvM account's links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549861474338472070)
- **tool crafting skill requirement**: According to the wiki, crafting these tools requires 0 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529832375205498920)
- **transcriber book copying requirement**: The book being copied with a transcriber must be in your inventory and not locked down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553221379883671573)
- **trap box strength**: All trap boxes reportedly have the same trap strength, and any box or chest can be trapped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541236705514881105)
- **trap kit razorglass and flashdust effects**: On the trap kit, razorglass reportedly gives a 10% higher damage modifier over an additional 5 seconds, while flashdust gives a 10% lower damage modifier but a 5 second hinder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527493006733738034)
- **trap removal tools**: Traps on chests are removed using trap removal tools, not lockpicks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546285139506634882)
- **trappable containers**: Pouches can be trapped, and Boom Boxes can also be trapped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530639951354531850)
- **trapped box with grab bag and organizer**: Tinkerers can trap a box; set a bag as your grab bag and drop it into the trapped box, then at home use an organizer to retrieve it, but only one bag may be in your inventory for the organizer to work (details uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535077860899946607)
- **trapped boxes**: Making trapped boxes likely requires about 100 Tinkering, and trapped boxes bought from player vendors may not contain a key, which can only be discovered by setting off the trap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522420653314015283)
- **trapped container crafting requirements**: Crafting a trapped container requires roughly 50 Carpentry and 50 Tinkering skill, and trapping it requires higher Tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544035678336196620)
