- **trapping bags and pouches**: Tinkering cannot trap bags, but the magic trap spell can be cast on a pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541236705514881105)
- **traveller's torch dyeing**: A traveller's torch cannot be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529100787077218304)
- **treasure maps source**: Treasure maps (T-maps) cannot be crafted by players and are obtained only as loot drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544350914356445337)
- **turning logs into boards**: Double-click your axe and then click the log to turn it into boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554354006716063837)
- **unattended macroing of crafting characters**: Unattended macroing of crafting characters is allowed on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534397119920865310)
- **using a locked down recycle box**: If a recycle box is locked down instead of secured, use its buttons to put items in and take them out, and remove the recycled materials after recycling, for example into a resource stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550041911379890247)
- **utility crafter skill order for society jobs**: For a pure utility crafter for Society Jobs, put all crafting skills on one character, training Tailoring first, then Alchemy and Inscription, and leaving Blacksmithy and Carpentry for last because they are costly to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533034608562671718)
- **weapon and armor information on wiki**: Information on weapons and armor is found on the wiki's Weapons Chart and Modifiers pages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535723596880543874)
- **wearing a hat as aspect helmet**: To wear a hat as your aspect helmet, get a leather cap, have a crafter make a leather cap restyle deed, apply it, and optionally use a clothing bless deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526612170039628028)
- **weekly society jobs per crafter**: Each crafter is reportedly given 6 available society jobs per week, always. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537912008052183191)
- **wizard hat in prev shop**: The only wizard's hat sold in the prev shop is the armored magical wizard hat, which reduces stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534866532876681266)
- **wooden lock boxes and copper keys crafting**: Wooden lock boxes and copper keys are crafted by players who have both carpentry and tinkering skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555726621569450075)

## Combat & pvm

- **1v1 tournament signup**: To enter the 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament, sign up at the Arena Stone, where signups open one hour before the tournament starts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541102400851542077)
- **21st 1v1 cash prize tournament**: The 21st Official 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament is the first major event of the 2026 King's Faire, starts at 10pm ET on Sunday, August 23rd, and awards cash prizes to the top three winners. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541102400851542077)
- **21st official 1v1 cash prize tournament prizes and eligibility**: The 21st Official 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament awards $100 plus a Statue and Engraved Nameplate on Champion's Row for 1st place, $50 for 2nd and $25 for 3rd, and is open to all players to set their template, participate or spectate. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541262381622100079)
- **creature damage resistance**: Since the August 11, 2026 patch, creatures receive a small amount of Damage Resistance that varies by creature and largely scales with the creature's Difficulty Value. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1536748638750122004)
- **damage resistance exemptions**: The new creature Damage Resistance does not apply to Followers, Player Ship Crewmembers, or Battle Trainers. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1536748638750122004)
- **entering stalag grotto event**: To enter the Stalag Grotto event, say "Event" to or double-click a Spirit of Leodcyning NPC, then choose your Difficulty. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525517091384590457)
- **golden belt boxing tournament consumables**: Each player in the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament may use 1 Bandage, 1 Heal Potion (any type), and 1 Refresh Potion. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **golden belt boxing tournament equipment and template rules**: In the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament, players may not wear equipment (unarmored clothing is allowed) and may use any 700 skill point template, but Spellcasting is not allowed. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **golden belt boxing tournament match length**: Matches in the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament last 5 minutes, followed by overtime in which damage increases by 50% per minute. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **jousting tournament requirements**: Knights entering the Knights in the Outlands Official Jousting Tournament must bring their own Jousting Lances and Jousting Shields and be mounted on a steed. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **king's faire snowbrawl format**: The King's Faire Cash Prize Snowbrawl is a last-player-standing event in which players battle each other with snowballs. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541823889129213963)
- **pvp thief inventory mechanic**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 adds an intentionally designed mechanic for PvP thieves to sift through player inventories, which is needed because the Razor item delay is completely removed. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **round 2 reward in the 21st 1v1 tournament**: Everyone who makes it into Round 2 of the 21st Official 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament receives free King's Faire tickets. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541262381622100079)
- **signing up for the 21st 1v1 tournament**: To sign up for the 21st Official 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament, visit any Public Moongate and select the Arena. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541262381622100079)
- **snowbrawl event description**: SnowBrawl is a free-for-all, holiday-themed event fought with snowballs rather than swords, where players can use the terrain to dodge and attack foes. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541823889129213963)
- **stalag grotto battle pvp event**: The Stalag Grotto Battle PvP event runs July 18-25, during which the Stalag Grotto becomes a battleground where players earn EventScore rewards by fighting one another. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528054330727334028)
- **stalag grotto expansion**: For the 2026 Hot Barbarian Summer event, the Stalag Grotto region has been vastly expanded to reveal the territory of the Dustclan Barbarians, with new limited edition Stalag Seed drops and rare drops. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525517091384590457)
- **stalag grotto guild cap**: During the Stalag Grotto Battle event, guilds are capped at 8 players in the region, and allied guilds do not show up green. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528054330727334028)
- **stalag grotto party feature restrictions**: In the Stalag Grotto during the Battle event, party features such as green flagging, auras, and minimap tracking are disabled, and a buff icon reminds players of this. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528054330727334028)
- **stalag grotto pvp battle event**: The Stalag Grotto PvP Battle is an event where players use stalaghorns in player combat to earn Event Score, trophies, and rare rewards; the July 18-25 run had 230 participants and The Andarian won with 62,440 points. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **stalag grotto survival event eligibility**: To participate in the Stalag Grotto Survival PvM Event, first earn a Stalaghorn from PvM anywhere. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525517091384590457)
- **stalaghorn acquisition**: To receive Stalaghorns, which grant entry into the Stalag Grotto during the Battle event, participate in PvP Battle Events (such as TS, CCC, DFP and Rifts), Factions, or PvP Tournaments (2v2, 1v1). _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528054330727334028)
- **weekend arena dueling tournament**: A weekend Arena Dueling Tournament runs on a posted schedule with 1vs1 and 2vs2 duel formats; check the weekly announcement for exact times. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553128273779761162)
- **air aspect for dexxer builds**: Air aspect is a cheap and strong choice for dexxer builds, including mace dexxers, because it addresses swing speed, though its price is reportedly rising. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552728303008223256)
- **air aspect swing speed for wrestlers**: The Air aspect gives a wrestler extra swing speed and raises the swing speed cap, making the cap easy to reach, overcapping it from about tier 10, and freeing skill points for other uses such as more Wrestling and less Focus. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541158120892530688)
- **arcane mage armor aspects**: Blood and Lightning armor aspects are generally considered best for an Arcane mage, with Void, Eldritch, Air and Frost also good; Blood with an Arcane weapon is the common recommendation, while Air is used to refill mana. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555619535309115494)
- **arcane mage link priorities**: An arcane mage uses spell aspect chance rather than melee aspect chance because it is higher, and spell aspect chance links help with mana sustain, but damage links are the priority until arcane aspect tier is high enough to justify building around proc chance. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536192673893851188)
- **arcane mage link setup**: Arcane mage links center on damage dealt by player (DBP) and spell aspect special chance, with the first roughly 20 links a blend of the two and the rest (spell damage, ignore resist, or utility links) a matter of preference; around 20 links is workable and 30 or more allows higher-tier aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549539181653663878)
- **arcane staff casting requirements**: To cast spells while keeping an Arcane Staff equipped, a player needs at least 80 Arcane, 80 Magery and 80 Wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587250160078903)
- **archer chain link choices**: Most archers favor Damage Dealt by Player links together with Melee Damage/Ignore Armor Chance links, ideally 15 of each via redline. Without a redline, melee special chance/damage links are the alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544769850264518666)
- **archery aspect choice**: Lightning is the commonly recommended aspect for PvM archers, giving strong DPS, good survivability and strong group play, with Madness and Alchemy as other options and a void weapon preferred for lightning archers. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988006200123523)
- **armor meditation penalty**: Armor heavier than regular leather imposes a meditation penalty that reduces mana regeneration, so casters should wear leather; for non-mana characters, heavy armor has no dex or swing speed penalty, with the only other downside being extra damage taken from Mindblast by PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548815585519865998)
- **backstab mastery chain build**: A backstabber's Mastery Chain should stack backstab damage links, such as the first 10 links, and can use the mastery chain effect type limit option for extra backstab links; raising the max hit cap is also good with plenty of redline. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536531804058558504)
- **backstabber weapon skill**: Macefighting is the preferred weapon skill for a backstabber because its Wild Swing stance gives far more damage at an accuracy penalty the build can ignore, while fencing and archery are viable but secondary, with archery being safer and useful against houses. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546986040089251901)
- **bard tamer farming build**: Bard tamer, especially tri-bard tamer, is widely considered the strongest and safest build for solo farming and leveling, with tri-bard summoner a viable alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534924794225623264)
- **bard tamer mastery links**: Bard/tamer builds commonly link follower damage first, then effective barding skill (to reduce barding failures) and follower attack speed, with bard reset/break ignore chance as another suggestion; with enough follower and effective barding links, Discord and then Peace begin to land reliably. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545527050213793792)
- **best aspect for summoner builds**: For summoner builds, Command and Frost aspects are the top choices and are roughly equal in damage, with Command slightly favored at range and Frost favored when within hit range because of added defense and chill; Death is a decent third and Eldritch is far behind. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545379951912423424)
- **best dexxer weapon skill**: Wrestling is currently regarded as the best dexxer weapon skill, ahead of swords and mace, thanks to high damage and a reliable AoE stance; swords remain a viable alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 17 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554189156450828439)
- **blood aspect**: Blood aspect is a good all-round aspect that is strongest on arcane mages, where its dexterity boosts swing speed and its intelligence stores more mana from arcane aspect procs, and it is only mediocre to decent on dexxers. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988427983659099)
- **cartography damage bonus**: Cartography increases the damage a player deals by 25% * (Effective Cartography / 100) as a multiplier against creatures from treasure map chests, trade caravans, or while on a ship, excluding followers and ship cannon damage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361298198855741)
- **codex bonuses in pvp**: Codex bonuses, stances and abilities work only in PvM and do not apply in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555582712104886275)
- **codex weapon ability hotkeys**: Codex weapon abilities have no auto-cast; to use one, bind a hotkey or macro that says [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 or [WeaponAbility3 (found under Commands > Codex > WeaponAbilityN) to activate your equipped weapon's Nth ability. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554226581063336027)
- **creature damage resistance patch**: Since the August 11, 2026 patch, creatures other than Followers, Player Ship Crewmembers and Battle Trainers have a small damage resistance that varies per creature and largely scales with their Difficulty Value. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215674681106543)
- **damage to diseased links**: Damage to Diseased links are useful on any Necromancy build (including arcane mages with necromancy, and possibly death armor or fencers) because disease application is reliable, and they are preferred over damage to bleeding links. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532496747220308238)
- **damage-to-barded links and pets**: Links bonuses such as damage to barded or diseased creatures apply only to the player who applied the effect and do not increase the damage of that player's pets or followers. A party member's bard applying barding briefly worked but stopped working in a later patch. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550542526652485634)
- **dexxer chain link priorities**: Dexxers (non-archer, non-mace weapon builds) benefit most from melee special chance and special damage links, with player damage links as a general option. Melee Damage/Ignore Armor links are less useful outside archery. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545790559317266472)
- **dragon vs monkey stance for wrestling**: Dragon stance is the recommended default wrestling stance, giving armor ignore on hits and a weapon special damage boost; Monkey may deal higher DPS against low-armor targets (roughly AR under 50), and Crab can be used when extra damage resistance is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544426910778396732)
- **eldritch aspect for summoner mages**: Eldritch is the most commonly recommended aspect for a summoner mage: it is relatively cheap, gives mana sustain through mana refund, and gives extra stats and beefier summons; Void, Death and Blood are the usual alternatives, and follower-damage builds favor Frost or Command. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553876881324118099)
- **focus and swing speed increase**: Focus is a major source of swing speed increase (SSI) and gives the most SSI per skill point, so maxing swing speed through skills such as Focus and Chivalry is preferred over SSI links, of which only about 4 gold links are needed on an archer build. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554250949252489237)
- **frost aspect**: Frost is a well-regarded, fairly cheap and well-balanced aspect that gives survivability (a protective shield, tankiness), an AOE damage proc and a damage boost once chill is stacked, and it suits melee, bard and tamer builds as an early aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553331663973392465)
- **herding crook bonus**: Herding grants bonus pet damage (roughly 15%, per one uncertain report) while you carry a Shepherd's Crook, and the bonus applies to necromancer pets; the crook may need to be in your inventory and double-clicked to activate. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554167796768833637)
- **leveling multiple codexes at once**: Multiple codexes can be leveled simultaneously, as many as the player's skills qualify for (some have extra prerequisites), with no noticeable gain-rate penalty; most builds run 2-3. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555026290556543007)
- **lightning aspect for wrestlers**: Lightning is a good, solid aspect for a wrestling build, giving strong damage and some tankiness (less than Air and more RNG-reliant), with Frost as a more defensive option and Madness as another alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550697756371451995)
- **madness archer build with lightning armor**: A common archer build pairs a Madness aspect weapon (usable on any weapon) with Lightning armor, using ignore armor, melee damage and damage to player links, 100 resists and capped swing speed, and Madness is considered the strongest archer aspect with higher burst than Lightning. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541943175411925082)
- **madness aspect**: The Madness aspect gives the highest multi-damage boost of any aspect but causes unavoidable HP loss, so it is risky and not recommended for beginners; it works best in groups with a healer, for bosses, or on the weapon only. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553328906285879307)
- **mage build types**: Mages typically choose either a summoner build, where summons tank and deal damage and a spellbook is the weapon, or an arcane mage build with no summons that casts constantly with an arcane staff; hybrid builds are generally underwhelming. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555289971643129917)
- **mage builds versus tamer**: Tamers generally farm faster than mage builds, and arcane mages only match or exceed them when the build is pushed to its limit (over 20 links, T15 arcane) at end-game. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326277475700746)
- **magery utility for tamers**: Magery is mainly a utility school for tamers: Bless buffs pets' damage and attack speed (about 5%), Curse debuffs enemies, and Magery also provides healing, arch cure/protection and self-buffs, while pets deal about 90%+ of the damage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551614316636278835)
- **melee aspect effect chance**: Melee aspect effect chance raises the proc chance of the large damage special from aspect weapons or spellbooks. It is rolled only on hits, and base per-swing proc chance is scaled by weapon speed (faster weapons lower, slower higher). Bonuses are multiplicative on a small base, so a 10% bonus turns 0.80% into 0.88%. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545066805217722459)
- **mind blast usefulness**: Mind Blast is a mana-efficient damage spell that arcane mages use when mana is low and against high-armor or high-AC targets, and it is often better than Flamestrike for sustain. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547643408430923919)
- **parrying codex requirements**: Using or leveling the Parrying codex requires a hard 80 Parrying skill, and it likely also requires 80 Tactics or Wrestling (Parrying with Macing does not qualify); without that, melee defense is the alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555276603980910685)
- **parrying without a shield**: The Parrying skill works without a shield, though equipping a shield still provides armor rating and, depending on weapon setup, damage resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534950527505272862)
- **poison dexxer build strength**: The poison dexxer build is very strong and tanky, with high poison damage from aspect and links, Alchemy health, and Parrying defense, though a nerf was announced in July and caster builds were nerfed by September while poison dexxer reportedly remained strong. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544384737320374374)
- **poison dexxer link choices**: For a poison dexxer, Poison Damage links (not the combined Poison Damage/Ignore Resist link) are preferred, followed by Damage to Poisoned and Damage Done by Player, since resist ignore comes from the poison kit and poison resist is rare on mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541742548383699025)
- **poison strike mechanics**: Poison Strike is a Necromancy spell rather than an ultimate ability; it uses poison from the spell itself, not poison applied to weapons, and the LastSpell hotkey only remembers the initial Poison spell. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549955985555202069)
- **spell aspect proc chance**: Spell aspect proc chance scales with the spell's mana cost, with a 7th circle spell as baseline; the reported formula is (mana cost / 10) + ((mana cost / 100) * aspect tier) percent, so Flamestrike at 40 mana gives about double the chance of Explosion at 20 mana. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551024342886776863)
- **spell interruption protection**: In PvM, 100 Magic Resist (Resisting Spells), 100 Inscription (Scribe), or 100 combined Arcane/Wrestling/Magery prevents spell interruption even when hit, but this does not work in PvP, where avoiding hits is the only protection. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555038008288477215)
- **summoner summon choices**: Earth elementals are the tank summon, fire elementals or daemons give melee damage, and liches give ranged damage; a standard summoner combo is earth elemental, fire elemental and summon creature, and earth elementals alone suffice for tanking in regular content. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551198126663143478)
- **tamer archer damage sources**: On archer/tamer builds, pets do most of the damage (about 90%), so the bow mainly procs abilities such as Hinder or disarm, and Herding is generally more useful than Arms Lore. A weapon that allows a shield is probably the best choice. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629304468209737)
- **tamer pet commands**: Tamers should set pets to 'all guard me' and let them draw aggro, then attack the mob (dexxers) or cast at it (mages); 'all kill' plus a target also works, but avoid it to initiate fights because it draws attention to you, and staying outside engagement range lets pets attack when you double click in war mode. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532254722520518796)
- **tamer treasure maps**: A tamer can run treasure maps effectively, especially with cartography and the new map setup, though possibly not as fast as other builds. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968357502394469)
- **tamer vs summoner strength**: Tamer is currently considered stronger than summoner overall, especially for farming, burst damage and low-to-mid progression, while summoner starts strong, has unlimited uptime, is more survivable in PvP, and is expected to match or out-damage tamer on bosses and longer fights; a tamer nerf is anticipated. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545383233401655306)
- **telekinesis and sticky explosion potions**: Telekinesis must be cast on a target before a thrown explosion potion will stick to it, the effect lasts 30 seconds and only one can be active on a target at a time, so only one alchemist can stick potions in group events; casting it on yourself prevents potion throwers from sticking a potion to you for 30 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550152093900476447)
- **tracking skill for avoiding pks**: The Tracking skill alerts you to nearby PKs so you can escape (e.g. recall) before they reach you, but it should be at 100 because lower values may fail and leave you vulnerable. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554206799509459096)
- **wizard's grimoire**: The Wizard's Grimoire lets players invest points into low-circle spells (Magic Arrow, Harm, Fireball, Lightning, plus utility such as mushroom, reactive armor, protection, reflect and mind blast) to upgrade them, giving decent damage even without Evaluating Intelligence, and mushrooms can be made to regain mana. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552227020216336427)
- **wrestling dexxer meta**: Wrestling is currently the dexxer meta after being reworked and buffed, commonly using melee special, special chance, damage and ignore-armor links with high Arms Lore and an aspect such as Madness. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536391278202200156)
- **wrestling weapon choice**: Martial manual, cestus and fistblade have identical stats, so the choice between them is cosmetic. A wrestling build still needs one of them to deal good damage, and a basic martial manual can be bought from a scribe NPC. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553017159289143448)
- **aggressive stance swing speed**: The Aggressive stance on the swords codex adds swing speed, which can reduce the need for other swing speed sources such as Magic Resist, though the exact amount (a claimed 50%) is not confirmed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555481606008086549)
- **arcane mage build**: An arcane mage is a pet-less mage build with no followers or barding, so it has nothing to tank mobs and is harder and more complex to play. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535504686084395038)
- **arcane mage mana sustain**: Arcane mage mana sustain depends on RNG procs, so low-tier arcane mages often run out of mana and must meditate between mobs, and without Meditation they struggle until Arcane Aspect is around tier 10. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547267702169665546)
- **archery codex early stance**: In the Archery Codex, Arcane stance is the recommended first focus, since it gives accuracy and damage, especially if accuracy is under 100%; take the best stance to level 5 to unlock the next stages before going for an ability, and eventually max everything. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553900970667147366)
- **armor and shield effect on mana regeneration**: Wearing plate armor greatly slows all mana regeneration (about 1-2 mana per minute with zero Meditation), and carrying a shield also impedes mana regeneration. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533522502423281864)
- **artisan aspect weapon use**: Artisan is regarded as the best weapon aspect for a solo dexxer, though any good proc is fine, and it must be equipped, not bagged, to boost crafting experience. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553151078302748742)
- **aspect choice for treasure maps**: For treasure maps, Harvest aspect is preferred for maximizing material wealth while Fortune aspect is preferred for maximizing experience; developers reportedly push using one of these two. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543697298763288666)
- **aspect weapon proc behavior**: Aspect weapon specials proc on attack attempt, so faster weapons proc more often; Command stacks its damage pool, and procs are thought to deal flat damage that bypasses damage reduction (unconfirmed). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543767342771867829)
- **backstab damage cap**: Backstab damage is capped at 10k per hit. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555328401366319217)
- **backstabber skill build**: A pre-codex backstabber build is roughly Mace, Tactics, Hiding, Stealth, Snooping and Stealing at 100 with Chivalry 90-100, and once Shadow Aspect and at least 10 points in the Thieves Codex are obtained, Tactics and Snooping (and later Stealth need) can be dropped, Macing needs only 80 and Stealth goes to 120. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532274457945702522)
- **bandage speed and dexterity**: Bandage timer speed is improved directly by Dexterity, not stamina. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532833341940830228)
- **bard summoner and bard tamer builds**: Bard summoner is a viable but less common build than bard tamer, and summoned thralls reliably hit; bard/tamer is regarded as one of the best builds for dungeon grinding. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550907957330575484)
- **bard tamer aspect procs**: Bard tamers rarely or never proc weapon aspects because they lack weapon or casting skill, though a weapon swing can occasionally proc it and the Provocation buff can compensate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554121285431197698)
- **best build for treasure maps**: Trapper is probably still the best template for treasure maps, but many builds with 120 Cartography can now run them. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541795535705604299)
- **challenger dungeon difficulty and rewards**: Challenger dungeons have harder mobs (boosted MR/AR, with HP increases not proportionate to the rewards) and give more XP and gold than normal dungeons, with loot and XP derived from difficulty. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550783849535897693)
- **chivalry damage bonuses**: Chivalry damage bonuses, including the 100 Chivalry gate bonus, are additive melee damage that stacks within the melee bucket rather than separate multipliers. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542316952456929412)
- **damage to bleeding links for arcane mage**: An arcane mage with blood armor unlocked (t10+) can use damage to bleeding links, ranked after spell aspect special chance links; ddbp links are the usual next choice, and some prefer spell charged chance/damage links. Without a set bleed, initial damage is lost, and that bonus is lost on leaving the blood aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550983298619150439)
- **dexxer power curve**: Dexxer builds start slower than tamer, summoner and some mage builds but become among the strongest damage dealers once codices, aspect and links are progressing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541439681009287301)
- **dexxer template strength and pace**: Dexxer templates are very strong but progress somewhat slower than templates like tamer, and take a long time to become strong. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531322912726843413)
- **dexxer two-handed weapons**: A two-handed weapon gives a dexxer 20% damage versus 10% damage and 10% damage reduction for a one-hander with a shield, so two-handers are generally preferred for damage, while shield setups give somewhat more durability; maces and 2h axes are suggested over swords, though swords remain viable. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213774601097307)
- **dual wield and wrestling swing speed bonus**: Dual Wield and Wrestling each have a built-in +10% swing speed increase, so characters using either can get by with fewer stat points than other weapon skills. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539632486995329114)
- **dual wield bard build**: Dual wield is a strong bard build: higher native swing speed, large Feint procs boosted by the tribard multiplier, Shank and Knave specials, and the ability to Peace and attack make it outperform wrestling; Arms Lore can help build Feint stacks faster. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555515802403217539)
- **explosion potion throwing**: Throwing explosion potions at groups of monsters gives a substantial damage boost, but missing and hitting a player turns you grey; the effect sticks to mobs but not players, so you can still throw one at a mob when a red player attacks you. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029947973996616)
- **hiking to escape pks**: Hiking (via the Atlas or camping) cannot be interrupted by PKs, so it is an effective way to escape PKs as long as you survive the hike's duration. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **lightning archer links**: A lightning archer build prioritizes melee special chance/special damage links, with melee damage or damage dealt by player, and armor ignore chance, using lightning armor and a void or lightning weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540698363849211964)
- **loot chance links dps cost**: Using loot chance links costs a large share of DPS (reported around 60%), making farming much slower, and special and rare loot links do affect drops on mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538794931915853905)
- **mana drain and mana refund cap**: Mana Drain is mainly useful for reaching the mana refund cap; once capped it gives only a small spell damage bonus via overcap and is not worth casting, and builds using Avarhide staffs may not need it to reach the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550568653257310331)
- **mana drain effect**: Mana Drain lowers the target's magic resistance, which makes it useful as a precast against harder mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551614778445660251)
- **necromancy damage boost**: Necromancy boosts the damage of necromancy summons and also adds a damage boost to spells the player casts, making it a key damage skill for summoner builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339360048554055)
- **parrying codex mirror stance**: The Parrying Codex Mirror stance reduces only magic damage taken (reported as 2% damage resistance and 6% magic resistance per tier), and although the player stats page and buffs do not display it accurately, the reduction is reported to apply. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529069212176224277)
- **plate armor suitability**: Plate armor is generally good for non-mages and for farming when not relying on mana, and for higher-tier arcane and blood aspect builds, while bone armor is adequate for a long time and lighter armor suits those wanting less AR or fearing Mindblast from PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538628393107591309)
- **plate versus leather armor choice**: Plate armor gives more protection than leather and is the best choice for nearly every character, while leather is lighter and is recommended for characters who use Meditation; this makes studded, bone and chain armor mostly obsolete. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532345259885985855)
- **poison dexxer poison kit links**: Poison dexxer kits commonly use Susceptible, Targeted (Venom) and Terminal links, with a fourth slot of Efficient or Direct Dose depending on preference; boss killers may also run 15/15 Poison Damage and Boss Damage links. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528030304462442637)
- **poison dexxer versus mage and summoner for bosses**: A poison dexxer is considered a strong boss killer, outperforming mages, and likely out-damaging summoners on bosses, while summoners are tankier and probably better for general farming; poison mage group poisoning is hampered by the multi-target poison nerf and hidden DR changes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544387483901632564)
- **sanctuary dungeon loot and xp**: Sanctuary dungeons give roughly half the loot, gold and XP of normal dungeons outside Sanctuary, though challenger dungeons beat them on XP thanks to an extra multiplier. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552719308852039702)
- **sources of accuracy**: Accuracy comes from weapon skill, aspect level, weapon quality, and Focus, with most of it coming from aspect level even at 80 weapon skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543652949941551204)
- **spell siphon buff**: When you are hit with a spell and receive the Spell Siphon buff, you gain its effects, such as bonus SSI and damage resistance, in addition to increased damage on your offensive spells. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527276900420948019)
- **spellbook wrestling special procs**: Wrestling with a spell book cannot proc melee aspect specials, since an actual wrestling weapon is needed to proc off wrestling; an aspected spellbook likely procs only from spells, using the spell aspect special chance. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539538615879606312)
- **summoner pet composition and role**: Summoners typically keep one tank pet and one damage pet up, such as Earth plus Fire, and can run an earth elemental, a fire elemental and a summon creature simultaneously; for damage use Fire Elemental plus Daemon or two Daemons, since three Earth Elementals only tank; when pets deal the damage, the summoner's role is crowd control, paralyzing enemies and blessing pets. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538121758408835112)
- **swing speed cap calculation**: To check whether you or your pets reach the swing speed cap, enter your values into the Outlands Butler swing speed tool (outlandsbutler.com/swingspeed) or follower stats calculator (outlandsbutler.com/follower-stats), since the game does not show it; factors such as delectable food and Chivalry's Divine Fury count toward swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541840091461455972)
- **tactics effect on arcane staff damage**: Tactics technically increases arcane staff projectile damage, but the bonus is very small, so stacking Tactics for bigger staff hits is not considered a viable build. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541243761718460427)
- **tactics skill and spell damage**: Tactics increases damage from melee and ranged weapons but not from spells, so it is wasted for pure casters, though it can still be used to interrupt spells. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549235694067650652)
- **tamer self-healing**: Tamers can heal themselves using Veterinary supplies, bandages, and Greater Heal potions, with Veterinary self-healing reduced in amount but still effective; bard tamers can also use music, and tamers have sticky explosion potions. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547211306526965791)
- **veterinary supplies**: Veterinary Supplies heal pets in an area of effect, making them most useful when multiple pets are taking damage, such as from AOE attacks in harder content. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974494796578929)
- **wrestling air dexxer strength**: A wrestling air (lightning aspect) dexxer is currently regarded as the strongest dexxer build, strong in PvE and decent in PvP, and it becomes decent once the codex is finished and the aspect tier is good. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545751570644471860)
- **60 magery pvp template**: A 60 Magery PvP template remains viable, offering dispel field, field and reflect, and a ranged finisher lets you tele explode. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530580061093105714)
- **air aspect for wrestlers**: The Air aspect is considered a good choice for a wrestling dexxer, especially paired with Alchemy, though switching aspects too often can stall progress. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778350491959468)
- **air wrestler links**: For an air wrestler, melee special chance/damage links come first (about 10x), and good follow-up links include melee damage/ignore armor, DDBP and damage dealt by player. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541259057313087620)
- **air wrestler links and aspects**: An Air-armor wrestler commonly uses Melee Special Chance, Melee Special Damage and damage-dealt links (with MDAI as a third-slot option), and Madness is also used as the weapon aspect with Air armor. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539287291334234203)
- **all guard pet mode**: Pets set to All Guard are in defensive mode and attack mobs that aggress against or target the player, taking aggro from mobs within about 10 tiles, though a mob still targets you if you are the only one in range, and in groups where another member holds aggro you must target the mob yourself for pets to attack. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534993238400696433)
- **all kill pet command**: The All Kill pet command has all pets attack the target the player selects, counts as an act of aggression by the player so the mob targets the player first, and the pets return to the player after the kill unless told to attack another target. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527960805004542082)
- **arcane and summons incompatibility**: Arcane mages cannot use summons, because having summons out disables Arcane and prevents arcane build-up. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545733339669864468)
- **arcane and summons incompatibility**: Arcane builds do not work alongside summons because summoned creatures generate no arcane build-up, so arcane mages do not use summons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546224519327522948)
- **arcane aspect proc mana for arcane mage**: The Arcane aspect proc, including Mana Thief, is a major mana source for an arcane mage and the build is very mana starved without it; proc-oriented builds feel better from around aspect tier 13. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540721947879542849)
- **arcane mage damage and swing speed build**: Arcane mages are mana efficient through damage output, so they benefit from a high swing speed build, with defense to mitigate damage while stationary for staff swings, and strong mana recovery (magic resist, focus, cooking) to boost procs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550988513791705239)
- **arcane mage playstyle**: An Arcane mage keeps procs and mana up by constantly moving to fresh mobs and feeding momentum so hit-based mana procs overlap; otherwise it waits on mana, with occasional 15-30 second proc gaps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399261150617720)
- **arcane mage stat allocation**: An arcane mage generally wants 100 intelligence (plus 100 strength per one player) as a mana buffer, can run much lower dexterity (around 25 early, as low as 40 for an omni build in Blood armor at full uptime), and should have Arcane, Wrestling and Evaluating Intelligence at 100 to avoid spell interruption. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529062436403937330)
- **arcane mage weapon aspects**: An arcane mage can only run Eldritch or Arcane aspects in the weapon slot, and Arcane on the arcane staff is effectively mandatory because one arcane proc gives the mana of 5-6 eldritch procs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540483736662052945)
- **arcane staff and arcane aspect**: The Arcane aspect is placed on the staff for mana procs and needs a high level (around T12) to feel decent; without a high base aspect proc chance the staff restores little mana, and it likely won't proc for non-arcane-mage characters. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533136960254775296)
- **arcane staff auto-attacks in pvp**: With an arcane staff in PvP, you can auto-attack while casting without your own casting being interrupted, but your attacks do not interrupt the opponent's casting; auto-attacks can still be used to break Paralyze. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541223236593913866)
- **arcane staff damage type**: Hits from an arcane (aspected) staff are classified as melee damage, shown as red damage, so the staff behaves as a melee weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544837583257870356)
- **archer template**: Common archer templates use 120 Chivalry, 100 Archery and 100 Tactics, with 80 Anatomy and 80 Healing; the rest varies (Arms Lore 60-80, Resisting Spells 80-100, or Focus/Alchemy). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552053109012824155)
- **archer weapon choice**: Archers should favor a fast, balanced bow or heavy crossbow-class weapon, since most proc chances scale with attack speed; high damage per hit mainly matters for backstabbing, and faster weapons consume arrows faster. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547985029651628103)
- **archery skill and accuracy**: Lowering Archery skill reduces accuracy somewhat, but a better weapon, higher aspect level, arcane stance, or shifting some Magic Resist points into Focus/Archery can compensate. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555971330749497405)
- **armor type for dexxers**: Dexxers should generally wear plate armor, using leather only if they need mana regeneration via meditation; leather suits mages, armor type matters little for PvM, and bone armor is probably best for PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550989104529932309)
- **arms lore value**: Arms Lore is regarded as valuable: it boosts DPS and is considered near-mandatory in the current PvP meta because of disarm, and 80 Arms Lore is favored over Tracking for mixed PvP/PvM builds. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553451730304507985)
- **aspect activation on weapons and spellbooks**: Activating an Aspect on a weapon or spellbook removes the aspect from all non-matching weapons and spellbooks in the backpack, and unequipped aspect items do not work, so only one weapon or spellbook aspect can be active at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527698613591871680)
- **aspect choice for summoner necromancer**: Death or Eldritch are good, inexpensive aspect choices for a necromancer or mage summoner (Death if using necromancy); Command or Frost are better but costlier, and Blood is also used. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551566877631848611)
- **aspect crystal effect on procs**: Carrying aspect crystals matching your weapon or spellbook aspect boosts damage and increases the chance of aspect procs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554634614088273933)
- **aspect effects in pvp**: Aspect effects, including Damage Bonus and procs such as lightning armor melee arc, do not work in PvP; the PvP mechanics gem in the aspect mastery menu only lists which aspect effects are not disabled during PvP, not added PvP effects. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554165858459328587)
- **aspect procs on missed attacks**: Aspect procs do not occur when your attack misses. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539677409270300742)
- **aspect special chance scaling**: Aspect special chance is scaled by weapon base speed, so fast weapons such as war forks have a low chance (for example 1.10% with Poison Aspect level 9 on an Averite War Fork); spell-based scaling is meant to use circle 8 spells (50 mana) but is reportedly bugged. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537626621463232523)
- **backstabber build viability**: The backstabber build starts slowly but becomes very strong, is relatively safe from PKs, suits solo players, and is easy for players short on time because it can hide to handle problems mid-dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551928919207313539)
- **backstabber one-shotting progression**: Backstabbers cannot one-shot strong monsters early on; reaching that point takes a long time because thief codex progress is slow while shadow aspect tier is low. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531780845961220267)
- **backstabber weapon skill choice**: A backstabber normally picks one weapon skill, and Macing is generally the best choice and recommended for new players because its damage ramps up faster, while Fencing and Archery can be viable for more progressed characters; a Macing backstabber typically takes Camping and Tracking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552765703088766997)
- **bard archer viability**: Bards are valuable from early to late game and are always needed in group content; an archer bard does modest damage (lower than melee), so lightning archer dps suits groups, provo/disco bard suits solo play, and new players often use melee instead. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542267103829033062)
- **bard reset links and lyric aspect**: Bard reset links have their own separate roll and do not stack with the lyric aspect's chance, so they work poorly on their own and overcap effective barding bonus, making them mainly useful in group play, while higher Lyric Aspect tiers grant Bard Reset. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555524524370305056)
- **bard tamer aspect procs**: Bard tamers with no combat skill sometimes use an arcane staff, harpoon, or about 20 archery mainly to gain aspect xp, but with no way to melee or cast they have essentially no chance to proc aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536694102572142693)
- **bard tamer chain link priority**: For a bard/tamer, link priority is follower damage first, then follower attack speed, then follower accuracy or effective barding links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539645802048262166)
- **bard tamer template for dungeon farming**: A bard tamer template, such as a tribard with four skills at 120 and three at 80, is a good build for farming dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523350972913680434)
- **bard tamer versus archer tamer**: A bard tamer deals roughly 20-30% more damage than an archer or melee tamer thanks to Discordance and is forgiving to play, making it the preferred option for straight farming, while an archer tamer suits all content and especially bossing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555861601981042816)
- **bard tamer xp farming build**: A bard tamer is a recommended low-risk, semi-active, low-APM build for XP farming and profitable PvM, and players often later drop Barding to 80. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551913076737966212)
- **best mage build**: The arcane mage is considered the best mage build, with many variants, and is strong for bosses when Inscription is swapped for Necromancy and Cooking for Alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545558754668449853)
- **best melee skill**: Wrestling is currently the strongest melee skill and pairs well with a cheap aspect like Air; swords were previously best until a damage calculation change removed their double-dipping bonuses. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536857477969084466)
- **boarding rope for ship boarding**: A Boarding Rope is needed to cross onto enemy or NPC mob ships. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542567108595032094)
- **broken weapon damage**: A weapon at 0 durability does less damage, so it should be repaired before use. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549781520519139349)
- **caldera's fury with no links**: Caldera's Fury treasure maps can be done with no links by using summons to absorb damage; Summoner's tome earth elementals survive long enough. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546055157715024)
- **caustic poison kit option**: The Caustic option in the Poison kit increases poison sting chance and reduces poison sting cooldown, and it likely also applies to spell poison sting since that has the same properties as melee poison sting. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544401881080537138)
- **chivalry gate ambush trick against harvesters**: Players ambush harvesters by stealthing next to a target, marking a Chivalry (Sacred Journey) gate beside them, then gating in from elsewhere; the gate cannot be seen, and players expect the trick to be nerfed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533029564723367956)
- **chivalry symbol sustain**: Passive chivalry symbol regeneration sustains Divine Fury plus one other ability, such as Consecrate Weapon, but not Divine Fury together with Enemy of One. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541706598626496532)
- **command aspect and summons**: The Command aspect affects summoned followers, improving their damage, attack speed and damage resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543012920491769986)
- **command aspect procs**: The Command aspect can proc from casting spells, including heals such as Greater Heal on pets for characters with Magery, and its proc heals your pets; other aspects require a weapon or offensive spells. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549287954759946241)
- **commanding pets to attack**: To make pets attack, say 'all kill' or 'all attack' (default keybind 3) and then target the mob, since the target is still required after the command. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536727009820733)
- **curse and mana drain with grimoire**: Curse adds spell damage and Mana Drain raises mana refund chance, but most players use neither; Mana Drain can be dropped once mana refund reaches 50%. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586088415428803)
- **dbp link meaning**: DBP stands for Damage by Player, a link type that works with everything and is considered a solid choice among the new links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547178161064771594)
- **dex tamer weapon role**: A dex tamer's weapon is used mainly for debuffs, procs and support rather than damage, because the pets provide the bulk of the damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541530912011976774)
- **dexxer and tamer power curves**: Tamers and some mage builds become strong early with few links, while dexxers do not compete until much later but become very strong at late game; at around 17 links a tamer likely still out-damages a stickmage, with dexxer and tamer scaling harder at high links and in redline. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549830617628147903)
- **dexxer aspect choices**: Madness gives massive damage but needs recovery support, Lightning and Frost offer strong survivability and good damage, and Discipline or Fire also work; madness, frost or void are more expensive, and madness armor with a fire weapon or double madness are good setups. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539819776094765158)
- **dexxer build templates**: Most dexxer builds are similar and differ mainly in weapon skill and aspect; the wiki's Dexxer templates can be adapted for dual wield by swapping in dual wielding, and most dexxers use 'damage dealt by player' rather than melee aspect chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548224655255535627)
- **dexxer definition**: A dexxer is a melee warrior-type character (sword, mace or fencing) with high or maxed dexterity, which affects weapon swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553771155939131423)
- **dexxer link priority**: For a melee or sword dexxer, the top link priority is Melee Special Chance/Damage (more specials cause more bleeds), then damage to bleeding creatures, then damage dealt by player; alternatives like poison/disease damage are used by some. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530769642631729337)
- **discipline aspect for dexxers**: The Discipline aspect is a recommended, cheap first aspect for a melee or wrestling dexxer, offering tankiness and a finisher threshold that kills mobs near 40% health, making it strong for solo farming. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553775013813952523)
- **dodging kraul hiveguard aoe**: The Kraul Hiveguard AoE triggers when its ability is off cooldown and you stay in melee range for a short while, so pull it for a few seconds and bait it in and out to learn the tell, for example by staying in melee range, counting to about 5-7, then moving out and back in; moving in and out too quickly will not trigger it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532075826487758960)
- **easiest high-level pvm build**: Players consider Tamer the easiest PvM build to play at a high level, though not necessarily the strongest, while Poison Dexer is another strong build that uses many Redline points. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521606373413093497)
- **escaping player killers**: Players can escape PKs without a PvP template by using tools such as teleport, rope, greater potions, trapped pouches, magic reflect, Wall of Stone cast before being flagged, and gates, plus knowledge of dungeon layouts and mob debuffs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548293292033310733)
- **explosion potion alchemy bonus**: The high-Alchemy benefits to explosion potions, such as automatically sticking to the target and larger explosion size and damage, apply only against creatures (PvM) and not against players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551626277474017322)
- **fencing and pet accuracy**: Fencing increases the accuracy of your pets, making it the go-to weapon skill for tamer builds unless you are an archer attacking from range. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528784354405257398)
- **finisher bonus from stances**: Raising each stance to level 5 gives your finisher a level or bonus, so leveling multiple stances to 5 maxes out the finisher. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549540333824774328)
- **flaying stance with swords and blood aspect**: Flaying stance boosts only bleeds from the swords weapon special, so it is the right bleed stance for a sword setup and works with a blood aspect weapon but adds nothing to the aspect's bleeds. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552813049910399040)
- **forensic evaluation damage bonus**: Forensic Evaluation grants bonus supplemental spell and melee damage (including archery) against creatures, calculated as 25% * (skill / 100) with a 30% maximum, added as Base Weapon Damage * bonus per swing; it gives much less in PvP and supplemental damage has caps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547073232400683050)
- **fortune aspect**: Fortune aspect gives about 20% more experience and a damage bonus, but mobs take about 50% longer to kill, so it yields more XP only if the bonus exceeds what a stronger aspect gains by killing faster. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552985403940929639)
- **fortune vs harvest aspect for treasure maps**: For treasure maps, the Fortune aspect suits XP (redline) grinding while the Harvest aspect gives more cash back if you sell the items; Fortune levels together with Harvest aspect, so Fortune users could swap to Harvest without harvesting. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537683565251141752)
- **frost aspect tier 0**: Frost Aspect at tier 0 grants a frost shell that helps any archetype avoid being one-shotted, and also gives about 28% damage after a few hits, though it is expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551890523071979575)
- **greater explosion potion cooldown**: Greater Explosion Potion has a base cooldown of about 15 seconds, reduced to about 12 seconds with max Potion Codex. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524952551114539080)
- **hiding against player killers**: Hiding and stealth are of limited use against player killers because many have tracking or detect hidden and reveal hidden players, so efficient farming and accepting occasional PK deaths is usually better. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527301563859599381)
- **lightning archer vs wrestler**: Wrestling is stronger solo and early, with better single-mob damage and pierce, while lightning archers are better in groups and at high aspect/links because they can kite, though the lightning aspect can take a while to turn on. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553585142671482982)
- **lightning armor weapon choice**: Lightning armor works best with slow, heavy-hitting weapons, so slow burst weapons are generally preferred with it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536407733996363786)
- **madness aspect proc damage**: The Madness spell aspect has a large proc, commonly 4k+ and the easiest of the aspects to push to around 10k damage, while earth, air and fire procs can also hit fairly high. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539821726874206219)
- **mage armor**: Standard mages wear leather armor because heavier armor slows mana regeneration, while arcane mages can wear plate or bone since they do not meditate, though plate requires a high Arcane Aspect tier. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549647082149912667)
