- **magic mushrooms for mana**: Magic mushrooms restore mana quickly, since there is no mana potion, and are obtained by upgrading Create Food in the Wizard's Grimoire, after which the Create Food spell can make them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583140180856893)
- **magic spellbooks and mana refund**: The mana refund chance cap is easy to reach, so magical spellbooks, which mainly add refund chance, are of little value beyond reaching the cap; a crafted spellbook is preferable after that, and the Eminently Potent prefix (15% refund) is mostly useless now. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553905854636625952)
- **mana drain refund bonus**: The Wizard's Codex Mana Drain/Mana Vampire refund bonus requires the drain spell to land unresisted (the mob shows 'hexed'), and if your mana refund is already capped, extra points in Mana Vampire only lower enemy mana refund and raise your damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549751997140303995)
- **mastery chain links against pvm**: A master chain link of 'damage to CREATURES above 66%' applies to PvM mobs while their health is above two thirds, which helps when running through dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534630411802513510)
- **melee aspect links on arcane staves**: Melee aspect special links work on Arcane staves, but the procs trigger as spell damage and are rated against magic resist when the attack lands. Spell damage links are still preferred because they raise proc chance on spells, and melee special links are probably not worth using. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545469305989234838)
- **mixed mage and summoner builds**: Mixing summon damage and mage damage in one build is possible but not optimal; the Mage-Summoner is safer than a bard build but weaker than any Bard build and is not as strong as it used to be. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551913076737966212)
- **mob kill speed efficiency**: Killing larger quantities of mobs in less time is usually better than slowly killing a few tough ones; a mob taking around 3 minutes to kill likely loses gold and exp per time, and mobs around 1k gold are usually fine depending on progression (300 to 1k for a beginner). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539241514188668969)
- **multiple weapon skill damage bonus**: Having more than one weapon skill gives a small PvM damage bonus when using one weapon skill because of the other, mainly useful in PvP for separate melee and ranged skills, and a single weapon skill gets no bonus; a third skill mainly adds accuracy with another weapon type rather than damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544542964343246908)
- **necro summoner pet roles**: For a necromancer summoner, the mummy (earth elemental) is the melee tank, the rag witch (water elemental) is the magic tank, and the lich (fire elemental) is the damage dealer; mummy and lich are the typical early pair, and later setups such as demon with fire elemental or vampire with lich are possible, with the vampire taking aggro in melee. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545995964282708079)
- **omega starspawn meteor event**: A King's Faire meteor event near 3700,3330 (by Salt Flats Crossing, north of Orange Island) spawns Omega Starspawn bosses and appears to be new this year. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540829897612861590)
- **overcapped swing speed conversion**: Swing speed above the cap converts into a damage bonus, likely flat melee damage percent like overcapped accuracy, though the wiki's exact wording is unclear. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534865875843285075)
- **paragon chest loot**: Paragon chests have a separate loot table for each level (lesser, normal, greater), and their loot resembles normal monster drops (magic items, gold, cores, occasional MCD), with occasional extras such as treasure maps or aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545188988950945822)
- **parry versus resisting spells**: In PvM, Parrying is generally the better defensive choice, as it gives a chance to parry spells and reduce damage by 75%. Resisting Spells is better for PvP, and taking both gives very high tankiness. Parry adds no damage output. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537822206183211039)
- **parrying with arcane staves**: Arcane staves count as two-handed weapons, so the Parrying skill works with them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327507434115092)
- **pk behavior toward low dungeon levels**: Many PKs tend to ignore players on dungeon levels 1-2, assuming they carry little worth taking, though this is a tendency and not a guarantee. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551735134804381769)
- **poison build link priority**: For poison builds, take straight Poison Damage first (the resist-ignore variant shares its slot), then Damage to Poisoned, then melee special chance/damage; for a poison tamer, prioritize follower damage, then follower accuracy, then damage to poisoned or melee special chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542303549558358066)
- **poison sting cooldown**: Since the August 11 patch, players can by default inflict a melee Poison Sting at most once every 5 seconds, which prevents chaining it with a fast weapon; the limit applies to melee and not to spell-based poison sting, and poison armour still gives a large bonus to effective poisoning. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544059871127928872)
- **poisoning arrows for archery**: Arrows cannot be poisoned, so poison archery builds are not viable; a lightning archer is the alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584951683711057)
- **preferred ranged heavy-hitting weapon**: Crossbows are the heavy-hitting ranged weapon, and heavy crossbow is preferred over rampart crossbow. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534950321673994260)
- **progressive spawn loot**: Progressive spawns do not have better loot rates than normal mobs, though some have a higher difficulty value that can yield better loot, and loot ownership depends on the initial hit combined with damage dealt. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547722954236887231)
- **pure dexxer build progression**: A pure dexxer is slow and fragile early because it must tank for itself and gains little bonus damage until codices and aspects are levelled, but becomes very strong late game once aspect/codex levels and swing speed are maxed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532392533546631399)
- **pvm armor choice**: In PvM, melee characters generally wear plate armor and mages wear leather, and some players wear bone armor because it is cheap to replace. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530703617764360272)
- **recommended wrestler stance**: Dragon stance is recommended for wrestling, especially against single targets, while Spider stance is recommended when fighting 3 or more targets such as AoE farming. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550860905552552088)
- **refresh potion effect**: Refresh potions (including Total Refresh, the red potion) restore stamina, which helps recover after being hamstrung. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109600338378873)
- **sanctuary dungeon loot and experience**: Sanctuary dungeons reduce loot to 66% of normal (reduced to, not by), which also applies to chest loot, and they also give less experience than normal dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552719447456743587)
- **sanctuary dungeon rates**: The Sanctuary dungeon had its drop and XP rates boosted and now gives about 66% of the normal XP and gold rate (previously 50%), with no reds and no thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522720727311188059)
- **shadow armor healing**: Shadow armor heals the wearer, reportedly with a chance to heal on a stealth step that improves as the armor's level increases. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541912590106632282)
- **sing your own praises bard codex point**: Sing Your Own Praises boosts bard song effects by 40%/120%/200% of normal for the bard and their followers, while reducing them by 20%/60%/100% for others, and it does not increase discordance on mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541926900837122249)
- **special and rare loot chance links**: Special and rare loot chance links can stack to 20 instead of the normal 10 and count toward the limit of other links in the chain, allowing up to 40% special loot chance; in a party only the highest link value among members applies, not the sum. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536418075921088593)
- **spell scroll usage**: Spell scrolls have no cooldown, and making Mana Drain or Curse scrolls gives no benefit when casting with scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554514401128620045)
- **sticky thrown explosion potions**: Thrown explosion potions require 80 alchemy or telekinesis (magery) to stick to the target mob; without it they do not stick, and if another player is nearby when one explodes you can go grey. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550417873715990530)
- **summoner build viability**: Summoner (necromancer or magery summons) is a cheap-to-kit, viable build with good damage and meatshields without the annoyance of taming, and it is the only viable caster build before 60 redline points; its gold drop amount was recently buffed. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531323589632987238)
- **summoner summon choice for damage**: Summoners who rely on summons for damage should use necromancy summons, while earth elementals are fine for those who do not care about summon damage; keeping earth elementals and skipping the mummy-conversion spell still allows Corpse Skin for extra damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547152801442824212)
- **summoner template**: Summoners are mages who fight with followers such as elementals, demons, or undead, and generally use Necromancy, with builds that are either spell-damage-focused or follower-damage-focused. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526105225390198794)
- **swing speed cap**: Swing speed can reach the cap through the right skills combined with the Divine Fury ability, delectable food buffs, or the Frenzy rune, and with Divine Fury active a Chivalry build may exceed the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544670885326364754)
- **swordsmanship bleed nerf**: Swordsmanship bleed effects, including their double-dipping, were nerfed, which made sword builds less effective relative to other builds. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529188170384801813)
- **swordsmanship viability**: Swordsmanship was nerfed and is no longer among the best melee skills, though it remains decent. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550590992950759515)
- **tamer dexxer build**: A dexxer tamer is a viable and common PvM build, with templates listed on the wiki TemplatesTamer page, and a current build uses 15/15 links for melee special chance/damage and damage dealt by player, plus Divine Fury, Consecrate Weapon, Dragon Stance and Haymaker. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553842848061726752)
- **tamer pet buffs for pvm**: Tamers commonly buff pets with Bless and Protection for PvM, and casting can proc Harvest for bonus damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525265558109683862)
- **tamer treasure map capability**: A tamer using Harvest aspect can run treasure maps up to level 6, and level 5 and below are easy even at Harvest level 1, though not fast. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545106370217517057)
- **telekinesis on self versus sticky potions**: Casting Telekinesis on yourself counters attackers' sticky explosion potions so they do not stick to you. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536898006987702365)
- **thieves codex backstab and mugging**: With the Thieves Codex active, backstabbing a monster automatically attempts to steal gold (sometimes an item) with all codex bonuses applying, and the Ransack perk allows Mugging attempts with ranged weapons up to 6 tiles away. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546985551284936774)
- **trapped pouch paralyze removal**: Opening a trapped (red) pouch deals 1 HP damage, which interrupts and removes the Paralyze effect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545656527082496170)
- **war mode and attacking**: Double-click attacking requires war mode, but hotkeys or macros that target and attack, such as attack nearest, do not need war mode; ghosts may use it to be visible for resurrection. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552686714336583793)
- **warrior stance in swords codex**: The Warrior stance in the swords codex is recommended when accuracy is below 100%, and it is also said to give a little extra defense. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541834685733146695)
- **weapon ability hotkey commands**: To bind a hotkey to a weapon ability, use the commands [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 or [WeaponAbility3 instead of the ability hotbar. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545806592669261854)
- **weapon aspect proc chance**: Weapon aspect proc chance is based on the spellbook/weapon aspect only (not armor aspect) and scales with the base weapon swing speed rather than modified speed, so more Swing Speed Increase yields more procs, and 20 points in a weapon skill gives only a small proc chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555935976357109912)
- **weapon finisher activation**: Weapon Finishers trigger automatically with a random chance once enabled and cannot be triggered at will. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093758027276359)
- **wrestler link choices**: For a wrestler, Melee Special Chance/Damage and Damage by Player links are preferred, with Melee Damage or Ignore Armor Chance as fallback in later link rows until a redline is built. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546933426748268635)
- **wrestler link recommendations**: Wrestlers are recommended to use 15/15 special chance/damage links first and then damage dealt by player (DDBP) links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539823235493797938)
- **wrestling accuracy dependence**: Wrestling relies heavily on accuracy to land combo strikes, so a wrestler should keep accuracy over 100% to avoid missing punches. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524957016353931436)
- **wrestling and damage**: Wrestling skill does not affect damage, and the damage bonus discussed applies only to the finish move, not to all hits. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527748380904787988)
- **wrestling and spell interruption**: Wrestling gives only a chance, based on your skill versus the enemy's weapon skill, to avoid melee hits and some special abilities, which indirectly reduces spell interruption from melee; it is not true interrupt prevention and does not stop interrupts from spells. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554939634134552687)
- **wrestling build aspects**: For a wrestler, almost any aspect combination is viable; Madness is the top armor aspect if you can farm comfortably in it, and Lightning, Frost, Air, Blood and Discipline are also playable. A recommended setup is Frost on armor with Madness or Void on the weapon, using 10 damage/armor ignore, 10 special chance/special damage, and 2 player damage links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541952914451599531)
- **wrestling paired weapon swing speed bonus**: Wrestling weapons carry a paired weapon type bonus of +10% swing speed, and dual wielding also provides a swing speed increase bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550710293003243655)
- **wrestling weapons and damage**: Wrestling weapons exist in Outlands (martial manual, cestus, fistblade), and wrestling is reported as top weapon-skill DPS, though Swords is described as competitive with it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555733371995562067)
- **accuracy modifiers**: Higher aspect, the Focus skill, and better weapons all improve accuracy, and magic weapons can also carry accuracy modifiers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522382865625645136)
- **active codex stance limits**: Only one codex stance, one finisher and one activated ability can be active at a time, though they can be swapped freely. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549192301501481001)
- **activities for strong players**: Strong players spend their time on dungeon grinding, boss fights, boating and boat PvM, group content, treasure maps, leveling alts, and very hard late-game dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531175983380566148)
- **agility potion effect on swing speed**: Swing speed depends on current stamina, which is capped by dex up to 100, so agility potions speed up swings only if dex is below 100 (and only slightly); at 100 dex they give no speed gain but act as a stamina-loss buffer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542328815873687642)
- **air aspect**: Air is currently a really good and cheap aspect that provides a swing speed bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532396464070987786)
- **air aspect swing speed**: The air aspect increases swing speed, all aspects reportedly increase accuracy, and better weapons also help, so air with dual weapons may be a good option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554432774188965950)
- **air elemental necromancer summoner**: Air elementals are considered a strong summon for a necromancy summoner, best in slot if they can always find two mobs to fight, and the build deals good AoE damage with herding and alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540783551908413542)
- **air elementals as summons**: Air elementals are decent summons and are great for treasure maps (tmaps). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527496467567087698)
- **air wrestler build flexibility**: The Air aspect lets a wrestler fit in considerably more defense while still reaching max swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521210306150273165)
- **air wrestler dps builds**: On air aspect wrestlers, Enemy of One outperforms Divine Fury, and 10/10/10 links with 15 Redline points in swing speed beat 15/15 Melee Special/DBP links in dummy tests (368 vs 330 DPS at 135 AR, 633 vs 604 at 65 AR). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521695880434942133)
- **air wrestler fist weapon choice**: An air wrestler build should use a fist weapon with some sort of accuracy property, and accuracy fistblades cost around 250k each. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536893665643995136)
- **alchemy replacing parrying in melee builds**: Alchemy can replace Parrying in a melee build, but it requires more active gameplay. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544130239196700672)
- **all kill command for necromancy pets**: After summoning a pet with necromancy, use the 'all kill' command and then select a target, as with a spell target, before the pet will attack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531257627991081102)
- **anatomy healing versus butler damage**: Since the Codex changes, a backstabber with Anatomy and Healing has slightly higher average damage than one putting those points into Butler, by less than 1%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541914827163705394)
- **arcane armor momentum**: Arcane armor rewards momentum, so a mage effectively has more mana while there is always a mob to attack, though the slow buildup does not matter for bosses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545468463903015013)
- **arcane aspect on arcane mage weapon**: An arcane chef mage build puts the Arcane aspect on the weapon, using a swing speed setup with blood or lightning armor aspect for bosses and farming; only arcane mages benefit from it, though it can go on a weapon aspect for most builds without much consequence on regular mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553830761898188911)
- **arcane item weapon and spellbook**: The arcane item is both a weapon and a spellbook, so arcane can be proc'd with spells even with a weapon equipped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525621704670314597)
- **arcane mage aspect dependence**: Arcane mages rely heavily on high-tier aspects and mastery chain links, including a high arcane weapon aspect and spell aspect links, to sustain mana spend, so they are slow to start, especially solo. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555292094971510866)
- **arcane mage boss damage versus tamer**: Arcane mages are considered the top single-target damage dealers on bosses, while tamers have a damage ceiling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543356064446021832)
- **arcane mage build with few links**: Players with fewer than about 20 links are advised not to run the arcane mage build, and at 16 links an arcane mage is better off not using Inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547254045561982986)
- **arcane mage early game**: Arcane mage is a rough starter template because of the cost per cast, and it stays weak until the codex is maxed and the aspect level is higher. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541265497067098232)
- **arcane mage farming setup**: Arcane mages farm well anywhere thanks to high mana regeneration and swing speed, which give many procs and good kiting; for farming, Lightning, Blood or Air aspects with spell damage and ignore resist links are preferred over gold/doubloon links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544920619135795252)
- **arcane mage link priorities**: For an Arcane Mage, Damage Dealt by Player links are prioritized over Damage to Bleeding Creatures, with damage-by-player used for links 1-10 and ignore resist chance spell damage used for links 21-30. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545456323611861112)
- **arcane mage mana management with mind blast**: Arcane mages can spam Mind Blast (or cheaper spells like Poison Strike or Energy Bolt) instead of Flamestrike to avoid mana problems, at the cost of lower damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533127951829307402)
- **arcane mage mana sustain after patches**: Arcane mage mana refund and buildup sustain were nerfed, and a later patch added a 30% mana regain that improved sustain when general farming, though many players still find it insufficient. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531334633898381504)
- **arcane mage mana thief proc**: The Mana Thief proc is widely regarded as the strongest part of the arcane mage; it requires the arcane aspect on the weapon, while armor can use Blood, Void or Lightning aspects, and aspect proc chance links are heavily relied upon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555613546572681257)
- **arcane mage playstyle**: Arcane mage is a kite-and-fight style that requires moving between casts, creating distance, meditating often early on, and buying reagents, making it more complex to learn than other mage builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587779426713672)
- **arcane mage spell rotation**: Arcane mages commonly rotate Mind Blast, Lightning and Flamestrike (Chain Lightning optional), using Mind Blast plus 3-4 low-level 15-second-cooldown spells, and chaining Flamestrike only when procs and mana allow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531334597105680605)
- **arcane mage treasure mapper build**: An arcane mage treasure mapper wearing Fortune can facetank level 6 map mobs with 20 special/rare loot links, or run about 10 gold/doubloon links for raw gold per cost, and can complete roughly 25-30 tier 4 maps per hour with fine mana. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544921418834378802)
- **arcane mage weapon requirement**: An Arcane mage build relies on an Arcane weapon, ideally T15, paired with a T15 armor aspect such as Blood, Lightning, Air, Void, Eldritch, Necro or Fortune. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549538616051630122)
- **arcane proc chance links vs damage links**: Spell aspect proc chance links are only worth running on an arcane mage at around tier 12 or higher arcane aspect; below that, damage links (such as Damage Dealt By Player) are better, and at tier 12+ spell aspect links can be split roughly 50/50 with damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545562174875762788)
- **arcane staff and material spellbooks**: Arcane users cast with an arcane staff and do not need a material spellbook, while material spellbooks are mostly meant for mages without arcane. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546668914421792931)
- **arcane staff aspect procs**: An arcane staff lets aspect special effects such as Mana Thief and Energy Surge proc on both spell casts and melee staff hits, which makes it useful for fishing for procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545458904853516288)
- **arcane staff features**: An arcane staff lets you cast while holding it without spell interrupts, can parry with Parrying skill, has its own unlockable codex with its own bonuses, and can trigger aspect procs on hit, while arcane buildup boosts spell damage and damage resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546331911922909215)
- **arcane staff use without wrestling**: An arcane staff can be equipped and aspected without arcane skill, magery or wrestling, but without wrestling you have no arcane skill, so the staff has no accuracy and the arcane codex cannot be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529865108719800402)
- **archer and dex tamer pvp survivability**: Archer Tamer and dex tamer templates have fairly limited escape and survival options in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **archer bard template**: Archer bard is a viable template that was possibly nerfed somewhat; archers must also maintain arrows or bolts, which costs less than maintaining reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609279672877076)
- **archer link priorities**: For an archer, the priority links are melee damage/ignore armor first, then player damage (DDP), then melee special chance/special damage only if the character is swing speed capped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555588328923996293)
- **archer mage pvp viability**: Archer mage is no longer as viable in PvP because bows now apply a cooldown to shooting after standing still, causing loss of range when running. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534974638231392386)
- **archer swords dexxer build**: An archery plus swordsmanship dexxer build trades damage for survivability, is solid for PvP in small numbers but weak against zergs, and is not great for PvM. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555270946254749737)
- **archer tamer dragon pairings**: For an archer tamer wanting dragons, an ember drake plus an ember dragon is a reasonable starting pair, and a drowned dragon and ruby wyrmling can be usable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537892524356534272)
- **archery and melee armor ignore links**: Melee armor ignore links also apply to archery weapons because archery counts as melee (physical) damage, so archers using T15 Madness Armor should pick the 'melee damage / ignore armor 100%' link. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543776720262266910)
- **archery codex abilities**: The archery codex lets archery get free accuracy or longshot, plus hinder stance and a move-and-shoot ability, and longshot is useful in group content, especially with ranged pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541537193439531130)
- **archery codex fowling for tamers**: In the Archery Codex, Fowling reduces the damage you take, which makes the codex somewhat better for tamers whose followers do most of the damage, though it was previously single-target damage reduction. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554434683431817299)
- **archery codex stance switching**: You can switch Archery Codex stances mid-combat, and only one stance is active at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537015888857923694)
- **archery in dexxer pk builds**: A dexxer PK build should include archery, because lacking a ranged weapon dramatically reduces kill potential and archery provides range. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535497954591383592)
- **archery melee classification**: Archery and other ranged weapons such as throwing count as melee in Outlands, so they benefit from anything that grants +melee. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532723719447777422)
- **archery weapon special hinder**: The archery weapon special Hinder pauses a mob for about 8 seconds, giving a break from healing it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541533656588488815)
- **area taunt macro**: Using [taunt and then targeting yourself performs an area-of-effect taunt that pulls every mob that sees it to you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820249063690311)
- **area-of-effect spells hitting other players**: Area-of-effect spells such as Mass Lightning hit other players near the target when cast on monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530378184258752654)
- **armor effect on mind blast damage**: Wearing heavier or higher-rated armor such as plate causes you to take more damage from the Mind Blast spell. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534375645260283964)
- **armor rating for dexxers**: High armor rating is crucial for a sustainable dexxer build, and a wrestling dexxer should wear full plate armor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539073341736886302)
- **arms lore for archers**: Arms Lore increases an archer's hinder chance and accuracy, so as aspect level and accuracy rise an archer can lower Archery and raise Arms Lore. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552866482113876029)
- **aspect level 1 dungeon safety**: At aspect level 1 you should be fine at most dungeons until you reach aspect level 3 or 5, but newbies should avoid Kraul, SSC and Tidal at level 1. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532687767543353494)
- **aspect on armor**: Aspect increases armor rating, and the aspect on armor is typically much more impactful than the aspect on the held item. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554562866105942074)
- **aspect proc spells for pet damage necro**: A death necromancer running full pet damage should still cast spells on mobs to gain aspect proc chances, even though the spells add almost no DPS; one suggested set is Protection, Bless, Lightning, Fireball, Magic Arrow, Mind Blast, Harm and Greater Heal, without Flame Strike. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551614165184151753)
- **aspect procs from spells**: Aspect special procs can trigger from spells without holding a spellbook, and they reportedly trigger far more often on spells, though this is uncertain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534599963248427158)
- **aspects and dungeon survival**: Aspects help substantially with dungeon survival, even for thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526567386734526485)
- **attack speed with redline and air aspect**: With the Redline and Air Aspect, a character can reach 70 attack speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552326445601390613)
- **auto attack targeting**: Auto attack starts only on the first mob that aggros you while you are out of combat, so if multiple mobs engage you must choose later targets manually, and toggling war mode and back to peace is the only way to stop it once started. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542079732840005672)
- **avarite weapon stats**: Avarite weapons are tuned for high weapon skill mobs such as level 4 mobs or daemons, and are said to give roughly +19 tactics and +12 accuracy, similar to common farming setups. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535796674813763734)
- **backstab against players**: Backstab gives no bonus damage against players; it only plays the sound effect, and the bonus damage applies only in PvM. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527388753956573194)
- **backstab archer template**: Backstab archer requires giving up bard skills and is slow at first, but with enough progression backstab one-shots most mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615572525711491)
- **backstab damage bonuses**: Camping, Tracking, and Forensics each add to backstab damage, with Forensics giving 25% at 100 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532274596365996032)
- **backstab group play**: Backstabbing characters are mostly solo players because stealthed players cannot see each other; a backstab archer is more group friendly than melee since it does not need to run up to the mob. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536077088895803422)
- **backstabber build farming**: The Backstabber build is considered fun and is pretty easy to farm with. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521526523545387229)
- **backstabber healing options**: Backstabbers can heal with potions or take a healing skill early until they can drop Snooping and similar skills, and once they have the Shadow aspect they have a chance to heal when stepping into stealth. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542062782030282815)
- **backstabber pk template**: A template built heavily around backstabbing is weak for PKing in Outlands, and Arms Lore and Swordsmanship are no longer good choices for a stabby build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532473639885082756)
- **backstabber weapon choice**: A War Hammer is a solid weapon for a backstabber build because it is slow with high damage; burst-type weapons or a quarterstaff are also recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548581866204823642)
- **backstabber weapon choice**: A mace is the preferred weapon for the Backstabber template because you only hit once per backstab, so you want maximum damage per hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524329421887115304)
- **backstabber weapon choice**: A backstabber's backstab damage scales with weapon speed, so slower weapons hit harder, and because backstab swings are rare with long delays the heaviest, hardest-hitting weapon such as a halberd is preferred. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526152459079123065)
- **bandage self macro**: To bandage yourself without manual targeting, open the in-game Options > Macros menu, create a new macro with the "bandageself" action, and bind it to a key. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529237737704652973)
- **bard break effect**: Bard break makes affected mobs swing slower and deal less damage to allies, and bards gain bonuses against mobs that bard break, though very hard mobs may not be fully lockable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548802347382218997)
- **bard codex upgrades and tamed followers**: Bard codex upgrades such as Ensemble do not give their damage bonus to a tamer's tamed followers, and effects that do not explicitly mention followers generally do not apply to them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546629265901223986)
- **bard dexxer template**: A bard dexxer can use Peacemaking (and later Provocation) while meleeing, which makes it fairly safe, but it is also the toughest new-player template because no follower tanks for you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525866138255360202)
- **bard finisher source**: A finisher comes from the equipped weapon (or a shield), so bards do not get a dedicated finisher. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534995537663627334)
- **bard paladin wrestler abilities**: A bard paladin wrestler can set Consecrate and Divine Fury on auto and punch continuously; Consecrate is still considered good with wrestling after the sword nerf. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520940397520617613)
- **bard pvp viability**: Bards are generally not viable for PvP; killing a PK as a bard is the exception rather than the rule. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528944881488363583)
- **bard skill on tamers**: Bard tamers mainly use the bard skill for its song buffs, applied by using the skill and targeting the ground; at 80 skill a 20% buff is reduced to 16%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528189944215109734)
- **bard song buff targets**: Bard song buffs apply to the bard, their party, and nearby allies (even if not partied), but not to random unaffiliated players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292651116961833)
- **bard song targets**: Bard songs buff both the player and their followers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541926399173206196)
- **bard tamer role**: A bard/tamer's role is mainly Discordance or Provocation, sometimes also Peacemaking, and it can aspect a weapon and try to hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529343859824394280)
- **bard templates in pvm**: Bard templates are currently very strong for PvM, and almost any bard build is viable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532718586047758367)
- **bard with melee skill solo build**: A Bard paired with a melee skill is a fun solo-farming build, and it can be used to work up the Bard Codex. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542187679322742895)
- **base weapon special proc chance**: With 0 Arms Lore, a weapon special has a base proc chance of 10%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527087626111160332)
- **best aspects for wrestler dexxers**: Madness and Lightning aspects do the most damage for wrestler dexxers, Air is the most versatile, Discipline is decent, and Holy is also viable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522809648930095155)
- **best character setup for tmap**: A tamer or trapper echo with Cartography is a suitable setup for the new tmap system, with the tamer considered stronger, though the trapper may benefit more from the Cartography buff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532107609455460466)
- **best summoner summon combination for damage**: Two Fire Elementals deal the most summon DPS, and Fire Elemental plus Daemon beats Fire Elemental plus Mummy because the Daemon deals magical damage that the Fire Elemental shreds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532356081781571767)
- **best tamer aspect**: Command is the best all-around tamer aspect, being best for farming, while Frost is best for bossing and Fortune and Water also have uses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547206806533705818)
- **best weapons for item id builds**: For Item ID builds, vanquishing weapons deal the most damage, and supreme vanquishing greater dungeon slayers would be ideal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522809872687829044)
- **best wrestling weapon ability**: Haymaker is the recommended weapon ability for single-target damage when playing a wrestler. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540578502653517885)
- **bleed damage scaling**: Sword bleeds and Blood aspect bleeds scale with the damage of the hit that applies them, so higher base damage weapons give stronger bleeds and more applications from a low-damage weapon like a katana are not necessarily better; the Blood multiplier no longer double-dips with bleed damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537133360621813770)
- **bleed damage tick interval**: Bleed damage, including that from the Swordsmanship weapon special, is dealt in ticks every 3 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544431321567338588)
- **bleed links versus player damage links**: 10 gold bleed links give only about 3% more damage than 10 gold damage-dealt-by-player links, and bleed links are not active immediately and require Blood armor, so player damage links are generally better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527774169733791804)
- **bleed out versus execute finisher**: When Execute is not killing targets, as is likely for newer players, Bleed Out is the better swords finisher. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534583245944131644)
- **bleed stacking**: Bleeds can stack, including a sword bleed from a crushing hit and a Blood aspect bleed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543386756567797881)
- **bleed stacking on mobs**: There is no known limit to how many bleeds can be applied to the same mob at once beyond cooldowns and bleed duration, and at least 17 stacks have been observed on a single mob. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532594657836666911)
- **blood armor for arcane mage**: Blood Armor and the arcane staff are recommended gear for an arcane mage; Blood Armor is best in slot, boosts damage and mana, and lets the build run about 40 dex and 85 int. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683374316093454)
- **blood aspect with swordsmanship**: Swordsmanship is recommended for a Blood Aspect build, both for the finisher and for the bleeds a sword dexxer gets from it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545664500412448799)
- **blood versus lightning aspect armor**: Blood aspect armor gives the best and most consistent mana sustain and is best for bosses, while lightning aspect armor gives very high damage and is the most scalable aspect for farming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551074394594615334)
- **boat passenger roles and xp**: Two people can be on a boat; a non-captain can only heal themselves, and receives party XP for the captain killing mobs but not for the captain sinking ships. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548377442945597511)
- **boss access without a guild**: Without a guild you can only take part in a boss fight if you find a natural or contested spawn, though bosses can also be bought from guilds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539287477364330677)
- **bow ammunition without quiver**: A bow can fire arrows carried in your backpack, so a quiver is not required to use a bow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542550069985939456)
- **bow average dps comparison**: Average DPS is about 10.07 (15.105 with the 1.5x two-handed bonus) for a light grind 2H bow, 9.33 (11.66 with 1.25x) for a medium grind 1H bow, and 8.27 (12.4 with 1.5x) for a burst 2H bow; the burst-to-medium gap is about 12.8% raw, so with roughly 200%+ in the additive bucket the burst bow is not better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527022654899486862)
- **calling guards on thieves**: You can call guards against a thief by typing 'guards' in chat, ideally while running toward the town center, and NPCs often witness the theft themselves, though there are blind spots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555020929581719575)
- **cartography damage bonus scope**: The Cartography damage bonus applies only to mobs spawned from treasure map chests or on the ocean, and gives nothing against regular land mobs or non-chest creatures on land maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537472635854659646)
- **cartography damage bonus vs chest monsters**: In the test patch, Cartography grants a damage bonus (reported as 25%) against treasure chest monsters, letting a player at 120 Cartography kill Message in a Bottle treasure map mobs roughly twice as fast. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531404944819749008)
- **casting and attacking at set target**: To cast a spell at your set target, use the Last Target command when the targeting cursor appears; to attack with a weapon, use Attack Last Target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548100814042702007)
- **casting with a shield equipped**: Casting spells with a shield equipped unequips the shield unless you have Parrying and at least 80 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551065450983723119)
- **chain lightning friendly fire**: Chain Lightning can hit guild followers, so it should only be used when alone or away from the group. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545560860041289728)
- **chain links for damage-to-disease casters**: A caster who mostly does damage to disease should get 10 of the relevant chain links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521630555093864640)
- **checking whether weapon skill can drop to 80**: To decide whether weapon skill can be dropped to 80, enter your build, weapon aspect and the mobs you fight into the Outlands Butler accuracy calculator and confirm you still get 100% accuracy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553052981761671530)
- **chill debuff effect**: The Chill debuff increases all damage the target takes from you and your followers, including pet damage and Frost aspect damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542524233400459294)
- **chivalry abilities**: Chivalry provides Divine Fury for swing speed and damage bonuses, gate travel, and an emergency heal; the common approach is to auto-enable Divine Fury and use other abilities such as Consecrate Weapon as needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553149212852621417)
- **chivalry benefits**: Chivalry provides a single target heal usable on anyone including yourself, an AOE heal, offensive abilities, increased swing speed and damage, bleeds, and defensive abilities against poison, bleed and disease. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554814296595365929)
- **chivalry dexxer build**: A typical chivalry dexxer build uses 120 Chivalry, 100 Tactics, 80-100 in the weapon skill, and 80 each in Healing, Anatomy and Arms Lore, usually with 80 Parrying plus Focus or Alchemy, with stats at 100 Str, 100 Dex and 25 Int because the Str and Dex cap is 100. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555428454235775138)
- **chivalry during pvp**: Chivalry is almost completely disabled while a player is being attacked in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532544242524750056)
- **chivalry swing speed**: Chivalry increases swing speed, so a character that can survive on Chivalry alone deals better damage than one that relies on healing and anatomy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552027933596455053)
- **chivalry with discipline aspect**: With the Discipline aspect, Chivalry is pretty much required to reach maximum swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522778437788500029)
- **classic dexxer and melee poisoner builds**: The classic dexxer and classic melee poisoner builds remain very good, with the poison dexxer only slightly nerfed by the latest patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534416446170599525)
- **cleave attack hit count**: Cleave counts as a single hit with some bonus damage applied to the side, not as a double hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549572275714531479)
- **codex abilities in pvp**: Codex abilities do not work in PvP, so codex should not be relied on for PvP and a PvP character gains nothing from it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554602446242971789)
- **codex and pressure points on ranged damage**: Healing Codex and Pressure Points apply to ranged weapon (bow and throwing) damage, because all physical damage, including ranged, counts as melee damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547697561203380255)
- **codex finishers**: Codex abilities are activated manually, while Finishers trigger randomly with a higher chance when the enemy is at low health, from about 5% health at rank 1 up to 25% at rank 5. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549955985555202069)
- **combining aspect effects**: Different aspect effects can be combined, such as Frost Shell from Frost Aspect on armor together with the Command inspiration spell from Command Aspect on a spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526607778049691799)
- **command versus frost aspect**: Command and Frost aspects deal nearly the same damage per second, but Command is better against multiple mobs because its damage resistance is always active, while Frost must stack chill to get its resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553580814644682793)
- **corpse skin disease application**: Necromancy's Corpse Skin applies disease with damage spells, including field spells, so it is desirable when casting for damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541958039987429467)
- **crafted vs magic spellbook preference**: Crafted (material) spellbooks are generally preferred over looted magic spellbooks because of their mana regen, with magic books mainly worthwhile for daemonic on omnis or certain modifiers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531007914565832946)
- **current dexxer build**: The current dexxer meta uses Wrestling instead of Mace Fighting, for example on a bard build, with air, madness, and lightning armor aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551928919207313539)
- **curse and poison damage**: Curse does not increase poison damage, including poison sting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551002610733949051)
- **curse value for mages**: Curse gives about a 25% additive damage increase (roughly 10-12% extra spell damage), so it only pays off over several casts; for farming, an extra damaging spell such as lightning, mind blast or Fireball's damage over time may be as good or better. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546985370925793352)
- **damage cap and bonus stacking**: Damage bonuses such as Forensic Evaluation and Camping stack in PvM, and the damage cap applies only in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533500308699742483)
- **damage links and poison damage**: Damage-to-poison links do not work for pets, and damage-to-bosses links likely do not boost poison damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543690871671758929)
- **damage loss from dropping skills on dexxer builds**: Dropping Anatomy/Healing on a poison dexxer costs some damage and swing speed, and a wrestling dexxer build loses a lot of damage without Chivalry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524178702995554364)
- **damage to bleeding creatures link**: The damage to bleeding creatures link is multiplicative and generally outperforms an additive melee damage link when you have other melee damage sources and can reliably stack bleeds, despite a lower listed percentage; it likely multiplies melee hits and special damage, but whether it affects aspect procs is uncertain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540436250463436810)
- **damage to bleeding mastery link**: Damage to Bleeding and Damage to Disease creature chain links can share a mastery chain, and sword users can use damage to bleeding instead of damage dealt by player, which is stronger against bleeding targets but less flexible. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555482088571146271)
- **death aspect for summoners**: Death aspect restores a lot of mana and is a cheaper useful option for a Summoner, while Wither can also supply mana for summoning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527554608455749703)
- **death aspect value**: The Death aspect is considered great for its cost and is reportedly the highest-parsing suit in the game for bosses, though it is not A tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521594693815898338)
- **death weapon proc consumption with poison strike**: On live and on test center, you can use Poison Strike to consume a Death aspect weapon proc and deal big damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532182854329700595)
- **dedicated tank requirement**: Time content uses a dedicated tank, while a dedicated tank is not really needed for non-Time content. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541468821490110476)
- **demon and thrall scaling over time**: Demons and thralls grow stronger the longer they stay alive, but also become squishier as they age. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530668530637209660)
- **detonating trapper traps**: Ground traps placed by a Trapper can be detonated with the [DetonateTrap command, which can be bound to a say macro, hotkey or on-screen button, or by double-clicking the detonator. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521316217414225950)
- **dexxer accuracy target for 3s and 4s farming**: A dexxer farming mostly 3s and 4s should have accuracy above 100%. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531147455314395266)
- **dexxer build options**: Fencing dexxer builds are hard to make work; alternatives include Wrestling as the weapon skill with Discipline aspect and Melee Special Chance/Damage links, often with Arms Lore or Parry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541058000880406591)
- **dexxer codex choices**: Dexxers typically use the Healer's codex plus the codex for their weapon (for example Swordsmanship for axes), and most add either Parrying or Alchemy depending on build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555315428409085963)
- **dexxer mastery chain links**: For dexxer builds, popular mastery chain links are melee special, melee damage (damage dealt by player) and ignore armor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555476330693402657)
- **dexxer ranged weapon use**: A dexxer can use ranged weapons as an archer, and ranged weapons are also effective for attacking moving players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **dexxer swing speed cap**: Swing speed is the most important stat for a dexxer, and builds should aim to reach the swing speed cap; higher Focus may help early since reaching the cap through links takes a while. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529303961675239475)
- **dexxer tamer playstyle**: A dexxer tamer uses a weapon to help pets kill mobs, fishing for more procs and adding some melee damage, and depending on the weapon special can benefit its pets, while a mage tamer uses spells instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552223304360788060)
- **dexxer templates for water aspect**: Both wrestling and archer dexxer templates are viable, and wrestler dexxer is a template that pairs with the Water aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548453298263298242)
- **disarm command toggle**: The [disarm command toggles the Disarm weapon ability on and off, so it can fall out of sync with Hamstring when switching weapons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527364996709879828)
- **disarm effect**: Disarm removes anything equipped in the hands, including shields. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551720225429266473)
- **discordance and provocation effects**: Discordance debuffs enemies so they take about 16.67% more damage, while the Provocation song gives players a +5% damage buff, so Discordance is often preferred over Provocation when debuffing enemies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553158714666782801)
- **disease damage stacking**: The disease damage-over-time effect stacks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527013925860675746)
- **dispel field versus gates**: The Dispel Field spell can dispel moongates and gates, and players script it as a macro for this purpose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536527078042767440)
- **divine fury auto-activation**: Divine Fury auto-activates only while you are in combat (aggro on you or after you perform an aggressive action); after a period of inactivity you go passive and must attack again to trigger it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539426347972296734)
- **dragon stance armor ignore**: Dragon stance grants armor ignore, so separate armor ignore links are redundant with it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527037039407665183)
- **dual wield and throwing viability**: Dual wielding and throwing are widely considered weaker build choices than wrestling or archery, with throwing seen as needing buffs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551035211872079954)
- **dungeon mob kill speed after patch**: After the recent patch, dungeon mobs take roughly 20% longer to kill, reportedly because of a hidden damage reduction tied to mob difficulty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537983189459537930)
- **dungeon moongate after attacking a red**: After you attack a red (murderer) player, the combat timer prevents you from using the dungeon moongate until it expires. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532057323432837341)
- **dungeon pet setups**: Manticore and bonehorn are preferred over a strider and 2 oozis as dungeon-running pets, and 5 cryptwings also work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539661437511933992)
- **early accuracy solution**: At lower aspect tiers, accuracy problems can be solved by using a surpassingly, eminently or supremely accurate weapon until reaching a higher tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544673486612471910)
- **earth elementals as tanks**: Earth elementals work well as tanks and strong aggro pullers, letting a summoner stand back and spam spells. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529034470890672148)
- **energy bolt usage for mages**: Energy Bolt is useful for mage mana sustain while farming, best used as mobs are about to die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546979352271519845)
- **escaping pkers with recall macro**: Keep a runebook with a rune set to a safe spot in town and a stock of recall scrolls, and make a macro (such as [recall to that rune) so a single button recalls you to safety when attacked by PKers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554335571948732417)
- **evil omen damage bonus**: Evil Omen can be used as an additive spell damage boost, but a 20% additive bonus yields only about 8% extra damage when other damage sources exist, and it has a drawback and requires switching d2d links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328072859975722)
- **explosion potion damage for trapper alchemist**: Explosion potion damage on a trapper alchemist depends on links, using trap links and damage done by player links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525571739583778847)
- **explosion potion damage on bard builds**: Damage to barded on chain is the best way to increase explosion potion damage besides discordance on the mob and high Alchemy with a codex, and explosion potions are complementary damage on a dexxer bard build, so a bard build relying on them as main damage is a support build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549103744862650500)
- **explosion potions**: Explosion potions are very effective in PvM but deal much less damage in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553928938269446276)
- **explosive potion area damage**: Without the sticky effect, explosive potions are area-of-effect and can hit nearby players, which flags you criminal, and mobs may move away from the explosion. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550419149950418975)
- **fishing for tamer command procs**: Tamers can fish for command procs by casting damage spells or beneficial spells on pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542910352734425158)
