- **fist blade and war axe weapon types**: The Fist Blade is not classed as a bladed weapon, and the War Axe is not classed as an Axe. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539511451973320704)
- **follower attack speed bonus cap**: Follower attack speed bonuses, including those from links, are capped at 50% per pet by default, though this is not certain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526456200001224774)
- **follower attack speed link overflow**: When a follower attack speed link exceeds its limit, the excess transfers to follower damage rather than player damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534364356849041589)
- **follower slot usage for tamers**: There is no benefit to using fewer follower slots; tamers should fill all their follower slots, since running a single low-slot pet slows them down considerably and gives no bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525542326691303424)
- **food buffs for arcane mage**: Food is a strong, inexpensive buff for Arcane mage builds, providing both a mana regeneration buff and a swing speed buff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545337420399116349)
- **frost armor attack speed cap**: Frost armor does not cap summon attack speed without the heavy lifting of links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528976517701308486)
- **frost aspect on bard gear**: Frost Aspect on a bard's crook has no effect, and Frost on a weapon does next to nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533519943432143069)
- **full pvm versus hybrid pvm/pvp build**: For gold per hour and character progression, running a full PvM build and occasionally dying to PKs is considered better than running a hybrid PvM/PvP build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548298178783084668)
- **gear risk rule for dexxers**: Players should only carry equipment they can readily afford to replace; dexxers often use crafted gear at whatever tier they are willing to lose (avarite/vanq being the most expensive), and power/vanq weapons are usually used only with item identification. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525624230677577862)
- **giant black widow pets**: Giant Black Widows are currently the top kill job, the top tame job and one of the hottest pets, and are good for farming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554487519641346130)
- **gold links for pvm dexxers**: The two most universal gold links for PvM dexxers are melee special chance/damage and damage dealt by player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527621316918644878)
- **gold looting and overweight**: Looting gold can make a player overweight quickly, so the time spent running back to unload can exceed the time spent killing mobs, which is why some players skip looting gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524140579133329630)
- **greater heal heal-over-time in pvp**: The heal-over-time effect from Greater Heal comes from a codex that is disabled in PVP, so the healing ticks do not work once PVP has begun. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532073482005778773)
- **grey flagging at sea**: At sea in Outlands, players are effectively grey (flagged to each other) because the region boats float in is lawless, although the nearby dock land is not lawless. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526315121310433290)
- **guild and alliance boss runs**: Guilds and alliances commonly run bosses together in large packs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546192056173469807)
- **hamstring effect**: Hamstring reduces the target's stamina to zero for 3 seconds, so the target can only walk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538939203864232016)
- **harvest vs fortune on treasure map characters**: On a treasure map character, Harvest yields more profit while Fortune gives more XP and is favored when core and rare prices are low; most players choose Fortune for XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538949300548149289)
- **harvester pk target selection**: Harvester-killing reds typically cannot kill players who fight back, so they target softer harvesters who do not resist. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549790323775905883)
- **healer talents marked cannot stack**: Healer talents marked '(cannot stack)', such as Combat Medic and Triage, can both be used: one applies its damage resistance buff during healing and the other after, and the same buff does not stack on itself but only refreshes its duration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537575356704362608)
- **healer's codex options for tamers**: Tamers, including Bard Tamers, are recommended to run the Healer's Codex options Without Borders (range healing), Triage, Specialist and Overheal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554784778614603809)
- **healing necromancer summons**: Summoned creatures can be healed with the necromancer healing ability or Greater Heal, but healing them matters less than for tamed pets because they can be resummoned with Wither. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526530975847288943)
- **healing summons**: A summoner or necromancer template generally does not heal its summons, since little other than the necromancer heal works on them; it is better to resummon and keep dealing damage than to spend time or vet kits healing them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547784750708695092)
- **herding crook summon buff**: Carrying a herding crook (herding skill) buffs summoned creatures by increasing their damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530693294777176074)
- **holy aspect armor swing speed**: Holy Aspect Armor increases swing speed only through Divine Fury, and with Divine Fury players report roughly 45% attack speed without Aggressive stance at around T14. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532796653226950727)
- **holy aspect armor tradeoff**: Holy is a defensive armor aspect that is safer but kills more slowly than DPS-focused aspects such as blood or fire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548724267925897237)
- **hybrid pvp pvm templates**: Hybrid PvP/PvM templates are generally poor at both, spending points that would help PvE, while pure PvM templates generally lack ways to fight back against players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554926475914911888)
- **ignore armor links versus damage links**: Ignore armor links are considered poor because they are not multiplicative damage, whereas damage dealt by player links are multiplicative and preferred. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527005888274239698)
- **invisibility and escaping pks**: Invisibility ends when you move, so escaping PKs by staying unseen requires the hiding and stealth skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553509622004973652)
- **invulnerability cap armor**: The Invulnerability cap is better than the normal leather cap and gives more AR, though less than a platemail helmet. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535847094429155352)
- **kraul hive**: Kraul Hive level 1 has 6 gates for escaping PKs and gives good experience and gold but has stealth backstab mobs, while level 2 and beyond is very dangerous for new players, with level 3 mobs dropping about 2-3k gold each. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553537792360054787)
- **kraul hive difficulty**: Kraul Hive is one of the hardest regular-content dungeons; characters with around 80 skill levels should choose a different sanctuary dungeon, follower templates (tamer or summoner) can try it but it is risky, and dexxers should avoid it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554450202960855092)
- **kraul hive vinekin threat to tamers**: Vinekin in Kraul Hive hit fairly hard but pose little threat to a tamer, especially a bard tamer with higher defense. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078509781024880)
- **lightning armor aspect effects**: The Lightning armor aspect provides hinder effects and a shield, which reduces the healing needed and leaves more mana for damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551045762194997289)
- **lightning armor aspect for arcane mage**: The lightning armor aspect is considered very strong for an arcane mage, as its many lightning hinders allow lighter armor than plate for slightly more mana regen, and it can out-damage many lightning archers in groups. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544400918513197067)
- **link slot allocation for farming**: For farming efficiency, link slots are generally better spent on follower damage and attack speed than on increasing drop rates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536418739501801622)
- **loot quality from higher difficulty enemies**: Higher-difficulty enemies have a better loot chance, and magic gear and rare loot dropped by them have better chances of rolling better modifiers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539241560829337710)
- **loot rights when sharing a monster**: When multiple players fight the same monster, the player who deals more damage gets loot rights, but the first attacker gets a bonus of about +15%, so a later player needs roughly 40% of the damage to claim the loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547411602490523700)
- **mace backstabber weapon requirement**: A backstabber template using Mace skill needs a magic weapon to function; one suggested setup uses a magic weapon with Force and two-handed, with Item ID in the build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532274784220479628)
- **mace codex wild swing for backstabbers**: The mace codex's Wild Swing ability adds accuracy, which makes maces a strong choice for Assassin Backstabbers and the first mace codex unlock for them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554842501259731046)
- **madness aspect for archers**: Madness aspect is a good choice for archers, including as a swap if AoE aspects become an issue in group content, though weapon aspect choice matters less than leveling quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988221011529801)
- **madness aspect weapon buff**: The Madness aspect weapon was buffed with more damage and much less damage taken, after an earlier nerf, and is now considered S-tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527864724669337680)
- **madness weapon for archers and wrestlers**: A weapon with the Madness aspect is considered a good choice for archers and wrestlers, largely because of its damage proc. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538220103827591248)
- **mage armor choice**: Mages who rely on mana should wear leather armor, while mages who do not use mana can wear plate; a new mage with mana problems can use armor with less mana penalty than full plate, such as bone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **mage armor choice**: Mages should wear only leather armor, because other armor types reduce mana regeneration (one author says it goes negative). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538130927836860457)
- **mage melee and kiting**: Mages should not melee while casting and are better off kiting, and magic skills do not increase melee skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526172553314439319)
- **mage spell damage bonuses**: Even fresh mages already have spell damage bonuses from Evaluating Intelligence, their aspect, their staff, and their spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328428549410856)
- **magery requirement for elemental summons**: Reliably summoning elementals, such as earth and fire elementals, requires 100 Magery and a full spellbook, which can be bought from player vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553401091134202037)
- **magic reflection spell**: Magery provides the Magic Reflection spell, which is useful as protection against PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530558044688224427)
- **magic resist potions and skill stacking**: Magic resist (black) potions work in conjunction with the Magic Resist skill in PvM, where casters use them, but they do not replace the skill and do not stack with it in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531325888963153981)
- **maiming special for archers**: The Maiming special is not terrible for archers but is not better than ignoring it entirely, and it performs worse than Longshot or Arcane Shot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533353501722153010)
- **manual triggering of disarm and hamstring**: Disarm and Hamstring can be triggered manually instead of auto-firing, letting you save Disarm for stacking damage at the start of a fight and save Hamstring to lock down a mob that is beating you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542875448147578880)
- **maus dungeon**: Maus is a dungeon whose monsters are stitched-together body parts, many of which can inflict disease, and Maus 1 is very small. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529193676734070792)
- **melee armor ignore**: Melee armor ignore is the percent chance for an attack to be an 'armor ignore' hit, which ignores all of a mob's armor down to its minimum cap (e.g. 20% gives a 20% chance per attack). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541186701135716352)
- **melee aspect modifier**: The melee aspect modifier on chain links increases the effect of your melee aspect proc, such as more damage or a stronger buff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538996299305721997)
- **melee defense scope**: Melee defense only applies to a mob's normal melee attacks; its special abilities and spells will still hit you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531702287410532635)
- **melee defense sources**: Melee defense comes mainly from weapon skill, with additional defense from focus and from links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531697969877749770)
- **melee dexxer weapon choice**: For melee dexxers, the weapon's speed class matters more than anything else, and swords is reported to give the highest DPS among melee weapon skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535497931065663638)
- **melee special chance and water aspect**: Melee special chance links combo with the Water aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539140407500349480)
- **message in a bottle gameplay and rewards**: Message in a Bottle (MIB) gameplay has a low barrier to entry, is very safe once learned, and needs no manual sorting; rewards include all normal special and rare loot, but much of the profit comes from ship upgrades and crew rather than loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212813086326865)
- **metabolism perks pet self-healing**: Metabolism perks let pets self-heal, but they are not very self-sufficient; they cope with random wilderness mobs but not dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528789717796257873)
- **mind rot effect on damage over time**: Mind Rot increases the damage dealt by poison and disease ticks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541958130748104805)
- **mob difficulty and rewards**: Mobs with higher difficulty give more exp and gold, and deeper dungeon levels have higher-difficulty mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539241155135545355)
- **mob special attack damage type**: Most mob special attacks deal physical damage, with basic monster specials split 75% physical and 25% pure, so armor and physical resistance help against them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549672074723991603)
- **monster hidden dr visibility**: Monsters have a hidden damage resistance (DR) that does not appear on any stat page, and players have not found any way to view it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537424582711971860)
- **monster magic resistance**: Monsters can have magic resistance, and their values are listed on the Outlands wiki Creatures List. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544747953720271030)
- **mugging with backstabber stealing**: A backstabber with stealing can mug mobs, automatically stealing bonus loot when backstabbing them on top of normal death loot; mugging requires being within one tile of the mob, so archery-based backstabbers must run up to mobs others are fighting and steal before they die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553968120320893029)
- **multi-poison damage penalty and airborne perk**: The more targets you have poisoned at once, the less poison damage you deal to each; the Airborne perk (ranks 1/2/2) reduces that penalty by 10%/30%/50% of normal, halved when resolving multiple ticks simultaneously. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555246748895543398)
- **mummy summon max hp decay**: The necromancy Mummy summon loses max HP over time, so an older mummy can have very low HP, and it lasts roughly half an hour. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527681795116499135)
- **murderer player class**: Nearly all murderer (red) players in Outlands are mages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532601333440581733)
- **necro summon herder build**: A necro summon herder build uses 15 spirit speak and damage links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545808014114824232)
- **necromancer followers vs regular summons**: Necromancer followers have increased stats and are stronger than regular summons, so they should be used instead of regular summons unless you need to give instant orders. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529066317510873181)
- **necromancer pet herder armor aspects**: Death, Eldritch and Command are viable armor aspect options for a necromancer pet herder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554563160940347393)
- **necromancy summon max hp decay**: Necromancy summoned creatures such as mummies lose max HP the longer they stay alive, so they need to be resummoned more often. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541956380179701860)
- **next target hotkeys**: The Next Target hotkeys only change which mobile is selected as your target; they do not attack the target or cast a spell. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548100442712576021)
- **nightwalker boss**: The Nightwalker, which resembles a Harrower from standard UO, has very high hit points and an AoE attack that can one-shot players, so it needs a group dealing high damage to kill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530386664814415892)
- **nox poison mage build**: A nox build is a poison-focused arcane mage build, and In Nox is a fast spell that lets it tag many mobs before returning to refresh the poison. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527272234186571818)
- **opening paragon chests**: To open a trapped paragon chest dropped by an ogre, use Detect Hidden to remove the trap, then use Lockpicking to open it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529458537749680240)
- **oss dungeon for backstabbers**: OSS is a good dungeon for backstabbers because its mobs have little armor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523014245669802105)
- **paladin healing options**: A paladin can be healed with Holy Light, Noble Sacrifice, bandages, and potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547489427490734101)
- **parry mirror stance**: The Parry aspect has a Mirror stance that helps against magic-using mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536016808333680661)
- **parry skill for dexxers**: Parry is a poor choice for a pure PvM dexxer because it makes it hard to cap swing speed, and against dexxers in PvP it provides no benefit and can increase damage taken. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535978809487003700)
- **parry versus alchemy**: After a recent patch Parrying is considered stronger and is preferred over Alchemy for most things; Parry is strong proactively and forgives mistakes, while Alchemy adds some damage and better reactive healing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531348547549663242)
- **parrying codex last stand finisher**: The Parrying codex finisher is reported to have two effects: a probability-based chance to ignore damage (25% with all 5 tiers, possibly reducing it to 1) and a flat reduction of incoming damage that activates at about 33% HP; exact values are unconfirmed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536845562286972938)
- **parrying with wrestling and other weapons**: Players can parry melee attacks with shields, two-handed weapons, paired weapons (wrestling or dual wielding) and parry daggers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551307831028752585)
- **parrying with wrestling weapons**: You can parry with a one-handed weapon plus shield, dual wielding, or two-handed weapons, and because all wrestling weapons are two-handed you can parry with them without a shield. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549384274384388178)
- **party health bar collectors**: To show party member health bars automatically, open paperdoll > options > "Health Bars & Drag Select" and use Health Bar Collectors; separate collectors can be set for different target types such as enemies and party members. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533928680634581175)
- **pet aggro setting**: To change a pet's aggro behaviour, use Animal Lore on the pet, open its Abilities page, and use the aggro option in the top left. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555585797120327763)
- **pet level power**: Pets become very strong at levels 10-15, level 10 is quick to reach, and level 15 pets were added around mid-2025 and were very strong when they dropped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553464972280078520)
- **pet stat priorities**: For melee pets the key stats are attack speed, attack damage and wrestling, with attack speed capping at 5 and damage and wrestling at 10; caster pets prioritize attack speed and spell damage, and good thresholds are roughly +4% speed, +9% attack and +8% wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555660860720943225)
- **pet tank setting**: In the pet Lore -> Abilities gump, set the tank pet's aggro to red (tank) and the other pets to grey (not tank); a tank heal macro can then bandage the tank without re-targeting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538502165700677682)
- **pets in pvp**: In PvP, all pets follow a restricted maximum hit cycle and a damage cap, so a pet's level matters little and pets are mostly ignorable. Some pets perform somewhat better than others, and melee pets have 80% move speed in combat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550583825543725198)
- **pets in pvp**: Pets are not bursty in PvP and are not meant to burst players down; they apply pressure, add free sustained damage, keep players from hiding, and finish low-HP targets, so a template with only Animal Kill and nothing else is unlikely to get many kills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538946376602361929)
- **pets while owner is dead**: While you are dead, your pets follow your ghost, and you cannot command them except with the 'all stay' command. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552066380759568487)
- **pincer crab hinder danger**: The pincer crab is dangerous because it hinders you, and freedom, rope or teleport are the ways to escape it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525693594697076766)
- **pit trials**: Pit trials are mainly the domain of tamers and trappers and can be done once per week. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552988887746351144)
- **pk and criminal health bar collector**: The automatic health bar collector for PKs and criminals shows their health bars automatically and works as a cheap substitute for tracking, letting you spot them and leave. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533299010540933322)
- **pk frequency by dungeon**: The frequency of being PKed varies by day and time, with PKs active from all time zones, and dungeons with a loot bonus are more likely to have frequent PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359591035670679)
- **pk gate trick against harvesters**: PKs use a second account or client to gate next to solitary treasure mappers, fishermen and miners and attack at once with lethal poison; having a gate bot gate right next to your harvester counters the chivalry gate trick. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531957493956218950)
- **pk risk at battle trainers**: PKs periodically kill everyone AFK at battle trainers outside the safe zone, such as the one by the Prevalia moongate, so players should go naked or wear nothing important when training there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526223247165886615)
- **planted state and moving throws**: Standing still for 3 seconds in PvE or 5 seconds in PvP makes a player Planted, which banks throws (several in PvE depending on weapon speed, 1 in PvP). If 10 seconds pass after becoming Planted and the player has moved, they lose any banked Moving Throws and must become Planted again; if PvP flagged, this happens after 5 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535400262972211290)
- **plate armor and swing speed**: Wearing plate armor does not lower swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528753929490268410)
- **plate armor versus mindblast in pvp**: In PvP, plate armor protects well against physical damage but takes more damage from mindblast, so leather or mastercrafted armor is preferable against mindblast users. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543179352303206490)
- **plus-dex potions and bandage speed**: Plus-dex potions increase bandage healing speed, so a healing build using Alchemy instead of Anatomy can put more points into intelligence for extra mana. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526927852619038750)
- **poison aspect summoner nerf**: A recent patch changed the poison aspect's multiplicative bonus to an additive one, reducing the Noxcro Summoner template's DPS on Test Shard to about 40-45%, and the developer is still rebalancing it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530114795146182656)
- **poison damage scaling**: Poison damage scales very strongly with higher Poison Aspect tiers and mastery chain links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524405668755538095)
- **poison damage/ignore resist link**: The Poison Damage/Ignore Resist link grants both increased poison damage and a chance to ignore poison resistance, but it is generally not worth using because most mobs lack poison resistance and the poison kit already reduces it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525567337275592825)
- **poison dexxer build**: A poison dexxer is a high-quality meta build for solo dungeon crawls and boss fights, but it is expected to be affected by the next patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548550712273670196)
- **poison mage link setup**: Poison mage is a good build but takes a lot of damage from its link setup, and pure poison damage links are preferred over poison damage/resist links because the latter give less damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555021522953965581)
- **poison necromancer summons role**: A poison necromancer has so many points in poison that its summons mainly tank, while the player's own damage comes from poisons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521848507475034203)
- **poisoning bladed weapons and food**: Bladed weapons can be poisoned and, once poisoned, can be used without the Poisoning skill; food can also be poisoned. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522736175423553556)
- **poisoning pvm builds**: Poison-based builds using the Poisoning skill are viable in PvM, and several different PvM builds use it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551587023624740985)
- **potion codex healing while pvp flagged**: While PvP flagged, the Potion Codex gives no extra healing or protection against player damage (its general effects, such as heal potions healing more over time, are disabled), though higher Alchemy skill still increases healing and the codex still gives damage resistance against monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551366489540534323)
- **preferred wrestling ability**: Haymaker, the middle wrestling ability, is the one most players prefer over Hugmaker. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525687822277808218)
- **preventing bandage override**: Use the [PreventBandageOverride command, listed in the [commands list, to make the server prevent starting a new bandage while one is already ticking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534930395139932362)
- **preventing theft**: Theft cannot be fully prevented, so players should avoid going AFK and keep valuables in trapped pouches so thieves cannot easily reach them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535256099190734910)
- **proc fishing with a cheap ranged weapon**: A player can use a cheap ranged weapon as a second weapon to fish for procs; the low hit chance does not matter because the aim is to trigger a proc rather than deal damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522452522038591508)
- **progressive spawn changes**: Many of the original progressive spawns were removed, and new ones such as orc and undead spawns (including in graveyards) were added recently and are not listed on the EXPLORE OUTLANDS map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725379509424179)
- **progressive spawn events**: Some locations, notably most orc forts and graveyards, have progressive spawn events in which more and tougher monsters appear after the initial ones are killed, until a mini boss spawns and the event ends when the final wave is defeated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532012837818339471)
- **provocation song benefits**: The Provocation song gives a percent damage boost to your pets, and Provocation can also make monsters fight each other, which helps against multiple monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **pvm account and character consolidation**: Keep all PvM on one account, ideally on one character at the beginning because of codexes and aspects, and use a second account for gathering. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529289806398488607)
- **pvm mace build**: A shadow-aspect backstabber mace build is currently considered a better pvm choice than a regular mace build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532085124630319205)
- **pvp dexxer build**: A viable PvP dexxer build uses 100 melee weapon skill, archery, tactics, anatomy, healing and resist plus a choice of tracking, arms lore or alchemy, and Healing is used because the Codex gives 25% more damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535496790860898345)
- **pvp events**: Outlands PvP events include factions, town struggle, stygian rifts, dungeon Flashpoint, corpse creek contest, and strangelands; Town Struggle is the only main event that can be done without friends. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536117626764263454)
- **pvp mechanics bonuses scope**: The bonuses listed under 'PvP Mechanics' apply only to mobs, not to damage to or from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521623009012486195)
- **pvp weapon choice**: PvP players typically use heavy crossbows, or swords and archery, and carry weapons of every damage class (interrupt, light grinding, heavy grinding, burst), alternating them as swings become available; in PvM any ranged weapon works. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550278355419664496)
- **quiver ammo savings**: A quiver helps you use less ammunition. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542550104286699580)
- **re-equipping weapon after teleport**: After teleporting into Prevalia, your weapon falls out of your hands from casting, so use an arm/dress hotkey to re-equip it quickly, which is faster than double-clicking and reduces the chance of it being stolen. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538412079227080815)
- **reactive armor buff control**: The Reactive Armor buff cannot be disabled or reapplied early. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555931365969502289)
- **resisting spells 100 for defense**: 100 Resisting Spells is recommended for general defense against caster PKs and mobs, including in PvP melee builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **resisting spells swing speed**: Resisting Spells grants swing speed through Spell Siphon after being cast on, which matters for dexxers and for characters below 50% SSI. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536023671754465390)
- **ricochet vs single target archery**: Archery's Ricochet ability is much stronger than Pincushion against groups of mobs, while archery and throwing deal similar damage against a single mob. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546868162677706772)
- **same-tile mob attack arc**: Standing on the same tile as a mob does not count as front, side, or back arc; no arc applies in that case. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315989887455484)
- **sanctuary dungeon rewards**: Sanctuary dungeons, including Ratman Hovel and Urukton, have reduced gold drops, and all sanctuary dungeons, including the weekly safe one, have reduced gold and experience. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532745113002836008)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Sanctuary dungeons forbid criminal actions and give reduced experience and gold, about 66% of normal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550783716081664012)
- **scorched earth fire elemental hex stacking with mana drain**: The fire elemental Hex from Scorched Earth in the summoner's tome stacks with Mana Drain/Mana Vampire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529125066283941909)
- **shield equip bonus**: Equipping a shield gives 10% damage resistance regardless of the Parry skill, though one author also reports a 10% accuracy penalty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **shield versus parry knife**: A shield provides armor rating that lets you tank more, while effective parry skill from a parry knife only increases parry chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524820744540782602)
- **slayer weapon damage penalty**: Slayer weapons do not reduce the damage you deal against creatures outside the slayer group. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540593654794682478)
- **solo pit builds**: Good solo pit builds rely on meat shields and mobility, such as tamer bard, summoner trapper or nox mage, and these builds can reportedly do 200k+ damage in the pit, while attrition from too many mobs eventually overwhelms a player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554270835739590709)
- **solo pit trial builds**: Poisoner summoner is reported to put up the biggest numbers in pit trials, while trapper and poison necromancer builds are considered viable choices for solo pit trials. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547172861779644528)
- **spell build link recommendations**: Useful links for spell builds include Spell Aspect Chance (mana recovery), Damage to Bleeding if running Blood, and Damage to Diseased if running Necromancy; a tri-bard mage instead uses Effective Barding, Damage to Barded and Damage to Diseased. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532721290866327602)
- **spell damage links**: Spell damage links still work, and splitting links between half spell damage and half damage dealt by the player often increases DPS. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537780303530041455)
- **spell range**: The range of spells is 12 tiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545914543241437184)
- **spell scroll casting bonuses**: When casting spells from a scroll, magical or crafted spellbook bonuses still apply. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554229973114425415)
- **spell siphon activation**: Before farming or entering a dungeon, cast a Magic Arrow scroll on yourself to trigger the Spell Siphon effect; scrolls can be cast with 0 Magery. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536839345284055161)
- **spell siphon swing speed buff**: Spell Siphon, when enabled in the settings, grants a 10% swing speed bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547063372338696232)
- **spellbook bonuses in pvp**: Spellbook modifiers, including holding a spellbook and item ID skill bonuses to spell damage, apply only in PvM and do not apply in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555246791740498001)
- **spellburn caster pets**: Caster pets ignore accuracy requirements, which makes them good for new players, and spellburn casters are good all-round farmers because Immolate boosts spellburn procs and spellburn deals physical damage, so they still do decently against resistant mobs; casters also get spells off more easily and frequently against players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535229171121389589)
- **spellcaster mob loot**: Spellcaster mobs drop magery reagents and gold that players can loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549604036741828689)
- **spinslash mechanics**: Spinslash is a powerful buff rather than a physical attack, and it is activated by clicking it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535285358898708612)
- **spirit speak for summoner tanks**: 80 Spirit Speak, with high Magery and a leveled Summoner's Codex, is enough for summoned earth elementals or mummies to tank; 120 only matters if you want summons to out-damage you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530286252027281619)
- **splitting damage sources**: Splitting a build's damage across different sources, such as summons and direct spell damage, makes the build less effective. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535500574928142356)
- **staff requirement for arcane**: A staff is required to play an arcane mage, and arcane cannot be used without one; mages not playing arcane do not need a staff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586273600151593)
- **stickmage flame strike mana management**: A stickmage cannot spam Flame Strike continuously from the start; cast it only when mana is above about 60 or Mana Thief is procced, and otherwise throttle back to Mind Blast to fish for mana-refilling procs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549595545557794838)
- **strength potions for health**: Strength potions raise maximum health, and keeping Strength at 120 with them gives about a 20% health buffer that helps survive attacks from red players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **summon duration mechanics**: Normal summons expire on a timer, while necromancy summons instead lose HP over time, and necromancy summons are generally considered better than non-necromancy ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553672522824683612)
- **summoner buff upkeep**: Summoners should keep Arch Protection, Reflect and Bless up for themselves and their summons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528448171599069344)
- **summoner build for treasure maps**: A summoner build with 25 bronze loot links and 5 bronze follower damage links works acceptably for treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538241587967037490)
- **summoner build types**: Summoner builds come in two styles: spell damage, where summons tank while you kill with spells, and follower damage, where summons do the killing and you cast few spells; the follower variant can take Herding. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527131282788716555)
- **summoner builds without necromancy**: Summoning can be run without Necromancy, where summons act mainly as meat shields and Herding can add summon damage, though the build is weaker and has different tradeoffs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553671270925606953)
- **summoner damage scaling with mastery links**: A summoner's summon damage increases as its mastery links increase, so links matter as much as the template and summons become very strong at high link counts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545302588109365353)
- **summoner damage sources**: A summoner mostly takes damage only from spellcaster mobs that cast Meteor Swarm or Chain Lightning, so should stand back from AoE. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527475083260723331)
- **summoner main-hand item**: Summoners usually equip a spellbook, either a magic spell book or a material spellbook, as their main item for the casting and mana benefits, since they gain little from equipping the crook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520864202451845180)
- **summoner survivability and shield**: A Summoner should take little to no damage, so a shield is unnecessary; if hit, run away and cast Hide. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528447073652047892)
- **summoner tome**: The Summoner tome works for Necromancer summons as well and lets you individually spec each summon, including strength, damage, and length of summon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149447315624108)
- **summoner tome spirit pact upgrade**: The Summoner Tome upgrade Spirit Pact reportedly gives more damage resist, reduced cast time, and more damage, and is considered a must for all summoners. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532320628806389860)
- **summoner trapper build**: In a tinker trapper summoner build, the earth elemental tanks the mobs while the player sets off or places traps, whereas a dexxer trapper must tank the mobs themselves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536709032880898098)
- **summoner wizard gear**: A summoner wizard should wear full exceptional leather armor for the best mana regeneration and use a player-crafted exceptional material spellbook such as a goldenhide mastercrafted one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541477999558271006)
- **summons while harvesting**: Harvesters can summon creatures such as earth elementals, or demons and fire elementals, to fight mobs while they keep harvesting, gaining loot and XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554604712550993983)
- **support bard role in group play**: In group play a bard is a support player who stays out of melee players' way, uses Discordance and Provocation on monsters, hinders or finishes targets, and may use Item ID, Tracking and Forensics, watch for PKs, and Item ID party backpacks so members can break down magic items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550853213949792458)
- **swing speed breakpoints**: Swing speed in Outlands has no framerate breakpoints like Diablo 2 attack speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524578912112214127)
- **swing speed increase for poison dexxers**: A poison dexxer does not need to prioritize Swing Speed Increase, as its main damage is poison damage and it is unlikely to struggle reaching the swing speed cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527227977253781575)
- **swing speed overcap and link slots**: The swing speed cap can be reached with skills alone, and swing speed beyond the cap gives exponentially larger damage the further over it you are, so link slots should go toward damage rather than merely reaching the cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522770200955715596)
- **swing speed overcap builds**: Builds with 120 chivalry plus a swing-speed aspect (e.g. 5 Holy) can be over the swing speed cap, so points can be shifted from chivalry and resist into arms lore for more damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550698964574015631)
- **sword archer solo pvp template**: Sword archer is a strong solo PvP template with the highest DPS compared to mace or fencing variants. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536066723088830614)
- **sword weapon special**: The sword weapon special applies bleed, causing the target to suffer total Bleed damage equal to the damage of the hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544430213004529755)
- **tamer all kill command**: Tamers who lead with the 'all kill' command take a lot of damage, whereas staying in 'all guard' lets them take very little damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553737253937872917)
- **tamer aspect choice**: Command aspect is a solid choice for a beast Tamer, and Frost aspect is a popular alternative because its chill effect applies to followers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542909944729305308)
- **tamer pet composition with bonfire wisp**: Tamer pet setups built around a bonfire wisp, such as a wisp with 2 incubi or a wisp with an eldritch mephit for hex and an ice mephit for chill, are viable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537915027720380467)
- **tamer pet setup**: A common tamer pet setup is two warpigs plus one Boreal Faerie Wyrm, which works well for a 120 taming tamer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535394516209762326)
- **tamer resourceless damage**: Tamers deal consistent damage that does not depend on mana, unlike mages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543355515290128394)
- **tamer tanking role**: A tamer's followers act as the tank for the tamer, so a tamer can be used to tank content. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532568537787273347)
- **tank requirements for bosses**: A full tank is not needed for bosses; area taunting mobs into the middle helps, and bosses are easy enough that almost any build works. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542266897708355735)
- **testudo versus bulwark**: Testudo is currently considered better than Bulwark. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523777044645806242)
- **thief and backstabber templates for stealing**: Thief and mugger/backstabber templates are both viable for earning gold by stealing from players, and a backstabber template that steals gets the Thieves Codex bonuses and can mug mobs for extra gold when backstabbing, while pilfering from mobs is a change of pace. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526656822487023686)
- **thief baiting**: Some thieves deliberately steal from a player to provoke that player into attacking them, which then lets the thief attack and kill the victim freely. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538396328156205096)
- **thieves codex backstabber build**: For a Backstabber build, the Thieves Codex points Ruffian and Shadow Hands are mandatory if you lack Tactics and Snooping, and a T12 shadow backstabber with nine backstab damage links, Ruffian, Shadow Hands, Without a Trace and a maxed Mace codex reportedly hits about 8k damage, occasionally reaching the 10k cap on mobs like blood demon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523013255746949150)
- **thieves near banks**: Thieves steal from players around banks and also camp there, so valuables should be handled carefully near banks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534573457856008282)
- **thrower parrying and mobility**: Throwers are a pseudo-ranged class that can often move while attacking, so they prioritize swing speed and Focus over Parrying. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521883366964596967)
- **throwing explosion potions**: To throw an explosion potion, double click the potion and pick a target; a macro (in-game or CUO) that uses the explosion potion and then targets the last target or a selected mob can automate this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541478115916783707)
- **time dungeon group requirements**: Time Dungeon is group content on Outlands that works best with a high level aspect and roughly 20 links for progression runs; lower links can handle levels 1-3, but progressing beyond that needs a strong carrying group. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536455253212532856)
- **top-tier melee pet stats**: A top-tier (S-tier) melee pet typically has roughly +4% attack speed, +9% attack damage and +8-9% wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461731810877511)
- **tracking damage bonus for backstabber**: Tracking gives a backstabber a damage bonus, reported as 25% at 100 skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543140129907146832)
- **trapper build strength**: Trapper builds are not quite as good as they once were but remain strong; dexxer trappers were hit hard by recent changes while summoner trappers were less affected. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554468418923536457)
- **treasure map level distribution and difficulty**: Most treasure maps are level 1-3 with a chunk of level 4 and very few level 5/6, and level 7 is very rare; early mobs are comparable to Oss 1 skeletons or Pulma 2 humanoids, level 5 maps are better with a gold chain, level 6 maps are best multiboxed or done with a friend, and pets or summons help. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540453361218879618)
- **treasure map mobs difficulty**: Treasure map mobs are easy to kill, even for low-link characters, and a 4x tamer with command armor, 120 Forensic Evaluation and 120 Cartography handles them well. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546228982939123753)
- **treasure mapper chain links**: Most treasure mappers use chain links for special loot and gold rather than for damage, so other builds are better off focusing on damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547664204800983071)
- **treasure maps with a picker and pvm character**: To run treasure maps with a lockpicker, dig up the chest on the PvM character, kill the mobs, then gate the lockpicking character in to open the chest; a character with hiding, stealth and tracking can also watch for reds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528340171765055588)
- **tribard archer dexxer for time content**: A tribard archer dexxer using peace and slay is pretty good for Time content. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554537349801713798)
- **two-character treasure map method**: To two-box treasure maps, hike to the location with the tmapper, decode the map and reveal the chest while gating home, log off, then log on the damage character to take the gate and clear the mobs, gate back, and have the tmapper or loot chain character open the chest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538223305692283032)
- **undecoded treasure map locations**: Undecoded treasure maps hide their location until decoded, so players travel to the spot without knowing which mobs they will face, such as Cauldara mobs or horse thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531113051774783568)
- **urukton bluffs progressive spawn**: A progressive spawn sits right outside the Urukton Bluffs dungeon entrance and players lure its mobs to the entrance to kill newer players; in the orc version the Blood Lord is the boss rather than the champions, and this undead/orc spawn also exists at Orc Rock, Orc Fort 2, Orc Fort 3 and Verdentia Orc Fort. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725026986565673)
- **vampire primogen**: Vampire primogen are found in Mausoleum level 4, have a difficulty of 329.5, and leave bats that damage you when you hit them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539261820878065717)
- **vanquishing versus avarice tactics bonus**: A vanquishing item gives a higher tactics bonus than an avarice item. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522817185162985595)
- **void armor aspect**: The Void armor aspect provides high survivability and is effective against mobs with high Magic Resist, but it adds little damage and suits mages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551075034163060737)
- **void armor aspect use**: Void armor aspect is used by Arcane mages mainly for mana recovery, and sometimes for its leech in level 4 group play. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399789016223784)
- **void aspect effects**: The Void aspect provides Void Mana, which compensates for slow swings, and some magic resistance penetration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522577604392259594)
- **void aspect uses**: The Void aspect is useful for training skills that need mana or constant healing, for grabbing a corpse, and for topping up out of combat in PvP, and Blood and Void are both good on dexxer echos. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555620133324595303)
- **void versus blood aspect for arcane mage**: Void is a workable option for arcane mage sustain until arcane staff procs can fully sustain mana, but Blood is considered the better armor choice. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545554738546999378)
- **warning ravens on dungeon murders**: Warning ravens are sent when a murder occurs on dungeon level 1 (sanctuary), and on level 2 there is a 25% chance they are sent when a blue player is killed; the surface outside a dungeon is Wilderness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545564550391275532)
- **warpig control slot cost**: Warpigs cost 2 control slots each, so a tamer with 5 slots can run two warpigs plus one 1-slot pet. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535397111967776880)
- **warrior necromancer death knight build**: A warrior/necromancer shadowknight or death knight style build has no supported archetype or synergy; it can function but needs a lot of button pushing for the same or less results than simpler builds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524262603843440822)
- **water elemental and ragwitch poison support**: Water elementals and ragwitches are used as summons for poison necromancers because they spread poison and have an ability that lowers poison resistance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524430489685983334)
- **water elemental poison summon**: Water elementals inflict poison and serve as a mage tank poisoner summon, making them usable as poison sources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524409300825542748)
- **weapon ability fill rate**: Weapon abilities fill at a rate of 10% + 10% * (Arms/100) every 6 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541168444651610172)
- **weapon aspect proc choices**: Among weapon aspects, Void is favored for single-target and boss fights, Artisan is good for farming and group or solo play but is expensive, Earth is cheap and good at piercing armor, and Discipline is used for dexer farming. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **weapon finisher chance and threshold**: Weapon Finishers can occur when a creature is at or below the Finisher Threshold (25% health at Tier 5 Finishers), with a base 10% chance plus 10% * (Anatomy/100), further scaled by weapon speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon procs with zero weapon skill**: Aspect procs can occur on a weapon you have no skill in, but only on a hit, and low accuracy combined with an already low proc chance makes them poor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549096782443585577)
- **weapon quality mechanics**: Weapon item quality is an essential mechanic affecting combat output, and base weapon bonuses and durability bonuses also matter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524530390210052096)
- **weapon setup bonus**: Weapon Setup Bonus grants bonuses against creatures based on the weapons, shields or spell books in your hands, shown as (Setup) on the stats page, and applies only to non-blessed weapons and spell books; details are on the weapon skill pages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546329153840742471)
- **weapon skill 100 benefits**: Raising a weapon skill to 100 improves accuracy and also gives bonus damage and melee defense, so it is a fix if you miss too many swings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535318709571158027)
- **weapon skill 80 versus 100 accuracy**: A character with 80 weapon skill has about 13.3% lower chance to hit than one with 100 weapon skill or 100 wrestling, so new players without good weapons usually should keep 100 skill to maintain accuracy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544546010368446565)
- **wiki weapons chart**: The Weapons Chart on the Outlands wiki page Armor & Weapons lists weapon swing speed and delay information. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555377310113337509)
- **wild swing macing stance for backstabbing**: The macing codex stance Wild Swing gives a large damage bonus at reduced accuracy; backstab attempts raise accuracy to offset it, and macing's damage range beats swords or fencing, so leveling it helps slow early backstab leveling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525989707924898063)
- **wilderness blood cult box**: To open the box dropped by the Wilderness Blood Cult encounter, find the key carried by one of the cultists, because lockpicking has 0 chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526995350852735107)
- **wilderness camp spawns and chest keys**: Random spawns such as orcs and brigands appear in the wilderness, and their leader often carries a key for the chests on the floor of their camp. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522621036716228608)
- **wilderness pk build skills**: A wilderness PK build is recommended to have Evaluating Intelligence at 100, at least 80 Meditation, about 120 Alchemy and around 100 Tracking, and does not need Inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531052522700148807)
- **wilderness recall farming**: Wilderness recall farming is an efficient method yielding roughly 300k XP and gold per hour plus loot, comparable to treasure mapping if you know the spots, since you bank loot and recall between spots to avoid mob density issues. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529899971355213824)
- **wilderness recall farming spots**: Good wilderness recall farming spots include human spawns that nobody touches (such as Old Pap), barbarians, sunscales, and Minax. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525626427154759690)
- **wrestler weapon accuracy requirement**: A wrestler needs accuracy, so a Valewood or Avar wrestling weapon is the minimum recommended weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521892801623883786)
- **wrestling and dexxer melee misses**: A character needs the Wrestling skill for dexxers to miss them with melee attacks; a character without wrestling is very vulnerable to dexxers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537225958409379941)
- **wrestling and parrying**: Wrestling is a defensive skill required to activate the Parrying codex, and a character can parry while fighting with wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536393447739629600)
- **wrestling aspect requirement**: A wrestler needs an aspect activated on the wrestling weapon as well as on armor to deal damage; an air wrestler with no aspect and no weapon deals no damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532357543295451259)
