- **wrestling dragon armor ignore**: A wrestler using the Dragon aspect or stance ignores 28 armor, so ignore armor links are redundant and weapon special damage and chance links are better used instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533353452636471508)
- **wrestling dragon codex stance**: Wrestling's Dragon codex stance has built-in armor ignore, which helps dexxers with few other sources of it; an Air-aspect wrestling dexxer is advised to wear plate with it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555731093292974093)
- **wrestling in pvp**: Wrestling is not the best choice for pure PvP because it cannot switch to a burst weapon and offers only one weapon type, with speed between a katana and viking sword that is good for disturb but weak on damage; it does give extra SSI and is a decent hybrid choice. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554232556126212178)
- **wrestling setup swing speed bonus**: The wrestling (paired weapons) class setup grants 10% swing speed increase just for using a wrestling weapon, which frees skill points many players spend on Parry or Alchemy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539071465318518814)
- **wrestling skill of higher-level mobs**: Time mobs can have up to 200 wrestling with 150 not uncommon, and many level 3 and some level 4 mobs have over 100 wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550864915554893924)
- **wrestling spell interruption avoidance**: Wrestling contributes to spell interruption avoidance but does not by itself provide 100% protection. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550154893590007899)
- **wrestling weapon special stagger**: A wrestling Weapon Special applies a Stagger effect instead of Disorient, increasing its damage by 150% and applying a 15% Stagger on the target for 8-16 seconds (scaled by weapon speed, stacking up to 45%), and Stagger increases damage from Weapon Specials, Abilities and Finishers against the target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534095662478659644)
- **wrestling weapon special stagger**: The weapon special for Wrestling-type weapons is Stagger, and it applies to wrestling in general regardless of the specific weapon (e.g. cestus vs fistblade). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539309556512063540)
- **1-slot pets stacking visually**: A group of 1-slot pets stack on top of each other when attacking and appear as a single pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525544091683913918)
- **120 chivalry point reserve**: With 120 Chivalry and Divine Fury and Consecrate Weapon on auto, a player always has 6 chivalry points left for emergencies, whereas at 100 Chivalry they may have to keep toggling abilities on and off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554814296595365929)
- **120 chivalry with 40 focus on wrestling build**: A wrestling build can run 120 chivalry with only 40 focus without problems, according to a player who has used it for a long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550818043456786443)
- **15/15 setup on arcane mage**: A 15/15 setup reportedly does not provide enough armor damage boost to work well on an arcane mage, though the author is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531362332960096429)
- **1h bow accuracy bonus**: A 1H bow is slightly slower than a 2H light bow but reportedly grants 10% accuracy, or 25% depending on whether a shield is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546377077492682814)
- **2h arcane staff bonuses**: A 2H arcane staff applies spellbook bonuses to spellcasts and melee bonuses to staff hits, so a caster does not need a separate spellbook for the book bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526187485774745660)
- **2x loot chance on chests**: The chance at 2x loot can double the contents of dungeon or treasure chests when opened, but paragon chests are not affected; a visual and sound effect plays unless the player is hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536798239909744801)
- **5x mage weapon burst**: Historically, PvP 5x mages equipped a heavy crossbow or halberd to add burst damage by timing the weapon swing; this may no longer be current practice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527275130990891138)
- **80/80/80 tri-bard failures on level 3 creatures**: An 80/80/80 tri-bard with 10 bronze links and no lyric aspect still fails regularly against level 3 creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546285991273300038)
- **abilities hotbar cooldown bubble**: The [Abilitieshotbar shows a bubble that fills while a weapon ability is on cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523372528809152592)
- **accuracy and chance to hit**: Accuracy determines the chance for your hits to land; 100 melee skill versus 100 melee skill is only a 50% chance to hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539142402520916050)
- **accuracy and damage**: Accuracy only increases chance to hit and does not change base damage, so if most hits already land you need other damage sources, while if many hits miss more accuracy raises DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539146615535960174)
- **accuracy links for melee pets**: Accuracy links may benefit melee pets because the best non-pig pets reach only about 60% accuracy without them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524446283727896616)
- **accuracy target while farming**: While farming you should get accuracy to 100 through weapon quality, aspect level, and skills like focus and the weapon skill; how much you need depends on the opponent's weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532412710476579117)
- **accuracy weapon tiers for air item id wrestler**: On an Air Item ID wrestler build, a surpassingly accurate weapon suffices on dungeon level 3, while level 4 needs an eminently accurate weapon (about 100.26% accuracy) because surpassingly would not cap accuracy there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522772746701111326)
- **active player killer count**: Roughly 10 active player killers are online at any given time, though this is an uncertain estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532603918532477029)
- **activities combining pvm and harvest aspect**: Fishing and MiBs (Monsters in Boats) are activities that combine PvM builds with harvest aspect progression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521380652212162633)
- **additional summon damage bonuses**: Herding and Veterinary also add damage to summons, as does the Command aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532962773657452584)
- **adventurer ropes for escaping**: Adventurer ropes might help you escape when boxed into a corner, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528547731667161169)
- **aegis3 blood demon paragon chests**: Blood demons in Aegis3 can drop paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520920495745404980)
- **afk pvm in shelter island dungeon**: The Shelter Island dungeon is reported to be the only place where AFK PvM is allowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540451218676260915)
- **afk trainer risk**: AFK skill trainers outside of town are common PK and thief targets, so valuables should not be carried while training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526305109498138716)
- **aggression rune placement**: Players place aggression (arcane) runes in boss rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529274604206559313)
- **aggressive aspect option for divine fury**: Putting aspect points into the Aggressive option may raise swing speed, which can help when using the Divine Fury chivalry ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523070913820758239)
- **aggressive fishermen and tradesmen boats**: Fisherman and tradesmen boats at sea are reportedly aggressive toward players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529154157422972968)
- **aggressive stance attack speed**: The Aggressive stance provides an attack speed bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532796453326422218)
- **aggressive stance for macing bard**: Aggressive stance is a straight damage boost for a macing bard, since the mobs being hit should mostly be peaced or provoked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523733373611282492)
- **aggressive stance swing speed**: Aggressive stance in the codex might push swing speed over the cap, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525006184753664125)
- **aggro pet targeting**: If pets are in All Guard mode and within range to be targeted, monsters will attack whichever pet is set as the aggro pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531770435820327164)
- **agility potions and swing speed**: Agility potions are still worth drinking even though swing speed caps at 100 stamina, because they provide a stamina buffer that keeps you above 100 when hit by mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535370592163987587)
- **agora armor aoe protection**: Wearing Agora armor protects against AOE damage spells; whether it also protects against AOE debuffs such as Mass Curse is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520895353417896079)
- **agora aspect**: The Agora aspect can cast only a single spell, so it effectively functions as a fire field aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521594363317321820)
- **agorawave damage scaling**: Most of Agorawave's damage is additive, so adding a multiplier such as Cartography would make it a decent damage source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536805559490191520)
- **agorawave farming spots**: Agorawave is limited by few spots where enough safe mobs can be grouped, and those spots are contested by other farmers; SSC level 2 is a decent spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536804890406293514)
- **air armor and earth aspect tradeoff**: Air armor and earth aspect give lots of damage resistance but no real armor damage buffs, making the character hard to kill but slow to kill with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538646137295085689)
- **air armor aspect for arcane mage**: Air armor aspect effectively prevents an Arcane mage from running out of mana but gives no damage boost, so it deals less damage than Blood. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551075000918736903)
- **air aspect accuracy values**: With air aspect level 10 on an aspected weapon, accuracy is around 98, and roughly 104 with the Valehide aspect, 100 wrestling and 60 focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521905769728184451)
- **air aspect arcane mage survivability**: An Arcane mage who is pinned can switch to the Air aspect, and a procced Air mage is very hard to kill even when swarmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543357274100211732)
- **air aspect attack speed**: The Air aspect is reported to give the maximum attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522431819960553643)
- **air aspect damage reduction**: The Air aspect grants damage reduction after a swing or cast, and the effect stays active very consistently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523469044546666758)
- **air aspect dual wielder build**: With the air aspect a dual wielder may not need focus and could run 80 alchemy and 120 chivalry, though accuracy might suffer, and a Shank stance can be used to reach the swing speed cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529872003878621266)
- **air aspect swing speed**: The Air aspect fixes the swing speed shortfall left by not having Chivalry when building for maximum swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529945117203628175)
- **air aspect versus holy aspect**: Air aspect provides better damage and damage resistance than holy, though holy symbols are a limited resource while air is not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529883308689985566)
- **air dexxer setup**: A common recommendation for an air dexxer is to play with Divine Fury plus Consecrate Weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522259553192902656)
- **air wrestle build daemon test result**: An air wrestle build reached about 1250 dps and 600k gph in the Pulma Fen daemon test, with 45% DR without the artisan proc and 52% with it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521183204449714349)
- **air wrestler alchemy tradeoffs**: An Air wrestler with the Alchemy codex reaches about 47% combat damage resist (excluding Artisan procs) with mixed codex results, and adding 80 Item ID plus 80 Alchemy yields lower damage (about 1150) than an Item ID build at about 1250. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521687129162383371)
- **air wrestler build**: A recommended air wrestler setup uses dragon/spider stance, chi thrust as the finisher and haymaker as the weapon ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539451082357346324)
- **air wrestler build**: An air wrestler build uses wrestling-specific weapons (Martial Manual, Cestus, Fistblade), the wrestling codex with dragon stance, the alchemy, parry and healing codices, and the air aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545454144574193664)
- **air wrestler build alchemy**: Alchemy is a key benefit of the air wrestler build, which is otherwise a PvP-ready template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521703787624927474)
- **air wrestler parry without chivalry**: An Air-aspect wrestler running Parry instead of Chivalry was reported to feel nearly invincible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521565217866121216)
- **air wrestler template stats**: An air wrestler template can reportedly fit about 100 resist and 100 Item ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545046893363462266)
- **airborne and targeted venom swapping**: Players swap the Airborne and Targeted Venom poison kit options depending on multi-target versus single-target fights, and the poison option should be maxed in the grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544401406142718083)
- **alchemy and parry damage reduction on pk hunter**: Carrying Alchemy and Parry on a PK Hunter provides extra damage reduction that makes it noticeably harder for mobs to kill you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526658677497397249)
- **alchemy and potion codex survivability**: Alchemy helps a character shrug off Evil Omen damage, and the Potion Codex adds further survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533920623208955944)
- **alchemy as alternative to focus or lore**: Some players use Alchemy instead of Focus or Lore, relying on Codex and explosion potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532930800016953416)
- **alchemy explosive bottles for tamers**: Alchemy lets a tamer throw explosive bottles at monsters the pets are fighting, and with Discord and the potion codex these potions hit well, especially when pulling multiple monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522290982077599745)
- **alchemy for pure pvm characters**: Alchemy can fit into a pure PvM character because it unlocks a codex that grants several PvM benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286681711181885)
- **alchemy health boost versus weaken**: Alchemy can be used to boost health to 120 to avoid a PK's Weaken effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531422889369407488)
- **alchemy potion cooldown versus bleed**: Alchemy reduces potion cooldown by about 1 second, which may be enough to survive Bleed with a potion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554997864772407368)
- **alchemy versus parry for overworld face tanking**: 80 Alchemy is considered better than 80 Parry for face tanking overworld mobs, because potions and alchemy do much of the work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537789840194674730)
- **all attack pet command**: Typing 'all attack' works as a pet command and is probably an alternate text for All Kill with the same effect, though this is an assumption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534992364462936185)
- **all guard command behavior**: The "all guard" pet command stops when you pass through a transition such as recalling, changing dungeon levels, or entering or leaving a dungeon, so it must be reissued afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536981398290623)
- **all guard command in pvp**: The all guard command does nothing in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550585176831295562)
- **all guard engagement and retaliation**: If you engage a mob using the 'all guard' command, your pets do not retaliate for you because you were never targeted by the mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527961619710083082)
- **all kill aggro behavior**: With all kill you initiate the attack, so the mob retaliates against you first; this is usually fine against melee mobs because they tend to switch aggro before reaching you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531770167120625674)
- **all kill command for summons**: Saying 'all kill' and then selecting a target makes your summons attack that target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523389994235072623)
- **all stay command for pets**: The 'all stay' command stops pets and minions from attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554591508181688363)
- **alt account treasure map run**: An alt with 120 cartography, 100 magery, 100 hiding, 100 meditation and 80+ spirit speak decodes a treasure map, digs, and gates the main in to kill the mobs; the alt then opens the chest wearing fortune armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538944105571155988)
- **anatomy bleeding damage reduction**: Some skills, such as Anatomy, reduce the damage taken from bleeding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538911772298190900)
- **ancient aspect for summoner tome daemon**: Ancient aspect gives the summoner tome daemon good damage resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529877751820189788)
- **animal lore on summoned demons**: Using Animal Lore on a summoned demon makes it attack at range instead of in melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144883284025345)
- **antediluvian dragon near urukton bluffs**: An antediluvian dragon spawns inside the cliff mini dungeon in the area near Urukton Bluffs and has dropped a scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547011983516377098)
- **anti-mage dexxer build**: Against mages, a sword or mace plus archery dexxer is best, e.g. 100 tactics, archery, swords, anatomy and resist, 80 tracking, 80 healing and 60 magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554189156450828439)
- **aoe need for pet summoner**: A pet summoner needs little AoE because mobs typically die in under 10 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527496325653069916)
- **applying lower-tier poison over higher-tier poison**: A lower-tier poison such as Deadly can be applied to a mob that already has a higher-tier poison such as Lethal on it, following the August 11th patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554134346565419019)
- **applying poison in a poison build**: In a poison build, apply poison by casting the Poison spell; Water Elementals can also apply poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547940462113988608)
- **arcane armor changes**: Recent arcane armor changes make the arcane mage build much more viable without needing 30 links or a redline setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335608998432959)
- **arcane armor tanking**: Arcane armor lets a tanky arcane echo face tank almost anything, as Flame Strike returns 22 HP per cast, removing the need to cast Greater Heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555622656030548160)
- **arcane aspect damage roll**: The Arcane aspect has a 50% damage roll that players consider nice for mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545098384099250357)
- **arcane aspect mage templates**: Most advanced mage templates are built around the Arcane aspect since the arcane template was introduced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528800789286359060)
- **arcane aspect versus longshot for early archers**: For an early-progress archer, the accuracy of the Arcane aspect is more valuable than the extra range from Longshot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532743344076361788)
- **arcane catalyst setting**: The arcane catalyst setting provides about 2k red damage and +30 mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335810018709545)
- **arcane clarity finisher scope**: The Arcane Clarity finisher applies only to the arcane user who triggered it, not to other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530017394267918446)
- **arcane codex accuracy bonus**: The Arcane codex can be used to improve accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553678738393272431)
- **arcane codex setup**: For the arcane codex build, run Catalyst and Seeking plus Shield (or Leech if running out of mana), and use Surge in the first ~15 seconds after a Mana Thief proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545455408104218624)
- **arcane codex shield stance damage resistance**: The arcane codex with shield stance gives 28% damage resistance and is used in a non-summon poison mage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529113260467425394)
- **arcane crystals for high-redline mages**: An arcane mage at 60 redline should be burning arcane crystals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333817816846397)
- **arcane crystals proc chance**: Arcane crystals increase proc chance on both the staff and its spells, provided arcane is on the staff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534600287736561884)
- **arcane mage aoe sources and hinders**: Arcane procs, explosion potions and Mana Thief all deal AOE damage, and an arcane mage has 3 hinder effects (4 with Parrying). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545560723441324062)
- **arcane mage boss and farming performance**: Arcane Mage is very strong for sitting and hitting a boss but weaker for general farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531327065310367744)
- **arcane mage boss and omni performance**: An arcane mage is considered the best option for omni and boss content; players believe nothing outbosses an arcane mage redline for redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545445184983007434)
- **arcane mage defensive buffs**: Arcane mages should keep Reactive Armor, Protection, Magic Reflection and Create Food buffs up, especially Magic Reflection, Reactive Armor and Protection, as Reactive Armor and the Resisting Spells damage-reduction buff are very strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545557715349143633)
- **arcane mage dexterity and armor**: Arcane mages benefit from extra Dexterity for arcane procs and use blood armor; the build is a glass cannon that could use more defense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327853879566356)
- **arcane mage dexterity for mana thief**: An Arcane mage with about 40 dexterity notices the swing speed boost when using Mana Thief, and flamestrike is only cast above roughly 50-60 mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544398746735869952)
- **arcane mage difficulty**: Poor experiences with arcane mage are said to usually come from player skill and technique rather than the build, as there are many small techniques to learn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531363797305004246)
- **arcane mage early redline allocation**: A recommended early redline allocation for Arcane Mage is 15/15 and then going into tiers, since Lightning, Blood, Void and Arcane all benefit from tier 20. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531326282812625069)
- **arcane mage endgame tanking**: At endgame an arcane mage can face tank most mobs, but must kite any mob with a nasty special ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552682723494068417)
- **arcane mage finisher choice**: Catalyst is the better arcane mage finisher when farming, while Clarity is preferred when stacking arcane procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529257387473768519)
- **arcane mage flame strike mana thief loop**: Arcane mages typically spam Flame Strike to trigger the mana thief refund loop, where chained Flame Strikes allow even more Flame Strikes to be cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545325832967290920)
- **arcane mage grimoire defensives**: Arcane mages should invest in the defensive abilities in the grimoire rather than overlooking them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364147588235417)
- **arcane mage grimoire setup**: An arcane mage grimoire can include Create Food, Reactive Armor, Protection, Magic Reflection, Lightning, Mind Blast and Flamestrike, plus one floater spell: Chain Lightning for mapping, Greater Heal for farming, or Curse for bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545890940881739786)
- **arcane mage level 3 dungeons**: A meditation arcane mage can farm level 3 dungeons easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523320130107473981)
- **arcane mage level 4 tanking**: Tanking level 4 dungeons while wearing leather armor is a problem for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523320205852545074)
- **arcane mage mana consistency**: Arcane mage mana consistency improves with chain links and codex perks, and aspect chance links are important for procing Mana Thief often enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540718505085763584)
- **arcane mage mana reserve**: Keep about 15-20 mana in reserve, enough for a heal, unless procced on Mana Thief; offensive spells should not be cast under about 20 mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545455610315673730)
- **arcane mage mana return**: For an arcane mage, the Mana Vampire grimoire spell and well-timed Energy Bolt return a lot of mana, and using filler spells (Magic Arrow, Harm, Fireball, Lightning) when off cooldown reduces the Flamestrikes needed per rotation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540725995529834580)
- **arcane mage mana return from energy bolts**: Arcane mages can time their Energy Bolts to regain mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326165760282695)
- **arcane mage mana sustain**: For arcane mage mana sustain, any mana spent on something other than casting In Vas Mani is beneficial. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335686639194272)
- **arcane mage map clearing speed**: An arcane mage can clear about one treasure map per 2 minutes up to tier 4 including drop-off, and the Chain Lightning codex ability is very effective for maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543758648927584256)
- **arcane mage melee swing speed redline**: Melee swing speed is a recommended redline investment for an Arcane Mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531326452610629704)
- **arcane mage mob killing approach**: Arcane mages should not kill every mob with spells; they should let mobs die from damage over time while swinging a weapon to regain mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526593940755583017)
- **arcane mage pet and summon restriction**: An arcane mage cannot use pets or summons to stay safe from mobs while casting, so it plays without that protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549587606717857863)
- **arcane mage pk defense**: Arcane mage builds have strong defense against dexxer PKs, and against mage PKs when running resist, along with high survivability and access to wall and invisibility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526599911297257614)
- **arcane mage playstyle**: An arcane mage has 64 spells with almost all having a use, and plays at very high actions per minute (casting, curing, healing, abilities, roping, invisibility, resurrecting, wall of stone, crowd control). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524840646039437333)
- **arcane mage pvp hybrid build**: An arcane mage with Meditation is suggested by one player as a mage PvP hybrid build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525113227208294612)
- **arcane mage self-healing against spellcasting-disabling mobs**: Against mobs that disable spellcasting, an arcane mage cannot heal themselves except by using potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524865014757064978)
- **arcane mage siphon and potions**: Arcane mages should spell siphon themselves and pack explosion potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545457374440071230)
- **arcane mage snack food**: Delectable food is recommended as the snack for the arcane mage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545455437774721115)
- **arcane mage solo farming of level 4 time dungeons**: An Arcane Mage with 20 links can solo-farm level 4 Time dungeons such as Blood Forest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531325923323019395)
- **arcane mage solo mana**: An arcane mage may have trouble getting enough mana for solo farming, unlike a tribard where solo farming was very smooth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523796128825479230)
- **arcane mage solo treasure map spots**: An arcane mage can solo treasure map spots with 2 obsidian, 2 archfiend and 2 gargoyles, but this requires high tier links and damage aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538234364532490360)
- **arcane mage spell priority**: An arcane mage should use Leech when below 30 mana and Shield otherwise (Surge is an option on a fresh proc), and should also use Catalyst and Seeking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540742078995239012)
- **arcane mage spell usage**: An arcane mage's core spells are Magic Arrow, Harm, Mind Blast (most used), Flamestrike when mana allows, and Lightning, with Chain Lightning best used when about 3 mobs are nearby and no other players are around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524834113243189268)
- **arcane mage spellbook**: An arcane mage uses the Arcane Codex rather than a weapon almanac. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527113181347188886)
- **arcane mage staff hit technique**: As an arcane mage, use more rope to spend more time planted for staff hits, and use more actions such as potions during casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540739166168416256)
- **arcane mage versus trapper map speed**: With Mana Thief active, an arcane mage using Chain Lightning can clear maps faster than a trapper, though trappers pull ahead overall because they have no mana downtime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543759108539289650)
- **arcane mage with water aspect**: Arcane mage is a decent fit for the Water aspect because of the spell charge chance and the added alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547315419956650114)
- **arcane nox build**: An arcane version of a nox build is viable but lacks supporting or utility skills because there is no skill room left. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524212644062560388)
- **arcane poison build for wild farming**: An arcane poison build is likely fine for farming in the wild because you can kite well on horseback, though it probably has little interrupt protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529113889718145255)
- **arcane proc rate**: A faster cast cycle, including using potions and other actions between casts, increases the number of arcane procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531336205239582822)
- **arcane staff and paralyze**: Re-equipping the arcane staff after casting Paralyze breaks the paralyze, even if the staff was removed before targeting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534310955549200586)
- **arcane staff and summons**: The Arcane Staff is meant for arcane mages and provides no benefit to summons, since an arcane mage build uses no followers or summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522446321032757279)
- **arcane staff auto-cast**: An arcane staff makes the wielder automatically cast spells at mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522446261377040547)
- **arcane staff hex special for caster pets**: For tamers with caster pets, an Arcane Staff helps with the Hex special, which reduces resist by 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314386743656529)
- **arcane staff ranged attack requirements**: An arcane staff's ranged attack requires neither Magery nor an arcane aspect; the 80 Magery requirement only applies to the arcane bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540182707533783170)
- **arcane staff swing hit scaling**: Arcane staff swing hits scale with swing speed increase (SSI), so dexterity matters for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529861025006882817)
- **arcane staff teleport de-equip threshold**: To avoid the arcane staff being de-equipped when teleporting, you need 80 arcane skill and more than likely 80 wrestling as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529872402069196962)
- **arcane staff weapon special hex**: The Arcane Staff's weapon special is Hex, which is not a skill and has a 10% base chance of procing on every attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527088201314074685)
- **arcane stance switch cooldown**: There may be a 5 second cooldown when switching Arcane Stances, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537015888857923694)
- **arcane void mage build**: A mage with arcane tier 12 and void can start with void using agapite plate and an avarwood staff, then unlock blood and/or lightning; lightning armor pairs well with an arcane weapon because arc and shock are calculated from purple damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545455135721787423)
- **arcane weapon armor aspect choice**: At high tier Arcane weapon a mana-assist armor aspect is generally unnecessary, and Death armor is a good single-target choice at the cost of a slower opener. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537451862721036298)
- **arcane weapon proc damage type**: An arcane weapon (aspected staff) counts as both melee and spell for proc chance purposes, while the staff's red damage counts as melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544837583257870356)
- **archer armor choice without mana use**: An archer who does not rely on mana can reportedly wear full plate armor, since plate's mana-related penalties do not matter to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525341405667524639)
- **archer backstab and damage cap**: Backstabbing with an archer is not recommended unless you have quite a few links to reach the 10k damage cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522637169531949116)
- **archer backstabber codex**: Longshot is good for an archer backstabber, but if using Ransack to mug creatures from 6 tiles away, the Arcane codex may be better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547244489159086160)
- **archer codex splash effect**: The archer codex effect that deals 10% of damage per rank to a random enemy within 2 tiles applies to a second target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542490879913365615)
- **archer damage**: Archers are somewhat weak in damage output, and close range combat gives more DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532562592822726668)
- **archer link split**: A 6/5/5 link split can cover all bases for an archer, and hindering links are valuable in group content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555596315612807209)
- **archer meta link setup**: MDAI is considered the bread and butter of archer builds, and the believed meta link setup is 15 DDBP and 15 MDAI. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538968448267198546)
- **archer pet combination**: A bonfire wisp paired with a mare is a good pet combination for an archer, with the wisp acting as a small tank with good damage and the mare providing a mount and spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525543786925658122)
- **archer special move rotation**: Archers alternate between Arcane Shot, Incendiary Shot and Longshot depending on what is needed, while Ricochet deals more damage when there are multiple mobs to hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533352165362499725)
- **archer ssi link priority**: If swing speed increase (SSI) is not capped, an archer should prioritise SSI links first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552038153668272229)
- **archer stabber power cap**: Archery builds can backstab, and an archer stabber becomes capped in power after enough chain links and aspect tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550091068324970518)
- **archer strengths**: Archer is good solo and excels in group play and AoE damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556007678394761277)
- **archer swing speed and accuracy targets**: An archer should aim for about 50% swing speed increase and 100% accuracy against 130 wrestling, and this accuracy can be reached without Focus using a 1-handed crossbow with 100 weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544011384478634064)
- **archer tamer build viability**: A 4x120 3x80 archer tamer can do all content and can easily grind codexes and aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528299902877040722)
- **archer tamer command proc fishing**: An archer/tamer with no accuracy links can reach about 87% accuracy while fishing for command procs, with runs yielding a few thousand mixed leathers and 28-35k gold plus items with Command around 12-13. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528428288261881896)
- **archer tamer pet suggestions**: Cave gorger and sabertooth are suggested pets for an archer tamer, but they have fairly high minimum taming skill requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569517314576404)
- **archer third link row**: There is currently no great third row of links for archers; melee special chance/damage or melee aspect effect chance are probably the best options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544772085669171273)
- **archer weapon and armor recommendation**: The wiki weapons chart reportedly recommends medium armor and weapons or burst weapons for archers, and burst weapons appear to be two-handed archery weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553631227595067493)
- **archery accuracy bonus vs hindered**: Players receive a +25% Accuracy bonus when using Archery weapons against a creature that is hindered at the time of the attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538939708992790608)
- **archery and healer codex choices**: For the archery codex, use Maiming or Longshot with Repeater, Ricochet or Pincushion; the healer codex uses Self Treatment, Combat Medic, Triage and Pressure Points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541942644916355153)
- **archery bard potion healing safety**: Archery bard builds that heal only with potions are considered safe, especially when using Hinder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543575263080616007)
- **archery build arms lore option**: A suggested archery build option is to drop Alchemy and add Arms Lore, since little else is available to boost damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528568029628071977)
- **archery damage and links**: Archery suffers a large damage loss compared with other weapon skills and reportedly needs around 30 links to work well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555019803595378779)
- **archery damage bonus and resist thresholds for pvp**: Skipping archery forfeits a 25% damage bonus, and resists under 100 are considered worthless for faction or overworld PvP, according to one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554234234376294482)
- **archery disarm**: Archery can disarm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535331929073909903)
- **archery special ability hinder**: The Archery special ability Hinder reportedly stuns its targets, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539765082110828627)
- **archery stance quality**: All archery stances are very good except Incendiary, which is the only one players won't use much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553902121060139059)
- **archery versus macing early game**: Archery carries an extra loadout cost for arrows or bolts, while macing has somewhat higher DPS in the early game, but archery remains viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553266871401447505)
- **archfiend special attack danger**: An Archfiend's special attack is very dangerous to treasure map hunters and can kill or ruin a run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538233945085452369)
- **area taunt range**: The area-of-effect taunt may have a range of five squares, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540188614229758044)
- **area taunt with chain lightning**: Area taunt combined with chain lightning is effective when adds pile up on an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364717354811464)
- **armor choice by casting**: Armor choice depends on whether you cast: casters (Magery) want leather and non-casters want plate, and being a tamer does not change this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542066898894856283)
- **armor choice for dexer wrestler**: Both void armor and blood armor are acceptable choices for a dexer wrestler, and the choice comes down to personal preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538253807379550369)
- **armor effect on stealth and backstab**: Armor has no impact on the ability to stealth or on backstab damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529914229849718814)
- **armor for dual wield dex character**: Plate armor is recommended for a dual wield dex character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534327553395785850)
- **armor for wrestling build**: Fortune armor is recommended for a wrestling build, and lightning armor is said to be even better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520578638217482381)
- **armor rating against mobs**: If you are struggling against mobs, increasing your armor rating (AR) with better armor helps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528781792264454265)
- **armor rating while flagged in pvp**: Per the November 19, 2022 patch notes, when a flagged player takes damage from creatures, Armor Rating reduces damage as normal including Aspect Armor bonuses, while damage from other players uses an adjusted Armor Rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528890310774620242)
- **armor shredding and monster hidden dr**: Armor shredding links reportedly do not affect monsters' hidden DR. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537424848845013003)
- **armor smash effectiveness**: Armor smash is helpful for a new player but becomes less effective against tougher monsters that have higher minimum AR thresholds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532465516965531881)
- **armor stamina loss**: Higher armor causes greater stamina loss, which can be offset by carrying refresh potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534375783215140895)
- **armor versus weapon for kill speed**: Armor improves only defense and not DPS, so a better weapon is what speeds up kills, and a single weapon costs less than a full armor set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767806063906817)
- **armor versus xp progression for survivability**: Armor matters less for survivability than XP progression such as codex and aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529911783660196071)
- **arms lore and fortune armor for easy level farming**: Switching to Arms Lore for slightly more damage and wearing fortune armor speeds up farming easy levels such as AK3, Maus3 and DM3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523491636833816627)
- **arms lore effect on poison dexxer**: Arms Lore increases weapon damage but does not boost poison damage, so it adds little for a poison dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521779360904773652)
- **arms lore for dexxers**: Sword or bow dexxers want Arms Lore to use their special move more often, while macing dexxers can take another skill instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548225125974016081)
- **arms lore for solo archers**: A solo (non-grouped) archer build should take Arms Lore, because Hinder is the archer's main damage source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550546372703424604)
- **arms lore hinder for pet-less builds**: Arms Lore gives access to Hinder, which a pet-less build may want because it has no pets to tank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554938866551619697)
- **arms lore in butler accuracy calculator**: In the Outlands Butler accuracy calculator, Arms Lore only grants accuracy bonuses when the player is disarmed, so changing Arms Lore does not change the results unless the disarmed option is selected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553088096709509233)
- **arrow and bolt types**: Only regular arrows and bolts exist in Outlands; there are no special ammunition types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951173432418335)
- **artisan and holy weapon procs**: The Artisan weapon proc increases damage and damage reduction multipliers for friends, while the Holy weapon proc gives a stacking armor absorb shield that makes group content less dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554095111162437744)
- **artisan aspect best use cases**: The Artisan aspect shines most in the Time dungeon and at pit trials, though it would not have a slot in the current pit trials meta. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530940152971526256)
- **artisan aspect proc damage**: The artisan aspect proc hits for about 5-6k damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539821836043558922)
- **artisan aspect usefulness**: The Artisan aspect is mainly worthwhile for group content and is not needed for omnis or bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530939340769984624)
- **artisan bard booster build links**: The artisan bard booster is a high-end party build that wants 10-15 links in Effective Barding and 10-15 links in the melee aspect modifier (if using archery) to maximize party boosts to damage, damage reduction and healing received. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545431668918198394)
- **artisan bard spell aspect links**: Some players run a bard with an Artisan weapon and spell aspect chance and modifier links, which is reported to work very well for groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542554202159452160)
- **artisan versus void weapon**: Artisan weapon is better for tanking group farming because it buffs the player, while Void is better for bosses because it debuffs the enemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524860819672662278)
- **aspect and mastery chain power share**: Roughly 90% of a character's combat power comes from aspects and the mastery chain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526272482846314704)
- **aspect armors for non-proc arcane build**: Because of the leather armor limitation, the non-proc arcane mage build suits defensive aspect armors: frost, temporal, arcane, void, blood, lightning, water and air. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525689829835276289)
- **aspect bonus focus**: The primary bonuses from almost every aspect are strictly PvM combat related. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527553706663612457)
- **aspect choice for pvp thieves**: Shadow aspect suits sneaky PvP thieves, while Void aspect (or War aspect) is the more popular general choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529488519041515561)
- **aspect choice for the build**: Lightning and Madness are valid aspect choices for the discussed build, and most aspects work except Eldritch or other unusual ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524543653484298300)
- **aspect crystal consumption**: Aspect crystals (spell stones) are used up as you fight, at the same rate as arcane essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160099645886475)
- **aspect crystal consumption in groups**: Until you do high DPS you won't consume many crystals in a group but still get the benefits, while boss DPS builds or being carried in a group burn essence fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536216912378204160)
- **aspect crystals cost**: Aspect crystals give a nice damage buff but are costly: command crystals cost 46 each, are burned through quickly, and dying loses 50k per crystal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524890727006605402)
- **aspect essence preloading before hunting**: Load a few hundred Aspect Essence before going out to hunt so you do not run out while hunting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541953988596076554)
- **aspect modifier mastery links**: Aspect modifier mastery links increase the effect and damage of the chance-based aspect effect on your weapon or spellbook, depending on whether the link applies to melee or spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526542804812042360)
- **aspect proc chance and weapon speed modifiers**: Divine fury and links do not change the weapon speed on which aspect special proc chance is based, though this is the author's uncertain understanding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529119275418390699)
- **aspect proccing weapon skills for tamers**: Ranged melee weapon skills are ideal for proccing aspect effects as often as possible on a tamer; Fencing is probably better but only if you can stand next to the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546620423397965935)
- **aspect procs affecting other players**: Several aspect procs also affect other players: the artisan proc gives a damage and damage resistance buff, the holy proc gives a shield, and the air proc is a cripple. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526779075580919918)
- **aspect special**: The aspect special is a random (RNG) bonus damage ability that can trigger with either a spellbook or a weapon equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526607035880439829)
- **aspect special attack proc item**: A certain item guarantees an aspect special attack proc and has a 1 hour cooldown, though the item is not named and the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526326827918950593)
- **aspect spellbook bonuses scope**: Bonuses from an aspect spellbook, such as the spell damage bonus, apply only to spells and not to traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526038347158523954)
- **aspect tier for level 3 dungeons**: Aspect tier 6-8 is recommended to comfortably navigate level 3 dungeons, and dungeon difficulty increases as you go deeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528538393909137408)
- **aspect weapon effect trigger threshold**: Aspect weapon effects reportedly trigger at 5% of mob HP, which may apply to Hamstring and Disarm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542901056382701600)
- **aspects and pets**: Aspects most likely do not affect pets, though a barder's effective barding skill can help and also affects reset/break ignore chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543591786612789440)
- **aspects for melee dexxer**: Air, Discipline and Lightning are suggested aspects for a melee dexxer to try. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543621123923771484)
- **aspects for swords build**: Discipline, Blood, Void, Frost and Air are good aspect choices for a swords build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543664542234579109)
- **attack nearest targeting for archery**: Attack nearest targeting works the same way for archery as it does for other weapon skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532143907536638154)
- **attack speed sources**: Attack speed can be increased with delectable food, skills, dexterity, links, and Chivalry's Divine Fury, with air armor as another option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554250907380621343)
- **attacking another guild's boss**: If you attack another guild's boss, that guild can freely attack you, even if you only auto-retaliated against the boss after it hit you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599683177324634)
- **attacking innocents in guard zones**: Attacking an innocent player within a guard zone causes guards to kill the attacker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538167045407903824)
- **attacking mobs without killing them**: You can attack a mob without killing it, such as a regenerating mob, by standing still and only attacking, which avoids gaining exp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542932194987606066)
- **attacking with harvesting tools**: A gatherer can attack mobs with a pickaxe or hatchet, which deals a small amount of damage and may trigger an aspect proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532881939428806656)
- **august 11th patch disease poison bleed changes**: The August 11th patch stopped applying disease, poison or bleed from letting another player activate those links, and allows a lower-tier poison to be applied over a higher-tier one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554132618503651471)
- **auto attack cooldown bar**: The auto attack cooldown bar does not adjust dynamically to current swing speed, so it must be set in advance for the weapon you intend to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538566133974573247)
- **auto attack when attacked**: You cannot disable the auto attack response when being attacked; you have to tab out to stop it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537078737580068915)
- **auto retaliate**: Auto retaliate cannot be disabled; toggling out of WAR mode stops further retaliation, and otherwise you keep retaliating if close enough, archers also retaliate at distance, and in other cases you must attack manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525072452336750693)
- **auto retaliation in peace mode**: A character may keep attacking automatically because of auto retaliation even in peace mode; unequipping the weapon or toggling war/peace mode repeatedly stops it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550796945524793357)
- **auto self-heal setting**: There is no in-game setting to auto cast heal spells on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **auto-attack spellcasting**: There are no auto-attack spellcasts; spells must be cast manually and a target chosen, which can be streamlined with hotkeys for each spell plus a Last Target hotkey pressed once the target reticle appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554680198635589663)
- **auto-firing of hamstring and disarm settings**: Auto-firing of Hamstring and Disarm is configured in Paperdoll -> Help -> Commands -> Mechanics tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542875179678433350)
- **auto-swing on combat initiation**: When not in combat, your character automatically starts swinging at the first thing that initiates combat against it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540562725086691348)
- **autocast and cleansing effects**: Autocast can handle cleansing effects, but not every effect can be autocast at once, so some must be handled manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524466979543715921)
- **automatic retaliation when attacked**: If something attacks you and you have no current target, your character automatically attacks back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529171232702992506)
- **automating disarm and hamstring**: Use the [DisarmUntoggleMode command to automate disarm so you don't need to press the disarm button each cooldown; [HamstringUntoggleMode does the same for hamstring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537803314966822912)
- **avadon mob difficulty**: The average mob encounter across Avadon can probably be killed by a couple of daemons, though this is an uncertain estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554628837512323116)
- **avar requirement fe skill**: Without 110 FE you have no chance of getting Avar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534511570124537866)
- **avarite gear risk**: Avarite gear is nice but is probably not worth risking by donating it to PKs or orcs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528701555900153987)
