- **avarite gear usage**: Some players reserve avarite gear and spellbooks for sanctuary dungeons only and use gold-tier gear for other content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526694937599676670)
- **avarite map danger**: Avarite maps are dangerous because Flame creatures can ambush a player on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528896722284183582)
- **average farming dps**: Average farming DPS for players with 720 skill points is roughly 400, while a 500-skill-point character would probably reach only about 250 to 300. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528487202890186814)
- **avoiding cone attacks with pets**: With pets set to non-aggro, face the mob away from them; the pets stack up behind the mob and avoid its cone attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528796384067719428)
- **axe damage versus swing speed**: Axes tend to be the sweet spot for damage versus swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524838407472156894)
- **axeman template strength**: The axeman template (Flaying and Rend) is no longer considered strong, and Wrestling is currently the preferred build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536073898741862471)
- **axes for pvm**: Axes can be dual wielded and are in the burst weapon category, which makes them acceptable but not ideal for PvM, where a grinding category weapon is preferred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531368747565191299)
- **azure ranged peace-sniping**: The azure ranged attack allows peace-sniping a mob inside a pack without pulling the rest of the pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545543328030793778)
- **azure special attack**: The Azure's special attack auto-hits every 7.5 seconds, deals 2.25x damage (the hardest-hitting pet attack), ignores 50% of armor, and has a 12-tile range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549868507640889505)
- **azure wyrm bard bonus and codex cooldown reduction**: The azure wyrm's bard-related bonus appears to be a cooldown ability, so specializing the codex in cooldown reduction is suggested as a strong combo, but whether it avoids the upcoming nerf is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530277276048949500)
- **backgating second character while digging treasure chest**: While digging up a treasure chest, cast gate to a marked house or inn rune (for example the Shelter inn rune) to bring in a second character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538295024016560198)
- **backstab and finishers**: Backstab does not use finishers effectively, so finishers do not matter for backstab damage, while stances and the Wild Swing ability still apply when using a mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524240182990213212)
- **backstab arcane mage template weaknesses**: A backstab arcane mage template is weak: without stealing it lacks the thief codex, it lacks SDI skills to boost backstab, its links do not synergise, its aspect benefits only arcane or backstab, and it needs a 13 second setup for about 1000 damage at best. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550801481844793407)
- **backstab build priority**: Maxing Wild Swing should be the first goal when building a backstab character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524240938770235392)
- **backstab build weapon combination**: A backstab build may use a high-damage weapon such as macing for the opening hit, then finish the mob with archery or throwing to avoid chasing it for a second hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554115484880863294)
- **backstab damage modifiers**: Anything that affects melee damage also applies to backstabs, but the backstab damage chainlinks are by far the most impactful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530808622081118268)
- **backstab definition**: In Outlands, backstab only means attacking from a hidden then stealth position and is not limited to blades, so wrestlers and archers can also backstab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525989876984709182)
- **backstab from spell invisibility**: It is unconfirmed whether you can backstab from spell invisibility; if not, use a smoke bomb, or cast invisibility and then use the Hiding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550788455192330306)
- **backstab in pvp**: Backstab cannot be used in PvP in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539317419779170405)
- **backstab mounting requirement**: You must dismount before you can backstab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534117863378653185)
- **backstabber armor type**: Armor type matters for a backstabber only when mind blasted in PvP; in PvM it does not matter, so plate can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533721386361819277)
- **backstabber aspect armor choice**: Backstabbers can wear Fortune or Death aspect armor instead of Shadow aspect armor, depending on goals and redline. Death armor can hit for 20k about 51% of the time with disease procs, and still hits for 10k without Shadow armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536533200635957359)
- **backstabber aspect choice**: Backstabbers mostly play with the Fortune or Shadow aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879211811741767)
- **backstabber build viability**: The Backstabber build is still good after the latest patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535394516209762326)
- **backstabber end goal**: The eventual goal of a backstabber build is to one- or two-shot most mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526152283832717333)
- **backstabber farming targets with raised damage cap**: With a raised damage cap, a backstabber should consider farming monsters with 12-13k HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536533485043580970)
- **backstabber hunting loop**: Backstabber loop: hide, wait for the cooldown, stealth, walk up to the mob, swing once, then loot the mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531522698080161892)
- **backstabber link priority**: Backstabber Damage links are the first links to buy for a backstabber. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521664718862028933)
- **backstabber mugging synergy**: Backstabbers who also use mugging do very well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522305449180008570)
- **backstabber playstyle controls**: Backstabbers are best played with hotkeys for potion, hide and stealth rather than a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522380169271181352)
- **backstabber positioning**: When playing a backstabber, stay near corners and bends in the road so you can break line of sight to hide after you stab and run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524846645378941029)
- **backstabber pvp templates**: Backstabber templates are not feasible for fighting back against PKs, so the practical approach is to rely on staying hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524789359289565224)
- **backstabber safety**: Backstabbers are very safe to play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521643186726899936)
- **backstabber shadow aspect tier target**: A backstabber build should aim for at least tier 10 in the Shadow aspect, though the tier at which it starts one-shotting enemies is unclear and takes a while to reach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534678304093638666)
- **backstabber skill flexibility at damage cap**: Once a backstabber reliably hits the damage cap, it can run almost any skill choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541914414738055168)
- **backstabber skill setup**: Most backstabbers train Snooping and Stealing alongside their other skills so they can steal gold from a mob when landing a backstab hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531780489289924658)
- **backstabber skinner build in groups**: A backstabber (skinner) build takes a while before it can attack while others already work the mob, so it is not ideal for group play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530704165574017205)
- **backstabber solo build**: Backstabbing is considered the best solo build but is rough until the character is damage capped, after which it can kill a boss with no issues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538331614738907259)
- **backstabber survivability**: Backstabbers are very squishy when they make mistakes, and Anatomy plus Healing gives room to survive errors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541915178608762970)
- **backstabber tactics and codex allocation**: A backstabber who wants to take down PKs that are red-lining can keep Tactics and spend Codex points elsewhere, though this is a niche option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541913518973132821)
- **backstabber template for stealing from players**: The backstabber/mugger template can be used to steal from players with minor changes depending on style, such as gray baiting or snatch and dash. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522306649027776704)
- **backstabber template hiding**: A backstabber template is reportedly hidden about 95% of the time, which can help players dealing with high latency or lag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545963535689850962)
- **backstabber template strength**: Backstabbers are slow to get going but become one of the strongest templates once the aspect has been progressed a few levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521641669492080702)
- **backstabber vulnerability to damage over time**: Backstabber builds without Alchemy are susceptible to damage-over-time effects such as bleeds and disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541913171617390622)
- **backstabber weapon and smoke bomb use**: A backstabber can use a quarterstaff for more speed, and should use a smoke bomb to hide again if the next non-hidden hit will not kill the mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549061301492518945)
- **backstabbing a corpus with a bow**: Attempting to backstab a corpus with a bow equipped will get the player killed because they are at range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554116118124306663)
- **backstabbing and fortune in pit trials**: Backstabbing and Fortune are considered poor choices in pit trials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520914866901352528)
- **backstabbing expansion changes**: Backstabbing in general improved in the expansion, mostly by a small amount, but archery backstabbing received a significant boost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527475104559398912)
- **backstabbing in pit trials**: Backstabbing is slow in pit trials because there are many targets, so a backstabber is unlikely to profit unless lucky with a random link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527815425843400866)
- **backstabbing in pvp**: Backstabbing gives no damage bonus in PvP, so a backstab build is good for PvM but generally poor in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540436924722847815)
- **bait crook against thieves**: A bait crook lets thieves steal it and reveal themselves, which buys time to escape while the crook still provides damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522367675823554681)
- **balestra crossbow finisher and ability**: Ricochet (finisher) and Skirmish (ability) are suggested for a Balestra crossbow with Madness on the weapon and Lightning on the armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545938812063186985)
- **bandage healing**: Bandages restore health, take time to resolve, and heal a substantial amount of HP, so players must learn to time them early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547565332720517180)
- **bandage healing mechanic**: After using bandages you get a target reticle; clicking it on a target once starts the healing timer, and when the timer reaches 0 the target is healed as long as the healer is still in bandage range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527524668192592003)
- **bandage healing of others**: Bandages can heal and resurrect other players, whereas potions cannot heal others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525428258600910848)
- **bandage resurrection message**: When you use bandages to resurrect a dead player, they receive a message saying you are trying to heal them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525311364598595707)
- **bandage theft prevention**: To prevent bandage theft in dungeons, hide bandages in trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548535727992610877)
- **bandaging while fighting**: To let bandages heal during combat, joust by moving in and out of mobs so bandages have time to complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524466329841565860)
- **bandaging while fighting**: You can bandage while fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529231455778246787)
- **bard and taming skills with two-handed melee**: Pairing Bard or taming skills with a two-handed melee template is a good boost, since pets can kill monsters while you also attack them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524977348875911289)
- **bard archer aspect setup**: For a bard archer, start with lyric armor and your highest leveled aspect on the weapon, then go lyric/lyric once comfortable; if no aspect is leveled, go lyric/lyric. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550928851863863476)
- **bard archer build order**: For a bard archer, a suggested order is to unlock the Repeater special ability first, then put 1 point in Arcane stance, then 5 points in everything else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553433941426569278)
- **bard archer codex choice**: A bard archer should take the archery codex, the bard codex, and whichever of the alchemy or healing codex is used to keep themselves up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676366764249218)
- **bard break links for solo play**: Bard break links are meant for group content and are not worth running solo, because breaks are not a bad thing for the bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525179298116538528)
- **bard break reduction sources**: Bard breaking is reduced by the bard codex, lyric, and chain, so effective barding can come from multiple sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522285676496949259)
- **bard breaking difficulty scaling**: Bard breaking becomes more annoying the higher the difficulty of content being played. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522285640958607411)
- **bard buff range**: Bard song buffs last only while the buffed player stays within range of the bard, which is reportedly about 50 tiles now (older 2018 notes said 12). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292152137650248)
- **bard buffs and bleed damage**: Bard buffs greatly increase bleed damage, which makes the lyrical swords build strong and means dual wield would not benefit similarly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551034781653803132)
- **bard buffs for tamers**: Bard buffs and debuffs are a good damage source for a tamer but typically cost weapon procs; a Syop bard buff gives constant extra damage and damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541528539306795028)
- **bard class viability**: Bards are liked as support characters and are also considered good on their own. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540037996081053837)
- **bard codex damage perks and pets**: Bard Codex perks that add damage apply only to your own character, not to your pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541924419843137648)
- **bard damage gating**: A bard's power is gated behind a skill timer and requires many conditions to be met to reach full damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535184043170201610)
- **bard debuff and aggro skills**: Discordance and double barded are damage debuffs, while Peacemaking and Provocation are aggro tools that also act as accuracy debuffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554095111162437744)
- **bard defensive barding**: A bard who attacks loses the defensive barding resist and wrestling benefits, so a bard is generally better off running away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551759746275475478)
- **bard defensive tools**: Bards use Peacemaking for defense along with Discordance and bard break powers, and defensive barding is also available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555517245759950891)
- **bard difficulty ceiling**: Bard reaches a ceiling where, once mob difficulty is high enough, bard abilities can no longer affect them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548784688351543411)
- **bard dps and richardo**: Bard is currently reported as the highest DPS option, and running 120 forensics and camping is said to allow obtaining richardo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531406364407107804)
- **bard duo partner**: A bard makes a good duo partner because pacifying or provoking mobs keeps both players from taking damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538615611884699708)
- **bard farming speed versus tamer**: Bard farming is slower than Tamer farming, but groups value bards highly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555982899969531976)
- **bard group damage buff**: A bard in a group buffs everyone's damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548801855629561980)
- **bard healing options**: A bard without Magery or Chivalry can only heal using Healing Potions, so bleeds and disease are very dangerous to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542565164421746728)
- **bard instrument range**: Discordance and Peacemaking can be landed from 12 tiles away without the mob aggroing the bard, including caster mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555524364471107614)
- **bard mage support role**: A bard mage can cover the main support roles (buffing, debuffing, healing, aggro management), since bard songs provide damage, damage reduction and healing buffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554095111162437744)
- **bard opening move**: When fighting as a bard, use Discordance first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525179651071410240)
- **bard opening with discordance**: A bard can open a fight by casting Discordance on the enemy and then using Peacemaking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521958060925653032)
- **bard pacify and discordance**: A bard can pacify mobs and apply Discordance to them, which lowers their attack and increases damage dealt against them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526150310433919017)
- **bard paladin build strength**: The bard/paladin ('peacadin') build is very powerful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547361770132344943)
- **bard power sources**: A bard's power comes mainly from mastery chain links and the Lyric Aspect rather than the weapon in hand, and it does not feel powerful until having some links and Lyric hits around tier 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555517434209771623)
- **bard provocation and peace songs**: Provocation song gives a lot of extra damage and peace song gives a lot of extra healing, and the peace effect also gives 15% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541926147078623303)
- **bard provocation onto players**: A bard can provoke mobs onto other players, but doing so loses defensive barding benefits and flags the bard for PvP, preventing moongate use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551830705879908353)
- **bard provocation skill**: A bard without Provocation misses a lot of damage, so Provocation should be taken as soon as possible if you have points in codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524889509962186924)
- **bard pull procedure**: To pull as a bard, land Discordance first from about 12 tiles away without aggroing the mob, then kite with archery until Peacemaking lands, then shoot the mob until it is dead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555520844460073111)
- **bard pvp defense bonus**: Bards reportedly get a bonus to defense in PvP as long as they do not attack back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537583750836125758)
- **bard resistances**: Bard builds already have fairly strong resistances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553146060158009437)
- **bard rotation while summons fight**: While summons attack, a bard uses Provocation when there are several mobs or Peacemaking when there is only one, and keeps reapplying Discordance and In Nox and refreshing Provocation/Peacemaking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532363261977034754)
- **bard shield use**: A bard does not really need a shield except in certain hard places, where a medium crossbow can be used instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555515404301115445)
- **bard single-mob survivability**: Against a single mob, discordance and provocation alone are not enough, so you still take hits and need to kite unless you also level peacemaking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547610748073676811)
- **bard summoner weak matchups**: A bard summoner build struggles against monsters with high magic resistance and against the purple ballsacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526001503817568316)
- **bard support role**: Bard is generally the only or main support function players use to support others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551289547692965900)
- **bard tamer aspect split-leveling**: A bard tamer using a 64 blessed mage book can split-level any aspect more easily than any other build, enabling defensive barding when attacked in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545527586732376085)
- **bard tamer disarm against reds**: Bard tamers should fully disarm when attacked by a red (murderer) to keep the effective wrestling from defensive barding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554122458309861387)
- **bard tamer pet attack speed**: A bard tamer can push pet attack speed toward the cap easily and can cap it with a few links by tier 12-14, though this is unnecessary because azures' special attack cuts through armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545544889025171487)
- **bard tamer pet choice for dungeons**: Stompyboi and RNBB pets are great with a bard tamer for dungeons such as the Ossuary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545546234067161179)
- **bard tamer power level**: Bard tamers were at their peak power on Outlands as of the discussion in September 2026, though balance may change with patches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551269552245964963)
- **bard tamer song failures on hard monsters**: A bard tamer may fail songs more often against hard monsters such as daemons and level 4 dungeon content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527941788612956300)
- **bard tamer weapon requirement**: A bard tamer can keep an activated crook in the bag but must hold an aspect weapon, such as a spellbook, in hand; without weapon specialisation a bard tamer does almost no damage compared to pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555998619302236174)
- **bard versus healer in parties**: A bard is generally more useful than a dedicated healer in a party because most players carry their own self-heal, though a healer is better for Time content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548783809720229980)
- **bard weapon aspect**: A bard can use a weapon of a different aspect and does not need a full lyric weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522288746404253717)
- **bard weapon choice**: A bard can use any weapon type depending on preference, and an archer bard with alchemy is considered a good combination. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530944206678261841)
- **bard wrestler codex stance**: For a bard wrestler, the crab codex stance (defense) and the dragon codex stance (offense) are the standard choices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525687427522498612)
- **bard wrestler dragon armor**: A bard wrestler using dragon armor likely does not need to worry much about armor stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524922310241288373)
- **bard wrestler link setup**: A suggested 30-link setup for a bard wrestler using lyric armor is 10 EFB, 10 Special/damage and 10 Damage to barded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524922213352869929)
- **barding codex damage modifiers and pets**: The damage modifiers from the Ensemble and Reverb barding codex nodes do not carry over to pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543429103145721896)
- **barding combat rotation**: Target the ground with all barding skills to apply songs, then target the enemy with Peacemaking; if it succeeds, attack the enemy, otherwise target the enemy with Peacemaking again and repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521957338360185052)
- **barding pacing**: Barding is gated by a skill timer, so it is slower than some other templates, but it provides a lot of crowd control and multipliers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555523995485601874)
- **barding upgrade priority**: For a barding character, Bard Codex and Summoner Tome upgrades that increase damage or improve special attacks are reportedly the best investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532320485671436309)
- **bards in group play**: Bards are valued for group play and are reported to be in high demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538574975374590043)
- **basic dagger usefulness**: The basic dagger is a fencing weapon whose damage is so low that it is essentially useless, comparable to a training weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555728921083912354)
- **basic summoner support role**: A basic summoner can heal everyone, and summoned elementals can hold aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542267177355321514)
- **battle-mage template viability**: Arcane mage is the closest template to a battle-mage, but wearing plate restricts mana regeneration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536542750457995346)
- **bear aggression**: Bears do not attack players unless they are attacked first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532534097136713880)
- **behemoth aspect with azure wyrmlings**: If you are using azure wyrmlings rather than the azure wyrm, switching the behemoth to the Hearty aspect is suggested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550546932798193818)
- **behemoth basilisk abilities**: The Behemoth Basilisk stones players and flies up to perform a devastating area-of-effect attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544027771716509706)
- **benefits of 120 chivalry**: Having 120 Chivalry provides more holy symbols (seals), a large increase in swing speed, and more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546678633115029575)
- **best armor type for non-casting melee**: Platemail is the best armor type for a melee fighter who doesn't cast, unless you prefer another look or have better quality, magic, or material armor in a lower armor type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547671086701740102)
- **best aspect for dexxers against bosses**: The Blood aspect is still regarded as the top aspect for dexxers fighting bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545667031238705163)
- **best bard weapon type**: For bards, dual wield is currently considered the best weapon type, followed by mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555492500557275167)
- **best boating build**: The Harpoon build is considered the best build for boating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530077073845256294)
- **best bow choice**: The 2H light bow is generally considered the best bow choice unless you need more accuracy or damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546377520474226709)
- **best bow type for archers**: Burst bows are currently regarded as the best bow choice for archers because of the 50% melee bonus, though this may change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541995084420087839)
- **best codex stance for poisoner**: Accumulate is considered the best codex stance for a poisoner, after Targeted Venom for single-target situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541742633112571975)
- **best damage summons**: Daemons and liches are considered the best summons for dealing damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529145096421773372)
- **best early tribard pets**: Warpigs or caster pets are the best early pets for a tribard tamer, and pigs remain best until you have many accuracy links or a decent barding chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523309760105943112)
- **best fencing weapons**: Short spear and pitchfork are the best fencing weapons by average DPS, but both are two-handed and cannot be paired with a shield for extra armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553401457666039858)
- **best group addition**: A bard is considered the most helpful addition when playing in a group, though this is one player's opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526779477793837218)
- **best mage boss-killing build**: The best mage boss-killing build is likely a glass cannon template with Death armor that relies on good Arcane proc luck. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528027252749504603)
- **best pet team**: There is no single best pet team, because different content and mobs call for different pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553574852261191786)
- **best single-target dps aspect**: Death aspect has the best single-target DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537450975713820722)
- **best tamer templates for farming and hard content**: For farming, a tribard tamer (Tamer/Bard) has the highest DPS, while a dex tamer archer is the best template for all content and harder content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546433804774805544)
- **best tank aspects**: Earth or Void are considered the best tank aspects depending on the situation, while Temporal aspect is rarely used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554320096418070539)
- **best way to raise aspect xp**: Ship PvM is reportedly the best way to raise aspect XP, and the standard pooner build can run pretty much any aspect, though this may have changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542223013594796102)
- **best weapon aspect for solo play**: Weapon Artisan is the best weapon aspect for solo play, and Madness, Earth, Air, Fire and Holy procs are all good weapon aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541953118869266472)
- **best weapon choice for tribard chivalry template**: For a tribard on a chivalry template, dual wield is currently considered best, mace gives big damage numbers, wrestling hits hard, throwing needs heavy micromanagement, archery is safest, and swords and fencing were nerfed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553859276639043627)
- **best weapon skills for lightning aspect**: Wrestling and Archery are the top two weapon skills for the Lightning aspect, according to one player's opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553802580327530617)
- **best wrestling aspect**: For wrestling, Lightning and Madness are ranked above Air, with later testing suggesting Madness is slightly better than the more RNG-heavy Lightning, and Fortune is useful on busy spawns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521561263660863741)
- **best wrestling finishers for solo farming**: Haymaker and Chi are the best wrestling finishers for solo farming in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524941494257975347)
- **best wrestling stance and ability**: The best stance and ability combination for a wrestling build is Dragon stance with Haymaker and Chi. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522773808166207598)
- **best wrestling stance and finisher**: Dragon stance with the Chi Thrust finisher is the best wrestling option most of the time; Dragon was previously unusable for a long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522243705510035626)
- **black rock elementals and zorns**: Black rock elementals and zorns shut down a caster's casting from near render distance by draining all of their mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544754664669450420)
- **blade spirits**: Blade spirits are a berserk-style all-rounder summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282212211003532)
- **blade spirits and energy vortexes vs innocents**: Blade spirits and energy vortexes do not attack innocents, so players cannot turn you grey by walking into them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521572010415624283)
- **bladewhirl multi-target ability**: Bladewhirl is a multi-target ability that is useful when farming around 4 mobs at a time, possibly for spreading poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539093718408233120)
- **bleed and disease survivability**: Panacea and Cleansing Brews, plus Close Wounds for dexxers with Chivalry, make it hard to die to bleeds and diseases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531348882934730762)
- **bleed application probability**: With a 34% chance on hit to apply bleed, about 12 of every 100 five-hit sequences apply no bleed at all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527780323201519657)
- **bleed blood dexxer aspect setup**: A bleed/blood dexxer remains viable with the Fire aspect on the weapon and Blood on the armor; Blood raises stats higher and improves survivability, which suits newer players, and Fire is recommended on the weapon rather than the armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548478629036687441)
- **bleed damage**: Bleeds were nerfed in general, though the date and magnitude of the change are unspecified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526945645456265307)
- **bleed damage links and bleed chance**: Bleed damage links increase the damage dealt by bleed but do not increase the chance to bleed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540954515723780148)
- **bleed damage strength**: Bleed damage is currently considered weak by players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525223904866472107)
- **bleed to wrestling link conversion**: When converting a bleeding-focused sword build to wrestling, the 'damage to bleeding' links must be replaced with 'damage dealt by player' links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522770936884101120)
- **bleed tracking and blood armor**: Bleeds are tracked individually, and the Blood armor bleed resolves differently from weapon bleeds with some skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542516673167237130)
- **bless and arch protection area of effect**: Bless has no area-of-effect, whereas Arch Protection is a base spell with inherent AoE unlike normal Protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525132288008192)
- **blessed cosmetic armor rating**: Blessed cosmetic armor slots reportedly have a flat 5 armor rating, roughly like basic leather, so high-level platemail can be more effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522264455092895774)
- **blessed spellbook as aspect weapon**: A blessed spellbook can serve as the aspect weapon, which leaves the hand free to equip a shield as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556000678965420063)
- **blessed spellbook aspect bonus**: You can hold the blessed spellbook and activate an aspect on it, but carrying it grants no bonus beyond what the aspect itself provides. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528607971641135104)
- **blessed spellbook requirement with arcane staff**: A normal blessed spellbook must still be in your inventory when using an arcane staff, since it holds your spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546669231167512626)
- **blood and lightning aspect armor effects**: Blood armor lets a mage run lower Intelligence and provides bleed and a 66% slayer effect, while Lightning gives periodic free Flame Strikes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522592701776789586)
- **blood arcane mage t8 boss clear time**: A solo blood arcane mage with about 30 links and some redline takes about 6 minutes to kill a T8 boss after the new HP changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538632175740526693)
- **blood arcane mage viability**: A Blood/Arcane mage build is solid but requires high-tier aspects before it comes online. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530349073037656284)
- **blood arcane mana from weapon swings**: On a Blood Arcane build, a few weapon swings restore enough mana to keep fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526593940755583017)
- **blood aspect and lightning armor for wrestlers**: The Blood aspect is comfortable for wrestlers because of its stat boost, and Lightning armor with Spider stance can be used to AoE bully lower difficulty enemies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541953929527697540)
- **blood aspect bleed chance**: The bleed chance granted by the Blood aspect increases only with higher aspect tiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539425700975616080)
- **blood aspect self healing**: Blood aspect does not include self healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546294743829446696)
- **blood aspect usefulness**: The Blood aspect is mainly good for the initial hit, or for players who face-tank special attacks rather than dodging them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535084067937329246)
- **blood demon armor for backstab**: Blood Demon reportedly has low armor, which makes it good for backstab damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523014245669802105)
- **blood oath summon damage**: Blood Oath gives summons another 30% damage output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541962387718938654)
- **blood vs lightning armor usage**: Lightning armor is used most of the time, while Blood armor is used only occasionally or for bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545558422215200769)
- **boat boarding and looting by other players**: Other players can board a boat with low health, kill the crew, loot the boat, and then sink it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533373258819309579)
- **boat fishing mob difficulty**: Mobs encountered while boat fishing are not very difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409534826061954)
- **boat pvm**: Boat PvM is considered both fun and lucrative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531176063424659516)
- **boat speed upgrades safety**: A fishing boat with all the speed upgrades is very safe on the ocean, with players going months without being killed despite hours of daily play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549785556970512416)
- **boating aspect choice**: Almost any aspect works for boating, and most players choose Fortune for extra loot and experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545479566988939375)
- **boating for new players**: New players starting boating should fight only small boats, maybe medium, because without links and boat abilities they will make little progress even against small boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526710923040133150)
- **bomb box locking behavior**: When a thief with lockpicks tries a locked bomb box, a menu appears showing it is trapped, but an unlocked bomb box shows no menu and explodes immediately, so a bomb box should be left locked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522376608126599179)
- **bomb box need for pvm farming**: A bomb box is not needed for farming in PvM, because trapped pouches already act as a sufficient warning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527623418332057641)
- **bonding with multiple pets**: When bonding pets, use several pets so that monsters do not directly target your newest unbonded pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539494952575443015)
- **bonfire wisp versus phoenix for tamers**: A bonfire wisp supported by the right pets may give results similar to a phoenix, which has bigger damage numbers while the wisp is more consistent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537922743365013506)
- **book mage spellbook choice**: A book mage generally prefers a crafted spellbook over a magical spellbook because of meditation rate, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531179518323069029)
- **book mage summon mana regeneration**: Book mages with summons received a mana regeneration buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526306249908555978)
- **boom box crafter turning red**: A character who uses boom boxes to kill enough blue players will eventually turn red, so the boom box crafter should not be your main gatherer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538723378829987922)
- **boombox and thief interaction**: The developers reportedly want to give thieves a way around Boomboxes and may tweak Boomboxes as a result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **boreal faerie wyrm and frost mephit sources**: A Boreal Faerie Wyrm can be obtained from Cav 4 or the broker, and a Frost Mephit tamed from SSC Level 1 is a solid alternative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535397936354172928)
- **boreal wyrm dummy dps**: Using the Boreal Wyrm on a training dummy inflates measured DPS numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532453830883803228)
- **boss and omni aspect setup**: For bosses and omnis, use the Madness aspect until level 66, then switch to Blood and a Void weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525223659655004210)
- **boss damage credit from followers**: Damage dealt by a player's followers does not count toward boss damage credit; only damage from the player's own character counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520255000117248030)
- **boss damage link**: Boss damage is the link to use for boss fights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527781343306711091)
- **boss loot and hp scaling**: Boss loot is considered underwhelming, and bosses keep increasing their HP over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542267292380045403)
- **boss loot sharing and helping**: Many guilds share boss loot equally, and a non-member can help a guild by dealing with small side mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601650729517067)
- **boss room flagging**: Hitting another group's boss, or even lingering in the boss room, flags you orange to that group. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546197930065526854)
- **boss room loitering risk**: Players in a boss room can be mistaken for thieves trying to steal a boss token, so watching another guild fight a boss from inside the room is risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599947141386271)
- **boss room mini-boss**: The mini-boss in a boss room has no loot and is not a mob or boss; it exists to stop anyone from hiding in the boss room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546120181678473258)
- **boss summoning**: Most bosses are summoned by guilds, which fill bars by killing a certain gold value of mobs in the boss's region and then consume those bars to summon the boss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528239669819740273)
- **bosses near the nightwalker**: Two different high-hit-point bosses spawn in the same area as the Nightwalker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530387217036349510)
- **bow and crossbow range**: A regular bow has a 10 tile range, while a heavy crossbow has an 8 tile range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542175939079970876)
- **bow retaliation when pets attack**: When pets are ordered to attack, a equipped bow may attack automatically through 'Retaliation'; it cannot be prevented, but tabbing out of war mode and back in prevents further retaliations, and unequipping the bow while pets move avoids it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527956741751570434)
- **bow swing speed bonus**: Bows do not grant a 10% swing speed bonus like wrestling weapons do. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550710341741191169)
- **bow type for archery builds**: The specific type of bow or crossbow does not matter for archery builds unless the player is wearing lightning armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526381202393792614)
- **break barrier bonuses against bosses**: Break Barrier bonuses against bosses are reduced to 50% of their normal value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525179472519626872)
- **bronze link melee special**: The bronze link melee special is described as Outlands' version of critical strike and is good to scale for a Holy Paladin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544898632845627453)
- **build choice in time dungeon levels 1-4**: In Time dungeon levels 1-4, any build works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524863863789588751)
- **build switching in deep time dungeons**: In deep Time dungeons, players switch builds roughly every 15 minutes to deal with specific mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524863828637257938)
- **builds able to reach harder content**: Tamers, arcane mages and summoners can go where most builds cannot, as can anything with variable heals or meat shields. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544831955336433754)
- **burst bows in pvm**: In PvM, burst bows are used for lightning archer builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527020268633981108)
- **burst weapons for non-backstabber dexxers**: Burst weapons are still usable by non-backstabber dexxers, though slightly less efficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538623050063413248)
- **butler resistance calculator**: Butler is the best tool for calculating resistances, because the in-game [stats command is not reliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547221749848875028)
- **caddelite elemental resistances**: The caddelite elemental is highly resistant to physical damage, though this is recalled from memory and may be imprecise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533932464769204465)
- **caddelite elemental solo difficulty and drops**: The caddelite elemental takes a very long time to kill when fighting solo and has a very small chance of dropping anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533929196454281296)
- **carrack advantage for ship farming**: A carrack makes it easier to farm other carracks and larger ships because it deals more damage and is tankier than a smaller ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542224947068280842)
- **cartography damage bonus and resource map mobs**: The Cartography damage bonus does not apply to resource map mobs, so it does not help a resource mapper dropped into a dangerous area such as the middle of Fury's Caldera. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531405580923830282)
- **cartography swing speed**: Cartography builds do not need maximum swing speed because their damage more than makes up for swinging slower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542234903247323269)
- **cast spells by one click option**: To enable single-click spell casting, open Options, go to Combat-Spells, scroll down to Spells, and tick the 'cast spells by one click' checkbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525888254929404014)
- **caster pets in boss fights**: Caster pets can be used in boss fights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541399487191326740)
- **caster pk damage and armor**: PKs who are casters reportedly do more damage the higher your armor is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524807927909585048)
- **casting from scrolls**: Casting from scrolls requires no reagents, weighs less to carry, and with Inscription gives damage bonuses to offensive spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554521536369659946)
- **casting from scrolls in pvp**: Casting spells from scrolls is allowed in PvP, and the wiki's Inscription page has a PvP bonus section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535813127923437649)
- **cavern chill debuff**: In the Cavern dungeon the chill debuff stacks up to 20% extra damage taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529068662760411270)
- **cestus and martial manual speed bonus**: A cestus and a martial manual give the same paired weapon speed bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523779835514847427)
- **chain lightning strength in codex**: Chain Lightning in the codex is very strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545560803393011765)
- **chain links and finisher chance**: Chain Links may increase the chance of Finishers activating, but this is unconfirmed and based on a single uncertain player claim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539551968652034058)
- **chainmail as camouflage against pks**: Carrying chainmail armor in your pack can serve as camouflage against PKs who hunt advanced players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525377856098795542)
- **challenger bonechiller magic resist**: Challenger Bonechiller reportedly has about 400 magic resist, making spells like Flamestrike do about 1 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544748112869064756)
- **challenger dungeon crowding**: The Challenger dungeon tends to have fewer players, PKs and thieves than the experience dungeon, meaning less mob stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546646600133255289)
- **challenger dungeon difficulty**: In a Challenger dungeon, the mobs have been increased in difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527902762489217136)
- **challenger dungeon difficulty scaling**: The Challenger dungeon scales the effective difficulty score, so players gain more experience as well as better drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540161302427603025)
- **challenger dungeon treasure chest loot**: Treasure chest loot tables in challenger dungeons are probably the same as normal ones, which can be checked by comparing the experience gained. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520700886249246720)
- **chaos shrine mini-boss summon**: The wilderness mini-boss summon takes place at the Chaos Shrine, a lawless zone, so other players can raid the fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523821301683191838)
- **chaos staff**: The chaos staff is a simple basic weapon buyable from an NPC vendor, roughly equivalent to a normal sword, and is intended for arcane mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527391827374637087)
- **checking and reaching swing speed cap**: Type [stats in-game to check your swing speed and accuracy, and eat food and keep Spell Siphon active (if you have Magic Resist) so you reach the cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525003481893834884)
- **checking mob difficulty**: To check a mob's difficulty, use animal lore on it with shift+click. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539241276363243531)
- **checking mob minimum armor with animal lore**: Use Animal Lore on a mob to see its minimum armor; if no minimum is listed, the minimum is 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541186945294536755)
- **checking murder counts**: To check your murder counts and sins as a PK, say [considersins in game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538447654650908734)
- **checking summon traits**: Right-click a summon and use animal lore to see its particular traits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523271841001504819)
- **checking swing speed**: Use the [stats text command in game to see your character's current swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537933689688686643)
- **chill stacking behavior**: Chill builds up with repeated application until it reaches max effect and keeps refreshing at max percent while you keep re-applying it; once you stop, it must be built up again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542515445343723550)
- **chivalry ability duration and holy symbol generation**: Chivalry abilities last 30 seconds, and a character generates 6 holy symbols per 30 seconds unless using holy armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521904597302640754)
- **chivalry dexxer swing speed**: The discussed Chivalry dexxer template reaches 59% swing speed with Divine Fury and 41% without it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544671142323691570)
- **chivalry dual wield swing speed sources**: For a Chivalry dual wield build, swing speed increase comes from Anatomy 100 (5%), Arms Lore 120 (6%), Chivalry 120 (18%), food (5%), Dual Wield (10%) and a shank (7%), totaling about 51%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544129496012038155)
- **chivalry for backstabber builds**: Chivalry gives a backstabber a free big heal and, at 90 skill, the ability to gate (teleport) around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531525373446328381)
- **chivalry for dexxer swing speed cap**: Outside of the Air aspect, a dexxer pretty much needs Chivalry to reach the swing speed cap, while with Air it may be possible to skip Chivalry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522770123801362462)
- **chivalry gate ambush**: A blue alt or friend can mark a chivalry gate near a gatherer so a red alt or friend can come through right beside them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534921913615253676)
- **chivalry gate ambush tactic**: Players mark a Chivalry gate beside a target and then gate in, a tactic used in much PvP content, especially factions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533040608619401258)
- **chivalry gate buff range**: A chivalry gate buff only works if the gate caster is in the dungeon with you and within about two screens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546144556607606794)
- **chivalry gate disruption of recalls**: Blue characters using Chivalry gates can gate in within 15 tiles of a player and disrupt that player's recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535312406727888944)
- **chivalry gate re-marking by attackers**: Attackers using a Chivalry gate can simply re-mark the gate to a new target location as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533035884327473276)
- **chivalry healing abilities**: Chivalry has two healing abilities, Holy Light and Noble Sacrifice, and Holy Light likely lets you target yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528402137351192717)
- **chivalry healing resource limit**: Chivalry healing is limited by its resource, which regenerates only 1 point every 5 seconds, so chivalry alone can struggle against ranged or mage mobs but is fine against mobs that deal no ranged damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552028233397043341)
- **chivalry healing usage**: Chivalry healing is not needed unless you are threatened or taking damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553149212852621417)
- **chivalry holy symbol uses**: Chivalry holy symbols fuel healing and Cleanse by Fire, along with permanent Divine Fury, though Chivalry 100 is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546686159625658498)
- **chivalry in combat**: Chivalry adds an extra element to combat because it works like a set of castable spells, and several of them are wanted on constantly, so players usually tick the box to auto-use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553893062718132265)
