- **chivalry on bard templates**: Bard templates in groups use chivalry so the player can resurrect other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553858778468978802)
- **chivalry poison mitigation**: Chivalry provides poison mitigation abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029186716340328)
- **chivalry sacred journey uptime**: The Chivalry Sacred Journey gate can be cast every 30 seconds and lasts 30 seconds, giving theoretically 100% uptime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532077224679706755)
- **chivalry spell curing bleeding**: A Chivalry spell reportedly cures bleeding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538912427649925251)
- **chivalry strength**: Chivalry is considered a strong and fun skill with great utility in addition to its combat performance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537818489996316774)
- **chivalry symbol regeneration rate**: Chivalry symbols regenerate at 1 symbol per 5 seconds, which is 6 symbols per 30 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541706491868749865)
- **chivalry wrestler swing speed**: A chivalry wrestler does not need swing speed from Magic Resist because the paired weapon setup already provides 10% swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523778179725262980)
- **choosing dungeon level for grinding**: If killing one monster on a deeper dungeon level takes as long as killing three or four on a shallower level, the shallower level is the better grind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535363527978786909)
- **classic mage in pve**: A classic mage (spells only, no summons or arcane) does not work well in PvE on Outlands because it cannot tank mobs well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527274287969599578)
- **cleansing brew**: Cleansing Brew removes all damage-over-time effects from the user, but it is hard to acquire and not worth stocking for general farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535404985343283210)
- **close wounds bleed removal**: Chivalry Close Wounds can stop a bleed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535404389295067238)
- **close wounds cooldown message**: After casting Close Wounds in Outlands, the player receives a system message that it cannot be cast again for a countdown of about 29 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539636954331877427)
- **closest pvpve build to pvp character**: The closest PvPvE build to a PvP character is a standard PvP dexer (swords and archery, no chivalry) with tier 10+ air aspect that does PvM strictly with archery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529607554919960596)
- **closest target cycling hotkey**: The 'closest' or nearest target-cycling hotkey works only against monsters in PvM and not against players in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549455207845339197)
- **codex ability cadence**: Codex abilities usually provide a decent buff or a heavy hit roughly once per minute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540564950270083102)
- **codex collection for pvm**: A character that will do any PvM should have every codex it has the skills for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547608198574514237)
- **codex finisher triggers**: Codex finishers like Pincushion trigger automatically; at rank 1 they trigger only when the target is at 5% HP or less, and at rank 5 when the target is at 25% HP or less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552887038062235739)
- **codex importance for builds**: All builds benefit from having their codexes, and players miss out on a lot without them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525326436142022837)
- **codex options and poison damage**: After the poison damage formula rework, codex options have little effect on poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537140410810507316)
- **codex points per summon**: In the codex, you can earn up to 20 points for each summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546920769433510040)
- **codex stance damage bonus**: A codex stance grants 3% bonus damage per rank, and a moving throw doubles it, so a rank 5 stance gives 30% more damage on a moving throw. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891368285642825)
- **codex stances and unlisted weapons**: Weapon codex stances do not list individual weapons such as the Cestus, but all stances affect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520801054407528478)
- **combat ability checkboxes**: Combat ability checkboxes turn on automatically when combat starts if you have the points, and they keep re-enabling after triggering until you have been out of combat for about 30 seconds (the exact timing is uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526313856937492510)
- **combat medic ability**: The Healers Codex ability Combat Medic gives patients a 2%/6%/10% bonus to damage resistance over the next 15 seconds, depending on rank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528219468474355855)
- **combat skill calculations requiring weapon**: A combat skill's attack and defence calculations, such as Macing, apply only while a weapon of that type is held in hand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537229628513718293)
- **combat skill effect on damage**: Raising a combat skill does not change damage unless two combat skills are used, in which case the supplemental bonus applies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537447204174692384)
- **command armor follower attack speed**: Command armor provides follower attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549865880308154389)
- **command armor for summon attack speed**: Command armor is recommended until you can cap your summons' attack speed with Spirit Speak links, and its attack speed bonus becomes almost a dead armor stat once you have 15 gold Spirit Speak links; the spellbook choice is minor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529065453429723167)
- **command aspect on spellbook**: Running Command on the spellbook increases follower (pet) damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533520086483075316)
- **command aspect procs requiring hits**: A command aspect proc cannot happen if the player cannot land a hit, since procs require the player to land hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522290294912061450)
- **command echo**: The Command echo gives a lower damage bonus than Frost but adds attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553580402252320909)
- **command proc with throwing weapon or staff**: Using a throwing weapon, arcane staff, or harpoon as the aspect item for Command lets a tribard tamer proc very rarely, but more often than never. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522383233084293280)
- **command summoner bard dps**: A command summoner bard is reportedly pretty good for DPS, though the claim is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530343632350216314)
- **commanding followers by name**: Named followers can be commanded by name, for example 'J come' or 'J guard me'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529118020402675784)
- **commanding pets individually by name**: Give each pet a different name, then command it individually with '[name] stop' or '[name] kill' style commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525136005496045639)
- **common pvm thief build**: The most common PvM-focused thief build is likely the Mugger, which uses hiding and stealth and backstabs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554835134673461250)
- **common pvp builds**: In PvP most players run magery with side skills such as parry, alchemy or summoning; dexxers are more common in faction fights but are not as good for dungeon pking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531505382835617832)
- **common tamer pet setups**: The most common tamer pet setups are warpigs (popular for the accuracy bonus from their ability and extra health as 2-slot pets), 5x1 high-wrestle frenzy pets such as Cryptwings, Black Cats and Blood Hunters, and spellburn casters such as Bonfire/Nightmare or Phoenix plus a 1-slot pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533490204860485643)
- **comparing template damage**: Open the damage meter with the command [damage to compare the damage output of different templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521641797942509609)
- **comparing weapon aspects on test shard**: To find the best weapon aspect, replicate your build on the test shard and try several weapons on that same build, comparing the resulting numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531773232129118299)
- **confirming a thief with detect**: A thief hunter can confirm that a player chasing a victim is a thief by using Detect Hidden with a lens on them; when the hunter then attacks the thief, the thief turns grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144756880154786)
- **consecrate weapon and bleed**: Consecrate Weapon, a Chivalry ability, is likely to affect bleed special damage, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546975414684098681)
- **consecrated weapon value**: Consecrated weapon is very worthwhile when a character has a high weapon special percentage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529223467512107169)
- **contested boss room pvp**: When a boss is contested, the whole boss room is fair game for PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546599683177324634)
- **cooking arcane mage dps target**: The DPS target for the cooking arcane mage build at T15 with 15/15 links is 1200+ on a prev dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524815575786983605)
- **core dungeon bosses**: All core dungeons in Outlands have a mini boss and a main boss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520605176405164182)
- **corpse looting likelihood**: Corpses are more likely to be looted when you die in high-traffic areas or wear valuable gear such as a full valorite or avarite set, compared with low-value gear like bronze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550751996653346827)
- **corpse looting method**: Currently you must target items in some way to loot them from a corpse; there is no automatic loot-all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542054433192550510)
- **corpse looting of armor**: Players looting corpses often take all armor, including armor bought from NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530642236214214687)
- **corpse skin disease stacking**: Disease procs from Corpse Skin effectively stack with each other, though each may run its own separate debuff with its own timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531751982346272850)
- **cortina quest on shelter island counting**: The Cortina quest on Shelter Island probably counts only mobs killed, based on mob value, and not looted gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554387498480963625)
- **cosmetic headwear armor**: Cosmetic headwear replaces the helmet and typically has armor equivalent to a leather helm, so wearing it instead of a plate helm causes a small armor loss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535620133488296030)
- **countering invisible mobs with reveal**: You cannot reliably stop mobs from going invisible, but casting Reveal and targeting yourself reveals an area around you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529702768703574128)
- **crab stance damage**: Crab stance does no damage and is not a DPS stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521892909786464348)
- **crab stance versus crane stance**: The extra damage resistance from Crab stance is likely better than the healing from Crane stance, though this has not been extensively tested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522243532881137826)
- **crafters in combat**: Crafting skills grant buffs that make fighting with a crafter character feasible, and the Skill Synergies wiki page shows which crafts help with combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522403043402846370)
- **crane codex skill for wrestling**: The Crane codex skill is suggested for wrestling builds when accuracy is below 100%, while crab or monkey are used for more wrestling-focused damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537775351189610506)
- **crane stance for hp regen**: Crane stance can be used when extra HP regeneration is needed, for example against otyughs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544427125560447037)
- **crane stance healing**: Crane stance in the wrestling codex heals 1 health per rank per combo, according to its in-game description. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546293865848381460)
- **crane wrestling codex style until 100% accuracy**: The Crane wrestling codex style is suggested until accuracy reaches 100%, after which another style may be preferable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545752547799859261)
- **crane wrestling dexxer azure pets setup**: A crane stance wrestling dexxer can run Azure pets; for dungeons like OSS with lots of weak trash, one author uses Giant Strider and Radiant Burrowbug while dropping Herding to 90 and raising Veterinary to 90. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546289138935013437)
- **criminal status duration**: Criminal status lasts 2 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538332632239177738)
- **cripple damage support for dexxers**: A bard friend or a fencer friend dealing cripple damage helps a dexxer deal more damage to a high armor class mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527480639299784835)
- **crook for herding and melee accuracy**: A crook such as an avarwood crook can be equipped for herding and melee accuracy synergy, and it is harder to steal when held in your hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546632504516280391)
- **crossbow ammo consumption**: A crossbow consumes less ammo than a faster bow, with slower attacks and bigger hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547985223231213693)
- **crossbow and bow choices**: One-handed crossbows have the highest average DPS and allow a shield for slightly more armor; two-handed burst bows do better damage on finisher shots or repeater; heavy crossbow and greatbow are stat-equivalent, and both have 2 tiles less range than two-handed interrupt bows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556006799268774051)
- **cure potions**: Cure potions erase poison, and you may need to drink several in a row to fully clear it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524982701491228953)
- **cure potions for poison**: Players without a reliable poison cure in their build can carry cure potions to cure poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551656914289430569)
- **cure spell**: The Cure spell removes poison, and a poisoned character shows a green health bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525834637786615928)
- **curing poison on yourself**: For curing poison on yourself, potions are generally preferred over Veterinary because they work much faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532929305972047972)
- **current arcane mage focus**: Current arcane mage play focuses on arcane swing speed while pairing it with other aspect armors and weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549538587853197393)
- **curse spell value**: Curse is considered a strong boost both offensively and defensively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533928155071643658)
- **curse spell value against mobs**: Curse takes a couple of Flame Strikes before its benefit outweighs its cost, and a mob is usually dead by then, so Curse is not worth casting outside of bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550568541827375267)
- **daemon and lich pairing against magic mobs**: After the recent magic resist change, running two daemons or two liches is better against magic mobs than one daemon plus one lich. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529139962925154495)
- **daemon hit chance**: With 100 weapon skill a Daemon has a 60% chance to hit you, which drops to 45% if you also have 100 Focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531699100657913897)
- **daemon keep mob dragging**: Mobs can be dragged outside the Daemon Keep's no-law zone and farmed there to avoid PvP risk, though some risk remains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522342723917447319)
- **daemon summon role**: Daemons are an all-rounder summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282212211003532)
- **damage bonus buckets**: Damage bonuses fall into buckets that multiply with each other; anything labeled melee or spell damage generally adds into one large common bucket, while other sources such as Tactics are separate buckets and multiply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540447447027945542)
- **damage bonuses and follower damage**: Damage-to-creature-type bonuses (such as slayers against barded or diseased creatures) and damage-boosting aspects like camping apply to your own damage only, not to your followers' damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541842341034459227)
- **damage calculators**: Stats are unreliable for judging damage, and outlandsbutler.com offers the most comprehensive set of calculators available to players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552169615973548123)
- **damage cap increase redline one-tap threshold**: With 24 redline points in damage cap increase, a character can one-tap mobs with 12k HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536533627083559003)
- **damage chain build order**: When building a damage-focused mastery chain, players start with damage links and eventually add attack speed links as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526386226666537030)
- **damage dealt by player links**: Damage Dealt by Player links are a flexible option that can benefit other builds too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532496747220308238)
- **damage done by player link**: The damage done by player link can substantially increase a mage's damage output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531233607941885962)
- **damage meter build comparison**: To compare builds in a damage meter, run a test of 5 minutes or longer so results stabilize, and enable the max spell damage toggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531290240424083646)
- **damage reduction for solo arcane mage**: For a solo arcane mage, reducing damage taken is a significant dps increase because it allows more sustained casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335754725331055)
- **damage resistance cap**: Additional damage resistance provides no benefit once you are already at the damage resistance cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547221880879063040)
- **damage resistance from held weapon or book**: Holding a weapon or book in hand appears to give about 10% damage resistance as a setup bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534581237555925142)
- **damage resistance link**: The damage resistance link increases overall resistances but is not considered worth it even for a tank archetype, and no regular dungeon requires defensive links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529067409674211328)
- **damage to diseased links for mage echoes**: Damage to diseased (DTD) links are eventually wanted for a book mage or arcanist echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545300630246006824)
- **damage tracking command**: The status page is an unreliable source for damage information; the [damagetracker command shows total damage and has a display for poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550688467334467685)
- **damage/ai link set order for void/lightning archer**: On the void/lightning archer build, the damage/ai link set is typically the last one players pursue among their 20-30 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526436290185265322)
- **ddbp links on arcane mage**: On an Arcane mage, DDBP is additive damage that is close to bleed in damage and works against everything, so higher DDBP links are generally better than damage-to-bleeding links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551407447166423054)
- **death armor defensive limits**: Death armor provides no defensive benefit, so a death dexxer sits well under the damage resist cap and plays as a glass cannon in farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532193980316647526)
- **death armor dexxer damage**: A dexxer wearing Death armor deals very high damage, out-DPSing a poison dexxer with multiple weapon types, and it works on live with less scaling than on test center. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532191402749071451)
- **death aspect for dexxer boss dps**: The Death aspect is poor for farming but is the best damage multiplier for boss DPS on a dexxer, reportedly better than Madness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541954038017564682)
- **death aspect for hybrid summoner**: Death aspect is a decent option for a hybrid summoner caster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525855595650093178)
- **death aspect for necromancer casters**: Death aspect is also a good aspect for a necromancer caster, not only for herders. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529063772088565830)
- **death aspect proc dps**: The Death aspect proc is still one of the strongest in terms of raw DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529063293262762145)
- **death aspect wrestler build**: A cheap wrestler build using Death aspect with 10 melee special, 10 DDBP and 10 damage to diseased (26 links) can deal more DPS than Madness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541953929527697540)
- **death dexxer build farming viability**: The Death dexxer build reportedly farms fine in level 3 and early level 4 content but probably struggles in deep level 4 unless cleansing brews are brought. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532203795059310644)
- **death disease dexxer swing speed needs**: The Death disease dexxer build needs a lot of swing speed, and dual wield and fencing builds get plenty of swing speed passively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532183116620234824)
- **death knight build**: A death knight build is a potential template in the upcoming patch, though many players call it mediocre. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536554555427528714)
- **death knight build summons**: A true death knight build in Outlands uses no summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532504458670637169)
- **death knight builds**: Death knight builds combining necromancy, death aspect and melee have been tried by several players and are considered poor even at 30 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531799039211864337)
- **death knight melee necromancy build**: No viable full death-knight style build combining melee and necromancy summoning has been shown on the test patch yet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533122058404233266)
- **death knight style approximation**: The closest available approximation to a death knight style is a normal dexxer wearing death armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532591434337747077)
- **death weapon proc handling**: If you get a death weapon proc, you can use Poison Strike to instantly consume most of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532109667541712936)
- **death wrestler template**: A Death wrestler template clears everything in tmap testing and is pleasant to play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537451410277535785)
- **dedicated healer for bosses**: For most bosses a dedicated healer is unnecessary because bosses die quickly and a regular summoner can handle the healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521200191401627898)
- **dedicated pvp alts versus echo**: Dedicated PvP alt characters are preferable to using echo because echo requires changing loadout, though echo is fine for timed events that can be planned in advance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526017834386325624)
- **defense needs in level 2 dungeons**: In level 2 dungeons players do not need to be as defensive as in harder content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528794171186483441)
- **defense versus damage mitigation**: Avoiding hits (defense) is considered better than reducing the damage of hits taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522347963265974292)
- **defensive barding**: Defensive barding only applies against players and turns off if you attack back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530275542870261800)
- **defensive barding**: If a bard does not attack a player killer back, they receive defensive barding, which uses music skills to give effects like wrestling and magic resist against the PK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554926475914911888)
- **defensive links survivability**: Defensive links combined with parry, healing and alchemy make a dungeon skinner/scavenger very durable; with 32 defensive links one can stand still in level 3 dungeons and outheal incoming damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527331052836753529)
- **defensive stance bonus deactivation**: The defensive stance resistance bonus probably deactivates when you switch off that stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531495532420141066)
- **defensive stance resistance bonus duration**: The defensive attack stances require hits to build up the resistance bonus; the bonus lasts about 5 seconds after a hit, and each hit refreshes the timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531496288225333450)
- **delectable food buff**: The delectable food buff grants an extra 5% swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537933689688686643)
- **demon hit points**: Most demons have about 16,000 hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541000665747165225)
- **demon kill time benchmark for farming templates**: A template that can kill a demon in roughly 30 seconds is generally considered good for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541000574789750845)
- **demon-level dps benchmark settings**: To approximate a demon benchmark on a dummy, use 120 wrestling, 50 AR and 25 MR, keeping in mind that real demons have higher MR. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541000418593742858)
- **detecting and escaping reds while farming**: Use tracking to detect red players and set an overhead message to warn of incoming reds; farm near a dungeon moongate and use ropes and teleports to escape. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521537411266642032)
- **detecting treasure map diggers**: Treasure map diggers can be detected by tracking players who stand motionless at about 100 tiles from a dig site, which is a sign of scouts watching it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **dex tamer command setup**: A dex tamer should use command armor and command weapon (raise command to 10-12 first) with follower damage links as the first 10 links; throwing and archery are also nice additions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526377474534150254)
- **dex tamer damage split**: On a dex tamer, the tamer's own damage is a very small share of total damage (roughly 5% player, 95% pets), so Follower damage links are better than ddbp links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527470951434948648)
- **dex tamer pk escape weakness**: A dex tamer template is very bad at escaping PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **dex tamer proccing consistency**: A dex tamer build gives consistent proccing, whereas at low aspect level proccing is not yet reliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552292855312293891)
- **dex trapper group play**: In a group, a dex trapper runs ahead and places a trap on the next target while the group follows behind and kills the creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526646700356407326)
- **dexer with 30 chain links vs tamer**: A dexer with 30 chain links plus redline outperforms a Tamer, though Tamer is still strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521612846851690747)
- **dexterity effect on bard cooldowns**: Dexterity does not affect Bard cooldowns; mage bards and dexer bards have the same 5 and 10 second cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523736559646671060)
- **dexterity potion effect on bandage timer**: The dexterity potion also affects the bandage timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475622145859677)
- **dexxer arcane staff shooter build**: A dexxer build that shoots spells from an arcane staff is considered a terrible build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527092483073245306)
- **dexxer armor and mana regeneration**: A dexxer build wears plate or chain mail at minimum, so mana does not regenerate fast enough to resummon creatures before they die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532561156294836334)
- **dexxer aspect armor choices**: Madness, lightning, air, blood, and earth aspect armor are all good choices for a dexxer, with earth armor being the tanky option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539815115933749278)
- **dexxer cartography treasure map build**: A dexxer build with 100+ Cartography is viable for treasure maps, with parry, alchemy and healing making the mobs easy to tank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546228944989323374)
- **dexxer chivalry swing speed breakpoint**: At 120 Chivalry a dexxer reaches 44% swing speed increase, which is 2 more gold SSI than the 42% at 100 Chivalry, and this reaches the swing speed cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554702990408159313)
- **dexxer damage links**: A dexxer build needs damage links on its chain, such as bleed damage or damage to player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532795948869091379)
- **dexxer damage maximization**: A dexxer maximizes damage by stance dancing, tossing explosion potions, and timing disarms with weapon abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522265589886882024)
- **dexxer disadvantage in pvp**: In Outlands PvP, dexxer builds are at a significant disadvantage, so landing only 2 of 10 hits is normal rather than bad luck. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535978809487003700)
- **dexxer discipline and holy armor**: Discipline and holy aspect armor are acceptable but not top choices for a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539815177879294013)
- **dexxer dps and farming setup**: In one player's test, a wrestling dexxer with Void weapon/Frost armor did about 440 DPS at 15 links versus about 470 for Discipline/Discipline, and Madness/Madness was judged best for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532430789545955459)
- **dexxer dps requirements**: Reaching 300-400 DPS with a dexxer requires committing fully to the dexxer build, and a 500-point dexxer likely cannot reach solid DPS even with 30 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528793948783644712)
- **dexxer link builds**: Builds exist that let a dexxer use links, and the tamer channel pin from Vin lists several tamer builds, including one using asps for damage to poison links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534340142150717540)
- **dexxer link threshold**: A dexxer build reportedly feels good-ish at around 20 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537550432254169098)
- **dexxer mace tribard armor choice**: A dexxer mace tribard who does not use mana should wear plate armor, since lighter armor types only provide more mana recovery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530266881787695154)
- **dexxer performance with low links**: A dexxer build performs poorly with low links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532822621970759781)
- **dexxer progression curve**: A dexxer grows stronger over time through XP-earned aspects and the mastery chain, which cannot be bought, so it starts weaker but ramps up massively later in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521075971195670568)
- **dexxer redline link order**: A typical dexxer redline link order is melee special/damage first, then cap swing speed, then damage by player, then probably melee/armor ignore (the last step is uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553258315159703673)
- **dexxer reliance on potions and bandages**: Dexxer builds rely heavily on potions and bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542589216012369940)
- **dexxer special move choice**: Spin Slash is a better special move than Rend for a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532795631394095175)
- **dexxer stat allocation**: A dexxer should run 100 strength, since intelligence does little for that build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524432023417126933)
- **dexxer swing speed target**: Dexxer builds should aim for 50% SSI to maximize damage, prioritizing damage before recovery, and skills that give both damage and recovery (like Alchemy) are highly valued. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529572877706199150)
- **dexxer swing speed target**: A dexxer build should aim to reach 50% swing speed with no links or as few links as possible, while keeping enough accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536382066508169216)
- **dexxer template link priorities**: For a dexxer template, suggested links prioritise focus, resist and swing speed, and air cores are currently cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533062179757097020)
- **dexxer versus tamer farming**: A dexxer may match a tamer's farming speed but cannot access the same content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538670483766120509)
- **dexxer weapon choice for farming**: Dexxers generally want grinding-category weapons for general farming, balancing swing speed and damage; 2H grinding is most popular for damage, while 1H plus shield gives more defense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538622217963966464)
- **dexxer weapon swapping**: A dexxer has seven potential weapons to swing at any given time, and choosing which weapon to swing determines how effective the player is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535498088255459469)
- **disabling trees to flee**: Turning off trees in the client options makes it easier to run away from a PK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522660762383024140)
- **disarm and hamstring activation modes**: Disarm and Hamstring can be set to stay always active, or set to attempt only once so that you must reactivate them for each attack you want to try them on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527407972064563221)
- **disarm and hamstring auto-activation**: Keeping Disarm and Hamstring always on is easier but not optimal: Disarm is pointless if you dodge special abilities, and Hamstring is a utility ability for kiting rather than for increasing damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536364164778557571)
- **disarm auto trigger**: Disarm can be set to trigger automatically on the next weapon swing and succeeds if the swing hits (RNG), or be triggered on demand so it can be paired with a Lightning shock and a weapon ability to ramp up damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522266699225628683)
- **disarm cooldown**: Disarm has a cooldown of about 30 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542875448147578880)
- **disarm mechanic**: A separate mechanic from Hamstring disarms opponents, unequipping shields and weapons, and these abilities are based on certain skills and activated by a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109910615957555)
- **disarm versus pk shields**: PKs in dungeons usually run 80 Parry with a shield, and a character with Arms Lore can use the disarm special move to break their shield and deal big damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **disarming dexxers**: Disarming a dexxer removes their wrestling, which gives a 100% hit chance against them, and the current PvP meta is dexxer heavy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530586626424705044)
- **discipline armor finisher chance**: Besides anatomy, discipline armor can increase weapon finisher chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529989846922170529)
- **discipline aspect bonuses**: The Discipline aspect gives well-rounded bonuses to both damage resistance and melee damage and is considered excellent value for its cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537541294086160485)
- **discipline aspect design intent**: The Discipline aspect was designed for Wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537550691344719983)
- **discipline aspect on archers**: Discipline aspect works well on an archer weapon for bossing and group farming in lower dungeon levels, and on armor in a group of archers it produces constant ricochets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551584029760036895)
- **discipline aspect pvm build**: The Discipline aspect PvM build works well with any weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548549439008804906)
- **discipline aspect special move trigger**: The Discipline aspect triggers special moves at 50% HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522778926999670935)
- **discipline macer finisher damage**: A macer using the discipline aspect regularly hits for around 6k or more on finishers, and can use one-handed weapons with a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528525065069793350)
- **discipline monk as mana sustain alternative**: Discipline monk is an alternative to arcane mage for players who struggle with mana sustain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521521549151305769)
- **discipline vs blood armor aspect**: With an Earth weapon, Discipline armor deals similar or slightly less damage than Blood armor in single-target fights but overtakes it in multi-target fights with spider stance, since bleeding hits only one creature while Discipline's boosted damage applies to all; Blood suits longer single-target fights and Discipline suits shorter or multi-target fights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537605547996614747)
- **discipline wrestler dps without parry**: A Discipline Wrestler without Parry reaches about 650 DPS, with finishers hitting for about 10k almost every time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528525176130638097)
- **discipline wrestler meta standing**: Discipline wrestler is considered close to the meta for both PvM and PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544425070544425001)
- **discordance at maus level 4**: A bard tamer with 80 skill and no EBS links can discord everything at maus level 4 and can even provoke with a few tries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544676645535752194)
- **discordance benefits**: Landing Discordance first makes Peacemaking or Provocation easier to land, increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555520844460073111)
- **discordance build vs veterinary build damage**: A 100 Discordance build with Herding dropped to 100 is reportedly about 9% better in damage than a 120 Veterinary pet build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551620307406688257)
- **discordance damage reduction**: Discordance provides a significant amount of damage reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533522402300919881)
- **discordance debuff at 80 skill**: Discordance at 80 skill applies a 17% damage debuff to the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541539739184922664)
- **discordance song buff**: Discordance also grants the bard song buff to the player in addition to its damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551616032509009973)
- **disease application with small spells and pets**: Using small spells such as Magic Arrow, Harm, Lightning and Fireball alongside pets can still apply disease to boost DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532727825352626346)
- **disease damage scaling**: A disease applied by necromancy or pets deals a percentage of the damage that triggered it, so a stronger trigger such as flamestrike applies a stronger disease than magic arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551930468579016705)
- **disease dot tracking**: Disease DoTs are tracked individually and come from sources such as blackguard on fencing and death aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542516673167237130)
- **disease effect stacking**: Each application of the disease effect, whether applied by the player or the player's pets, is completely separate and does not interfere with or override the other applications. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551932769687572554)
- **disease handling in ratman hovel**: The Ratman Hovel requires a way to deal with diseases, such as Chivalry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524465558475767878)
- **disease stacking**: Diseases do not override each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551930579426082879)
- **disease stacks**: A single disease stack has multiple ticks, so one spell applies one stack that deals several ticks of damage rather than a single tick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543606902951256084)
- **disease versus poison and cure**: Disease is not treated as poison for players, so the Cure spell does not cure disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525557825684639938)
- **disguising armor as unidentified loot**: Wearing a mix of random armor pieces rather than a full matching set makes it look like unidentified loot, so looters often skip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530645046897021038)
- **dispelling chill debuffs**: Chivalry's dispel curse may dispel some debuffs with luck, but debuffs cannot be mitigated easily, and chill may be reapplied almost instantly by mob melee attacks so the effect stays on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529068794121818164)
- **distraction flanking damage bonus**: Distraction gives a damage bonus when attacking a mob from its side or rear by increasing Stealth skill for the damage calculation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549051643314700449)
- **divine fury autocast**: Divine Fury is generally best set on autocast because it provides a large amount of swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524467089702785115)
- **divine fury for air wrestlers**: An air wrestler does not really need to use Divine Fury. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534865968654979123)
- **dodging periodic monster hits**: Hard periodic hits from monsters can likely be dodged by moving more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535779422005624853)
- **double bard damage debuff**: Having two bards (double barded) applies an additional 15% damage debuff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541539739184922664)
- **double barding accuracy bonus**: Double barding a target, using two of Discord, Provocation or Peacemaking on it, gives an accuracy boost against it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540177059681280070)
- **double lich pet survival with vet kits**: A double lich summoner using veterinary kits plus greater heals can keep the liches alive even against Khal Ankur 3 special attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530151929894666300)
- **double thrall summoner setup**: Running two thralls is a common summoner setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530673902454309147)
- **double void support mage tactic**: A common tactic is to run double Void on a support-focused mage during boss runs for healing, resurrection, PvP and leeching experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554557745112285276)
- **dps arcane tanking**: A DPS-oriented arcane build can tank some damage while still dealing damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537044283947884605)
- **dps benchmarking on a dummy**: When benchmarking DPS on a dummy, set wrestling and armor rating to reasonable values for the content you compare against, or the DPS numbers will be inflated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541000307541278751)
- **dps boost from farming with a friend**: Farming with a friend is considered the best way to boost DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522094777926156398)
- **dps measurement routes**: Repeatable routes such as AK3.5 heading north or Kraul 3 heading southeast in a circle can be used to measure DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532070268833370122)
- **dps test window**: To open the DPS test window, use the Damage Tracker entry in the Help menu on the client's top toolbar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555377889996968022)
- **dps-only pet builds early damage intake**: A character relying only on DPS pets takes a lot of hits until it can get an aspect and defenses up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528790303652184074)
- **dragging mobs from spawn**: Mobs can be dragged a little way from their spawn location, possibly farther in the wilderness than in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545496128135372860)
- **dragon cone attacks**: Dragons, drakes and wyrms have cone AoE attacks that can hit a player and their pets hard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528794629582094388)
- **dragon pet combination for pve**: For PvE, a dragon combination such as a water dragon and a skeleton dragon is considered a good tamed pet setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534001358007697438)
- **dragon stance versus crane stance**: Dragon stance is the newer stance players eventually switch to, while Crane stance is good when starting out because it keeps accuracy up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546326057848668220)
- **dragon vs monkey armor ring choice by mob ar**: Dragon is reported to be better against higher-AR mobs and Monkey better against low-AR mobs, with a break-even point around 60 AR. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541174918014697504)
- **dragon wrestling codex rotation**: With the Dragon wrestling codex, use Dragon, then Chi Thrust, then Brawl if the mob has lots of HP, or Haymaker if close to the finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534944228600184953)
- **drain self-heal chivalry crane stance tank limits**: A drain/self-heal tank build using Chivalry and Crane Stance is only sufficient for roughly dungeon level 1 or 2, because healing per second cannot keep up once enemies use abilities for 60+ HP every 8 seconds plus auto attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546341609698893864)
- **dual weapon skill pvp setup**: A PvP character with both a close-range weapon skill and Archery can fight with a sword or mace and switch to a bow when the opponent runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555274705584398407)
- **dual wield accuracy with air 12 aspect**: A dual wield build with Air 12 aspect should reach about 100% accuracy, and with Anatomy at 100 Chivalry is not needed, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528265253371117721)
- **dual wield bard dexxer build**: Dual Wield suits bard dexxer builds because it has a stance, finisher and ability that gain bonuses from being to the side or behind the target, which combine with barding bonuses to bridge the dexxer power curve gap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542592835906445333)
- **dual wield codex feint stacks**: Feint stacks that the dual wield codex applies to enemies give damage reduction, which suits single-target tanking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524861383081066526)
- **dual wield poisoner stance**: A dual wielding poisoner dexxer is recommended to stay in Defensive stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520924382682153073)
- **dual wield special attack group buff**: The Dual Wield weapon special attack also buffs the user and their allies, making dual wielders desirable for group play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541414693065981962)
- **dual wield stance switching**: When playing a Dual Wield build, switch between the aggressive and shank stances during combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522230617620611202)
- **dual wield versus swords**: Dual Wield is not strictly better than Swords; players report that Swords likely does more damage and Dual Wield feels weak by comparison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539631933326102569)
- **dual wielding damage**: Dual wielding does more damage than swords only when the player stands behind the target, so it needs positioning; swords are more straightforward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544741422849327187)
- **dual wielding finishers**: Dual wielding finishers are passive and trigger randomly, with a higher chance when the mob is at low health; each Stance raised to level 5 raises the Finisher by one level, and they are rarely seen at low rank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530559055108767845)
- **dual wielding on thrower builds**: Dual wielding adds nothing to a thrower build and is recommended to be dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521856048430842017)
- **dual wielding versus wrestling damage**: Dual wielding in aggressive stance can do about the same damage as wrestling, though weapon abilities struggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523499445008994405)
- **dual wielding viability**: Dual Wielding can be good but may need more links to work out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545095283854147616)
- **dual wielding when testing aspects**: Dual wielding is considered a handicap compared with other options when testing aspects such as Temporal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521598857409200188)
- **dual-boxing mobs in the wilderness**: Fighting mobs in the wilderness with two characters at the same time is allowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542333564262027365)
- **duergar special attacks**: Duergar mob special attacks are dangerous for dexxers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541391668299829248)
- **dullhide spellbook for pvp**: Dullhide is an accessible material for a PvP spellbook, giving a large mana regeneration bonus in a weapon setup while unflagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535807784682004480)
- **dummy testing accuracy with mob damage reduction**: With the new mob damage reduction (DR), testing on a dummy may be a less accurate measure of damage against real monsters, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540954515723780148)
- **dummy testing bias toward bleed damage**: Dummies cannot die, so the longer a test runs, the better bleed damage appears compared with a battle target, which skews results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541000307541278751)
- **dungeon boss spawning**: Guilds summon dungeon bosses, and random boss spawns also occur roughly every 12-24 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553157808449519727)
- **dungeon build viability and depth**: Any build can work in any dungeon, and the more advanced a character is in the five progression systems, the deeper they can go. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520507896503337155)
- **dungeon chest picking as loot source**: Dungeon chest picking is a way to obtain loot comparable to PvM without killing monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550327206952181791)
- **dungeon corpse recovery**: Every dungeon has a healer outside it, so after dying a player can resurrect there, buy heal reagents, bandages and heal/cure potions, then run back in naked to try to loot their body. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525805794216509582)
- **dungeon floor difficulty**: Higher floors of a dungeon are harder than lower ones (e.g. Ossuary level 4 is harder than level 2), so players should test floors to find where they can kill comfortably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525860452242952213)
- **dungeon gold beacon event**: The gold beacon in the dungeon is a PvP event on level 1 with no mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535623631072137308)
- **dungeon level 4 danger**: Dungeon level 4 can be dangerous if you are not careful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045808063356959)
- **dungeon level choice for killing speed**: Killing mobs faster on a level 2 dungeon is better than being able to tank them on a level 3 dungeon if the kills take very long. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529113919338315806)
- **dungeon loss risk from reds**: Players can lose everything to a red (murderer) deep in a dungeon, a risk that guild resources make easier to handle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525716644498898986)
- **dungeon mount restriction**: In dungeons players are forced off their mounts, which reportedly gives a better fighting chance against PKs than in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664481657888779)
- **dungeon pvp magery template**: A dungeon PvP template uses 40 Magery with scrolls for circle 3 and 4 spells such as telekinesis, teleport, wall of stone and greater heal, plus Dispel Field scrolls, though scroll casts may fizzle somewhat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554233852501819462)
- **dungeon pvp strategy**: Dungeon PvP rewards staying alive and using mobs to your advantage more than raw damage, unlike faction or overworld PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554236081149579360)
- **dungeon pvp versus overland and event pvp**: Dungeon PvP plays out differently from overland PvP or event fights like Town Battle, so separate characters for dungeon PvP and for factions are advisable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528352208075362415)
- **dungeon safety tactics**: In dungeons, position at spots with more than one escape route and a reachable portal, and rotate between dungeons to learn the layouts of their first levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530325991719964722)
- **dungeon scavenger tactics**: A dungeon scavenger can stealth around when possible and fire out elementals when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538854948379435028)
- **dungeon spawns during xp week**: During XP week, dungeon spawns are likely to be already killed because of crowding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528977427919798272)
- **dungeons for experienced players**: Ssc, Hive and Tidal dungeons are intended for experienced players rather than newcomers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538573225121030244)
- **duo partner for provoker**: A tanky character, tamer, or summoner is a good duo partner for a provoker because they hold aggro when provoked mobs are not kept provoked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538615772979658803)
- **duo t8 treasure maps with prestige drop**: Duo T8 treasure maps are still well worth doing once the prestige drop is added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529903284402258102)
- **early arcane mage spell rotation**: With a low proc rate early on, an Arcane Mage should rotate small spells until the proc rate improves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536201110753251348)
- **early chivalry benefits for tamers**: Early on, Chivalry gives tamers extra heals, an instant resurrection of one pet every 30 seconds, and Sacred Journey for travel to dungeons and towns until they have a filled rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536058501757931592)
