- **early lightning bolt damage**: A new character's Lightning Bolt deals low damage early on, roughly equal to one spear hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523002937524224080)
- **early mage mana limits**: Starting mages scale poorly early on, casting only about three spells before running out of mana, especially on an arcane character with poor mana regeneration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525626261173702686)
- **early pit trial waves**: The first several waves of a pit trial contain only low-value monsters, so a character earns little reward for the time spent early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527815890006184016)
- **earth aspect for early wrestling**: The Earth aspect is a fine choice for early-game wrestling, as it makes you more comfortable and lets you die less, and the cores are cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539073610952474685)
- **earth aspect for sustained tanking**: The earth aspect is considered much better than other aspect options for sustained tanking in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524862490519797890)
- **earth aspect macing build**: An Earth aspect macing build is reported to be very tanky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545184144290615397)
- **earth aspect weapon armor pierce**: An Earth aspect weapon provides an armor-piercing proc, which is best tested against heavily armored targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537535038168502302)
- **earth elemental earthquake immunity**: Earth elementals are believed not to be immune to earthquake, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553606484712230913)
- **earth elemental for summon trapper**: Earth elemental is preferred for summon trapper builds because it is the tankiest summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546357525996249189)
- **earth elemental summon duration**: A cast earth elemental summon lasts about 2 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551148450115092551)
- **earth elemental tanking upgrades**: Upgrades that increase earth elementals' damage resistance or survivability make them tank well, including against daemons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529112058417643672)
- **earthpull for summoner against multiple mobs**: Earthpull is good for a summoner when fighting multiple mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549663228072828981)
- **easy taming teams for 100 or lower taming**: Easy-to-acquire taming teams for 100-or-lower taming that remain very good include 5x flamehounds, 2x nightmares with a flame minion or searing imp, 5x corpse eaters (which may be nerfed), and 2x searing mantis with a firebat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540108377227665418)
- **eld aspect value**: The Eld aspect is considered great for its cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521594700564533388)
- **eld versus death aspect for necromancers**: Eld aspect sometimes outperforms Death aspect on necromancer builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528188326698287105)
- **elder daemon summoning**: Elder daemons cannot be summoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549912432682602559)
- **eldritch armor mana refund**: Eldritch armor mana refund is currently 57.5% (down from 72.5% about three years ago) and falls to 50% when any other aspect armor is mixed in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549498344898826356)
- **eldritch aspect build links**: An Eldritch aspect build can use the links 'damage to disease' and 'damage dealt by player'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541087925637484585)
- **eldritch aspect energy surge**: The Eldritch Aspect special Energy Surge deals (600 + 60 * Tier Level) damage split among creatures within a 6 tile radius, reduces their Magic Resist by (25 + 2 * Tier Level) for 30 seconds, and creates a 30 second Mana Well providing (10 + 2 * Tier Level) mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545887432661008497)
- **eldritch aspect for pet summoners**: Eldritch is the weakest aspect for pet-damage summoners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527470070312206437)
- **eldritch aspect for turbo meditation book mage**: The Eldritch aspect also works for a turbo meditation book mage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545301209613869126)
- **eldritch build rotation**: The Eldritch build casts from scroll, cycles through damage spells whenever grimoire cooldowns allow, and spams FS in the gaps between those cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541088039412039752)
- **eldritch mage mana regeneration links**: An eldritch book/armor mage build can use damage done to player, damage to dungeon (dtd) and meditation links to get strong mana regeneration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531232189780332544)
- **eldritch stick mana generation**: Eldritch on a stick (stickmage) generates much less mana than mana thief does as it stacks up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549498344898826356)
- **eldritch summoner build**: Eldritch summoner is a cheap build, and mage-summoner builds that emphasize the mage side are essentially a summoner version of a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541399487191326740)
- **eldritch summoner link choice**: A spell summoner using Eldritch should run damage-to-diseased-creatures links instead of meditation rate links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526404733642870987)
- **eldritch summoner safety**: The Eldritch summoner is a very safe template with decent damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547214671029866567)
- **elemental summon combination**: Water elemental and air elemental summons can be used together to provide both damage and crowd control. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541962654636318775)
- **elemental tanking roles**: Earth Elementals are likely better at tanking enemies that deal physical damage, while Water Elementals are likely better at tanking enemies that deal magic damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547226998072672350)
- **energy bolt grimoire upgrade**: The grimoire upgrade listed under Energy Bolt makes Energy Bolt do more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522642554506449048)
- **energy bolt mana gain on kill**: In Outlands, casting Energy Bolt at a target that dies within 5 seconds of the cast grants the caster mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522642224532291746)
- **energy vortex damage and control**: Energy vortexes are the strongest damage dealers on paper but cannot be controlled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523272394444378183)
- **energy vortex summon role**: Energy vortexes are a berserk all-rounder summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282212211003532)
- **ensemble 3 and reverb 3 damage bonus**: Ensemble 3 and Reverb 3 together give a 39% damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543548344389996598)
- **ensemble bonus damage effect**: The Ensemble bonus appears to give little to no noticeable damage boost, possibly because it is additive, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549182087297507479)
- **ensemble vs virtuoso barding**: Ensemble becomes useless when barding breaks happen frequently, so some bards choose Virtuoso instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521424029645541387)
- **epic barrage hex stacks**: Epic Barrage does not currently apply stacks of hex; players want it to, since each hex stack would reduce magic resist by 50 per lich (-100 with two liches). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545385131164967042)
- **equipping armor from grid loot**: Hold Ctrl while clicking an armor piece in the corpse grid loot window to put the armor on your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523536015027998800)
- **escaping a mob**: To get away from a mob, paralyze it and move off screen, or run the mob off first and then paralyze it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528920357111730236)
- **escaping a pk by riding**: When chased by a PK, ride away steadily without panicking or getting stuck on terrain, and if they will not let you Recall, keep riding to town or use line of sight to break pursuit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522660612117762098)
- **escaping paralyze**: When a PK casts Paralyze on you, drink a pouch (potion) to free yourself, which adds roughly 5% to your escape chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522660612117762098)
- **escaping pks camping a dungeon**: When PKs camp a dungeon, run out, wait about 5 minutes until they finish, then return, and run again about 20 minutes later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474976883548262)
- **escaping pks on the surface world**: PKs typically use Magery and must stand still to cast, so steadily riding away from them gains distance and often lets you escape on the surface world, though this is not guaranteed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524140134348492800)
- **escaping player killers**: Escaping a PK is fairly easy to learn, and many PKs are poor at PvP, so a lone PK in the wilderness will often run if you charge them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522721553475964988)
- **escaping red players**: Recall is the only way to escape a red player, unless you are near a gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535374002552307863)
- **escaping red players in dungeons**: When a red (murderer) player attacks you in a dungeon, try to reach a dungeon gate and leave. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528778731575840858)
- **escaping reds while mapping**: When a red (PK) attacks while mapping, a player can outheal their damage and run them 100-150 tiles away, then rehike to map with a new setup, so losing a map is hard unless ganked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542360530243821568)
- **evaluating intelligence for poison summoner**: A poison-focused nox summoner without Evaluating Intelligence gains little from other damaging spells; even with 100% eval, an 800-900 damage Flame Strike isn't worth casting compared to poison ticks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548291131144413265)
- **event dungeon difficulty**: The hard version of the event dungeon is probably similar in difficulty to 4th floor core dungeons, while normal is comparable to floor 3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526268717531398355)
- **event dungeon xp efficiency**: Event dungeon mobs have high HP relative to the experience they grant, so XP per HP is low, but the dungeon is stress-free because there are no PKs or thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526264516625567764)
- **evilfireblade stealth pk build**: EvilFireblade's stealth PK build hamstrings out of stealth and uses hide, stealth, wrestling, magery, meditation, evaluating intelligence and tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548868868653449328)
- **exceeding stat caps**: Exceeding caps such as swing speed converts the excess into extra damage, but this is generally not worth it; it is better to get close to the cap and spend points on better damage sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539145327284723712)
- **excess accuracy conversion to damage**: Excess accuracy over the cap may be converted into additional damage, but this is unconfirmed; one player recalls it as additive damage and not very good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539143281928183928)
- **expanded health bars**: With expanded bars turned on, you can see allies' mana and stamina as well as their hit points on their health bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540563259659128972)
- **experience in shelter island dungeon**: Players cannot earn experience in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540451307649900745)
- **explosion potion area damage**: An Explosion Potion thrown at one monster also damages other monsters near it through its area of effect, which is normal behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033183749087274)
- **explosion potion bomb cooldown**: The cooldown on explosion potion bombs is considered too slow for meaningful grinding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549102838360178931)
- **explosion potions as area damage**: Explosion (purple) potions are one of the only decent area-of-effect damage options in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524954445194985533)
- **explosion potions revealing vinekin**: Explosion potions can reveal hidden vinekin in KH, but without sticky a nearby player could be hit by the explosion, flagging the thrower criminal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555758463144173600)
- **extra carry weight for dungeon runs**: The extra carry weight from aspect and chain options is useful for extended dungeon runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536533788258078822)
- **extra chivalry seals effect**: The two additional seals from higher Chivalry boost the other abilities in the Chivalry book, giving more damage, more special damage, more swing speed, and a higher chance for Dispel Evil to reflect spells and attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680694644805784)
- **extra mind blast instead of curse or mana drain**: Casting an extra Mind Blast instead of Curse or Mana Drain deals the same damage and saves a couple of points in the codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550568337359110175)
- **extra swing speed and mana refund conversion**: Extra swing speed beyond the cap is supposed to be converted into an additive bonus to melee physical damage at a low rate, possibly 1:1, and extra mana refund is converted similarly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538831542011297843)
- **extreme survivability build**: Extreme survivability can be built through item identification, parrying, inscription and water aspect armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547591416966811678)
- **face tanking level 4 creatures**: Face tanking level 4 creatures is generally not the way to play, and a poison fencer can let poison do the work instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544832192037781504)
- **faction dungeon mob difficulty**: Mobs in faction dungeons are easy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552484830296539260)
- **faction dungeon pvp skills**: Parrying and Arms Lore are recommended for pvp in faction dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552493140316004446)
- **farming level 4 spawns with 4 links**: With only 4 links, farming level 4 spawns is horribly inefficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527475362982920223)
- **fencer tamer codex synergy**: The alchemy, healing, fencing and bestiary codexes complement each other and together greatly boost survivability for a fencer tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523832677562847332)
- **fencer tamer weakness**: The biggest weakness of a fencer tamer is AOE mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523832677562847332)
- **fencing and bows for dexxer tamers**: Fencing synergizes with taming because it cripples the target, raising pet accuracy, and bows let a dexxer tamer fight from a safe distance while pets do the work and the tamer heals them from behind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530247792793223420)
- **fencing build poison use**: Fencing is meant to be used with poisons, and using it without poisons is considered suboptimal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555481606008086549)
- **fencing codex fang stance**: The fencing codex provides a fang stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521204202033123348)
- **fencing poisoner balance**: Fencing Poisoner is very strong on live but is being tuned down in the upcoming patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532834654380359880)
- **fencing special attack cripple**: Fencing has a special attack that inflicts cripple on an enemy, increasing your and your pet's chance to hit that enemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528793238465675386)
- **fencing special moves**: Cripple, Bane, and Aggressive are all considered very good in the Fencing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526820459641966703)
- **fencing two-handed options**: Fencing includes two-handed weapon options, such as spears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530248217097404528)
- **fencing vs dual wield for nox build**: Fencing is preferred over dual wielding for a Nox build because of the Assassinate special and Bane with Arms Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526793130882633839)
- **fighting harvester pks with a dexxer**: A dexxer character can fight back against harvester PKs, who are generally poor fighters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549830751426453515)
- **fighting provoked mobs**: When fighting provoked mobs, alternate damage between them so their health percentages stay roughly even, so when one dies the remaining mob has less HP left. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547611700050657310)
- **finisher cooldown**: A player can trigger only one Finisher on each mob (infinite cooldown), but can trigger a Finisher every 60 seconds on a Boss-Type Creature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **finisher documentation**: Finisher mechanics are documented in the Finishers section of the Weapon and Parry Codex page on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553075281810555000)
- **finisher proc timing**: A finisher is a separate attack from the auto attack, so it can still proc after an auto attack drops a mob below the 10% HP threshold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553080880980041799)
- **fire aspect dexxer gear**: A fire aspect dexxer build can run an item with Item ID on it and at least Fortification Armor, though this is a suggestion rather than a requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521615478378987580)
- **fire aspect flamestrike procs**: With the Fire aspect, flamestrike procs benefit from the melee damage of an arcane staff, producing strong double flamestrike procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535340027763101696)
- **fire aspect on tanky macer build**: Fire aspect works well on a tanky macer build because the build gains extra damage from Reflect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528524946219860152)
- **fire aspect viability**: The Fire aspect is not considered meta but remains a good option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530939230166057042)
- **fire aspect weapon speed**: For Fire Aspect, a fast weapon is recommended to maximize flamestrike procs because the flamestrike deals fixed damage that does not scale with weapon damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525199910138417214)
- **fire aspect wrestler with spider stance**: A wrestler using the Fire aspect with spider stance can work well by pulling a large group of mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526077782566899874)
- **fire elemental follower slots**: Each summoned Fire Elemental occupies 2 follower slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533578774468104273)
- **fire elemental summon role**: Fire elementals are a ranged glass cannon summon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282212211003532)
- **fire field risk outside safe areas**: Casting Fire Field outside your own inn room or house is risky because other players can run into the fire to turn grey (criminal) and then legally kill you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521399294220046417)
- **fire mephit availability**: A Fire Mephit is available from SSC level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534427615979638924)
- **fire salamander vs flamehound hit points**: Fire salamanders reportedly have 25 more hit points than flamehounds, which may let a team of 3 fire salamanders and 2 flamehounds also afford a point in Menagerie. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528582752239226890)
- **fire swords for fire aspect build**: Fire swords are a good option for a fire aspect build if the player does not want to deal with poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521618448050946049)
- **fire weapon for wrestling dexxer**: A wrestling dexxer can use the Fire Weapon option for its big proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528818625148882944)
- **fireball scaling**: Fireball scales on its base value, so without Evaluating Intelligence it is a weak choice compared with low-cooldown spells that give a large additive damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542931892192415814)
- **first archer ability for archer tamer**: Repeater is the recommended first archer ability for an archer tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534409316113842346)
- **first archery codex point**: Arcane is recommended as the first Archery Codex point for early PvM because its accuracy bonus helps a lot early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532675399379849217)
- **first aspect choice for dex characters**: Discipline was a cheap and decent first aspect choice for a dex character, though this reflects one player's experience at the time and may have changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536646999615733770)
- **fishing add damage with lightning build**: Fishing provides very good add damage when running a Lightning build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533252817240854693)
- **five flamehound summoner team popularity**: A summoner team of five flamehounds is popular again as of July 2026. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528667024589328476)
- **fixing accuracy with magical weapons**: Accuracy issues with a weapon can be solved by using magical weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532465516965531881)
- **flame strike spam risk**: Spamming Flame Strike is a gamble because a mage may only have mana for about 2 casts and is stuck without mana if the refund does not proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545325993038708756)
- **flamestrike burn tracking**: Casting flamestrike from your grimoire applies a burn that is tracked individually, with multiple debuffs running in the background. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542516673167237130)
- **flamestrike damage and mana cost**: Flamestrike deals heavy damage but costs a lot of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549655525115830383)
- **flamestrike from scroll with inscription links**: Casting Flamestrike from a scroll with Inscription links lets a summoner cast without necessarily consuming the scroll, and the damage from spamming it can offset lost follower skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521336292682764488)
- **flamestrike hybrid necro build**: Flamestriking with a necromancy, spirit speaking and herding hybrid build is rough and depends heavily on mana refund. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545381802212859904)
- **flamestrike mana cost**: Players with higher-tier aspect, links and codex levels use Flamestrike because their levels can support its mana cost; a new character probably cannot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554586244812378123)
- **flat damage link vs swing speed**: For players already at the attack speed cap from skills alone, a flat damage link (or damage to bleeding creatures when using swords) is probably better than additional swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537931903070507018)
- **flat melee damage bucket**: The extra accuracy damage is called flat melee damage because it feeds a large melee damage percent bucket that has many contributing sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532907998517792839)
- **flaying damage at end game**: Flaying does the most damage at end game, but it is less effective if your weapon special chance is not maxed out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541834898170585229)
- **focus for accuracy at low weapon aspect**: Going to 100 Focus gives better accuracy when the weapon aspect level is low. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529308020641628211)
- **focus for wrestling accuracy**: Wrestling builds use focus to reach 100% accuracy against most mobs, but 40 focus is acceptable because few mobs have weapon skill high enough for the difference to matter much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550859386258456588)
- **focus mitigation**: Focus provides mitigation by increasing the chance that mobs miss, and special attacks can be learned and dodged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523777309952184400)
- **follower frost combo**: The follower frost combo uses the Command aspect on the weapon and Frost armor, and followers contribute to frost buildup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527095095747412060)
- **follower stats calculator**: The Outlands Butler website offers a calculator where you can enter your pet's details to see its speed and accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527807809859620954)
- **food buff to hit speed**: Eating food makes you hit faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526219616001720450)
- **force weapon property**: The Force weapon property is claimed to grant +15 Tactics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526995141733388460)
- **forensic evaluation damage buff for backstabber**: A backstabber build likely benefits from the Forensic Evaluation damage buff better than other builds such as tamer or necro summoner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554970757698691174)
- **forensic evaluation in pvm builds**: Forensic Evaluation is most commonly added to PvM builds for extra value, and scavengers are the closest thing to dedicated skinners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529654863431209120)
- **forensic evaluation spell damage increase**: Forensic Evaluation provides additive spell damage increase of 25% per 100 skill points, and Tracking and Camping give the same bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072597575860246)
- **forsaken keep disease**: The disease in Forsaken Keep cannot be cured with cure potions; Cleansing Brew must be used, which does not remove it but makes healing easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528512661497839866)
- **forsaken keep haunted mirror mob**: In the Forsaken Keep boss room, a mob spawns near the haunted mirror bearing the hunting player's own name, and if it is a paragon it drops a chest with that player's own name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541873294771495002)
- **fort aspect chain experience builds**: Fort Aspect is good for chain experience, and any build can be run in Fort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522393550908555386)
- **fortification armor**: Fortification armor is worth keeping in addition to invulnerability armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550062305553686639)
- **fortune armor aspect**: The Fortune armor aspect is considered a decent armor choice because it has a 50% chance to boost damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551075000918736903)
- **fortune armor build selection**: When running Fortune armor, players should choose builds that do not rely solely on armor aspects, such as tamer, summoner, some dexxer builds and trapper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545096305934733313)
- **fortune armor with pets**: If the player wearing fortune armor has pets doing the damage, the fortune armor bonus still applies to mobs the pets kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551779227588755539)
- **fortune aspect damage buff**: The Fortune aspect gives a chance at a 50% damage buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538220909624565901)
- **fortune aspect group value**: Players running the Fortune aspect are appreciated in groups because loot is much better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546629996590796842)
- **fortune aspect in pit trials**: Fortune aspect is believed not to affect loot or gold in the pit trials, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520871439622996160)
- **fortune aspect rare drop luck**: Fortune aspect armor or chain links increase luck for finding rare items from killing monsters, though most players don't bother with them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536251244916641822)
- **fortune in pit trials**: In pit trials, Fortune mainly helps with mugging, so you steal more gold, black goods and valuables from monsters, and it does not add to the gold score value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520911177465597972)
- **fortune stabbing viability**: Fortune stabbing is only good when the character is very highly progressed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879720752783411)
- **freedom and panacea in pvp**: Freedom and Panacea work in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551358498808406058)
- **freedom versus player-applied hamstring**: Freedom does not clear Hamstring when it was applied to you by another player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551359639256432643)
- **frost armor for tamers**: Frost armor gives damage bonuses to a tamer's pets because they can apply chill; it is less good for DPS than Command but gives the player more survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530319121219190987)
- **frost aspect chill effect**: Frost aspect's chill applies only to the player who applies it, still grants damage resistance only to that player, builds quickly so any weapon applies it in a few swings, and its proc is a multiplicative damage modifier rather than additive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542269165262475416)
- **frost aspect pet damage**: Frost aspect boosts pet damage as well as the player's own damage and poison ticks, and it is nearly the only gear or aspect effect besides barding that affects pets without explicitly mentioning follower damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542293777169915989)
- **frost aspect tamer cost**: A Frost aspect tamer costs about half as much as a Command aspect tamer and can easily work on any codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537594098704318596)
- **frost aspect weapon strength**: The Frost aspect weapon is weaker than it used to be. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527858507120906300)
- **frost echo**: The Frost echo gives a tamer more survivability and is more useful for other echos too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553581020148793445)
- **frost echo versus command echo for bard tamer**: For a bard tamer, using the Frost echo instead of the Command echo gives comparable damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553580327459496050)
- **frost or command armor aspect**: Using a frost or command armor aspect may boost all of your damage, most likely with frost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549172435469738076)
- **frost shell tanking tier**: Frost shell is rated S+ tier for tanking, and at tier 15 the player is invulnerable for 5 out of every 20 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524862225141993653)
- **frost sword dexxer after double dip removal**: After recent changes removed the double dips on Frost and bleed, the frost sword dexxer is reportedly weaker and plays better in Madness armor than in Frost armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524491901594501362)
- **frost weapon for tamers**: Frost weapon is near useless for a tamer or summoning herder, who wants to proc inspiration with attacks and so always runs Command on the weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530319121219190987)
- **frost wrestler build**: A suggested frost wrestler build is 110 Chivalry, 110 Arms Lore, 100 Wrestling, 100 Tactics, 80 Anatomy, 80 Healing and 60 Focus, with the remaining 80 points in Alchemy or Parry. It uses links for melee special chance/damage, damage dealt by player and melee damage, with Dragon stance, Haymaker and Chi finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524547365376102411)
- **full 120 bard damage**: A full 120 bard still deals a lot of damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524889034533634120)
- **full tank template for solo play**: A full tank template is poor for solo play because kills take extremely long, but it is good for high-level group content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542266284874539079)
- **full tank template use in time dungeon**: A full tank template is only really needed for the time dungeon (time tanks), and nobody runs blacksmithing on time tanks, though Item ID is still great. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542266403036598334)
- **gatekeeper boss mechanics**: The Gatekeeper's chain lightning is based on movement, so you get struck more if you move and should stay still, while his starfall calls down stars that nearly instantly kill you unless you move. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544027468023726174)
- **gathering skill weapon buffs**: Gathering skills give weapon buffs: Lumberjacking buffs swords and Mining buffs maces. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531193778092638278)
- **gear in pvp**: Gear bonuses apply in PvP, but most players avoid wearing expensive gear because of the risk of losing it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535783220593819810)
- **gear versus aspect damage**: Better gear increases damage before an aspect is unlocked, but unlocking an aspect greatly boosts damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545347919907913768)
- **gem elementals difficulty**: Gem elementals such as diamond elementals are strong enemies that are difficult for weak characters to kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541207692677230)
- **generic wrestler template**: The same wrestler template works for Frost, Madness, Lightning and Air aspects, with Enemy of One used instead of Divine Fury for Air. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527912632928047264)
- **getting revealed in vendor building**: If you are revealed while in the vendor building, move away immediately and quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556065681126989878)
- **giant sandroach spawn**: Giant Sandroaches pop out of Colossal Sandroaches when the Colossal Sandroaches are hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536833914700824576)
- **glacial staff and cold bolt**: There are no glacial staffs that work with cold bolt in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534589325063356577)
- **glass cannon damage reduction**: The Glass Cannon setup still has 45% universal damage reduction in combat, rising to 52% after Artisan procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521552235241406755)
- **glass-cannon melee build**: A high-damage glass-cannon melee build relies on kill speed as its defense, using around 15 damage from play (links) and 15 melee special damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545044649784254584)
- **gloomwood mob difficulty**: Gloomwood mobs are roughly comparable to high-end floor 2 dungeon mobs, with the rest about on par with the average floor 3 dungeon mob, judged by hits to kill and damage dealt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527971348054282422)
- **gold carrying capacity tradeoff**: A character build has a limit to how much gold it can carry before the build is weakened too much, since swapping skills for carrying capacity noticeably increases time to kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520400245115060325)
- **gold defense links needed against 200 wrestling mobs**: Against a mob with 200 wrestling, about 15 gold defense links combined with 100 weapon skill and 100 focus are needed to bring its chance to hit you down to about 12%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531703898975244480)
- **gold farming with poor stat pets**: A pet with poor stats can still farm gold effectively, though it will not deal maximum DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461354185228420)
- **golden spellbook mana regeneration**: The golden spellbook gives roughly 35 to 40% extra mana regeneration, which is reportedly enough without avarhide, especially when running focus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531008688926625813)
- **great bow for ranged backstabber**: Great bow works well for a ranged backstabber, offering distance and opening the codex more, though mace still tops out damage if redline is invested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522637169531949116)
- **great bow rate of fire**: The Great Bow fires more slowly than other bows but deals bigger damage per hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527020128934301866)
- **greater explosion potion attachment with 80 alchemy**: With 80 Alchemy, a greater explosion potion can be attached to a target so that it hits just that target, but it does not attach to a player unless Telekinesis is cast on that player first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523859523234693252)
- **greater heal flex slot**: In the arcane mage build the Greater Heal grimoire slot is a flex slot, swapped for Curse against bosses or Chain Lightning when farming mob packs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531825815854125106)
- **greater heal healing formula**: Greater Heal heals (40 to 50) * (Magery / 100) hit points to the target, is reduced if the target is poisoned, and can be upgraded for PvM with a Wizard's Grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538439491428163765)
- **greater heal potion use for mage casting uptime**: Using a greater heal potion instead of moving or casting Greater Heal lets a mage keep casting Mind Blast and Flame Strike, adding indirect damage on top of purple potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537790352595882065)
- **greater magic resistance potions**: Greater magic resistance potions help a lot against casters and give a significant benefit at low cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531332651477106709)
- **greater paragon chest opening**: Lockpicking and Detect Hidden alone may not be sufficient to open greater paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553475877457891391)
- **greater paragon sewer rat spawn**: A greater paragon sewer rat can spawn in the sewers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541871606937297046)
- **grey status and boat piracy**: Everyone is grey on the water, and players can lower your boat so they can board, kill you and your crew, and loot the boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521725159470534766)
- **grimoire buff duration**: Grimoire buffs last roughly 5 minutes, so protection and bless should be kept up on double lich summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530029875270782976)
- **grimoire mana drain mana refund**: The Grimoire Mana Drain gives a mana refund chance that can be capped, so a noxcro can use a material book for mana regeneration instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544378380604936263)
- **grimoire upgrade priorities**: Grimoire upgrades are best spent on spells regularly used in the attack rotation and on beneficial improvements like Magic Mushroom, and the Eldritch aspect reportedly still works for a necro summoner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520463436872679434)
- **group approach to t8 treasure maps**: To make T8 treasure maps manageable, run them with a small group in which each member contributes one map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529903148435636364)
- **group event pvp gear loss**: In group event PvP, PKs do not lose their normal exceptional gear, so they commonly wear very cheap outfits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521553706519232643)
- **group safety in dungeons**: Being in a group often deters murderers in dungeons, and an organized group can fight back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532604432653619340)
- **growing fury ramp-up time**: Growing Fury takes about 8 minutes to reach its full damage increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529877662540103681)
- **guild boss practice on test server**: Guild bosses may be spawnable on the test server for practice, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539292029152923731)
- **guild boss summon cooldown**: A guild can summon a boss again 5 minutes after the previous boss dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553158672044265567)
- **halberd mage in faction pvp**: Halberd mage is still great for faction PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535008814527549460)
- **hally mage build**: A mage who fights with a halberd is commonly called a hally mage, and the archer mage has fallen out of use as a PvP build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537870928451600485)
- **hamstring from chivalry**: Hamstring is an ability gained by taking Chivalry, and it is considered very important in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553451622087004354)
- **hamstring mechanic**: Hamstring is a mechanic that drains the victim's stamina, forcing them to walk instead of run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547109457329135637)
- **hamstring stamina drop duration**: Hamstring drops the target's stamina to 0 for about 3 seconds, enough for a mage to cast Weaken, Explosion and Teleport or throw an explosion potion, then switch back to a halberd to finish the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547112613786157077)
- **hamstring weapon requirement**: Hamstring may need to be used with a fighting weapon such as a quarterstaff rather than a harvesting tool, and it must be set up to toggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554268619746181246)
- **handling bleeds without panacea**: Healing codex combined with chivalry can be used to handle bleeds instead of relying on panacea. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521932995139735612)
- **hard cast mage gate ambush**: Some players hard cast Mage Gate outside of render range to ambush targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539699689941770342)
- **harm cast speed versus recall**: Harm casts quicker than Recall, so it can interrupt a recall attempt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535386814343413770)
- **harpoon accuracy with low aspect**: A build with low aspect and only 80 Fishing may have poor accuracy with a harpoon, so accuracy should be checked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542224005912862790)
- **harpoon boat pvm stat priorities**: For a harpoon boat PvM character, capping swing speed and having enough accuracy for the enemies fought matters much more than Alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527064899308748841)
- **harpoon skewer stance and salvo finisher**: The harpoon's Skewer stance and Salvo finisher are considered very strong options for harpoon users. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527065706947022930)
- **harpooner on ocean**: Harpooner remains a good choice for ocean play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528168703785439242)
- **harvester build with links and thralls in fury's caldera**: A harvester build with 30 links and two thralls could not kill the mobs in the worst part of Fury's Caldera in a reasonable amount of time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531424046896513195)
- **harvester reds in pvp**: Harvester reds are the weakest tier of red players, and since grindable content is deactivated in PvP their main advantage is only about 20 skill points, so a good PvP build can hold its ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535613538251579472)
- **harvesting skill damage bonus**: The damage bonus from harvesting skills such as Lumberjacking is weak, not worthwhile for throwing axes, and only useful for clearing random mobs along the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534457087147642910)
- **heal over time codex abilities**: The heal-over-time abilities from the Healer's Codex and Alchemy Codex help offset the self-damage of a high-damage dexxer build using madness aspect gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539818625471348797)
- **heal parry mage 1v1 strength**: A heal parry mage character is considered nearly invincible in 1v1 combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522722555205517466)
- **healers codex healing range bonus**: The Healers Codex increases the range of heals, including bandages and veterinary supplies, and adds healing boosts that help keep pets alive once the skill requirements are met. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539723301910225106)
- **healers in dungeons**: Healers are not really used in dungeons; they are used only for bosses and Time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521183858282987643)
- **healing a pet slightly out of range**: If a pet is slightly out of healing range, start applying a bandage while running away to get close enough, then run close again as the heal is about to finish. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522229965616185486)
- **healing and potions stacking**: The Healing skill works on top of potions, and the combination can be quite effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525428168608190604)
- **healing buffs for potion-based builds**: On builds where potions are the primary source of healing, stacking as many healing buffs as possible is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543561536210210886)
- **healing necromancy summons with vampiric embrace**: Vampiric Embrace can be used to heal necromancy summons, though the author is unsure of the exact effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527584308556992562)
- **healing pets with vet supplies**: To heal pets with vet supplies, bind a hotkey to the [VetSupplies command and keep your pets' health bars on screen so you can press it when they need heals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554637459881594911)
- **healing red thieves criminal flag**: Healing a red-named player who is stealing (a red hand) does not turn you criminal, unlike healing an ordinary red. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539687747264974869)
- **healing spells versus potions**: It is best to heal with spells when possible and drink potions only when really needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525869736389378199)
- **healing summons**: A summoner does not need to heal their summons and can use heal potions for the small amount of damage they take themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550583578801475647)
- **healing with bandages from a locked box**: To heal with bandages stored in a locked box: unlock the box, open it, hit the bandage-self hotkey, close the box, then lock it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535863443779878942)
- **heavy crossbow burst versus halberd burst**: Heavy crossbow burst is currently better than halberd burst, though halberd is still very strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554233694649323563)
- **herding crook melee accuracy**: A herding crook used as a melee weapon has poor accuracy and will rarely or never hit monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522374401973031116)
- **herding crook theft**: Thieves will steal a herding crook of any quality, so it is advisable to keep the crook inside a trapped pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541320479158050876)
- **hidden player health bar visibility in pvp**: In some PvP situations such as PvP events, flagged states, or factions, a hidden player's health bar may be removed from view. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542633122024390696)
- **hiding and combat state**: Hiding automatically takes you out of combat so your character stops swinging, and a smoke bomb does the same instantly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550797346600914945)
- **hiding in pure pvp builds**: Hiding is not a great skill for pure PvP; a better anti-mage build is an archer/stabber with tactics, healing and anatomy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554164606883340310)
- **high damage mage weapon choice**: High damage mages generally use arcane staffs rather than spellbooks at present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553906159273115689)
- **high magic resist mobs vs lightning armor**: High magic resist mobs die just as quickly when fought with lightning armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531332941802897661)
- **high-dex air mage**: A high-dex air mage is very tanky, gets up to +90 mana, and lands two staff hits between spells, making it good for sustain and as a roach mage in a party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532168479397118002)
- **high-end magic item drops**: Finding high-end magic items is entirely random (RNG). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529894332549566564)
- **higher taming skill pet teams**: Teams needing slightly higher taming that are good include giant black widow, black widow, ember dragon, ember drake, and 2x harvestman/frost mephit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540108717733716069)
- **highest efb builds**: The players with the highest EFB use the Artisan aspect and Carpentry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542264533538709534)
- **hinder drawbacks with provoked mobs**: Hinder can do more harm than good: hindering at a bad time makes positioning and corralling mobs awkward, and hindered provoked mobs do not damage each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554963122358460467)
- **hinder duration**: Hinder lasts roughly 5 seconds plus 0.5 seconds per tier level, and a single author reports never seeing it last longer on a regular mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530558143824658612)
- **hinder effect**: The Hinder effect, from shield bash, parry codex and archery, leaves a mob unable to move, but it lasts only briefly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536122100337877022)
- **hinder effect**: Hinder is a stun that stops movement, melee attacks, and spellcasting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536122589703835759)
- **hinder in pvp**: Hinder does not work in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525540880293822555)
- **hinder stacking and boss resistance**: Hinder does not stack with itself, and bosses, if affected at all, are hindered for a shorter duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530558065965793404)
- **hindered effect**: Hindered prevents all movement, casting and melee attacks, and does not increase the hit chance of melee weapons against the hindered target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538939772209201202)
- **hit chance target**: To be sure of hitting your target, the hit chance shown on your stats page should be 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543652087752036514)
- **hit-and-run cycle**: Hit-and-run cycle: hide, stealth, attack, run, then hide again; this stops you swinging at the target, and the target can walk over you without you attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550797475361853563)
- **holy aspect melee viability**: Holy aspect is great for melee survivability but is out-damaged by many other aspects late-game; at T10+ it remains useful for its weapon proc in group farming or for added defense while leveling other aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522957446727991378)
- **holy dexxer bronze link options**: A holy dexxer can use bronze links for either special chance/damage or damage dealt by player; damage dealt by player is more universal and can be swapped to any other link, while special chance/damage is only useful to dexxers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531596583274287245)
- **holy sword dexxer build tweaks**: A holy swords dexxer is said to feel better when parry is dropped, item identification is added, and vanquishing swords are used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532170004441731232)
- **holy sword dexxer damage and sustain**: A holy sword dexxer deals less damage than blood, lightning or void dexxer builds but sustains better, and it became a good build after a recent patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532168921095082205)
- **hybrid dexxer weapon set**: A hybrid dexxer can carry a katana as a disturb weapon, an executioner's axe as a PvM weapon, and a halberd as a burst damage weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535673619840245770)
- **hybrid pvm/pvp builds**: Outlands does not support hybrid PvM/PvP builds well; a hybrid will lose to players about as often as a full PvM spec. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538585283023605800)
- **hybrid wrestling build with air aspect**: A wrestling build with 120 chivalry, 100 tactics, 80 wrestling, 80 arms lore, 80 parrying, 80 healing, 80 anatomy and 100 focus is considered good for hybrid PvM/PvP when running air aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550697478347685970)
- **ignore armor and ignore magic resist**: A successful ignore armor proc treats the target's armor as 0 if it was above 0, and if the target already effectively has 0 Armor or 0 Magic Resist, an Ignore Armor or Ignore Magic Resist proc instead grants a +15% damage bonus to the attack or spell, never in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539184049510285372)
- **ignore resist links vs high magic resist mobs**: Ignore resist links are considered underrated, and mobs with around 200 magic resist are reportedly weak to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531362151057457404)
- **immobile mobs in shelter island dungeon marsh**: In the marsh area of the Shelter Island dungeon, some mobs cannot move, so players can attack them and back away when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547266033872543817)
- **immunize usefulness**: Immunize is especially useful in areas with many bleed and disease effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535635631626264626)
- **in vas flam damage**: In Outlands an In Vas Flam does about the same damage that a Corp Por did on OSI. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527133915377176767)
- **increasing damage**: Leveling your aspect and getting more links are the main ways to substantially increase your damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537666608976101446)
- **increasing wrestling dexxer damage**: To increase damage as a wrestling dexxer, get the Haymaker ability, use Consecrate Weapon for more damage on specials, make sure the [disarm setting is on, and use the Chi Thrust finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522258599252983960)
- **inscription arcane mage pvm spells**: An inscription arcane mage in PvM can use fire strike, mind blast, magic arrow, fireball, harm and lightning, upgraded in the codex along with magic mushrooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525978618499436628)
- **inscription mage scroll casting**: Inscription mages cast damage spells from scrolls to get higher damage, but they still need to carry reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552977214822289490)
- **inspiration proc for double command tamer/bard**: For a tamer/bard using double command, inspiration procs are hard to trigger, so players commonly use a surpassingly accurate or better bow or arcane staff and accept an occasional proc, and many ignore the mechanic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529241555968327721)
