- **invisibility detection by pks**: Invisibility may work if PKs pass by, but PKs with tracking or detect hidden, or who run over you, will find you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553509893435035664)
- **item id air build performance**: The item id air build runs without parry and handles bosses well; at about 203 AR on T13 air it can solo 3 daemons, though AK4 is troublesome because of bleeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529898807469543504)
- **item id build fit**: Air builds and backstab builds are the easiest builds to fit high Item ID into. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545043507423486002)
- **item id equivalence to parry and tactics**: With Item ID, the extra defense from Hardening armor is roughly equivalent to the damage mitigation of 30 Parry, and the extra damage from Force weapons is roughly like 30 Tactics; this is an approximate comparison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542555718920442007)
- **item id with enchanted weapons vs avarite**: At the very top end of progression, a maxed enchanted weapon combined with Item ID is reported to slightly outperform Avarite items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525993928627716287)
- **item identification air wrestler links**: Good links for an Item Identification air wrestler are Melee Special Chance/Damage and Damage Done By Player for the first 20-30 links, with Dragon links also recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548709076081311775)
- **item identification for time dungeon tank**: A Time dungeon tank build may use Item Identification for its bonus to magic items to reach maximum armor, though this is not a new-player build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366180483371071)
- **item identification invulnerability armor rating**: Item Identification with invulnerability armor gives about 330 armor rating and does not require Artisan armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542263242607566989)
- **jack-of-all-trades build content limits**: Jack-of-all-trades builds with 500 skill points and 80-skill pets can likely handle only level 2 dungeons and maybe some level 3s, since damage stacking favors specialization. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528793948783644712)
- **kiting effectiveness**: Kiting works better for ranged characters, but any character with low HP can use it to gain extra time to heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542404009548054548)
- **kiting melee monsters in wilderness**: In the wilderness, melee monsters can be kited on a mount with ease, reducing the need for defensive skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525915254855438539)
- **knave weapon ability for tamers**: The Knave weapon ability may suit tamers, though this is only a tentative suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539093971018588230)
- **knightly weapon ability**: The Knightly weapon ability gives straightforward extra damage and accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539093882673832008)
- **kraul hiveguard circular aoe**: The Kraul Hiveguard has a circular AoE attack with a visual tell, which can be avoided once it has been activated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532074974909562990)
- **kryss weapon type**: A kryss is a fencing weapon, not a wand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525605643438788680)
- **large two-handed weapon swing speed**: Large two-handed weapons such as a big sledgehammer hit hard but swing slowly, so misses cost more time and higher accuracy is needed to use them effectively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532411423777357944)
- **last pvm patch additions**: The last pvm patch added 2 new aspects and 2 new weapon skills, which are widely considered to perform poorly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552723218161205249)
- **last summon slot choice**: For the final summon slot, Summon Creature can yield a ghoul, and a ranged summon such as a skeletal marksman is an alternative that avoids constant resummoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546000522803155054)
- **leather armor tradeoff**: Leather armor makes a character somewhat less durable than plate but removes most mana concerns for the wearer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532227426959233114)
- **leather turbo-meditation arcane mage in tidal2**: A leather-armor turbo-meditation arcane mage can face-tank mobs in Tidal2 at about 54% damage resistance from arcane buildup, shield stance and freedom, using tier 5 water aspect and a rotation of lightning, flamestrike, mind blast and energy bolt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522540671301455902)
- **leaving war mode to stop attacking**: Press Tab to leave war mode and stop attacking the current target; if you were not in war mode and auto-attacked something that attacked you, press Tab twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529172005776261332)
- **lethal poison charge usage**: Applying lethal poison to a weapon reportedly does not consume a whole charge per application in PvE, though it may against players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550233309127376917)
- **lethal poison potion consumption**: The chance to consume a lethal poison potion when upgrading poison is already low, so carrying a few lethal potions is enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544402371705307256)
- **lich summoner dps**: A lich summoner can reach over 700 DPS, though this is an unverified single-player claim and may be affected by recent balance changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530346537035632763)
- **lich summoner perk setup**: The lich summoner build runs the greater heal grimoire perk together with the healer codex overheal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530152258132774922)
- **lightning archer aspect strength**: The lightning archer build is reportedly one of the weaker aspects, with air wrestling considered better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528764200044724364)
- **lightning archer in omni**: A lightning archer is helpful in an Omni. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545449859807576165)
- **lightning archer leveling**: Leveling a lightning archer build is considered a very poor experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526599625300119753)
- **lightning archer setup**: A common lightning archer setup uses lightning aspect armor and weapon, full plate armor, a greatbow, and the Archery and Healers codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555982751726043207)
- **lightning archer weapon choice**: The greatbow is preferred for damage on a lightning archer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529213153378963658)
- **lightning archers in regular dungeons**: Lightning archers can steamroll everything in regular dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524865207086612532)
- **lightning armor aspect pulling**: The lightning armor aspect pulls multiple mobs, making it hard to pick a single mob out of a pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551045762194997289)
- **lightning armor for arcane mage damage**: Lightning armor deals very large damage, especially with spell damage ignore links boosting purple damage, and is suggested over Scribe for arcane mage damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545560377960701992)
- **lightning aspect archery kiting**: With a lightning aspect you can swap to archery and kite mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538643670465511445)
- **lightning aspect benefits**: Lightning aspect is good for farming because of its hinders, its shield provides occasional mitigation against multi-hit abilities, and its cleave damage helps control adds when bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555623281644540016)
- **lightning aspect endgame requirement**: Lightning is one of the few aspects where the warning that it needs an endgame build is considered valid, because of how it scales with shocks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525151721347743804)
- **lightning aspect for solo melee**: Lightning is a good aspect choice for solo melee play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543697647595159762)
- **lightning hindering mobs**: Lightning can be used to hinder mobs if it is selected in the Wizard's Grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552704761189376021)
- **lightning madness archer build**: The lightning/madness archer build is playable at level 3 dungeons with around T10 and 10 links, and it really starts to shine at T17. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534566528396296312)
- **lightning mage gear setup**: Lightning armor combined with a madness weapon is considered an ideal setup for a lightning mage build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555259969970897019)
- **lightning spread priorities**: Pure lightning players using lightning armor and a madness weapon favor melee damage/ignore armor first, and in the super late game reportedly redline 15 melee damage/ignore armor followed by 15 player damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555591192211890257)
- **lightning wrestler build link thresholds**: A lightning wrestler build is reported to feel really good once it reaches 15x15 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532373686407921714)
- **lightning wrestler suggested links at swing speed cap**: For a lightning wrestler build at swing speed cap, Damage Dealt by Player and Melee Special Chance/Special Damage are suggested links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546929266103681025)
- **links needed for poison necromancer or trapper in pit trials**: A poison necromancer or trapper probably needs more than 12 links to make solid profits in pit trials, unless the player is very experienced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527816106646048859)
- **links that increase follower damage**: Only links that explicitly state they affect followers increase follower damage; other damage links do not apply to followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541021515863040020)
- **llama aggro as pack animal**: Llamas draw less aggro than bears when used as pack animals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538275138909249636)
- **lockpicking chest damage resist bonus**: Picking chests grants a damage resist bonus, so after the last chest a lockpicker should run out of the dungeon and teleport. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540811500304867419)
- **loot rights calculation**: The player who tapped a mob first or dealt the first damage receives a large bonus to the internal damage calculation that determines who gets looting rights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532621613357469787)
- **looting and sinking an npc ship**: After boarding an NPC ship, clear its loot and sink it, then embark back onto your own ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542567516776435822)
- **looting corpses while hidden**: When looting corpses while hidden, run to the next corpse so the Grid Loot gump opens and hide again immediately, or sneak to the corpse, wait, open it, wait, then loot; taking up to two items is feasible without drawing aggro from nearby mobs before re-hiding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866523044024390)
- **looting corpses while scavenging**: To loot corpses while scavenging, stay hidden and wait until comfortable, sneak to the corpse, skin or take an item and instantly re-hide; up to two items can be taken and re-hidden quickly without drawing aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529595139729653760)
- **looting of unidentified weapons**: An unidentified weapon may be looted less often than high-end crafted gear, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536092963136868495)
- **looting other players' mobs in dungeons**: Looting another player's mob in a dungeon is allowed and encouraged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532513291413360720)
- **low aspect spellbook choice**: Running a low aspect means using a magic spell book instead of a material spell book, though refund can still be capped out relatively early. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552292855312293891)
- **low bard skills debuff reliability**: Bard skills at 80 without links make it hard to land debuffs on higher-level mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541529581369167903)
- **low evaluating intelligence spell damage penalty**: Low Evaluating Intelligence applies a negative modifier to spell damage, which is why many summoners cast no damaging spells at all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544888791028863026)
- **low level arcane blood mage rotation**: A low level Arcane/Blood mage should use flamestrike and the low level rotation (harm, lightning, etc.), and use timed energy bolts to recover mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546974946817745041)
- **low mana small spell casting**: Casting smaller spells while low on mana raises an arcane mage's DPS and gives additional chances to proc the arcane effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524837604804268052)
- **low tier treasure map builds**: For lower tier treasure maps the build matters little as long as it has a fast kill solution, such as an agorawave tank or a summoner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531008290165625103)
- **lumberjack build meta status**: Before nerfs to bleed tick operation and various patches, the Lumberjack build was the top-performing build for a long time; it is no longer a secret meta, though some Lumberjack builds still perform strongly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543396690969628803)
- **lyric weapon proc cacophony**: The Lyric weapon proc, Cacophony, hits hard and instantly lets the bard rebard mobs in its area of effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530944396244291706)
- **mace chance to hit formula**: The chance to hit with a mace class weapon equals (attacker's mace fighting skill + 50) / ((defender's weapon or wrestling skill + 50) * 2), plus any relevant accuracy bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529236393589604433)
- **mace damage on discipline**: Maces hit just as hard on Discipline as other weapons do. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524960094209446060)
- **mace damage to clothing**: Mace weapons do not destroy clothing in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532848085724565696)
- **mace dexxer strength**: Mace dexxers are well behind other dexxer types at the moment and will remain so after the upcoming patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532834449086087278)
- **mace pierce effect**: Maces provide the pierce effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531772526638923848)
- **mace special move choice**: Aggressive and wild swing are the mace special options that usually provide more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525161859693416549)
- **mace usage in pvm**: Mace is a reliable tool in end game PvM but is not commonly used in regular content, where players seek high DPS and quick experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530959907321548892)
- **macer dexxer dps with 30 links**: A macer dexxer with 30 links does roughly 300 to 500 DPS depending on aspect, with Discipline and Fire being the best aspects for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528524721837047969)
- **macing and fencing viability**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, Macing and Fencing are niche weapon skills that typically do not compete in damage unless the player has the right build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555733371995562067)
- **macing codex unlock order**: For the Macing codex, players recommend maxing Aggressive to its tier 5 unlock first, then putting Wild Swing to tier 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524585263676784810)
- **macing dexxer with parry and alchemy**: A macing dexxer with Parry and Alchemy is tanky and works well as a party tank, but its damage output is low and it is slow for solo play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528522230902947971)
- **macing farming with wild swing**: To farm with a mace, use the Wild Swing ability and run after each hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555022124043866254)
- **macing power level**: Macing is not considered underpowered, though some other melee aspects outperform it in certain scenarios. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530944045407277106)
- **macing weapon special**: The macing weapon special causes the target to lose armour rating, using a Pierce effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530472937533083668)
- **macros and hotkeys in combat**: Macros and hotkeys save time in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554211069629698100)
- **madness archer melee special links**: A madness archer takes melee special links only if they do not have redline for their last 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532050951379222728)
- **madness aspect for bard damage**: Using the madness aspect instead of lyric gives a bard substantially more damage, with suggested links of EBS or perfect pitch depending on mob difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529025633030639716)
- **madness aspect mind blast damage**: A mage using the Madness aspect at tier 12 hit about 2.1k Mind Blasts on the lizards in Nusero. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520812116091605063)
- **madness aspect vs command tamer**: At tier 17, the Madness aspect build is not as strong as a tier 5 command tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534714527336370307)
- **madness bleed self-damage**: Bleed damage can proc the Madness self-damage, which is reportedly limited to one instance of 5 HP per second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553331357965484045)
- **madness book for summoners**: The Madness book may be decent for a summoner to run if the player spams Mind Blast, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538282054096257054)
- **madness death fortune aspects**: Madness, death and fortune aspects can work in group play but not solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525689829835276289)
- **madness dexxer treasure map build**: A madness dexxer is a viable treasure map build because the Madness proc deletes chest mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543759151056822293)
- **madness versus air aspect damage**: Madness aspect gives a linear damage increase, and Air would eventually out-DPS Madness but not within current hard caps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525217546750394408)
- **madness versus discipline aspect**: The Madness aspect outperforms Discipline for boss fights, while Discipline is preferred for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537549776130940968)
- **madness weapon aspect damage**: The madness weapon aspect deals the most damage among weapon aspect options, at the cost of a small amount of the wielder's life. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555281504672682136)
- **madness wrestler accuracy target**: A Madness wrestler can use any weapon level for the aspect, but low accuracy makes it feel worse, so a target of about 106 accuracy is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533453145697423381)
- **madness wrestler build**: A Madness wrestler build is considered very strong by at least one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535107813074800640)
- **madness wrestler endgame strength**: A madness wrestler is strong in endgame content as long as it is kept alive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551597720169357445)
- **madness wrestler vs arcane mage roles**: A madness wrestler is better for farming while an arcane mage is better for bosses, though a wrestler still allows farming and good DPS at omni. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551582446875582485)
- **madness wrestler with item id**: A madness wrestler with Item ID can hit for around 1500 damage but is fragile, so it should wear a full set of fortified plate armor rather than an outfit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545043597760663552)
- **mage action per minute**: Mage is considered the highest action-per-minute class in the game, though this is a single player's opinion and not an established fact about utility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531670979514990753)
- **mage advantage in pvp**: On the PvP side, mages usually have the advantage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545449889993990285)
- **mage armor choice**: Lightning armor is a great armor for mages, but blood armor is better when you want more mana sustain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531668730847826071)
- **mage bard greater heal mana refunds**: With a high enough aspect providing mana refunds, a mage/bard can cast Greater Heal many times before running out of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548801855629561980)
- **mage build archetypes**: Mages in Outlands generally either use summons to absorb damage while they deal damage, or play with a staff, which forms one of the tankiest builds in the game, and just cast spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550148843507552338)
- **mage build damage comparison**: A mage with eval, many links, high aspect, 100 eval, about 120 points in scribe and 40 in camping should do noticeably less damage than a build with 80 necromancy and 80 poisoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556092173018210398)
- **mage death loss cost**: Mages and summoners lose only reagents plus their spellbook or satchel on death, typically under 10k, which is cheaper than a melee character losing armor and weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533312079900049489)
- **mage durability**: Mages are very tanky and hard to kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524832703890063550)
- **mage fighting with spellbook equipped**: A mage with a spellbook equipped will still swing at the first monster that aggros them when they have no aggro, but does little damage with fists while holding a spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554679742609756261)
- **mage grimoire flame strike damage**: A mage grimoire build with a full defense book, flame strike, mind blast and chain lightning can deal about 1500 damage with flame strike even without spell damage ignore links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538295619116859533)
- **mage grimoire loadout**: A mage grimoire loadout can use Mind Blast, Lightning and Flame Strike, with Curse used for bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549755779442020447)
- **mage mana and damage boosts**: Ways to improve a mage's mana and damage in Outlands include the Meditation skill, a wizard grimoire, and a magic spell book that gives a mana refund chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550147311055937649)
- **mage mana and kill time**: Longer kill times on mobs mean more spells are cast per mob, giving a mage more chances to run out of mana between proc triggers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537992254789124116)
- **mage mana buffer**: Having less than 100 mana is risky for a mage because streaks of no mana refund or no proc can drain mana, and a larger buffer lowers the chance of running dry before a proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522588634153226361)
- **mage mana management**: Mage templates must manage mana, while other templates can sustain their optimal DPS without such penalties. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535505027949662209)
- **mage mini spell cooldown**: Mage mini spells have a 15 second cooldown, which one player feels makes inscription/mini-spell mage builds play awkwardly, suggesting 10 seconds would be better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520811568559030342)
- **mage pk burst combo**: A mage PK burst combo is Telekinesis, then a purple potion (explosion), then spamming spells with the remaining mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532169404396077157)
- **mage poisoner nox mage build**: A Mage/Poisoner (nox mage) build is currently considered strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527820286613917847)
- **mage pvp build types**: Inscription mage PvP builds exist, as do tank mage builds that combine a weapon with spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530708505575821463)
- **mage reagent depletion**: A mage killing mobs eventually runs out of reagents and cannot kill anything without scavenging for more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525627079050137680)
- **mage support setup**: In a mage support setup, use blade spirit to aggro, provocation for crowd control, and flamestrike, curse, mana drain and mind blast from a grimoire/Eldritch book, and use invisibility to drop line of sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549957344752836681)
- **mage tamer codex spell rotation**: A mage tamer casts Magic Arrow, Harm, Fireball (only if mobs live 15+ seconds) and Lightning from the Wizard's Codex, using Mind Blast while those cooldowns are active; Energy Bolt and Explosion are not great in the codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542930710845718569)
- **mage tamer incubus and earth mephit debuffs**: On a mage tamer using incubus and earth mephits, pets bring heals and strip armor and magic resist from targets, and scour plus primal let the debuffs stack high enough to stay valuable against boss-type mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554095111162437744)
- **mage tamer spell mana thresholds**: A mage tamer should avoid casting Flame Strike unless above roughly 50-60 mana or procced on Mana Thief, using Lightning (above about 25 mana, saved as a finisher) and Mind Blast (above about 20 mana) otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545455532033450054)
- **mage tamer survivability against pks**: A mage tamer can still be killed by pks, but it is harder for them to kill you before you reach a gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552224856123383842)
- **mage tamer template role**: A mage tamer template is well suited to dungeon crawling at a safe distance from your pets and to healing a group of friends. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543252428437200926)
- **mage tamer tradeoffs**: Mage tamer deals less DPS than other tamer builds but offers more utility, such as protection and bless buffs for pets, and is among the most relaxed tamer builds along with archer tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545524949811462205)
- **magery against pkers**: Magery is considered one of the best skills to have when confronted with a pker because it offers many options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552224093846249505)
- **magery cast cooldown**: Magery has no skill cooldown between casts, as three Fireballs can be cast in a row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542842032987308072)
- **magery curse to reduce enemy damage**: With Magery you can cast Curse on enemies to lower their damage output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551614342246563894)
- **magery for avoiding pks and death**: Magery is useful for avoiding PKs and avoiding death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531328228004856011)
- **magery requirement for pvm**: Magery is not needed for PvM if the build does not focus on magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541794075210948629)
- **magery spells for pvp thief chases**: For PvP thieves, Magery is a useful survival skill during chases, with Greater Heal, Cure, Teleport, Invisibility and Wall of Stone all being valuable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540086713676996679)
- **magery use for pure thieves**: Pure thieves usually double as mages, using magery for utility such as walls, teleports, invisibility and buffs rather than for PvM fighting; it is used in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525623978914349207)
- **magic arrow scroll before throwing farming**: Before farming with the throwing build, hit yourself with a Magic Arrow scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537440770896953354)
- **magic book weapon category**: The magic book that mages hold is a weapon-category item, separate from the spellbook that holds your spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525606007458365632)
- **magic potions in pvp**: Magic potions have no effect in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535321131928522832)
- **magic reflect grimoire damage reduction**: Magic reflect with 3 points in the grimoire gives 30% magic damage reduction; if a mage mob removes it for 1 minute, it can be reapplied after 30 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538297139489284277)
- **magic reflect interrupt protection**: Magic Reflect prevents one spell interrupt while it is active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537225577927278594)
- **magic reflection precaution**: Keeping Magic Reflection active as a precaution can block the first spell cast against you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535388424146518046)
- **magic resist for mages**: Magic Resist gives full PvE disrupt immunity and an extra mana refund, so the refund cap can be reached without casting Mana Drain with a material book, and it reportedly helps a mage escape PvP encounters in about 90% of cases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526871221927415808)
- **magic resist versus wrestling against pks**: Magic Resist is considered better than Wrestling for surviving PKs because most PKs are mages and dexxer PKs are rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534376634185158867)
- **magic weapon drops and identification**: Mobs drop magic weapons that must be identified before recycling, although using a weapon yourself reveals its properties through your player stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549613514493272155)
- **magical slaying bows rarity**: Magical slaying bows are valuable, but it is very rare to find one with both high bonus damage and a decent accuracy modifier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552088092931002439)
- **maiming stance effects**: Maiming stance increases hinder duration and overpowered hinder damage, but at low tier players cannot rely on hinders and lightning shocks to keep mobs off them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553901539733671997)
- **maintaining necromancy summons**: Necromancy summons lose max HP over time, so check their max HP with Animal Lore and recast when it gets low, or precast a new summon as the old one dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540225271947468840)
- **making pets draw aggro**: To make a mob aggro your pets, use Animal Lore on each pet, click the Abilities button, and make sure its Aggro indicator is red; otherwise the pet avoids getting aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531768657472913651)
- **mana cost of summoning five creatures**: Summoning five creatures costs about 70 mana, or about 56 mana if Wither is used for one of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532560983606821046)
- **mana drain and mana vampire with summons**: Using Mana Drain or Mana Vampire alongside Daemons or Fire Elementals increases DPS by lowering the target's mana resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532362072631934976)
- **mana drain on low spell resist mobs**: There is no reason to cast Mana Drain on a mob that has no real spell resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550546514336546868)
- **mana drain wizard grimoire**: Using a mana drain wizard grimoire appears to help with mana problems as a wizard, according to one player's experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555651928585932923)
- **mana efficiency of damage spells**: Players who can replenish mana quickly or have high mana refund can chain flamestrikes, while others get more casts without meditating by using lower-tier damage spells that cost less mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520464035244413132)
- **mana management for arcane mage**: To manage mana as an arcane mage, use Mind Blast until a couple of procs are rolling, then switch to Flame Strike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522923102885908491)
- **mana problems on platemail no-med arcane builds**: Players moving to platemail no-meditation arcane builds commonly run out of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525691799761584258)
- **mana spam with meditation bonus**: With the 30% meditation book mana bonus, players can cast wizard grimoire spells and Mind Blast almost continuously. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549034630609506395)
- **mana thief dungeon mana return**: Mana Thief returns a large amount of mana once it gets going while farming a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549986791124238389)
- **mana thief follow-up roll accuracy**: After a mana thief proc, the follow-up probability roll can be unreliable because of accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525693057117454516)
- **mana thief proc reliability when solo farming**: Mana Thief procs are random, and when solo farming where mobs are not constantly available, the Mana Thief timer resets, leaving the player at risk of running out of mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522910988855152690)
- **mana thief siphon scaling**: The Mana Thief siphon amount depends on the speed of your staff hits, so losing swing speed reduces the mana siphoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545459196911161366)
- **mana thief stacking**: Mana Thief returns more mana more consistently as multiple procs stack, sometimes returning a full mana bar or 100+ mana per staff shot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555615556265054333)
- **mana vampire vs mana drain magic resist**: The Mana Vampire aspect/effect lowers the target's magic resist significantly more than Mana Drain does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529157035596185832)
- **manual weapon ability triggering**: Triggering weapon and chivalry abilities manually allows more precise application and can save points, since auto-activation may waste an ability just before a mob dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536366194968232007)
- **marked valley ogre and ettin loot**: The marked valley has Ogres and Ettins that drop about 500gp of loot on average. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525713957040685206)
- **material spell book procs**: Using a material spell book with food and meditation lets a player cycle spells to occasionally trigger spell book procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549174305915543583)
- **maus as caster spot**: Maus is a poor spot for casters because its many walls and pillars block line of sight, and the curser cannot retry on LOS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531360938022670337)
- **mausoleum banshee abilities**: The Banshee in Mausoleum uses invisibility and teleport attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529705424851304529)
- **maxed mana thief mage strategy**: A maxed Mana Thief mage should emphasize big upfront damage without damage over time, using special chance and damage links with madness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540126134690259035)
- **meaning of farming**: In Outlands, farming commonly means going into dungeons to kill mobs, using weapons as a dexxer or spells and followers as a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525808476339834920)
- **measuring damage bonuses**: To measure damage bonuses, add up the SDI bucket bonuses, or test on the test shard against a 0 armor dummy using max damage rolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526998818158280725)
- **meditation rate versus focus for pvp**: Running 100 Meditation Rate (MR) instead of Focus allows a book mage to fight red players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531232286085877800)
- **melee anti-pk harvester builds**: Melee-focused harvesting builds exist that are designed to fight PKs while appearing to be harmless harvesters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531172833785544895)
- **melee aspect effect chance chain link**: The Melee Aspect Effect Chance chain link is considered poor; Melee Damage/Armor Ignore or Melee Special Chance/Damage are better choices later on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537016297521414244)
- **melee aspect special proc rate**: The melee aspect special proc rate is normalized by weapon speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553951872556204143)
- **melee axe link setup swing speed**: A tested link setup for a melee axe build used 8 damage to bleeding and 5 swing speed, reaching 46.5% swing speed increase with food, divine fury, and the swords stance that gives swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537227970979041394)
- **melee build books**: Melee builds use weapon, parry, and healer books (codex and grimoire) rather than mage spellbooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528016200716783646)
- **melee build starting links**: A good starting point for a melee build is Melee Special Chance and Special Damage links together with a two-handed weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548763351616856075)
- **melee cleave character for treasure maps**: A melee character that can cleave well may now be able to do treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538146923410755635)
- **melee defense link**: The melee defense link increases melee defense (avoidance), letting you avoid melee auto-attacks, and because some mob specials trigger only when they can melee you, avoiding the melee means no special occurs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529067656236368004)
- **melee defense values**: Focus gives 15 melee defense, links give up to 56.25 (15 gold melee defense links), and Warrior Stance gives 14. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531701459538677790)
- **melee dexxer and ak4 synergy**: Melee dexxer builds and AK4 do not go well together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527379854364774613)
- **melee dexxer resist requirement**: A melee dexxer needs at least 80 Resist to be viable in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535761322594148372)
- **melee dps aspects**: For melee DPS, the Madness weapon aspect is recommended, and the Lightning armor aspect is possibly a good pairing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530939897634885754)
- **melee dps versus tamers at low links**: Melee builds can out-DPS tamers, but many players are at 30 links and redline, so a dexxer at 13 links will not see comparable damage for a while. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544831813967417344)
- **melee hit chance cap**: A monster's melee chance to hit you reportedly caps at around 10% regardless of how much melee defense you have. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531702081021284443)
- **melee kiting usage**: Melee characters do not need to kite between every attack, but kiting is useful while waiting for a bandage to finish or a healing potion cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542410045596114945)
- **melee plus spell template**: The only template combining melee with a powerful spell is a dueling template for the arena, which is not usable in other PvP or the rest of the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536549005083811920)
- **melee poison sting**: When a player lands a melee hit with a poisoned weapon on a creature already poisoned with the same poison type, there is a chance to resolve a Melee Poison Sting that immediately resolves 1 poison tick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544062805450293311)
- **melee proc chance for bard mage**: Melee proc chance is considered too low for a high reset bard mage, and about 2 procs per minute on average would make it better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524849190868353197)
- **melee skill strength ranking**: Wrestling and poison fencing are currently great, swords is okay, dual wield can be good but is not the strongest, and macing is weak. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534583674291617906)
- **melee special chainlinks and backstabs**: Melee special chainlinks do nothing for backstabs because backstabs cannot activate weapon specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530809661400285266)
- **melee special chance and damage links vs arms lore**: Ten gold links of Melee Special Chance/Damage are equivalent to more than 220 points of Arms Lore for the swords proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539259115241738250)
- **melee special links and codex finishers**: Melee special chance and special damage links do not affect Codex finishers, because special attacks and finishers are separate mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546582564410761336)
- **melee special trigger**: The melee weapon special triggers roughly every couple of seconds, playing a noise and dealing about double damage on that hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538191946722320484)
- **melee swing speed and accuracy**: A melee character should aim for 50% swing speed and enough accuracy to deal good damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548724267925897237)
- **melee tamer codex recommendation**: A melee tamer should add the weapon codex in addition to the Bestiary and Healing codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543906579261423636)
- **melee weapon specials**: Melee specials include hinder for archery, crush for macing, and bleed for swords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530360313843552376)
- **melee weapon specials**: Each melee skill has its own unique weapon special, documented on the wiki, and these differ from codex abilities and aspect procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538188852840366161)
- **meta aspects for fastest experience**: The fastest experience is usually obtained by using the meta aspects, and Lightning is one of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552986989282852875)
- **meta builds air wrestler and poison dexer**: Air wrestler and poison dexer are both considered meta builds, with air wrestler seen as better in PvP while remaining very capable in PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540896753358868490)
- **metabolism and tanking pets**: Metabolism keeps tanking pets healed as long as they take little damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528789717796257873)
- **metabolism perk for pet life leech**: Metabolism, a Utility category perk costing 5 points, gives Tank pets life leech. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533859424920273057)
- **meteor elementals physical immunity**: Elementals spawned at past meteor sites were immune to physical attacks, so bringing a mage is advised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529888049641820332)
- **meteor site alien creatures**: The alien creatures at a meteor site are likely immune to physical damage and are best fought with a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541058958594089)
- **min-maxed air item id wrestler spell setup**: A min-maxed Air Item ID wrestler build skips Divine Fury and instead uses Enemy of One, Consecrate, and Dispel Evil. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522772976968401046)
- **min-maxing damage testing**: To min-max damage, join the test shard, fight a battle trainer with common AR values set up, and turn on maxdamagerolls (under the test category in [commands). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527749609315897418)
- **mind blast against high armor**: Mind Blast is worth considering against high armor targets, provided you are in an area with a good number of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546981810381004930)
- **mind blast and lightning procs on mage tamer**: On a mage tamer, spamming Mind Blast generates hinder and command procs, and Lightning is kept in the grimoire for an on-demand hinder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543325642496680106)
- **mind blast fishing**: Mind Blast fishing is a way for a wizard to sustain mana until they can sustain Flame Strike spam. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555674272578535477)
- **mind blast versus energy bolt damage**: Mind Blast does more damage than Energy Bolt to most mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545559734264791110)
- **miner template pk survivability**: The miner template with Wrestling, Parrying and Magery reportedly makes dexxer PKs (many gatherer PKs are poison dexxers) unable to hit you and lets you heal through mage PKs with greater heals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544362280144343061)
- **mini boss aspect requirement**: Many guilds will not let anyone attack a mini boss unless they are aspect 5 or higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535437110860054589)
- **mini boss list**: A list of mini bosses is on the Outlands wiki's Mini Bosses page at wiki.uooutlands.com/Mini_Bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532612324484190270)
- **mini boss respawn time**: Mini Bosses naturally respawn between 12 and 24 hours after being killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528238961225371778)
- **mini boss summoning in sanctuary dungeons**: You can summon a mini boss in a sanctuary dungeon, but it is subject to the same experience and loot reductions, and anyone can still attack it and will flag orange as usual. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539285558629499063)
- **mini-boss difficulty for duos**: Two average players can defeat a mini-boss, but it takes a lot of perseverance and a long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523821301683191838)
- **minimum farming build requirements**: A build lacking about 30 links, Redline and a full aspect is described as too slow at killing mobs on Outlands to be useful for PvE farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525137948469891092)
- **mining skill damage bonus to macing**: Mining skill adds bonus damage to mace weapon attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521386825095315486)
- **mixing spell damage and summoner builds**: A character either deals spell damage itself through magery with summons as tanks, or acts as a bard/summoner whose pets deal the damage; mixing the two works poorly, especially for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530693973318963216)
- **mob armor values**: Average mob armor is about 25, with some higher-end farm mobs having 50-75 armor, and armor reduces damage, which lowers the value of weapon special damage links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533353109236088833)
- **mob damage resistance buff**: Mobs recently received a damage resistance (DR) buff, which makes them feel stronger than before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548723765414731858)
- **mob hit points compared to osi**: Mobs in Outlands appear to have more hit points than on OSI, which makes pure burn damage less effective against them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527133582705950771)
- **mob hp breakpoints and redline damage cap**: Above 10k HP, most mobs' HP pools rise in 2k steps (10k, 12k, 14k, 16k), and almost no mobs outside Time content have odd-value pools like 11k, 13k or 15k, so redline damage cap points rarely pay off at odd breakpoints. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536534641291558953)
- **mob hp increase**: Mobs received more HP a few months before August 2026, and recent changes over the last month or two should let players do more damage, though a thief tome may need a respec. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533682520485396620)
- **mob invisibility attack timing**: Some mobs make their big attack when coming out of invisibility and others when going into it, so Reveal works better against some than others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529703106852687974)
- **mob poison resistance**: Few mobs have poison resistance, which makes poison builds broadly effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541742758170075176)
- **mob respawn timer visibility**: A mob's respawn timer is not visible to players, so it must be worked out by observation, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544694972614180864)
- **mob scaling in 3-man pit trials**: Mob scaling in 3-man pit trials is modest; one player scored only slightly lower than on solo runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555204393496748084)
- **mob special timing**: Most mob specials happen on a timer (cooldown), are telegraphed, or can be anticipated, so they are usually dodgeable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529068448699908136)
- **mob stealing rules**: Attacking a mob that another player is already fighting is not against the rules, because players do not own mobs or dungeons and attacking mobs is not a criminal offense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554993542508707841)
- **mob wrestling skill levels**: Mobs with 140 wrestling are about the most players regularly encounter, and only a handful of 150 wrestling mobs exist in standard dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553058952042782796)
- **mob wrestling skill variation**: The wrestling skill of mobs varies from one type of creature to another. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541985277927628911)
- **mobs before tmap chest**: With the new tmap system, mobs such as sunscales can be encountered before reaching the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532106905240080554)
- **mobs on boats and mob damage resistance change**: Mobs on boats were not affected by the mob damage resistance (DR) change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541867075398672394)
- **monkey stance combo bonus**: The monkey stance buffs the final hit of a combo but requires 4 consecutive hits, resets on a miss, and only 1 in 4 hits is buffed, making it a gamble. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521180755496140879)
- **monster armor rating lookup**: A monster's AR can be looked up in community tables, and it may be possible to check it in game with a lore or evaluation skill, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525614740540231741)
- **monster damage in pvp dungeons**: Monsters do not appear to deal reduced damage to players during PvP in dungeons, though player followers have special PvP damage cap rules documented in the Animal Taming wiki page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537022888375230545)
- **monster difficulty and first aspect**: Monsters in Outlands are tough, so a character without Codex, Aspect and Chain progress is weak, and unlocking the first Aspect gives a noticeable boost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546332332099772457)
- **monster health bar poison debuff**: The debuff display on the monster health bar shows poison data, and it may need to be enabled in the options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522994723667709962)
- **monster hidden resistance scope**: Monsters' hidden resistance applies to all sources of damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537425655782834176)
- **monster hp visibility**: Animal Lore can be used on a monster to see its exact HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546254547691774052)
- **monster hunter 75k task farming speed**: Players with fewer than about 20 links are unlikely to farm the 75k monster hunter tasks quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531644359336788100)
- **monster resistance to barding skills**: Monsters have a resistance to Barding skills, so peacemaking can fail even with high skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554920951911555196)
- **monster spawning in walls**: A monster can spawn inside a wall and use a grab effect that holds the player, but players can typically escape by roping out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523052465677795440)
- **monster targeting of summons**: Monsters tend to attack summons rather than the summoner, so a mage-style PvMer may not need wrestling for defense, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534376634185158867)
- **movement while casting**: You must stand still while channeling a spell, but once the targeting cursor is up you can move. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548101800144408756)
- **multiboxed pk against hidden chivalry gatherer**: A player can multibox a PK character to kill a gatherer who is protected by a hidden chivalry mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529892472355033148)
- **multiple dot debuff display**: Multiple individually tracked DoTs show as one debuff with stacks on the enemy hotbar, and may resolve individually or be added together if they fall in the same time interval. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542516673167237130)
- **multiple-target stances and backstab**: Multiple-target weapon stances such as Cleave do not work with backstab attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547767593434218617)
- **murder tagging**: Killing enough blue (innocent) players tags you as a murderer in Outlands PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551091829708038166)
- **musicianship and discordance for tamers**: Taking Musicianship and Discordance on a tamer is reported to provide about 25% more damage via the discordance buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522287362502168789)
- **natural boss spawn cooldown**: Natural boss spawns have a cooldown of about 12 hours for mini bosses and 24 hours for main bosses, after which they reportedly spawn randomly within a 12-24 hour window; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553159509604827139)
- **necro bard aspect setups**: For a necro bard, the recommended aspect setups are Command on both the book and weapon, or Command on the book with Frost on armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533519852344574183)
- **necro bard build focus**: A necro bard generally does not run Meditation or cast many spells; the build puts everything into pet damage and runs Command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533519142353899541)
- **necro poison template**: Necro poison is considered a very strong template right now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523301300295700611)
- **necromancer bard air elemental aoe**: A necromancer bard build can use air elementals with Provocation for AoE damage to take down packs, and does well in OSS3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549174305915543583)
- **necromancer build against bosses**: A necromancer build is considered best against bosses because of their large HP totals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545605999371751514)
- **necromancer damage boost**: A necromancer mage gains roughly 30-40% more damage depending on content, can fit damage to diseased links, and uses Necro codex points to trigger other damage skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524764902303072366)
- **necromancer dps setup**: When doing DPS as a necromancer, one player rarely uses aspects and instead relies on the madness book and earth armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551567063879786539)
- **necromancer mage playstyle**: A necromancer mage casts spells and uses necro abilities to increase their power and apply diseases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528799412334235679)
- **necromancer poison strike scaling**: The necromancer Poison Strike ability appears to scale with poison ticks and displays as a green tick, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524823423396614305)
