- **necromancy and chivalry abilities in pvp**: Necromancy and Chivalry abilities such as Poison Strike have no effect in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528348561693999224)
- **necromancy and chivalry buff duration**: Most necromancy and chivalry abilities are buffs that last 30 seconds, so most players leave them on auto. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527014389088129075)
- **necromancy auto start abilities**: On the necromancy bar, any ability other than Vengeful Spirit or Pain Strike can be set as an auto start ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541885708707430491)
- **necromancy disease damage over time**: Necromancy causes offensive spells to apply a disease damage-over-time effect, and some necromancy abilities increase overall offensive spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548027807441879071)
- **necromancy free mana ability**: A Necromancy ability (the second to last ability) gives roughly 50 free mana every 30 seconds to spend on non-offensive spells such as summons, buffs, heals and revives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548027924014301335)
- **necromancy mummy form hit points**: Necromancy mummy form never regains the hit points it loses, so it becomes brittle after being used for some time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554261214803267645)
- **necromancy playstyles**: Necromancy is built for either running summons or casting spells; a melee-leaning option is disease with the death aspect, fencing and water elemental summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524384933005496440)
- **necromancy poison strike with fencing poison**: Necromancy Poison Strike works with poison applied from fencing, since poison is treated as the same effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541027505018765374)
- **necromancy spell dps bonus**: Necromancy reportedly adds extra DPS to spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531559464560492634)
- **necromancy summon and blood oath choice**: Players with Necromancy should use the necromancy versions of the summon and Blood Oath rather than the non-necromancy equivalents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532361837570424965)
- **necromancy summoned pet damage**: Necromancy summoned pets reportedly deal about 20% more damage than regular summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531568071393677353)
- **necromancy summons**: Necromancy summons have better stats than regular elemental summons but take longer to grab aggro, and a summoned undead follower takes 1 to 2 seconds before it follows commands such as all guard or all attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553705013480792087)
- **necromancy summons mana cost and damage**: Necromancy summons cost no mana to summon and deal much more damage than other summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549174305915543583)
- **necromancy wither for mana on bard build**: A bard necromancer build can use the Necromancy Wither spell to regain mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526007909576867971)
- **new catalyst damage**: The new Catalyst did about 1k red damage in one player's tests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526306320859267323)
- **new weapons and pure dex builds**: Two newly introduced weapons reportedly weakened pure dex builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528168005949722674)
- **no damage causes**: Running out of aspect essence, or equipping a weapon that does not match your chosen weapon skill and codices, can cause you to deal no damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529330564363063366)
- **no shield accuracy bonus**: Using no shield gives a large accuracy bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544013899764863086)
- **non-arcane mage equipment**: A non-arcane mage equips a magic book (sometimes a purple magic book that can boost damage or mana refund) and leather armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525606370710130910)
- **non-blood-armor arcane mage stat distribution**: A suggested stat distribution for a non-blood-armor arcane mage is 100 STR / 36 DEX / 89 INT, where 89 INT reaches 100 after casting Cunning and an Agility potion keeps dexterity at 56. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522577386292379719)
- **non-proc arcane mage leather build**: An arcane mage in leather armor without an arcane proc can farm Tidal 3 with minimal rope kiting if it has meditation and cooking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525689728320667781)
- **nox codex and dual wield**: The Nox codex leans toward defense and red damage, so dual wield fits it poorly, as dual wield is better suited to weapon special red damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526820219580977172)
- **nox dexxer build**: A nox dexxer build is poor unless barding is squeezed into it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545382255705325618)
- **nox dexxer poison kit properties**: A nox dexxer is recommended to use Accumulation, Caustic and Targeted Venom on the poison kit, plus Efficient or Susceptible when fighting poison resistant mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547314012323323974)
- **nox dexxer weapon choice**: A nox dexxer that leans into poison damage should use Fencing weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524210735285276765)
- **nox necro meta**: Nox necro is a top meta choice right now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523297227970314291)
- **nox summoner poison tick damage**: A high-end nox summoner's poison ticks do roughly 600 to 1,100 damage; stings consume one tick and the poison aspect may consume a tick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548291215882063904)
- **noxcro and nox dex damage**: Noxcro and Nox Dex builds deal very low damage after the latest update, according to player testing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528156807309295696)
- **noxcro disease application**: A Noxcro (poison necromancer) can apply disease with damage spells using an ability, so Damage to Diseased Creatures links suit that build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525564920727339219)
- **noxcro dungeon farming template**: Noxcro is a dungeon farming template that deals massive damage while summons absorb hits, letting players burn through one target at a time in level 4 dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526992763185533061)
- **noxcro poison strategy**: A Noxcro casts nox spells repeatedly until the target reaches deadly or lethal poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524833021331636408)
- **noxcro template**: Noxcro is the nickname for the poison summoner template (Poisoning/Necromancy); it was strong and trendy in the past, especially at Ocean, but has been nerfed and is less popular now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548292405294534798)
- **noxious necromancer link choice**: A plain poison damage link is the preferred choice for a noxious necromancer, over a poison damage/resist ignore link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545524263929520238)
- **npc and monster ships on the ocean**: There are NPC and monster ships on the ocean that can be farmed like a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668839941546135)
- **npc crook versus no crook**: Even a crook bought from an NPC is better than carrying no crook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527131618316386344)
- **nuking resource maps**: Players can nuke a resource map to clear out its spawned monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528173673075441785)
- **nusero dungeon status**: Nusero dungeon changed from Sanctuary to Challenger status, and Challenger dungeons have tougher monsters than normal dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525297024423956490)
- **obsidian body slam danger**: An Obsidian monster's body slam is very dangerous to treasure map hunters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538233995542659113)
- **ocean fighting build**: Fighting on the ocean requires an entirely different skill build than a standard gatherer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526589786624888864)
- **ocean fishing risk**: Ocean fishing is a viable activity, and the main risk is other boaters coming to sink your boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536933090872791090)
- **ocean pvm and chain experience**: Ocean PVM is a fast way to earn chain experience, and chain experience works as a gold farm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522393047378169896)
- **old disease fencer build composition**: The old disease fencer build reportedly did not use Death armor and was a regular dexxer in Blackguard stance with disease links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532393862616846359)
- **old poison damage videos**: Videos showing 1-2k poison tick damage are outdated, because poison damage was changed within the last couple of months. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544402110198587403)
- **omega starspawn loot**: One player's Omega Starspawn event run yielded about 18k gold, a handful of magic items and an arcane scroll, with no rares. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540835900374913117)
- **omni boss parry alchemy template**: For Omni boss content, a Parry + Alchemy template with 5 SSI links slotted rarely dies, and invulnerability/fortitude gear can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533355026788122706)
- **omni fight mechanics**: Omni deals no direct damage, and the fight involves hundreds of summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537040647381585982)
- **one-handed crossbow accuracy bonus**: Using a one-handed crossbow without a shield grants +20% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554962569846853676)
- **one-handed crossbow and shield**: A one-handed crossbow lets the wielder equip a shield for a higher armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547989561974464616)
- **one-handed weapon and shield resistance**: Using a one-handed weapon with a shield provides 10% damage resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524861579160584322)
- **one-slot pets for phoenix**: Fire Mephit and Incubus are popular 1-slot pets to run with a Phoenix, and Incubus is a great utility pick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535403320984997908)
- **ossuary custodian**: The Custodian in Ossuary protects the boss room from people camping it when it is not in use for bosses, and it drops no loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530441572804460615)
- **outlands wiki armor and weapons burst weapon chart**: The Outlands wiki page 'Armor & Weapons' has a chart of burst weapons for the initial Backstab hit, after which players switch to a quicker weapon for follow-up hits and proc specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555699996157026504)
- **over-investing in cartography**: If you over-invest in Cartography for the map levels you run and your location has many harder non-chest mobs, clearing them can take a long time before you reach the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537473157827526677)
- **overcapped accuracy conversion**: Accuracy above 100% versus the target's fighting skill converts to flat melee damage percent at a 1:1 ratio, so 105% accuracy gives 5% more flat melee damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532907998517792839)
- **overheal ability**: The Healers Codex ability Overheal applies an additional 8%/24%/40% of healing amounts to the patient, divided over the next 3 seconds, depending on rank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528219468474355855)
- **overlooked backstabber ability strength**: After the nerf, the Overlooked backstabber ability is considered weak; players typically use Extortion for extra black market goods or distraction, and Ransack is mostly used by archer stabbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524678768923377724)
- **overpower damage bonus**: An overpower damage bonus is gained when chance to hit exceeds 100%, capped at 25%, and this cap is easy to reach on level 3 mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537447410480058408)
- **overpowered hinder behavior on hindered targets**: With an overpowered hinder, if the target is already hindered (or possibly in cooldown) you deal more damage instead of hindering again, and you also get longer hinders and more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531710195363741897)
- **pack animal against harvester hunters**: A pack animal helps against harvester hunters because its moo warns that something is nearby, and hits it takes are hits not landing on the player, since wilderness reds using scripts often hit it accidentally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535335109299802243)
- **palabard template**: The Chivalry/Discordance/Provocation/Focus/Musicianship/Peacemaking/Swordsmanship/Tactics template is a classic Palabard, a powerful template, and bards are valued as group support. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528699481397268570)
- **paladin tamer viability**: A paladin tamer is possible but not very good, since most of Chivalry buffs the character while taming focuses on pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536026817666883635)
- **panacea and freedom levels**: Panacea and Freedom should be at least level 1 to have a chance of being used, and they are worthwhile even for regular PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539199363534819359)
- **paragon monster journal text**: Paragon monsters appear with golden text in the journal when you pass them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544214146827026523)
- **paragon spawn chance**: Almost every mob has a fairly low chance to spawn as a paragon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545495080998150195)
- **paragon spawn mob type**: A paragon spawns as the same mob type as its spawn location's normal mob, so unusual mobs nearby were likely dragged in or came from a progressive spawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545496128135372860)
- **paralyze against mobs**: Paralyze is effective for holding mobs, is underused by players, and costs no mana when used to re-paralyze a held mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528920391752618024)
- **paralyze as crowd control for summoners**: Using paralyze on monsters that your summons are not attacking is helpful crowd control. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521538833513054329)
- **paralyzing blow and hamstring**: Outlands does not have Paralyzing Blow, but it does have Hamstring and Battle Hamstring, which are used in events. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534590575360344174)
- **paralyzing mobs as resource mapper**: Resource mappers can paralyze the mob as a fallback if their summons go down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531431944720482394)
- **parry and alchemy survivability in dungeon pvp**: With Parry and Alchemy and the codexes maxed, a player is very hard to kill by mobs in dungeon PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554233987499556906)
- **parry and stances**: Parry is much more effective when the player uses stances properly; without them most of its benefit is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364394254991380)
- **parry book taunt cooldown**: The parry book taunt has a cooldown of roughly 15 seconds, though the exact value is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534789402943950868)
- **parry buff in recent patch**: Parrying was already very good for healing Time content and became better in a recent patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531356155589300224)
- **parry codex mirror stance**: Parrying improves survivability against monsters, and the Parry codex's Mirror stance helps greatly against magic-using mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525091894059597905)
- **parry dagger versus shield**: A parry dagger is generally worse than a shield because additional armor rating becomes more beneficial the more AR you already have. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524821937799303419)
- **parry damage reduction display**: The status display shows 50% parry damage reduction when parrying with a halberd, but 75% when parrying with dual-wielded weapons, the same value shown as with a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534279843259351193)
- **parry finisher barrier nerf**: Barrier, the flat damage reduction parry finisher, was severely nerfed in a recent patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536846139339440158)
- **parry finisher proc threshold**: Parry finisher procs such as Barrier depend on the player's own health threshold, not the monster's health. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526856144977526845)
- **parry for level 4 solo blood armor arcane build**: For soloing level 4 dungeons with a blood armor arcane build, Parry is recommended when tanking harder content, and raising Wrestling and Arcane may help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522992994658160690)
- **parry for mages**: Parry does not improve mage survivability because mobs that kill you without it also kill you with it, as it does not avoid their special attacks; it is better suited to niche situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531667053650378763)
- **parry for poisoners and trappers**: Parry is very helpful for poisoners and trappers because you are stuck in place once you start placing a trap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523777604451307560)
- **parry stance hotkeys**: Parry only needs three stances hotkeyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364642625163585)
- **parry stance management**: Parry works well with a defensive grimoire (magic reflect, protect, reactive armor) and stance choice: Mirror when taking heavy damage (with 100 Magic Resist), Warding if you cannot out-heal a disease, and Testudo otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531350829888438484)
- **parry strength**: Parry has become weaker in recent updates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543734272588914748)
- **parry substitute for escaping**: Magic resist and wrestling are reported to work as a substitute for parry when escaping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521550092635472075)
- **parry versus arrows**: Parry applies to arrows because archery counts as melee for anything that references melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529688826514112563)
- **parry viability**: Parry is generally a poor choice for most content, with niche uses such as facetanking for allies on an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529945612399935558)
- **parry with bare fists**: If you fight with plain fists and no wrestling weapon, you need a shield to parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549384076106928269)
- **parrying blocks spells**: Parrying can block spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531348727250555050)
- **parrying for tanking**: Parrying is recommended when tanking harder content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522992994658160690)
- **parrying instead of alchemy for front-tanking dual wielders**: A dual wielder who front tanks everything can drop Alchemy and take Parrying instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528780955702137023)
- **parrying survivability against tidal giant fish**: With Parrying, a player can survive for a long time at very low hit points while tanking a giant fish in Tidal that hits for about 70 damage, though a second fish can still kill them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522704106341400616)
- **party bard requirement**: A dedicated party bard is only needed for Time, Mini, Main, T8, Omni and Oss4 content; other content is easy without one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542633326571954286)
- **partying in dungeons**: Partying up makes dungeon content faster for everyone involved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522792425209462794)
- **peacedin bard healing method**: Peacedin bards drink potions to heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531927657933963365)
- **peacemaking accuracy buff for azures**: Peacemaking gives a 15% accuracy buff, which with decent wrestling azures brings them to roughly 81% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549867413330329841)
- **peacemaking and disarm accuracy bonus**: Peacemaking a target and/or disarming it boosts your accuracy against that target, though peace is of limited use if the target breaks free of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543994921487310978)
- **peacemaking while running past mobs**: Peacemaking can be used while running past a mob to stop it from fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548070676190068807)
- **pet aggro on boats**: On a boat, enemies reportedly target your crew instead of your pets, so you can bandage crew rather than use veterinary supplies and do not need a tank pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539232447118446642)
- **pet aggro option colors**: In the pet aggro option, red means the pet gets aggro and gray means it does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555585891702018212)
- **pet aggro setup for ranged and non-tank pets**: It is good practice to set ranged and non-tank pets to not get aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555586143930687729)
- **pet all kill against casting mobs**: Against some casting mobs, ordering pets to 'all kill' makes the mob target and hit you instead of the pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527960443753074761)
- **pet all patrol command**: Say 'all patrol' and click a spot to send pets there; they walk in small circles and aggro anything in range, which can pull more mobs than intended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527962790105579661)
- **pet aoe directionality**: Strider AOE and the AOE of any pet with charge are not directional, while directional AOE pets such as the ember dragon or drake are somewhat slower but still effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543523312813080626)
- **pet attack speed versus ebs**: Once accuracy and attack speed caps are reached, pet attack speed is preferred because it converts to pet damage at a better ratio than EBS via the Provocation song. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549868704261480551)
- **pet build role in boss fights**: Pet builds are not best for boss damage; their role is to tank adds and heal teammates while arcane mages and dexxers handle DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525772362253996195)
- **pet damage against high magic resist mobs**: Summoned pets deal roughly 100-200 less damage against mobs with high magic resist, so summoners should max out magic resist shred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333033565884457)
- **pet damage bug in pvp**: A known bug lets a thief or PK deal over 200 damage in one hit to a pet in PVP, and admins have said it needs a complicated fix. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532136163454746717)
- **pet damage necromancer spell usage**: A pet damage Necromancer casts few offensive spells and mostly uses the spells from the grimoire rotation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543346253608517773)
- **pet epic barrage zero damage window**: A pet using Epic Barrage deals zero damage for a couple of seconds, which reduces its DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529137650425008261)
- **pet frenzy attack speed cap**: The pet ability Frenzy likely does not let pets exceed the attack speed cap, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540965507476496476)
- **pet guaranteed hit after miss at high accuracy**: When a pet has 80% or higher accuracy and misses, its next hit is guaranteed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549867413330329841)
- **pet guard command**: Typing 'all guard' (default keybind 2) makes pets guard you and attack back when you attack or are attacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546536665366007880)
- **pet healing with poison field**: Standing pets in a cast Poison Field while healing them is suggested over basic bandage heals, which are slow; curing poison and resurrecting dead pets is much faster than basic healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974175261663353)
- **pet healing with veterinary supplies**: Rather than checking a pet's health, constantly spam veterinary supplies (bandages) on the pet regardless of its current health. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522376191091146773)
- **pet leveling via guild boss runs**: Pets level very quickly when they tag along on guild boss runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552718862967902360)
- **pet lore stay-or-engage icons**: In pet lore settings, the book icon makes the pet stay next to you while the sword icon makes it go down to the mob, so spellcasting pets should be set to the book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538508560538009620)
- **pet modes for phoenix setup**: For general content, set the Phoenix to melee mode with aggro on and the 1-slot spellcaster pet to casting mode with aggro off; for bosses, set both to ranged mode with aggro off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535403667656806410)
- **pet paired with two warpigs**: The pet that usually goes with 2 warpigs is Frost Mephit or Boreal Faerie Wyrm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531421333173309624)
- **pet poisoning panel value**: The poisoning value on a pet's biology panel is its Poisoning skill, which affects its chance to apply poison each hit, and the letter shown means the poison tier: (G) Greater, (D) Deadly, (L) Lethal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537396536290316338)
- **pet resurrection via chivalry**: A dexxer character can resurrect a pet using the Chivalry heal ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533258237623668767)
- **pet resurrection via magery**: A mage can resurrect a pet using the Magery resurrection spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533258237623668767)
- **pet summoner endgame viability**: Pet summoners excel at pushing into harder content because they can summon very tanky pets that take only two follower slots, and a daemon is even better than a caster mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545384125689499782)
- **pet tanking and aggro settings**: Any pet can serve as a tank as long as its aggro setting is configured properly, and the aggro settings matter most. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538502353299316766)
- **pet team viability after rebalance**: After the pet rebalance, many pet team compositions are viable, and a tamer can farm with nearly any pet combination, though some comps are specialised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540109366324101181)
- **pet-based summoner damage build**: A pet-based summoner going all-in on follower damage drops Evaluating Intelligence, focuses on pet damage boosts, and uses Spirit Speak and Follower Damage links with the Command book and either Command or Frost armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538281362111602710)
- **pets and aspect special attacks**: A follower (pet) does not trigger an aspect special attack, so aspect effects such as Lyrica's cacophony do not extend to pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523311163490828399)
- **pets and summons in pvp**: Pets and summons behave essentially the same in PvP and share the same damage caps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538946273854492843)
- **pets for low-level treasure map monsters**: Pets with an AOE cooldown, such as a giant or colossal strider, drowned dragon or ruby wyrmling, are effective for killing level 1-4 treasure map monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543522939058782258)
- **pets for thieves**: For a thief, pets serve mainly to tank and to give the appearance of not being a thief, so they can be sub-par pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549477641348849796)
- **phoenix and fire mephit pet modes**: With a Phoenix and a Fire Mephit, set the Phoenix to melee mode with taunt on, and the Fire Mephit to spell/ranged mode with taunt off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534427872016728095)
- **phoenix boss pairing**: A phoenix is good against bosses when paired with a fire mephit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534409232328425502)
- **phoenix tamer ranged build dps**: A phoenix-based tamer using 30 links split 15/15 can reach 1k+ DPS as a ranged build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530348864228556892)
- **phoenix wrestling benefit**: For a phoenix, wrestling skill up to 100 prevents it from being hit and from having its casting interrupted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521181668638064660)
- **phoenix wrestling stat value**: Wrestling is a low-value stat for a phoenix because even a bad roll should reach 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521181668638064660)
- **physical damage for parry nox dexxer**: Red (physical) damage is generally not important for the parry version of the nox dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524209371075317842)
- **pickaxe damage for defense**: A pickaxe can deal up to 32 damage, so a defensive miner can use it to chase off attackers who do not expect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531439635165614100)
- **picking dungeon chests**: You can pick dungeon chests without clearing the surrounding mobs by using stealth or a tele rope plus hide before aggro, plus smoke bombs and invisibility; it is easier if the mobs are out of the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532156060025098374)
- **pig nerf**: Pigs are reported to be nerfed in an upcoming patch, though no official patch notes confirm the details. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530275605155938386)
- **pincushion trigger conditions**: Pincushion has a low trigger chance and can only trigger when you are below 25% hp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537016297521414244)
- **pistol crossbow shield use**: A pistol crossbow can be used together with a shield, which gives more protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527017692434010113)
- **pit trial bard build**: The pit trial may require a different bard build than other content, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542633604155183236)
- **pit trial xp by party size**: One player found that 3-man pit parties gave the best XP, 5-man parties gave about the same, and solo runs gave lower XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555204563194355803)
- **pit trials gear**: Survival gear is used for Pit Trials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555040118761463832)
- **pk activity timing**: PK activity is higher on weekends when US players are online. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541923298601074859)
- **pk approach methods against map runners**: PKs approach map runners using stealth or a blue gater, meaning a blue-flagged character arriving through a gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542083294089449472)
- **pk chivalry gate ambush**: A PK can stealth in, set a chivalry gate location, stealth off screen, recall home, then chivalry gate back and relog so the gate opens next to the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539699002529026048)
- **pk codex and link usage**: Some PKs run many codexes and links because the bonuses, though ineffective against players, make them more resilient to monsters while chasing victims. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551329714763731065)
- **pk dungeon preference**: PKs tend to gravitate toward dungeons with bonuses such as gold, exp, challenger or respawn, including the weekly bonus dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539223987404546138)
- **pk encounter rate factors**: The number of PKs you encounter depends on the day and time, the weekly regional dungeon bonuses, whether you farm in a bonus dungeon, and your activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552158705565310997)
- **pk guild activity schedule**: PK guilds tend to run almost nightly during a window of a couple of hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554370558601203763)
- **pk locations and harvester routes**: PKs are mostly found at PvP points of interest, near towns like Prev, and on routes where harvesters are common, so harvesters may avoid them by choosing different routes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535343990105317437)
- **pk looting under new tmap system**: Under the new tmap system, PKs are expected to rarely loot a chest because the setup makes looting difficult, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531109850690490408)
- **pk mounted movement speed**: A player killer on a mount can move about 11 tiles per second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542041718654898226)
- **pk recall on top of players in wilderness**: PKs can recall on top of players in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538296247360946307)
- **pk risk for treasure map runners**: PKs rarely attack treasure map runners in the wilderness; one player reports about one PK encounter per 50 T-maps without tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531425331875942410)
- **pk risk in challenger and xp boost dungeons**: Challenger dungeons and xp boost dungeons are the most dangerous places for PK encounters, so players who want to avoid PKs should stay out of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533310399846285495)
- **pk risk while picking chests**: While stealthily picking dungeon chests, only PKs using Tracking (which many run) can find you, and keeping enough mobs between you and PKs keeps you safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546173165820969010)
- **pk spellcasting pause**: Each time a PK casts a spell they must stand still briefly, so a fleeing player tends to gain distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522660612117762098)
- **pker risk mitigation**: Risk from pkers depends mainly on where you farm, so farming in safer areas and dungeons is the best way to mitigate it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552228292432494623)
- **pks spotted by 60 tracking**: PKs spotted with 60 Tracking are mostly ones not running toward the player, so they are not a threat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542042038244089896)
- **placetrap command**: The [placetrap command exists for setting a Trapper's traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521316034341109820)
- **plate armor for tribard tamer**: Plate armor is considered a good choice for a tribard tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556026446286426294)
- **plate armor rating at tier 15 aspect**: Plate armor with a tier 15 aspect gives roughly 145 armor rating, though this figure is approximate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527388327907561592)
- **plate armor while backstabbing**: Wearing plate armor while backstabbing may save the player from being one-shot, but offers little else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544542476419727410)
- **plate armor without head piece**: You can wear plate armor without the plate head piece to keep your preferred headwear, at the cost of some armor rating (AR). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925399004184647)
- **platemail aspect proc versus leather**: Platemail with arcane or blood aspect proc chance is better than the leather non-proc build, and mages would only be freed from aspect proc dependency by nerfing mana thief, the arcane proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525690041467404528)
- **player damage boosts and pets**: Effects that boost your own damage often do not boost your pets' damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547231941990813787)
- **player damage link effects**: Player damage links usually affect direct damage only, which indirectly boosts effects based on the initial hit's damage, such as necromancer disease and bleed stacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543691155638718534)
- **player killer avoidability**: Player killers are mostly avoidable by fleeing and are best treated like NPC-like threats that cannot be cheesed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529223743602294825)
- **player killer encounter rate on treasure maps**: One player reports meeting a player killer about once in every 50 treasure maps when running without Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536828371403546784)
- **player killer loot overlooking**: Player killers often overlook valuable gear that looks like ordinary gear, such as a suit of invulnerability plate that looks like regular plate, because they do not mouse over items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529750315971383337)
- **player killer looting behavior**: Player killers sometimes loot everything, only some items, or nothing from your corpse, depending on circumstances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532752765548363866)
- **player poison damage**: Player poison damage depends on the poison tier inflicted and the poisoner's Taste Identification, and weapon damage does not change how much damage the poison does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550205500354723963)
- **player spell interruption**: Player-cast spells interrupt a caster regardless of wrestling skill or other interrupt-avoidance measures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546655868500705422)
- **poi name danger**: POI names can be deceiving; for example, Illuminated Springs has angry fairies that cast flame strikes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537464829697064960)
- **poison and evaluating intelligence in pvp**: Poison remains effective in PvP, and spells hurt more with Evaluating Intelligence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528348814975701144)
- **poison arcane necromancer staff aspect**: A poison arcane necromancer should still put the arcane aspect on the staff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549927870246424617)
- **poison build armour**: A poison build works best with poison aspect armour and is a full all-in template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542997671516577913)
- **poison caster rotation**: Keep Mind Rot running, cast Poison until the target is upgraded to Lethal, then use Poison Strike when available while stacks of lethal are up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544401114718281788)
- **poison chain alternative options**: Enfeeble adds tankiness and Efficient offers a different approach to damage as poison chain options, and Terminal can be dropped if kills are so fast that mobs do not get a full cycle of poison ticks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521145615520632892)
- **poison codex point allocation**: For the poison codex, take Terminal first, then Efficient; spend the last 5 points on Susceptible or Direct Dose, with Direct Dose pairing well with Terminal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **poison codex tick upgrade**: An entry in the poison codex grants an extra poison tick when upgraded, so casting poison a couple of times may do more damage rather than less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554443780839575585)
- **poison dexer poison damage cap**: A poison dexer reaches the cap for poison damage through aggressive stance, the Taste Identification bonus, and skill bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527269837506613328)
- **poison dexxer build**: Aggressive stance gives swing speed for a poison dexxer, and a build with 100 Alchemy and 100 Poisoning works well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526938014004154439)
- **poison dexxer build against pks**: A good poison dexxer build against PKs is likely the standard build but using Resisting Spells instead of Parrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524164338015928393)
- **poison dexxer dungeon performance**: Poison dexxer builds still perform strongly in dungeons, and the recent nerfs were aimed at the pit rather than dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543698194364366849)
- **poison dexxer follower links**: Follower damage and Follower attack speed links are suggested for a poison dexxer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554481180252971011)
- **poison dexxer skill setup**: Poison dexxers using alchemy usually run healing and anatomy, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524507185420439662)
- **poison dexxer special chance links**: A poison dexxer should focus on increasing poison ticks, as it cripples enough without any Special Chance links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541752168191627324)
- **poison dexxer viability**: Poison dexxers are viable for PvM but not really for PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521993046915285102)
- **poison dexxer viability**: A poison dexxer is viable after the patch if you have good links/chain and redline, though a lightning or madness wrestler is preferred as a primary dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543699098329157712)
- **poison dexxer vs death knight**: A poison dexxer is reported to perform about as well as a death knight while using far fewer buttons, making it the simpler option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521850356819169412)
- **poison dexxer weapon**: A fast fencing weapon is recommended for a poison dexxer; a kukri is a suitable choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556036065855541309)
- **poison dexxer without parry or healers codex**: A poison dexxer can be viable without Parry or the Healers codex, but against some mobs the player must kite heavily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547058238640365691)
- **poison dot stacking**: Poison is applied once, refreshed if applied again, and replaced if a higher-level poison is applied. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542516673167237130)
- **poison fencer kiting**: Poison does much more damage than weapons, so a poison fencer can stab a mob to apply poison and then kite it without needing a bow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548759769731567841)
- **poison fencer weapon choice**: Poison stings have a 5 second delay, so weapon choice for a poison fencer is mostly a matter of preferred look or sound. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550205730643120301)
- **poison field in pvp**: Poison Field is best avoided in PvP because other players walking into the field will turn you grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524025043581927504)
- **poison hazards in petram and dm**: Mount Petram and DM dungeons have poison to deal with, and Petram has many trap spiders, so carrying Greater Cures is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527910067054051369)
- **poison kit**: The Poison Kit provides a big boost to poison damage and should be obtained and leveled early. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527683001385877656)
- **poison kit codex**: The Poison Kit is the codex for poison and gives damage and damage reduction buffs against poisoned creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550226193331257385)
- **poison kit damage bonus**: The Poison Kit grants a 15% damage bonus against poisoned creatures via Accumulation, including damage from traps and explosion potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553190945082712156)
- **poison kit enfeeble damage resist**: A poison kit with the Enfeeble property grants Damage Resist against poisoned creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547940462113988608)
- **poison mage codex choice**: For the poison mage codex, take Airborne when killing multiple mobs at once and Targeted Venom when killing one mob at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **poison mage core build**: A poison mage build has poison taste necromancy at its core. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525649498070581329)
- **poison mage grimoire entry**: A poison mage should take the poison entry in the mage grimoire to get more effective poisoning skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **poison mage level 4 rotation**: For a poison mage at level 4, cast Poison, wait for two poison ticks, then cast Poison Strike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523498689828753529)
- **poison mage necromancy damage**: A poison mage without necromancy deals about half the damage of one with necromancy and is considered poor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525650089694068817)
- **poison mage spell usage**: A poison mage only needs Mind Rot on auto cast and should cast Poison Strike whenever it is off cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **poison necro mage and fortune armor**: A poison necro mage's damage is largely tied to Poison aspect armor, so it is likely a poor fit for Fortune armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545096082021818408)
- **poison necro summoner reagent use**: A poison necromancer summoner build consumes a large number of reagents on each run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555284128654561344)
- **poison necromancer damage profile**: A poison necromancer deals much of its damage over time through poison and disease, producing spread-out damage rather than high burst damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524417500652110007)
- **poison necromancer damage reduction and armor**: Various Grimoire spells and the Poison codex have a lot of damage reduction built in, and wearing platemail armor helps a poison necromancer avoid being squishy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524416724030591016)
- **poison nerf**: Poison was nerfed recently, which reduced the strength of poison-based nox dexxer builds that were previously very strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545382127544049786)
- **poison resistance by dungeon**: Monsters in Petram, Darkmire and Pulma have meaningful poison resistance, while monsters in AK, Cav and Maus have almost none. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521978961629024436)
- **poison resistance of monsters**: Very few monsters have significant poison resistance outside the Time dungeon, so poison resist ignore is usually not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521976996517773392)
- **poison spam caster resource use**: A poison spam caster rarely runs out of mana but burns through nightshade quickly, so bring plenty of nightshade and lethal poison potions to upgrade the poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544390372200030211)
- **poison stacking**: After the most recent patch, multiple poison applications can stack, which makes poisoning more valuable as a pet skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537401184506216448)
- **poison stacking after lethal poison**: Once lethal poison is applied to an enemy, casting additional poison does not stack further and is only worthwhile for the stings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540149815663403081)
- **poison stealth backstabber fencer template**: A poison stealth backstabber fencer template works fine at higher links once the player starts hitting the 10,000 damage cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522054052525904103)
- **poison sting resolve stacking**: A poison sting can resolve a tick, a sting, and bane (3x resolve) together, totalling 5 resolves at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544062619478921346)
- **poison strength**: Poison was nerfed so it is no longer overpowered but remains good, though using it risks being attacked, and all mobs received another global buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537776096735526963)
- **poison strike damage after poison ticks**: Waiting for a couple of poison ticks to pass before casting Poison Strike makes its damage much higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **poison strike mechanics**: Poison Strike is cast on a creature already afflicted with Spell Poison or Disease and resolves up to 3 Poison ticks and up to 8 Disease ticks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524538015350001744)
- **poison strike with death aspect change**: With the death aspect change, Poison Strike may become more appealing for an arcane mage with 80 Necromancy, since stacking four Flame Strikes before firing it could yield roughly 8 resolutions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531733175339061298)
- **poison summoner build approach**: For a poison summoner, max the Dismissive, Purification, Spirit Pact and Stagnant traits, throw summons into groups of mobs, poison them, let them die to recover mana, then resummon quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547231069009354783)
- **poison summoner versus poison dexxer**: In the current patch, poison summoners struggle to get lethal poison and stack damage but excel at AoE poisoning, while a poison dexxer resolves poison ticks and deals more immediate damage; the next patch is expected to give summoners poison stings that resolve ticks and higher single-target damage while nerfing their AoE. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534836977416016013)
- **poison trapper summoner's tome points**: A trapper running poison only needs Accumulation and Enfeeble from the Summoner's Tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524439894041170062)
- **poison versus bleed swords strength**: Bleed swords was stronger than Tamer before its nerf, and poison is now about as strong as bleed swords was, possibly stronger on bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521613009578102885)
- **poisonable two-handed weapons**: Among two-handed weapons, only fencing spears can be poisoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531943702799581244)
- **poisoner build dps**: Poisoner builds are often seen doing very high DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528866094951960748)
- **poisoner template aspect and mastery chain**: The poisoner is one of the templates that benefits most from a high aspect and mastery chain, and training poisoning can be somewhat expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524417215452024883)
- **poisoning dual wielded knives**: Dual wielded knives can be poisoned, but this uses the Dual Wielding skill rather than Fencing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540797667880476704)
- **positioning when tmap mobs spawn**: When treasure map mobs spawn, step away so you are not standing in the middle of the five of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537440407359586344)
- **potion attachment to monsters**: Explosion potions automatically attach to monsters (mobs) without any extra steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523864898247983267)
- **potion cooldowns**: Cure and heal potions have a 10 second cooldown in Outlands, and potion cooldowns are believed to be 10 seconds across the board, though the general claim is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539588628471218216)
- **potions and aspect procs**: Potions never proc aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526034495759712408)
- **power and vanquishing weapon rarity**: Power and Vanquishing magic weapons are rare drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544565445918862)
- **power weapon accuracy bonus**: A power weapon provides no accuracy bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521907230973100193)
- **preferred archer links**: For most archers the preferred links are MDIA and DDBP, although melee special can be argued for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548320815156691005)
- **pressure points healing anatomy damage difference**: With Pressure Points maxed in the Healer's Codex, a backstabber running 80/80 Healing/Anatomy loses less than about one percent of damage compared with using Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541900101742755852)
- **preventing arcane staff auto-cast**: To stop an arcane staff from casting automatically, place it in the backpack and leave it there, then pick it back up once finished using Paralyze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534314862518468771)
- **prismatic staff**: The Prismatic Staff is an Arcane Staff, so it can proc the Arcane weapon special. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527085208354951260)
- **progressive spawn rare drops**: Any mob during any phase of a progressive spawn can drop the spawn's rare item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723951549980854)
- **progressive spawn reward chest**: Progressive spawn locations usually have a tent with a locked chest; killing the boss drops the key, and the chest contains gold and a few items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532013569481117716)
- **progressive spawn trigger**: The first wave of a progressive spawn probably starts at random, likely based on elapsed time, and further waves are triggered by killing the spawned monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532019228260171948)
- **protection spell behavior**: The Protection spell in Outlands gives an armor buff that expires after a couple of minutes and does not protect from spell interrupts as it classically did in Ultima Online. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537225238691979376)
- **provocation song with syop**: Provocation song combined with Sing Your Own Praises (SYOP) quickly catches up on the discordance debuff and can maintain it nearly all the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541539739184922664)
- **provocation versus single pulling**: Provocation is fine for group pulling, but single-pulling with Discordance then Peacemaking is recommended, especially for a weaker bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555521908017991711)
- **pulling aggro without summoning build**: Earth Elemental or Blade Spirits can be used to pull aggro without investing in the Summoning build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533130400686149823)
- **pure bossing build**: A tribard dexxer is considered the current pure bossing build apart from the arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551303978673774653)
- **pure dexxer pvp builds**: A pure dexxer is rough for PvP; most players combine melee and archery, or add some magery for utility such as teleport, a mini heal or two, and wall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521993511291850935)
- **pure dexxer versus hybrid dexxer build**: A pure dexxer build is possibly better than a dexxer hybrid that adds mage and necromancy, though this is an unconfirmed opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532502506037313617)
- **pure discordance bard without meditation**: A pure Discordance bard build can run without Meditation, but then it cannot handle boss content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526008088325394533)
- **pure summoner vs necro summoner builds**: Pure summoners can reach damage comparable to necro summoners but rely more on their own spell damage than pet damage, favoring skills like evaluating intelligence and inscription and possibly the eldritch armor aspect, while necro summoners are pet-focused and favor frost or command with herding and veterinary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545379860610945084)
