- **purge impurities in summoner codex build**: Purge Impurities is considered an essential ability in the summoner codex build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549662167488405557)
- **push through blocking enemies**: Two rows of enemies can block you from pushing through, but you can still push through a single row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544713614714478603)
- **pve hybrid alchemy versus arcane**: For a PvE hybrid, 100 skill points are better spent on Alchemy than Arcane, because Arcane red damage is weak unless it is the catalyst. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541262797554581597)
- **pve mage damage mitigation**: A PvE mage needs summons to tank monsters, or arcane damage reduction bonuses to mitigate incoming damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527274410711449680)
- **pve taming recommendation**: For PvE, players are advised to push animal taming to 110 and acquire cryptwings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534001926264328364)
- **pve throwing weapon speed**: For PvE throwing weapons, a weapon in the middle of the slow-to-fast speed range is usually the sweet spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537491893351358484)
- **pvm armor choice by stat build**: PvM characters typically wear leather armor with 100 INT and plate armor with 100 DEX. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359420264841248)
- **pvm characters and pvp**: PvM characters can kill other players but should focus on PvM for progress; when attacked it is often easier to escape than fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525863588596809841)
- **pvm content gating**: Most Outlands PvM content is not gated behind levels, links, or other power systems aside from time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529818457166844014)
- **pvm damage bonus caps**: PvM has supplementary damage caps, and the largest of the skill damage bonuses for magery is the limiting one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530822872463835297)
- **pvm dps evaluation**: PvM DPS depends on the build and what is being farmed, and most players judge performance by gold per hour (GPH) and XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535837886568599602)
- **pvm farming follower setup**: A good PvM farming setup needs a tank plus a combination of damage-dealing followers, and most pets are viable for early to mid-game content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532596320743723208)
- **pvm mechanics in pvp**: Pretty much none of the PvM-specific mechanics, such as aspects, function in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527388868171661423)
- **pvm melee build for level 4 areas**: A PvM melee build of 100 Wrestling (or Dual Wield), 120 Chivalry, 100 Tactics, 100 Anatomy, 100 Resist, 80 Healing, 80 Parry and 40 Focus can stay in a level 4 area without problems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544129962779611136)
- **pvm ship combat requirements**: PvM ship content requires a character suited to water combat plus a boat, supplies and crew; logging into the portal and verifying lets you talk to ship players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553559472545341502)
- **pvm skills while pvp flagged**: Skills that excel in PvM builds, such as Chivalry, Arms Lore, Parry and Focus, do not work at all or are diminished while PvP flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555272363250155560)
- **pvm spell damage choices**: Flamestrike, or the smaller spells that the grimoire buffs on rotation, are commonly used for PvM spell damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547643365997281331)
- **pvm template cost**: Every PvM template other than a dexxer is reportedly expensive to set up and maintain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545973889170153622)
- **pvm templates**: Hybrid templates are not commonly used for PvM on Outlands; pure dexxer or pure mage templates are recommended instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525599701385220147)
- **pvm threats to fishing ships**: Fishing ships are often attacked by PvM threats on the ocean, but staying fast and attentive usually keeps you safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549703228336373841)
- **pvm weapon dps grind type**: For PvM, medium grind weapons have better DPS than other grind types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527020215810920488)
- **pvm xp progress for pvp characters in dungeons**: A PvP-focused character with progress in the PvM XP systems survives better against dungeon mobs, and deeper dungeon levels have mobs that can crush a character with no such progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547614316658688111)
- **pvm xp sources**: PvM XP in UO Outlands is earned from killing mobs in the overworld, dungeons, and on the ocean, as well as from lockpicking chests, treasure maps, dungeon chest picking, and stealing from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378717981020261)
- **pvm-only builds in pvp**: A build dedicated purely to fighting monsters will have a hard time in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535985120857821204)
- **pvp attack re-engage bug**: In PvP, attacking can bug out when targets run, and you may need to toggle war mode and double click the target to re-engage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524014896470167685)
- **pvp availability**: Outlands has plenty of PvP: open-world PvP in the wild, structured events every hour on the hour, Strangelands a few times per week, and factions available at any time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545243493054808094)
- **pvp boxing tournament progression**: For the PvP boxing tournament, no character progression such as Codex or Chivalry leveling is necessary or helpful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542695802466472028)
- **pvp capability by build**: Tamers have essentially no PvP capability, while bards get defensive barding and dexxers can kill a mage PK 1v1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521525472473780304)
- **pvp damage reduction links**: PvPers use links dedicated to reducing damage taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528538393909137408)
- **pvp damage testing dummy**: There is believed to be no PvP dummy for testing damage, but damage can be tested on the test server using two characters or with a friend. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588796561662044)
- **pvp design for new players**: Outlands PvP is designed so new players can start quickly and take part on equal footing, so many grind-heavy things apply only to PvE. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530563734307868686)
- **pvp echo cooldown threshold**: A dedicated PvP echo is only considered worthwhile if the echo cooldown is 15 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526016381911568504)
- **pvp events without item drops**: Some PvP events do not drop players' items as long as they are using basic gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545193425945497600)
- **pvp flagging**: A player is PvP flagged as soon as they attack or are attacked, though there may be exceptions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535399006656659616)
- **pvp gear difference**: Gear differences in PvP amount to roughly 10% mitigation and 15% damage, mostly affecting dexxers, and exceptional crafted gear is generally sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538657000425128037)
- **pvp hybrid wrestling swap**: Swapping swords with wrestling may be better overall for a pvp hybrid: you lose bleed but gain a useful pierce. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537853025421492354)
- **pvp mage template**: A common PvP mage template is five Magery-related skills at GM (120), then adding 100 and 120 in two other skills of interest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541243847349243944)
- **pvp mage with weapon skill**: A PvP mage build that uses a weapon skill exists, but it is not intended for PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527273872489971743)
- **pvp movement restriction tools**: Besides hamstring, paralyze, paralyze field and stamina reduction, Energy Field and Wall of Stone can also restrict player movement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538733251110248478)
- **pvp rope and teleport item cooldown message**: In PvP, trying to use the rope or teleport item again displays a system message with the remaining cooldown time, but no message appears until the item is used again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541067067891916870)
- **pvp skill levels**: Playing below 100 skills is not really done in PvP since Razor exists; players want max skills with general armor and decent weapons for dexxers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538656670547447878)
- **pvp skill parity**: In PvP, maxing your skills puts you on an even field with other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527395121296052264)
- **pvp skill vs pay-to-win**: PvP in Outlands is described as based on skill and practice rather than pay-to-win. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521553409323565229)
- **pvp template dps in pvm**: A PvP-oriented template can farm PvM, but its skills are spread thin, so its DPS is lower than a dedicated PvM build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536328290787135578)
- **pvp thief playstyle**: Stealing from players as a PvP thief is still viable, and some players do nothing but steal from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528260850148839465)
- **pvp versus pve templates**: PvP-focused templates outmatch PvE glass cannon templates, and PvP outcomes depend largely on player skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522721553475964988)
- **pvp versus pvm character specialization**: Because of the skill cap, a character is tailored to either PvP or PvM and is less effective in the other, so pure PvM characters tend to be glass cannons in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615073290158080)
- **quarterstaff for mace dexxer**: Quarterstaff is a great weapon choice for a mace-skill dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532412710476579117)
- **quarterstaff mace fighting vs high-armor mobs**: Quarterstaff mace fighting remains a good choice against higher-armor mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542008686107689052)
- **queued spell last target behavior**: When beneficial and harmful spells are queued, the queued last target passes to the next target in line regardless of alignment, so if the mob dies before the cast goes off, a harmful spell can hit the friend previously healed, even with smart last target enabled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524555513512329227)
- **ranged attacks around corners**: You cannot attack with a ranged weapon around corners without line of sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532144812021518397)
- **ranged fire mephit pulling**: A Fire Mephit that sits back at range may pull additional monsters if the player's positioning is wrong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534428446082469919)
- **ranged summon creature option before tome leveling**: Before the Summoner's Tome is leveled, the ranged option for the summon creature spell is Ghoul. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161428238172161)
- **ransack versus distraction damage**: Ransack with 10 or more steps remaining does slightly more damage than Distraction, but only by a couple of percent, and it requires managing stealth steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549052731338002536)
- **ratman hovel dangers**: The Ratman Hovel packs many mobs close together, and the ratmen there inflict disease on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522713149688647700)
- **ratman's hovel spawn behavior**: Ratman's Hovel may behave like a progressive spawn in which higher-level creatures such as Gnawers and Squeakers appear the longer you farm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535889270408085545)
- **ravage proc stacking**: Multiple Ravage (Blood Aspect weapon proc) procs are intended to be tracked as separate bleed dots on the target, though they may display as a single debuff on the buff bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532382102627160195)
- **reactive armor grimoire bonus**: Three points in Reactive Armor in the grimoire gives a permanent 20% reduction in incoming damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364051878285312)
- **recall escape from harvester pks**: Standing still and recalling away repeatedly is a way to escape pursuing harvester PKs; defensive barding gives about 60 effective wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549909154703999087)
- **recall farming method**: Recall farming means recalling nonstop between wilderness PvM spots, killing monsters, looting gold and skinning everything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525626260703940698)
- **recalling away from a pk**: When recalling while a PK is engaging you, break line of sight first, because the PK can interrupt your 2-second recall cast with Magic Arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542934572675760220)
- **recent adjustment in upcoming patch**: In the upcoming patch discussion, the only thing reportedly adjusted was the healing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531092499693572167)
- **recent tamer patch pet meta**: A recent patch to tamers shifted the pet meta, and because of how zoology works it takes time to determine which pets are best. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537893889501831291)
- **recognizing progressive spawns**: A progressive spawn can be recognized when, after you kill a spawn, more mobs appear a few minutes later casting flamestrike; its mobs may also cast other spells such as explosions and have unusual names, especially at the higher end. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546929120984694844)
- **recommended azure pet abilities**: A recommended ability set for an azure pet is Cornered, Lethality, Mutation and Behemoth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549870058514284625)
- **recommended boating setup**: A suggested boating setup is at least 8 links for cannon and ship damage plus boat abilities focused on either sail or gun damage, with crew slots filled by almost anything at first, which can consistently handle up to large boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526711272199164016)
- **recommended scavenger loadout**: The recommended scavenger loadout is plate armor (mages use leather unless they add Meditation), Greater Heal/Cure/Magic Resist/Total Refresh potions, trapped pouches, and optionally Adventurer's Rope and Smoke Bombs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866523044024390)
- **recovering items from pks**: If you know who PK'd you, there is a slight chance of getting your item back by asking them very nicely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526995496067928130)
- **red challenger dungeon**: A red-colored dungeon is a challenger dungeon in which every monster is harder than normal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522378457290510450)
- **red character pvp event participation**: A red character can still take part in PvP events because they receive a grace period. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529426386089939004)
- **red hand lootability and attackability**: Red Hand players are freely attackable and their corpses are freely lootable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548924715513413663)
- **red pk frequency and grouping**: Reds (PKs) are less frequent than before and are now almost always in groups rather than solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552721718911438999)
- **red player presence at necromancer island map**: A red player typically arrives within 3-4 minutes at the necromancer island map location, even late at night. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528899138232520794)
- **red player wrestling skill**: Nearly all red players run 80-100 wrestling, which makes them hard to hit with weapon skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538583002446172340)
- **red players and treasure chests**: Because the treasure chest opens on boss death, red players can kill the boss and loot the chest without first killing the blue players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528891318787379262)
- **red players exiting houses hidden**: A red player who leaves a house while hidden can still catch you even if you use a tracking-recall script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521721394105286786)
- **red players grouping**: Red players are almost always in groups with at least one other player, so 1v1 fights with a red are rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538580300584714413)
- **red players in region bonus areas**: Region bonus areas are more likely to have red (murderer) players present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527902874544115903)
- **red players recalling onto farmers**: When farming a popular spot, red players often recall right on top of you, so tracking does not always warn you in time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535386701244137593)
- **red portal hotkey**: Create a hotkey for using the red portal so you can escape quickly when fleeing a PK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521640550460162280)
- **red rock wilderness mob**: Red rock is a wilderness mob whose special only breaks off smaller pieces, so it is safe to let several attack while you AoE them down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538644382209675444)
- **red thief stealing healing reagents**: A red character with the thief class can steal healing reagents from you, which can leave you unable to heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529428351209574430)
- **reducing spell damage**: The Resisting Spells skill reduces spell damage, and other reduction methods exist depending on skills, aspect, codices and links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552376584185323683)
- **reflect damage and monster hidden resistance**: Reflect damage, such as from a fire tailor, does not seem to be affected by monsters' hidden resistance, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537425655782834176)
- **reflect damage tank build**: A reflect-damage tank build used to be strong on Outlands, but patches and changes have since removed its strength. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546342482076237934)
- **regional boss bars**: PvM in the wilderness and core dungeons counts towards the boss bars for those specific regions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521908925178318868)
- **regular elemental summons**: Regular elemental summons obey commands instantly, which is useful when you need to grab aggro immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553705013480792087)
- **remove curse debuff clearing**: Remove Curse clears debuffs such as pierce. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524466839650959391)
- **removing damage over time effects**: Cleanse by Fire or Close Wounds can remove damage-over-time effects such as bleeds, diseases and poisons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524466705642815558)
- **removing focus for resisting spells**: Removing Focus in favor of Resisting Spells reportedly gives more defense in PvM and PvP and lets a dexxer reduce swing speed increase (SSi) to 51%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549852086857105509)
- **repeater finisher damage scaling**: The repeater finisher damage is not scaled by weapon damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527029360022786320)
- **repeater hit weapon swap**: For Repeater hits, players switch to a heavy bow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553434186210091039)
- **repeating -1 chat log after provocation**: An endlessly repeating '-1' in the chat log after provoking creatures reportedly stops once you return to the provoked creatures, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535568996252782714)
- **reporting murderers**: Reporting a player for murder removes their blue status so they no longer appear blue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527038468855828713)
- **requirements for effective summons**: Effective summons require a codex, an aspect, the right skills and crooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553400192760287324)
- **resetting thrall max hp pool**: To reset a thrall's max HP pool without resummoning, drop a piece of your armor on the ground to remove the aspect, pick it back up, and apply the aspect again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530674649472700517)
- **resist-ignore and damage mastery links**: Resist-ignore and damage mastery links are valuable, and arcane hexes are noticeably missed when they are gone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545388954134511646)
- **resource map pop location**: Under the new resource map system, the location where a map will pop is not known in advance, so players should have summons up and be ready for mob aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544470767306276984)
- **resummoning cost**: Bringing summons back costs mana, and mana is the only cost of resummoning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530664199963803718)
- **retaliation against gray players in town**: If you attack a gray player, they can attack you back even in town, so there is no safe place once you attack back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535373612574314565)
- **reveal on ground near summons**: If you are away from your summons, you can cast Reveal on the ground near them, since the mob likely still has aggro on the summons and is moving toward them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529703321248469126)
- **revealing hidden players**: Murderers, who are mostly mages, can attempt to reveal a hidden player, and if they are running tracking they will likely have an arrow pointing at the spot where the player hid. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529497919734939709)
- **risks of fighting out-of-league monsters**: Fighting monsters out of your league makes escaping PKs more dangerous, and standing still too long lets a thief visit you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541853373186445362)
- **rope movement during arcane casts**: Using a rope to maneuver during casts still allows arcane staff hits to land. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545555929238347887)
- **rope use to reduce greater heal casting**: A mage can use rope to avoid having to cast Greater Heal often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524837309483319377)
- **roping for arcane mage**: Roping costs no mana and can be done while casting a combat spell for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364004172271726)
- **rune teleport use in combat**: Rune tome or runebook teleports can be used in combat as long as you are not interrupted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542933758745780287)
- **rushing through mobs with pets**: To rush past mobs, stay in 'all guard' so pets grab aggro from whatever targets you, say 'all follow' to bring them along, and switch back to 'all guard' when approaching a new mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538505262946721863)
- **sanctuary dungeon**: A sanctuary dungeon has reduced loot but allows players to hunt without risk of being PKed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529477518401343529)
- **sanctuary dungeon difficulty**: The Sanctuary dungeons are roughly on par with one another in difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520504924910125139)
- **sanctuary dungeon loot and experience reductions**: All sanctuary dungeons reportedly apply the same reductions to loot and experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542833598472654919)
- **scribe and resist interrupt avoidance**: Both Scribe and Resist (Resisting Spells) provide interrupt avoidance for PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **script necessity in pvm**: Scripts are not necessary for any PvM gameplay on Outlands; it is a matter of how much you hotkey versus letting scripts play for you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539985109984477235)
- **selecting weapon finisher in codex**: To use a weapon finisher in Ultima Online: Outlands, select the finisher in your codex; after that no manual activation is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545566684499284038)
- **self heal sources across builds**: Nearly every build has some source of self healing, with the exception of a few pure glass cannon swords bleed builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521200312822792315)
- **self treatment for lightning archer**: Self Treatment in the healer's codex gives faster bandages and is a reasonable pick after Pressure Points for a Lightning Archer build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533953475040382997)
- **self-healing dps pets**: Few DPS pets can self-heal; bats are the main one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528789429332873409)
- **separate pvp character**: Players should use a separate character for PvP rather than a PvM build, since PvP characters carry mostly worthless gear while PvM characters carry valuable gear and loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529606871176974486)
- **set last target default keybind**: Set Last Target has a default keybind, which can cause accidentally targeting a party member if pressed unintentionally, so players may want to unset it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540563827790454796)
- **setting ranged summons to ranged attack**: For ranged summons such as fire elemental or lich, use animal lore on the summon, open the abilities page, turn off aggro (top-left circle black, not red), and set the summon to ranged attack (top middle). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161754467074142)
- **shadow armor backstab bonus**: Shadow armor grants a (12.5% * (3.75% * Tier Level)) bonus to Melee Accuracy, Melee Damage, and Damage Resistance on any Backstab attempt and for 10 seconds afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547243567628427394)
- **shadow aspect accuracy bonus**: Tier 0 shadow aspect gives 12% accuracy, and a decent weapon can add another 9-12% accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526975578270335168)
- **shadow aspect and wild swing**: Shadow Aspect offsets the accuracy penalty of the Wild Swing stance, so the extra damage is effectively free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522023450154238054)
- **shadow aspect on stealth pk**: Shadow Aspect is useful on a stealth PK, but the backstabber template is not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535265113605669025)
- **shadowglass and winter glass mobs**: Shadowglass and winter glass mobs kill you quickly if you stand still near them for too long, so keep moving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538644465202495630)
- **shadowspire cathedral floor 1 danger**: Shadowspire Cathedral floor 1 (SSC 1) is far more dangerous than some level 3 dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527230164243845213)
- **shadowspire gargoyle danger**: In Shadowspire, gargoyles that target you will likely one-shot you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078357313626137)
- **shank stance swing speed**: Shank stance pushes swing speed over the cap when attacking from the side or behind a mob, but leaves it slightly under the cap when attacking head-on without the double bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526273947585347675)
- **shared template for madness and lightning builds**: The template posted in #template-builds works for both the madness and lightning builds, and both are considered pretty great. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535795840851902524)
- **shatter finisher and pierce**: The Shatter finisher deals extra damage to targets that are affected by pierce. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531775240181645533)
- **shelter dungeon loot rate**: The Shelter dungeon gives 50% less loot than the wild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532462172892954886)
- **shelter dungeon mob difficulty**: Shelter dungeon mobs die in about one hit, so many can be killed and skinned in a loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532459137835728946)
- **shelter dungeon reward balance**: Shelter dungeons give an unrealistic feeling of reward versus difficulty because the penalty was removed from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532745229784842361)
- **shelter dungeon rewards**: The Shelter dungeon gives 75% of the normal exp and gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330489823596575)
- **shelter dungeon second floor difficulty**: The second floor of the Shelter dungeon is noticeably harder than the first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850297705304155)
- **shepherd's crook aspect use**: An activated shepherd's crook gives the herding bonus without herding, and it can be equipped with the melee weapon aspect activated for a chance to proc the aspect special when bashing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526807461288218744)
- **shepherd's crook damage bonus**: A shepherd's crook gives summoner builds roughly a 10% damage boost, though one player felt it was not worth the price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527131492180955278)
- **shepherd's crook herding bonus for summons**: Carry a shepherd's crook and activate it to give a Herding bonus to your summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543018897572233226)
- **shield damage resist and fire aspect**: A shield provides 10% damage resist, which lets a Fire Aspect player deliberately take more damage to get more reflected damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525201057892925510)
- **shield necessity**: Most content (about 90%) does not require a shield, because a shield slows you down, 2-handed weapons carry damage bonuses, and you still get parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532466075491373117)
- **shield use with one-handed ranged weapons**: A shield can be used with a one-handed ranged weapon without needing Parry, and one-handed weapons are a bit quicker in speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553900035375235114)
- **shield use with wrestling**: You cannot wear a shield while using wrestling, which is its main drawback. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531643966213329077)
- **ship attack size rule of thumb**: As a general rule, do not attack ships more than one size larger than the ship you are using. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542225734616092833)
- **ship boarding and ship-land combat**: Boarding only works ship to ship; attacking between land and ship is technically possible but damage is massively reduced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542580180252627045)
- **ship size and top-end farming requirements**: The smaller the ship used, the better the chain and aspects need to be to farm at the top end, which is why the galleon is most often recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542225439894933594)
- **ship to ship damage reduction**: Ship-to-ship combat now has damage reduction, and cannon damage used to proc Fire Aspect in the past. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525200970584424589)
- **shop potions strength**: Potions bought from shops are weaker than Greater potions but still help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525869659835072625)
- **single-target poison dexxer damage**: After the latest poison changes, single-target poison dexxer damage remains solid even with 20 of 30 bronze links, with stings over 1k and banes over 2k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540450324597313606)
- **single-target taunt range**: Taunt on a single targeted mob has a range of 12 tiles and requires line of sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540279226299580536)
- **skill level for dps summoner**: For a DPS summoner, buying 50 in the relevant skill is enough, since extra skill only makes Bless last longer on the follower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524783596492161177)
- **skill versus redline in solo pit**: A top solo pit player reached the first leaderboard page with 0 redline and about 30 links, suggesting skill matters more than redline, while most players on the same build cap out around wave 13-16. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521230098458742926)
- **skills on mobs**: Mobs have special abilities, and skills do not work on them exactly as they do on players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555049485720227882)
- **slayer choices for sanctuary dungeon**: A Daemon slayer is generically good for the sanctuary dungeon, Nature slayers are commonly seen, and a Construct slayer would be valuable because constructs have high armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521550128522068120)
- **slayer groups**: There are eight slayer groups, and each group's wiki page lists which creatures are harmed by that slayer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526006177996083300)
- **slayer society goblin quest locations**: Goblins inside the sanctuary dungeons do not count toward the Slayer Society goblin-killing quest; goblins outside the dungeons must be killed instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541781030753665105)
- **slayer weapon damage bonus**: Slayers were nerfed so that greater slaying gives +25% damage and regular slaying gives 20%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522821365327986839)
- **small spell damage boosting debuffs**: Curse, Mana Drain, and the necromancy spells Mind Rot and Corpse Skin make small spells do much more damage, while the mob is kept peaced and discorded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532721290866327602)
- **small spell damage without grimoire**: If a build loses the grimoire, small spells do little damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532728034031960177)
- **smoke bomb as offensive cooldown**: Using smoke bomb as an offensive cooldown leaves a character more vulnerable, because it is then unavailable as a defensive cooldown to escape a dangerous situation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533445468363821207)
- **smoke bomb use on cooldown**: Using a smoke bomb while it is on cooldown only informs the player that it is on cooldown, with no other penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544056648866332703)
- **smoke bomb use when attacked**: A smoke bomb can be used to hide when attacked by a mob, but not when attacked by a player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527299190663680142)
- **smoke bomb visibility**: Smoke bombs are less subtle than hiding: other players can see where you vanished and estimate your path, and players with tracking can still follow you within limited range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533446844351250532)
- **smoke bombs for lockpickers**: Smoke bombs serve as an escape tool for a lockpicker in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540813556990087300)
- **smokebomb hiding effect**: Using a Smokebomb automatically hides the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540536315467272223)
- **smokebomb system messages**: Smokebomb shows no system message when used, but shows a system message when you try to use it while it is on cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540681499815190689)
- **solo cav 4 tamer**: Any tamer build can solo Cav 4. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530303019558764545)
- **solo dungeon pvm meta build**: Tamer is the current meta build for solo dungeon PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553710902191067148)
- **solo farming archer ability**: An archer farming solo will probably use the Pincushion ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533352287244914799)
- **solo farming deep dungeons on a dexxer**: Solo farming deep dungeons on a Dexxer is difficult without 30 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547798280602255421)
- **solo mauss 4 templates**: Poison dexxer and wrestler templates can reportedly solo Mauss 4. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531819154238079109)
- **solo pit trial profitability**: Solo pit trials are generally not profitable in Ultima Online: Outlands, especially with only 12 links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527814367872159836)
- **solo stealth archer viability**: A solo stealth archer gives up about 200 skill points for Hiding and Stealth, making solo kills difficult, but the build can work with a partner where both are hidden and attack together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550286678910967860)
- **solo versus group content**: Most Outlands content is solo and is generally more efficient than group play, while group content is mostly bosses and omnis and is considered a chore by some players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552993224379859146)
- **soloing mauss 4 as discipline wrestler**: Mauss 4 can be soloed with a discipline wrestler build, provided monsters are pulled carefully. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536894022189060196)
- **special attacks and parry**: Special attacks are believed to be unable to be parried, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524821833738752140)
- **special effects while hindered**: Some special effects still occur while a mob is hindered: some mobs that summon other mobs still summon them, and some self-heals still happen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538940034495942656)
- **special loot in sanctuary dungeon**: Special or rare loot in the Sanctuary dungeon is possibly based on a weaker monster's base chance, yielding about 33% less than a normal dungeon, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536499535436578926)
- **special spellbook drops**: Special spellbooks, such as ones affecting mana regeneration, are loot items that drop from mobs with a certain chance, and the chance is reportedly lower on Shelter where enemies are easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546602692267483208)
- **spell casting delay and daisy chaining**: A 200ms gap is required between casts, and daisy chaining casts speeds up casting while letting you use cast time for maintenance such as drinking potions, eating a mushroom, or changing stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540742827175055511)
- **spell damage increases**: Spell damage can be increased with a Wizard's Grimoire, Evaluating Intelligence, and aspects; some players also use Inscription and cast from scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549648573757530243)
- **spell damage summoner aspects and links**: A spell damage summoner works with Eldritch or Void aspects, and suitable links are Damage to Diseased Creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523284806236897390)
- **spell interrupt timing**: Spell interrupt timing depends on the circle of the spell and on the percentage of the cast completed when the interrupt occurs, and there is also a minimum interrupt time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541523676451700816)
- **spell interruption**: Nearly any damaging spell interrupts enemy spell casting, with a few caveats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538982760000262205)
- **spell interruption**: Spell casting can be interrupted by both mobs and players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543436987434930308)
- **spell interruption in pvm**: Without interrupt avoidance, every instance of damage taken in PvM interrupts spell casts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **spell interruption protection skill**: In Outlands, spell interruption is resisted by Resisting Spells or Wrestling, whichever is higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529550039607672903)
- **spell overhead words visibility**: Spell words are verbal, so other players can see what spells you cast and the overhead text cannot be completely removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523450874578604163)
- **spell poison sting requirement**: A spell poison sting may only have a chance to trigger if the poison spell lands at the same poison level already on the mob rather than a higher one, though this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544424212679368784)
- **spell recovery delay between casts**: Spell recovery between casts is roughly 200-300 ms, mostly around 240-270 ms and never a consistent 200 ms, possibly with some variable delay plus ping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542951169394081832)
- **spell siphon activation**: Spell Siphon works with any amount of Resisting Spells, with the buff size scaling with the amount of resist, and it activates when you are hit by a spell while you have resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536837384166187068)
- **spell stone depletion**: A spell stone disappears once it runs out of uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196326558638141)
- **spell targeting timing**: A spell only goes off if the target cursor is up, so pressing the last target key too early may not queue the spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548101809761943613)
- **spell thumper monsters**: Spell 'thumper' monsters hit every player who stands too close to them, not just their target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523679699274825809)
- **spell-based poison sting**: When a Poison spell fails to upgrade an already poisoned target's poison (always the case against Lethal poison), the target takes Poison Sting damage of 10 * (((Poisoning + Taste ID) * 0.5) / 100), roughly Fireball damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544388384942850109)
- **spell-damage mage tanking with summons**: A spell-damage mage uses a couple of earth elementals or mummies as tanks while casting damage spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530694687663325365)
- **spellbook and shepherd's crook hand restriction**: You can hold only one of a spellbook or a shepherd's crook in your hands at a time, and you cannot cast spells while holding a crook, so carrying the crook is only worthwhile if you use the mace fighting skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528608964705517608)
- **spellbook choice for poison summoner**: A material (resource) spellbook seems to give slightly more consistent damage and adds mana regeneration for a poison summoner, whereas testing showed Vanquishing spellbooks gave no damage increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548291638537748570)
- **spellbook mana versus arcane mana**: Spellbooks provide a stable, predictable source of mana, whereas arcane mana recovery is chance-based. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546330355420766281)
- **spellburn pet combinations**: Pets with the spellburn ability perform about the same across combinations, and because spells don't miss they are not bad at low accuracy links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523310223517945887)
- **spellcast bar**: The spellcast bar shows only a spell's casting time, not the small delay between spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542840452326363166)
- **spellcasting disabled in some time dungeon levels**: In some Time dungeon levels, mobs can switch off all spellcasting, so mages cannot be used there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524863306920100041)
- **spellcasting equipment requirements**: Casting spells requires no equipped item, only the appropriate Magery skill; a spellbook can be equipped for bonuses, and most other held items will unequip when you cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526174150681694268)
- **spellcasting mage archetypes**: There are two spellcasting mage archetypes: the summoner, with spell or pet damage bonuses that uses summons to mitigate damage, and the arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527275075211104306)
- **spellcasting pet stats**: Spellcasting pets mainly need spell damage and attack speed, and about 4/9 on those is considered S-tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535398605613961287)
- **spellcasting targeting and war mode**: Spells do not work like melee: dragging a health bar and double-clicking it in war mode does not cast; casting needs a 'last target' or 'target nearest' style hotkey or manually clicking the health bar per spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523389627417755689)
- **spells cast while holding aspected staff**: Spells cast on a target while holding an aspected staff count as spell damage rather than melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544843078987153598)
- **spinslash sword special**: Spinslash is the sword special that most players choose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535129709308936324)
- **spinslash vs chop for two-handed sword pvm**: For a two-handed swords PvM player, Spinslash is considered a better choice than Chop in the sword codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537095579891405020)
- **spot fishing mob difficulty**: The mobs spawned at fishing spots are easy enough to kill without needing loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540215343765651536)
- **stabber attacking outside war mode**: A stabber may be able to attack without being in war mode, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539588388804497490)
- **stabber codex choice**: Stabbers usually pick the codex that provides the most damage, and macing with Wild Swing is a popular choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547243899502858301)
- **stabber dexxer skill requirement**: Because shadow armor's bonus lasts 10 seconds after a hit, a stabber does not need pure dexxer skills as much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547243567628427394)
- **stabber healing and survival**: A stabber heals by drinking potions from a satchel or by walking while stealthed to heal from the shadow armor effect, and should carry smoke bombs for emergencies; using smoke bombs on cooldown also increases DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547243567628427394)
- **stabber pulverize and weapon ability tier**: A stabber may find Pulverize more useful than other weapon abilities, and one suggested path is to take Pummel and then put 5 points into each ability to max out the tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524685842273144893)
- **stabber solo viability**: Stabber is considered a good solo option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537550939119026207)
- **stagnant summoner's tome category**: Stagnant is a Summoner's Tome category that triggers on follower spellcast, so a summon using it inflicts greater poison, while the player's own poison spell may take a couple of casts to reach deadly poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524435683836428408)
- **stamina and player blocking**: If you are below 100% stamina other players block your movement, and running through players costs stamina, so carrying Greater Heal, Cure and Total Refresh potions helps, since Total Refresh restores stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524140134348492800)
- **stance choice by target count**: Aggressive stance is recommended against a single target, and defensive stance against more than one target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526936180497580212)
- **stance for testudo setup**: When using the Testudo setup, the player should be in warding or mirror stance when taking damage-over-time or AoE damage types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534912421624283346)
- **starfall meteor site activity**: At Starfall meteor sites players kill the monsters including the Omega, which may drop unique decorations; a Lyceum quest may involve them, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550962677281456190)
- **starting arcane mage grimoire setup**: For a starting arcane mage, max everything on page 1 (buffed Reactive Armor optional), put 3 points each in Mind Blast and Lightning, put the rest in Flamestrike, then Protection if points remain; Mana Vampire is useful until mana refund is capped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524836918544695377)
- **starting wave for backstabbing in pit trials**: Starting a pit trial on a wave with high-difficulty monsters would make backstabbing less terrible, though it remains a poor approach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527815890006184016)
- **stat points needed for 50% swing speed on warrior or archer**: A warrior or archer needs roughly 720 total stat points to reach 50% Swing Speed Increase for decent damage, whereas Wrestlers and Dual Wielders can manage with about 640. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528784258305359943)
- **stay and stop pet commands**: The 'stay' pet command makes a pet remain where it is, while 'stop' makes it halt whatever it is doing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525143744133988552)
- **stealing from monsters terminology**: Stealing from a monster is typically called Pilfering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554835285848756288)
- **stealing while looting own corpse in town**: Other players can hide next to you in town and steal from you while you loot your own corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546036846117527663)
- **stealth archer backstab bolt damage**: With enough aspect and links, a stealth archer's backstab bolt can deal 10,000 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550291995170177048)
- **stealth dexxer pvp builds**: Stealth dexxer PvP builds exist, but they do not rely on the backstab mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527389516472647843)
- **stealth mage pk build**: A recommended stealthy PK build is a mage using Magery, Evaluating Intelligence, Meditation, Resisting Spells, Wrestling, Hiding, and Stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539318870840709130)
- **stealth pets in dungeons**: Other players who see tamed pets walking around a dungeon may assume they are following a ghost, which is why stealth pets suit a stealth build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549643448682815549)
- **stick mage aspects**: One player's stick mage uses Blood, Lightning and Void aspects after the patch that changed death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533109839465549935)
- **stick mage bronze and silver link chain**: A stick mage chain of 20 bronze and 10 silver links can reportedly keep up in damage with a player wearing mostly gold links including boss damage links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533126553091833927)
- **stick mage link order**: A stick mage is recommended to prioritize aspect special chance links first, then damage to diseased targets, then damage dealt by player for the last row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533111358961488003)
- **stick mage plate armor and alchemy swap**: A stick mage can wear plate armor as long as procs keep flowing, and swapping Meditation for Alchemy makes the build very tanky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533127852675829801)
- **stickmage flame strike spam with procs**: Once a stickmage has enough arcane aspect and links, a couple of procs allow near-continuous Flame Strike spam, though RNG still requires some mana management. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549582705065459713)
- **stickmage inscription pvm use**: Stickmage is reported to be the best PvM use of Inscription, and the arcane aspect must be boosted to get the weapon high enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549581789796769814)
- **stickmage mind blast scroll count**: A stickmage can carry about 100 Mind Blast scrolls for Mind Blast spam. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549595585344970835)
- **stickmage requirements**: A stickmage can still perform well but needs a high arcane weapon aspect (12+), a high link count (north of about 10 links), and redline for an extra link type; grinding a high arcane weapon can be slow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549830617628147903)
- **stopping a tame that attacks you**: If a tame is attacking you, command it to follow you and it should stop attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539307408130580541)
- **stopping an auto attack**: To stop an auto attack in progress, tab in and out of war mode, as is done manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542197543641944095)
- **stopping attacking minions**: To stop minions that are attacking you, you must also stop attacking them by toggling war/peace mode twice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554599801914400842)
- **strength and bless stacking**: Strength and Bless spells do not stack; the strongest effect overrides the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525265401758486528)
- **strongest mobs encountered while harvesting**: The strongest mobs harvesters commonly meet are ogres, which deal large physical damage, and reapers, which are trees that are very strong casters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531173527628288001)
- **strongest pvm starting builds**: Tamers and mage summoners are the two strongest PvM starting builds, though most standard builds farm well enough; summoner needs less investment but falls off earlier than tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531505382835617832)
- **strongest pvp skill**: Magery is considered the strongest PvP skill a player can pick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526917181835706559)
- **stuck treasure map mobs**: If mobs at a treasure map are stuck or in an annoying spot, wait until the timer hits, click the chest and choose 'monsters' to teleport all remaining mobs to the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537871744763961395)
- **summon creature summons**: Summon Creature summons are weak and useful mainly as cannon fodder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282212211003532)
- **summon creature tanking**: Casting Summon Creature creates creatures that tank mobs for you in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549604306888687659)
- **summon damage sources**: Summon damage is increased by the Spirit Speak skill, the Summoners Tome Codex, and follower damage mastery chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532961027082158254)
- **summon follow behavior**: There is no setting for summons to follow; unless a summoned creature is stuck on terrain, it follows the owner's commands such as 'all follow'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533631185823989810)
- **summon release tactic against pks**: In PvP, summon around 20 mobs onto a player, have them all attack the PK, then release them all at once so the PK is immediately targeted by all the mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538947724165128323)
- **summon trapper build for treasure maps**: A Summon Trapper build is reportedly pretty strong for treasure maps (T-maps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526669133683363970)
- **summon trapper in kh 3**: A Summon Trapper wearing MS leather with traps can handle KH 3 groups of 4 or 5 mobs well, at low risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547550401241292820)
- **summon upgrades in tome**: All summon types become significantly better once upgraded in the tome, so players should eventually level up each of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520463436872679434)
