- **summoned demon survival bonuses**: Summoned demons receive massive bonuses from staying alive, so they should be kept alive as much as possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529100275418267821)
- **summoned elemental grimoire points**: For summoned elementals, grimoire points should go to damage for a fire elemental and to tankiness (hit points and defense) for an earth elemental. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541913791594500146)
- **summoned lich damage with command aspect**: With the Command aspect, summoned liches deal about 700-800 damage per hit against magic mobs with -150 magic resist, and around 1200 per hit when a bard is in the group. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529138046732079176)
- **summoner and necro staff requirement**: The staffs named 'summoner staff' and 'necro staff' are not required for summoner or necromancer builds; they are only cosmetic looks for non-arcane mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586478810669067)
- **summoner armor and book damage tradeoff**: Command armor and the Command book give a summoner the most damage, while Frost armor provides better personal defense at the expense of some damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538281904594358283)
- **summoner bard buff set**: A suggested buff set for a summoner bard is Refrain, Perfect Pitch, Revolution Song and SYOP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524456239277539530)
- **summoner bard build**: A summoner bard can use Provocation, Discordance and Music instead of Tribard to save codex points for buffs: summons tank, monsters are gathered and provoked onto each other, and the bard and summons deal the damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524455835332378675)
- **summoner bard solo farming**: A summoner bard build is not well suited to solo farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530688685459247165)
- **summoner build focus**: A summoner must choose whether to focus on spell damage or follower attack damage, which strongly affects link selection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523282701573029999)
- **summoner codex effect on necromancer pets**: The Summoner Codex boosts necromancer pets as well as other summoned pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554163558223454249)
- **summoner damage link setup**: Summoners reportedly run 10 follower damage links, though the purpose of the remaining slots is unconfirmed and may be spell aspect links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147018103066805)
- **summoner death aspect**: A summoner who also does some spell damage should take the Death aspect for the extra disease ticks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527470216664055938)
- **summoner demon and skeletal mage damage**: A summoner using summoned demons with a skeletal mage can consistently hit 700+ damage without a tribard setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527492586502230172)
- **summoner dungeon choices**: Dungeons other than Shadowspire Cathedral are easier places for a summoner mage than Kraul Hive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553787019279470626)
- **summoner evading pks in dungeons**: To evade a PK in a dungeon as a summoner, keep running and gather dungeon mobs behind you, then once you have a good pack, send your summons and the accumulated mobs at the PK without retaliating personally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548292915464380447)
- **summoner follower damage**: Summoner follower damage is constant, and summoned liches cast 600-800 damage spells continuously, which can outdamage a mage reliant on spell procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528168901509120061)
- **summoner healing range**: A summoner can heal from 12 tiles away in complete safety. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531331976986886336)
- **summoner link priorities**: A summoner's summons should take essentially all aggro, so Damage Resist links are not needed; prioritize Follower Damage links first, then Follower Attack Speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527473375578951761)
- **summoner mage casting tool**: Summoner mage variants use spellbooks rather than staves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586335696822324)
- **summoner mage spellbook modifiers**: A summoner mage should use magic spellbooks and focus on the potency modifier for mana refund. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522446577351000134)
- **summoner minimal gear setup**: A summoner build can run with just a verewood crook and a verehide spellbook without burning arcane crystals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333236687503381)
- **summoner pet resummoning**: Summoner builds currently require frequent resummoning of pets, which players find annoying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549036229348294811)
- **summoner setup composition**: A summoner setup uses two demons (thralls) and a skeletal mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527502951440977961)
- **summoner skill setup**: Animal Taming, Animal Lore, Veterinary and Herding together give maximum summon DPS and a strong self-heal every 5 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542878526196293675)
- **summoner tank vulnerability when swarmed**: A summoner is in trouble if their summoned tank dies when swarmed, whereas an Arcane mage can switch aspects to survive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543357190327504956)
- **summoner tome dismiss upgrade**: The Summoner Tome upgrade Dismiss is very good, especially when running with low or zero Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532348900512370791)
- **summoner tome earth pull upgrade**: The Summoner Tome upgrade Earth Pull is worthwhile when using an Earth Elemental. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532348776411304096)
- **summoner trapper agorawave with fortune**: A summoner trapper can run Agorawave with the Fortune aspect and it works well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521441289521074176)
- **summoner trapper versus tamer trapper**: A summoner trapper deals less damage but has more utility (can heal through a PK, rope tele, etc.), while a tamer trapper deals more damage but has less utility because it has no Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546540798596882575)
- **summoner's tome blade spirit**: The Summoner's Tome has the Blade Spirit ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537173349099245638)
- **summoner's tome for harvesters**: A Summoner's Tome on a lumberjack or miner lets the character still kill some enemies while skinning in dungeons, and beefy summons benefit the scavenger playstyle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547356332405956688)
- **summoner's tome leveling**: Leveling the Summoner's Tome increases the strength of summoner followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554146543114920067)
- **summoner's tome player benefits**: Bonuses on the Summoner's Tome likely do not benefit the player, and any that did would be explicitly stated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526694806053720144)
- **summoner's tome spell damage increased**: The Spell Damage Increased bonus on the Summoner's Tome applies to your pet, not to the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526694630400462948)
- **summoners in end game content**: Summoners have little to no place in end game content; for regular dungeon farming a noxcro is preferable to an arcane poisoner, while arcane is better for end game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548292088058093619)
- **summoners versus tamers viability**: Summoners are not dead compared to tamers, and many players keep a PvP-ready character on an alt account to respond when something happens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538746208833503273)
- **summoning pool 3 skeletal mages with summoner's tome**: To maximize the chance of summoning a pool 3 skeletal mage with the summoner's tome's Summon Creature, put maximum points in both Creature Catalog 1 and Creature Catalog 2, which yields mages about half the time and ghosts the other half. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530771879630082130)
- **summons in pit trials**: Summons are a great anchor in pit trials and can take a lot of aggro off the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541843236845518968)
- **summons returning after monster death**: When a monster dies, your summons walk back to you, so if you are hidden or invisible they can reveal your position to other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521538627530653836)
- **summons tanking in fury's caldera**: Summoned creatures such as earth elementals can tank all mobs in the worst part of Fury's Caldera for a player with T15 harvest and no links who is dropped there via the [go menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531424046896513195)
- **supremely accurate weapon on low-tier aspect build**: A supremely accurate weapon may help accuracy for a while on a low-tier aspect build, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545860261401993248)
- **survivability options**: Survival is generally manageable thanks to Chivalry heals, potions and bandages, plus parry codex and healing codex damage reduction, and alchemy codex if using alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532466310796284075)
- **survivability skills and sources**: Melee, Parrying and Resisting Spells are the skills that let you resist attacks, and tamers and lockpickers tend to lack them; Aspects, Codices and Mastery Chains also add survivability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528547731667161169)
- **surviving a single pk**: With practice, most templates can survive an encounter with a single player killer quite easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533246874692223077)
- **surviving pk attacks**: To survive PKs, use greater strength and magic resist potions and a script that pops potions and runs to the red gate instead of fighting reds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784341006385254)
- **surviving red players**: To survive red players, carry cure and heal potions to recover health, and be ready to run and escape using teleport or rope if you have Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528779302345375765)
- **swapping chivalry into focus**: Swapping 20 Chivalry into Focus keeps the same swing speed increase value and trades some damage for accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554814874071081076)
- **swing speed and weapon proc chances**: Increasing swing speed, such as through Arms Lore, gives more proc chances because proc chance is scaled by weapon speed (swing delay), unlike spell casting speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555525383959347243)
- **swing speed breakpoint and ssi link**: In the current build a swing speed of 50.5% is the reference point, so any lower Focus would require a swing speed increase (SSI) link to keep it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545614202721542225)
- **swing speed calculator for builds**: When changing skill points, check a swing speed calculator to confirm the build is not over the swing speed cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539636507827114015)
- **swing speed cap**: The swing speed cap is typically 0.50 (50%) unless altered by the air aspect or redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550423632637984820)
- **swing speed cap across weapon builds**: Other weapon builds can also cap swing speed increase, so capping is not an exclusive wrestling advantage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529190348361043999)
- **swing speed cap gold links**: Five gold speed links reach the swing speed cap, and some resists can be dropped for more Focus if you want cheaper or fewer speed links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546627362764890162)
- **swing speed cap with aspect**: The swing speed cap rises above the 60 shown on the Outlands Butler when an aspect is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329914533806111)
- **swing speed for arcane mages**: Swing speed is key for arcane mages using aspect procs since the rebalance, and skills like Cooking, Magic Resistance and Focus improve it more than extra dex; a cooking-based build with Melee Special links procs less over sustained sessions than Spell Aspect Special, which also has a higher multiplier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531361972589826151)
- **swing speed relevance**: Swing speed mainly matters when a character is out of mana (dry), and swapping to air is an easier fix for that situation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522600436639600822)
- **swing speed wiki page**: The Outlands wiki page Swing_Speed likely explains the swing delay calculation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541838951306887178)
- **swing speed with earth t7 and aggressive stance**: A build with Earth T7 and Aggressive stance L5 reaches only about 43% swing speed, which is considered insufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522360774641586308)
- **swing timer with blood armor and dex**: With the same skills, swing timer is about 2.28s at 25 dex without blood armor, 2.05s at 25 dex with T15 blood armor, and 1.85s at 46+ dex with T15 blood armor, so 25 dex with blood armor is not much worse than 46+ dex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522589433600147467)
- **switching to earth aspect for tankiness**: A player can switch to the Earth aspect for extra tankiness when needed, then switch back to Lightning or Madness for damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522778394574590103)
- **sword archer weapon loadout**: A sword archer template carries seven weapons: halberd, axe, viking sword, katana, heavy crossbow, crossbow, and bow; the viking sword can realistically be skipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536113562513178734)
- **sword aspect choice for dexxers**: A sword using the Blood aspect is expected to deal considerably more damage than one using the Air aspect for dexxers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536602415887810651)
- **sword bleed effect**: Sword weapons apply a bleed effect on hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545190076034588773)
- **sword codex options**: The sword codex may have options for accuracy and swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532462896649605230)
- **sword codex point allocation**: For a sword codex, raise warrior to level 5 first if accuracy is not 100%; if accuracy is already 100%, raise flaying to 5 first, then unlock an ability and raise the others to 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529271841300938863)
- **sword codex tactics requirement**: The sword codex is believed to depend on printed (base) Tactics skill rather than skill gained from weapon or aspect bonuses, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554599374577999876)
- **sword tamer viability**: A sword-wielding tamer is viable in Outlands but less safe than an archer or mage tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529606514938220565)
- **swords and blood aspect synergy**: Swords have a built-in bleed effect, so they have little synergy with the Blood aspect other than triggering d2b links more quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537133909110689882)
- **swords and haste cap**: Swords may make it harder to reach the haste cap, though this is an unconfirmed guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548457947137581199)
- **swords build with frost and madness**: A swords build with 80 Alchemy and 100 Arms Lore, using Frost armor and madness weapon aspects, performed well on the test server, with the 720 skill cap limiting points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537227970979041394)
- **swords dexxer first link**: Damage done by player is probably still the best first link for a swords dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520441180196835428)
- **swords dexxer paladin skill choices**: Replacing Arms Lore, Resist, and Parry with Discordance, Pacify, and Provoke is claimed to significantly increase damage dealt for a swords dexxer paladin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539249076875558943)
- **swords finisher choice for bleed**: For a swords chivalry dexer who causes bleed often, the second swords finisher in the Weapon and Parry Codex may be more effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532594469612818713)
- **swords versus wrestling for bosses**: Swords are probably better than wrestling for boss fights, according to one player who switched from frost swords to wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525206890886205460)
- **swords viability**: Swords is still a pretty good melee option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536885165077565462)
- **swords weapon ability for farming**: Rend is not worthwhile for farming; Spinslash is the better swords weapon ability. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534583310376767628)
- **swordsman farming and pvp weapons**: A swordsman can farm with an executioner's axe and carry a halberd and katana for PvP purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536341414160502914)
- **swordsman weapon progression**: Swordsmen should use vendor-crafted weapons: one-handed with a shield early on, then a two-handed weapon upgraded to higher ore such as verite or valorite. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523342999847829554)
- **symbol budget allocation for autocast**: Do not spend your entire symbol budget on autocast; keep some free so you can manually select anti-bleed, anti-curse or anti-spellcast symbols as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524477197635686511)
- **syop demons in bard summoner build**: Demons summoned with SYOP deal decent damage in a bard summoner build, with bombs providing extra damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549159978441515029)
- **t-map boss health**: After the T-map update, the T-map boss has almost 3x its previous health. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **t-map chest opening**: After the T-map update, the chest opens when the boss dies, which suits raids, and the chest carries the player's name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **t15 earth armor rating with item id**: T15 Earth armor with 120 Item ID and a shield reaches about 265 armor rating, roughly 280 with protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542263538863837185)
- **t8 frequency with tracking**: Players recalling around with 120 tracking typically find only a couple of T8s in progress per day. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537841111077355610)
- **t8 map travel requirement**: After the patch, T8 map owners must travel to the map location or lose the map, so raiders can camp one to three spots and wait for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537841454469095496)
- **t8 treasure map digging raids**: T8 treasure map digging parties can be raided by other players, and since a patch the treasure map guardians take longer to kill, giving raiders a larger window to catch diggers still at it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **t8 treasure map monster health change**: An upcoming change doubles T8 treasure map monster health, making T8s slower, though they remain a good fit for duos. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529902056788201604)
- **t8 treasure map raiding guilds**: Roughly 4-5 guilds on Outlands raid T8 treasure map diggers as a hobby, and most of them use scouts (dedicated scout characters or blue characters farming) positioned around the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537956197183918110)
- **tactics and slaying damage scaling**: Tactics is a multiplicative damage bonus while slaying is additive, and since backstabbers stack many additive bonuses, an extra 25% slaying bonus yields only about 10% more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542225322500558858)
- **tactics skill codex and defensive stance**: Without the Tactics skill you lose access to the Tactics codex and its defensive stance, which players consider good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629915263729685)
- **tactics target for weapon damage**: If you deal damage with a weapon, you want 100 Tactics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521645884910207166)
- **tagging and pulling range**: Monsters can be tagged and pulled from within 18 tiles, and if the monster was taunted before, aggro stays on the taunting player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540283510257094696)
- **tamer afk capability**: A tamer can nearly AFK any content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522230634376855653)
- **tamer aggro and aoe avoidance**: As a tamer, your pets hold aggro for nearly everything, so you can stand out of the way of AoE attacks and take little damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524807752768290826)
- **tamer and summoner command and frost**: Most tamers run Command, summoners run it less often, and Frost is also very good for summoners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521984725290451035)
- **tamer archery and ranged playstyle**: Some dexxer tamers use archery so they can stay back and shoot while their pets fight and kill the mob, and mage tamers also stay back as a lower-risk build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552223866900975657)
- **tamer aspect choice**: Tamers want the Command aspect for its many follower buffs, which leaves little room to use other aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553778011378286654)
- **tamer blue links for bossing**: For tamers, blue links are better suited to bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555730659618586654)
- **tamer buff and population**: Tamer received a buff, and tamer numbers have declined slightly since then. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534919291013697687)
- **tamer build for coze**: Tamer is considered the best choice for Coze and is also an effective solo farming build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521612368147386460)
- **tamer build standing**: Tamer is still reported to be the top-performing build, even after trapper nerfs and tamer changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544647238285008996)
- **tamer build tradeoffs**: A dex tamer procs more easily but deals less overall damage than a bard tamer and fits Alchemy more easily; a mage tamer procs less than a dex tamer in exchange for Magery utility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541528539306795028)
- **tamer build viability**: Tamer is viable everywhere except the deep levels of Time and outperforms most builds once the player masters commands like all kill and all guard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533076793060495461)
- **tamer command aspect without combat skills**: A tamer without combat skills can equip a Throwing Weapon or an Arcane Staff and activate Command; against peaced creatures, roughly 20-30% accuracy is enough to proc specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549314386743656529)
- **tamer damage focus**: A tamer should commit either to dealing damage personally or to letting the pets do it, because trying to do both leaves neither effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522716147529547887)
- **tamer dexer build for player damage**: A tamer dexer build focused on player damage is serviceable and works, though it is not considered the best build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537961838480724078)
- **tamer discordance success with barding links**: A tamer with 80 Discordance, Provocation and Peacemaking, 10 silver effective barding links and a supreme instrument has roughly a 75% chance to discord mobs in places like Tidal 3, with a higher chance to peace already discorded mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553172093913407570)
- **tamer fortune links**: For tamer templates, fortune links are a niche choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555730659618586654)
- **tamer gameplay**: Tamer gameplay is easy but expensive and somewhat boring, since it mostly involves moving around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545382678734569533)
- **tamer gameplay loop**: Playing a tamer mostly consists of using all guard, all follow, rope, veterinary supplies, health potions and cure potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522277497163481189)
- **tamer green links for farming**: For tamers, green links are a little better at farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555730659618586654)
- **tamer harvest armor with command weapon**: A tamer can use a command-aspect weapon together with harvest-aspect armor, and the harvest armor grants a decent damage resist bonus while skinning things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521057159620726835)
- **tamer hit rating for aspect command procs**: A tamer build using a 1-handed bow with 20 Archery plus an aspect can reach 68% hit rating for aspect command procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524039764674740235)
- **tamer impact from scalar change**: Tamers running 120 in every skill are reportedly unaffected by the scalar change, while other builds kill more slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528156581190045696)
- **tamer links that debuff the mob**: Pierce, Hex, Cripple and Weaken links apply their debuffs to the mob, so other players can also take advantage of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554132618503651471)
- **tamer links with command armor**: With command armor, a tamer's links should prioritize max follow damage, 45 EBS, and follow attack speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549865022858203237)
- **tamer mule pets**: Tamers have pets considered mules that can carry gold into dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527170273994997764)
- **tamer pet composition**: A combination of spellburn casters, such as 2 nightmares and a fire minion, is recommended for a tamer over utility pets, though this is one player's uncertain opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522733117649981494)
- **tamer pet teams**: Several tamer pet teams are viable, and a zoology-based zoo team reportedly performs very well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543363084884910171)
- **tamer power after overhaul**: Tamers were extremely powerful after the first overhaul, and later changes reduced that power while leaving the class viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525172869179510866)
- **tamer pvm ocean build**: A Tamer PVM ocean build mirrors a tamer dexxer build, with Fishing taking the place of one skill, and gains cannon damage, ship damage and similar bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521675878139166880)
- **tamer self-only links**: Chill, bleed, disease and poison links generally only affect the tamer and/or their pets, not other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554132618503651471)
- **tamer solo dungeon capability**: A 3-bard tamer with a giant widow plus a normal widow, or a colossal plus something else, can solo Cav 4, Ossu 4 and Time 1+2 while wearing plate mail with a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553764915385204819)
- **tamer survivability while sitting**: A tamer can sit and survive as long as they have bandages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531360262043471912)
- **tamer survival tactics**: Tamers survive by learning threat range and keeping all guard up on pets when within a mob's range; mobs instantly target pets, and you tell pets to follow again once the mob is attacked, though AoE damage can still hit occasionally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547585863968358410)
- **tamer tankiness**: A tamer's tankiness improves as aspects are leveled, but tamers remain fragile by most metrics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526372945914626128)
- **tamer versus summoner damage**: A tamer who gets their procs will probably out-damage a summoner, while without procs the summoner out-damages the tamer in longer fights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538797520073789460)
- **tamer veterinary range with codex**: With the Healing codex and the Beyond Borders trait, a Tamer can use Veterinary healing on pets from up to 5 tiles away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528269034536042506)
- **tamer viability at 13 links for level 4 dungeons**: Around 13 links, a character is generally better off staying a tamer for farming level 4 dungeons because tamers are very strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544827502680215663)
- **tamer weapon choice cripple hinder**: Cripple (available from fencing) and hinder are good weapon special choices for a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541530824074334228)
- **tamer weapon setup**: A one-handed crossbow with a shield is probably the best weapon setup for a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553749290147381269)
- **tamers in pvp**: Tamers are poor at fighting PKs because tamed pets have many drawbacks during PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551656079207825429)
- **taming for boating pvm**: Taming is not great for boating PvM compared to a straight Harpoon build, but a Harpoon Tamer build is possible and would have better PvP ability thanks to pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522486583931179140)
- **taming power level**: Taming is considered pretty overpowered, so pet choice can be made largely by preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569339257983036)
- **tank and healer builds**: Dedicated healers appear on guild runs, and the wiki TemplatesMisc page lists tank and healer builds for party and guild content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540038274658213950)
- **tank build for time-limited content**: An arcane tank or pure dexxer tank is recommended for time-limited content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537040476195000341)
- **tank pet bestiary skills**: For tank pets in the Taming Bestiary, Stalwart and Survival are recommended skills to spend points on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533162179816198304)
- **tank pet positioning**: A tank pet can be positioned to turn the mob away from the group, helping the others avoid some AoE attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522230905471766688)
- **tank pet self-healing build**: A tank pet using Metabolism, Mending, Survival and Tolerance reportedly heals nearly 50% of the damage it takes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522228559676965012)
- **tank-focused build**: A tank-focused build is a fun niche build but lacks the damage needed for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541477409520492655)
- **tanking against time monsters**: Earth or frost are much better than armor for tanking, since armor alone does not save you from Time monster damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542263276594004038)
- **tanking omni**: A regular arcane or dexxer tank works against Omni, but avoid face-tanking mechs and avoid area taunting when there are too many rift daemons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537043843419996241)
- **tanks in regular dungeons**: Tanks are not really needed in regular dungeons, and the best tank is not a dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524865160123121674)
- **tanky aspect choice**: Earth or Holy aspects are suggested for a tanky character such as a mace dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529639490715385906)
- **tanky summoner codex build swaps**: In a tanky summoner codex build, Shatter can be removed and replaced with Grounded for more tankiness, or with Slam for more utility. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549662081609895957)
- **target cycling hotkeys**: Depending on which target-cycling hotkey is used, cycling can include players, and commands such as SelectNearstCreature exist in both ClassicUO and Razor for cycling through on-screen targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540560676907384885)
- **target kill time for mobs**: A good target when killing a mob is about 20 seconds, which leaves time to move and loot before your cooldowns return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541853038577197110)
- **target nearest hotkey priority**: When multiple monsters are at the same distance, the target nearest hotkey appears to prioritize by creature serial number, so a rogue using stealth pilfering may keep pilfering the same creature repeatedly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541027636376117249)
- **target self queue**: Pressing Target Self shows a 'target queued' overhead message, and a following spell such as Heal is then cast on yourself immediately without a reticle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536866466148647063)
- **targeted venom usage advice**: With Targeted Venom you should poison only one creature at a time; use Airborne instead if you want to poison multiple creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524412991704010842)
- **targeting hotkeys for melee dexxers**: Multiple targeting hotkeys exist (such as next and nearest); for a melee dexxer, 'nearest' is more useful than 'next' as the primary targeting hotkey because you run up next to the mob you target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523365687848992870)
- **tarsands tarpits center spawn**: The spot in the middle of the Tarsands Tarpits has about 5 mobs that respawn around you at any time, with ranged abilities, AoE abilities and hard-hitting melee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533488925539307561)
- **taunt armor rating bonus**: Taunt grants an armor rating bonus equal to 25 × (Effective Parry / 100) for 15 seconds after a taunt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502133217370263)
- **taunt in time**: The tank or backup tank in Time needs to be able to taunt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531345010359009330)
- **taunt requirements**: Taunt requires a two-handed weapon or a shield to be equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541253876034969720)
- **taunting mobs with parry**: To taunt a mob, say or type [taunt and then target the mob; with the parry book this single-target taunt applies to the chosen mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541253784469114981)
- **teleport spell with rope**: While a Teleport spell is being cast, you can use a rope, and the spell still teleports you when casting finishes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554820850820059149)
- **template accuracy improvement**: Accuracy on a template can be improved by adding a skill like focus and using a crafted weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534918019237806220)
- **template melee special and ddbp stats**: The template provides 15 melee special chance/damage and 15 ddbp. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535795840851902524)
- **temporal aspect as tank aspect**: The temporal aspect may be usable as a tank aspect, but this is unconfirmed speculation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537041232839311410)
- **temporal aspect damage at t15**: At T15, a tester reports the Temporal aspect without its field up deals about 28% more damage and suspects the printed bonus does not work as stated, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521595142111236096)
- **temporal aspect for wrestlers**: Players consider the Temporal aspect a poor choice for a wrestler and recommend almost any other aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526077344853262506)
- **testing spell damage without randomness**: Use the command [TestMaxSpellDamageRolls to test spell damage without random variation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553086435588964353)
- **testudo aoe damage-over-time change**: Testudo was changed recently so that a dexxer can AoE damage-over-time enemies while remaining very tanky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534912185959059656)
- **testudo mirror against magic mobs**: A Testudo mirror is recommended when taking heavy damage from magic-using mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332281561616446)
- **thief codex defensive skill nerf**: The defensive Thief Codex skill was nerfed recently and is less powerful than before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530540978275094549)
- **thief disarm and steal tactic**: Thieves commonly use Disarm followed by Steal, so a thief who steals from you will probably also disarm you and try to steal your weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542622317031596133)
- **thief escape method**: Using Teleport together with a rope and a wall is a reliable way for a thief to escape pursuers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546813049065705563)
- **thief spell needs**: A thief who only wants to steal mainly needs defensive abilities to escape after the theft; Wall of Stone is not a useful spell for that purpose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526917555732742205)
- **thief stealing crafting tools**: Thieves can steal crafting tools from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529946254778568874)
- **thief supply habits**: Many thieves carry few supplies such as cure potions, trapped pouches, and armor, so a player can exploit whichever key supplies a given thief lacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547374760449675284)
- **thief survival in dungeons**: Most players gang up on thieves in dungeons, so a thief's objective there is usually to escape or survive rather than to fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525625008276242556)
- **thieves codex backstab to mug**: A thieves codex can turn backstab into mug, which steals from monsters at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554835134673461250)
- **thieves stealing potions or bandages**: A thief who steals potions or bandages from you is likely trying to bait you into a fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542622242578632868)
- **third link choice for madness lightning archers**: The third link choice for Madness/Lightning archers is Melee Damage Additive Increase (MDAI). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538966687011967016)
- **thrower ability choice**: Throwers should use Torrent when not at max swing speed; once at max swing speed, Rake is a good choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521844083646140637)
- **throwing additive damage bonus**: The 25% additive damage bonus from Throwing is only gained when another weapon skill is used alongside it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537446601382043769)
- **throwing against omnis and hard mobs**: Throwing is sometimes a life saver when fighting Omnis or other hard mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541533982544367718)
- **throwing ammunition**: Throwing weapons require no ammunition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532717493599338507)
- **throwing and bard synergy**: Throwing is reported to pair poorly with a bard build because Peacemaking prevents kiting mobs, while throwing requires alternating between raking and kiting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555515972075520073)
- **throwing build viability**: Throwing is not considered a viable build in Outlands; testers could not make it work in any combination on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520825042231885874)
- **throwing damage versus archery on test server**: On the test server, throwing did damage similar to archery, though archery hinders targets and throwing does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524512472256745482)
- **throwing finisher chance mechanic**: Throwing may have a mechanic that grants 10% increased finisher chance, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529989961972187287)
- **throwing mobility versus archery**: Throwing lets you move while throwing, whereas Archery requires stopping to shoot; throwing may do slightly less damage than archery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534974389236404466)
- **throwing proc chance**: Throwing ensures you at least have a chance to proc all the time, though this is stated with some uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531406472649511044)
- **throwing range and torrent**: Throwing has access to torrent and allows more mobility than other options, but the target must be within 7 tiles to be hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541533656588488815)
- **throwing versus wrestling damage**: The only player seen making throwing look decent had 100+ redline points, and a wrestler build reaches the same damage numbers as that thrower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520823276132110346)
- **throwing weapons**: A throwing weapon gives ranged attacks without the need to track ammunition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552139832816566273)
- **tidal 3 and oss 4 mob magic resist**: Tidal 3 and Oss 4 are filled with low magic resist mobs, which suits magic-damage builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531332837247025252)
- **tier 16-20 redline link choices**: For tier 16-20 redline links, mana refund is fine, 1 extra link is fine, and spell charge or spell damage no followers are options; 14/14 is also acceptable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545568087565271111)
- **tier 3 necromancy skeletal mage damage**: Five Tier 3 necromancy skeletal mages deal about 5x3 damage per attack against a player with 80 resist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538946561973948438)
- **tier 3 necromancy summons versus tamer familiars**: One player's testing found Tier 3 necromancy skeletal mages about as good as tamer familiars in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538946195312091226)
- **tier 4 treasure maps with harvest aspect**: One player runs tier 4 treasure maps using the Harvest aspect with no damage links and relies on traps, and a tamer or summoner class can handle resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546613012856842)
- **tier 7 backstabber hunting spots**: Tidal Tomb and KH are suggested hunting places for a Tier 7 backstabber, provided the player targets mobs they can one-shot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522382522598817952)
- **tier 8 treasure maps solo**: Tier 8 treasure maps are not intended to be soloed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537102251875635323)
- **time content bard build**: A bard for Time content just runs Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542638873811877898)
- **time content difficulty for spellcasters**: After the last major Time rebalance, Time content is harder for spellcasters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524864296851341372)
- **time dungeon difficulty**: The Time dungeon is the hardest dungeon in the game, and groups running it need specific roles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520288729376362617)
- **time dungeon difficulty progression**: Deeper Time dungeon levels get progressively harder for builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524863880101368041)
- **time dungeon readiness**: Time is a late-game PvM goal; players should first do bossing, Omnis and learn dungeon mobs to prepare for it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531350267570819135)
- **time dungeons versus summoners**: Time dungeons counter summoners because of dispel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531327541749616640)
- **time echoes**: Experienced Time players commonly keep different echoes to handle specific content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524864374601421003)
- **time monster armor ignore**: Time monsters have very high armor ignore values on their special attacks, so armor does not protect against them and a higher damage reduction cap is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542263930821419038)
- **time monster special mechanics**: Some Time monsters deal more pure damage, and some switch off spellcasting or reflect ranged attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524864815917437090)
- **tinker trapper chain experience**: A tinker trapper in Fort Aspect is the second fastest way to earn chain experience, but tinkering is not cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522393351058624602)
- **toggling war and peace mode**: Press Tab to toggle between war mode and peace mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547550652740149298)
- **top dexxer gear setup**: Dexxers that mow down the hardest mobs are likely running about 30 links, redline, and a T15+ aspect, though this is a guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541412733034037329)
- **top dps builds after poison aspect nerf**: After the poison aspect nerf, tamer builds are reported as top DPS, with T18 Madness or Lightning dexxer possibly in fifth place, and air armor is considered lacking compared to madness or lightning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535060882537848903)
- **top modifier drops from high difficulty enemies**: Even very high-difficulty (2k+) enemies cannot drop only top modifiers, but they produce Supremely items more often than lower-difficulty areas like AK1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531287234471268533)
- **toxic bard build**: The Toxic Bard build reportedly produces poison ticks of roughly 1.6k to 2.1k, with decent melee damage and strong crowd control. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540339757777821728)
- **tracking after being scanned**: If an enemy scanned you with tracking they see your last position; if you can stealth they get no position updates, though they may still track you at a lesser distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525044796631285871)
- **tracking for pk avoidance**: Tracking can be used to avoid PKs while farming, and a Telepathic Arcane Mage build uses tracking to play through peak PK activity hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553087545733025952)
- **tracking on mugger**: Tracking on a mugger build detects PKs so the player knows to stay in stealth rather than come out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554841224504938558)
- **tracking refresh interval**: Tracking refreshes every 5 seconds, so missing a single update within that window can leave a red player directly in front of you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536918752304562278)
- **tracking skill warning time against reds**: At 100 Tracking skill there is typically enough time after detecting a red to place a campfire and hike back to town before the red arrives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529118628996452484)
- **tracking use while treasure mapping**: Players who run Tracking while treasure mapping typically use it to bail out when reds (PKs) appear, and some set an auto-recall to trigger from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542363680212262972)
- **training dummy dps testing**: A training dummy gives ideal conditions for DPS testing and is not very reflective of real play, though it is good for comparing builds; dexxers do not get finisher procs there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532068445875863862)
- **trapped boxes on ground or in corpses**: Trapped boxes dropped on the ground or placed in dungeon corpses will be opened by players unless the item decays first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535079403053391964)
- **trapped pouch corpse protection**: Placing valuables in a trapped pouch nested several layers deep in your pack, with nothing in the first layer, makes looters spend time rummaging through your corpse and raises their risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550749641996247173)
- **trapped pouches versus paralyze**: Trapped pouches can be used to un-freeze you when a PK casts Paralyze on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542879740363538492)
- **trapper aspect for regular treasure maps**: For regular treasure maps, a trapper-aspect character is useful because it kills mobs quickly with area-of-effect damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550497085760077908)
- **trapper dungeon crowding**: Trapper is still very strong, but dungeons are often crowded with players killing all the mobs, which reduces the value you can get. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547576547450298389)
- **trapper kill stealing and group niche**: Trapper kills can be stolen by other players, and trapper is a niche choice for group play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526645862678401047)
- **trapper strength after patch**: Since the patch, trappers just starting their Codex face a harder climb, but with a fully fleshed-out Codex they are roughly as strong as before the patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526645434788085841)
- **trapper strength for bossing**: Trappers are still very strong for bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526645862678401047)
- **trapper template hidden player tracking**: The trapper treasure map template can track hidden players fairly well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540476602914316438)
- **trapper tmapper one-shotting maps after cartography change**: After the recent cartography change, a trapper tmapper in Harvest aspect can one-shot treasure maps up to level 3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538206202864074854)
- **trapper trap mechanic**: A trapper lays traps on the ground, and when a mob steps on a trap it explodes for big damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523748655578742904)
- **trapper-bard link priority**: A suggested link priority for a trapper-bard is Trap Damage first, Damage to Barded second, and Damage Dealt by Player third. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540022511557935214)
- **trapping in treasure maps**: Trapping is very strong in treasure maps, which are among the best content in the game for gold per hour and fun per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539428846577778738)
- **traps and aspect procs**: Traps can proc the Gadget aspect, but no other aspects proc via traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526033715967295549)
- **treasure chest guards**: Once the mobs guarding a treasure chest are killed, the chest can be opened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555030502963023884)
- **treasure map bosses after patch**: After the patch, treasure map bosses are a wild mini-boss without adds, and the changes mostly affect solo players and small groups rather than larger guilds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528891675559334009)
- **treasure map builds**: Good treasure map builds are those that kill spawned mobs quickly, such as tinker trapper, mage tamer and necro summoner; bard is a poor choice and bard tamer or dexxer tamer are only maybes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550789180970500157)
- **treasure map character types**: Any character with multi-attack or area-of-effect damage makes a good treasure map character, and tamers are recommended to use five 1-slot mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546230375091671162)
- **treasure map combat limits**: Treasure map chest mob combat is limited to one character, and in ocean content only the boat owner can attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548517554115579995)
- **treasure map destination**: In the new treasure map system the destination is unknown in advance and players may be dropped randomly among monsters in the open world, so they must be ready to fight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532097979538997370)
- **treasure map difficulty for tamers**: A tamer without bard skills can easily clear level 1-3 treasure maps, since chest-spawned mobs at levels 1-2 and probably level 3 are very easy unless the map is in an area with hard mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541972934023979018)
- **treasure map dig danger source**: On treasure map digs, the main danger usually comes from the creatures spawned around the location you teleport into rather than from the chest's own spawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538233836746571937)
- **treasure map hiking bonus**: Having either Camping or Cartography at 60 or higher gives the treasure map combat bonuses without double clicking an explorer pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537296949655633980)
- **treasure map nuking**: After the recent changes, a treasure map can reportedly be nuked from anywhere rather than only from nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528902294077308928)
- **treasure map spots needing main character**: Some treasure map dig spots are too dangerous for a dedicated treasure-mapper build and require a higher-damage main character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538234296094167102)
- **treasure map templates with cartography**: Cartography is powerful enough that any template can run treasure maps by swapping a DPS skill for it; level 6/7 maps have been run on an arcane mage (Necromancy swapped for Cartography) and a tamer (Herding swapped for Cartography). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544393684525654117)
- **treasure map worthiness**: Treasure maps are worth doing in Outlands, though they require some aspects and links to be effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539724439657259099)
- **treasure mapper pvp risk**: Treasure mappers can be attacked by reds while mapping, but reds usually run because they are PvP flagged and the mobs and wilderness mobs nearby can wipe them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537847934245277766)
- **treasure maps as a dexxer**: Doing treasure maps as a dexxer is hard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552416902096224257)
- **trebard tamer damage link setups**: A trebard tamer runs follower damage links with special/rare or doubloon/gold links for treasure maps, and for farming uses follower damage links first, then whatever EBS and attack speed links are needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541840180430897183)
- **tri-bard codex upgrade recommendation**: For a Tri-Bard, the Bard Codex upgrade that prevents bard break is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532274338890383472)
- **tri-bard mage mana sustain**: A tri-bard mage can sustain mana with a high Lyric aspect (10+), an Avarite spellbook and Delectable Food, casting small spells until mana is full and then using Mind Blast, Energy Bolt and Flamestrike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532721290866327602)
- **trial pit group sizes**: Trial pits have no 2 or 4 person option, so two players must use the 3-person pit trial, and some players do it solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552294299000119309)
- **tribard archer build**: A tribard archer build is decently strong and very safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542785180786233375)
- **tribard dexxer recommended links**: Recommended links for a tribard dexxer are damage to barded creatures, melee special, and effective barding skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526656839037616148)
- **tribard discord and peace in tidal 3**: A tribard build with 2 points of Self Taught, 80 Tribard skills and 6 corrupted effective barding links can discord and peace mobs in Tidal 3, though with a decent number of failures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548576619382181991)
