- **tribard mace damage**: Tribard mace builds are back to dealing raw red damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542785231331926036)
- **tribard melee build**: Barding can almost always take advantage of Shank and Knave, making tribard good for melee builds, and dual wield tribard is considered the best bard build for damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542785206203850823)
- **tribard play pattern**: A tribard plays by veterinary-healing pets from 6 tiles away while singing buff songs for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523309760105943112)
- **tribard poisoner build**: A tribard poisoner build still deals strong damage even after nerfs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555519881506463846)
- **tribard provocation buff proc**: For tribard tamers, using the Provocation buff gives a command proc that stays active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540233438269931530)
- **tribard song buff strength**: At roughly a 49% success chance, the tribard song buff gives about a 17% bonus to damage, defense and healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523310573213847674)
- **tribard stance redundancy**: For a tribard using provoke, the Fowling stance is redundant because provoked mobs do no damage to you, and Arcane is redundant as a single-target damage stance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546867957869838456)
- **tribard tamer command procs without magery**: Tribard tamers without Magery can try to get command procs by aspecting a throwing weapon or an arcane staff, though the weapon has a low chance to hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540176728956080250)
- **trolls difficulty**: Trolls regenerate and are very hard to kill without an Aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549247066465640519)
- **turning grey from beneficial actions**: Performing a beneficial action on a grey target or on a mob can turn a player grey, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541460514620838040)
- **two-character approach for t8 treasure maps**: After the patch, a suggested approach for T8 treasure maps is to use two characters: a PvMer kept for maximum DPS and a separate cartographer/scout/harvester-aspect character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550497085760077908)
- **two-handed parry damage reduction penalty**: The damage reduction penalty for parrying with a two-handed weapon is believed to apply only against players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534258321819832360)
- **two-handed weapon accuracy and disarm**: Two-handed weapons have lower accuracy than one-handed weapons, and disarm helps compensate for that. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531327813561356440)
- **two-handed weapon accuracy cap**: When using a two-handed weapon, accuracy is reportedly not capped until around tier 14-15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530245242287165701)
- **two-handed weapon damage**: Two-handed weapons give the best damage output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524820744540782602)
- **two-handed weapon damage versus shield build**: A two-handed weapon such as a quarterstaff is likely the higher-damage alternative to a one-hander with a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531331652330983454)
- **typical mob armor rating**: Commonly encountered mobs have about 50 armor rating, making 50 AR a better benchmark than 135 AR, which applies only to specific Time mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521582665323774035)
- **typical summoner team composition**: A typical summoner team is fire elemental, earth elemental, and summon creature; as a necromancer the elemental summons become lich and mummy respectively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161092484407368)
- **undead progressive spawn boss**: The boss of the undead progressive spawn is a tier 8 treasure map miniboss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547724389028470915)
- **undead summon damage boost**: The undead version of a summon gives a 20% damage boost, so it is better to resummon it than heal it, except in a pinch when you should heal your tank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541962049154842694)
- **undead summon damage versus stats**: Undead summons such as the Lich do not have higher base stats than other summons such as the Fire Elemental; their higher damage comes from Vengeful Spirit and optionally Blood Oath. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528045081691426896)
- **undermountain difficulty**: Undermountain is about as difficult as SSC2, though some mob special attacks are very dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541389593482629200)
- **undermountain dungeon**: Undermountain is a dungeon with many stealth monsters that use deadly poison, and it is not suited to new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541389555540688987)
- **undermountain mob composition**: Undermountain mobs are not very strong individually but are packed together, and some have nasty special attacks such as ranged attacks, stealthing, magery and blinking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541389866514911283)
- **undermountain patrolling boss**: A particularly dangerous boss-type monster patrols part of Undermountain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541390272565612555)
- **unidentified weapon damage display**: Unidentified weapons may not show their damage information in the stats/info display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525610321887236306)
- **unlock spell dropping held items**: Casting unlock reportedly makes your character drop the items in its hands, allowing you to quickly double-click another weapon to equip it, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528233263959642132)
- **upcoming pierce pet nerf**: An upcoming patch reportedly nerfs many pierce pets, which may make macing viable for tamers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530247993708515489)
- **urukton early farming dungeon**: Urukton is a good early farming dungeon with a more even difficulty spike, provided the first floor treasure room is avoided. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535889270408085545)
- **using a shield to absorb group special attacks**: A tank can gather a group of enemies, let them all use special attacks at the same time, and absorb them with the shield; the shield comes back before most abilities, so this can be repeated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524862626574635048)
- **usual poison damage type**: Players usually use regular poison damage, except in niche situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521993823503388753)
- **vampiric embrace and summon hp loss**: Vampiric Embrace is a Necromancy ability that may help mitigate the HP loss of necromancy summons, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541956656215101540)
- **vanish aspect special effect**: The Vanish aspect special effect is a random proc, and links or codex perks can increase the likelihood of it triggering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532501748466581826)
- **vanishing players as thieves**: If a player walks into your line of sight and vanishes, they may be a thief who has hidden in order to steal from you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537600802921779271)
- **vanquishing accuracy build option**: Vanquishing weapons with accuracy can satisfy the accuracy requirement, allowing Item Identification and Air aspect (for swing speed) to be combined in a build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525215969897873430)
- **vanquishing versus force greater slayer weapons**: A plain vanquishing weapon is most likely better than a force greater slayer weapon, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526995552267669524)
- **vanquishing versus slaying**: Vanquishing is recommended over slaying for weapon damage against a creature type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542225523575496764)
- **vanquishing weapons**: Regular Vanquishing weapons are niche for PvM, but are worth saving for the omni PvP phase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548212705318412331)
- **venge spirit timing with blood oath**: When using Blood Oath, cast Venge Spirit before summoning earth elementals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541956405844770899)
- **veterinary kit use time**: Veterinary kits take only 5 seconds to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528791132589392123)
- **veterinary kit use while moving**: A veterinary kit can be used while running to the next spot, and pets following on foot stay in range to receive the heal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522230340679106672)
- **veterinary kits and pet survivability**: Veterinary kits can keep nearly any pet alive, so a tamer can use high-damage pets instead of tank pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522230446094811316)
- **veterinary vs discordance pet damage bonus**: A 120 Veterinary pet build is reported to give about +10% pet damage, versus about 25% from Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551615421378076763)
- **viewing weapon damage in game**: To see a weapon's damage in game, hold the weapon, type [stats to open the character stats, and click the 'melee' section at the bottom; the number is only somewhat accurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525609981376729158)
- **vinekin in kraul hive**: Vinekin mobs in Kraul Hive stealth and backstab players, dealing heavy damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553538395974930483)
- **virtuoso and bard buffs on pets**: Virtuoso, the bard codex and reverb do not apply to tamed pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526705480787824691)
- **void armor mana restoration for bard tamer**: Level 14 void armor restores mana quickly for a bard tamer when equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524179876481994812)
- **void aspect for dexxers**: Void aspect armor is generally not very good for a dexxer unless fighting something with around 300 armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539818704794034176)
- **void aspect in low monster availability**: Void aspect helps when monster availability is low in a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526309284650946630)
- **void aspect mana refund**: Void Aspect gives a mana refund chance of 10% plus 2% per player Void Tier Level, according to the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523785388815028435)
- **void aspect swap against high magic resist mobs**: Against high magic resist mobs, swap to the void aspect to reduce their resist, then swap back to your normal aspect; this is reported as viable by one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531362577253404774)
- **volt shield and frost**: Volt Shield from the lightning aspect covers the benefit of Frost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537342967344271380)
- **waking from paralysis with trapped pouch**: When paralyzed, use a trapped pouch: it explodes for 1 HP damage, which breaks paralysis; trapped pouches can be bought from a Provisioner NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524140134348492800)
- **warding against diseases and poisons**: Warding is recommended when afflicted by nasty diseases or poisons that the alchemy codex cannot cure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548332281561616446)
- **warding parry stance**: The Warding parry stance is reportedly useful against damage-over-time effects such as disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529069324680302632)
- **warpig ability accuracy**: The warpig's ability accumulates a large amount of bonus accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533546730199716073)
- **warrior versus flaying stance choice**: Players reportedly recommend the warrior stance when accuracy is below 100% and the flaying stance when accuracy is 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552805686285570120)
- **water aspect arcane healer**: A water aspect arcane healer is overkill for support outside of content like omnis and time dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526779738025361498)
- **water aspect for archers**: Water aspect is a poor choice for an archer because the extra hinder from increased weapon special chance is meaningless, and lightning or madness give more damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551886429527998495)
- **water aspect on wrestling**: Wrestling is about the only template that can use the Water aspect effectively outside of boating; a tier 12 Water wrestler reached close to 300k gold per hour in Maus 3, though aspects like Lightning and Madness perform much better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520885542600839289)
- **ways to reveal hidden creatures**: Besides explosion potions, the only ways to reveal hidden creatures such as a Wendigo are the Reveal spell and the Detect Hidden skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555758463144173600)
- **weak mob loot and xp penalty**: Fighting weak mobs carries a reduced loot and experience penalty, stated by one player as 50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538573008694804560)
- **weaken debuff strength**: Weaken is considered the weakest debuff because it only reduces melee and spell damage, while mob abilities tend to be the more dangerous part. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554132834644529154)
- **weapon ability hotkeys**: The commands [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 and [WeaponAbility3 let you hotkey weapon abilities, but there is no auto renew for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548018672079995012)
- **weapon ability hotkeys**: There are no built-in hotkeys for weapon abilities, but you can create a say macro in either CUO or Razor that speaks the weapon ability command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527372179581173761)
- **weapon and aspect pairings**: Fire or blood aspects pair well with swords, which are good for bleeds and have relatively cheap aspects, while air aspect pairs well with macing and works with almost any weapon for starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520634942743380049)
- **weapon and magic blending**: PvP is the main place where players blend weapons and magic in a single build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536586636689809490)
- **weapon and spellbook restriction**: A player cannot use a weapon and a spellbook at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527555531970052258)
- **weapon aspect proc conditions**: A weapon aspect cannot proc from bleed ticks (such as swordsmanship bleeds) or poison ticks; it requires a direct weapon hit or a spell cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549563527977500764)
- **weapon build differences**: The real differences between weapon builds come from base weapon stats, codex and special moves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529190531299807333)
- **weapon choice and balance**: As long as a weapon is compatible with your skill, weapon choice is mostly personal preference because weapons are roughly balanced against each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524329421887115304)
- **weapon choice at t15 madness**: At T15 madness, any weapon choice is viable, including a small crossbow with a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543767757592727582)
- **weapon choice by average dps**: Most builds benefit more from weapons with the highest average DPS than from those with the highest single-hit damage, and medium grinding weapons tend to have the highest average DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553401286869913664)
- **weapon codex accuracy ability**: Most weapon skill codexes have an accuracy-increasing ability that can be used short term at low weapon aspect level, and accuracy becomes less of an issue at high aspect level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536382066508169216)
- **weapon codex applicability**: The weapon codex does not list every weapon; it applies if you have 80+ in the relevant weapon skill and real Tactics (excluding bonus from an equipped weapon) and a matching weapon equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520801117263495301)
- **weapon codex features**: Weapon codices provide stances with bonuses such as damage, accuracy and defense, a finisher ability that can trigger when a mob's health is low, and abilities dependent on the melee skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612484561670175)
- **weapon damage and shot speed**: Lower-damage weapons fire faster shots, while heavy-damage weapons fire slower shots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543767156066619483)
- **weapon equipped after casting**: A weapon cannot be kept equipped after casting a spell and must be re-equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528437264424632320)
- **weapon finisher damage resolution**: A Weapon Finisher first resolves the original hit as normal, then uses that hit's damage as the baseline damage for the Finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon finisher damage scaling**: Weapon Finisher damage scales from +0% (Heavy Crossbow) up to +250% (Kryss) based on the weapon's printed Average Damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **weapon finisher tier 2 threshold**: At finisher tier 2 of 5, the weapon finisher can only activate when the target creature is at 10% health or less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539383790240006144)
- **weapon finishers**: Weapon finishers trigger automatically when the target mob reaches low health, at roughly 33% or 25% (the exact threshold was changed and is uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527692779788959774)
- **weapon finishers activation**: Weapon finishers in Ultima Online: Outlands activate automatically as a chance on hit while the target creature is below a health threshold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545566588571361430)
- **weapon power determination**: A weapon's power is determined by its modifiers together with the base stats of its weapon type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527392303331803276)
- **weapon proc damage with ddbp and madness**: With damage-done-by-player (DDBP) links and madness armor, many weapon procs deal close to 10k damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539821694699569264)
- **weapon role on poison dexxer**: On a poison dexxer the weapon serves mainly as a delivery vehicle for poison, and possibly a weapon stance for defense, rather than as a source of damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530649223702249572)
- **weapon selection criteria**: When choosing a weapon, single hit damage matters more than weapon speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549084556865568799)
- **weapon setups wiki page**: Weapon setups are documented on the community wiki page Template:WeaponsSetup at wiki.uooutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526948265533112340)
- **weapon skill damage ranking**: Mace fighting and fencing are by far the worst damage weapon skills; wrestling, swordsmanship and dual wielding are the real options, with archery great for groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538688419591360654)
- **weapon skill requirement message**: The weapon skill requirement message appears on weapons regardless of your skill level, so it does not indicate you lack the skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529844935266795721)
- **weapon skill swing speed bonuses**: Swords, throwing, and fencing weapon skills also have swing speed bonuses, while mace does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547063652908138607)
- **weapon skill with low-tier aspect**: With a low-tier aspect, having 100 weapon skill probably helps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553802259660415109)
- **weapon specials per weapon**: Each weapon has its own named weapon special with a distinct effect that can proc on attacks; Hinder is one example. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527088138797977731)
- **weapon speed and special chance**: Faster weapons have a lower chance to perform a weapon special, and slower weapons have a higher chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539814591352283156)
- **weapon speed for farming versus pvp**: When farming heavily, light or medium weapons are preferred, while interrupt effects are more useful in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534951001977520399)
- **weapon spellbook equipping**: A weapon spellbook must be held (equipped in the weapon slot) to grant its bonus, and a player can carry several and switch between them as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528022912253296841)
- **weapon stance change cooldown**: There is no cooldown between changing weapon stances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531435487741477060)
- **weapon statistics lookup**: Detailed weapon statistics are not available in game, so players should consult the official wiki's Armor & Weapons page for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553400508834779156)
- **weapon stats relevance and power scaling**: Power scaling mechanics such as aspects and chain links make individual weapon stats largely irrelevant, and weapon damage tables are available on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525610797768638635)
- **weapon swap after backstab**: After a backstab, a player may weapon swap if the mob is low enough and reportedly retains the tactics bonus from the original backstab for 10 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554115484880863294)
- **weapon swing delays**: Weapon swings have specific delays that players use to time follow-up actions; this matters mainly in PvP, while melee PvE is mostly standing and hitting the mob. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541838381229539459)
- **weapon swing timer**: The weapon swing timer is shared among all weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523846004460355634)
- **weapon switching via macros**: Players can switch between weapons by recording a set of macros for the equip actions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534829064932561017)
- **weapon user spell-like output**: A weapon user wanting more spell-like output can best summon something, at the cost of overall DPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536554232117862560)
- **weapons against undead**: Outlands has no silver weapons for undead; it instead has slaying weapons for various mob types, undead being one of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539613210993234001)
- **weekly dungeon rotation**: A weekly dungeon rotation exists and can be checked to decide which dungeons to avoid or focus on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **wiki weapons chart pa abbreviation**: On the wiki weapons chart, 'Pa' stands for 'partnered' and can be treated as meaning a two-handed weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525744837327061083)
- **wiki weapons chart rows**: Weapons in the same row of the wiki Weapons Chart are essentially the same and differ only in appearance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523343267918385293)
- **wiki weaponschart speed terms**: The terms 'grinding', 'burst' and 'interrupt' in the wiki WeaponsChart template refer only to the speed of the weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555734615438790748)
- **wild swing accuracy penalty**: Wild Swing reduces the user's accuracy, so it is only suitable if accuracy is already at 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524585755828158585)
- **wild swing damage multiplier**: Wild swing does not apply a separate damage multiplier because all melee damage is treated as one bucket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525620288572882995)
- **wild swing stance**: The Wild Swing stance reduces accuracy but increases damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522023450154238054)
- **wild swing with item identification dps test**: Wild swing with item identification was tested at about 545 dps on a leather battle trainer, which the tester considered poor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525590577066803323)
- **wilderness arcane farming**: When wilderness farming as an arcane mage, proc on a training dummy and then recall out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335535895773316)
- **wilderness farming for low-level arcane mage**: Wilderness farming makes kiting easier for a low-level Arcane Mage; later they can move to dungeons using rope plus spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536201110753251348)
- **wilderness mobs on treasure maps**: Even with the cartography bonus for treasure map mobs, players sometimes still have to deal with insanely strong wilderness mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538240685390561431)
- **wildwood reaper difficulty**: Wildwood reapers have a difficulty rating of 197, comparable to a tanky dungeon level 3 mob, and are not easy for fresh players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542951328756666369)
- **witcher runes and pk exposure**: Players near witcher runes are often found by PKs because the runes are connected everywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533245301870297189)
- **wither ability for summon mana**: The Wither ability can provide free mana for summoning when summons are staggered so they are not resummoned at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541957461152374784)
- **without borders aoe healing**: Without Borders provides area-of-effect healing with a radius of about 4-5 tiles that also heals the caster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522229709612781578)
- **wizard grimoire bless trait targets**: The wizard's grimoire Bless trait allows up to 10 targets; whether they must be party members is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547525604381818940)
- **wizard grimoire curse and field damage**: The Wizard Grimoire curse increases spell damage, but testing suggests it does not apply to fire field damage and probably not to paralyze or poison fields either. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553086180516696145)
- **wizard's grimoire effect on followers**: The Wizard's Grimoire does not impact followers much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526510212876468315)
- **wizard's grimoire in pvp**: The Wizard's Grimoire does not work in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547607937067913256)
- **wizard's grimoire versus evaluating intelligence**: The Wizard's Grimoire helps PvM at the expense of PvP, while Evaluating Intelligence helps PvP at the expense of PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552227439332032555)
- **wrestler 50/50 chance when disarmed**: A wrestler does not lose their 50/50 chance when disarmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554233694649323563)
- **wrestler armor choice**: A wrestler is advised to wear full plate armor rather than leather armor to survive better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533354811557281943)
- **wrestler aspects**: Fire, Air, Discipline, Void, Blood and Earth aspects all work well for wrestlers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528075857246031952)
- **wrestler bard link setup**: A wrestler bard setup uses 10/10/10 EBS links, Damage by Player links, and Melee special chance/damage links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529025633030639716)
- **wrestler build strength**: Wrestler builds, including Discipline Wrestler, are currently considered strong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521612442277515285)
- **wrestler damage variables**: Special chance is one of the biggest variables in wrestler damage, along with armor rating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527749705411461161)
- **wrestler defense against pks**: Resist is the recommended defensive skill for a wrestler build that wants to defend against PKs, and PvP without Resist feels weak. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524279112196165663)
- **wrestler fistblade, cestus and martial manual**: The Fistblade, Cestus and Martial Manual have no functional difference for the wrestler; they only look different. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552771213812834415)
- **wrestler form usage**: Wrestlers mainly use Dragon form and switch to Spider form only when attacked by a large group, such as ten mongbats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535948921900109844)
- **wrestler in level 4 dungeons**: A wrestler can do fine in level 4 dungeons by sacrificing Arms Lore for Parry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544832342437396610)
- **wrestler links after ssi and acc caps**: A wrestler that has reached the SSI and ACC caps can use Melee Special Chance and Damage Dealt by Player at 15/15 as links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528397141498794087)
- **wrestler parry stance choice**: For a wrestler parry build, use Mirror stance against mobs that cast spells, Tetsudo against mobs that do not, and Warding when the mob's bleed or disease is more dangerous than its melee or magic attack (mostly level 4 and Time mobs). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524506045785833622)
- **wrestler pve performance**: Wrestler is strong against content up to level 3 and can deal more single-target DPS for bossing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552473977975480422)
- **wrestler solo and boss damage**: Wrestler is very strong for solo play, and with healers and good party mechanics it can nearly match an arcane mage's boss damage; some top boss damage dealers this season are wrestlers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545449995585454110)
- **wrestler solo pvm and pvp viability**: A wrestler build can solo level 4 dungeons and still hold its own against PKs who attack it, according to one player's experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523318772314931400)
- **wrestler swing speed bonus**: To get the wrestler swing speed bonus (an extra 10%) to show and apply, set your equipped gear to a wrestling weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546342724184309781)
- **wrestler swing speed cap**: A wrestler should sit as close to the swing speed cap as possible, and can balance Discipline and Air aspects so Air slightly over-caps while Discipline is slightly under. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544426219599175790)
- **wrestler swing speed on mob spawn**: A wrestler build can have Brawl and Ready active each time treasure mobs spawn, allowing it to cap out swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538988245243920415)
- **wrestler tankiness and skills**: A wrestler is quite tanky and can use alchemy, parrying, resisting spells and similar skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545453572089446460)
- **wrestling accuracy requirement**: Wrestling requires accuracy, so a wrestling build needs magic gear to hit reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522216641684045895)
- **wrestling and chance to be hit**: Wrestling lessens the chance of being hit by autoattacks for anyone, including tamed creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521179912579321938)
- **wrestling aoe stance**: Wrestling has the best AoE stance of all the dexxer weapon skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537480975959728268)
- **wrestling armor and stance changes**: Plate armor is recommended for wrestling, and players should carry Total Refresh potions if changing stances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534592506996723875)
- **wrestling bleeder build with blood aspect**: A wrestling bleeder build using the Blood aspect is reported to feel pretty decent to play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526096929388494989)
- **wrestling boss damage**: Wrestlers with well-developed builds can easily do around 300k damage at bosses when in parties with higher-end players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525214064685355188)
- **wrestling build aspect compatibility**: The wrestling build works well with almost any aspect, but arcane or eldritch aspect on the armor is not recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523491205118169088)
- **wrestling build survivability**: A wrestling build can take Parry until comfortable, or switch into Crane stance when HP starts dipping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527720370495291523)
- **wrestling build versatility**: Wrestling is currently a very versatile and forgiving build that is hard to get wrong. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520826461253140594)
- **wrestling cleave**: Wrestling has the best cleave, hitting 3 targets instead of 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527562730968715305)
- **wrestling combo buildup**: With Wrestling, missing an attack breaks your combo buildup, so misses are especially costly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543653121543114835)
- **wrestling damage profile**: Wrestling deals decent damage but lacks burst, hitting for roughly 16 to 30 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554444805948444683)
- **wrestling defense against pks**: Against a PK, 100 Wrestling versus the attacker's 100 weapon skill is reported to give a 50% chance to avoid being hit, which helps avoid cast interruption. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546655868500705422)
- **wrestling dexxer armor advice**: The wiki advice to wear lighter armor on a wrestling dexxer may be outdated, since wrestling was rebalanced and is probably no longer tanky enough to go without armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555945895890256045)
- **wrestling dexxer aspect setup**: An Earth weapon aspect combined with a Discipline armor aspect is a solid setup for a wrestling dexxer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539073792893128714)
- **wrestling dexxer ssi overcap**: A wrestling dexxer build with 56% SSi is probably overcapped in SSi. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549851794102816969)
- **wrestling dodge bonus**: Wrestling skill reportedly gives a small boost to dodging melee attacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521552219235684525)
- **wrestling for pvm**: Wrestling is considered strong for PvM and can fight back against reds and thieves in the dungeon; swords were changed a few patches ago, prompting the move to wrestling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539310073556508712)
- **wrestling gear and aspect choices**: A wrestling weapon with the air aspect, along with Madness, Lightning and Discipline armor, is considered the better setup currently, and Frost is also good. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524511902733045952)
- **wrestling pvm benefits**: Wrestling gives a 10% swing speed increase, has a good Stagger special, and deals 150% damage instead of 100%, making it higher DPS for PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535672401449455768)
- **wrestling special message**: A successful wrestling special logs the message "You stagger your target, increasing your weapon damage against them...". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530473078369292348)
- **wrestling swing speed bonus**: After the latest patch, a wrestler gets an extra 10% swing speed bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546326430005072043)
- **wrestling weapon requirement**: A wrestling weapon (scroll) must be held to use the wrestling-related ability, and one can be obtained from the mage shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533954209031127163)
- **wrestling weapon styles**: Wrestling lacks burst or interrupt weapon styles, and all three wrestling weapons are the same medium-grinding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543009063401422859)
- **wrestling weapon varieties**: All three wrestling weapon varieties are functionally the same weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550697051384455242)
- **wrestling without accuracy**: Wrestling performs poorly without an accuracy bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554619817657376851)
- **zen strike and crane wrestling options**: Zen Strike and Crane (healing stance and finisher) are mainly useful when tanking and lag in DPS; Zen Strike mattered more when mana issues existed and is less important now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522242487484289237)
- **zero armor rating damage**: A character with 0 armor rating takes full damage from mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525591659612471428)

## New players

- **discord verified player role**: To get the VERIFIED PLAYER role needed to post in restricted Discord channels such as Trade and PvP, log in to the Outlands Portal (portal.uooutlands.com/account) with your OutlandsID credentials and link your Discord account; the !verify command shows these instructions. _(official, conf 0.85, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534559201341345892)
- **exitlag node selection**: When connecting to Outlands with ExitLag, select an Ashburn node as the destination (end) node for the best results. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1523821474828390510)
- **learning outlaws rules**: To learn how to play Outlaws, double click the Event Stone in the Outlaws waiting room. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1533186927782789372)
- **outlaws event requirements**: Outlaws is a free-for-all event that requires no skills or gear, and all players are welcome to join. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1533186927782789372)
- **patching support channel**: Players who need help with patching can ask in the designated patching support channel on the Outlands Discord. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1526237492536410122)
- **shard and client access**: The Outlands test shard can only be accessed with the beta client, and the live shard can only be accessed with the live client. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **snowbrawl requirements**: The King's Faire Cash Prize Snowbrawl requires no special skills or equipment, and all players are welcome. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541823889129213963)
- **test shard file verification**: To make sure game files are up to date before using the Test Shard preview, click Verify in the Outlands launcher. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1549901811018760243)
- **verifying files after file patch**: After a patch that includes a file patch, run the Launcher and click VERIFY before logging in to confirm your files are up to date. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550569608300466307)
- **verifying game files after a patch**: After a file patch, or if the game asks for a patch and no patch option is available, run the Launcher and click VERIFY (verify files) to confirm your game files are up to date before logging in. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525160820114329600)
- **verifying game files in launcher**: After a file patch, run the Launcher before logging in and click VERIFY to confirm your game files are up to date. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1554192084380942418)
- **accounts per outlands id**: Each player is allowed one OutlandsID, which can hold up to three game accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553492320626802811)
- **arcane mage difficulty**: Arcane mage is a hard, non-beginner-friendly build that is hard to play until you have high aspect levels and many spell aspect links, and it runs out of mana often even late game, so Flame Strike cannot be spammed freely. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556063573879422987)
- **character creation starting skills**: At character creation a player picks 8 skills that start at 60 instead of 0 (advanced creation is capped at 60 per skill), affecting only starting values and gear, and the 8th skill can be lowered or dropped later; premade templates with 80 are outliers. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 9 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554373511177306153)
- **character slot limits**: Each Outlands ID can have 3 accounts, and each account has 5 base character slots (about 15 total), with a possible extra slot via achievement or deed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690018314813554)
- **early gold farming locations**: New players should farm the sanctuary areas until their codexes and aspect are running. After that, floor 1 of core open-world dungeons earns gold faster, except Shadowspire Cathedral, Kraul Hive and Tidal Tomb, but carries the risk of dying to red players. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549178710744240231)
- **new character inn room credit**: The first character created on each account receives an inn room credit deed worth roughly two weeks of free small-room rent, and the new player quest gives one more deed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615193762566236)
- **new player dungeon skill gain bonus**: The New Player Dungeon (Shelter) gives boosted skill gain for non-crafting, non-gathering skills, reportedly up to 80, and only while inside the dungeon; elsewhere there is no skill gain boost. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556037125739118664)
- **new player quest aspect unlocks**: Completing the new player quests gives your first Codex and a kit with 3 free aspect unlocks, which do not all have to be used on the same character and can be passed to other characters, including on other accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542579834272878652)
- **new player quest codex**: The new player quest chain (!npq) gives one free codex of your choice (the 'A Codex to Go' quest), which may be tradeable to another character after it is picked. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553592407281635349)
- **new player quest rewards**: The new player quest chain is worth completing because it gives gold and strong boosts, including a chain, a link and a tool, and one unlocked link slot. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147508509347861)
- **new player quest rewards**: The new player quests give new players their first mastery chain/link, aspect, and codex for free, plus a blessed runetome, getting them into end-game progression systems much faster than before. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542832870689738854)
- **new player quest rune tome reward**: The new player quests, starting on Shelter Island and outside the new player dungeon, reward a free blessed rune tome with several locations already saved, and the quests can be done only once per account; further quests in Prevalia are marked by an arrow to the next quest. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452722336956467)
- **new player quests**: Outlands has one-time new player quests that every new player should complete, and they can be listed with the !npq command in Discord. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546531136656638082)
- **outlands butler website**: The community website outlandsbutler.com offers tools to build templates and compare skills, bonuses and damage, a crafting training tool, and popular builds with codex and aspect leveling suggestions. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550700450410401874)
- **red player looting behavior**: Red (murderer) players loot victims out of spite regardless of how little the victim carries, so carry only cheap gear you can afford to lose. A red who loots a corpse is not guaranteed to leave the dungeon alive with the items. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536939578748051476)
- **shelter dungeon skill gain after losing young status**: After losing Young status, a character keeps the accelerated skill gain in the Shelter dungeon and loses only Shelter Island vendor access and gathering benefits on the island. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541615374905245768)
- **shelter dungeon skill gains**: The Shelter dungeon boosts skill gains for non-crafting, non-gathering skills, but only up to 80 skill; skills stop gaining there at 80, so train higher levels outside. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551671180396724275)
- **shelter island skill cap**: Skills are capped at 80 on Shelter Island (as in the new player dungeon), with no codex or aspect gains there, so players must leave to train above 80, e.g. to mine avarite. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554905832217387051)
- **shelter new player dungeon**: The Shelter Island new player dungeon gives boosted skill gain (about 2x) up to 80 for all characters, even those that have left the island; new players should raise skills to 80 and stats to 100, complete the single newbie quest, then leave. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366331755012191)
- **summoner starter codex choice**: A summoner should take the Summoner's Tome from the codex bundle quest and buy the Wizard's Grimoire later, though some players prefer the Grimoire first for spell damage builds. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554325333929623604)
- **summoner's tome source**: The Summoner's Tome is a player-crafted item that holds summoner upgrade points; one is given by the new player quest after leaving Shelter Island, and others can be bought from player vendors found via the vendor search on the Outlands portal. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550149764648280176)
- **tamer as starter template**: Tamer is widely considered the easiest and a strong starter template and currently the best for farming, though its core items are expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555982125042503737)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon**: One existing dungeon rotates weekly into a safe sanctuary dungeon (reportedly at 8pm EST on Fridays), where players avoid PKs, can farm safely and learn maps; the current one can be checked on the banner near banks in game or in a Discord channel. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556005511189504103)
- **wiki skill training information**: Every skill page on the Outlands wiki has a Training section with efficient training tips and typical resource costs, and the wiki's Skills & Stats page lists which NPCs train which skills. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559973361033277)
- **wiki templates page**: The Outlands wiki has a Templates page (wiki.uooutlands.com/Templates) with suggested builds for each main archetype, including a Dexxer subpage, and each skill's page has a training guide at the bottom. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554287200148131922)
- **young player status**: Young player status is kept until you leave Shelter Island or renounce it; if lost, you can still gain skills on Shelter Island up to 80 but can no longer access the bank or merchant NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535110097775362108)
- **best starting templates for new players**: Follower templates such as tamer and summoner are the best starting options because their power spike comes early, whereas a pure dexxer is harder and riskier for a brand new player. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529076609879900341)
- **combined pvp and pvm characters**: PvP and PvM are largely separate on Outlands, so players typically make separate characters; one build can be okay at both but is hard to make excellent at both. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547633153466834954)
- **enabling item tooltips**: To see item names and properties on mouse-over, open Options, go to the Tooltip section, and check 'show item tooltips'. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529231118807601242)
- **free codex from new player quest**: The new player quest rewards a free codex (the Codex Starter Bundle, reportedly of your choice), and it can be completed only once per account. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539104903782469682)
- **new player dungeon experience restrictions**: Players cannot earn experience toward Aspects, Codexes, Mastery Chains and similar progression inside the New Player Dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528401732907040950)
- **new player quest rewards**: Completing the new player quests rewards a runetome (reported as blessed and preloaded with commonly traveled places) plus items for your aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554346530213855325)
- **new player quest rewards**: The new player quests reward starter items that introduce progression systems one at a time, including a Codex, Aspect, skill orb or scroll, Mastery Chain, grimoire and spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544135200219340940)
- **new player quest rewards**: The new player quest chain gives a free codex, three aspect unlocks and a mastery chain, but it is reportedly locked out once you have farmed more than 5 million gold across all your accounts and is probably available only once. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551279852622192643)
- **new player quests**: New player quests, including the Wellington quests, are only available to new players, give very valuable rewards, and should be a new player's top priority to pick up. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550136228223909929)
- **new player resources**: New players should use the wiki's New Player Guide at wiki.uooutlands.com/New_Player_Guide and the Outlands Gameplay Basics playlist, which is the official tutorial series, plus community videos such as Pwnstar's Newplayer 101. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548359958943244411)
- **new player template skill goals**: Custom template starting skills are set to 60 and cannot be lowered, and a new player's first goal is to reach 80 in the skills of the chosen template, with the wiki providing template lists for dexxer, mage, bard, tamer, gathering, PvP and misc builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554678283214397461)
- **outlands wiki**: The Outlands wiki at wiki.uooutlands.com is the main reference for the shard and covers roughly 90% of game data, though it is not fully comprehensive and occasionally has outdated information; the normal UO wiki is a poor source for Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531177137342517268)
- **sanctuary dungeons for new players**: Prevalia Sewers and Urukton Bluffs are permanent sanctuary dungeons that are good for continued learning, with Sewers followed by Bluffs a good progression; Urukton Bluffs is in the book from the Prevalia quest. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529191734691762186)
- **shelter island**: Shelter Island is the new player starting island and dungeon, reachable via moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546488035233759324)
- **shelter island access after leaving**: After leaving Shelter Island players can return, for example to train in the dungeon, but they can no longer use its vendors, bank or stable because they are no longer young; these services are available in other towns. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552323227093565493)
- **shelter island dungeon skill training**: The Shelter Island newbie dungeon gives increased skill gain for non-crafting, non-gathering skills such as Magery, Wrestling, Tracking, Camping and Spirit Speak, usable up to 80 skill, and its vendors stop serving a player after they leave the shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547045008459177984)
- **shelter island skill cap and revisiting**: Shelter Island has an 80 skill cap, and after leaving you can return to trade and level skills up to 80, though there is little useful to do there once skills reach 80. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534013410641969192)
- **temporary nameplate display**: To show player and NPC names only when needed, hold Ctrl+Shift to open the red nameplate settings box, uncheck 'always active', then press Shift+Ctrl to display nameplates briefly. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525552077080891435)
- **thieves at town banks**: Thieves frequently steal from players at busy town banks such as Prevalia, and items withdrawn can be stolen before use, so using a less popular bank such as South Prevalia reduces the risk. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553074847582785698)
- **viewing skills**: To view your skills, open the Skills button on your paperdoll, use the Skills tab in Razor, or type [skills. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547902570658267147)
- **wasd movement**: Enable WASD movement under Options > Experimental; it overwrites only keys that are already bound, so unbind any hotkeys or macros on W, A, S, D if they conflict. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529229221266722877)
- **wiki template pages**: The Outlands wiki (wiki.uooutlands.com) has template pages including TemplatesMage, Gathering Templates (with a hybrid mining and lumberjacking template) and Skill Synergies, though some templates are outdated, e.g. listing 700 skill points instead of 720. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546774825627025488)
- **account link option and outlandsid**: Outlands accounts are linked to an OutlandsID; the account link option at login exists so old players, who previously had 3 independent accounts, can move them into their OutlandsID. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540258508966989884)
- **aspect starter bundle**: The new player aspect starter bundle grants 3 free aspect unlocks; it does not upgrade aspects or bypass core requirements. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541502158334333009)
- **aspect starter bundle**: New players can receive an aspect starter bundle from new player quest rewards, containing enough supplies to unlock an aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541110321194729573)
- **beginner quests**: New players should follow the beginner quests, which introduce the shard's new systems and give many free items that make the first week easier and faster. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524861983420190800)
- **character template statue**: A statue at character creation lets you choose from a handful of preset templates and also lets you reroll your template once. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550052361794363413)
- **container size adjustment**: To change container and item sizes, go to Options > Interface > Containers and adjust Container scale (and Items scale). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529231713253982269)
- **copying ui profile between characters**: Use the Profile Manager in options to clone a profile to another character, or copy the character's profile folder or xml files in the game directory and rename it for the new character, backing up the old folder first. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555041704715755584)
- **dexxer vs mage tamer for new players**: A tamer dexxer is generally the better choice for a new player than a tamer mage, since it is easy to play, farms much faster early on with little risk, and avoids the keybind setup and spellbook cost of a mage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526104089090326548)
- **easiest new player builds**: The easiest new-player builds are bard dexxer, summoner (mage with summons), and tamer (including archer tamer), because pets tank and deal damage; summoner and tamer are easiest at low links and for fast farming. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537587213825740891)
- **gathering as beginner gold source**: Gathering, such as mining or lumberjacking, is the fastest and most effective way for a new player to earn gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602492227264593)
- **guild acceptance of new players**: Nearly all Outlands guilds accept brand new players and help them along, and the Discord has a guild listings channel. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546909136099475647)
- **identifying unidentified gear on shelter island**: Unidentified armor and weapons need a higher Item ID skill or an Item ID wand (buyable from players); this is not possible on Shelter Island, so players keep unidentified items until they leave or sell them to NPCs at a poor price. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546966609086906428)
- **journal hotkey**: Alt+J is the default macro that opens the Journal in the Outlands client, and it can be checked or changed under options > macros. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539856544232112188)
- **losing young status**: Losing Young status means losing access to the bank, vendors and harvesting on Shelter Island, the starter area. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545085437427585114)
