- **nameplate menu**: Press Ctrl+Shift to bring up the nameplate menu, where you choose which nameplates (nearby items, mobs, corpses) are shown; it can be customized further in the options under nameplates. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543024345255772210)
- **new player guides**: The wiki's New Player Guide, the official YouTube basics playlist and the !newplayer command (linking Pwnstar's Newplayer 101 and other videos) are good starting points, with advanced guides on YouTube from Pwnstarr Gaming, Wes Furtive and Sir Shrimpington. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541504543295012998)
- **new player quest bonded horse**: The new player stable quest, the second new player quest, is a very simple quest that rewards a free bonded horse, which stays as a ghost and can be revived if it dies. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553207208572100669)
- **new player quest bonded horse**: A new player quest gives a free bonded horse (mount) along with better starting gear; the quest's apple tree is southwest of the stable on the way to the southwest gate. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537767048204132392)
- **new player quest completion limit**: The new player quests, including the runebook and bound horse rewards, can be completed only once per Outlands ID, not per account or character. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534348109361057882)
- **new player quest gold limit**: The new player quests are unavailable once you have farmed 5 million gold across your accounts (OutlandsID), so they must be completed before reaching that amount; earning 5 million is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550052028938584187)
- **new player quest rewards**: Completing the new player quests grants about 3 Aspect unlocks along with a codex and a few other rewards. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537556854320668743)
- **new player quests**: New player quests in Sanctuary and Prevalia reward a codex, an aspects bundle and a chain, giving new characters important early strength. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553787669899911352)
- **new player quests in prevalia**: After the starter island, new players take the moongate to Prevalia, pick up quests there (most at the society house, with one at its entrance), and then fight in the sewers on the north side. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548250903499382876)
- **new player spending priorities**: New players are advised to sell commodity boards for gold and spend it first on quality-of-life items (strongbox, magic item recycler, shelf, resource stockpile) and harvesting cores. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529828424825180301)
- **outlands wiki templates**: The Outlands wiki has template lists for Dexxer, Mage, Bard, Tamer, Gathering, PvP and Misc gameplay, and the TemplatesNewPlayer page explains basic gameplay of each starting template. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564385092767764)
- **player pet market**: An Animal (Stable) Broker NPC, typically found in stables near Stable Keepers, gives access to the player pet market, where cheap level 1 mounts (roughly 750 gold to 2k) are sold and level 1 pets are bonded. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552118811136884818)
- **recommended new player builds**: For brand new players, tamer is the recommended starting build, then mage tamer or a summoner build, as these are easier than pure arcane mage; a spell damage summoner template without summons is effectively an arcane mage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529544605278933022)
- **recommended new player pvm templates**: Recommended starting PvM templates are Tamer, Bard Dexxer, Mage/Summoner, or the tank dexxer (a paladin is essentially a dexxer with holy aspect), chosen by preferred play style. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564237298073611)
- **regional skill caps**: Shelter Island and the New Player Dungeon are the only areas with regional skill caps, where skills cannot be gained beyond 80. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554160828826263635)
- **reopening the journal**: To reopen a closed journal (chat) window, use the top bar menu Gumps then Journal, or press ALT + J. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550879870006075548)
- **resurrection after dying in the wilderness**: After dying in the wilderness, find a town healer (ankh), a healer caravan (white/red sign on the map), a wandering healer (unmarked), or a dungeon entrance to be resurrected, then walk back to your corpse to loot it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528069908196364490)
- **returning to shelter island**: Players can return to Shelter Island after leaving, for example to level up or change skills, but can no longer use its NPCs or bank, except quest givers and the innkeeper. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552901421299671041)
- **returning to shelter island**: Players can return to Shelter Island at any time, including after renouncing Young status, to train skills, trade safely, and use the Shelter dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531191652004139018)
- **scavenger as starter character**: A scavenger is a good first real character: it is cheap to start, builds gold within days, and lets players learn dungeons without much risk from losing items or dying. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554362823860293694)
- **scavenger template nerf**: The Scavenger template was nerfed in a recent patch and is reported as not viable on the new player island. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547536126028423179)
- **shadowspire sanctuary dungeon difficulty**: Shadowspire, when it is the sanctuary dungeon, is very difficult for new players because of its brutal slow spawn. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533008362457792513)
- **shelter dungeon magery training**: Magery (and Camping) should be trained in the Shelter dungeon until skills reach 80. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553401191180931161)
- **shelter island npc access after losing young status**: Once a player loses Young status, they can no longer use the NPCs on Shelter Island, including the bank and vendors, though they can still return to the island. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850036408549517)
- **shelter island skill gains**: Skills can be leveled easily to 80 on Shelter Island, but past 80 nothing more is gained there and its main remaining use is as a safe place to trade. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550135520854679573)
- **shelter island skill training**: Skills, including combat skills, can be trained somewhat passively on the trainer NPCs on Shelter Island, such as the ranger by the campfire, which is easier than starting in the new player dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547563415399305226)
- **shelter island training limit**: Shelter Island is safe for training skills up to 80 as long as you keep Young status; going past 80 requires leaving the island and dropping Young status, which exposes you to PKs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544628895721070602)
- **shelter skill training cap**: On Shelter Island, skills can only be trained up to 80 and no Aspect, Codex or other XP can be gained; non-crafting, non-harvesting skills reach 80 quickly, and you must leave Shelter to progress further. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539208235007868938)
- **skill purchases on shelter island**: On Shelter Island, skills can be bought from NPCs up to 50, but the Necromancy skill book cannot be bought there, although training from the NPC works. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533821523079467204)
- **starter templates for new characters**: Outlands offers starter templates to choose from the first time you log into a new character, and the wiki lists templates for Dexxer, Mage, Bard, Tamer, Gathering, PvP and Misc play with skill combinations that work well together. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589450829136065)
- **stuck character help**: If your character is stuck, open Paperdoll > Help > In Game Help > Character Is Stuck > Teleport to Town; after about a minute it kills you and teleports you to town, usable once every 24 hours. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550701922472956035)
- **tank dexer starting build**: A tank dexer is a solid, simple build to start with; it starts a little slower early on but plays well later, and a Magery character can use Summon Creature to kill things. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554355357365837847)
- **test shard for builds**: Players can try out a build on the test shard before investing real time into it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548201567251988501)
- **training credit deed for new characters**: Each new character starts with a training credit deed that can be used to train a skill, whereas rental deeds are once per account. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551763199559336009)
- **urukton bluffs access**: You can reach Urukton Bluffs by walking or by using the starter quest rune tome, which likely includes a rune to the bluff. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545334050884030464)
- **weapon setup bonus documentation**: Weapon setup bonuses for PvM are listed on the wiki's Armor & Weapons page rather than on weapon skill pages such as Wrestling. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523780428404887663)
- **young status after leaving starter island**: Leaving the starter island (Shelter Island) causes a player to lose Young status, after which they can no longer buy from or interact with NPC merchants and mages there, and must use the bank and shops in another city. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355998408048721)
- **account deletion**: Accounts cannot be deleted in Outlands, so unused accounts can simply be ignored, and extra accounts remain useful for crafting society quests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533761931070930984)
- **account-linked quests after character deletion**: Deleting all characters on an account does not reset the account-linked quests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526993766420975827)
- **accounts per outlands id**: Each email corresponds to one Outlands ID, and up to 3 accounts can be tied to that ID, with the option to create more appearing after logging in; societies can be done on each account to get iron or boards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525874281031143454)
- **action bar item keybinds**: Items can be placed on the action bar, and right clicking an item's cell lets you set a keybind for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547566085996417024)
- **adding items to the counter bar**: Items on the counter bar must be added manually by dragging them from your bag onto the bar. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531165823371186357)
- **aegis keep difficulty for new players**: Aegis Keep floors 1 and 2 are manageable for new players, while floor 3 is a bit tricky. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530309005241614496)
- **afk safety**: The game does not punish AFK, but other players might, since thieves can steal inventory in normal towns; idle on Shelter Island or in your rented room instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531198365797449909)
- **alchemy training cost for new players**: Training Alchemy is relatively expensive for a new player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553896563942756353)
- **antivirus quarantining game files**: Antivirus software such as Norton can quarantine the Outlands game files and block login; adding an exception for the Outlands files can fix it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540261645295558659)
- **arcane essence loading amount**: A reasonable amount of arcane essence to load for a low-level aspect is 100 to 500, and 1000 lasts a good while. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532500536232902832)
- **armourer npc on shelter**: An Armourer NPC on Shelter Island sells basic plate armor, though another player reported seeing only cloth and plate offered by armorer vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527340752714207284)
- **aspects on npc armor**: Aspects can be put on and used with NPC-purchased armor; exceptional player-made armor is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527341333839220746)
- **attacking monsters**: To attack a monster, enter war mode by clicking the war mode button on your paperdoll or pressing Tab, then double-click the target (anything without a yellow name), or use a targeting macro. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567744201793546)
- **avoiding already logged in message**: To avoid the 'another character is already logged in' message, log out inside an inn, a guild house or a friendly house; no inn room rental is required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553393113270329439)
- **avoiding pvp**: PvP is largely unavoidable except by staying in newbie or sanctuary dungeons, which have reduced loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671065248305182)
- **bank safety**: The Prevalia bank is not safe from thieves; the only 100% safe bank is Shelter, which players age out of when young status ends. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529265127579451472)
- **basic starter dungeons**: Sewers, Ratman Hovel and Urkton are the super basic starter dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533007347205804162)
- **blessed runebook for additional characters**: To get a blessed runebook for an additional character, buy a runebook from a player vendor and a runebook bless deed from a previous vendor; alternatively, pass your one free blessed runebook between your characters until you can afford more. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525198338209743020)
- **blessed starter dagger**: The blessed starter dagger is a tool for dagger tasks such as gathering kindling from trees and not a real weapon; for fighting, use a proper dagger together with the fencing skill. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525590734139293767)
- **bot commands for new player info**: The bot command !dungeonpath shows the dungeon progression path, and !npq reportedly gives information on new player quests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550138869058637947)
- **buying level 1 mounts**: Level 1 mounts are not sold by the Stable Master; they are bought from players through an Animal Broker NPC at the stables, cost roughly 1-2k gold, and need no Taming skill to buy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546525032782630963)
- **buying spells from mage npc**: The first few spells can be bought as scrolls from a Mage NPC; drag the scrolls onto your spellbook to add them, then cast from the book. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282336391004252)
- **changing skills after character creation**: Skills are easy to change after character creation: set unwanted skills down and train new ones instead of deleting the character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549588929370394786)
- **changing video settings**: Double-click yourself to open the paperdoll, click its Options button, and open the Video section to change video settings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531123261734260766)
- **character creation presets**: Newer character creation offers preset builds instead of manual attribute selection. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537965564692140083)
- **client download location**: The Outlands client can be downloaded from the official Outlands website at uooutlands.com/connecting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552298186092322847)
- **closing stuck lifebar windows**: To close lifebar windows that won't close, hold Alt and right click on them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542786281463881769)
- **codices in new player dungeon**: Codices do not level in the New Player Dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522042215768264795)
- **companionbot templates command**: Type !templates in Discord to have the CompanionBot list the Outlands wiki template pages (Starter, Dexxer, Mage, Bard, Tamer, Gathering, PvP, Misc). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532223743676383356)
- **container scale client setting**: The client settings include a container scale (item size) option, separate from the general UI scale, that changes the size of bags and the items inside them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523789582963834943)
- **counters bar rearranging**: Items in the Counters bar cannot be dragged to other positions within it; you must drag them from your inventory instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532801610013479104)
- **customize bot command**: Use the !customize bot command to get a list of forum guides for customizing the game screen, including User Interface, Cooldowns and Nameplates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541439467976527943)
- **dark dungeon fix**: Disabling Options > Video > Light level fixes dark dungeons and turns the lights back on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540633334953021451)
- **death and loot loss**: Players can be killed by other players and monsters and lose their loot, so they should carry only what they can afford to lose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530692062020763658)
- **dexxer difficulty for new players**: A dexxer (melee) is a hard starting path for new players because of low accuracy and no links, unless the character is a bard, while a tamer is much easier at the start. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553770787205546136)
- **discord verification for trade chat**: Type !verify in Discord to see the instructions for becoming a verified player, which is required to use trade chat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541541085619298375)
- **dungeon item identification**: Players bring an item identification wand and a sewing kit into dungeons to identify items as they go and recycle unwanted ones; scripts exist that use the wand to identify everything, recycle bad items and keep decent ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532418904553689269)
- **early game progression speed**: Early progression is slow for every template until codices and aspect are leveled up somewhat; joining a guild and going on its boss runs is close to power leveling for codex points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767142412025927)
- **early pvm strength by template**: Summoners and tamers have an easier early PvM game because their pets or minions tank, while dexers are stronger later in the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547616536850604092)
- **echo command for viewing skills**: Type [echo in game to print your character's skills and build, which is useful for posting when asking for support. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550147328470679613)
- **enabling skill gain messages**: To turn on skill gain messages, click your character and select the show skill gain option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537241771514527907)
- **enabling the counters bar**: To enable the counters bar, open Paperdoll > Options > Counters, check enable counters, and press apply. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531131182727692288)
- **fencing and parry codices**: Fencing and Parry codices are player-made and cannot be bought from NPCs on Shelter Island; the new player quest gives the first codex for free. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532412204949700670)
- **first character runetome unique hue**: The first character on an account receives a runetome with a unique hue that cannot be recovered if lost, though other first-character items can be bought later. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534598087069401099)
- **free mounts at shelter fountain**: Breeders hand out free mounts to new players at the shelter fountain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529246904095997963)
- **gathering on shelter island**: Shelter Island has no PKs, but gathering there yields fewer boards and ingots than elsewhere, and it can only be mined for a limited time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549603464970109010)
- **gear importance**: Gear is cheap and not very important in Outlands, with no best-in-slot weapons, and it is lost on death, so treat it as ammo and only invest in what you can afford to lose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548163549115846747)
- **gear loss on death**: Gear is lost on death in Outlands, so players should treat gear as consumable, keep replacement gear in grab-and-go bags, and not carry what they cannot afford to lose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529224306037358714)
- **getting unstuck**: Use Help > In-Game Assistance > I'm Stuck to be sent to town within 1-2 minutes; usage is limited to about once or twice a day. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518959371587665)
- **invest-a-gator quest**: The invest-a-gator quest requires using the quest-provided tool on alligators and then killing them; plain kills do not count, and you must return to the quest giver to complete it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522413534296801321)
- **item insurance and loss on death**: Outlands has no item insurance, so most items can be taken from a player on death in PvP or dungeons unless they are blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529286710431711313)
- **item theft while idling in prev**: Idling in Prev can result in items such as shepherd's crooks, lockpicks and trap removal tools being stolen, so avoid leaving the character idle there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521323247654666270)
- **joining an active guild**: Joining an active guild unlocks many options and noticeably speeds up leveling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531176299358584893)
- **journal hotkey**: Press Alt+J to open the journal, which keeps a scrollable history of chat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525585388926669053)
- **knight in new player dungeon**: The knight in the new player dungeon is a real player, not an NPC or bot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552039767879852136)
- **learning harvesting maps**: To learn how harvesting maps work, buy a Dullwood map and run it, since one run answers most questions; maps can also be tried on the test server. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555186732662788237)
- **learning new spells**: To learn a spell you do not have, buy its scroll from an NPC mage vendor and drop the scroll onto your spellbook to add the spell. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552045973834961007)
- **leaving shelter island**: To leave Shelter Island, use the gate at the top right of the island, or alternatively take the boat at the docks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537544679170637934)
- **let's ride quest mount reward**: The Let's Ride beginner quest mount reward is not locked to a specific character; it can be claimed on any character and transferred between characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555779269148545155)
- **lycaeum orientation quest gating**: The Lycaeum orientation quest gates all other Lycaeum quests except the one at the gate in Prev and the NPQs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529820354758049872)
- **lycaeum orientation quest signs**: The Lycaeum orientation quest requires finding about 22 office signs scattered across the entire Lycaeum area on multiple levels, including the zoo. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529819869422420079)
- **magic item identification**: Magic items must be identified before their properties are visible; unidentified items show as 'unidentified' when clicked. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532813778238832883)
- **melee dexxer difficulty**: Melee dexxer templates are among the harder beginner templates because they start slow with low damage and are tougher at lower Aspect/Link levels. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544128330050183238)
- **mining tool vendor**: Mining and other crafting tools can be bought from the Provisioner NPC in town; the Tinkerer is a possible alternative for mining equipment. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525609617776709773)
- **missing template menu on new character**: If the initial template menu does not appear on a fresh character and you cannot move, relogging fixes it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554101194727886848)
- **necromancer summoner starter build**: A caster/summoner necromancer (Death aspect, 120 Scribe, Spirit Speak, Necromancy) gets about half its damage from spells and half from summons, farms well, and is considered a good starter build. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327566041255936)
- **new character starting items**: New characters start with a bag containing another bag with bandages but with no gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564842347667510)
- **new player aspect kit wrong unlock**: A charge from the new player reward aspect kit that was used to unlock the wrong aspect cannot be undone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549571025677717575)
- **new player dungeon ankhs**: Ankhs in the new player dungeon resurrect you, when approached or double-clicked; elsewhere resurrection requires another player or a healer, and a healer NPC building sits just south of the main dungeon entrance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919982645706784)
- **new player dungeon quest**: A quest outside the new player dungeon requires killing 2500 gold worth of monsters in that dungeon. Monsters there drop little gold, so the quest mainly introduces players to combat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525600000900464820)
- **new player fishing guides**: The noobcruise YouTube video 'Minimum Viable Pooner' shows a new player how to go from shelter to making money fishing on a boat, and Sir Shrimpington's 'Complete Fishing Guide' also covers fishing in Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531304736782028840)
- **new player gear versus experience**: For new players, experience such as the codex matters more than gear, and they should not farm with gear they cannot afford to lose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536086078887301192)
- **new player progression**: New players should do the new player quests to learn mechanics, train skills to 80 in the new player dungeon, then leave the starting island and explore elsewhere. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546630461512618044)
- **new player quest aspect kit**: The New Player Quests give an Aspect Kit containing free Aspect Unlocks, including one for the Harvest aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552378351732269068)
- **new player quest eligibility**: New player quests are available only to characters who have made less than 5 million gold in total. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532562916350365907)
- **new player quest link reward**: The new player quests reward a random link plus an item (a reforge kit) that can be used to reforge it into the link you want. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541323966507913216)
- **new player quest reward value**: The new player quests give a one-time reward of items worth roughly 1.5M to 2M gold in total. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539596059259703347)
- **new player quest rewards**: The Shelter Island new player quests give rewards such as a tome after the first quest, along with aspects and codexes, which you need to progress your character after Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554252892679053344)
- **new player quest unlocking and limits**: Multiple new player quests can reportedly be unlocked at once, though quests from the same questgiver follow a fixed order, and each quest can be completed only once per player across all your accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538639178324250706)
- **new player quests**: Players with an Outlands ID under 5 million can do one-time new player quests: the runetome quest must be accepted on Shelter Island, and the later quests in Prevalia give a free horse, a codex, chain, aspect starter kit, and a link with its tool. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545718250271277116)
- **new player quests and shelter return**: New player quests, including the starter runebook, are only available once per account ID, but you can return to Shelter Island through a town moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522345463599071292)
- **new player quests and tome**: New player quests exist, and a New Player Tome is available from Noobert by the docks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528024518998888548)
- **new player smithy setup**: Building a smithy to craft your own items is very challenging and expensive for a new player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541174780441526454)
- **new player starting content**: New players should do the new player quests in Prevalia and the beginner dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524647935563010150)
- **new tailor starting tools**: A new tailor starts with scissors only, which cannot be used on leather, so sewing kits must be bought to craft with leather. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528952896434212986)
- **newbie dungeon duration and gold**: The newbie dungeon takes roughly one to three hours to play through, depending on prior UO knowledge, and is a safe way to earn starter gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549669461617934397)
- **newbie-friendly guild leveling**: Joining a newbie-friendly guild or teaming up with other players significantly speeds up early leveling, since guildmates can farm with you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767195176247448)
- **next dungeon after shelter island**: After leaving Shelter Island, new players are commonly advised to go next to the Prevalia Sewers or the Bluffs as their first dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550136041497694230)
- **non-sanctuary dungeon pvp danger**: Any non-sanctuary dungeon will have players who want to kill you, and red players do enter dungeons to attack others, so always know where the nearest moongate is. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532746239567859884)
- **obtaining spellbooks and scrolls**: A spellbook can be obtained through a player trade or by buying one from a player vendor, and spell scrolls bought from NPC vendors can be placed into a spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537246415804170350)
- **opening multiple clients**: To play several accounts at once, launch the client again (click Play in the running launcher a second or third time); each launch opens a new login screen where you pick another account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329742605226026)
- **opening the aspect window**: Open the aspects window by double clicking the star of David above your head in your paperdoll, then use the arrows to toggle between aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527674603621843084)
- **orientation quest signs**: The Orientation quest requires finding all the signs, and players commonly find locating the last sign tedious. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529046424535175168)
- **outlands information sources**: Most Outlands mechanics are not explained in game, so players should use the Outlands wiki, Discord or community questions rather than general web searches. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534606050156609637)
- **outlands portal login**: Log into the Outlands Portal using the same credentials (your OutlandsID) that you use to log into the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547797306953171015)
- **paying trainer npc**: To pay a trainer NPC, drag the coins onto the NPC or drop them on his nameplate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019244339466363)
- **permanent character mistakes**: There are no permanently wrong choices you can make with a character or account in Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534596631540928708)
- **player killers in shelter**: Players cannot be killed by player killers in Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549593435445530740)
- **profane character names**: Profane character names are not allowed; the devs decide which words count as profane, and offensive names can be reported. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555635403472637993)
- **progressive spawn list**: No official list of progressive spawns exists; the !earlyspots map marks some of them, though some may have changed since the maps were last updated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546989605146857522)
- **pvm templates**: Any template listed on the Outlands wiki works fine for standard PvM, so chasing the highest DPS is unnecessary, but PvP templates do not translate well to PvM because PvM systems like aspects do not work in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525863380060209253)
- **pvm vs pvp build focus**: Outlands PvM is deeper than OSI, with several progression systems (about four post-skill XP systems that take a long time to progress), so PvM builds are focused and usually not good for general PvP, while a PvP character can be mostly ready within a few days. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530308201214509077)
- **pvp accessibility**: PvP in Outlands is designed to be accessible and does not require investing in aspects or codices, and players who avoid PvP can still enjoy the game, often by escaping when PKs appear. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528160781290438857)
- **reagent sellers in the mage shop**: Not every NPC in the mage shop sells reagents: scribes sell none, healers sell only some (healing reagents), and actual mages sell the full set. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546863048738869258)
- **recommended game window size**: A game window of roughly 1000x1000 (for example 1200x1006) shows the full visual range while leaving room for other UI elements. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531199697270607974)
- **recommended new player template**: Tamer is recommended over Wrestler or Summoner for a new player to grind links and level aspect quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528452874885922929)
- **recovering an off-screen gump**: If the counter bar or another gump is off-screen, open Options > Window Manager, find counterbargump and press its reset icon, or use the move all gumps on screen option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531131448138928340)
- **renaming pets**: Hold ctrl+alt while clicking a pet's healthbar to rename it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528480480066797568)
- **renouncing young status on shelter**: Renouncing young status means you can no longer gather lumber and ingots on Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525563808150585374)
- **replacement spellstone**: A new spellstone cannot be obtained once the starting spellstone has been used up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521438114319564820)
- **resurrection outside the new player dungeon**: Outside the new player dungeon there are no ankhs to resurrect at; you must find a healer in a town, or a wandering healer often near dungeon entrances, or have another player resurrect you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544920112706879548)
- **returning to starting area**: Players can return to the starting area after leaving it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520976197239181503)
- **riding a mount**: To ride a mount, turn war mode off with the Tab key and then double click the mount; in war mode, clicking it attacks it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546527894296334416)
- **runebook vs runetome**: The runebook and the runetome (from new player quests) are different items with different interfaces. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527321477895028739)
- **sanctuary dungeon difficulty**: Sanctuary dungeons are a new-player preference rather than a difficulty measure and likely do not scale monsters down, and they do not overlap with Challenge dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075462736486463)
- **scavenger character account setup**: A scavenger character may be kept on a separate account from the main adventuring character depending on what you do simultaneously, with aspects and chain used on the PvE account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522835897127538828)
- **scavenger character purpose**: A scavenger character exists to loot gold, gear and skins left behind in dungeons rather than to deal damage, and it is a time-effective way for new players to make money for their other characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525177361522360432)
- **scorpions in new player dungeon**: Scorpions in the new player dungeon can poison players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524978466099957800)
- **second account uses**: Second or third accounts are commonly used for society crafters, PvP characters, gatherers/harvesters, utility characters such as a bless bot, and a tamer holding extra pets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521626718400675920)
- **server update method**: Server updates are applied through the launcher's verify function. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530336145362260108)
- **shelter island duel pit and pvp outside shelter**: Shelter Island has a duel pit for practicing PvP, and PvP also exists outside Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535289291012313099)
- **shelter island dungeon paladin**: A paladin stands at the front of the Shelter Island dungeon by the blacksmith and taunts mobs that try to come further in. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534916558059733123)
- **shelter island golden tome**: The golden tome from the first Shelter Island quest is a blessed rune tome that is not exclusive and can be obtained otherwise, though it is expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525166477987156058)
- **shelter island leaving advice**: New players should get their skills to 80 on Shelter Island, which has only one new-player quest, and then leave for Prevalia, where further quests are available. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549849736851492975)
- **shelter island mage shop restock**: Shelter Island mage shop NPCs that sell out of reagents restock every 15-30 minutes, and only young players can buy from Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546862897064452287)
- **shelter island pvp restrictions**: Players on Shelter Island cannot attack, fight, or loot other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531171406887387209)
- **shelter island resource penalty**: On shelter island all resources gathered are halved, and everything you do there is reduced except skill gain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550135600223355002)
- **shelter island spellstone death behavior**: The spellstone received on Shelter Island is not blessed, so it is kept when leaving the island but can be lost on death. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527131745508524093)
- **shelter npc vendor restrictions**: In Shelter, players who are no longer Young cannot buy from NPC vendors; the NPCs only let them buy skills up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763146180333568)
- **skill cap on beginner's island**: Skills, including Magery, are capped at 80 on Beginner's Island (the new player dungeon), so a player must leave the island to train further. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554147833928749126)
- **skill training and respeccing**: Skill training and re-speccing in Outlands are fast and easy, so choosing the wrong skills is not a permanent problem. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555981324245012582)
- **society progression order**: Players typically start with monster hunter societies and then move on to crafting societies (tailoring, inscription, then alchemy), with tailoring the cheapest to train and alchemy the most expensive; most players keep a crafter with tailoring, alchemy and inscription on each account and use a main PVM character for hunter/adventure societies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553762025291644959)
- **spell icon buttons**: Drag spells from your spellbook onto the screen to create spell icon buttons; to cast, click the button and then click your target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525601146759155834)
- **spell reagents**: Casting spells requires reagents, which differ by spell and can be anywhere in your bag, unless you use a spellstone with charges; red on-screen text indicates missing reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532814890329444463)
- **spellbook requirement for casting**: Casting a spell requires having it in your spellbook along with the required skill and reagents, so a mage needs a spellbook to cast and farm. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550695509558038630)
- **spellstone binding**: Spellstones are bound to the character, cannot be transferred or acquired otherwise, and are given to new characters for training in the new player dungeon; a new character gets a new one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522374445635866685)
- **standard skill template**: A typical template uses seven skills at 100 each (700 total skill points), and a finished template should aim for 100 Strength, 100 Intelligence and 25 Dexterity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925129480601620)
- **standard skills gump toggle**: Open Options > General > Gumps & Context and toggle 'Use standard skills gump'; deselecting it gives an easier-to-read skills gump without categories, and enabling it restores the standard gump. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548492642751479950)
- **starter island quest requirement**: Only one quest is required to complete the starter island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525541979533086780)
- **starter island tool vendors**: Pickaxes are sold by the Provisioner NPC on the starter island, and tinkerers also sell tools. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525531618742374491)
- **starter island vendor directions**: On the starter island, take the path west from the main plaza and the house straight ahead is the mage's; healers are further north and battle trainers further south. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545198218219094057)
- **starter island vendors**: The starter island has a mage shop with a mage vendor and an alchemist, who sells healing potions and reagents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197987997683722)
- **starter template reroll**: A new character can reroll their starter template once for free at the statue in front of the spawn point, including starting with all skills at 60. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589784794632225)
- **starting gold and inn room rent**: The starting 10k gold is enough to rent the smallest inn room for about 2 real-time weeks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525627581594861578)
- **stat icon order in ui**: The stat icons below the bars, with values beside them, are ordered strength, dexterity, intelligence, and the center juggling-hand icon is dexterity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526231136748175481)
- **stat point allocation**: Characters get 225 stat points with a cap of 100 per stat, so 25 is the lowest value to set for any stat, and an intelligence of 25 is recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553577869144494081)
- **stopping attack with war mode toggle**: To stop attacking a target, press Tab to toggle between war mode and peace mode; another hotkey such as the mouse wheel can be bound to the same toggle. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919776814702662)
- **stopping continuous running after releasing right mouse button**: To stop the character from continuing to run after you release the right mouse button, change the relevant setting under Options > Experimental. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547216105632964728)
- **summoner versus arcane mage for new players**: Summoner is an easier mage start than arcane mage, and is probably the better build to run until about 10 links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552683306879815832)
- **tamer as beginner class**: Tamer is widely considered the easiest and best class for beginners, especially at lower link counts, and even mediocre players can do well with it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537550568158134292)
- **tamer build dominance**: Many players consider tamer the dominant build on Outlands, and its price of entry is steep. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546670190287126538)
- **test server login confusion**: Players can accidentally log into the Outlands test server and mistakenly think the main server is dead or empty, so they should check which server they connected to. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530928024793387080)
- **testing cosmetics on test server**: To see how items occupy equipment layers, check the wardrobe on the Test server before spending large sums of gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529884986516439110)
- **theft protection on shelter island**: Items can be stolen from a backpack in Prevalia but not on Shelter Island, so trades should be done on Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526672710233489569)
- **toggling always run**: To toggle Always Run, open the in-game options and go to the General page, where it is the first option at the top. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526002116530012331)
- **town tailor npc inventory**: Tailor NPCs in town sell cheap clothing items that can be worn over your actual armor for appearance, along with basic dyes and a dye tub. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521509473414414499)
- **training credits for npc trainers**: Training credits can be dragged onto starter isle NPC trainers to pay for training instead of gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545338739381895278)
- **training dummy skill gain bonus area**: The training dummy skill gain bonus applies only inside the new player dungeon, not across all of Shelter Isle. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536421696192647280)
- **training skills in shelter before leaving**: New characters should train their non-craft skills (including all except Lumberjacking) to 80 in the Shelter dungeon before leaving Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549658898372239414)
- **unstick character**: If your character is stuck, for example on an island, open Options > Help > In-Game Help and choose 'Character is stuck' to be sent to town; there is a cooldown before you can use it again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549236036926840843)
- **uo outlands shard description**: UO Outlands is a heavily modded custom shard with a hand crafted map and a mix of T2A and UOR mechanics, run by a small company and developer team. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551267834678480928)
- **useful hotkey setup**: Bind Last Object, Last Skill, Last Spell, Last Target and Target Self, plus a target-cycling hotkey that sets the chosen mob as Last Target and hotkeys for commonly used skills, spells and items, so the target reticle can be applied to either a target or yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549455207845339197)
- **viewing and locking stats**: To view and lock your stats, drag out your health bar and double-click it to expand it, press Alt+S, or click Status on the paperdoll. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529225139705741394)
- **viewing pets for sale**: To view pets for sale, use the buy option on the Creature Broker NPC located in the stable; the Creature Broker is not the stable master. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532942610883281077)
- **wilderness on bank dungeon board**: "Wilderness" on the bank dungeon board is not a dungeon; it means everywhere outside of dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526891925318144092)
- **wrestling meta status**: Wrestling is currently one of the meta-ish skills, and the Air wrestler build is great for new players because of its high attack speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553802850851889215)
- **young island harvesting and safety**: On the young island you harvest half the normal amount, but you cannot be killed by reds or have items stolen from you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531164211949080657)
- **young status and shelter island vendors**: Leaving Shelter Island to pick up the newbie quests in Prevalie renounces Young status, after which the player can no longer shop or bank on Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526039783074431066)
- **young status check and accidental loss**: Clicking yourself shows whether you still have the Young tag, and Young status can be lost accidentally while on Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537762588975177788)
- **young status loss effects**: When Young status ends you only lose access to NPCs for buying, selling and banking in the newbie town; you can still return to use the inn and the new player dungeon, which gives a skill gain bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554933497821536267)
- **25k dungeon slayer society quests for new players**: New players can always attempt the 25k dungeon slayer society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535618318873010258)
- **7x100 template as start of the grind**: In Outlands, reaching legendary skill levels is only part of character creation; the real grind begins once a character has a 7x100 skill template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522253870296727712)
- **accessing spells without the spellbook**: Spells can be used without opening the spellbook by clicking and dragging the spell icon out, creating Razor hotkeys for spells, or making in-game hotkeys and on-screen macro buttons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539462196537327647)
- **account character allocation**: The pvm character and most characters belong on the first account, crafters are useful on all three accounts, and the first account's pvm character can use echoes rather than a new character for each build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544664140801380444)
- **account or verification support**: Players with account or verification problems can submit a ticket so staff can look into the issue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604652807458960)
- **account password change**: The Outlands account password can reportedly be changed from the Outlands launcher landing page, before selecting an account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524439439101923338)
- **account password recovery**: Outlands accounts have a password recovery option; if it does not work, create a support ticket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534626017438728295)
- **account recovery**: To recover access to an account, open an Account Support ticket in the support channel with the account name, characters, last access time, IP and other identifying details, and do not post these details in public channels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536427154483576953)
- **account verification code**: The account verification code is sent only once, after the first Outlands ID is created, so players should keep it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604191027167235)
- **activating speech to avoid triggering abilities**: Press Enter to activate speech before typing so that the keys you type do not trigger abilities or spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534938460761100288)
- **adding runes to new player runetome**: After completing the new player quest and receiving a runetome, mark blank runes and add them to the book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527260223679627444)
- **affordable mace weapons for chivalry macing bard**: Affordable mace-type weapons for a chivalry/macing/bard character include gold, bronze or rose quarterstaff, blackstaff, gnarled staff and crook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522008152839557352)
- **age of shadows content**: UO Outlands does not include Age of Shadows content but has a large amount of newly added custom content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377363627540602)
- **air aspect as first aspect**: Air is a good first aspect because it is reasonably cheap and fun to play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521195810987970784)
- **air monk wrestling build**: A beginner Air monk wrestling build can disappear before a PK reaches the player, making it a fun starter character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545153785293447299)
- **always full screen client setting**: Most previously recommended must-have client options are now on by default, but Always Full Screen should still be turned off in Video Options so the black space around the game window can be used for UI layout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554826908313591819)
- **anti-pk guild alliances**: Several anti-PK guilds exist, including two main alliances: KoU-NEW-Sir-DTF-DOPE-MMx and Path-Bear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554457938569990255)
- **antivirus exception for connection problems**: New players with connection problems may fix them by adding an exception for the Outlands folder in their antivirus software. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550677329032904736)
- **apprentice status without aspect**: A character without an Aspect and with little Codex progress should still be considered an apprentice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533496038923571293)
- **arcane codex leech stance priority**: Leech stance is the recommended arcane codex power to max first when starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549192413870821498)
- **arcane mage starting archetype speed**: Arcane mage is arguably the slowest starting archetype but is still very viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523005082071859352)
- **arcane magery youtube guide**: A YouTube video, 'Arcane Magery Guide for New Players', explains how to play the Arcane Mage in Outlands, covering starting skills and Arcane, Evaluating Intelligence, Focus, Inscription, Magery, Meditation and Resisting Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523000959616418015)
- **arcane template difficulty**: Arcane is a more involved template than others, so new players may want to postpone it until they are up to speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546772285317451816)
- **archer tamer pvm starting path**: Archer Tamer is probably one of the safest and easiest PvM paths for new players to start with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548055624779309139)
- **areas after the newbie dungeon**: Uruk'ton, the Sewers and the Ratman Hovel are the next areas after the newbie dungeon and serve as a 'newbie 2.0' for raising skills to 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524465558475767878)
- **armorer npc locations**: Armorer NPCs sell basic armor and are usually found with or near the Blacksmithing NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527341961680392355)
- **aspect and codex gains on shelter island**: No Aspect or Codex gains can be earned on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542265140672602204)
- **aspect bundle vs codex starter kit**: The aspect bundle lets a player choose 3 aspects while the codex starter kit gives only one codex; the bundle is reportedly usable by any character within the same OutlandsID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545823351547633745)
- **aspect mastery system for returning pvm players**: Returning players doing PvM should first learn the aspect mastery system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524862454411300944)
- **aspect quest after codex quest**: Aspect is the next quest in the new player quest chain after the codex quest, and it greatly increases overall character strength. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547613733847699477)
- **aspect xp focus**: Working only one aspect at the start directs all aspect xp into that one aspect, so leveling a single aspect first is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529640318356684971)
- **aspects and dungeon progression**: Unlocking aspects makes a character much tougher, and players are advised to move on to dungeons once aspects are unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535362358484930622)
- **aspects importance**: In Outlands, reaching GM in skills is only the beginning, and a character cannot do much without an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535159659969781880)
- **attacker behavior toward targets**: Players intent on murder or theft usually will not inspect a target's gear or ask questions before attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537968536583020604)
- **attacking a creature with warmode**: Press Tab to toggle warmode, then double left-click a creature to attack it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545751555817349160)
