- **attacking a mob**: After entering combat mode, double click the mob to attack it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530702253546279095)
- **auto item descriptions on hover**: To show item descriptions automatically on hover, open Options and go to the Tooltip tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525068493874135080)
- **avoiding pks**: PKs are easily avoided with a handful of hotkeys and a little practice, and most players can learn to escape most of the time within hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549446720746819695)
- **avoiding thieves in town**: Keep valuable items in your inn room or house and recall to Shelter Island directly from the inn, so you avoid carrying valuables through town where they can be stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526673666878865420)
- **backstabber leveling spots**: The Prevalia sewers is an alternative to the Urukton Bluffs orcs for new backstabbers and may be easier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531520153756504165)
- **banking frequency rule of thumb**: Bank whenever your backpack holds more than you would be upset to lose, since many small banking trips are better than losing one big haul. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525495075927494896)
- **banking items to avoid death loss**: Stashing most of your items in the bank keeps you from losing everything when you die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524979625913221141)
- **banking items to avoid pk loss**: Bank items often, because anything not in your bank box can be lost to PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522723098493976646)
- **banking valuables before battle trainers**: Players should bank anything of value before going to the battle trainers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529242115664511170)
- **bard build for new players**: Bard is a fairly safe build choice for a new player, though monster resistance to Barding can make peacemaking fail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554911312109379696)
- **bard class difficulty and gear risk**: Bard is easy to play, and with skills capped and only NPC-bought gear it can farm level 1-2 monsters, so losing that gear to a PK costs little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546828498998398996)
- **bard skills for new player high-end content**: Adding bard skills trained only to 80 is claimed to be the fastest way for a new player to reach high-end content, because the buffs and the codex make up for what is lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539102146253815859)
- **battle trainer locations**: Guilds may have a battle trainer, and another battle trainer is reportedly near the Prevalia moongate; dummies are used for training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543221782872461312)
- **beginner friendly starting builds**: Most players start with a beginner-friendly build whose skills are easy and cheap to train and effective at farming gold to support crafting characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554286957297672273)
- **beginner quests**: The beginner quests can be done only once per player; they are not hard and are completed sequentially. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546773502902800384)
- **beginner training credit item appearance**: The beginner training credit item appears as an unrolled scroll in your bag, and single-clicking any item tells you what it is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544972590018465882)
- **beginner training credits and starting skill**: Beginner training credits (deeds or cash gold) only buy 50 skill points at 500 gp per 50 points from NPCs, while a custom template lets a character start with 60 skill; deeds matter less since the new template creation menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544976241004642354)
- **beginner-friendly towns**: Prevalia, Andaria, Cambria and similar towns are usually the most reachable for brand new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294435242647622)
- **best dps for new player at 7 links**: With 7 links, a tamer is the best DPS available to a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538515608264777809)
- **best mount**: The green ostard is considered the best mount across all 7 continents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534350322028515529)
- **bestiaries**: Bestiaries are player-crafted; one is given free for completing the new player quest chain, and afterward they must be bought. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543610252350722158)
- **birds of paradise near kraul hive**: Birds of paradise spawn right outside Kraul Hive near the Witcher rune 325 location and can kill a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553866905155276893)
- **blacksmith npc weapon sales**: Blacksmith NPCs in town sell weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547900107704377435)
- **blessed doublet at character creation**: A blessed doublet may be obtainable at character creation depending on the chosen skill combination, but the exact combination is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533400824397566113)
- **blessed items on new characters**: Apart from the clothes a brand new character receives, nothing comes blessed, so a stack of disposable clothes is the cheapest option until you can afford clothing bless deeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547295378494464011)
- **blessed runetome replacement cost**: If the first character is deleted, replacing a blessed runetome is fairly expensive for a new player early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534598262852554876)
- **blocking spamming players**: To block spamming players, open in-game options, go to the ignore list, add the players, and click apply so the changes take effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550485765031600191)
- **bonding a horse**: A horse becomes bonded once it is leveled to level 1; any horse works, whether bought from a stablemaster or tamed in the wild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532371205359665252)
- **bonding pets in newbie dungeon**: Pets can be bonded in the newbie dungeon in a couple of minutes, which is about as safe as bonding gets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555966742847557633)
- **brigands near prevalia**: Brigands outside Prevalia are difficult for weak characters, so the sanctuary dungeons are a suggested alternative for early training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552858871750729781)
- **build choice at 32 links**: At 32 links almost any build works well, so build choice becomes a matter of preference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538521988828758118)
- **built-in templates for starting**: The built-in templates are optimized well enough to start with, and specialization only matters in the late game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534565057952874661)
- **buying id wands**: ID wands can be bought from vendor backpacks outside Prevalia or found via the Outlands Portal vendor search tool, though the exact name and locations are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548718661546676377)
- **buying reagents from smuggler npcs**: Buying reagents from Smuggler NPCs as commodities avoids the problem of items falling to the ground, unless you buy extremely large amounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541034279105077279)
- **buying reagents with a pack ox**: If you cannot target your pack ox when buying reagents, place a container in the ox's pack and target that container so items do not fall to the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541032908490276907)
- **buying supplies from starter island**: To buy supplies from the starter island, take the moongate on the north east side of the island to another town, buy what you need, then return to the island to continue training skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763146180333568)
- **captcha entry**: To pass the captcha, type only the 3 numbers shown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525493751722541107)
- **casting without reagents**: A new mage who lacks reagents but still has the starting spell stone can cast spells without reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532968766021959842)
- **changing skills**: Changing skills later in the game is very easy, so players cannot permanently ruin their skill choices, though investment in an Aspect may need to be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546772439998922772)
- **character creation choices**: At character creation only the name really matters, because skills can be retrained quickly and for free (or by paying 500 gold to have NPCs train to 50), while name and gender can be changed later for a notable amount of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551648436137365606)
- **character creation skill choice for spellbooks**: Picking Necromancy or Chivalry at character creation makes it easier to obtain the spellbook for that skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551316657149059213)
- **character creation template options**: The character creation screen offers both premade and custom templates, switchable with the arrows left and right of the center image. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520719462787973131)
- **character deletion policy**: Deleted characters are not restored on Outlands; a 7-day wait applies before a character can be deleted and a confirmation must be typed in first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526239897390813254)
- **character name rules**: Character names can be anything as long as the first letter is capitalized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544743637295042570)
- **character progression order**: Character progression is commonly described as proceeding in the order Skills, then Codices, then Aspects, then Mastery Chain, then Redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523438914273149060)
- **chat prefixes**: Chat prefixes are / for party, \ for guild, and | for alliance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532105174699606128)
- **chatgpt build advice reliability**: ChatGPT is unreliable for Ultima Online Outlands build advice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555287732174061581)
- **checking a spellbook is blessed**: Click the spellbook that holds your spells and confirm it shows [blessed], meaning it cannot be stolen or dropped on death; you can still trade it or deliberately put it on the ground or in a box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527406962747113564)
- **checking gold balance**: To check your gold balance, say 'balance' near a bank teller. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527364191118168144)
- **checking leaderboards**: To check the leaderboards, open the paperdoll, then choose Help, then Server Rankings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548051505842495589)
- **checking young status**: Single-click your own character; if you still have Young status, '(Young)' appears next to your name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547532439260241950)
- **classicuo client**: ClassicUO (CUO) is the game client, the main game program used to play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530596463154036832)
- **classicuo log file location**: ClassicUO log files are in Program Files (x86)/Ultima Online Outlands/ClassicUO/Logs, are date and time stamped, and include a 'loading error' file when relevant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534629485339607173)
- **client verify to fix login**: In the Outlands client, click Verify at the top middle, let it finish, then click Play Now to log in; this often resolves login problems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540259018738503751)
- **closing gumps**: To close most gumps (windows), right-click them; if that does not work, alt-right-click. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526102090571714560)
- **codex acquisition**: The first codex is free through the new player quests; after that, codexes are crafted by players and can be found through the vendor portal at portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528754867273732178)
- **codex purchase order**: A new taming player should buy the Bestiary codex before the archery codex, since pets kill faster and earn the gold needed for the archery codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533146008987500767)
- **codex starter bundle contents**: The Codex Starter Bundle kit gives only one codex, chosen by the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543077414442237972)
- **codex use on shelter island**: Codices do not work on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552321721976229900)
- **command list**: Typing [commands shows the list of available commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777444811087924)
- **common pvm archetypes**: Common PvM archetypes include melee dexxer, melee backstab, dexxer tamer, melee bard, melee poison dexxer, necro summoner, mage tamer, necro poison summoner, and arcane mage with no summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529356665713852526)
- **common ui layout**: A common UI layout makes the game window smaller than the client window and places UI elements outside the game window instead of using the default full-size game window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525666498595782766)
- **connection failures and exitlag**: Using a VPN or connecting from certain countries commonly causes connection failures, and admins frequently suggest ExitLag as a workaround. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553879933439311883)
- **connection lost before character selection**: If the connection is lost before selecting a character, try adding an exception for the game folder in your antivirus software, though this may not resolve every case. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554603980137435161)
- **content after new player quests**: After the new player quests, further content includes the lycaeum and the time dungeon, and societies are somewhat like quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530320341627441184)
- **continuous bandaging macro**: To keep bandaging continuously, record a macro of the bandage action and loop it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541861505207898172)
- **copying client settings between characters**: To copy client settings and gump layout between accounts or characters, use the !profiles bot command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541337493356417064)
- **corpse looting on new player island**: On the new player island you cannot open any corpse unless you killed the creature, and this restriction does not apply elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540077258105159751)
- **cost of starting ship play**: Starting out with ships is difficult for new players and costs roughly 500k to 1m gold to get out there; joining a boating guild makes it easier to get hand-me-down boat gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523494615217606728)
- **counter bar purpose**: The counter bar is mainly designed to track item counts, and actions like drinking a healing potion are normally done with keybinds or macros rather than the bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531166446644629524)
- **counters bar restoration**: The counters bar can be restored in the client via Options > Counters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523846196307955853)
- **crafters for new players**: Crafters are not a good choice for new players because they cost a lot to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522402539050500167)
- **crafting cost for new players**: Crafting requirements are very high and crafting education is expensive, so new players are advised to buy tools rather than craft them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537053316826136606)
- **crafting skill gain in shelter**: Crafting skills do not gain faster in the New Player Dungeon or on Shelter, and recycling works the same inside or outside the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524921732966907976)
- **create food spell**: Create Food is the spell most players get first; it creates magic mushrooms that can be eaten for free mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554585795556548659)
- **creating a hotkey macro**: To create a hotkey, open Options, then Macros, then New Macro; assign the hotkey in the blank field at the top and fill in the macro actions below it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554552320027791422)
- **creature broker pet purchase**: Pets can likely be bought from the creature broker in the town stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539644549088153610)
- **creature brokers**: Creature broker NPCs, located near stables in nearly every town, sell tamed mounts at low prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525134098794938438)
- **customizing nameplates**: Press Alt+Shift to bring up a red menu, and customize or deactivate nameplates under Options -> Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535420139955159120)
- **dark nights setting**: To make it get dark at night and light during the day, enable the Dark Nights checkbox located below the light level setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527058526713937931)
- **dealing with pks**: The recommended way to deal with PKs is to play in groups or run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528214840647221299)
- **death in outlands**: Death is a normal occurrence in Outlands and players should not be overly upset when they die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531175523609346098)
- **death on tutorial island**: Dying on tutorial island causes loss of items if they cannot be retrieved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529171693648744620)
- **dedicated pvm and pvp characters**: Mixing skills for multiple playstyles makes a character average at both, so most players make a dedicated PvM character and a dedicated PvP character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555276354172489769)
- **default client mode**: The default client display mode is windowed mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534207466038886420)
- **default inventory macro**: Alt+I is likely the default macro to open your inventory, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544917253890379826)
- **default movement speed by cursor distance**: By default, the farther the cursor is from your character, the faster your character moves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526002116530012331)
- **defensive skill for chivalry warrior build**: A chivalry/warrior build needs a defensive skill such as parrying or alchemy, and parrying is recommended for a beginner with no aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543664542234579109)
- **deleting a character**: Wait one week after character creation, then hover over the character's name on the login or character selection screen and click the red X to delete it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496804214087771)
- **destination after shelter island**: After Shelter Island, players typically go to Prevalia, which has more newbie quests and all special NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525713053784608969)
- **dex tamer weapon skill training after shelter**: After leaving the shelter, a dex tamer goes to the previous moongate and uses the trainer there to level up weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530733190430330890)
- **dexxer starter template skills**: For the standard dexxer starter template, Swords determines chance to hit and should be raised to at least 100 early on, and chivalry should be used with the Divine Fury ability while fighting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548768853977342134)
- **differences from osi**: Outlands differs substantially from OSI Ultima Online, and most of what returning players remember beyond basic interactions will be different. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545243658016657479)
- **disabling fullscreen game window**: To make the game window not fullscreen, go to Options > Video > World Viewport and turn off 'Always use fullsize game window'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524527807856640142)
- **disabling right+left click automove**: To disable Right+Left Click Automove in the Outlands client, go to Options > Experimental > Disable default UO hotkeys and enable Disable Right+Left Click Automove. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531813720055873719)
- **discord guild recruitment channel**: The Discord guild recruitment channel lists guilds seeking new players, with information about each guild and often links to their open Discords. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547183809357676565)
- **display scale setting**: Adjust the interface scale in Options > Video, using the setting called Display Scale (listed under General in the latest description). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537262456169041960)
- **double-click and drag interaction**: Much world and item interaction in Outlands, including equipping gear, is done by double-click or left-click-and-drag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547565244744736879)
- **dropped world atlas**: Dropping the World Atlas on the floor causes it to be deleted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538321827758219314)
- **dungeon entry requirements**: There is no minimum skill requirement to enter a dungeon; players choose when to progress based on their own comfort with the mobs' difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520507469741293730)
- **dungeon progression chart**: The dungeon progression chart is a general guideline, and different builds excel in different places or progress faster in different dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522263842481246362)
- **dungeon progression for new players**: Use the !dungeonpath command to see the dungeon progression path; newer players should start on Floor 1 of core dungeons that do not have a star next to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529477116964634655)
- **dungeon skill boost outside shelter island**: Outside Shelter Island, a skill boost in dungeons brings skills up to 80, which helps if you want to change skills later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534013621787557948)
- **dying in chaos shrine**: If you die in the Chaos Shrine, take a teleporter out of the shrine and revive at a healer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526975101390684222)
- **early armor choice**: For early armor, use what you loot or buy a copper plate suit; full plate is recommended over chain with plate arms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522008257630310541)
- **early armor choices**: Mastercrafted iron armor and basic leather armor are decent early gear choices, and leather is recommended if you use Meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548164917360721943)
- **early backstabber progression path**: An early backstabber's best path is to steal manually from monsters until having enough codex points to drop tactics and snooping, and possibly to scavenge enough to unlock the shadow aspect without the quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529911909531254824)
- **early backstabber pvm hunting grounds**: A backstabber wanting to PvM early should stay on the first floors of core dungeons, targeting low-armor, low-wrestling monsters that can be killed in one or two hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529911909531254824)
- **early bow upgrade**: Basic bows such as goldenwood are a good early upgrade and can typically be bought from player vendors for about 1500-2k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532655820200738928)
- **early chain link priority**: Chain links are expensive early on and their benefits are negligible until several chain slots are open, so leveling your aspect and buying quality-of-life items is a better early use of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520279368885080106)
- **early character hunting areas**: Early characters are advised to stick to the newbie dungeons, the sewers and the hovel rather than harder dungeons such as Aegis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524464338079977627)
- **early dungeon spots difficulty**: Early dungeon spots 2 and 3 on the dungeon path are less difficult than Ratman Hovel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531781535533891747)
- **early farming spot travel**: After leaving Shelter Island, you can reach early farming areas by using the corresponding Witcher Rune numbers to port directly to or close to the area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521286456319016980)
- **early fishing equipment**: Cheap fishing equipment is sufficient for the first few hours because little is caught at low fishing skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527312452201615522)
- **early funding and template advice**: Mining and Lumberjacking are suitable side jobs for gaining initial funds, and Paladin/Bard is an easy and powerful template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532111689275670670)
- **early game equipment needs**: Early on, vendor-bought equipment and plain crafted equipment such as plain iron or leather is generally enough to get by. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547267405250691133)
- **early game loot value**: During the early game most looted items are basically worthless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525607952269180938)
- **early game mage summoner advice**: A mage without summons can struggle early on, so a common suggestion is to play a summoner for meat shields until the post-skill XP systems are leveled, then switch to arcane. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546224563506126928)
- **early game skill cap**: In the early game a player cannot raise skills beyond 100 until they spend gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544740575943860264)
- **early game skill goal**: Early on, the main objective is to get all skills to 80 so you can progress to better areas and eventually finish the build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523004848155394068)
- **early game spending priorities**: Early game funds are better spent on the progression systems than on Item ID skill scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548451996414255226)
- **early gold from wood chopping**: A new character can earn gold by chopping wood and selling the boards; yields are lower on Shelter Island, so chop elsewhere for better returns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555948610095419496)
- **early gold sources**: Early gold can come from a simple combat money-maker template, or from focusing on lumberjacking or mining and selling commodities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540110984302305301)
- **early gold without monster killing**: Early gold without killing monsters can come from harvesting, lockpicking dungeon chests, or scavenging loot from other players' farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540122025027444756)
- **early hunting locations after shelter**: Good early hunting locations for new players after Shelter are Prevalia Sewers, Urukton Bluffs, and the Ratmen Hovel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545195963071602758)
- **early hunting spots urukton and ratman hovel**: Urukton and the Ratman Hovel are reported by one player as reasonable early-game hunting spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553535096550596639)
- **early hunting valley with 500g mobs**: A valley with 500g mobs is suitable for early characters, and the !earlyspots bot command lists early hunting spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533495557568463018)
- **early leveling at shelter dungeon**: To level up early, pick up the quest in front of the Shelter dungeon and kill monsters inside it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526109361146040330)
- **early leveling with treasure maps**: With 110 forensics and 90 cartography, a player can speed run early levels using tier 1-2 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539241818875756584)
- **early mastery link slotting**: Slotting mastery links early gives little noticeable power increase, so funds are better spent leveling your aspect, and active guilds regularly run activities that award links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546725696271945870)
- **early quest givers**: Quest givers (red NPCs) outside the new player dungeon offer quests that are very valuable early on and are a way to earn early gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567118906691704)
- **early scavenger priorities**: Early on, a scavenger is best used to secure Alchemy, Tailoring and Inscription, build a leather inventory for societies, and obtain strong boxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523771161945702604)
- **early skill training path**: Train skills to 80 in the newbie dungeon first, then after leaving Shelter Island macro skills at the zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341771890786385)
- **early training dungeons**: Ratman Hovel and the Prevalia sewers are sanctuary dungeons that are good early training spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526563636959510758)
- **easiest beginner template**: The gatherer is considered the easiest beginner template because it does not rely on damaging monsters to earn money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544128330050183238)
- **easiest society profit start**: The cheapest and easiest way to start earning society profit is to make a tailor and do the tailor society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528581847800614914)
- **echo item price for new players**: The echo item used to switch builds is expensive for a new player, who should buy other essentials first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545711889491955784)
- **echoes and new players**: Echoes are considered not to be new player content because many people make mistakes in them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539725750691823708)
- **eldritch summoner starter build**: The Eldritch summoner build is still considered a strong starter build in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542981814027812884)
- **equipping an item that will not equip**: If an item won't equip, try double-clicking it or dropping it in the black area of the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520802342440800367)
- **escaping wilderness after death**: If stuck in the wilderness after death, use the help function or wait for the 30-minute timeout to be ported back to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528070197771243612)
- **exceptional gear viability**: Almost every build works with exceptional gear, and roughly 2k worth of equipment can be earned back from about two enemies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526045122150797312)
- **expanded stats window**: Double clicking the resource bar opens an expanded stats window, and clicking the dash at the bottom right of that window returns it to the resource bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547569126250381332)
- **expo's shop location**: Expo's shop is located roughly in the center of the New Lyceum and lets players see what they can spend points on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526719146186768524)
- **factions system and character creation**: The factions system is optional organized PvP and does not affect how you create your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546698279989940334)
- **familiars in new player dungeon**: Familiars are available in the new player dungeon (near the necromancer on level 1) and are among the best pets to leave with; they are 1-slot pets that can be hard to keep alive, so a colossal frog serves as a decent tank for a while but won't get far. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535229171121389589)
- **farming low level dungeons at 80 skills**: Players commonly get their skills to 80 and then farm low level dungeons to continue progressing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544652172900433942)
- **farming templates**: Wrestler is a good melee template for farming, and tamer is a powerful template that is easy to play and level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545494360211202128)
- **field spells in new player dungeon**: Field spells such as poison field and fire field cannot be cast in the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522064429875990628)
- **finding skill training methods**: To find how to train a skill, open the wiki article for that skill and scroll to the bottom to read its training section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524486916047765705)
- **first cure potion**: The first cure potion drunk is free and is not consumed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535081655776321617)
- **first dungeon readiness**: Players are advised to try a proper dungeon once they can stealth around and hide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540079209307705496)
- **first gold farming spot after shelter island**: Prevalia Sewers (entrance inside Prevalia) is a convenient first gold-farming stop after Shelter Island, while Urukton Bluffs is a weaker alternative that resembles real dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525354189797068830)
- **first society crafters**: Tailoring, alchemy and inscription are good first society crafters, because getting the cheapest three to 100 skill carries a player a long way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546353981037617222)
- **first three aspects quest**: At level 1, completing the 50k gold farmed quest gives your first 3 aspects for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532464426995810354)
- **forensic evaluation income for new players**: New players can use Forensic Evaluation income to fund their own tailors to get into societies, and can also loot leather left behind by others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072681063612470)
- **forgot password button**: The game launcher may have a forgot password button for resetting an account password, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546539527940604065)
- **free atlas command**: Say [atlas to receive a free atlas containing cities, dungeons and points of interest, with an option to show a guiding arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521718601407664271)
- **free blessed runetome quest**: A quest rewards a free blessed runetome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527806663279509695)
- **free bonded mount quest**: After arriving in Prevalia, complete the quest there to receive a free bonded mount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539727667627167796)
- **free chivalry book for new players**: A free blessed Chivalry book can be obtained by creating a character on another account, choosing Chivalry at start, and trading the book over; otherwise it costs about 5k, and the new player quest can only be done once per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543213893772509266)
- **free codex token source**: A free codex token is given by the first big quest after leaving Shelter Island in the newbie quest chain; otherwise a summoner tome must be bought from a player vendor or crafted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526333106280468511)
- **free color control for gloves, neck and head**: Gloves, neck and head pieces have colour that can be controlled for free to start, and the remaining armor colour can be hidden by wearing a robe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521507510346055711)
- **free mastery necklace**: A free mastery necklace can be obtained from the new player quests, or a crafter can make one for you if you supply the materials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533672585391378452)
- **free necromancy book**: The necromancy book can be obtained for free by making a new temporary character instead of buying it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533822128498020434)
- **free rune tome quest reward**: The reward rune tome from the free rune tome quest is blessed, so it is not lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526158631752695808)
- **friends list and global chat**: The game has no in-game friends list or global chat, so players use Discord for that, and Razor friends only manage lists of targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479984870199421)
- **full screen setting for gumps**: New players are advised to turn off full screen mode so there is black space around the game window for placing gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530861058774925352)
- **game balance and builds**: Outlands is relatively balanced, so there is no overpowered build to be found on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534605940295471205)
- **game screen customization guides**: AreYouKidden's Outlands forum guides cover customizing the game screen, including the user interface, cooldowns and nameplates, and are retrievable via the bot command !customize. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538727473330520105)
- **gathering skill leveling time**: Gathering skills take a long time to level, so a new player should pick one gathering skill to start with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537620570559094794)
- **gathering starting template skills**: The gathering starting template is close to a useful gatherer skill set, covering skills such as lumberjacking, mining, tracking, detect hidden and camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537589649130782760)
- **gathering template selection**: When creating a new character you are prompted to choose a template; pick the gathering template if you want to be a gatherer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537587499944386592)
- **gear importance for new characters**: Gear gives only a minor bonus, so players are advised to invest in aspect and codex first, and looted gear is sufficient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539593649627598929)
- **gear progression**: Gear is not the main progression system in Outlands; it is more of a sidegrade, and the biggest damage increases come from other systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532655686503370803)
- **gear risk advice**: Players should carry only what they can afford to lose, and NPC gear may be fine for a while. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528701440149688412)
- **getting codices crafted in shelter**: After getting a codex, buy the needed materials and ask in the crafting channel for someone in Shelter who crafts for others, or buy from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552323227093565493)
- **global video scaling option**: The game has a global video scaling option for sizing the interface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554564878637858869)
- **gold dungeon versus challenger for new players**: For new players the gold dungeon is likely a better gold source than the challenger, because challenger mobs may take too long to kill to make the higher gold worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534585596884943070)
- **gold location for purchases**: Player vendor purchases are paid from gold in your bank, while you only need gold in your backpack to buy skills up to 50 from town trainers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532679804304887921)
- **grimoire new player reward**: Following the new player quest line lets you choose a grimoire as a reward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544918938972852294)
- **guild acceptance of new players**: Practically every guild accepts new players, and guilds can be found in the guild recruitment channel, though some small guilds do not want new members and do not post there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553222080676503704)
- **guild advice for crafting**: Joining a guild is recommended as the best way for new players to get through crafting hurdles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533148595144888521)
- **guild and group advertisements**: Guild and group advertisements appear in a dedicated advertisement channel on Discord and in-game in Shelter and Prevalia chat, where ad bots also post. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529284621471191140)
- **guild application requirements**: Most guilds do not require application forms; nearly every guild has an open Discord, and some just ask you to join voice chat for a talk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538103494655877222)
- **guild chat command**: To use guild chat in game, type a backslash (\) before your message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550766190681530409)
- **guild incentives to recruit newbies**: Game mechanics incentivize guilds to take on new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525715740370403418)
- **guild recruitment locations**: Guilds mostly recruit on Shelter Island and in a recruitment channel, and may approach players who are not wearing a guild tag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525716751088750594)
- **guild recruitment of new players**: Guilds benefit from new players' activities, so they are incentivised to recruit them, and most guilds are happy to help newbies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545203935055192175)
- **guild storage shelf gear**: Many big guilds keep a storage shelf full of gear that guild members can use for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550051369568833607)
- **gump terminology**: Game windows in Ultima Online are called gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526103182848032879)
- **hardest beginner template**: The mage is considered the hardest beginner template because of its reagent requirements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544128330050183238)
- **harvester and crafter roles**: A harvester character gathers raw materials such as boards or ingots, while a crafter character uses those materials to make items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634174045126687)
- **harvester definition**: A harvester is a character with Mining, Lumberjacking or both, typically in a mage summoner build, that makes money by selling ingots and boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535614805707333633)
- **hawaii ping suitability**: Playing from Hawaii gives acceptable ping for everything except PvP dueling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537040254027038781)
- **healer role in team pvp**: A new player in team PvP events can play a dedicated healer or support role and try to keep the team alive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899603814256720)
- **health bar position**: The health bar shown under characters cannot be moved above their head; alternatives are an info bar, a pull-out healthbar, or the status bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520504197840240682)
- **hiding pet names**: To hide pet names, open Options, go to Nameplates, and adjust the Own Followers selection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548107466196389960)
- **hiding training location for low skill**: Players with Hiding below 80 can train it in the entrance room of the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539347632164446250)
- **hoarding magic items while young**: While a character is still Young, strictly hoarding every magic item for essence extraction is not essential. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528105890186793142)
- **holy aspect for beginners**: The Holy aspect is popular with new players, while frost or lightning aspects are stronger late game but require more expensive cores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553013878521209015)
- **holy aspect for new players**: The Holy aspect is considered non-meta but is commonly recommended to new players for survivability while they learn the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536381918134804543)
- **holy parry swordsman equipment**: A Holy aspect parry swordsman build uses a long sword, a shield and full plate armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849041836474399)
- **hotbar rearranging**: To rearrange hotbar items, drag and drop them onto the desired slot; right-click a slot and choose remove to clear it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532799536316027141)
- **hotkey setup by skill**: Which hotkeys or macros to set up depends on the skills you use; for example, a character with Magery should set up spell hotkeys. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526577332255719575)
- **house purchase priority for new players**: A house is probably one of the last things a new player should buy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534551298400325823)
- **housing options for new players**: Finding open land for a house is highly unlikely, so new players are advised to use the Rental Room System, or to check the Real Estate Vendor NPC for houses for sale. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **i got stuck option**: The Help menu has an 'I got stuck' option that teleports you to town once per day, usable as an emergency escape when stuck, such as when dead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541713357562708018)
- **identifying and recycling beginner dungeon drops**: Magic items dropped in beginner dungeons such as Urukton Bluffs are worth identifying, and they can afterwards be recycled into essence using a sewing kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534990870095331509)
- **identifying new player template**: To identify which new player template you selected, check the TemplatesNewPlayer page on the Outlands wiki and find the template that matches your skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527101059015905350)
- **in-game item stat inspection**: Item stats, especially for weapons and armor, cannot be inspected in game, including vendor wares, so the wiki must be consulted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549838938263392289)
- **in-game private messaging**: There is no in-game private message; players communicate through distance-based chat and party, guild and alliance chats, and otherwise use Discord. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526649788043362506)
- **inn room rental vs house for new players**: New players are advised to rent an inn room rather than buy a house, and to spend gold on codices and materials to level the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534551490343997440)
- **island healers and help teleport**: There are almost always healers on islands; otherwise the help function can teleport you to town every 12 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533242734993997898)
- **item icon counters gump**: The gump showing item icons such as potion counts is enabled under Options > Counters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534652977833578616)
- **item names on single click**: Item names appear when you single click them, but this only works if you are in the 'all' chat tab rather than the combat tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524886616739549266)
- **items dropped in starter square**: Players sometimes drop items in the starter square for other players to take. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545304725396783166)
- **joining a guild**: To join a guild, DM the guild recruiter or join the Discord they link; guilds usually have an application process. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526109441991245894)
- **keeping pets alive while fighting**: To keep pets alive while they fight, stand next to them and heal them; the stationary vine-type mobs in the room with the frogs can be used for this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526159618214985859)
- **keeping young status in rented rooms**: To keep Young status when using a rented room, do not exit the room normally; instead use a Chiv/Moongate or Recall back to Shelter, unless the room was rented on Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866075402731520)
- **king's faire game types**: Most King's Faire games are idlers, and the mini-games with active gameplay do not require a developed character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540523102293856336)
- **launcher auto update issues**: Older versions of the launcher sometimes cannot auto update themselves; redownloading the launcher can help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533747130143998022)
- **launcher beta client toggle fix**: To possibly fix launcher issues, close the client, click the gear in the launcher and check beta client, click the gear again, then uncheck it to switch back; this is not guaranteed to work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534631328908316802)
- **launcher login service connection error**: A launcher message about being unable to connect to the login service can be caused by an SSL negotiation problem (System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException, error 0x80090302). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534628352751571017)
- **launcher not starting client**: If the Outlands launcher does not start the client, run the launcher as administrator and use the Verify button once to check the download. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538920337780248576)
- **launcher troubleshooting checklist**: For launcher problems, disable the Discord overlay and other overlay or hooking programs, launch via the Outlands desktop shortcut rather than an old launcher executable, ensure no other Outlands Launcher is running, check the launcher log, and check antivirus or Windows Defender. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538922823681056919)
- **launcher verify failure**: If the launcher verify fails, the patch server may have been down, so wait a while and try verifying again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544818726115876895)
- **learning boating on test server**: Players can learn boating on the test server by building a boat there, where grey players on the water are not a threat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536712199580680233)
- **leaving newbie island**: Leaving the newbie island only costs you the ability to interact with the island's NPC vendors; you can still return to train and use the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524890730873622608)
- **leaving newbie island**: New players should stay on the newbie island until they are comfortable with the game and their non-crafting, non-gathering skills are at 80; they can return to train later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525857091980624044)
- **leaving newbie island**: Leaving the newbie island early to explore is possible but makes things harder; the general advice is to leave soon after reaching 80 in all wanted skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529179502733824151)
- **leaving shelter island**: Leave Shelter Island when the skills for your build are at 80; melee characters then go to the Prevalia moongate and hit the trainer dummy until weapon tactics is 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528527765828014200)
- **leaving shelter island**: Leaving Shelter Island forfeits new player status, so the island's vendors can no longer be used, but you can still teleport back to the Shelter dungeon to train skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538206041605537813)
- **leaving shelter island penalty**: Leaving Shelter Island costs you bank and vendor access. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534013515361423542)
- **level 1 nusero difficulty**: Level 1 Nusero is not a sanctuary, but it is still fairly easy for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554128013044613121)
- **library quests for new players**: Many Outlands library quests are not new-player friendly because they require reaching areas with tough monsters, though a handful can be done by new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543303027291721728)
- **link xp on shelter island**: Link XP is not gained when killing creatures on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533562757365104791)
- **linking original uo accounts**: Accounts from the original (official) Ultima Online cannot be linked to Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525529384964849735)
- **linux support and wiki guide**: UO Outlands can be run on Linux, and the official wiki has an Install UO on Linux page covering setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551276374030033019)
- **listing commands in codex**: Type [commands to see a list of commands, including stance changes, in the Codex tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523459631438106807)
- **locating healers before danger**: Locate the closest healer on the map before entering a dangerous area so you can resurrect quickly if you die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532754929402511480)
- **lockpicker stealth template**: Lockpicker (stealth) is a popular template with a lot of competition, and stealth lets players learn dungeon layouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546771056579055637)
- **lockpicking shelter chests for gold**: A new player can earn gold by lockpicking Shelter Island dungeon chests with a newbie lockpicker character, at about 100 gold per chest, then use it to buy gear for killing low-level monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549667854444535839)
- **logging into the test server**: To log into the Test Server, open the launcher, click the cog icon, tick the beta client checkbox, let it patch, then log in, choose your character and select Test Server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527017547302699038)
- **lowering skills after template creation**: A skill can be set down after character creation, so a starting template with 8 skills can be reduced later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521446059329716326)
- **lutris installation method**: When using Lutris, do not use Lutris's built-in installer because its launcher is outdated; instead download the Outlands launcher and install it directly through Lutris using the latest Proton version. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551283166403371111)
- **lycaeum orientation quest purpose**: The Lycaeum orientation quest pushes players to use tools such as awareness and item nameplates/filtering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529820016697151508)
- **macer vs archer stabber for new players**: Being a macer is better for newer players than being an archer stabber. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550091172133871647)
- **mage difficulty for new players**: Mage is a hard path for newer players who have low links and aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545327111022055447)
- **mage reagent cost**: Reagent cost for a mage becomes a non-issue after the first couple of days, especially in a guild, since most guilds keep a shelf of reagents and gear for newbies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552319040939098283)
- **mage reagent cost**: Mage can be hard to level up early because of the gold needed to buy reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521448378058407976)
- **mage starting spellstone**: Creating a mage character grants a spellstone that allows many free casts, reportedly around 2500, though the exact number is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541132615300546580)
- **mage template cost for new players**: A mage template can be cost prohibitive for newer players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545088861024292864)
