- **magery spellbook**: A character with Magery should have a red magery spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282923610472569)
- **magery training in new player dungeon**: Magery can be raised in the new player dungeon, reached by returning to the Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533255548483407922)
- **magic item keep guidelines**: Magic items with vanquishing, power, invulnerability, fortification, exceedingly, or supremely in the name are generally worth keeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521966872893849730)
- **main character and echoes advice**: Players are advised to pick one character as their main and open echoes on that character rather than keeping multiple characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539004553121366017)
- **mana conservation via codex spells**: Mana can be conserved by casting more mana-efficient spells that have points in the arcane codex, such as lightning and harm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553927310384697476)
- **mandrake root visibility**: Mandrake Root can be hard to spot in the backpack, and the 0 shown next to 400 is not the root. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532967737473630420)
- **map enlarge gem**: If you place the map at the top left of the screen, you can quickly enlarge it by dragging the blue gem on its corner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535393689948528733)
- **map hotkey**: Alt+M is suggested as the hotkey for opening the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537547188597559317)
- **map layout**: UO Outlands uses a custom map and has no Trammel/Felucca split. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377686341754911)
- **marking a return rune near library gates**: A player with Magery can mark a rune at a spot near the library gates and put it in their starter rune tome for quick return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530366835336413367)
- **mausoleum floor 1 difficulty**: Mausoleum floor 1 has only slightly higher average mob difficulty than the New Player Dungeon, and several other first floors are about the same difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520507213511131136)
- **maxing strength first**: Strength is usually the stat players start with and stats are easy to raise, so maxing strength first is advised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524519363816980621)
- **melee dexxer starter template**: The melee dexxer starter template is a solid starting point for PvM melee characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529212942913114132)
- **mining advice for new players**: Traditional mining is the recommended way for new players to level Mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528213026304557136)
- **missing launcher play button**: If the launcher's Play button is missing, antivirus software may be the cause; add antivirus exceptions for the launcher and run it as administrator. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541739848409419786)
- **monster hunting society start**: To start with the Monster Hunting Society, go to the Societies hall in Prevalia and accept jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553852907802067056)
- **monster slaying job locations**: The monster slaying job NPC does not tell you where to find the target monsters; you can look them up with Outlands Butler or Explore Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554865127562682451)
- **monster societies for new players**: Monster societies can be frustrating for new players who are not big farmers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524510568659030087)
- **moving the game window**: To move the game window, hold ALT and click and drag the window border. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525309821757165638)
- **multi-boxing rules**: Players should read the Outlands shard rules at https://uooutlands.com/rules/ before multi-boxing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521216793002246470)
- **nameplate display options**: Press Ctrl+Shift to choose which nameplate text is shown, and adjust each category in the in-game Options under Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545970673799794740)
- **necro vet herd grinding cost**: A necro vet herd build is cheap to grind: experimental leather, a regular bag and a potion bag are enough, and the shepherd's crook is the most expensive item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545301648900104212)
- **necromancer spellbook shortcut**: To avoid paying gold for a Necromancer spellbook, make a temporary character and hand the book over to your main. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527709176569135144)
- **new backstabber anatomy and healing setup**: Anatomy plus Healing gives a new backstabber room to learn the playstyle without dying much, and the author later swapped in Tracking after reaching tier 10 Shadow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541914463270080513)
- **new backstabber armor choice**: A new backstabber should wear regular vendor-bought platemail rather than expensive crafted armor, since new backstabbers die often and the money is better spent elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542997886365736980)
- **new bard progression**: A new bard should first run 80 peace and 80 discord, then raise alchemy to 80, or alternatively invest in 120 tribard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532067284196130926)
- **new boater ship sinkings**: New boaters on the ocean are likely to get their boat sunk several times at first, but sinkings become rare as the player learns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531381798452592681)
- **new character starting location**: Shelter is where new characters start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536003060411662398)
- **new gatherer route setup**: A new gatherer should buy an unmarked rune, start in a town, and mark their own mining route instead of using other players' runes, banking often and settling on a good route to stay safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533248377633116201)
- **new lycaeum orientation quest prerequisite**: The first New Lycaeum quest, the orientation quest involving finding signs, must be completed before the other quests can be started, and it has no time limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523699599435366462)
- **new lycaeum questing hub**: The New Lycaeum is the hub of the questing system and offers several quests that a new player can complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523702880857620743)
- **new lycaeum repeatable quests**: The New Lycaeum has easy repeatable quests that give a handful of goods every day or every few days, including a daily kill-X-gold-worth quest from the creature at the far east end of the zoo area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523703181631295629)
- **new lyceum daily quests**: New Lyceum has a few easy daily quests that give items, including one that gives a bag of reagents (reportedly about 50 of each, unconfirmed), which saves new players some gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545300285122154588)
- **new lyceum wilderness**: New Lyceum has a small stretch of wilderness with mobs and no player traffic, where new players can get used to fighting non-sanctuary mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545298407692836966)
- **new mage spell choice**: New mages are probably best served by low-tier offensive spells such as Lightning, Harm and Fireball. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554585934123769968)
- **new mage starting skills**: A new mage is advised to prioritize Resisting Spells over Inscription at the start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523002602382561413)
- **new mage starting spell stone**: New mages typically start with a spell stone that has a limited number of casts, allowing them to cast before they need reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535007272915304629)
- **new player apple quest**: To collect apples for the new player quest, find the cart of apples (not the individual apples on the ground) and use the quest item you were given on the cart. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553205419017642126)
- **new player aspect choice**: New players are advised to pick the same Aspect for both weapon and armor to start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529240685809500243)
- **new player bonus without young status**: Any skill can be raised to 80 with the new player bonus even after losing Young player status, though it is recommended to do so while still Young. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527099945482719282)
- **new player crafting society focus**: New players are advised to focus on alchemy and tailoring for crafting societies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529946327918575818)
- **new player dungeon access**: Young status is not required to use the new player dungeon, unlike for the NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529315382974873642)
- **new player dungeon afk players**: Many players in the new player dungeon are AFK or playing on another screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529224981005865102)
- **new player dungeon experience**: In the New Player Dungeon, the only experience allowed is level 0 pets earning XP up to level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538573765993308211)
- **new player dungeon experience and sanctuary status**: The New Player Dungeon gives no XP for most systems and no rare drops, while the early-game dungeons and the weekly rotating core dungeon are Sanctuary dungeons where criminal actions cannot be performed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159246869733460)
- **new player dungeon gathering penalty**: The New Player Dungeon area applies a 50% penalty to gathering skill gain, so gathering skills are better trained elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536165990587437146)
- **new player dungeon gold achievement**: Farming 1 million gold in the new player dungeon reportedly grants a hidden achievement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537477696013992066)
- **new player dungeon gold reduction**: Gold dropped by creatures in the New Player Dungeon is reduced to 75% of normal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526370408335671438)
- **new player dungeon layout**: The new player dungeon has 2 levels, and the stairs down are in the SE or NE corner of level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544152003767177338)
- **new player dungeon loot restrictions**: Special items (treasure maps, arcane scrolls) and rare items (mastercrafted diagrams, rare cloth) do not drop as loot in the New Player Dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526370408335671438)
- **new player dungeons**: New player dungeons forbid criminal actions, and a weekly rotating dungeon applies the same rule with reduced loot and experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530692192082071754)
- **new player early steps**: New players should get a bonded mount and start the Wellington quest chain as early as possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522266143425822943)
- **new player friendly templates**: Tamers and, to a lesser degree, summoners are very friendly to new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541131702964068462)
- **new player gathering progression**: A new player should start gathering in a city, then gather progressively outward, marking runes along the way so they can recall to the newly marked runes in time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533250394237698218)
- **new player gold sources**: New players can make gold by scavenging, harvesting leather or ore, and farming monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528583313982357564)
- **new player hunting spots**: Graveyards, ratmen and lizardmen are good starting hunting spots for new players, with good graveyards east and south of Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526893025744261242)
- **new player island quests**: Only one quest is available on the new player island, and the remaining available quests are found after leaving the island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355503148699721)
- **new player mount and tome**: Go to Shelter to do the new player quest for the free mount and to pick up the new player tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529425291464937574)
- **new player participation in group activities**: New players can join group activities right away, though they will die more than experienced guildmates until they learn mob mechanics; only a few things, such as deep delving in Time, should be avoided early because they slow the team down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529283794321014905)
- **new player progression**: New players are advised to use the new player dungeon and quest system, get an apartment, and then grind dungeons and society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533309283045867530)
- **new player progression advice**: New players should get combat skills to 80 before leaving the starter island and then start with the sanctuary dungeons on the dungeon progression guide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533836625631514634)
- **new player progression after shelter sewers**: After the shelter sewers, a new player should try Bluffs, then floor 1 of the current sanctuary if Bluffs is too easy, then floor 2, and so on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526403454841393304)
- **new player quest aspect unlocks**: Aspects unlocked through the new player quest reward do not consume the aspect items, so you keep your cores and distillations for your first couple of rank-ups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547239043270709498)
- **new player quest chain final reward**: The final reward of the new player quest chain is 250 Arcane Essence, which players find underwhelming, while earlier rewards in the chain are considered very valuable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539725532319588574)
- **new player quest chain order**: The new player quest chain with requirements of 25000, 50000, 50000 and 75000 must be completed in order, and you should turn in and accept the next quest promptly because credit stops once you hit the current cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524880806169018388)
- **new player quest codex**: The new player quest gives a codex only to that specific character, and codexes for other characters must be bought from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528429453527486597)
- **new player quest codex reward**: Completing the new player quest on your Outlands ID gives a codex, but you must leave Shelter Island to do it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552321930021830657)
- **new player quest combat**: Some new player quests require killing monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929281656950926)
- **new player quest completion requirements**: Completing the new player quests requires a combat character (warrior, summoner or tamer), and only that method counts toward them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536709506791252079)
- **new player quest epic scroll**: The new player quest awards an epic scroll that increases the caps of all skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528804357213131022)
- **new player quest horse**: The horse that follows you from the new player quest can be ridden by double-clicking it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553206824495480834)
- **new player quest line**: The new player quest line starts from an NPC in front of the societies, and its rewards save a lot of gold at the start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522262170895646850)
- **new player quest link blessed status**: Links given by the new player quests are blessed, but a link loses its blessed status if it is slotted into a chain and then removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537529978181394632)
- **new player quest mount limit**: The new player quest mount can be obtained only one time per ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555780060726829147)
- **new player quest runetome**: The runetome from the new player quest can have more runes added to it, and a script can use the command "[recall home" to recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549621112885870603)
- **new player questlines**: The new player questlines reward useful items such as a first horse and first blessed rune tome and introduce post-skill progression systems, but each quest can be completed only once per player account, not per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **new player quests**: The New Player Quests include a 25K quest and a 50K quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589277409677404)
- **new player quests**: Outlands has new player quests that help new players get started. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538683992868659260)
- **new player quests**: The new player quest series (!npq) gives important and valuable rewards and requires killing monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540111006934630551)
- **new player quests rewards**: New player quests reward a horse and a rune tome; the first quest, from the quest giver right outside the Shelter dungeon, gives the rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537620826298384445)
- **new player quests timing**: New player quests are best saved until you are ready to do PvM on a fresh character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525598442074800298)
- **new player recycling advice**: New players should recycle most magic items except supremely, vanquishing and greater slayer items, since essence is needed most at first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **new player scavenger dungeon gold**: New player scavengers still receive gold from inside dungeons, but substantially less than before, roughly half at best. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528133193578840156)
- **new player skill progression**: A new player should get some or all 7 skills to 100, then buy codexes, skill mastery scrolls and orbs to progress further. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544740799873286256)
- **new player skill training path**: New players train skills to 80 on Shelter Island (optionally including utility skills like Magic Resist and Healing, and doing the first quest), then leave, dropping Young status, and train main skills to 100 off the island, dropping the utility skills and doing other quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548004655575867516)
- **new player starting advice**: New players are advised to build a simple, cheap PvM character first and save up money before building a PvP character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529607570271109121)
- **new player swing speed build**: New players without swing speed links need to maximize swing speed through their build, which differs from the build of a player who has many swing speed links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523436032954208276)
- **new player template bonus**: To benefit from the new player template bonus, complete the new player quest and raise the template's skills to 80 in the NPD. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527099437871136809)
- **new player template statue**: The wiki is somewhat out of date, but the starter templates shown on the new player statue on Shelter Island are mostly good choices for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526583592870875328)
- **new player tutorial gold farmed limit**: New player tutorials are unavailable to characters or accounts that have farmed at least 5 million total gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544106077258383420)
- **new player vendor affordability**: With starter quests and some mining, new players can afford to keep a vendor even if they do not use it all the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530903529504636958)
- **new player weapon recommendation**: Sword and shield is recommended over a two-handed weapon for new players because Parry is strong, though it becomes more template-dependent once the aspect is leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554529223954145305)
- **new player weapon stat priorities**: New players need accuracy more than tactics, and a medium rarity material crafted weapon is usually a cost-efficient choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541128902762832034)
- **new player zones off shelter island**: Urukton Bluffs, Prevalia Sewers and the rat hovel are intended for brand new players leaving Shelter Island and, as sanctuary areas, have no PKers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525355113793978440)
- **new-player rune tome charges**: The new-player rune tome comes with 50 charges preloaded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522386913401508030)
- **new-player skill bonus on shelter island**: The new-player skill training speed bonus applies on Shelter Island for skills below 80, even for characters who are not new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533873117133279272)
- **newbie dungeon ants**: Ants in the newbie dungeon are dangerous to new players, so they should be approached with caution. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525914260734218392)
- **newbie dungeon gold quest requirements**: Gold for new player quests such as the Runebook quest only counts when earned by killing monsters in the New Player Dungeon, not from chests or lockpicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554139535187775489)
- **newbie dungeon pk restriction**: PKs cannot enter the newbie dungeons, and runes to a couple of newbie dungeons should be in the starting tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534917743529426964)
- **newbie dungeon population**: The newbie dungeon is reported to usually have other players present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525501938853089330)
- **newbie farming spots**: Newbie farming spots include the Sewers, Urukton, Ratman Hovel, and floor 1 of the core dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520464531304874016)
- **newbie gear keeping and recycling**: At the newbie stage, keep weapons with force or better properties and armor with hardening or better, and recycle hardening armor once you have a decent supply of better armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550065341466542083)
- **newbie island quests**: The newbie island quests provide almost everything a new player needs to enter the main world ready to fight mobs, while Young status lasts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546316858079060069)
- **newbie island respec statue**: Use the respec statue on the newbie island to receive starter gear and have your skills reassigned to a chosen premade template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529181442133725334)
- **newbie island spell casting**: Spells normally consume spell reagents, but on the newbie island starter characters use a spellstone from their starter gear instead, and spells also cost mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529178492472656073)
- **newbie island vendor items**: Vendors in other towns sell the same items as the newbie island vendors, just slightly less conveniently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524890959211663480)
- **newbie learning curve**: Outlands has a steep learning curve but is easier for new players than most Ultima Online servers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526092878072381551)
- **newbie onboarding resources**: The Outlands server owners produced a series of YouTube tutorial videos, and new players start on a newbie island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526093828396814336)
- **newbie quest aspect kit binding**: The Aspect Kit from the newbie quest can be used by any of your characters despite saying 'bound to'; it is an exception to the usual bound rules. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521217752365273248)
- **newbie quest locations and progression**: The first newbie quest starts outside the newbie dungeon and the rest are in Prevalia; they can be done anywhere by killing monsters to reach gold milestone caps, even after leaving young player island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522265719142613203)
- **newbie quest rewards**: Newbie quest rewards can only be claimed once per ID, so the character that received them should not be deleted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534919948378570782)
- **newbie weapon death behavior**: A newbie-flagged weapon stays on the character when they die instead of dropping to the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544121081881829406)
- **newbied clothing on new characters**: New character creation can give newbied pants, shoes, a kilt and a shirt, but not a robe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538930348161900606)
- **newplayer quest aspect unlock kit**: The newplayer quest gives an aspect kit that unlocks up to 3 aspects for free and can be passed to another character if not all 3 are used; afterward each aspect level requires more cores and distills, plus arcane essences. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541994984746524752)
- **newplayer quest bonded mount**: The newplayer quest on an Outlands character rewards a bonded mount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532764353407877411)
- **newplayer quest gold kill requirement**: The newplayer quest steps requiring 50,000 gold worth of creature kills count only base gold value and do not benefit from the Bonus Gold weekly dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546713653892350012)
- **next zone order after the starter areas**: Prevalia Sewers, Ratman Hovel, and Urukton Bluffs are all fine to do next, so the exact wiki order is not strict. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520843999538053140)
- **non-combat build difficulty**: The server does not make non-combat builds easy except for crafters, and some combat skill helps for resource maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553981068280074360)
- **non-pvp starter builds**: Tamer and summoner are suggested builds for players who want to avoid PvP, and both are easy to start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534335360631443466)
- **npc armor as stopgap**: After losing gear, armor bought from NPC smith shops can serve as a temporary replacement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526053088224612434)
- **npc buy and sell gump usage**: To use NPC buy/sell gumps, stand where the NPC can see you, such as right next to the shop wall when outside, and use the vendor buy or vendor sell command without clicking the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537759183686991882)
- **npc profession hotkey**: A hotkey shows NPC professions, which helps locate trainers such as the Necromancy trainer near the Prevalia bank and one on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523756601582813196)
- **npc tinker crafting tool stock**: NPC tinkers sell all the crafting tools, because player tinkers can make all the different crafting tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533044350685155470)
- **npc vendor hatchets for beginners**: NPC vendor hatchets are fine to use when you are just starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526995606466330715)
- **npd xp gain**: The only XP obtainable in the NPD is from tamed pets going from level 0 to level 1 to bond them; no other XP is earned there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552535820605587477)
- **obtaining a taming bestiary**: Complete the codex quest in the new player quest chain and use the item it gives to get a free Taming Bestiary, or alternatively buy a player-crafted one from a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529159815128027289)
- **obtaining harvest aspect**: Harvest Aspect is obtained by completing the new player quests or by buying the items from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549608151647789117)
- **ocean content cost**: Getting into ocean content (being a pirate) is costly, so players should wait until they have saved up some gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546710864151842897)
- **ocean content entry cost**: Ocean content is expensive to start and has a lot to learn, but it can be tried for free on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541528935001620502)
- **office of alchemy and magic location**: The Office of Alchemy and Magic for the orientation quest is located at the bazaar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548472429221777540)
- **office of the shield location**: The Office of the Shield for the orientation quest is located at the moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548472429221777540)
- **official tutorial series**: The first link in the !newplayer bot post, the Outlands Gameplay Basics Full Playlist, is the official tutorial series for Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530308284517716060)
- **open world pvp and looting**: Outlands is an open world PvP game where players can be stolen from, or killed and dry looted of almost everything they are carrying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537966811075706900)
- **opening journal from gumps menu**: To open the Journal without the hotkey, click the Gumps button in the triangle bar (game bar) and choose Journal from the drop-down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524946656980766730)
- **opening multiple game clients**: In the launcher, clicking the play button again opens an additional instance of the game client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547641076091850892)
- **opening the health resource bar**: To view your health bar, left click and hold your character sprite and drag to pull out the resource bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547564863205675028)
- **opening the world map**: To open the square world map, click Maps on the UO bar at the top of the screen and then select World Map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531454432724910312)
- **opening your own corpse**: To open your own corpse reliably, assign a hotkey for Show All Names, press it, then click the corpse that displays your name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549821433436446721)
- **orange text on login**: The orange text shown on login is the game loading map markers, and it appears on every login and whenever you use resync. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525999168072450099)
- **orientation quest purpose**: The orientation quest acclimates players to the area so they can go on to do the 100+ quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526723403564843169)
- **orientation quest sign locations**: Signs for the Orientation quest are located on both upper and lower floors, so check every floor of the area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555351460450144277)
- **outlands era identity**: Outlands is not a specific UO era; it is heavily custom with all-new content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521628204044124210)
- **outlands id account linking**: If a player had no Outlands ID when they last played, they must open a support ticket, because the 3 accounts are now linked to a single Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546544291948658788)
- **outlands id limit per person**: Only one Outlands ID is allowed per person, so you cannot create an account for another person and play on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535436435010752605)
- **outlined materials from prevalia quests**: The outlined materials new players find are obtained through the Prevalia quests after leaving the newbie island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529241057957642421)
- **overhead health bars setting**: Overhead health bars for yourself and other players require both options in the settings menu to be checked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527295415152676964)
- **pack animals at stables**: Pack horses and oxen can be obtained at the stables and carry loads without requiring Animal Taming, but they cannot be bonded or named. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547426581473923072)
- **paladin-style build**: A recommended Paladin-style build in Outlands is a Holy aspect parry swordsman. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544849013671591939)
- **paladin/bard starter template**: Paladin/Bard is a commonly recommended starter and early money-making template that is strong, easy to control and valued as support, though weak in PvP and not among the preset templates, so it needs a custom template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555981120334602314)
- **party management access**: Open party management in-game by clicking the scrolls on the right side of your paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526604930440368381)
- **party persistence and online status**: Party membership persists across logins and lets you see which party members are online; joining a guild is another social option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526604222177738763)
- **path to becoming a crafter**: A new player who wants to become a crafter first needs to be a gatherer to obtain resources, or another type of PvM character to earn the gold needed to fund a crafter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537222627913896006)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons after shelter island**: After leaving Shelter Island there are 3 more permanent sanctuary dungeons where players cannot be PK'd or stolen from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527421547545890987)
- **permanent upgrades priority**: Permanent upgrades such as codexes, aspects and chain links should be prioritised over better weapons, because weapons are lost on death and better ones give no significant bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521094701157974036)
- **pet level cap on new player island**: Pets do not level past level 1 on the new player island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531022875706920971)
- **pet naming feedback**: When naming a pet, watch the system messages to see whether the name is accepted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553744243346907187)
- **pk activity in cemetery near town**: The cemetery next to town is a common place where player killers hunt new players for easy kills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554464403380768769)
- **pk patrols in newbie areas**: Some guilds and individual PKs aggressively patrol newbie areas and the few spots they farm, such as daemons, on their blue characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522343573687898193)
- **plate armor for new scavengers**: Plate armor is a reasonable choice for a new scavenger who is still learning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530561897550844165)
- **player-bought circle 1-6 spell cost**: Circle 1-6 spells bought from a player cost roughly 160 gold in total, which is much cheaper than buying them from NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527405274179174580)
- **poison necromancer early progression**: Get the template skills to 100 first (7x100), start the Poison aspect and obtain the poison kit, wizard's grimoire and summoner's tome, then buy scrolls to raise those skills to 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527683701318877374)
- **poison summoner suitability for new players**: The poison summoner approach likely needs a good amount of progression before it feels effective, so it may not suit a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547230555828129853)
- **post-80 skill progression on starting island**: After reaching the 80s in combat skills on a dex template on the starting island, players can continue the new player quest chain, hunt in the sewers or Urukton Bluffs, or AFK train at a public battle trainer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525612220489273456)
- **post-island goals**: After leaving the starting island, players are advised to do quests to obtain a Codex, Aspect and Chain, and to rent a room soon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546631015248830474)
- **post-shelter island dungeon training path**: After training early skills in the Shelter Island Dungeon, a new player heads outside Shelter and starts training Lumberjacking and Mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537614498213666947)
- **post-shelter island progression**: After Shelter Island, the Prevalia sewers are the next step up for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535551066228265000)
- **post-skill progression priority**: Progression in the post-skill XP systems matters far more than better gear and cannot be lost, and the third newplayer quest chain provides the first items needed for those systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546728770747109446)
- **premade tank dexxer template weapon**: The premade tank dexxer template from the respec statue is a solid choice, but it starts with swords and the weapon cannot be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529182701385416755)
- **preparing to leave shelter island**: Before leaving Shelter Island, players should be comfortable with game mechanics, and grinding the starter runebook quest is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535330963884875877)
- **prevalia and outpost as locations**: Prevalia is mainly worth visiting for societies, and the Outpost is a comfortable default location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549150580004618316)
- **prevalia moongate safety**: The area around the Prevalia moongate is unsafe, since players can be killed and stolen from there, so carry only items you can afford to lose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529277976343089333)
- **prevalia sewer farming**: Prevalia Sewer is an easy and safe place for new players to farm and train, with its entrance in town inside a safe zone, and it also has a quest inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552903265417437205)
- **prevalia sewers dungeon**: The Prevalia sewers dungeon is not restricted to Young players, so skills can rise above 80 there, and its enemies are reportedly tougher than in the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555068398042611723)
- **prevalia sewers first dungeon**: The Prevalia sewers are a suggested first dungeon for new players, with a quest giver in front of the entrance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522261968516546801)
- **prevalia sewers purpose**: The Prevalia sewers were added so new players would not need to travel to the orc dungeon, which was for a while PvP enabled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555069589912555521)
- **prevalia sewers safety**: The Prevalia Sewers are a very safe hunting location that does not require using recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197217374277643)
- **progression after shelter island skill cap**: After reaching the skill cap on Shelter Island, players should move on to one of the sanctuary dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520623133449523240)
- **progression systems in pvp**: Advanced progression systems generally do not work in PvP (except possibly against nearby mobs), so little grinding is needed to play PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545205085255106590)
- **progression to core dungeons**: After clearing the newbie dungeons easily, a player who feels ready should move on to Level 1 of the core dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533007873280446654)
- **public dip risk at horseshoe bay**: When using the public dip at Horseshoe Bay, carrying nothing valuable limits your loss if you are killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549594330484973709)
- **pulling your own health bar**: To pull your own health bar, hold click on yourself and drag it out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554805370126336011)
- **pvm aspect progression**: For PvM progression, players should grab an aspect and progress it, and tamer builds work quite well early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552352670474571857)
- **pvm sailing for new players**: PvM sailing content is feasible for a new player who knows what to do and does not require much money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520885139394003136)
- **pvp guilds helping new players**: Many PVP guilds in Outlands help new players build a PVP character, such as supplying reagents for magery, and teach Outlands PVP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526325008933195836)
- **pvp progression requirements**: PvP and PvE use different rules, and PvP has no Codex or Aspect, so there is no large grind before starting PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535399006656659616)
- **quest item acquisition order**: Most quests require you to obtain the quest item after you have accepted the quest, so items collected beforehand usually do not count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549288327985762355)
- **quest item stolen by a pk**: If a PK takes a quest item you needed, you will most likely need to restart the quest to get the original item back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526995168262361239)
- **quest locations for new players**: The starting area has only one quest, and the remaining early quests are all in Prevalia, close to each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538035874376458260)
- **quest turn-in location**: A quest must be completed by returning to the original quest issuer, not the NPC to whom an item was handed over. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539573996536856616)
- **questlets**: Questlets are mini situations encountered in the world, such as guards being attacked by orcs, where players can jump in and help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520608531911409675)
- **random starting skills viability**: Randomly picked starting skills may not form a viable build, so a character's skills should be compared with the templates on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525883163904315402)
- **random useless-looking items**: Most random items that look useless are quest items and should not be discarded or vendored without checking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540701484218322944)
- **ratman hovel for new backstabbers**: Ratman Hovel is not the best area for a new backstabber because without Chivalry you are extremely vulnerable there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531780845961220267)
- **reagent carrying advice**: Players are advised to carry all reagents rather than only the ones they expect to need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554182507673427979)
- **reagent purchase sources**: Reagents are used to cast spells and can be bought from mage scribes and alchemists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534974472782745683)
- **recall to shelter island bank**: After getting the Rune Tome from the new player quests, make a hotkey or script line that says "[recallcharge Shelter Island Bank" to recall to the Shelter Island bank using a charge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315115110567977)
- **recentering map on character**: To make the map center on your character again, unclick the "free view" option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530888388046094347)
- **recommended build for brand new players**: For a brand new player, a Dex Tamer is recommended, with Archery as the best weapon choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555982660113932300)
- **recommended starting tamer variants**: Dex tamer and bard tamer are recommended as starting tamer variants for new tamers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545508711706005514)
- **recovering a guarded corpse**: To recover a corpse guarded by a monster, revive, lure the monster away from the corpse first, then run in a big circle back to your corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549249982434123897)
- **recovering off-screen gumps**: If a gump is not visible, use Options > Window Manager > Move all windows into screen bounds to bring it back on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534653385066680370)
- **recovering off-screen windows**: To bring off-screen windows or containers such as a backpack back on screen, open the client options, go to the profile/windows manager, and use the option that moves all windows within screen bounds (exact wording may differ). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522026204817784984)
- **recycling early loot for essence**: Early in the game, basic unidentified weapons and armor found as loot can be recycled for essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005926354976830)
- **red name meaning**: On Outlands a red name indicates a PK (player killer). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531169934040629350)
- **red player distribution**: Red (murderer) players are fewer now than a year ago, but they are much more common in newbie areas than in later-game areas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522716381135765564)
- **red players in wilderness**: Many red players (PKs) roam wilderness spots killing new players, and with mounts they can reach you before you notice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664268419334185)
- **renaming versus making a new character**: If a character is fresh and has not yet invested in Aspect, it is simpler to make a new character than to pay to rename it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496093950517289)
- **rental contract check for alt characters**: A character made on another account receives another rental contract check of 2k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374654989303839)
- **reopening the buff bar**: To reopen a closed buff bar, click the blue gem on your health bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529899458710474913)
- **repeatable daily quests**: There are a couple of repeatable daily quests that give a fair reward for the effort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526723196055978005)
- **replacement world atlas**: Typing [atlas obtains a new World Atlas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538316896229793945)
- **reporting inappropriate behavior**: To report inappropriate behavior, press the help button in game and use the in-game help at the top, or open a ticket through the Discord ticket channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541394263139688461)
- **resizing the game window**: To resize the game window, go to Options - Video, turn off "Use full size game window", then use the gem at the bottom right to resize and drag from the border to move it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532796033237778504)
- **respec statue skill limits**: The respec statue cannot assign skills or stats as high as the full template values, so they must be raised naturally afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529182609748394095)
- **restarting a character**: To restart a character, go to the statue where you started and click on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553779079088574505)
- **restarting quests after death**: If you die during a quest you should be able to restart it, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547261827291942973)
- **restoring hidden menu bar**: To restore a hidden menu bar, uncheck the 'Disable menu bar' option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542950836542640279)
- **restoring hidden npc names**: If an NPC's name was hidden by accidentally right-clicking it, press Ctrl+Shift, untick the 'always' option and tick it again to restore name display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555018592284704780)
- **resurrecting at a shrine**: A dead player can resurrect at a shrine in Outlands by double clicking the shrine or by running up to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538313958920949810)
- **resurrection after death**: After death, a gump pops up asking you to accept the resurrection, and someone standing at the front door can also resurrect you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532435752367948068)
- **resurrection after dying near a dungeon**: After dying near a dungeon, go to the healer next to the dungeon, marked on the map with a red cross icon, to be resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532863870102802644)
- **resurrection fallback options**: You can resurrect at a nearby shrine; if nothing is nearby, use the help option to be sent to town, or have an alt send a gate if you have a rune to gate from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522555120473210971)
- **resurrection troubleshooting at ankh**: If resurrection at the ankh does not work, run far away and then come back to the ankh. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532435993775575130)
- **resurrection via npc healer**: To resurrect after dying, approach an NPC healer while dead and accept the resurrection prompt that appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555684269899255909)
- **resynchronize option**: Resynchronize makes the client check that all game files are in the right place and is only needed when you are having problems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525999926432104600)
- **retrieving a lost horse**: To find a lost horse, go to a stable master, access the stable, and choose 'Retrieve lost followers' from the options at the bottom of the menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553880653974610061)
- **returning after death far from town**: If you die far from town, you can run back as a ghost, or if physically stuck you may be able to use a limited teleport-to-town option under Help > Player Stuck (exact menu wording uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526986595205648405)
- **returning player account recovery**: A returning player who previously created an Outlands ID resets their password; a player with no Outlands ID must submit a support ticket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539402123450523729)
- **returning to newbie dungeon after young status**: After losing Young status, players can still return to the newbie dungeon to train for its increased skill gain chance, for the skills it applies to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550355998408048721)
- **riding a horse**: To ride a horse, double click it while not in war mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527097287619248260)
- **risk of losing equipment on death**: Players will die to PKs or mobs and may be unable to recover their belongings, so they should not wear equipment they cannot replace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **rope macro for new players**: A rope macro is recommended for new players, who should get used to using it early because it saves a lot of trouble. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535553265322819615)
- **rune tome acquisition**: A Rune Tome is obtained by completing the NPQs, so new players should do them early. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526782620514390257)
- **running one aspect early**: Running just one aspect at the beginning of the game is advisable for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539596159906091059)
- **rush-killing xp dungeon first floor**: Low-level characters can rush-kill the whole first floor of an XP dungeon, and by the time they reach the end the monsters have started respawning so they can loop around quickly, though it can be crowded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541869756397650042)
- **safe animal taming training**: To train Animal Taming safely, buy a forest ostard from the stable broker, then tame and release it so it will not attack you; this is a tentative suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530543381422411836)
- **safe areas**: Sanctuary dungeons are the only fully safe areas, and cities are only somewhat safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533310332196622386)
- **safe logout without a house**: Without a house, you can log out safely by walking into an inn and logging out there, and renting an inn room is recommended over getting a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527954717244653590)
- **safe trading to avoid dropped items**: To avoid losing items on the ground while trading, single-click the trade partner to open the gump first, or open the trade window with a cheap item such as a bandage before placing valuables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532513798873677835)
- **safe zones**: Shelter Island is the safe zone on the server, and the Sanctuary dungeon is also safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537600977828585576)
- **sanctuary dungeon**: The current sanctuary dungeon is listed on the billboard in towns and offers somewhat more gold and difficulty than the basic starter dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533008237090050099)
- **sanctuary dungeon of the week for beginners**: The Sanctuary dungeon of the week is good for beginners because dying does not lose everything as long as you recover your body, which is easier by hiding, sneaking and looting the body while hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554366612151472159)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Sanctuary dungeons exist on Outlands for grinding without worrying about PKers; several are aimed at new players and one rotates weekly as a regular dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526095642126974976)
- **sanctuary dungeons runebook**: The sanctuary dungeons are included in the starter runebook if the new player quest was completed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552859283450896385)
- **saving nameplate filter setting**: To save the nameplate filter setting, select a different option such as Mobiles & Corpses, then click the Log Out button on the Paperdoll; closing the game another way usually does not save settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542946759880478842)
- **scaling the ui on high-resolution monitors**: If the UI is too small on a high-resolution monitor, use the display scale slider in the options to scale the entire UI up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527197407853543515)
- **second account for multiple characters online**: Players can have a second account so that two or three characters are online at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525867828308087006)
- **second new player quest npc location**: The second new player quest NPC is at the society hall, which can be found on the map after arriving at Prev. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522449711754383501)
- **self-gathered crafter leveling**: A crafter can be raised almost entirely on materials the player mined or chopped themselves, and surplus material can be sold for a decent amount of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526041165537873960)
- **selling gems to jewelers early game**: Selling gems to a jeweler in the early game noticeably boosts the value a player carries out of a dungeon per run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528105599538299061)
- **selling unidentified items on shelter island**: Unidentified items can be sold to NPCs on Shelter Island, and the weaponsmith is east of the main plaza. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925467464040449)
- **separating locked ui elements**: Hold Alt to separate UI elements, such as spell icons, that are locked together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553438000564928593)
