- **server count**: Outlands has only one server, so European players cannot choose a European server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548540188161216612)
- **shelter dungeon access for non-young players**: Players who are no longer young can still enter the shelter dungeon to train skills up to 80, but they cannot use the bank or shops there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527391108961796399)
- **shelter dungeons for new players**: Shelter dungeons have no PKs or thieves and give less XP, but let new players learn to fight and survive much as in regular dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524467103581863976)
- **shelter gathering eligibility**: Only players with Young status can gather resources in Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549606133872730113)
- **shelter gathering timer**: A new player timer can expire and then prevent further gathering on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549605697048547469)
- **shelter haven amenities**: Shelter Haven has no guards, no bank and no thieves, but has all other amenities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523833820686712902)
- **shelter haven bank access**: Shelter Haven has no bank, so players who are no longer Young probably cannot use a bank there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523833820686712902)
- **shelter inn rental eligibility**: A rental inn room can be located in Shelter even if the player does not have Young status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526674053140844575)
- **shelter inn room exit safety**: In Shelter, exiting your inn room by the door puts you into a 100% safe area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526731230454874263)
- **shelter island**: Shelter Island is a starter area that players are not meant to spend much time on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547534642930778232)
- **shelter island caster skill training**: Magery, Meditation, Necromancy and Spirit Speak level quickly on Shelter Island, and a stone there supplies the reagents needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521249873200939078)
- **shelter island death loot**: On Shelter Island, all of your items remain on your dead body when you die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526111918602063892)
- **shelter island first quest limit**: The first Shelter Island quest can only be completed once per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525165865052668105)
- **shelter island leveling safety**: On Shelter Island you can level up without worrying about strong monsters, PKs and thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533166119916011670)
- **shelter island mage npc spell circles**: On Shelter Island the mage NPC sells spell circles 1-6, though at a higher price than player vendors usually charge. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531273882739146752)
- **shelter island magical item drops**: The chance of finding a valuable magical item on Shelter Island is very low. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521309503977426974)
- **shelter island monster difficulty**: Monsters in the Shelter Island dungeon are weaker than the animals outside, which are regular and harder mobs, so beginners should fight in the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547265813952864287)
- **shelter island newbie dungeon gold yield**: The newbie dungeon on Shelter Island may yield more gold than the Sewers, though this is an uncertain impression from one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525713396643659837)
- **shelter island purpose**: Shelter Island is intended as an extended character creation area where skills train very quickly, and players are meant to leave after a few hours once their skills reach about 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531191675597361192)
- **shelter island quests**: Quests on Shelter Island can be skipped before leaving, since a player can return later to pick them up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539837787359154216)
- **shelter island resurrection crosses**: On Shelter Island, there is a cross at the entrance and another in the dungeon where you can resurrect yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547262041549705308)
- **shelter island runebook quest limit**: The runebook quest on Shelter Island can be completed only once per player (OutlandsID), not once per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535510110087159919)
- **shelter island safety**: Shelter Island is described as the only safe place in the game; elsewhere, including near vendors, thieves and reds are a danger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527515619879157790)
- **shelter island skill cap**: Shelter Island lets new characters train skills up to 80 skill points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534621237576339580)
- **shelter island skill trainers for macefighting**: The skill trainers on Shelter Island can still be used to train Macefighting, and it is usually easier to continue training it in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554901262393417819)
- **shelter island statue template change**: The statue on Shelter Island may allow a character to choose a different starting template at least once, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522357139396628663)
- **shelter island training speed bonus**: The Shelter Island training speed bonus applies only to fighting skills, not gathering or crafting skills, and only inside the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526563100252438673)
- **shelter island vendor access**: Shelter Island NPC vendors can only be used while a character still has Young status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532447348129792160)
- **shelter moongate pet bonding**: A pet newly obtained from the shelter moongate should be bonded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534411713443659947)
- **shelter newplayer quest npc gold earned**: The newplayer quest NPC at the Shelter lists how much gold you have earned, though it may not count all gold sources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534244858955305040)
- **shelter portal freebie spellbook**: A full spellbook obtained from the Shelter portal freebies is blessed by default. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542955645139947621)
- **shelter safe zone**: You can still die in Shelter; the safe zone only prevents other players from killing or looting you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525599042845802497)
- **shelter safety**: Shelter is a fully safe town, so exiting a rented room into Shelter carries no risk even with valuable items on you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526562272539971585)
- **shelter sanctuary xp**: Shelter is the only sanctuary that grants no XP, while other sanctuaries grant reduced XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522012109230309416)
- **shelter skill gain bonus**: Shelter provides a massive skill gain bonus, so it is recommended to stay there until all relevant skills reach 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539208334706606140)
- **shelter spam bots**: Many teleport bots and guild recruitment bots spam messages in Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526103609585172590)
- **shelter spellstone**: In the Shelter new player dungeon, a spellstone grants a limited number of free spell casts without reagents, and once it runs out you need reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554922400079151145)
- **shelter training dummies location**: The Shelter training dummies (battle trainers) are located in the southwestern building of Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536144934934028410)
- **shopping after losing young status**: A player who has lost Young status should leave Shelter and shop in another town such as Terran Outpost rather than Cooks Corner or Prev. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537760228240531456)
- **show hp option**: To display health below your character, enable Options > General > Mobiles > Show HP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547203166905307176)
- **showing overhead names**: Pressing Ctrl+Shift opens a red box where an option can be picked to show overhead names all the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549830820620148837)
- **single main pvm character to avoid splitting xp**: Having only one main PvM character avoids splitting XP, so players are advised not to split XP across characters if they can help it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546236319817015468)
- **skill boost after young status**: Skill Boost for non-crafting and non-gathering skills remains available to a character after they are no longer Young. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522031652250062938)
- **skill buttons on screen**: Skills with a blue gem in the skills list can be turned into an on-screen button by clicking and dragging them out of the list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539468953636573224)
- **skill cap on shelter**: Skills reach their cap very quickly on Shelter, the starter island, so training there is effectively an extension of character creation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525521356370739331)
- **skill changing and melee training**: Skills can be changed very easily, so training melee skills does not hurt a future mage or summoner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531194316737740892)
- **skill information resources**: Most information about each skill is on the wiki; there are no tutorials for individual skills, only some community template tutorials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042838977183826)
- **skill leveling and template switching**: Skills at 80 are easy to level and templates can be switched daily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541547090004410378)
- **skill point progression speed**: Skill points are the earliest and easiest stage of progression, and a full template can be completed in roughly 1-3 days, even from a fresh character, depending on specifics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529306862447497256)
- **skill respec and newbie quests**: Skills can be learned and unlearned freely, but newbie quests cannot be undone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546670485226524753)
- **skill training limits on shelter island**: On Shelter Island you can only train skills up to 80, and you cannot train Codex or Aspect at all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534185099489443870)
- **skills window**: Open the skills window with the Skills button on the paperdoll or with Alt+P, then expand the skill group arrows to see which skills have points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525591581984555038)
- **smart heal and cure self spells**: Smart Heal and Cure Self are Magery spells, so binding them without Magery produces the message 'you do not have that spell'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524981709442125955)
- **societies**: Societies incrementally build wealth over time and are worth learning about early as a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531177975020654713)
- **society job selection**: Choose society jobs that match activities you would be doing anyway, such as skill-raising jobs while training a crafter and dungeon-clearing jobs while clearing a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528592650498871358)
- **spell buttons from spellbook**: To get a spell casting button, open the spell page in the spellbook and click and drag the spell icon out of the book onto the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538716190329806928)
- **spellbook requirement for casting**: You can only cast spells that are in your spellbook; choosing a skill at character creation does not necessarily give you the spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282185262112840)
- **spells needed to start mage farming**: Only a few spells are needed to start farming as a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544134990500077739)
- **spellstones**: Spellstones act as a replacement for reagents and work for any spell, and they are meant for training new characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522388261971034122)
- **spellstones and reagent stones**: Reagent stones cannot be bought; Spellstones are a starter item for new Mage characters, bound to that character, and once used up the player must switch to reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523377093776379997)
- **spousal account rule**: A spousal account is allowed on the same IP address but comes with gameplay limitations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535437040508731393)
- **ss and sa abbreviations**: SS stands for Spider Silk and SA stands for Sulphuric Ash. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531348229889855498)
- **stablekeeper horse sales**: Stablekeepers sell horses, but those horses do not come bonded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537767568046161951)
- **stablemaster pet bonding**: Pets purchased from the stablemaster should already be bonded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539497235371528193)
- **standard platemail via portal vendor search**: The Outlands Portal vendor search can list standard platemail sellers, and standard platemail is plain iron, mastercrafted, and a good starting point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549693414193365014)
- **starter aspects**: The Death aspect and the Eldritch aspect are cheap, decent starter aspects that make a player stronger against mobs, though this is a tentative recommendation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522448910595919882)
- **starter island gold quest**: Gold collected for the starter island quest counts toward the quest even if lost on death, and it does not need to be turned in, so the reward is still received if the corpse cannot be retrieved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526158430786682920)
- **starter quest rental credits**: The starter quests may give some rental credits that can be used for rental rooms, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533987919508013076)
- **starting a bard**: To start a bard, pick up a guitar and level Peacemaking, Discordance and Provocation to 80 in Shelter (Musicianship is not needed); after gaining some XP in a dungeon, put the first 3 codex points into Self Taught in the bard codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529460942553743480)
- **starting clothes**: Starting clothes likely cannot be changed at all, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533244685294899200)
- **starting cost of pvm sailing**: Starting PvM sailing content costs roughly 100k for ship expenses if you harvest materials yourself or buy a ship, and the ship should pay itself off fairly quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520886569928622270)
- **starting crafting template**: Tailor is a safe starting crafting template, with a scavenger harvester supplying leather; selling crafted goods is hard before obtaining Artisan Aspect because others have a much higher exceptional chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525209861464264884)
- **starting fishing**: To fish, go to the dock fisher NPC, buy a fishing pole, then double click it or use the item in hand via a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540286178031304715)
- **starting gold location**: Starting gold is held in your bank, so check the bank if you cannot buy things with your gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525598794622701628)
- **starting location prevalia**: Starting a new character in Prevalia instead of Shelter Island is not the typical choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522348356817391638)
- **starting shepherd's crook choice**: A common approach is to start with a plain exceptional or mid-tier crook such as a golden wood crook and loot better crooks over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527073333529546752)
- **starting skills at character creation**: Only 3 starting skills can be picked at character creation (stated with uncertainty). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533030647071903776)
- **starting spell stone binding**: The starting spell stone (aspect crystal) is likely bound to the character rather than blessed, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545161592994267268)
- **starting spellbook**: Characters do not start with a full spellbook; the spellbook must be filled with spells over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525594858335502396)
- **starting spells in spellbook**: Flipping through the circle pages of the spellbook shows all your spells, and you may start with some higher-circle spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525601241432981524)
- **starting stat distribution**: A suggested start is to set Intelligence to 25 and cap it so the other stats can rise, with Strength at 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554372537381822516)
- **starting statue for basic build**: A statue where players appear after creating a character lets them create a basic build from examples. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547322421432811640)
- **starting templates**: Creating a new character shows the current starting templates, which indicate the current meta for new players, and the wiki also lists templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525608028219375756)
- **starting treasure mapping as a new player**: New players can start treasure mapping without connections by mining their own ingots, or by selling crafted jewels to recoup gold while raising tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537104185382801488)
- **stat bar order in ui**: The three stat bars in the Outlands UI are ordered health, mana, stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526231638428745909)
- **statue character restart limit**: The statue character restart can reportedly only be used once per OutlandsID, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553783690054729740)
- **status bar order**: The status bars are ordered health, mana, stamina, and the icons below them showing stat values are strength, stamina, intelligence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526228658715492483)
- **stealther template for dungeon learning**: A stealther template is ideal for learning dungeon layouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542483861135687751)
- **stockpile suitability for new players**: The Stockpile is not intended for new players and is better acquired later. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523004530722340945)
- **stranglelands event**: Stranglelands is a beginner-friendly PvP event where players join, pick a character, and are given all gear, like a battle royale with everyone starting at the same point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899015734824962)
- **strongest early progression template**: Animal tamer is likely the strongest template for early progression, though all presets are viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525515339742576650)
- **strongest starting templates**: A fencing dex tamer and a summoner mage are probably the strongest templates right from the start in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548054187613618307)
- **suggested account layout**: A suggested account layout is to keep all PvM characters on one account and put one tailor on each account, then split other crafters across accounts as desired. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532420591682850836)
- **summon creature early game**: Summon Creature can be used to survive and kill monsters in the early game, and saying 'all guard' directs the summons to guard you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550340792554496043)
- **summon creature for new summoners**: A new player can use the Summon Creature spell instead of summoning elementals or a daemon when starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531174194811895961)
- **summoner build for new mages**: A new mage player can play a summoner until Arcane reaches at least t13 by dropping Arcane and Parry and adding Spirit Speak, Alchemy or Veterinary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537556830581030983)
- **summoner early game strength**: Summoners are considered strong early on because their summons absorb damage and aggro while the player learns mob mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555299801258664009)
- **summoner mage template**: The wiki has a basic summoner mage template suited to new players, in which summoned pets fight and tank for you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525594350967324702)
- **summoner trapper starter build**: A single player says a summoner trapper is the best way to start with money and is very effective with zero links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527405040980197568)
- **summoners for new players**: Summoners work very well for new players, but you must maintain reagents to cast spells once your spell stone runs out of charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550914688060227686)
- **support restoring lost items for new players**: The game support team can see a character's history and may restore lost items for new players who submit a help request. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525166943403774095)
- **switching archetype with no codices or aspects**: A character with no codices or aspects that wants a different archetype, such as a mage, is best served by creating a new character on the same account, which is faster than retraining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553814419580911689)
- **switching to arcane mage**: Players can start as a summoner and later switch to an arcane mage that uses no summons once they can output more damage and know how to survive without summons tanking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544925470607417354)
- **tamer and summoner as first characters**: Tamers and Summoners are considered good first character choices because their creatures tank damage for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537969959068631132)
- **tamer creature acquisition**: Tamers acquire creatures either by taming them in the field, which is free but potentially dangerous, or by buying them from other players with gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551547746727755877)
- **tamer new player power curve**: Tamers have a very quick power curve and are the easiest PvM template for new players, ramping up in power quickly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525860452242952213)
- **tamer progression quests**: Players suggest that tamers who have outgrown Shelter Island should do the new player quests from Wellington in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552747986537160815)
- **tamer strength for new players**: Tamers are quite strong on Outlands and are one of the easier paths for getting started. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547358840515985448)
- **tamer template progression speed**: Tamer is recommended as the template for faster character progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545499445737558057)
- **target tracker gump location**: The gump showing the currently targeted mob is called Target Trackers and is found in the gumps menu on the horizontal menu bar, not in options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527036205928026154)
- **template re-roll and character slots**: A template can be re-rolled once using the statue in Shelter Haven, characters can be deleted after a week, and each account has 3x5 characters in total. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544946695656316959)
- **template re-roll at shelter statue**: Players can re-roll their template once at the statue in Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524331330530312212)
- **template statue near docks**: A statue in front of the docks lets you try out a new template, reportedly about 3 times, and double clicking it shows the templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589156764590151)
- **template switching while young**: A player may be able to switch their chosen template at least once while they still have Young status, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540081275149484183)
- **test center for build experimentation**: Test Center (TC) can be used to experiment with builds and echoes before committing on the live shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530417440071094342)
- **test server for build testing**: The Outlands test server can be used to try out builds in dungeons and elsewhere to see if and how well they work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541967970052341862)
- **test server for builds**: A test server exists where players can obtain all skills and items to try out builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523008944644296746)
- **test server for builds**: A test server exists where players can try out builds before committing to them on the main server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521448378058407976)
- **test server for mechanics testing**: The Test server lets players try game mechanics without risk of loss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532382835242045480)
- **test server for template trials**: The test server can be used to try out templates such as Summoner or Tamer before committing to them on a main character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541125901410893924)
- **thief danger outside sanctuary**: Thieves can target players anywhere outside of sanctuary areas, so players should stay alert for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554370287389253663)
- **thief risk in cities**: Players can still be stolen from inside cities, so bank often and carry only essentials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545295997083717723)
- **thieves in town**: Thieves operate in town, so valuables should be kept in the bank or an inn room rather than in your pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548250998890438658)
- **three account layout**: With 3 accounts, put the main character with many echoes (including a crafter, a harvester and other PvM styles) on Account 1, and a crafter for societies on each of Accounts 2 and 3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **tidal tomb and kraul hive difficulty**: Tidal Tomb and Kraul Hive are somewhat harder than other starting dungeons, though their first floors have nothing too dangerous. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552078357313626137)
- **tidal tomb newbie suitability**: Tidal Tomb is not a recommended dungeon for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545919172985356381)
- **tier 0 arcane farming location**: A tier 0 arcane character should farm the wilderness rather than Tidal 3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525693728683987087)
- **time to reach average competitiveness**: Reaching an average level of competitiveness takes roughly 1-3 hours a day for a few weeks, yielding a few links and levels in an aspect or two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549446082260639805)
- **toggling combat mode**: Toggle combat (war) mode with Tab or the Peace/War button on the paperdoll; if Tab only works while held, untick the hold-tab setting under options combat, and mouse wheel up/down can also switch war/peace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530701471417634986)
- **toggling the speech bar**: Press Enter to toggle the speech bar at the bottom of the screen so you can type chat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532448329987002388)
- **tooltip option for item inspection**: Turn on the tooltip option in the in-game Options so you can mouse over items to see what they are. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532823009650409593)
- **training gold coins use**: Training gold coins are likely usable only to buy skills up and not to buy a horse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533047799380185149)
- **training house dangers**: Thieves steal from players training at training houses and reds kill everyone there, so only bring what you need to train. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535254422370648114)
- **training spot safety**: Players should pick an empty training spot because thieves and murderers may be present at crowded ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529585865574191134)
- **training weapon source**: Training weapons can be obtained from armourers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536597418592706580)
- **transferring beginner quest items**: Items from the beginning quests, such as the runebook, can be given to your other characters, so you can delete a disliked character without losing them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526994293879738529)
- **trapped containers in the starter area**: Loose boxes and chests found lying around can be trapped, so they are suspicious, while bags cannot harm the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545305616791380080)
- **tribard vs peacemaking build for starting players**: A single player considers a tribard build (sword, tactics, focus, healing, anatomy and a bard skill) better than a sword/peacemaking/musicianship build for a starting player with no links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527391551943217225)
- **triple harvesting for new players**: Triple harvesting early on is a recommended way for new players to fund their PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551890386375676057)
- **true fullsize client window setting**: The true fullsize client window setting is found under the Resolution option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534206945651724520)
- **tutorial quests**: The tutorial quests walk new players through the mastery chain, getting a link, and unlocking and using aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524976873426391271)
- **typical pvm progression**: A typical PvM progression is to find a location with mobs you can handle, farm gold and finish new player quests to kick-start the progression systems, then move to progressively harder grinding locations as those systems level up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527071193709023344)
- **ui customization guides**: To find guides for customizing the user interface, cooldown display, and nameplates, use the !customize bot command, which retrieves the Arcane Academy threads on the Outlands forums. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531641850841141442)
- **ui scaling option**: UI scaling can be adjusted in a game options menu to enlarge the UI without blurring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530287952121430286)
- **ui templates**: Outlands has no ready-made UI templates, so players must configure their own UI. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525665293190303835)
- **un-upgraded boat fishing viability**: A fisher can do well with an un-upgraded boat, though upgrades maximize results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527083312655630586)
- **unidentified items recycling advice**: Unidentified items are better collected for later recycling than sold, unless you urgently need gold for your first gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925467464040449)
- **unrecoverable items tied to first character**: Most things that cannot be recovered if mishandled are tied to the first character created on an account, so deleting that character can cause permanent loss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534597873080078556)
- **unstuck after dying on an island without a healer**: If you die on an island with no visible healer, open the Help menu and use the unstuck option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532472201285703)
- **uo client problems on windows 11**: If the UO client has problems on Windows 11, run the client as administrator, add a virus protection exception if the install failed, and try clicking verify in the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537205603833745568)
- **urkton bluffs as early dungeon**: Urkton Bluffs is suggested by one player as an entry-level dungeon with low PK risk to visit after the Prevalia sewers, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534319413305565)
- **urukton bluffs difficulty**: Urukton Bluffs is new player friendly, and it has deeper levels with more difficult monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554129489447886919)
- **utility mule character**: A mule character on an alternate account with Magery, Resist, Camping and Hiding (plus Frost T0 to avoid being one-shotted) is useful for holding items, shopping, marking runes and retrieving corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538584593819631647)
- **vendor gate safety**: Most vendor gates are safe to enter, as the vast majority of home owners do not kick customers out and murder them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549115441975402648)
- **viable farming builds**: Builds listed as viable for farming without extreme requirements are Poison Dexxer (dual wielding), Dex Tamer, Summoner, Poison Necro (weaker than Poison Dexxer) and Dex Bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525137948469891092)
- **video scaling option**: Options > Video has a scaling setting that makes everything larger, which helps increase font size on 4K screens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520719981023592489)
- **viewing achievements**: To view your achievements, type [achievements in-game or click the Help button on your character's paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525845969688854618)
- **viewing armor rating**: To see your armor rating, open the status window from your paperdoll, or add armor to your info bar via the client options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527386931531612441)
- **viewing quest text**: Open Paperdoll and select Quests to view the text of your current quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522413394735661076)
- **viewing total armor stats**: Type [stats to bring up the screen showing total armor and other character info. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540069312365203537)
- **void armor for new players**: Void armor is recommended for newer players because of its survivability and armor ignore, though wrestlers can also do well in a variety of aspect armors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538268486885711963)
- **wasd movement and always run**: With WASD movement you need a hotkey to toggle run/walk, while mouse movement allows finer control by dragging the cursor further away to run; dungeon and PvP players are advised to use WASD with AlwaysRun on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529229881982976041)
- **weapon build stat distribution**: A weapon-using build uses 100 Strength, 100 Dexterity and 25 Intelligence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338719314214944)
- **weapon equip restrictions**: Any weapon can be equipped regardless of skill or codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520802193903452323)
- **weekly dungeon suitability for new players**: Levels 1 and part of 2 of the weekly dungeon may be okay for new players, who should avoid crossing any rope or trap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538477461367689246)
- **wellington quest chain aspect bundle**: The second quest in the chain from Wellington rewards a bundle that unlocks up to 3 different aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816896424546456)
- **wiki skill templates**: Following a pre-established template from the wiki is much easier than balancing all skills yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538722273035423904)
- **wiki template viability**: Nearly all of the templates shown on the Outlands wiki are viable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547609094263808061)
- **wild herdy tribal bard tamer starting build**: For a wild herdy tribal bard tamer, pick any starting build offering 80 Taming skill, since barding skills are easy to macro up with essentially no risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549998616582823989)
- **wilderness resurrection sources**: Roaming healers and caravans can resurrect a dead player in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526986850533773393)
- **windowed mode**: The game can be run windowed or maximized via Options > Video, and in windowed mode it behaves like any other window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525485543071420528)
- **windowed mode menu placement**: Run the game in windowed mode and resize the actual game screen so black bars surround it, which lets you place menus outside the game view. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535390534179360859)
- **wizard codex source**: A Wizard codex can be bought from player vendors or obtained through the new player quest, and other codexes such as the Summoner Tome exist for other roles; an Alchemy codex is for 80 or more alchemy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549649613089144905)
- **wizard satchel for reagents**: A wizard satchel for holding reagents can be obtained from the guild's shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532993269762494625)
- **writ of orientation**: The Writ of Orientation is a quest item that can be checked in the quest log. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530268193925369989)
- **writ of orientation delivery**: For the beginner quest to deliver the Writ of Orientation to Godfrey (Dean's Assistant), Godfrey is reached through the portal right next to the quest giver. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544799227236982794)
- **young island access**: A player can leave and return to the young island at any time, but can no longer buy from the island NPCs after leaving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527546985144385657)
- **young island purpose**: The young island is meant for safe trading and for getting skills up to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531163553749274655)
- **young player skill gain bonus on shelter**: On Shelter, young players get no bonus skill gain for crafting skills and a 50% skill gain penalty for harvesting skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541937964827811970)
- **young player status loss from inn room**: Leaving an inn room can place a character in a town, which can cause that character to lose its Young Player status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541613979800182875)
- **young status shelter access**: After renouncing young status, a player can still return to the shelter and train skills up to 80, but cannot use the bank or shops there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528949870264844288)

## Scripting & razor

- **razor item delay in beta client**: The Razor item delay is completely removed in beta client 1.0.3.704, which is available only on the test shard. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **unified action queue**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes a Unified Action Queue for both the client and Razor, which should fix many Razor-induced drag and drop issues. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **aspect experience text display toggle**: Use the [ShowAspectExperience command, or Razor > Hotkeys > Outlands Commands > Text Displays > Show Aspect Experience, to toggle text display of earned Aspect experience; toggling can turn off the overhead text while keeping the system message. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215827030810704)
- **casting on last target with macros**: Create a macro with spellcast, then waitfortarget, then lasttarget actions in that order and bind it to a hotkey, and use a separate button or hotkey to set your target, so spells hit the last target automatically even if the mob is no longer the closest. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553944629131345991)
- **community razor scripts**: Community-made Razor scripts for Outlands, including mining and combat scripts, are available and searchable at outlands.uorazorscripts.com, and the Outlands wiki documents the extended Razor scripting features. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549454515952947252)
- **outlands razor script website**: Community-made Razor scripts for Outlands, including skill-training scripts browsable by skill, are hosted at outlands.uorazorscripts.com (UORazorScripts.com). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539342653777248268)
- **razor macro and script concurrency**: Razor can run only one macro or script at a time, and starting a new Razor macro or script stops the one currently running, while Razor hotkeys and client macros do not interfere with a running script. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530054941945888788)
- **razor script pvp restrictions**: Outlands uses a modified Razor that restricts some scripting, such as movement, and disables many script functions and checks like cooldown and debuff in organized PvP (factions, town struggles, structured events). Wilderness PvP is probably less restricted, and details are on the wiki's Razor Scripting page under PvP Restrictions. Python scripts are not allowed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1556024748889342003)
- **razor version on outlands**: Outlands uses its own heavily customized fork of Razor (Community Edition) that is built into the client, is officially part of the server, and has some functions such as movement commands limited. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341049497686089)
- **afk animal taming razor script**: Animal Taming (and Animal Lore and Herding) can be trained AFK with a Razor script that releases a pet and re-tames it in a loop (e.g. say 'trainimp release', respond to the release gump, use taming on the pet, wait about 12.5s, repeat); you can record one manual run in Razor and add timing, or use the 'Flu AFK Tamer to 120' script. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553027114993975307)
- **casting spells on last target with macros**: To cast a spell without clicking a target, make a macro that casts the spell and then targets 'last target' (or current target), and bind it to a hotkey; ending the macro with a 'CurrentTarget' entry makes follow-up 'LastTarget' hotkeys work. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545889063976837210)
- **razor ctrl+mouse wheel hotkeys**: Razor can have hotkeys bound to Ctrl+mouse wheel (such as next/previous target), which fire when zooming with Ctrl+mouse wheel and can cause targeting error messages, especially when entering a new area. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525744553687257138)
- **razor scavenger agent**: The Razor Scavenger agent automatically picks up listed items lying on the ground, such as arrows, bolts, or items left behind after an NPC purchase. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539985558829408346)
- **razor targeting hotkeys**: In Razor, the closest-target hotkey works for PvM but not PvP, so for PvP you cycle next/previous non-friendly player targets. No single hotkey selects the next target and attacks, which takes two hotkeys or a script/macro. Razor profiles allow different hotkeys per character. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555602258501308457)
- **uo razor scripts community site**: outlands.uorazorscripts.com, provided by Jaseowns, is a community site where players share UO Razor scripts for Outlands, browsable by skill, though some scripts may be outdated. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542574704299221042)
- **afk taming razor script**: The 'Flu AFK Tamer to 120' Razor script on UORazorscripts.com trains Animal Taming unattended, but stops working if the pet is too far away or you have more than 1 follower. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554083011874529321)
- **attack hotkey macro setup**: To make an attack hotkey work, bind the macro to the AttackSelectedTarget action and make sure no Razor hotkey is bound to the same key, since that conflict blocks it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539747848952742018)
- **auto-recall scripts on red detection**: Scripts exist that automatically recall the player out the moment a red appears on tracking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535374002552307863)
- **calling razor scripts**: To run a Razor script from a macro button, use the 'say' action with the text '>script name'; within a Razor script, another script can reportedly be called with the command script "nameofscript". _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552136683171090575)
- **client macro to attack closest hostile**: To attack the closest hostile without clicking, create a macro in the UO client (not Razor) under Options, Macros, using the Targets sub-category (Target Closest Non-Friendly / Closest Monster) combined with attack selected target. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544043518954049621)
- **finding razor hotkey bound to a key**: In Razor, open the Hotkeys tab and type the key in parentheses, such as (g), into the search/filter box to find which hotkey is bound to that key. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551426108413448193)
- **fishing pole double-click macros**: Macros and scripts that double-click a fishing pole can fail or stall, even though the same approach works for lumberjacking and mining tools. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551678269642907790)
- **invoking razor scripts from hotkeys**: To run a Razor script from a client hotkey or GUI button, make it say the speech command '>script SCRIPTNAME'; to restart or call a script from another script in Outlands, set a hotkey for the target script in the Razor Hotkeys tab, press record then the hotkey, and use the recorded syntax, which looks like 'Play Script: <script name>'. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532498456755703960)
- **multi-boxing harvesting clients**: Running three clients at once with mining scripts is permitted and is a common practice among Outlands harvesters to increase resource output. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535526452747960382)
- **poison strike command**: The command for Poison Strike is [necromancy2 (also [poisonstrike), typed via say; the correct command is listed in the Help > Commands > Necromancy menu. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524542649607131167)
- **prevent criminal looting command**: Use the [PreventCriminalLooting command to toggle whether you can loot corpses that would make you criminal; macros must match the command's case exactly because commands are now case sensitive. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544777464897732708)
- **preventing bandage override**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, typing the in-game command [PreventBandageOverride toggles the setting that prevents bandage override, which stops a pet-bandaging script from spamming bandages without healing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547438173338992680)
- **razor grab item hotbag setup**: To grab items into a set bag, use the Razor hotkey Set Grab Item Hotbag (Razor > Hotkeys > Misc) and target the container, then use the Grab Item hotkey and target the item; scripts using Grab Item also require this hotbag to be set. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555857935953961055)
- **razor health checks on other mobiles**: Razor scripts can only check your own health and cannot check another mobile's health, such as a pet's, with a condition like 'if hits mobile < 100'. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538578965340491836)
- **razor hotkeys and running scripts**: Pressing a Razor hotkey, including those auto-created for Razor macros and scripts, cancels a running script; only client (CUO) macros such as say-macros for verbal commands avoid interrupting it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538585212701777921)
- **razor input delay versus classicuo**: Razor adds a small input delay (roughly 100-120ms by some reports) compared with ClassicUO, so setting up spells and macros in ClassicUO is preferable, mainly for PvP, magery, barding or high ping, though one test showed identical timing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546566071539204218)
- **razor item recycler scripts**: Razor scripts exist that identify and recycle items while farming: dennozz's 'SUPER ID-Recycler-while-farming' recycles magical armor and weapons, keeps only the items you want to save, reports to the system journal and can eat arcane essences, and 'Item Recycle while Farming (i)' works on your backpack without a set bag. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544322698610475068)
- **razor lift queue bug**: Razor has a queue bug affecting scripted lift commands that can be worked around by putting '@drop backpack' before the lift, and a fix is in a client patch not yet deployed that is expected to return to the test server shortly. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537316995958055043)
- **razor lifttype amount behavior**: In Razor scripting, a lifttype amount set to a specific number lifts exactly that many items from a stack, and if the amount exceeds the stack size it takes whatever is present instead of failing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529546111310627046)
- **razor organizer agent**: To move items between containers, open the Razor Organizer agent, add the item types to its list, set the target container (hotbag, which can be a bank container or a trapped box), then press organize to run it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540174384281550941)
- **razor quick escape scripts**: Razor scripts exist for quick escape, such as one bound to a hotkey that exits through a nearby gate to the last selected town, and one that recalls using a tome or book as an escape. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341240571760840)
- **razor scripts in pvp**: Razor scripts are restricted during PvP as described in the PvP Restrictions section of the Razor Scripting wiki page, but in the PvP scenarios not restricted there, the standard cooldown check can be used. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536328266099589141)
- **razor scripts versus macros**: Razor has both macros and scripts; macros are simpler but less powerful, while scripts are more flexible and easier to edit, debug and copy/paste, so scripts are generally recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548770527726796957)
- **razor targeting hotkeys**: In Razor's hotkey settings, bind 'target closest non friendly monster', 'attack last target', 'last target' and 'target self' to keys or mouse buttons; then press Last Target or Target Self while a targeting cursor is up to cast on your current mob or yourself without clicking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474470690193421)
- **razor versus client macro delay**: Client macros are slightly faster and more limited, while Razor has far fewer limits but a tiny delay that matters mainly in competitive PvP; Razor spell-cast macros need about 200 ms between casts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543338222216683540)
- **razor while casting loop**: In Razor scripts, a 'while casting' loop (with a short wait inside), and a 'while queued' loop, is the best way to wait for a cast to finish and works better than a fixed wait, but it covers only the casting itself and not the delay after the cast. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542842671457112174)
- **recall macro commands**: The [recall command casts Recall using mana, while [recallcharge uses charges; put the command in a macro and bind it to a button to recall with one click. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524536274948456589)
- **recalling without opening a runebook**: Set a default rune on your runebook, then cast recall and target the runebook so you need not open it (this can be macro'd); alternatively, make a Razor hotkey with a say macro for the recallcharge command followed by the rune name, which works with a rune tome or rune book. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341179964072077)
- **scripted corpse looting**: Scripts and macros cannot interact with other players' corpses, and scripts cannot interact with a corpse's contents until it is opened, so looting corpses via script is not possible. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537430873681690654)
- **self-healing with razor hotkeys**: Use Razor's hotkeys instead of a script to heal yourself: the spells hotkeys include cast heal/cure on self (smart version picks a big or small heal, and it does nothing at full HP), and there is also a heal-self-with-bandages hotkey; an in-game macro also works. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **setting loot bag**: To set the bag where looted items go without looting a corpse, use the CUO macro SetGrabBag (on screen or a hotkey) or the button inside the Grid Loot gump. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542054433192550510)
- **setting up a grimoire cooldown trigger**: To set up a cooldown trigger, cast the spell with the grimoire upgrade, find the system message in your journal, and use that text as the trigger. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523063020492685424)
- **showing stealth steps**: Saying [ShowStealthSteps in game shows stealth steps, which can be used with overheads to track timing and skill cooldowns; they can also be shown overhead instead of in chat via Classic UO or Razor settings. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531366902792982588)
- **stopping the dash key from opening chat**: To stop the '-' key from opening the command prompt in the classic UO client, uncheck 'Use additional buttons to activate chat' in the options. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534594509919224030)
- **third-party software policy**: Third-party software is not allowed on Outlands; the only permitted automation tool is the included version of Razor, and tools such as Razor Enhanced are banned. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529602059379408966)
- **tracking for gatherer template**: A gatherer template benefits from Tracking and Camping; tracking-based gatherer scripts call for about 100 Tracking and at least 90 Detect Hidden, and Tracking at 120 gives maximum security. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205695820300309)
- **veterinary supplies cooldown**: To track a veterinary supplies cooldown, either bind a Razor script to a hotkey or create a cooldown entry triggered by the system message 'you begin using veterinary supplies'. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530480202784702534)
- **waiting for target selection in razor scripts**: After casting a spell hotkey and using waitfortarget, add 'while targetexists / wait 100 (or 1000) / endwhile' to pause until the player has selected a target; to limit the wait, use 'waitfortarget 10000' then 'if targetexists' followed by hotkey '> Interrupt' to cancel the cursor after 10 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526002638347571220)
- **activating weapon abilities with razor scripts**: A Razor script can activate a weapon ability by saying '[WeaponAbility1' (or 2 or 3), without a closing parenthesis; for example, if insysmsg 'Weapon ability ready' then say '[weaponability1' endif, with 'loop' added to keep it running, and it can also choose the ability by left-hand item: findlayer self lefthand, getlabel, say '[WeaponAbility1' if the label contains 'shield', otherwise '[WeaponAbility2' (the default with an empty left hand). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533814432814338099)
- **adding a razor script**: To add a Razor script, open Razor, go to Scripts, create a new script, then copy the script text and paste it with Ctrl+V into the script box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537762756495679528)
- **afk auto taming script setup**: An auto taming script is not fully AFK unless the pet is kept where it cannot move, such as a small room; the stable behind the gate or small rooms in town inns work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554116848587513877)
- **allowed client and interface**: Only the official included custom client (UOC) and the included Razor fork are allowed on Outlands; using any other interface is against the rules and strongly enforced. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529281235673682101)
- **anti-pk tracking script**: An anti-PK Razor script can start Tracking and recall the player out instantly as soon as a PK is tracked. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549664955492732949)
- **arcane mode switching script**: Use a script that sets arcane mode to leech when mana is about 30 or less, to surge for 15 seconds after a proc, and to shield otherwise; catalyst is another setting used by default. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531335920102412399)
