- **auto dexxer razor scripts**: Players have built Razor scripts for auto-dexxing during PvM, findable by searching for "auto dexxer" on the UO Razor scripts site. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554538365393571874)
- **auto gold looting script**: A script that automatically loots gold from monster corpses is not possible in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527800634282344528)
- **auto loot and pathfinding availability**: Auto loot and auto pathfinding are disabled in the Outlands client and its Razor fork. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529281477601136823)
- **auto recall for harvesters**: Outlands has an auto recall mechanic that works as AFK protection for harvesters, and most harvesters reportedly use an auto recall script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552106224605204582)
- **auto refreshing weapon abilities with scripts**: A script can auto refresh a weapon ability by checking for the system message 'Weapon Ability Ready' (insysmsg), optionally waiting about 500 ms, and then saying '[weaponability2' (or '[weaponability3' for the third ability). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548020849339015259)
- **auto-picking up arrows and bolts with razor**: To automatically pick up arrows or bolts, open Razor > Agents > Scavenger, click the button to choose a target, then click an arrow or bolt on the ground. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542550467161227335)
- **auto-recall script while flagged**: An auto-recall script still works when you are flagged. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535387759651459173)
- **automated mining scripts**: Complex automated mining scripts exist, such as the 'SUPER-AUTO Mining and Lumberjacking' script on UORazorscripts.com. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549665131561222165)
- **automating follower commands before recall**: To automate keeping followers with you, add a say 'All Follow Me' command in your script above the step where the recall or runebook is used, before double clicking the book. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536792078141497415)
- **autopilot scripts in group content**: Full autopilot scripts are ineffective or harmful in group or complex content such as Omnis because of the many mechanics and emergent events, so scripting is mostly a solo-focused feature. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529294601582674073)
- **background script to cut hats**: Run a script in the background that cuts the wizard's hats made during Inscription training with scissors so they are recycled while you train. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546612413175042138)
- **bapeths ocean master background script**: The Razor script "Bapeths Ocean Master Background" is the default background script to keep running most of the time for Pooners or Mages; for mages it adds Necro and Barding (Discord) functionality, and in defensive (peace) mode it auto heals, auto cures, tops up bard buffs and uses the spyglass automatically. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542265699462942780)
- **begging skill in razor scripts**: Razor scripts for Outlands commonly use the Begging skill as a line-of-sight check, since the game reports that it cannot see the target if it is not visible; the skill itself is rarely used for anything else. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532144297128886364)
- **built-in razor and third-party tools**: UO Outlands includes a mildly nerfed built-in version of Razor launched with the Play Now button, and no third-party tools are allowed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526575618655781045)
- **bundled modified razor**: Outlands bundles a modified, mildly nerfed version of Razor that opens as a second window with the game; the client is also customized, and staff would like to remove Razor once its functions are moved into the client. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530596580262940702)
- **buy agent vendor requirement**: The Razor buy agent does not require a specific vendor and works on any vendor that has the listed items in stock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553872814279233599)
- **calling razor scripts by name in cuo**: When calling a Razor script by name from the CUO client, do not wrap the script name in quotes; scripts stored in a folder may need the folder path included, e.g. 'DropOff/Router'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528752961512280156)
- **classicuo last target reliability**: Last target macros in ClassicUO are unreliable, with discrepancies between the ClassicUO Last Target and the Razor Last Target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532148591408451737)
- **clearsysmsg frequency in razor scripts**: Calling clearsysmsg too often in a Razor script can interfere with the script's system message checks, so it should be used sparingly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525849981863333938)
- **clickable macro for razor agent**: To make a clickable in-game macro for a Razor agent, create a Razor script that calls the agent, then use the command >script SCRIPTNAME in an in-game macro to call it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532993948249882675)
- **client macros and running razor scripts**: In-game (client) macros do not stop a running Razor script, so client macros can be triggered manually while a script keeps running. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523479127959801940)
- **client macros versus razor hotkeys**: Client macros/key bindings and Razor hotkeys are two independent systems that can overlap and conflict, with Razor hotkeys able to override client macros; Razor hotkeys can bind directly to skills without macros and include bindings like [pouch and [rope. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526787494786633809)
- **closing container gumps via script**: Container gumps cannot be closed directly by script; the known workaround is to lift and drop (drag) the container, which closes its gump, or to move out of range, which scripts cannot do. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550130592228839445)
- **container names**: Players cannot name containers; each has an internal name like 0x238E2D that is mainly useful in scripts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526812401293594675)
- **cooldowns for actions without trigger text**: To tie cooldowns to an action that has no trigger text, you need to write a script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523063539290345502)
- **corpse auto-open failure**: A corpse may fail to auto-open if another game action (bandaging, casting, opening a bag) is in progress as the mob dies, because only one action can occur at a time; the corpse stays unopened and auto open corpses catches it on your next step, so moving one square can trigger it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548305372844925079)
- **currenttarget command type**: CurrentTarget is an in-game macro command and not a verbal command. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528693808999567522)
- **cursor-position targeting macro**: It is not possible to script or macro a single button to click Rope and then target wherever the cursor hovers, because Razor only records fixed target coordinates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533793064466907249)
- **dropping items by script**: To drop an item on the ground by script use 'drop -1 -1 -1'; when dropping into a container use -1 -1 as the coordinates so items stack, because specific coordinates dictate a position in the container and prevent stacking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364508606431242)
- **elven spellblade skinning script**: A Razor or UO Steam script that uses findtype and dclick on an Elven Spellblade as the skinning knife works with any color of knife, only skins corpses not already skinned, and works on skinning maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537191079009583166)
- **empty drop before scripted lift**: Putting an empty '@drop backpack -1 -1' before a scripted lift is a convenient and robust way to avoid lift errors caused by an item already being held. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537422048568279102)
- **entering red moongate in dungeon**: To enter a red moongate in a dungeon quickly, run to the gate and use a hotkey script that says "[moongate", waits for gump 3773199800, responds 15, waits for the same gump again, then responds 2. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522261382764957877)
- **essence tracking in scripts**: Essence cannot be tracked through a script, so a script cannot check whether essence is at 1000. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551501654182862889)
- **finding an item's serial in game**: Type `>info` (or `>item`) in game and click the target item to display its name, id, and serial. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548063368118673451)
- **finding item types for razor scripts**: Use the in-game >info command to look up item types needed for Razor scripts, such as for dual wielding and throwing weapons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523095017084944584)
- **finding mouse wheel bindings in razor**: To find mouse wheel hotkey bindings in Razor, open Razor > Hotkeys and type 'wheel' into the search/filter bar. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525744553687257138)
- **findtype minimum range**: The lowest usable range for Razor's findtype is 1, which searches a 3x3 grid, so it is not possible to search only the tile you are standing on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538855065853497396)
- **findtype range zero behavior**: In Razor's findtype command, a range of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default, which is any range. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538853810842239076)
- **getting bank box serial for scripts**: To get your bank box serial, record a macro or script that drops an item into the bank box, convert it to a script if needed, and read the serial from the 'drop [serial]' line. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545737017797902428)
- **harvesting macro weight tracker**: Add a weight tracker to a harvesting macro so that, when near carry capacity, it moves ore to a pack animal (for mining) or recalls home (when the pack is full), avoiding exceeding capacity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526221154023641148)
- **health bar collector priority order**: In the Health Bar Collector settings, priority 1 is the highest priority and is considered first. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525679390485381191)
- **keeping looping script running with hotkey scripts**: To keep a looping script running when a hotkey script interrupts it, end the hotkey script with `script "looping script name"` so control returns to the main loop. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538585302417932298)
- **keyboard movement without always run**: To use keyboard movement without always run on, make a macro in the Outlands client using the 'AlwaysRun' main-level macro command to toggle it on and off. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540089474711683282)
- **last target in client versus razor**: The in-game (ClassicUO) last target is not the same as the Razor last target, so macros using lasttarget in one may have no target set from the other. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544600459753431050)
- **listing backpack items in scripts**: There is no way to list every item in the backpack in a script without using findtype; you must know the item or type ID beforehand. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534532933816156170)
- **loadout switching scripts**: A script can swap between loadout configurations, and outlandsbutler.com offers a loadout script maker that automates this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539502440157276)
- **locking skills with scripts**: A Razor script can cap a skill by checking its value and locking it, e.g. if skill 'Healing' >= 80 then setskill 'Healing' lock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550779613725065279)
- **looping character names to dress**: In Razor scripts, you can build a list of character names with createlist/pushlist, loop over it, compare each entry to 'name', and run 'dress <name>' for the matching character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545694476310421505)
- **macro movement key conflict options**: The client options under experimental include two settings that prevent macros from running on the same keys as movement, even with modifiers; with WASD movement enabled, a macro bound to a movement key will make the character walk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534142941692428389)
- **macros and on-screen buttons**: Macros can be created in the Razor hotkeys tab or in the in-game client under Options > Macros, and macro buttons can be placed on screen; the Outlands UI buttons are themselves in-game macros pulled out as buttons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536918750878761102)
- **magery leveling reagent cost**: Leveling Magery with auto-leveling scripts consumes a large amount of reagents, and the jaseowns leveling scripts are good enough for the purpose. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526974615845343342)
- **magery training razor scripts**: Razor scripts on uorazorscripts.com can train Magery automatically, including a 'Train Magery 0 to 100' script using the Shelter Dungeon with restocking from a Restock Agent or storage shelf, and one casting Invisibility from scrolls for 0 to 80; scripts cast at max speed and can run AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660091031093248)
- **moongate escape script**: Spam a moongate script when near a yellow or red gate to escape almost instantly, but you must still reach the gate first. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476303395233803)
- **moving bulk npc-bought items between characters**: To move many NPC-bought items (such as sewing kits) between characters, use the Razor Organizer agent (Razor > Agents > Organizer), or put the items in a container and hand it over or leave it in a rented room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532198043305119774)
- **moving items between containers in razor**: To move listed items from the backpack to another container in a Razor script, loop with foreach and for each item do: if find item backpack, lift item, wait 300, drop the destination container variable, wait 300; lift and drop with X and Y coordinates can also place an item at a specific backpack position. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552297642673832059)
- **multiple clients on one razor profile**: Running multiple clients at once on the same Razor profile can cause settings problems and script malfunctions, so work on Razor scripts with one client open at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529795417397661767)
- **nearest monster targeting macro in melee**: A macro can target the nearest monster while in melee as long as it is not a player; this does not work for PvP targets. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524565203201691838)
- **notoriety checks in scripts**: Scripts can check a target's notoriety for friend, murderer and possibly enemy (orange), but notoriety checks also include all mobs and wildlife, so they do not isolate players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552605935225143378)
- **one-line script calling another script**: A script consisting only of a one-liner that calls another script does not work; adding an extra line (overhead) before the call makes it work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1521009026932932769)
- **outlands wiki command and scripting references**: The Outlands wiki has a Commands page listing in-game commands and a Razor Scripting page at wiki.uooutlands.com/Razor_Scripting, and Razor has a say command under its hotkeys for Outlands commands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526014443862102019)
- **pet aggro setting via script**: Changing a pet's aggro setting via script is possible but very unreliable because it requires controlling gumps, and there is no way to check the current setting without changing it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552455551093313549)
- **plant and breeding scripts**: Scripts that make plant growing and mount breeding easier exist and can be searched at outlands.uorazorscripts.com. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533877657375211681)
- **poison strike macro targeting**: Poison Strike works via a macro when combined with the Razor hotkey 'Set Last Target', but not with the in-game Last Target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524549153378533427)
- **profile manager switch button**: The Switch button in the profile manager activates (loads) the selected profile. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532067083368796172)
- **programmatic data extraction and script looting rules**: Programmatic extraction of data from game logs is forbidden in Outlands whether done live or after logging out, and looting items through a script is not possible. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542036787688513558)
- **quick weapon switching**: To switch weapons quickly, place them in the in-game hotbar and assign hotkeys, or in Razor add them to an Arm/Dress list and set hotkeys in the arm/dress section of the hotkey settings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520845860714320053)
- **razor and classicuo grab bag**: Razor and ClassicUO have separate grab bags: in CUO, the set grab bag button on the grid loot gump sends grid loot and double-click loot into the set bag, and the Grab macro with CUO Grab Bag gives a target cursor that works on floor items; in Razor, Set Item Grab Bag works only with the Grab Item hotkey, which puts targeted items into the Razor-set bag. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550040292454043691)
- **razor arrow scavenger hotbag bug**: If the Razor arrow scavenger will not accept the hotbag, it is a bug; closing everything, restarting the game from scratch and assigning the hotbag again fixes it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541881679629647902)
- **razor assistant program**: Razor is a third-party assistant program that improves the UI and runs macros and scripts; it is not strictly required, but a skill-training macro is recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526099191720579214)
- **razor bandage self hotkey**: Bind 'Bandage Self' in Razor > Hotkeys by filtering for 'bandage' (bandages use the Healing skill). In scripts, call it with: hotkey 'Bandage Self' (the hotkey's exact name, not 'Hotkey'). For manually targeted pets, use hotkey 'Use Bandage', wft, then loop while targetexists, and call the loop script. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539336779289858129)
- **razor bracket placeholder behavior**: A bracket placeholder displays the raw bracket text when no word exists at that position, and words beyond the last used placeholder are not shown (e.g. using only {3} {4} shows only the first two words of a longer name). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529105315318988821)
- **razor camping script**: A Razor script can automate camping training by looping: while Camping skill is below 80 and kindling is in the backpack, use kindling when no campfire is nearby, with a 1000 ms wait. A timer-based variant uses dclick every 5.5 seconds and reuses kindling every 600000 ms (10 minutes) to restart the campfire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549671844519481355)
- **razor capture of player speech**: A Razor script cannot capture or react to the player's own speech as a conditional; it can read system messages and similar text but not the player's own chat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530018329043931146)
- **razor character name expression**: In Razor scripts the expression for the character's name is 'name'; 'char' is pseudo code and does not work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545857471510221062)
- **razor client assistant**: Razor, the client assistant program, runs automatically alongside the Outlands client and provides quality-of-life features such as hotkeys and scripting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525474918991397004)
- **razor collector detection range**: A Razor collector can detect red mobs at up to 18 tiles, even before they are visible on screen, and a separate collector can be set to a shorter range such as about 4 tiles for grey mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542562876995149996)
- **razor container variable re-selection check**: In a Razor script, check whether the stored container serial is found in your backpack (e.g. 'if not find box_serial backpack'), and if not, run '@setvar' to prompt for it again, or use findtype to locate the container automatically. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540403279094222888)
- **razor cooldown bar for hamstring**: To make a Razor cooldown bar start on Hamstring, set a cooldown time on the bar and set it to scan system messages (sysmsgs) rather than overhead messages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529413263669067787)
- **razor dress agent re-equip**: Razor's Dress Agent stores worn items and re-equips them in one click, including after disarm and directly from your corpse without opening it, provided the list is left serialized and not changed by type. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531563024463302759)
- **razor dress items not adding**: The Razor problem where some items did not add to the Dress list has been fixed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523536402661376030)
- **razor drop ground command**: In a Razor script, 'drop ground' drops an item onto the character's own tile and is reported to work reliably, and 'droprelloc 0 0' also drops at the character's own tile. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537563957617758218)
- **razor f1 all names hotkey**: In Razor, F1 is bound to 'all names' by default, and a profile hotkey (such as F2) can also be assigned to show all names; this is changed in Razor hotkeys, where searching with the key in parentheses, such as (f2), finds the hotkey itself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525790867221123172)
- **razor findtype versus find commands**: In Razor scripts, find and target commands use a specific serial, while findtype and targettype use an item or mobile type ID or name, and findtype can store the result with 'as <name>'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543355016369414254)
- **razor grab item hotkey**: The Razor 'Grab' hotkey works with 'Set Grab Item Hotbag', brings up a target cursor, and moves the targeted item (taken from a container by double click) to your Razor grab bag, which is separate from the loot bag used for grid loot from corpses; these are Razor functions, not game macros. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536474419218874470)
- **razor grab vs classicuo grab bag**: The Razor grab functions (Set Grab Item Hotbag and Grab item) are independent of the ClassicUO set grab bag function and do not interact with it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530567806582521866)
- **razor gump id specification**: In Razor scripts, always specify the unique gump ID: waitforgump without an ID (or with 'any') returns instantly because always-open gumps like Necrohotbar or Cooldowns count, and gumpresponse should include both the button ID and the gump ID. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549729571300048937)
- **razor hotkey command naming**: The Razor script hotkey command requires the full recorded hotkey name, such as hotkey 'Use Bandage (No Timer)' or hotkey 'Play Script: <script name>', and a shortened name like hotkey 'Healing' is not valid. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538590524834054194)
- **razor hotkey passing to client**: In Razor, passing a hotkey means allowing the key press to also be seen by the UO client so both can act on the same key; unticking the pass-to-UO checkbox prevents a client-bound macro on that key from running. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548764638961860730)
- **razor item search and unopened containers**: Razor scripts may fail to find items held in hand or in containers (pouches, satchels) not opened since login, so open the container first so Razor can count its contents. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530008455794917406)
- **razor less-than operator and string comparison**: In Razor scripts, the operator < means strictly less than (at-or-under is <=), but a comparison written as 'variable < number' can be evaluated as a string comparison, so flip it (e.g. 'if 1000 > resistVar') to avoid that. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554230203386167319)
- **razor lift and drop handling**: In a Razor script, add 'drop backpack -1 -1' before each 'lift' to prevent scrolls from getting stuck held, and use a drop command such as 'drop 121 121 0' after a wait to place a lifted item at specific backpack coordinates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528036112789012611)
- **razor loadout name matching after drop down update**: Since the drop down menu update, Razor scripts cannot match shelf or codex loadouts by name, so name-based scripts no longer work and the loadout number must be used instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545490507784786040)
- **razor macro backup**: Back up your Razor macros and UI profiles, for example to Google Drive, so you do not lose them if your PC crashes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526681756177273052)
- **razor macro category creation**: In Razor's scripts/macro list, adding a category while an existing category is selected creates it as a sub category inside it; to create a main-level category, first click the empty area or a main-level entry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536500877597347890)
- **razor macro recording**: Razor can record a stream of actions into a macro, which can then be edited to add timeouts and other changes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543341514405584946)
- **razor macros interrupting looping scripts**: Executing a Razor macro interrupts a looping script in UO Outlands, and this has always been the behavior. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528216687092957326)
- **razor magery script language compatibility**: Razor scripts are generally preferred over macros, but the Magery script works only with English hotkey names and fails under Russian language settings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522401710780317827)
- **razor outerwaist layer support**: Razor scripts do not currently recognize an OuterWaist layer, since some layers have not yet been added to Razor, and the RazorCE script layers guide does not list it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535128043377397792)
- **razor outlands window closing**: The Razor Outlands window cannot be closed because it is part of the game, but it can be minimized to the system tray using the 'show in system tray' option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533817965605290005)
- **razor overhead message for system messages**: In Razor, to show an overhead message for a system message, use the Search in SysMsg field to enter or find the message text (e.g. 'Now tracking'), click Add, then type the text to display overhead; the color can be set. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538846538363568158)
- **razor overhead messages**: Razor can be configured to show overhead messages above your character's head instead of in the journal for events such as bandage timers, rare ore or log drops, or a red approaching. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529238239217586257)
- **razor poisoning training script**: The 'Training Poisoning with no shelf' Razor script on outlands.uorazorscripts.com trains Poisoning from 50 to 120. It needs separate bags for each poison type and by default poisons a kryss. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529354496738725939)
- **razor profile location**: Razor profiles are stored in Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Plugins\Assistant\Profiles and can be deleted manually from that folder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553197970772729857)
- **razor rails removal**: Rails (pathing) were removed from Razor on Outlands, which previously let macro users automate mining routes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544810118082854984)
- **razor script @ prefix**: In Razor scripts, prefixing a command with @ silences some of its info/warning/error messages but does not otherwise change behavior, and it only works for a handful of commands (not hotkey); '!' is a separate modifier related to saving the variable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551274601168896003)
- **razor script calls not returning**: In Razor, a script called from another script does not return control to the caller, so all actions must be completed before the call and the call must be the last line; anything placed after it, such as a wait, does nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555051401812648037)
- **razor script input via runebook name**: Razor scripts cannot take input while running, but you can pass input such as a rune number by renaming a runebook or marked rune and having the script read the name, pausing the script while waiting for the rename. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528747377454743723)
- **razor script quote characters**: Razor scripts accept straight single and double quotes, but curly typographic quotes do not work; overhead text strings may need double quotes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541058653874823300)
- **razor script skill cooldown check**: A Razor script that uses a skill in a loop will spam it unless it checks cooldown, so create an in-game cooldown triggered by the skill's overhead message (such as the barding cooldown reset message) and have the script check whether that cooldown is running. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549329958701375539)
- **razor script to equip spellbook**: A working Razor script to equip a spellbook is: if findtype 3834 backpack as mybook, then lift mybook 1, wait 300, drop 'self' RightHand, wait 300, endif. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548396420954980387)
- **razor script variables**: In Razor scripts, set a variable with '@setvar! name value' and test it with 'if name = value ... endif' or 'while name = value ... endwhile'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541049953600671804)
- **razor scripting logical operators**: Razor scripting supports 'and' and 'or' as logical operators, avoiding the need for nested ifs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541931203660226651)
- **razor setvar versus setvar! lag**: In Razor scripts, setvar saves the variable to the Razor profile .xml file, so each access needs a file read and can cause lag in looping scripts, while setvar! keeps the variable in memory, but only when a value is assigned at declaration; if setvar is run without a value (cursor targeting), the ! has no effect and the variable is stored on disk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550870445459247127)
- **razor smart targeting**: With Razor Smart Targeting enabled, the last beneficial target and last harmful target are tracked separately, so one 'Last Target' hotkey heals your last healed person after a heal and hits your last attacked mob after a harmful spell or item, and the 'Set Last Target (Harmful)' hotkey can set the harmful target. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547120844298526760)
- **razor sound command availability**: The Razor scripting sound command is not available on Outlands, and staff will not add it because they do not want to support unattended gameplay. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544632022771957851)
- **razor spam message filters**: Message spam from Razor commands that do not support the '@' prefix can be suppressed by setting up text filters under Razor -> Filters -> Text & Messages, which also removes unimportant system spam messages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542844494813073428)
- **razor target not found error**: A Razor 'target not found' error, shown with a line beginning with 'Razor', appears when a Target Next function from a script, macro or hotkey finds no target of that type nearby. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523108405135282317)
- **razor update and outdated guides**: Razor has been updated, so older guides may show options that no longer exist or are unnecessary. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532790716290568264)
- **reading debuff details from target**: Scripts cannot read the 'Cripple' debuff text from the target label, nor obtain a list of a target's debuffs with their percentages or durations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543248840654594149)
- **releasing summoned creatures via script**: A script can release summoned creatures by having the player say or whisper '<Name> release' or 'All Release', which avoids scripting a menu. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551734938288529504)
- **reselecting script container in razor**: In Razor, to reselect the container a script uses, go to the Scripts tab, open options, find the variable the script uses and remove it from the list, or use the retarget function. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527624127278616700)
- **returning from a called script**: In Outlands Razor scripts, calling another script with 'script' ends the currently running script and starts the called one from the beginning, and there is no built-in function to return to the caller. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524941957594353675)
- **returning to first razor script after invoking another**: To resume a Razor script after invoking a second script, track the stage in a local variable and have the second script end with a 'script' call back to the first (or push the first script's own dispatch ID after the invoked script's ID), so the first script continues from the stage where it called the second. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525161785873793104)
- **returning to main background script**: To get back to a main background script after a one-off script finishes, have the one-off script call the original script at its end. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524932745447608411)
- **saving chivalry and necromancy hotbar positions**: Use the commands -savechivbar and -savenecrobar to save the Chivalry and Necromancy hotbar locations so you don't have to reopen and reposition them every login. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535759839308025927)
- **saving razor and script changes**: When changing scripts or Razor settings (including hotkeys), close all other clients first, make the changes with only one client open, then exit using the in-game logout and fully close the client, because each session saves settings on close and an older session can overwrite the new ones. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545831353789194310)
- **saving razor hotkeys**: After creating or changing Razor hotkeys and settings, save the Razor profile, pressing Save a couple of times before logging out, so they do not vanish. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545831883160428656)
- **saving razor settings**: To keep Razor settings, have only one client open, make your changes and click save in Razor General, then close the client cleanly by logging out via the paperdoll logout button and using 'quit' so changes are saved. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533501201575051375)
- **script legality**: Scripts, including ones that pilot an entire character, are legal on Outlands as long as you are not gaining experience (chain, aspect or pet) or resources (gold, lumber, ore etc.) while AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541832087663939644)
- **scripted gatherer auto-recall**: Some players script everything when harvesting with multiple characters, and some gatherer scripts include an auto-recall that recalls the character away when tracking detects a red (hostile) player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544336221537574923)
- **scripting a chivalry healer**: A pure healer with chivalry cannot be fully scripted on Outlands, and the developers want less automation rather than more. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529297703937249401)
- **scripting after map patch**: After the map patch, only clicking buttons on the map gump is disabled for scripting; harvesting actions, auto recall and other scripted actions can still be scripted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536925960253866077)
- **scripting combat advice**: Scripting is useful for repetitive tasks like restocking, but long-term scripting of combat is discouraged because it plays the game for you and stunts learning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547566496484691968)
- **scripting new resource map gumps**: The new resource map gumps cannot be scripted in Razor; button presses record only as 'waitforgump' and not as a gumpresponse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537312950598246512)
- **scripting text checks in context menus**: Scripts probably cannot check for text inside a context menu (non-gump menu) prompt, since 'ingump' does not work for that kind of menu. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551709936323399771)
- **scripting treasure digging**: When scripting digging up a treasure, loop the dig action continuously rather than waiting for a system message, because the completion message is not a system message. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537014928613838849)
- **skinning blue corpses**: Blue (non-criminal) player corpses can be skinned, but they must be targeted manually; scripts exist that try to skin all nearby corpses, grey or blue. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553311055323861073)
- **skinning blue corpses with a script**: Use a Razor script that targets the corpse directly (not self) to skin blue corpses, which gives skill gain chances from any dead mob on the ground without turning you grey; while it runs, do not touch anything, just skin and walk away. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555529207893725255)
- **smart targeting and target trackers**: Enable Smart Targeting in Razor; the last beneficial and harmful targets can then be viewed on the Target Trackers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536858837053612163)
- **smoke bomb command**: Type [smokebomb to use a smoke bomb via command, or use the Razor hotkey assigned for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544056408419344406)
- **spell hotkeys**: To bind a hotkey to a spell, open Razor (the program that launches with the game) > Hotkeys and filter or search for the spell; in-game macros using the CastSpell command also work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525601644102811720)
- **splitting stacks against theft**: Splitting items into multiple stacks prevents them from being stolen all at once, and a script that splits bandages, potions and arrows automatically makes theft harder. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527429653575373005)
- **stopping razor scripts**: Stop a running Razor script from the script menu in the Razor window, and bind the stop-all-scripts hotkey, the first entry under Razor > Hotkeys, so you can halt scripts quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523103121042313380)
- **stopping script before afk**: Stopping your harvesting script before going AFK is the safest option and avoids ending up in jail. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549416515785199707)
- **swapping macro sets between echoes**: To use different macro sets on different echoes, copy and paste the macros.xml file in the Razor profiles folder (or rename profile folders) before logging into the new character; deleting a profile makes the client create a fresh one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528695370031562842)
- **taming script setup**: To run a taming script in Razor, create a 'taming' cooldown under options -> cooldown and untick the snooping filters under Razor -> filters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549742702919155773)
- **taming training script setup**: To use a taming training script, get the script from UORazorScripts and paste it into Razor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522470681391140914)
- **targeting hotkeys in scripts**: To target in an Outlands script, bind and record a targeting hotkey and call it as hotkey "target X"; to target players, use the next or previous target hotkeys instead of closest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1520846507362750624)
- **targeting methods**: Outlands supports targeting via scripts, drag select, health bar selectors/collectors, and classic clicking including double-clicking nameplates, and HP bar collectors are especially helpful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540417228124594247)
- **taunt keybinding**: To bind a key for taunt, use an in-game macro with the [taunt command, or in Razor go to Hot Keys -> Outlands Commands -> Mechanics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820192952295445)
- **tome item ids**: Outlands tomes use a separate item ID for each tome rather than one ID with multiple hues, and the IDs are 70142-70145 and 70158-70168. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548955195113742407)
- **tracking system messages triggering scripts**: Tracking system messages still work and still trigger scripts such as recall scripts, even after the recent patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537231570174349423)
- **unsupported equipment layers in razor scripts**: Some equipment layers, such as the outer waist layer used by the ornamented waistband, are not recognized by Razor scripts and cause an error when referenced by layer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535128043377397792)
- **using getlabel value outside its block**: To use a value obtained by getlabel outside its block in a Razor script, store it with setvar before the if statement, since setvar variables are global scoped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538726874841227359)
- **vet supplies hotkey**: To hotkey Vet Supplies, create an in-game say macro with [VetSupplies, or alternatively record a script or macro that double-clicks the item itself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553484532810776688)
- **weapon ability say commands**: Weapon abilities can be triggered by saying [WeaponAbility1, [WeaponAbility2 or [WeaponAbility3 (for example [weaponability1 activates Skirmish from a codex), and these commands can be placed in a CUO macro. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534255488060096642)
- **wizard hat swap script for stealth**: A script that hot-swaps a magical wizard hat prevents you from walking over people or mobs and revealing yourself while stealthed; use it while walking, not while stabbing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522380308832583792)
- **abilities hotbar persistence**: The abilities hotbar disappears each time you rejoin the game, and opening it can be added to a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553143175307198467)
- **ability cooldown tracking script**: To track ability cooldowns such as Poison Strike, use a script that casts or triggers the cooldown; the forum guide Arcane Academy - A Conveyance of Cooldowns explains how, and its Pain Spike example can be adapted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524437280842842112)
- **ability hotbar opening**: The ability hotbar cannot auto-open on login; its position can be set, but you must make a macro that says [AbilityHotbar and a macro button to click after logging in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547579115912036392)
- **adding missing item ids to razor scripts**: To add missing items such as harpoons or new weapons to a Razor script's item ID list, use the >info command on the unidentified items and add the reported IDs to the list in the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533175857504456734)
- **alchemy training bottle recovery**: While training Alchemy, drink the lesser resist potions with a Razor script to get the empty bottles back; the 'Crafting Queue Alchemy Helper' script does this and moves empty bottles to a bag or chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541981050882891886)
- **alt+i backpack not opening fix**: If Alt+I does not open the backpack, check Options > Macros for a changed backpack macro, check Razor > hotkeys for a hotkey assigned to Alt+I, and fully restart the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526172820244009040)
- **anti-pk gathering setup**: Using an auto recall script with Detect Hidden 80 and Tracking 100 is one player's setup for protecting against red player killers while gathering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527307050655420577)
- **anti-thief loot bag protection script**: To protect your loot bag from thieves in a Razor PvM script, find the loot bag by its color in your backpack as a variable and add a 'lift' of that variable inside the anti-thief section, so the script lifts and holds the bag while you run away if a thief pops it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527672756752351272)
- **anti-thief razor script**: An anti-thief Razor script can detect a lost trap pouch by comparing the red pouch count (counttype 3705 backpack 38) against the previous total, then warn overhead and lift the loot bag so a thief cannot reach it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528036112789012611)
- **anti-thief script gold stashing**: In Orb's anti-thief Razor script, gold is stashed into the lockbox only while in peace mode, so it does not interrupt other functions during war mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537197388215877744)
- **anti-thief script item placement**: For Orb's anti-thief survival script, potions and bandages must be kept in a lockbox, which the script unlocks and locks automatically, while trapped pouches must be kept in the root of your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537197388215877744)
- **approximate weapon ability cooldown bar**: To approximate a weapon ability cooldown bar, script the weapon ability command, wait about the swing time times the expected number of swings to hit, then trigger a named Cooldown (e.g. 'Bane') set to the ability's cooldown; this is only a rough estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523373648877191321)
- **aquamarine pet and paragon chest shared graphic id**: The Aquamarine Pet shares graphic/body ID 2475 with the Paragon Chest, so a script searching for ID 2475 can mistake the pet for a Paragon Chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542528993486446645)
- **arcane essence tracking**: Outlands sends one system message when arcane essence runs low and a notification when it runs out, and there is no known way to track the exact amount in Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547560398797148200)
- **archprotection macro delay**: Archprotection self-targets the caster, so a Razor macro needs no wait-for-target step and a delay of about 1500 ms (200 ms plus the roughly 1.25 s cast time of a 4th circle spell) is optimal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543338336813326566)
- **artisan aspect upgrade button id**: In the Outlands Aspect gump (gump id 2424293173), the upgrade button for the Artisan aspect has button id 7 when used via gumpresponse in a Razor script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555847855795867719)
- **aspect armor and weapon macro commands**: Type [AspectArmor <aspect> for armor and [AspectWeapon <aspect> for weapon, replacing <aspect> with the aspect name (e.g. Shadow). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537111651650642031)
- **aspect gump refresh behavior**: The aspect gump closes and reopens every couple of seconds to update experience values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555847967598968864)
- **atlas hotkey script**: Record a simple script of opening the Atlas and selecting your destination, then bind it to a hotkey; the Atlas hike itself is a manual action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **attack lasttarget fallback behavior**: In a Razor script, 'attack lasttarget' attacks the last target, which can be a blue (innocent) player, if none of the preceding Target Closest commands (Enemy, Grey, Murderer) find a target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524384910373027931)
- **auto health collector tools and nameplates**: Auto health collector tools affect only health gumps and do not affect nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545533970760859718)
- **auto queue object delay workaround**: The Auto queue object delay setting might work around corpses failing to auto-open, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548305541057617981)
- **auto re-equip weapon after spell macro**: Create a weapon arm/dress setup with a hotkey, edit each spell macro, begin recording at the end, press the arm/dress hotkey, then stop recording; the resulting 'Dress: Weapon' line can be copied and pasted at the end of other spell macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528443402939793450)
- **auto taunt script self-targeting fix**: If an auto taunt script targets yourself, add a 'wait for target' command before the self-targeting step. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522699775953076324)
- **auto track and recall script setup**: Use an auto track and recall script set for red and grey players (or blue players too for extra safety), and occasionally track manually to see who is nearby that the red/grey tracker might not be picking up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543052329656254604)
- **auto unequip hands for spellcasting**: There is an auto unequip hands option for casting spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532150487309357248)
- **auto-drinking magic resist potion in razor**: To auto-drink a Magic Resist potion in Razor, check if not findbuff "Magic Resist Potion", then findtype "Black Potion" self, dclick it, and wait 500. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528127688349585448)
- **auto-looting scripts**: On Outlands, scripts cannot be used to auto-loot corpses; only grid loot or grabbing items without a script works, and restock cannot be used to loot from a body. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551915416098574387)
- **auto-recall script hang risk**: If an auto-recall script hangs, it will not recall you out, so the script must be reliable and not hang. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533250048824180746)
- **auto-recycle scripts**: Scripts exist that automatically recycle items from a bag using wands or skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546350322526588940)
- **auto-targeting hotkey script**: A hotkey script can target automatically with the pattern: perform the action, waitfortarget, then target lasttarget (e.g. cast 'Fireball', waitfortarget, target lasttarget). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536857981457535036)
- **autoclickers and razor scripts**: Autoclickers are not allowed, but Razor scripts are allowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533023268997562538)
- **autoloot**: Autoloot is disabled except for small interactions with your own body. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537432237786529804)
- **automated reagent buying rules**: Automatically buying reagents from NPC vendors is reportedly not allowed and a stationary penalty has been added, but some players still find ways to automate it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541870657992786122)
- **automatic movement in scripts**: Automatic movement is forbidden and is removed from scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535310823147175956)
- **automating codex abilities**: To automate a codex ability such as Spinslash, macro it; for weapon abilities, type [codex to keep the gump open and click whichever ability you want to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551599072391987211)
- **avoiding fishing net throws near monsters**: A script can avoid throwing a fishing net when a monster is on screen by pressing the next hostile mob hotkey and then checking whether a last target is found, though this approach is untested and uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536871439360065707)
- **avoiding pet targeting**: To avoid accidentally targeting pets, pull out health bars and click the health bar of the exact mob, or set up cycling hotkeys in Razor: cycle to the desired monster (making it Last Target), press the spell hotkey, then press the Last Target hotkey when the reticle appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554693099605860414)
- **avoiding repeat pilfering of creatures**: To avoid re-pilfering the same creature in a Razor script, add each pilfered monster to a list and skip to the next monster if it is already in the list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541055924108533952)
- **avoiding repeated discordance or peacemaking in razor**: To avoid repeatedly using Discordance or Peacemaking on a monster in a Razor script, call getlabel on the target and check whether the label contains 'discord', 'pacified' or 'barding break' before using the skill, and treat summoned, bonded, tame or released creatures as already handled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549329958701375539)
- **avoiding smoke bomb waste when hidden**: To avoid wasting a smoke bomb when already hidden, start the Razor script with 'if hidden', then an overhead message and 'stop', then 'endif'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535660653409472562)
- **avoiding speech request throttling**: To reduce the 'ignoring speech request' message when running scripts, add a 1 second delay between speech-based commands such as [pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524012053734363249)
- **backstabber reward item overheads**: A backstabber's special reward items produce a 'you steal X' system message, where X is the item, so you must create one overhead per item or a single catch-all overhead, and you cannot filter out unwanted items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531902420777701416)
- **bandage loop scripts**: Many players run a bandage loop script so they do not have to bandage themselves manually every 7 seconds once their codex is leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539985156889383094)
- **bandage macro setup**: To create a bandage macro, make a new macro with the action "bandageself" (or just "bandage"), which sets up bandaging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547568453676699739)
- **bandage timing via overhead messages**: You can time bandaging by watching the overhead message countdown, and setting the overhead message duration to 1 second instead of the default 5 is suggested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533461611489263756)
- **bandaging check side effect**: A script that blocks bandaging while already bandaging may also prevent you from healing yourself while you are bandaging someone else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533460932292771910)
- **bandaging pets and lasttarget in scripts**: Manually bandaging a pet changes LastTarget, which can disrupt a running script that relies on LastTarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538570315448189109)
- **bank box as organizer hot bag**: To use the bank box as an organizer hot bag, record a script that moves an item in the bank to get its ID, make a script targeting that ID, and run it after the organizer asks for a target; an easier solution is to use a subcontainer in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528376774218747964)
- **bank box targeting in scripts**: The bank box itself cannot be targeted when moving items in scripts, so place a bag or box inside the bank box and use that as the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532665239013691432)
- **bank hotkey auto-deposit behavior**: When the bank is opened with a hotkey, the client attempts to lift and place any gold stack into the bank automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529101862056366230)
- **bard training prevalia zoo script**: The 'Bard Training - Prevalia Zoo' Razor script keeps bard skills balanced when training all three and uses the lower discordance cooldown to speed up training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549006325629976586)
- **basic harvesting macro**: To make a basic harvesting macro, record yourself double-clicking the tool and targeting yourself, then experiment with a loop timer that suits your ping, and add an overhead message for when it is time to move. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521225704958857226)
- **beta client script lift cursor behavior**: In the beta client, lifting an item via script is intended to make it show on the cursor the same way as lifting it manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524898792837484656)
- **binding hotkeys in the client**: If a hotkey does not register when binding it in the client, press the desired key several times in quick succession while binding so it registers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532149126588796949)
- **binding macros to hotkeys in cuo**: To tie a macro to a hotkey in CUO, click the empty field at the top of the macro window and choose your hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522741902959710450)
- **binding mouse button to razor macro**: To bind a mouse button to a macro in Razor, hover over the key section for the macro and press the mouse button you want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530716729481887816)
- **binding potion hotkeys in razor**: To bind potion-drinking hotkeys, open Razor, go to Hotkeys, and filter for 'drink'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524979330671972374)
- **bless buff detection**: In Outlands, the "Cunning" buff is absent once Bless wears off, so a Razor script can use findbuff "Cunning" to check whether Bless is active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528134974169940008)
- **bless duration tracking**: A cooldown (buff) bar can be used to track Bless duration, and recasting Bless while it is still active resets the cooldown timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529466422038757397)
- **bless end message in razor**: The message shown when Bless ends does not appear in the Razor system log, so a Razor overhead cannot be triggered by it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529462436422488186)
- **bless friendly script**: A working script to cast Bless on a nearby friendly player is: hotkey "Cancel Current Target", cast "Bless", waitfortarget 3000, hotkey "Target Random Friendly". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1520840009811230882)
- **blessed spellbook as audible notification**: A blessed spellbook makes a sound when opened, so opening it can serve as an in-game audible notification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544687869824864368)
- **blue mobs in razor collector**: Blue (innocent) mobs should appear in a Razor collector the same way red mobs do, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542562965650149457)
