- **boss loot organizer script**: A boss loot organizer script lifts items from the backpack, drops them at coordinates -1 -1 in the distro chest, then picks them back up and places them in the correct spot in the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525270825291223070)
- **bracket commands in macros**: Bracket commands are verbal, so trigger them with 'say' in a CUO macro or Razor script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522829576600948858)
- **bugged shiphold fix**: If a ship's hold is bugged, turning the ship can sometimes fix it, although this reportedly does not help when using the Restock agent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543185536758456341)
- **bulwark bonus delay cooldown tracker**: To track the Bulwark bonus delay after moving, create a cooldown in options named "Bulwark Delay", choose the movement cooldown type and set it to 3 seconds; while it shows, you lack the bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537064160490160278)
- **butler crafting script input limits**: The butler crafting scripts cannot interact with the in-game input field, so the player must enter item quantities manually; a checkbox makes the script pause and show which values to enter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532790110096195586)
- **butler crafting training module**: The Butler tool has a new module for crafting skill training that generates the crafting script/queue for you, making it less likely that you miss a step. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532064059455967322)
- **butler loadout scripts for swapping aspects**: With a few butler loadout scripts, swapping between aspects, echoes and links takes only a few seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523771882619404408)
- **butler redline config menu**: Butler has a redline config menu at the top of the page for setting up redline links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547292746199601172)
- **butler template tool**: Butler is a tool for building templates and calculating damage in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555515515215282197)
- **button macro editing**: The black boxes showing bindings are button macros; hold Alt to unlock them so they can be moved, and right-click them to remove them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546478292520140800)
- **buy agent movement requirement after recall**: After recalling into a vendor shop you must move a few tiles before the buy agent works, to prevent AFK bots from buying up resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553871249078222919)
- **bypassing pet release confirmation**: A script can bypass the pet release confirmation by using waitforgump followed by gumpresponse 1, which waits for the popup and selects option 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543355716641759423)
- **calling a hotkey in a script**: To call a hotkey inside a script, use the command: hotkey "NameOfHotkey". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541772199696928829)
- **calling a script from a script**: A script can be called from another script with the say command using the text ">script <scriptname>", for example say ">script testers\TESTX". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1521010167506800802)
- **calling razor agents from macros**: Razor agents such as the Organizer can be called from within a macro or script, for example to store crafted items into a container while crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532199696255291454)
- **camping safe place script**: Camping can be scripted with a hotkey button that hikes you to your safe place, and the trip cannot be interrupted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553984171767238748)
- **capturing findtype result into variable**: A findtype result can be captured into a variable with 'as', for example 'if findtype 11762 ground any any 2 as foundItem', after which 'getlabel foundItem itemLabel' retrieves its label and 'overhead itemLabel' displays it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543866812494774274)
- **cartography automation organizer setup**: For the Cartography automation, set up the Razor organizer for gold and set the hot bag to the material bag in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549546403905142805)
- **casting on a cycled target**: To cast on a cycled target, press the cycling hotkey (which sets Last Target), then press the action hotkey that opens a reticle (e.g. a spell), then press the Last Target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536862828944822373)
- **casting wall of stone behind while running**: To cast Wall of Stone behind your character while running, make a separate script for each of the 8 directions and play the one matching your running direction (running north means targeting south -1). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537206177593561101)
- **catching razor system messages in scripts**: Razor system messages, such as low reagent warnings, likely cannot be caught by scripts to display overhead text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886039807922286)
- **cause of razor macro hangs**: Razor macro hangs are caused by targeting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529887005532622878)
- **chaining razor scripts**: To chain Razor scripts, call a second script from the first with the command script "SCRIPTNAME" (for example script "BandageLoop"); two scripts can chain into each other, so e.g. weapon abilities and a bandage script run together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530054854028824686)
- **chaining scripts with dispatch queue**: A dispatch queue can be used to chain scripts together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1521010820304343090)
- **changing razor window size**: To change the Razor window size, make sure only a single UO client instance is running, and exit by logging out and quitting normally rather than closing with the X button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543104366066802778)
- **character facing direction in razor**: A Razor script on Outlands cannot determine which direction your character is facing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537202088474447894)
- **chat activation option and macro hotkeys**: If the 'press enter to activate chat' speech option is enabled and the chat box is up, a hotkey bound to a macro does not work; it works when the chat box is not up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532149499873595565)
- **checking buff active and below duration threshold**: To check that a buff is active and below a duration threshold, combine both conditions, e.g. 'if findbuff "Strength" as myStrength and findbuff "Strength" < 60', so an inactive buff does not give a false result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553366815613263903)
- **checking item description for numbers in scripts**: To check whether an item description contains a number, chain substring checks with if/elseif, testing each specific number separately (e.g. 'in itemdesc' '30', then elseif '31', and so on). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546573342348148746)
- **checking overhead text in razor scripts**: A Razor script cannot check overhead text directly, but you can set up a cooldown that is triggered by the overhead text and have the script check whether that cooldown is running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537311931528904796)
- **checking party membership via gump**: You can check whether you are in a party by opening the party gump with [Party and using ingump for your character name; if your name is not in the gump, you are not in a party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524770447122763798)
- **checking razor action queue in loops**: To check whether Razor's action queue is still busy inside a larger script without stopping it, check 'queued' once per loop iteration, store the result in a variable, and check again on the next iteration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537296559165804565)
- **chest open and close sound files**: The chest open and close sounds are chstopen2.wav and chstcls3.wav, which do not appear in Razor's sound info and are not filtered by it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551797176584118274)
- **chivalry hotbar gump id**: Gump id 1387930325 is the Chivalry hotbar gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549745372728139797)
- **chivalry symbol count in scripts**: There is no apparent native script command to check the number of Chivalry symbols, but a script can read the Chivalry number displayed in the gump and store it in a variable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1523372055712628816)
- **chop weapon ability macro**: Chop from the Swordsmanship codex is weapon ability 3, so make a macro that says [weaponability3 to use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541217772556525590)
- **chopping macro recall limit**: A chopping macro can be set to recall the character home once it holds a set amount of logs, such as 2,000, to cap potential losses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535611788035366962)
- **classic uo macro storage**: Classic UO (CUO) macros do not have separate profiles; they are stored on a per-character basis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548746579404529715)
- **classicuo and razor grab bag separation**: ClassicUO cannot see Razor variables, and the ClassicUO grab bag and the Razor grab bag are separate settings that neither recognizes in the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546704180134150194)
- **classicuo and razor hotbag settings**: ClassicUO's SetGrabBag macro and Razor's 'Set Grab Item HotBag' hotkey are separate: a ClassicUO macro can be made for setting a loot hot bag, but ClassicUO cannot set Razor's hotbag and Razor cannot set ClassicUO's. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537925964623777923)
- **classicuo health bar config**: The classicUO config file may allow showing both dead-mobile and out-of-range health bars, which the in-game options do not allow at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535750093976641607)
- **classicuo log file location**: ClassicUO log files for the Outlands client are stored in C:\Users\<USER>\Outlands\ClassicUO\Logs\. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523843595063398541)
- **classicuo macro buttons for spells**: In ClassicUO, create a macro to cast a spell and use its Create Button option to get a clickable button like the default gray square buttons such as 'All Guard'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538716333003505694)
- **clearignore for find commands**: Find and findtype commands in scripts can fail to find items that were previously ignored; calling clearignore at the start of the script resets the ignore list and fixes this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543866746056745020)
- **client grab versus razor grab**: Grab in Razor is not the same function as Grab in the game client; the client grab bag works with Grid Loot, while the Razor grab bag is set with a separate command and is for double-clicking items in a container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546594439261065257)
- **client macro file location**: Each character's client macros are stored in C:\Users\<USER>\Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Profiles\<ACCOUNT>\UO Outlands\<CHARACTER>\macros.xml. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523486730672537611)
- **client rate limiting from fast scripts**: Looping a script about twice as fast as intended triggers client rate limiting, which prevents interacting with other items such as potions or bandages until the script is stopped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529183816298528879)
- **client run as administrator**: If the game client is not started with 'Run as Administrator', it may lack write permission to its data files and fail to save macros and keybinds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525910887330742553)
- **client versus razor profile folders**: The folder other than the Plugins folder holds the in-game client profiles, while the Plugins folder holds the Razor profiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553198464400101418)
- **client-only macro functions**: Some functions, such as OpenDoor, AlwaysRun (toggle), and CloseInactiveHealthBars, are reported to exist only as client macros and not in Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526787494786633809)
- **client-side grab bag assignment**: The client-side grab bag used for grid loot cannot be assigned from Razor and must be assigned in the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541882245223162027)
- **close wounds auto-cast script**: To cast Close Wounds as soon as it is off cooldown when bleeding or diseased, use a script that checks findbuff 'disease' or findbuff 'bleed', chivalry skill >= 70, diffhits >= 1 and not findbuff 'close wounds', then says '[closewounds'; the author is unsure this is exactly correct. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539643773246644274)
- **closeinactivehealthbars macro behavior**: The CloseInactiveHealthBars macro might also close health bars of followers that are alive but too far away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532592168965902417)
- **closest player targeting**: There is no option to target the closest player; only next and previous player targeting exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544598709537349713)
- **closing a container in a razor script**: To make a Razor script close a container gump, record yourself closing the box with the Razor recorder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535885234242068510)
- **code after infinite razor while loop**: In a Razor script, code placed after an infinite while loop never runs because the first loop stays active, so additional logic must go inside that loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541093138704236565)
- **codex point set swapping**: Currently outlandsbutler has tools that generate scripts to swap codex point sets; an upcoming patch is said to offer saved codex sets natively, which would make the scripts unnecessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535561031701495821)
- **codex profiles via razor**: Use Razor to switch codex profiles, since the game has no built-in codex profile feature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521424966644400188)
- **codex say macros**: Say macros for codex abilities, such as changing stances, can be created in the client, and the [commands menu has a codex section listing the commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531333019409977635)
- **codex stance keybind**: To change a codex stance with a keybind, make a macro or script that says the stance command, for example say "[FishingStance3". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532358904309354577)
- **codexhotbar blessed item requirement**: The [codexhotbar command does not require a blessed item, unlike using a spellbook for sound alerts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788879267762262)
- **collectors for hostile players**: Collectors work for red, grey and orange players; deselect the option that removes the HP bar when out of range so you can see who it was and retarget when they return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521913118119170299)
- **community item id lists**: Community-maintained lists of item IDs exist, but they are almost never complete and omit rarer items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534577618672812185)
- **community magery training 80-100 script**: The community script site lists a 'magery training 80 - 100' script in the mage section that uses Fire Strike on the trainer rather than at the zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537779843243057202)
- **companionbot map command names**: The CompanionBot !map commands no longer use the 'map-' prefix, so commands such as !sewers, !dungeonpath and !progress are used without it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555249196444024897)
- **complex razor script setup**: Complex Razor scripts need setup beforehand, and the code usually includes comments explaining what each variable does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521236395446894694)
- **conflicting mouse wheel bindings**: To find conflicting mouse wheel bindings, open Razor > Hotkeys and filter for 'wheel', then also check the in-game macros under options > macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524954549327233186)
- **container contents client sync**: The server does not send container contents to the client unless the client requests them, so a bag's items only appear in the toolbar after the bag has been opened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525431120110288977)
- **continuous razor script looping**: To make a Razor script loop continuously while using secondary scripts, each secondary script must call back to the primary script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524155676170125473)
- **cooldown bar not showing timer**: If a cooldown bar shows no active timer, check that a duration is specified, because with a blank time it does not know how long to display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530995321054691508)
- **cooldown entry default cooldown**: A cooldown entry has a default cooldown at the top, which is used whenever no cooldown is specified for a given trigger text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523064297469640846)
- **cooldown handling in client and scripts**: Cooldowns are mostly handled in the client, but they can also be set in a Razor script when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540778081315201044)
- **cooldown name matching**: The cooldown name used in a script must exactly match the name given when the cooldown was created in CUO Options > Cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541440098162442340)
- **copying macros between characters**: To copy client macros to another character, copy the macros.xml file from the source character's client profile folder to the target character's profile folder, or copy only specific macros from within it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523478707472433304)
- **corpse opening options**: Outlands offers options to open all corpses in range and to clear the open corpse list, but has no option to automatically open corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538308597031768175)
- **counter bar low reagent indicator**: Configure a counter bar with a threshold value so the displayed number turns red when reagents run low, giving an on-screen visual warning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886798695923783)
- **counter box re-equip hotkey**: Drag items into a counter box, then right click the box to set a hotkey for that item so you can re-equip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544923114821914664)
- **counting list elements with foreach**: To count a list's elements, push a fake element to the front of the list, foreach through it setting a variable to the built-in `index`, then pop the fake element; index starts at 0, so the fake element makes the final count correct. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548103049073922254)
- **crafting maps and tinkering from bank**: To craft maps or tinkered items from the bank, craft from your bank box into a sell hot bag in your backpack and run a sell script that also places the gold in the mat bag in your bank. For maps, keep a blank map bag inside the bank you craft from, add the gold to organizer 1, and set the hot bag to the blank map bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538303876980019210)
- **crafting setup for map disposal**: To bulk-craft maps and discard them, set the resource stockpile as the source for resources and set a trash can as the destination for the crafted maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390791371755631)
- **creating a macro**: Open Options, then Macros, then New Macro; use the Add button at the top to add another line to the macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529176438991749150)
- **creating macros**: Macros are created under Options > Macro, and the top row of the action dropdown is a search field so you can type the action name instead of scrolling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547567813630230608)
- **creating overhead from system message**: To create an overhead from a system message, enter the original text in the box right of 'Show' and press Add, then enter the overhead text in the pop-up; words of the message can be referenced as {1}, {2}, etc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536860059995217951)
- **creating razor script categories**: To create a new top-level category in Razor scripts, select a script at the desired level, right click and choose add category, or create the folders manually in the razor directory of the Outlands installation; the menu option is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534912002299007286)
- **cuo and razor macro interop**: There is no intended way to invoke ClassicUO (CUO) macros from Razor, but CUO macros can invoke Razor scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546684320935182407)
- **cuo loot bag and razor grab bag**: A CUO Loot Bag and a Razor Item Grab Bag can be set at the same time, giving two different loot destinations depending on how items are picked up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542054433192550510)
- **cuo macros and razor scripts**: CUO macros do not interrupt running Razor scripts, so they can be used while background scripts are running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541510312958763058)
- **cuo versus razor macro speed**: Razor macros are slightly faster than CUO macros, by only about 10-20 ms, so the claim that CUO macros are faster was not validated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541516657950986240)
- **custom loot script**: A custom script can replicate the Razor Loot Bag/Grab Item behavior, supporting any number of different loot bags and optional item sorting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542054433192550510)
- **custom xml map markers**: Place custom XML map marker files in the ClassicUO Data\Client folder (e.g. C:\custom folder\ClassicUO\Data\Client\), then activate them in the in-game marker menu; the exact path depends on where ClassicUO is installed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549785094699360388)
- **cycling target hotkeys and last target**: Cycling targeting macros (nearest, next, etc.) exist in ClassicUO and as built-in Razor hotkeys, and using one sets the cycled mob as Last Target, so the last target hotkey can then be used once a targeting reticle is up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548725293299147014)
- **dclick serial format in razor scripts**: When using dclick in a Razor script with a serial copied from the >info window, do not prefix it with 0x because the displayed serial is already complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553913635158622219)
- **dclicktype failing on vendor-bought items**: If dclicktype fails on an item just bought from a vendor, drag and drop the item once and retry the script; this works around a bug. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549688361130663937)
- **dclicktype in razor scripts**: In a Razor Enhanced script, replace 'dclick <serial>' with 'dclicktype <type>' so the script works with any item of that type instead of one specific item serial. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534352418651898060)
- **dclicktype script for hidden backpack items**: The script command 'dclicktype 3713 backpack' may be used to find and use an item such as a crook that is in your backpack but not visible; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521618627411841195)
- **dclicktype universality for staves**: A script using dclicktype works with all staves of the same item type, rather than a single specific staff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534353094866108536)
- **death knight setup**: A death knight build can deal very good damage but is more complex and click-intensive than a dexxer; keep Blood Oath on autorenew and use a macro to re-equip the weapon after casting spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521849345958351009)
- **debugging razor scripts that consume items**: To debug a Razor script that unexpectedly consumes items, add a sysmsg to every script section that consumes something, so the message shows which section is running when the unwanted consumption happens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524456927923277874)
- **default razor folder path**: The default Outlands Razor folder is C:\Program Files (x86)\Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Plugins\Assistant, though the exact path may vary by install location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540538353814872215)
- **detecting activated weapon ability in razor**: Razor has no way to check whether a weapon ability such as ArcaneAbility is already activated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522734057195307008)
- **detecting held item in razor scripts**: Razor scripts cannot check whether an item is currently held on the cursor, because the 'hand' serial never changes and so cannot be used for that. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537497389181575178)
- **detecting house presence with razor hotkey**: To detect whether you are inside a house in a Razor script, use the hotkey that launches the house lockdown/secure survey mechanic and check the system message it returns, which differs by location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554395192797433889)
- **detecting item consumption in razor**: To detect whether an item was consumed, compare the item counts before and after using it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541091988735270922)
- **detecting players in scripts**: Players can reportedly be detected in scripts by combining last target range limiting with the cycle target hotkeys. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526887970408501288)
- **detecting players via getlabel**: Attempting to getlabel on a player is blocked by the client, which immediately produces a system message with an error that can be checked with insysmsg (no delay needed since it is client-side); this can be used to detect that a target is a player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552770820495900673)
- **detecting pvp via debuff in scripts**: The debuff 'pvm bonus deactivated due to pvp' can be checked with finddebuff to detect PvP combat, and the 'if pvp' condition also covers PvP situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552606941883273318)
- **detecting recall arrival in town**: When recalling to a town, a Razor script can detect arrival by waiting for the 'under protection of guards' system message, but this only works if the recall starts outside a town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545623702819831990)
- **detecting recall completion by position**: Because a recall rune always points to a specific x, y location, a script can check the character's position to determine when the Recall has completed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545644461541822556)
- **detecting stationary time in razor script**: To measure how long a character has been stationary, create a MOVE cooldown in the game client (e.g. a 'walk' cooldown of 0.3 seconds), then in the script check 'if cooldown "move"' and clear a script timer while it is true; once it is false the timer keeps counting up and shows the stationary time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525494024499363840)
- **detecting whether the player is in their inn**: Set a variable to the inn's door serial and test 'if find <door variable> ground'; if true the player is in range of the inn door (in the inn), else they are in a house or elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552287587878838394)
- **developer stance on script cast timing**: The Outlands developers do not want players to exploit script timing to cast spells faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542844154487513139)
- **dexxer script setup**: Dexxers usually run only a bandage loop as their script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539242473086390272)
- **dexxer scripting advice**: A pure dexxer is the most autopilot build aside from dex tamer; scripting attacks is not advised, but heals and buffs should be scripted early, ideally bandaging every time damage is taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529293896503529595)
- **disable gump dragging**: To prevent spell icons and gumps from being dragged accidentally, enable the option that disallows dragging gumps without holding Alt, found in the options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524460830840852560)
- **distinguishing paragon chest from aquamarine pet**: To tell a Paragon Chest from an Aquamarine Pet in a Razor script, run findtype 2475, then getlabel on the found item, and act only if the label contains 'paragon'; otherwise ignore the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542562101061492757)
- **dress agent with aspect hotkeys**: The Razor Dress Agent can be combined with aspect hotkeys to re-dress and return to an aspect in about 3 seconds, which is useful in Time Dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526680745643474945)
- **dress macro reliability**: The dress macro can be glitchy; clearing the list and re-adding currently carried items each time you change your loadout works reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532510390809006214)
- **dressing from corpse with razor dress agent**: With the Razor dress agent not set to by-type, pressing dress equips your gear straight from your corpse; keep non-worn items in a bag so they are quick to grab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534565453106643175)
- **dropping held item in razor**: To drop whatever item is currently held in Razor, use 'drop item' or the hotkey 'Drop What You are Currently Holding'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537497389181575178)
- **dropping items onto a trapped box**: To drop items onto a trapped wooden box without re-entering the container serial number each time, use a Razor organizer agent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540115984222916699)
- **dual wield skill name in razor**: In Razor Outlands Edition, the Dual Wield skill may be displayed under the name Ninjitsu in the skills window because it mirrors the Ninjitsu skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545470185920663622)
- **dual-boxing a magery training script**: Two characters on different accounts can be logged in at the same time, with one of them running a Magery training script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532910224409891066)
- **dungeon and treasure map chest looting**: After a patch, dungeon and treasure map chests are grid loot and can no longer be looted via scripted autoloot, like mob corpses, so dungeon picker scripts needed updating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542589732457029712)
- **early storage management with razor agents**: Before you have QoL storage items, use a combination of Organizer and Restock agents in Razor > Agents, and chain them in a script so that different agents handle different item types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531359719158190171)
- **easy backstab razor script**: The Razor script 'Easy Backstab Script' works for backstabbers with or without Healing: its hotkey hides, auto-uses smoke bombs if hiding fails, casts Invisibility if the character has Magery, and auto-enters Stealth once able. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541915856647229550)
- **echo character razor setup**: When creating an echo character, clone your current Razor profile and tweak it; in-game macros stay the same, and different UI layouts can be set up in UO Options > Profile manager. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537833776103694397)
- **elderstone lumberjacking script**: Elderstone's lumberjacking script requires a hotkey at each group of trees (or harvests all trees in the 24 tiles around you) and has no auto recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534317420788056155)
- **empty mapmaker npc stock**: Mapmaker NPCs often have no blank maps in stock because players run scripts that buy up reagents and maps from NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541860583958253579)
- **enter rental room razor script**: The 'Enter Rental Room' Razor script quickly enters an inn rental room for owners and co-owners, and requires being within 12 spaces of an innkeeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521558328331993308)
- **equipping items in razor scripts**: To equip an item in a Razor script, lift the item and drop it on 'self' at the target layer (e.g. drop 'self' RightHand), not on the item itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548396420954980387)
- **equipping items on unsupported layers**: Items on layers that Razor scripts do not support can still be equipped in a script by item type instead of by layer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535128782157914142)
- **escaping solo pks**: To escape solo PKs, set up a macro to use the nearest gate, a hotkey for rope usage (carry 20-30 ropes), and an hp collector arrangement for reds and criminals, who can be seen from a maximum of 18 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553356392935460905)
- **essence warning amount message**: The aspect gump has a setting in its top right for an essence warning amount, and a system message appears when essence dips below that amount, which a sysmsg check could potentially catch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527687531158700182)
- **exact script address**: To get the exact address of a script, bind a hotkey for running the script, record pressing that hotkey, and the recording gives the exact address. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1520949325805387828)
- **explosion potion cooldown tracking**: To track the explosion potion cooldown, use the system message 'Where should I throw this potion' as the trigger for a 15 second cooldown bar, since there is no dedicated system message for the potion being ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550158338803638323)
- **extensive scripts for training**: Extensive scripts are slow and teach the player nothing, so relying on them is not recommended, especially for new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527308747754704907)
- **f1 keybind conflict**: F1 can be bound both in Razor (for example as an all names macro) and in the in-game macros (for example for guards), which can cause conflicting behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521608117530525757)
- **filling tomes by script**: A script can fill tomes by looping findtype over tome item IDs on the ground (range 2), using 'menu' on the tome, waiting for the system message 'found in backpack' or 'added to tome', then ignoring that tome item before continuing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536825587405164625)
- **find and findtype syntax for ground items**: To check for an item by serial on the ground within range 2, use 'if find [serial] ground any any 2'; to check by type, use 'if findtype [name/ID] ground any any 2'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543858657576620192)
- **find command on secured item recycler by serial**: In Outlands scripting, find or findtype targeting items inside a secured item recycler works when the recycler's serial is given as the source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543866850918666240)
- **find command with ground source and recycler**: Using 'ground' as the source in find or findtype does not locate items stored inside a secured item recycler; the recycler's serial must be specified instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543866850918666240)
- **findbuff blood oath check**: In scripts, 'if not findbuff "Blood Oath"' is true while the Blood Oath buff is inactive and false once it is active; avoid naming a script variable "Blood Oath" because it can interfere with the check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546224143526269000)
- **findbuff less-than comparison bug**: The '<' comparison with findbuff always returns true in the Outlands scripting language, even when the buff is no longer active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553351347238338571)
- **findbuff magic resist value comparison**: The value findbuff returns for the magic resist potion buff is a duration that can exceed 1000, so comparing it against small numbers like 20 in a script may behave unexpectedly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554228988510081146)
- **findbuff name matching**: findbuff is not case-sensitive and allows partial matches, so entering only part of a buff name can produce false matches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553478266944491741)
- **findbuff return value**: In the Outlands scripting language, the findbuff command returns the remaining duration of a buff in seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553351347238338571)
- **findbuff return value for inactive buff**: When the buff is not active, findbuff returns the value '<not found>'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553366815613263903)
- **findbuff strength duration glitch**: findbuff for the Strength buff sometimes reports under 60 seconds while 10+ minutes remain, counts down, then resets to the proper value; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553441005900922940)
- **findbuff strength potion test result**: In tests, findbuff "Strength" returned the duration of the Strength buff rather than the potion cooldown buff, with or without alchemy and potion codex and regardless of buff bar order. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553488168899186689)
- **findbuff usage syntax**: In the Outlands scripting language, 'findbuff "Strength" as myStrength' stores the remaining buff duration in a variable, and 'findbuff "Strength" > 60' compares the remaining duration directly against a threshold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553351347238338571)
- **finding a gump id in razor**: To find a gump's ID in Razor, use the Record macro function while interacting with the gump; this is the easiest method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524539507263672350)
- **finding an item's layer name**: To find the layer name of an item in Ultima Online: Outlands, type -info and point to an object in that layer; a gump appears showing the layer name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527578479229534209)
- **finding client macro assignments**: Find and change client macros under Options > Macros in the game; if you assign the key to something else, the 'Already in use' warning helps you locate the original entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525710715204276285)
- **finding gumpresponse for gump button**: To find the gumpresponse for a gump button in a Razor script, record a script and press the desired button in the gump; this does not work for the new resource map gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537303893422247968)
- **finding item IDs for scripts**: Item IDs for scripts can be found by typing >info or >item in-game or by using a serial ID list such as the one on outlands.uorazorscripts.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526961993578188880)
- **finding item names for scripts**: To find the correct item name for a script, use >info and target the item; if the item has an aspect, add its hue so the script double-clicks only the weapon with that aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541768735185182751)
- **finding item serial in backpack with razor**: To make a Razor script find a specific item serial in your backpack, add a clearignore command before the find check and make sure the backpack is open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549445617288216642)
- **finding items in boom trap box**: Organizers and other script functions can be used to find items inside a boom trap box without opening it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542693001049018378)
- **finding recycler with razor script**: A Razor script can find a recycler on the ground with 'if find recycler ground -1 -1 2 as container', then use 'Menu container 1' to select its menu option, followed by 'Endif'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535114121522057266)
- **finding repair bench in razor script**: A Razor script can find a repair bench on the ground with 'findtype "repair bench" ground -1 -1 2 as bench' and then double-click it with 'dclick bench', which works with all repair bench types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553916741698982053)
- **finding source of repeating razor message**: To find the source of a repeating Razor message, check the Razor hotkey tab for assigned buttons and the macro tab for anything currently running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523108717296488489)
- **finding stuck razor loop**: To find which loop a Razor script is stuck in, add your own overhead or system messages inside each loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524155361073037389)
- **findtype command parameters**: The findtype scripting command takes (name/ID) [source] [hue] [quantity] [range], where range is the depth of search when the source is a container, and all preceding parameters must be included when specifying range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546186707819569172)
- **findtype for wooden box**: To make a Razor findtype search match a wooden box, remove the hue 38 parameter or change it to the box's hue, because wooden boxes lack the red trapped-pouch hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538225482301055168)
- **findtype hue and quantity wildcards**: In the findtype scripting command, 'any' and '-1' used for the hue and quantity parameters act as wildcards that allow any hue or quantity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546186991203258498)
- **findtype item id list limit**: Findtype accepts a long pipe-separated list of item IDs with no known maximum number of types, but a bug exists where a couple of items do not work by number at all. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548392861156909178)
- **findtype search scope**: The findtype scripting command searches only your backpack for the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522933940480905226)
- **findtype top-layer container search**: To findtype only in the top layer of a container, use a range of 1, for example: findtype (ID) container_serial any any 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546186817253150770)
- **findtype with multiple item ids**: To make a findtype command match more than one item id, put the ids in quotes separated by a pipe character, e.g. while findtype "0x0e3c|0x0e3d" ground -1 -1 2 as jaseCrate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1531721130438688930)
- **fire strike training automation**: Fire Strike training can be automated by recording a Razor script that self-casts Fire Strike and targets a mob with a wait added, or by using a community script from the web. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537779118639284318)
- **fishing rod macro workaround**: If a double-click macro on a fishing rod stops working, throw the rod away and re-target with a new rod, which then works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551679343346847875)
- **fixed wait for recall**: A fixed wait of roughly 2100 to 2200 ms may be used to wait for a Recall to complete instead of a 'while casting' loop, though this is uncertain and untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545694476310421505)
- **fixing razor lift by verifying client**: If Razor's scripted lift stops working, exiting the client and running verify may fix it, as Razor may have been in a bad state. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537314500557144096)
- **fixing setvar lag in razor**: To fix lag caused by setvar in Razor scripts, clear the permanently stored variables from the Razor profile .xml file and use setvar! instead of setvar wherever possible, remembering that ! only works when a value is assigned at declaration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535724916853182514)
- **fixing targeting error spam from hotkeys**: To fix targeting error spam caused by a hotkey, open the hotkeys tab in Razor, search for 'target', and check whether any target hotkey has mouse scroll bound to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527443856256139324)
- **fixing unload script after tome graphic changes**: If an unload script no longer files skill scrolls or maps into their tomes because the tomes' graphics changed, use the >info command, target each tome to read its id number, then edit that id in the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548786126859403388)
- **foreach list counting performance**: Counting a list by iterating through it with foreach gets slower as the list contains more elements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548103049073922254)
- **full health pet heal message**: Trying to heal a pet that is at full health gives a system message, which might be used as a workaround for detecting full pet health, though this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554639995594346519)
- **game sound controls**: Game sounds, including the lumberjack sound, are controlled in the Razor client assistant, which has options to mute sounds and possibly adjust volume. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526208312658497626)
- **gather scripts behavior**: Gather scripts are largely automatic and flee when red players appear; the player only needs to move the avatar between gathering spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548521354314256416)
- **getlabel return type**: Getlabel returns only text, so arithmetic comparisons such as 'if < 23' cannot be performed on numbers read from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536869788024840284)
- **getting a tame's serial for scripts**: Type >info in game and click your tame to get its serial, click the blue gem next to the serial to copy it, then paste it into the script's target line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543354715650134077)
- **getting gump ids**: To get gump IDs, record a script while using the gumps. Built-in gumps such as the main menu and options cannot be recorded, though the gate menu and some others can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522387681705988236)
- **getting item ids for razor scripts**: Use the >info command to get item IDs for Razor scripts; dclicktype also works with item names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539205061677285396)
- **getting loot bag serial**: To get the serial of an in-game loot bag, use the >info command and target the bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535577730257649788)
- **getting object serial with info command**: In game, use the '> info' command to get the serial of an object such as the bank box; it can also be made into a CUO button bound to a key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545740745883779122)
- **ghost handling in script dead check**: A ghost is also treated as 'not dead' by the script dead check, which matters when using it to identify players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552770820495900673)
- **gold in razor scavenger list**: Gold should not be added to the Razor scavenger list because it can leave you overweight in dangerous situations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524873771780149268)
- **grab bag missing warning after death**: To warn yourself when your grab bag is missing after death, use a CUO macro that sets the grid loot grab bag and then immediately calls a Razor script that stores a variable from the last target, and have other Razor scripts such as the loot drop-off script check that the bag exists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546705370473304188)
- **gray tint on out-of-range mobs**: To remove the gray tint on out-of-view mobs and players, untick the option 'no color for objects out of range'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531114443126210674)
- **grimoire cooldown tracking trigger**: Grimoire cooldown tracking in the Outlands client requires a trigger, which is the system message shown when a grimoire upgrade is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523061189653958676)
- **ground item drop restrictions**: Items cannot be dropped on the ground on tiles that do not allow item placement, which can break scripts that drop items such as gold at the character's feet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537689094015029309)
- **guard protection message recall detection limitation**: The 'under protection of guards' message method for detecting recall arrival only works if the character starts the recall outside of a town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545625487869607966)
- **guild and alliance chat in razor scripts**: In Razor scripts, use guild "text" to speak in guild chat and alliance "text" to speak in alliance chat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551787723235528705)
- **guildhouse bots**: Players can build guildhouse bots with scripts that buy certain loot from guild members, unlock boxes, and sell arcane essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525756280080175336)
- **gump ids and pet release gump**: Gump ids are the same for every player, and gump 2426193729 is the pet release gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543358694002266223)
- **gump overrides wiki page**: The Outlands wiki has a Gump Overrides page at wiki.uooutlands.com/Gump_Overrides. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522225544354201721)
- **handling adds with chain lightning**: When adds pile up, run the grimoire change script to swap in chain lightning, then spam it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531364913270755478)
- **handling interrupted spells in razor script**: In a Razor script, after casting a spell wait while 'casting' is true, then check 'insysmsg "interrupted"' to branch: do something else if the spell was interrupted, otherwise use 'lasttarget'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525498065237049375)
- **harvest script sound alert**: Set the harvesting script to double-click a musical instrument when it says to move to the next spot, which produces a sound alert. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788106257530992)
- **harvesting hotkeys**: Set Ctrl to use item in hand and Alt to target self to streamline harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545425466545143950)
- **harvesting script auto-recall**: A decent harvesting script should include auto-recall on tracking, among other features. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537437858468462743)
- **harvesting script setup**: Harvesting scripts are typically set up by hitting a wall, then tabbing out and returning after 10-15 seconds to move to the next spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525630025469005904)
- **hat macro for stealth grouping**: When running with other stealthed players, a hat macro keeps stamina from being full; with non-full stamina you will not step on another player or mob and accidentally reveal yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536078081910120559)
- **health bar collection for pvm farming**: When farming PvM you do not need to collect NPC or blue health bars, whereas a red player would collect blue bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542563341363318904)
- **health bar collector for pk detection**: Set up a health bar collector to grab red names as soon as they come into range, so a tamer can see and flee from PKs immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530326913170673796)
- **hiding razor targeted overhead messages**: Disabling Razor removes the targeted overhead journal messages but also removes all other Razor messages; the messages appear to count as a Label type, so disabling Label messages might hide them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551765938808954914)
- **hiding script for afk harvesting**: A script that hides when lumberjacking stops is not very useful; if you must hide while AFK harvesting, have the script use an invisibility effect instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522022784832639098)
- **high-value hue highlighting script**: A script can use a look-up table of valuable hues and the overhead script command to display bright text over the character or item marking it as high value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526960147250020353)
- **hiking script to custom atlas locations**: To script hiking to your first custom location, say '[atlas', wait for gump 341416395 and respond with gumpresponse 100, wait for the gump again and respond with 20, then wait again and respond with 14; to target custom location 2 or 3, change the 'gumpresponse 20' line to 21 or 22. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550182123716218972)
- **horse stable detection in scripts**: When a house has the horse stable feature enabled, a script can detect that the character is inside it by checking whether the character is mounted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553977111117561900)
- **house bot party invite regardless of party state**: To send party invites from a house bot regardless of party state, send two context menu entries (e.g. slots 6 and 7) so whichever slot holds the invite option is triggered; the other entry should be harmless, such as opening the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524770056616022018)
- **house survey mechanic messages**: The house survey mechanic returns 'No insecure items found within house.' or 'insecure ground items in house.' inside your house, 'You are not inside a house currently.' outside, and 'Only the owner and co-owners of this house may survey its contents.' in another player's house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554395192797433889)
- **hp collector gump nameplate grouping**: The HP collector gump can group nameplates of incoming mobiles within X tiles and auto-remove them beyond Y tiles, with groups such as summons, monsters and pk/grey players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544291662300446812)
- **identifying a player serial via find**: To check whether a target serial is a player: if the target is not dead, is on screen, and cannot be found with the find command, it must be a player, since find works on NPCs but is blocked for players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552770820495900673)
- **if/elseif chain performance in razor scripts**: In a multi-character Razor script, use an if/elseif/else chain on the character name rather than many separate if statements, since the chain is slightly faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545856902024400937)
- **ignore list in razor scripts**: As an alternative to findtype chains, create a list, add the mobs to ignore to it, and test with an 'if inlist' check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540850024718532638)
- **ignoring containers in findtype searches**: The @ignore command may be used to exclude a container from a findtype search, but it is unconfirmed whether it also ignores the items inside the container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534544966884393041)
- **ignoring monster types with findtype**: To ignore a monster type found via findtype in a Razor script, use @ignore on it instead of setvar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540848446838149140)
- **in-game cooldown system message detection**: The in-game cooldown system only catches serverside system messages and does not catch messages sent by Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541435655769301123)
- **in-game harvest macro**: Repeating a harvest action with one button can be done with an in-game macro, without external scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525633328626270298)
- **in-game macro deletion scope**: Deleting a macro in the in-game macro options reportedly deletes it for every character, so back up macros.xml before deleting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523486135567912983)
- **in-game macros calling razor scripts**: Macros created in-game that call Razor scripts are saved per character, not shared across characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545831353789194310)
- **in-game skill macro for skinning knives**: An in-game macro that uses a skill, waits for a target, then targets self will use any skinning knife you carry without being redone per knife, and unlike a Razor script that double-clicks a specific knife, it is not interrupted by a running Razor script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555528521823166479)
- **in-house check in scripting**: Outlands scripting has no generic 'if in house' check; only workarounds exist, such as checking specific house serials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553977134928756779)
- **indirect razor script triggers via gumps**: To trigger a Razor script indirectly, use a square bracket command or double-click an item such as a codex that opens a gump; the script can detect the gump with gumpexists, act on it, and close it afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530166706666737754)
- **inn room dump and recycle workflow**: Dump items in your inn room and have another character run a script to identify and recycle them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500637049491566)
- **isolating razor problems with a fresh profile**: To check whether a Razor problem is a game bug, back up your profile, start with a fresh profile, and report it as a bug if the problem persists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523105283453489193)
- **item identification training macro**: In a UO Steam style macro, loop: if skill 'Item Identification' < 120, use the skill, wait for target, target the item serial, wait 1200 ms, then repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530593477304254664)
