- **item info chat command**: The chat command '>item' outputs an item's name and hue directly to the chat box, whereas '>info' and '- info' bring up gumps instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528771252435812434)
- **item name id and serial usage in commands**: An item's name and id are used with type-based script commands such as findtype and targettype, while its serial is used with commands that do not use type, such as find and target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548063602513285191)
- **item recycle script keep value**: In the 'Item Recycle while Farming (i)' Razor script, a value of 1 probably means keep the item, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544323159530930337)
- **item type 3834 spellbook matching**: Item type 3834 can match the 64 spellbook as well as magic or material spellbooks, so a script may pull the 64 spellbook instead of the preferred magic or material spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548397611856306369)
- **item-moving script wait time**: The wait time in the item-moving script can often be lowered below 250 ms depending on ping; 200 ms works for the author. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526962826361700454)
- **journal log writing to file**: Closing the client causes the latest journal log to be written to file. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541464798967898194)
- **journal message limit**: The 2000-message journal limit counts all individual chat messages, including system messages and spam, not just player chat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542692828772048911)
- **journal text limit**: The in-game journal holds only a limited amount of text, so system messages printed to it are eventually pushed out and lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534531866927956098)
- **journal-reading workaround for script input**: Players work around the lack of speech-based input in Outlands scripts by reading the journal, for example when renaming a rune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539570761008816128)
- **key customization and f1 popup**: Most keys can be customized with a few odd exceptions, and the F1 popup is likely set by a ClassicUO in-game macro or a Razor hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545557863865258044)
- **lantern state for swapping script behavior**: In Outlands scripts, a lantern state can be used to swap behavior in between during script execution, though it is limited. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539582181737762838)
- **lantern trigger for razor scripts**: When player speech cannot be read by a Razor script, a lantern paired with an ingame macro that triggers it can serve as a trigger control without disrupting a running script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550843620473577493)
- **last object command target**: The 'last object' command used for harvesting repeats double-clicking the mountain (the target), not the tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525629979126141080)
- **last target macro prerequisite**: The last target macro only works if the monster is already your last target, which you can set by casting the first spell on it or by using another macro to set it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544631819100758066)
- **leather entries in mine.gumps.xml**: The leather entries in the counter's mine.gumps.xml use graphic ID 4225 with hues 0, 2419, 2406, 2413, 2418, 2213, 2425, 2207, 2219 and 1763. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **lifting a full stack with lifttype**: To make the Razor lifttype command pick up an entire stack, use the maximum stack amount 65535 as the amount, e.g. "lifttype 'gold' 65535 ground any". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529545843802378281)
- **list size comparison syntax**: In Outlands scripting, you can compare a list's size to a number with the syntax `if list 'MyList' > 10`. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547866548000268309)
- **list size variable comparison**: The variable holding a list's counted size cannot be compared directly the way list size conditions can, so script logic usually needs to be refactored. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548103049073922254)
- **loadout grab potion checkbox**: The 'grab potion' checkbox must be enabled for the loadout to grab potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543148065509351485)
- **loadout profile cost and scripts**: Extra loadout profiles are an expensive customization, so most players run a script instead of buying them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550447486521450498)
- **location of outlands options**: Outlands options exist in both the in-game client and Razor, except for a few customization menus in Help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542182499046924349)
- **locking chivalry at 100 via script**: In the Outlands scripting language, you can lock Chivalry once it reaches 100 with: if skill 'Chivalry' >= 100, then setskill 'Chivalry' lock, then endif. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552512797416357899)
- **log protection with organizer agent**: Set your Organizer-11 agent to a trapped pouch or boombox so harvested logs are protected immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534317863811289139)
- **looped razor macro appearance**: A looped macro running in Razor looks the same as a script running, so the macro tab should be checked when something unexpected repeats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523108131578843247)
- **looping a musical instrument in razor**: To play an instrument repeatedly, record the action from the Razor scripts tab, then add 'wait 5000' followed by 'loop' below the recorded action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538628399311097866)
- **loot drop off scripts**: Many drop off scripts are available that automate dropping off loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333937597513869)
- **loot goblin and explore outlands map setup**: To use Loot Goblin and Explore Outlands with maps, set render scale to 100% in both, make sure the full map is visible for Loot Goblin, and when snipping for Explore Outlands include no pixel outside the map (including borders); snipping smaller is fine. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531299193304518656)
- **loot processing script**: A loot processing script can discard or recycle low-value magic items and move high-value loot such as rare cloth, dyes, rares and cores into a designated loot bag, with price checking deferred until items are put on a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526959483987689493)
- **lootgoblin tool technology**: The lootgoblin tool uses OCR (screen text recognition) to function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347708641579051)
- **lootgoblin under resource map system**: Lootgoblin, which tracked player location for resource map navigation, is not banned but is pointless under the new resource map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534344835987804211)
- **looting with scavenger active**: When looting a mob with the scavenger active, wait for it to finish picking up arrows before clicking to loot gold or other items, since the actions conflict and make play clunky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524874986307850370)
- **lord glacier gatherer scripts**: The Lord Glacier lumber and mining Razor scripts rely only on Tracking and harvesting skills and recall away when red players appear; they do not use Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554205181183397979)
- **lumberjacking semi-automation**: Lumberjacking can be semi-automated with a Razor script so a key does not need pressing every 3 seconds, but the character must still be moved manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532554335282790410)
- **lycaeum quest sign script**: A player-made script exists that overheads when you are near a sign and auto-clicks it to credit the Lycaeum quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529820446416179252)
- **macro buttons**: Any macro can be made into a button, and a macro can call a Razor macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540712733593436232)
- **macro hotbar button**: A macro can be dragged onto the screen to use it as a hotbar button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529177166116552935)
- **macro mouse button mapping**: Macros can be mapped to mouse buttons through Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530716308461715527)
- **macro to return to war mode after hiding**: To macro returning to war mode after hiding, use the skill Hiding, wait 500 ms, then toggle war mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539585878123352064)
- **macro to set last target without clicking**: A macro action exists that sets a last target without needing to click on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544631879339212842)
- **macroing and scripting limits for gathering**: Players can AFK macro and use simple scripts while actually playing, but cannot automate gathering unattended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672105930760294)
- **mage last target macro**: Set up a macro that uses Last Target and then casts the spell, so pressing the spell cast key sends the spell to the last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531336380943306933)
- **magery 0-80 training script**: The Magery 0-80 training script uses Lightning (needs Mandrake Root and Sulfurous Ash) below 60 skill, with Greater Heal for healing, and Invisibility (needs Bloodmoss and Nightshade) from 60 to 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522392041202647090)
- **magic mushroom meditation script**: To eat a magic mushroom and then meditate in Razor, take the 'Focus, Necromancy or any Magery related skill' script from outlands.uorazorscripts.com and remove the fireball casting line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536208429817925632)
- **magic resist potion buff name**: The Magic Resist Potion in Outlands applies a buff named "Magic Resist Potion", which a Razor script can check with findbuff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528127347385958624)
- **making pack-mule script loop continuously**: To make the pack-mule script run constantly, replace "if not dead" with "while not dead" and the final "endif" with "endwhile". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526962347321852075)
- **map script breakage after patch**: Some existing map scripts may break after the patch because certain map messages changed between system messages and overhead messages, so scripts need rewriting to match. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536926238680154183)
- **map script helper functions**: A map script can check harvest status, check for captcha before a map begins so it does not occur mid-map, and then recall home after harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536925748382662778)
- **meditation script warmode handling**: In a meditation script, turn warmode off, pause about 50 ms, turn it off again, pause 50 ms, then use the meditation skill; doubling the warmode off command helps ensure it is off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542191226235650172)
- **melee attack hotkey**: Melee attacking needs an attack hotkey such as 'attack lasttarget', because melee attacks do not bring up a target reticle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536863082070933504)
- **melee auto attack script by abysmal_xx**: The 'Melee Auto Attack' script from abysmal_xx on uorazorscripts re-equips the weapon but cancels spellcasts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524571615143137421)
- **mimicking script return in razor**: Razor scripts have no true return from a called script, but it can be mimicked with conditionals, depending on how complex the scripts are. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524942205616390246)
- **mining script extensions**: A mining script can be extended with parts from other scripts to find nearby forges and automatically smelt, and to auto-recall if a PK is within 70 steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555092993336287263)
- **mining script loop delay**: If a mining script loop delay is too low, swings are skipped; one player uses 960 ms at very low ping and raises it to about 1000 ms when latency is bad. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529113268113641562)
- **mining script multi-boxing**: A mining script tells you when to move to the next node, so one player can run several miners in split screen by moving each when the script says to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521216397999345785)
- **mining swing timing**: The next mining swing can be started before the previous swing has finished, so a looped mining script can run faster than about 1.2 seconds per swing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529114548202770432)
- **moongate gump ids**: Dungeon moongates (blue moongates) use gump id 3773199800 for destination selection, and player-cast moongates use gump id 3899019871, where response 2 confirms travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549730347069997137)
- **moongate script hotkey range**: A moongate script hotkey only works when pressed within 2 tiles of the gate, so you can spam the hotkey while running toward the gate and it will go through automatically once in range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549730631351672844)
- **mount token hotkey via razor counter**: To hotkey a mount token for mount/dismount, create a Razor counter for the token and assign a hotkey to that counter; the same method works for any item, such as potions or a skinning knife. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538872276621983846)
- **mouse soft macro targeting rules**: Using mouse soft macros to target at the cursor position is prohibited on Outlands and may result in a ban, although reportedly the server cannot detect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533794456635969697)
- **mouse wheel macro binding**: Binding the mouse wheel to in-game (client) macros works poorly, while Razor macros bound to the wheel work fine. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532147508690817115)
- **moving gold from loot bag to backpack in scripts**: In the recycling part of a Razor script, set a variable for the loot bag and use it as the source container when finding gold so only the loot bag's gold is lifted, e.g. if findtype "gold" my_lootbag as shinies, then drop backpack -1 -1, lift shinies 60000, drop backpack -1 -1, endif. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1531376475767574688)
- **moving items to pack animal script**: To move purchased items from the backpack to a pack animal, set a PackMule variable, then loop with findtype for the item IDs in the backpack, lift the item with lift TargetItem 60000, wait 250 ms, and drop it onto PackMule with drop PackMule any any 0, waiting 250 ms between steps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526961770911240344)
- **moving non-regular leather to another container**: Loop on findtype for cut up leather in the backpack; if findtype with hue 0 finds an item, ignore it with '@ignore! found', otherwise lift the found item with a large amount and drop it into the other container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552430949864833085)
- **multi-character razor script**: To serve several characters with one Razor script, wrap each character's code in if/endif blocks that check the character's name (using 'name') so each character runs its own section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545836564008149013)
- **mushroom chat command**: There is believed to be no chat command in Outlands to consume a mushroom, unlike for items such as a smoke bomb or rope. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520577052984479866)
- **mushroom findtype value in razor script**: A number in a Razor script's mushroom findtype section may be the mushroom's hue rather than its item ID, so it will not match as an item type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524455819071062156)
- **musicianship discordance peacemaking script**: The 'Training Musicianship, Discordance and Peacemaking' script looks for the same instrument type but does not include Provocation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549006414951882772)
- **muting sounds in razor**: Razor lets you mute any sound, including weapon sounds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534949505877803193)
- **muting specific sounds with razor**: Razor can show a system message naming the sound that is playing, and you can tick that sound's box in the Razor sound options to stop it, though there is no search function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521533438404853894)
- **nameplate hotkey not working**: A nameplate hotkey that does nothing is usually bound to the same key as another function in Razor, so the conflicting binding must be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543326298922025140)
- **nested containers and razor organizers**: Unless the base-level container is open, the game often does not know about its nested containers, which may stop Razor organizers from moving items into them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546654584171134977)
- **new resource map automation**: Under the new resource map system, resource maps can be almost entirely macroed except for the short jog to the chest location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544761890687684628)
- **notification config sources**: Both Razor configs and client configs can affect notifications, so both should be checked when troubleshooting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541486881219416188)
- **notoriety color settings**: Set notoriety colors for health bars and nameplates in the ClassicUO (CUO) options, because Razor has no notoriety settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539193013287264346)
- **npc profession macro**: A macro exists that shows NPC professions, making it easier to find a thief NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521701064058077207)
- **ocr use for reading item data**: Using OCR to read item data is against Outlands rules and can get a player banned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526895880202879047)
- **omni encounter scripting limits**: In the new Omni encounters, large group activities require many manual actions because scripts lack conditionals to decide what to do at a given moment, especially when interacting with allies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529295533385191666)
- **one-button target and attack razor script**: In Razor, open Scripts, click NEW, name the script, paste the lines hotkey "Target Closest Non-Friendly Monster" and hotkey "Attack Last Target", save it, then bind a hotkey to the script name in the hotkeys tab to target the closest enemy monster and attack it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520948146434215986)
- **one-key loot drop-off, repair and restock scripts**: Players commonly script a single keypress that drops off loot, repairs gear and restocks supplies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550499246560510096)
- **opening containers for ground-search scripts**: Opening containers beforehand will likely not help a Razor script find tomes if the script searches the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537923028766167142)
- **orb anti-thief script gold stash setup**: For the auto-gold stash function of Orb's anti-thief Razor script, set up an Organizer agent (Organizer 1) with the gold in your backpack as the Target and your locked lockbox as the Hot Bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537197388215877744)
- **ordered attack spell casting with hotkeys**: To cast attack spells in a specific order, bind each regularly cast spell to its own hotkey plus a last target hotkey, then press the spell hotkey, wait for the target reticle, and press the last target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724848790872148)
- **ore extraction message type**: The 'you extract some ... ore' message when mining on Outlands is an overhead message rather than a system message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537016080655061084)
- **ore map digging script**: A script can be written to keep digging at an ore map location and recall the player away when the map is done. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533776915125768192)
- **organizer agent**: An Organizer Agent can be set up to sort items automatically into containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364519180279859)
- **organizer agent**: An Organizer Agent can move many item types (such as magic items) from the backpack to a container, and its configurations are stored in an XML file that can be edited or shared. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548405550226743307)
- **organizer agent usage**: To use the Organizer agent, add items and amounts to its list and set the target container; when activated it moves those items and amounts from the source container to the target container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529471007696621630)
- **organizer agent with pack ox**: You can prepare an Organizer Agent with a bag in your pack ox to sort items automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541035046050467930)
- **osi macro storage**: OSI macros are stored as XML files, so they can be copied to another account and edited in Notepad. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536567501058736158)
- **outerwaist layer number**: The OuterWaist layer is layer number 35. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527579705258016879)
- **outlands butler income estimate**: Outlands Butler can estimate crafting society income once you enter your settings and prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524507959424716831)
- **outlands butler journal log parsing**: Outlands Butler can parse archived journal logs and display them in different ways. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533819175070335197)
- **outlands client macro tools**: The Outlands client includes Razor for macros and scripts, and ClassicUO also includes some macro capabilities of its own. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529377305774919680)
- **outlands razor version compatibility**: UO Outlands uses a custom or legacy version of Razor, so some scripts and macros may not work on other UO servers that use Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540539478215491595)
- **outlands scripting resources**: A script site dedicated to Outlands scripts exists, and the in-game ClassicUO macro menu offers many macro options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526430554650710138)
- **outlands ui customization guides**: Use the !customize command to reach the Outlands forum guides by AreYouKidden, which explain customizing the UI, cooldowns and nameplates; the cooldowns guide includes examples and likely a copy of the cooldown triggers file. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529509755230490765)
- **overhead commands and speech limit**: Overhead script commands count toward the automated speech limit in Shelter, even if commented-out overhead lines are separated by waits, and later say commands are blocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555074048894046280)
- **overhead file location for a character**: A character's overhead file is at C:\Program Files (x86)\Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Plugins\Assistant\Profiles\YOUR-CHARACTER-NAME, and shared overhead data is pasted between the <overheads> and </overheads> tags. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525929790618599517)
- **overhead low reagent warning cost**: Getting an overhead warning for low reagents in a script would require adding extra complexity to every spell cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886768841003130)
- **overhead messages and speech blocker**: Overhead messages sent in rapid succession without waits do not trigger the automated speech blocker, but when separated by waits they count toward it and later say commands are blocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555074048894046280)
- **overweight gold dropping**: Characters that drop gold piles when overweight use a Razor script, typically bound to a hotkey, rather than an automatic game feature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522379790345179206)
- **own corpse nameplate setup**: Set up a nameplate for your own corpse only so you can toggle it and easily grab your corpse after death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526680382001381518)
- **parsing guild chat with razor**: Guild chat should not be parsable with Razor scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552729991744327735)
- **party manager bot script by mags**: The 'Party Manager Bot' script by Mags (Avron) lets a guild keep everyone in a party by running it on an extra account character in a shared space like a guild house; it can area invite and do random friendly invites. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524894305028673629)
- **party ping keybinds in classicuo**: Assign party pings to keybinds through the macro options at the bottom of the ClassicUO client macros menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541521434369855538)
- **pasting into razor macros**: Text cannot be pasted into Razor macros; pasting works only on the Scripts tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543356443376230581)
- **peacemaking harvester script setup**: A peacemaking-only harvester setup using scripts auto-peaces all mobs on screen while the player keeps moving and mining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533261513467629660)
- **peacemaking macro delay**: If a peacemaking macro targets the nearest hostile creature, it may need a 50-100 ms delay after Peacemaking, or UseSelectedTarget changed to Last Target, because the nearest creature sets the last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526951252649316486)
- **per-pet animal lore macro**: A macro can target a chosen pet, use Animal Lore on it, wait for the pet gump, and send recorded gump IDs and response values to set options such as aggro for that specific pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522015530402320435)
- **pet aggro change script**: A pet aggro change script uses Animal Lore on the pet, waits for the target and targets the pet, then waits for gump 3280914284, sends gumpresponse 3, then gumpresponse 4, and finally closes the gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552455943650938943)
- **pet command hotkeys**: Having all pet commands on hotkeys is useful because you may sometimes need to direct pets to attack a specific mob in a pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527968537816338442)
- **pet command macros**: Pet commands like all guard and all stay can be macroed, and the pet aggro toggle in the animal lore gump can be scripted as a gump response, but this needs extensive setup unless it is a single pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522012882588532848)
- **pet health scripting check**: There is no scripting syntax to check a pet's health, only your own health. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554637459881594911)
- **player detection in outlands scripting**: Player detection is highly restricted in Outlands scripting, so auto-buff bots need another trigger, such as a lantern, to detect nearby players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526885649293246515)
- **player targeting in scripts**: Targeting players via scripts on Outlands is generally limited to last target and next hostile, which are ClassicUO macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536621295171665930)
- **portal escape hotkey**: Create a script or macro bound to a hotkey that uses the portal so you can quickly escape PKs and mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850957322391634)
- **post-recall mining timer**: A timer after recalling must expire before you can mine, so a recall-based mining macro cannot loop continuously. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545424612706353162)
- **preventing pet wandering during tame and release script**: To stop a pet from wandering away while using a tame-and-release script, tame inside a box in a stable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546101601385840671)
- **prioritizing monster types in razor scripts**: To prioritize specific monster types in a Razor script, chain 'if findtype "<name>" ground -1 -1 10 as found' / 'elseif findtype ...' checks in priority order, set a target variable on match, and fall back to the 'Next Monster Target' hotkey in the else branch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540847687950405734)
- **profile manager and macros**: The profile manager handles only gump layouts and not macros, so macros should be kept in Razor and switched through Razor profiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523478055132070019)
- **provoking targets with a razor script**: To provoke with a Razor script, use skill Provocation, wait for target, then select Hostile and Current target; a second hotkey doing the same lets you choose the next target, since one script may otherwise keep picking the same target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539311314503999729)
- **purple potion last target macro**: It is not possible to make a macro that reliably sticks purple potions to the last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524554913621868545)
- **pvp script function restrictions**: Many script functions, such as auto-healing and stamina checks, are disabled in PvP, reportedly because players abused scripts that automatically used items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541444988489965599)
- **quest progress tracking with overhead messages**: To track quest progress with overhead messages, use the system messages of a tracked quest as the trigger, since picking up a tracked quest item produces a system message; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538516488280084560)
- **random emote script**: To pick a random emote in an Outlands Razor script, use 'random n' (n being the number of emotes), then map each result to an emote with a chained if/ifelse structure; this is untested and uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1523699417041997914)
- **razor 'if casting' after cast command**: In Razor, 'if casting' fails directly after a cast command because the casting flag is set only after the server approves the cast and the client receives that response. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542914312459518054)
- **razor @overhead prefix and journal messages**: Prefixing a Razor script command with '@' does not suppress targeted overhead messages in the journal, even though it quiets commands like drop and setvar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551755646955692083)
- **razor action queue stalls**: Razor's action queue can get stuck and then execute a delayed action minutes later, for example a script unloading into containers that were out of range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523102660318990416)
- **razor action queue system messages**: After the recent change to item movement queueing, Razor shows system messages such as 'finished 2 actions in 0.6 seconds'; they can be hidden with Razor's text filter, and the 'Show Action Queue Status' option does not disable them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533579700616827093)
- **razor add friend keybind**: The Razor add-friend keybind may be broken or removed, since it sends the apparently former command [addfriend. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549482073926930502)
- **razor agent pickup range**: A Razor agent may try to pick up items that are too far away, which can happen when an item is close by but on a different floor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523017148371570790)
- **razor agents for loot**: Razor agents can be configured to place looted items into the containers the player chooses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520942726080626768)
- **razor and client macro interoperability**: Razor macros and scripts can be called from client macros, but client macros cannot be called from Razor, so pings must be set up in the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541524513127407738)
- **razor arm/dress macro hotkey**: To add a hotkey for an arm/dress macro in Razor, look under Hotkeys - Dress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533563232478957673)
- **razor attack closest mob script**: A Razor script can attack the closest mob: clear the sysmsg, target closest nonfriendly, and if the sysmsg contains "no one matching" show an overhead message, otherwise turn warmode on and attack lasttarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547550962808528936)
- **razor auto collector**: Razor has an auto collector feature that gets bars for you without needing drag select. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520976915962269857)
- **razor auto queue object delay option**: Razor has an 'Auto Queue Object Delay' option under Options > Targeting & Queues that can affect how queued actions behave in scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546614713389949089)
- **razor auto-heal script**: A Razor script can auto-heal by checking 'if hits < 70' and casting hotkey 'Greater Heal' then waiting 2500 ms, with 'elseif hits < 100' casting 'Heal' then waiting 1500 ms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537495319447601152)
- **razor auto-recall harvesting script**: Razor scripts automate game actions, and a harvesting script can auto-recall away when tracking detects a red (hostile) player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526043028760957061)
- **razor automatic replacement lootbox lookup**: In a Razor script, use 'findtype box_id backpack as new_box' in the else branch and then '@setvar box_serial new_box' to automatically store the serial of a replacement container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528700926104305674)
- **razor bandage timer**: To show the bandage timer in Razor, go to Display-Counters > Bandage Timer and enable Show bandage timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532123119748255775)
- **razor bard skill label delay**: In Razor scripts, the label showing a bard skill's effect (such as discord or pacified) can take longer than 100 ms to appear depending on latency, so a script loop may run several times before the label is recognized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549350298320109601)
- **razor bard sound filter**: To filter bard skill sounds in Razor, enable 'show none filter sounds', play the sound, find it in the long sound filter list and tick its box, then save the filter in General. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546124110373855233)
- **razor beta lift command queue behavior**: In the Outlands Razor beta client, a lift command while an item is already lifted freezes the script until the previous item is dropped; the lift command triggers the 'Queue lift/drop actions' queue but never marks it finished (so 'while queued' never ends), and with that option unchecked the first drop after lifting is not executed and the script freezes at the next lift. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525478516525764778)
- **razor buff added trigger**: A Razor script trigger can be set to 'Buff Added' with the Hidden buff, allowing a script to react when the player becomes hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540537390244827297)
- **razor bugged state fix**: If a Razor script behaves wrongly, for example findtype not finding a bag that is in the backpack, Razor may be bugged out, and closing and reopening the client can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546589312580321310)
- **razor buy agent for reagents**: Set up a buy agent in Razor with the desired reagent amounts so you can buy them quickly when the NPC vendor is stocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551165440900866179)
- **razor buy agent usage**: Add the items and quantities you want to the Razor buy agent and enable it, then say 'vendor buy' in range or click buy on the vendor's context menu to auto-buy those items if in stock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553871249078222919)
- **razor cancel target and ground targets**: With Razor smart targeting, the cancel-target hotkey cancels ground targets from AoE spells but does not cancel the ground target set when throwing an explosion potion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551855201567117413)
- **razor cancel target hotkey**: To cancel the last target in Razor, open Razor hotkeys and search for 'cancel' to find and bind the cancel-target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551854367437496361)
- **razor capture of square bracket commands**: Square bracket verbal commands that trigger a game command cannot be directly captured by a Razor script, though their effects can usually be detected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530018329043931146)
- **razor casting highlight**: Razor tracks casting but does not highlight it the way it highlights other things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542413582933827634)
- **razor collector display setup**: When creating a collector in Razor (e.g. a red-mobile detector), set it to hide completely, otherwise a yellow square appears on the screen; you can adjust it later by returning to the same settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530715529684455424)
- **razor collector settings location**: Collector settings are found in Razor under Options > General > Health Bars and Drag select, at the bottom of that section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530716241457844374)
- **razor collector setup**: To set up Razor collectors, delete the existing collectors, then create one new collector for monsters and a second for reds and greys, without collecting blue health bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542562158385299567)
- **razor cooldown condition for magic mushroom**: In a Razor script, the 'cooldown' condition can check whether the Magic Mushroom is on cooldown (e.g. `if cooldown 'Mushroom' > 0`), so the script can use Meditation while it is and eat the mushroom otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536208861722189924)
- **razor cooldown condition syntax**: To test a named in-game cooldown in a Razor script, use the syntax: if cooldown 'NameOfYourCooldown', substituting the name you gave the cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538501961664569414)
- **razor cooldown timers scripting**: Cooldown timers in Razor can be controlled from a script, but they must first be created in game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540502544235626557)
- **razor cooldown triggers**: Sysmsg and overhead triggers added in game are often enough for most cooldown situations in Razor, while scripts offer more options for how cooldowns trigger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540503194315005983)
- **razor cooldown xml script**: The Razor script 'Ultimate Cooldown XML file - all skills in one cooldown' by Jaseowns includes instructions on where to put the cooldowns.xml file and creates a single cooldown called 'skill' covering all skill cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555162614747766795)
- **razor counter and containers**: The container may need to be opened for the Razor counter to count the bandages inside it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535863327970955345)
- **razor counter splitting**: Razor counters cannot be split into two counters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543318897678352525)
- **razor counters**: Razor counters do not work on Outlands and are different from the client counters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525431470808629410)
- **razor counting bag contents**: To have Razor count the contents of a wizard bag or pot bag, the bag must be placed inside your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549644090587619469)
- **razor custom sound filters**: Razor sound filters not listed in the filter > sound & music section can be added in the <soundfilters> section of the Razor profile XML. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554537518886551676)
- **razor detection of cuo grab bag**: Razor can find the bag that is set as the ClassicUO grid loot grab bag, but cannot tell whether that bag is actively set as the CUO grab bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546704451241517117)
- **razor dress agent list reset**: The Razor Dress Agent list must be reset each time you get a new loadout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526680479384731868)
- **razor dress and bags**: Pick up your bags and backpacks before triggering Dress in Razor, because it can try to move a bag into another bag and the mouse hangs for a bit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523493013517631580)
- **razor dress auto-undress**: The Razor dress feature reportedly takes items off your body automatically, but this is untested by the reporting player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527094808299180124)
- **razor dress equipment swap**: Use Razor's Dress feature (Razor > Dress) to switch between equipment sets, such as swapping weapons when changing which skill you are training. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547771219611230320)
- **razor dress list after gear change**: When you are equipped with different items, you need to remake the Dress list in Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523494518962393149)
- **razor dress re-equip**: Use Razor > Dress to re-equip gear, including weapons and directly from your corpse; configure the Dress list, assign a hotkey, and recreate the list when you get new gear since generic item settings were unreliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544923294594244668)
- **razor dress setup**: To set up a dress in Razor, create a new dress on the left side, then add individual parts yourself or use 'add current' to add everything your character is wearing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527094722412150795)
- **razor filter and dungeon picker script**: Having the filter enabled in Razor may cause problems with the dungeon picker script, so disable the filter if the script misbehaves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538665998239014962)
- **razor filter repeating system messages option**: Razor's 'Filter repeating system messages' option on the filters tab hides repeated system messages, including script output, and can break scripts that rely on server system messages, so use manual text filters for specific spam instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537541226008412213)
- **razor filters on overhead messages**: Adding the overhead message strings as Razor filters removes them completely, including the overhead text on screen, rather than only hiding them from the journal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551755921691119791)
- **razor findlayer layer list**: The Outlands wiki page Razor_Scripting (findlayer section) is the only known working list of layers for the Razor findlayer command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540846625889591326)
- **razor findlayer outerbody syntax**: In Razor scripting, 'findlayer self Outerbody as item' works for the Outerbody (Satchel) layer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527581708705337374)
- **razor findtype and clearignore**: In Razor scripting, findtype with a source argument matches by graphic/type ID, and an item serial stored in a variable may not be found if the ignore list still contains it; adding @clearignore fixes this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542577818075009215)
- **razor findtype argument order**: The Razor findtype command likely takes arguments in the order source, hue, quantity, range, where a quantity of -1 means any amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549734135663300722)
- **razor findtype container for worn satchel**: When the satchel is being worn, a Razor findtype script should use 'self' as the container instead of 'backpack' to find items inside the satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530034063757279284)
- **razor findtype hue parameter**: In a Razor script, the hue parameter in a findtype line (such as 38) restricts the search to items of that hue, which excludes regular non-red pouches when searching for trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538225482301055168)
- **razor findtype item use on self**: In a Razor script, 'findtype "item name" backpack as variableName' finds an item in the backpack and stores it, after which 'dclick variableName', 'waitfortarget' and 'target self' use it on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541049953600671804)
- **razor findtype loop running once**: A Razor findtype loop that only runs once before a new bag appears in the inventory is probably caused by an ignorelist issue or possibly a variable conflict. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546588884564054189)
- **razor fork wiki page**: The Outlands wiki has a page describing the differences and added functionality of the Outlands Razor fork. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529281604042883103)
- **razor getlabel behavior**: In Razor scripting, getlabel on a mobile collects the next text displayed overhead the mob, which may be the desired label, a damage number, or a mob special notifier, so it can return unintended text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549329523424624721)
- **razor hotkey change propagation**: Razor hotkey changes are initially known only to the currently active Razor session, so a game window or Razor instance started in the meantime will not pick up the changes until it reloads the profile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545831353789194310)
- **razor hotkey command message removal**: To get rid of the messages produced by the Razor hotkey command, create a text filter manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551274601168896003)
- **razor hotkey key compatibility**: Some keys do not work properly with specific Razor functions, so when in doubt assign a normal key such as a letter with Ctrl for testing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523104025543966790)
- **razor hotkey profile scope**: Razor hotkeys cannot be bound to a single character; they are saved per active Razor profile (General -> Profiles), so they apply to every character that uses that profile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545831353789194310)
- **razor hotkeys and scripts**: Razor can be used to set hotkeys for spells, potions, and pet commands, and to play scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520942515635622008)
- **razor hp comparison scope**: A Razor script condition such as 'hp < maxhp' evaluates only the player's own character and does not work for pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547505099629273148)
- **razor if casting after cast**: To make 'if casting' work right after a cast in Razor, place 'getlabel backpack waitForPing' after the cast, since it blocks the script for one ping so the server has already responded to the cast request; alternatively use an empty 'while not casting' loop, but it loops forever and hangs the script if the cast never starts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542914312459518054)
- **razor if condition numeric comparison**: Razor scripting in Outlands may not allow an if condition to compare a variable against a hard-coded number with greater-than, though this is an unconfirmed player impression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542598851737813132)
- **razor ignore list commands**: Razor has an ignore list that excludes items from searches; the 'ignore' command adds one or more serials to it, 'unignore' removes serials, and 'clearignore' clears the entire list at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549481122818298017)
- **razor ignore list scope**: The Razor ignore list only affects mobiles in findtype searches; find <serial> and targeting hotkeys such as Next Monster Target can still find mobiles on the ignore list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540814287658946660)
- **razor in keyword with not**: In Razor scripts, the 'in' keyword may not work correctly when combined with 'not', possibly in system message checks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547090545673773127)
- **razor info command**: Saying >info in Razor brings up a target reticle that, once you target an item, shows item information such as its type ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541810014090432512)
- **razor insysmsg timing**: In Razor scripts, 'if insysmsg' may not trigger when checked immediately after an action because the message takes time to appear; adding a short wait such as 'wait 50' before the check makes it work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547089561572614235)
- **razor item counting scope**: Razor only counts items that are in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549643876581515316)
- **razor item description search limits**: In Razor scripts, text in an item description (itemdesc/get label) can only be searched by substring; numeric comparisons such as 'greater than 30' are not possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546571073024303165)
- **razor item label parsing**: In the Razor scripting system, an item's label cannot be split to extract only the uses remaining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540988343956013096)
- **razor item movement queueing**: Razor now queues consecutive item drag-and-drop movements automatically; scripts do not need changes and drag and drop works the same way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533582626474954762)
- **razor item moving methods**: In Razor, items can be moved either with an Organizer Agent or by adding the items to a list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540393434274078881)
- **razor last target casting**: In Razor, cast a spell and target the mob the first time, then later casts using Last Target hit the same mob until it is dead; if you target yourself you must pick the mob again to avoid casting on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529808634567987292)
- **razor lasttarget and lastharmful commands**: In Razor scripting, the lasttarget and lastharmful commands return a target serial, which can be used directly or stored in a variable to switch between targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553057308152701123)
- **razor lasttarget variable for explosion potions**: To keep throwing explosion potions at the original target while manually switching attacks, use a Razor hotkey that stores lasttarget as a variable and have the throw-explosion-potion hotkey target that variable; cycling hotkeys set lasttarget without clicking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547116695200473088)
- **razor lift command stack amount**: When using the Razor lift command, an amount of 60000 can be used to lift an entire stack, since 60000 is the maximum a stack can hold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555056879502237777)
- **razor lifttype command syntax**: In Razor scripting on Outlands, the lifttype command has the syntax: lifttype ('name') OR ('graphic') [amount] [src] [hue]. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529545760411095091)
- **razor list as chivalry symbol counter**: In a Razor script, use a list as a counter for chivalry symbols, which avoids the first-digit number comparison limitation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544441127317540895)
- **razor list commands and @ prefix**: Razor list commands such as createlist and pushlist produce no Razor journal output, so the @ prefix has no effect on them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545696765905346591)
- **razor list growth without clearing**: In a Razor script, running createlist and pushlist repeatedly without clearing makes the list grow with duplicate names and slows the script, so add a listexists check or a clearlist right after createlist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545696765905346591)
- **razor lists of item types**: To work with a list of item types in a Razor script, use createlist to create the list, pushlist to add entries (e.g. '123|456'), and foreach item in listname ... endfor to iterate over it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548401697297272964)
- **razor loop and non-loop conditionals on one line**: In Razor scripting, a loop conditional and a non-loop conditional cannot be combined in the same line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541040310581203014)
- **razor loot bag after death**: To keep Razor from getting stuck after death, set your loot bag to your main backpack after dying, since it may still point at the old bag left at the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544319670293626891)
- **razor loot bag handling**: In Razor, findtype "bag" backpack 0 as itemz followed by lift itemz 20 picks up and holds a hue-0 bag from the backpack, and a script can prompt the player to select a loot bag stored in the variable my_lootbag if it does not exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1531376475767574688)
- **razor loot drop-off script tome source**: To make a Razor loot drop-off script find tomes inside a container instead of on the ground, specify the container's ID in place of 'ground' in the script's conditional line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537923346857984102)
- **razor lootbox serial change handling**: In a Razor script, check 'if find box_serial backpack' and drop loot to the box if found; otherwise run '@setvar box_serial' to prompt for a new container, so the script recovers when the lootbox serial changes (e.g. after death). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528700926104305674)
- **razor macro and script concurrency**: Razor stops all running Razor macros and scripts when a new one is triggered, though client macros are not affected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523490474546036898)
- **razor macro bag screen location limits**: Razor macros can arrange items but cannot set the on-screen open location of bags. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533569900591845517)
- **razor macro for casting two spells**: In a Razor macro, add a Use Selected Target step after the first spell cast so the first spell's target is selected before the second spell is cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543330122826907678)
- **razor macro for stealing and snooping training**: A basic Razor macro that records double-clicking the target and loops that action can be used to train stealing and snooping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522626621662826606)
- **razor macro hang after world save**: If a Razor macro works but hangs after a world save, take the parts that work in the macro and convert them into a Razor script instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529802486213378080)
- **razor macro hang after world save**: Simple Razor macros, such as a basic item id macro, can hang up after a world save. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529802486213378080)
- **razor macro hang duration**: Razor macros can hang for about 30 seconds and then release themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529886967674962011)
- **razor macro item placement by coordinates**: In Razor you can make a macro that places items in a bag by coordinates, and the drop command accepts coordinates so items can be placed at exact locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533568282353729588)
- **razor macro to re-equip gear after death**: A possible workaround for re-equipping gear after death is to record a Razor macro that equips each item with a 500 ms pause between items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529446392035279008)
- **razor magic mushroom hotkey**: Razor has a built-in hotkey for the magic mushroom, which can be found by searching 'mushroom' in the hotkey list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533435905941962772)
- **razor meditation script**: A Razor script can meditate until mana reaches 40 by clearing system messages, looping while mana is below 40, using the meditation skill only if the message 'You enter a meditative trance.' has not appeared, waiting 500ms, then casting Flamestrike with waitfortarget and target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524175975045402694)
- **razor mining autopilot script**: A Razor mining autopilot script with auto recall exists for Outlands and can save significant mining and lumberjacking time, though it runs somewhat slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527308598357528687)
- **razor moongate escape script**: A Razor script can escape quickly to the moongate: say "[moongate", waitforgump 3773199800, gumpresponse 15, waitforgump 3773199800 again, then gumpresponse 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545533620796661760)
- **razor moongate escape script**: The Razor moongate escape script also works with public moongates and usually, but not always, takes you to Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533324771998040095)
- **razor movement macros**: Movement commands have been removed from Razor macros on Outlands because of bot abuse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526072917287374950)
