- **razor nearest hostile targeting**: Razor cannot target the nearest hostile, but it has a 'Next Hostile Player' hotkey that targets a random hostile player near you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525220211861749772)
- **razor nearest mob attack and target macro**: The shared Razor macro both attacks and targets the nearest mob; remove the currenttarget part to avoid queueing targets, or remove the attack part to avoid attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524565520282550302)
- **razor nested label bug**: Getting a label nested inside a statement such as a Find statement in Razor scripts has been working incorrectly since a bug that appeared in roughly the week before mid-August 2026. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538694945311957072)
- **razor no target found message**: Razor shows a message when a script uses the targeting hotkey and no target can be found on screen; this is a Razor reminder, not a bug. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525931700998246470)
- **razor number comparison limit**: Razor scripts cannot compare numbers beyond the first digit when reading values such as chivalry symbol counts, so 12 is not recognized as greater than 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544359023191785493)
- **razor object delay**: If a 600ms object delay in Razor options (targeting and queues) is not working, raising it to 1200ms can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544319710227603636)
- **razor organizer agent bank box target**: The Razor Organizer Agent can drop items into a container placed in your bank box, and possibly into the bank box itself, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539586180423614526)
- **razor organizer agent hotkey**: An Organizer Agent in Razor can be triggered with the hotkey 'Play Agent - Organizer 1'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540174422860632075)
- **razor overhead bracket placeholders**: In Razor's overhead display text, numbers in brackets such as {3} and {4} insert the word at that position in the matched system message, e.g. from 'Now tracking Number Nine' {3} and {4} yield 'Number' and 'Nine'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529090409425403984)
- **razor overhead messages**: Razor's overhead messages make game messages easier to read than scrolling text, and overhead triggers read from the system log (system messages), not from chat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529460495256649768)
- **razor overhead messages for skill gains**: In Razor, the overhead messages options can be configured to announce when you reach skill max and when you gain a skill, though this can be spammy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527801190795182224)
- **razor overhead text loop throttling**: A Razor script loop that prints overhead text with no wait may be throttled because messages are sent too fast, so a pause should be included. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541059299210436660)
- **razor overhead tracking message tokens**: In the Razor overhead for the message 'Now tracking: Name (94 spaces to target)', 'Now' is {1}, 'tracking:' is {2}, the target name is {3}, '(94' is {4} and 'spaces' is {5}. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531899200151752755)
- **razor party pings**: Razor most likely has no built-in command or feature for sending party pings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541524845001572477)
- **razor pet command hotkeys**: Razor has pet commands under Hot Keys > Misc > Pet Commands, and you can also make an in-game macro that says the command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546537191218356336)
- **razor pet command hotkeys**: To bind a pet command such as 'all follow me' in Razor, open the Razor hot keys and type the command into the filter box; it shows where the command is so you can assign a key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525786837505933352)
- **razor profile backup**: To back up Razor profiles and settings, copy the entire Assistant folder, which mostly contains small text files. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540539059938533486)
- **razor profile manager behavior**: The Razor Profile Manager is expected to change hotkeys if anything, while macros should stay the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548601608093433919)
- **razor profile sharing**: Razor profiles are shared across all characters under one OutlandsID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541482619718344827)
- **razor profiles per character**: To keep Razor settings tied to a character, save them to individual Razor profiles, found under the General section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527319743952982188)
- **razor profiles per character**: Different characters may use different Razor profiles, so settings can differ between characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527444932913008811)
- **razor queued loop timing**: In Razor scripts the 'queued' state needs a ping to update, so a pause is needed before and after a 'while queued' loop for it to work reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546682530856702083)
- **razor recall wait pattern**: A working Razor recall wait pattern is to say '[recallcharge Home', wait 1000, loop 'while casting' with wait 500 inside, then wait 500 afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545699459378192386)
- **razor recording secure storage pulls**: Recording a Razor script that pulls an item type from a room secure storage produces an 'item not found or out of range' error. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553162343163232277)
- **razor resource info bar display**: The Razor resource display setting for info bars appears to have been removed and may no longer be available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547212543687266304)
- **razor restock and sell agents**: For Razor restocking, add items by targeting them, set a backpack bag as the hot bag, set the amount, click restock and target the source; for selling, set the hot bag to a backpack bag in the sell agent tab and say 'vendor sell' at the NPC vendor, which also lets crafted maps be kept in a map bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538303670519595128)
- **razor restock from secure container**: Items can be restocked into the backpack from a secure chest or bag with a Razor restock script, and placing items in in-game counter boxes provides item totals via the in-game counter rather than the Razor counter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535149522018115676)
- **razor restrictions in pvp areas**: Razor restrictions in PvP areas exist to stop auto-healing and other automation in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1556069475835453473)
- **razor scavenger agent item delay**: The Razor scavenger agent can trigger your item delay, which can prevent you from drinking potions if you are not careful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539985871829344299)
- **razor scavenger agent limits**: Razor's scavenger agent picks up items from the ground but cannot loot bodies or containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526057186076397710)
- **razor scavenger agent setup**: To use the Razor Scavenger agent, add the item to its list with Add Target and then enable it; no hotkey is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532292663313825904)
- **razor scavenger reliability**: The Razor scavenger function works but is not fully reliable and can skip some items on the pickup list, such as bolts and arrows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524873684949532853)
- **razor script and afk rules**: Razor scripts are generally approved, and AFK skill gain is allowed, but AFK resource harvesting and AFK monster farming are not allowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531167343407923451)
- **razor script bandage check**: A Razor script can avoid starting a new bandage while one is already being applied by checking 'if not bandaging' before the 'Bandage Self' hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533459924812562473)
- **razor script code reuse**: Razor does not appear to support code reuse between scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524171008330956840)
- **razor script concurrency**: Only one Razor script can be run at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533713047548596265)
- **razor script container error**: A Razor script, such as a backstabber script, can throw an error message because the container is not set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555688361908510782)
- **razor script cooldown command**: To set a cooldown in a Razor script, use the command: cooldown "name" #### where #### is the duration in milliseconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540778081315201044)
- **razor script editor green text**: In the Razor script editor, green text marks text wrapped in quotes (' or "), so a large block of green text usually means a closing quote is missing, and a word with an apostrophe such as you're can be treated as an opening quote. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535404118808469605)
- **razor script for aspects gump**: A recorded Razor script opens the aspects gump and performs aspect actions with: say '[aspects', waitforgump 2424293173, gumpresponse 200 (twice), waitforgump 2424293173, wait 8000, gumpclose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555852895948378243)
- **razor script for magic item recycler**: To make a Razor script that adds items to the Magic Item Recycler, record clicking the recycler and then the Add button; the recorded script works only for that specific recycler, so to generalize it, use >info to target the recycler and script: if findtype 'magic item recycler' ground as recycler, click recycler, click Add, endif. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535112306726535258)
- **razor script for witcher rune tomes**: A Razor script exists for Witcher runebooks (rune tomes) where you put the tome number at the start, and it finds the correct book at a rune library and recalls you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550494183121494170)
- **razor script list sharing between profiles**: The Razor script list is shared across all profiles, while hotkeys and the rest of the Razor setup can differ per profile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534908054393327636)
- **razor script macro naming**: To make a Razor script work, create a Razor macro with the same name as the script or macro being referenced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1521645238647521333)
- **razor script matching multiple values**: When a Razor script needs to match several possible values without string manipulation, use a large if/else chain if you roughly know what you are looking for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551148110674395187)
- **razor script math with variables**: Razor scripts generally cannot do math with variables, and the math they can do is not always correct. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549643782364995595)
- **razor script name conflicts**: Razor scripts whose names begin with the same word (for example 'test') may conflict when called by name, so frequently used scripts should be given distinct, appropriate names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538599605871181834)
- **razor script recording**: In Razor, press the record button in the script editor and then perform actions in game to see what the corresponding script code looks like. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541810014090432512)
- **razor script recording of built-in gumps**: Razor script recording does not capture clicks on the client's built-in main menu or layout gump, because they are built-in gumps rather than server-sent dynamic gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522008493090017395)
- **razor script refresh potion spam workaround**: To stop a Razor script from spamming Refresh potion use, have the script check system messages for the failed-use message, then run clearall and restart the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524454338490007653)
- **razor script resources**: Razor scripts that automate dungeon grinding, such as auto-healing and gold pickup, are available in the Scripts channel and on outlands.uorazorscripts.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554231564882419783)
- **razor script sounds**: In a Razor script, the only sounds that can be played are unlocked emotes, triggered by saying the emote command (e.g. '[yes'). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523188242747363328)
- **razor script stop at archery 80**: In a Razor training script, 'if skill "Archery" >= 80' followed by 'stop' and 'endif' stops the script once Archery reaches 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541884851337171116)
- **razor script storage**: Razor scripts are stored as plain text files in folders, so categories and scripts can also be created in the file explorer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536500377195905136)
- **razor script timing precision**: Razor is not designed to be millisecond-precise, so script timing is inherently imprecise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542818688611385394)
- **razor script to return leather to material bag**: To script moving leather back into the material bag after recycling: in Razor's Agent Organizer add a target for leather, set the hot bag to the destination container, create a hotkey for it, then in Scripts record yourself pressing that hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528954363190579291)
- **razor script to select shelf loadout**: To select a shelf loadout in Razor: findtype 'storage shelf' on the ground as Shelf, wait 200, gumpclose, wait 200, dclick Shelf, then loop 'while not ingump "N/M"' doing gumpresponse 18 and waitforgump 3232825965 until the target loadout number appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545487550997602584)
- **razor script to skin**: In a Razor script, if the skinning blade (e.g. Elven Spellblade) is found in the backpack via findtype, dclick it, waitfortarget 500, then target self. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549806131780517919)
- **razor scripts and captcha**: All Razor scripts are forced to stop when a captcha comes up in Ultima Online Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555090042559668335)
- **razor scripts for begging**: Razor scripts for the Begging skill are listed on uorazorscripts.com, and begging can be macroed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601047298515024)
- **razor self vs backpack item source**: In Razor scripts, using self as the source for an item check searches both worn equipment and the backpack, whereas backpack searches only the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547073085822476298)
- **razor sell agent for gems**: The Sell Agent in UO Razor can be used to quickly sell gems to the jeweler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046363540201504)
- **razor sell script sell list**: Razor's sell script only sells items on its sell list, so adding maps to the list makes it sell maps and not pens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538303759615266857)
- **razor settings with multiple accounts**: Razor does not save settings properly when more than one account is in game during setup, and you must click save on the Razor general tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521528249518129172)
- **razor setvar limitation**: In Razor scripting, setvar only works for a single item, not a list of item types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548401697297272964)
- **razor setvar message behavior**: In Razor scripting, when a value is assigned directly in setvar, no message is displayed anyway, so writing '@setvar!' versus 'setvar!' makes no practical difference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550870445459247127)
- **razor shelf loadout selection by number**: In Outlands Razor scripts, a storage shelf loadout is selected by checking the gump for its number in the form 'N/total', such as '5/7', rather than by loadout name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545483383281295400)
- **razor skill cap column**: The skill cap column in Razor is a read-only readout of the game's value and cannot be edited. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550778539698159758)
- **razor skill groups**: In the Razor skills window, create a new category, drag skills into it, and single-click the group to name it; use the arrows on the left to collapse and expand groups. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548187505348706355)
- **razor skill lock changes**: Razor applies skill lock changes live without needing to log out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548186760687657112)
- **razor skill threshold comparison**: In Razor scripts, use '>=' rather than '=' when comparing a skill to a threshold (such as Archery at 80), because skill can jump by more than 0.1 and skip the exact value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541883999251734719)
- **razor skill-conditional scripts**: In a Razor script, use skill checks such as 'if skill "Fishing" >= 80' so one hotkey performs different actions depending on the character's skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537551278710980719)
- **razor skinning script corpse id**: The Razor skinning script checks for mob corpses with item ID 8198, and a corpse's ID can be verified with the >info command by targeting the corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555532120061911162)
- **razor skinning script knife location**: Razor skinning scripts look for the skinning knife in the player's backpack, so the knife must be kept there for scripts to work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530685718035431434)
- **razor sound command origin**: The Razor sound command was added to upstream Razor after Outlands forked its own version of Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544638964932284416)
- **razor sound filter lookup**: In Razor's Filters > Sound and Music tab, enable 'show non-filtered sound info' and trigger the sound to display its file name, which can then be added to the filter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794590758080515)
- **razor spell hotkeys**: Razor provides a separate hotkey for every spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542403219354026035)
- **razor spell timer offset**: A Razor timer measuring spell cast time reads about 30-60 ms longer than the in-game cast time (for example Magic Arrow at about 0.5 seconds) because of ping combined with the Razor client delay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541099082465017926)
- **razor stack at feet setting**: If Razor's option to stack ore, logs and fish at your feet is turned on, turn it off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533069006599225405)
- **razor string manipulation**: Razor scripts in Ultima Online: Outlands have no string manipulation, so a getlabel result cannot be searched against a variable-built string. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551148110674395187)
- **razor target command type setting**: In Razor, only the 'next' target command sets the harmful/beneficial target types, while 'target closest' sets all three target types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541153875086680255)
- **razor target use detection**: In Razor scripting, whether a target was used or cleared can only be detected by checking if a targeting reticle exists with the 'targetexists' condition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541091988735270922)
- **razor target-by-type setup for trees**: In Razor, when setting up a target-by-type for a tree, click yourself rather than the tree. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548975192599171094)
- **razor targeted cast pattern**: For spells needing a target, cast the spell, wait 300, loop 'while casting' with wait 100, loop 'while not targetexists' with wait 100, then if targetexists, target the desired mobile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542882999207460914)
- **razor targetexists command while pvp flagged**: The Razor scripting command targetexists is reported to be acceptable to use while PvP flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526014942095081675)
- **razor targeting**: Razor is an assistant program that can assist with targeting, and targeting errors can come from a Razor script or a hotkey that tries to target something it cannot find. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527443203072987136)
- **razor targeting hotkey location**: The cycle target, last target and target self hotkeys are found in Razor > Hotkeys, and target self lets you cast heals or cure on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548725564511092817)
- **razor text color setting**: In the Razor menu there is a button likely labeled 'Set Hue' that lets you change your text color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529183378480304249)
- **razor text filter for no target message**: Add a text filter in Razor to hide the 'no target found' message; for filters to work with scripts, leave "Ignore filtered messages in overhead and scripts" unchecked and never check "Filter repeating system messages". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525931700998246470)
- **razor text filter for spell messages**: Using the Razor text filter may hide spell overhead messages, as Razor can filter many kinds of text, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523453958176374905)
- **razor trap cooldown triggers**: In Razor, add a normal cooldown trigger as an estimate, then add a second trigger on that cooldown with a timer at 0 that fires on a system message when the cooldown is ready again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521432461450412033)
- **razor trap-ready overhead alert**: To get a trap-ready alert in Razor, go to Display/Counters > Overhead Messages and search the system messages for 'you may now detonate another trap'; text then appears over your head when the trap is ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521431008728322110)
- **razor unlock and attack script**: A Razor script to unlock a box and attack can be written as: cast 'Unlock', then dclicktype 'halberd' 'backpack', then attack lasttarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526173372462137414)
- **razor variable named book**: In Razor scripting, naming a variable 'book' is discouraged because 'book' may be an item type for blank books, which could cause issues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548396420954980387)
- **razor variable scoping**: In Razor scripts, variables created by getlabel or findtype 'as blockVar' are block scoped, accessible only at the level where they were created and in nested statements, while only variables from setvar, timers and lists are global. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538768300857888858)
- **razor waitforgump with old gumps**: In Razor scripts, close any existing gump with gumpclose before waitforgump, because waitforgump may skip the line if an old gump is already open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549735224601219156)
- **razor waitfortarget command**: In a Razor script, waitfortarget is more reliable than a fixed delay because lag spikes can eat a delay; it takes a parameter in milliseconds for how long to wait before giving up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534010276314087444)
- **razor while casting recall reliability**: A 'while casting' loop after casting the recall command no longer reliably waits for Recall to finish on Outlands; it stopped being reliable around late August 2026. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545618745559359508)
- **razor yell macros in classicuo**: Recording yells via Razor and pointing ClassicUO at that Razor macro for follower commands fails, while ClassicUO macros that use 'say' instead of yells work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529118603251552356)
- **re-arming a weapon with razor**: To re-arm a weapon with Razor, place the weapon in the counter box (or add it to an arm/dress set), record a script, bind it to a hotkey, and press the hotkey after recalling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529951167084368033)
- **re-equip weapon community script**: A community script named 'Re-equip Weapon' on outlands.uorazorscripts.com automatically equips a pre-selected weapon and works best when bound to a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529952970983215275)
- **re-equipping a bow after precasting**: To re-equip a bow after precasting, use a double-click-by-type hotkey (adding checks such as aspect hue if relevant), or try lifting and dropping the bow onto yourself; the lift-and-drop method is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540594060593463327)
- **re-equipping sword and shield after recall**: To re-equip a sword and shield after recalling, use a dress hotkey, macro, or script, such as a macro that double-clicks the weapon and shield with a small delay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528320375732174968)
- **re-equipping weapon after reactive armor in a script**: After casting Reactive Armor, a script can wait 600 ms and then use dclicktype to double-click a weapon such as a heavy crossbow in the backpack to re-equip it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528233567254220992)
- **re-equipping weapons after runebook use via script**: Scripts reportedly cannot re-equip a weapon or shield after using a runebook or spellbook via a say command; a possible workaround is a script that double-clicks a known runebook or tome and interacts with its gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524763903668650054)
- **reactive armor targeting**: The Reactive Armor spell always targets yourself, so a script does not need to wait for or select a target after casting it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528211828801404999)
- **reading arcane essence via scripting**: There is no convenient way to read through scripting how much arcane essence is charged on your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527686495744294982)
- **reading client journal log in real time on windows**: On Windows the Ultima Online client's journal log can only be read after the client is closed, not in real time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526895222347530330)
- **reading essence with ingump checks**: You can try ingump checks to read arcane essence, but the aspect gump must be opened to read it, and you must choose a value or range that will not also match other numbers in the gump, such as an aspect's level progress like 1000/XXXXX. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527686495744294982)
- **reading journal log on linux**: On Linux the journal log file can reportedly be read without closing the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526899932152467486)
- **reading uses remaining in razor scripts**: To read uses remaining from an item label in a Razor script, chain multiple if statements testing whether the label contains strings such as "/1" or "/2". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540988453578084392)
- **reagent check before spell cast script**: To check reagents before every cast, have each spell hotkey set a variable (e.g. FS for Flamestrike) and call a central script that first performs the reagent check, then uses an if/elseif chain to cast the spell matching the variable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536899365673771008)
- **reagent dump script for carrying capacity**: A script can drop a regular wizard satchel, dump all reagents into it, then refill with 20 of each reagent so the player can carry more gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531360222613078118)
- **recall command runebook usage**: The recall command uses any runebook in your backpack that contains a rune with the name given in the script, so scripts need not be tied to a specific runebook; books outside the backpack do not work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550493867822817451)
- **recall commands**: The only recall commands available are for recalling from a runebook or runetome in the player's own backpack; there is no command to select towns in the Chivalry portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535995575391092757)
- **recall commands for macros**: The commands [recall and [recallcharge can be used to create macros for specific locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523328941933330562)
- **recallcharge equivalent for atlas hiking**: No built-in equivalent of the recallcharge command is known for Hiking with an Atlas, so it would require a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544341764490535054)
- **recallcharge with blessed rune tomes**: If all your rune tomes are blessed, you may be able to recall by rune number using the command '[recallcharge add number'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550494000639778910)
- **recorded macro swing speed**: A basic recorded macro can swing faster than community scripts, which can slow harvesting, because you can swing faster than it takes for ore or boards to land in your bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521233115966869594)
- **recording razor scripts**: Razor scripts can be made by recording your actions, such as opening your bank and taking gold out, while the recorder is running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529236881013739582)
- **reducing arrow and bolt usage**: Turn on the Scavenger in Razor and use a quiver to help reduce arrow and bolt usage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532856272599388203)
- **refilling locked-down runebooks with a script**: A simple recorded script can refill all locked-down runebooks and tomes, working around the shelf button's inventory-only limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523375412909183146)
- **relogging to fix client oddities**: Relogging is the first thing to try when the client behaves oddly, such as scavenging not picking up items or a Razor error continuing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523059924530102295)
- **removal of all scripts**: The Outlands team has never considered removing all scripts from Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525636405202653307)
- **repeating razor message cause**: A Razor message that repeats while the player sits idle without pressing keys is caused by a running script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523106616424267797)
- **resetting broken key bindings**: As a last resort for broken key bindings, delete your profile and let a fresh one be created. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525711056465432596)
- **resetting client and razor profiles**: To reset client profiles, delete the character folders under C:\Users\<USER>\Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Profiles\<ACCOUNT>\UO Outlands\<CHARACTER>; Razor profiles are under ...\Data\Plugins\Assistant\Profiles\. Back up first, for example by renaming a folder to folder.ORIG. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527596281025794119)
- **resist potion disposal**: Resist potions have a script to keep drinking them, so kegs are not needed to dispose of them, whereas poison potions cannot be drunk to recover the bottle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524325100814336151)
- **restock agent for recall scrolls**: A restock agent can pull a single recall scroll or a set quantity out of a container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531672976649359550)
- **restock agent for selling**: Use the Restock agent to pull items from a source container (such as a pack horse) into your bag so the Sell agent can sell them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533220293269520456)
- **restock agent source container limitation**: The restock agent works, but not when the source container is in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546264784692056136)
- **restock agent usage**: To use the restock agent, keep a container with your reagents on the floor or in another container, set your destination bag as the Hot Bag, then trigger the agent and target the source bag in your chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546264784692056136)
- **restock regular kegs setup for poisoning script**: If your Poisoning skill is below 55, you must set up the restock_container_regular_kegs variable in the 'Train Poisoning using a Shelf' script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522732164314169415)
- **restocking blank scrolls with razor**: To restock blank scrolls with a Razor script, record a Restock agent targeting your secure chest or bag, add a wait at the end, and wrap it in 'If counttype 'blank scroll%s%' < 10 backpack' ... 'Endif' placed after the wait. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553167010907558011)
- **restocking from ship hold**: When restocking from a ship, you may need to restock from a bag or box placed inside the hold rather than from the hold itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543189452267200663)
- **restoring hidden window**: Press Ctrl+Shift to bring back the hidden window; enabling the 'prevent overlapping' option is recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553356747132108851)
- **reverse cooldown for weapon abilities**: A reverse cooldown can be set up so that when the trigger text shows a weapon ability is ready, a cooldown bar appears as a reminder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523372799215931423)
- **rope and hamstring commands**: The commands for rope and hamstring are [rope and [hamstring; to build cooldown timers, use the abilities in game and check system messages for the trigger text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534284361044852756)
- **rope and teleport razor script**: A Razor script called 'Quick Rope Tele with cooldowns (F)' on UORazorscripts.com can be used to perform the rope and teleport combo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554811740342980659)
- **rope macro limitations**: A script cannot perform the left click for a rope macro, because it cannot know which way you are facing or target a set number of tiles ahead, so the cursor must be placed manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554943252447236179)
- **rope spell targeting macro**: Use a client macro for [rope, enable the tile distance counter on the targeting reticle and optionally tile highlighting, and ensure clear line of sight within 10 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524755724717133835)
- **rope teleport cooldown tracking**: A rope teleport cooldown cannot be tracked accurately by script: it can be started when the teleport is activated via script, but it keeps running even if the teleport attempt fails. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541445258162995314)
- **runebook copying**: Copying a runebook requires visiting and marking each location, even with 120 inscription, though a Razor script can automate the process. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530880101292441760)
- **runebook in razor scripts**: To use a runebook in a Razor script, run the >info command and target the runebook to get its code, or record opening the runebook and clicking the gem or recall button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554100030917447793)
- **runebook script command location requirement**: The script command for runebooks and tomes only works on a runebook or tome that is in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524566897495113810)
- **running a script from a hotkey**: To run a script such as Healing from a hotkey, set the hotkey action to 'play script: Healing'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532672427287642246)
- **sacred journey gate delay**: The Sacred Journey moongate does not appear on the ground immediately after the destination is chosen, so a script must loop until the gate is present or the confirmation gump appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549741377489870959)
- **sacred journey gate item type**: The Sacred Journey gate is a moongate item of type 30528 with hue 2091. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549731874086191129)
- **sacred journey gump ids**: Sacred Journey uses a first gump with id 1482653814 for destination selection, where button 4 is the Custom destination, and a second gump with id 3899019871 for travel confirmation, where button 2 is Confirm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549731874086191129)
- **safer resisting spells training script**: A resisting spells training script can be made safer by adding a check that, when hit points drop below 30, says 'all stop' and stops the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533580789290242149)
- **satchel layer**: The Satchel item is likely on the layer called Outerbody. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527578479229534209)
- **saving macro keybinds**: When setting up a macro, you must click the check mark on the right of the keybind bar at the top for the keybind to save. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529177099049369620)
- **saving razor changes**: After adding or changing something in Razor, go back to the General section and click save, doing so every time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527320583304380607)
- **saving razor keybinds**: To save keybinds properly in Razor, have only one client logged in, click Save under General --> Razor, log out manually via the paperdoll, and close the client using Quit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525912859014467745)
- **saving targets in scripts**: Scripts have no direct way to save a target and retrieve it later; setvar with a variable may be usable as an alternative to LastTarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538570508809932932)
- **saving the necromancy gump**: Use the command -savenecrobar to save/lock the Necromancy gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554472986960990229)
- **sazeracs one-tile loot drop script**: The 'Sazeracs One-Tile Loot Drop - Dungeon + Boating (v1.05)' Razor script dumps doubloons and gold to your bank vault if it is within 2 spaces, and supports boating and dungeon loot offloading. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530224194699268176)
- **scalability of findtype monster scripting**: Scripting specific monster types by findtype is feasible for areas with few mob types (such as an Omni) but becomes very large for many monster types, where manual handling is usually better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540848743560126594)
- **scavenger agent pickup memory**: The scavenger agent remembers items it has already tried to pick up, so if you walk past arrows or bolts too fast it will not retry them; clearing the agent's cache usually fixes this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523068614813679769)
- **script action recording**: Most player actions can be recorded and then performed in a script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536871439360065707)
- **script behavior during world save**: Scripts pause automatically right before the world save and resume afterwards, so waiting for the 'save complete' message is theoretically unnecessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552395753815806075)
- **script chat throttle**: Script commands that send chat are subject to a chat throttle, which can be avoided by setting a delay of about 300ms between them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1521092848035041310)
- **script cooldown command**: A script can start a cooldown timer with the command `cooldown "CooldownName" desiredCountdownTimeInMS`, e.g. `cooldown "Wither" 30000` starts a 30 second countdown for a cooldown named Wither. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541438377474130060)
- **script cooldown under pvp restrictions**: The script 'cooldown' function/expression reportedly does not work under PvP restrictions, although the wiki documents it as both a function and an expression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541440458872586301)
- **script interaction with other players**: Script interactions with other players are intentionally restricted compared to what scripts can accomplish against monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **script library website**: A website containing many pre-existing scripts exists for players to browse and try. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552022318144950393)
- **script object cooldown risk**: Scripts can delay your actions by using up the object cooldown at the wrong times, which can get you killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539985679831007233)
- **script recall on tracking red**: A mining or lumberjack script can recall the character away when Tracking detects a red; in a dungeon on a PvM character you must run to a gate instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531840311523938466)
- **script reliability**: Scripts will eventually break, so players should know how to play the game without them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521236946637291660)
- **script restrictions on outlands**: Autolooting and moving items via script are forbidden on Outlands, and script interaction with players is heavily limited because of PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535968116427980820)
- **script-triggered cooldown**: A cooldown can be triggered by a script included in the hotkey that casts Telekinesis, and it must be triggered after the cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536899684348600390)
- **scripted auto healing**: Scripting can auto cast heals, but you cannot move while casting, so a script that stops you to cast at the wrong time can be worse than just moving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553816303456886865)
- **scripted fishing pole equip**: To equip a fishing pole in a script without double-clicking: find the pole in the backpack, use the 'Undress Both Hands' hotkey, wait 650 ms, lift the pole, wait 650 ms, drop it on self RightHand, then wait 250 ms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551689440378884169)
- **scripting a context menu entry**: A context menu, which is not a gump, can reportedly be triggered from a script with 'menu <yourcharacterid> 3', where the last number selects the menu entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551723274361376869)
- **scripting and botting rules**: Scripting and automation are allowed within reason, but rules against proper botting still apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535387535193149572)
- **scripting artisan aspect level-up**: A script may stop the crafting queue once enough experience for an Artisan aspect level is gained, but automatically leveling up the aspect is not supposed to be scripted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555845794505162844)
- **scripting check for player targets**: There is no direct scripting command to check whether a target is a player, because player interaction is highly limited in the scripting system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552604661750702141)
- **scripting find functions in pvp**: The scripting find functions are disabled in PvP on Outlands, which prevents a thief from instantly grabbing your most valuable item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541832603533975662)
- **scripting hiking**: Hiking can be automated with a script instead of being done manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550179420029849722)
- **scripting in structured pvp**: Scripting is very limited in structured PvP such as factions and events, while scripts can be used in unstructured PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672497099804672)
- **scripting messages in guild chat**: It is possibly allowed to script messages in guild chat on Outlands, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544188987449806911)
- **scripting movement stop when hidden**: There is no Razor script command to stop movement once hidden, so spamming hide while running cannot be scripted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542849922712215593)
- **scripting recycling of worn tools**: To script recycling of worn tools, find the tool by type ID, use getlabel to read its uses-remaining text, and check it with if/elseif conditions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536868200246157373)
- **scripting rules**: Scripting for killing monsters, healing or gathering is allowed as long as the player is present at the screen; being away while scripts run is punished. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526194246976143391)
- **scripting stockpile item removal**: Items cannot be removed from the stockpile via scripting, so essence used for recharging must be kept in a stack outside the stockpile for a script to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527686495744294982)
- **scripts adding containers to razor ignore list**: Scripts that process containers such as paragon boxes (for example unlocking scripts) may add the box to the Razor ignore list to avoid processing it repeatedly, which can make later find checks for that serial fail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549481122818298017)
- **scripts in pvp**: Scripts written for PvM generally do not work in PvP, because scripting was reportedly changed to block it, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534148837831348264)
- **scripts targeting trapped box contents**: As long as the game knows what is inside a trapped box, scripts can still target the box's contents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527633344316313765)
- **self-healing macro in classicuo**: In ClassicUO, use a macro with the verbal command [BandageSelf to bandage yourself without cancelling a running script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536871439360065707)
- **setgrabbag and grabbag functions**: Bind the setgrabbag client function to a macro to set a target bag, and bind the grabbag function to a macro to get a reticle that moves a chosen item into that bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523789582963834943)
- **setskill script command**: The Outlands script command setskill changes a skill's gain arrow, accepting the parameters up, down, or lock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544008322448101376)
- **setting script variables by targeting items**: In Outlands scripting, a script can set a variable at the start by prompting the player to target an item, for example targeting the runebook sets A and targeting the spellbook sets B. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539582081540169808)
- **setting up a razor script**: Find a script on outlands.uorazorscripts.com, copy it into the script section in Razor, save it, then hit play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554259368508133417)
- **setting up collectors**: Collectors are in the in-game general options near the bottom; create separate collectors for mobs, party, and reds/orange, each set to grab only its respective targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521906321228693636)
- **setvar target cursor**: The setvar script command brings up a target cursor so the player can select the target to store in the variable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538570596500115599)
- **setvar versus pushlist speed**: In Razor scripts, setvar is faster than pushlist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545740323953582140)
- **shared hotkeys between client and razor macros**: The same key can be assigned to both a client-side macro and a Razor macro/script, and the Razor > Hotkeys list can be searched with a filter such as "Alt + X" to find existing bindings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533322243868856351)
- **shared overhead xml files**: Players share personal overhead/cooldown xml files on uorazorscripts.com; searching for "xml" finds them, including a large one called "Bapeths Total Overhead Messages". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525929790618599517)
- **sharing organizer setups**: To reuse another player's organizer setup, copy the relevant Organizer section (e.g. Organizer 3) from their XML file into yours, optionally moving it to another Organizer slot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548406010836816016)
- **sharing razor between characters**: Razor can be shared between characters through Razor profiles, selected on the Razor home screen; client changes are saved per character and can be shared by sharing the client profile or copying the character's folder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533500256107626507)
- **sharing razor macros between characters**: Macros built in Razor can be shared across characters, with only the hotkeys that need to differ changed, so they do not have to be recreated for each character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528693867317297222)
- **shelf loadout snippet placement**: The shelf loadout snippet should be placed at the end of the script rather than at the front, because placing it first makes the script get caught in a loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545489014038077583)
- **shelter automated speech limit**: In the Shelter area, scripted say commands are blocked with the message 'Automated speech is not allowed in this area' after a script has issued about 10 say commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555061526757642322)
- **shiphold restock bug**: The shiphold can be bugged so restocking from it fails with the error 'Invalid target container', which also hampers scripting; this works only some of the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543185536758456341)
- **silencing razor command messages**: Prefixing a Razor script command with '@' (for example '@drop backpack -1 -1') silences the messages Razor would otherwise log for that command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537433025791533066)
- **simple dig script setup**: A simple dig setup is to bind a script to a key that double-clicks an Elven Spellblade (skinning knife) in the backpack and targets self, then press the key about every 2 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537016685045878784)
- **simple lumberjacking razor script**: A simple lumberjacking Razor script loops: double-click the hatchet, target yourself to start harvesting, and repeat every couple of seconds; a recording that clicks the hatchet then targets yourself also works, subject to the rule against AFK harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531167206778470500)
- **single key recall and loot macros**: Set up a macro per character, profile and runebook to recall and enter your room with one key press, and a separate macro to drop all loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521330517562359828)
- **skill macro buttons**: Skills with a small blue gem next to them in the skill page can be dragged out to create macro buttons, and skill groups such as Thieving can be expanded with the arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525617566469325022)
- **skinning corpses command**: Outlands has no dedicated command to skin corpses; players reportedly use the 'use skill forensic' command or click the knife in a macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535438444619243661)
- **skinning macro corpse targets**: The skinning macro only skins grey corpses and does not skin blue corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530558099717492818)
- **skipping monsters with next monster target**: To skip unwanted monsters with the Next Monster Target hotkey, keep your own ignore list: each time the target changes, check whether the monster is in that list and, if so, immediately call the targeting hotkey again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540814287658946660)
- **smart targeting last target**: Smart targeting tracks separate beneficial and hostile last targets based on spells cast directly in game; Razor's set beneficial/set hostile commands do not work in game, while target last beneficial and target last harmful do work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538963221694644304)
- **smoke bomb buff bar cooldown entry**: Smoke bomb cooldown entries were recently added to the buff bar, so older cooldowns.xml files may lack them and they may need to be added manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544055537904128041)
- **smoke bomb cooldown timer**: If a system message appears in chat when a smoke bomb is used, use that system message as the trigger for a cooldown timer in Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540503591398150265)
- **smoke bomb macro**: Create a ClassicUO macro that says '[smokebomb' to trigger a smoke bomb. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526659810710393054)
- **smokebomb buff**: Smokebomb usage may apply a buff whose appearance and disappearance a script could key off, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1540778261158821929)
- **smokebomb macro**: A smokebomb macro can reportedly be made in the game client using a say-text action with the [smokebomb command, though the exact command is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533824517812654191)
- **society optimizer profit value**: The profit value in Outlands Butler's society optimizer accounts for the material cost to complete the job and the value of a single society point at an efficient conversion rate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535678091018375229)
- **sorting mibs with butler tools**: To locate and sort MIBs efficiently, use the Outlands Butler tools, which include sorting scripts and a map file you can add, rather than clicking each MIB individually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555558107189485700)
- **special buttons in client hotkeys**: Special buttons may cause problems when bound to client hotkeys; testing with a normal key such as Ctrl+A can verify a macro works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532148234057814086)
- **special command throttling**: Special commands such as [ commands have been throttled the same as normal speech for years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555178881588400129)
- **speech command throttling in scripts**: Commands such as [pouch that make the character speak are still subject to the 'ignoring speech request' throttling when used in scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524012053734363249)
- **speech-based script variable input**: It is not possible to set a script variable by speaking in-game in Outlands scripting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539570761008816128)
- **spell graphic on macro button**: To use a spell's graphic on a macro button, find the graphic's name in your gumpoverrides folder, convert it with a hex calculator to get the number, and use that number. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524430819152625845)
- **spell stone with casting scripts**: A spell-casting Razor script will use a spell stone as well as reagents, since it just casts spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522392267581689927)
- **spellbook sound alert for multiboxing**: A spellbook can be used as a blessed item that makes a sound to signal when to move to the next harvesting spot while multiboxing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535788172179410954)
- **splitting stacks in scripts**: A script can split stacks of items such as reagents, potions, scrolls and rope into smaller piles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1543649347554644069)
- **stance dance scripts**: Stance dance scripts alternate between a defensive stance and an offensive stance, such as warding if diseased or shield bash otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526681522004824145)
- **stat locking via scripts**: There is no script command equivalent to setskill for locking stats such as Dexterity, although scripts can check a stat's value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544007896331714561)
- **stealing macro**: A simple macro can be set up to use the stealing skill on whatever nearby monster is currently targeted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546711881580810402)
- **stealth step counter**: To show the stealth step counter, use the command [ShowStealthSteps or enable Razor > Options > Additional Options > Count stealth steps; the setting is remembered between logins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530572024865357834)
- **stealth step counter**: A game help command shows the stealth step count overhead, and Razor also has a stealth steps counter that can be set to display overhead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536314141155786793)
- **stopping F1 from showing all names**: To stop F1 from showing all nameplates, find the AllNames hotkey under Options > Macros or Razor > Hotkeys and rebind it to another key or remove it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529088399586103327)
- **stopping a training script at target dexterity**: To stop a training script when Dexterity reaches a target value, use a condition such as 'if dex = 65', then show an overhead message, wait, and stop the script, ending with endif. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1530885245283336325)
- **storing last harmful target in razor**: In a Razor script on UO Outlands, you can store the serial of your last harmful target with: if noto lasttarget 'harmful' followed by @setvar!
