LastHarmful lasttarget. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550461792365584415)
- **stuck arrows for scavenger**: There are a few rare locations on the map where arrows can get properly stuck for the scavenger agent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523069081014636544)
- **stuck razor organizer**: If a Razor organizer bugs out and gets stuck trying to move items (possibly worsened by the object/action queue), press 'stop' on the running organizer in Razor to end it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546653707222122577)
- **super id-recycler-while-farming script**: The 'SUPER ID-Recycler-while-farming' UO Razor script can automatically eat arcane essences if that option is activated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1534874171828469912)
- **swapping hotkeys between characters**: Create and use different Razor profiles to swap hotkeys easily between echoes (characters). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548770527726796957)
- **swapping weapon and spellbook**: To swap between a weapon and a spellbook, set up a Dress/Undress list in Razor and bind it to a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535647334216761435)
- **swing cooldown timer**: You can create a swing cooldown timer, but you must set its time manually because it is not dynamic and does not adjust to swing speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542329771742990356)
- **swing timer cooldown in classicuo**: To show a swing timer, open ClassicUO Options, go to the Cooldowns tab, create a new cooldown, give it a color and set the type to swingspeed; the timer resets on each swing, so set its duration to your swing time including all your SSi increases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541840091461455972)
- **syncing client and razor settings between computers**: To get the same Outlands client and Razor settings on two computers, copy the assistant and profiles directories from one machine to the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555667025639120953)
- **tag_overhead settings**: The tag_overhead and tag_overheads settings add a tracked player's name to overhead messages, and a number in curly braces inserts word #n of the system message into the overhead message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522253156422254753)
- **taking one recall scroll with a script**: A UO Assistant style script can take one recall scroll from a stack by finding item type 8012 in a container, lifting one, and dropping it into the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531671696854094144)
- **tamer scripted dungeon farming**: With a tamer build and scripts, a player can press one button and steer with the mouse while the rest plays itself, which allows runs through level 3 dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522289953592315996)
- **taming script pet range fix**: If a taming script releases the pet and it wanders too far, increase the range in 'if find tameTarget ground -1 -1 2 as pet' to a larger value such as 5 (-1 -1 5). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533294877683748946)
- **taming script requirements**: A taming script should be run with only one pet and while not inside an inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533205554002919424)
- **taming script training location**: A taming training script should be run in a smaller area, not inside a house or inn room, because if the untamed mob wanders the script can break. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522472073274855486)
- **targetexists loop reliability**: Waiting for the target cursor to disappear with a targetexists loop is less reliable than reading system messages to confirm that a spell was actually cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524461940112359444)
- **targeting item by serial in razor script**: To target a specific item by serial in a Razor script, use 'target SERIAL backpack' instead of 'targettype'; targettype 'dagger' only works if a dagger is in the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533407634680709170)
- **taunt macro nearest target**: To make a taunt macro apply to the nearest target, place waitfortarget followed by selectneartcreature after the taunt command; smartlasttarget or lasttarget can be used as alternatives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548117808880156784)
- **tazuo client prohibition**: TazUO is prohibited on UO Outlands; the server only allows connection through the official Outlands Launcher, which uses its custom ClassicUO with Razor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554881651409035266)
- **telekinesis duration cooldown tracking**: Since self-cast Telekinesis applies no buff, create a cooldown that triggers when you cast it on yourself to track its duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536898390376456283)
- **telekinesis self-cast system message**: Casting Telekinesis on yourself produces a system message that can be used as a trigger for a cooldown timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536901275315216464)
- **teleport and rope hotkey**: You can cast teleport and rope back to back, and you can set up a single hotkey that does both at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552704761189376021)
- **testing pvp restrictions on test center**: To test PvP-restricted script behavior on Test Center, log in two characters that are not guilded or partied together, which puts them under PvP restrictions; placing them in different factions can test that case too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541475720553963603)
- **testing the random command**: To test the random command, create a script containing only 'random 32', run it, and print your journal to see the result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1523699927891447989)
- **text commands list**: Type [commands to see several pages of text commands usable from scripts or macros, including changing aspects and toggling disarm; they produce system messages that can be shown as Razor overheads. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545062742661009458)
- **theft warning with trapped pouch**: To get a theft alert, carry a trapped pouch and a container of a unique kind, drag the backpack onto your counters, then drop the backpack into the trapped pouch; the bag stays openable via the counters, and if the trapped pouch goes off a thief is stealing, so run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527429198791049326)
- **thief razor last-target steal**: Thieves can lower their object delay, temporarily move items, and set a target in Razor so they can hotkey a last-target steal without seeing the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143376258011229)
- **thief scripts popping pouches**: Thieves use scripts that can instantly pop pouches and snag items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535076750793642025)
- **third-party tool ban risk**: Using third-party tools other than Razor scripts risks a ban. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522400577164804147)
- **third-party tool policy**: Only the included Razor or the standard client are allowed in-game, and third-party macro programs are not permitted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524500891502383277)
- **third-party tool requirements**: Playing on Outlands does not require Stealth, UO Pilot or Inject. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529374686960549909)
- **throwing purple potion at nearest mob in classicuo**: In ClassicUO, a macro setup exists that throws a purple potion at the nearest mob instead of the last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524560623541813400)
- **tiles disallowing item drops**: Tiles near transitions and gates typically do not allow items to be dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537873035900624997)
- **tome id mismatch after graphic change**: A script that locates tomes by item id fails on tomes whose graphics have changed, because the ids in the script no longer match. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1548786295306846209)
- **tracking arrow and script triggers**: The colored tracking arrow is unrelated to whether an escape script triggers; the script trigger comes from elsewhere, such as system messages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537230098812379248)
- **tracking chivalry symbols in razor**: To check how many chivalry symbols you have, use ingump on the Chivalry gump in a Razor script; any count over 9 can be saved as 9 rather than 12 or 13. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544358942920937543)
- **tracking overhead alerts against pks**: Tracking can be configured with overhead messages to make approaching PKs more noticeable, or a friend with Tracking can accompany you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476693654249624)
- **tracking overhead without brackets**: A tracking overhead can be set without bracket placeholders, so it simply announces that someone used the Tracking skill without naming the target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529106117958041621)
- **tracking recall script**: For a tracking-based gatherer script, use a blessed runebook and write a script that recalls to the rune of your choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554204546538938441)
- **tracking text color**: The tracking text color in the chat log cannot be changed directly, but you can create an overhead message triggered from it in any color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536859666141683812)
- **train magery script behavior**: The Train Magery script casts Heal on you after casting Lightning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534175109202448455)
- **transferring character and razor settings**: To transfer your character and Razor settings between devices, copy the two directories listed by the !profiles command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526234015055745064)
- **trap pouch macro**: To use trap (explosive) pouches via macro, use the [pouch command (say "[pouch") or, in Razor, open Hotkeys and filter for "pouch"; a double-click macro on the pouch only opens it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532775481458294986)
- **trapped pouch hotkey**: Assign a hotkey to the pouch command in Razor under Hotkeys by filtering for 'pouch', or make a client macro that says [pouch; this is essential for escaping paralyze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530454774879752232)
- **trapped pouch hue**: Hue 38 (red) is the hue of a trapped pouch in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538225482301055168)
- **trigger text for spells without grimoire points**: A spell with no points in the grimoire probably has no trigger text to capture for a cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523063452015394949)
- **troubleshooting missing notifications**: To check whether missing notifications are a config issue, move the Razor and client profile folders to another location such as the Desktop; new default files are created on next login. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541486045236035714)
- **ultimate thief trainer razor script**: In the 'Ultimate Thief Trainer' Razor script, lines 4 to 8 select which skills train (1 trains, 0 does not), so set a skill's line to 0 to skip it, e.g. lines 5, 6 and 8 to 0 to train only hiding and stealth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538865901846134824)
- **unattended harvesting script penalty**: If staff find your harvesting script still running while you are away, they put a timer on you, and a repeat offense reportedly results in a ban. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549416940701876306)
- **unequipping a hand in razor scripts**: To unequip a hand in a Razor script, use the command 'hotkey unequip left' or 'hotkey unequip right'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532147216553087056)
- **uo addicts script builder**: The UO Addicts Script Builder generates Razor scripts for Outlands builds, including one that shows poison ticks overhead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529668144166076456)
- **upcoming rope macro update**: An update expected soon is rumored to make rope macros slightly easier, but the details and timing are unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554944502261883294)
- **use item loadout number command**: The 'use item loadout number' approach with a value like '1/7' performs the same loadout selection as reading loadout names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1545508950517096521)
- **using a profile on another character**: To use a profile on another character on the same account, log in that character, open Options > Profile Manager, select the profile and click Switch; manually copying profile files from the game files also works, and Clone cannot be used between characters on the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532065949870460949)
- **vet kit script for healer codex buffs**: Use a script that spams veterinary bandage kits to keep healer codex buffs active and gain regeneration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530029875270782976)
- **vet supply script**: A vet supply script can be made by recording the vet supply actions with the Razor script recorder, since it involves only vet supply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533201042978771056)
- **vs code extensions for razor scripts**: Free VS Code extensions already exist for editing Outlands Razor scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532530063688597686)
- **wait command during world save**: The Razor script wait command stops counting during a world save and resumes afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552405026478100491)
- **wait time between casts**: The wait between casts in a script should equal your ping but never less than 600 ms, increasing if ping exceeds 600 ms; some players simply use a fixed 600 ms wait because getlabel-based ping measurement often fails. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542846532506882109)
- **waitfortarget in combined cast macros**: When combining casting and targeting in one macro, add a WaitForTarget action between the cast and the targeting action so the target cursor is ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544632191978315878)
- **waitfortarget in pvp scripts**: Almost all wait commands are on the list of commands disabled for pvp scripting, but waitfortarget (wft) reportedly is not, so it may be usable to add waits to pvp scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551954892954927216)
- **waiting for queued actions in razor**: To make a Razor script wait until queued actions finish before continuing, use an empty 'while queued' / 'endwhile' loop, noting that it may not reliably wait for restock agent moves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546610464363118672)
- **waiting for system message in razor**: To wait for a system message in a Razor script, try a 'while not' loop on the system message check, or use variables to control which script sections run, with the else case replaying the script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547090545673773127)
- **walking in mining scripts**: Scripts may only dig and recall when tracking finds a red; scripts that walk were disabled because many players used walking in scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545423859400974366)
- **wall of stone target offsets**: Target positions for casting Wall of Stone in a script are fixed relative to the character regardless of facing, so targeting offset 0,0 leaves a hole in the middle of the wall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537202088474447894)
- **warmode off for training dummy**: For training on a training dummy, the Razor command 'warmode off' can be used to stop attacking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541884928570949672)
- **weapon ability activation**: Use the weapon ability, shown below the finisher, by clicking it when it is full, or by scripting it with the say [WeaponAbility command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527692864312574101)
- **weapon ability command in healing script**: A weapon ability command added to a healing script will not be said until the ability is ready, because the system indicates when the ability is ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530086385757720707)
- **weapon ability cooldown notification**: A system notifies the player when a weapon ability is off cooldown, which may be usable to script an automatic ability command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520928545008779294)
- **weapon ability ready notification**: To be notified when a weapon ability is ready, create a Razor overhead message for the system message so it displays over your head, and bind an in-game say macro for the ability to a key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522736215902785578)
- **weapon ability ready system message**: When a weapon ability is ready, the game displays the system message 'Weapon ability ready', which a Razor script can detect with insysmsg. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522733469061611562)
- **weapon ability toggle commands**: Saying '[WeaponAbility1' and '[WeaponAbility2' in-game, including via script, toggles the primary and secondary weapon abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533814432814338099)
- **weapon ability trigger detection**: No trigger text appears when a weapon ability activates and scripts cannot confirm it fired on hit, so an accurate cooldown bar for the ability itself cannot currently be built. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523372799215931423)
- **wft script command limits in pvp**: The 'wft' script command does not work in faction PvP or while the player has the 'pvp restrictions' buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551702646463926333)
- **while casting wait loop**: In Outlands scripts, a 'while casting' loop with 'wait 50' pauses the script during a cast and re-checks every 50ms until the cast finishes, which prevents spam casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539629699549106236)
- **while loop inside if in razor scripts**: A Razor script may reportedly place a 'while target exists' loop with an empty body inside an if block to wait for a target to disappear, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526024167001161769)
- **while queued behavior with restock agent**: The 'while queued' loop in Razor waits for manual item drops but does not reliably wait for restock agent item moves, exiting while several moves are still queued. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546648232900300923)
- **witcher tmap location markers for razor**: To show Witcher TMap location markers on the in-game map, place the provided .xml file in the Ultima Online Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Client folder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531092366398717993)
- **witcher tome auto teleporter script setup**: The 'Witcher Tome Auto Teleporter' script by jfrostp finds the correct Witcher tome and rune using nearby rune tomes; edit lines 22 to 36 with your own tome info, and it will then work only for that specific rune library. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550495334990348378)
- **words of power as cooldown triggers**: The words of power spoken when casting a spell are not trigger text for cooldowns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523063894019670109)
- **xml files for treasure chest map locations**: Adding XML files to your game is allowed and can show treasure chest locations on the world map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536495674852376656)

## Economy

- **barbaric summer 2026 prevalian merchant**: The Barbaric Summer 2026 Prevalian Merchant sells the Summer Scratch ticket, limited-edition clothing, and exclusive home decorations, and some items are marked NEVER RETURNING and will not be offered again after the merchant leaves. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1531134372026253393)
- **buying sarape raffle tickets**: To buy tickets for the Shimmer Oxide Ragged Sarape raffle, visit Barbara the Ragged Sarape Raffle Official at Prevalia Bank. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1527785902959624362)
- **discord trade listing limit**: In the Outlands Discord trade channels, each player may have only one active listing per channel, and creating a new listing automatically removes the previous one in that channel. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534562181817831567)
- **harvestmaster merchant item preview**: All items sold by the Zucchini Harvestmaster 2026 Prevalian Merchant can be previewed on the Test Shard. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553882084236591204)
- **harvestmaster prevalian merchant**: The Harvestmaster Prevalian Merchant at Prevalia Bank sold a limited edition release with a new shimmer hue, limited edition clothing and home decorations, purchased with Prevalia Coins. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553882084236591204)
- **hot barbarian summer prevalian merchant**: The Hot Barbarian Summer Prevalian Merchant sells barbarian clothing including back-worn Backworn Axes, new and limited-edition home decorations, a Summer Scratch, and the permanent Terracotta Paver Tile Set. It was available July 10-26 and remains available after the event ends until a set date, and items can be previewed on the Test Shard. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **hot barbarian summer prevalian merchant**: The Hot Barbarian Summer Prevalian Merchant sold Never Returning items that will not be available again once the merchant is gone. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **hot barbarian summer scratch ticket**: Hot Barbarian Summer Scratch Tickets cost 25,000 gold at the Hot Barbarian Summer Merchant, are available July 11-26, and can win prizes including a random-hued Camel Plushie, Howling Wolf, and Golden Idol. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525252973565837453)
- **king's faire merchant**: The King's Faire Prevalian Merchant sells a new collection of clothing with new animations, home decorations, a limited edition hue, and a Scratch ticket with unique prizes, and departs at a scheduled time. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1545597367850369084)
- **melting ice cream raffle prize**: The Melting Ice Cream Raffle awards five blessed Melting Ice Creams when the Faire ends. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **mount token raffle ticket price**: Tickets for the Shimmer Flare Mount Token Raffle cost 1000gp each and are sold by Sunny at Prevalia Bank. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548068723942756352)
- **outlaws for cash prize winner reward**: The winner of the Outlaws for CASH PRIZE event receives $50. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543061860939468911)
- **outlaws showdown first place reward**: In the 3-round Outlaws Showdown event, 1st place wins 10 Prevaliacoin. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1533186927782789372)
- **prevalia lotto drawing**: The Prevalia Lotto is drawn at 8PM ET and the jackpot prize is gold. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1537881062544248913)
- **prevalia lotto tickets**: Prevalia Lotto tickets cost 1000gp each and are sold at the Prevalia Casino. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **prevalian merchant at fairegrounds**: The Prevalian Merchant has moved to the Fairegrounds and sells Limited Edition wares such as the new Shimmer Flare hue, clothing and home decor, available until the release ends. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **prevalian merchant test shard previews**: Prevalian Merchant releases, including the King's Faire Prevalian Merchant (August 2026) and the Harvestmaster Prevalian Merchant (September 2026), were made available for preview on the Outlands Test Shard. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1549901811018760243)
- **reposting expired listings**: If a trade channel listing is still relevant after it expires, repost it. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534562181817831567)
- **shimmer flare mount token raffle**: The Shimmer Flare Mount Token Raffle, run by Sunny the Shimmer Flare Mount Token Raffle Official at Prevalia Bank, awards a one of a kind Shimmer Flare (hue 1694) Mount Token of the winner's choosing. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548068723942756352)
- **shimmer oxide ragged sarape raffle**: The Shimmer Oxide Ragged Sarape flash raffle prize is a blessed Shimmer Oxide-hued Ragged Sarape, with tickets costing 10,000 gp each at Prevalia Bank. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528562715453554759)
- **trade channel post format**: Posts in the WTB trade channel must include WTB (Want To Buy), and posts in the WTS trade channel must include WTS (Want To Sell). _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534562181817831567)
- **trade listing expiration**: Listings in the Outlands Discord trade channels automatically expire after 7 days. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534562181817831567)
- **trade post auto-removal**: Trade channel posts that do not follow the required WTB/WTS format may be automatically removed. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534562181817831567)
- **zucchini harvestmaster event rewards**: Rewards for the Zucchini Harvestmaster event were distributed directly to players' bank boxes. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553422728550154372)
- **zucchini harvestmaster prevalian merchant goods**: The Prevalian Merchant sells limited-time zucchini-themed decor and seasonal attire that are exclusive to the Zucchini Harvestmaster 2026 event. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553882084236591204)
- **arcane essence sources**: Arcane essence is obtained by recycling magic items, by picking dungeon chests, or by buying it from player vendors (e.g. with gold earned from selling harvested resources). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546470764402708521)
- **arcane scroll value and sources**: Arcane scrolls drop from monsters and treasure chests and are worth looting; they sell for roughly 1000-1500 gp each on player vendors, while skill scrolls can sell for 6k-7k each. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550694899593121884)
- **buying from player vendors to bank**: Player vendor purchases cannot go directly into a sub-container, but the send to bank option delivers items to your bank for a small markup (about 2% per the wiki), and if the bank box is full items wait in a queue viewable with [BankQueue. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331347512631306)
- **clothing bless deeds**: Clothing bless deeds keep clothing from going to a dead body on death but only work on fancy clothing; the only other bless deeds are for runebooks and rune tomes, and deeds are costly (priced in Prev coins, bought with real money or player gold). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549753580846714961)
- **colonial marks**: Colonial Marks are a currency dropped mainly by Time dungeon mobs (and a few uncommon Time spawns in the overworld) and are spent in large quantities on Time quests and related purchases. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533974494593552475)
- **early gold from lumberjacking and mining**: Lumberjacking and mining are good ways for new players to raise initial gold, and selling ingots and boards early is lucrative for funding PvM characters such as a mage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547072372224426035)
- **finding items on player vendors**: Use the vendor-search page on the Outlands portal (portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search), enter an item name such as 'delectable' or 'arcane essence', and sort results by price to find player vendors selling it. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541378862909231125)
- **full spellbook price**: A full 64-spell spellbook costs roughly 30K-40K gold from players, and the portal lists them under the search term '64 spells'. The price is driven mostly by the 24 Arcane Scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550785709395284038)
- **harvest aspect on treasure maps**: Harvest Aspect gives a chance to double loot, including stackable gold, when opening treasure maps, so it is favored for maximizing treasure map profit. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538209209798234242)
- **iron ingot commodity deeds**: Iron ingots can be turned into commodity deeds holding 5,000 ingots each, which sell to other players for high prices (about 142-145k at the time) and are a good way to raise early funds for training expensive templates. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544714769905225768)
- **iron ingot player market price**: A commodity of 5,000 iron ingots sells on the player market for roughly 135K-150K gold, about 27-30 gp per ingot. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538895469328212089)
- **items sellable to npc vendors**: NPC vendors buy very little from players, mainly gems and some magical equipment; they do not buy raw resources such as ore, ingots or boards, so most items are better sold to players. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547975452457705633)
- **mastery chain link sources**: Mastery chain links are obtained from contested and omni bosses, guild Omni Boss runs, T8 treasure maps, omni books, crafting T8s, achievements, societies and faction silver, or bought from players via Vendor Search or the advertising channel, which is the most reliable early option. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655024242491425)
- **outlands portal**: The Outlands Portal (portal.uooutlands.com) is a staff-maintained vendor indexer and sales history site for player vendors, accessed with OutlandsID credentials, where you can search items by price and locate vendors, but you must travel to the vendor yourself and it is not an auction house. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867430885429269)
- **player vendor rental price**: Players can rent vendor spots in other players' houses for a weekly fee set by the owner, typically about 2.5k to 5k gold per week (some are higher or even free), and the vendor also takes a cut of sales. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503818484817990)
- **prevalia coin acquisition and resale**: Prevalia coins are obtained by donating (or by buying them with gold from other players), can be spent in the Prevalia shop on limited-time event rares that are typically offered only twice, and can be sold to other players for roughly 22K-24K gold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552994495304310907)
- **prevalia coin gold value**: Prevalia coins trade between players at roughly 22k-24k gold each (higher during events with new items), while the Prevalia merchant values one coin at 25k gold after its gold prices rose about 25%. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537557739344101486)
- **prevalia coins**: Prevalia coins can be bought with real money (about $1 each) and sold to other players for gold, but all Prevalia items can also be bought with gold, so coins are not strictly required. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550990768091561991)
- **society points gold conversion**: Players turn society job points into gold by buying gold reforging tools (faster cash) or gold links (slower) and selling them to other players; junk links always sell, and points can also be advertised to buy whatever a buyer requests. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576871097274450)
- **strongbox deed**: A strongbox deed is an account customisation that lets a character carry more gold (gold weighs less in the bag), and is obtained for 500 Society points or bought from other players for roughly 2-2.5 million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554885453440880652)
- **vendor search portal**: A vendor search site at portal.uooutlands.com (vendor-search) shows who is selling what and where on player vendors, which makes selling through player vendors much more effective. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543136945297821828)
- **arcane essence price**: Arcane essence sells for about 20-25 gold each on player vendors; a claim of roughly 1k gold each is an outlier, likely confusing it with scrolls or runes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540796084161355897)
- **best crafting skills for societies**: Tailoring is the easiest and cheapest society crafting skill and the best starting choice, followed by Alchemy and Inscription, which are more resource hungry; other crafting skills cost more to raise and earn less from societies. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549634174045126687)
- **blacksmithy training cost**: Training Blacksmithy to 120 costs roughly 7 to 8 million gold in ingots (about 7.2M in ingots plus around 20 skill scrolls to raise the cap from 100 to 120), and training all crafting skills may total about 20 million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525474368401047622)
- **character rename deed**: A character rename deed is sold by the Prevalia merchant for about 10 prev, which is roughly 200-250k gold. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548496028372836393)
- **cheapest mount token sources**: The cheapest ways to get a mount token are society points and achievement points; the standard token costs about 400 society points, roughly 2 million gold, and cheaper special mount tokens exist. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551175380088660090)
- **circle 7 and 8 scroll availability**: No NPC vendors sell 7th and 8th circle magery scrolls; they are player-crafted and must be bought from player vendors or scribes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548147836783304815)
- **container id wands**: A container ID wand costs more up front than an item ID wand but gives more value per charge because it identifies a whole bag (around 100 items) at once; it is wasteful for bags of only 20-30 items, and wands can be recharged. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546349654139207680)
- **crafter income source**: Crafters earn their income mainly from society jobs, while crafting and selling on the market has very low profit margins. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544304411507953704)
- **crafting society weekly income**: Crafting society work yields roughly 100-150k gold per week per 100-skill crafter, and players running several crafters or well-established setups report about 750k to 1.5 million gold per week, depending on investment. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531178273529139220)
- **magic item recycler cost**: The Magic Item Recycler costs 25 Prevalia coins (a $25 website donation) or 625,000 gold in game. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655934722740275)
- **mount token creation kit acquisition**: The Mount Token Creation Kit is a reward-point item (reportedly 400 points at 5k per point) but can also be bought from other players for about 2M gold. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538577144890794105)
- **npc vendor restock**: NPC vendors, including mages, periodically restock their wares, at a variable interval of roughly 10 to 30 minutes that prevents clearing them out on a fixed timer. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552338755724116029)
- **outlands portal vendor search**: Search player vendor listings and sales history on the Outlands Portal (portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search) by logging in with your OutlandsID, or use the in-game chat command '!portal <term>'. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550392921860214895)
- **scrolls versus reagents cost**: Spell scrolls are often cheaper and lighter than reagents, especially for spells needing more than two reagents (e.g. mind blast and greater heal at 4 reagents vs 3 scrolls), and buying scrolls is cheaper than scribing them yourself. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549194587149701181)
- **secure player trading location**: Player-to-player trades should be done on Shelter Island, which has no stealing or player killing, so scams and theft are avoided. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545121820641075353)
- **selling iron ingots to players**: To sell iron ingots, gather 5,000 iron, put it into a cheap bank-bought commodity deed (no house needed), link your Discord account via the Portal, and post it in the buy/sell channel; or sell via a vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549595625002115084)
- **selling without a house**: Players without a house can sell items by renting a vendor, such as a vendor spot in another player's house or in a guild vendor house. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549257885006172192)
- **society point spending**: Gold reforge tools and gold links are good ways to spend society points, with gold reforge tools giving cash sooner and selling better than silver; bronze links are a waste, and market prices should be checked before redeeming. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551367544122908673)
- **society points gold link**: A link bought with society points is random and cannot be chosen by the player. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548368679564218442)
- **strongbox gold weight reduction**: Strongbox is an account-wide customization unlock bought with a deed using society points. The first deed reduces carried gold weight by 25% and the second brings the total to 50%. The reduction applies only once gold is in your backpack, so you can still be overweight when recovering a corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554537713728884889)
- **transferring gold between characters**: To move gold between characters on the same account, go to a banker and say 'balance' to open the check gump and write a check (5k or more), which pulls from your other characters' bank gold on that account if the current character lacks enough; for a different account, write a check of 5k or more and give or trade it to the other character. For items, rent a room and use a secured container with co-owners. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549832970179969177)
- **unlocking echoes**: An echo (additional skill template) can be unlocked with arcane essence for roughly 425-450k gold, which is much cheaper than paying 3m gold; skill scrolls are another way to unlock one. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539098595663933)
- **achievement point spending on emote deeds**: Emote deeds and bear mounts are exclusive to achievement points, and emote deeds can also be bought from players, so spending achievement points on deeds to sell may be profitable if a buyer is found. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541793070776066059)
- **armor crates on vendors**: Armor is commonly sold as crates containing full sets because it is more convenient for sellers than pricing each piece, which makes single armor pieces hard to find on vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767479617159360)
- **aspect crystal usage**: Aspect crystals are mainly used for bosses, Omni and other higher-end content, and are generally considered not worth the money early on compared to other bonus systems. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536209481841508383)
- **avoiding theft when buying from vendors**: When buying from a player vendor, hide quickly (about 50% chance to hide within 1 tile of a house), buy, then run at least one to two screens away before recalling, as thieves may be nearby; alternatively pay the small fee to have the item sent to your bank. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584302434947195)
- **bank gold withdrawal and checks**: At the bank, say 'withdraw' followed by an amount to take out gold, or say 'check' followed by an amount to convert bank gold into a bank check, which can still be used to buy things without carrying gold and which combines with other checks into one. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543616049973563503)
- **banking items bought from player vendors**: Items bought from player vendors should be sent to the bank immediately, because vendor thieves camp vendors and can steal purchased items, while the bank is safe and cheap. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547521246571528243)
- **bronze link value**: A bronze link costs 100 society points but sells for far less because bronze links are mostly useless and heavily oversupplied from many other sources. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524828221139456081)
- **buying a full spellbook**: Buying a completed spellbook from a player is cheaper than collecting every spell yourself; the price mainly reflects the 24-25 arcane scrolls needed for the 7th and 8th circle, so circles 1-6 are effectively free, and the seller may ask you to supply the scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546339279247118436)
- **buying items via outlands portal**: To buy items from player vendors, search for the item on the Outlands Portal (adding modifiers to narrow results), click the item to see which vendors sell it and where they are, then travel to that vendor in-game and buy it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551766021621415946)
- **casino game payout requirements**: In the casino game, every icon, including the crown, needs 3 matching icons to pay out. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541461324746195005)
- **clothing bless deed cost**: A clothing bless deed costs about 250k gold or 10 Prevalia coins, and is needed so clothing does not drop on death. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542799364857274448)
- **command and harvest core prices**: Command and harvest cores once cost about 140-200k each when the harvest aspect launched and tamers were overhauled, but prices have since dropped to around 36k per harvest core. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521148881474162730)
- **container id wands**: Item ID wands, including Container ID wands that identify every item in a container, can be crafted or bought from other players (searchable on the Portal) and are not very expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548189158340821093)
- **corpse gold decay**: Gold on a corpse is halved when the corpse turns from blue to gray, and it then loses a further 10% every 60 seconds. Corpses turn gray after 5 minutes and decompose 5 minutes later for mobs, or 15 and 15 minutes for player corpses, at which point the gold is gone. Gold on the ground decays 10% every 60 seconds down to a stack of 9. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545079964959772803)
- **creature broker pet purchases**: Players can buy pets that other players have listed for sale from a Creature Broker NPC, which avoids long taming sessions for good random stats, and some listings are overpriced while good-stat pets can often be found for much less than the top listings. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666061280551084)
- **echo stamping cost**: Stamping echoes costs 1M gold for the first and an additional 1M more for each subsequent one (2M, 3M, 4M, etc.), and swapping to an already stamped echo costs no additional gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550486334005841993)
- **echo unlock cost**: Echo cost scales with echo number: echo 1 costs 1m gold or doubloons, 100 skill scrolls, or 25k arcane essence; echo 2 costs 2m, 200 scrolls or 50k essence; echo 3 costs 3m, 300 scrolls or 75k essence; the seventh costs 7m gold/dubs, 700 scrolls or 175k essence. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550579668397326456)
- **echoes cost**: Echoes are relatively cheap, especially the first one or two, and cheaper than levelling an aspect, so using echoes on one main character avoids levelling aspects twice. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000291833282671)
- **empty paragon chests**: Emptied paragon chests are just containers usable for storage or decoration, or sold or traded for small value (a few thousand gold or a little essence). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536419473160933488)
- **finding player vendor items**: To find items sold by player vendors, search the vendor portal at portal.uooutlands.com, filtering by category or searching by name, to see every vendor selling the item with prices and locations. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524801687162847352)
- **fishing from a boat for money**: Fishing from a boat at sea is a viable and good way to make money in Outlands, even for new players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539859722482487398)
- **gems**: Gems are useful for leveling Tinkering and can be sold to vendors for a decent bonus of gold per dungeon run, especially early on. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046724166459555)
- **gold links from society points**: Gold links are a good use of society points, though their market value has fallen to roughly 2.5M gold from about 3.5M and link prices have dropped in general. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549427327014928500)
- **king's faire ticket acquisition**: King's Faire tickets can be bought with gold or farmed from monsters, and because they are spent quickly, players are advised to save farmed tickets for games they enjoy. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540733263902015528)
- **leather uses**: Leather can be used to make armor, sold to other players for quick money, or used for societies, which increases its value. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550339616005955717)
- **massive logs pricing and use**: Piles of massive logs sold by players are not sold in the Portal, so the seller sets the price; buyers want them for decoration and for the achievement for registering all items in a category. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532293542163255326)
- **mount token player market price**: Mount tokens sell on the player market for roughly 1.7-2.5 million gold, with about 2.2M being a recent typical vendor price. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538578486212431972)
- **npc reagent vendor stock**: NPC reagent vendors sometimes sell out of reagents such as nightshade, since players burn through them; Smugglers reportedly always have stock at higher prices. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552336865087062102)
- **outlands portal price overview**: The Outlands Portal vendor search has a price overview page (vendor-search/price-overview) with price history, including commodity prices such as ingots, and it has no public API. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554563356642381864)
- **plain scrolls from mobs**: Plain scrolls dropped by mobs are generally not worth collecting, since NPC scribes do not buy them and mobs do not drop tier 7/8 scrolls. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554576516589818019)
- **player vendors**: Player vendors let players sell items without relying on the Discord #buy and #sell channels, and the Outlands wiki 'Vendors' page explains how to set them up. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530212721507827795)
- **player-driven economy**: Outlands has an established player-driven economy in which you do not really sell items to NPCs; gold comes from dungeon drops or trading with players, goldenwood bows are bought from player vendors found via the portal vendor search, and reaching grandmaster blacksmith will not make you rich. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540012359521935370)
- **portal vendor price search**: The Outlands player portal at portal.uooutlands.com has vendor-search pages, including a price overview, that list vendor items and prices and can be used to estimate item prices. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544653553342218260)
- **prevalia coin shop items**: The Prevalia shop sells quality-of-life items such as the stockpile or resource pile, storage shelf (resource storage), magic item recycler, repair bench, tomes and blessed runetomes, plus cosmetics and collector's items. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413705989652700)
- **runebook bless deed**: Jakesh, the Prevalia merchant, sells runebook bless deeds (reported around 62.5k to 100k gold, with runetome deeds at 125k) to bless a runebook; he was recently at the King's Faire. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554338135159083049)
- **scroll cost npc versus crafting**: NPCs sell scrolls for around 50 gold each (about 200 gold for recall), while crafting them with Inscription costs only about 3 to 6 gold each. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554507198074462209)
- **sell discord posting rules**: Posts in the sell Discord channel must start with WTS or they are removed, and posting is rate-limited to roughly once every several hours up to a day, though existing posts can be edited. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545123043897249884)
- **selling boards ingots and ore to npcs**: NPC vendors do not buy boards, ingots, or ore; these can only be sold to other players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540110368041336942)
- **selling crafted items to npc vendors**: Players can generally sell crafted items such as jeweled beads to NPC jewelers but not raw materials, though aside from jewelry it is probably not cost effective. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098141182468107)
- **smuggler npc pricing and stock**: Smuggler NPCs sell unlimited amounts of certain vendor items at a 25-33% markup over normal vendors, and vendor discounts do not apply to them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951170508853476)
- **society jobs rewards**: Society jobs earn points that can be spent on rewards, which can be sold or used; reforge kits are a popular purchase. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008959333408830)
- **strongbox upgrades value**: Strongbox upgrades are expensive, low-return quality-of-life purchases that become worth it later, especially for group content or when you spend a lot of time returning from your farming area, since they extend dungeon time and reduce restock trips. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525437552667136020)
- **thieves at vendors**: Thieves can steal from players who are shopping at vendors, so players should be careful and hide while shopping. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671118704705677)
- **treasure map run time**: A full treasure map run from decode to drop-off takes roughly 1-3 minutes for level 1-3 maps (about 2 minutes, around 30 maps per hour), faster with about 11 damage links and an unobstructed dig spot. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543758479947468831)
- **unblessing cost**: Unblessing an item costs 25k gold and returns the cloth of the item, which can be worth more than the deed; the cost also acts as a gold sink that helps limit inflation. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525488718100566036)
- **achievement shop items available elsewhere**: Some mounts and tomes in the achievement points shop are also available via other points systems such as societies, so spending finite achievement points on them is not recommended. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528456488891449529)
- **arcane crystal uptime**: Arcane crystals are cheap and Moose stocks up on cores, so players can run them at 100% uptime. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524175620563800196)
- **arcane essence price**: Arcane essence is currently very cheap, much cheaper than a couple of years ago, so it is generally fine to spend it to fight more efficiently rather than leveling down an aspect to save it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556011075013451859)
- **armor and weapon color options**: Armor and weapon color can only be the material color or aspect color, and unlocking color choice for many pieces, weapons and spellbooks costs millions of gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521506502253478039)
- **avoiding theft while vendor shopping**: To avoid being stolen from after buying at a vendor, move away immediately and recall, or recall and press buy during the recall casting phase, or hold the purchased item on your cursor while casting recall. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542688893428830228)
- **bank checks**: A bank check obtained from a banker represents your gold, takes up less space in the bank, functions as gold while in your bank, and has spent gold deducted from it automatically. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554245464302288947)
- **black market bonus value**: Black Market bonus percentages are small in absolute terms, since Uncommon goods are worth about 50 gold and a +40% bonus adds only about 40 gold, and the chance of the rarest items is tiny. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523681027132887161)
- **blank scroll supply**: Smuggler NPCs sell an unlimited supply of blank scrolls at a slightly higher price, though many player vendors stock them more cheaply. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552817392629846097)
- **board commodity price**: A board commodity (made from 5,000 boards) sells for roughly 125k-135k gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537600049855332363)
- **board commodity sales**: Wood is typically sold to other players as board commodities in groups of 5000, which can earn fairly good money. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555949465695686697)
- **bronze link disposal**: Bronze links can be traded to players for essence or a silver, sold via the Outlands portal, or handed to the exchange officer in Prevalia. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521514026557767922)
- **buying from player shops with bank gold**: You can buy from player shops using gold held in your bank, so you do not need to carry gold in your bag. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539150803326074890)
- **buying full spellbooks**: Full 64-spell spellbooks can be bought on the Outlands Portal by searching '64 spells', once Young status has been dropped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547416090538414226)
- **checking link value**: You can check how much a link is worth by looking it up on the Outlands portal, which shows player market prices. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520285248590450828)
- **checking vendor sales and prices via portal**: To see what your vendors actually sold, open the Portal and use the 'My vendors' link; clicking 'vendor search' in-game also links you to the vendor portal website, where you can look up item prices. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553532662084272129)
- **chromatic aspect changes and core prices**: Chromatic aspect changes regularly cause core prices to fluctuate depending on the current meta, and resellers have lost large sums during such swings. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531105543475826748)
- **clothing bless deed cost**: The clothing blessing deed is more expensive than the leather cap restyle kits. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526613917009182961)
- **clothing bless deed purchase**: The clothing bless deed is bought from the Prevalian merchant using Prevalia coins, and the coins can be bought cheaper from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543256749212045332)
- **coal forge antiquity**: The coal forge is a crafting antiquity, and antiquity versions sell for far higher prices than normal forges. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528027684557295737)
- **codex acquisition and price**: Codexes, such as the thieving codex, are crafted items that must be bought from players, and the thieving codex costs around 45k gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525326192289382622)
- **codex prices**: Codices sell for roughly 35k to 45k gold depending on the vendor, with thieves codices around 40k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550392828226572301)
- **colonial mark price**: Colonial Marks are scarce and sell for roughly 100-200 gold each, and buyers for small quantities (under about 5,000-10,000) can be hard to find. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531006518093287564)
- **colored resource prices after map overhaul**: The map overhaul increases the drop rate of resource maps, which raises the supply of colored resources and is expected to lower their value, so resource maps are likely worthwhile over normal mining only for avar/val/ver maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **colored wood commodity sales**: Colored wood commodities sell for about 2500 each, and colored wood can sell in smaller stacks because many players only buy what they need for the weekly soc. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539153335070752808)
- **command core price**: Command cores are now much cheaper than before, when they cost around 60k, and the items they drop were also pricier then. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552717828920967169)
- **commodities and the society system**: Commodities are just a convenient way to sell items in bulk, and the society system is what gives commodities their purpose and value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527784718597361875)
- **commodity deeds for leather**: Carrying leather as commodity deeds (for example 5000 leather in one deed) makes it far more valuable per weight than gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551814740794417283)
- **converting a check back to gold**: To turn a check back into gold, place the check in your bank box and double click it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554246142206804039)
- **corrupted link pricing**: Corrupted links are cheaper than gold links because they are only usable for a limited number of days. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545414967942185031)
- **crafter income from society jobs**: Crafters such as alchemists make money mainly through weekly society jobs rather than by selling goods or potions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008884406100058)
- **crafting cost and self-gathered resources**: Some types of crafting are very expensive, but costs are much lower if you lumberjack and mine your own resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527376129550188669)
- **crafting profitability**: Crafting is expensive and not very profitable up front, bringing in gold slowly (often via crafting societies), but it is essential; boards and ingots sell very well, so gatherers can earn gold fairly easily, and you can get by without crafting by buying from Player Vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550893936770285709)
