- **crafting society gold earning**: To earn from the crafting Society, train several crafters (start with 3 tailors; tailoring/inscription/alchemy to 100, then tailoring/alchemy to 120, to 15 society points across three accounts), take jobs, burn resources for points, trade points for Reforge Tools, and sell them for gold, reportedly yielding about 1.2-1.5 million gold per week for around 20 minutes of work. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531670289757503538)
- **death aspect double dip fix**: A double dip interaction with the Death aspect was fixed, which reduced the Death aspect's build viability and caused core prices to decline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520809761971372204)
- **dull copper resource map price**: Dull copper resource maps have recently sold for about 7k, down from 15k+ when competition was active, and one seller says he has never sold them for more than 9k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531356781346033864)
- **dungeon cloth vs shimmer cloth availability**: Dungeon cloth, such as cavernam cloth which dyes bright white, is more plentiful and cheaper than rare shimmer cloth from old events. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525152265449767064)
- **dungeon gold farming efficiency**: Dungeon farming is currently low in gold efficiency because you can farm only about 10-15 minutes before leaving, especially without a strongbox, so many players take a little gold and focus on XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547647766417645578)
- **dyeing shields**: Aspect dye can be used on a shield, but each replacement shield needs fresh aspect dye, which can get expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555277220396798025)
- **early gold from xp dungeon**: To make early gold, train Hiding and Stealth, sneak to the lowest level of the current weekly XP dungeon (or a challenger dungeon), and carry out the gold other players leave behind on corpses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866523044024390)
- **early gold making**: Gold can be made early through lumberjacking and selling the commodities to players, mining, or scavenging gold and skins off bodies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528697143085502664)
- **echo cooldown upgrade costs**: Echo cooldown reduction has three upgrade tiers; the first two cost 2.5m gold each and the final one costs 5m. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550498055650811917)
- **echo cost**: Echoes are bought per character, and each additional echo on the same character costs progressively more, with no known limit; even the first is expensive for new players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550387631919992864)
- **echo creation cost**: Echoes are expensive, with a large up-front cost that increases as more of them are created, but they offer high long-term value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **empty paragon chest exchange**: Empty paragon chests can be exchanged for a small amount of essence at the exchange officer in Prevalia. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489790157201539)
- **event cosmetic availability rotation**: Event cosmetics are sold only during their event, appear once more as a last-chance buy at the following year's event, and then never return to the merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315534041845924)
- **exceptional masterwork kryss price**: Exceptional masterwork kryss weapons sell for around 1500gp, which is considered cheap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532802356583075850)
- **faction silver and point transfers**: Faction silver and other point-system points cannot be transferred directly between players, but goods bought with them are tradeable, so players pay others to buy items using their silver. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528846635210375300)
- **finding a full spellbook**: To find a full spellbook, search 'spellbook 64' (64 spells) on the Outlands portal, which shows the lowest price and the location. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522351825083302048)
- **gem demand from tinkerers**: Gems are used for tinkering, and players buy them in bulk at higher prices than NPC vendors pay, mainly to train tinkerers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474322880921661)
- **gold for vendor purchases**: Gold in your backpack cannot be used to buy from vendors; the gold must be in your bank, and being within range to open your backpack is close enough. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522290361915932842)
- **gold from fishing**: Players can make gold by fishing up nets and selling them, or by running messages in a bottle (MIBs) obtained from fishing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542220539475525756)
- **gold from grey mob corpses killed by others**: Looting a grey mob corpse that someone else killed earlier yields a reduced amount of gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538376681885007893)
- **gold nerf and gold decay**: A recent patch added a significant gold nerf, reportedly including gold decay that did not exist before. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536754918935896124)
- **gold reforge society cost and price**: A gold reforge costs 100 society points and sells for roughly 440-520k gold, with the price varying over time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528583222336946216)
- **gold-making templates**: Templates suited to making gold include tamer, wrestler dexxer, harvester (lumber or ore gathering), backstabber, scavenger, and Paladin/Bard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522260252714729493)
- **handling looted magic items**: Players are advised to collect magic items and identify and recycle them to extract magic rather than vendoring them, though selling loot to NPCs is acceptable if gold is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533001117791686757)
- **harvester versus pvm income**: Early on a harvester earns gold more easily than a PvM character, but once a PvM character gains power it outpaces a harvester and becomes the biggest earner. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531178733396955199)
- **house deed resale loss**: Selling a house deed back to the real estate vendor loses only 10% of its value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524428531960909854)
- **house resale value**: The deed price is often a minor part of a house's resale price; location drives value, and boat houses and houses with good dockmaster locations sell especially high. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529874058244657364)
- **inexpensive quality-of-life purchases**: The resource stockpile and magic item recycler are recommended inexpensive quality-of-life purchases after the storage shelf, while the much more expensive strongbox comes later. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500245959999629)
- **item identification wands availability**: Item Identification Wands cannot be bought on the starter island; they are crafted by player Tinkerers and sold on player vendors off the island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540768287867146301)
- **item price history lookup**: Item market values and price history can be checked on the Outlands portal's vendor-search page, which helps in deciding when to sell goods such as colored leather. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827272368980118)
- **large trade safety**: For large trades, trade in Shelter, ideally without the ox so the contents are visible, trade in batches, and take partial payment each time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535564957717102612)
- **leather commodity player price**: Leather sells to players for well above 1gp per unit, with a 5,000-leather commodity estimated at roughly 7-9k gold, possibly more. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827372562382900)
- **loot sale value**: Rare loot prices have dropped, and loot now sells for very little. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550258818359894017)
- **magic item recycler**: The Magic Item Recycler lets players dump magic items and has a drop-all button that takes every item in your backpack at once. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544072823289413722)
- **market price trend**: Prices have been dropping across the board because loot has been extremely plentiful, with strong players and many higher-difficulty areas added. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542666400928108564)
- **mastery chain link resale value**: Mastery chain links generally hold their value and can be resold to other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524640147549847634)
- **mastery link reforging prices**: A Mastery Link Reforging tool sells for around 100k and bronze bard mastery links with damage/buff bonuses sell for around 50k, so it is probably better to sell the reward link and tool and buy the desired link; check current prices first. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553167355473960961)
- **monster gold drops and difficulty**: Gold dropped by monsters is derived from the monster's Difficulty, so players seeking gold should hunt the hardest monsters they can handle. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539695649644224512)
- **moving gold between banks**: The bank balance menu only allows withdrawals; to move gold between banks on the same account, go to the bank, say balance, and write a check of 5k or more. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535911630532120578)
- **npc armor resale value**: NPC armor is worth much less than other armor, with five pieces of plate selling for about 250 gold in total. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530645163704057947)
- **npc mage scroll prices**: Circle 1-6 scrolls sold by mage NPCs are heavily overpriced compared with the material cost of making them, so buy only the few you need; there is no better route to a full spellbook than buying scrolls from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547415174049300500)
- **npc shop potions**: NPC shops such as the Alchemist and Naturalist sell only regular (lesser) heal potions; stronger potions such as Greater Heal must be crafted by other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539508034961805312)
- **npc vendor restock**: NPC vendor stock is often bought out by players and restocks in about 20-30 minutes, so check back periodically or try another town. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530240618733764699)
- **npc vendor stock sharing**: NPC vendor stock is shared among all players, so players can deplete it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554553409443602613)
- **npc vendors not buying materials**: NPC vendors generally do not buy items by design, including ingots and boards; players sell them to other players via a rented vendor spot or the trade channel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529581315484028928)
- **obtaining a medium ship**: A medium-sized ship can be bought from a player or crafted for you by someone from gathered materials; ships for sale are posted in a dedicated Discord channel and are pricey. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541417330503061564)
- **obtaining doubloons**: Doubloons are obtained by boating or by buying them from a boater, usually for less than the gold price; a test boat costs about half a million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527377465293406338)
- **ocean farming**: Ocean farming gives very good gold per hour and decent XP, but it takes place in lawless waters where other players may sink you, and it requires a boat, upgrades, a ship crew and knowledge of ship mechanics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548037663884574763)
- **outlands portal vendor search**: On the Outlands Portal vendor search, use the map button to see the vendor's location on the Outlands explorer map, and use the yellow mark button to get an in-game tracker arrow to the vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547621132155486223)
- **per-item pricing on player shops**: To price individual items in a stack on a player shop, check the 'Use Item Pricing Menu' checkbox to open the pricing gump. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552241236331728926)
- **pit gold income**: Pits have been yielding about 1 million gold per hour, and an upcoming poison change is reducing this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898021150527559)
- **player trading options**: Outlands has no in-game player market; players trade through vendors, rented spots with hired NPCs, or a trade channel, and meet at Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503239842824363)
- **player vendor purchase delivery**: When buying from a player vendor, you can have the item sent to your bank or your bag, and buying to bank carries a markup, while Prevalia Merchant items always go to the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522291069268656128)
- **player vendors and early income**: Major trade in Outlands goes through player vendors, and selling farming loot there is a useful way to generate early income. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867316821332104)
- **poison potion vendor sales**: NPC vendors do not buy or sell regular poison potions; they are player-made and can only be sold to other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549873848084860972)
- **polar lantern availability**: Polar lanterns were a limited-time dungeon drop that only dropped in the hue of the corresponding dungeon, so a specific colour must be bought from a player who owns it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527993956682432663)
- **portal vendor search for codex**: The Outlands portal vendor search lists the codex of macing as "a blessed codex of macing" and auto-completes, so typing "codex mace" brings it up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529270192197206178)
- **portal vendor search range filter**: The range filter on the Outlands portal vendor search persists across new searches and can hide results, so it should be checked or reset when results seem missing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530953903586279615)
- **prevalia vendor clothing blessing**: Clothing bought from the Prevalia vendor is not blessed, and a bless deed is needed to bless it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525309925331566744)
- **price checking a large dragonship**: To price check a large dragonship, screenshot the ship's stats pages and post them in the community channel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548867759767818321)
- **raw rib value**: A raw rib is worth about 2 gold, and large quantities can be sold in bulk to players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556013351971197040)
- **redline point certificate cost**: Each Redline point requires its own certificate, costing 1.25 million gold per point. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541095893908987995)
- **refreshing a vendor**: To refresh a vendor's inventory display, close the bag and open the vendor again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523017376591909018)
- **renting a player vendor**: To place a vendor, visit a vendor house (a guild house or an advertised one), double click the rental contract or locked-down scroll there to see the weekly rent and rent it, then stock the vendor with items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541099958839808070)
- **runebook trading**: The new player runebook is tradable between characters, and empty non-blessed runebooks can be bought from players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538001897003421829)
- **sanctuary dungeon farming**: Farming the Sanctuary dungeon is a way for players who cannot afford more gear to earn money. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522648040253423670)
- **sanctuary dungeon gold income**: Sanctuary dungeons such as Prevalia Sewers drop low gold, making them a slow way to earn gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549247370942742649)
- **scavenger looting gray corpses**: Scavengers loot and skin gray corpses left by other players for leather, hides, and other leftovers, though gold is often heavier than it is worth. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526042236406730923)
- **secure player trading**: To trade securely, click the other player to open the trade window instead of dropping items on the floor, and verify everything is correct before accepting, which also reduces misclick risk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526672710233489569)
- **selling commodities**: If you sell more than the occasional commodity deed, rent a player vendor; you can also post commodities in the trade channel or DM players looking for boards. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540110601877983273)
- **selling goods without a vendor**: Players without a vendor can sell goods through the Discord sell channels, where bulk goods work best and you must be verified to post. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540021364918845491)
- **selling items without a house**: Without a house or vendor, look up item prices on the portal, post a listing in the buy/sell trading channel, then meet the buyer at the shelter to trade; alternatively rent a vendor in game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538835773460185088)
- **selling loot to players**: To sell loot to players, place items on a rented player vendor, advertise in the Discord market/sell channels, or PM players directly (who usually lowball). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549828696167419965)
- **selling prevalia coins**: To sell Prevalia coins, message buyers from the trade channel or post in the selling channel so interested buyers reach out, then meet on Shelter Island to complete the trade. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535022146781184090)
- **selling rare leather**: Rare leather sells best when it matches materials used by current society jobs, and it tends to sell at the weekly society reset when society crafters buy it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525157263898050594)
- **selling stacks at per-item price**: To sell a stack of 3 commodities at 135k each, use sell by stack price: enter 405k in the top square and 135k in the bottom square, since a flat price would sell the whole stack of 3 for 135k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530901312781287445)
- **sending vendor purchases to bank**: When buying from a vendor, especially in a risky area, send the purchase directly to your bank so it cannot be stolen or looted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534309354298413216)
- **ship exchange refund**: Crafted ships can be exchanged for half of their materials with the Prevalia Exchange officer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550981771401629822)
- **skill mastery orb sources**: Skill mastery orbs can drop as monster loot, including from corpses of monsters killed by NPCs, or be bought from players and player vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554971609708896328)
- **skinning leather and ribs uses**: Leather from skinning is used in leather armor crafting and is bought by players, while raw ribs can be cooked, sold to a meat vendor, or sold to players who use them to level cooking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541969675762802688)
- **smuggler npcs**: Smugglers are resource NPCs who sell reagents and other commodity items in bulk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554556924765274113)
- **smuggler reagent vendors**: Smugglers are NPCs that never run out of reagent stock, though they are slightly more expensive than normal NPC vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530564923938181120)
- **societies crafter profit**: Societies crafters profit by selling society points as gold reforges, strongbox deeds or gold links (gold links usually most profitable) rather than the crafted output; with 15 points and all skills at 120, ignoring exceptional town and artisan or links, profit is about 548k after costs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532066154162421812)
- **society job rewards**: Society jobs pay off over time with valuable rewards such as links, strong boxes and gold reforging tools. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535749331674472598)
- **society reward tradeability**: Items obtained as society rewards can be traded between characters, including across accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529592379768836229)
- **source of fancy clothing and cosmetics**: Most fancy clothing and cosmetic items are not craftable and usually come from the event Prevalia merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315418773983333)
- **special rare loot links on treasure maps**: There is no cap on rare/special loot links beyond the theoretical limit of how many can be equipped, and 25 gold special rares plus fortune can be used on treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540846926986219614)
- **stable npc deed cost**: A stable NPC deed costs 2.5m gold from the Prev Merchant (deeds, page 2). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525648502158266529)
- **strongbox deed acquisition**: The Strongbox deed is purchased with 500 society points, or can be bought from other players who spent the points and are reselling the deed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542567912613609512)
- **strongbox echo cost**: The strongbox echo costs about 2.5 million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540828619260039289)
- **strongbox for dungeon gold farming**: Strongbox upgrades or the strongbox enchantment are recommended for dungeon gold farming, because gold weight otherwise forces you to leave the dungeon after about 10 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213891156476067)
- **strongbox gold carrying capacity**: Strongboxes let a character carry more gold, with having both strongboxes allowing twice as much, and they are considered a good investment that pays for itself quickly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525263842949464170)
- **survival gears and research material prices**: Survival gears drop at a rate much higher than the number of pits players will run, and research material and survival gear prices on the Portal have been declining since the patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537107796061982810)
- **t8 treasure map run rate**: Before the patch, a skilled T8 treasure map runner could complete about 10-12 T8 maps per hour depending on location, while Witcher reportedly ran about 50-60 per hour. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537105037807849584)
- **top gold earner and treasure mapping**: The top gold earner on the server leaderboard is a treasure mapper, who also ranks third in treasure map levels. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548050005301010523)
- **trapped chests bought from vendors**: A trapped chest bought from a vendor is typically still trapped, and there is no guarantee it comes with a key. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544035703875178546)
- **trapped pouch prices**: Pre-trapped pouches cost 25 gold from a Provisioner NPC, while a smuggler NPC asks about 5K gold for a trapped pouch commodity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523630877391720499)
- **treasure map income via cartography**: Cartography lets players run treasure maps, and with 85 Cartography, level 1 treasure maps are a cheap-to-build-up way to earn loot and gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548271988244615240)
- **treasure map loot prices**: Prices of special loot from treasure maps have dropped, and much of the loot is worth significantly less than before the recent update. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543757093952032778)
- **treasure map tiers**: Lower-tier treasure maps are the ones most commonly run: T2 maps are common, cheap and give a good yield, T1 maps are rarely run on their own, and tier 5 and 6 maps are rare. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538977183953985669)
- **unbless deed vendor**: Unbless Deeds are sold cheaply by the vendor in Prevalia. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522169845570076792)
- **vanquishing weapon prices**: Most vanquishing grind weapons cost around 10k gold, while an accurate vanquishing weapon can cost around 28k. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537851255089659915)
- **vendor listing sync to portal**: Player vendor listings are automatically synced to the Outlands portal website, which periodically reads in new data so listings can lag or change. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545128111887360131)
- **vendor purchase delivery**: When buying from a vendor, send the purchase to your bank and then run fast to your inn room to avoid theft. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547174964895944815)
- **vendor purchase gump shortcuts**: Enlarge the vendor buy gump by dragging the small blue gem at its bottom; Shift+double-clicking an item moves the vendor's entire remaining stock to the purchase side, and holding the + next to an item adds quantity faster than repeated clicks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544165576190992414)
- **vendor rent income**: Vendor rents earn little gold compared to farming, unless you own a large mall. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542123931354529882)
- **vendor send to bank fee**: Vendors offer a 'send to bank' purchase option. The fee is roughly 2% of the item cost and is capped at 25k gold, so expensive items cost 25k to send. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553037411775414303)
- **vendor spot rentals**: Several malls let players rent a vendor spot, and gate spam bots near the Shelter Island moongate and the Prev bank often advertise rental offers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551991037977952368)
- **veterinary bandages**: Veterinary bandages are player-made and not sold by the stable vendor; they can be found through the player vendor search portal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526586784689950834)
- **veterinary supplies source**: Veterinary supplies are sold by player-run vendors, which can be found through the portal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542345801685008484)
- **witcher rune number in vendor names**: A 'Witcher [number]' or 'W [number]' (e.g. W123) in a player vendor's shop name or description is the Witcher rune teleport number used to reach that vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525684881055547473)
- **wood commodity deed price**: Wood can be sold to other players as commodity deeds, with a 5000-wood board deed selling for roughly 130k gold, though the price may have shifted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536289670835601499)
- **accidentally selling valuable items to npcs**: The chance of accidentally selling an item worth 10K or more to an NPC vendor is very slim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528105722250788966)
- **account-wide currencies**: Currencies are shared across the whole account rather than tracked per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523835905939476530)
- **achievement points trading**: Achievement points cannot be traded; they can only be spent on items such as emote deeds or mount tokens, which can then be sold for gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532264773964664843)
- **adventure time guild hall vendor spaces**: The Adventure Time Guild Hall and Rune Library sometimes has free vendor spaces (e.g. 4 weeks free rent) that must be kept stocked, and it can be found via the Outlands Vendor Search Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524017972807729314)
- **afk fishing fish steak yield**: AFK fishing only occasionally generates regular fish steaks, which are useful for training cooking but are worth less than 1gp each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530653005488197844)
- **air aspect core price**: Air aspect cores cost about 10k each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529878927999242260)
- **ak3 loot value versus raw ribs**: Running through AK3 to pick up gold and leather for about 3 minutes yields roughly the value of 5000 raw ribs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556013719417266321)
- **animal broker horse listings**: At the Animal Broker (Angeline in Prevalia), tick the filter by name option and type horse to list horses that players are selling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537773689158897764)
- **animal taming mastery scroll price**: Animal Taming skill mastery scrolls sell on the vendor portal for roughly 7k to 40k, and prices above about 10k are considered too high. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541379249011687435)
- **antiquity large plough price**: The antiquity large plough sold for about 20k gold on the player market after the listing price was lowered by 10k each day, though one copy reportedly once sold for 100k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549952922903773327)
- **appearance ingredient sales**: Appearance ingredients sell very quickly on a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546790266223198209)
- **arcane aspect cost and codex**: Arcane Aspect is not cheap and also requires an Arcane Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549647370197794878)
- **arcane crystal price**: Arcane crystals are very cheap to obtain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531334290900652205)
- **arcane essence for aspect mastery**: Arcane essence fuels Aspect Mastery and can be bought on the vendor portal in commodity or individual form. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528855060283527238)
- **arcane mage as new player money maker**: Arcane mage is not a good money maker for a new player; mining, lumberjacking, or a Paladin or Bard are suggested as temporary money makers instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549589277409677404)
- **arcane mage wilderness looting income**: Roughly 250k gold per hour from wilderness looting is considered standard for an arcane mage with a 30 link floor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531357407840698500)
- **arcane scroll exchange**: 25 arcane scrolls can be exchanged for either a full spellbook or a codex with 1 Mastercrafting Diagram. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533001999136591913)
- **archer and mage upkeep costs**: Archers and mages have ongoing upkeep costs, namely ammunition for archers and reagents for mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526149961442398239)
- **armor and weapon market conditions**: Buying the big 3 colors cheaply and selling armor or weapons may be acceptable, but the market for nearly everything is currently a race to the bottom on price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531389603330654208)
- **armor color customization**: Players typically wear cloths to get the armor color they want, while in-game customizations costing millions per armor piece let you choose the color from your available aspects via the manage hues menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523276730171789332)
- **arrow and bolt vendor price**: A stack of 1000 arrows or bolts costs 2000 gold from a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526227833259561031)
- **arrow sources**: Arrows can be bought in other towns or from Smugglers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538063448548573224)
- **arrow vendors bowyer and carpenter**: Bowyer or Carpenter NPCs sell arrows, but their stock can be bought out and takes roughly 10-30 minutes to restock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552076109699350559)
- **artisan aspect value for society crafters**: Artisan Aspect on society crafters does not pay for itself: the difference between T15 Artisan and no artisan, with no exceptional town, is only about 5k gold profit per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532063764524961994)
- **aspect crystal cost versus arcane core price**: Aspect crystals are expensive to use when the arcane core price is high, and when cores are cheap you can use crystals all day while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536211068307771432)
- **aspect distillations purchase**: Aspect Distillations can be bought from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540041504494723132)
- **aspect investment for leather**: Investing in an aspect on a random character just to gather leather is a waste, since buying leather is cheaper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535771097415295027)
- **aspect kit price**: Aspect Kits can be bought from other players for about 10K gold each and can be searched on the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537250665989148684)
- **aspect mount prices**: Aspect mounts sold for roughly 2-3 million gold each when the author was breeding them; the current market price is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533878590846927028)
- **aspect quest cost**: The aspect quest costs 50k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548767743917170830)
- **auction house**: There is no auction house in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525401032635453470)
- **automated lockpicking services**: Some malls offer automated lockpicking services for opening chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534750482608816320)
- **avarite valorite verite map prices**: Avarite, valorite and verite maps are expected to stay at the same price after the map changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529894724083646464)
- **avoiding buy-to-bank markup with hiding mule**: To avoid the buy-to-bank markup, use a mule character that can hide: run to the shop and hide immediately, make the purchase, run two screens away, then recall out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521719506232152075)
- **avoiding theft while vendor shopping by hiding or running**: To avoid being stolen from while vendor shopping, hide next to a house before pressing buy and then trap the pouch holding the purchased item, or press buy while running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542688893428830228)
- **avoiding thieves when buying**: To avoid thieves when buying from vendors, cast Reveal, keep moving, and keep a recall macro ready so you can leave instantly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521716282356007033)
- **bank check double-click behavior**: Double-clicking a check in your bank box converts it to gold in the bank box, so the account balance stays the same. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413350279123024)
- **bank check usage**: A bank check can be left in the bank and does not need to be used or withdrawn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543646807186477066)
- **bank checks and theft**: Bank checks are blessed and cannot be stolen by thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544036923306156142)
- **bank checks and vendors**: Bank checks do not need to be converted to gold piles in your bank for vendors to draw funds; checks work as they are. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525526655936888974)
- **bank delivery cost for purchases**: Sending purchased items to the bank costs barely any extra now. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547521266540347433)
- **bank gold capacity**: When the bank stops accepting gold it is at capacity, and the gold should be condensed into a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553964942796001292)
- **bank gold capacity via checks**: To store more gold in the bank, convert bank gold into a check; a check likely has no upper limit and you can make multiple checks, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768154172657726)
- **bank gold transfer between accounts**: Bank gold transfer works only between characters on the same account; across accounts you can log in two characters at once and pass checks between them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538630224726728704)
- **bank safety against thieves**: Spend as little time at the bank as possible and, while there, stand next to multiple NPCs, which makes thieves less likely to target you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555624583569215509)
- **banker voice commands**: Say 'Balance' near a banker to open the balance gump, or say 'Check [amount]' near a banker to have a bank check created for that amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768362424303747)
- **bard tamer gear cost**: Bard tamer is a strong choice even with few links, has the lowest re-equip cost, and can use store-bought gear effectively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545526576358101065)
- **basic plate armor price**: Basic plate armor is cheap from an NPC vendor, with the chestpiece, the priciest piece, reportedly costing about 70 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526221018178257179)
- **best arcane essence exchange return**: The best return for arcane essence at the exchange officer is distills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537783701478580295)
- **best farming methods after patch**: After the patch, treasure mapping and boating are regarded as the best farming methods, with dungeon chest picking also possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537151860211847178)
- **black cloth value**: Any black cloth is valuable, and players typically want to use a bless deed on items made with it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521509754927710319)
- **black goods batch turn-ins**: Turning in Black Goods in batches is a more time-efficient approach than turning them in one at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523681893940203520)
- **black goods high-bonus rewards**: At least one player who turns in Black Goods above a 40% bonus has received thief items such as dyes and lanterns but no antiquities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523683111924273152)
- **black goods turn-in rewards**: The black goods turn-in rewards are not super loot, so there is no urgency to turn them in immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528292228374466680)
- **black goods weekly scarcity**: When players exchange Black Goods of a given Rarity Level, that rarity's Weekly Scarcity affects both the gold received and the chance of receiving a Special, Rare or Unique item instead of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523681979457863901)
- **blackgoods income**: Players report that blackgoods can be a lucrative money source, yielding roughly 2-5 per 10 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554842211156496417)
- **blacksmithing and carpentry profit timeline**: Blacksmithing and carpentry take years to turn a profit, according to one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531388994322174145)
- **blank map demand**: Blank maps are in high demand because players are raising cartography for treasure mapper characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537096976405897236)
- **blessed item decay and broker fee**: Blessed items can decay too, and the Broker fee to recover one is still 40k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536471949872464082)
- **blessed spellbook prices**: Basic blessed spellbooks are sold by NPC mages (possibly scribes) for about 100 gold or less, while the 64-spell blessed spellbook is sold by players for roughly 30k or more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528419970927558686)
- **blessing fancy clothes**: Blessing fancy clothes is an end-game activity because the bless deeds required are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855945776332823)
- **blessing fancy dress**: A fancy dress is cheap to buy from an NPC, so using a bless deed on it is not worth the cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525075432297336903)
- **blessing wizard hat**: A clothing bless deed can be used to bless a wizard hat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534114353828073523)
- **board price**: The going rate for 5000 boards was about 120k gold as of late July 2026. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531163987159552030)
- **board versus kindling sale value**: Boards sell for more than kindling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763660015992913)
- **boards and ingots commodity value**: 5,000 boards or ingots can be turned into a commodity that sells for about 130-170k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532462736011694350)
- **boat sales**: Boats can sometimes be found on vendors, but their stats cannot be seen there, so most boat sales happen in a dedicated Discord room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526653673730605077)
- **boating cost and complexity**: Boating is expensive to get into and to maintain and is very complicated, so it is effectively a late-game activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526712698627424516)
- **bonded horse prices from script sellers**: Bonded horses sold by script-running players are aspect hue mounts and likely cost around 50k or more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533080656689627216)
- **breaking checks into 60k stacks**: Breaking a check automatically separates the gold into 60k stacks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553947422735204483)
- **broker fee for decayed runebooks**: A runebook is worth paying the Broker fee to recover after it decays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536471562411049014)
- **bronze and silver links society points**: Bronze and silver links should not be bought with society points because they are obtained from guild activity such as T8s and Omni Bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536733324477730926)
- **bronze follower damage links**: Bronze Follower Damage links are relatively cheap and are worth placing in free mastery chain slots if better links are unaffordable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526384777928642591)
- **bronze link exchange**: To exchange bronze links, put them in your bank and visit the merchant just west of the casino. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525350297109663764)
- **bronze link exchange to silver**: Bronze links can reportedly be exchanged up to silver links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525348263358763039)
- **bulk arrow purchases from player vendors**: Arrows can be bought as commodities from player vendors in lots of 5000, and they take little space until used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532855331099771121)
- **bulk buying of popular items for resale**: Players buy popular items in bulk to resell later at higher prices, and these items are often unblessed because the buyers do not wear them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527316558634946711)
- **buy to bank tax**: Buying to bank from a player vendor carries a 2% tax, capped at a maximum of 25k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522291123958190184)
- **buying a full spellbook**: It is generally better, easier and likely cheaper to buy a full 64-spell spellbook than to assemble one from individual scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542268401618128966)
- **buying cloth cheaply**: To buy lots of cloth cheaply, buy bolts from tailor NPCs and cut each once with scissors to turn it into cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538960857629982882)
- **buying echoes to save gold**: Buying echoes saves gold overall, because relevelling an aspect or expensive skill on a different character is the biggest waste of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527291601796333608)
- **buying from a player vendor**: To buy from a vendor, click the item and select Buy, choose a quantity if it is a stack, then either place it in your backpack or pay about 5% extra (unconfirmed) to have it sent safely to your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532762284953440379)
- **buying from player vendors**: To buy from a player vendor, double click the vendor's name to open their bag, left click the item, select buy, and send it to your bank box; you do not need to enter the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532670197381726218)
- **buying inside a house**: When buying inside a house, recall away as soon as you buy the item to your backpack, because only players added to the house can hide inside it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521716549226991716)
- **buying master crafted gear via portal vendor search**: To buy master crafted weapons and armor consistently, use the Outlands Portal vendor search and search for 'armor crate'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538464845647712257)
- **buying nightshade commodities from player vendors**: To buy nightshade commodities from player vendors, search the portal for "night comm". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552343322255958141)
- **buying prevalia coins with real money**: Prevalia coins can be bought with real money through the Outlands donate page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531087898433028197)
- **caddelite decoration sale value**: Caddelite decoration sells for 2 million gold or more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533929196454281296)
- **cancelling a player vendor**: Type [vendors to cancel a player vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546877641758482453)
- **caravan cost versus inn room rent**: A 3m gold caravan costs the equivalent of about 5.7 years of rent in the Large Inn Room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526976228148510811)
- **carpet dye cost**: A single carpet dye costs roughly 60k gold worth of infinity coins at current prices, and infinity coins are currently cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200961785434163)
- **casino game payout chart**: The chart on the left of the casino game shows the payout for matching 3 of a specific icon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541461472398548992)
- **casino slot machine cost**: Slot machines in the casino cost 250 gold per roll, and poker tables have higher limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537541820886683871)
- **cav farming with double demon summoner**: In Cav, almost every mob has about 25 magic resist and dies quickly to a double demon summoner, yielding roughly 300k gold per hour and filling up in one loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529141606714839080)
- **cav random mob value**: Random mobs in the middle of Cav are each worth about 700-1000 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529141966325940505)
- **chain cooldown reduction**: Endgame players can pay to reduce the chain cooldown to 15 minutes, reportedly costing about 10-15 million gold, though the price is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548552230649467001)
- **chat spam scripts**: Using a script to spam messages in local chat reportedly does not break Outlands rules, and players run such trade scripts around the clock in Shelter and Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536671038539038790)
- **cheap potions from alchemists and healers**: Alchemists and healers sell cheap potions that can be used for extra healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524989919737548872)
- **cheapest repair kit type**: Tailoring repair kits are the cheapest type of repair kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991960421572609)
- **checking doubloon balance**: To check your doubloon balance, say "balance" while at the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548871299625918528)
- **checking total gold earned**: Type [achievements in game, open the Luxury category, and check the Affluent achievement to see total gold earned; if you have only farmed the new player dungeon, this reflects your gains there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531014282970529893)
- **cheesy scavenger gold method**: To make gold as a 'Cheesy Scavenger', create a fresh character with Hiding and Stealth (Camping helps), go to the lowest level of the current XP dungeon, and collect the gold there, since other players do not pick it up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521201916900671510)
- **chest picking and gold nerf**: Picking chests is not affected by the gold nerf and is a decent income source if you enjoy the gameplay loop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536755282615468192)
- **chromatic core loot table addition**: Chromatic cores were added to the loot table in April 2024. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537987900027830422)
- **chromatic core price**: Chromatic cores were selling for about 30k gold in early September 2026, though prices have been falling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545974368641884241)
- **chromatic prices**: Chromatics are currently cheap on the market. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520926542220496936)
- **clothing alteration kit availability**: Players sell clothing alteration kits on their vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543256546597671052)
- **codex and aspect material sources**: Codices are crafted by players, while aspect materials are rare monster drops that players sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529949088907395272)
- **codex of macing cost**: A codex of macing costs roughly 40k-50k gold, which is cheap enough that cost is not a big concern once a player is established. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529262393626988615)
- **codex of wrestling portal price**: A codex of wrestling was listed on the Outlands portal for 40k at the time of the claim (June 2026). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521093533203828736)
- **codices requirement**: Codices are required in current Outlands and are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543671159948841051)
- **colored ingot supply**: Most colored ingots in the Outlands economy come from the drop rate of resource maps, so the economic impact is the same whether one player or many complete the maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529590196096602355)
- **colored leather pricing**: The price of colored leather fluctuates based on which society jobs are paying well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532429778789990400)
- **colored ore commodity deed size**: Colored ore only requires 2500 to fill a commodity deed, and most colors sell in less than a full deed amount since buyers usually want only enough to finish their weekly society needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544715174341116056)
- **colored scroll drops**: Colored scrolls dropped by enemies are worth collecting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554577892451688449)
- **colored torch sources**: Colored torches come from various events or sometimes from the prev shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527707040258981948)
- **commodity deed capacity**: A full commodity deed of base resources holds 5k, which is the typical amount to collect before selling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537895199341289562)
- **commodity deed theft risk**: Commodity deeds are not blessed and can be stolen, so trades involving them should be done on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544714461326348399)
- **commodity prices at player vendors**: Some commodities are cheaper from player vendors than from NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540415664047661067)
- **commodity purchase quantity for logs and ingots**: Players generally buy logs and ingots in lots of 5000, which is called a commodity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554353639282180218)
- **commodity system and basic resource value**: The commodity system keeps basic resources such as regular iron and lumber valuable in the player economy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527783649657884713)
- **converting obsolete items**: To check whether an old, possibly obsolete item can be converted into the new type, bring it to the exchange officer located west of the Prev casino. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520468246925672528)
- **cook vendor rib baskets**: The cook vendor buys rib baskets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522934823507722250)
- **copper vs shadow platemail crate prices**: Copper platemail armor crates are currently cheaper than shadow platemail armor crates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543190973947838505)
- **core price drop cause**: Core prices dropped mainly because of increased supply, since there are more players than ever and farming is relatively easy, rather than because of lower demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546000816765403136)
- **core price trend**: Core prices have been declining for a while, attributed to patches delivering mostly nerfs and few buffs or reworks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538950533782437979)
- **core prices**: Core prices have dropped substantially, with chromatic cores having been listed for around 35 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679323833434212)
- **corpse eater taming value**: Corpse Eaters on level 2 of the dungeon are in demand for taming; Lore them to check stats, and one with 4+ attack speed, 8+ damage and wrestling can sell for a good amount of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545087572240498718)
- **cosmetic item pricing**: Cosmetic items are priced very high because they are aimed at end game players and act as a gold drain on the economy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540947168549019648)
- **cosmetic piece pricing**: Cheaper cloth colours can look good, but desirable older limited-release cosmetic pieces can be very expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526322041681219716)
- **cosmetic quivers**: Cosmetic quivers may be available from the Prevalia Merchant and are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554328553821044767)
- **cost of buying wood**: Buying wood for crafting is expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538722772077912064)
- **cost of pvm and pvp boats**: Building a PvM or PvP boat costs a lot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521725389444223018)
- **crafted crooks and instruments**: It is typically easier to buy crafted crooks and instruments in bulk than to use magic ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542349248148930700)
- **crafter income via societies**: Selling crafted goods will not recoup the crafting skill investment for a very long time; societies are how crafters earn their money back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523735407278293175)
- **crafting profit market**: Crafted gear is very good and cheap in Outlands, but there is almost no market for profit from crafting and selling armor or weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550050210623787080)
- **crafting queue item cost**: The crafting queue item is costly, roughly 300K to 500K gold, and is not aimed at new players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521122492255567952)
- **daily deals on small purchases**: Buying items a few at a time lets players pick up daily deals, which are usually about 10% below market price, instead of paying convenience pricing for bulk purchases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535860943626571879)
- **daily resource map creation rate**: About 350 maps of each resource map category are created every day on the server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528202664251228301)
- **damage resistance links value**: Damage resistance links are considered low value and sell at junk link prices on the portal, since a gold DR link gives only about 1.5% damage resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553145399353671865)
- **damage to poisoned creatures links vs poison damage links**: Players rarely prioritize Damage to Poisoned Creatures links over Poison Damage links because the difference in value between them is large. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524823999731728485)
- **deadly poison kegs**: Deadly poison may be easier to source by searching for kegs of it than by looking for individual potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522218654194729074)
