- **dedicated buyer character**: A second-account character with resist, hiding and parrying makes a good dedicated buyer that can always hide and has a better chance of surviving attacks by reds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584827876511745)
- **dedicated item identification character**: Building a dedicated item identification character is recommended because it saves money on container ID wands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528262439454642328)
- **deed gold value and priority**: The deed gives 2.5 million gold that can be used to buy an aspect, and the gold weight reduction is nice but not important early on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540086324768276642)
- **delectable food price**: Delectable Food rose to about 300 gold each during the season, though the price may have changed since. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533774639405334619)
- **demand for colored boards**: Colored boards have a similar demand problem to colored leather, but to a much lesser extent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525675714131529758)
- **demand for colored leather**: Demand for low and mid-end colored leather outside societies is insufficient, and societies do not consume nearly enough low-end colored leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525675714131529758)
- **depositing gold at the bank**: To deposit gold, open the bank box and drop the gold into it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529101516596576327)
- **destard gold farming during wilderness bonus**: Periods of a 20% wilderness gold bonus occur, and during them players commonly farm gold in Destard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536454135392772116)
- **direct player trading in shelter**: To trade with another player without a vendor, meet in Shelter; the buyer clicks on the seller to open a trade window and trades a check for the items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536002681661825105)
- **discipline aspect cost efficiency**: Discipline is said to perform at roughly 95% of Frost for about 20% of the cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537549708065509494)
- **discipline weapon gold income in kraul**: A player using a discipline weapon reports earning about 350k gold per hour in Kraul 2/3. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535405108920324156)
- **discord sell channel access**: To gain access to the sell channel in Discord, log into the Outlands Portal and link your Discord account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549412469695447192)
- **disguise kit sources**: Disguise kits can be bought from Thief NPCs or from player Tailors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522844554284236890)
- **distill prices**: Distills sell for only about 2-3k gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679243156258848)
- **doubloon discount on loadouts**: Buying loadouts with doubloons instead of gold gives roughly a 10-15% discount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547464283875577916)
- **doubloon exchange rate**: Doubloons can be obtained at roughly 0.85 gp each, though the rate may fluctuate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524832212741132499)
- **doubloon purchases from prevalia merchant**: Doubloons can be used to buy most of the items that the Prevalia Merchant (Jakes) sells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541048164889526312)
- **doubloon use for customizations**: Doubloons are ocean currency but can also be used to pay for customizations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524832559282782300)
- **dull copper weapon pricing**: Dull copper is cheaper than iron, so vendors selling cheap weapons mostly stock dull copper as their lowest tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522271713658929244)
- **dullhide leather map price**: Dullhide leather maps were reportedly purchasable for about 10 gold each, though the price may have changed since the speaker last checked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529873937763270868)
- **dullhide value per weight**: Dullhide is not as valuable per unit of weight as gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551830445573021757)
- **dungeon antiquity value**: A dungeon antiquity is worth more unregistered than registered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538707313895153734)
- **dungeon chest loot value**: Dungeon chest loot is currently low in value, with the best outcome roughly a double proc on research materials, whereas a month earlier a 100k chest with a double command proc was possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545810326904115381)
- **dungeon farming loadout cost and returns**: A typical dungeon farming loadout is worth about 15k-20k gold and is lost roughly once every 8-10 runs, while each run yields about 20k-40k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552720517155262627)
- **dungeon gold looting limit**: Players must leave the dungeon roughly every 5 minutes or they stop receiving gold loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549475576396652645)
- **dungeon income**: Dungeons are a source of quick money, though the start of the server is somewhat difficult. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548556315637457017)
- **dungeon income compared to newbie island**: A regular (non-starter) dungeon yields more money than the newbie island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529179691259400292)
- **dungeon level 3 unlooted mobs**: On level 3 of a busy dungeon many mobs are left unlooted, so a stealth scavenger can pick up roughly 3000 gold per mob, and skinning can yield around 200 avarhide. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541855292852019290)
- **dungeon redline farmer routine**: Dungeon redline farmers do not make bank trips and just grind. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524141003710402720)
- **dungeon slayer items**: Dungeon slayer items such as cloth, lanterns and dyes share the hue of that dungeon's drops and are mostly wanted as deco rares. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546259403072872488)
- **duo-boxing treasure maps**: Since the harvest change, duo-boxing treasure maps is beneficial because the second character can skip the 60 second timeout and start digging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525571123373146272)
- **dye and cloth value lookup**: The value of dyes and cloths can be looked up on the portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537811886416863313)
- **early gold in shelter dungeon**: About 5,000 gold can be earned quickly in the Shelter dungeon, enough to cover a week of the cheapest inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546240625236775123)
- **early income timeline**: A new player can expect about 10 hours from start to selling a first commodity of ingots or boards for roughly 150K, after which income is about 75k per hour and rising. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533047827830280252)
- **early money maker expectation**: Players are expected to run a money maker for a while before moving into the more expensive professions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524202014232281250)
- **early money-making options**: Early money-making options in Outlands include Lumberjack/Miner templates, Paladin+Bard, joining a guild, and doing Society Jobs, which bring in good gold after a few months. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528697042116022313)
- **echo cooldown reduction cost**: The 1-hour echo cooldown reduction costs 5 million, which can be paid in doubloons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524832138632106124)
- **echo cost scaling across currencies**: When the cost of an echo increases, all currency types increase, regardless of which payment method is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539744324680417372)
- **echo purchase cost**: Echoes are purchased once with no ongoing fee after buying one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526124820180500621)
- **echo purchase methods**: An echo can be bought with scrolls and essence rather than only gold, and deals can be found on the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540568925304127568)
- **echo unlock costs**: Doubloons are almost always cheaper than gold for unlocking Echoes, skill scrolls are an alternative when doubloons are not cheaper, and gold should be avoided. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532728586526527659)
- **elemental summon scroll source**: Elemental summon scrolls are made by player Scribes rather than sold in the Prevalia shop, though this is not firmly confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524158488836833382)
- **empty bottle purchase**: Empty bottles can be bought from a smuggler either individually or as a commodity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540397667719446608)
- **event dungeon gold income**: Event dungeon gold and loot income is roughly comparable to several floor 3 core dungeons, but the event is not a good gold source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526261510479937586)
- **event scratch card vendor**: The scratch cards for the event are sold by the merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525234193255366776)
- **exceedingly and supremely instrument modifiers**: On instruments, Exceedingly gives +20 and Supremely gives +25 (likely Enhanced Bard Skill), and both are considered decent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531285613373030550)
- **exceptional shadow iron plate cost**: An exceptional set of shadow iron plate costs only a few thousand gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542998075381911572)
- **extra aspect hue cost**: Extra aspect hues are bought in the customization menu under help for millions of gold, reportedly about 31 million including the spellbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549975996810268723)
- **faction mount gear purchase**: Faction mount gear is bought with faction silver, the same currency that buys gold codex, on test center. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535128913666248735)
- **faction silver and society point prices**: Faction silver is advertised at roughly 55-65 gold per silver, and Society points go for around 5k gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528407051158552596)
- **fashion items and bless deeds**: Fashion items other than basic clothes and dye tub colours are generally the kind of items that players use a bless deed on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521510555045593231)
- **fastest way to get a gold link**: Buying a gold link outright from a vendor is the fastest way to get one and is better than taking a negative-profit society job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535679070493343825)
- **finding armor on the vendor portal**: To find armor on the vendor portal, search for 'armor crate' and optionally add a material name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522272113749266627)
- **finding item id wands for sale**: To find an Item ID wand for sale, use the vendor search in the top bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546920166418415636)
- **finding mage armor with vendor search**: To find mage armor with the vendor search tool, search for 'armor crate leather'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533647441746722958)
- **finding summoner codexes for sale**: Summoner codexes for sale can be located using the vendor search on the Outlands portal at portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522620326016585868)
- **fire aspect distillations availability**: Fire Aspect Distillations are available on player vendors in decent quantity and can be found via the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547229220747354142)
- **first commodity deed**: A player can obtain a first commodity deed by gathering at least 5k of a resource on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549605130477903913)
- **fish as byproduct**: Fish caught in Outlands are effectively a byproduct that sits around unsold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527123817762127913)
- **fish filet vendor price**: Fish filets sell to vendors for 100 gold each, which adds up when boating a lot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555371515250343988)
- **fishing boat and crew cost**: A fishing boat and crew can be obtained for about 50k gold in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394041232171169)
- **fishing income source**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, the money in fishing comes from the special fishing nets obtained while fishing, not from the fish themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527124010142404618)
- **fishing net profitability requirements**: A fisher needs around 120 skill plus boat modifiers, a solid crew and upgrades to pull more value from nets than they sell for. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541276703999922196)
- **fishing net sale price**: Fishing nets can be stacked and sold in batches of 100 or more to players, for about 9,000-9,500 each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549690701808148510)
- **forensics leather to mcd**: With Forensics, a mage can skip gold and turn each 5k of leather into a mobile commodity deed (MCD), which is roughly equal in value and weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524834643197558796)
- **fortune gold value in pit trials**: Using Fortune in pit trials yields only about 80k worth of gold value, roughly one third the value of the current survival gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520934895218589799)
- **frost build cost**: A frost build is expensive, requiring 20 skill orbs plus 20 arms lore and chivalry skill scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529268973709820076)
- **full spellbook cost**: The cost of a full spellbook is mostly the 7th and 8th circle spells, which are player-made and each requires 1-2 arcane scrolls to craft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527405472733204521)
- **full spellbook player vendors**: Full 64-spell exceptional blessed spellbooks can be bought from player vendors found via the portal vendor search; Anchor's Rest has an easy-to-find vendor selling one for 35k, and the Cambria vendor sells one for 39,900. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553619485749940264)
- **funding echoes**: Echoes should be funded with hoarded cheaper resources rather than purchased with gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539023856252231760)
- **funding inn rent**: Inn room rent can be funded by running dungeons and scavenging gold left behind by other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521628642629910849)
- **gadget core price**: The gadget core's cheapest market price fell from about 4500-5000 to about 1500. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520927574593896579)
- **gathering income for new players**: A new player needs about 10 hours to train mining or lumberjacking to 100 and earn a first batch of roughly 5K ingots worth about 150K; after that, income is about 75K per hour without an aspect, making gathering likely more lucrative than wilderness farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602714214862909)
- **gathering versus crafting profitability**: Gathering wood and ore is very profitable, while crafting is not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525472363129602118)
- **gem buyer shop sign**: The shop that buys gems is identifiable by a sign with a green gem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533001547884138697)
- **gem selling location**: Gems can be sold to a Jeweler NPC, with one located against the west Prevalia wall, a bit southwest of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553474213065531634)
- **gem weight value versus gold**: One stone of weight of gems is worth more than one stone of weight of gold, which is 100 gold with Strongbox 1 and 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545509375228121230)
- **getting scrolls to shelter island characters**: To get scrolls to a character in Shelter Island, use a mule character outside to buy them, give them to the mule, then transfer them to the character that needs them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554333194843594793)
- **glowing barrels availability**: Glowing barrels are now only available from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524531868941291733)
- **gold decay**: Gold decay makes it hard for a player to restart and get going again on the server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545813320399847576)
- **gold decay drop sizes**: With gold decay, gold stacks dropped by creatures are smaller (roughly 500-3k instead of 1k-6k), so filling a backpack with gold takes longer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536794044741459991)
- **gold drop rate outside sanctuaries**: Outside sanctuaries the gold drop rate is much higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529233709335580772)
- **gold earning alternatives**: Gatherers and scavengers are alternatives to progressing through PvM for earning gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522056063162257469)
- **gold earning rate on shelter island**: Roughly 12,500 gold can be earned in one to three hours in the dungeon on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548439111000526853)
- **gold farming pickup habits**: Most players take only the gold weight customizations, pick up gold until full, then pick up only rare loot items to sell until they finish farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522273677641781389)
- **gold harvest links leather yield**: Grabbing 10 gold harvest links does not significantly increase leather yield and is not a great investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **gold link loot bonus**: 22 gold links may give only about 2% better loot, though the actual value is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1526320274872598528)
- **gold needed on character**: The only time a player should need to carry gold on their character is to buy a skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543616559992537219)
- **gold per hour reducing factors**: Gold per hour drops when mobs are already dead or when travel time and bank trips are involved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524139327112745000)
- **gold sinks this year**: Gold sinks this year include a Winterhoof lottery, Terran and Cambrian unique house lotteries, increased redline point costs, a 25% increase in Prev merchant prices, and gold decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544154958377783416)
- **gold stack auto-stacking limit**: Dropping a gold stack onto another stack does not auto-stack up to 60k; the remainder is left aside and must be calculated manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553947134959812740)
- **gold stack limit**: A gold stack holds at most 60,000 gold; amounts beyond that need a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553946577645735937)
- **gold weight reduction deed upgrade**: The deed upgrade that makes gold weigh less requires 2 of the item, which can be bought with gold from a player or with society points or achievement points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540084861404971219)
- **gold weight value versus items**: Gold is worth less per unit of weight than many valuable items, such as instruments, which are worth far more than 50 gp per weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527762095112982589)
- **golems update gem demand**: The upcoming Golems update will use gem stones, and a gem price increase is expected once it arrives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524189517026693150)
- **good food source**: Good high-quality food in Outlands is made by players, while NPC bakers mostly sell flour and similar ingredients. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522763768998793327)
- **good magic weapon availability**: Good magic weapons are hard to find on the Outlands shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522779522423062708)
- **greater heal potion keg price**: A keg of greater heal potions costs about 2.5k gold and holds 100 potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531930097538437220)
- **greater slayer item strength**: Greater slayer items are generally considered weak currently, though some players may still keep them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524453758673883218)
- **ground gold**: Gold found on the ground is no longer a meaningful source of income on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537620494986121226)
- **ground gold decay**: Gold piles lying on the ground lose 10% of their gold every 60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540801080731107380)
- **ground gold decay floor**: Ground gold piles stop dwindling at about 9 gold, likely because 10% of 9 rounds down to less than 1 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540805816418832415)
- **guarding plate kits**: Guarding plate armor can be used as a kit to recover a corpse, and guarding plate kits sell for around 3 to 5k each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531288358599266305)
- **guild boss runs for money**: Doing boss runs with a guild is another way to make money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866966214312157)
- **guildhouse npc vendor contracts and guild discord sales**: A guildhouse may offer contracts for NPC vendors, and guilds with a Discord allow selling directly to guild members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549830785383661674)
- **hair dye value versus cloth**: Hair dye and similar dyes are worth more than the cloth colors that drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544562080252825682)
- **halloween 2024-2025 item price**: A never-returning item that was available during Halloween 2024 and 2025 now costs roughly 800k to 1M+ to obtain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528788345805733930)
- **harvest cores for levels beyond t10**: Going past Harvest level T10 requires harvest cores, which cost gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530950428278263990)
- **harvester aspect early level value**: A character who mines or lumberjacks and sells the materials can probably outpace the cost of Harvester cores for a while, so the first few Harvester Aspect levels may be worth it for sellers of mats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521684120139464825)
- **healer purchases from bank**: Basic healing supplies can be bought from the healer using bank funds, with no cash needed on your person. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523514092957077544)
- **high circle scroll availability in shelter island**: Seventh and eighth circle scrolls cannot be bought from NPCs in Shelter Island and must be purchased from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554332581091344507)
- **high end weapons market**: The high end weapons market has been stagnant for a few months. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548087861918699542)
- **high-value pets via animal lore**: Using Animal Lore to inspect creatures can reveal pets with 4+ attack speed and 8+ melee damage, which can likely sell for more than 50k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549714935267991553)
- **higher level chest loot**: Higher level chests contain armor, weapons, gems and valuable items that can be sold or used to improve a character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341381329789050)
- **highest-end gear sourcing**: The highest-end weapons and armor must be looted rather than crafted, and the highest-end magic weapons are very rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521490115715792967)
- **hired vendor accessibility**: Hired vendors are generally reachable by Witcher rune or regular teleporting, but vendors on an island without a Witcher rune are hard to reach. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530963128203088093)
- **house cost and pvm gold rate**: A house costs a few million gold, and a PvM player can reach about 200k gold per hour without great difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525959093213200424)
- **house deed versus placed house value**: House deeds are much cheaper than placed houses, and dungeon masters (DMs) and location are what increase a house's value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539265395825971341)
- **house lotteries as goldsinks**: House lotteries act as goldsinks for the rich rather than a means of wealth redistribution. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525959093213200424)
- **house prices**: In-game house prices match those quoted in Discord because the house market is entirely player-driven. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539592241759391784)
- **housing prices and population stability**: Server population and housing prices are fairly stable year-round, and housing prices are not expected to drop significantly until a new land mass is added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533894190646165737)
- **identification wand cost versus item id scrolls**: Identification wands may be cheaper than buying 20 Item ID skill mastery scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544511051087745115)
- **identification wand sell price accuracy**: The sell price shown by an identification wand is not the item's actual sell value; the Outlands portal shows a much higher price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532967454165172376)
- **identification wands for magical item recycler**: Container identification wands are likely better than item identification wands for filling the Magical Item recycler, since they probably add more charges at once for a better price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529330925739966574)
- **in-game gold per hour tracker**: An in-game tracker for gold per hour exists and can be used in the gold dungeon and the challenger to compare them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534585821934522490)
- **in-progress maps and player vendors**: Any map that was not in a tome before the August 11, 2026 patch counts as in progress and cannot be placed on a player vendor, which prevents selling partially harvested maps, but it can still be sold or handed to another player directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536815357594046495)
- **inn credit deed value**: An inn credit deed is likely worth about 10K, covering roughly a week of the smallest inn room, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539635450736677036)
- **inn room cost versus bank upgrade**: Renting an inn room is probably cheaper than buying the bank storage upgrade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092573290045523)
- **inn room rent payment**: Inn room rent drains slowly, and it can be paid from a second account's bank holding only enough gold to cover the desired weeks of rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550042306365628478)
- **invulnerable clothing from prevalia vendor**: Invulnerable clothing items such as headbands are sold by the Prevalia vendor and provide basic armor equal to a leather cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523284357157228756)
- **iron demand and dull copper surplus**: Players buy up iron for training purposes, while there is a large surplus of dull copper that people rarely use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522271795313512601)
- **iron ingot sale price**: Resource harvesting is lucrative, with 5000 iron ingots currently selling for about 145k-150k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537040803732660235)
- **iron sale price**: 5k iron reportedly sells for roughly 150k gold, though the figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521148154081181777)
- **item duplication**: There is no way to duplicate items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534242485201801399)
- **item identification build weapon needs**: Builds using Item Identification want vanquishing weapons, which are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548087321142763581)
- **item identification items lookup**: Item identification wands and container identification items can be found by searching 'item identification' in the portal vendor search at portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537803695406710845)
- **item identification scroll cost**: Item Identification scrolls are cheap, with 20 scrolls costing about 160k gold at most, and are considered junk scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530593117546221719)
- **item price lookup and harp prices**: Item prices can be checked on the Outlands vendor search portal, where harps sell for roughly 500 to 2000 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522440933621104783)
- **item pricing method**: A reasonable way to price items is a mix of median market price and how long the item has been listed; an item that is not selling may need a lower price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547576158223208468)
- **item sale value and top modifiers**: Significant gold from selling an item is only expected if the item has at least one or more of the top modifiers on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548444336096673845)
- **item turnover and economy**: Item turnover from players losing equipment helps prevent parts of the economy from stagnating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520479720725024849)
- **items worth keeping after identification**: Power and exceedingly accurate items are worth keeping after identification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528275057560780952)
- **king's faire ticket price**: King's Faire tickets reportedly cost about 2500 gold each, though the author is unsure of the exact price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540733503279202414)
- **kings faire event and prev coin prices**: Kings Faire is an annual in-game event; last year Prev Coins sold for about 19.5k each, and habits sold for 5-10 million at the end of the event before reaching a high of 120 million. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107136267096188)
- **kings faire gold sink**: Kings Faire is the biggest gold sink of the year and causes item prices to drop considerably that week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544158984284672116)
- **kraul cloth cosmetic colour**: Kraul cloth is a cheap cosmetic cloth colour, and the cloth piece itself rather than a dye is what is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529882736326606868)
- **lantern hue rules**: Most lanterns, including holiday dungeon drops and regular lanterns, have a fixed hue that cannot be changed; the skull lantern is the exception. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527994986933518446)
- **late-game economy income sources**: Late-game economy-focused players make money mainly through content that yields single sales of high-value items, such as flipping, treasure maps and factions, rather than hauling gold out of dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529282546968432680)
- **leather and magic item farming loop**: Bring 15k gold, deed leather, loot rares and magic items, break the magic items down into crystals until you have run out of 200-300 crystals, drop undeeded regular leather, refill on gold, then take the red gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531360072247017613)
- **leather armor modifier value**: Leather armor is worth little even with Fortification or Invulnerability modifiers and has only niche demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531285226033254400)
- **leather availability**: Leather is very cheap and effortless to obtain and sustain on this shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525677525487849562)
- **leather commodity deed price**: Regular leather commodity deeds sell for about 10k each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532429778789990400)
- **leather commodity size**: A leather commodity consists of 5,000 leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827176264638586)
- **leather value**: Most of the intrinsic value of leather is in rose hide or higher tiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541906800272740432)
- **leather versus gold value per weight**: Leather is worth more than gold per weight as long as the player can proc bronzehide or better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541911447855177769)
- **level 4 mob gold drops**: A single level 4 mob can drop roughly a week's worth of vendor rent in gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530903623540674675)
- **level 7 treasure map value**: A Level 7 treasure map is worth about 175k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538560613943484426)
- **link forging tool sales**: Link forging tools sell quickly if you watch the portal and price them strategically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528585759752327359)
- **link tier costs and strength**: Silver links are about 25% better than bronze and cost about 400k more, and gold links are about 25% better than silver and cost about 2.4 million more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552473977975480422)
- **loadout unlock cost**: The loadout unlock costs 4.5 million gold for 6 profiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539500452057190)
- **locked chest antiquities and rare dyes**: Chest antiquities are among the coolest finds in locked chests, and the most valuable find is a double proc on a rare lustrous or powder hair dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553261865188982786)
- **lockpick chest dye drops**: The most valuable drop from dungeon lockpick chests is probably a lustrous or powder dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544554338922405948)
- **lockpick chest shoes with rare cloth**: Shoes from lockpick chests can carry 6 of a rare cloth, which may make them a valuable drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544556564411588648)
- **logs and boards buyers**: Logs and boards are sold to other players rather than to NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537600020746866800)
- **looting blue corpses after gold decay patch**: Looting blue corpses is expected to remain effective for a beginner scavenger after the gold decay patch, though gold income will be slower. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530588225075282072)
- **lore page trading volume**: Lore page trading on the Portal dropped from many trades per day to a couple after the treasure map patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537108351014666480)
- **lottery ticket storage**: Purchased gold lottery tickets go into the player's bank and need to stay there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537971332380237954)
- **lower-level ingot prices**: Lower-level ingot prices have likely dropped since the resource map change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544096362755395585)
- **lumberjacking commodity income**: Lumberjacking and selling wood commodities yields about 120k gold for an hour or two of work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528584692134183104)
- **lumberjacking for gold**: Lumberjacking for 1-2 hours on another character is an easy way to earn gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532462322482675802)
- **lumberjacking income source**: Higher Lumberjacking skill does not directly mean more money; the profit is in selling normal colored boards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544398921101480029)
- **macing gold earning vs archery**: Switching from archery to macing can roughly double gold earned in the same amount of time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555024342101008405)
- **magic item acquisition**: Magic items are random drops from mobs, and players obtain useful ones by luck or by buying them from players who found them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528399860070486117)
- **magic item handling for pvm runs**: Magic items you can use should be kept to build spare sets in case you lose everything on a run, and items you cannot use should be recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522999007662702725)
- **magic item recycling value**: When recycling magic items, keep vanquishing, supremely accurate, and invulnerability items (possibly one level weaker if you plan to use them) and recycle the rest, since only those sell for much. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524453596622622821)
- **magic spellbook damage and vendor availability**: A magic spellbook may also increase spell damage, and Magic Spellbooks and crafting codexes can be found on player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549649089719963689)
- **magic trap casting cost**: Casting Magic Trap 100 times costs about 900 gold, since each cast uses 3 reagents at roughly 3 gp each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523631287112564836)
- **magic weapon vendors**: Weapons with magical modifiers are sold by player vendors rather than NPC vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549613152994467851)
- **map levels gold return**: Maps of level 1-3 yield slightly more gold than they cost, while level 4 and higher lose more gold as level rises, so higher maps are a gold-for-aspect-leveling trade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538903518583459851)
- **map tome price**: Map tomes can be bought with achievement points at roughly 10 prevailing coins each, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520925696036442254)
- **maps in pilfer and mugging loot**: Maps are in the loot pool as a potential drop from pilfering or mugging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550103253197398147)
- **material price spikes**: Prices of a material spike during weeks when that material has a highly profitable society job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548176792391778328)
- **meta pet farming value**: A current meta pet with extremely good stats can be worth millions of gold, and some players farm them to earn serious gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666249248284865)
- **miner gold income**: One player reports that a miner earned about 75k gold per hour last year; current rates may differ. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521215315587891431)
- **missing bank check after double-click**: If a bank check seems to vanish after double-clicking it and the balance does not change, re-open the bag or bank box to refresh the displayed contents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544414869175144498)
- **money-making characters**: Miner and lumberjack characters are good for making money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529809278964334692)
- **monster difficulty and rare drops**: Higher difficulty monsters have a higher chance of dropping rare or special loot, but even level 1 monsters can drop rare items such as powder iris shoes that sell for over 2 million gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530589821423325284)
- **monster gold scaling**: Gold earned from monsters scales with mob difficulty, so fight the hardest mobs you can handle without taking too long, about a minute or less per monster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549178908262400136)
- **monster hunter 25k task points**: The 25k monster hunter society tasks give about 3-4 points each, equal to 9-12 points per 75k and 18-24 points per 150k, making them the best tier per farm for points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531644829673455656)
- **monster hunter society point spending**: The best uses of monster hunter society points are gold reforges for quick cash, or strongbox deeds or gold links if you can wait for better value per point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588125880000515)
- **monster seller in stables**: Players can put tamed monsters up for sale at the monster seller in stables, and every town with a stable has one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541297364633915533)
- **monster-dropped gems uses**: Gems dropped by monsters can be sold to jewelers or players, and can be used to train Tinkering, which saves a lot of ingots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033101847040063)
- **most profitable crafting skills**: The most profitable crafting skill combinations are tailoring, inscription, alchemy and magery, while item identification, tinkering and carpentry can be added later, especially to support blacksmithing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535614526832254986)
- **mount token tradeability**: All mount tokens are believed to be tradeable, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547418171047149649)
- **multiboxing lumberjack income**: This season's best multiboxing lumberjack averages about 14 board commodities per day, which works out to less than 200k gold per hour of play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527348890591039488)
- **multiboxing treasure map digging**: Multiboxing treasure map digging was never removed on Outlands, but few players do it because it is not worth it; the most gold has historically come from running a single treasure mapper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525570714193756242)
- **new player dungeon gold tracker**: There is no standalone gold tracker for the new player dungeon, unlike most other regions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531014453221527603)
- **newbie dungeon lockpicking gold**: A character that picks locks in the newbie dungeon can earn serious gold for new players compared to fighting mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555982928788332548)
- **non-combat money making**: Players can make money without fighting mobs by working as a breeder (mounts), planter (plants), or crafter, or by lockpicking dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534335963285946569)
- **npc butcher sell batch size**: Selling to an NPC butcher sells 50 pieces per sell action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546343029126725652)
- **npc potion sales**: NPCs only sell lesser potions, while kegs of greater potions can be found for sale by players on the portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542064788882853898)
- **npc price for beginner dungeon ruin weapon**: An NPC vendor pays about 75 gold for an accurate ruin weapon found in the beginner dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528105042056581231)
- **npc reagent stock**: Reagents sold by NPC vendors have infinite stock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537092918949576855)
- **npc vendor buy list**: NPC vendors only buy gems, items made while training tinkering, blank scrolls, blank maps, and maps made while training cartography. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522934573120487445)
- **npc vendor gear quality**: NPC vendor gear is poor quality and not cheap, so players should avoid buying it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331064380063795)
- **npc vendor gold payment**: Regular NPC vendors in towns accept gold carried in the backpack, pulling from the backpack first, as long as the total price is at most the gold carried. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533640544377638967)
- **npc vendor meat purchases**: NPC vendors will not buy meat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553617284008902747)
- **npc vendor stock cap**: NPC vendors stock only up to 999 of an item at a time, so items such as bottles can sell out when other players buy them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543362825399836692)
- **obtaining aspect cores**: Aspect cores are easiest to obtain by farming and selling rares to buy the cores you need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538617487615066193)
- **obtaining rotated-out event cosmetics**: Once an event cosmetic has rotated out of the merchant, it can only be obtained from other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315610013536266)
- **ocean and netherzone colours**: Ocean and Netherzone are cheaper colours with varying shades that look nice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529882599239974952)
- **ocean boating run income**: With 4 ocean redline points, a player can run four 250k boating runs per day, earning about 1 million gold daily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536810530998849689)
- **ocean farming versus treasure mapping returns**: Ocean farming yields more gold and experience than treasure mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900118969680142)
- **ocean fishing gold per hour**: Ocean fishing yields roughly 150k gold per hour for a character fresh off Shelter Island, about 200k per hour while raising fishing from 100 to 110, and 500k-750k per hour for end-game players fishing and rescuing castaways, with MiBs paying more; results vary with RNG and ocean familiarity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534240670171004978)
- **ocean weekly gold bonus**: The Ocean weekly gold bonus requires sailing and killing NPCs and ships. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535648685612863558)
- **opening vendor bags via yellow names**: You may be able to click the yellow vendor names to open a vendor's bag when you cannot enter the place where the vendor is, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527773750798585967)
- **order of armorers reward cloth price**: Order of Armorers reward items (cloth) can be bought from other players, typically for around 75k gold per cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541526217415458880)
- **ore price fluctuation around king's fair**: Ore prices normally fluctuate around the King's Fair event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1545880189605642381)
- **ore sold as ingots**: Most ore is sold in ingot form as a commodity rather than as raw ore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537576243782754374)
- **ossuary 3 lockpicking income**: A dungeon lockpicker can leave Ossuary 3 with roughly 40-50k gold plus loot and trash per run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554001294681964627)
- **ossuary level 4 gold yield**: A single Ossuary level 4 run can reportedly yield around 60k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522288876939509882)
- **outlands butler planner tool**: The Outlands Butler planner tool calculates how long it takes to earn links given gold per hour and a number of weeks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522394797011107880)
- **outlands economy prices**: The Outlands economy fluctuates, and Essence and Dubs are currently cheaper than they were before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533583310121336893)
- **outlands portal pricing**: On the Outlands portal, listed prices are per unit (for example 1.59 per vet supply), and some sellers only allow buying the entire stack, while vendors with a specific symbol allow choosing the quantity to buy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527883537297182731)
- **outlands portal vendor search**: The Outlands Portal has a vendor search page (portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search) where items such as a blessed potion codex can be searched and sorted by price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544449577023963146)
- **outlandsmall price site**: Outlandsmall.com, the old player-run price site, is dead and has been replaced by the Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554009484781682830)
- **overworld gold farming**: Farming gold in the overworld is convenient because players can recall straight to their house to deposit gold and then return to repeat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536453779614863401)
- **paragon chest core rewards**: Paragon chests sometimes give a core, reportedly about 1k from a lesser, 2k from a regular, and 3k from a greater paragon chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545188691981500456)
- **passive income route**: The recommended route for passive income is three accounts with 120 tailoring, plus 120 alchemy as a bonus, doing society quests every Friday on all of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536208532003623002)
- **pawnbroker chest retrieval cost**: Retrieving a chest from the Pawnbroker costs 25,000 gold per chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542776107089133629)
- **pawnbroker item recovery**: The Pawnbroker NPC lets you get back lost items for a fee. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547809468719435857)
- **per-item stack pricing limit**: Per-item pricing of a stack only works for stackable items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552240672038453258)
- **pet level and value**: A pet's level makes little difference to its value because buyers focus on its stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555666061280551084)
- **pit trial entry price**: The pit trial entry price has risen compared with an earlier period, so fewer players are expected to run 3-man pit trials solo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555203264998408233)
- **plain leather price**: Plain leather has sold for around 10k gold per 5k commodity, down from about 12k earlier, though prices fluctuate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525678490035159133)
- **plate and chainmail fortification invulnerability demand**: Plate and chainmail armor with Fortification or Invulnerability modifiers sell quickly and are in constant demand, with plate worth more than chainmail. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531284565170061362)
- **player market stack sizes**: When selling resources to other players, the usual stack size is 5k for commodities such as boards and 2.5k for colored variants, and this applies to all resources. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536113123872735323)
- **player trade venues**: Player trade on Outlands is mostly done through the portal, and some players also post trades in Discord. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522630098950291746)
- **player vendor armor and weapon stock**: Player vendors reportedly sell only master crafted armor and weapons, along with magic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538465119560933417)
- **player vendor gold collection**: Gold collected from a player vendor goes straight into your bank, not your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298402147401768)
- **player vendor gold payment**: Purchasing from player vendors requires the gold to be in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533640544377638967)
- **player vendor inventory**: Items in a player vendor's inventory cannot be moved around; if an item is not visible, open the crate, bag or chest in the vendor's inventory to find it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532762201394385027)
- **player vendor prices on crafted items**: Player vendor prices on crafted items are usually cheaper than other sources, so use the vendor search to buy them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543913659258900480)
- **player vendor purchase history and stealth**: Player vendors in Ultima Online: Outlands do not appear to provide a purchase history showing who bought your items, and players stocking or buying from them should avoid staying visible near the vendors longer than necessary. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552463836756451370)
- **player vendor search for furniture**: Player-made furniture appears in the player vendor search under 'all items' rather than under the Furnishing tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554615688663146536)
- **player vendor stack purchasing**: Player vendors are not set up to let you buy a single item out of a listed stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554276160530161807)
- **player vendor stock levels**: Many player vendors are nearly empty because many players run small vendors with only a couple of items, while a few malls are well stocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546324722726215761)
- **player vendors**: Players place vendors in their houses, stock them with items, and set prices manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551766174923100241)
- **player vendors and the portal**: Player vendors are set up at player homes across the map, and the Portal acts as a vendor aggregator where items listed on vendors appear and can be searched. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542067991812898917)
- **player-crafted items sold to npcs**: The player-crafted items that are sold to NPCs are items crafted with gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098331235024917)
- **player-made exceptional armor price**: A full set of player-made exceptional armor costs about 500 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331219116462140)
- **player-run weapon and armor shops**: Players run weapon and armor shops in Outlands, margins are thin, and loot items sell reasonably well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525472908216893532)
- **poison aspect core farming**: There is no specific best place to farm Poison Aspect Cores; players sell the aspect cores they get but don't need and buy the ones they do need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528112369476173835)
- **polar lantern dyeing**: Polar lanterns cannot be dyed; their colour reflects the dungeon where they were originally farmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527992744067334244)
- **popular materials vendor display**: The vendor's display has a 'Popular Materials' section at the top listing all materials and how many society jobs use each this week, but it does not distinguish highly profitable jobs from poor ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548181124931653632)
- **portal bot command**: Use the !portal bot command followed by an item name, for example '!portal codex of macing', to create a search link for the Outlands Portal vendor indexer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525331101093199892)
- **portal vendor search antiquity registration**: The Outlands portal vendor search does not appear to distinguish between registered and unregistered antiquities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538707885259759698)
- **portal vendor search for bulk arcane scrolls**: Bulk arcane scrolls can be found through the portal vendor search at portal.uooutlands.com/vendor-search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524678367373295716)
- **posting in sell channel**: To post in the Discord sell channel, link your Discord account in your Portal account settings, and always meet buyers or sellers in Shelter for trades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554009333958844458)
- **potion kegs and shop potions**: Kegs of potions can be bought from player vendors at fairly low prices, and basic potions can be bought from shops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525869473666437271)
- **potion stacking on vendors**: Potions no longer need to be placed in kegs for sale on player vendors, because many potions fit in a single stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551042692836753470)
