- **powder iris cloth value**: Powder Iris cloth is highly desired and can be found in loot; a pair of Powder Iris shoes can sell for about 2.4 million gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524311874659815444)
- **powdered hair dye drop value**: A powdered hair dye dropped from a lockpick chest has sold for roughly 4 million gold in one reported case, where a guild mate double-procced the drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544558535663423498)
- **power scroll prices**: Power scrolls are currently at their cheapest prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541949773467361291)
- **preloaded mining runebooks**: Runebooks preloaded with mining runes can sometimes be found on vendors or commissioned from a scribe, and may sell for around 50K. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528828206814199969)
- **premade veterinary supplies price**: A stack of about 30k veterinary supplies can be bought premade for roughly 10-15k gold, which is quicker than crafting them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974702095605833)
- **prevalia coins for magic item recycler**: The number of Prevalia coins needed for the Magic Item Recycler is reported to be unchanged, while the value of coins has increased. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544074108583677962)
- **prevalia coins pay-to-win status**: Prevalia Coins are not pay-to-win; they offer convenience, but real progress remains gated by experience, codex levels, aspect levels and link chain levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526676654397849660)
- **prevalia coins purpose**: Prevalia coins are mainly meant to be spent on fancy clothing and decorations from the Prevalia merchant, and players can buy them from other players with gold to get cheaper items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537542408848285876)
- **prevalia merchant 2-year item cycle**: Items sold on the Prevalia merchant follow a 2-year cycle, so a Halloween 2025 item returns to the merchant at Halloween 2026. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527316979105661000)
- **prevalia merchant vendor**: The Prevalia Merchant is a vendor where items can be bought using various currencies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527032360422608956)
- **prevalian merchant event rotation**: The Prevalian Merchant's stock changes with each event, and limited edition items sold there will not return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413696242090025)
- **prevalian merchant gold purchases**: Most items sold by the Prevalian merchant can also be bought with gold, though some items may be doubloon exclusives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535062653108752466)
- **prevalian merchant inventory**: The Prevalian Merchant sells a wide range of items that can be purchased with Prevalian (donation) coins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544413583675363430)
- **prevalian merchant wiki listing**: The wiki lists all events and their Prevalian Merchant items at Category:Prevalian_Merchant, but without prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544075471514509442)
- **price check channel purpose**: The price check tab/channel is intended for rare items that cannot be found on the vendor portal site. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553532714617929729)
- **price drop of treasure maps, research materials and aspect items**: After recent changes, treasure maps, research materials, aspect items and links have all become cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545812671960584322)
- **profit from selling crafted gear**: Crafting gear and selling it yields almost no profit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846491048972479)
- **profiting from societies**: Craft the items the society NPC requests (which consumes the resources) to earn points, trade the points for items such as gold links or gold reforges (usually the most profitable), and sell those to other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528581847800614914)
- **programmatic vendor search queries**: The Outlands vendor search must not be queried programmatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526896599098195988)
- **protecting ingots from thieves**: Because thieves steal commodities, keep ingots at home and convert them into commodities there, moving them by trade in Shelter or by warp tile directly to a vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537043417974964255)
- **protecting smuggler purchases with magery**: A character with 100 Magery and the Invisibility spell can use it before buying from a smuggler to avoid theft, without needing a dedicated runner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553738161815953480)
- **public recyclers for item identification**: Some vendor malls have free public recyclers and guilds often provide them too; these can identify items if they have item id charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529914076606631966)
- **rare dungeon hue items**: Rare dungeon hue items such as the blue drum are mostly bought for house decoration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546506259455283263)
- **rare hue dyeing cost**: The cost of dyeing clothing with a rare hue equals the price of the colored cloth used, so some hues are nearly free while others are very expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523067296707379381)
- **reagent commodity prices**: Smugglers sell reagent commodities for 20k, while the raw price from magicians and alchemists is 15k, so player vendors selling near that range are pricing fairly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552343322255958141)
- **reagent price**: One reagent costs 3gp from a normal vendor, or 4gp if bought from a smuggler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525716064346837174)
- **reagent vendor stock timing**: Reagent vendor stock often runs out on Friday and Saturday when new Society Jobs start. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530564923938181120)
- **recall scroll sources**: Recall scrolls are not sold by mage NPC stores and are instead bought from player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527438327815344299)
- **recycling drops into arcane essence**: Drops such as those from Prevalia sewers are generally better recycled into arcane essence, which is needed to fuel an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553524825832820766)
- **recycling magic items for juice**: Keeping only the last tier of magical items for recycling is usually enough that a player never needs to buy juice (the recycling resource). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529894141633364039)
- **recycling magic items into essence**: Bad magic items should be recycled into essence, while good magic items should be kept, used or sold, and turning an item into essence is always worthwhile no matter how poor the item is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532418516521844816)
- **recycling spell scrolls into blank scrolls**: A stack of 2 identical spell scrolls can be recycled into 1 blank scroll, which is worth 3 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527181833828307024)
- **red trapped pouches supply**: Red trapped pouches can be looted in large numbers from factioner bodies, and the smuggler sells 100 of them for 5K. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523784501459816619)
- **redline certificate costs**: Redline certificate costs are not retroactive, so players who redlined early paid far less, saving hundreds of millions of gold compared with later players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532406061519208589)
- **redline gold cost**: Roughly 50-60 million gold, about half of the 30-link journey, is reported to unlock everything needed for redline, with the remainder being cosmetic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532400089849659483)
- **reduced corpse gold change timing**: The reduced gold from looting corpses killed by others was introduced roughly 3-4 days before 2026-08-16. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538376884444991518)
- **reforge market prices**: Reforge market prices are currently down because supply outweighs demand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550588305828085871)
- **reforge tool value versus links**: Reforge tools can sometimes be worth more than the link a player actually wants, so it can be cheaper to sell the reforge tool and the link you have and buy the desired link directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656421038002248)
- **reforges as society reward**: Reforges are among the highest valued items purchasable with society currency and are commonly sold by players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544304585341014026)
- **registered achievement items**: Items already registered for an achievement can no longer be used for it, buyers usually pay less for registered ones, and registration is thought to be irreversible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532294469787975710)
- **regular ingots and boards value**: Regular ingots and boards sell for good money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537624636160741426)
- **remote banking transactions**: Nearly all transactions use remote banking, and the only cash transaction is buying skill training from an NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533640723633672334)
- **remote vendor gold management**: A player can monitor, deposit and withdraw gold for their vendors from anywhere without being at the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464010795028622)
- **renting a vendor via a rental contract**: To rent a vendor, walk into the house and double-click the rental contract, which looks like a bundle of 3 scrolls and shows the weekly or monthly price set by the house owner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550810626518028339)
- **repair bench charge cost**: Repair bench charges are very cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521358600638042275)
- **repair kit player price**: Players sell repair kits for about 8gp each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554991744800784385)
- **replacement ostard cost**: A replacement ostard costs about 500 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533964710490407053)
- **research materials treasure maps**: Research materials can be combined into high level treasure maps, which most players sell to other players for good gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532625281993408602)
- **resource inflation control**: Resource inflation is managed through weekly societies in which many players burn off resources, along with many gold sinks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523344913599823928)
- **resource map completion rate**: Resource map completion fell after a patch from about 3,000 maps per day, mostly by 2 players, to almost 600 per day, mostly by 4 players; a handful of players can do at most about 18 maps per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544060865907658823)
- **resource map cost versus profit**: Resource maps must be purchased, so map harvesting profit is reported to be lower than regular harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529895528022802504)
- **resource map drop rate control**: Staff can control the supply of resource maps by lowering their drop rate, since every created map is eventually completed by someone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528230317926912041)
- **resource map leaderboard page count**: The resource map leaderboard had 192 pages last season and has 193 pages this season with 30 days remaining. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544118428929892433)
- **resource map profitability**: Most low and medium color resource maps yield only about 1-2k profit each, while the highest color maps still have decent margins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535327020496724048)
- **resource mapping profitability**: Resource mapping reportedly yields less profit per hour than a single-client lumberjack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531440782764933151)
- **restrictions and gold value**: Outlands restrictions on looting and gold gain are a main reason gold retains value in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529282237399302179)
- **reveal scroll price**: Reveal scrolls cost 500 gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550411881641152585)
- **ridable wolf token cost**: A ridable wolf sold for tokens costs about 1200 SOC points, which is quite expensive, assuming it is still token-only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530308536267964488)
- **riverside mall vendor contract rent**: Vendor contracts at Riverside Mall are available to rent for 11.5k per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531090031408709662)
- **runebook search on portal vendor search**: Searching 'runebook' on the Outlands portal vendor search returns hundreds of results. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530953149802872923)
- **running pits with few links**: Running pits with fewer than about 20 links is generally not worth it, especially given the rising price of gears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521334502641766550)
- **safe selling of high-value items**: To sell items such as a commodity deed safely, get verified, find a buyer, and complete the sale in Shelter to avoid thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537726584377704498)
- **safer way to buy items**: A safer way to buy items is to post in the trade channel and meet the seller in Shelter to trade, rather than sending items to the bank or buying from vendors where thieves or reds are around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521718861370757252)
- **scavenger gold farming in deep dungeons**: Running a scavenger through deeper dungeon levels can make gold quickly, though this may be programmed out in the future. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535749715973509211)
- **scavenger gold income**: Some scavengers extract hundreds of thousands of unlooted gold per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535749906004705430)
- **scavenger money-making strategy**: A scavenger character in the highest dungeon floor is a quick way to make money by picking up items left on the floor by other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526042054076006422)
- **scavenging as backstabber or thief**: Scavenging leftover items on a backstabber or thief character still yields plenty of items for easy cash as a new player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540079079368171611)
- **scavenging gold income**: Scavenging can earn a lot of gold fairly easily, enough within minutes to buy several supply loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522647906425766009)
- **scribe npc book sales**: Scribe NPCs sell books. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555973616980467713)
- **scroll purchase from scribe npc**: Scrolls can likely be bought fairly inexpensively from a scribe NPC, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530530553097621585)
- **securing purchases with a lock box**: If someone is next to you inside a house, send purchases to the bank instead of your backpack, move the items into a lock box, lock it with its key, and take the box to your room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521717039431946331)
- **selling and recycling empty spellbooks**: Empty spellbooks cannot be sold to NPCs but can be recycled normally. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549469916199919700)
- **selling and recycling loot**: Identify magic items with an ID wand or Item Identification skill, then recycle them with a tinker tool or by saying 'recycle'; sell other non-reagent, non-scroll items via a rented vendor or the portal, and sell gems to an NPC jeweller. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527932309477658634)
- **selling black goods to thief npc**: Black goods likely cannot be sold to the thief NPC from the bank and probably must be in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537216662066044999)
- **selling black goods to thief npc**: To sell black goods to a thief NPC, the goods must be in your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555897500857147453)
- **selling boards in bulk**: Save up 5000 boards, put them into a commodity, and sell that commodity to other players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531191329114165248)
- **selling colored ingots**: It is better to wait until you have your own player vendor before selling colored ingots, to avoid dealing with many buyers who each want a small amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544715174341116056)
- **selling colored lumber and ingots**: Selling colored lumber and ingots in stacks is likely better than in commodity deeds, because buyers more often want a smaller quantity than a full commodity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548162064479162522)
- **selling colored materials for society jobs**: To maximize profit, sell colored materials in stacks, and sell a given color only during weeks when that material has a highly profitable society job. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1548176792391778328)
- **selling commodities**: To sell a commodity, become verified, then list it in the Discord trade channel, or rent a vendor so buyers can find your items on the vendor portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537576550055284797)
- **selling commodities safely**: To sell commodities, verify and post in the sell channel, check the Outlands portal for the right price, and trade only in Shelter, where no criminal acts such as theft can occur. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555951305363558564)
- **selling dropped shoes**: Dropped shoes are best cut into cloth, since buyers usually only want the cloth, and the shoes sell for about 6x the cost of the cloth color. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538275740942868530)
- **selling drops to npcs**: The only drops worth selling are gems sold to a jeweler, and only in the early game, since players later buy gems in bulk at a higher price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553098242772836406)
- **selling gathered resources**: Resources like iron can be sold through a hired NPC vendor or in the trading channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549602945824198660)
- **selling goods faster via vendors**: To sell goods faster, rent a vendor spot and undercut the lowest bids on the vendor portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528828824840704100)
- **selling goods with npc vendor**: To sell goods, rent a spot and hire an NPC vendor, which is an easy and fast way to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533048503121481849)
- **selling harvesting tools to vendors**: Harvesting tools such as picks, remove trap tools, spyglasses and armor can be sold on vendors, though the profit may be small. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533046087403831336)
- **selling high-value items**: High-value items sell well when posted in the buy/sell channel at your maximum price, since buyers will pay slightly over for the convenience of buying directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534312186715832543)
- **selling items methods**: Items can be sold through a player vendor, by trading in Shelter via Discord, or by listing in the Discord sell channel, which is best for higher-tier items or large quantities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532500919160143872)
- **selling junk magic items to npcs**: Unidentified or junk magic items can be sold to NPCs for gold, though recycling them for arcane essence is often more valuable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529239656623771739)
- **selling leather to npc vendors**: Selling leather to NPC vendors at 1gp each is a poor deal; filling a 5,000-leather commodity and selling it to a player is better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549827176264638586)
- **selling logs to players**: Logs can be sold to other players in commodities of 5k normal boards each, through the discord trade channels or a player vendor, with a player vendor being the easiest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528772345744068839)
- **selling meat**: Meat can be sold to Butchers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523004530722340945)
- **selling resources via vendor**: To sell resources, rent a vendor at a house and list the items for sale; the Vendor Portal automatically shows vendor listings so buyers can find you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537895401347227731)
- **selling single commodities**: Selling a single commodity attracts few buyers, so a player vendor is the better way to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526941939956449482)
- **selling single items**: Single items are usually bought in bulk on player vendors, so selling one item that way has little success; players without gold for a vendor do better finding a buyer in the buy channel and DMing them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537921139496460328)
- **selling society points**: Players selling society points state how many they have, the buyer asks for a specific item, and the price is worked out from that item's value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549032130904858637)
- **selling tamed creatures via stablemaster**: Tamed creatures may be sellable through a stablemaster, though this is unconfirmed and the Creature Broker NPC is the more clearly stated way to sell tames. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539728225364869291)
- **selling tinker-crafted jewelry**: Jewelry crafted by a tinker, such as sapphire jewelry, is sold to a jeweler NPC rather than a tinker NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526342875053297695)
- **selling via own vendor**: Using your own vendor is a safe method to sell large amounts of items, though transporting the items to the vendor exposes you to possible highway robbery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535569631891423302)
- **send to bank cost**: The Send to bank feature is currently very cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542662661706088588)
- **send to bank option value**: The send to bank option on vendor purchases is considered overpriced and no safer than carrying the item yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534573995855450293)
- **sensible caravan prices**: Sensible caravan prices are between 500K and 1.5M depending on location and addons, and 2.5M is considered overpriced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525516124073234553)
- **shepherd's crook prices**: Exceptional gold shepherd's crooks are pretty cheap, and rosewood crooks are not more expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543019413370830889)
- **shimmer cloth availability**: Shimmer cloths are only available from the Prevalian Merchant for a limited time and generally never return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524311302456086578)
- **ship deeds and dockmaster system**: Ship deeds go into the dockmaster system and can no longer be sold on standard player vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549238241763270667)
- **shopping from player vendors**: Player vendors are accessible from within about 12 tiles; double-click the vendor and click the backpack on their paperdoll if it doesn't open, then click an item and select buy from the context menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520811226526126184)
- **silver and gold link liquidity**: Silver and gold links are fairly liquid: they can sell overnight on a vendor, though gold links on a vendor lose around 100k per day, or they can be sold all at once through a trade channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546612477020733561)
- **silver in faction dungeons**: Silver in faction dungeons is likely given by mobs carrying the faction mob tag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541744332154085426)
- **skeletal dragon from creature broker**: Skeletal dragons can be obtained from the creature broker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486623730180167)
- **skill scroll handling**: Skill scrolls are sold to other players rather than recycled, and junk scrolls that sell for under 7k should be saved for echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552971649333338143)
- **skill scroll tome price**: The Skill Scroll Tome costs about 10 Prevalia coins from the Prevalia merchant, though this price is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524788999972192296)
- **skinner income sources**: Skinning leather is nearly free money, but most skinners earn more from the gold other players leave on corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525689668497178756)
- **skull lantern availability**: Skull lanterns were bought from a previous holiday merchant, rotated out around Halloween, and are no longer sold by vendors, so they must be bought from players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527994301265612841)
- **small caravan cost versus inn room**: A small caravan costs multiple millions of gold, which would pay for the biggest inn room for years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544447437316423733)
- **small ship salvage cost**: Salvaging a sunk small ship likely costs nothing, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530015454599315639)
- **smuggler arrow purchases**: Smugglers sell unlimited arrows at a slightly increased price, but you must buy at least about 500 at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552076109699350559)
- **smuggler buy list reagents**: To add a reagent to a smuggler's buy list, the reagent must be in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530565034143649923)
- **smuggler npc blank map sales**: Smuggler NPCs likely do not sell blank maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537093110977405000)
- **smuggler npc commodities**: The Smuggler NPC may sell commodities, possibly including sulfurous ash, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530241632887115837)
- **smuggler reagent purchase quantities**: Smugglers reportedly only sell reagents in quantities of 500 or 5k at a time, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527239714069807155)
- **smuggler reagent sales**: Smugglers around the world sell reagents in unlimited quantity, at 1 gold more per reagent than normal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527236967647936604)
- **smuggler runner protection**: A smuggler runner character with detect hidden, tracking and invisibility can protect bulk purchases worth roughly 100-400k from being stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553738083042857091)
- **societies optimiser tool**: The website outlandsbutler.com/societiesoptimiser can be used to decide whether spending arcane scrolls on the inscription society is worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547706675924832397)
- **society crafter slot payback**: Society crafter slots cost 12 and then 15 society points to unlock, and a crafter with several maxed crafting skills (100/100/100, or 120 in crafts such as tailoring and alchemy) recoups the cost in roughly 10-12 weeks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546354074343964723)
- **society crafting income**: Society crafting with 100/100/100 tailoring, alchemy and inscription is claimed to be the best time-based money maker in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529946561990365329)
- **society items as resource drain**: Items made for Societies are removed from the game, acting as a resource drain on the economy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523922017223446538)
- **society job limit maximum**: Maxing out the society job limit of 15 requires 3 upgrades and is very expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532528607317069866)
- **society jobs default cap**: The default society jobs cap is 10, and upgrading it costs 1 million for the first upgrade alone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532528651780886738)
- **society jobs gold for 120 tailoring**: With 120 Tailoring, Society Jobs are a good way to earn gold. They reward sellable items such as Chain Links rather than gold directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523608411160444950)
- **society jobs tailor money making**: The recommended way to earn money is to create 3 tailors to do Society Jobs, which pays very well after a few weeks if done consistently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521150388001312798)
- **society link acquisition strategy**: When doing society jobs for links, it is typically best to take gold links or gold reforge tools, sell them, and then buy the specific links you need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655024242491425)
- **society point accumulation time**: It takes a while to save up enough society points to turn them into good gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547991305634840627)
- **society point cost and item pricing**: Item prices on the market are not determined by how many society points the items cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524828384247546026)
- **society point spending value**: Players want gold links, so spending society points on anything other than a gold link probably gives a worse deal per society point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524828442795839499)
- **society points account sharing**: Society points are shared across the crafters on one account, so each account can earn the society profit multiple times (e.g. 50k x 3 for three crafters). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528582190185713814)
- **society points for gold links**: Working on societies can earn enough points for a gold link or two, which can be sold to fund filling chain link slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520279959292219472)
- **society points from tailoring alchemy inscription**: Having 100 Tailoring, Alchemy and Inscription yields roughly 75-85 society points per week per account when doing only the most profitable butlers, though this figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523769251511533619)
- **society points gold reforging tools**: Save up 100 society points to buy gold reforging tools, then sell them to gain supplies and fund more society crafters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529947037724835910)
- **society points profit calculation**: The society points profit calculation is based on the per-point amount the player sets, and the Resource Costs can be updated if they are inaccurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547748322553626716)
- **society points tradability**: Society points are account bound, but they can be spent to redeem an item that can then be sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550999224332853249)
- **society upgrade cost on portal**: Buying both society upgrades on the Portal (reforging tools and strongbox customization) costs about 5M in total. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525434425117249566)
- **society weekly quests and consumables**: Societies offer profitable weekly quests that encourage players to craft their own consumables, so fewer potions and similar goods appear on player vendors than on other UO servers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541174615475228822)
- **solo bard farming gear**: Hardening armor and Force weapons are not very expensive and are used when solo farming as a bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542554152213684314)
- **solo tier 8 treasure map profitability**: Soloing tier 8 treasure maps is regarded as the most lucrative treasure map activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528244402206806066)
- **special containers acquisition**: Many special containers exist; some are rare rewards or drops, while others are purchasable only for a limited time during events. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524532653121081534)
- **special fishing net profitability**: Without a high-level harvest aspect, 20 special/rare loot links, a full-tidings boat setup and 220+ effective fishing skill, selling special fishing nets is more profitable than running the MiBs yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540212813086326865)
- **special fishing net sale price**: Special fishing nets sell for about 8k gold each in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394579688656979)
- **special fishing net yield rate**: Fishing yields roughly 25-50 special fishing nets per hour, depending on luck and competition from other fishers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549394579688656979)
- **special loot links in group farming**: Special loot links can be effective in a coordinated farming group, for example farming blood elementals for gold alongside gold bonus links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536419164397371474)
- **spell scroll looting value**: Looted spell scrolls are generally not worth picking up, because two identical scrolls are needed to make one blank scroll, which sells to an NPC for only 1 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528669929488781312)
- **splitting a check**: To split a check, make a new check from the existing one at the bank, or use a checkbook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553950791637794817)
- **splitting stacks at player vendors**: A large stack at a player vendor can be bought in smaller amounts if the vendor search shows the split icon; otherwise it cannot be split. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533233620817412257)
- **spyglass requirement on resource maps**: The overhaul removes the spyglass requirement on resource maps, which removes an ingot sink from the economy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **stable creature broker npc**: Each stable in Ultima Online: Outlands has a Creature Broker NPC where players can buy and sell tamed creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539728522094837853)
- **stable slot customization cost**: A customization granting +60 stable slots costs about 1 million gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525547989697826956)
- **stabling cost**: A stabler will hold a pet for 1 gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534350444552519712)
- **stars carpet pricing**: The stars carpet is not listed on the Infinity Market wiki page and costs 5 infinity coins per tile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200115387211888)
- **starter crafter money-making approach**: Smith, tinker and carpentry crafting are expensive to train, so a crafter with tailoring, alchemy, inscription and mage can instead save society points to buy items such as gold links to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555706450498691156)
- **starter fishing boat cost**: A cheap small or medium fishing boat can be started with for under 100k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **stealth chest picking income**: Picking dungeon chests while stealthed is decent passive income, comparable to backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546172996631396383)
- **stockpile and tomes vendor**: The stockpile holds cores, distillations and many other items and is more useful than the tome; both the stockpile and tomes are sold by Jakesh the Prevalia Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538914721774837790)
- **storage shelf theft risk**: A storage shelf bought via the Outlands portal may be stolen, either at the vendor house or from you when you remove it from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521520306731221114)
- **straight gold farming locations**: Players who want straight gold can farm the challenger dungeon or the weekly gold bonus dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552120632471195779)
- **strangelands point value benchmark**: Earning more than about 7 or 8 points in a Strangelands run is considered worthwhile compared with monster hunter quests, and most players score below that. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531643290670207026)
- **strongbox gold carrying**: Players with two strongboxes can carry an extra 5k gold out of dungeons per run, provided they have refreshes available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528823853780959313)
- **strongbox payoff time**: A strongbox can take a lot of volume over months to pay off its cost, so players without time to grind may do better spending society points on quality-of-life, aspect, links or expanded society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553578899399778305)
- **strongbox versus echo cooldown enchantment**: The strongbox enchantment suits players who farm with the same echo for long periods, while the echo cooldown enchantment suits players who switch roles often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550213278138110166)
- **suggested purchase order for upgrades**: One suggested purchase order is to raise aspect to about tier 13-15 first, then buy the storage shelf, then the resource stockpile, and only then the strongbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546363510156562523)
- **sulfurous ash vendor stock**: Sulfurous ash can sell out at mage shop vendors because players run around buying scrips. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530564762256019659)
- **summoner bard reagent cost**: A summoner bard must buy reagents, costing roughly 6 to 9 gold per spell cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530662418496360518)
- **summoner dungeon farming income**: A summoner can earn about 3k-5k gold per minute from dungeon farming and looting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531332196282142740)
- **summoner dungeon gold income**: A 30-link summoner can earn roughly 300-350k gold per hour in dungeons depending on how busy the dungeon is, with take-home around 200k per hour including looting and depositing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531331267310653642)
- **t1 and t2 resource map profitability**: Running T1/T2 resource maps is expected to require 2 explorer packs, with raw material costs of about 100gp versus 3-4x that on the portal, making them less profitable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531108214068875435)
- **t20 artisan with corrupted crafting links**: T20 Artisan with 15 corrupted crafting links adds about 30k gold of profit potential for a 7-10 million gold investment, not including the links, which is not worth the cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532066227508477992)
- **t3 map profitability by fortune or harvest**: Running a T3 map on fortune gold covers the map cost each run; on harvest it costs a few thousand gold less than covering it, or breaks even on procs, and all loot is extra. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530990228439957545)
- **t3 treasure map price**: T3 treasure maps sold for about 18k each in October and have since fallen to about 11-12k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107696818913340)
- **t8 treasure map lore page cost**: A T8 treasure map typically requires roughly 300-350k worth of lore pages to create. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **tailor npc robes**: Robes can be bought repeatedly from the tailor NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550989701534720056)
- **tailoring society job profitability**: Tailoring society jobs are usually the most profitable, but there are typically only about 5 per week, so players fill the rest with alchemy and inscription jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547992353632026764)
- **tailors across accounts for society weeklies**: Players can make 3 tailors across accounts, which are useful for society weeklies and are the best use for leather. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525156751752826930)
- **tamer build cost at low links**: Tamer builds are expensive at low links because command scrolls (about 20 scrolls x 4) and command cores must be purchased. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537587230594302013)
- **tamer crook purchase**: A crook is the one item worth spending gold on for a tamer because it speeds up farming; a cheaper coloured crook suffices, such as an exceptional rosewood crook (under 3k) or a goldenwood crook (about 2k). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530327084172447814)
- **tamer gold farming spots**: Outside the pits, an empty level 4 dungeon floor is a good place for strong tamers to farm gold, while a few very intensive players farm in the pits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529506158736441385)
- **tamer gold per hour benchmark**: A 24-link tier 12 tamer farming 25 armor rating mobs can reach roughly 350k gold per hour, and 250k per hour is a good standard if sustained for the full hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524138664064585839)
- **tamer pvm money maker**: A tamer with 120 Camping and 120 Forensic Evaluation is a good PvM money maker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546233266682593451)
- **tamer rare pet finds**: While farming, a tamer can find rare pets worth around 1 million gold to sell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531331755817046198)
- **taming bestiary price**: A Taming Bestiary costs about 38k on vendor search, though the price may vary over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532817735401078925)
- **taming min-maxing and pet market**: Taming involves min-maxing pet stats, and there is an entire player market for pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526106498814447668)
- **thanatite items**: Thanatite items are used for a quest tied to the time dungeon and are moderately valuable, selling for roughly 10k to 35k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538242170304073778)
- **thief camping of aspect triumph vendors**: Thieves camp popular player vendors selling Aspect Triumphs and steal the item from buyers who do not use the send-to-bank option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553035826898804817)
- **thief gold scavenging in dungeons**: A thief can scavenge gold in relative safety in the normal dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536709280886161509)
- **thieves codex acquisition**: A thieves codex can be bought on the portal or made by a player Scribe from the required materials, and portal vendors usually add little markup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522390954802413819)
- **thieves guild black market payout**: Turning in black goods at the Thieves Guild black market pays out almost entirely gold, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526462757082497114)
- **thieves in mall areas**: Thieves frequently operate in mall areas because many players gather there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534566600022425763)
- **third echo customisation cost**: The third echo customisation costs 5 million. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527535022377144422)
- **tier 16 aspect build cost**: Aspect Triumph is the most expensive part of a tier 16 aspect build, while the cores are cheap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531312946561679552)
- **tier 3 treasure map gold rate**: Clearing 100 tier 3 treasure maps, including dropoff, killing wilderness mobs and collecting rift daemon cult drops, takes about 3 minutes per map and yields roughly 300k gold per hour in redline, though loot prices have been falling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537701270503030824)
- **tier 4 treasure map gold yield**: A tier 4 treasure map chest yields about 16k gold, plus roughly 20-22k gold from mobs, when using Fortune with a gold/doubloon chain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538221055049601195)
- **time dungeon carpet hues**: Time Dungeon carpet hues are obtainable only from the Infinity Coin vendor; the dyes do not drop in the dungeon, but infinity coins drop randomly there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200860987654175)
- **time to cap redline**: Farming about 500k gold per day is estimated to get a player capped on redline in roughly 4-5 years, though the figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532397593815158855)
- **tinkering blacksmithing carpentry society value**: Tinkering, Blacksmithing and Carpentry provide only small improvements to a society's weekly profit and are better left until a player is more established. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523768951530852483)
- **tinkering training cost**: Training Tinkering costs roughly 7 million gold, varying with the training route taken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523735361736413457)
- **top gold-per-hour dungeons**: Tidal 3 and Oss 4 are reported to be among the highest gold-per-hour dungeons for farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531332615515148400)
- **top ingot consumers after resource map change**: Some of the top ingot consumers on the server left after the resource map change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544104182980812862)
- **top magic gear modifiers**: The most valuable magic gear modifiers are the top tier from each category: Exceedingly/Supremely, Fortification/Invulnerability, and Power/Vanquishing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531284787967299604)
- **top tier fishing boat cost and income**: A top tier, fully upgraded fishing boat costs roughly 3-4 million gold and reportedly earns about 500k gold per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549440851665621023)
- **trade channel post format**: In the trade channels, posts must start with WTS in the sell channel and with WTB in the buy channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552756016779632662)
- **trade meeting location**: Trades are done by meeting in Shelter, and the Portal shows the current gold price of 5k iron. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549595831680630827)
- **trading from shelter island**: To trade from Shelter Island, post in the trade channel, wait for a DM, meet in Shelter, check the Portal for prices, and link your Discord account so you can post in the sell channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546790722764546078)
- **trading pack animals**: A pack animal such as an ox can be traded, and the recipient cannot look inside it until the trade is completed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535564355343622265)
- **traditional redline region cost**: Traditional Redline regions cost 5,000,000 gold plus 1,000,000 gold per tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525944824052715660)
- **trapped chests from player vendors**: Chests bought from player vendors might be trapped, though this is only a tentative claim from one player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535988382625308704)
- **trapped container trading**: Trapped containers cannot be traded from player to player, and a trapped pouch probably cannot be put into a commodity deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523629532651847751)
- **trapped pouch supply from hunting pks**: Hunting PKs provides a nearly endless supply of trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544046355083690014)
- **trapper build cost**: A trapper build is expensive to make, costing lots of gold or many gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550079786813231167)
- **trapper skill nerf**: The trapper skill was recently nerfed heavily, and gadget core prices crashed as a result. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536276742015033494)
- **trapping market after patch**: Trapping is still viable after the patch, and cores are in low demand, so it is a good time to buy them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535383749066363041)
- **treasure map change impact on tier 8**: The treasure map change mainly hurts players soloing tier 8 treasure maps, which are an outlier in profitability and are being nerfed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900367482060882)
- **treasure map chest loot value**: Treasure map chest loot is lucrative compared to treasure map prices, and it is improved by Harvest or Fortune aspects and Special/Rare loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537110569927184394)
- **treasure map extra item value**: Extra items from treasure maps, such as aspect cores, count as profit on top of the raw gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552119308111315005)
- **treasure map gold and xp rates**: Since the changes, a skilled mapper burns about 25 T3 maps per hour (the average player about 15), with each T3 map grossing roughly 55-60k gold, for about 775k net per hour for skilled players and roughly 500k per hour for average players, while XP has dropped to about 250k per hour for 25 T3 maps and 300k per hour for 25 T4 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525625855139774474)
- **treasure map income modifiers**: Treasure map income is further increased by the T16 harvest aspect and 22 special loot links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525625789327085578)
- **treasure maps and boating gold farming**: Treasure maps and boating are considered very good methods of farming gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547647851352424581)
- **undecoded resource map prices**: Undecoded resource maps are expected to drop to around 25k each after the patch, though prices usually swing before the market stabilizes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528614296899162242)
- **undercutting vendor prices**: If you undercut everyone else on the market, your vendor items can sell very fast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530902305820639232)
- **unregistered antiquity items**: An item marked 'Unregistered', such as a Woodsman Axe, is worth more left unregistered than if it is registered as an antiquity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533347311365918812)
- **used grimoire trading**: Grimoires can still be bought and sold after they have been used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553593529337512071)
- **valuable loot keywords**: Loot with the keywords Invulnerability, Supremely, Vanquishing and Slaying is worth keeping, and Exceedingly combined with Might, Power or Force is also worth something. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531290525234368562)
- **value of lucky identified drops**: Lucky identified drops can be valuable: vanquishing maces are in demand for backstab templates and crooks are rare, so both can be worth keeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553524903678840943)
- **vanquishing two-handed mace prices**: Vanquishing two-handed maces sold well in August 2026, with one player selling 30-40 at about 190k gold each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548193770208755722)
- **vanquishing weapons with accuracy**: Looting everything yields dozens to hundreds of Vanquishing weapons, and a Vanquishing weapon that also has some accuracy is rarer and more worthwhile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548121717191221299)
- **vendor command**: Type the [vendor command to manage your vendor and collect its gold from anywhere, without having to visit the vendor in person. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546298261873364993)
- **vendor item pricing**: There is no autopricing for vendor items, but the new pricing menu lets you set a price for an item so later drops of that item on the vendor take that price automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537801454914641990)
- **vendor item purchases**: Items in a player vendor's stock disappear in real time when other players buy them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523017358082310352)
- **vendor listing search delay**: There is likely a cooldown between placing an item on a vendor and it appearing in the Outlands website item search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553803982965837936)
- **vendor malls near moongates**: Vendor malls near moongates are good places to look for vendors selling items in bulk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527297255076270130)
- **vendor portal discord verification**: You do not need to verify your Discord account to use the vendor portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537920249863864451)
- **vendor portal item highlight**: Clicking the icon on the vendor portal and then alt-tabbing back to the game opens a gump with an option to highlight the item in the vendor pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527773959108558859)
- **vendor portal price checking**: The vendor portal can be used to see what other players charge for items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524824666638647356)
- **vendor price confirmation**: When setting prices on a vendor, click the blue button to confirm the price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551972519320231958)
- **vendor pricing manifests**: Vendor pricing manifests are stored server side only and are not available to the client, so they cannot be changed by editing a local JSON file. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1552770873147129897)
- **vendor purchase range**: You need to be within 2 tiles of a vendor to buy from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532447066230362113)
- **vendor purchases paying from bank**: Almost every vendor purchase pulls gold from the bank, so gold or checks should be kept in the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768560865087742)
- **vendor restocking risk**: The main risk when restocking a vendor is being killed by a player killer (PK). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524533401854410824)
- **vendor restocking safety**: Restocking a vendor is not safe in general, but it can be made fairly safe with preparation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545126908092485802)
- **vendor run safety**: There is little reason to carry valuables on vendor runs, since a hiding, defensive mule can be sent instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522661458088038522)
- **vendor sales checking**: Type [vendor in game to see the total gold your vendor holds, or check the My Vendors sales history on the Outlands portal website to see what it has sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529743875508404244)
- **vendor shop name rune tag**: Including the nearest Witcher tmap rune (e.g. 'W150') in a vendor's shop name helps buyers find it quickly, and exploreoutlands.com lists these runes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525164908738510950)
- **vendor site search abbreviations**: The Outlands vendor site search accepts abbreviated terms, so searching for "alc sk" finds the alchemy skill mastery scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526959483987689493)
- **vendor spot rental cost**: Vendor spots can be rented for as little as 2.5K, and a portal filter helps find them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530973594086015098)
- **vendor stack listing strategy**: Listing commodities as a single large stack on a vendor (e.g. 100 leather) sells better than several single-item stacks, and waiting until you have 2+ of an item type lets it sell faster at a higher premium. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525164326107742399)
- **vendor stocking distance**: You must be standing next to your vendor in order to place goods into its inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541698815197712455)
- **vendor website login requirement**: The Outlands vendor website requires you to be logged in with your account before you can use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1526941666949337178)
