- **vendors command access via help gump**: The [vendors command can also be reached through the Help gump, on its bottom row. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464460738859019)
- **vendors command remote monitoring**: Use the [vendors command to monitor your player vendors without being at the vendor location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552463887159529565)
- **verifying traded items**: Players should left click items offered in trade to verify they are what they claim to be, since scams using look-alike items can happen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522647178391064606)
- **veterinary supplies vendor search**: Veterinary supplies can be searched on the Outlands vendor-search portal, but a vendor that was outside Prevalia's north gate does not appear in that search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531081187513073725)
- **viable money-making characters**: Viable money-making characters include a miner, a lumberjack, a miner/lumberjack, a PvM character, a dungeon chest picker with skinning, or a scavenger who skins mob corpses without picking chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555707269382017095)
- **vicious unlock cost**: The Vicious unlock costs 500k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533863819233984602)
- **void aspect leveling value**: Leveling the void aspect is considered worth it, and cores have gone down somewhat in price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540763704805564587)
- **wands on outlands portal**: Many wands are listed for sale on the Outlands Portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532419358570315988)
- **water aspect kit cost**: A water aspect kit costs about 20k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549344292827439125)
- **ways to earn gold**: Players can make gold by farming dungeons for gold and special items to sell, or by playing a miner or lumberjacker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524105442421113043)
- **weapons as ammunition**: Weapons are lost on death, so cheap weapons can be bought in bulk and treated as ammunition like arrows. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521094701157974036)
- **weekly city bonus npc discount**: The weekly city bonus makes items bought from NPCs in that town cost a little less. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554161913347440792)
- **weekly gold reward scarcity adjustment**: Weekly gold rewards appear to be adjusted by a scarcity percentage, e.g. a 150k legendary base shows about 160,500 and a 10k rare base shows 11,400. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546412596125769738)
- **weekly society job income**: Society jobs on three crafters plus a monster hunter yield about 300k gold per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528584692134183104)
- **weekly society resource consumption**: Resources such as boards are consumed weekly through society jobs, so they sell reliably. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553990939251318805)
- **weekly vendor rebate town**: The weekly vendor rebate town discounts only buying from vendors, not selling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549253826345836697)
- **where to buy runes**: Runes can be bought from mage shops and possibly from provisioners. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546860226899349685)
- **wilderness farming routine**: Farm about 15k gold in the wilderness, loot rares and other items, break down magic items, stay until you have burned 200-300 crystals, then fill up on gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333110694940814)
- **witcher rune set cost**: A Witcher rune set is expensive but considered a good investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520403446111539292)
- **writing a check with the check keyword**: Saying 'check <amount>' at the bank also writes a check. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549833334878769353)

## Housing & storage

- **blue and red star carpet storage in flooring tile racks**: Some newly released Blue Star Carpet and Red Star Carpet added to Flooring Tile Racks may not have been stored correctly. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541024250746380288)
- **flooring tile racks**: Flooring Tile Racks are usable again after the 2026-08-23 server update. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541024250746380288)
- **great gardens of avadon eligible entries**: In the Great Gardens of Avadon Decoration Contest, a House, House Boat, or Inn Room on the Live shard can be decorated as a garden and submitted for entry. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **great gardens of avadon prizes**: The Great Gardens of Avadon contest awards prizes for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place, the overall winner also receives the Toy Small House Model, and all participants receive a small decorative token. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **great gardens of avadon submission**: To enter the Great Gardens of Avadon contest, respond to the official contest thread on the forums with your character name, screenshots, and the coordinates of your submission. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550930775623606383)
- **house decay lottery structure**: A House Decay Lottery can be run as two separate raffles: one for the house itself (e.g. a Guild Fortress) and another for all the items inside it. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1551609013282799648)
- **house decay lottery ticket cost**: Tickets for the House Decay Lottery cost 1,000 gold each and are sold at the IDOC House Lottery. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1551609013282799648)
- **replacing misstored star carpets**: If a Blue Star Carpet or Red Star Carpet was not stored correctly in a Flooring Tile Rack, PM Luthius to have it replaced. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541024250746380288)
- **storage shelf loadout renaming**: To name an individual Storage Shelf Loadout, use the Rename button in the loadout interface. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **storage shelf loadout switching**: To switch Storage Shelf Loadouts, use the Loadout Up/Down Arrow buttons or select a specific Loadout directly. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **storage shelf loadouts section**: The Storage Shelf menu has a dedicated Loadouts section where players manage Storage Shelf Loadouts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1545460816646508564)
- **expired inn room items**: When inn room rent runs out, stored items go to the bank queue of the character who rented the room, not to other characters. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534792262230117)
- **inn rental rooms**: The inn rental room system works like housing, letting a player have a room without owning a house; it can hold furniture and almost everything except vendors, can be entered from any town's inns or from some player houses and guild houses with stewards, and serves as a home until the player can afford a house. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549082435613098045)
- **inn room co-owners across accounts**: Characters on the same account as the inn room renter are automatically co-owners, while each individual character on other accounts must be manually added as a co-owner, which carries a theft risk if the accounts belong to other people. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544107354004525136)
- **inn room rent cost**: Inn rooms cost 2,500 gold per week per secure, so a small room costs 5k per week and larger rooms up to about 10-12.5k per week. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043059935256630)
- **inn room upgrades**: An inn room's secure item count can be upgraded (up to double the starting secures) without changing rooms, but its size cannot; to get a larger footprint you must cancel the room and rent a larger one. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545552937797812335)
- **inn rooms versus houses**: Inn rooms are in many ways superior to houses for storage and utility, including features like resurrection, and they cost far less than houses, though real houses allow NPCs and may hold more storage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553093088627662891)
- **interior decorator tool**: The Interior Decorator tool costs about 500 gold from an Architect NPC and lets you survey your home and lock down, secure, release, rotate and reposition items, including chests and crates. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555149846518702173)
- **land expansion house placement odds**: A land expansion is expected later this year, and players who have never owned a house are expected to have a much higher chance of winning a house placement, possibly through a raffle or ticket within the first 30 days. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550982024863555656)
- **locking down and securing items**: To prevent decay, say "I wish to lock this down" and target an item, or say "I wish to secure this" and target a container, in a house or rented room you control. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553488014674632768)
- **pawn broker decayed items**: Items that decay in your home or inn can often be recovered, for a fee, from the Pawn Broker NPC in Prevalia, but not all decayed items appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **placing a trash barrel**: To place a trash barrel in your house or inn room, stand in the spot you want it and say "I wish to place a trash barrel"; it does not need to be bought, and to move it you stand in a new spot and say the phrase again. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543303186960490566)
- **storage shelf loadouts**: The Storage Shelf lets you save loadouts of gear and reagents so you can re-equip and resupply with a single click after a death, greatly reducing the tedium of death and PK. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554936875221909658)
- **strongbox customization deed sources**: A strongbox customization deed can be obtained through society jobs (tailoring and alchemy are cheapest to start, taking several weeks of points), achievement points, or faction silver, or bought from a player for roughly 2.3 million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547641522772648067)
- **changing inn rooms**: To move to a different inn room, double-click the door, choose end rent and then the moving crate option; the innkeeper holds the crate, so rent the new room, enter, double-click the door to retrieve the crate, then sort and lock down or secure items again. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607991553003602)
- **ending an inn room contract**: When ending an inn room contract, for example to move to a bigger room, choose the moving crate option to have your items moved automatically; otherwise the items are deposited into your bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554282768266174627)
- **house ownership limit**: Each Outlands ID can own up to 3 homes (houses or rental rooms), one per linked account, and the second and third homes incur taxes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143382222020650)
- **house placement availability**: There is currently no space to place a new house on the server; space is not expected until the planned land expansion. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524426659930046717)
- **house storage chests**: Chests for house storage are crafted by player Carpenters, who can be hired or commissioned, and basic wooden chests need only low Carpentry skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487227382792323)
- **inn room style**: The style of a rental inn room depends on the town where it is rented, though not every town has a unique style. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607414974750833)
- **moving items from bank to safe location**: To move items from the bank to your inn room or home without thieves stealing them, load a bag, pouch or lockable box inside the bank, then take it whole (ideally nested in another container, or kept on the cursor) and recall or enter the inn immediately; a locked box's worst case is a stolen key. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555625185120493692)
- **rental room rent payment**: Rent for a rented room is paid automatically from the renter's bank box when payment is due; if that box lacks gold it tries other characters on the same account, and if no gold is found the renter is kicked out and the items go to the bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538222687581638786)
- **skill scroll tome**: The Skill Scroll Tome stores skill scrolls like a stockpile, making storing and counting them much easier and saving time and space. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535171264132423782)
- **stacking chests**: To stack a chest on another in a house or inn room, drag the upper chest to the bottom right corner of the lower chest before releasing it so it snaps on top; targeting the tile below the chest is an alternative method reported when placing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539615746504785931)
- **storage shelf**: The Storage Shelf is a player-crafted item, separate from the stockpile, that stores items, reduces item count, and lets you set up loadouts to grab all gear for a dungeon run. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552037680500703315)
- **storage shelf lockdown**: A storage shelf now works fully when simply locked down and does not need to be secured, although securing it also still works. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536918116926365788)
- **adding other-account characters to a rented room**: To give characters on other accounts access to a rented room, log them in and bring them to an innkeeper NPC, where a character from the renting account uses the rental room gump to target them and add them as friends or co-owners. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553459466295447604)
- **anvil in inn rental room**: An anvil add-on can be placed in an inn (hotel) rental room. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537552508308824184)
- **bank theft risk and inn rooms**: Thieves can steal items kept in the bank, so valuables should be kept secured in an inn room and the bank used only when necessary. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553773195847278724)
- **commodity weight**: One commodity weighs 1 stone, so 5,000 plain leather stored as commodities weighs 125 stones, while plain leather not stored as commodities is heavier than the equivalent gold. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553997248025858052)
- **free house plots availability**: There are currently no free house plots available on the server for placing a new house. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537165702006575244)
- **garden shelf**: A Garden Shelf is a storage item that holds plant-related items such as seeds and leaves so they take up less room. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595499245703278)
- **giving other-account characters inn room access**: To give a character on another account access to an inn room, meet them at the same innkeeper (or outside the room), and from the account that rented the room add the character as a co-owner by saying 'room', choosing add, and targeting them; friend status alone does not allow opening anything. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548622308162146355)
- **house ban bots**: Many players and some public houses run ban bots that target criminal-flagged players, such as reds, and ban them from the house, which keeps people training safe and also protects rented vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552587481260757013)
- **house deed blessing duration**: House deeds are blessed for 60 minutes after purchase, during which they are unstealable, but they can still be looted, so a deed should not be bought until a spot is ready. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532468699477442622)
- **house item decay and pawn broker**: Items on the ground in your home that are not locked down or in a secure container decay after 1 hour, and some decayed items and containers can be recovered from the Pawn Broker NPC in Prevalia, a bit south east of the main bank, though not all appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550045644293537824)
- **house lottery**: The house lottery is a gold sink: established players spend millions on tickets, ticket totals are not shared, and a given player's odds of winning are low. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544347330537590794)
- **housing availability on new continent**: Housing space on the new continent is extremely limited because there are too many players for the available empty spots, and a land expansion update is coming that should add a lot of space. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556005756304760883)
- **inn room access**: A rented inn room is the same single room accessible from any town's inn, and you exit only at the inn you entered from. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533985938386976828)
- **inn room cancellation without moving crates**: If you cancel an inn room without using moving crates, all items in the room are sent to your bank box, and they queue if the bank is full. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533954780207255562)
- **inn room rent default**: If you stop paying inn room rent or are away from the game, rent is drawn from your bank until it runs out, then the room is deleted and its contents are sent to your bank, unlike houses where contents are lost. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529264360210301160)
- **item decay in homes and rooms**: Items in a home or rented room that are not locked down or in a secure container decay after 1 hour on the ground; decayed items may be recoverable from the Pawn Broker in Prevalia, though not all appear there. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **moving items between characters**: Rent an inn room, put the items in a secure bag or chest inside it, and add your other characters or accounts as co-owners so they can retrieve the items. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554235671613542451)
- **npcs in inn rooms**: Some NPCs, such as a stable master, can be placed in inn rooms (rentals) as well as houses, and inn room storage can be upgraded. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525646910436806717)
- **potion storage shelf restrictions**: A storage shelf only holds greater-tier or higher potions (greater heal, greater cure, total refresh, and higher-tier poison), so lesser potions cannot be stored on it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549874282732200049)
- **rental room co-owners on same account**: All characters on the same account as the renter are automatically co-owners of a rented room, and rent can be pulled from their funds if the renting character's bank runs out, while characters on other accounts must be added manually. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553459466295447604)
- **rental room containers**: Rental rooms do not come with chests, so players must make or buy containers, or use bags and pouches from NPC vendors, and should secure them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526675610326401224)
- **rental room gold source**: Rental gold is taken first from the renter character's bank box and, if that is empty, from sibling characters on the same account, so gold must be in the bank of the account that took out the rental. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533988782171492505)
- **rental room moving crate option**: When closing or cancelling a rental room contract there is a Moving Crate option that collects your items into boxes inside a crate, so you can retrieve them in a new room. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551098298717437983)
- **resource stockpile**: The Resource Stockpile stores ingots and nearly every other crafting resource, including vendor-bought harvesting tools, and crafting can be done directly from it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550997381028384890)
- **sewing kits in storage shelf**: A resource storage shelf accepts only mastercrafted/exceptional player-made sewing kits, not sewing kits bought from tailor NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544338504144781342)
- **society points strongbox upgrades**: Players are advised to spend society points first on the Strongbox 1 and Strongbox 2 upgrades, which are considered must-haves, unless they need immediate profit. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553576683565486091)
- **sources of bags and chests**: Bags and pouches can be bought from the Provisioner NPC, while chests and tables can be bought from player shops or crafted yourself with a fresh carpenter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615515742248982)
- **stockpile theft risk**: A resource stockpile or storage shelf can be stolen by thieves while it is in your pack, for example in town, so take it straight to your room and lock it down instead of carrying it around. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541807501370982510)
- **stolen lockbox key recovery**: A thief cannot use a stolen key to open your locked box; if a key is stolen, go to your house or inn room, destroy the box with an axe, and make a new one. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555395564982640661)
- **storage shelf bag restock**: To make a storage shelf take bags, put the bag in a container, select restock, and target the container; the shelf takes empty bags and NPC bags. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550991822640382093)
- **storage shelf loadouts**: A storage shelf saves lockdowns with a loadout function, and items in it do not count against the room's lockdown capacity; it has one loadout by default and more are purchased as customization unlocks. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554539221329518665)
- **storage shelf resupply loadouts**: Multiple storage shelves share the same resupply loadout so one shelf plus loadout scripts is enough, but additional shelf loadouts can be purchased (at a high gold cost) for different resupply configurations. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539765724560621678)
- **strongbox account linking**: Strongboxes and all their customizations are linked to the account, and a player can have 3 accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550822258908467261)
- **trainers in inn rooms**: Trainers, including battle trainers, can be placed in an Inn Room, according to most players; one uncertain author suspects otherwise. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552611507643355157)
- **trash barrel**: A trash barrel can be placed to dispose of unwanted items such as maps, but it cannot be placed out on the streets. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536473366276349982)
- **vendor rent and daily gold cost**: Renting a vendor involves a weekly rent that is paid to the home owner from your bank, and a separate daily gold cost that is the NPC's salary, a server gold sink, paid from gold deposited in the vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535165950767140874)
- **adding items to a storage shelf**: Most single items can be added to a Storage Shelf by dropping them onto it, provided the item is fully repaired, armor and weapons are exceptionally crafted, and the shepherd's crook is deactivated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103049776439467)
- **additional storage loadouts**: Additional loadouts for the storage shelf are bought as upgrades in the [customizations menu (check the next page for more); they are expensive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547461982024765511)
- **adventurer's satchel**: The Adventurer's Satchel is the item that holds other blessed items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523396810713071788)
- **bank and item storage**: The bank has a small item limit, so players keep only gold (and restock loadouts) in the bank and store other items in house or inn room secure chests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546419673866702942)
- **bank deposit safe vendor**: The Bank Deposit Safe, which sends gold from a room or house to the bank, is sold by Jakesh the Prevalia Merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530689185114099884)
- **bank safety and room rental**: Players can be robbed at the bank, so renting an inn room and keeping items there is recommended over using the bank for storage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544718228226580572)
- **bank usage advice**: Keep only gold in the bank and store all other items in a house or inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525628991179067392)
- **basic home storage containers**: Chests, wooden boxes and wooden crates are basic home storage containers; some players use paragon chests for looks, and bags can also be bought from NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533018761790230678)
- **battle trainer deed vendor**: The house Battle Trainer deed is sold by a Prevalian Merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545521119048630354)
- **blocking entry to public house**: To stop people from walking into a public house, lock down an item on the doorway so it blocks the entrance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524877220223389769)
- **boat blessed status**: A boat is blessed before you register it but is no longer blessed after registering. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549421966178652223)
- **buying houses for sale**: The houses-for-sale menu shows each house's location on the map; once at the house, you buy it through a menu on the house sign. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543735088704131183)
- **caravan secure containers**: A caravan has 3 secure containers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526137265082863636)
- **chest secure efficiency**: Items can be placed in a chest that is secured so that only 1 secure is used, and the storage shelf can be locked down without using a secure. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043355121983609)
- **closing rental room without moving crate**: Closing a rented room without using a moving crate sends all items to the bank unorganized, whereas a moving crate lets you relocate items and can be used in a different town. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552423806059155618)
- **container item limit**: All containers hold at most 125 items, except that the main backpack and bank can be upgraded to hold more and special containers like the shelf and magic item vault have infinite capacity for specific items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540018978511126598)
- **converting gold to checks for bank limits**: Gold can be converted to bank checks, which weigh much less and reduce the bank item count, so bank limits are usually hit by item count rather than weight. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534368908822450306)
- **deed direction option**: The east/west/south option on a deed sets the direction the placed item will face, and the deed's direction can be changed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532791981774864446)
- **deposit safe for homes and inn rooms**: A deposit safe item can be placed in a home or inn room, and gold (only) dropped onto it is transferred to your bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768036753375294)
- **distribution chest bank transfers**: A distribution chest can send gold and other items, such as paragons, ship crew items, colonial marks, black goods and society crafting materials, to your bank or to the banks of your other characters, for example crafters on second or third accounts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523033577632170075)
- **entering inn room**: To enter your inn room, say 'room' near the innkeeper or click the innkeeper and select the option; the Other Rooms option in the inn UI also lets you enter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037874599460875)
- **escaping inn room as a ghost**: If you die inside your inn room and are a ghost, double click the door to leave the room and then revive. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540822708726538412)
- **expired inn room items**: If autopay on an inn room is cancelled and the room expires, the items inside are sent to the owner's bank/queue. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524872773518889110)
- **filter behavior after patch**: After a patch, the items-only filter no longer shows vendor scrolls and they no longer identify as 'rolled maps', but selecting 'all' in the filter works. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524022412709199872)
- **finding houses for sale**: To see houses that players have for sale, visit a Real Estate Agent or other house NPC in town and use its gump; you must travel to the house location to view it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545699358471618600)
- **first storage quality-of-life purchases**: The Storage Shelf, Resource Stockpile, Magic Item Recycler and Magic Item Vault are the recommended first storage quality-of-life purchases, with Storage Tomes, Bank Vault, Checkbook and Garden Shelf also useful. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554935502048723045)
- **following through inn room gates**: Strangers cannot enter a player's inn room by following through a gate cast from that inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534351274986831974)
- **for sale house purchase contents**: Buying a house through its For Sale sign includes all of the items inside it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537178707188260864)
- **free house land availability**: Free land on which to place a new house is almost non-existent because the server is years old and already built up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526137785126486068)
- **free house plots**: There are no free plots left for a fresh house in Outlands, so players must buy houses from other players, which is costly but attainable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539592156728266752)
- **guild house amenities for new players**: Guild houses often provide new players with storage shelves for armor, weapons and reagents, magic item recyclers, and repair benches. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525716327812169818)
- **guild house repair bench**: A guild house has a repair bench that guild members can use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546500568460173393)
- **guild house steward inn room access**: A guildhouse with a House Steward lets you reach your inn room from the steward, so you can recall to the guildhouse and enter your room; most guilds have one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544038124777119754)
- **guild vendor spots**: Guilds often provide exclusive, cheap or free vendor spots for their members. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551994032270479401)
- **home storage shelf multiple loadouts**: Multiple loadouts for a home storage shelf are possible, either through paid customization unlocks or by using scripts to change the loadout. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536903659835756544)
- **house acquisition**: A player can only get a house in Outlands by buying one from another player or by winning the lottery held when a map expansion occurs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529263344144482495)
- **house and inn room costs**: Houses are a one-time purchase plus ongoing taxes, while inn rooms are rentals. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535668863398707212)
- **house availability and inn rooms**: Free spots to place a house are effectively impossible to find, and an inn room offers nearly everything a house does. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544205680049655858)
- **house decay lottery**: Every house that is not refreshed by its owner goes into the house decay lottery, including its item collection, whereas previously some decaying houses collapsed or only had their items lotteried; players can bet on house ownership and separately choose whether to bet on the item collections from decayed houses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530861460564213760)
- **house door access without key**: To let only chosen people open or enter a house door without a key, unlock the door with the key first, then set the door's permissions as for shelves and chests without clicking apply to all; afterward the key is not needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555722165918113873)
- **house item decay and lockdown**: Items in a house, including those dragged and dropped on the floor, must be secured or locked down or they can decay and disappear. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543062467146424381)
- **house lottery winner lookup**: To check whether your character won a house lottery, search for the entered character's name in the lottery results channel on Discord, where House Decay Lottery results are announced. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539256821124956321)
- **house management speech commands**: In a house, say 'I wish to lock this down', 'I wish to secure this', or 'I wish to release this' and target the item; 'I ban thee' and 'Remove thyself' manage unwanted visitors, 'I wish to place a trash barrel' places a trash barrel, and '[survey' checks for items that can decay. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487284714864705)
- **house placement and resale**: There are currently no free places to place a house; a purchased house can be placed in the bank and sold back to the vendor NPC for only about a 5% loss. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529528482344997116)
- **house placement availability**: There are currently no free spaces left in the world for placing a new house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541169687570686012)
- **house placement availability**: Free space to place a house is very scarce, so players recommend renting an inn room instead; a land expansion is possibly coming later this year, and players who have never owned a house may have a higher chance of getting a ticket for a small house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542122975954993252)
- **house placement spyglass vendor**: The house placement spyglass (Home Surveying Tool) is sold by the architect NPC in Prevalia, not by the real estate vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530848006763577448)
- **house taxes by house count**: House taxes depend on the number of houses on an account: one house has no tax, two houses have a small tax, and three houses have a large tax, calculated on footprint size and applied from the largest to the smallest house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539271042126839838)
- **house warp tile cost**: A warp tile costs about 500k gold and lets you recall or mark a rune inside your house so you never need to use the door. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543111822113120357)
- **houseboat placement**: Houseboats can only be placed at fixed sign points at houseboat docks, so unlike land houses they cannot be placed in any clear spot, and a small houseboat cannot be placed to leave room for another boat beside a larger-size location. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531473801873985547)
- **inn floor item decay time**: An unsecured item thrown on the floor of an inn lasts 1 hour before disappearing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547809097246711849)
- **inn rental rooms**: Inn rental rooms are a safe place to store items and in many ways are better than a house, as a 10k inn room costs far less over years than a 3m caravan. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529263930894057554)
- **inn rental system**: UO Outlands has an inn rental system that lets players rent rooms. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379098387611669)
- **inn room as housing**: Real estate is limited and prized in Outlands, and a room at the inn can serve as a house alternative. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554558822864003184)
- **inn room rent payment**: Inn room rent is taken from the bank of the character that rented the room first, and if that character lacks funds it is then taken from other characters on the same account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539625881205473321)
- **inn room rent payment source**: The Outlands inn rental room takes rent gold from the renter's character, and if that character lacks enough gold, the rent is taken from another character on the same account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539051625258418196)
- **inn room rental storage**: Renting an inn room provides 10 secure containers for storage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526418417316397309)
- **inn room secures and expansion**: Inn rooms can be expanded to double their starting secure count: a small room starts with 2 secures (5k per week) and can go to 4 (10k per week), and a medium room (7500 per week) plus one extra secure (2500) costs the same as a large 4-secure room (10000 per week) but can later expand by 2 more secures. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550043276696887337)
- **inn room storage**: In an inn room, keep non-gold items in a secure bag or chest and only gold in the bank; a fully set up inn room can hold a shelf, repair bench, tomes and a bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550500217248555009)
- **inn rooms vs houses**: Inn rooms (the Rental Room System) function almost identically to a house, with lockdowns and secured chests working the same way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537037874678210570)
- **interior decorator tool**: The Interior Decorator makes it easy to place bags and boxes on top of each other and has a Survey option so you don't forget to lock something down. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533020294191648771)
- **interior decorator tool**: The Interior Decorator tool is used to move and rearrange furniture and items in a house or inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541808120878342215)
- **item decay on ground**: Items that are not locked down or secured decay after about one hour on the ground. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538916905132490904)
- **item storage**: Items are better kept in secured containers such as a secure chest or bag in your inn room or house than in the bank, because thieves can rob you at the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532975132790755531)
- **key inn room essentials**: The most useful quality-of-life items for an inn room are a storage shelf, a resource stockpile, and an item recycler. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521516975669514260)
- **land expansion housing lottery**: Players without houses have a higher chance in the land expansion housing lottery, with about 100 winners per day over roughly 30 days, and a win grants a pass to place an 8x8 small house deed anywhere in the new expansion land, subject to normal placement restrictions; the new land can be explored beforehand. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529869823016960102)
- **land expansion placement race**: Players who do not win an early placement in a land expansion can still try to claim a spot by being online, running to the new area, and placing a house, though it gets chaotic. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522632208819687486)
- **large pearl shell**: A large pearl shell is a decorative item that can be locked down in a rented room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520938454802759741)
- **locked down container lockdown cost**: A locked down container uses one lockdown for itself, and each item placed inside becomes locked down and counts against the home's total lockdowns, so removing items requires releasing the item or the container. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531623822049017967)
- **locked down versus secure containers**: Items in a locked down container cannot be picked up and the container must be released to move items in or out, whereas a secure container lets you put items in and take them out freely. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538917512866177134)
- **locking down items in a rented room**: Items and chests in a rented room must be locked down or secured, especially those holding valuable reagents, or their contents can be lost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544717966430445658)
- **magic item recycler lockdown behavior**: A locked-down Magic Item Recycler still works through its context menu and buttons to add, remove and recycle items, but the raw materials produced by recycling are not locked down and will decay if not removed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537854638894882896)
- **magic items vault capacity**: The Magic Items Vault can store an unlimited number of magic items, but it is expensive for new players to buy. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550059967048982529)
- **magic recycler availability**: Most guilds have at least one magic item recycler in their guildhouse for members to use, and many players also own one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655680086671361)
- **mcd location in stockpile**: MCDs are found in the third tab from the right in the stockpile. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525086759782973440)
- **missing crates**: Dropping one crate on top of another can make it appear that a crate is missing because items can get placed inside other crates, so check inside nearby crates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555148332207448087)
- **moving anvil or forge**: To move an anvil or forge, left click it, choose Convert to deed, and place the deed in the new location; using a hatchet on it also works. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525957471062196265)
- **moving inn room**: To change the town, inn or size of your rented inn room, cancel the current rental (the menu offers a 'Moving Crate' option), pack belongings into moving boxes or your bank, then rent the new room and move in. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533985826512572426)
- **moving stockpiles and shelves**: Resource stockpiles and storage shelves can be moved around your inn room or house without releasing them, and they do not weigh what their contents would weigh. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541807495629242418)
- **moving to a new rental room with a moving crate**: In the old room, double click the door, click End Rent, and click Moving Crate to pack everything into boxes; then rent the new room, go inside, double click the door to get the crate back and unpack it, and lock down or secure the items again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554423647827922995)
- **naming containers on vendors**: Containers on your player vendor can be named; elsewhere you can tell containers apart using dyed bags (cheap) or paragon chests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526812500539080755)
- **natural-colored metal chests**: Natural-colored metal chests are sold by the Prevalia merchant and are exclusive to Prevalia. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537875831169359983)
- **new expansion house placement restrictions**: For the first 30 days after a new land expansion goes live, houses cannot be freely placed in the new region; players win passes through a daily lottery to place a house, and after 30 days placement opens to everyone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529857845372260382)
- **new landmass raffle house size limit**: Raffle winners on the new landmass can initially place only the smallest house size until placement is opened up to everyone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539263443293704244)
- **not-for-sale container restriction**: A container can only be set as not for sale if all items inside it are for sale; items blending into the container background, such as very dark cloth, can make an apparently empty container fail this check. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556063720042668083)
- **npc vendor deeds source**: NPC vendor deeds for houses, such as the Stablemaster Deed, are purchased from the previous merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538438124135256156)
- **pit trial table on test server**: To use the pit trial table on the test server, lock it down by first renting an inn room or placing a house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553475941995388989)
- **player vendor house requirements**: A house must be public for player vendors to be placed and used in it, meaning anyone can open the door, and doors can no longer be locked on houses with vendors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529218520028549140)
- **player vendor rental cost**: Player vendor spots can be rented cheaply, roughly 2.5K to 8K gold (about 3-8K per week), and the process is automated so no landlord contact is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550620273932378215)
- **player vendor rentals**: Many houses rent out player vendor spots, often with vendor rental contracts on the ground that let you rent a vendor for that spot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550810522759331906)
- **preventing house chest despawn**: To keep a chest in a house or inn room from despawning without locking down its contents, secure the container rather than locking it down. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531608519130746982)
- **qol items wiki category**: The Outlands wiki has a QoL category listing an extensive set of Quality of Life items for use on your person and for storage in an inn room or house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553094305780994200)
- **qol storage items**: QoL storage items such as the Storage Shelf are containers that technically hold well over the 125-item container limit and greatly increase available storage space. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092837325799445)
- **real estate broker house prices**: Buying even the smallest house from the real estate broker costs multiple million gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544446902467035259)
- **recovering decayed inn items**: To check what has decayed in your inn room, visit the pawn shop NPC (pawn broker), who holds items lost from your room; in Prevalia this is the pawn broker there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527364655113179176)
- **removing a trash barrel from an inn**: To remove a trash barrel from your inn, double-click an axe and target the barrel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544028675576434808)
- **rental room credits deed allotment**: Each game account under an Outlands ID receives one Rental Room credits deed, and the Prevalia sewers quest grants one additional deed once per Outlands ID. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526671165714595902)
- **rental room non-payment consequences**: If rent on a rental room goes unpaid, no items are lost; the room's contents are moved into the player's bank, unlike a falling house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537038204971126825)
- **rental room rules**: A rental room cannot be rented on an account that already owns a house, but it can be rented on a second or third account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541663970836873227)
- **resource shelf sewing kits**: The resource shelf stores sewing kits as charges rather than as items, so kits intended for recycling must be player-crafted exceptional ones rather than 100-charge kits. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529830969660538972)
- **resource stockpile contents**: The contents of a resource stockpile are specific to that individual stockpile and are not shared between stockpiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552785978362437764)
- **resource stockpile function**: The Resource Stockpile does not craft items itself but acts as the source of resources and also holds crafting tools, so the player need not carry them; it stores crafting materials, arcane scrolls and MCDs, but not orbs or RMs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552293143494267062)
- **resource stockpile placement**: The Resource Stockpile must be locked down in a house, and it cannot be kept in a bank box. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551584743689158737)
- **restock runebooks button scope**: The 'restock runebooks' button on the shelf only refills runebooks in the player's inventory, not locked-down runebooks in the room or house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523375235812950148)
- **resupply target container**: When resupplying items back, Resupply only looks inside the container you target, so target your main backpack (e.g. via the paperdoll) rather than a pouch inside it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532996332787339324)
- **safe vendor restocking**: To restock a vendor safely, either have the house owner secure a friends pouch on the ground, recall in, drop loot in it and stock the vendor, or store goods in the inn, recall onto the vendor, hide, and restock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545126908092485802)
- **salvage master item timer**: Items left on the salvage master have a per-item timer and cannot stay forever; the limit is believed to be 30 days. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523389102232436786)
- **secure house trade window**: A secure pop-up trade window is available when trading a house manually. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522646348363730944)
- **secure versus lock down**: A secure container automatically uses 125 lockdown spaces but lets items move freely in and out, while a locked down normal container does not use 125 slots and auto-locks dropped items, so it suits rarely accessed items; items must be locked down or secured to avoid decay. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554620004417282089)
- **secured containers**: Securing a container instantly consumes 125 lockdowns, after which it works like a normal bag so items can be put in and out without unlocking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554620004417282089)
- **securing a container in a house**: To make a bag or box a secured container, drop it on the ground in your house, say 'I wish to secure this' (without quotes), and target the container. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533019908265218139)
- **securing a house front door**: To secure a house front door, the owner says 'I wish to secure this', targets the door and sets access to owner, co-owner or friends; the owner can unlock it by double clicking the house key, and the door stays locked for everyone else. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543109799863001188)
- **selling a house deed**: To sell a house deed, place it in your bank, go to the real estate vendor, and use the button in the bottom right-hand corner of the menu to sell it back. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524427788680040549)
- **selling registered ships**: A registered ship can be sold without unregistering it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550993287739998430)
- **shared inn room across characters**: All characters on the same account share a rented inn room or house, so items can be shared between all of a player's characters there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548627446545260627)
- **shelf display glitch**: A shelf that refuses trapped pouches may be showing a display glitch: it displays 0 items but is actually full. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530214082588967073)
- **small house lottery priority**: Players who have never owned a house on any account get priority in the small house placement lottery during land expansions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526976701924642888)
- **stocking a vendor safely**: Hide or cast invisibility while stocking a vendor, preferably while friended to the house so you hide automatically, and recall out if red players approach, since thieves may be nearby and trackers need Detect Hidden plus tracking set to include people in houses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461939580342273)
- **storage loadout increments**: Storage loadouts can only be set in increments of 5 for some items such as heal, cure and refresh potions, while a manual withdrawal can take just 1. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543114594174636132)
- **storage locker vs storage shelf**: The storage locker works only from a single character's bank box, while the storage shelf can be placed in a house or inn room and is usable by all of a player's characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541997374191313036)
- **storage shelf and resource stockpile purpose**: The storage shelf and resource stockpile are personal items: the shelf holds loadout items and the stockpile holds crafting resources, whereas recyclers are shared and can be used wherever found. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550389647954149437)
- **storage shelf and stockpile sources**: The Storage Shelf is a player-crafted item bought from player vendors, while the resource stockpile and item recycler are bought from the Prevalia vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540037810050961408)
- **storage shelf armor and weapon quality**: Armor and weapons added to a Storage Shelf must be exceptionally crafted; master crafted items are not accepted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103125857050776)
- **storage shelf aspected items**: Disabling the 'Keep Aspect Items' option should allow aspected items from your inventory to be put back into the storage shelf, provided they are fully repaired; an option on the shelf may otherwise prevent it from accepting aspected items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103859550003220)
- **storage shelf item requirements**: A storage shelf only accepts player-crafted items that are exceptional or mastercrafted and fully repaired, so NPC-bought gear cannot be stocked on it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535473053541081159)
- **storage shelf price**: A storage shelf costs roughly 400k gold to buy, with premade shelves listed around 450k, though prices are approximate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537960364791042069)
- **storage shelf requirements**: Crafted gear and tools placed on a storage shelf must be crafted items (exceptional quality for gear) and at full durability. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528049193372094584)
- **storage shelf runebook recharging**: A storage shelf can automatically recharge runebooks and tomes when you resupply if that setting is enabled on the shelf and it holds recall scrolls, which makes recharging largely automated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535260053744132097)
- **strongbox upgrade benefit**: The strongbox upgrade reduces how often a player must make bank runs, which suits dungeon hunters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555918429989380167)
- **survey tool house fit check**: If the survey tool says a house can fit, then in theory the spot is valid for placing that house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544205935571107850)
- **theft protection in inn room**: Players can be stolen from while in the bank or the inn, but items inside the inn room that they rent cannot be stolen. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538309498190561330)
- **trapped boxes against thieves**: Trapped boxes are a precaution that protects your items against thieves stealing from your containers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539685998617952378)
- **trash barrel and deco tool**: A placed trash barrel cannot be moved with the deco tool. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529631158738882750)
- **trash barrel placement and removal**: To get a trash barrel in a house, say "I wish to place a trash barrel"; remove it either by using a hatchet on it or by clicking it and choosing the remove option in its context menu. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543303186960490566)
- **turning placed tapestry back into deed**: A placed tapestry can be turned back into a deed by Shift+clicking it and choosing the option to convert it back into a deed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526215886187266078)
- **upcoming land expansion**: Another land expansion is reportedly planned with no confirmed date, which would open up more housing room and may bring a land rush where houses cost only the deed price. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546506266103390259)
- **vendor house privacy**: A house used for player vendors needs to be public. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529328940676808826)
- **abandoned house and inn room handling**: If a house owner goes on a break, the house and its contents go into the raffle; if a player misses inn room rent, the room's contents go into the owner's bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536082092872704010)
- **adventure time vendor house free rent**: The Adventure Time vendor house offers 4 weeks of free vendor rent, but the vendor must be kept stocked or the spot is lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524033756439117915)
- **adventurer's satchel nesting**: Adventurer's satchels can be placed inside other adventurer's satchels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525631573590933525)
- **antiquity sorting**: There is currently no in-game way to sort antiquities other than storing them in a chest, despite many requests for a dedicated storage item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536433611736358983)
- **apartment rent payment**: Only one character on the account needs gold in the bank to pay the apartment rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521200499444158637)
- **apply settings to all in house button**: The 'apply settings to all in house' button copies a container's permissions to all other containers, but using it is optional. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523857190354685962)
- **aquarium fish storage**: Caught fish can be placed in an aquarium, which is quite expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532126953036058794)
