- **arcane essence location on test server**: On the Outlands test server, arcane essence is found in the storage pile on the second screen of the 'scroll and bottle' emblem tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529119490573340844)
- **aspect tome chromatics storage**: The aspect tome cannot hold chromatics, although the resource stockpile can. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524789628111159369)
- **attacks inside public houses**: A player can be attacked inside a publicly accessible house, though some houses use scripts to ban troublemakers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461361093550231)
- **auto-stacking items via container**: To auto-stack items, drop them onto the container holding the stack rather than onto the stack itself; in the bank, place a container in the bank, since you cannot drop onto the main bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553964525059842149)
- **available tomes**: Tomes exist for treasure maps, lumber maps, ore maps, fishing maps, skinning maps, skill scrolls, rare cloth (which also holds aspect cloth), dyes, and ship upgrades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549651305855844385)
- **avoiding theft when entering inn room**: To avoid theft, hold the item on your mouse cursor, ride to the inn, enter your room using a hotkey or script, then drop the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535075946485256222)
- **backpack item storage**: Players should avoid placing items directly in their backpack and instead use the inn room with organizers to place and retrieve items in trapped boxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175665382457407)
- **bag item capacity**: Bags in Ultima Online: Outlands can hold a maximum of 125 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238197853786122)
- **balcony attack risk in private houses**: In a private house you can be attacked if you stand too close to a balcony or terrace edge, because players outside can throw explosive potions at you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552488863958704160)
- **bandage equivalent of potion satchel**: There is no bandage equivalent of the potion satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527427682269401282)
- **bank box capacity for new players**: A new player's bank box fills up quickly, and renting a room gives extra storage; a full bank box cannot accept anything, even gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529233312755875870)
- **bank box item limit**: A bank box holds at most 125 items, so tomes, stockpile and other containers can be used to store loot instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532975497162788988)
- **bank box sharing**: Your bank box is the same at every bank location because banks are linked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526135157331988660)
- **bank deposit safe**: A bank deposit safe only deposits gold into the bank; other items such as wood and iron must be placed in the bank box manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532974995142217750)
- **bank deposit safe and checkbook**: The bank deposit safe and the checkbook let players handle banking without traveling to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523007904859291788)
- **bank deposit safe in inn room**: A bank deposit safe can be placed in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523601536985600030)
- **bank deposit safe priority**: The bank deposit safe is a very low-priority purchase and does little for players with many upcoming expenses or progression needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523029324662575264)
- **bank queue system**: The bank has a queue system: when it is full at 125 items, extra items are queued and enter as space becomes available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542953415460528210)
- **bank safety**: Players advise using the bank only for currency because items other than currency stored there are considered unsafe from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527429198791049326)
- **bank safety from thieves**: Banks are not very safe because of thieves, so renting a room is recommended for storing valuables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537043535386386432)
- **bank space filling from looted magic items**: Collecting all magic items from the shelter dungeon on a new account fills the bank quickly, which pushes players toward renting an inn room for extra storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528106963940933752)
- **bank storage advice**: Ideally only gold should be kept in the bank, with other items stored elsewhere such as an inn room or house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526673813415133336)
- **bank storage limit**: The bank limit is both item-count and weight based, roughly 125 items or 25000 stones, whichever is reached first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534368908822450306)
- **bank theft risk**: Thieves can and will rob you at the bank, so the inn room is pretty much the only safe place outside of private houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525628729337053316)
- **bank versus home storage**: Each character has its own individual bank, but a home is a common storage area accessible to all of a player's characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525178225716629735)
- **banning people from a house with a vendor**: A player who has a vendor in a house can probably ban people from that house, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552461885742383165)
- **battle trainer on test shard**: On the test shard you can buy a house, place it, and buy the battle trainer from the Prevalia shop; the battle trainer can also be placed in an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824585579335721)
- **bed crafting costs**: Beds made through the carpenter's artisan furniture are very expensive to make, while tailor-made beds are considerably more affordable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614240004939878)
- **beds**: Beds in the game are only decorations and cannot be used for sleeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525868257326661704)
- **best housing option for new players**: An Inn Room is the best housing option for new players, since even the smallest house costs millions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525515936260554763)
- **best inn rooms**: Horseshoe Bay is claimed to have the best inn rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294598472372264)
- **blank scroll storage**: Blank scrolls belong in the stockpile, not the storage shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526395082293383239)
- **blessed gold house keys**: Blessed gold keys come with a house and are used to lock and unlock the house doors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543235890099396628)
- **blessed item incinerator in prevalia**: An incinerator in Prevalia destroys blessed items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536473022817636533)
- **blessed item weight in strong box**: Blessed items stored in a strong box weigh nothing, so players can keep all their blessed items in one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528447131646693537)
- **blessed runebook**: A blessed runebook stays with you if you die but is expensive, while an unblessed runebook can be kept locked down in your inn room to save money. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546762240412356749)
- **blocking a house front door**: You can block a house's front door by placing a locked-down box in the doorway, ideally in the middle; you need to buy the warp tile so you can mark inside the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529335870203887778)
- **board commodity deed capacity**: Board commodity deeds in Outlands hold 5,000 boards each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549029597125943309)
- **boat item management**: A boat must be taken off the dock master before items can be added to or removed from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549422557797683283)
- **breeding troughs**: Mount breeding involves managing many troughs, which can be stacked to save space in a room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533877611804234020)
- **bulk discarding items with organizer**: To quickly discard many items, use Razor > Agents > Organizer and target your trash barrel; saying "I wish to place a trash barrel" in your room creates one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522870863748268102)
- **buying from player vendors in guarded zones**: Items are supposed to be buyable from a player vendor placed in a guarded zone, but this is untested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553892122422411361)
- **campfire placement in loft room**: Campfires cannot be placed on the default standing tile of the loft room even in an empty room, but can be placed after stepping off the tile and back onto it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529565004016386208)
- **camping item storage**: The reusable camping item can be stored in a storage shelf or storage locker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527325394980573266)
- **cancelling an inn room**: To cancel an inn room, use the house sign on a house, then double click the door inside the inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528842902564901015)
- **caravan home price**: A caravan home can sometimes be bought from other players for around 800k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612138082304091)
- **carpentry locked chests**: Carpentry can be used to craft locked chests, which protect stored items from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538722950835081236)
- **changing inn room size**: To change an Outlands inn room from small to medium, cancel the current room contract and start a new one, using moving crates to transfer items; this is believed but not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520560110206718094)
- **changing won house type via neighboring house**: One player won a house, bought the house next door to move it over one tile so they could change the house type they won, then sold both. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523324224851279972)
- **checking vendor rent cost**: To see how much a vendor spot costs to rent, double click the locked down scroll at a vendor house, which displays the rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524017679667691630)
- **circleoftransparency house viewing and forge use**: Enable CircleOfTransparency to see into houses; if a forge sits next to a wall, you can use it while standing outside the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522779191895003257)
- **clearing restock shelf activity log**: Only the house owner can clear the activity log on a restock shelf, according to an in-game message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532873896506818630)
- **closed vendor contents**: When a player vendor is closed or dismissed, its items and gold are typically sent to the owner's bank, and no reports of lost gold are known. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553061099052728391)
- **closing a rental room**: Closing a rental room dumps everything into your bank, with items removed from their boxes and left loose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551096709273227345)
- **cloth storage in tome**: Cloth can be stored in the tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538276133014085752)
- **co-owners across accounts**: Characters on a player's other accounts (accounts 2 and 3) can be added as co-owners of a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527585696913559706)
- **codex storage in satchel**: An adventurer's satchel can be used to hold codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527160637598208120)
- **colored material commodity deed capacity**: Commodity deeds for colored materials in Outlands hold 2,500 units each, versus 5,000 for plain board deeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549043782719377430)
- **confirming vendor item price**: After entering a price in a player vendor's price field, click the gem next to the price field to confirm it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554133091369615381)
- **container capacity**: All containers are equal in capacity and hold 125 items each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526604221581885481)
- **container capacity upgrades scope**: Increases to carry capacity or bank storage apply only to the base container (backpack or bank), not to containers inside it, so an individual pouch in your backpack still holds only 125 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092155587698709)
- **container item limit and carry capacity**: No container holds more than 125 items, and the Redline endgame system can increase carry capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553089035780497500)
- **convenience items**: A bank vault, checkbook, and tomes are useful convenience items, and tomes also help declutter house chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520402844308734092)
- **counters and wizard's satchel**: On-screen counters can occasionally stop seeing items stored in a Wizard's Satchel, so the bag may need to be left open for them to be counted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536897824116183263)
- **courtyard rune marking**: Courtyards may still allow marking runes without a warp tile, with permissions settable on the sign, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527634924641718543)
- **crafting from storage shelf**: Players cannot craft directly from items stored in a storage shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527424884517372044)
- **crewmember storage tome**: There is probably no tome or dedicated storage for crewmembers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532817275206504588)
- **crook activation in trapper pouch**: A crook can be kept activated inside a trapper pouch together with a musical instrument. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522383610773246022)
- **custom house design**: Outlands has no in-game custom house design; houses are not designed by players in game, though some player-created designs were submitted as files and added to the shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525512919369121813)
- **decorating tool survey on close**: Use the survey on close option at the bottom of the decorating tool to confirm you did not forget to lock down anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554621181812801549)
- **decoration sources**: Much of the decoration in Outlands is sold by the Prevalia merchant, often as seasonal or limited-time items that sometimes return for sale again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554614084627075097)
- **deed-placed furniture lockdown**: Furniture placed in a house using a deed does not need to be locked down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543062366252433498)
- **default storage shelf colors**: The default storage shelf has two colors, dull and regular, which can be cycled by rotating it with the interior decorator. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530957477212848300)
- **discarding unwanted items**: Unwanted items can be discarded by dropping them anywhere on the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536473621546016778)
- **dismissing a vendor**: To dismiss a vendor, open the help menu, choose My Vendors, click the blue button, then click Dismiss at the bottom right; all items and gold are sent to your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521609469354705038)
- **dismissing vendors with items**: A vendor that still holds items cannot be dismissed, so it must be emptied first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521612028152910054)
- **distribution chest as bank deposit alternative**: A distribution chest can replace the bank deposit safe by sending any item to your bank when you put yourself alone on the distro list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523031931837481042)
- **dm house definition**: A DM house is a house that can house a dockmaster and is capable of launching a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535245808038051850)
- **dock master use in other players' houses**: A dock master typically cannot be used in someone else's house, but it can be used if the owner makes the house public or friends you and sets access to friends. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523385154322563183)
- **docking command at a house**: When docking at a house, say [dock, though the exact command is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531958125580521472)
- **dockmaster house distance limit**: The distance limit for a house to use a dockmaster is measured in tiles, with the house needing to be within 18 tiles of the water. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522678770207690934)
- **dockmaster placement**: A dockmaster can be added to any house or inn, but it can only launch a ship if the house is close enough to the water. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522679240544354394)
- **dyeing carpet tiles**: To dye a dyable carpet tile, keep it in your backpack and apply the dye twice; this is recalled from memory and may be inexact. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554593905310310461)
- **early housing purchases**: The magic item vault, resource stock and shelf are among the most worthwhile early purchases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550065341466542083)
- **early room rental deed**: Renting a room early grants a 10K deed worth 2 weeks of rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520721989180854322)
- **economizing lockdowns with secured containers**: Secure the containers you use often and lock down the ones you use less often to economize lockdown slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531623822049017967)
- **editing a storage book**: To edit something on a storage book, use the >info command and target the book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551803797922127945)
- **empty house spot creation**: An empty house spot appears only when someone intentionally drops a home to place a different one, or when a home is demolished and its placement timer expires, believed to be about 30 minutes though possibly an hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530861460564213760)
- **emptying bomb box with a shelf**: Targeting a bomb box with a shelf (QOL item) at home removes all items the shelf can store from the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527623885942427698)
- **entering a private house behind the owner**: Another player can run into a private house behind the owner after the door is opened, but can only take what the owner carries if they kill the owner inside before the owner says 'I ban thee'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543108875908153364)
- **entering inn room with item on cursor**: You can enter your inn room via the innkeeper's 'Room' option while holding a bank item on the cursor, and the item never touches your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544043577519116298)
- **event item storage**: The trophy hutch stores many event items and the prevalia trunk stores the exclusive purchases from Jakesh; no storage for antiquities is known. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536341139043655781)
- **exiting inn room after death**: If you die inside your inn room, double-click the inn room door to exit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250301948960769)
- **expansion landmass house placement**: The expansion landmass does not become crowded with house placements until it is opened to everyone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537217174471573555)
- **extra loadout profiles**: Creating additional loadouts on the storage shelf requires unlocking extra profiles, found under Customisations for a price. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550442195746562090)
- **extra secures for rented rooms**: Additional secures can reportedly be purchased for a rented inn room, though the author was not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525192969320267786)
- **finding houses for sale**: Houses for sale are listed in the Real Estate Discord channel and through a broker south of the Prevalia bank whose in-game sign lists houses, with prices starting around a million gold and up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525960977206480906)
- **finding unlocked items after changing rental rooms**: To find items not locked down in a house after changing rental rooms, use the [survey command or a decorating tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551663850141651116)
- **finding vendor rentals**: Vendor malls and vendor rental areas can be found by asking the Shelter advertisers, who list available rentals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524532765792538834)
- **first house quality-of-life item**: The Storage Shelf is typically the first quality-of-life item players get for a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523007904859291788)
- **fixing a malfunctioning recycler filter**: If the Magic Item Recycler filter seems to malfunction, unsecure the recycler and then place and secure it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548544875706720347)
- **free inn rent credit for new accounts**: The first character on each account gets a 10K gold inn room rental credit (about 2 free weeks, tradeable to whoever rents the room), and the first completion of the Prevalia sewers quest per Outlands ID grants another 10K credit, totalling about 8 free weeks on the smallest inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536081939461574656)
- **full bank workarounds**: When a bank is full, players can rent an inn room, pass items to other characters to hold, use a player vendor, or break down magic items for essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534905514373415033)
- **furniture default color reset item**: An item reportedly returns furniture to its default color, but it likely does not give back any dye colors previously used on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474781073154049)
- **furniture dye recovery**: A furniture dye is likely not recoverable once applied to a piece of furniture, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548474781073154049)
- **future housing expansion**: A future housing expansion is reportedly planned and would be the next opportunity to place a new house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537166475826303088)
- **gems in resource stockpile**: Gems are used in the Resource Stockpile furniture item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553033536938705108)
- **giant castle secures**: A giant castle in Ultima Online: Outlands provides 80 secures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528241033576452269)
- **glowing barrel container**: The glowing barrel is used for decoration and storage and has one of the largest container gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529873271963652096)
- **glowing barrels**: Glowing Barrels are empty barrels usable for organizing items; they can be found via portal vendor search and are costly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527853951049793697)
- **going afk safely**: When going AFK, do it inside your house or room rather than in public, and bank items in a pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534307010017755298)
- **gold location for rental room payment**: Gold used to buy or pay for a rental room must be in the bank, not in the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533988392054947853)
- **guild bank deposit safe access**: A guild gives access to a bank deposit safe, which can also be bought by donating 25 prev coins, or possibly for about 500k gold if not going through prev. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550499751466901615)
- **guild hall eligibility**: Any house can be made a guild hall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552544224669335603)
- **guild house battle trainer**: If you are in a guild, there should be a battle trainer at the guild house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552589945347117117)
- **guild house rune books for trading**: A guild house can hold a set of locked-down rune books that players can use to recall to trading locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533763092897333308)
- **guild house witcher runes**: A guild house should have a set of Witcher runes available to guild members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623846729744395)
- **guild houses and ownership limit**: Normal guild houses count toward the house ownership limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143591693951106)
- **guild secure house vendor protection**: A guild's secure house is hoped to keep thieves out and thereby protect player vendors, though this depends on the guild having one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521900220072595578)
- **guild teleport to inn room storage**: Guild members can teleport to the guild with their loot and go to their inn room to deposit goods without visiting town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538399547590582323)
- **hair and beard dye storage**: All hair and beard dyes, including those labeled rare, go in the single dye tome; the name 'rare dye tome' is only a name, and opening the tome lists what can go in it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549650478575394848)
- **heavy loot bag and strongbox deeds**: A loot bag holding a lot of gold or ore can be too heavy to loot and is not recognized by strongbox deeds, because the strongbox weight effect only counts items in your bag, so remove the gold from the bag first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537430337867616326)
- **heavy stack storage**: Heavy stacks can be kept in a bank box or in locked down containers, which avoids carrying them on the character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538415366454116363)
- **hiding skill in vendor house**: Players with a vendor in a house automatically get 100 hiding skill while inside that house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525165273546621038)
- **home ownership limit**: Technically the limit is 3 homes per player, where a home can be either a room or a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531734492270559463)
- **homes of inactive players**: Homes of players who have quit the game are placed in a lottery, and homes are also frequently sold by players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612728263086301)
- **house agreement cancellation item handling**: When you cancel a house agreement, the items inside go to your bank, and shipping crates can be used to store items when moving or upgrading. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550889843590955060)
- **house auction start message**: The house auction start message is informational only, announcing a new listing on the auction broker, and you do not need to be present to win. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534529397502115850)
- **house availability options**: All house spots are currently taken, so players can try the house lottery, rent an inn room, or buy a house from another player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530847054731939981)
- **house ban scope**: Bans from a house are account-wide, so a ban on a red or thief character also affects the other characters on the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537073750435172434)
- **house building and availability**: Players cannot build houses in Outlands and can only buy and place pre-made custom houses, and because there is currently no room for new homes, existing placed houses must be bought. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537542736326951035)
- **house chest access for friends**: A secured chest set to owner/co-owners only cannot be opened by a friend of the house; the owner can set a lower secure level or promote the friend to co-owner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554985461850841110)
- **house chest access restriction**: A house chest can be set to restrict access so that only the owner and co-owners can open it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541063657654321275)
- **house commands**: House commands include "I wish to lock this down", "I wish to secure this", "I wish to release this", "I ban thee", "Remove thyself", "I wish to place a trash barrel", and "[survey", which checks for items that can decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607819171307541)
- **house container co-owner permissions**: A house container set to 'Co-owner' permissions cannot be opened by friends of the owner, so friend-level access needs a different permission setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554988547365408840)
- **house context menu differences for non-friends**: The context menu entries differ in a house you are not a friend of, because the eject option is not present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524771190420537515)
- **house courtyard rune marking**: Houses with a courtyard allow runes to be marked within them, and the owner can set permissions for who can recall to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525394491165511690)
- **house decay**: If you are away from the game for about a month, your house decays and everything in it is lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521629338066223315)
- **house decay lottery claiming**: When you win the house decay lottery, you can choose which items to claim one at a time using the lottery ticket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531137785094869083)
- **house decay lottery ticket notification**: Anyone holding a ticket in the House Decay Lottery receives a system message at the bottom right of the screen along with a sound. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539254668725715025)
- **house decay lottery timing**: Houses enter the house decay lottery when owners fail to refresh them within about 21 days, and a house in the lottery collapses roughly 5 days after it is announced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529855914033680404)
- **house deed placement**: Buying a house deed does not guarantee a place to put it, so find a location before buying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535669053559930930)
- **house deed resale value**: A house deed can be sold back for roughly 90% of the price paid. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549082218125729825)
- **house door access setting**: Do not set a house door's access to 'anyone', because then anyone not added to the house can open the door. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543109976078286900)
- **house footprint upgrade**: To get a larger house footprint, cancel the current room and rent another; choose the Moving Crates option when cancelling to move your items, otherwise everything is deposited in your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527132154184597585)
- **house for sale listing refresh**: A house listed for sale on its sign does not need its listing refreshed, but the owner still needs to refresh the house itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529853468683272304)
- **house invite nearby players menu position**: The 'invite nearby players' context menu option in a house changes position depending on whether or not you are already in a party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524768695803445400)
- **house lotteries**: UO Outlands holds house lotteries where players can buy tickets to potentially win homes that have been abandoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379100056817777)
- **house lottery and inn ownership**: If you win a house in the lottery, your inn closes down, so you should not enter the lottery on the account that owns the inn; the inn room's contents also go to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532056202727653678)
- **house lottery duration**: The NPC for house lotteries tells you how long a lottery runs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532054480118353960)
- **house lottery ticket cap**: There is no cap on the number of tickets sold in a house ownership lottery; the total depends on how many players buy tickets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544346882409762916)
- **house lottery ticket purchase**: The house lottery vendor sells tickets in quantities of 1, 10 or 100 and shows the area where each house is located. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529190589529063475)
- **house lottery total tickets**: The total number of tickets purchased for a house lottery is not shown anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529187833162498152)
- **house lottery winner guarantee**: Every house lottery draw always produces a winner of the main prize, with no rollover and no secondary prizes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529191490172092446)
- **house lottery winning odds**: Getting close to a 50% chance of winning a house lottery would likely cost more in tickets than the house is worth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544357399941353544)
- **house lotto**: The House Lotto lets players buy a ticket for 1000 gold for a chance to win a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544104899904798747)
- **house material storage item**: The house item for storing materials such as ingots and leather is called a Resource Stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532838762277769266)
- **house patio line of sight risk**: Some patios and courtyards in player houses have line of sight from outside the house, so players can be attacked from outside while afk there; staying afk inside the house is safer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549523011760038001)
- **house placement and new landmass**: House placement is currently pre-Felucca style with scarce housing, and a new landmass is likely to be added within the next couple of months. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537037874678210570)
- **house placement availability**: There are currently no open spots to place a house; houses can be won in the house raffle, and new spots are expected with the upcoming expansion, with special rules for the first few weeks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536080804319592528)
- **house placement lottery**: New house placement is usually run as a lottery at launch, and accounts on which no character has ever owned a house have a higher chance of winning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556005756304760883)
- **house placement protection after dropping**: After you drop a house, other players cannot place a house nearby for 30 minutes unless they are in the same guild, and blessed deeds provide further protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539264702171844679)
- **house plot availability**: All house plots are currently owned by players, so finding a free plot is very unlikely, but smaller homes can be bought fairly easily and rental rooms are a cheap alternative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524887062375829504)
- **house prices**: Houses are bought from other players for millions of gold, with a recent cheap listing around 3.5 million rather than the 250k deed price on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526138219513516032)
- **house prices**: House prices in Outlands start in the many millions of gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539218084655530065)
- **house queue and shipping crate expiry**: The house queue has no time limit, while items in shipping crates disappear forever after about 14 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550893644720906344)
- **house raffle keys**: If you win a house raffle, the house keys are placed in your bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533178028740448498)
- **house raffle ticket cost**: A house raffle ticket costs 1,000 gold and can win a large property such as a castle or the Cambrian Farmstead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536082302558408775)
- **house rental secures upgrade limit**: From inside the same room, a house rental's secures can only be upgraded up to double the number it started with. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527131899561119844)
- **house replacement window**: After you demolish a house to place a new one, there is a short window in which others cannot place a house on that spot unless they are you or in your party, but the protection is not absolute, so act quickly and carefully. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551619866908164210)
- **house sale method**: House sales should generally be done by buying the house directly off its sign for a gold amount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522645509150609591)
- **house sign ownership display**: House owners can choose whether to show their name or guild on the house sign, so ownership is not always visible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551649118492041270)
- **house storage starter containers**: Any container (pouch, bag, or backpack) can be used to start storing items in a house, as long as you use the lock down or secure commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552060949890994329)
- **house survey in inn rooms**: The house survey hotkey is believed to work from inn rooms too, but the messages it generates there have not been verified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554395192797433889)
- **house tax display on sign**: Your house taxes, based on the houses on your account, can be viewed on your housing sign. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539271171001028668)
- **house taxes**: Only secondary and tertiary houses incur taxes; a player's first house does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524503775585239150)
- **houseboats blocking waterways**: Houseboats can block waterways, sometimes entirely, which limits boat access and lowers the value of some boat houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529875169076842666)
- **houses for sale listing**: Houses for sale are listed by the Real Estate Vendor NPC in-game, and a real estate channel also lists them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **housing lottery announcements**: Outlands staff announce the expansion housing lottery in advance as a published event, so it is not sprung on players unannounced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526978307751416059)
- **housing lottery newer player definition**: For the housing lottery, newer players means players who have never owned a house before; a rental room does not count as owning a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526979195358675055)
- **housing lottery ticket tracking**: Housing lottery tickets are not stored as separate items; the lotto gump itself keeps count of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537971332380237954)
- **housing plot availability**: Housing plots only become available when a player intentionally removes their home without replacing it, or when several homes are consolidated into one larger home that leaves enough space for a new home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612234211696660)
- **housing tax calculator tool**: The Outlands Butler website provides a housing taxes calculator at outlandsbutler.com/housingtaxes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539271477323632741)
- **howling wolf cosmetic pet behavior**: The howling wolf cosmetic pet may not howl on its own until it is locked down, similar to the Halloween cat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525250344374894652)
- **idoc houses and guild fights**: Some houses in danger of collapsing (IDOC) are fought over by guilds, and a portion of them goes to the lottery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529190339884093490)
- **idoc lottery and inn rooms as housing options**: Players can obtain a house by winning the IDOC lottery, and the inn room system is another housing option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544447242017050695)
- **idoc lottery odds for new players**: Over roughly a month, about 60% of IDOC lotteries were won by the same group of people, so buying only 1-2 tickets is not a reliable way for a new player to get housing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544474515965218968)
- **immaculate stone table dyeing**: The Immaculate Stone Table cannot be dyed with curio dye even though furniture dye works on it, possibly because of an oversight in the list of items curio dyes accept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543003235839905903)
- **inactivity and housing loss**: Accounts and characters are not deleted for inactivity, but housing is lost if the owner does not log in for 30 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554561281791492251)
- **inn credit scope**: Inn credit applies across the whole account but is not shared across the Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539630364635562004)
- **inn rental and vendor spots for new players**: Outlands has an inn rental system and a decent number of cheap or free vendor spots, so new players without a house miss out on little. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524426719648284742)
- **inn rental deed stacking**: Inn rental deeds from multiple characters can be stacked on one character, giving almost 2 free months of a basic inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534598774549381253)
- **inn rental room storage**: Enter a rental room from any inn building, including inns outside guard zones, and use it to store items instead of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523835131268173896)
- **inn rental rooms**: Inn rental rooms give much more storage than the bank, have no thieves, and allow easy item trading between characters of the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525409018649251900)
- **inn room access**: A player's inn room can be accessed from any inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525622184297631805)
- **inn room bank transfer limit**: Sending more than 125 items from a rental room to the bank places them in a bank queue, and carrying items back to the inn risks theft by thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545554393498128424)
- **inn room barkeeper**: An inn rental room can have a barkeeper, which is obtained from the inn keeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537554060293574726)
- **inn room basic storage**: To get basic storage in an inn room, drop a bag on the room floor, say "I wish to secure this", and target the bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526735874753036460)
- **inn room contract cancellation**: When an inn room contract is cancelled, all lockdowns in the room, including secured containers and the resource stockpile with its contents, are sent to the player's bank box by default, or to the moving crate if that option is set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554589673307902023)
- **inn room contract thieves**: After an inn room contract ends, players should beware of thieves while removing their items from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529377299768672326)
- **inn room eviction before storage shelf**: Before owning a storage shelf, being kicked out of your inn room can take hours to restore (about 3 hours each time for one player). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546363050028699649)
- **inn room exit location**: To make an inn room exit to Outpost instead of Prevalia, cancel the current contract and rent a room in Outpost; a Moving Crate option is available to transfer items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535162262736871424)
- **inn room item decay**: Items in an inn room that are not in a secured container can decay, and trash barrels in the room dispose of their contents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527364544601526422)
- **inn room limit per account**: Only one inn room is allowed per account, so additional characters on the same account share that room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550783571319455855)
- **inn room mount storage**: You cannot upgrade an inn room to stash your mount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532783811073544382)
- **inn room quality-of-life items**: Quality-of-life items usable in an inn room include the storage shelf, resource stockpile, bank box and collection tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525609807971881123)
- **inn room render proximity**: Inn rooms are often placed near the edge of render distance of other players' inn rooms, so parts of neighboring rooms can sometimes be seen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545835804301987943)
- **inn room rent default consequence**: If the renter cannot pay rent on an inn rental room, they are kicked out and their items are sent to the bank or bank queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525387642080985109)
- **inn room rent payment**: Inn room rent cannot be pre-paid; it is automatically pulled from the owner's bank every week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521628472282451998)
- **inn room rental**: You can rent an inn room in the town where you want to be based. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525606666152837281)
- **inn room rental upkeep**: Gold deposited on the account that owns an inn room is used to keep the room rented, so the room can persist through long breaks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528056090384924834)
- **inn room safety deposit box**: The safety deposit box in an inn room only allows sending gold, and nothing else, to the bank without visiting the bank in person. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552768505143894140)
- **inn room secure containers**: An inn rental room does not come with secure containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525410579341119519)
- **inn room secure expansion**: In an Outlands inn room, the number of secured items can be expanded, but this does not change the room size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520558882915745924)
- **inn room secure limit**: An Inn room in Ultima Online: Outlands can have only 9 secures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238197853786122)
- **inn room security**: Inn rooms are fully secure as long as you do not invite anybody, but items must be locked down or secured or they will decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528093921979273336)
- **inn room sharing**: An inn room in Ultima Online: Outlands is shared with all characters on your main account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554235921598128209)
- **inn room storage**: A rented inn room provides storage for ingots and other resources in addition to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548845510805159988)
- **inn room storage**: A rented inn room holds much more than a bank box and avoids the risk of carrying valuables to and from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526135656059768852)
- **inn room storage of valuables**: Valuable items such as a sealed paragon chest can be taken to your inn room for safe storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549142802397659157)
- **inn room storage shelf cost**: Storage shelves and magic item recyclers for inn rooms are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522264948770738217)
- **inn room storage shelf for training**: A storage shelf in an inn room can be used to train skills and to stockpile reagents for leveling magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525625842422517841)
- **inn room styles reference**: The Rental Room System wiki page shows the available inn room styles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607702565716054)
- **inn room tomes**: Inn room storage provides tomes for maps, skill scrolls, dye and rare cloth. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549974036585381909)
- **inn room vs house**: An inn room functions much like a house for storage and use, so a house is not strictly needed and is largely a matter of prestige. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539592939007639582)
- **inn rooms and houses**: Inn rooms are considered very good, making a house generally an extra luxury, and houses sell for millions of gold on the shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529530750339252405)
- **inn rooms and idoc protection**: Inn rooms protect your items from loss in an IDOC (in danger of collapse) situation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544106085290475553)
- **inn rooms location**: Inn rooms are located in the Malas facet, which is now basically a void that exists for inn rooms and has no traversable tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545835163731238912)
- **insta-logging locations**: You can insta-log at any friendly home or inn foyer, even without renting an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537088723009675376)
- **interior decorator for lockdowns**: Using an Interior Decorator prevents you from forgetting to lock down items in your house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536471194629439609)
- **interior decorator item layering**: Items placed with the interior decorator can layer on top of one another or go below a floor and appear lost, but they are still there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526698224222736456)
- **invisibly blessed items**: Some items, such as storage shelves, are invisibly blessed and cannot be stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542471805145583656)
- **item storage habits**: Players commonly store items in their inn room and use bags, boxes, and secured containers for organization. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533718499468509305)
- **item storage tomes**: Tomes exist for storing nearly every type of item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524789198882603069)
- **items left in lapsed rented room**: Items left in a rented room after the lease ends are sent to your bank in a crate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542947889482047538)
- **items left on the ground**: Items left on the ground vanish after a while, so they must be locked down or secured to be kept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546577295706431569)
- **keeping the world atlas**: To keep the World Atlas rather than have it deleted, place it inside a secure chest or bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538321642676162581)
- **key copying and blanks**: Keys likely cannot be copied on Outlands, though key blanks exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541547324831178752)
- **kings faire bank box item movement**: In Kings Faire, items that can be equipped in the weapon or shield slot, such as weapons and lanterns, cannot be moved within the bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541085592958402634)
- **land expansion house lottery**: In the last land expansion, houses were awarded by lottery, and players who had never owned a house on any account had a much better chance of winning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550982378057371659)
- **land expansion placement passes**: Roughly every couple of years UO Outlands gets a large land expansion, and players who have never had a home are favored in the first 30 days to win a placement pass allowing them to place a house in the new area before it opens to everyone else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379296425869383)
- **landmass expansion home lotteries**: Each new landmass expansion is followed by a month of daily lotteries that award players the right to place a home in the new area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544107276036481174)
- **lanterns not recyclable**: Lanterns cannot be recycled into cloth; they are useful as light source decoration for your home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537265016489640016)
- **large gump containers**: The harvest bushel and canopic jars are also containers with large gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529877600913195068)
- **large island near w351 housing**: The large island near W351 has almost every house owned by Kor and has no vendors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534481114620498012)
- **larger room rentals**: No room rentals larger than the two-story inn room have been announced; that room was added roughly 1-2 years ago. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548440851435495487)
- **listing vendors in a house**: Double clicking a house sign and clicking on vendors lists the vendors in that house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532679504336781523)
- **living out of bank box**: Living out of your bank box is not recommended because of thieves, limited storage, and difficulty sharing items between characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530904108645486622)
- **loadout needs without echoes**: A character without echoes should not need more than one loadout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550445951984992287)
- **lock box key storage**: A character with Tinkering gets a key when crafting a lock box; players carry a lock box while farming to store items, unlocking it with the key, moving items inside and locking it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555395441515040771)
- **locked chest protection from thieves**: After buying an item, put it in a locked chest before unhiding to protect it from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584395871326281)
- **locked down distribution chest**: A locked-down Distribution Chest is likely to behave like the Magic Item Recycler, but because it creates no new resources it should have no decay concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537855031318159502)
- **locking down and securing items with the decorator tool**: With the Interior Decorator tool, click an item such as a bag or chest and choose lock down, release (if it is locked down), or secure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538497680932864062)
- **locking down qol items in houses**: All QOL items can be locked down in a house, though some may have limited functionality when only locked down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523830786372145213)
- **looting corpse of player who died on roof**: Someone inside a house (public or private) with access to a corpse can probably loot the corpse of a player who died on the roof, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549524733899575487)
- **magic item box storage**: A magic item box can be used to store an item safely so it is not lost to PKs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521670894097797201)
- **magic item chest**: A magic item chest that stores a practically unlimited number of items can eventually be obtained. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551258673832263864)
- **magic item recycler**: The Magic Recycler is a costly but very convenient house item that can identify and recycle items at the click of a button, is charged with ID wands, and is typically provided by guilds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527694024968769536)
