- **magic item storage**: Magic items are stored in a separate storage from the crafted-gear storage shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522721875162038376)
- **mah account house and skinning restrictions**: MAH accounts reportedly cannot own a house and cannot be used for skinning, for example on a boater or backstabber character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537962803107991562)
- **making a house public**: To make a house public, double-click the house sign and choose the option to make the house public. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529215350657257692)
- **map tome add all in backpack**: The Add All In Backpack option on the map tome should work for adding maps to the new map tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536780735061565581)
- **map tomes and magic item vault**: Map tomes can be bought to store treasure maps, and a magic item vault can be bought to keep loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520924827538686042)
- **marking runes inside a house**: To mark runes inside a house you need to purchase a warp tile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527634757620465726)
- **moving a trash barrel**: To move a trash barrel within a room, go to the new spot and say the placement command again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530047576639017152)
- **moving crate for inn room to house transfer**: A moving crate makes it easier to transfer items from an inn room to a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550890428981837916)
- **moving crates and resource stockpile**: Packing a rental room with moving crates keeps resource stockpile contents in place in the stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554380624679407697)
- **moving crates option when closing rented room**: When closing a rented room, select the moving crates option to make it easier to move your belongings to the next room; otherwise all items end up in your bank when the room closes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520619624067239936)
- **moving goods from house to rental room**: You can demolish a house and take moving crates to move goods, but a rental room cannot be rented until the house has been given to another player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532820800951029940)
- **moving items between characters**: The inn room system can be used to move items between characters, since there is no mail system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526994390550183936)
- **moving items home from bank safely**: To move an item home safely from the bank, nest a couple of pouches plus the item in your bank, drop the nested stack in a bag (not at root level), then recall home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535076194872066109)
- **moving large stacks into containers**: If a large stack won't fit in a container, likely due to weight, put a small portion in the container first, then drop the rest of the stack onto the container itself to merge them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553489195241316523)
- **moving materials from inn to vendor safely**: To move materials from your inn to your vendor, recall directly to the vendor, hide as soon as you arrive, and carry valuables in a locked box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534308875862409349)
- **moving rental room contents to a house**: To move a rental room's contents to a house, end the rent on the inn room's account to receive a moving box, then take that character to the house and use the box by double clicking the house sign; the house may be bought on a different account, or the rent may be ended before buying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527584900738322623)
- **moving shelf items to resource stockpile**: To move items quickly from a storage shelf to the resource stockpile, keep commodity deeds in the shelf, pull items out as commodities, then grab them from yourself using the stockpile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527425715862114427)
- **moving stockpile items to shelf**: Moving reagents and potions from the stockpile to a shelf is not easy, but may be scriptable, and taking them out as commodities may help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522388779917381753)
- **moving tomes safely**: To move tomes between a rental room and the bank, put them in a lockbox, or at minimum in a trapped pouch inside a trapped pouch, to protect them from theft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545463033357148251)
- **multi-level house access**: In a multi-level house such as the windmill, upper levels are reached by stairs on the outside right of the house rather than the front door, so both the stairs and the front door must be blocked, and only one spot can be marked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529341562343919737)
- **multiple house tax**: Outlands taxes players for owning more than two houses, so any house beyond the first is very expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539592621821923369)
- **new custom decorations and clothing**: New custom decorations and clothing are released on Outlands on an ongoing basis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529279558245941268)
- **new landmass house placement priority**: New landmass placement typically favors players who have never owned a house, and the new landmass is expected to hold about twice the housing currently available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531735276693487848)
- **new landmass house raffle**: When the new landmass is added, a raffle is run with one ticket per person, and players who have not owned a house before have a slightly better chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539263222832697415)
- **new player housing option**: The best housing option for new players is the Rental Room System, because open land is highly unlikely to be found; houses for sale are listed by the Real Estate Vendor NPC in-game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **new player inn room rent**: A new player starts with 2 weeks of rent on an inn room if they pick the 5k a week room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537767741207879680)
- **non-added followers through house gates**: A player who is not added to your house and follows you through a gate inside it reportedly ends up outside the house, per a patch the author vaguely recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535580393615659070)
- **obtaining housing**: To obtain housing, buy a house from another player via the real estate channel or the in-game real estate agent, or rent an inn room, which gives all the benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533967409805922335)
- **open house placement spots**: The chance of finding an open spot to place a house is nearly zero. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525958734164000778)
- **open housing plot availability**: New open housing plots are almost never available on the Outlands map, and a land expansion is planned for the future. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612090258981065)
- **open land for house building**: Finding open land to build a new house in Outlands is highly unlikely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550370544971550804)
- **open land for new houses**: There is essentially no open land for new houses in UO Outlands, though a tiny chance exists to find a small spot for a caravan if a home was resized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379024681115770)
- **opening vendor backpack**: To open a vendor's backpack, double-click the house sign, click on the vendors, and open the backpack from the sign. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536002175811981382)
- **organizer item transfer to bank**: An organizer can move items on its list into a bag in the bank; do this by dropping off items in your inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531102657249542236)
- **organizer reagent removal for mages**: If reagents are on the organizer list, the organizer removes every reagent from a mage, so keep reagents off the list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531102758998900921)
- **pack item limit**: The item limit in a player's pack is 125 items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528822268296433724)
- **pawnbroker holding lost room items**: The Pawnbroker NPC may hold items lost from a lapsed rented room, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542948718033248361)
- **pets logging out in home**: Pets are supposed to log out with you inside your home, but sometimes the logout does not trigger, so stabling them first is safer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527671887063421018)
- **placing a ship at a house**: At a boat house, place the ship from the outside (back) part of the boat house; for other houses, go outside the house, click the dockmaster name plate to put the boat in the water, and the dockmaster puts you inside the house when docking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531930740772573386)
- **placing a ship from a house**: To place a ship from a house near the shore, stand outside the house, because ships cannot be placed while standing on a house that is not a houseboat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523828565898956840)
- **placing a trash barrel in a hotel room**: To place a trash barrel back in a hotel room, type 'I wish to place a trash barrel'; the barrel is placed at your character's feet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539011513266741378)
- **plant bowls in inn rooms**: Plant bowls must be locked down, but they can be placed in an inn room, so a house is not required to grow mushrooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555621147628937297)
- **player house locations**: Player houses can usually be found near the moongates of the cities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299877109604353)
- **player vendor account-wide ownership access**: If a player owns a Player Vendor, all characters on that player's account have full access to the vendor's ownership features. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542537952826237038)
- **player vendor contract expiry**: When a player vendor's contract does not renew, the items in the vendor are sent to the owner's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533808771367702629)
- **player vendor shopping range**: You do not need to enter a vendor house to shop from a player vendor, and staying at the outside wall is best. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522289354108567594)
- **player vendor without a house**: To get a player vendor without owning a house, find a vendor house that offers contracts to players and use one of those. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524011722707566715)
- **potion keg storage shelf**: If empty bottles are on a storage shelf, dropping a potion keg onto the shelf fills the bottles, storing the keg's potions away; the keg must hold greater-tier-or-higher potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527581207930343546)
- **potion satchel**: Double clicking the potion satchel absorbs a potion keg and empty potion bottles, and the potions are then held inside the satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532438852298604555)
- **pouch bag backpack difference**: The difference between a pouch, bag and backpack is only visual. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530639389439295548)
- **preexisting house prices versus inn rental**: Preexisting houses for sale cost more than a few years of inn rental, even the smallest ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537166203196407849)
- **prevalia architect location**: The architect in Prevalia is south of the bank, in the building with the tailor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526738502027313213)
- **prevalian trunk and trophy hutch placement**: A prevalian trunk and trophy hutch may be placed with the other storage items in front of the Prevalia bank, as seen on the test shard, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554543642696220705)
- **previous expansion housing lottery rules**: In the previous Outlands expansion housing lottery, entry cost 10k gold, each player got only 1 ticket, and newer players had a higher weighting in the random roll, though rules may differ in future lotteries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526979110633738272)
- **pricing items in vendor containers**: To price items inside a container on a player vendor, check the "use pricing menu" box, mark the container itself as not for sale when placing it, then put items in the container and price each one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554133727905579180)
- **priority house items**: The stockpile and the storage shelf are the priority items to get for a house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523030697818980402)
- **protecting items from thieves**: Use the 'send to bank' feature to move items into the bank so thieves cannot steal them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544036413912252527)
- **protecting items in a rented room**: To protect items in a rented room, secure a bag (container) so its contents don't decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549615366848643083)
- **protecting shepherd's crook from theft**: To protect a shepherd's crook from being stolen, store it in a trapped pouch or a locked box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527069678902710465)
- **public dockmaster house risk**: If a house's dockmaster is public, anyone who docks a ship arrives on the house roof and can enter the house, risking the owner being killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529217292485918871)
- **public dockmaster visitor access**: If the dockmaster is set to public, visitors can only access the roof and cannot open anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529218016879968307)
- **public house with private working room**: To have a public house with a private working room, block off a pathway with furniture that you can still get behind, preferably with an unlocked recall tile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533237881479499877)
- **public houses with free item identification**: Some public houses, such as the riverside mall house, are set up to identify items for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553526655044030545)
- **public repair benches**: Public repair benches are available, so owning a personal repair bench is less essential. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523747314823467019)
- **public repair benches near butler services**: A player running a public butler service is likely, though not certain, to have a public repair bench nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552300380543787031)
- **purpose of locking down items**: Locking down is intended for furniture and decorations rather than for storing items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527366017305546873)
- **qol items in secured chests**: Most quality-of-life items can reportedly be used directly from secured chests, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521629994256957592)
- **quest decoration rewards**: Some quests offer decoration rewards, and the butler website lists many of the quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526719366056640532)
- **raffle ticket allocation**: Players receive one raffle ticket for every raffled house, and 10 tickets on the contents raffle if the contents weigh more than 1000. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536083501311332392)
- **raw meat in resource stockpile**: Most raw meat can be stored in a resource stockpile, though this is not confirmed for every meat type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522949450975154206)
- **reaching inn rental room**: To reach an inn rental room, recall to the Shelter inn (outside the room) and then enter the room, for example with the Enter Rental Room script. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521557944725012741)
- **reagent theft protection**: A locked chest can protect reagents from thieves, and reagents can still be used from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551111652550774866)
- **real estate broker locations**: Real estate brokers are found in most towns; Prevalia has one near the bank and Andaria has one in the middle of town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539591789114167347)
- **real estate lottery information**: No winner or ticket count information is given for real estate lotteries, unlike other lotteries such as the Kingsfaire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550144898148073592)
- **real estate npc for pre-placed houses**: There is a real estate NPC where players put pre-placed houses up for sale. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522630738967658498)
- **recalling to inn room**: You cannot recall directly into an inn room, but you can mark a rune inside an inn and then immediately enter the room from there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525622184297631805)
- **recovering a moved plant**: To recover a plant that vanished after being moved with the interior decorator tool, use the tool's 'recover last' option, or turn on all nameplates and filter them by the plant's name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537934894141935686)
- **recovering items lost while decorating**: To find an item lost while decorating, turn on nameplates to locate it, use the decorator's recover last button, or move to your feet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526698286600290355)
- **recovering vanished chests from rental rooms**: Chests that vanish from a rental room can reportedly be recovered from the Pawnbroker, and properly locked down items should not disappear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542771720190955520)
- **recycle box placement requirement**: A recycle box must be locked down or secured in a house or inn room to function, and it does not work from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550041494583386164)
- **recycler unlock requirement**: Every recycled item may need to be unlocked, or the recycler may refuse to work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523831303949127700)
- **recycler when locked down**: The recycler works when locked down, but recycled items will decay, so using it that way is not recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523831349683683528)
- **remote banking of items**: Items cannot be sent to the bank remotely; apart from gold, you must go to the bank and place them inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546432184666300486)
- **removing trash barrel from hotel room**: To remove a trash barrel from a hotel room, use an axe on it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539011447705706556)
- **renaming and dyeing bags and pouches**: Bags and pouches cannot be renamed, but they can be dyed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542567039556919357)
- **rental credits for inn rooms**: Rental credits can be left in your bank and are used automatically to cover the cost of Inn Room rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538612994798518363)
- **rental inn room co-owners**: Any player can be added as a co-owner or friend of a rental inn room, even if they are not under the same Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526671203689824446)
- **rental payment character order**: Rental payment may possibly be drawn from another character on the account before the renter character, perhaps by character list order, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526672692218953830)
- **rental room access**: You can enter your rental room from any inn in the world but always exit in the town where you rented it; the room style depends on the town rented in, and Prevalia has all the special NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546575994843045888)
- **rental room access for same-account characters**: All characters on the same account as the renter can use a rental room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550624519784497303)
- **rental room agreement transfer**: A rental room agreement cannot be transferred to another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526956116116766873)
- **rental room credit deed duration**: A rental room credit deed covers two weeks of the smallest rental room size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526418750482681989)
- **rental room credit deed priority**: A rental room credit deed is believed to take priority for paying inn rent as long as it is in a bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539626402964308098)
- **rental room credits deed transfer**: A Rental Room credits deed can be handed from one character to another, including across accounts under the same Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526670659843789032)
- **rental room deed for new accounts**: Every new account receives a rental room credit deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530702952279441418)
- **rental room duration**: A rental room has no time limit and stays as it is as long as the bank holds enough money to cover the rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547009460600307804)
- **rental room expansion**: A rental room cannot be expanded in size, but additional lockdowns can be added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551088402214944899)
- **rental room floor size upgrade**: The floor size of a rental room cannot be upgraded in place; the player must terminate the rental and rent a new room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374482532114455)
- **rental room lapse behavior**: If payment on a rental room lapses, the stored items go to the bank, whereas if a house is allowed to decay all its contents are lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526419292021850133)
- **rental room lockdown slots**: A stack of any item, such as ingots, takes up only one lockdown slot in a rental room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527485178451329114)
- **rental room neighbours visibility**: Other players' rental rooms cannot be hidden while in your own rental room; zooming in is the only mitigation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531420265073086665)
- **rental room options at the inn**: The only real difference between the rental room options at the inn is the layout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533988199523680327)
- **rental room renewal**: A rental room automatically renews until the contract is manually ended, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533508195610525906)
- **rental room safety and storage**: Rental rooms have no thieves and offer more storage than a bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546576964784234576)
- **rental room sizes**: Rental rooms come in several sizes, and the second smallest is recommended as a starter room because the smallest quickly becomes too small. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526675198848401569)
- **rental room storage**: A rental room can be used to store valuables instead of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521136218828701706)
- **rental room theft protection**: Players are advised to get a rental room to protect their items from theft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535257104032595978)
- **rental rooms accessibility**: Rental rooms are far more accessible than houses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531199170646380676)
- **rental rooms coverage**: Rental rooms cover nearly everything you need a house for except vendors, which can be handled through vendor malls or guild house malls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524887546994364506)
- **rental spot filter menu**: Press Shift+Ctrl to reopen the filter menu that helps find spots to rent if the small red menu has been closed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553503818484817990)
- **rented room access**: A rented room can be entered from any inn by saying "room"; renting in Shelter only means exiting the room door puts you in the Shelter town square. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526561996324208731)
- **rented room lapse handling**: If a player runs out of money for a rented room, the items are moved to the bank of the character that rented the room instead of decaying or being auctioned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550046153121202277)
- **rented room rent payment**: Rent for a rented room is pulled from other characters on the same account if the renting character's bank is empty; if all are empty, the rental ends and items move to the bank, or to a bank queue if the bank is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554932396003168429)
- **rented room sharing**: Rented rooms in Outlands can be shared with all characters across all of a player's accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550046153121202277)
- **rented room upgrades**: A rented room can have its secure containers doubled through upgrades while keeping the room, but to get a larger room footprint you must cancel the current room and rent the larger size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520619411944378378)
- **repair bench availability**: Repair benches are managed by players and are only publicly available in player houses; Shelter Island has none. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526543686861586493)
- **resource stockpile map storage**: The Resource Stockpile can hold blank maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550389883837747304)
- **resource stockpile pull restrictions**: A resource stockpile has options that stop it from pulling various types of items, which can prevent it from taking regs out of a wizard satchel in your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546588199361450107)
- **resource stockpile source**: The Resource Stockpile can be obtained from the Prev merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532838986261860632)
- **resource stockpile usage**: Resource Stockpiles must be locked down in a house to be used, and only the house's Owners and Co-Owners can use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549789792319836211)
- **restock shelf activity log retention**: The restock shelf activity log holds only a limited period of data, roughly 24 to 72 hours, though the exact window is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532874297188810843)
- **restock shelf container targeting**: When a restock shelf target is a container such as a loot bag rather than self, only the contents of that container are used to restock the shelf and the container itself is not pulled in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530224903809270023)
- **restocking vendors with other characters**: All of your characters can now restock a vendor, so buying the vendor's item with another character no longer works to empty it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521613241967706153)
- **restocking with the storage shelf**: To restock with the Storage Shelf, define what you need to take as a loadout, then use 'Resupply' from the shelf's context menu or the button in the window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532995832972837005)
- **restyle deed on storage shelf**: A restyle deed placed on a storage shelf cannot be retrieved and is tied to that individual shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529351265513902141)
- **returning deeded house items to deeds**: If a house item originally came from a deed, you can axe it or click the item to turn it back into a deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538490647655227434)
- **returning items to a guild storage shelf**: To put items back into a guild Storage Shelf, click the shelf, click the top option, then click yourself; this returns everything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532995503417987164)
- **reusing trapped pouch contents**: A trapped pouch can be popped and its contents reinserted into a new pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527623360182354014)
- **room rental**: Renting a room is highly recommended and is arguably better than owning a house in some regards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523007904859291788)
- **room rental storage**: Renting a room increases bank and inventory storage space, with rental rooms costing about 5K and up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532994002067132508)
- **rotating placeable decorations**: Some placeable decorations can be rotated with an architect's tool, some have a context menu option to rotate, and some can be double-clicked to cycle through styles; this does not work for all items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552068478331002981)
- **rotating storage shelf color**: If rotating a storage shelf turns it grey, continue rotating it to return it to the original color, which is likely intended behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533275573080821810)
- **rune stacking**: Runes stack together in a single stack in your inventory or bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520921637971689493)
- **runebook blessing**: Runebooks are not blessed by default and can be blessed with a runetome bless deed, which covers only one book and is costly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527806629305782314)
- **runetomes**: Runetomes hold more runes than runebooks and can be kept in your room or house, so they do not need to be blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522980343580332163)
- **safe house replacement**: To safely replace a house, bring trusted friends, use Tracking and Detect Hidden to confirm nobody is nearby, stay hidden while replacing, practice or script it on the test center first, and empty the house beforehand without replacing it right away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551621007876292720)
- **safe loot storage in trapped box**: To keep loot safe in a trapped box, use a pouch as a grab bag, save the pouch's id in a script, move the pouch into the trapped box, and when home use a script to move the grab bag out of the trapped box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527633142565965864)
- **safe ship storage**: The only safe place to keep a ship is docked at a house you have access to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532408206251397322)
- **secure and lock down limits**: A house or inn room has a limited number of secures and lock downs, and the limits can be seen by interacting with the door or the house sign. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547323792282484746)
- **secure container count**: A house or caravan with only one secure container is too restrictive because containers have item limits, so at least two are recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526136950803660900)
- **secure container limit in smallest inn room**: The smallest inn room likely allows securing 2 containers, which keeps the items inside safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527365936967979101)
- **secure containers lockdown cost**: A secure container immediately consumes 125 of a room's lockdown slots and allows items to be freely added and removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526570085681201192)
- **securing containers in inn rooms**: Containers in an inn room should be secured rather than locked down by using the 'I wish to secure this' command, which keeps their contents safe and lets you take items out easily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527365475724693766)
- **securing house doors without a key**: After unlocking the door once with the key, say 'I wish to secure this' and set the door to owner, co-owner or friends; the key is then no longer needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543251515760836628)
- **securing individual house containers**: To set permissions on a single container in a house, say 'I wish to secure this' and target the container; its permissions can then be adjusted independently of other containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523856861672247326)
- **securing items and setting access permissions**: To set access permissions on an item, say 'I wish to secure this', target the item and set permissions, then add the person to the house friends list; the permissions prompt does not appear in rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524670799838183537)
- **selling a house**: Move all of your items out of a house before listing it for sale, otherwise everything inside is sold along with the home. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541671997321384007)
- **selling a house with items inside**: Listing a house for sale with items still inside it results in those items being owned by the new buyer, so empty the house first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537969438416961566)
- **send to bank item handling**: With send to bank, a purchased item does not have to land in your base backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534574166160965692)
- **sending items to bank via distribution chest**: To send items to a character's bank via a Distribution Chest, add the receiving character to the chest, log that character out, then use an alt to send the loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546452611014594581)
- **setting a bag not for sale on a vendor**: To keep a bag not for sale on a vendor, place the empty bag in the vendor first and set it as not for sale, then add items to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556063165664596141)
- **sewers quest inn rental deed reward**: Completing the sewers quest gives one inn rental deed per Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534598717754310716)
- **sewing kit shelf requirement**: Sewing kits must be mastercrafted to be added to a shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541551068553420840)
- **sharing a supply shelf in a house**: To let friends use a supply shelf in a house, the owner says "I wish to secure this", targets the shelf, and then sets permissions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555710793343959202)
- **shelf access in inn rooms**: A shelf in a house can be set up to let friends use it, but in an inn room only the owner or co-owners can open things. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541997737699049502)
- **shelf item requirements**: The shelf only accepts exceptional-quality items, and items with uses, such as harvesting tools, must be at their maximum number of uses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550996216119165119)
- **shelf lockdown indicator**: The Shelf does not display that it is locked down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523831623659946228)
- **shelf secure functionality**: The Shelf may have recently had its secure functionality removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523831428771614760)
- **shipping crate delivery to house**: If you own a house, the shipping crate is delivered outside on the house step and must be moved inside manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541234036612272199)
- **small house corner placement claim area**: With strategic corner placement, a small house can claim roughly a 15x15 to 19x19 area (18x18 to be safe) that can later be replaced with a larger house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539266841933774871)
- **small house cost versus inn rent**: A small house costs about as much as renting an inn room for roughly 18 years. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546238923724824637)
- **small house placement trick**: Place a small house on a spot that blocks out a large plot, so the plot is reserved until a bigger house can replace it, then sell the small house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526977049594564679)
- **small house real estate availability**: Real estate for small houses is not realistically available on the server, so players use a rented inn room plus a vendor rental elsewhere instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524532561336995930)
- **smart vendor houses**: Smart vendor houses block the entrance so vendors can restock safely, so buyers and anyone other than vendors and their stockers should not be inside the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552464037915402373)
- **spell scroll storage in storage shelves**: A storage shelf can hold an almost unlimited number of spell scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527183102739349645)
- **stablemaster npc in rental room**: A stablemaster NPC can be placed in your rental room, but they are costly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532784144222785547)
- **starter container capacity**: A bag, backpack, or pouch works as a starting container and has the same item capacity as a chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553487275004792925)
- **stockpile and shelf in locked down chest**: A stockpile and shelf can be placed inside a locked down chest and still be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538302818018918520)
- **stockpile and shelf with trapped pouches**: The stockpile and shelf systems pull items from trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544045852245622856)
- **stockpile ignoring purchased items**: If purchased items like ink and pen won't go into a stockpile, check the settings button at the bottom of the stockpile menu, which may be set to ignore them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543743800432918579)
- **stockpile placement in a bank**: A stockpile placed in a bank may work, but this is unverified and should be tested on the test server first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539960255491080333)
- **stoppable container sounds**: Sounds from chests, boxes and bags cannot be stopped, but sounds from the shelf, stockpile and magic item recycler can be stopped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521536855676420127)
- **storage capacity sources**: Bank storage is increased through customizations, inventory capacity is increased through the Camping skill, and the redline mastery also increases capacity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553092311510945833)
- **storage drop-off items**: Storage Shelf, Stockpile and Bank Deposit Box are a great step up for drop-offs and can be placed together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531359929183768597)
- **storage furniture lockdown**: Many storage items such as the trophy hutch, prevalia trunk and wardrobe hold different item types and function when locked down, so many secures are rarely needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550044350703079456)
- **storage lockers**: Storage Lockers exist and can be crafted by carpenters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549788054946840608)
- **storage shelf acquisition**: A Storage Shelf is crafted by players and is not bought with Prevalia coins. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523708076321018057)
- **storage shelf activity log duration**: The Storage Shelf activity log shows item add/remove activity from the previous 48 hours, reduced from the previous 7 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525222775214833755)
- **storage shelf and spare gear**: A storage shelf and extra full sets of gear let you keep going out on runs and earning gold after several bad runs that lose equipment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520282860781572227)
- **storage shelf container acceptance**: A storage shelf only accepts containers such as quivers, potion satchels or wizard's satchels if they are exceptionally crafted, and the container must be placed inside another container rather than targeted directly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088871086723214)
- **storage shelf contents**: The storage shelf only stores empty bags and pouches; target the parent container that holds your bags (possibly the backpack in your paperdoll) to put them in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532780864478515340)
- **storage shelf interface loot drop-off and restock**: The storage shelf interface lets you drop off loot and restock quickly without needing scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539777477042249870)
- **storage shelf item limit**: A storage shelf has no practical item limit, with a cap of about 9999999. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539609752823136356)
- **storage shelf item requirements**: A storage shelf only accepts fully repaired, fully charged, exceptional items, and a container such as a potion satchel must also be empty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524908132319629433)
- **storage shelf keg capacity**: A Storage Shelf can hold empty kegs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552175253369651361)
- **storage shelf loadouts**: Each character has its own storage shelf loadout, and the first upgrade 'Shelf Life' gives each character 2 more loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543961721738104883)
- **storage shelf one-button resupply**: The storage shelf one-button resupply provides potions, reagents, bandages, arrows and similar supplies, and also fills runebooks with recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539765340505116822)
- **storage shelf potion requirement**: Kegs cannot be stocked on a storage shelf; potions must be in bottle form. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527578722784247930)
- **storage shelf skins**: Storage shelf skins likely apply to the individual shelf item rather than the account and can be freely swapped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550175182382178405)
- **storage shelf tool quality**: A tool that can be crafted as exceptional must be of exceptional quality to be placed in a storage shelf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528049780490502275)
- **storage shelf weapon and armor types**: The storage shelf holds only exceptional weapons and armor, while magic weapons and armor are stored in the magic item vault. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537870877733945365)
- **storage shelves contents**: Storage shelves can hold only armor and delectable food. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522729516428955939)
- **storing containers on a storage shelf**: To add a container to a Storage Shelf, place it inside another container and target that outer container, because targeting or dropping a container directly onto the shelf empties it instead of storing it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553103276193615994)
- **storing cores at a store**: When storing cores at a store, bring them in small amounts rather than all at once if you fear being attacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552488863958704160)
- **storing spare mounts**: A spare non-bonded mount can be stored by visiting a stable keeper NPC and placing it in the stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544811601851449465)
- **storing unidentified items**: Unidentified items can be kept in a bag in the bank until you can afford a container ID wand to identify them in bulk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521314686094671956)
- **strongbox 2 upgrade requirements**: Upgrading to Strongbox 2 requires two deeds, and Strongbox 1 and Strongbox 2 are separate customizations unlocked in the help/customizations page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554974296386969731)
- **strongbox deeds via customizations**: Type [customizations to see purchasable upgrades, including strongbox1 and strongbox2, the deeds that reduce gold weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530316864318865476)
- **strongbox unlock deed scope**: The strongbox unlock deed is account-wide, so a deed earned on one character can be used by other characters on the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522728462870118612)
- **strongbox upgrades**: Strongbox upgrades stack, so players keep upgrading their existing strongbox instead of buying a separate strongbox 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522727655017943211)
- **survey command for decay**: The [survey command used in a room or house checks for any items that can potentially decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550045409974550561)
- **survey command for decaying items**: Type [survey in a home to check for items that can decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536463741565014038)
- **taking a break with a house**: Taking a break from the game while owning a house can be disastrous, whereas renting an inn room carries no such risk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548441482560536718)
- **taking boat off dock master**: If you are in a guild with a dock master, you can take the boat off the dock master at the guild house or at any guild member's house that has a dock master. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549422465187323927)
- **tavern room rent**: Tavern room rent is charged weekly, and a first character starts with a rental room credits deed covering about 2 weeks of the small room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548434333398863923)
- **tertiary house tax cost**: The tax on a tertiary (third) house is roughly 10 times the tax on a secondary (second) house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539271239514988865)
- **test dummy deed**: A test dummy deed, reportedly sold by the Prevalia merchant, lets a player with a house place a dummy with customizable stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521582909864022250)
- **test dummy placement**: A purchased test dummy can be placed on the steps of a house while the player stands in the grass, giving a personal dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521583282712477957)
- **test shard home wipes**: The test shard has homes wiped daily and is periodically updated to match the live server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523343990601289841)
- **testing house upsizing on test server**: When testing houses on the test server, you can place every house around your own house to see what sizes you can upsize to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523323664609710130)
- **theft risk when moving items to bank**: Players are likely to be robbed in the window while they move items into the bank or take them out and relocate them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525629055670685848)
- **thief hiding in vendor building**: A thief can only be hidden or stealthed in the vendor building if they have a vendor there themselves, and if you are hidden there you are safe from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556065643726508074)
- **time dungeon satchel blessed variant**: Time dungeon satchels can come as a blessed item, but that version is deprecated and less practical. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521131416056762389)
- **tome storage**: Tomes are mostly kept in a house or in the bank for storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545458901162659981)
- **tools in resource stockpile**: Tools placed in a resource stockpile cannot be removed from it, so you must craft exceptional crafting tools and add them to your storage shelf instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541787575726112859)
- **transferring items between alts or accounts**: To move items between alts or accounts, rent a room and lock down or secure a container in it so the other character or account can access it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548498116309946499)
- **transferring items between characters**: To transfer items between characters, rent a room at an inn and secure a container to the floor so another character can access it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546575649823653980)
- **trapped box storage of loot**: Loot is worth storing in a trapped box because it is light and easily stolen, while gold is heavy and not worth stealing, so gold should be left out of the box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552746696381825165)
- **trapped pouch counter**: If you move the trapped pouch after placing the bag in it, the counter shows 0 and no longer opens the bag, so leave the trapped pouch unmoved after placing the bag for the counter to work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527432840118141079)
- **trapped pouch detection**: A trapped pouch lets you know if someone tried to get into it, because you see that it was popped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544042786863714385)
- **trapped pouch theft protection**: A single trapped pouch gives only weak protection against a thief with a good script, so multiple layers of security are recommended. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535076925444202527)
- **tree visibility options**: Trees cannot be removed in Outlands, but a player can turn all trees into blocks (visible only to that player) via Options > General, or hold Ctrl+Shift to see vendor nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536001516689952799)
- **turning placed deedable items back into deeds with a hatchet**: Using a hatchet on a placed deedable item such as a tapestry or anvil turns it back into a deed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526216075249975419)
- **type-specific storage item limits**: Shelves, stockpiles and other type-specific storage items are not traditional containers and so are not subject to the 125 item container limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537857705191153735)
- **unlisted house advertising**: Houses that are not listed with the realtor are usually advertised in a dedicated Discord channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522631113812480022)
- **unlocked house door with permissions**: A house door that is unlocked but has permissions set only lets the people you specified enter the house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551370406277939211)
- **unlocked items in rental rooms**: Unlocked items left in rental rooms are not retrievable for free, likely to prevent abuse as extra free storage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534372520063406161)
- **unmaintained house**: If a house is not maintained, it gets auctioned off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553534848629743629)
- **upcoming land rush**: Another land rush is expected soon and is described as pretty chaotic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550146037170307134)
- **upgrading a rental room**: To upgrade a rental room, rent the larger floor, move into it, then close the old room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554374770424942673)
- **upgrading inn room size**: To move to a larger inn room, close the current rental and reopen it with the larger size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526763999306186825)
- **useful early investment items**: Worthwhile items to invest in include a storage shelf, a resource stockpile, and a recycler if you do not already have them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525264432387588229)
- **using trapped pouches against thieves**: To protect items from thieves, nest trapped pouches inside one another and react when a thief triggers one by moving the item and putting it into another trapped pouch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542880341277286440)
- **vendor contract placement on friended house**: Being friended on a house does not allow you to place a vendor contract; the house owner places it, and then both players interact with it to set the rental parameters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543353939829850293)
- **vendor contracts**: Vendor contracts are a rental that renews weekly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535648747944681522)
- **vendor gold deposit and withdrawal**: You can deposit or withdraw vendor gold from anywhere without being at the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552991784915837049)
- **vendor house ban bot**: Some vendor houses advertise a ban bot that bars reds and thieves, and a thief is banned once they go grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530701093493932032)
- **vendor house eject and ban script**: A script can be used to eject and ban someone from your vendor house or vendor spot if they try to attack you while you restock your vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1527442098133930045)
- **vendor house rent**: Houses with vendors are available for rent; double-clicking the locked down scroll at a vendor house shows its weekly rent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554867339701387308)
- **vendor house sale effects**: When a vendor house is sold, a courtyard rune is likely cleared by a clearing deed, and a warptile spot likely has its settings changed and must be set up again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546874934477987891)
- **vendor menu confirmation gems**: The vendor menu shows a small blue gem next to each input field, and it must be clicked to confirm the entered value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530899567128608808)
- **vendor minimum gold deposit**: The minimum gold deposit for a vendor is 5K, and all gold can be withdrawn before canceling the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530902380005031989)
- **vendor ownership scope**: Vendors are tied per account, not per Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533979779324182669)
- **vendor placement on wagon roof**: To place vendors on a wagon roof, build steps out of carpet or rug tiles; placing the vendor contract directly on carpet or ore did not work for the reporting player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522983603393527809)
- **vendor portal**: Because the vendor portal exists, players generally do not need to open each vendor in proximity individually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530646697825403110)
- **vendor rental after house ban**: If you are banned from a home where you rent a vendor, abandon the rental contract, and your goods are sent to your bank when the contract expires. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537073750435172434)
- **vendor rental location choice**: A vendor rental is more convenient when it is close to an easy waypoint such as a witcher rune, moongate or town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524533067526574192)
- **vendor rental payment**: Vendor daily cost and weekly rental are not taken from your bank; you must deposit gold on the vendor gump, and vendor sales earnings also cover these costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552991300347891745)
- **vendor slot scrolls in houses**: Some houses have vendor-slot scrolls locked down on the floor; double-clicking one grants a vendor slot, and owners typically claim those scrolls themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546275153288368219)
- **viewing decay lottery house location**: The location and land of a house in the decay lottery can be viewed only via a button on the lottery gump menu, not from the announcement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529854822549946480)
- **warp tile for house recall**: Owners of a house (not an inn room) can buy a warp tile to mark a spot in their house for recalling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521558057497268224)
- **warp tile on demolished house**: If a house with a warp tile is demolished, the warp tile remains enabled on the deed when the house is placed again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542036864418971678)
- **warp tiles**: Warp tiles are placeable tiles that set where a player lands when recalling to a location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527635083111174204)
- **warp tiles in houses**: Warp tiles can be placed inside a player house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525408736871579801)
