- **weekly vendor rental renewal**: The weekly rental renews automatically, and if the bank lacks enough money, belongings are moved to your bank or bank queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537082499107258389)
- **weight reduction bags**: Bags with weight reduction are reportedly limited to reagent and potion containers, with none for general loot, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551674607948267592)
- **wizard satchel add all**: Clicking the wizard satchel to add all moves reagents and scrolls from the backpack into the satchel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551918239527993365)
- **wooden box vendor search**: Searching vendors for 'wooden box' finds lockable boxes that fit in a bag, but the results are more likely to be trapped than locked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524219988725202996)
- **world atlas lockdown**: The free blessed newbie World Atlas may not be able to be locked down; this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538316965259780197)

## Travel & locations

- **claiming pumpkin mask**: To claim a Pumpkin Mask, double-click the Scary Pumpkin Statue located next to the Prevalian Merchant. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **house decay lottery vendor location**: The House Decay Lottery Official NPC is in Prevalia next to the Society Hall (to its left), near the main bank. _(official, conf 0.85, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1551609013282799648)
- **joining snowbrawl**: To participate in Snowbrawl, visit any Public Moongate and select Snowbrawl Arena. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541823889129213963)
- **king's faire location**: King's Faire festivities, raffles, and games take place on the Fairegrounds. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **mount racing location**: Mount Racing takes place weekly at Prevalia Meadows, a racing track region reachable through any public Town-Destination Moongate, with eight racers per race and a betting guide on the Outlands forums. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **prevalian merchant location**: The Prevalian Merchant moves back to the Prevalia bank when the King's Faire ends, and the Faire has ended. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543604630703964170)
- **reaching the outlaws arena**: To reach the Outlaws event arena, use any Public Moongate and select the Outlaws Arena destination. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543061860939468911)
- **spirit of leodcyning npc locations**: Spirit of Leodcyning NPCs are located in Prevalia, Corpse Creek, and the Anchors Rest burial mound. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525517091384590457)
- **tria the harvestmaster location**: Tria the Harvestmaster is located in Prevalia near the Prevalia Bank, and her twin is in Corpse Creek, for the Zucchini Harvestmaster event. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550884202717650975)
- **viewing and betting on mount races**: To view the racers, check their stats and place bets on the weekly Mount Race, use any Public Moongate and select Prevalia Meadows. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1537881062544248913)
- **dungeon travel without magery or chivalry**: Builds without Magery, Camping or Chivalry can travel to dungeons using a runebook or runetome loaded with recall scroll charges, for example via the Outpost moongate, or with a chivalry bot on a second account. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546637508237070456)
- **monster spawn lookup tools**: Monster spawn locations can be found using the monster search on exploreoutlands.com, which shows map pins, or the similar tools on outlandsbutler.com. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554579713446641768)
- **necromancy trainer locations**: Necromancy trainer NPCs are in Prevalia, northwest of the bank in the old library (also reported underground west of the healers), with possibly another in Cambria; a free Necromancy book is given at character creation. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554158579236339825)
- **outlands butler creature library**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com/creaturelibrary) has a creature library/bestiary where players can search a mob by name and see creature information and many of its spawn locations, and ExploreOutlands.com offers a mob search that can cover mobs the Butler lacks. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554865552172916789)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons**: Prevalia Sewers, Urukton Bluffs (inside), Ratman Hovel and Shelter Island Dungeon are permanently sanctuary dungeons, where criminal actions such as theft cannot be performed and players are safe from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111460353777817)
- **recall scroll charges in runebooks**: Dropping a recall scroll onto a runebook or runetome consumes it as a charge, and anyone can then recall from that book with 0 Magery. Scribes can make the scrolls cheaply, and NPC mages sell them at higher prices. Some Magery is needed to recall from a rune stored in a box or bag. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 13 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452722336956467)
- **repair bench locations**: Repair benches are placed in player houses, and many are publicly available in battle trainer and vendor houses, such as those near the Prevalia and Outpost moongates (including the battle trainer house near Prevalia and just outside its northern gate); most guild houses also have one. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554846223096356997)
- **using runebook recall charges**: To charge a runebook or runetome, drag a recall scroll onto the book itself, not onto a gem inside it. To recall, open the book and click the blue gem button next to the desired rune, not the recall icon. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545719967410954322)
- **adding locations to a runebook**: To add a location to a runebook, mark a blank rune at the location and then drop the rune onto the runebook; a blank runebook can be bought from a vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546762473305018439)
- **beekeeper npc locations**: Beekeeper NPCs are Francisca in Andaria (near the west entrance), Jacques in Cambria, Carroll and Chet in Horseshoe Bay, Ananda in Prevalia, and Marcus at the Cathedral and Inn POI; others are reported at the Southreach inn and in Shelter Haven village. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555774789241544755)
- **cambria rune library location**: A free rune library is located in the stone/marble house with shelves just west or south of the Cambria Moongate (around 1706, 3181), and another library is next to the Outpost Moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545331395952517160)
- **dungeon forges**: Nusero is the only dungeon that has forges, and its floor is largely mineable; mining is also possible in some other dungeons such as Cavernam. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522779343271624909)
- **dungeon recall restrictions**: In dungeons you can only recall near the entrance on level 1 next to a yellow gate, and deeper you must leave via special gates, which prevents recalling in on top of players. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474344563118134)
- **outlands map**: The Outlands map is completely new rather than the original Ultima Online map, with new places and town names. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547478724184772628)
- **recall command via rune names**: Say '[recallcharge <rune name>' (e.g. [recallcharge shelter island bank) to recall to a rune in a runebook or runetome using a charge, which works without Magery; characters with Magery can say '[recall <rune name>' (e.g. [recall home), and either command can be hotkeyed in a script. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554852623163723947)
- **recalling at a rune library**: At a rune library, such as the one at the outpost moongate or in a player house, drop a Recall scroll onto the runebook or runetome you want to use, then click the blue gem next to the desired rune to recall to farming spots (non-dungeon). _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703344290144257)
- **sacred journey buff range**: The Sacred Journey buff stays active only while you are within 50 tiles of the character who made the gate, not of the marked location. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545442708653613156)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon**: One core dungeon each week is designated a sanctuary: players are safe from PKs and thieves there, with about 33% reduced rewards. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784663808680068)
- **witcher rune system**: Witcher is a player-made rune system covering nearly the entire Outlands map, widely adopted for travel alongside Point of Interest rune libraries, and can be viewed by turning on Witcher Runes on the left side of the Explore Outlands map. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553621539927105667)
- **bard trainer locations**: Bard NPCs are on Shelter Island, on a stage in the south/southeast part east of the docks along the route from the moongate to the bank, and another is against the castle wall just east of the Paladin in east Prevalia toward the zoo. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547572103769759836)
- **creature spawn lookup websites**: exploreoutlands.com and outlandsbutler.com/creaturelibrary are websites for searching where creatures spawn, including wilderness spawns and ratmen. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533219191543304323)
- **finding healer caravans**: Go to exploreoutlands.com, enter your in-game map coordinates to locate yourself, and select healer caravans in the left panel to see the nearest ones. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541386111193159)
- **finding witcher rune locations**: Open exploreoutlands.com and enable the 'Witcher Rune System' option on the left to see rune locations, find the rune closest to your destination or vendor, then recall there from a witcher library; you can also add witcher runes to your in-game map and use the set map position button. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554114741809577985)
- **hiking interruption**: Hiking cannot be interrupted, so it works as an escape without a runebook, but the player is not immune and can still die while hiking. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550153340241846423)
- **horseshoe bay pickpocket dip location**: The pickpocket dip is at a beach house just outside Horseshoe Bay town on the shore, between the town and the moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554490288003616951)
- **mapmaker npc locations**: Mapmaker NPCs exist in Prevalia (Isoke, 1985,1692; also one in far southeast Prev near the south exit toward Forsaken Keep), Andaria (Shen, 2167,790), Cambria (Penda, 1752,3017), Horseshoe Bay (Kalika, 2029,2293), the Outpost (Ardith, 3083,530) and Terran (Dane, 682,1515). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549545643175845890)
- **marking runes at dungeon gates**: You can mark runes within about 8 tiles of a yellow (golden) dungeon gate, found only on dungeon level 1, which lets you skip part of the first floor; red gates do not work. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553537305313280061)
- **necromancy trainer locations**: Necromancy trainers are found on Shelter Island (Mage shop west of the main plaza) and in Prevalia, on the way to the dock, next to the stable, and in the library west/north of the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-05–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552351680211718198)
- **outlands custom map**: The Outlands custom map is hand-made rather than procedurally generated, and Owyn is the person primarily associated with its design. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529278569287520446)
- **paladin chivalry gate**: A character with enough Chivalry, such as a Paladin, can cast a Chivalry gate spell (the guy-on-a-horse icon in the book or hotbar) to open gates to towns and dungeons that other players can use. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703027267993621)
- **prevalia bard location**: The bard NPC in Prevalia is south of the bank, between the zoo and the castle gate, against a wall just east of the Paladin. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554529396230979615)
- **prevalia horse quest apple cart**: The apple cart for the horse quest in Prevalia is in the southwest of Upper Prevalia. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553481587310600374)
- **prevalia thief guild master location**: The thief guild master in Prevalia stands near the bridge between Upper and Lower Prevalia, outside and south of the zoo. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526942209348337704)
- **recalling to inn room**: You cannot recall directly into a rented inn room, but you can write a script that recalls and enters the room with a single button. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553102690916241440)
- **rune tomes and recall**: Runes are marked with the Mark spell to store a location, and Recall cast on a rune teleports the caster there. A rune tome holds many runes and also holds Recall scroll charges, so a character without Magery can recall using those charges. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545006297328394311)
- **runebook versus rune tome**: A rune tome is a larger, better runebook with more rune slots and recall charge storage, plus options to rearrange and rename runes without removing them, while a normal runebook is cheaper but holds fewer runes and charges. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547312540294578227)
- **sacred journey activation**: To use Sacred Journey, click activate ability in the Chivalry book (or double-click its icon in the Chivalry hotbar), then choose a destination such as a town or dungeon, which summons a portal you can use. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529206002241765627)
- **sanctuary dungeon weekly reset**: The Sanctuary dungeon changes weekly on Fridays, and the countdown to the reset is visible in game. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554844508385050655)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: The weekly sanctuary dungeon is safe from PKs, so farming there avoids PK worries. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535362503482151035)
- **travel without magery**: Players without Magery or Chivalry can use Recall and Gate travel via a rune tome or runebook, provided it holds the appropriate scrolls or recall charges. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531074963044302858)
- **adventurer's rope**: The Adventurer's Rope is the item that lets you blink a short distance without casting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546637557209768088)
- **anchor's rest access**: Anchor's Rest is a town reached via the public moongates; from its docks a ferry to the west takes you to the town proper. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523498431421878434)
- **atlas for hiking**: Type [atlas in game to open the Atlas, which is used for hiking and travel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533410160033136640)
- **bear location on newbie island**: Bears on Newbie Island are on the second floor of the newbie dungeon, reached via the southeast or far east entry stairs, with a bear right at the top of the stairs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525913247155224636)
- **camping travel skill requirement**: Travelling to Atlas locations via camping (Hike) requires about 60 Camping skill, and the locations are stored in a blessed Atlas. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538003349222334465)
- **carrion beetle spawn locations**: Carrion beetles spawn on Morthuna and in the Mausoleum; Explore Outlands lists 6 spawns, but the 3 Mausoleum entries are really one spawn while the Morthuna ones are separate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536624422499393536)
- **casino access via prevalia**: The casino is reached through the gate to Prevalia, and the Prevalia boat from the Shelter Island docks also goes there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537541718482624634)
- **citadel progressive spawn**: The Citadel progressive spawn is no longer active. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725567862771732)
- **current sanctuary dungeon**: The sanctuary dungeon for the week of 2026-09-26 is Kraul Hive, and its level 1 is good for newer players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553535603692413019)
- **dungeon gate spell requirements**: Casting the Dungeon gate spell requires 90 base (printed) Chivalry, with equipment bonuses not counting, plus 90 Tactics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543650141825933502)
- **explore outlands map accuracy**: Explore Outlands is outdated for some content, for example it does not mark a progressive spawn in Midlands Ruins 1. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547551536534786069)
- **fast dungeon travel with runebook**: To travel to dungeons quickly, use a character able to cast the Dungeon gate/mark spells to mark a runebook with a rune for each dungeon, then use the runebook to travel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525654842385629334)
- **fast travel options**: Rune libraries provide fast travel for characters without chivalry or hiking options, and an Atlas with Hiking is a recommended fast travel method. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539297138641473546)
- **filling a rune tome**: To fill a rune tome with locations, mark runes at the desired locations and drop them into the tome. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542328580472578088)
- **forsaken keep difficulty**: The Forsaken Keep, the black brick fortress outside Prevalia with rift cultists, is an Expert-level area. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522341292028465205)
- **frenzied ostard locations**: Frenzied ostards are spread all over the wilderness and can also be bought at the stable from the broker. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525125001022279740)
- **getting runes for new player locations book**: Buy blank runes from mage NPCs, have a player mage with enough Magery to reliably cast Mark mark them, then add them to the New Player Locations book (tome); alternatively get a marked rune from another player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452160245694535)
- **gloomwood shaman and pathfinder location**: Gloomwood Shaman and Gloomwood Pathfinder, needed for the huntmaster task, are found in Old Papua. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529522783380443206)
- **go command on test server**: On the test server the [go command cannot warp to arbitrary coordinates; you can teleport via the menus, or go to a nearby point of interest and run the rest of the way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523320514888597656)
- **goblin location**: Goblins can be found on the first level of Aegis, which is usable for the Slayer Society goblin quest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541786692489445458)
- **hair and beard restoration stylist**: A stylist NPC in Prevalia, next to the Casino and Society Hall, can restore your hair and beard to normal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539095306971390052)
- **healer at la cosa nostra headquarters**: A healer at the La Cosa Nostra headquarters can resurrect players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541800710600134739)
- **healer map icons**: On the in-game world map, town healers appear as a green square with a gold ankh, and healer caravans appear as a white icon with a red cross. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532754287522746439)
- **healers on world map**: Right-clicking the world map and showing caravans reveals healers in the area, typically at dungeon entrances and some other points, but wandering healers are not shown, so find a healer before entering a dangerous zone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523512177166909540)
- **hiking requirements**: Hiking no longer requires a secure campfire or explorer pack after the latest patch; only 60+ Camping skill is needed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537152036293054535)
- **hiking to marked spots and inn**: Players can hike (mark and travel) to marked spots using three free custom slots, a script can hike to the inn, say the room and click it, and the 'new player' tab already includes the previous inn location. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546514394249302016)
- **jeweler location**: Jewelers are found in cities, and in the city the Jeweler is located in the west, against the walls. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533248248867848295)
- **least crowded city**: Cambria is probably the least populated city, though its bank is still fairly crowded. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525524690884493472)
- **marking runes for recall**: With 60 Magery, buy blank runes, plus Mark and Recall scrolls added to your spellbook and reagents; cast Mark, target a blank rune at the desired spot, rename it by double-clicking, then add runes to a rune tome. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549619803856314449)
- **maus level 4 dungeon difficulty**: Maus level 4 is regarded as one of the roughest and most annoying level 4 dungeons and is harder than Cavernam level 4. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522792137089876082)
- **moongates**: Every city has a moongate that leads to other cities or near them, and the Shelter Island moongate, located up on the mountain, can be used to reach other moongates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553735784056492063)
- **mount petram route from cc**: Mount Petram may be closer to CC, but reaching it means going around a mountain rather than taking a straight path. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530310169710428271)
- **nightmare location in ossuary**: Nightmares are located inside the small maze on level 2 of the Ossuary. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522734313014165554)
- **nusero mining location**: Nusero is a mining location with heavy dragon presence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549869236820910081)
- **ocean boat safety**: A small or medium boat on the ocean is one of the safest ways to play Outlands, since ocean danger was greatly reduced by the big ocean patch from the previous year. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521069796769267782)
- **outlands butler creature library**: The Outlands Butler Creature Library website (outlandsbutler.com/creaturelibrary) shows where creatures, including tameables, spawn. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524115875156721897)
- **outpost moongate runebooks**: The Outpost moongate has player-hosted points-of-interest runebooks that anyone can use by dropping a recall scroll on the book they want to use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545718164804079616)
- **outpost rune library**: A public rune library is in the battle trainer house directly behind the Outpost moongate, with runebooks everyone can use, including a book of dungeon runes on the table outside the door. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703344290144257)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons**: Ratman Hovel and Urukton Bluffs are permanent sanctuary dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541390939916869732)
- **pets glitching underground**: Pets can glitch underground in the Paralia sewers and in Darkmire. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551309681073324153)
- **prevalia animal broker location**: An Animal Broker NPC is at the stables just north of and behind the Prevalia bank; brokers are usually near Stable Keepers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546525263334998127)
- **prevalia exchange officer location**: The Prevalia exchange officer is located between the stylist and the casino, and accepts emptied paragon chests in trade. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536419999051284580)
- **prevalia paladin location**: In Prevalia, the paladin is in a room or small tower in the wall next to the main road leading to the eastern gate, at the castle entrance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526564531436916918)
- **prevalia thief and paladin npc locations**: The Thief NPC in Prevalia is not far from the bridge between Upper and Lower Prevalia, and the Paladin NPC is just north west of the Thief NPC. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547241257078620170)
- **prevalia thief npc location**: The thief NPC in Prevalia who buys black goods is in the bottom right area of the map, to the left of the zoo. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555897447014731779)
- **public library dungeon travel**: Public libraries can be used to travel to dungeons, and one such option is the Outpost moongate, located at the same house as the battle trainer. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527908686746484736)
- **public repair benches**: Free public repair benches are located near many moongates, including a small building just northeast of the Outpost moongate, and are easier to use than repair kits, which have restrictions and require unequipping items. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **public rune libraries**: Public rune libraries exist near practically every moongate, and the most commonly used one is just north of the Outpost Moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534167267720298636)
- **rare drops in stalag grotto**: Rare items are reported to drop in Stalag Grotto. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525541668055683183)
- **ratman hovel access**: Ratman Hovel is not a standard dungeon and must be reached on foot or by runetome. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522378224771010682)
- **reaching a treasure map location via witcher runes**: To reach a treasure map location, find the closest Witcher rune to the map location (Witcher tmap numbers can be added to your map in game); a friend can then use a Witcher runebook to recall to that spot and travel the rest of the way. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546272825982189588)
- **reaching tidal tomb**: Travel to Tidal Tomb using a rune to it from a public library runebook, since most public libraries have one; this also works for other dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545919172985356381)
- **recall mana cost**: Casting Recall (including via Rune Tome charges) costs 11 mana, so a character needs at least 11 intelligence and should keep 11 mana available, especially when wearing plate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553577856917962863)
- **recall requirements**: Recall only works if you have a rune marked to the destination. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546761967438405632)
- **recalling in the overworld**: In the overworld you can recall anywhere, including to escape when tracking finds a red. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521546247251427549)
- **recalling to a rune**: To recall without opening a runebook, say '[recall <rune name>' or '[recallcharge <rune name>' and the game searches all your runebooks for that rune. To recall to your default rune, cast Recall and target the runebook where that rune is set as default. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529459567837319208)
- **recalling to an inn**: Mark a rune to your inn, put it in a runebook with recall scrolls, recall to it, and say 'room' to go inside. A recall macro for escaping makes this a safe, quick way to bring loot home and avoid thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549185351636226109)
- **red gate destinations**: Red gates in dungeons take you to a town of your choosing. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521546954482389034)
- **riverside vendor mall**: Riverside is a vendor mall reachable by port from Prevalia, run by a bot that is normally always present (except right after a server restart) and offers a rune library, repair bench and a lockpicking bot, with a Chivalry gate opened behind the bank by the bot spamming text. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545332556365439046)
- **ruined lycaeum difficulty**: The ruined Lycaeum is harder than the nearby valley because it has magical mobs, and its healer is the caravan at the ruined Lycaeum. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549248769852178593)
- **ruined original map remnants**: Outlands contains a ruined, abandoned version of Papua and a ruined version of Jhelom, with other remnants of the original UO map scattered around the new map. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671584335364167)
- **rune libraries**: Rune Libraries exist in the game and help players travel to places such as the safe farm in Deadmire Temple. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552383019757740083)
- **sacred journey combat restriction**: Sacred Journey cannot be used for some time after being in combat, and attempting it shows the message 'You have been in combat too recently to use that ability.' _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550231961023414292)
- **sanctuary dungeon safety**: The dungeon marked (Sanctuary) in the atlas is a safe dungeon where players cannot be looted or killed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550759470311931915)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Shelter, the sewers, ratman and urukton dungeons are sanctuary dungeons, along with the dungeon in the weekly rotation, and they are good places to find other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546045541593645089)
- **scarab location**: Scarabs are found in the Ossuary. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525284430527332443)
- **shelter haven town**: Shelter Haven is the small town next to Shelter, toward the path town, containing a cathedral/abbey and an inn, and is named only through the healer caravan. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531782731124576509)
- **shelter island boat**: The boat from Shelter Island is a one-way trip, so you cannot use it to return, but you can get back to Shelter Island via a moongate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541186295202578503)
- **shelter island dungeon guard**: The protector or guard in the Shelter Island dungeon is a player character running a script, not an NPC, and may sometimes be offline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540450786507489422)
- **shelter island thief trainer location**: The thief trainer on Shelter Island is located in the tavern or inn, and can train lockpicking. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555019491547549878)
- **starting runetome contents**: The starting runetome does not include a rune to Andaria, but runes can be added to it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552883349914390559)
- **telescope island poi runes**: Telescope Island is a POI whose runes can be found at rune libraries, and the Outpost moongate has a house behind the gate for POI spots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554480049124540531)
- **terracite vein**: Terracite vein is a Lycaeum quest location and is unrelated to mining. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526422288788881599)
- **tidal tomb leveling spot**: Tidal Tomb near the stairs to level 3 is a farming spot for a leveling arcane mage, with pincer crabs, shellpods, ironscale groupers and ocean bedrock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526598410554048532)
- **tidal tomb map listing**: Tidal Tomb appears on the Explore Outlands map as a point of interest rather than a dungeon entrance, near coordinates 3865,3597. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530366088653570088)
- **tidal tomb sanctuary dungeon**: Tidal Tomb is the new Sanctuary dungeon in Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530364627966361610)
- **town npc availability**: Every town has the same set of NPCs, except Prevalia, which has all the special NPCs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549601234455896067)
- **travel to dungeons without sacred journey**: Without Sacred Journey, players can reach dungeons by walking, camping, using rune books or the Recall spell, and cartography can also be used for travel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546750751588491305)
- **uko/uruk dungeon**: Uko/Uruk refers to the orc dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330018614517811)
- **urukton bluffs dungeon sanctuary**: Urukton Bluffs is a sanctuary only once you are inside the dungeon itself, not in the surrounding area. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552046348910592083)
- **urukton dungeon location**: Urukton dungeon is just outside the starting town of Hailstone, which is SIR's territory. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545164175108735087)
- **viewing region bonuses**: To see region bonuses, such as which dungeon is sanctuary or has the gold bonus, check the posters or maps near town banks; some are also shown in your [atlas. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520900447584522360)
- **walking to tidal tombs**: To walk to Tidal Tombs, use the public moongate system to travel to Totem on the same continent, then run from there, which takes a while. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530646031832973373)
- **weapon skill training npcs**: A weapon-skill training NPC at the Prevalia moongate trains skills by being hit, and another is in the tome library through the vendor gate at the Prevalia bank stairs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530445805994115265)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeons**: To find which dungeons are Sanctuary dungeons each week, say [alts or [atlas, open help alts, or double-click the map at the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522426941611708487)
- **witcher rune numbers**: Witcher Numbers are a numbered rune system created by a player named Witcher, used in runebook systems and public rune libraries, so a vendor named W123 is at Witcher location 123. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521718601407664271)
- **24/7 gate bot locations**: A 24/7 gate bot is available at Shelter Island MG and Prevalia Bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531090031408709662)
- **8x8 grid on world map**: To display the 8x8 grid on the world map, zoom in on the world map until white gridlines appear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522900327999868998)
- **adding marked rune to runebook**: Drag and drop a marked rune onto a runebook or rune tome, provided no book or tome is currently open on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553452474956910693)
- **aegis keep location**: Aegis Keep is a short run to the east of Horseshoe Bay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530309753815961800)
- **aegis keep xp dungeon**: Aegis Keep is currently the XP dungeon and grants an aspect XP bonus, though it is unclear whether it also helps codex XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541850695911612427)
- **alchemist shop location**: The alchemist shop is the unmarked building north of the bank and west of the inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534975724606328933)
- **andaria outpost tunnel and bridge**: A tunnel leads from Andaria toward Outpost, and a bridge at Outpost leads to the continent containing Anchor's Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541188796383502376)
- **apple cart location**: The apple cart used for feeding a horse is in the western area of Upper Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524310874532089917)
- **apple cart location in prevalia**: The apple cart in Prevalia is located north-west of Prevalia's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545003004955201607)
- **arachnai ravager location**: The only location listed on the wiki for Arachnai Ravager is Darkmire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526604212082049034)
- **armoured wizard's hat vendor**: The armoured wizard's hat can be bought from Jakesh the Prev Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535841040886669413)
- **armourer location on shelter island**: The armourer NPC is located east of the main plaza on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549693215261855804)
- **atlas book hiking with exploration effect**: Players with an active Exploration Effect can hike to destinations in their Atlas Book without securing a campfire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528068217304780920)
- **atlas hiking requirement**: Using the atlas to hike to locations appears to require the Camping skill; a character without Camping reportedly cannot use it this way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538584300595978330)
- **atlas hiking versus recall**: Hiking via the Atlas takes about 5-6 seconds and needs 60 camping or cartography, while recall scrolls and runebooks or rune libraries are faster and need no skill investment, making recall the meta. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537464310886830170)
- **atlas interface**: Type [atlas in game to summon the Atlas into your bag; it is the interface used for camping and travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525595837433118881)
- **atlas poi access**: With 60 Camping, your Atlas gives you access to all the POIs, letting you hike to them without magery or recall scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537463145377824970)
- **avadon danger and group play**: Avadon is full of criminals, so guilds usually do treasure-map type content there in sizable groups to fend off attackers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524135234805956779)
- **bard tamer hunting locations**: Good hunting places for a bard tamer include Ossuary level 3 (humans), Darkmire underground, and Kraul Hive level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527941915688042518)
- **barrel of apples quest location**: The barrel of apples quest object is at the southwest gate in Prevalia, not far from the jeweler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538059132035141662)
- **battle trainer house location**: The battle trainer house is just to the right of the Outpost moongate and is reachable from any other world moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543300349220229251)
- **battle trainers area npc**: The only NPC in the area with the battle trainers is a banker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537765972218351616)
- **blessable head items from prevalia shop**: Other blessable head items can be bought from the Prevalia shop left of the bank, and anything labeled armor counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549925116039663687)
- **blessed runebook emergency escape**: Work toward obtaining a blessed runebook so you have an instant emergency escape button instead of having to run away from danger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537599069843755159)
- **blessed runetome**: The blessed runetome holds many runes, and recall scrolls dropped into it provide charges so players without Magery can recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526136660507496488)
- **blessed traveler's torch vendor**: The blessed traveler's torch was probably sold by the vendor Jakesh, unless it was a limited-time item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548856201255723019)
- **bluffs dungeon chests**: The Bluffs have dungeon chests that require lockpicking to open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555068621812797493)
- **boat controls**: Boat driving is done through in-game commands, other boat actions use in-game macros, and all commands can be found in the help commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536711762123161623)
- **boat launch cooldown after recall**: Boating has a cooldown on launching a boat after recalling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537964440811471000)
- **boat storage at shelter**: Get your boat from the Shelter dock and return it to the Dock Master there when finished; the boat is not blessed, so never leave Shelter with it in your backpack and never dry dock it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549421660900167833)
- **boating explorer pack**: To use boating, double click the explorer pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528325376261230672)
- **book of grudges vendor**: The Book of Grudges is sold by the Prevalia Merchant outside the main bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525232617530593350)
- **bot summoning gates in orevalia**: Summoning gates run by bots in Orevalia announce where they lead, and many announce repair benches, libraries and other services. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552299877109604353)
- **brigand road blocker chests**: Brigands or orcs blocking roads usually have locked chests, their leader usually carries the key, and the locks can also be picked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542880322629144606)
- **broken silver horn turn-in**: Turn in the Broken Silver Horn to Selwyn the Archivist as part of the quest 'The Old Lycaeum of Moonglow'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523686603451535511)
- **buying a taming bestiary**: To buy a taming bestiary, search the Outlands Portal for a vendor selling one, preferring a vendor located near a town or point of interest that you can reach with a tmap or runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551908371882311692)
- **camping and atlas travel to poi markers**: With 60 Camping and an Atlas, a player can easily travel to all of the blue POI markers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532392243346931754)
- **camping fast travel network**: Camping offers a very extensive network of locations (places of interest) for fast travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528001908453675072)
- **camping location unlocking**: Atlas camping locations no longer have to be unlocked by exploring; that was the older system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525598628427858083)
- **camping skill hiking**: With 60 camping skill, a player can hike to dungeons, points of interest and towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551146723643232307)
- **camping travel with atlas points of interest**: With the Camping skill and the Atlas, the Points of Interest tab combined with the exploreoutlands website lets you reach most of the world by camping and hiking for the cost of a piece of kindling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527322189114642592)
- **carpenter npc location**: The Carpenter NPC is located southwest of the Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537764784601170021)
- **cartography world atlas hiking**: Cartography lets you use your world atlas for hiking, giving a quick way to travel around the entire world. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548271948255989853)
- **cave bear and ostard sources**: Cave bears for taming can be found near Shelter, and ostards can be bought from the broker at any stable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529459073051918376)
- **chameleon spawn locations**: Chameleons are found at three spawns in Nusero level 1, one in Nusero level 2, and one in Shelter dungeon level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554580388914012201)
- **chivalry for travel versus runebook**: If you only want Chivalry for travel, buying a runebook is a better option than training Chivalry for the Gate spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543650414438780988)
- **chivalry gate**: The Chivalry gate spell is the easiest way to get around and also grants a damage buff when used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554361652126818409)
- **chivalry gate hate one-way travel**: The Chivalry gate hate (gate travel) is usable only one way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546228642789720074)
- **chivalry gates for dexxers**: Chivalry gives dexxers gates to every dungeon and town, and apart from Divine Fury (the haste buff) the other symbols are useful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529187597589680281)
- **chivalry gates unlock**: At around 90 or 95 chivalry, players gain access to chiv gates that make travel to core dungeons and towns easier; the exact threshold is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548768853977342134)
- **chivalry sacred journey ability**: Chivalry's second-to-last ability, Sacred Journey, creates a gold gate that leads to a town, dungeon, or shrine. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532753420275028099)
- **closest healers after death**: Outpost, Terran, Totem and Shelter are believed to be the towns with the healers closest to run to when dead, and the Terran healer is just down and to the left of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525805326727643196)
- **closest location to ratman hovel**: Witcher 22a is the closest location to Ratman Hovel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522379101720285186)
- **closest moongate to cavernam**: The closest moongate to Cavernam is probably Outpost, reached by running through the underground tunnel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532382889671393381)
- **clothing bless deeds**: Clothes can be blessed, and the merchant Jakesh sells clothing bless deeds next to Prevalia's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855734144475157)
- **codex society quest location for solo dexxers**: For a solo dexxer, the sewers are probably the easiest place to do the codex society quest because they are the closest run to the bank and a healer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538661461713232053)
- **colossal strider spawn location**: Colossal striders spawn at coordinates 3735,2787 on the Explore Outlands map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542275820960088155)
- **combat trainer location**: A trainer with target dummies for hitting practice is located at the Prevalia Gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524576393499775046)
- **common travel methods across avadon**: Common ways to travel across Avadon include public or personal rune libraries and the player-made Witcher runes system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528001411445428264)
- **comprehensive public rune location**: One public rune location has runebooks covering points of interest, towns, Witcher, taming and recall farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534168841733537993)
- **corpse creek danger**: Everyone at Corpse Creek is grey (flagged), so it is dangerous to enter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533662678785069117)
- **corpse creek town**: Corpse Creek is the lawless town and is described as the least popular town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551694719967301734)
- **corpse creek zone status**: Corpse Creek is a lawless zone in the wilderness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547795480908660882)
- **creatures outside shadowspire**: Some creatures not listed on Outlands Explorer can be found outside Shadowspire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529485654508044348)
- **cult of deceit quest location access**: The Cult of Deceit quest location can be reached via normal gates to the Totem or via the Kraul dungeon, and the quest may require a boat or an inn room in Totem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537117952388636733)
- **current sanctuary dungeon**: The current sanctuary dungeon is Cav. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521980716114510027)
- **custom location dungeon recall rule**: The yellow moongate dungeon recall rule may recently have been extended to work for hiking and sacred journey custom locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386540247523389)
- **custom map markers**: Right-click the in-game map and choose Add Marker by Player to place a named custom marker, for example to label dungeon locations such as the level 1 Cavernam. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538600057262047333)
- **custom moongate to ratman hovel**: With enough Chivalry skill, after running to Ratman Hovel the first time you can set your custom moongate there for fast travel on future trips. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522378817270710514)
- **daemon keep zone type**: The Daemon Keep is a neutral no-law zone used for factions and PvP, with some PvM also taking place there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522341826533654549)
- **danger at witcher rune and poi spots**: Many Witcher rune and point-of-interest spots can be dangerous because of mobs nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528003651208220745)
- **deep crawler spawn locations**: Deep crawlers reportedly spawn in the far northwest corner of floor 2 and possibly on the overworld beach east of the Sacrificial Cliffs POI, south of far southeast Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542642895998296095)
- **dockmaster purchase location**: The Dockmaster can be purchased from a Prevalia merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523825438848450631)
- **dragon taming location**: Dragons to tame can be found west of Andaria, in the mountains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549448792548450395)
- **dungeon chest locations**: Dungeon chests stay at fixed locations and are not randomized. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555041086794371165)
- **dungeon difficulty bot command**: The bot command !dungeondiff shows dungeon difficulty information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542229445404925983)
- **dungeon difficulty parity**: Apart from Kraul Hive, Tidal Tomb and Shadowspire, the other dungeons are roughly equal in difficulty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552075359246090281)
- **dungeon gate exit destination**: Walking through the gate when leaving a dungeon ports you back to your town of choice at a random spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545333587547787334)
- **dungeon list and buffs**: The list of dungeons and their buffs is posted every Friday at reset in a Discord channel, and a map or banner showing it is placed near every bank in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987453022445729)
- **dungeon moongates as exits**: Yellow and red moongates inside a dungeon are quick exits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550547364693934286)
- **dungeon recall near yellow moongates**: You can mark runes and recall into or out of a dungeon when within 8 tiles of the yellow moongate on the dungeon's first floor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550386540247523389)
- **dungeon rune books availability**: House vendors don't usually sell full rune books of dungeons, but most guilds have them available for members to use, and public rune libraries likely exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551313889181040825)
- **dungeon travel methods**: Players can reach a dungeon by walking or running, by casting Recall (reagents or scrolls) on a recall book or rune for that dungeon, by hiking with the Camping skill using the world atlas, or by using Chivalry's Sacred Journey to create a portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526888404774551573)
- **dusk black vendor location**: Dusk Black is sold by the Prevalia merchant Jakesh outside the main bank under hued cloth, and is mostly for cloth, shields and accessories rather than armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521505095185858590)
- **early arcane mage leveling at fury's caldera**: Early-leveling arcane mages can mind blast obsidians and scoria at Fury's Caldera, which is a good sweet spot when starting out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526598340534599920)
- **early grinding locations**: Before entering the post-skill XP progression systems, most grinding in Outlands is done in the new player dungeon and the three perma sanctuary dungeons, with a handful of overworld spots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527070887625490653)
- **easiest stablemaster location**: The easiest stablemaster to find is in the tunnel west of the outpost moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524148283264466965)
- **escaping isolated islands via help menu**: A player stuck on an isolated island such as Dragon Roost can use the Help option in the in-game help menu to get to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555898708363841627)
- **ettin valley gold grinding spot**: An unnamed valley north of the ruined Lycaeum, nicknamed Ettin Valley by one player, has ogres and a nearby healer caravan around a waypost and is a gold-grinding spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549248115134177352)
- **ettin valley location**: Ettin Valley is located near Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521647389495005266)
- **event objects blocking runes in prevalia**: Temporary event objects can sometimes block runes marked in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547670560018800650)
- **explore outlands map user markers**: User markers in the Explore Outlands map should not disappear on their own; if they appear missing, they may have been disabled in the map menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530906851779149865)
- **explore outlands player tracking**: The Explore Outlands tool no longer tracks players in real time because the player tracking API was removed, so it shows coordinates of 0,0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366920304066722)
- **explore outlands tool**: Apart from the removed player tracking, Explore Outlands is simply a website. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551366920304066722)
- **exploreoutlands website map**: The exploreoutlands website offers a large map with filters showing dungeons and related information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529191256553422920)
- **exploreoutlands witcher location after t-map update**: After the T-map update, players can still use ExploreOutlands to find the witcher location: hike to the area, crop the minimap, get the witcher number, then reveal the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531086588484784258)
- **exploreoutlands.com accuracy**: exploreoutlands.com is fairly out of date and does not mark some progressive spawns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546523121748672562)
- **explorer pack buff**: An explorer pack grants a 1 hour buff that removes the need for a secure campfire to hike. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534398409048330432)
- **faction access to old dungeons**: Participating in factions reportedly gives access to the old dungeons, whose monsters were redone, and the layout is believed but not confirmed to match the original. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527070833204265110)
- **faction dungeon rotation list**: Dungeons that rotate into faction dungeons include Destard, Deceit, Shame and Cove. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552712775053213858)
- **finding locations**: Locations can be found using the in-game map with coordinates or the website exploreoutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525325698955214878)
- **finding monster locations**: To find monster locations such as Banshees, use the Explore Outlands feature or the Outlands Butler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547406601890172948)
- **finding witcher vendor locations**: Many vendor shop names include a Witcher number like W116; alternatively, use the vendor portal button that opens the location in Explore Outlands, where Witcher locations can be toggled on in the left panel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537477336218345603)
- **fire mephit location**: The Fire Mephit can be found in Shadowspire Cathedral on level 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528976964273176680)
- **fishing island healer**: The fishing island reportedly has a healer to the south that can be reached by walking across shallow water, though this is recalled from memory and unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552258037727756328)
- **forest ostard and llama spawns near terran**: Forest ostards and llamas are sometimes found outside Terran. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539645408836583515)
- **forsaken keep death timeout**: If you stay dead too long in Forsaken Keep, you are taken to Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528512661497839866)
- **free custom camping spots**: Camping has custom camping spots that can be used for free. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527322324926337188)
- **gate spell restriction near town bank**: Gate spells cannot be cast close to the bank in town, but moving a little further away from the bank allows casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532922605483593778)
