- **gate travel**: Gate Travel lets a player teleport to dungeons or towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531526956389105726)
- **gate travel restrictions**: Opening a gate with the Gate Travel spell is forbidden in certain locations such as the Societies Hall, where it gives the message 'A mysterious force prevents your spell from working here'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550790415689449624)
- **gating a red player with chivalry**: A blue player sneaks ahead of the red, marks the target spot, and then gates the red player in using a Chivalry gate (Sacred Journey). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547374691398848542)
- **gender change deed purchase**: Buy a Gender Change Deed from the Prevalian Merchant in the Prevalia shop left of the bank; a name change deed is also sold there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529940272098578432)
- **giant spider locations**: Giant Spiders are found nearly everywhere in the wilderness, are easy to find with Tracking, and can otherwise be located using exploreoutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542501557491339364)
- **godfrey north library tower npc route**: To reach the NPC locked in the tower during the Godfrey north library quest, use the runic tiles to teleport from the ground floor to the second, then to the third, then climb a ladder and another set of stairs to his floor; alternatively, a path in the building just right of the library skips the tiles and enters the library next to the ladder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555337996163620975)
- **gold gates**: Gold gates are one-way, so a player who goes through one must return by Chivalry, camping, or recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555899781543501885)
- **golden statue all tomes option**: The Golden Statue's All Tomes option provides a link tome containing every obtainable chain link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554051524513103943)
- **guild islands**: Many islands with large empty squares on them are likely guild islands, and there are now quite a few of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530017044559302776)
- **guild runebooks**: Guild members may have access to a set of points-of-interest runebooks or runetomes, though this is stated tentatively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549754861212663819)
- **guild runebooks**: Guilds also provide runebooks or runetomes that members can use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532746728187625524)
- **hailstone to urukton road safety**: The road from Hailstone to Urukton is usually relatively safe to travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545164398467747964)
- **harpy location**: A few harpies can be found south of Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540586208684675222)
- **harpy nest location**: A nest of harpies is located northwest of Horsehoe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550201531578454188)
- **healer caravan at urukton**: A healer caravan, shown as a white square with a red cross, sits not far outside the entrance of the orc dungeon (Urukton) and can resurrect players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539114601264980078)
- **healer distance from sunscale area**: A healer is about a 2 minute walk from the Sunscale area, and the totem is also not far away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526987725218119811)
- **hiking out of dungeons**: You cannot hike out of a dungeon from the yellow gate, so recall is the better way to leave. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527327637565997106)
- **hiking restrictions**: Normal hiking restrictions include things like PvP flags and a frozen character, not a skill requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536831254010400798)
- **hiking via camping**: Hiking via Camping reportedly requires surviving for about 5 seconds before it completes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527327051353292860)
- **hiking with camping skill**: Hiking with the Camping skill lets a player travel to the different points of interest (POIs) in the world, which is handy for getting around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537152036293054535)
- **horseshoe bay and cambria beekeepers**: Horseshoe Bay beekeepers are Carroll the Beekeeper and Chet, and the Cambria beekeeper is Jacques. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551067123659571311)
- **horseshoe bay armorer**: The armorer in Horseshoe Bay stands next to the blacksmith and sells leather and studded leather armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527342347468410980)
- **horseshoe bay pk**: A PK reportedly lives in a house near the Horseshoe Bay mining route and shows up on tracking, which may trigger scripts that recall you away when a red appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534927242398924881)
- **horseshoe bay training house**: There is a training house at Horseshoe Bay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535252344076238969)
- **ice node ground items in cav**: The 'Ice Node' items on the ground in Cav that delete after a few minutes are Lyceum quest items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521489613523521639)
- **identifying dungeons with the wiki**: To identify a dungeon, compare its layout against the maps in the wiki Dungeons category to find the matching name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554866894195130408)
- **ikea castle vendor rentals**: A castle named Ikea, reached via a portal in Shelter Island, offers vendor rentals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524533510130499624)
- **in-game healer locator**: There is no in-game way to point toward the nearest healer after dying in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518632778047588)
- **infinity coin vendor location**: The Infinity Coin vendor is located in Colony. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553200665009061909)
- **inns in towns**: Every town in Outlands has an inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554607384314249277)
- **iron bank public repair bench**: A public repair bench is in The Iron Bank, a large building just north of Prevalia's north gate on the left side of the road. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549697789728923671)
- **island healers**: Islands tend to have only a wandering healer NPC rather than a healer caravan, and wandering healers are not marked on exploreoutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546518784364388392)
- **island rune book location**: Island Rune Books can be found east of Witcher 305. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533143846928650433)
- **jakesh npc location**: Jakesh is an NPC located just south west of the main bank in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553502125819044014)
- **jakesh vendor location**: The vendor Jakesh is located at the King's Faire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540743712521326753)
- **jungle ban bot and battle trainer**: The Jungle location has a ban bot, and the battle trainer is in the middle of that room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552587799973339187)
- **kindling npc vendor in shelter**: An NPC in the Shelter area sells kindling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537763794090991726)
- **king's faire portal locations**: A portal to the King's Faire is reportedly located next to every bank, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541895113444171806)
- **king's faire scratch-off tickets**: Scratch-off tickets from the King's Faire are bought from the Prevalia merchant, who is moved to the Faire while it is running. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541914599530438779)
- **king's faire ticket booth location**: King's Faire tickets are sold at the ticket booth visible when you come in off the docks at the Faire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540735026197565470)
- **kraul hive access**: Kraul Hive can be walked to from the Totem Moongate but the route is quite dangerous; otherwise teleport from a public rune library, where Witcher runes 325 and 331 are close to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553862642538520737)
- **land expansion preview period**: During a land expansion there may be a preview period in which players can scout promising areas, and mark runes can be used to save locations, though this depends on the expansion following the previous pattern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539269626079350846)
- **lawless region near docks**: The land near the docks is not lawless; only the region that boats float in is lawless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526315303494090823)
- **leaving a dungeon**: To leave a dungeon, walk outside; a gate portal may also work, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550371139228925963)
- **leaving the lycaeum**: To leave the Lycaeum, take the gray gate that returns you to Prev and avoid the blue gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540484115193663618)
- **locating nearest healer**: There is no command to locate the nearest healer, but healers can usually be found on the world map if healer markers are enabled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555685276406259855)
- **logging out inside a dungeon**: Logging out inside a dungeon may relocate your character outside the dungeon or to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528670768291119204)
- **lower prevalia inn rental**: Rooms cannot be rented in Lower Prevalia; the rentable inn is always the one in Upper Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545640964981264457)
- **lycaeum weekly shrine quest**: The Lycaeum has a recurring weekly quest to visit all shrines on foot, which suggests every shrine is reachable on foot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541234032837263521)
- **mage shop location**: A mage shop selling reagents is located just south down the road from the area the player was in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525838595187937351)
- **magery trainer locations**: Mage NPCs teach Magery; on Shelter Island they are on the west side of town, and in Prevalia they are just north of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555042958313656443)
- **main city**: Prevalia is the main and biggest city in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531514341223043122)
- **main popular city**: Prevalia is the main and most popular city. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551168103428259911)
- **making runes for a runebook**: An alt with 60 Magery can use cheap mark scrolls bought from vendors to make runes for a runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527805822518820947)
- **making your own rune**: To make your own rune, buy a blank rune from a mage NPC, cast Mark (6th circle) on it at the desired location, double click the rune to name it, then drag it onto your rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545180240890961922)
- **map drop sources**: All maps drop from mobs and may also be found in dungeon chests and paragon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548974689852985405)
- **map maker location**: Map makers are typically found near the harbor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520416513406795826)
- **map orientation option**: The map orientation can be matched to the game screen by using the 45 degree option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532799343596146770)
- **margery for t8 boss access**: Margery is useful for gating other players into the location of a T8 boss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538599654847946913)
- **marking a rune**: To mark a rune, cast the Mark spell and target a blank rune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539800225181605888)
- **marking custom spots by dungeon gates in atlas**: To mark a custom spot next to a yellow dungeon gate in your atlas, use the Camping skill to make a campfire at that spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541914181111128166)
- **marking runes in low-traffic spots**: Mark runes in out-of-the-way, low-traffic spots so players or NPCs are unlikely to block the destination. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547666893563895878)
- **marking runes near dungeon gates**: Mark a rune inside a dungeon near the yellow gates so you can recall straight back there; marking near the red gates is not possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550547510949453915)
- **marking runes near the bank**: Don't try to mark a rune right next to the bank; try another spot and check the message you get. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676535073538139)
- **marking runes on alt character**: Runes can be marked on an alt character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541794148170858576)
- **marking runes via mage**: Ask a mage to mark a rune for you, then place the marked rune into your runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526136271825670217)
- **marking runes without mark spell**: A Paladin who cannot cast Mark can create an alt on another account to mark runes for the runetome obtained from the new player quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553703027267993621)
- **marking vendor coordinates on map**: To mark a vendor's location, copy the coordinates from the vendor search page, then right-click the in-game map and choose 'add marker on player' to place an X at those coordinates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543698245115711488)
- **martial manual vendor**: The martial manual is sold by a Scribe NPC, probably in the mage's shop on Shelter Island, though the exact location is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549842679209267282)
- **medium ship for fishing**: A medium ship is a good choice for fishing because it reaches speed cap easily and is fairly inexpensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542219775873130537)
- **mid-sea oyster event npc**: Mid-sea oysters are part of a limited-time event, and an NPC near the Prevalia bank weighs them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520284545046548621)
- **mini-map shop markers**: You can right-click the mini-map to choose which kinds of shop markers appear on it, which may help locate shops such as the blacksmith in Anchor's Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546924397636489396)
- **misaligned sextant origin**: The misaligned sextant is believed to be a New Lyceum quest item, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547673868536385680)
- **missed faire ticket takers**: If you miss a ticket taker during the faire quest, open the in-game world map, where all ticket takers are shown, and revisit them one by one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543344837816881323)
- **monster locations on new player dungeon level 2**: Gazers are on level 2 of the New Player Dungeon, and a necromancer, a familiar and ghouls are at other marked locations on that level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522076404173504622)
- **monster slaying job location**: The target monsters for a society monster slaying job can be found in Nusero, an area described as PK infested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554866722887041157)
- **moon gate to shelter island**: A moon gate on the west side of Prevalia town can be used to travel back to Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553471696713949448)
- **moongate locations on maps**: On the in-game world map a red circle marks the moongate location, and exploreoutlands.com also shows moongates when its moongates checkbox is ticked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531515476226740284)
- **moongate travel to anchors rest**: Any moongate can be used to travel to Anchors Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553581306447921203)
- **moongates and scribe vendor location**: Moongates stand outside every town, and a 120 scribe vendor is located near the Cambria moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537714169506439178)
- **mount petram multiple character entry restriction**: A player cannot enter Mount Petram while another of their characters is already inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548013529288671304)
- **mug source in sanctuary orc dungeon**: The sanctuary orc dungeon has chests full of food and drink, where a mug can probably be found. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527420690410770453)
- **multi-floor dungeons**: Outlands has roughly 14 or more multi-floor dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520606033389817957)
- **naming runebook locations**: You can name a location within your runebook, and you can also name it on the rune itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545825241333502113)
- **necro scroll drop from antediluvian dragon**: A necromancy scroll rare has been reported dropping from an antediluvian dragon in the Sacrificial Cliffs area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723556928884766)
- **new lycaeum gate location**: A gate to the New Lycaeum is located just west of the Prevalia stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523702887979683871)
- **new player rune tome urukton rune**: The Urukton rune in the new player rune tome likely places you just outside the dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545197403252985926)
- **new treasure map spots**: The new treasure map system adds new spots, and some of them port the player into a full danger zone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538222330310823936)
- **non-mage island crossing**: Players who are not mages can reportedly use a rope to cross to the island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534480930427899955)
- **north prevalia bank thieves**: The north Prevalia bank is a common gathering spot for thieves, so carrying valuables there is risky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549142556137357514)
- **npc ships on the ocean**: The ocean is populated by NPC ships that do not always spawn in the same spot, and some of them attack player boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530396115755597926)
- **nusero level 1 safety**: Nusero level 1 is fairly safe for a regular dungeon because PKs tend to go straight to level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553354128225476629)
- **ogre hunting location**: Ogres can be killed at the Urukton Bluffs, east of Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529431216397488218)
- **old dungeon access**: The old dungeons in Outlands are accessible by faction members only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671547916226663)
- **old pap spawn spot**: Old Pap is a humanoid spawn spot near Totem that is great for backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536453585381097623)
- **opening a gate from a rune or tome book by command**: When controlling the character yourself, use a command such as [recall gate (exact command uncertain) to open a gate using a rune or tome book in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552730224859549840)
- **orange non-attackable wilderness mobs**: Orange non-attackable mobs in the wilderness are world flavor and may be tied to quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554164212404723865)
- **orc mage location**: Orc Mages can be found on the surface at Urukton Bluffs, outside of dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532563916331286729)
- **outlands mall**: The Outlands Mall no longer exists and has not for years; the Outlands Portal replaced it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547124366205255680)
- **outlands survey records atlas**: The Outlands Survey Records atlas at harald.ist.org/tools/uoo_atlas is a role player's map of Avadon that lists guild territories, with voluntary entries only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536513458399486077)
- **outpost bank and jeweler tile**: At the outpost there is reportedly a tile where the bank and the jeweler NPC can both be accessed at once, which is useful for leveling Tinkering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549863459548831826)
- **outpost dungeon runebooks**: A mage can use the dungeon runebooks in the rune library at the outpost moongate to travel to dungeons without dropping recall scrolls on the book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532746596557525224)
- **outpost gated rune library contents**: The rune library behind the gate at Outpost has runes for points of interest and dungeons but none for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534167913328545942)
- **outpost poi recall**: Outpost has points of interest (POI) spots, and with the explore Outlands tick you can use POI recall to travel to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532391847765348383)
- **outpost rune library**: Outpost has the old rune library. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534167703978381454)
- **outpost thief npc for stolen scrolls**: A thief NPC at the outpost can be asked whether scrolls were stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535073063518077070)
- **outpost town size**: Outpost is a smaller town similar to Totem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526736213027979369)
- **pack animals in dungeons**: Pack horses, pack llamas and oxen cannot be taken into dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527170213748015194)
- **party treasure map travel**: On a party treasure map hike, the other party members do not automatically travel to the destination when the map owner arrives; the owner must open a gate or give coordinates so they can make their way there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551659286839431209)
- **pawn broker location in prevalia**: A pawn broker is located in Prevalia, just east of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551663161227219079)
- **permanent dungeon gates**: No location in the world has a permanently open gate to the normal dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525654842385629334)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons**: Outlands has 3 permanent Sanctuary dungeons where criminal activity is not allowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537967399725441065)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons**: Three dungeons permanently remain Sanctuary, or four if Shelter is counted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552719484869935127)
- **permanent sanctuary dungeons location**: The three permanent sanctuary dungeons are located at or near Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538001504630472747)
- **pet left behind after rune tome teleport**: A pet that does not follow you through a rune tome teleport has likely stayed behind at the location you teleported from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542386241910218902)
- **pets following on rune travel**: Followers and pets travel with you when you use rune travel, provided you have told them to follow or guard you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531079570554617907)
- **pinned location map**: A pinned map in the Discord channel shows other locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522379214316245104)
- **pks in weekly sanctuary dungeon**: The weekly rotating sanctuary dungeon has no PKs, according to a player who saw none in six months of play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552719149682401291)
- **plant pot vendor in prevalia**: A farmer NPC next to the north exit out of Prevalia sells plant pots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287009492869271)
- **player locations tome charges**: The new player locations tome has some buttons that use reagents and others that use stored recall charges; the blue jewel button in the main overview likely uses charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523328941933330562)
- **player-made town portals**: Most player-made portals in towns lead to vendor malls rather than being traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538359212231499806)
- **player-run chest-opening butler**: A player-run butler in one of the malls, possibly the riverside one reached from Prev, may open locked chests for you; the exact location is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524478905409470707)
- **poi books location**: POI books can be obtained at the Outpost moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549755037784215585)
- **poi rune libraries**: Point of interest (POI) rune libraries are found in many places throughout the world. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537463506495078412)
- **points of interest locations**: Outlands points of interest locations are listed in several in-game libraries, for example the one at the Outpost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524700741124620388)
- **prev zoo thief npc location**: A thief NPC who trains Stealing stands just outside the Prev zoo, on the left side. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541455930573594745)
- **prevalia architect npc**: The architect NPC in Prevalia is Elysia, located directly south of the bank in the tailor shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523070850146894015)
- **prevalia arrow vendors**: In Prevalia the Provisioner sells 250 arrows while the Ranger/Bowyer sells 999 arrows; both are left of the fountain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532250847310909602)
- **prevalia bonded horse quest**: A quest in Prevalia grants a bonded horse, and it is best taken on a harvester or other character that has trouble controlling or bonding pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841873169022997)
- **prevalia castle entry**: Entering Prevalia Castle likely requires being in factions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523783937644822679)
- **prevalia chivalry trainer**: A second chivalry trainer in Prevalia is in a hole in the wall on the left side on the way to the zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539947070058926131)
- **prevalia dock steps to shelter island**: The 'To Shelter Island' steps at the Prevalia docks are disabled because of abuse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553472301964599348)
- **prevalia mage shop location**: In Prevalia there is a mage shop just north of the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546338788534521957)
- **prevalia mapmaker location**: In Prevalia, the mapmaker is in the far southeast, a bit east of the far southeast exit out of town and south of the docks in the bottom right. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530195702909763695)
- **prevalia moongate location**: The Prevalia moongate is outside town near the training house; from the front of the Prevalia bank go left over the bridge, then turn right, though the directions are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552880849643643058)
- **prevalia moongate location**: In Prevalia, a moongate is located northwest of the bank just outside the city. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522346217546186822)
- **prevalia npc macro**: A macro (the !prevalia bot command) shows NPC names and their professions in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533821150403104819)
- **prevalia rare cloth and dye vendor**: The Prevalia shop to the left of the Prevalia bank sells rare cloth and dye. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527820222508302526)
- **prevalia shop location**: The Prevalia shop is located basically right outside the Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526676230420828201)
- **prevalia south bank**: The Prevalia South Bank is reportedly always empty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551699425489854546)
- **prevalia stable keeper location**: A stable keeper NPC is located just north of the Prevalia bank, west of the mage shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544811720600588450)
- **prevalia theft frequency**: Prevalia has the most thefts of any city and is considered the worst city for thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039541677137963)
- **prevalia town status**: Prevalia is a town that is part of the game server rather than a guild-run town; guild houses and islands exist but are much smaller than the towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522956516624306257)
- **prevalia training houses**: There are reportedly two training houses at Prevalia, by the gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535252164744581190)
- **prevalia vendor mall portals**: Portals in Prevalia lead to vendor malls where players can window shop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539457058716524554)
- **prevalia vendor mart rune libraries**: The vendor marts in Prevalia have rune libraries that can be used to travel to Urukton, so players should use them instead of running there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330448006123642)
- **prevalia water tiles as a water source**: Water tiles near the Prevalia vendor area may also work as a source for filling water containers, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531402419370463434)
- **prevalia yellow statue tomes**: Use the yellow statue in Prevalia to obtain all available tomes, including one tome that contains every link you need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534435654224580768)
- **prevalian shop services**: The Prevalian shop, located left of the Prev bank, offers a stockpile, magic item recycler, bank box for depositing gold, and tomes for maps, while the shelf and repair bench there are player-made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535950443866230834)
- **provisioner npc location**: Provisioner NPCs are found in towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530641310967664682)
- **provocation trainer location**: The bard who teaches Provocation is in the auditorium at the bottom right of the shelter map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541363294793891932)
- **public battle trainer location**: A popular public battle trainer is located at the previous moongate, and reds will occasionally kill people at public trainers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530109815723135076)
- **public recycler count**: There is one public recycler in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531090103190163527)
- **public repair benches**: Visit a public repair bench to keep equipment in good condition before heading out; one is just outside the Prevalia north gate, a DIY-looking station beneath the balcony. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529267250580816013)
- **public rune libraries**: Public rune libraries are located inside player homes and contain books with destinations, and you do not need your own runes or a runebook to use them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521718601407664271)
- **public rune tome libraries**: Some guilds and players leave rune tomes publicly accessible as libraries containing runes to many locations, and the outpost reportedly has one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545171478167691344)
- **public runebook for dungeon travel**: A public runebook with the dungeons marked is available at the public battle trainer house next to the Outpost moongate; drop a recall scroll on it to add a charge, then use it to recall to a dungeon such as a sanctuary dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538001504630472747)
- **public runebook locations**: Public runebooks (dungeon, POI and town books) are at the Outpost moongate and on the beach on the way from town to the moongate, where the Horseshoe Bay beach house also has treasure map books. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551908371882311692)
- **public runebooks at the outpost**: Public runebooks at the Outpost are locked down and publicly available for use, but they cannot be taken with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538001993862357082)
- **public witcher rune location**: Public runebooks with Witcher rune locations are at the Horseshoe Bay beach house, on the beach down from the moongate on the way to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549754731486773322)
- **quest apple location**: The apples for the quest are in a basket by the apple tree in the southwest corner of North Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537895743615148033)
- **quick travel skills**: Chivalry and Hiking both provide a quick travel option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526782485759922247)
- **random world events**: Small random events appear across the map, such as wolf packs with a dead adventurer, waylaid caravans, cultist tents, a mama bear with cub, and ratmen with crates of cheese. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543486415856209930)
- **ratman hovel dungeon**: Ratman Hovel is a beginner dungeon but is dangerous for characters without an effective way to deal with diseases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522264006784450812)
- **reaching britain bank roof**: To reach the Britain bank roof, open the bank door and cast Teleport targeting a tile above the door, or teleport onto the rooftop, run inside the bank, then cast Teleport again using the last-target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522984364269371412)
- **reaching distant vendor houses**: To reach a distant vendor house, find a nearby rune or point of interest on Explore Outlands, recall or gate to it (via the outpost moongate, a runebook with a recall scroll if you have no mage, or a rune library number), then run to the house; return with Chivalry, a runebook or a runetome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532680599804973177)
- **reaching faraway player vendors**: To reach a faraway player vendor, use a publicly available Witcher rune library and exploreoutlands to find the closest rune, travel there, then teleport back to Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525332058296291439)
- **reaching kraul hive**: To reach Kraul Hive safely, get a player with Chivalry to open a chiv gate that takes you inside the dungeon, since running there is dangerous because it lies in a hard area of the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553868847394590753)
- **reaching tidal tombs from prevalia**: To reach Tidal Tombs from Prevalia, recall there from a rune library or take a Chivalry Sacred Journey gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530646031832973373)
- **reaching totem**: To reach Totem, use the gate system, press Totem, then walk north. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552661797717278762)
- **rearranging runes in a rune tome**: Runes in a rune tome can be rearranged later, and other runes can be dropped in or added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545180934054215710)
- **recall in scripts without magery**: In a script, the recall command is used by saying '[recall home' in-game; a character without the Magery skill must instead use the '[recallcharge' command (for example '[recallcharge home'). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550491895757676616)
- **recall requirements**: Recalling requires the Magery skill and a rune book or rune tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1554201027832713257)
- **recall scroll in library runebook**: A player without a mage can drop a recall scroll into the library runebook they want to use, but must provide their own way back, such as their own runebook, Chivalry, or camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534952763648249998)
- **recall scroll with zero magery**: With 0 Magery, the only spell scroll worth carrying is a recall scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528805211630604298)
- **recall spell versus rune book**: A player does not need the Recall spell if they have a rune book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541928857332883586)
- **recall versus hiking cast time**: Recall takes about 3 seconds to cast while Hiking takes about 5 seconds, so hiking is slower than recall, though the figures are approximate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550178514685132961)
- **recallcharge command with runetome**: On the surface world, the command [recallcharge <name of a runestone> works if you carry a charged runetome, and the runetome is recharged by dropping Recall scrolls onto it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524140134348492800)
- **recalling into inn rooms**: You cannot recall directly into an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037924968996976)
- **recalling to lower prevalia inn**: Use the command [recallcharge Lower Prevalia Inn to recall to the Lower Prevalia Inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545640964981264457)
- **recalling while holding an item on the cursor**: You can keep an item held on the mouse pointer by dragging it without releasing, then press a recall macro to recall; the item is not lost as long as you do not drop it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175994459430962)
- **recharging runebooks and runetomes**: Recharge a runebook or runetome by dropping recall scrolls onto it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535259994650452088)
- **recovering a sunk ship**: To recover a sunk ship, go to the shelter dock and move the boat from salvage to the dock master, not to your backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530015572778160309)
- **red gates in dungeon levels 2 and 3**: Dungeon levels 2 and 3 have red gates; the only ways to escape a red there are running through these gates or going back up to level 1 and out the entrance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521546547085709444)
- **red player travel method**: A red-named (murderer) player cannot use recall and most likely travels using a Sacred Journey/Chivalry gate set up by a blue player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1547374691398848542)
- **removing a rune from a runebook**: To remove a rune from a runebook, open the runebook, click the box for the rune's location, and choose the 'drop rune' option at the bottom. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555190792585216092)
- **renaming a marked rune**: To rename a marked rune, remove it from the rune book, double click it, and type the new name into the chatbox. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548384342512902145)
- **renaming an unnamed rune in a rune book**: To rename an unnamed rune in a rune book, go to the 2nd page, click the drop rune button, then rename the dropped rune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548383832892514330)
- **resource map destination**: A resource map takes the player to the Caldera, and reaching the map spot requires dealing with multiple mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529571312450932817)
- **resource map locations**: Resource map locations depend on the map itself rather than its level, so low-level resource maps send players to the same expansion-area locations as higher-level ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528546942961848331)
- **resource map travel to location**: Under the new resource map system the map takes you directly to the location, so runes or rune tomes marking each location are not needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536015293917175819)
- **restocking arrows from town vendors**: To restock arrows from town NPC vendors more easily, have a mage mark runes at the vendors and keep them in a rune book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532855248685633637)
- **returning to corpse without a resurrection point**: If you die somewhere without a resurrection point, walk south across the water to the healer caravan, or use Help to teleport to a town and recall back to your corpse using a runebook from a library that includes a POI book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532409053526097951)
- **returning to ship after death**: After you die, a rune to your ship is placed in your bag; put it in your runebook to use it to return to your ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537610976470376518)
- **returning to town when stranded**: When stranded or dead in a remote place, open the in-game Help tab and choose the Stuck option to get back to town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544842038825193703)
- **riverside mall chest unlocking**: At the Riverside mall, chest unlocking is player driven by a bot that posts its instructions; you put your chest into a box to have it unlocked (details are recalled from memory and may be inexact). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525754253929353226)
- **route to new lyceum**: To reach New Lyceum, use the gate near the northwest Prevalian stables. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546356678147055746)
- **route to the rune library**: To reach the rune library, go to the Prev moongate and pick Outpost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527258338109427794)
- **rune book blue dot recall**: The blue dot in a rune book always uses a charge and cannot be changed to cast the recall spell; a macro such as say '[recall Prevalia' can be used to recall via spell instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548383832892514330)
- **rune book blue gem**: Clicking the blue gem on a rune book consumes a charge to recall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534673284933746772)
- **rune libraries and dungeon runebook**: Rune libraries around the land hold runebooks, and the small marble shop next to the Terran moongate has a dungeon runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549691432753832049)
- **rune libraries near prevalia**: Rune libraries exist; there is likely none near Prevalia, but the outpost gate has one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552881785577283626)
- **rune library cast recall**: Click the empty square beside the blue button in the rune library to open a page with a 'cast recall' option, which requires reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532483290597163160)
- **rune library recall scroll consumption**: A rune library consumes as many recall scrolls as it has room for, so drop only one scroll at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532483029128314890)
- **rune location blocked error**: Rune teleportation can fail with 'the location is blocked' when something such as a player or NPC occupies the destination spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547666637443043329)
- **rune re-marking behavior**: Marking a rune at a new location automatically overwrites its previous mark. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545127302977822831)
- **runebook blue jewel buttons**: A recall scroll may need to be dropped onto a runebook before its blue jewel buttons can be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549691618452570175)
- **runebook default location**: To set a default location on a runebook, click the green or red gem at the top left of the rune page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554852297484542084)
- **runebook fast travel**: A runebook or runetome provides fast travel that largely removes the need to use camping for getting around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527390800021950654)
- **runebook sharing between characters**: A runebook can be locked down in the inn so all of a player's characters can use it, or it can be transferred between characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536113429075722252)
- **runebooks versus sacred journey**: Runebooks and runetomes are more flexible for travel than Chivalry's Sacred Journey, which is mostly beneficial for its damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535259994650452088)
- **runebooks with preset locations**: To obtain a runebook that already has locations in it, a player must hire someone to mark the locations for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538001967614398515)
- **runetome copying tool**: A runetome copying tool can be purchased that copies runebooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551313968784740506)
- **runetome quest cost**: The runetome from the Shelter dungeon quest costs 2500 gold, while the codex quest costs considerably more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552883157559418921)
- **runetome sharing between characters**: A Runetome can be shared between characters so its charges can be used for travel until you can afford to buy more. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538584896929407067)
- **runic tomes vs runebooks**: Runic tomes are considered much better than runebooks, so players should work toward tomes rather than buy many runebooks, since eventually only tomes get used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554248145058136127)
- **running restrictions in time dungeon**: There are places in the time dungeon where you cannot run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529230651826372619)
- **sacred journey gate**: The Sacred Journey (chivalry) gate remains where it was cast and is one way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545442232444915863)
- **sacred journey moongates**: The 'sacred journey' moongates with coordinates are player-made gates that players use to reach their vendors, not for normal travel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526580743424184340)
- **sacred journey to sanctuary dungeon**: Sacred Journey can take you to the current sanctuary dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522377919161303090)
- **sacred journey travel alt**: To travel to towns and dungeons, make an alt with Chivalry and any melee weapon skill, train both to 80 and then 100 by afk attacking the battle trainer, park it in your inn room, and cast Chivalry Sacred Journey gates with it when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530310685760688258)
- **safe zones**: UO Outlands has a couple of safe zones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377838158651433)
- **saltshore docks moongate**: The moongate at the Saltshore docks is a different gate from the one at Anchors Rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532811779594518578)
- **saltshore mob key usage**: To use a key dropped by a mob in Saltshore, find chests nearby and use the key on them until you find the one it opens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537897442152816660)
- **sanctuary dungeon indicator**: The atlas shows which dungeon is currently sanctuary, and the map at the banks shows the same information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523861013965963404)
- **sanctuary dungeon locations**: Sanctuary dungeons exist in places other than Shilter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529179835115507792)
- **sanctuary dungeon monsters**: The Sanctuary dungeons on Outlands typically contain Orcs, Ogres and Ettins, and occasionally cultists. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541440199366549584)
- **sanctuary dungeon rotation map**: A map showing the current sanctuary dungeon rotation can be checked at the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533309952888803428)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Three dungeons are permanent sanctuaries where PvP is not allowed, and one additional dungeon becomes a sanctuary each week on rotation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553850231374876765)
- **sanctuary dungeons**: Besides Urukton, Sewers and Ratman are the only two firmly sanctuary dungeons, and the weekly core dungeon may also be a sanctuary dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530308761997283388)
- **sanctuary dungeons as farming spots**: The sanctuary dungeons are a worthwhile place to farm and should not be overlooked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520266642502979675)
- **sanctuary dungeons in the atlas**: In the Outlands atlas, opened with the [atlas command, sanctuary dungeons are colour coded yellow with 'Sanctuary' in brackets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111192203665430)
- **seafaring skill requirements**: Seafaring requires specific skills, and the details are documented in the seafaring channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554907632165457941)
- **server setting**: The Outlands server is set in Avadon, not Britannia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533643351453339839)
- **setting default rune in runebook**: To set the default rune in a runebook, open Manage Runes, click the grey box of the desired rune, and set it as default on the page that opens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527321802320384000)
- **sewer location**: The sewer is located just above the new player dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549617432572723301)
- **shadowspire cathedral tapestry location**: The shadowspire cathedral tapestry is believed to be a long red tapestry on the wall near the daemon bridge boss room, and it is a decoration item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532004941441532025)
- **shadowspire silver moongate rooms**: In Shadowspire, silver moongates lead to several random rooms with mobs not found on other floors, and within those rooms another silver gate randomly teleports the player back to the normal floors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522699451049705504)
- **sharing rune tome between characters**: A Rune Tome (new player locations runebook) can be shared between characters by storing it in a secured container inside a rented room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538613668613459988)
- **sharing unblessed runebook across alts**: Until you can bless a runebook, keep the unblessed one locked down or in a secure bag in your inn room so all alts can open it and recall from it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554351667447730247)
- **shelter dungeon portals**: The yellow and red portals in the Shelter dungeon are both exits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549850780268240897)
- **shelter healer respawn location**: Shelter has a healer, and players who die can be found at the front of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554806461253558283)
- **shelter island chivalry trainer**: The chivalry trainer in Shelter Island's town center, named Giles, stands next to the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555018193431564309)
- **shelter island mage shop layout**: The Shelter Island mage shop has an alchemist, a scribe and a necromancer downstairs, and a mage upstairs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546864669568929843)
- **shelter island moon gate vendor portals**: The moon gate on Shelter Island has many vendor portals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530963852043485278)
- **shelter island provisioner shop**: A provisioner shop is located on the east side of Shelter Island, near the stairs to the moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525875329632309290)
- **shelter island trading safety**: Shelter Island is criminal free and is where in-person trades with other players should be done. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537967124746739782)
- **ship movement controls**: Ship movement cannot be controlled with the mouse except by clicking the buttons on the ship gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542259258068832306)
- **ship retrieval at dockmasters**: A ship can be retrieved from any dockmaster regardless of which dock it was left at, and public dockmasters exist at every dock on the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541254117261836289)
- **shop location via valor shrine rune**: A rune to the Valor shrine is likely the way to reach the shop location a player asked about. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548263943984652470)
- **shortest town to dungeon distance**: Aegis Keep is likely the shortest distance from a town to a dungeon among all dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530310034058252298)
- **shrine of sacrifice access**: The Shrine of Sacrifice cannot be reached on foot; a boat is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541232286039679077)
- **skeletal dragon locations**: Skeletal dragons can be found outside Shadowspire Cathedral. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522733117649981494)
- **smuggler location via totem gate**: A smuggler can be reached by taking the totem gate and going north. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527237002452533328)
- **smuggler npc locations**: Smuggler NPCs are found at Black Market Vendor, Corpse Creek, Desert Outpost, Dusty Mercantile, Granite Docks, Palmshade Trading Camp, Smugglers Den, Smugglers Dock and Winter Harbor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554951170508853476)
- **societies character travel**: A societies character can use recall scrolls (optionally in a runebook) or Magery with Meditation to travel, as it only sits in the house or inn and goes to the society building and back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541952230704554054)
- **society jobs location**: Society jobs can be obtained in Prevalia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546529280022945894)
- **south prevalia bank**: The South Prevalia bank is rarely used by other players, unlike the North Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534078400514494645)
- **spending prevalia coins**: Prevalia coins are spent at the Prevalian Merchant, located to the left of the Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520383619716223016)
- **stable master locations**: There is a stable master in every town, including one just north of the Prevalia bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531484720070918226)
- **starter island tinker location**: The tinker NPC on the starter island is located near the stairs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525532536615338195)
- **strangelands event entry via moongate**: Entering a certain moongate can place a player into the Strangelands event, where the player is labeled a 'stranger' and other players can kill them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550150618142875749)
- **teleport button macros**: Button macros can be set up to teleport to different locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546484608634327070)
- **teleport spell range over water**: Teleport spells reach at most 10 tiles, so crossing a longer water gap requires placing a boat and teleporting in two hops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534479698925584394)
- **teleporting a friend to a treasure map location**: Apart from a gate, there is no way to teleport a friend to a treasure map location; recall and camping to the spot do not work, so other means of travel must be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546273252169744456)
