- **terran bank roof access**: The roof of Terran bank can reportedly be reached by teleporting up from the right spot, or by using a rune marked on the roof. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535579258825478154)
- **test server clothing rack**: The test server has a clothing rack in the town center of Prevalia, reachable with the [go command, from which any clothing piece in any hue can be grabbed to try out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543300929770627253)
- **test server dungeon travel command**: On the Outlands test server, typing [go opens a menu in which you can choose any level of any dungeon to travel to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529119628620726373)
- **test shard prevalia bank area**: On the Test shard, the area around the fountain in front of the Prevalia bank is crowded with storage items and colored statues, and the [go command does not work there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551294711304556635)
- **third-party map trackers**: Third-party map trackers such as Ultima Mapper reportedly no longer work for UO Outlands, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551259689780510783)
- **time dungeon artifacts**: Items marked 'time' are Time Dungeon artifacts, and the Time Dungeon is an endgame dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520888663880237376)
- **totem bank and inn proximity**: In Totem the bank and inn are close enough that you can stand between them and use both at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293274724868187)
- **totem city location**: Totem is a city on another continent (Wildlands), reachable through any regular town gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544294314207875092)
- **totem teleport to bank and inn**: Teleporting to the totem places you at both the bank and the inn, so a single hotkey covers both. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538418061659480105)
- **totem town layout**: Totem is the smallest town, so there is less walking as a ghost, and the innkeeper and banker are reachable from one spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526734298567147541)
- **town struggle gate locations**: A Town Struggle gate is always present at Prevalia, though other gates may exist elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554995856565076069)
- **town travel methods**: Towns are mostly reached by moongates, and Chivalry also provides Sacred Journey as a travel option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526782211523739781)
- **town travel options**: Every town has a moongate, and players can also travel by chivalry gate if they have chivalry, or hike with 60 camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552881711304413266)
- **town with map maker near bank**: The town with a map maker close to a bank might be Cambria, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550390820031565847)
- **tracking on the ocean**: Tracking is not needed on the ocean because anyone can use a spyglass, which requires no skill, to see who is nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527626670436122664)
- **trade location**: Player trades should be conducted on Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528408740792111158)
- **travel from inn to shelter**: A player can get from their inn room to Shelter by using Chivalry (Sacred Journey), camping, or recalling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536003235754680420)
- **travel speed comparison**: Travel by recall, hiking and chivalry is generally much quicker than traveling by boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541235096886181929)
- **travel to fair merchant**: Take the blue portal at any town bank to reach the fair, where the merchant is located. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542243110434897920)
- **travel to prevalia via help command**: Type [help and use the in-game option to travel to Prevalia; it has a 12 hour cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552290648806129765)
- **travel to shelter island**: Use a moongate and choose Shelter from the destination list to travel to Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522345463599071292)
- **traveling to a vendor via camping**: To travel to a vendor, enter the vendor's coordinates from the vendor portal into exploreoutlands, find the nearest Point of Interest marker, then hike to it using Camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527322905904681061)
- **traveling to western vendor houses**: To reach a vendor house on the western landmass, open Explore Outlands, tick the POI box, find a POI near the target vendor house, then use the outpost rune library behind the gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534952334457569371)
- **traveling via witcher runes and horseshoe bay**: Tick Witcher runes in Explore Outlands to find a tmap spot near the target house, then use the Horseshoe Bay beach house runebooks, which are on the way to town from the gate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534952586464202773)
- **treasure map mapper role**: The mapper, who opens a gate for a treasure map, needs to be a mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551662029050478724)
- **treasure map runes**: Treasure maps no longer require runes; the player hikes to the spot and is placed directly into the zone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538228937753366568)
- **treasure maps unlocking links**: Treasure maps (tmaps) can unlock links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544625114220462162)
- **tundra ostard locations**: Tundra Ostards are reportedly found in snowy areas, including the area west of Andaria, though this is not firmly confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532231432305508514)
- **uncrossable green gate in andaria**: A green gate in Andaria that cannot be entered is likely a PvP-related object; single-clicking it shows what type of gate it is. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536568217269436467)
- **unmarked wandering healers**: Unmarked wandering healers that are not healer caravans are almost always found near a point of interest, such as the one at Blackthorn's fort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550532619207188601)
- **upper prevalia inn**: There is an inn in Upper Prevalia with rooms, such as room 301. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536511004345892954)
- **urukton bluff treasure chests**: Treasure chests in Urukton Bluff respawn their contents sooner than their lock, so a chest can appear unlocked because someone else has already unlocked it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532636953609113724)
- **urukton bluffs cave entrance**: A cave entrance near the Urukton Bluffs fort transports you inside the dungeon itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552047243681472653)
- **urukton bluffs exit**: Urukton Bluffs is not a closed instance, and you can step out of it right next to the moongate used to arrive from the newbie quest runetome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531948730427904071)
- **urukton bluffs fort wilderness status**: The fort outside Urukton Bluffs is still in the Wilderness, so other players can attack you there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552047172005007661)
- **urukton bluffs hiking access**: With Camping skill at 60, a player can hike to Urukton Bluffs from the Atlas book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536118670034735145)
- **useful runebooks**: Useful runebooks are those for dungeons, points of interest (POI), witchers and banks; if you are in a guild you don't need any. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522979820559011910)
- **using witcher rune libraries**: To use the Witcher Rune system, find a Witcher Rune library (many are free), make a rune to that library, then travel from the library to anywhere on the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623638537343086)
- **vendor house gate bots**: Gate bots to some vendor houses exist near the moongates at Shelter and Prevalia, while many other vendor houses are reachable only by Chivalry gate and some use a blue moongate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534955155911475372)
- **vendor mall training dummy**: At least one vendor mall that usually has a Shelter teleport also has a training dummy, and players are less likely to be killed there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529298897737093192)
- **vendor mart yellow portal**: To use the yellow portal at the vendor mart, double click it or walk through it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545332636384231424)
- **vendor portal exploreoutlands button**: The vendor portal has a button that opens exploreoutlands at the vendor's coordinates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527323413125922948)
- **vendor search locate button**: The first button in the vendor search opens an in-game gump with a Locate button; once within about 100 steps an arrow appears and the world map shows an icon for the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543694600504348782)
- **vendor search portal**: The vendor search portal lets you search for an item and shows every vendor selling it with a map and coordinates, and it can place an in-game tracker with a directional arrow and step count to guide you to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527299121134960670)
- **viewing witcher runes on map**: Open the exploreoutlands.com map link and turn on Witcher Runes in the left-hand side panel to see them on the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547623336719290532)
- **w339 spellbook vendor route**: To reach the W339 spellbook vendor, go to the Horseshoe Bay beach house just outside town on the way to the moongate, recall to rune 339, then run to the vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553619074532245504)
- **wandering healer at volcano island**: A wandering healer is possibly located near the spring on the east side of the remote island with four demons in a volcano, a PK hotspot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522342991157788692)
- **wandering healers on atlas**: Wandering healers are not shown on the [atlas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522343622736089129)
- **warpig spawn location**: Warpigs spawn in the wilderness between Totem and the Saltshore docks, a fairly hard area. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522226169397903430)
- **water dragon location**: Water dragons are found in Western Palma level 2. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520611923517903002)
- **we need it quest chain**: The quest 'We Need It' is given by Zevida the Necromancer in New Lycaeum, and its second part 'We're Hungry' requires a Ruined Silver Horn, which is a different item from the Broken Silver Horn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523686067960811532)
- **weekly bonus dungeons**: To see the bonus dungeons for the week, check the board near each city's bank or your Atlas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532746533265735853)
- **weekly dungeon bonus map**: A map on a pole at or near all banks shows the dungeon bonuses for the week, including sanctuary status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111325121019936)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon color**: The weekly sanctuary dungeon appears in a different color from other dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522378069250150472)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon location**: To find the current weekly sanctuary dungeon, double-click the map available at any bank in town, or check the atlas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550305793021054997)
- **wiki dungeon category pages**: The Outlands wiki has category pages listing dungeons, such as Category:Dungeons and Category:Shadowspire_Cathedral, which can be used to find a dungeon's name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538590895866388531)
- **witcher bot command**: Using the !witcher command with a rune number (e.g. !witcher 84) makes the bot link directly to that rune's location on exploreoutlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547633777482797057)
- **witcher rune libraries near town gates**: Many town gate locations have nearby houses with partial public Witcher rune libraries, such as the home next to the Outpost gate with a dungeon rune on a table, but no world gate has a full Witcher library right beside it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537453944849309787)
- **witcher rune library at vendor malls**: Vendor malls reachable from Shelter should have a Witcher rune library. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525332407530819634)
- **witcher rune set for treasure maps**: A Witcher rune set reportedly lets a player do treasure mapping without having to travel to a library. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520402928404529212)
- **witcher runebooks at outpost and terran prev**: Outpost and Terran Prev do not have Witcher runebooks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534167372850528429)
- **witcher runes in rune libraries**: The outpost rune library has no Witcher runes, but the Horseshoe Bay house with runebooks does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534953258215276685)
- **witcher runes locations source**: Witcher runes locations are available on exploreoutlands.com and on the in-game map by adding an additional xml file for custom locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528001800957989074)
- **witcher zones**: Witcher zones are just runes marked by a player and are not an official game system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533763497542811739)
- **witcher's tome utility**: Witcher's Tomes remain useful for finding vendors and getting around, and they save recalls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538234411944771635)
- **world atlas hiking requirements**: Hiking with the world atlas has been done successfully with only 7.5 camping and 120 cartography once a campfire is lit and secured. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528069123534225479)
- **world gate travel to check npc stock**: Use the world gate west of Prevalia to jump to other towns, for example to check other NPCs' stock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549561582755774475)
- **world moongates**: World moongates are the static moongates outside of towns; the one on the hill north of Shelter lets you travel to other towns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543300568561352855)
- **yellow and blue gate behavior**: Yellow gates are chivalry gates and are one-way, while blue gates are two-way and let you return to where you entered when the gate reopens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552544224669335603)
- **zoo escape artist anaconda**: The zoo has an infamous escape-artist anaconda, reportedly caused by a software glitch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532991358690791554)
- **zoo location**: The zoo is in the Shelter dungeon, to the left behind the player guard, and the 'prev' location also has a zoo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550341532878503997)

## Systems & mechanics

- **2026 king's faire content**: The 2026 King's Faire includes an entirely new King's Faire Merchant collection, new trophies and rewards, cash prize tournaments, and a Fashion Show. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **2026 king's faire event**: The 2026 King's Faire runs nine days from Saturday, August 22, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET to Sunday, August 30 at 11:00 AM ET and features 37 Faire games, including the new Rat Catcher game. _(official, conf 0.85, 3 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **8th annual king's faire**: The 8th Annual King's Faire features the Celestial Contest, in which players can take on all 37 games, along with festival events, raffles and other surprises. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1537881062544248913)
- **action queue**: The Outlands Action Queue has been unified and overhauled, so Razor and the client now use the same pathways for lift/drop and double click. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **activating a selected loadout**: After selecting a different Loadout in the Codex Menu, players must still click the 'Active' button to make it their currently Active Loadout. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1540432718079336549)
- **backworn scythe restyle option**: Backworn Scythes can be restyled to switch which shoulder the scythe rests over, a feature added in the 2026-09-28 patch after earlier being announced for the next patch. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1554202397604192268)
- **beta client 1.0.3.707 patch contents**: The 1.0.3.707 beta client patch includes updated handling for Stealing and Last Target, various target cursor features, and more fixes for the 'satchel bug'. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **beta client availability**: The beta client is restricted to the test shard only for now. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **beta client instability warning**: The new beta client is unstable and should not be used for activities that could cause catastrophic item loss, since picking up, using or dropping items might not work as intended. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **codex scalar changes and testing patch update**: The Codex Scalar changes in the Testing Patch are on hold and will be revisited, while the updated Testing Patch on the TEST SHARD marks its changes in orange text. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528235950575190057)
- **grid loot auto loot button**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes grid loot with an auto loot button. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **item counter fixes in beta client**: Beta client 1.0.3.704 includes fixes for item counters. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1524868842470510763)
- **jousting tournament mount requirement**: Knights must be mounted on a steed to participate in the Jousting Tournament. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **jousting tournament signup**: To join the Jousting Tournament, sign up starting one hour before it begins by entering via any Public Moongate and selecting the Jousting Arena. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **jousting tournament skill requirements**: No special skills are required to participate in the Official Jousting Tournament, and all players are welcome. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **king's faire bomberman battles tickets**: Participating in the King's Faire Bomberman Battles event at the Arena earns free King's Faire tickets. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541608763335778314)
- **king's faire celestial contest**: In the King's Faire Celestial Contest, every participant is sworn to one of two alignments, Solar or Lunar, and the two sides compete, with each King's Faire event a participant takes part in earning points for their celestial team. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **king's faire celestial team points**: Every King's Faire event a player participates in earns points for their celestial team, Solar or Lunar. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1535037218840776779)
- **king's faire event schedule**: Each evening of the King's Faire features a different event, including a 1v1 Cash Prize PvP Tournament, Outlaws, Snowbrawl, Boxing, Bomberman Battles, the Fashion Show and the 50th Cash Prize Jousting Tournament, after which the Faire closes; each event has its own ruleset. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1540456675264299088)
- **king's faire game count**: The 2026 (8th Annual) King's Faire features 37 Faire games, including the new Rat Catcher game. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1540456675264299088)
- **king's faire prevalia scratch tickets**: King's Faire Prevalia Scratch Tickets are usable again after the 2026-08-23 server update. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541024250746380288)
- **king's faire prize delivery**: King's Faire prizes are automatically delivered to players' banks when the Faire ends. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543639186110812270)
- **map chests and camps deleted on patch**: Chests from Treasure Maps and Resource Camps from Resource Maps that exist in the world are deleted when the server patches, so players should not start new maps shortly before a patch. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1536732416574623954)
- **melting ice cream acquisition**: To get a Melting Ice Cream, double-click the Ice Cream Cart at the Fairegrounds. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542942536186855586)
- **mount races during kings faire champion season**: During the Kings Faire Champion Season, Mount Races run every night instead of only on Sundays. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525959989368324188)
- **mount races weekly schedule**: Mount Races run every Sunday night at 8 PM ET, except during the Kings Faire Champion Season when they run every night. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525959989368324188)
- **mount racing bet types**: Mount Racing supports Win, Place, Show, Exacta and Trifecta bets, and wagers go into parimutuel pools. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525959989368324188)
- **mount racing system**: Mount Racing is a system where players can gamble on or spectate races run by Mount Racer NPCs. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1525959989368324188)
- **multiple account household requests**: Official staff announced that Multiple Account Household (MAH) requests are temporarily paused while support infrastructure is rebuilt after the Discord disruption, and accounts flagged as MAH cannot harvest and receive a system message saying so. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1523801179421937776)
- **net 10 client update**: An Outlands client update moves the client to .NET 10 with the necessary components self-contained in the client, so no separate install is needed, but it may cause compatibility or performance issues on some systems, especially older computers or operating systems. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1545872366276714746)
- **outlaws event gameplay**: In the Outlaws event, players use pistols or rifles to shoot other players, can take cover behind barrels and walls, and must avoid wild caravans charging through the battlefield. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1533186927782789372)
- **outlaws showdown round structure**: The Outlaws Showdown event consists of 3 rounds, with each round beginning 5 minutes after the previous round ends. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1533186927782789372)
- **post-patch file verification**: After a patch that includes a file patch, run the Launcher and click VERIFY before logging in to confirm your files are up to date. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550852405040775200)
- **pumpkin mask account limit**: Pumpkin Masks are limited to one per account. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **pumpkin mask expiration**: Pumpkin Masks vanish on November 1st. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **rat catcher event**: Rat Catcher is a new King's Faire event in which players race to rid the Fairegrounds of a rat infestation in a fast-paced competition. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1535037218840776779)
- **red hand dungeon death region restriction**: A Red Hand thief who dies in a dungeon receives a 30-minute Region Restriction but can move to another dungeon during that time. To avoid the restriction entirely, leave the Thieves Guild or switch away from being a Red Hand member. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548438619398733868)
- **red hand dungeon death restriction**: Since the August 11, 2026 patch, a Red Hand member of the Thieves Guild who dies inside a dungeon receives a 30-minute Region Restriction preventing re-entry to that dungeon. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548438619398733868)
- **red hand thief dungeon region restriction**: A Red Hand thief who dies in a dungeon such as Mount Petram receives a temporary region restriction, shown as a debuff with a timer, locking them out of that dungeon regardless of Echo, whether they were stealing, or the cause of death. _(official, conf 0.85, 3 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548438619398733868)
- **red hand wilderness death restrictions**: Red Hand Thieves do not receive Region Restrictions for deaths in the Wilderness. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548438619398733868)
- **reporting net 10 client issues**: To report new crashes, graphical issues, or performance problems after the .NET 10 client update, submit a Technical Ticket including a description of the issue, when it occurs, Windows version, CPU, GPU, RAM, and any crash logs, error messages or screenshots. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1545872366276714746)
- **ship respawn after patch**: Ships respawned after the server came back online following the 2026-08-12 patch. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1537022326435221525)
- **shroomtober event dates**: Shroomtober runs from October 1st through October 31st, ending at midnight on All Hallows' Eve. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555232965460754563)
- **shroomtober start date**: The Shroomtober event begins on October 1st. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553422728550154372)
- **stalag grotto event reward distribution**: Stalag Grotto event rewards are distributed directly to qualifying players' bank boxes, with the Battle event based on final Rank %. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **stalag grotto survival pvm event**: The Stalag Grotto Survival PvM Event ran July 11-18 with over 2,390 participants, the largest Survival event yet, and was followed by a Stalag Grotto PvP Battle event. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1528054330727334028)
- **switching loadouts in codex menu**: Players change between Loadouts in the Codex Menu using a Drop Down Menu or the Up/Down Arrows. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1540432718079336549)
- **testing patch status on test shard**: Testing Patches on the Outlands TEST SHARD are subject to change and may or may not reach the Live Server, or may be adjusted in some fashion. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1531376195990458488)
- **tome drag and drop support**: Drag/Drop support for Tomes works for players who have updated their game files via the launcher. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1536796437164064778)
- **typical patch downtime**: Shard downtime for Outlands patches is typically estimated at 10-15 minutes, as announced for the 2026-07-13 and 2026-08-21 patches. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1540431638297845771)
- **upcoming outlands expansion**: The Outlands development team is currently working on an upcoming expansion. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1552066450087354441)
- **viewing region restrictions**: To view Region Restrictions, open the Criminal Summary menu by saying "I must consider my sins" or typing [ConsiderSins, then select Region Restrictions. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1548438619398733868)
- **zucchini harvestmaster event**: The Fall Harvest 2026 Zucchini Harvestmaster event runs for 1 week, and players plant, tend, and harvest zucchinis to compete for zucchini-themed rares and Event Score rankings, with special prizes for the girthiest and the most microscopic zucchini. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553128273779761162)
- **zucchini harvestmaster event entry**: Bring Zucchini Harvest Crates to Tria near Prevalia Bank (or her twin in Corpse Creek) to have them weighed; your score is the weight of your best crate. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550884202717650975)
- **arcane essence from recycling**: Recycling identified magic items yields arcane essence, the fuel that keeps an aspect running; it is consumed after activation and must be replenished regularly, though new players who have not unlocked an aspect can just bank magic items. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724513011667125)
- **arcane essence source**: Aspects consume Arcane Essence, which is obtained by extracting or recycling the magic from looted magic items, so keeping aspects active requires access to a magic item recycler or chest; in regular early and mid game play, essence from breakdowns usually covers consumption, and shortfalls mostly come from fighting above your strength, dying often, reactivating aspects, or unusual aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543596034859733125)
- **arcane essence uses**: Arcane essence is the resource used to make echoes (consumed from the casting character's carried essence), can be bought from player vendors at about half the gold cost of other methods, and can also be used for aspects, which require a lot, or sold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540022095839502468)
- **aspect damage reduction**: Aspect levels reduce damage taken from mobs only and do not reduce damage from players in PvP, but the mob reduction still applies while the player is flagged for PvP; aspect protection is therefore useful for PvM and open-world or dungeon PvP, but not needed for structured PvP events like Town Struggle and Dungeon Flashpoint. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551358793445679176)
- **aspect essence consumption**: Aspect essence is consumed only while fighting, in proportion to damage dealt in PvE, so higher aspects consume it faster; it is not used when not fighting mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541953862498521118)
- **aspect experience split**: Aspect experience is split roughly 50% to the armor aspect and 50% to the weapon/book aspect, so both must be equipped and aspected for full experience, and using the same aspect on both slots levels it twice as fast. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555997374055321671)
- **aspect unlocking and slots**: Unlocking an aspect unlocks that one aspect for armor, weapon and spellbook alike, and you can have one aspect active on armor plus one on the held item (weapon or spellbook, not both since they cannot be equipped together); the held item's aspect determines the proc, and you can check activation by single-clicking the item. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 11 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554562705497526313)
- **character and account limits**: Each account can have 5 characters (6 with the unlocked customization), up to 3 accounts per ID, and only one character per account can be online at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555988249841766503)
- **checking gear durability**: Type [stats (or open help / player stats) in game and click the equipment tab or gem at the bottom left to see the current durability of worn gear and your equipped weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549743280848113685)
- **codex effects in pvp and pvm**: Codex effects do not work against players or while PvP flagged, but they work against monsters and while unflagged, though some effects may be disabled, as noted in their descriptions. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475336815612018)
- **codex experience requirements**: A codex gains experience only while it is in your backpack and you meet its skill requirements (80 or more in the related skills), and all such codexes can level at the same time. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300029329838131)
- **corpse decay timing**: A player corpse turns to bones (grey, freely lootable) after about 15 minutes and decays completely after about another 15 minutes, 30 minutes in total. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548420162909245483)
- **damage dealt by player chain link**: The 'damage dealt by player' chain link is a multi link that works across most builds and is widely considered a good, often best, general-purpose link choice, though not necessarily first choice for every build. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550834463578132504)
- **dead bonded pet resurrection**: A dead bonded pet can be resurrected at a healer, or by a player using chivalry heal, the mage resurrection spell, bandages (with healing and anatomy), or veterinary for tamers; it can also be stabled and retrieved. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554796338015633541)
- **echo swap cooldown**: The default echo swap cooldown is 12 hours, and paid upgrades reduce it in steps (12h, 6h, 1h, 15m); having both Jack of All Trades and Jill of All Trades brings it to 1 hour, and the final upgrade to 15 minutes costs roughly 10M gold in total. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550497725018275981)
- **echo unlock cost**: Unlocking an echo with gold is most commonly reported as costing about 1 million gold for the first echo, though there may be cheaper alternative ways to unlock it, and one claim says each further echo adds a flat 1m (2m, 3m, 4m). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556010985553137665)
- **essence from recycling**: Recycling magic items yields aspect essence, which is used for aspects; players who recycle their loot generally gain more essence than they spend, and essence can also be bought if needed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548841759075868764)
- **harvest aspect armor requirement**: The Harvest Aspect must be on worn armor to work and earn aspect experience, and putting it on the pickaxe or hatchet does nothing; some players say a helmet is needed, and skinning may not give experience in Shelter. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555364762815303713)
- **harvest aspect experience sources**: Harvest aspect gains experience from successful harvesting and from opening dungeon and treasure map chests, but not from paragon chests or combat; it needs a harvest aspected item equipped (armor is enough), and treasure maps are the fastest source, followed by ocean fishing or lumberjacking. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555365620332236822)
- **harvest aspect on treasure map chests**: Harvest Aspect still rolls for a proc when a treasure map chest pops; if you log in with the aspect already applied, you may need to re-apply it for procs to work. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540454232472166534)
- **harvest aspect scope**: Harvest is the aspect for gatherer characters and covers anything that levels or benefits from it, including fishing, lumberjacking and ore from resource maps; food does not affect harvesting. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553088708025253968)
- **health bar collectors**: Multiple health bar collectors can be created, each with its own settings, grouping bars by type (self and followers, party, summons, monsters, players, reds) and with a range set in tiles, such as 12 tiles for killable monsters or maximum range for approaching reds. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543018963095523388)
- **leaving red hand status**: To stop being Red Hand (and avoid its region restrictions on death), visit a Thief NPC such as Giles in the Shelter Island inn, open the Thieves Guild gump from the context menu, check whether you are a Red Hand member, and either switch to Grey Hand or leave the guild. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550882685990207569)
- **link type limits**: Some links count as the same link type and share a limit, so they cannot be stacked separately, e.g. poison damage with poison damage/resist, and melee special chance with melee special chance/damage. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539140078645805119)
- **mana refund chance cap**: Mana Refund Chance is capped at 50%, so Mana Drain/Mana Vampire grimoire upgrades cannot raise it further; excess refund chance converts to weak additive damage, and points already invested in Mana Drain can be moved elsewhere in the grimoire. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549755560704999465)
- **mastery chain experience sources**: Mastery chain experience is account-based and is not gained from crafting, harvesting (mining, lumberjacking), artisan activity, or scavenging gold. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553337673618292764)
- **mastery chain wiki page**: The wiki's Mastery Chain page lists all chain link types, with a table showing which links can be converted or upgraded into which. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554077150263640095)
- **mastery chain xp**: Mastery chain XP is earned account-wide from character creation, even without a chain, and each amount of XP unlocks a new link slot for buffs; early on, gold is better spent leveling aspect than on links, and characters needing chain links should stay on one account. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547613984826593400)
- **mount token**: A mount token is an item that stores a mount: the Mount Token Creation Kit turns a mount into a token, double-clicking the token lets you ride again, and it can toggle the mount on and off under you (e.g. to hide it while backstabbing); tokens can be obtained via achievement or society points, or bought from players, and are not cheap. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539600074475049051)
- **outlands progression systems**: Outlands progression centers on Codex, Aspects and Skill Mastery Chain systems that continue after reaching maximum skills; you raise core skills first, then work on these, and equipment matters relatively little. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274585050185731)
- **pet bonding**: A tamed pet becomes bonded once it reaches level 1, and bonded pets can be resurrected when they die so they are not permanently lost. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 8 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551275709421592628)
- **pet control slot limit**: Going over 5 pet control slots stops pets from obeying commands and following you (except via All Follow), so they won't protect you; pets take 1 to 4 slots and a previously ridden unridden horse may count. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553486887329472764)
- **player corpse looting**: A player corpse stays blue for the first 15 minutes, during which only the owner or consenting players should loot it, and it turns grey after that so anyone can loot it without penalty; looting a blue corpse without consent turns the looter grey and killable. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016305130737856)
- **recycling magic items**: Identify magic items with an item ID wand (or a container ID wand for bags), then use the recycle option on a crafting tool such as a sewing kit to get essence; this works in the dungeon, which saves carry weight, and items you set to save, such as vanquishing items, are kept. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553904728042381385)
- **sanctuary dungeon loot penalty**: In Sanctuary dungeons the gold value of creatures, which drives loot, gold and experience, is reduced to 66% of normal (about a 34% loss) as a trade-off for no criminal activity, per the May 1, 2026 patch notes. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552159246869733460)
- **single pvm character with echoes**: Most players focused on long-term PvM progression keep one PvM character holding all leveled aspects and use Echoes to play different builds on it, rather than levelling multiple PvM characters; a new PvM character should keep PvMing until Echoes are affordable and aspects are levelled. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532966841469894759)
- **spellbook mana regen and mana refund**: Material spellbooks provide extra mana regen (about 50% for better books) and possibly damage bonus, while magic (looted) spellbooks can carry a mana refund modifier; if you can cap mana refund from skills and aspect alone, use a material book for regen. Material book regen bonuses apply only after a 60 second delay following casting with a magic spellbook. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 6 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533927358187180044)
- **stat and skill caps**: Outlands caps total stat points at 225 across Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence, and caps total skill points at 700 naturally (720 with items), with each skill capped at 100 naturally (120 with items). _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540762304059150467)
- **treasure map cartography requirement**: Since the treasure map overhaul, decoding a treasure map and digging up and opening its chest require printed Cartography skill instead of Detect Hidden and Lockpicking, maps are blessed and bound to the decoder, and at first only the decoding character can open the chest. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 10 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555030435229335604)
- **war aspect experience**: War aspect experience comes only from organized PvP such as town struggles, factions, and official PvP events or arenas; killing PKs gives no aspect experience, and the aspect helps a player survive mobs while PvPing. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527479846274601010)
- **weapon and parry codex reset**: Weapon and parry codex points cannot be reset because they have no point limit and everything can eventually be unlocked. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551007909322956821)
- **weapon codex progression**: In a weapon codex, put 5 points into each stance first, since each stance at level 5 raises the finisher by one level, then max your preferred stance to 7. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546257402410565633)
- **wizard's satchel blessing**: A wizard's satchel cannot be blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 5 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545490178917929051)
- **wrestling swing speed bonus**: Wrestling provides a 10% swing speed bonus from its weapon setup, so wrestlers need fewer other sources to reach the 50% swing speed cap, and switching to another weapon type loses that 10%. _(consensus, conf 0.80, 7 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539368808664272908)
- **activating a mastery chain**: Single click the mastery chain and use its context menu to activate it; a link shows +0.00% until the chain is active. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537016297521414244)
- **active resource map limit**: Only one resource map of any of the 5 types can be active per Outlands ID at a time, so a fishing map on one character blocks an ore or treasure map on another character on the same account. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761121426505759)
- **air aspect and swing speed cap**: The Air aspect raises the swing speed cap, and players using it can reach or slightly exceed the cap, for example a swords dexxer at air aspect level 10 with rank 6 aggressive stance, or a mace build at Tier 11. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531327070184149003)
- **antiquity achievement points**: Registering antiquities earns achievement points that accumulate over time and can be spent on valuable items such as gold chain links, emote deeds (which can be sold) or a mount token. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555390842447855647)
- **arcane and followers restriction**: Arcane bonuses do not work while the player has followers: no damage bonus, no hex, and no stances, so arcane builds cannot be combined with pets or tamer play. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546169990410018826)
- **arcane aspect proc chance**: Arcane aspect procs on both casting and shooting with a much higher chance than a regular book aspect, and spell aspect special links raise the Arcane staff proc chance, though actual procs occur at roughly 60% of the listed chance. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544400043908399114)
- **arcane essence recycling**: Weapons and other magic items can be recycled into arcane essence, which can be stockpiled and fuels your aspect; early game uses tools bought from NPCs, while mid-to-late game uses a Magic Item Recycler from the Prev Merchant. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532418305657409537)
- **armor aspect requirements**: All armor pieces must be equipped for an armor aspect to be active and gain aspect experience, and activating a second aspect swaps out the first. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533528180277907638)
- **armor slots required for aspect activation**: Activating an aspect requires wearing a full suit of armor of the matching type, covering six slots: helm, gorget, chest, gloves, arms and legs; the helm, gloves and gorget can later be replaced with fancy clothing alternatives that count as exceptionally crafted leather. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887404912410777)
- **aspect hue management**: Open the aspect gump and click the Manage Hues button at the top to choose which aspect hue is used; three hues are available by default, plus any others bought in the customization menu. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549975996810268723)
- **aspect leveling costs**: Aspect leveling gets expensive at higher tiers: core requirements rise sharply (for example from about 5 to 30, up to roughly 15-40 cores per tier), and echo costs also increase progressively. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529948306493538435)
- **aspect leveling priority**: Players, especially solo ones, should focus on leveling a single aspect rather than splitting between two or farming with a capped aspect, because aspect levels give more bonus than filling a single link slot. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548218323945394251)
- **aspect upgrade costs**: Aspect unlock cost was reduced from 12 cores and 6 distills to 4 cores and 2 distills, the first few levels cost 2 cores and 1 distillation each, and later levels require progressively more cores and distills. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887493483401246)
- **aspect xp splitting**: Aspect XP is split evenly between all active aspects, so two different aspects each get half, the same aspect active on two items earns double XP, and XP for a capped (T15) aspect that is not upgraded is lost rather than redirected. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531710009434443857)
- **aspecting armor and weapons**: Armor items, including the blessed armored wizard hat, can be aspected, and using the same aspect on both weapon and armor helps level the aspect faster, which suits new players. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551888496615231531)
- **autousespellscrolls command**: Typing [AutoUseSpellScrolls toggles whether spell scrolls in your backpack are used automatically when casting instead of reagents; using it again switches back, so check the system message for the current state. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549193596543172639)
- **bank withdrawal theft protection**: To avoid theft when withdrawing from the bank, put an empty container in your bank with a trapped pouch inside it, drop the withdrawn items into the trapped pouch so a thief never sees them, move the outer container to your backpack, and run quickly to your inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175538236334180)
- **bard buff range**: Bard buffs only take effect within about 50 tiles of the Bard; beyond that range the buff icon stays on the buff bar but the buff is not active. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541926918079651860)
- **blessing tomes**: Aspect item tomes, skill mastery tomes and other tomes (including dye tomes) cannot be blessed; only runebooks and rune tomes can be blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550599555211333776)
- **character progression model**: Outlands has no traditional levels or classes. Characters progress through multiple systems, including skill points, and are built freely. Power comes mostly from these systems rather than gear, and key progression stays on death. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531195196937736202)
- **codex acquisition**: Your first codex is free from a new player quest; additional codexes are crafted by player Scribes (inscription) and bought from players, via player vendors or by searching the portal. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554844948061225053)
- **codex resets**: Weapon codices cannot be reset, but other codices (such as the bard codex) can be reset or respecced for free after a short cooldown, letting you move points around. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547617675507802163)
- **codex usage requirements**: A player can use multiple codices at once, provided their skills meet each codex's requirement, which is 80 skill in each relevant skill. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532818177338245322)
- **corpse looting timers**: A dead player's blue corpse turns grey after roughly 15 minutes and becomes lootable, looting a blue corpse before then is a crime that turns you grey and invites attack, and a monster corpse killed by another player is not freely lootable for about 5 minutes until it turns grey. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016305130737856)
- **death aspect buff change on test server**: On the test server, the death aspect buff applies to all poison and disease effects applied by the player (not only spell-based ones), works retroactively on already-applied poisons and diseases, and boosts the disease tick itself, unlike live where it only raises spell damage by 20%. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531743402696245389)
- **decoded resource map limit**: A player can carry multiple resource maps but can have only one decoded at a time; the decoded map must be finished or junked before another can be decoded, and the tome of maps and decoding supplies are not blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536930923457806377)
- **echo build swapping**: Unlocking an echo stores your current build as a second build on the same character, both starting identical, and activating the echo swaps between them, so one echo is enough for two builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550486743575437342)
- **echo swap cooldown**: After swapping echo builds there is a cooldown before swapping again, 12 hours by default, which customisation upgrades can reduce to as little as about 1h15m or 15 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553544589884006512)
- **echo system**: The echo system lets a character unlock multiple skill/stat profiles and switch between them with a cooldown, keeping progression toward codices, aspects and leaderboards without swapping characters. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553545066843209839)
- **follower damage sources**: Command aspect, Veterinary and Herding provide follower damage, with Herding giving a significant boost; Cartography does not. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545300401614626846)
- **harvest aspect and chest opening**: The Harvest aspect adds effective Lockpicking and Detect Hidden skill when opening chests and gives a 2x chance for stackable loot, so it can reduce the raw skill needed. It does not help with stealing. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416273081372673)
- **harvest aspect double loot on chests**: The Harvest aspect can proc double loot on treasure map chests and message in a bottle chests, and it still does so after the new patch. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541868039103053945)
- **harvest links usefulness**: Harvest links are generally not useful for treasure mapping, lumberjacking or mining (t-map links only add rare finds, and in lumberjacking and mining they merely reduce rare failed swings), and are used mainly by fishers or by PK-resistant resource-map-only builds. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539255807873392741)
- **hiding messages in game viewport**: To control system messages in the game viewport, right-click the Journal (or click its gear icon), open Settings, and toggle 'Hide Messages In Game Viewport'; enabling it keeps messages only in the journal, and disabling it shows them on the left of the screen. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554581697528463493)
- **in-game chat channels**: Outlands has no global or local in-game chat; only party, guild and alliance chat exist, with Discord serving as the global chat, and scripts reportedly cannot type into party chat. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544188987449806911)
- **link proc chance scaling**: Link proc chance bonuses are multiplicative percentage increases on the current chance rather than flat additions, so a link giving 4.5% multiplies the chance by 1.045x. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552444862014427307)
- **loot links and harvest on treasure map chests**: Special/rare loot links affect treasure map chest loot, while effective harvest links do not; the harvest aspect gives a chance to double chest contents. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1550051784427307129)
- **moving locked gumps**: Gumps are locked in place when Options > General > Gumps & Context > 'Hold ALT key to move gumps' is enabled; to move a gump such as the spell cooldown bar, temporarily disable that option, drag the gump, then re-enable it if desired. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553485752611119105)
- **murder count decay**: Murder counts decay over time, and the 'next decay' timer shows when a count will drop, but the timer only runs while the character stays logged in and logging out resets it. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538450897879830568)
- **nameplates menu hotkey**: Holding Ctrl+Shift brings up a menu for nameplate settings, including a 'Nameplates' option controlling displayed names. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540736363639476234)
- **pet follower limit**: The pet follower limit is a maximum of 5, and a player over that limit (for example 7/5) has pets that obey only follow commands. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556035987459805217)
- **pet rename uniqueness**: A pet's name must be unique: a rename is rejected if the name is already taken by a player character or pet, or is on the disallowed names list. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553744205174669409)
- **poison damage versus damage to poisoned creatures links**: Poison Damage links give +4.00% each to poison tick damage (10 links turn a 100 tick into 140), while Damage to Poisoned Creatures links give +1.75% each (17.5% for 10) multiplicatively to your own damage against poisoned targets. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547940613943730219)
- **post-patch resource and treasure map state**: After the August 11, 2026 patch, previously decoded treasure maps reverted to undecoded and most resource maps likely did too, except partially completed ones, which stay partially completed; resource maps now work like the manual process players used before and are faster to run. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546215506170613760)
- **potion satchel bug**: The potion (alchemist) satchel has a bug where potions may not be usable unless it has been opened; keeping it open or minimized via the buckle, or opening it once after resupply, avoids the problem. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546956172353871892)
- **progression systems**: Character strength on Outlands comes mainly from custom post-skill XP systems (chain links, aspects/Aspect Mastery, codexes, and echoes), which are separate from random-gain skill training, so progression items matter more than gear. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560732073431045)
- **red hand death lockout**: A Red Hand (thieves guild) member who dies in a dungeon, such as the Time Dungeon or Sanctuary, is locked out of it for a period even without stealing or committing a crime; switching to Grey Hand avoids this. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548420208648130753)
- **red hand thief attackability**: A Red Hand thief is always freely attackable by anyone, anywhere (even in town and even when their name appears blue), cannot give murder counts to those who kill them, always flags criminal to the player they steal from, and sometimes flags criminal to everyone else. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555304633759563832)
- **renaming a pet**: To rename a pet, pull out its health bar and click it to reveal a quill icon, while not in war mode or you will attack the pet; if modern health bars make this hard, enable Options > General > Health Bars & Drag Select > Health bars > Use custom healthbars gump (modern old style); the rename fails if the name is unavailable or unacceptable. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544274636940906536)
- **runebook charge and recall scroll consumption**: Using a runebook can consume both a charge and a Recall scroll; this is a long-known issue, and automatic scroll consumption can be turned off. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546625056187088927)
- **society orc kill job counting**: For the society kill-orcs job, orcs in the wilderness outside Urukton Bluffs count, while orcs inside the Urukton Bluffs dungeon appear not to count, and it is unclear whether this is a bug or intended. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531910521580814469)
- **thief grey flag visibility**: A thief who steals can flag grey only to the victim rather than to everyone, so other players may not see them as grey. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549144090837258250)
- **trapped pouch explosion**: A trapped pouch explodes when opened by someone other than its owner, such as a thief, which warns the owner; opening one picked up off the ground can also explode and may be dangerous. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525953438590963792)
- **treasure map lockpicking**: Treasure map chests no longer require lockpicking: the chest opens instantly after the mobs are defeated with no lockpicking timer, and the player only needs Cartography to decode the map and then fights the mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548968159195963514)
- **unlocking the first echo cheaply**: To unlock the first echo, open Help > echos and pay with 25k arcane essence or 100 skill scrolls instead of gold or doubloons, which costs about half price; change the cost type with the arrows next to the cost. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556010291613929605)
- **activating aspect on armor**: To activate an aspect on armor, use the armor button (the lowest of the 3 buttons, possibly on a different page) in the aspect menu and single-click the item; the whole worn armor set must be worn at once, the game reports any missing piece, and clicking an armor piece in the paperdoll shows the aspect if applied. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527699307573284915)
- **afk farming restrictions**: XP farming for advanced systems and resource or material gathering are not allowed while AFK, which includes AFK mob farming; only regular skill gain may be done AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529237900263428290)
