- **air aspect skill flexibility**: The Air aspect adds tankiness and frees enough skill points to fit both Alchemy and Parrying in a swing-speed-capped melee build, which otherwise costs 160 points from swing-speed skills. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546354577366974485)
- **arcane codex skill requirements**: Arcane Codexes require at least 80 Arcane, 80 Magery and 80 Wrestling skill to use, and under the proposed patch full benefit would need 100 in each. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530868736838467634)
- **arcane essence consumption**: While an aspect is active, a meter fills with all damage you deal (not only the weapon ultimate attack, scaled by aspect level), and when it fills your arcane essence is consumed, so essence is required to have aspect charges. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532725479822594219)
- **arcane essence consumption from damage**: Arcane essence consumption is driven by damage inflicted: a hidden meter fills by Damage / (3000 - Aspect Tier * 30) percent, and at 100% one essence charge is lost and the meter resets; follower damage may also count, at least when commanded. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536218692696801403)
- **arcane mage mana recovery**: Arcane mages recover mana mainly through aspect procs and a percentage chance on staff hits, which rises with Arcane armor, so mana comes in bursts; Meditation helps early until the Arcane staff aspect and codex are leveled. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544399107488223298)
- **arcane runes**: Arcane Runes are placed on the ground and give their bonus only within a limited number of tiles, so guilds typically use them at bosses and omnis rather than for regular farming; whether skills are required is uncertain, though the buff may be stronger with Arcane and Inscription. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533935797852438650)
- **armor and weapon durability at zero**: Armor and weapons are not destroyed when they reach 0 durability; they lose their effectiveness (armor rating) until repaired. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542913606851629186)
- **armor mana regeneration penalty**: Heavier armor imposes a mana regeneration penalty (not only a Meditation penalty) based on armor class, so more armor means less regen; armor color does not matter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535491509636440084)
- **aspect activation cost**: Activating an aspect such as Lightning Aspect requires arcane essence, which is consumed as fuel while fighting, and activating a lower tier of the aspect uses less essence. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546486715919892500)
- **aspect armor set requirements**: Applying an aspect requires a complete six-piece armor set (head, neck, arms, hands/gloves, chest, legs), which can be magical, vendor-bought or crafted. Casters wear leather and others wear plate. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554514308539355147)
- **aspect experience gain**: Aspect XP is gained mainly by killing monsters with an aspect applied to a weapon or spellbook and to armor. Any aspect except Harvest and War can be gained this way, and one aspect level covers weapon, spellbook, and armor. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526881025446121522)
- **aspect hue vs helm dye color**: To show your helm's actual dye color instead of the aspect hue, click the Manage Hues button at the top of the aspect menu, toggle the aspect hue off, then activate the aspect again. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551702975507075235)
- **aspect kit usage**: An Aspect Kit is needed only to unlock an Aspect (it is a free unlock for up to 3 aspects), not to level it; leveling requires only cores and distillations, and the kit does not give cores or distills to sell. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543617937640792306)
- **aspect link choices**: Bleeding aspect links give only a very small bonus compared to player damage links and lock a character into one build and aspect, so for a 15/15 aspect link setup the recommended links are melee special chance/damage and damage dealt by player. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527789076340670504)
- **aspect progress and templates**: Because aspects are tied to a single character, it is ideal to keep aspect progress on one character and stick with one template until you can afford Echoes, which let that character switch between multiple templates while sharing aspects and scroll-raised skill caps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525866535887966310)
- **auto-opening ability hotbar after login**: The ability hotbar itself must be opened with a hotkey or macro button, but the Chivalry and Necromancy hotbars can be set to open automatically after login using a save command, as documented in the Chivalry page of the Outlands wiki. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540711929369337866)
- **avoiding fame loss near a title threshold**: To avoid losing fame near a title threshold, farm easier content where you are unlikely to die, and do not accept a resurrection inside a dungeon unless it is safe; instead leave, gear up and return to your body. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540027373250940951)
- **bedroll logout**: A bedroll provides a logout menu in the overworld but does not work for logging out inside dungeons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546976940844646452)
- **blessed items on death**: When you die, blessed items never go onto your corpse. They stay with you and return to the top level of your backpack, and a blessed adventurer's satchel returns to the top layer as a whole. They cannot be stolen. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196361589465159)
- **blessed spellbook equipping**: The blessed spellbook only holds spells and does not affect damage or stats, so there is no technical reason to equip it; weapon spellbooks are the ones that occupy the weapon slot. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528019270196265051)
- **casting from scrolls without reagents**: Spells cast from scrolls do not use reagents, so a character can cast using only scrolls, though reagents remain useful for spells without scrolls, and scroll casting offers some bonuses that scribe mages value. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527183250584240160)
- **chain swap timer on treasure maps**: Swapping link chains has a cooldown timer, so swapping from a damage chain to a loot chain before looting a treasure chest is slowed by it, which matters since clears are already fast. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538534362721689611)
- **checking hit accuracy**: To see your hit accuracy, type [stats in game, or open the Help menu, choose Player stats, and click Melee. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548227889961500743)
- **circle of transparency hotkey**: To toggle Circle of Transparency with a hotkey, create a client macro using the CircleTrans command (a macro button at the bottom of the screen also exists) and assign a key to it in Options > Macros. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533795594743709817)
- **codex**: A codex is a cheap, blessed, one-time purchase carried on your character that unlocks a skill build's abilities, and using related skills earns exp points that can be applied to enhance it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550699819868233749)
- **codex progress saving**: Codex unlock progress is saved per character, so switching to a different codex skill or not using a skill leaves the codex inactive but does not lose its unlocked progress. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556009778080256041)
- **codex xp gain requirements**: A codex gains XP while it is in your inventory and you meet its skill requirements, even if you kill with a different weapon. Multiple codices gain XP at once, but the bonus applies only to the one matching your equipped weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540029442146046074)
- **command aspect proc from heals**: The Command aspect can proc from healing spells, but the other aspects cannot proc from heals. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543350688812113961)
- **criminal looting and healing prevention commands**: Typing [PreventCriminalLooting and [PreventCriminalHealing in game toggles whether the character is blocked from looting or healing criminals, which avoids going criminal by accident. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529696061369745518)
- **damage to poisoned links poison requirement**: Damage to poisoned links only triggers if the target is afflicted with Greater poison or higher; Lesser or regular poison does not trigger them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542228180708888657)
- **disease and dot stacking**: Damage over time effects such as disease and bleed stack on monsters with no limit; each offensive spell landing during the 30-second disease window adds a stack whose total damage is based on the triggering spell's damage, giving extra damage without extra mana. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545326044599558165)
- **dungeon exp bonus scope**: The dungeon region experience bonus (such as +15% or +20% EXP) does not affect skill gain; it applies only to progression systems such as codex, aspect, mastery chain and redline experience. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542719862516752465)
- **echo command**: Type [echo in game to display your character's skill and stat information, and share a screenshot of the result when asking for build advice. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533493552468983852)
- **echoes**: An echo is a stored skills and stats template on the same character that can be swapped to (with a cooldown between swaps) without changing name, looks, or other attributes; each Echo purchased adds another template, and echoes are a mid-game purchase. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554690018314813554)
- **endgame content focus**: Endgame content in Outlands is largely PvP, including ocean PvP with boats, and PvPvE is a niche late endgame mode. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539859779504312350)
- **equipment durability display**: Armor and weapons have durability, which can be viewed by typing [stats in game and opening the equipment tab. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549702133299941410)
- **essence requirement for aspect xp**: Aspect XP is gained only while you have enough arcane essence; without enough essence you gain no aspect XP, and when essence reaches 0 the aspect turns off. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523496993157283841)
- **focus mana refund**: Focus increases mana refund chance, and summoners without Focus will struggle with mana because it is needed to cap the refund chance. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530051069864972400)
- **fortune armor xp buff**: Fortune armor's XP buff increases Redline XP gained, which is why it needs an explicit XP boost since gold and doubloon links do not raise XP. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546649104027746334)
- **fortune aspect bonus**: The Fortune aspect gives bonus gold and experience (reported as about 29% more), which makes it desirable even though it is not the best damage boost. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413244269596733)
- **fortune aspect value**: For most builds, including tamers, the normal aspect tailored to your damage output yields more experience per hour than fortune; fortune is mainly worthwhile for lockpickers, treasure mappers, boaters, or when farmable content is limited. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552382561689534515)
- **getting arcane essence on the test server**: On the test server, get arcane essence from a full stockpile or a link tome taken from your own copy of the yellow/gold statue (not the locked-down ones in the square), or use the stockpile in Prevalia, which stocks it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548692374371442739)
- **ghost and living player visibility**: Dead players cannot see living players unless those players have [ghostvisible enabled, so ghosts cannot scout. Players can hide from ghosts with ghostvisible, and a ghost is seen by the living only while it is in warmode. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532410811794980994)
- **going grey from looting or attacking blue players**: Looting a blue (innocent) player's corpse, stealing, or attacking a blue player makes you a criminal (grey) and lets others attack you freely, but looting a blue-named mob's corpse or healing a mob does not. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541459538883125278)
- **harvest aspect essence and armor requirements**: Harvest aspect only works and gains experience when arcane essence is above zero and harvest armor is checked (equipped). _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553123803083841568)
- **harvest aspect weapon benefit**: A weapon's Harvest aspect has no damage modifiers and gives no benefit for gathering or aspect experience gain, though a weapon's aspect can give bonus experience for lockpicking and treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555365201275256965)
- **healer codex with veterinary**: The Healer Codex works with Veterinary supplies if you qualify, but some traits do not apply to them, so read each trait's description. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555629915263729685)
- **healing codex**: The healing codex provides substantial damage (up to about 25% increase) and damage reduction, so it is worth obtaining early and may be needed for harder content. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543654135763701790)
- **health bar collector target filter**: The health bar collector cannot be configured to show only your current attack target. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548402026780688515)
- **hiding next to a house**: Standing next to a house, including a vendor house, gives a 50% chance to hide (+50 Hiding) even at 0 Hiding skill. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452233781805157)
- **identifying magic items before extracting essence**: Magic items must be identified before their magic can be extracted or recycled into Arcane Essence, which fuels Aspects; unidentified items still work when equipped but their properties are not easily visible. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540768153934504096)
- **independent aspect colors at tier 10**: With tier 10 in an aspect you unlock the ability to turn off aspect coloring on helm, neck and gloves or apply an aspect's color independently of your active aspect; using a second aspect's color while another is active requires tier 10 in both the active aspect and the aspect whose color you want. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529088363728998481)
- **item recycler color coding**: In the item recycler, green means the item type or quality will be recycled and red means it will not, so excluding all durabilities or all qualities prevents any items from being recycled. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538926290126774374)
- **level 1 mount bonding**: Level 1 mounts are bonded regardless of Taming skill, need no feeding, and return instantly when you die and resurrect instead of being lost. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841477134188695)
- **level 1 treasure map requirements**: Opening a level 1 treasure map normally requires lockpicking plus fighting ability to kill the guardians, and a main PvM character can team with a second account's lockpicking character; opening it without lockpicking may be possible but slower. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520440897718849677)
- **logout delay outside inns and houses**: Logging out inside an inn or a house you own, co-own, or are friended to removes your character instantly; anywhere else your character remains in the world for about 5 minutes before logging out. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539971527351468123)
- **looting blue corpses**: Looting or skinning a blue (innocent player) corpse is a crime that makes the looter criminal, a prompt warns before looting, and other players may hunt the looter. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541465428847493150)
- **lost pet retrieval**: A lost pet that still exists is pulled to you by the stablemaster's retrieve option, and a pet that is not found is abandoned after about 24 hours. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537151642149847040)
- **magic mushrooms mana restore**: Magic Mushrooms restore mana when eaten, but only if the wizard grimoire has the Summon Food (create food) upgrade; without it they do nothing. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551005070127136780)
- **magical wizard's hat stealth trick**: Taking off and putting on a Magical Wizard's Hat drains 5 stamina, and a character at non-max stamina cannot push through mobs, so a stealthed player can walk through monsters without revealing, though the hat must be re-equipped repeatedly. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534112913617457183)
- **mana regeneration sources**: Mana regeneration comes from active use of Meditation (which can gain skill as mana regenerates after use) and from regen upgrades such as Focus, delectable food and material spellbooks, with an Exceptional Avarhide book possibly adding 1-2 mana per second. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546594762222469180)
- **mastery chain and redline xp sharing**: Mastery Chain links and Redline XP are shared across all characters on the same account, so characters that benefit from them (such as PvM characters) should be kept on the same account. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555589345241600153)
- **mastery chain experience sharing**: Chain experience is shared across all characters on the same account (global XP), but each character needs its own chain purchased to benefit from it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534063205330976788)
- **mastery chain link order**: The order or position of links in a mastery chain does not affect how the bonuses are calculated. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549848076775067699)
- **mastery chain link reforging tool**: A Mastery Chain Link Reforging Tool is consumed on use and changes the bonus on a link to any other link bonus type. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554655343135424533)
- **melee classification for accuracy chain links**: Any physical weapon, including bows and arcane staves, counts as melee in Outlands, so melee accuracy chain links apply to archery and those weapons. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542652980904333374)
- **melee poison sting chance**: The chance for a Melee Poison Sting is based on the higher of the player's effective Poisoning and effective Alchemy skill, so Alchemy is not required if you have Poisoning, though the mechanic is expected to be reworked in the next skills patch. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544400614115512320)
- **monster nameplates and health bars**: Nameplate health bars are on by default, and monster names and health bars above heads are controlled by the nameplates option, separate from the health bar collector, with NPC (not controlled) needing to be toggled on. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541090190863376447)
- **moving cooldown icons**: To move a cooldown icon, hold Alt (Shift is also reported to work) while left-clicking and dragging it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551635464065257483)
- **moving the cooldown bar gump**: Alt + drag moves individual cooldown bars; to move the cooldown bar base, turn off the 'hold alt to move gumps' option first, since the base cannot be moved while it is enabled. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540558939345911878)
- **multiboxing after patch**: Multiboxing remains possible after the patch, for example one character mapping, one doing regular harvesting, and one boating, fishing, lockpicking, or running MiBs. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536936397162942535)
- **multiple accounts and simultaneous logins**: A player can have 3 accounts and can be logged into all 3 at the same time by opening multiple instances of the game. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555778707258605639)
- **murder count decay time**: Each murder count takes 72 hours (3 days) of online time to burn off. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538332632239177738)
- **murder counts required to become red**: A player becomes red (murderer) only at 5 or more murder counts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538333360366161992)
- **necromancy summon hues**: Spell hues do not apply to necromancy summons, so they cannot be hued. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531559502208307272)
- **opening the aspect menu**: Say [aspect in-game (commands generally start with [) or double-click the hexagonal aspect icon to open the aspect menu. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528526763465117746)
- **organizing the skills list**: In the skills menu, click the blue category text to rename a category or create a new group, then drag skills (including those under 'New Skills') into it to keep the list organized. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529225767517425844)
- **outlands id per ip limit**: Only one Outlands ID is allowed per IP address; a second ID on the same IP requires staff approval via a ticket or application, and extra IDs may conflict with the 3 account rule. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554604775599775876)
- **outlands test server**: Outlands has a test server (Test Shard) where players can preview and try items and systems before investing or buying. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540016918545829910)
- **pet damage and aspect procs**: Damage dealt by pets does not trigger the owner's aspect weapon procs, though pet damage still counts toward raising the Command aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551779227588755539)
- **pet level cap on shelter island**: Pets tamed on Shelter Island can only reach level 1, while the maximum pet level is 10; pets come in slot sizes 1, 2, 3 and 4. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532823016981925899)
- **pet limit and pet level cap**: The maximum number of pets is 5 and does not increase with skill, but pets can level up to a maximum level of 15, and the bestiary unlocks many possibilities. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556034687502389299)
- **pet naming restrictions**: Pet names do not have to be unique among pets, but a pet cannot be given the same name as a player or a name on the naughty list. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538575335711441016)
- **player render distance**: Other players and objects are only displayed within roughly 18 tiles of your character, with some players estimating about 20. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554564143657259019)
- **poison field and grimoire poison bonus stacking**: The Poison Field and Poison spell effective poisoning bonuses probably do not stack, because grimoire bonuses appear to be scoped to each individual spell. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524268581586473030)
- **preventing accidental criminal actions**: To avoid accidentally turning criminal or grey, use the commands [PreventCriminalHealing and [PreventCriminalLooting to block healing criminal targets and looting that would flag you. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541459880714567792)
- **preventing overlapping nameplates**: Press Ctrl+Shift (with the red menu closed) to open the options and tick 'prevent overlapping nameplates' so nameplates stack instead of overlapping. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554646151314284555)
- **progression binding for codex, aspect, mastery chain and redline**: Codex and Aspect progress is tied to the individual character that earns it, while Mastery Chain and Redline progress are tied to the account. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542079860241866762)
- **red hand death lockout**: Under the Red Hand system, dying after taking aggressive action, including in PvM dungeons, triggers a roughly 30 minute lockout, and echoes do not protect against it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540054502827229315)
- **red hand thief status**: Players who steal become red hands flagged by the thieves guild, may appear blue, and can be attacked by anyone without criminal flag or murder count; they can leave the guild by visiting a thief NPC. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537931460948922460)
- **red resurrection fee**: A character with 5 or more murder counts must pay 4,000 gold to resurrect. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529423720618262698)
- **redline scalar unlock**: Reaching tier 15 (T15) in an aspect, such as Artisan or Holy, unlocks the redline scalar. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533519672446816326)
- **redline unlock via aspects**: Each tier 15 aspect unlocks about 33% of redline XP for other characters on the account, so three tier 15 aspects give roughly 100%, and unlocking 30 links unlocks 100% instantly. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552983585550504008)
- **reducing message spam**: To reduce message spam such as player area taunts, open the game's text and messages options and adjust the settings under the filters tab. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526128097009602663)
- **removing an aspect from gear**: To remove or turn off an aspect, move the aspect item out of your backpack and off your person, for example onto the ground or into a bank or inn room box; worn gear must also be placed in another container. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549977197786169445)
- **removing anchored health bars**: To remove a health bar from the screen, hold Alt and right click it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541639981095976960)
- **resizable game window with black border**: To get black space around the game window, uncheck 'Always use fullsize game window' under Options > Video > World Viewport, then drag the blue gem at the bottom right of the game window to resize it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537262148672028752)
- **retrieving lost pets**: If you have at least 1/5 followers and your pets show on the followers tab of the stats gump, visit a Stablekeeper NPC, open the Stables Gump, click More Options, then Retrieve Lost Followers; if you show 0/5 followers, have no pets on that tab, and did not stable them, visit an Animal Wrangler to try to retrieve Abandoned Pets. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554795973253791754)
- **retrieving missing or stacked pets**: If your follower count shows pets you cannot see, open the stables, click more options, and use Retrieve Pets (available before abandonment); if the count exceeds your slots (e.g. 6/5), stable a pet or visit a stablemaster in a different town and press the retrieve lost follower button, which can reveal pets stacked on one tile. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525134781027713064)
- **ruffian as tactics replacement for codex leveling**: Ruffian counts as Tactics for leveling weapon codices, so a Mace backstabber can skip Tactics; it was changed to require multiple points, with one later report of 5 points in Ruffian being sufficient. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540051847174160414)
- **sanctuary dungeon restrictions**: Sanctuary dungeons prohibit criminal and harmful acts, including pickpocketing, PKing, and friendly player corpse looting, so they are safer for new players recovering corpses, and corpses killed by another player show as locked until they turn grey. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536119835187093646)
- **sanctuary dungeons and society kill tasks**: Monsters killed in Sanctuary Dungeons (new player friendly dungeons) do not count toward society job kill quests; they must be killed outside them, and it is unclear whether the weekly sanctuary counts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534918525779578880)
- **shepherd's crook activation**: An activated shepherd's crook gives its pet benefits while it is in your backpack or equipped, and casting spells unequips it. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533898012852621322)
- **society job kills in sanctuary dungeons**: Kills made inside Sanctuary (newbie/safe) dungeons do not count toward quests or society jobs; kills must be made outside, where reds and thieves can still attack. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534916671565856860)
- **source of character strength**: Most of a character's damage, defense and overall strength comes from leveling the post-skill XP progression systems (codices first, then aspect) rather than from gear, which gives only a moderate improvement. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548766657445625877)
- **special rare loot links on treasure maps**: Special rare loot links work on treasure map chests. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1551122338160836719)
- **spell mana refund**: Mana refund on spell casts comes mainly from the aspect level on your equipped spellbook (up to 40% at tier 15), magical spellbook properties, and the Focus skill; at low aspect levels a magic spellbook is probably worth using for the refund chance even with Resist. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **stat lowering behavior at cap**: A stat set to lower only starts to decrease once the total points reach the cap, then points shift to the stats being raised; skill points behave the same way. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525832225860620460)
- **stats display reliability**: The [stats display is broken and should not be relied upon; not all effective skill bonuses show in the skills gump, so use third-party calculators like Outlands Butler or the wiki formulae for accurate values. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538951294390239294)
- **swing speed and dexterity cap**: Swing speed (and bandage speed) is calculated from current stamina and caps at 100, so dexterity above 100 gives no extra speed but acts as a buffer that keeps you at full speed when current stamina drops below 100. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537240417005871224)
- **t-map location and travel**: After the T-map update, players cannot run many T-maps in one spot and must travel between map locations. A map's location is unknown until the player hikes there, so a poor area cannot be avoided. Players can carry several maps, but each must be decoded on site. T-map loot is unchanged. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531076942659326204)
- **tamer link unlocking**: Tamer is the suggested fastest template for unlocking links solo; the build unlocks around tier 14 and 20 links, each link after about 20 comes faster than the last, and sticking with one build is the faster way to unlock links. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547379358530805881)
- **thief npc theft history**: A thief NPC can show your theft history, listing events where items were stolen from you. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542595454615949362)
- **thief stealing of containers and items**: Thieves cannot steal a filled container as a whole, but items inside your bag can be stolen; equipped items cannot be stolen. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525629772229775361)
- **thieves and gold**: Thieves cannot steal gold from players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544036705525309491)
- **thieves stealing from pack**: Thieves can steal items from your pack, so valuables should be kept in your inn room, house or bank box rather than carried; a bank should hold only gold and some loadouts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549973796319137905)
- **treasure map gump scripting**: The new treasure map gump on Outlands cannot be scripted because it has no gump response, which is intentional so that it would not be automated. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1538913084071215154)
- **treasure map lockpicking requirement**: Under the new system, lockpicking is no longer required for treasure maps or resource maps; maps stay undecoded, cartography is used for treasure maps and the relevant harvesting skill for resource maps. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550102177056563211)
- **treasure map overhaul**: Treasure maps are undergoing a major redesign that is being tested on the test server but is not yet released, and the overhaul has reportedly been in progress for years. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535638363833503849)
- **treasure map update**: A treasure map update stopped T-maps from auto-looting, and lockpicking is no longer used for T-maps, so players switch to cartography. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531043404568465558)
- **veterinary stable slot bonus**: The old rule of one extra stable slot per 10 Veterinary skill no longer applies, having been replaced by a base stable slot increase. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525546264937103391)
- **wall spells at low magery**: Below a certain Magery threshold, wall spells become curbs that do not block passage and only give a chance to stumble. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528790030783483935)
- **war aspect bonuses**: War Aspect is leveled through structured PvP activities such as town struggle, but its bonuses apply only against monsters (PvM) and not to PvP damage. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549346877764280331)
- **weekly society job rotation**: All players receive the same society jobs each week. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543297035262885959)
- **wiki modifiers page**: The Outlands wiki Modifiers page lists the possible magic item modifiers and the bonuses on crafted and magic items, including instruments, and shows the differences between them. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551764317022453792)
- **wrestling codex abilities and chi trust**: Dragon, Chi and Haymaker are abilities in the wrestling codex; leveling all stances and abilities to 5 unlocks Chi trust, and Haymaker and Chi Finisher are considered good choices. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540143302714724392)
- **ability hotbar command**: Type [abilityhotbar to open the weapon ability bar on screen. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545806239932620852)
- **account deletion**: Players cannot delete accounts themselves and can only delete or re-make characters, though staff may help via a ticket. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548500193018908713)
- **achievement point links**: Links bought with achievement points are random. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544707947412848640)
- **adding recall scrolls to a runebook**: Close the runebook before dropping a recall scroll onto it, because an open book does not accept recall scrolls, including locked down runebooks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538414377718251540)
- **additive versus multiplicative mastery links**: Mastery Chain links are either additive, adding to the shared melee/spell damage bucket alongside existing bonuses and so having less impact, or multiplicative, using a separate bucket that multiplies against the others and is more noticeable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540434889168658473)
- **advancing aspect tiers**: After reaching max Aspect XP, open the Aspect menu via the hexagon and consume more cores and distills to advance to the next tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548519244935995412)
- **adventurer's rope**: The Adventurer's Rope works like the Teleport spell and is not used for recalling. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527115598515929139)
- **afk and unattended activity rules**: AFK or unattended resource gathering, vendor purchasing, begging, malicious scavenging, stealing and XP gain are prohibited, with the stealing prohibition applying only while AFK. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532512070124310581)
- **air aspect swing speed**: The Air aspect provides swing speed, and about 5 Air puts you over the swing speed cap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529642592009064659)
- **alchemy codex in pvp**: The full Alchemy codex, including Panacea, remains active while flagged in pvp. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551333830508417157)
- **aoe spells flagging criminal**: Area-of-effect spells such as Fire Field can flag a player who runs through the field as criminal. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520889412072898752)
- **arcane aspect chance scaling**: As arcane aspect tier rises, the spell aspect chance link becomes effectively more valuable, and high aspect tier, links and arcane aspect crystals are needed to maintain the aspect most of the time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555614776468443331)
- **arcane crystal damage boost**: Burning arcane crystals gives roughly a 10% damage-per-second boost to a mage's own spells, but it does not boost pet damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531333330509889546)
- **arcane essence meter per item**: The arcane essence damage meter is calculated separately for worn armor and the weapon or spellbook, and effects that reduce essence consumption, such as weekly region bonuses, reduce meter progress. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536218706164588544)
- **arcane mage aspect proc sources**: Arcane mages get most of their aspect procs from spell casts rather than melee swings, while staff melee hits add extra free proc chances, and wizards roll separate proc dice for melee and spells. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545459057253687396)
- **arcane mana source for mages**: Arcane serves as a mana source in Outlands, added to bridge the gap that kept pure mages PvP-only, and PvM mages find play difficult without it, though effectively infinite mana is not meant to be easily achieved. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555663153067724974)
- **arcane scrolls versus essence**: Arcane Scrolls are not added to an aspect the way Arcane Essence is, and they do not convert into essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538419885665812531)
- **arcane stance commands**: Activate an Arcane Codex stance with the commands [ArcaneStance1 through [ArcaneStance5, where N is the stance's position in the codex; they are listed on page one of the in-game commands menu. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548115274207600761)
- **armor rating effect on melee damage**: Higher armor rating (AR) means less melee damage taken per hit; monsters have a set AR by type and a player's AR comes from the armor worn. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525611966570434703)
- **aspect activation**: Activate your Aspect on both a weapon or spellbook and your armour, since you gain 50% of the aspect XP from each; the activation buttons are on the second page of the aspect tab. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542122179359936553)
- **aspect activation and armor**: Aspects are activated while wearing any armor and are not tied to specially crafted armor; the aspect power does not persist when you die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540015159400206478)
- **aspect activation essence cost**: Activating an aspect costs 5 essence per item category (armor, weapon, spellbook), so activating all three costs 15 essence in total, and higher aspect tiers or procs may consume additional essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527698357521223720)
- **aspect activation indicator**: When an aspect is activated, the color of the worn gear changes to show it worked. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887037214687384)
- **aspect activation requirements**: Aspect Mastery can be activated on one or all of the three gear sections (armor, spellbook, weapon), though a weapon and spellbook cannot be equipped together, and a full suit of armor of any type is needed to activate the armor aspect fully. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553886932810076273)
- **aspect and codex progression across echoes**: Aspect and codex progression is shared among echoes, so a leveled codex stays leveled when switching echoes and does not need to be leveled again for another build that uses it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545341347202998303)
- **aspect armor color setting**: The aspect menu (middle top) has an option to stop armor from changing color with your aspect, which lets you hue a restyled hat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542724815276744795)
- **aspect benefits**: Aspects are easy to train and start at the same level, but most of their benefits are not noticeable until tier 10. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536017129114042551)
- **aspect crystal consumption**: One aspect crystal is consumed each time arcane essence is consumed, so crystals drain at the same rate as essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536213818735198238)
- **aspect hue effect on armor**: Aspect hues apply to armor only; robes and hoods dyed or worn over armor do not carry the aspect effect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521521413746593913)
- **aspect item types**: Aspects apply to three item types: weapon, spellbook, and armor; a mage typically applies them to armor and spellbook, while a dexxer applies them to armor and weapon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522776950291173616)
- **aspect level bonuses**: All aspects provide damage and armor rating bonuses that improve as the aspect level increases. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529912599712370738)
- **aspect level cap**: The default maximum aspect level in a field is 15, where most players stop, and it can be raised to 20 with the Redline system. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **aspect level-up requirements**: Aspect level-up required items shifted to be more top heavy, so earlier levels became cheaper and previously spent cores and distillations are refunded. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536325858338406510)
- **aspect leveling**: Aspects level from kill experience rather than battle trainer training, and the War aspect levels only in PvP events. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533849123768242362)
- **aspect menu pvp mechanics option**: The [aspect menu has a 'pvp mechanics' option at the bottom that shows how each aspect works in PvP, and some aspects have PvP-specific effects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543386230543229018)
- **aspect proc chance stacking**: Aspect proc chance bonuses stack multiplicatively rather than additively. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545562470037590027)
- **aspect reactivation cost**: If a character runs out of arcane essence, the aspect must be reactivated at a cost of 5 essence for each aspect piece. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532749555454578698)
- **aspect slot unlocks**: The first 3 aspect slots are unlocked from the start, and the remaining slots must be unlocked as customizations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527699860931743935)
- **aspect starter bundle**: An Aspect Starter Bundle is used in place of the normal items for the next 3 aspects you unlock, one charge each, and the remaining charges can be used by other characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548380941666492592)
- **aspect starter kit**: The aspect starter kit provides what is needed to unlock an aspect and is not locked to one character, so it can be given to another character on the account, though Aspect Essence may still be needed to fuel the aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541952996794179705)
- **aspect xp from pet kills**: Kills made by your pets grant Aspect XP (and XP to other equipped XP-gaining items such as codices) as if you had made the kills, but you must hold or wear an item that can be aspected, such as a weapon or spellbook, to receive all of the Aspect XP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550561457421422615)
- **aspect xp sharing**: Aspects must be activated to gain XP and share XP across slots, so activating the same aspect on all slots gives the fastest progress. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540029724817104916)
- **aspects and shields**: Aspects cannot be applied to shields, and shields cannot be aspect-colored. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522794782554984569)
- **attacking red hand thieves**: Attacking a Red Hand thief flags you only to that thief and not as a criminal, and if guards kill you after you attack someone, that person was not actually a Red Hand thief. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540053276748415007)
- **auto pickup of arrows and bolts**: To auto-pick up arrows and bolts, open Agents, scroll to Scavenger, and add the items you want picked up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532437149918564442)
- **auto use spell scrolls from wizard satchel**: To use spell scrolls from a wizard satchel without taking them out each time, toggle the [AutoUseSpellScrolls command; the [commands menu lists commands and shows whether each is toggled on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541842812859846677)
- **autorun option**: Autorun is in the experimental options section and triggers when both mouse buttons are clicked: hold right click to run, tap left click, then release and the character keeps running. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524750015925321749)
- **avoiding potion satchel counter issue**: To avoid the potion satchel counter issue, keep the satchel open, reopen it after looting it from your body following death or after changing maps, or keep health potions outside the satchel. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552790485960106069)
- **avoiding presnoop when buying**: To avoid being presnooped, move away or move around before buying from a vendor. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534573345071173643)
- **backstab from invisibility**: To backstab after becoming invisible, you must go invisibility, then hide, then stealth, because you cannot go directly from invisibility to stealth and can only backstab from stealth. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550796059767214213)
- **backstabber play and shadow aspect**: Backstabbing is hard to play without the Shadow aspect unlocked, which is obtained through a quest requiring loot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532461717848588340)
- **base strength and intelligence maximum**: Base Strength and Intelligence are each capped at 100; higher values are only temporary via potions and similar effects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525864847408107713)
- **battle trainer essence use**: Hitting a battle trainer does not consume Arcane Essence. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532734038673068082)
- **being visible as a ghost**: To make other players see you as a ghost so they can resurrect you, toggle into War mode. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530264635981168720)
- **best aspect for treasure maps**: Fortune and Harvest aspects are the preferred choices for treasure mapping, with Fortune said to give more experience. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552396819491725347)
- **binding a mastery chain**: To bind a Mastery Chain (including a gilded one) to a character, open it or double-click it and choose to bind it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541846183411056720)
- **bless attack speed bonus scaling**: The 5% attack speed bonus from Bless is reduced at lower Magery levels. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528789858343194646)
- **blessable items**: Few items can be blessed: runebooks, rune tomes and fancy clothing can be blessed with a type-specific bless deed (codexes are already blessed when made), and unblessed items can be lost on death. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016986524647434)
- **blessed item theft protection**: Blessed items cannot be stolen or pickpocketed and are not lost on death, unless you place them on the ground. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550935267639164949)
- **blessed items on death**: Only items tagged Blessed, shown in the name or when you click the item, stay with you on death, and all other items can be looted from your corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016526375944285)
- **blood armor aspect buffs**: The blood armor aspect gives a dexterity buff, an HP buff, and a mana buff. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540755296283131985)
- **bonus xp and codex points**: Bonus XP counts toward Codex points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539135899588108389)
- **bound deeds and spell stones trading**: Inn credit deeds, training credit deeds and spell stones display as bound to a character name but can still be traded between your own characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539630522849038418)
- **bound item protection**: Bound items typically lack blessed protection and can be looted, but they are safe if stored in the bank. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502647929634838)
- **buff bonus display**: Applying a buff shows its bonus percentage in a system message, and with buff icon values enabled the value also appears at the upper left of the buff icon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537561144305127424)
- **buff icon size**: Buff icons can be enlarged to make their values easier to read, but at large sizes they pixelate and look odd. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537562091274113114)
- **bulk identifying items with container id wand**: A container ID wand identifies an entire bag of items in one go; such wands can be bought through the Outlands portal vendor search. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533231225387618455)
- **camping item weight**: The reusable camping item weighs one stone. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527325652351717398)
- **cancelling an accidentally accepted society quest**: If a society quest is accepted by accident, open Help > Societies > Abandon to cancel it, which carries no penalty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529901213053882388)
- **catch of the week**: The [cotw command opens the catch of the week system, where you turn in a randomly selected set of three fish each week for reward points based on weight ranking, and fish can be held in an aquarium until they match the week's set. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551794404845559870)
- **chain activation requirement for links**: Link bonuses only apply when the relevant chain is active, so the chain must be active for links to take effect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537340632778145894)
- **chain link slot unlocks**: Link slots are unlocked by farming gold, which earns chain XP; the first slot unlocks at 250k farmed, the second after an additional 500k, the third after an additional 750k, and so on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554147974328614955)
- **charged spells in magery**: In Outlands Magery, classic spells can sometimes become charged versions of themselves, as described in the Charged Spells section of the Magery wiki page. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527100202039906324)
- **chest trap death handling**: Failing a trapped paragon chest can kill you, so attempt it in an inn room or house. If you die in an inn room, leaving and re-entering as a ghost reportedly resurrects you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546287971307880520)
- **chivalry effect on skill abilities**: Chivalry skill increases the strength of skill abilities, and the Chivalry ability Army of One adds extra damage (about 16% was mentioned). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524947356615708805)
- **chivalry unlock and links**: Links add available Chivalry points but cannot unlock Chivalry abilities such as Holy Light, because unlocking requires the printed skill value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544744641067229306)
- **circle of transparency hiding obstacles**: Circle of Transparency can hide walls and plants that block movement, so check it if you are blocked by something you cannot see. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523054716148252982)
- **circling warning ravens**: Crows or ravens circling you are Warning Ravens indicating a murderer (red) has just killed someone else in the area; they do not reveal your position and can be turned off. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553166915822682193)
- **class setup bonuses damage bucket**: Class setup bonuses go into the additive melee damage bucket and are not multiplied directly against weapon DPS. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527022094670631015)
- **closing health bars of dead mobs**: To close health bars of dead or inactive targets, set Options > General > Health Bars & Drag Select > Health bars to close when dead, or bind the CloseInactiveHealthBars command under Options > Macros; Health Bar Collectors are another option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532591791591653486)
- **closing nameplates by clicking**: Individual nameplates can be closed by clicking them, and enabling the relevant nameplate setting prevents misclicks from closing them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532324270047323)
- **clothing carrying aspects**: Some clothing can carry an aspect, including gloves, neck and head layers (the head layer only if the hat is Armored), provided the item is blessed; a hat can take an aspect such as Fortune in place of the helmet. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543588771813924924)
- **clothing replacing armor slots**: Head, neck and hand armor slots can be replaced by clothing items such as a hood or scarf, which must be blessed to be aspected, and some armor rating may be lost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550988975102234666)
- **codex buffs in pvp**: Codex buffs such as Shield Bash do not apply against players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551317291646582947)
- **codex build profiles**: Outlands does not currently support saving build profiles or loadouts for codex setups, such as spell selections. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523035518244225137)
- **codex experience in sanctuary dungeons**: Codex (aspect) experience is gained in all sanctuary dungeons, but at a reduced rate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538572099185025096)
- **codex hotbar commands**: Use [codexhotbar to open a hotbar for codex abilities, and [abilityhotbar to open an ability hotbar; the exact spelling of the second command is debated ([abilityhotbar vs [abilitieshotbar). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-29–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548209323744821249)
- **codex point reset**: Codex points can be reset only on codices that support different setups, such as the summoner, bard, wizard, tamer, trap kit, poison kit and thief codexes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539730290614861969)
- **codex point reset**: Codices with a limited number of points, such as the healer's codex, can be reset about once every 5 minutes so points can be moved around without losing them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529503864800280596)
- **codex progress**: A Codex always starts from scratch when you obtain it unless you have already completed it, because Codex progress is tied to your character rather than the book. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537441296585728090)
- **codex progress storage**: Codex progress is stored on the character rather than on the codex book item itself. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540029616004272161)
- **codex pvp effects**: Codex improvements generally give no PvP bonuses, but some still work while flagged: extra healing from greater heal potions, disease and bleed cure from panacea, and a shorter bandage timer from the healing codex; some bonuses also still work against monsters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553820404387291190)
- **codex requirements for inactive echo**: Codex bonuses and leveling require the relevant skills to be on your currently active echo, so an inactive echo's skills give no codex benefit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300164591812713)
- **codex sharing**: Codices can be shared between characters and accounts, but the experience is not shared. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523749886556901446)
- **codex theft protection**: Codices, including the Wizards Grimoire, are blessed and cannot be stolen. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553584435281137685)
- **codex xp on shelter island**: Codex experience cannot be gained on Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523855997012148244)
- **command aspect damage proc**: For mage summoners and tamers, command aspect's chance to increase damage is gained by casting spells, and higher tier spells have a higher proc chance that scales with the spell's mana cost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554120642700247143)
- **completely safe places**: The only fully safe places are houses, inn rooms, guild houses and sanctuaries such as Shelter Island. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554293615952658444)
- **conserving arcane essence**: To conserve arcane essence, recycle loot such as magic items, pick up lightweight magic items (1-3 stones) left by others, and lower the currently applied Aspect tier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529888777319878797)
- **consolidating progression on one account**: Aspect and link progression is best consolidated on a single account, because splitting it across accounts leaves each with less progress (e.g. 11 links on one and 10 on the other). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522248587642409091)
- **cooldown gump visibility**: The cooldown gump cannot be set to auto-hide when no cooldowns are active; hiding the whole gump also hides cooldowns, but individual cooldowns can be dragged out and placed separately. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529489682662948976)
- **cooldowns buff added trigger**: In the cooldowns tool, the 'buff added' trigger fires when the buff entered is added, so the entered name must match the actual buff added, which can differ from the spell's name. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521002380265521203)
- **copying ui settings between characters**: To copy UI settings between characters on the same account, use Options > Profile Manager > Clone Profile; alternatively, copy the desired profile in the game folder's profiles directory and paste it into the other characters' profiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542713521480011798)
