- **corpse looting and cutting**: Other players can loot, run the pockets of, or cut up your corpse after you die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196987438080151)
- **corpse looting and decay timers**: A player corpse becomes bones after 15 minutes, at which point anyone can loot it without flagging criminal, and the bones decay 15 minutes later (about 30 minutes total); non-player corpses use roughly 5 and 5 minutes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555493049038143489)
- **corpse name display toggle**: To turn off the corpse name display, open the paperdoll, go to Options, then General, then change the toggle at Corpses (the last option). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531474757256613980)
- **criminal status from poisoning food**: Poisoning food and having someone eat it does not make the poisoner criminal or grey or give murder counts; testing could not get the poison to kill the victim. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535081349617291274)
- **custom skill groups**: In the skills window, press New Group and drag the skills you use into it to create a custom group; to remove a group, single-click it and press Delete. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529181228337467622)
- **damage dealt by player link upgrade**: Double-clicking a damage dealt by player link lets you upgrade it into any link of your choice. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525348263358763039)
- **damage dealt stat with multiple chains**: When using multiple chains, the damage-dealt-by-player stat shows only the value for the currently active chain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546634464552034354)
- **damage-to-poisoned requirement**: The damage-to-poisoned effect requires Greater poison or higher, applied by you or your follower. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537558291843129514)
- **dead blue players in cambria**: Dead blue players in the Cambria streets are most likely from the Town Struggle PvP event, or possibly from faction fights. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554877641243369483)
- **definition of a mobile**: In Ultima Online, a mobile (mob) is anything that is not an item, such as monsters and NPCs, and players are technically included. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526127547882930317)
- **deleting characters with aspects or quest rewards**: Characters that hold quest rewards or an aspect should not be deleted, because those benefits would be lost. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549588987008786523)
- **detective lens**: With the Detecting Hidden skill, a player can use a Detective Lens on players to tell whether they are Red Hand thieves (or Grey Hand) and to see who has looted a corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **disable right+left click autorun**: To stop unwanted auto-run, which triggers when you left click while holding right click, enable 'disable right+left click automove' in Options -> Experimental. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535325449104793662)
- **disarm and hamstring toggles**: The disarm and hamstring toggles persist through logoff and death. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531357264789901484)
- **discontinued red achievements**: Achievements marked red and discontinued can no longer be earned; they remain so players who previously unlocked them can use the title. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537794492265005066)
- **double click looting to loot bag**: With double click looting from containers enabled under Options > Interface, double-clicking an item in a container (corpse or bank) sends it to your set loot bag, or to your main backpack if none is set; single-clicking in Grid Loot also sends items to the loot bag. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293573418291210)
- **dps scaling with chain links**: A character's DPS and kill speed rise as it gains more chain links, and choosing links that fit the build matters a lot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548480856711106634)
- **dread wolf, grizzly and polar bear mount tokens**: Anyone can use Dread Wolf, Grizzly and Polar Bear mount tokens. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537861224069337138)
- **drinking potions without a free hand**: Potions can be drunk without a free hand, so there is no need to unequip hands to drink one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1532150487309357248)
- **dungeon ranks**: Dungeon ranks are earned from redline points in a region, with six points for rank 1, 13 for rank 2, and increasing amounts for higher ranks; they are not a ranking among players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543600772946862100)
- **echo behavior**: An echo is not a fixed snapshot; it is a skill/stat profile that can be changed normally while it is the active one, and you swap between profiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553545262897696821)
- **echo builds**: Echoes let one character hold different builds, such as a tamer and a dexer, each on its own echo. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539727050636664954)
- **echo sharing of aspects and chains**: Echo variants of a main character share aspects and chain experience, whereas separate alts must level them again, so skills transfer more easily than aspects and chains and echoes are expensive to grow. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539726711774650539)
- **echo skill profiles**: A character has one skill/stat profile by default, and unlocking an echo gives a second profile, allowing swapping between two templates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553544439962542093)
- **echo template swapping**: Once a character is established, a player can unlock an Echo on it, which saves other skill templates and lets the player swap between builds, subject to cooldowns. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555299801258664009)
- **echoes and mastery chain**: The mastery chain is shared only within a single account, so anything that benefits from it is best kept on one account; because accounts have a character limit, most players use echoes, which also allow trying different builds (aspect levels) without ruining a good one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549507371070521527)
- **echoes and skill loadouts**: Echoes let a single character hold multiple skill builds, so one character can have all skills over time but cannot use them simultaneously, while Aspect progression stays bound to that character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554834165785170011)
- **effective skill links**: Effective skill links (e.g. +3 alchemy) only apply to combat: the bonus does not affect crafting and does not show in the skills menu, but computations that use that skill, such as greater heal potion healing or greater explosion damage, behave as if the skill were higher while the link is equipped. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554684994729808054)
- **emote usage commands**: Once an emote is unlocked, it is used with a bracket command such as [yell or [groan, and a macro can also be made for it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536762745880453305)
- **equipment at zero durability**: When equipment durability reaches 0, it becomes less effective but is not destroyed or lost, and repairing it restores its effectiveness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542302449992343653)
- **equipment durability and breaking**: Armor and weapons worn by players can break, there is no known system message warning of low durability, and durability can be checked on the equipment page of [stats. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525613126710595655)
- **explorer pack change on test server**: The explorer pack change was being modified on the test server, where double-clicking the pack did not work, so the final behavior may differ. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531356296388022302)
- **explorer pack consumability**: Explorer Packs are consumable items that are used up when used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536746765527687238)
- **extra stable slot sources**: Stable slots come from 60 base slots from skill, with additional slots obtained by purchasing them in the customizations menu and by completing zoology entries. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525546487742988349)
- **extra stable slots from pet use and zoology**: Using a specific tame to kill creatures for a while can earn an extra stable slot, and completing zoology entries also grants extra stable slots. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525543282560598122)
- **fame loss on death**: Dying costs roughly 10% of your total fame, which hurts more the closer you are to 1 million fame. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540024156542996481)
- **faster aspect leveling methods**: Grouping up, running bosses (including guild boss runs) and doing society kill quests help level aspects faster. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533854521036509194)
- **fixing unwanted squares in dungeons**: If unwanted squares appear in dungeons, verifying the game files fixes the problem. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550407045923082293)
- **food buff duration**: The buff from eating food, including Delectables, lasts 60 minutes from when it is eaten. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526596366535495750)
- **food buffs**: Outlands has no hunger meter; eating food gives bonuses such as faster mana regeneration and a mild swing speed increase, but no harvesting bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544450663386456094)
- **fortune armor experience bonus**: The fortune armor experience bonus applies to everything that can gain experience, including chain, aspect and codex experience. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539666192292388994)
- **fortune aspect experience bonus on mastery chain**: The Fortune aspect's global experience bonus applies to mastery chain XP, boosting any gain that can earn experience. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525501998286377110)
- **fortune aspect pilfering experience**: Pilfering mobs gives Fortune aspect experience and yields better XP than picking, but a picker has things to do when other players kill all the mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546630382756175882)
- **gadget aspect cooldown**: The Gadget aspect has a 1-minute cooldown, so switching aspects between Gadget and Harvest or Fortune during treasure maps is considered impractical. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540451682033606716)
- **gear versus long-term progression**: Gear matters less than the hours spent leveling codices, aspect, the mastery chain, and eventually redline; early on, aspect levels on armor matter more than the mastery chain, which gets completed over time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529948190843994192)
- **ghost auto-teleport**: A player who stays a ghost for an extended time (reportedly about 30 minutes) is automatically sent back, possibly to town, though whether the player must be AFK is unclear. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549592654835224710)
- **ghost visibility opt-in**: Players can opt in to being visible to ghosts using the [GhostVisible command, which protects against ghost spying in dungeons and boss rooms. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530264817519034368)
- **ghostvisible command**: Type [ghostvisible to toggle whether ghosts can see your character; the setting is stored per character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525311510522368081)
- **giving a codex to another character**: A codex can be given to another character, but progress does not transfer, so the new character starts from zero with nothing unlocked. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535717086574284913)
- **gold decay in dungeons**: Gold on the ground or in a movable container inside dungeons reduces by 10% every 60 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540078890058522715)
- **grid loot bag opening**: With grid loot, bags cannot be opened without immediately attempting to loot them, though this is not certain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550202960628293694)
- **grimoire cooldown meaning**: The grimoire cooldown shows when the grimoire's increased effect will next trigger, not when a specific spell can be cast again, so the same spell can be cast repeatedly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523065646416531497)
- **guard calling after theft**: NPCs near a theft call guards automatically, but nearby players must call guards manually. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143511046164653)
- **guild progression from pvm**: PvM progression contributes to guild progression bars, so players contribute to their guild just by playing in most content types even without grouping up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529284230423515147)
- **guild switching cooldown**: Players must wait about 3 days after leaving a guild before joining a new one, though the exact duration is not officially confirmed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544028617800159300)
- **harvest aspect damage resist**: The Harvest aspect grants damage resistance for 60 seconds after each harvest, which lapses if you stop harvesting, and switching to the aspect carries a 60 second delay before it takes effect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **harvest aspect placement**: The harvest aspect is not required on a PvM character and can be placed on a separate harvester, though it is useful on the PvM character for fishing or chests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530534968587980861)
- **harvest aspect sources and benefits**: Harvest aspect experience comes from harvesting resources, fishing (maps and ocean), and skinning leather from mobs spawned at special fishing locations and MiBs. The aspect also benefits maps, chests and MiBs, doubling MiB crate loot and skinned leather but not other mob drops. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537646750058283088)
- **harvest aspect swap delay**: Swapping to the Harvest aspect has a 60 second delay before its bonuses apply, so swapping in mid-activity is not worthwhile, though clearing treasure map mobs in Harvest aspect is fine. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546214183685853327)
- **harvest aspect tier upgrades**: Harvest aspect does not gain experience while an available tier upgrade remains unpurchased, so each level must be upgraded as soon as it is available. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553121253693460606)
- **harvest xp rate for pure harvesters at t15**: A pure harvester at T15 Harvest aspect receives 100% of Harvest XP for harvesting. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525963378345119906)
- **healer codex point gain**: Codex points are gained by killing monsters, not by healing or using bandages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548203429011390464)
- **healing potion cooldown and codex points**: The healing potion cooldown changes with potion codex points, so a custom cooldown bar must be recalculated after adding codex points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521496891555315835)
- **healing while hidden**: The Codex or the Stealth skill provides a heal while you walk hidden, and the healing codex also grants a backstabber perks beyond bandaging. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541904655775305789)
- **health bar collector layer settings**: There are no layer settings within health bar collectors. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523448976588800062)
- **health bar collectors**: To auto-open enemy health bars, go to Options > General > Healthbars and set up a health bar collector by drag-selecting; it can be configured for enemy type, placement, open distance and auto-close on leaving range, but it cannot filter by whether the enemy is attacking you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555577395082174505)
- **hidden damage resistance on tough mobs**: Since the August 11th patch, tougher mobs have a hidden damage resistance based on mob difficulty, so reaching the 10k damage cap without Item ID or vanquishing weapons no longer reliably one-shots 10k mobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555339957030363137)
- **hide guild tag option**: The option to hide your guild tag is on page 2 of the Overview. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541898626442334228)
- **hiding corpse nameplates**: To hide corpse nameplates, untick 'always active' for nameplates or choose mobiles-only in the nameplate options; right-clicking a nameplate closes it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495338507804774)
- **hiding plate helm in paperdoll**: You can keep a plate helm equipped and hide it in the paperdoll, but the in-game sprite still looks blobby because the hide option only affects your own view. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526324089822773289)
- **highlighting corpses with nameplates**: To highlight corpses around you, use the nameplate menu (Shift+Ctrl); the nameplate options can also be bound to hotkeys in Options under nameplates. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535533444958785596)
- **hiking without repeated campfires**: While the reusable camping item is active, you do not need to keep starting campfires in order to hike. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527325272439783677)
- **hit chance calculation**: Chance to hit is determined by the attacker's weapon skill versus the defender's weapon or wrestling skill, so weapon skill affects both your chance to hit and your chance to be hit. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529236087484977313)
- **hit points, stamina and mana in echoes**: Hit points, stamina and mana stats are included in Echoes and change with them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535268929214349395)
- **holy symbols of chivalry accumulation**: There is no way to accumulate holy symbols of chivalry faster other than using the Holy aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539195434558558268)
- **hued item drop locations**: Cloth-hued items like the lantern can drop anywhere at random, while regionally hued ones such as the Aegis Keep lantern drop only in their corresponding regions, and these items drop blessed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553595109323575397)
- **in-game macros and keybinds per character**: In-game macros and keybinds are stored per character, so each new character starts with its own separate macros and keybinds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528693540517838959)
- **in-game messaging options**: The game has no typical direct message system, but offers a whisper filter in chat plus guild, alliance and party chat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526107593146241104)
- **increased gold weekly dungeon mastery xp**: The weekly dungeon with increased gold drops does not grant extra mastery chain XP despite the higher gold. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534411074022150245)
- **info bar criminal status for stealing**: The info bar criminal entry does not show victim-specific criminality from stealing; it only shows proper criminal status, such as from looting a blue corpse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538587268779085855)
- **inn room resurrection**: Entering your inn rental room resurrects you, but only characters on the same account as the renter. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525807603370688603)
- **inscription and satchel scroll rolls**: The Inscription skill roll and the Wizard's Satchel roll to avoid consuming a scroll are separate rolls, not added together. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524562145100959825)
- **item stat display**: Numerical item stats are not shown on items in game because item stats have no RNG, so players look up the modifiers and calculate or equip the item to see what changes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535723499115782365)
- **junk links**: A link not among the 5-6 used by top templates is normally considered junk and is usually reforged. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526950572761026701)
- **lantern effects with two-handed weapons**: Holding a lantern with a two-handed weapon carries no penalty, and the different lantern types give no bonuses or penalties because they are cosmetic. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595198719496192)
- **lasttarget stealing nerf**: A nerf to LastTarget for Stealing is planned for the next patch and has not yet been applied, so it works as before until that patch lands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539684721187885166)
- **leveling lightning aspect**: Leveling the Lightning aspect, for example on a weapon or on a bard or tamer, is a good way to get through the early aspect levels faster. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555983647218077857)
- **leveling multiple codices simultaneously**: Leveling two codices at the same time yields the same total XP as leveling them one at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540029328505446481)
- **leveling the void aspect**: Putting the Void aspect on a weapon is a solid choice for most builds when the goal is to level it, and it has been leveled on a dexxer (0-10) and a stickmage (10-14). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554552027806179452)
- **lightning aspect proc**: The Lightning aspect is RNG-based, with a low proc chance until higher levels (around tier 11+), and its proc is an extra ~2k damage and sometimes a 3 second stun. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532373281183764721)
- **lightning aspect scaling**: The Lightning aspect scales non-linearly, so it feels weak at low tiers but each level becomes a noticeable improvement at higher tiers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-20–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553802792853053471)
- **link bonus stacking types**: In Outlands, the Spell Damage link bonus is additive, while the Damage by Player link bonus is multiplicative. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533747357328478259)
- **link cap per type and redline points**: Without redline points only 10 links of the same type can be active at once; with full redline points this rises to 15 links of a type. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537316951439839302)
- **link conversion choice**: When offered a link conversion, you may keep the old link or convert to the new one; both work and the old type is not always worse. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524821399246475428)
- **link progression across characters**: PvM and PvP are best played on separate templates, and separate characters share link progression. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536618188748357713)
- **loading arcane essence**: To load arcane essence into the aspect, double-click the essence and target yourself to eat it; it is then consumed as you play. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533238392077287715)
- **locating abandoned pets via animal wrangler**: Pets that were abandoned and cannot be retrieved through the stables can be located by visiting an Animal Wrangler, such as the one at the Prevalia stables. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520621736104693830)
- **lock rename follower setting**: With Options > General > Mobiles > Lock Rename Follower enabled, you must Ctrl+Alt+click a follower's nameplate to rename it, and normal renaming is blocked; disable the setting to rename normally. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538585520316358686)
- **locked box theft protection**: A locked box with an item left inside it cannot be stolen from by thieves, making it a viable theft protection, though setup is not trivial. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535077078825963692)
- **logging out with pets at an inn**: You can log out with your pets in your inn room and they log out with you, so stabling is not required. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554136722785304581)
- **looting object delay**: Looting is limited by an object delay of roughly 500 ms, so items can only be looted one at a time at about that rate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527676133842092113)
- **looting your own corpse while hidden**: You can loot your own corpse while hidden or invisible (via the Hiding skill or Invisibility spell), but looting any other corpse reveals you. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534565609000669306)
- **madness bow definition**: A madness bow is simply a bow with the madness aspect applied; madness is an aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556006041660035114)
- **magic trap spell**: A mage can use the Magic Trap spell to trap or retrap pouches, and targeting yourself automatically retraps your pouches. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521219652733243573)
- **main server wipes**: The main server is never wiped, though on very rare occasions it has been rolled back to the last save. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523343777023004753)
- **master hunter kills in sanctuary areas**: Monsters killed in sanctuary areas, except possibly the weekly core dungeon, do not count toward Master Hunter society kill quests. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530288548199137400)
- **mastery chain binding and trading**: A mastery chain cannot be traded, sold, or used by anyone else once it is bound to a character; it stays with that character permanently and the links on it hold the value. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541414480875884574)
- **mastery chain link activation**: A newly equipped or activated mastery chain takes about 30 seconds before its links activate and show above 0%, and once active the links work even when they are only in your bag and not worn. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656928460836945)
- **mastery chain link limit**: A mastery chain is limited to 10 links, and only 10 links of the same type are allowed, except rare loot chance links which can stack to 20 by default. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526455431348879451)
- **mastery chain type**: The type of mastery chain you buy is purely cosmetic, and all chains function the same. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548410070897926218)
- **mastery chain xp scope**: Account XP is shown when opening a mastery chain, and it is shared across characters on a single game account, not across all accounts linked to the same Outlands ID. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543965538970116127)
- **mastery chains and links**: You can have multiple Mastery Chains with different links, but there is no profile system for a single chain; to change a chain's setup you remove and add links, or move links from one chain to another. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534245798588448909)
- **mastery link leveling cost**: Mastery links are expensive and require continuous spending to level, making them a long-term farm. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535428363466969198)
- **mastery links for thief stealth**: Mastery links can add stealth steps for a thief, making stealth faster, but they are not required to start. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526569383407653049)
- **maximum aspect tier**: Aspects go up to tier 15, possibly tier 20 with redline points, but levels beyond 15 are very expensive in aspect triumphs and unnecessary for some aspects. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554501672124944405)
- **maximum render distance**: The maximum distance at which objects are rendered cannot be changed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525484763312291912)
- **melee aspect effect chance**: Melee Aspect Effect chance determines how often an Aspect Special Effect triggers on attacks. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521280948644089997)
- **melee damage classification**: All combat skills except magery count as melee, but trap damage does not; damage shown as red in the log is melee. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528514903055400980)
- **melee damage links**: Melee damage links stack additively rather than multiplicatively, unlike some other links such as damage-to-bleed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529428120564924418)
- **meta aspect build requirements**: Meta aspect builds generally require 30 links on the mastery chain and high-tier aspects, sometimes lots of resources and an expensive kit, plus knowledge of mob mechanics and dungeons; until 30 links, almost every build is viable. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544488043929665596)
- **mind rot disease scaling**: On live Outlands, Mind Rot only buffs new spell-based diseases and does not scale all diseases; the broader scaling exists only on the test center patch. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532190292264878162)
- **monster hidden damage reduction**: All monsters now have hidden damage reduction that scales with difficulty rating. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537386248233291786)
- **monster resist reduction minimum**: Monster magic resist cannot drop below its stat-sheet minimum (normally 0), and further resist reduction beyond that is converted into supplemental damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529138636635902173)
- **mount breeding for hued mounts**: Breeding mounts is the way to obtain rare and highly valued hued mounts. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533874793504309349)
- **mount token creation from blood courser**: Mount tokens can be created only from breedable mounts, not from a transferred Blood Courser. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537860940844896396)
- **moving the spellcast bar**: To move the spellcast bar, open Options -> Interface, uncheck 'lock spellcast bar' in the spellcast bar section, drag the bar to the desired spot, then re-lock it; a button in that section also brings it back onto the screen. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553519298541133905)
- **moving through players and monsters**: You cannot move through people or monsters unless you have full stamina. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523049669045915709)
- **multi codex**: A character can have multiple codex, and a multi codex gives a codex for each skill that can use one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547676722059546795)
- **multi-account household approval**: A Multi-Account Household (MAH) approval is still required when playing from different devices on the same network. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553478535790993531)
- **multi-account login limit**: You can have multiple characters logged in at once, but only one character per account (e.g. 3 characters across 3 accounts). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553393826368847883)
- **multi-account pvm and dungeon limits**: Playing PvM on all three accounts at once is allowed, but characters cannot share chain (link) progress, and only one account/character can be in a dungeon or engaged in PvP at a time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548508633866833942)
- **multiple accounts on one ship**: Multiple accounts can be on one ship, but only the ship owner can steer or act. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521626718400675920)
- **multiplicative damage modifiers**: Many damage sources in Outlands are multiplicative, including Tactics, DDBP, 'damage dealt to' links, Chivalry gate, Madness armor, Artisan buff, Void, King's Faire buff, Cartography, Temporal armor, Discordance and Bard buffs, and the full list is more than double the commonly cited one. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542310033390567546)
- **murder reporting and killing AFK players**: Reporting someone for murder gives them a murder count, and killing AFK players carries no other penalty besides the scorn of law-abiding players, who will count you when they return. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542484854669578280)
- **murder reports for attacking grey players**: If you attack a grey-named player and they kill you, no murder report is generated. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543380833153323109)
- **nameplate filter gump hotkey**: Pressing Ctrl+Shift (the default hotkey) brings back the floating nameplate filter gump used to filter nameplates (e.g. mobiles only, PvM default, PvP default). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544498631003086941)
- **nameplate interrupting dungeon chest clicks**: If an item nameplate such as 'rock' interrupts you when clicking a dungeon chest, switch to a nameplate filter that includes items and double-click the chest's nameplate, or increase nameplate transparency. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551978764475301891)
- **nameplate removal**: A nameplate is normally removed by right-clicking it, and a game setting may allow alt-click removal instead, though its exact location is unconfirmed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525265510177046549)
- **nameplates hotkey**: Holding ctrl+shift brings up nameplates, though players are not fully certain of this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495594226257921)
- **naming pack horses and deep crawlers**: Pack horses cannot be named, while deep crawlers are normal pets that can be named, though a name already used by another player's pet is rejected. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546279717911666798)
- **nearby npcs and players vs theft**: Nearby NPCs and players make stealing harder: each human NPC within 8 tiles raises the thief's notice chance by 5% (2.5% without line of sight), and nearby players lower the success chance and raise the chance the thief is flagged, so standing near others reduces theft risk. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143671838867628)
- **obtaining emotes**: Emotes are obtained by spending Achievement points on Emote Deeds, each of which unlocks one random emote, or by buying deeds from other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537742232273027182)
- **ocean redline cost per level**: Ocean redline cost per level is now believed to be about 500k, up from roughly 200k earlier, versus 1 mil per level in the wilderness. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898983600689323)
- **ogre kills in sanctuary and shelter dungeons for monster society**: Ogres killed in the permanent sanctuary dungeons and in the Shelter dungeon may not count toward the monster society ogre kill quest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529439698303455283)
- **old slayer links**: Old slayer links can be changed to any link type you like. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537778326653894806)
- **one character per dungeon or boat**: Only one character per player can be in a dungeon at a time, and the same restriction applies to doing anything on a boat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554367833490587840)
- **opening chest when mob died on it**: If a mob died on your chest and you cannot double click it to open it, press Shift+Ctrl to show the nameplates menu and select 'Items' to access the chest. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541876379401068664)
- **opening corpse loot behind walls**: To open the loot of a mobile corpse behind a non-transparent wall, hold Control and Shift and click the corpse's gump; if the gump is not clickable, turning on the 'all mobiles' setting made it clickable again. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545238905744527484)
- **outlands id accounts and logins**: An Outlands ID can hold up to 3 accounts, and you can log in only one character per account, so up to 3 characters at once, one from each account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552329796963270727)
- **pack for horse on mount tokens**: Pack for horse is not available on mount tokens. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548347362945138759)
- **pack llama bonding**: A pack llama cannot be ridden and cannot be bonded. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533077490216730906)
- **panacea in potion codex**: Panacea in the potion codex is generally worth maxing, though it is optional if there are no damage-over-time monsters where you fight, and it can be a lifesaver while the codex also provides reduced potion cooldowns and stronger or longer buffs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554996360258912370)
- **party ping wheel**: Alt-click opens a party ping wheel; configure it under Options > General > Party Pings, and changing its key to one you never use effectively disables it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554582929936744479)
- **perk reset time**: Dungeon and town perks change at midnight UTC+0, the same time societies reset. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525133897552101579)
- **pet bonding**: To bond a pet, fight alongside it against low-level monsters (usually 3-5) while keeping it healed until it reaches level 1, which requires minimum Taming skill to give aggressive commands; if it dies before bonding it is lost, and a bonded pet can also be obtained by trade. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546869269202210888)
- **pet bonding at broker**: Pets sold at the broker at level 1 and above are bonded, and unbonded animals bond once leveled; only the stable master's cheaper animals are not bonded. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533045736508493844)
- **pet bonding level requirement**: A pet bonds once it reaches level 1, so a purchased pet should be at least level 1 to be bonded. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-22–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555780663448178779)
- **pet death and bonding**: An unbonded pet that dies is lost permanently, while a bonded pet (bonding happens when the pet reaches level 1) becomes a ghost that follows you and can be resurrected by a healer or player. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545005994718011484)
- **pet health bar placement**: To place pet health bars on screen, hold Alt and left-click drag a box around the pets (default hotkey) to grab their bars, then drag them where you want them; a separate collector can be used for bars that only pop up during combat. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-05–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525135967806034100)
- **pet stacking while following**: Multiple following pets occupy the same tile and appear stacked as one, and may scatter in different directions if the player says 'all move'. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538321096246304869)
- **pet weight carrying ability**: The ability of certain pets to carry weight has been removed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538847214129127454)
- **point-limited codex passives**: Point-limited codices have all invested bonuses active at once as passive bonuses, and the bard codex has no stances. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547618329538203718)
- **poison and disease indicators**: When actually poisoned the avatar turns green and a health bar toggle beneath the feet can highlight poison, while disease is signaled by a fly sound effect and is not highlighted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535887956751941743)
- **poison links after upcoming patch**: Poison damage links were buffed in the upcoming patch; on the test server flat poison links are considered poor, and multiplicative links no longer outperform other options except for tamers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536558764017197136)
- **poison necromancer mastery chain**: The first mastery chain links to unlock for the poison necromancer template are Poison Damage, and a character at poison aspect tier 13 already has a mastery chain and only needs to obtain a chain to see it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544385543889231953)
- **poison resist ignore sources**: Poison resist ignore comes from the codex in addition to the poison resist ignore links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521976482073804840)
- **poison tick overhead display setting**: A setting lets you see poison ticks overhead instead of as system messages. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534428351996100710)
- **potion duration when drunk before pvp flag**: Potions drunk before becoming PvP flagged retain their codex-extended duration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475427291201567)
- **potion satchel counter reset**: After changing maps, potion counts in the counter bars for the potion satchel can reset to zero and the drink hotkey stops working until the satchel is reopened; it is believed to be a bug, though possibly not unintentional. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552790467622604881)
- **prevalia test shard item spawning statues**: On the Outlands test shard, the Prevalia town center has statues, clothing racks and storage shelves for spawning items, and the green (possibly yellow) player statue spawns items such as shepherd's crooks with modifiers, a chain and all tomes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-09–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824280129147016)
- **prevent bandage override setting location**: The prevent bandage override setting is an in-game Outlands command found in the [commands list, not a setting in the Razor client. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547438173338992680)
- **protecting purchases from thieves**: To protect purchased items from thieves, put them into a trapped pouch (ideally nested) while hidden or invisible, run a screen away, then recall. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534573923726004356)
- **protection spell tooltip accuracy**: The in-game spellbook tooltips for the Protection spell are incorrect and should be ignored; the wiki description, which says it increases armor rating, is accurate. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555412373538472058)
- **purchasing customizations**: Customizations are purchased through the customizations command or the in-game help menu and can be paid for in doubloons. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527377217544388752)
- **pvm powerup systems in pvp**: Outlands has four PvM powerup systems (codexes, aspects, chain links and redline), and none of them take effect against players in PvP. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540017770408710237)
- **pvp and loot rules**: Outlands is open-world PvP with mostly full loot everywhere except Shelter Island and certain Sanctuary dungeons; a handful of progression items and some clothing are blessed and cannot be taken, but weapons cannot be blessed and several armor slots have no blessed option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545192816022528050)
- **quest horse resurrection**: If a quest horse cannot be ridden after you die, bring it to a healer to be resurrected. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535748775883047093)
- **quest progress in sanctuaries**: Quests, including weekly quests, do not count progress while you are in sanctuary locations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381499072286792)
- **quick logout via dungeon campfire**: Quick logout by camping with a secure campfire in a dungeon is disabled because it would be abused in contested bosses. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523677848072749218)
- **ranged damage progression**: Ranged damage increases come from progression systems: Codex and Aspect leveling first, then the mastery chain, and much later redline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553752364123553853)
- **reason for auto loot and pathfinding restrictions**: Auto loot and auto pathfinding are restricted because the economy is tightly managed, looting becomes limited and narrow in the mid and late game, and these features would also enable AFK play. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529281745466163260)
- **reason for mah harvesting lock**: MAH accounts are locked from harvesting because the potential for abuse, such as multi-boxing harvesters, is considered too high. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537959975442186392)
- **recall mana usage**: Recall always consumes mana, even when cast via charges, because it is still a spell cast; charges only substitute for the Magery skill requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528711072448516210)
- **recovering lost pets**: To recover lost pets, use the normal stablemaster's 'more options' then 'retrieve lost followers' (not the Animal Wrangler); if you are too close, go to another town. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524147385452724255)
- **recycling junk items for arcane essence**: Junk magic items, including those from easier dungeons, can be recycled into arcane essence, which fuels Aspects, one of Outlands' biggest progression systems. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534990920813117695)
- **recycling unidentified items**: Unidentified items are magic loot items that can be recycled for materials and Arcane Essence, which is essence for your aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-12–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550655190603141174)
- **red hand grey hand swap cooldown**: There is a 24-hour cooldown on swapping between Red Hand and Grey Hand status. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **red hand region restrictions on death**: Region restrictions on death now apply to Red Hand members of the Thieves Guild, in the same way they apply to murderers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550991244384272509)
- **red hand status**: Red Hand (Thieves Guild) status depends on Thieves Guild membership rather than skills, and it is character-wide rather than bound to an echo, so echoes may not reliably show it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539512433998037052)
- **red line link type stacking**: With the Red Line upgrade allowing more than 10 links of the same type, multiple link types can be used at the higher count, such as 15 Follow Damage links plus 15 Follow Attack Speed links. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536533627083559003)
- **red wall collision highlight toggle**: To toggle the red highlight that shows wall collision, change the setting in the transparency options. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549051403652300880)
- **redline points and farming rate**: Each 2 redline points up to 10 significantly improves farming rate, while points beyond 10 give only minor gains. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532374634337534163)
- **redline points and link configurations**: With 10 redline points a player can use a 15/15 or 15/10/5 link configuration. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532413625745281135)
- **redline progression**: Redline is the ultra late-game progression system that lets players exceed existing caps, such as mastery chain links and aspect levels, and casual players are unlikely to reach it for years. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546756730665439303)
- **redline system age**: The Redline system has existed for over two years. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521941367318642888)
- **redline unlock requirements**: Redline unlocks by reaching 30 unlocked Mastery Chain links (100% Redline scalar) or by getting 3 different aspects to T15, each T15 giving 33% scalar, reaching 100% after the third. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529815919143030904)
- **regional gold bonus and experience**: The regional bonus for extra gold in an increased gold dungeon applies after experience is determined, so the extra gold does not add to experience, including mugging exp. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546639779658211398)
- **registering antiquities**: To register an item marked Unregistered as an antiquity, use an Antiquity Manifest on it, which puts your name in its description and gives credit toward achievements. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533347592568569976)
- **released creatures**: Released creatures do not attack their former owner. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532536010506764439)
- **released pets behavior**: Released pets can walk around and may wander out of range, and pets left in busy areas are often interfered with by other players. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523696320131629127)
- **releasing a follower via context menu**: Single-click a follower to open its context menu and choose release; this is the default behavior, though it can be harder because followers stack. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546681113899171920)
- **removing links from a chain**: Removing links from a chain does not destroy them, so they can be reused. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532487580195487754)
- **removing pages from lore books**: Pages cannot be taken back out of lore books from research materials once they have been added. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535046892088725525)
- **removing paperdoll backpack dye**: To remove the dye on a paperdoll backpack, use a Wig Stand, which lets you swap to any hue you have unlocked. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536101484196794480)
- **repair benches**: Double-click a repair bench to repair your equipment; public benches are free and are often near moongates such as Outpost, and some houses or shops have benches that repair everything you wear or carry. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552298929901674528)
- **resource map delay design intent**: The resource map system's delays are intended to offset faster resource lookup, so casual mappers cannot gather as fast as optimized mappers and flood the server with resources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534347706775109834)
- **resource map sorting**: After the resource map update, sorting maps is removed and existing sorted maps become unsorted, so players no longer need sorting or the exploreoutlands website to find where to go. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534788223870439557)
- **resource maps and mining leaderboard**: Ore gathered from resource maps counts toward a player's lifetime mining leaderboard score, and resource maps let players gather ore much faster (reportedly about 10x) than other maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525897076439912609)
- **resource maps on gathering leaderboard**: Resource maps currently count toward the gathering leaderboard. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529892472355033148)
- **restoring a closed gump**: To bring back an accidentally closed gump, press Ctrl+Shift. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552717339596685394)
- **restoring a missing nameplate bar**: If the nameplate bar is missing, go to options > window manager to reset its default position, and check whether a filter is active in the Ctrl+Shift menu; this may not fix every case. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528693067534565416)
- **restoring stamina when blocked**: When stamina-blocked from moving through people or monsters, drink a refresh (red) potion to restore stamina. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523049669045915709)
- **restoring the selection box**: Hold Ctrl and Shift to bring back the selection box used to pick what is displayed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532587411673190615)
- **resurrecting a dead pet**: To resurrect a dead pet, either have its ghost follow you to a healer who will resurrect it, or stable it and take it back out. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533258237623668767)
- **resurrecting after dying in inn room**: If you die in your inn room, double-click the inn door to exit to town, then re-enter the inn room and you will resurrect automatically. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541358886760480819)
- **reveal immunity from picking**: Picking resources and dungeon or treasure chests grants Reveal Immunity, which protects the player from being revealed and killed while doing so. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552248231209996392)
- **rope teleport max range setting**: There is currently no setting to make the rope/teleport use its max range when the cursor is beyond range, though a later update is reportedly planned to add this. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553185753557762061)
- **running 15 links instead of 10**: Running 15 of the same link instead of 10 is done with redline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543744454941483050)
- **sacred journey buff eligibility**: The Chivalry Sacred Journey buff applies only if you cast the gate yourself or the caster stays with you; a gate cast by another character that does not stay with you does not give the bonus. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555655774498463938)
- **sacred journey cooldown from yellow gates**: Passing through any yellow gate, not necessarily your own, within the past half hour triggers a Sacred Journey cooldown, even if you cannot cast Sacred Journey. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539126979096215602)
- **sanctuary area looting rules**: In a Sanctuary area such as Aegis Keep, players cannot be stolen from or perform criminal actions, so nobody can loot a blue corpse, though gray bones can be looted. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528079697605431317)
- **sanctuary criminal protection**: Sanctuary protection against criminal actions applies only inside sanctuary dungeons, not outside them, such as the courtyard outside Urukton. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545196288792862783)
- **saving gump positions**: To save gump positions, arrange the gumps, open Options > Gump Manager, hold Ctrl+Alt to show red pins on pinnable gumps, click a pin, click get current position, then click remember ui window positions; not every gump can be pinned, and hovering the ? in the bottom right shows instructions. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550242067656089691)
- **saving spell icon positions**: If spell icon positions are not saved between logins, run the game as administrator and log out with the logout button in the Paperdoll so the profile is written. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546256529924034662)
- **scroll consumption at high inscription**: Scrolls can still be consumed at 125 Inscription, usually because the player is PvP flagged or forgot to use the aspect/chain. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524541138025971762)
- **sealed paragon chest theft**: A sealed paragon chest counts as a single item, so a thief can steal it as a whole. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549141446521651323)
- **self-targeting when hidden behind objects**: If your character is hidden behind an object such as a totem pole, targeting yourself can fail; move away from the object or target your health bar or nameplate instead. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538426690408022017)
- **server crash rollback**: A server crash rolls players back to an earlier state. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537190274953121923)
- **setting grab bag for grid loot**: To loot corpses into a specific bag in ClassicUO, enable grid loot under Options > General and use the SetGrabBag macro command (Options > Macros) to set the bag. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531101481653112932)
- **shelter island society quest progress**: Society crafting and monster hunting quest progress does not count when done on Shelter Island, though artisan progress can still be earned there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533848566370406432)
- **shepherd's crook color herding bonus**: Rarer crook colors give a bigger Herding bonus, but the difference is small: plain to Avarwood is only about 4% total. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543019413370830889)
- **ship crew and command aspect**: Ship crew do not count as followers for the Command aspect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541971695840002068)
- **shipping crate from ship hold**: At an NPC dock master (via the boat menu), click the shipping crate button before clicking dock ship to send everything in the ship's hold in a crate to the center of your inn room or to your house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-23–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542249095010193438)
- **single account for pvm**: All PvM should be done on a single account because it becomes important later on. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529607675439087638)
- **skill and stat changes**: All skills and stats on a character can be changed, so training the wrong skills does not ruin a character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522356939902816410)
- **skill locks when switching builds**: Switching builds (echoes) locks all skills, so skills set to up or down arrows must be re-adjusted or unlocked after switching back, which takes an extra 5-10 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550465599111565333)
- **skills and king's faire games**: Character skills do not affect the outcome of the King's Faire games. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540816719055028338)
- **social features lfg and friend system**: Outlands has no looking-for-group (LFG) system and no in-game friend system. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526603366447317163)
- **societies reward points**: Societies reward points that can be spent on items such as gold links, and 120 Scribe is useful for doing scribe societies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552894638501793823)
- **society crafted item turn-ins**: Items crafted for the Societies vanish instantly when turned in. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533042313935327302)
- **society job limit**: By default you can accept only 10 society jobs per account at a time, and this limit applies at the beginning. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532787980601921566)
