- **society job points tracking**: Society jobs and their points are tracked per account, so each account has its own batch of points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545404266615930970)
- **society job weekly reset**: Society jobs reset weekly on the weekend, which wipes any progress on current jobs. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538073611548626964)
- **special loot chance and mugging**: Special and rare loot chance bonuses apply to items obtained through mugging. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539971678887608330)
- **speech color and title color**: Changing your speech color in options under speech also changes the color of your in-game title, including your guild title. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547247713811308604)
- **spell hue settings menu**: Open Help -> Customizations -> Spell hues to view and cycle spell hue settings, including which spells they apply to and which hues you own. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524787007858151484)
- **spellbook aspect procs**: An aspect applied to a spellbook has a chance to proc as an Aspect Special when offensive spells are cast on a mob, governed by spell aspect special chance, while charged spells are a separate mechanic similar to critical hits. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545887432661008497)
- **spellbook durability spell damage penalty**: Magic and Material Spellbooks suffer scaling durability penalties to Spell Damage similar to weapons, up to a maximum of -5%, viewable on the Spells page of the Stats menu, and repairing the book restores its full durability. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531620247121956865)
- **spellbook equip requirement**: Material and magic spellbooks do not hold spells, and the spellbook that holds your spells has no effect when equipped; you only need to carry it in your inventory. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532443944602964060)
- **spellbook loss on death**: You do not lose your spellbook when you die. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549625486500696106)
- **spellbook quality and summons**: The quality of a worn spellbook has no impact on summoned creatures. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523799628229640307)
- **stats accuracy baseline**: In-game [stats accuracy is calculated against a creature with 100 wrestling, but many monsters now have more than 100 wrestling, so it overstates actual hit chance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529609846926606388)
- **stats command reliability**: The [stats window is outdated and unreliable for bonuses and armor values, and is trustworthy only for durability, so use the character status window and the Outlands Butler for accurate values. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545891223871430706)
- **stats gump for equipment durability**: The [stats gump can be used to keep track of the durability of equipped gear, and that is its main use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544102794343219300)
- **stats page reliability**: The stats page is unreliable for actual numbers of ability effects such as Spinslash; its most accurate values are caps like mana refund and swing speed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525623315757007100)
- **strangelands scoreboard points**: The Strangelands scoreboard shows how many points players earned, and in one observed run the top player earned only about 15 points. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531642226747117588)
- **strongbox customization scope**: Strongbox and other customizations are account-wide, tied to the individual account rather than the Outlands ID, so the gold weight reduction applies to one account and not all three under an Outlands ID. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-14–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552468416043028626)
- **summon creature scroll control slots**: Pets from the Summon Creature scroll each take 1 control slot. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538122060298059777)
- **swing speed cap shortfall damage loss**: Falling short of the swing speed cap means swinging less often and dealing less damage, but being 1% below the cap costs only about 0.667% damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524578128893182012)
- **swing speed increase cap**: The 50% swing speed increase cap is easy to reach with lightning aspect, and exceeding it is only possible with air aspect (redline may allow reaching the cap without air). _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549508113583964182)
- **tabula rasa server reset**: Tabula Rasa is the Friday server reset, which is also when faction silver is distributed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538520084090327122)
- **taming bestiary bonuses**: The Taming Bestiary (taming codex) gives passive bonuses to pets of the matching class, including damage boosts and self healing, and is very important for Tamers. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532817694330454036)
- **teleport casting unequips weapon**: Teleporting (casting) causes your equipped weapon to unequip. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538412212321001523)
- **temporal aspect strength**: The Temporal aspect has nothing to do with speed and is considered weak, and it is mainly leveled on weapons because it is cheap. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521589329414197279)
- **temporal aspect usefulness**: The Temporal aspect is considered to have no practical use case because it only affects the user and has downtime, and players say it needs a rework. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552723986473816075)
- **test server purpose**: The test server is a snapshot of live taken at a certain point in time, used to try out changes before they are committed to the live server. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539279790580830310)
- **thanatite shard quest**: Ten Thanatite shards can be turned in for a quest that rewards a thanatite ore chunk, which reduces healing on time dungeon bosses when you are near them; the quest is part of the end-game time dungeon content and can be restarted at any time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538389723377041502)
- **theft history check**: To see what was stolen from you, go to a Thief NPC and choose the 'Theft History' option, which costs 1000 gold each time you have new thefts to check. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551595907114336257)
- **thief codex tactics line effect**: Spending 5 points in the thief codex line lets you remove 100 Tactics from your skills while the game acts as if you still have it; it does not double Tactics. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552763627151429754)
- **thief notice chance**: Each non-friendly player within 8 tiles of a thief, meaning not in the thief's guild, raises the chance of being noticed by 10%, or by 5% if the player lacks line of sight to the thief. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555312858948964383)
- **thief retaliation rules**: If a thief steals from you and you attack the thief, the thief can kill you without penalty. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535255298527334482)
- **thieves codex point thresholds**: Thieves Codex abilities unlock at 1, 3 and 5 points spent, and each skill can be raised only to 5 points after an update that made maxing easier. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543912333011582976)
- **tier 15 aspects and bleed chance**: Once a player has tier 15 blood, arcane or lightning aspect, they can drop skills for others they could not otherwise run, but at tier 15 Blood the bleed chance is only 36%, so the first 2 or 3 spells will probably not benefit from the bonus damage to bleeding creatures. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528781161180958752)
- **tier upgrades above t15**: Tiers above T15 cannot be gained through normal XP; they require redline points and a purchase, costing 15 redline for T16, 30 for T17, 45 for T18, 60 for T19, and 75 for T20. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522791203454849146)
- **toggling lanterns inside containers**: To toggle lanterns on and off while they are inside a container, uncheck the 'double click to loot items inside containers' option. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088222144135238)
- **total stat cap**: The total stat cap is 225 points, though this comes from player claims rather than official sources. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554375776407658527)
- **town guards and thieves**: Town guards exist but do not fully protect against thieves, who are prevalent. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537043816501092503)
- **town thief suspicion system**: Towns use a 'suspicious' system for thieves in which guards only kill a thief when NPC witnesses are nearby and thieves only have a chance of being caught, so the best defense is hiding your items well. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533982109121908776)
- **tracking skill alerts**: Tracking skill determines both the success chance and the distance of detection alerts; it checks every 5 seconds, so lower skill still eventually gives alerts but later and from a shorter distance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528752942348369961)
- **trap damage on paragon chests and bomb boxes**: Failing to remove a trap on a paragon chest, or opening a bomb box, can kill a character, including one standing inside their inn room. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546250621240221823)
- **trapped pouch**: A trapped pouch can be carried as an alert, because items placed in it warn you when a thief tries to look into it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549145149068812379)
- **trapped pouch damage**: A trapped pouch deals only 1 damage to whoever opens it, including the person who trapped it, so it works mostly as a warning, whereas a trapped box made by a high-level tinker can kill a thief. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542898725880594432)
- **trapped pouch decoys**: Loading trapped pouches with worthless items is a common tactic used to deter thieves. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555626498839412807)
- **treasure map decoding**: Under the new treasure map changes, a single character must complete the whole decoding process and cannot hand it off to another character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549792027544256624)
- **treasure map digging requirement**: Following the August 11, 2026 patch changes, only a character with Cartography can dig up treasure maps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549183059285254355)
- **treasure map spots near witcher's tome locations**: Treasure map spots are still found around Witcher's Tome locations, though some are deeper inside certain areas; near a point of interest the spot is usually inside the tower or house. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538231213125279756)
- **turning off aspect hue**: To turn off aspect hue on equipment pieces that already show the aspect color, reactivate aspect on those pieces; closing and reopening the paperdoll may also refresh the display. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553411126820077650)
- **two characters in a dungeon rule**: Players are not allowed to have two characters in a dungeon at the same time. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531728373515026563)
- **unblessing clothing bless deed**: Unblessing a blessed item does not return a clothing bless deed. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525488190452924549)
- **unbonded pet death**: An unbonded pet that dies is lost permanently. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555953726123016342)
- **undermountain wilderness status**: Undermountain is subject to wilderness modifiers and counts toward the Wilderness society; it is not a permanent Sanctuary dungeon. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541389695353626725)
- **unlocking an aspect**: To unlock an aspect, double-click the aspect starter bundle to open the aspect menu, use the arrows to find the desired aspect, and click unlock. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529638350812741823)
- **unlocking echoes with society points**: Echoes can also be unlocked using society points earned through societies. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523750316674384043)
- **upgrading ship crew**: It is fine to start with expert-level crew members and upgrade to more advanced ones later. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540351829504823307)
- **usescrolls toggle check**: If scrolls are being consumed unexpectedly, check that the [usescrolls command toggle is enabled, since the scroll-use feature depends on it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524534968452255835)
- **vendor horse bonding**: A level 1 horse bought from a vendor is already bonded, and an unbonded horse cannot be leveled up. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533188695887446168)
- **void aspect regeneration**: The void armor aspect regenerates health and mana, reportedly about 30 HP every 20 seconds and mana every 60 seconds. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540761221681381537)
- **war mode hotkeys**: The default war mode hotkey is TAB, and alternatives such as Alt+Tab, Ctrl+Tab, Shift+Tab, or mouse wheel up can also be used. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538064087261388800)
- **weapon codex stacking**: Only the codex of the currently equipped weapon applies, so you cannot benefit from two weapon codices at once, though you can own several codices for different skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522804411741638678)
- **weapon codex unlocks**: A weapon codex can be fully completed to unlock everything, and unlocked upgrades stay permanently unlocked for all codexes of the same weapon type even when not carried; other codexes use 20 points that can be reset. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551008359426035713)
- **weapon/parry codex gump persistence**: Not every gump has a Stay option, and the weapon/parry codex gump does not reopen automatically after a client restart. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544818410112819230)
- **weekly bonus locations**: Weekly bonus locations are chosen randomly. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522185512402681866)
- **weekly pit trial limit**: Pit trials are limited to 7 per week. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548038731536269455)
- **weekly sanctuary dungeon buff**: Each week certain dungeons receive a buff; the weekly Sanctuary Dungeon grants reduced xp and gold (reported as about 33% less, i.e. 66% of normal, though one early claim said 25% less), but players cannot be PKed or stolen from there. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545330467119702106)
- **wizard codex skill requirement**: The Wizard Codex requires either Meditation or Evaluating Intelligence, not both, and most codices use a similar either/or skill requirement. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528138178181992509)
- **wizard grimoire access**: Having Magery and Meditation gives access to the Wizard's Grimoire, which can be used for better heals. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-01–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546760839661621248)
- **wizard's grimoire achievement progress**: Once a character has maxed the Wizard's Grimoire, the only way to earn further points toward the Wizard achievement is to master Wizard's Grimoires on new characters. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533410329848053851)
- **wizards grimoire codex**: The Wizards Grimoire is a codex like the Summoner's Tome, with upgrades capped at about 40 points versus 20 for other codices, and it adds conveniences such as mushrooms and increased offensive spell damage. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553583565617365126)
- **xp tracking per account**: XP is tracked per account, so players should do all PvM and chain XP progression on a single designated PvM account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528340002902376568)
- **yellow nameplate in dungeon flashpoint**: A yellow nameplate in a dungeon, such as on dungeon level 1 during the Dungeon Flashpoint PvP event, marks a participant in that event, similar to the Town Struggle event. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536528922483621948)
- **-info command**: The -info command is an alternate version of >info that shows a different, larger semi-transparent gump with somewhat different information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540900404278329475)
- **5-step restriction**: A 5-step restriction was introduced to stop instant spots and instant recalls, partly because of recall farmers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529897871766192209)
- **80 sp builds and upcoming patch**: The upcoming patch is not going to destroy 80 SP builds, according to a player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528507930901745824)
- **80 tri-bard self codex node levels**: For an 80 tri-bard build, only 2 levels are needed in the self-focused bard codex node once the aspect is around level 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543515942619971656)
- **[stats command reliability**: The [stats command is partially broken: about half of its values look odd and some listed attributes do not really exist, so its output should not be fully trusted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527387981881544755)
- **abandoning treasure map when unsafe**: When doing a treasure map, a player can stop the map and leave if the location is not safe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553343095201071195)
- **ability duration display**: Ability durations such as Skirmish cannot be displayed in game; hotbar buttons can trigger a cooldown timer on press, but it starts at button press rather than at the next swing, so it is imprecise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540685934683496618)
- **accessing character customizations**: Open the in-game HELP menu and choose CUSTOMIZATIONS to access character customizations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555988575474942063)
- **account name changes**: Account names cannot be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524198867069964368)
- **account xp from kills**: Killing monsters grants account-wide XP, not skill XP; training skills gives no XP, and the XP is spent to unlock mastery chain link slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526193612638126111)
- **account-tied progression scope**: Account-tied progression applies only to the PvM account and not to the other two accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531103702981673131)
- **account-wide customizations**: Customizations, such as society-related purchases, are account wide, so other crafters or characters on the same account share them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537911513686343690)
- **accuracy display location**: Your accuracy can be viewed in the Player's Stats menu, accessed from the Help menu at the top of the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539141856187781121)
- **accuracy overcap measurement on air build**: The accuracy overcap figure (2.4% on the referenced Air build) is measured against level 4 mobs on the butler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521579445826097183)
- **achievement announcements**: When a player completes an achievement, it is announced to the whole server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525845836918161510)
- **achievement point mount token**: A mount token received from achievement points is already a mount and does not need to be linked to a mount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539601227422236712)
- **achievement points exclusive rewards**: Achievement points are finite and best saved for exclusive rewards such as emote deeds and bear mounts, which are not obtainable any other way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528456463117193318)
- **achievement points versus society points**: Achievement points appear to be a separate system from Society points and may be spent on items such as emote deeds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537059520411344947)
- **achievement spam option**: The option to turn off achievement spam is likely found in the [achievements menu, via an options button at the bottom right. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528115105651364001)
- **achievement title unlocking**: Achievement titles such as Monster Hunter ranks are probably unlocked by completing the next achievement in that line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547686526861840455)
- **achievement types**: Outlands achievements are a mix of automatic and manual ones, and some harvesting achievements require very large amounts of work, such as chopping 1,000 logs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525846030384631962)
- **achievements gump refresh**: Gumps do not auto-update, so the achievements gump must be refreshed to show progress made while crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538773302015954984)
- **achievements scope**: Achievements are account-wide rather than per character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537281003524202597)
- **achievements trophies section**: The achievements window has a trophies section where you can see which trophies you have earned and choose to display them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543601052073594900)
- **activate echo swap**: Pressing Activate Echo swaps to the other echo loadout and stores the current one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550457501575553107)
- **activating a finisher**: Click the gem next to the finisher to turn it on; once enabled it triggers randomly during combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534994553076191292)
- **activating an aspect with essence**: To activate an aspect, move essence into the aspect menu by double-clicking the essence and targeting yourself or using the menu button; essence in your bag alone does not activate it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522776250869874688)
- **activating harvest on armor**: Attempt to activate Harvest on your armor; the game either activates it, tells you it is already active, or says you are not wearing a full set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538732266694385764)
- **active codices limit**: A character can have as many codices active as they meet the prerequisites for; most templates use 2-4. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527156628825178254)
- **active map limit per outlands id**: After the patch, each Outlands ID (account) is limited to one active map at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536936523956625500)
- **adding a new character to the guild**: To add a new character to the guild, click the character to add it, then @ an officer in guild chat to accept your other character (unconfirmed). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533078603388944536)
- **adding a resource to the counter**: To add a resource such as a log, board, ore or ingot to the counter, get its ID with the >info command and replace the leather graphic ID 4225 in an existing control line of mine.gumps.xml, adjusting the hue as needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **adding arcane essence to aspect**: Double-click the Arcane Essence and target your avatar, or click 'Add' in the Aspect menu and then target the Essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538419783333052426)
- **adding items to resource counter**: To add items manually to the resource counter, edit the mine.gumps.xml file in the ClassicUO Data\Profiles\<Account>\<Character> folder of the Ultima Online Outlands install directory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **adding scrolls to an open book**: Scrolls likely cannot be added to a spellbook while it is open, as with adding recall scrolls to an open runebook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546859116360769547)
- **additive and multiplicative bonuses**: Additive bonuses are summed into one percentage before hitting the target, while multiplicative bonuses bypass the additive pool and multiply the final output. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556092803556184165)
- **additive versus multiplicative damage equivalence**: For spellcasters, roughly 2-2.5% additive damage is equivalent to 1% multiplicative damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533747672719294465)
- **additive versus multiplier bonus stacking**: A 2% additive bonus and a 2% multiplier bonus each take 100 base damage to 102 on their own, and combining both gives 104.4; the benefit snowballs when multiple sources stack to 20-50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556085876956602369)
- **administrator dislike of map chaining**: Outlands administrators reportedly dislike map chaining, harvesting scripts, and wilderness multiboxing, and the resource map changes are speculated to address these. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529295129377116210)
- **adventure satchel blessed status**: Adventure satchels are blessed and enable use of the item counter bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544483969783959552)
- **adventurer society weekly pet jobs**: The Adventurer Society offers different 'use X pet' jobs each week that require using specific pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525543477956313089)
- **adventurers lodge society tame jobs**: For Adventurers Lodge Society jobs requiring a certain tame, one tame is enough, but more of that tame speeds progress, which is based on slots used like the zoology entries. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525245105345265676)
- **aegis slime party xp**: Killing a zombie with aegis slimes in the party grants 11 xp per slime slot (1 slime 11, 2 slimes 22, 5 slimes 55), regardless of whether the pet actually hits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524064511772852254)
- **afk activity rules**: In UO Outlands, AFK is acceptable for skill training, but activities that gain gold, resources, or XP should not be done AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547378168082464840)
- **afk client disconnect**: The client can disconnect after about 15 or more minutes of being AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544791794032578730)
- **afk fishing from houseboat tos status**: AFK fishing from a houseboat is not against the TOS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530653005488197844)
- **afk invisibility at public moongates**: Going AFK invisible at a public moongate is not safe, because you can be revealed and stolen from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523319522331852920)
- **afk macro rules**: On Outlands you cannot AFK macro resource gathering or XP gain in the additional progression systems, but you can AFK macro skill gain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526099357206839337)
- **agorawave aspect**: The Agorawave aspect is a new aspect that allows its user to cast field spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520889533477163019)
- **agorawave aspect switching delay**: Switching between the agorawave aspect and the fortune or harvest aspects reportedly requires a 60-second wait, making agorawave impractical for treasure mapping if you want to remain in fortune or harvest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544327945160626319)
- **air aspect defensive benefit**: The Air Aspect makes a character tankier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531328080340058276)
- **alchemy 80 mob targeting**: At 80 Alchemy, a targeted mob stays targeted and does not flag you when a player is nearby. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523776781847494818)
- **alchemy codex bard benefits**: The Alchemy codex reportedly gives a bard roughly 17.5% damage resistance plus bleed and disease immunity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524522243206545631)
- **alchemy codex cleanse**: The alchemy codex provides a 100% bleed/disease cleanse every 20 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541531333397053581)
- **alliance visibility of dead members**: Alliance members can see each other when dead as ghosts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525314603939004556)
- **allnames client macro**: Create a client macro using the AllNames command to display NPC professions and horse bonded status above names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525531858845175900)
- **allnames macro command**: The in-game macro command AllNames displays the professions of NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525481685184024747)
- **alt right click counter removal**: Holding ALT and right clicking reportedly removes the smaller counters and the items inside the big counter grid's boxes, but not the grid itself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527991671395057805)
- **alt xp share on treasure map chests**: When an alt opens a treasure map chest while the main kills the mobs, the alt gets half XP plus a 40% boost for mobs and 100% on the chest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538944571226980433)
- **always active nameplate setting behavior**: If the Always Active nameplate setting is disabled, nameplates may appear only while Shift+Ctrl is held or if they were not individually closed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532180074332272)
- **always full screen option**: Turning off Always Full Screen in Video Options lets players use the black space around the game window for their UI layout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541405348248952893)
- **always showing mobile names**: To always show mobile names, hold Ctrl+Shift to open the nameplates gump (if it was closed), switch it to mobiles, and click always on; this is separate from the temporary names shown when mobiles come into range, which is set in the options menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551252601402564739)
- **always-visible cooldown bars**: In Options > Cooldowns, uncheck the option to hide the box when the cooldown is inactive to keep that cooldown bar always visible on screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544052405522399362)
- **anchored health bars and auto-close on death**: Anchored health bars must be turned off for the option that auto-closes health bars on death to work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532594790561091674)
- **anchored health bars setting**: The behavior where pulled-out life bars connect to other life bars is called 'anchored health bars' in the settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522269732005351435)
- **animal lore window resizing**: The Animal Lore window probably cannot be resized normally, but it may be changeable through Gump Overrides, possibly affecting text layout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528444836922003608)
- **antiquity container**: An antiquity container has been confirmed as an upcoming addition to the game, though no release date is given. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536433884399407215)
- **applying mount gear via mount tack**: Add mount gear to the mount tack item, and it applies the selected gear whenever you mount the relevant mount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535132335530319912)
- **arcane aspect weapon buffs**: To get the buffs from the arcane aspect weapon, use each of its skills and target the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540521730349465731)
- **arcane build progression**: Arcane takes a while to become properly established and functions more smoothly with more mastery links and a higher aspect level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533920623208955944)
- **arcane buildup at 80 skill**: At 80 Arcane skill you get less percent arcane buildup per hit than at 100, but the faster attack speed compensates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551370567414714399)
- **arcane codex finisher trigger**: The arcane codex finisher is triggered by casting spells; if you rely on summons or pets instead of casting, the arcane codex does nothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549963870691393628)
- **arcane codex finishers on wiki**: The wiki's Arcane Codex page lists Clarity and Catalyst as the finishers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535719755514777731)
- **arcane codex point spending order**: One suggested order for Arcane Codex points is rank 5 leech, leyline, rank 7 leech, then rank 5 for the rest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522630132563705928)
- **arcane codex surge effect**: The Surge special chance in the arcane codex boosts weapon damage rather than spell damage, and nothing in the arcane codex boosts spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524425211590742196)
- **arcane essence alert**: You can set an alert that warns you when your arcane essence reaches a chosen level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532749831381057768)
- **arcane essence pool weight**: Arcane Essence stored in the Aspect arcane essence pool is believed to have no weight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538425377339211860)
- **arcane essence storage cap**: You can hold more than 5,000 Arcane Essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538425784644018227)
- **arcane mage food mana regen**: Mana from arcane mage food is greater than from meditation, but its mana regeneration does not work in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539225330764611664)
- **arcane mage link setup**: For arcane mage links, first test damage dealt by player links, add spell aspect links (links 11-20 can be spell aspect) only until proc issues feel okay, then swap back to damage links; dump the no-followers link into spell damage/ignore resist and convert every other link to gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537790692326252737)
- **arcane rune buff visibility**: The only known way to see an Arcane rune's buffs is to click on it after it has been activated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528060621826822185)
- **arcane scroll holding limit**: There is no specific cap on how many Arcane Scrolls a character can hold; only the normal weight limits apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538416967122165800)
- **arcane scroll weight**: 300 Arcane Scrolls weigh 30 stone, or 0.1 stone each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538418249753169963)
- **arcane staff aspect mastery slot**: On the Aspect mastery screen, an Arcane Staff can count as either the weapon or the book for aspect effects, at the player's choice, and it is the only weapon type that can do so. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544362321248395374)
- **arcane staff hit stationary requirement**: Arcane staff hits require the caster to be stationary for 0.5 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545555929238347887)
- **arcane weapon skill cooldown**: There is a 10 second cooldown between each arcane weapon skill use when obtaining their buffs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540684874128822372)
- **arch protection armor bonus**: Arch Protection gives the same armor bonus as Protection but applies it to summons as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528449773403902154)
- **archery codex multi shot procs**: The archery codex multi shot appears to roll aspect proc, special and damage once at the start and then duplicate that result across the individual hits, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529222783068934336)
- **archery codex naming**: Archery is considered a melee skill, but its codex is still called the archery codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612060232196167)
- **arena build requirement**: Entering the arena for 1v1 or 2v2 likely requires creating an arena build first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530708862540447754)
- **arena build restoration**: Leaving the arena restores your original build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530708993411125381)
- **armor aspect appearance and clothing**: Some armor pieces can take on the aspect appearance while others are merely covered by clothes, and certain clothing hides armor and shows skin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529875650402455612)
- **armor aspect choice**: Armor aspects differ much more in mechanics than weapon or spellbook aspect procs, so choosing an aspect usually means choosing the armor aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **armor aspect swap cooldown**: Swapping armor aspects to fortune or harvest has a 1 minute cooldown before those bonuses become active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538976530846187580)
- **armor effect on backstabber**: Worn armor affects meditation rather than stealth or hiding, so a backstabber can reportedly wear plate armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544526538815307838)
- **armor ignore links after redline**: Once a player unlocks redline, they should drop the armor ignore links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527041230809333820)
- **armor penalties**: Wearing armor carries no hiding or stealth penalty on this server, but armor does impact meditation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550342331696156794)
- **armor rating display**: The status bar shows armor rating correctly, but it does not count the armor bonuses from Protection and Taunt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522694440743862312)
- **armor set aspect activation cost**: Activating an armor set's aspect costs 5 essence, and typically only one armor set should be activated at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548319805738590251)
- **armor set bonuses and aspects**: Armor has no set bonuses, and aspects can be applied to any mix of armor pieces. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524161005637206086)
- **armor slots**: There are 6 armor slots in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552089863178821717)
- **armor type meditation penalty scope**: The armor-type meditation penalty applies to every piece of that armor type, not just the chest piece, which is only the example icon for the classification. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527402877239431259)
- **arms lore disarm effect**: Arms lore allows disarm, and disarm previously only increased follower melee damage rather than specials; it is believed, but not confirmed, to be unchanged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541538160486518895)
- **arms lore ssi bonus**: Arms Lore gives a 6% SSI bonus at 60 skill and an 8% SSI bonus at 80 skill, and also unlocks Disarm at 80. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552073770754121738)
- **artisan aspect armor requirement**: Artisan Aspect requires wearing a full armor set, which can be leather only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537412611077832744)
- **artisan aspect leveling**: Artisan aspect is best leveled on your main account because the redline in endgame shares it, ideally on an echo of the main. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536206419525894185)
- **artisan aspect tier 15 xp**: Artisan is an easy harvest aspect to bring to T15 first, which enables the redline XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527534309236408403)
- **artisan aspect upgrade ready message**: When an Artisan aspect has enough experience to upgrade, the system message 'You have acquired enough experience to upgrade your Artisan Mastery Level' appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555847855795867719)
- **artisan echo for tier 15 redline**: Some veteran players keep an Artisan echo, sometimes only to reach tier 15 and unlock redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530534586306527253)
- **artisan worn bonus on echo**: A character with the artisan aspect on a weapon but no crafting skill in the current build can have a crafting echo, but the worn bonus does not help while crafting from the echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541789384561533000)
- **aspect activation on death**: Aspect activation is lost on death, because dying unequips everything to the corpse and unequipping an aspect item turns it off, so the aspect must be re-activated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527698063714422916)
- **aspect and codex commands**: Aspects can be activated with a say command, and all codex items have commands too. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526681065530593381)
- **aspect and codex experience tracking**: Aspect and codex experience is tracked per character rather than per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526123079934283927)
- **aspect and codex progress**: Aspect and Codex progress are character specific and are shared between all echoes of the same character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537459974320553985)
- **aspect and mastery binding scope**: Aspects are character-bound, while mastery chain and redline progress are account-wide; the echo system lets you save multiple templates on a single character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525960257182896331)
- **aspect arcane essence drain**: Aspects drain arcane essence based on damage dealt and aspect tier, filling a meter that removes essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530610109250535474)
- **aspect armor color on shields**: Activating aspect armor does not apply its color to a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542253642109952150)
- **aspect character binding**: Aspects are tied to the character they are unlocked on, and only that character benefits from them unless the aspect is also unlocked on another character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529815919143030904)
- **aspect coloring persistence**: Aspect coloring on gear is not permanent; it only shows that the aspect's bonuses apply to that gear, and the gear loses the aspect when you die or put it in a container not on your person or on the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529080979040374794)
- **aspect command behavior**: The aspect command turns the aspect on if it is not already active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543265580713517176)
- **aspect contribution to character strength**: A large share of a character's overall strength comes from Aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538861575333744680)
- **aspect core combining**: These items may be combinable into Aspect Cores, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601884377288744)
- **aspect core distill stockpiling**: Players should buy core distills for their aspect in advance so they have stock ready when they level the aspect up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535874504667172934)
- **aspect crystals usage**: Aspect crystals are not multi-use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521948866109247558)
- **aspect enchantments**: Aspects work like enchantments placed on gear and are lost once the item leaves your inventory, such as when traded to another character; you can level your Aspect Tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529240171092906024)
- **aspect essence economy while farming**: When farming, picking up, identifying and recycling every unidentified item usually yields more essence than the aspect system costs, making it net positive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540022777107587113)
- **aspect experience gain**: Characters earn Aspect experience and level up their individual Aspects by killing creatures while equipped with Aspect Gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533528180277907638)
- **aspect experience when using two aspects**: When two aspects are used at once, experience is reportedly split 50/50 between them with no penalty, and higher-level aspects level more slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533859135505039411)
- **aspect gear assignment**: The gear assigned to each aspect can be changed; players are not locked into an assignment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530319538141528255)
- **aspect head armor requirement**: Aspect does not work unless a helmet or other head armor is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538861519830384721)
- **aspect hue material option level requirement**: The aspect hue can be set to Material (normal armor appearance) with no level requirement; level 10 is required only to use the color of another aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551703224346476565)
- **aspect hue toggle**: The aspect hue on gear can reportedly be turned off once the aspect reaches level 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527699768837668955)
- **aspect hue toggle**: The aspect hue can be turned off for head, neck and hands, with head free and neck and hands costing gold; the aspect remains active but its hue does not show. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534322412802412659)
- **aspect item bonuses**: Aspect bonuses only work while the aspect item is worn, so taking it off reduces your damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522380572339601618)
- **aspect level 15 requirements**: Unlocking aspect level 15 requires Aspect Triumph in addition to cores and distills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531788815620899028)
- **aspect level 15 upgrade stone**: The shining stone needed to upgrade an aspect to level 15 is called an aspect triumph. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539613095662456894)
- **aspect level-up reapplication**: After leveling up an aspect you do not need to reapply it; it uses whatever tier is set in the aspect gump, which becomes the new highest level automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554507769531473951)
- **aspect leveling account choice**: It is advisable to level aspects on the same account as your PvM characters, because T15 aspects benefit PvMers and re-leveling the same aspect on another account takes more time and effort. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527676176620060712)
- **aspect leveling materials**: Cores and distillations are needed to level up an aspect, and the essence icon shows how much essence remains and when it will warn you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553885523708477481)
- **aspect leveling order**: Players should bring one aspect to level 10 before working on a second aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543506524024873051)
- **aspect leveling order**: A player can gain a few levels on a different aspect while leveling their main aspect, so it is advisable to get one aspect to tier 10 or 13 before starting a new one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526726502379557075)
- **aspect leveling per character**: Aspects are leveled independently on each character, so swapping between aspects without losing progress only works on the same character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416078658605082)
- **aspect leveling value**: Roughly 75% of aspects are not worth maxing to level 15 or higher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539444247332261959)
- **aspect mastery**: The Outlands wiki has an Aspect Mastery page, and aspects are a large part of character progression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522265332369064096)
- **aspect mastery cost after rebalance**: The overall cost up to Tier 15 of Aspect Mastery stayed the same after the rebalance; only the up-front costs were moved down the line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526702897205870632)
- **aspect mastery equipped gear**: With Aspect Mastery, only the currently equipped aspect gear provides benefits and earns XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533528826561167562)
- **aspect mastery wiki table**: The Outlands wiki Aspect Mastery page has a table of aspect tier upgrades with cumulative distill and core costs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526703352594038938)
- **aspect ownership**: Aspects are owned permanently once obtained, so builds, echoes and aspects can be swapped freely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523771665442537663)
- **aspect permanence**: Aspects are pretty permanent, unlike most other character choices which can be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525866707241930784)
- **aspect proc chance links scope**: Aspect proc chance links only affect Aspect Special Effects listed on the aspect page, such as Energy Surge for Eldritch or Mana Thief, and do not affect armor effects like blood armor's bleed, which has its own fixed chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545459930780274752)
- **aspect proc source**: Aspect procs come from the player's own hits, so the player must be the one dealing the hit for aspect procs to occur. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522290491234848828)
- **aspect purchase and reactivation**: An aspect is bought once and after death costs only a small amount of essence to reactivate, but it must be kept upgraded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529948731749830857)
- **aspect quest reward**: The aspect quest reward unlocks 3 different aspects and can be traded between your characters, so different aspects can be unlocked on different characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527675685198495835)
- **aspect requirement for redline experience**: Redline experience can probably be gained without being aspected, but this has not been tested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548368976348848230)
- **aspect requirements for book mage and arcanist echoes**: Book mage and arcanist echoes do not work without the arcane, eldritch, blood and similar aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545300667458125854)
- **aspect selection**: After obtaining an aspect bundle, open the menu found under gumps to choose the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535206242757382205)
- **aspect selection**: An aspect should be chosen to fit your template, rather than building the template around an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523746444547330149)
- **aspect spellbook and weapon matching**: The aspect spellbook and aspect weapon may need to be of the same aspect, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533528084563759166)
- **aspect starter bundle**: Double click an aspect starter bundle to pick an aspect for your build and unlock it; one unlock covers the weapon, armor and book of that aspect, and the bundle can unlock 3 different aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528525839401095350)
- **aspect switching at low bronze links**: Switching aspects with only 9 bronze links is unlikely to make a dramatic difference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543635897906499584)
- **aspect tier and chain power scaling**: Raising aspect tier and chain power lets a character compensate for skill point limits by improving swing speed, accuracy, spell damage and follower damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540569852836581447)
- **aspect tier charge consumption**: Upgrading an aspect to a higher tier makes it consume more charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548217977525112957)
- **aspect tier power boosts**: Unlocking the first aspect gives a noticeable power boost, a similar boost comes around tier 5, and tier 10 feels stronger still, though this may not apply to every aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534678015500615841)
- **aspect tier upgrade**: To upgrade an aspect tier, have 2 cores and 1 distillation, then press the Upgrade Tier button (it may take a couple of presses). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523497656142528614)
- **aspect tier xp requirements**: Tier 3 aspect corresponds to about 3k Aspect XP, reaching Tier 15 needs roughly another 475k aspect XP and 188 cores, and Tier 10 is much quicker and a good ramp up in power. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530322879361716394)
- **aspect toggle for helmet, gloves and neck**: The aspect appearance can reportedly be toggled on or off for free on the helmet, gloves and neck slots, while customizing other slots costs millions in unlocks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551703130289475746)
- **aspect transfer**: An unlocked aspect cannot be transferred to another character; it must be unlocked the normal way on each character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531160805297360986)
- **aspect unlock cost**: Unlocking an average aspect requires roughly 75k-125k in value of materials, so choosing a wrong aspect is not a huge grind to correct. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527553269700886721)
- **aspect unlock costs and starter bundle**: Aspects vary in unlock cost and the aspect starter bundle unlocks one for free, so choosing a more expensive aspect gives a better deal; the template type largely drives the primary aspect choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529636818138693754)
- **aspect unlock requirements**: Unlocking an aspect requires wearing a full set of armor and using arcane essences, which are double-clicked and targeted on yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529638670032961606)
- **aspect unlock requirements**: Unlocking an Aspect requires having the Aspect Kit, 4 aspect cores, and 2 distillations in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537251909314945094)
- **aspect unlock skill requirements**: No skills are required to unlock an Aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537251098459643958)
- **aspect unlocking**: Unlock and progress aspects on a single account, preferably a single character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534919948378570782)
- **aspect upgrade at max xp**: When an aspect reaches 500/500 XP, it can be upgraded by buying the required cores and distillations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529906228291965140)
- **aspect upgrade cost scaling**: The aspect upgrade cost requirement eases up at later stages, so you must farm longer per aspect core you need to purchase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529911043197898926)
- **aspect upgrade requirements**: Once the aspect level bar is full, the core and distill are required to upgrade the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527695509488406608)
- **aspect xp for non-harvesting activities**: For non-harvesting activities, aspect experience works like any other aspect, so 2 of the 3 aspect items must be activated to earn maximum aspect XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529590442658627654)
- **aspect xp gain and level bar cap**: Aspect XP is gained when the aspect procs only while the current level bar is not full; while the bar sits at 100%, further aspect XP is wasted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527695539930665061)
- **aspect xp gain ratio**: Aspect XP is gained at roughly 100 gold to 1 XP per activated type (weapon, spellbook, armor), effectively 50:1 if the same aspect is applied to both weapons/spellbook and armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529504450539163688)
- **aspect xp rate**: Aspect XP accrues at about 1/100th of the numbers used by other XP systems, because Aspect was the first XP system introduced and uses different numbers, but progression per mob difficulty is equivalent. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550561457421422615)
- **aspect xp requirement**: To gain full aspect XP, the aspect must be applied to an item held in your hand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536700783255486565)
- **aspect xp splitting**: Players should not split aspect XP before reaching 30 links or 100% scalar, since meta aspect improvements are not meaningful until close to T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526985178814218461)
- **aspected blessed spellbook aspect xp**: Aspect XP can still be earned with an aspected blessed spellbook; the restriction on holding a regular blessed spellbook applies only to the weapon setup bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537501009155203083)
