- **aspecting a witch hunter's hood**: Buying an item like the Witch Hunter's hood lets you aspect it directly, and buying a clothing bless deed from the Prevalia shop keeps it from being lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531157868286447706)
- **aspecting blessed armor slots**: Any armor slot can be aspected as long as the item is blessed, including Prevalia items, blessed tailor artisan-crafted items, and reward items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522264251341738014)
- **aspects acquisition and benefit**: Aspects are obtained free through a quest and improve accuracy substantially, while Aspect Extracts rarely drop now, so players want Distillations instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545328541120335923)
- **aspects and chivalry book**: The chivalry book does not count as a spellbook for aspects, and the maximum number of aspects active at one time is two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531572801784516748)
- **aspects and codices unlocking**: Aspects and codices now unlock for free through quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520317133655900240)
- **aspects on fishing poles**: Aspects cannot be applied to a fishing pole, though this is stated with some uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409246002225162)
- **aspects sharing**: Aspects are not shared across an account; they are character-only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551000214872006657)
- **aspects system**: Aspects enhance damage and survivability and grant abilities, but consume arcane energy and require materials plus exp points to level up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550699819868233749)
- **atlas player locations option**: The atlas has a player locations option used to mark locations for camping hikes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537135439625064560)
- **attacking guild-tagged bosses**: If you attack a boss tagged by a guild, you temporarily flag orange (enemy) to that guild, and its members may kill you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547724407760359525)
- **attacking innocents as a criminal action**: Attacking an innocent player is a criminal action even if they fight back, but if you first attack a criminal the usual protections do not apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543385145174917120)
- **attacking thieves**: A thief can be freely attacked anywhere at any time, and in a guarded area the thief can be guard whacked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535256099190734910)
- **attacks on tamed pets**: Other players can possibly attack your tamed pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554292632396632146)
- **auto move toggle**: The auto move feature can be turned off, and the option is believed to be located in the experimental settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531803113986457620)
- **auto move with mouse**: Left clicking while moving with right click keeps the character moving (auto move). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528906854263029860)
- **auto removing far-away health bars**: To remove far-away health bars automatically, open Options > General > Health Bars & Drag Select > Health Bar Collectors, then set Auto Remove Min Range under CollectorSettings > Behaviour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523406372899786842)
- **auto scroll preference setting location**: To make spells automatically look for a scroll first, open the help menu and find the setting in the command section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536488897062903888)
- **auto-blessed items**: Spellbooks holding spells, Chivalry and Necromancy books, codices (Codex progression items) and bank checks usually come blessed automatically. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555016986524647434)
- **auto-follow availability**: Auto-follow does not exist on this shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535391459644153856)
- **auto-potion option for missing potions**: A setting in the auto-potion options turns off auto use of potions if you do not have those types of potions with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1547023639109697637)
- **autoloot availability**: Outlands has no loot-all or autoloot feature; the only options are grid loot and grab item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555382239326371931)
- **autolooting in upcoming patch**: An upcoming Outlands patch is reported to add autolooting to the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1533276492405145712)
- **automatic last target casting**: Spells do not automatically cast on the last target by default because automatic targeting would cost the player too much control. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553944528732422185)
- **automatic stealth setting**: A setting exists that automatically stealths while moving, so the Stealth skill does not need to be pressed manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521826763813163130)
- **autostealth and showstealthsteps commands**: The client command [AutoStealth toggles automatic activation of Stealth when moving while hidden, and [ShowStealthSteps displays remaining stealth steps as in-game text. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527866523044024390)
- **autostealth and stealth steps menu location**: Type [commands to open the menu, then find the AutoStealth toggle under Commands > Mechanics and ShowStealthSteps, which shows remaining stealth steps as text, under Commands > Text Displays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521826936911822848)
- **autousespellscrolls command**: Enabling [AutoUseSpellScrolls makes the game prioritize casting from spell scrolls you are carrying, without changing keybinds or macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535811282245128294)
- **avoiding stealable worn containers**: Avoid wearing a reg bag or potion satchel, since thieves can steal from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534306739644665866)
- **avoiding theft at the bank**: When using your bank, lift the item onto your cursor and use a recall macro while holding it to avoid theft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531886944567693413)
- **avoiding theft at vendors and dungeons**: At a vendor, use 'send to bank' to avoid theft, and in a dungeon stay in sanctuary; there is no way to completely avoid being stolen from by a thief. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531886944567693413)
- **avoiding thieves**: To avoid thieves, avoid banks, conduct business in your own room, and trade on Shelter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533214050601664663)
- **avoiding wrong echo overwrite**: To avoid overwriting the wrong echo, go to the echo you do not want and redo its skills instead of using the overwrite button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532289578310832158)
- **backpack dye on paperdoll**: Dyeing the backpack shown on the paperdoll replaces the previous colour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525580680585543850)
- **backpack grid loot layout**: The backpack cannot be made to look like the grid loot layout, although some backpack display overrides are available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551917817035759687)
- **backpack gump locking**: There is no way to lock the backpack gump in place so that it cannot be moved. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528596100003401789)
- **backstabber red hand requirement**: Backstabbers do not need to be Red Hand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538060989118021743)
- **bag contents recognition after login**: After logging in, the game does not recognize an item inside a bag, such as a spellstone, until the bag is opened again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545160964431675502)
- **ban bots at training houses**: Some safe training houses run a ban bot, and the jungle junction runs a ban bot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535252455007195216)
- **bandage timer cooldown setup**: To set up a bandage timer cooldown, open Options > Cooldowns and create a new entry for the bandage timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530481128971178077)
- **bandolier potion delay**: A bandolier reduces the time between potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522669651417366760)
- **bank box stockpiles**: Stockpiles exist for the bank box, allowing the queue to be used for region bonuses and Society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549786584188981390)
- **bank gold deposit command**: There is no command to deposit gold into the bank; only withdrawing gold has a command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550498961431863336)
- **bank queue command**: Type [bankqueue in game to view the items currently waiting in your bank queue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520581248865796166)
- **bard codex buff target settings**: The bard codex settings offer buff-target options beyond just party members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292651037393038)
- **bard tamer late-game skill swap**: Once command is high and links are decent, a bard tamer can drop barding for forensics and camping to upgrade links to gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535678676752932904)
- **base hit points**: Every character has 100 HP, rising to 120 HP with a strength potion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550338604956385384)
- **bedroll use tied to camping skill**: The ability to use a bedroll is now built into having the Camping skill rather than requiring you to secure a fire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528680166212239492)
- **beneficial and harmful last targets**: There are separate beneficial and harmful last targets: beneficial spells like heal go to the beneficial last target, and hostile spells like energy bolt go to the harmful last target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553946003072225381)
- **best scavenger character choice**: The best character to use for scavenging is the one with high aspect and unlocked codices for defenses, regardless of account links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529585846510944518)
- **bestiary codex off-spec points**: The bestiary codex now grants 5 off-spec points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549869539972612229)
- **bestiary crossover points**: In the taming bestiary, each pet category has its own block of 20 points (unlocked over time) that affects only pets in that category, and up to 5 points per category can be spent on crossover abilities from other categories. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533859424920273057)
- **bestiary manual point reset cost**: Resetting points in the bestiary manual costs nothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533860450326806658)
- **bleed and disease damage vs damage reduction**: Bleed and disease damage are not impacted by damage reduction (DR). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537504403681189948)
- **blessable items**: Only clothing, runebooks and runetomes can be blessed; shepherd's crooks cannot be blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525967319057043478)
- **blessed 48-spell spellbook contents**: A blessed 48-spell spellbook contains only the vendor-available spells and no 7th or 8th circle spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550785486555971689)
- **blessed cloth equipment durability**: Blessed cloth equipment that provides armor takes durability damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542915878306324520)
- **blessed clothing safety**: Blessed clothing in Outlands is essentially safe from destruction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532848387735687188)
- **blessed codexes spellbooks and chains**: All codexes and spellbooks that hold spells come blessed, as do chains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525967570543575272)
- **blessed item behavior**: A blessed item never leaves your inventory unless you choose to move it out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527406929276567702)
- **blessed items after decay**: Blessed items that nobody picks up when they decay are moved to your bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536472746031185930)
- **blessed items on death**: The most impactful items to lose are blessed and so are not lost on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520473936368762984)
- **blessed items on pack animals**: A pack animal (mule) is effectively just a backpack, so a blessed item placed on it goes into the animal's backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539344187466719232)
- **blessed spellbook role**: The blessed spellbook is not a weapon; it is the repository of your known spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528607724466864181)
- **blessing armor**: Armor cannot be blessed in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521509356007329852)
- **blessing clothing and armor**: Society points clothes, pvp points clothes, special event clothes and prevalian merchant clothes can be blessed, but magic armor and colored armor such as a valorite platemail chest cannot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540014995021111296)
- **blessing magic or material spellbooks**: Magic or material spellbooks, which you hold and activate an aspect on for combat bonuses, cannot be blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528605808919576736)
- **blessing weapons and armor**: Weapons and armor cannot be blessed, which includes the shepherd's crook. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548855898045292636)
- **block dismount option in war mode**: An option exists to block dismount while in war mode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528845702514348063)
- **blood aspect and followers**: Blood aspect does not rely on followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521512699249295521)
- **blood aspect damage scaling**: The damage bonus from the Blood aspect scales with the aspect level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536379506917376000)
- **blood aspect level 15 redline scalar**: Reaching Blood Aspect level 15 unlocks a 33% redline scalar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534584164874191129)
- **blood oath auto refresh**: Set Blood Oath to auto refresh, because changing echoes can make you forget to reapply it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529067139913355355)
- **blue meteors event**: Strange blue-hued meteors fall from the sky in Outlands, and the impacted areas swarm with dangerous creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533926874252578988)
- **boat crew**: Veteran crew such as a medic and a boat repairs person can be added to a boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534127480909205575)
- **boat passengers and captain attacks**: Multiple players can embark on the same boat, but only as passengers, and only the captain can attack anything. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532144477525905439)
- **boat speed buff exceeding max speed**: A speed buff lets a boat sail faster than its normal maximum speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539231065460179034)
- **boat theft risk**: Boats are not blessed, so a thief can steal a ship left outside; many players leave their boats with the dockmaster for safekeeping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541254117261836289)
- **boating as xp farming method**: Boating is a fun method of farming XP but is expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544833266824249405)
- **boating spyglass scripts**: The boating spyglass mechanics were recently updated, so older spyglass scripts for finding boats and fishing spots are outdated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524949160204173322)
- **boating xp and link unlocks**: Boating gives very good XP, which can be used to unlock links by fishing or by hunting PvM boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553463332558606457)
- **body items after help-menu return**: After dying and being returned to town via Help, the items on the player's body might be gone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555898791734018090)
- **bomberman and proving grounds start condition**: Events like Bomberman and Proving Grounds start once enough players sign up for them, though this is not certain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523444280956555314)
- **bonded mount disappearance**: A bonded mount left far from its owner for a very long time (around 24 hours) can disappear, and it may be recoverable at the wrangler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537151262368337941)
- **bonded mount logout in inns**: If you log out in an inn without stabling your mount, a bonded mount logs out with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534215079535575192)
- **bonded mount quest limit**: The bonded mount quest can only be completed once per Outlands ID, so a spare bonded mount can be shared with an alt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544812632140283915)
- **bonded mounts at stables**: Bonded mounts can be bought from the stables; a mount counts as bonded if it is level 1 or higher, and the list can be filtered by hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526360396058071141)
- **bonded pet death and control count**: Killing a bonded pet does not lower your control (follower) count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532780112787935364)
- **bonded pet death debonding**: Killing a bonded pet is expected to de-bond it, though this is stated tentatively and is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541530248460636304)
- **bonded pet left out at logoff**: A bonded (level 1) pet left out of the stable when you log off can be retrieved and is not lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554136629063585913)
- **bonded pet unbonding**: A bonded pet does not unbond unless it is left extremely far from its owner for roughly 24 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534602166868643900)
- **bonuses when pvp flagged**: Some bonuses switch off entirely while PvP flagged and are replaced by generic PvM damage and damage resistance bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549347113366982677)
- **book of grifts and grudges refund reason**: The Book of Grifts and Grudges was refunded because its fundamental operation was changed, whereas resource map tomes continue to store maps as before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528233956195963061)
- **books of grifts and grudges reset**: The books of grifts and grudges reset every week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550530040037384283)
- **boom-box loot protection**: Dropping loot into a box with a deadly trap (a boom-box) is the serious method of protecting loot from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521217389889454221)
- **boss bar cap increase from repeated summons**: Summoning several times in a week for a region raises the boss bar cap for that region. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523080319916314624)
- **boss health bar color**: Boss health bars, including omni bosses, appear red and may not be adjustable through the notoriety settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539195900268908594)
- **boss killing society targets**: The boss killing society's targets are main or mini bosses in dungeons, and T8 bosses likely do not count toward it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535578344542838835)
- **boss rares and region-hued drops**: Boss rare items drop only from their respective bosses, and region-hued items such as lanterns are colored to match the region they drop in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528112727686643846)
- **bound items transfer**: Items marked 'Bound to' a character do not appear to be strictly locked and may be passed to other characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540112737106137179)
- **breeding requirements**: Breeding is not a skill; it uses items and the mounts themselves, requires the necessary furniture, and can be done in a rented inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533877207024275777)
- **bringing followers when recalling or teleporting**: Say "All Follow Me" before you recall or teleport so your followers hear the command and travel with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536789490893594735)
- **broker recovery window for decayed items**: A decayed item can be recovered from the Broker for up to one week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536472037285961728)
- **bronze link activation**: A bronze link (chain) must be activated before its bonuses, such as poison damage, apply; either equip it, or single-click it and activate it via the context menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546189400252354570)
- **browsing guild information**: Guild information for all guilds on the server can be browsed in the in-game guild menu under "diplomacy". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546206013018087424)
- **buff bar customization**: Right-click the buff bars to choose which buffs and debuffs they display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546042028146823218)
- **buff bar duration sync**: The buff duration shown in the buff bar is out of sync with the actual buff duration by about 1 second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553351347238338571)
- **buff bots on boats**: Buff bots such as alt-account bards no longer work while on boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528338273972260874)
- **buff icons for fluctuating stat bonuses**: Values that change with every swing, such as the Torrent Stance SSI bonus on a throwing weapon, are not shown as buff icons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523871862608761036)
- **buff icons on health bars**: To show buff/debuff icons on mobiles' health bars, go to Options > Interface > Buff Icons and enable 'Display buff icons on health bars for'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524118419354685540)
- **buff icons on nameplates**: There is no option to display buff icons on nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524136668418801774)
- **buff icons on pet health bars**: To show buff icons on pets' health bars, go to Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Display buff icons on health bars for > Own followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522672206277120203)
- **buff removal**: Buffs generally cannot be removed from a character and must be waited out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536104336608858173)
- **build switching via echoes**: Switch builds through Echoes (not an item) by typing [echo in game to open the Echo menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535322835613126757)
- **butler gear comparison and unidentified items**: The Outlands butler can be used to compare gear, and unidentified magic items can be viewed in player stats after you put them on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523441176051581049)
- **butler template tool buff toggle**: In the Butler template tool, open the Status tab and use the Settings option to toggle on buffs, food and similar effects so the stats screen reflects them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542537683992190986)
- **caddellite meteor debris**: A meteor event may leave caddellite debris at its landing site, though this is based on a single uncertain player observation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545541582235893771)
- **camera zoom option**: An option exists to zoom the camera in and out with Ctrl + mouse wheel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521566743460319333)
- **camping dungeon time**: Using camping lets a player stay in a dungeon for roughly an hour at a time before running out of supplies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534721661562130684)
- **camping requirement for harvest maps**: The test server requirement to camp for harvest maps was a bug that the developer said he would fix, and the gump is not planned to require camping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534386309974724658)
- **caravan guild activity**: A caravan is a guild activity in which the caravan travels a route and players protect it from monster spawns, and PvP equivalents exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529276510781964418)
- **carrack crew capacity**: A carrack can have five crew members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540381519720353824)
- **carry capacity**: A character can carry up to 125 items or stacks and has a weight limit of 450 stone, which increases with the Camping skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538417208969924719)
- **carry weight limit**: The carry weight limit is 450 stones, which is easily exceeded when looting everything (such as regs, bandages and arrows) while running harvest and T4-5 maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542358547566694431)
- **carry weight unlock via redline**: Additional carry weight can be unlocked much later in the game through Redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528446249043497071)
- **carrying capacity modifiers**: Carrying capacity is increased by the STR stat and the Camping skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525555998880829460)
- **cartography additive damage bonus**: The cartography/explorer additive damage bonus was replaced by a multiplicative bonus on a one-for-one basis. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537453457252818974)
- **cartography bonus to resource map yield**: A player suggests that Cartography should boost resource map yield proportionally, as it boosts trap damage, but this is a design proposal and not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531107891573035048)
- **cartography change scope**: The cartography change probably only altered the damage type, and the DR bonus is likely not lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537457403425984542)
- **cartography damage bonus**: Cartography is said to give a damage bonus that testers considered too strong, and it is unclear whether it will be kept. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534150772365987912)
- **cartography damage bonus and followers**: The cartography damage bonus in the test patch does not apply to follower (pet) damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529124419115421726)
- **cast range display**: The cast range display shown in the patch notes clip is currently only available on the beta client and is still in early testing stages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526637682397282375)
- **cast spell by one click option**: The Options Spells tickbox 'cast spell by one click' also applies to skills and macro buttons, not only to spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534144035118252102)
- **casting invisibility while monsters watch**: Invisibility can be cast while a monster is looking at you, unlike hiding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550797670069698613)
- **chain and aspect switching delay**: Switching chains and aspects incurs a wait time of about 30-60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538105407170412586)
- **chain and link blessed status**: Chains are blessed but links placed in them are not blessed by default; once a link is slotted into a chain it cannot be stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537529698479775907)
- **chain lightning mage redline**: A chain lightning mage at tier 19 can reportedly have over 70 redline, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526600590329778348)
- **chain link bonus size**: Each chain link gives a bonus of roughly 2-3.75% depending on its tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520282200279482438)
- **chain link grind**: Chain links are a time-consuming grind: the first three or so links come fairly quickly, but each subsequent link takes exponentially longer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529304049252434090)
- **chain link sources**: Chain links come mostly from societies, pit trials, and group content such as bosses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534090060637540454)
- **chain link tiers**: Links are installed in a chain and come in three tiers: bronze, silver and gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520281862512054353)
- **chain link xp and character slots**: Each account has 5 character slots, and chain link XP is tied to the account's first character, so players are advised to do chain content on that character; this is an uncertain claim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548551315842400289)
- **chain links on second character**: A second character on the same account can benefit from chain links, which can help against monsters while PvP flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526874112398594130)
- **chain xp on pvm accounts**: Only PvM characters need chain links, so chain xp only needs to be worked up on the account holding the PvM characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525012492567183460)
- **chain, aspects and codices sharing**: Chain is not shared across accounts, and Aspects and Codices are not shared between characters, which is where Echoes are useful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530586449857085561)
- **challenger dungeon bonus**: A challenger dungeon is one of the weekly regional bonuses that makes all mobs in that dungeon more difficult for that week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528506562094825592)
- **changing character title**: A character's title can be changed using the [Title command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544034356094312509)
- **changing field spell display**: To change how field spells display (e.g. blocks instead of fire), go to Options > General, scroll about 90% down and change the Field settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521401042477125702)
- **changing spell color on screen**: To change the color of spells on screen, check the combat spells section of the options menu (possibly options > speech > you speech color); Razor also has a spell-related setting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554458276253401170)
- **chaos and order mount token requirements**: Using a Chaos or Order mount token has no requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547418536866095164)
- **character deletion confirmation**: Deleting a character requires typing the character's name and now includes a 60-second wait. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531027400094126111)
- **character links for pvp character**: Links between characters are only needed for crafter, gatherer and similar PvM characters; a PvP character does not need links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529426869290668114)
- **character rename client profile**: Renaming a character creates a new client profile file, so existing UI settings do not carry over unless the old profile folder is renamed to the new character name; the client may have since been updated to handle this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521989073693053069)
- **charged spells**: Charged spells are only an additive damage bonus and are not a spell crit, despite appearing to be one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526891844405825638)
- **chat channel prefixes**: Party chat uses the / prefix, guild chat uses the \ prefix, and alliance chat uses the | prefix. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525413770485305354)
- **chat timestamps option**: There is no option to turn off chat timestamps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532608537803358330)
- **chat window gump hotkey**: Pressing Alt+J may bring back the chat window gump, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529752056917786635)
- **cheap aspect options and balance**: Discipline and holy aspects are solid cheap options, and many aspects are currently fairly evenly balanced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534686911426199752)
- **checking active pvp bonuses**: Click the blue 'pvp mechanics' gem in the bottom left of the screen to see which bonuses remain active in PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549346309444468747)
- **checking aspect level requirements**: Type [aspect to see what is required to level up an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528854556551680031)
- **checking control slots**: Click the status bar on your paperdoll, or use the drop-down menu in the upper left corner, to see how many control slots you have. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538122403782332436)
- **checking creature wrestling skill**: To see the wrestling skill of creatures you fight, open the Outlands Butler creature library, filter by region and level, enable the Wrestling column via the Columns button at the top of the table, and sort by that column. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529609846926606388)
- **checking current stance**: To see your current stance, find the codex book in your backpack and use getlabel on it; you can then change the stance if needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542024473698369676)
- **checking flashpoint time remaining**: Type [battle to see the time remaining on an active dungeon flashpoint, such as the Cavernam flashpoint. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536380130753118318)
- **checking follower limit**: Open your status window to check whether you are over the follower limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555614915484721284)
- **checking journal log after interference**: Log off, which saves your journal to a text file, then read that file to see whether someone was interfering with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554290727465394187)
- **checking name availability on test server**: Trying the name on the Test server is another fairly reliable way to check whether a character name is taken, unless someone claimed it since the last sync. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525497121061732504)
- **checking name availability with pet naming**: To check whether a character name is taken before using a name change deed, try naming a pet with it, since this will not allow an existing character's name, though it is not 100% reliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525496710426791946)
- **checking pet follower speed**: Lore the pet and switch the stats view to current, then add your own follower speed bonuses to the listed value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527807463984861226)
- **checking ping**: To check ping, open the client menu bar and look under Stats > net stats, though the exact location is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532617998161154078)
- **checking ping**: Check ping via the Net entry in the statistics at the top of the client, or by typing >ping in game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532985037681590312)
- **checking real accuracy**: To check your real accuracy, enter your build into the Outlands Butler planner at outlandsbutler.com/planner/create, because in-game player stats may display accuracy incorrectly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520916428193009725)
- **checking region restrictions with considersins**: Type [ConsiderSins in game to see whether your character has a region restriction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536810811274567770)
- **checking society reset time**: Click the quest icon on the paperdoll to see the days and hours remaining until the society reset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545609833519120414)
- **checking weapon ability activation via hotbar**: To check whether a weapon ability is activated, close and reopen the ability hotbar; if the part you double click on is empty, the ability is activated, since the hotbar icon fills up when armed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1522735491458273331)
- **checking weight and trapped pouches on corpses**: You can keep regular corpses to check weight, or additionally open the casket and click the items in it, which also allows picking up trapped pouches. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529231271803490444)
- **chest link stacking**: Chest success/progress links stack multiplicatively rather than additively, so 10 bronze links give a 30% bonus and a 70% chest success chance becomes 91% (70*1.3) instead of 100%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543361125008154664)
- **chest opening aspect experience split**: When opening chests, aspect experience is split as usual between aspects if different aspects are on your armor and in your hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555358981742927976)
- **chest trap types**: Not all chest traps cause explosions; some only reveal you and prevent hiding for a period of time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550317023450497129)
- **chest xp calculation**: XP gained from chests is reportedly based on the gold value of the loot, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550850212204122226)
- **chill effect type**: Chill is a debuff rather than a damage-over-time effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542514881046122526)
- **chivalry abilities book**: Chivalry comes with a book of abilities that can be toggled on and off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529185376961298633)
- **chivalry ability hotbar**: Chivalry abilities can be accessed by double-clicking the white book in your backpack and opening the hotbar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548206681174057071)
- **chivalry and necromancy hotbar gump refresh**: The Chivalry and Necromancy hotbar gumps refresh themselves every 5 seconds when a new symbol should be earned, keeping the visible count of available symbols accurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549746359240757250)
- **chivalry codex books**: Chivalry has only one codex book. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526148636067627098)
- **chivalry codex damage avoidance**: A Chivalry codex ability can give a random chance to take no damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524466609706635437)
- **chivalry gate bonuses in pvp**: Chivalry gate bonuses may not apply in PvP, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552711871013060699)
- **chivalry gate marked locations**: A Chivalry gate holds 1 marked location by default, and extra marked locations can be obtained. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533033182679662602)
- **chivalry personal moongate**: Players with Chivalry can create a personal moongate that can take them and others to dungeons and cities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553536273296269396)
- **chivalry sacred journey gate range**: A Chivalry Sacred Journey moongate can only be used from one tile away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549864561870512319)
- **chivalry symbol counter**: There is no in-game counter for chivalry symbols comparable to the HP counter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544358579924901988)
- **choosing paperdoll skill title**: To choose which skill title shows on the paperdoll, say [title in game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523894248057995346)
- **choosing summons with magery**: The player chooses which creature to summon with Magery spells and earns points for each summon type in the Summoner's Tome codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521861267181142146)
- **chromatic link term**: Players call the damage-dealt-by-player link 'chromatic' because it can be converted to any other link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533142147837067417)
- **city buff condition**: The city buff applies only while standing in the city, not while inside an inn room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533150922069512283)
- **clearing red status on test server**: There is likely no way to un-red a character on the test server, but deleting and recreating the character on test is possible. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539463618838401105)
- **clearing spell overhead format**: Clearing the spell overhead format setting in the spell options may cause your own spell overhead text to show nothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523456404919419061)
- **clearing unwanted windows or bars**: Hold ALT while clicking to clear unwanted windows or bars from the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532588269215158404)
- **client object delay queue option**: Uncheck the client option 'object delay queue'; when enabled it queues repeated actions done faster than 600 ms, such as equipping a weapon, and replays them later, wasting seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546855303885361162)
- **client zoom macro command**: The Outlands client has a macro command called "Zoom" that may allow binding camera zoom to a different key. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525745433660358728)
- **cloning options between accounts in game**: To copy options from a character on one account to a character on another account, log in the source character and run the in-game option clone from that character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534169750685487134)
- **cloning options on the same account**: In-game option cloning does not work between characters on the same account; for same-account characters you must copy the settings files in the game folder instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534169938225270784)
- **closing anchored gumps**: Alt + right-click closes anchored gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544729535566712853)
- **closing extra health bars**: Extra health bar boxes can be closed with alt + right click, and a setting reportedly exists to auto close them when the target dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547570886545248266)
- **clothing and armor layering**: Depending on the item, clothing may display over armor, hide it, or appear under it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534313024935039118)
- **clothing replacing armor pieces**: Clothing items can replace head, neck and hand armor while the armor aspect still works, but clothing bless deeds must be bought for this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543132475180585072)
- **codex ability commands and macros**: To trigger Codex stances, finishers and abilities by macro, look up the commands in help/commands/codex and bind the chosen command to an ingame macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550093585594978365)
- **codex activation requirement**: Owning a codex gives no immediate benefit; it must be leveled to unlock its bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547612630066135201)
- **codex and aspect carryover on build switch**: Maxed codexes and levelled aspects carry over when switching builds on the same character, saving the cost of cores needed to level a new character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548553251455111290)
- **codex and aspect ownership**: Codices and aspects are per character; a physical codex can be traded between characters, but the experience gain and points distributed within it are tied to each character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527156857817403492)
- **codex and aspect progress scope**: Codex progress and aspect progress are tracked per character, not per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532971968645824593)
- **codex and bestiary experience**: Experience in the healer codex or bestiary is gained from killing mobs, not from healing pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544665351734698025)
- **codex aspect and link effects against mobs**: Codex, aspect and link effects are active against monsters unless their description states otherwise. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551313528114258073)
- **codex aspect and mastery chain xp storage**: Codex experience and aspect experience are stored per character, while mastery chain experience is stored per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526290465308283001)
- **codex buff scaling below 100 skill**: Under the proposed patch, codex buffs apply at reduced strength (about 80%) when relevant skills are below 100, for example a 20% buff becoming 16%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528135987207737537)
- **codex carry limit**: There is no limit on the number of codexes a player can carry; the practical limit is total skill points (700-720), since each codex requires 80 points in one to three skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527498992865378344)
- **codex experience gain**: All codexes gain experience simultaneously if you qualify for them and have them in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538385967705100408)
- **codex experience gain without equipping**: Experience toward a codex can be gained even when it is not the codex currently in use, provided the player has the skills for it, e.g. with Tactics and two weapon skills one can gain toward one weapon codex while another weapon type is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551300337418244157)
- **codex experience locations**: Codex experience can be gained in Sanctuary dungeons but probably not on Shelter Island or in the Shelter dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548072786235363380)
- **codex experience ownership**: Codex experience is tied to the character rather than the codex item, so a codex maxed on one character and traded to another starts at zero for the second character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532814094300614898)
- **codex experience requirements**: Some codexes, such as weapon codexes, require more experience to max out than the 20-point codexes (potion, healers, thieves, etc.). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538385967705100408)
- **codex experience without codex in inventory**: On the live shard, experience is gained for Taming bestiary, healer and bard codices even when the codex is not in your inventory, according to a player test. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551296213628747879)
- **codex experience without owning codices**: Characters appear to earn codex experience toward codices even if they do not yet own them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541758357923307531)
- **codex hotbar menu command**: Say [codexhotbar in game to open the codex stances as a menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537016141392646255)
- **codex hotbar visibility**: The codex hotbar may not appear if your codex level is too low, though this is only a guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548209809373929522)
- **codex leveling**: A codex levels up by killing monsters while carrying it and having the appropriate skills; kills in the New Player Dungeon do not count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537243745534087389)
- **codex leveling independence**: Each codex levels independently of the others, regardless of how many your skills allow you to use, and experience is not split among them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527717905855152283)
- **codex leveling skill minimum**: For PvM, the minimum skill needed to level a codex is 80 in the related skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527111797671460937)
- **codex low-level bonuses**: At low links or aspect levels, the codex can give bonus accuracy or damage resist when needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541539342055645265)
- **codex perk skill requirements**: A codex perk deactivates if you lose one of its required skills, so you must keep those skills to retain its benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532724300937695294)
- **codex point gain**: Codex points are unlocked with XP as you kill, and you gain points for each codex in your bag as long as you meet its skill requirement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528404190395633856)
- **codex point persistence**: Once a codex point is earned it is unlocked permanently and does not need to be re-earned when swapping loadouts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550936701852061717)
- **codex point reset**: Most codex points can be reset freely by clicking the reset points button, though weapon and parry codexes are exceptions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551007801055248497)
- **codex point resets**: Combat codices cannot reset their points because they can eventually be fully unlocked, while thief, healer, taming and similar codices can be re-specced freely. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527670398886478006)
- **codex progression order**: Raise the main stance to 5, then the main ability, then alternate stances to 5, then the main stance to 7, then alternate stances to 7, and finally alternate abilities. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538147302508859455)
- **codex purchase and progression**: Codexes are a one-time purchase, and their power ramps up as their points are unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529890789881020528)
- **codex rank 0 effect**: Rank 0 of a codex ability does nothing, and the first rank grants the first increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546294011344723979)
- **codex rank power scaling**: A single codex rank is barely noticeable, but power increases noticeably once you have many ranks across several codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533008034803093544)
- **codex scalar in resource map patch notes**: The codex scalar mentioned in the initial resource map patch notes was removed by Luthius after a day or two. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536837753646350416)
- **codex sharing and xp**: Codices can be passed freely between characters, but the XP earned in a codex is character-specific and stays with the character who earned it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529815919143030904)
- **codex single-click display**: Single-clicking a Codex displays the player's selected Stance and, if one is activated, their selected Finisher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **codex skills on buff bar**: Some codex skills, such as Ruffian and Shadow Hands from the Thieves codex, may appear on the buff bar upon obtaining the codex with 0 points spent, but they have no effective value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543622504348909589)
- **codex special attacks**: A codex lets you set up special attacks that give different effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554953320190443571)
- **codex stance bonuses**: Only the currently active codex stance gives bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537175400558501941)
- **codex stance rules**: Combat codexes such as swords and parrying allow only one stance active at a time, while utility codexes such as healing use resettable points that let multiple perks be active based on the points allocated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529270974833492058)
- **codex stances and finisher tier**: Raising codex stances, with a stance at tier 5 giving +1, increases your finisher tier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537175475993190531)
- **codex values stats page accuracy**: The in-game stats page is usually incorrect for codex values, so the calculators and template planner on the Outlands Butler website are more reliable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524665019067924573)
- **codex with shield**: The Codex works normally while a shield is equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549381246751211531)
- **codex xp**: Codices earn XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544749952054468650)
- **codices per template**: A typical template has access to 2-4 codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526148954465505350)
- **codices versus aspects payment**: Codices are a one-time payment, while Aspects require a payment at every level up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527795484444594318)
- **collector box settings**: Overlapping collector boxes malfunction, and the Murderer option should not be checked on gray collector boxes because it will collect red mobs such as the omni boss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554878197584236737)
- **collector placement for players and monsters**: Player collectors and monster collectors should be placed in different areas rather than in the same position. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542564533783236628)
- **color coding magical item labels**: There is no way to color code the labels of magical items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528563167444340919)
- **colossal frog control slots**: A colossal frog takes 2 control slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532781000185352445)
- **combat codex unlocks**: You can eventually unlock every point in a combat codex, after which you choose which stance and finisher you want active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532845934785069067)
- **combat skill accuracy calculation**: Combat skills determine accuracy, calculated against the opponent's combat skill; a creature's wrestling skill is used against your combat skill and any melee defense bonuses to determine its chance to hit you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537446827169816704)
- **combat-spells query options**: Options > Combat-Spells has two 'Query' options that show a pop-up when you are about to perform an action that could make you criminal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529695975872921643)
- **combined experience scalar scope**: The combined experience scalar applies only to gathering; when fighting, the weapon's aspect benefits still apply but the scalar does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523006368796246146)
- **command aspect effects**: The Command aspect increases followers' attack speed, damage, and defense. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529639720240414813)
- **command aspect level 9 cost**: Leveling the Command aspect to level 9 requires 7 command cores. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520925557402108036)
- **command aspect unlock materials**: Unlocking the Command aspect requires cores and distills, which can be found by searching the portal vendor search. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541994838629679184)
- **command aspect xp tier cap**: Command Aspect XP stops accruing when the aspect is at its tier cap, so you must upgrade the tier before gaining more XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523497466513850521)
- **command prompt hotkey**: The '-' key opens the command prompt in the game client, and one player suggests this may depend on having the enter bar always open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546632747873865828)
