- **command spell proc feedback**: When Command Spell procs from Greater Heal, a sound effect and animation play, plus a buff shows how much of the bonus damage remains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547235921282203659)
- **common aspect pairing**: A common aspect pairing is Holy for armor and Fire for weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533045438586949652)
- **comparing gear armor rating**: To compare gear, check your armor rating in your stats, and apply an aspect to the pieces being tested so the comparison reflects their real values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523440645954605350)
- **container auto-stacking**: Items dropped onto a container automatically stack with matching items already in that container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364237117394964)
- **container gump position memory**: To make containers open where you last closed them, set Options > Interface > Containers > Override container gump location to "remember". _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528328486274727946)
- **container gump position persistence**: Container gump positions persist between sessions only if the containers are physically open and on screen when you log out and close the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529099372892258405)
- **context menus via shift-click**: To get context menus from clicking, go to Options > General > Gumps & Context and toggle 'hold shift for context menus'; with it on, shift+click the health bar to open the interact menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547242187975163974)
- **controlling npc ships**: You cannot control an NPC ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542567458064568391)
- **converting an unwanted link for your build**: An unwanted link can be converted with a tool into the type your build needs, then added to the chain; the chain must also be set to your character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520285248590450828)
- **cooldown bar presets**: Cooldown bar presets are available under Options > Cooldowns and can be dragged onto the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542835089069576212)
- **cooldown display settings**: Cooldown display settings are configured under Options > Cooldowns in the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523058988177031440)
- **cooldown on switching tmapper to harvesting**: Switching from a tmapper setup to harvesting is subject to a cooldown that was added to Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531106329295589606)
- **cooldown timer triggers**: A cooldown timer can be started by several triggers, including a buff being removed from your buff bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565065884115086)
- **copying build to echo**: A build can be copied to an echo at any point, and the current template does not need to be complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534413163032871036)
- **core dungeon floor 1 sanctuary status**: Floor 1 of the core dungeons is not a sanctuary by default. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522339320449597451)
- **corpse container gump location**: To change where the corpse container opens, use the override container gump location options in Options -> Interface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520548680153694389)
- **corpse loot coffin box**: Outlands devs moved monster loot into an unlootable bag or coffin box inside corpses, reportedly to prevent auto-looting of gold from corpses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535940547527581757)
- **corpse looting consent**: To give someone consent to loot your corpse, join their party and flag green. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520760752661725304)
- **corpse looting rules**: Anyone can loot your corpse, and thieves or reds may take items before it turns to bones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538504512917217352)
- **corpse name clutter settings**: To reduce corpse name clutter, open the general options and adjust the 'show incoming mobiles' and 'show incoming corpses' settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554497660671500389)
- **corpse name plates**: Corpse name plates can be turned off by right-clicking the name tag, or permanently by holding SHIFT and CONTROL and unchecking the corpse name plates option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525873780033982717)
- **corpse skin disease application**: Corpse Skin only applies disease with directly damaging spells and does not apply it with poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545179815924207747)
- **cosmetic clothing blessing**: Cosmetic clothing must be blessed, otherwise it drops to your corpse when you die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526320773243998320)
- **cosmetic clothing layers**: Cosmetic clothing uses item layers: legs, chest and arms are worn as armor with cosmetic pieces layered over it, while head, neck and gloves slots are generally replaced by aesthetic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526318871693365419)
- **cosmetic headwear durability**: Cosmetic headwear can be repaired and does not break when its durability reaches 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535620603279843579)
- **cosmetic pants over plate legs**: Cosmetic pants and similar clothing can be double-clicked to be worn over plate armor leg pieces, visually covering them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526321423587475496)
- **counter bar settings**: Open Options > Counters to hide or modify the counter bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529247570571034775)
- **counter drag and drop**: Items can be dragged and dropped onto counter squares for quick access and to monitor item counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886949049147515)
- **counter square right-click options**: Right-click an individual counter square to Use Item, Remove Item, or assign use of the item to a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886949049147515)
- **counters feature**: Enable Counters via Options > Counters, drag and drop items onto squares for quick access and to monitor item counts, and right-click a square to use the item, remove it, or assign it to a hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554806879702622209)
- **counters toggle and settings**: Counters can be toggled on or off via Options > Counters, where highlighting settings and the number of columns and rows can also be adjusted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536886949049147515)
- **cracking objects aspect proc boost**: Cracking these objects temporarily increases your Aspect Proc chances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546601759865049098)
- **crafter template and echo**: A separate crafter cannot fit on the same template as a PvM character and so needs an echo; time-reduction customizations are only worth buying on your main account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526295437299023932)
- **crafters for weekly society quests**: Having crafters is very worthwhile for the weekly society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545846413567594567)
- **crafting skill armor bonuses**: Blacksmithing bonuses apply to any armor of the type that skill could craft, including magic armor and not only player-crafted items; carpentry and tailoring work the same way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542263590646452266)
- **creating an echo**: To create an echo, eat essence commodities; they drop at your feet, then you target yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525619842605125775)
- **creating echoes from banked arcane essence**: To create an echo that requires a large amount of arcane essence, consume essence so the echo is created from your character's banked pool of essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553523889349464156)
- **creating macros**: Open Options > Macros to create a new macro entry, choose an action, then set a hotkey and/or generate a button that performs the macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553139849433841827)
- **creature corpse decay rules**: Per the April 4 2024 patch notes, a carved creature corpse with 0 items decays after 60 consecutive seconds, and an uncarved corpse with 0 items decays after 5 consecutive minutes; standard decay is typically 15 minutes but varies for bosses and event creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555494141037645868)
- **creature experience source**: A creature's experience is tied to its creature difficulty rather than the gold it drops, though difficulty roughly correlates with gold dropped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546648773642424340)
- **crew loyalty bonuses**: Increasing a crew member's loyalty raises their HP, damage, wrestling, and ship bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540757979001917480)
- **criminal targeting risk**: In areas where criminality can occur, any player can be targeted by criminals, as there are no levels or protections shielding players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537968344312053843)
- **criminal timer after failed stealing**: After a failed steal attempt you stay criminal to the victim for roughly a minute or two: the victim can call guards for about 30 seconds and you appear grey to them somewhat longer, probably around 2 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538586681396174848)
- **cripple effect**: The Cripple effect lowers the enemy's weapon skill by up to 30%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520883001460785233)
- **cripple effect**: Cripple gives bigger poison ticks and more accuracy for you and your pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542302913047830629)
- **croatz build redline requirement**: The Croatz build requires a lot of redline because redline provides damage and damage resistance through additional codex points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521612195169964234)
- **cross healing amount**: Cross healing with veterinary supplies or bandages reportedly heals about 50% of normal healing values, and the choice between the two likely does not matter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522214801290297345)
- **crossover penalty for cure and resurrect**: The crossover penalty is 50% against healing amounts and against the chances for cure and resurrect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538891479462846476)
- **crows after pk kills innocent**: When a PK kills an innocent player, crows appear on other players' screens so they can leave. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526045271404970115)
- **curing disease**: Disease is not cured the same way as poison; Cleansing Brew from Brewing can cure it, and Chivalry may offer a countermeasure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535888226965921792)
- **curio dye application**: Applying a curio dye requires applying it twice to confirm the application. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543004018534654133)
- **current event score accumulation**: In the current event, your score accumulates each time you return rather than counting only your best score. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525826456981209169)
- **cursor stuck holding item**: If your cursor is stuck holding an item (for example when Razor gets stuck), you may be unable to double-click your main bag, and relogging can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549823536833765520)
- **custom skill gump**: To get a skill gump matching the custom style, go to Options > General, scroll to gumps and context, and deselect 'use standard skills gump'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525679575424565279)
- **customization account scope**: Customizations apply to one account only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534033553057255434)
- **customization versus original uo**: Apart from movement and interacting with objects, practically everything in Outlands has been customized compared with original UO. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541506500076511302)
- **customizations and enhancements menu**: The customizations and enhancements menu can be opened by typing [customizations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543745652192714914)
- **daemon scroll summoning of greater or elder daemons**: Outlands has no known mechanic that uses daemon scrolls to summon a stronger Greater or Elder daemon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548026783427858444)
- **damage by player multiplier scope**: Multiplicative Damage by Player bonuses apply to all player damage, including explosion potions and aspect proc damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533747441680125993)
- **damage command meter**: The [damage command shows a damage/gold meter that can be used to measure the effect of build changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532410925628526674)
- **damage dealt by player link scope**: The 'damage dealt by player' link applies to all damage done by yourself, with the exception of follower damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531608442853261353)
- **damage dealt by player links**: Damage dealt by player (DDBP) links are multiplicative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521585813643591832)
- **damage display option**: Damage can be shown where the system messages pop up when you untick the attack/target name overhead option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529799306939334748)
- **damage increase at minimum magic resist**: Once a monster's magic resist reaches its minimum, damage dealt to it noticeably increases. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529139236601860197)
- **damage meter attack speed accuracy**: The damage meter does not count all attack speed modifiers, so damage-per-swing estimates are approximate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531325512880750656)
- **damage meter inflated results**: The damage meter can show inflated results if it is run up after being stopped; resetting and re-running gives accurate numbers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531331244326125669)
- **damage mitigation sources**: Damage mitigation comes mainly from your build and your aspect and aspect level rather than from links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553143946652295269)
- **damage resistance cap**: Damage resistance is capped, and most players reach or nearly reach the cap through aspects at level 13+, so the Mirror stance's resistance matters less later and only its magic mitigation remains useful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529069522189942855)
- **damage resistance cap**: The damage resistance cap is around 45%, though the actual cap is hidden and its workings are unclear, and all bonuses are reportedly multiplicative with each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528159964609384529)
- **damage scaling and follower aggro**: Characters need aspects and codex progression to significantly increase their damage, and tamers and summoners can venture into more dangerous areas because their followers hold aggro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538616228862632037)
- **damage spell cap against players**: Inscription, camping and tracking are included in the 10% cap on damage spells against players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539455804665495552)
- **damage to diseased link requires necromancy**: The 'damage to diseased' link requires the necromancy skill, so a build without necromancy must use the death chain instead if it wants that chain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531825342228988046)
- **damage to diseased mastery link scope**: The Damage to Diseased (D2D) mastery chain link increases only the player's own damage, not the damage of followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545267822723076248)
- **damage tracker command**: A damagetracker, invoked with the [damagetracker command, is available for running damage tests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546374655949152307)
- **damage tracker command**: Players can open the damage tracker in Outlands with the [damagetracker command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542520644523266048)
- **damage tracker dot categories**: The damage tracker treats bleeds, poisons and diseases as individual damage types that roll up into special damage, though poison may be tracked separately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542520985251610704)
- **damage tracker gold per hour**: The damage tracker lets you monitor your gold per hour so you can judge whether you are farming too slowly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541852839985549384)
- **damage-to-x bonus stacking**: Damage-to-X bonuses add together into a single bucket that then multiplies with other damage sources, so having several gives more damage than one but they do not multiply against each other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540385435262652486)
- **dangerous trapped containers**: Boxes and chests trapped by player tinkers are the dangerous traps that can hurt you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521219265674350765)
- **day/night cycle**: Outlands does not currently have a day/night cycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540422686956593374)
- **ddbp chromatic link investment**: DDBP is a chromatic link, which makes it a better investment overall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551422928459923608)
- **ddbp link on pets**: The Damage Dealt By Player (ddbp) link does not work on pets, so it does not boost pet damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527470789228494898)
- **dead bonded mount resurrection**: A dead bonded mount such as an ostard cannot be ridden, but taking it near a healer brings up a gump pop-up that lets you resurrect it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537873052803538984)
- **deadly boomboxes against thieves**: Deadly boomboxes work similarly to trapped pouches in protecting items from thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521723879834255400)
- **death item loss and resurrection**: Most items drop on death and no container keeps reagents on your body, so you can only resurrect with blessed items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532749489423777844)
- **death looting rules**: On death your items stay on your corpse and can be looted by a thief or red who stops by, and once the corpse turns to bones anyone can loot it and remain blue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523334111421267988)
- **decayed pack animal corpse blessed items**: If a pack animal's corpse decays, the blessed items it carried reportedly return to the owner's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539344350926872697)
- **decoded t-map time limit**: After the T-map update, a decoded map must be completed within 1 hour of decoding or it is deleted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531068818347262073)
- **decoded treasure map timer**: Click a decoded map to see how much time remains before it expires. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540324821823651840)
- **decoy item against thieves**: Carrying a decoy item in the main bag can make thieves steal it instead of valuable items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534306328200085617)
- **dedicated pvm character and account-wide links**: Keeping PvM on one dedicated character frees the other character slots to take advantage of account-wide link unlocks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526965206973153320)
- **default chat history hotkeys**: Ctrl+Q and Ctrl+W are preset to navigate the chat input history, which only matters if you do not use Enter for chat, so they are rarely a conflict. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533323546351108319)
- **default ping keybind**: The default ping keybind is Alt+Click. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532104311532814476)
- **default scroll wheel targeting**: By default, scrolling up targets your last target and scrolling down targets yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529239622566285352)
- **defensive links list**: Defensive links include Melee Defense, Physical Damage Resistance and Spell Damage Resistance, among others. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1527331052836753529)
- **deleting blessed items**: To delete a blessed item you must burn it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521117994640740383)
- **deleting health bars with alt right click**: Holding Alt and right-clicking a health bar deletes it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523409506028093611)
- **detachable journal tabs**: Journal tabs can be detached from the main journal, which allows a separate combat log. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535397091256565843)
- **detect distinguishing grey and red hand thieves**: Players with Detect can discern whether a thief is a grey hand or a red hand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546638265405145231)
- **detecting hidden immunity message**: A Detecting Hidden message saying the target is immune means the player has lockpicked within the last 60 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552248081863671861)
- **developer intent for t8 maps**: The developers do not want T8 maps to be soloable, and a major goal has been to remove solo T8 runs for many players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528901989445144628)
- **dexer codex unlocks**: Dexer codices can eventually be fully unlocked, and players can switch between their options on the go. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539730400065233036)
- **dexxer mana usage**: Dexxers no longer use mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521894237145403613)
- **disabling additional chat activation buttons**: To stop additional buttons from activating chat, open Options > Speech and turn off 'Use additional buttons to activate chat'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1546700661385863310)
- **disabling aspect gain messages**: Aspect gain overhead messages can be turned off through the text menu opened with the [Commands command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529185310104359052)
- **disabling footstep sounds**: In the in-game options under Sound, uncheck footsteps to stop footstep sounds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521530166214656040)
- **disabling on-screen counters**: To turn off the on-screen counters, open the options and disable them under the Counters section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527992031043915807)
- **disarm mechanic**: Disarm appears to be a separate weapon special attack rather than an automatic effect of Arms Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527086953244266607)
- **disarming trapped boxes in backpacks**: There is currently no way to disarm a trapped box in a player's backpack other than triggering it, with potentially lethal consequences, so it works as a thief-proof protection method. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527622796073505020)
- **discipline armor mana finisher requirement**: The discipline armor mana-trigger requirement for the finisher bonus was removed in a recent change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530000081615454379)
- **discipline aspect drunkenness**: The Discipline Aspect can make players drunk, and some players run it hoping for a special effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524992455190118532)
- **discipline aspect mana requirement**: Discipline Aspect likely no longer requires the old mana condition (wearing a wizard hat or playing drunk), though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548550453925646357)
- **discipline melee damage bonus**: The Discipline melee damage bonus is additive, so it is less valuable than it first appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542322672954904647)
- **disconnect lockout and dungeon item loss**: After a brief power or internet disconnect, a player can remain locked out of Outlands for about 5 minutes after reconnecting, and a prolonged disconnect of around 30 minutes risks losing items in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522856887748657184)
- **disconnecting while holding cursor item**: If you disconnect while holding an item on the cursor, the item may end up on the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544042421401419857)
- **discordance effect scaling on creatures**: Since the June 23, 2023 patch, Discordance effects on creatures scale to the bard's printed Discordance skill divided by 120, as a percent of normal effectiveness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526660041107570739)
- **discordance retry delay**: After a failed Discordance attempt, the player must wait 5 seconds before trying again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544676980312645773)
- **discordance skill effect**: Discordance skill mainly affects the duration and success chance of discordance on creatures. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526660217687769148)
- **diseased links for arcane mage**: Swapping some spell aspect chance links to damage to diseased links improves mana management and adds a little damage for an arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525915568270741746)
- **disguise kit and incognito**: A disguise kit changes name and appearance but requires Thieves Guild membership, while the Incognito spell changes them temporarily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525878492317745193)
- **dismembering player corpses**: Outside Shelter, a customization lets you dismember player corpses and collect their heads. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525600484780408872)
- **dispelling gates on outlands**: On Outlands, dispelling a gate with Dispel Field removes it on both sides, unlike old-school UO where only the dispelled side was removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536559315039686667)
- **displaying a trophy icon on the paperdoll**: Open Help > Achievements and go to the 3rd page (Trophies); unlocked trophies have a gem that you click to activate them so the icon shows on the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539085425342283776)
- **distill use in mount breeding**: Distills can be used for mount breeding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679327864426547)
- **dot types on mobs**: There are four DoT types that can be placed on mobs: fire, bleed, disease and poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542514313174982738)
- **double click item moving and auto equip**: Double clicking items in a container moves them to your backpack, and holding ctrl while double clicking armor pieces from a corpse auto-equips them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521136400601186477)
- **double click to loot setting**: To enable looting by double click, open Options > Interface > Containers and turn on 'Double click to loot items inside containers'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530563022672756826)
- **double proc of maps inside chests**: After the patch, maps found inside chests can double proc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536825306751434904)
- **double right-click pathfinding**: The double right-click pathfinding option has been removed from the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525961215627759717)
- **drag select settings location**: Drag select settings are found at Options > General > Health Bars & Drag Select > Drag Select. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523409849226887368)
- **dragon fire breath ability type**: Dragon fire breath is likely just a basic attack and not an immolation ability for taming bestiary purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545105728929267823)
- **dropping items onto character**: Dropping an item onto your character is treated as dropping it into the top level of your backpack, so loot held in a sub-container is not automatically stacked into that sub-container. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546364032938934383)
- **druid magic school**: A druid magic school is a planned feature that has reportedly been delayed several times, with no confirmed release date. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541489333666844772)
- **dry docking boats**: A boat that is dry docked can be lost, so players should use the dock master at the dock instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521724732423274656)
- **dual aspect xp rate**: Activating the aspect on both armor and spellbook doubles aspect XP gain compared to activating only one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527697222488293437)
- **dual weapon skill damage bonus**: Having two weapon skills at 80 grants a 20% damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555026290556543007)
- **dungeon antiquity**: A dungeon antiquity is a rare decoration item that can be registered at an in-game item to count towards some achievements, and otherwise serves only as decoration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538707288489984142)
- **dungeon chest respawn time**: Dungeon chest respawn time increases with chest level, and very low level chests probably respawn in about 15 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554841190619160627)
- **dungeon death region restrictions**: Murderers who die in a Dungeon (not Wilderness) always receive a minimum 15-minute Region Restriction for that region in addition to any restrictions from recent murders, and thieves who die in a Dungeon now also receive a region restriction of 30 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539685501492011098)
- **dungeon flashpoint event**: Dungeon Flashpoint is a PvP king-of-the-hill style event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553463550125801505)
- **dungeon murder alert range**: A dungeon murder alert applies to anywhere in the dungeon, not just the level the murder occurred on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539433272176812134)
- **dungeon re-entry cooldown after death**: There is no cooldown to re-enter a dungeon after dying unless you are Red, and then it applies only if you committed crimes while inside. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554856241795301501)
- **dungeon xp buff scope**: The dungeon XP buff applies to all of a character's experience systems, including codex, aspects, chains, and redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524961609917927495)
- **duplicate lore pages**: When gathering lore pages, you can receive the same lore page more than once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552964880490037282)
- **durability and repair rules**: Gear never breaks; tools break at 0 durability and can never be repaired, instruments break at 0 but can be repaired with a repair bench before they run out, and other items just lose effectiveness at 0. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542303164835963000)
- **early aspect leveling and core shock**: Leveling a B-A tier aspect rather than an S tier aspect early may save on core shock once you reach about tier 10, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523772040706916544)
- **earth and water aspects**: The Earth and Water aspects are considered weak and slow to progress with, so Air and Discipline are recommended instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524071517875339265)
- **earth phylactery guaranteed aspect proc**: A phylactery such as the Earth Phylactery gives one guaranteed aspect proc for its matching aspect, usable once per hour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631584137224363)
- **eating magic mushroom while pvp flagged**: The game may prevent eating a Magic Mushroom while the player is flagged in PvP, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536210539867283536)
- **echo**: An echo is a second build on the same character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533002247582253066)
- **echo build slot cost**: Unlocking an echo (an alternate build slot) costs roughly 450k and lets you swap between two builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1556009778080256041)
- **echo builds**: Echoes allow a character to have almost any build, and a summoner echo is easy to obtain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533925956295725266)
- **echo character timing**: An echo is best made later, once the main template is sorted and upgrades are affordable, and it should use a different set of skills and a different aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527685090878947438)
- **echo characters for aspects**: Ideally each account has a gatherer echo of the main character to work Harvest Aspect and a crafting echo of the main to work Artisan Aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534393327204565214)
- **echo characters via codexes**: Additional characters with other weapon skills can be created later as echoes using other codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554396456142643213)
- **echo cooldown reduction**: The echo cooldown can be bought down. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523771830853308466)
- **echo cooldown reduction source**: The echo cooldown reduction is an account customization available by typing [customizations, not a Prevalia vendor item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524830669476335738)
- **echo cost and build flexibility**: Echoes let one character have more builds since the character holds every codex, aspect and chain, but echoes and their cooldowns are expensive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529949184029884567)
- **echo cost scaling**: Echo costs scale linearly: the first echo costs x, the second 2x, the third 3x, and so on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523750292427116575)
- **echo count limit**: There is no known limit to the number of echoes a character can have, though this is based on player knowledge rather than an official statement. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520508452185702411)
- **echo duplication overwrite**: Copying a different echo over an existing echo replaces it entirely, so copying the wrong echo over a 120 mining echo loses that echo's skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541437207473037312)
- **echo duplication warning**: The red confirmation warning shown when duplicating an echo displays the skills of the two copies being duplicated rather than the echo being overwritten, so it does not clearly show what will be lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1541511823746924677)
- **echo for holding skills**: An echo can be used to hold expensive or difficult-to-train skills so a player can easily switch to any build they want. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529168687423291603)
- **echo lock duration**: Without an additional investment, a player is locked into an echo for 12 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521641298355027988)
- **echo overwrite behavior**: Clicking overwrite on an echo changes the echo on the right to match the current character and leaves the other echo untouched. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524837325224542208)
- **echo overwrite button**: The overwrite button copies the stats and skills on the left onto the echo on the right, replacing that echo's existing setup. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532286177749635113)
- **echo slots**: Every character has one echo slot by default, and buying a second echo provides two configurations to swap between. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543437369376509963)
- **echo template adjustment**: An echo template can be adjusted or reworked later without repurchasing the echo system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541793169363173467)
- **echo template switching**: An Echo lets a character switch between skill templates once every 12 hours at no additional cost, or faster with a cooldown as short as 15 minutes at a total cost of roughly 10 million gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532713133989171230)
- **echo template switching**: Unlocking only one echo is enough to switch between two templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538897056654041211)
- **echo template switching**: Echoes work like separate templates that swap places with the current build, and swapping between them is limited by cooldowns that may need to be purchased. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540795614776791090)
- **echoes and aspects sharing**: Echoes are not mandatory but save gold long term because all Aspects can be unlocked on one character and shared across templates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523747565483462698)
- **echoes as character versions**: Echoes are different versions of the same character, so many players prefer one PvM character with many echoes and aspects over many separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549315502550159482)
- **echoes build switching**: Echoes let you save a copy of a character's stats and skill points so you can switch builds on a cooldown, which reportedly starts around 24 hours and can be reduced to 15 minutes with upgrades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529290629027467334)
- **echoes scope**: Echoes are tracked per character, not per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533700940484317345)
- **echoes stat and skill snapshot**: Echoes store a snapshot of a character's stats and skills at a specific time, so a player can change stats and then use an echo to swap back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543353403940536481)
- **echoes usage restrictions**: Echoes cannot be used in the Arena, within 5 minutes of PvP combat, or within 2 minutes of PvM combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542972403695755325)
- **effective arcane and wrestling**: Effective Arcane is mirrored by Wrestling, so an arcane build needs both Arcane and Wrestling and no followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546170147981754459)
- **effective barding links**: Effective barding links increase barding success chance against higher level monsters, barding duration, and barding song damage multipliers, and they are likely in a different bonus bucket than melee special chance and damage links, so mixing both may be best. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553169010785394809)
- **effective harvesting skill cap**: There is no hard cap on effective harvesting skill; a player could theoretically reach 167.5 with a T20 Harvest aspect and 15 Corrupted Harvest links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538949391216279614)
- **effective inscription effects**: Effective Inscription counts toward interrupt avoidance/immunity, spell scroll damage boost, scroll refund, buff duration, and spell perks like reactive armor hardiness, but not toward crafting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549151553024295035)
- **effective mining skill formula**: Effective mining skill equals raw skill plus harvest aspect plus harvest links, and it does not matter how the total reaches 110. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520935059283116033)
- **effective poisoning and poison tiers**: The interaction between effective Poisoning above 200 and poison tiers is unclear, since one player with four effective poison links still saw some Greater poisons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524311471734128730)
- **efficient tick damage bonus**: The 25% tick damage bonus from Efficient is now additive within a large bucket of additive bonuses, having been changed from multiplicative, so it is less impactful than before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544401795751870515)
- **eight-skill template and self taught perk**: A template with 8 skills will have one skill below 100 until the Self Taught codex perk is used to remove Musicianship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528699288304226354)
- **eldritch aspect**: The Eldritch aspect gives spell damage based on mana spent and a higher mana-refund cap, and includes Mana Well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533920623208955944)
- **eldritch aspect quality**: The Eldritch aspect is not considered a very good aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533098788493988022)
- **eldritch aspect tier 6 inscription bonus**: The Eldritch aspect at tier 6 grants +125 inscription, enabling capped scroll casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544542914833813514)
- **eldritch crystals in bag**: Players using Eldritch should always keep eldritch crystals in their bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526404811388358728)
- **eldritch summoner aspect progression**: An Eldritch summoner is better off sticking with Eldritch all the way to tier 15 unless bored of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526632163485679769)
- **eldritch tier 15 redline scalar**: Leveling Eldritch to tier 15 unlocks a 1/3 redline scalar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526404936219361442)
- **elementals follower classification**: Elementals count as followers, and summoned elementals may be classified under Necromancy for follower purposes, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541956026985619497)
- **emote deed use**: Double click an emote deed to unlock a random emote. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536395072675905536)
- **emote deeds and achievement points**: Laugh sounds and similar emotes are player customizations bought with achievement points via deeds; each deed grants a random new emote and becomes account-locked once used, though before use it can be traded or sold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524150886484414526)
- **emotes tab in customizations menu**: The emotes tab of the [customizations menu shows which emotes a player has unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536395161909727343)
- **endgame progression**: Outlands endgame progression involves obtaining a Codex, unlocking Aspect, and collecting chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520716250785775729)
- **endgame progression**: In Outlands, endgame is much harder than in traditional UO because reaching max skill is not enough; players must progress through all PvM systems to gain real power. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527067850374909982)
- **enemy of one ability**: Enemy of One increases only melee damage, and its bonus is added to the player's other melee damage rather than acting as a separate multiplier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521560559110062090)
- **enlarging health bar**: To enlarge your health bar, enable Options > Nameplates > Compact nameplates, or increase Options > Video > Display Scale to make the whole interface larger. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548409408592023583)
- **equipping unidentified items**: Unidentified items can be equipped, but their bonuses are more effective once identified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548189063041908818)
- **essence burn at aspect cap**: Arcane essence continues to be consumed while an aspect is capped and no longer gaining experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527696619271753779)
- **essence removal from menu**: Essence cannot be taken back out of the menu once it has been drunk, so load only what you need. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532500812834537735)
- **essence usage and recycling**: Most builds need to recycle everything they find to keep up with essence usage, though it can sometimes be more efficient to take gold instead and buy essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553904498471346201)
- **essence yield from identified items**: Identified items give more arcane essence when recycled than unidentified ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553526424617492500)
- **estimating rope range with out-of-range color option**: Enable 'No color for objects out of range' in Options > General to show an 18-tile range cutoff as grayscale, then place the cursor roughly halfway between the character and the grayscale cutoff to estimate distance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546901250958958672)
- **estimating unlocked mastery link slots**: Without a chain, estimate your unlocked mastery link slots by checking your gold-collected achievements (Achievements > Luxury > Affluent) against the cumulative gold table on the mastery chain wiki page; this is only a rough estimate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553061265293975554)
- **evaluating intelligence spell damage bonus**: In Outlands, Evaluating Intelligence at 100 skill gives a 50% spell damage increase, while 0 skill gives a -25% damage penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544888385640992870)
- **event dungeon gold and score scaling**: Gold and score earned in the event dungeons depend heavily on player count, since mob spawns are limited and more players means fewer mobs per player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526261688352112662)
- **event dungeon reward tiers**: In the event dungeons, end-of-event rewards include all rewards up to and including whichever tier your total score places you in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526262142976790568)
- **event item conversion**: Winter crackers, battle commendations and similar item-giving things stay as they are until the player initiates the change; they do not convert on their own, though this is stated with some uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527481504161333288)
- **event reward delivery location**: Event rewards are delivered to the bank of the specific character that turned in the items, so check that character's bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520581361235398737)
- **event standing check**: Open the [eventscore command and press the button at the bottom that shows your character to see your event standing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520582487192109116)
- **experience sharing in parties**: Guild membership does not share experience automatically; you must form a party and check the EXP sharing box in the party window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553031475996262525)
- **experience versus skill gain**: Experience and skill gain are separate, different systems in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539347839287558204)
- **explorer pack consumption on map actions**: Players must have Explorer Packs in their backpack, which are consumed on successful completion of Decode Map and Reveal Camp actions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534323547634143262)
- **explorer pack use when digging too far**: Digging in a location too far from the chest might still consume an explorer pack, so more than 2 packs may be needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212776177827890)
- **extortion bonus and thieve's codex xp**: The Extortion bonus does not count towards Thieve's Codex XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531709947480510605)
- **extra gold drop chance link on treasure chests**: The extra gold drop chance link likely applies to treasure chests, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550316087214604359)
- **extra society quest customization scope**: The Extra Society quest customization applies only to the account it was purchased on, not to all accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536251171717644408)
- **face items over armor**: Some recently added face items can be worn over armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526318871693365419)
- **faction capture points and castle sieges**: Faction gameplay includes capture points and castles that can be besieged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531176883511754862)
- **faction city war**: Four cities are at war in the faction system, and players can opt in to that conflict for bonus rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546671929312809043)
- **faction dungeon rules**: Faction dungeons differ from normal dungeons in that players can ride mounts and recall in and out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552712701413949441)
- **faction dungeon score cap**: Faction dungeon score only counts up to twice your current faction score, so a current faction score of 0 caps dungeon score at 0; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538520254022688808)
- **faction flag run guild prestige**: Successful faction flag runs award guild prestige to players who significantly assisted, but it is unclear whether this guild prestige counts as PvP general reward points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528635534434369716)
- **faction hue requirements**: Faction hues require faction participation to wear, at least on clothes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545950420575199262)
- **faction names**: The four factions are Prevalia, Andaria, Terran and Cambria, and they represent major cities without much deeper lore or mechanics behind them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546698299195523082)
- **faction pvp rules**: Factions are a PvP system in which members can freely attack enemy factions anywhere, including in town, without going grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531176737608568842)
- **faction score earning limit per outlands id**: If you earn faction score on one character, no other character on the same Outlands ID can earn faction score until 1 hour has passed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537964440811471000)
- **faction vendor purchase requirements**: Buying faction shield cover and mount gear with faction silver probably requires being a member of the faction, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525396374680768552)
- **factions flagging and ganking**: Being in factions means you can be ganked pretty much anywhere, but faction flagging is disabled in PvP events like Town Struggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528353146219397160)
- **factions system**: Outlands has a Factions system that is documented on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534239874239037673)
- **factions versus pvp events**: Factions and PvP events are two separate systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529424816883634306)
- **failed methods for freeing stuck pets**: Saying "all follow me", using a nearby exit portal, or using 'pull followers' on self did not free a pet stuck in a wall. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525408705384808489)
- **faire tickets**: Faire tickets can be used to enter carnival-style games at the King's Faire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541625413476950036)
- **fame and death loss reference**: Fame and its loss on death are explained on the Reputation page of the Outlands wiki (wiki.uooutlands.com/Reputation). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527520162524434484)
- **fame and karma location**: Your Fame and Karma can be seen in the titles menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542553437583966269)
- **fame in sanctuary dungeon**: Fame in the Sanctuary dungeon is probably reduced along with other rewards there, though this is a guess. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533267715786276885)
- **fame requirement for lord title**: Fame is the stat that determines whether a player unlocks the Lord title. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542382821874729072)
- **fancy cosmetic piece slots**: Fancy cosmetic pieces are available only for the helm, neck, and gloves slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529085635812655145)
- **faster corpse looting**: To loot corpses faster, use grid loot, a grab hotkey that targets an item in the corpse, ctrl or alt plus double click to auto-equip an item from the corpse, or double click to move items into your bag; the exact modifier key (ctrl or alt) is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534566009393119312)
- **faster logout**: To log out faster, log out in an inn, or if not near an inn, use camping with a bedroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523316017831477310)
- **fastest path to full redline**: Leveling the same aspect on both weapon and armor may reach tier 15 at about 11 links, so with around 15 links raising two more aspects to tier 15 is likely quicker than reaching 30 links for 100% redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552984286343340094)
- **feeding distills to essence**: Distills can be fed into essence. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525679267931750430)
- **feeding pets during breeding**: Pets can be fed and watered during the breeding process. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534602197008908329)
- **fencing codex specials**: The Fencing codex has the Cripple and Bane specials. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542302431755509820)
- **field of view range**: The field of view in Ultima Online: Outlands extends 18 tiles from your character in each direction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538151531193303041)
- **fighting buffs from non-combat skills**: Skills considered useless on other shards, like cooking or camping, come with fighting buffs on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522386288064331797)
- **fighting efficiency leveling time**: Fighting Efficiency (FE) takes a very long time to level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541915428522299432)
- **filled boss token tome with gate active**: A boss token tome that is completely filled and displays 'gate active' has already been used and is now useless. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540457593221283843)
- **finding a buff name**: To find a buff's name, hover over it in your buff bar while it is active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565137225027726)
- **finisher selection**: Each codex offers two Finishers to choose from, toggled with the large button next to each, and players can switch between them freely at no cost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550096590486769704)
- **finishing tier 15 aspect before expanding**: Finishing a tier 15 aspect before expanding to others is recommended, because holy is an exceptional armor and weapon aspect for chivalry gating and group play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543622604118560789)
- **fire reflect damage mitigation bypass**: Fire reflect damage bypasses many forms of damage mitigation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537509444437680258)
- **first aspect activation slots**: When training a first aspect, it can be activated on both a weapon and armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536644926908010547)
- **first echo cost command**: Typing [echo in game shows the cost of the first echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522997435784364124)
- **fishing aspect alternatives**: There is no alternative aspect for fishing other than the Harvesting aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543409534826061954)
- **fist hit and interrupt avoidance formula**: The chance to hit with fists and to avoid interrupts while casting equals (attacker's wrestling + 50) / ((defender's weapon or wrestling skill + 50) * 2), plus relevant accuracy bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546656811484979220)
