- **fixing missing nameplate**: If a character's name stops showing above it, open the nameplates menu (Ctrl+Shift) and un-check then re-check 'always active'; right-clicking removes the nameplate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544522180266561576)
- **fixing queued item messages when looting**: To avoid the queued item messages bugging out when looting, set the auto-queue object delay to 600ms; alternatively disable auto-queue, but then failed actions require clicking again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535725856109109339)
- **focus refund chance**: Focus gives a refund chance that makes running a material book easier, and it also adds meditation rate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **focus ssi bonus**: Focus gives 12% SSI at 80 skill and 15% SSI at 100 skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552073770754121738)
- **focus stat effects**: Focus affects swing speed and accuracy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552866177020207235)
- **focusing on one aspect initially**: It is best to focus on a single aspect initially, since bouncing between aspects arrests progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523893835929747557)
- **follower damage against players in pvp**: Follower (pet and summon) damage against players in PvP is capped based on the amount of follower skills in the player's template, reportedly at roughly 7 damage per follower slot every 5 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538946575232139334)
- **follower damage chain activation**: A follower damage chain must be activated before it adds stats: equip it, or single-click it and choose Activate from the context menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540709248952963194)
- **follower damage links and summons**: Follower damage links buff the damage dealt by your summons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527439161248710737)
- **follower damage versus d2d links**: Follower damage links are better if pets are the main source of damage, while damage to diseased (D2D) links are better if you mostly cast spells with pets acting as meat shields. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545280116987269140)
- **follower rename field behavior**: The follower rename field does not clear itself when a name is unacceptable, so you must watch system messages to see whether the rename worked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529118394027212975)
- **follower roping mechanic change**: Followers once roped alongside the player, but the developer Luthius changed the follower mechanics after Elderstone reported it, so followers no longer do this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531094471016452106)
- **follower slot overflow**: If you have more followers than available follower slots, your pets stop responding to verbal commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525134985751953518)
- **follower slots**: A character has 5 follower slots; Colossal Frogs and Battle Toads take 2 each, so you can use only 2 of them, or 1 plus 3 familiars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525111158158262322)
- **follower speed cap**: The follower speed cap varies and can be checked on the Outlands Butler follower-stats page; the goal is to reach a breakpoint without going over it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541840683336339567)
- **follower speed links**: Follower speed links are useful up to the cap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555733993117323305)
- **followers damage multiplier**: Followers damage is believed to be the only damage bonus that is always a multiplier, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521585644231590141)
- **following players as harassment**: Continually following a player between dungeons and areas to interfere with them can count as griefing or harassment, whereas merely taking mobs in a shared dungeon does not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554994097637560391)
- **font client settings locations**: Font-related client settings are reportedly found at Options > Nameplates > Use chat font for nameplates, Options > Fonts, Journal > Settings > Style > Font, and Options > Tooltip > Tooltip font. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520958035672043580)
- **food bonus for dexxers**: Food reportedly gives a large bonus to dexxer builds, though the author is unsure about its value for mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539224999448281099)
- **food buff expiry alert**: To get a visible alert when a food buff wears off, create a cooldown in Options > Cooldown triggered by removal of that buff, enter the buff's name, and set a duration of 30 seconds to 1 minute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544565065884115086)
- **food buff refresh cooldown**: Moving to a higher food buff may be subject to a 60 second cooldown on refreshing the food buff, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526596159257182339)
- **food choice recommendation**: Players are advised to eat only the best food, such as Delectable food. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553908512860545055)
- **food mana regen effect**: Food gives a chance to regenerate 2 mana instead of 1 on each regen tick, and better food gives a higher chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545337746342543360)
- **food mechanics**: Food is used only for buffs, and players do not need to eat to survive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535736215825944606)
- **food saturation buff**: Normal foods can be eaten repeatedly to reach the full saturation buff but only with a cooldown, so players prefer player-made Delectable foods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525807110628180099)
- **food swing speed bonus and mining**: The swing speed bonus from eating food does not make mining faster and only helps if the character is also swinging a mace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522216610633482342)
- **forced area lighting**: Lighting in some areas is forced and cannot be changed through video options, so players must wait for daytime. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540848819779010612)
- **forcing buffs into buff bar**: New buffs cannot be forced into the buff bar by the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536899545550823454)
- **forensic evaluation and camping damage scaling**: Forensic Evaluation and Camping give the same amount of damage per skill point. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532461384879706132)
- **fort aspect armor for unlocking links**: The Fort aspect armor is what you want for unlocking Links quicker. Fort works on any build except that it is not recommended on a bard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523610692593254521)
- **fortune aspect**: Fortune is the aspect that combines harvesting with some killing power. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539657444232265728)
- **fortune aspect early value**: Players are typically better off choosing a different aspect than Fortune until they have finished their codices and have a handful of chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550413499140673617)
- **fortune aspect effects**: The Fortune aspect increases results for both chest opening and stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416534198030387)
- **fortune aspect on ocean**: The fortune aspect is reportedly still a worthwhile aspect for ocean activities and does not stop being good there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530892844544557138)
- **fortune aspect proc feedback**: The Fortune aspect proc gives only a sound and an animation, with no system message or buff bar entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549452450661011589)
- **fortune aspect purpose**: The Fortune aspect is not meant for farming but for specific content like boating or treasure mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523761915845673082)
- **fortune aspect usage**: Most players use the Fortune aspect only for lockpicking, treasure maps, or boating. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547879211811741767)
- **fps cap benefit**: There is likely no longer any benefit to playing at more than 60 FPS, although some exploits were previously tied to FPS. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537777731759116308)
- **free cure usage tracking**: Free cure usage is tracked in your counters, and a system message is likely shown when you receive a free cure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535081861984952382)
- **free resurrection at inn room**: A player can get a free resurrection by leaving their inn room and entering it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535988482483421305)
- **freedom and mixed results damage resistance**: Freedom combined with mixed results gives 17.5 DR, plus an additional 10 DR from resisting spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544130559360368670)
- **freedom in potion codex**: Freedom in the potion codex should have at least 2 clicks if the area where you fight has hinder effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525183935657807974)
- **freeing a pet stuck in a wall**: To free a pet stuck in a wall, go to a stable, click the "More Options" button at the bottom of the Stable UI, and choose "Retrieve lost followers"; the pet teleports to you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525407519223054549)
- **friends list absence**: Outlands has no friends list, so a player can sometimes not be found when only their character name is known. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537256417201758268)
- **front arc visual guide**: A visual guide to the first (target) arc was published in the patch notes for the May 30, 2026 mini-expansion and Ossuary 4 patch. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528134245980307546)
- **full scaler at 30 links**: Players reportedly get the full scaler at 30 links, and leveling from 20+ links is faster than from 0-20. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532401340020687132)
- **full stamina benefits**: Having full stamina lets you hit faster and walk over players and monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532833020145565808)
- **fully modified magic items**: It is theoretically possible to roll a magic item with every modifier, such as Indestructible Supremely Accurate Vanquishing Greater Slaying, but such an item would be exceptionally rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542298140097511525)
- **fully shadow meaning**: Being fully shadow means using the Shadow aspect on both weapon and armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521650810541572116)
- **gadget aspect special trigger sources**: The Gadget aspect special can be triggered by weapons, spells, and traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532801962092007575)
- **gadget aspect value**: The Gadget aspect is valued mainly for its trap cooldown reduction. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539444724694261841)
- **gadget special with arcane staff**: With an arcane staff equipped, all three Gadget aspect special trigger sources (weapon, spell, trap) can roll at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532812794607566959)
- **gadget trap trigger chance with spellbook**: Holding a spellbook instead of a weapon should not change the chance for traps to trigger the Gadget aspect special, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532812694707638432)
- **game play window size setting**: If the game window displays wrongly, set a specific size under Options > Video > World Viewport > Game Play Window Size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534194268485320824)
- **game sound file packaging**: The game's individual sounds are packaged together and cannot be accessed as separate files in the game folder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521533012251246823)
- **gate duration**: Gates last considerably longer than players expect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546225169700233337)
- **gate use against red players**: If you attack a red (murderer) player you cannot use gates to escape, but being attacked by a red does not prevent gate use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536851229857288322)
- **gatherer multiboxing removal**: There is unconfirmed discussion on test/admin chatter about removing the ability to multibox gatherers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532813928101576885)
- **gathering and redline experience**: Gathering does not currently contribute to redline experience, which largely locks gatherers out of a major area of the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525888080840757278)
- **gear re-equip hotkey**: In the later early game, a player can re-equip a full gear set at home with a single hotkey press. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520479124903166114)
- **ghost timeout**: A ghost times out after 30 minutes and relocates to a town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533242734993997898)
- **ghost visibility and pets**: Even when a player turns off ghost visibility, ghosts can still see that player's pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530266066356404274)
- **ghost visibility in war mode**: Players can see ghosts only when the ghost is in war mode, and ghosts can see players only while in war mode, unless the players are allies or have opted to be seen using the [GhostVisible command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551287068381155411)
- **going grey in sanctuary dungeons**: Players normally cannot go grey in a sanctuary dungeon such as Cavernam, though rare one-off cases have reportedly occurred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522326323274715327)
- **gold carry capacity**: A player can carry roughly 15k gold at the start, about 30k with the gold weight customizations, about 60k with customizations and camping, and about 80k when effective camping links are added. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522273677641781389)
- **gold decay on npc corpses**: Gold on an NPC creature corpse reduces by 50% when the corpse becomes freely lootable (5 minutes after death), then by 10% every 60 seconds afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530587023486877888)
- **gold weight customizations and pack size**: Two purchasable customizations each reduce gold weight by 25%, and the Camping skill or effective camping links increase pack size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522273677641781389)
- **gold-value monster kill quest location**: Once you accept the quest to kill X gold worth of monsters, you can complete it anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533837982161834015)
- **golden beetle as follower**: A golden beetle can be kept as a follower but does not act as a pack animal that carries items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540173843526717440)
- **golden beetle as pack animal**: Only pack horses and llamas serve as pack animals; a golden beetle cannot carry items as a pack animal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540171000887517344)
- **golemancy upcoming content**: Golemancy is reportedly an upcoming content addition in which crafting Golems will require gems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547974832111620161)
- **grab item hotkey**: A Grab or Grab Item hotkey can be bound; pressing it and targeting an item moves it into your backpack, but it is still subject to the 500 ms item-move delay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527677372415873136)
- **gray hand thieves guild pilfering**: The Gray Hand thieves guild allows you to pilfer from monsters, which yields gold and a chance at an item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550327206952181791)
- **gray names for criminals**: Players who have recently stolen or committed a criminal act appear with gray names and healthbars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537968819103076373)
- **great shuck off missing reward**: If a Great Shuck Off event reward does not appear, it may be stuck in the bank queue because the character's bank box is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520580814352679082)
- **greater strength potion hit point bonus**: A greater strength potion gives about 20 extra hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784964800315443)
- **green potions on the ground**: Clicking a green potion left on the ground uses it instead of picking it up, and it can poison you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526111713949384844)
- **grey boundaries outside line of sight option**: The option to show grey boundaries outside line of sight is found under Options, General. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531670113693208637)
- **grey hand thief attackability**: A Grey Hand thief is not open to being attacked anytime and anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550883151109296130)
- **grey nameplate criminal status**: A grey nameplate means the player is a criminal, and the criminal flag lasts only for a timer after which the player returns to blue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528349371278688316)
- **grey players in sanctuaries**: A grey (criminal-flagged) player can enter sanctuaries but cannot perform criminal actions inside them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522330223801143356)
- **grey timer after attack**: When you are attacked, the attacker becomes grey to you and you become grey to them for roughly 2 minutes, and attacking each other refreshes the timer so you can freely fight back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531171009917620265)
- **grid loot**: Grid loot, enabled in Options > General, shows a book-like menu of a corpse's loot where clicking items loots them into the set loot bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555382402275082271)
- **grid loot bag**: Set a loot bag in the grid loot settings (or via an in-game macro) so looted items go into that container; if none is set, loot scatters through the backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551916238433820763)
- **grid loot containers in corpses**: With grid loot only, you cannot open a container inside a corpse without looting it or dragging it to the ground; opening containers requires the corpse gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537428856020009040)
- **grid loot delay**: Grid loot has an inherent delay of a few hundred milliseconds between clicks, and there is no setting to remove it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529622066481856584)
- **grid loot hotbar button**: A hotbar button similar to Grab Item is connected to the Grid Loot feature. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536474101621989396)
- **grimoire magery specificity**: The grimoire is Magery specific and gives bonuses to various spellcasts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544919281572118559)
- **grimoire upgrade scope**: Grimoire upgrades apply only to the spell they are listed under. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522642404841226432)
- **guard call window after theft**: After a theft you have roughly 25 seconds to call guards on the thief, after which the thief is safe even if grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534305696760201296)
- **guard response to thieves**: Guards may not always kill a thief automatically, as there is reportedly a chance they do not respond. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538396116599709706)
- **guard-kill theft penalty**: A thief killed by guards in a town receives an increasing further -10% penalty to theft chances in that area, lasting 12 hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037583154323598)
- **guards bank room hotkey**: The 'guards bank room' hotkey combines three commands: it calls guards, opens your bank box if you are near the bank, and opens the inn room menu if you are near an innkeeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539085849155739688)
- **guards vs red players**: Guards in town attack red (murderer) players immediately; their behavior toward thieves is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523834389182681279)
- **guild activities**: Guilds offer lucrative activities such as very high level treasure maps that scale with the number of participating players, caravans, and dungeon crawls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546672655627718759)
- **guild benefit for codex farming**: Joining a guild is the strongest boost for farming codex points, and guild boss runs are a great way to gain them, though generally you just keep killing stuff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521741308014755941)
- **guild boss and caravan loot**: Joining your guild for boss and caravan activities earns you good loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520287807719997521)
- **guild boss summoning cost**: Guilds must earn gold in the dungeon to summon their boss, the cost increases with each summon, and the cost resets on Fridays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553159064408555541)
- **guild caravan event bar**: Gathering resources increases a guild caravan event bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521908814482505921)
- **guild diplomacy peaceful status**: A guild shown as peaceful in guild diplomacy only means you are not at war with them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527038202509000906)
- **guild dungeon boss bar bank cap**: The maximum you can bank on a guild dungeon boss bar is 2x the cost of your most expensive summon (main or mini) in that region. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523080198361317568)
- **guild event bars and prestige**: Most of a guild member's actions passively contribute to several guild event bars and earn guild prestige, which earns the guild temporary favors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521908343868883014)
- **guild leaving cooldown**: Leaving a guild in Outlands costs the player nothing personally, but a three-day cooldown applies before the player can join another guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545228188022476851)
- **guild membership scope**: Guild membership is per character, not per account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551292920282226700)
- **guild prestige and favors**: Several activities add guild prestige, and each prestige threshold earns the guild a new favor, such as bonus damage or gold in a specific dungeon for a limited time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520288020748566628)
- **guild prestige rewards**: Guilds can earn prestige rewards, including a custom guild house or island at roughly 5000 prestige. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550143965146259498)
- **guild requirements for pvp events**: Dungeon flashpoints and town pvp require being in a guild, while shrines do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552948768662622250)
- **guild swap timers**: A 3-day timer applies to swapping guilds, added because players used to constantly jump guilds for harvest buffs; it also applies to PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529095950415560744)
- **guild switching cooldown**: The guild switching cooldown is believed to be 3 days. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534542323831275631)
- **guild use of research materials**: Guilds use research materials to make tier 8 maps to obtain links for the guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532998943426744471)
- **gump layers**: The client program places gumps into layers, and some gumps change layers when clicked while others do not. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523448216904011986)
- **gump manager red pin**: To use a gump placed in the gump manager, hold ctrl+alt until a red pin appears on it, then click the red pin, though the click location can be finicky. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546954828452995103)
- **gump override coverage**: The Outlands gump override feature appears to cover only the backpack and paperdoll gumps, though other containers such as boxes may be possible to work out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531091759310831747)
- **gump overrides for ui appearance**: Gump overrides can change the look of the backpack and other gumps in Outlands, and the wiki page Gump_Overrides has instructions but no example images. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531091177070399568)
- **gump position settings**: To change where pop-up windows such as the storage shelf or animal lore info appear, open Options > Gump Manager; hovering over the ? in the bottom right gives instructions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541861824817799218)
- **hair and beard colour changes**: Hair and beard colour can be changed at the stylist back to colours already used, while other dyed items are likely one-time changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525581127027523605)
- **hair dye on test server**: On the test server, hair dye is obtained through the dye tomes in Prevalia, including a full dye tome, and aspect hair dye can be made using Prevalian Merchant Dyes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528329136060239964)
- **hand requirement for thief's codex quest**: Any hand works for the quest as long as the player can use the Thief's Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538061840326590535)
- **harvest and fortune on treasure chests**: For treasure chests, the Harvest aspect increases gold while the Fortune aspect increases experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538108889281863710)
- **harvest aspect proc links**: No link or mechanic is known to make the Harvest aspect proc more often. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543521027253076048)
- **harvest aspect switch cooldown**: Harvest Aspect has a 60 second cooldown before it becomes active after switching to it, which was added to prevent quickly swapping aspects to open locked chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521056702001184858)
- **harvest aspect with forensics for society characters**: Combining Harvest aspect with the Forensics skill is a good way to get society characters unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537619241702789150)
- **harvest experience with mixed aspects**: If weapon and armor carry different aspects, harvest experience is probably shared between them, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535914835257065583)
- **harvest gear switch cooldown**: After switching to harvest gear, there is a one-minute cooldown before the extra skill and proc chance take effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535717813875122266)
- **harvest level 10 experience requirement**: The experience required to reach the next Harvest level jumps considerably around Harvest level 10. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539274937548668928)
- **harvest map stealing after patch**: After the patch, in-progress harvest maps are blessed and cannot be stolen mid-harvest, while undecided (not yet started) maps may still be stolen, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536938890395389972)
- **harvest tier 15 redline unlock**: Reaching harvest tier 15 gives a second redline unlock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1520926331083165757)
- **harvesting aspect double chance**: The chance of the Harvesting Aspect doubling a stackable item scales with aspect tier, with a T15 aspect giving a 36% chance to double. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524197220981801051)
- **harvesting aspect doubling**: The Harvesting Aspect can double stackable harvested items, except redline bottles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1524196485233770717)
- **harvesting aspect experience**: Actual harvesting activities such as lumberjacking and mining do not produce aspect experience for aspects other than the Harvest aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555358981742927976)
- **harvesting aspect scope**: The Harvesting Aspect applies to all harvesting activities, including chopping trees and mining ore, not only treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523855058771509318)
- **heal potion cooldown**: Heal potions have a cooldown, and there is no system indicator showing when another can be drunk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521780255415861288)
- **healer codex utilities**: The Healer codex provides utilities such as a large self veterinary supply, reduced damage from bleed and disease, and increased damage resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553764915385204819)
- **healer pet resurrection**: Healers resurrect pets; after being revived you may need to walk a few steps away and re-approach the healer to get the horse resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542260421992648916)
- **healer's codex respec**: The healer's codex can be freely respecced, unlike a weapon codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529929920887918733)
- **healers codex click usage**: One player uses 3 codex clicks in Beyond Borders and 2 clicks elsewhere, except for Pressure Points and self treatment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533060313912578059)
- **healers codex pet support**: The Healers Codex appears to offer nothing that helps pets and seems to be for self-healing only. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533021839998324926)
- **healing monsters with chivalry criminal flag**: Healing a monster with a chivalry spell makes the player criminal (grey). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529693027927589054)
- **healing potion buff icon**: Drinking a healing potion does not give a buff icon and only shows a system message, while other potions such as strength potions do give a buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521496807132237986)
- **health bar auto-open behavior**: Auto-open for health bars works only for NPCs; player enemies must be drag-selected into the matching collector box, though greys or reds may auto-open outside pvp events. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555577853129789581)
- **health bar buff and debuff display**: Buff and debuff icons on health bars can be enabled and enlarged, and changing the health bar layout or orientation enlarges the nameplate so buffs are easier to see. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533816756483657920)
- **health bar collector box overlap**: When setting up multiple health bar collector boxes, they should not overlap, because overlapping breaks their behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555578451241738344)
- **health bar collector distance filter**: Health Bar Collectors bring up health bars of nearby mobs or players and can be configured with filters such as distance; casting range (12) is a good distance, with a low distance for collectors used to heal friends and a large distance for enemies you might attack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525706301080862851)
- **health bar collector minimum size**: Health bar collectors in the UI have a minimum size that limits how small they can be made. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525246274788397226)
- **health bar collector settings**: Health bar collector settings are at the bottom of either the General or Interface settings, where the collectors can be turned off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533294061975507087)
- **health bar collectors for buffs and debuffs**: Health bar collectors are a UI customization option that may be used to view buffs and debuffs, though nameplates themselves likely cannot show them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524118536564506696)
- **health bar stacking location**: In the general options near the drag select setting, you can choose the X and Y location where enemy health bars stack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530175232038535168)
- **health gump styles and dragging**: There are 3 styles of health gump, and health gumps can be dragged out of mobs and players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525507149743128716)
- **healthbar alt-pull nameplate option**: The option 'Options > Nameplates > Don't pull healthbars unless ALT is pressed' exists but is marked as broken, so it should not be relied on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532441147383742615)
- **heat of battle debuff trigger**: The Heat of Battle debuff, which prevents recalling, is gained only by directly targeting and attacking a player; auto-attack does not trigger it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542933999738159175)
- **heat of the battle buff as criminal timer**: The Heat of the Battle buff may be usable to count down the criminal timer after stealing, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538587903955964017)
- **heavy armor dexterity penalty**: Wearing heavy armor in Outlands does not penalize dexterity, unlike on other shards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534375536984326155)
- **help rankings menu**: A rankings menu under Help lets players verify guild claims, with options such as this season and all time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534538759251558552)
- **help stuck cooldown**: The Help stuck function has a very long cooldown (on the order of many hours) before it can be used again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532414604540514445)
- **herding crook theft prevention**: Keeping the herding crook in your hands reportedly prevents it from being stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522374090256810024)
- **herds followers bonus display**: The Herds Followers bonus is not shown in the pet's base stats; it may appear by clicking the arrow next to "BASE" on the pet's lore screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533896182609477733)
- **hidden map chest location**: A map chest can sometimes be hidden behind objects such as a wall; turning on nameplates helps find it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540324749496946808)
- **hidden player proximity message**: A system message that someone hidden is nearby appears only if you run into them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541316552530460672)
- **hiding and stealing in vendor houses**: You cannot hide inside a vendor house unless you are friended or have a vendor there, and you cannot steal from someone who is restocking their vendor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522289354108567594)
- **hiding armor graphics**: There is apparently no option to hide equipped armor graphics other than helmets, so plate armor may clip through cosmetic clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547602256210432163)
- **hiding bags behind items**: Hiding a bag behind other items does not protect it from thieves, because thieves can set a queue delay and easily move the items out of the way. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521723879834255400)
- **hiding body names**: Hold Ctrl+Shift to open an options menu that cycles through which names are displayed, which allows body names to be hidden. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533205966533820587)
- **hiding in combat**: You cannot hide while in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547615777379844176)
- **hiding in-world text**: In the Outlands client, in-world text can be disabled to declutter the screen via Journal > Settings > Settings > Hide Messages In Game Viewport. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525663966578212958)
- **hiding inside public houses**: Hiding no longer works inside public houses because staff changed the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1554490016841990250)
- **hiding loot in bag corner**: A weak way to hide loot from thieves is to drop items in one corner of your bag so they cover the actual sub-container; it offers only minimal protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521217389889454221)
- **hiding neck piece on paper doll**: The neck piece cannot be hidden on the paper doll directly; the only way is to wear another piece that covers it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529085483987112027)
- **hiding other players' pet nameplates**: Other players' pet nameplates cannot currently be hidden because staff is aware of the issue, but they can be removed manually with alt+right click. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528237875286642729)
- **hiding the info bar**: To remove the status/info bar, open options, go to info bar, and uncheck show info bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530796501507379320)
- **hiding with zero skill in houses**: You can hide with 0 Hiding skill while inside your own house or a house that has friended you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530534152204718212)
- **high war aspect**: High War Aspect is only gained while PVPing and makes some PVPers better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526325319919865868)
- **hiking immunity**: Players are immune to interruption or attack while hiking, including when using Camping to hike out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535322368032112794)
- **hiking uninterruptible benefit versus thieves**: The hiking uninterruptible benefit is reversed against a thief who is not a murderer, so the effect works the other way for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527327086505754675)
- **hold-alt setting**: The hold-alt setting probably only closes windows and does not lock them, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528595674264768653)
- **holding bank item on cursor at distance**: An item held on the cursor from the bank stays held even when you are far from the bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544042380007837766)
- **holy aspect enemy of one damage bucket**: The Enemy of One effect of the Holy aspect is additive melee damage, in the same bucket as melee special damage, melee damage links and melee damage from codex passives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530349717911769271)
- **holy aspect ramp-up**: Holy aspect armor takes several aspect levels, around rank 5 or 6, before it feels noticeably better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536378438703652967)
- **holy aspect ranking**: Holy aspect is a middle-of-the-pack aspect, not the worst. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533355414291484742)
- **holy aspect swing speed**: With chivalry and food but no aspect, swing speed is 40%; adding 12 Holy raises it to 46.75%, with a food cap of 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529642592009064659)
- **holy symbol tick and holy aspect**: A tick every five seconds grants a holy symbol, and the Holy aspect gives a chance of a bonus symbol on each tick, yielding two symbols instead of one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530313934849179768)
- **horse cost in achievement points**: A horse can reportedly be purchased for 350 achievement points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537059171357167661)
- **horse logout behavior**: If you are riding a horse when you log out, the horse logs out with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527097971793985546)
- **horse speed**: All horses run at the same speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545984062550843425)
- **hotbar availability**: Ultima Online: Outlands has no unified hotbar, but spell icons can be dragged from the spellbook and arranged into a bar shape. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546564789487014009)
- **hourly rotational pvp events**: Four rotational PvP events run on the hour, every hour, in the order Town Struggle, Corpse Creek Contest, Stygian Rifts, Dungeon Flashpoint. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523444036931948643)
- **household play on one outlands id**: Household members can play together on one Outlands ID while an MAH exemption is pending, but not together in a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553493054109786255)
- **hybrid mage summoner links**: In a hybrid mage-summoner build, links boosting mage damage do not boost summons and vice versa, so a full mage or full pet damage build is better. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533132312517283902)
- **hybrid summoner template nerf**: The spellcaster/hybrid summoner template was recently nerfed as a result of the Mind Rot nerf. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544078063841579100)
- **identifying items without item identification skill**: To identify items without the Item Identification skill, obtain an Item ID wand from another player and use it on the item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533200223990710283)
- **identifying magic item modifiers**: Identify a magic item and compare its modifiers against the Magic Modifiers wiki page; equipping an unidentified item and watching how values change also reveals its modifiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532569231311372469)
- **ignore list behavior**: The in-game ignore list hides ignored players' speech in the game window but their speech may still appear in the journal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546469732654387201)
- **immolate modified abilities**: The only two abilities modified by Immolate are Flamestrike and Spellburn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545121510963028068)
- **immunization in healer's codex**: Some players spread extra points into Immunization in the Healer's Codex as an optional choice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551233220320960523)
- **immunize buff**: The 'immunize' buff in Outlands is a healing buff. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1539632655052570687)
- **in-game client profiles**: The client does not let you create different profiles in game or clone the same profile on the same character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523485884618379375)
- **in-game mousewheel zoom setting**: In-game Ctrl+Scroll zoom scaling is toggled under Options > Video > Zoom > 'Enable mousewheel for in game zoom scaling'; unchecking it disables the zoom. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1525745293386186862)
- **in-game percentage bonuses**: Percentage bonuses shown in game should not be assumed to be multipliers, because most are additive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521585421086228590)
- **infamy and ship visibility**: Going red on the ocean by sinking players grants infamy, which increases how far away your ship can be seen; heavy sinkers can be seen from hundreds of tiles away. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523671960649863218)
- **infamy decay rate**: One infamy point is removed per day, at around 6 or 7pm CST according to one player's observation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy gain from sinking player ships**: A player gains 1 infamy for killing a player captain and another 1 infamy for sinking that captain's boat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy red ship threshold**: A ship turns red at roughly 10 or more infamy, though this threshold has reportedly changed several times and the exact value is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy ship visibility range**: Each infamy point adds a raw +10 tiles to the distance from which other players can see your ship, capping at 30 infamy for +300 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546669419969646622)
- **infamy threshold for red name**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, a player's name turns red (murderer status) at 30 infamy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546675621206425731)
- **inn room pet checker**: A rogue NPC runs from inn to inn to ensure no training pets are left in inn rooms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533963341188567080)
- **inscription damage bonus cap**: Inscription's damage bonus is capped by other bonuses such as Tracking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531053023101452439)
- **inscription effect on scroll buffs**: Inscription increases the duration of buff spells cast from scrolls, such as Bless, but not their strength; scroll buffs will still apply to Reactive Armor and Magic Reflection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549873824328196188)
- **installing mastery links**: Install mastery links by opening the mastery chain and pressing install link; double clicking the link in your bag does not install it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526455256509321266)
- **instant item disappearance from corpses**: Items vanishing instantly from a corpse when clicked is a visual effect rather than actual instant looting, and some items may still be on the corpse if you leave and return. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527678328692146347)
- **instrument theft protection**: Dropping your instrument into a trapped pouch prevents it from being stolen, and you can still use it from there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530914932034506855)
- **intelligence and dexterity value**: Without Magery there is no point in having 100 Intelligence, and more Dexterity gives more stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530561686153593013)
- **intelligence and strength stat effects**: Intelligence determines maximum mana and Strength determines maximum hitpoints. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525796505313874001)
- **interruption protection alternatives**: With around 75 Magic Resist, Arcane or Scribe, the remaining interruption protection can be supplemented with meditation or disrupt avoid chance chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550179067217715200)
- **investigator quest lens use**: For the investigator quest, the lens must be used on the gators. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538060990246162514)
- **invisible characters after login in inns**: Characters logging in inside an inn are sometimes invisible, possibly because everyone is made invisible when the server reboots, though this cause is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523392133141106860)
- **item counter supported items**: The item counter works for chains, runebooks/tomes and clothing, as well as mount tokens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544484121806377010)
- **item durability and repair benches**: Outlands has item durability, and double-clicking a Repair Bench restores the durability of all equipped gear and all gear in your inventory. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535386480334213173)
- **item exchange for new version**: To replace an item with its new version, use the Prevalia exchange officer with the item in your bank; it exchanges for crystals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520770553529630822)
- **item focus compared with OG UO**: Outlands is less item-focused than current OG UO, and some players suggest treating gear as ammunition. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534589484853891143)
- **item hue statue**: One of the statues lets a player change the hue of items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537877088424427641)
- **item info command**: Use the -getinfo or -info command and then target an item to see its item info; the exact command name is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528787382390886431)
- **item recycler red setting**: In the item recycler settings, a red entry means items in that category (such as a quality category set to don't recycle) will not be recycled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527356793431392326)
- **item stat display and properties**: Outlands does not display weapon and armor stats and has fewer item properties than OSI, so players infer stats from the material or magic property rather than adding magical properties. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548162639203541023)
- **item transfer between own characters**: When running two characters on different accounts, you can hand items between them without a room, and adding the other character to your party flags them green so you can loot their corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538585409750179961)
- **items with deletion countdown timers**: Items that show a countdown timer to deletion are usually quest-related, such as the Thanatite Shard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631930477682739)
- **joining a faction through a guild**: A guild can opt itself into a Faction; once it has, toggling yourself into Faction places you in your guild's faction, and enemy factions then appear as orange names that you can attack and be attacked by anywhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531176903309004890)
- **joining town struggle**: To join the Town Struggle, enter the gate that appears at the Prevalia bank, which takes you to a waiting area; when the event starts, another gate opens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554995746103894097)
- **journal and log timestamps**: The in-game journal and log files store timestamps without seconds, and players cannot change this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531621923707031713)
- **journal appearance customization**: To change the journal's look, click the gear wheel on the journal and select a different border style (e.g. minimalism); setting opacity to zero makes the background black. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525678533970497666)
- **journal customization**: Customize the Journal via the gear icon at its top right: enable 'Hide Messages In Game Viewport' to stop chat and system messages in the viewport, set Border Style to Minimalism, and right-click to add tabs with custom filters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551341873631858819)
- **journal logs location and criminal search**: Journal logs are stored in the ClassicUO Data\Client\JournalLogs folder and can be searched for the word 'criminal' to find why you turned grey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529691853480398960)
- **journal message filtering**: The journal cannot be filtered, so NPC speech and other messages cannot be hidden and it cannot be made to show only real player messages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543276695522644118)
- **journal settings location**: Journal settings, including timestamp display, are found under the cogwheel icon in the journal window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531621923707031713)
- **journal system message filtering**: System messages in the journal can be filtered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523063165070344203)
- **judging aspects at higher tiers**: Aspects at low tiers such as tier 2 give barely any benefit, so they should be judged at tier 10 or 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536378748025176214)
- **junk aspect link conversion**: A junk aspect link can be converted into the links a build needs by using the tool the player receives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543618252947857460)
- **karma and lord title version**: Karma determines which version of the Lord title (e.g. Lord vs. Lady or dishonorable variant) a player receives. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542382884243906610)
- **karma effects of stealing and killing mobs**: Stealing from mobs likely lowers karma, while killing them, such as by backstabbing, increases it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545143497575637002)
- **karma locking at ankh**: Karma can be locked at an ankh so that it can only decrease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545145369015353476)
- **karma loss from stealing in sanctuary dungeons**: Stealing from monsters in sanctuary dungeons may still cause a loss of karma, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520477659824525313)
- **keeping armor material colour with aspects**: To keep an armor's material colour while using an aspect, select the option to keep the material colour in the Hue management section of the aspect screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529875901574287443)
- **keeping aspect active**: Players should always keep their aspect active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543597050107662357)
- **keeping aspect active while pvping**: Keeping an aspect activated while PvPing saves paying to re-activate it later, but risks losing it if you are killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528457661333504021)
- **keeping chat entry open**: To keep the chat entry open without pressing Enter, enable the relevant setting under Options > Speech; hotkeys may not work while the chat box is up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551330006536421437)
- **keeping pets after logging in**: If you log out with pets, say 'all follow me' after logging in and before recalling, otherwise your pets stay behind in your room. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536669209545932840)
- **keyboard movement option**: Enable keyboard movement via Options > Experimental to free the mouse for clicking health gumps and targeting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525644486414307609)
- **killed released pets**: If you release a pet and someone kills it, it is permanently gone, even if it was bonded before release. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549380982317121559)
- **killing track during treasure map hunting**: Killing a track can now be done from outside a house while the player is inside it, a change to treasure map hunting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537988661734281366)
- **label display toggle menu**: Pressing Ctrl+Shift opens the menu for toggling the display of labels for everything in the game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532324120409280612)
- **lacerate buildup on health bars**: Lacerate buildup on enemies can possibly be displayed on pulled health bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540367537278029844)
- **lantern toggling with double click loot option**: With the 'double click to loot items inside containers' option enabled, a lantern cannot be toggled on unless it is in your hands, though lanterns on the ground can be toggled regardless of the option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544088576508039169)
- **lanterns going out when stored**: Lanterns reportedly go out when put away into containers, which is said to be the intended behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544087829905412268)
- **large player clumps travelling together**: A large clump of players travelling together can be a faction event, or a guild caravan event if the players are escorting NPCs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541441374006804502)
- **last laugh perk looting restriction**: If an attacker kills a player with the Last Laugh perk and then dies, the attacker is on a wilderness timer and cannot loot that player on any character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529672906572042281)
- **last target mechanic**: Performing an action against a mobile sets that mobile as the player's Last Target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527507687858896967)
- **layered trapped pouches against thieves**: Placing items inside multiple nested trapped pouches slows thieves, since each layer takes them about half a second to open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533213931596943561)
- **layering items in same slot**: There is no mechanism for wearing an item over another item in the same equipment slot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524165897399435494)
