- **leaderboard points from maps**: Resource maps and Message in a Bottle maps provide leaderboard points, which appeals to leaderboard grinders and evens the ground between MIB players and PvPers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531445008891384019)
- **leaderboard season length**: Seasons on the Outlands leaderboards reportedly last 90 days, though this comes from a passing remark and is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525906033359192074)
- **leaderboards**: Other leaderboards exist besides the mapping leaderboard, and the mapping leaderboard remains open to everyone since all mappers are slowed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536937911344439297)
- **leather body strap paperdoll effect**: A leather body strap likely removes the visible leather chest piece on the paperdoll, but this should be checked on the Test server first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529884661969321994)
- **leaving the strangelands event**: Type [stranglelands to open the event menu, which contains an exit button to leave the Strangelands event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550151849544384583)
- **legacy aspect armor**: Aspect armor pieces found on the ground are legacy items from before the aspect system was revamped and are mostly expensive decoration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540015628570730577)
- **lethal poison first tick timing**: Under the current poison system, lethal poison applied 1 second before the target's next tick produces its first lethal tick after 1 second. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520791606452682793)
- **lethal poison upgrade requirement**: Lethal poison potions must be carried on your person in order to upgrade into lethal poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523607729963274360)
- **level 0 mount death risk**: A level 0 mount that is not levelled up to level 1 or higher might die, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549841540145356872)
- **leveling an aspect**: To level an aspect, unlock it, activate it on your armor and weapon, then kill monsters until the progress bar fills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529641178801373344)
- **leveling aspect on spellbook and armour**: Equip the Poison aspect on both your spellbook and your armour to level that aspect faster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542213679758704750)
- **library quest mob spawns**: The mobs for the library quest spawn randomly at certain points of interest or locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540874139881963682)
- **lightning arc vs damage reduction**: Lightning Arc is probably not impacted by damage reduction, though this has not been verified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537504573655089292)
- **lightning armor proc weapon speed scalar**: Lightning armor proc chance is affected by a hidden weapon speed scalar based on the weapon's base swing time, while the percentage shown in the aspect description does not change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536408433199157348)
- **lightning shock debuff**: Mobs affected by the Lightning shock debuff boost your next few swings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545939123783733319)
- **link activation requirement for link xp**: Link must be active in order to gain link XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533563136932577281)
- **link chain upgrades**: Upgrading your link chain, for example to silver links, is considered the best thing you can do in the game, especially before reaching 30 links when redline becomes a concern. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531669426984845464)
- **link limit cap**: The link limit cap can be raised through the redline system, but progressing that far takes a very long time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525256734128603167)
- **link to the future quest reward**: The Link to the Future quest for the Gilded Mastery Chain rewards a bronze link and a tool, and the chain is also added to your backpack, though it may be buried among other items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541827034588774480)
- **link type documentation**: Which links count as the same type is likely documented only on the wiki, if listed there, and not elsewhere. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524790158266863788)
- **link values showing 0%**: Link values display 0% when the link's chain is not active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537780070075203645)
- **lockbox must be open for client to see items**: The lockbox must be opened for the game client to see the items inside it, which is required before a bandage can be used from it via hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1535876009377931264)
- **locked box theft protection**: Once a locked box is unlocked, its contents are reportedly open to thieves, and a hidden player with an open pack reportedly cannot be stolen from. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534309838694383759)
- **locking down an item in a bag**: To lock down an item in your bag so it cannot be lost, left click it in the bag and select lift lock. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534063782383321270)
- **locking outfits on body**: There is no way to lock an outfit so that it cannot be moved from your body. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543264473916117032)
- **lockpicker aspect choice**: For a lockpicker, the harvest aspect is sufficient because the aspect switch timer makes swapping aspects impractical. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540811297652871280)
- **lockpicker on pvm account unlocking links**: A lockpicker on your PvM account helps unlock links for your PvM character regardless of which aspect you pick. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544500266596831292)
- **lockpicking chests codex experience**: Lockpicking chests in dungeons gives no codex experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542199850840490134)
- **logging out in dungeon with lockpicker echo**: A dungeon lockpicker echo with the harvest aspect can log out inside the dungeon once all of its chests have been picked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524480085837484093)
- **logout macro availability**: There is no way to create a logout macro in Ultima Online: Outlands; logging out requires the paperdoll logout button. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1542496242481893416)
- **logout time outside houses and inns**: The logout time when not in a house or inn is likely 5 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548558864356479086)
- **loot all button**: A loot all button is reportedly not planned, as the feature was said to have been cancelled, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528050311158038598)
- **loot all button and loot queuing**: Developers reportedly planned a loot all button and loot queuing that loots one item every 500 ms, but the loot all button was reportedly dropped because players would demand filters to skip junk. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527677372415873136)
- **loot all on own corpse with re-equip**: On the test client, with the re-equip option selected, 'Loot All' on your own corpse moves everything to your backpack but does not re-equip the items you were wearing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1524912882989531136)
- **loot all patch status**: A loot-all function from Tranq's patch is in development, and it is expected to return to Test Center once another patch currently being tested there goes live. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529444354169508052)
- **loot bag hotkey**: A loot bag can be set with a hotkey instead of only through the looting interface on a corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540792452430958594)
- **loot goblin necessity after planned change**: A planned change is expected to remove the need to use the loot goblin, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531101979420659822)
- **loot link caps**: Gold and doubloon loot links cap at 10, whereas special loot links cap at 20. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1540196072964489246)
- **loot links and paragon chests**: Rare or special loot links do not affect paragon chest loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538926131837931611)
- **loot weight reduction**: No bags reduce the weight of loot; a common way to manage weight while out is to carry an ID wand and something to recycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548440347011452969)
- **looted corpse hiding**: Looted corpses cannot be hidden automatically and instead time out eventually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530638454101245952)
- **looted item usage**: Most looted items are broken down for crafting materials and used to operate the aspect system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525607249416818720)
- **looting own characters**: Looting one of your own characters with another character on the same account turns you gray because your characters are not automatically allies, while characters in the same guild can loot each other without issue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537448789290385408)
- **looting rights on mobs**: If you deal less than 50% of a mob's damage, the next person who kills the mob gets the looting rights. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531756650736652498)
- **looting while hidden in trapped pouch**: To access loot while hidden in a trapped pouch, keep one unique-type bag as your loot bag, put it on your counters bar so you can open it by clicking, place it inside a trapped pouch, and use an organizer agent to remove it; this breaks on logout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521218613707538623)
- **lord fame title**: Reaching the Lord fame level unlocks a permanent title. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539417544857882693)
- **lore book mastery chain link rewards**: Completing a Lore Book rewards a Mastery Chain Link whose type is random, with roughly 1% gold, 7% silver and about 92% bronze. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529896399444115487)
- **lost pet retrieval**: Lost pets can be retrieved only by going to a Stablekeeper. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554099620127178834)
- **low circle grimoire spell timing on test**: A few months before early October 2026, the test server had low-circle spells with a 10 second timing in the grimoire that came close to an easily sustainable low mana-per-second rotation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555673178431299695)
- **low circle spells and aspect procs**: Low circle spells are not very efficient for generating aspect procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543325642496680106)
- **low link count character strength**: A character with few links (e.g. 7) feels weak regardless of spec and cannot be compared to a player with 30 silver or gold links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532780888000036966)
- **low-link build aspects**: Madness is a good aspect for a low-link build, and Blood is also decent though not outstanding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526705036762284093)
- **lower aspect level tradeoff**: Running a lower aspect level than your max tier likely gives lower bonuses in exchange for using less essence, and experience gain may be slower because the character is weaker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540401674168963182)
- **lowering dexterity**: To lower Dexterity, set it to point down and raise the other stats; Dexterity decreases once the 225 stat total is reached, and it is not locked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525864461179687093)
- **lowering karma by snooping or poisoning**: According to the Outlands Reputation wiki page, repeatedly snooping or poisoning could lower karma. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545140913909796946)
- **macroing rules for experience and resources**: Macroing anything that earns experience or resources, such as farming monsters or mining, is not allowed on Outlands, while macroing skill gain is allowed because skill gain is not equivalent to experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522024189035282632)
- **madness aspect lightning requirement**: The Madness aspect needs a high Lightning aspect level to get good proc rates, so Madness feels better earlier in progression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538233321832718429)
- **mage aspect armor type**: Mages should use leather armor for their aspect armor suit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553887168957648947)
- **mage stat distribution**: A mage staying with blood armor should run 40 dex and 85 int; otherwise 100 str/100 int/25 dex works, and dex above 25 is not needed with lightning armor or when switching armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531668782152421457)
- **magic item recycler matching option**: The 'only matching properties' (middle) option in the magic item recycler is the wrong option for unidentified items, because it looks for identified items in your backpack to put into the recycler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526620914286854244)
- **magic item recycler settings**: The magic item recycler box can be configured to keep the items you want, and the settings persist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550678083303112847)
- **magic item vault recycling in preview**: In the preview, players can get many magic items from the magic item vault, identify them and recycle them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555559740996718704)
- **magic mushrooms requirement**: Making and consuming Magic Mushrooms requires upgrading 'Create Food' in the wizard's grimoire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536858285146378441)
- **magic resist cap overflow on build**: On the described build, Magic Resist, Delectable Food, the Chivalry spell Divine Fury, a little Anatomy and a little Arms Lore combine to reach 51.9 against a cap of 50. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540883601330147379)
- **magic resist spell interrupt protection**: Magic Resist grants spell interrupt protection equal to its skill value percent, so at 80 resist it is 80% protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551370289961771089)
- **magical item identification**: Magical items always have to be identified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548841692294160456)
- **mah account structure**: A MAH setup consists of 3 accounts of its own, and MAH accounts are flagged as such and linked to their parent accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537960282255663105)
- **mail boxes**: Outlands does not have proper mail boxes and is not expected to get them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536513603988103339)
- **malicious scavenging definition**: Malicious scavenging means placing multiple characters around Shelter Island with valuable items in the Razor scavenger agent to pick up items accidentally dropped during trades. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532513631701438584)
- **mana drain at eldritch tier 9**: At Eldritch tier 9, a player using material spellbooks should be casting mana drain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526405178780286976)
- **mana potions**: There are no mana potions in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526008368156770384)
- **mana refund and purple damage**: Mana refund bonuses reportedly add to purple damage, which would benefit Lightning. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545572986956943361)
- **mana refund cap**: With T0 aspects and a rosewood staff, a mage is already over the cap for mana refund. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546229520560816138)
- **mana refund mechanic**: Mana refund is not a mana cost reduction, so a spell can still proc a special even when its mana is refunded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526874304590123058)
- **mana regeneration formula**: Base passive mana regen is 1 mana per 2 seconds, increased by 100% * (Meditation skill/100), increased by 100% when actively meditating, and reduced by 2% per point of Total Armor Meditation Penalty; the maximum rate is 1 mana per 0.5 seconds and the minimum is 1 mana per 8 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529880442126204948)
- **mana restoration by mushroom**: Consuming a mushroom restores mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532721290866327602)
- **mana-free casting wands**: There are no wands that allow casting without mana, because spells are balanced around requiring mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554526508393955453)
- **manual map sorting removal**: Manual sorting of maps into tomes has been removed from the game and replaced by a new map system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544886196503580773)
- **manually dragged health bars in collectors**: Health bars that are manually dragged can be collected into a collector and then removed automatically by the collector's auto remove behaviour. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523412441076207767)
- **manually dragged pet health bars layering**: Pet health bars that are manually dragged out are not placed above other gumps, possibly because bars held by a collector behave differently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523448310348906567)
- **map border toggle**: Double-click the map in the top right to toggle its border, which is needed when you want to enlarge the map. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531203791125217370)
- **map chest persistence**: The map chest should not disappear unless all the mobs that came with it have been killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540304165140701185)
- **map decoding changes**: After the map changes, players reportedly can no longer decode multiple maps and complete all of them in a single area, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529666081378009178)
- **map deletion conditions**: A map is deleted if its timer runs out or if its owner abandons it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540325071506251927)
- **map gump hiking**: Hiking through the map gump works only for the character with Cartography, so other characters need a gate to be brought to the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546213099621715968)
- **map timer duration**: Maps have a 30 minute timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540324553635532810)
- **map tome decoded map storage**: After the upcoming tome change, map tomes can no longer hold decoded maps, though they could before. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528238833597157498)
- **mark cave tiles client setting**: The client settings include a 'Mark cave tiles' option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550402782752677988)
- **mass undecode of decoded maps**: The admins mass-undecoded all decoded maps ahead of the T-map update, and undecoding maps does not refund spyglasses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531025634585874443)
- **master account meaning**: The 'Master' account refers to the Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522728995563638956)
- **mastery chain activation**: A mastery chain does not need to be worn as long as it is activated in your bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534063897202528277)
- **mastery chain appearance**: The appearance of a mastery chain cannot be changed, only its hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534245526382579752)
- **mastery chain blessing**: Mastery Chains are automatically blessed, but the links placed in them are not blessed and cannot be blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526566077528674515)
- **mastery chain equip requirement**: Mastery chains do not need to be equipped to maintain their bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534245798588448909)
- **mastery chain experience from fishing and mibs**: Killing mobs while fishing and mobs in bottles (MiBs) gives mastery chain experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522205781162852473)
- **mastery chain link caps**: A mastery chain link can normally be stacked up to 10 times, Redline progression can raise some links to 15, and special or rare loot chance links are capped at 20; the total number of link slots and the experience needed to max them is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524639809510047804)
- **mastery chain links on death**: Links on the mastery chain do not drop on death and remain on the chain until you remove them manually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522804682786078861)
- **mastery chain loss**: A mastery chain cannot be lost unless you bin it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521112081859084430)
- **mastery chain quest rewards**: The mastery chain quest gives the player both a random link and a reforge tool to teach how the system works. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554656383033675868)
- **mastery chain xp estimation**: Mastery chain xp can be roughly estimated using the gold earned achievement, or by getting a chain on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534244858955305040)
- **mastery chain xp past harvest aspect t15**: Echo and ocean fishing can be used to gain the mastery chain XP needed to progress beyond harvest aspect T15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553434856938016779)
- **mastery link follower scaling**: A mastery link that does not explicitly mention followers usually contributes only to the player's own damage, not to followers' damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545280278648459395)
- **mastery xp from treasure maps and mibs**: Treasure maps and ocean MIBs (messages in bottles) grant mastery XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553438610311614585)
- **max stamina hat trick against invisible targets**: Wearing a hat that reduces max stamina can prevent you from shoving past an invisible target, since shoving requires max stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542847790038913044)
- **maximizing society points**: Leveling all crafting skills on all accounts is a way to maximize society points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521151515136364544)
- **maximum follower count**: The maximum number of followers is 5 for every character and cannot be increased; some minions take 2 slots and others take 1. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550933391245844482)
- **maximum stack size**: The maximum possible stack size in Ultima Online: Outlands is 65535. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1529546023477706782)
- **maximum theft success chance**: The maximum chance to successfully steal is capped at 75%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037271802744934)
- **meanings of defense**: The word 'defense' has two uses in the game: the lowest-level magic armor prefix, and the defense links in mastery chains along with the defense stat that helps avoid being hit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551186014016512062)
- **melee codex tier strength**: Each tier in melee weapon codices gives a smaller boost than tiers in point-limited codices, so they must be leveled more to give noticeable benefits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547611980125315142)
- **melee damage bonus stacking**: Nearly all sources of melee damage increase are additive rather than multiplicative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521585310880759809)
- **melee damage modifier stacking**: All melee damage modifiers (chain, aspect, crystals, codex, special, chivalry, etc.) are additive in a single damage bucket rather than multiplicative. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531483732907659434)
- **melee defense chain links effect**: Melee defense chain links reduce your chance of being hit; for example, 10 bronze melee accuracy/defense links lower a monster's 50% hit chance at equal 100 weapon skill to 35%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542658046864396399)
- **melee special chance chain link**: The melee special chance chain link is never used in practice. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525709137080483911)
- **melee special chance meaning**: Melee special chance refers to the weapon-specific special attack of each weapon type, not to aspect special. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530472368609300490)
- **melee summons via golems**: Melee characters are expected to get their own summons once golems are added, if golems are still planned for the expansion release. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529521722569658559)
- **metabolism buff**: Metabolism is reportedly getting a buff, which would help keep pets alive while harvesting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532873602670792924)
- **meteor landing on tmap dig spot**: A meteor can land directly on top of a treasure map dig spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545542831173799966)
- **mib system leaderboard**: The MIB system has a leaderboard. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532091756542169129)
- **mid-sea oyster event scoring**: In the mid-sea oyster event you receive an event score based on the weight of oysters, and at the end of the event you get unique rewards based on your score. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520284802652311684)
- **mine.gumps.xml counter entry format**: Each counter entry in mine.gumps.xml is a control line with a graphic attribute (item ID) and a hue attribute, matching the ID and hue values shown by the >info command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1553605135211569234)
- **minimap party member color**: There is believed to be no way to change the color of a specific party member on the minimap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535733459325026396)
- **minimum magic resist per mob**: The minimum magic resist differs per mob and is not a flat -150 for magic mobs or -25 for physical mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529139097711546459)
- **mining codex smelting**: The Mining Codex lets a player smelt ore from anywhere at set intervals. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1530390024615624714)
- **missing event reward fix**: If staff cannot resolve a missing event reward, verify the game client files, which reportedly fixed the issue for another player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520593033848946869)
- **missing overhead damage numbers bug**: Missing overhead damage numbers on mobs is a bug that may be fixed by hitting the mob with a spell such as Magic Arrow; otherwise submit a ticket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529794722338443270)
- **mixing armor materials**: Armor of different materials can be mixed (e.g. leather with one plate piece) without any aspect bonus penalty or reduced experience gain; only the baseline armor rating from equipped pieces is affected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529878844956344454)
- **mob behavior during flashpoints**: During flashpoints, mobs are believed to stop spawning while those already present remain until killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526659180738511061)
- **mob gold and xp variance**: Mob gold and XP are derived from the mob's difficulty and vary slightly, so the same mob does not give exactly the same experience on each kill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535405691483717713)
- **mobile-enter-screen chat spam**: The chat spam shown when mobiles enter the screen reportedly cannot be fully disabled because it stems from the game's networking and engine. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526127320564371517)
- **modifiers applying to followers**: Modifiers generally apply to followers only when their description explicitly says so. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554950246268674079)
- **monster abilities and spell siphon**: Monster abilities such as a small drake's flamestrike are not spells, so they do not trigger spell-based effects like Spell Siphon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536838243667148900)
- **monster fame and gold value**: Fame gained from monsters is tied to the gold value they drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533267814167871559)
- **monster front arc**: A monster's front arc extends outward at an angle from the monster up to its attack or aggro range; if a monster is facing you and damaging you, you are in its front arc. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528134771383996446)
- **monster hunter societies**: Monster hunter societies exist in which players kill monsters to earn society points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531178738497355795)
- **monster loot changes**: Normal monster loot has not changed, but loot obtained through scavenging and pilfering has been altered. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547267612512227519)
- **monster properties derived from difficulty**: Many monster properties such as fame and karma are derived from difficulty, which is almost equal to gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533267899329020036)
- **mount auto-stabling in dungeons**: Mounts are automatically stabled when you enter a dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539728045420580866)
- **mount feeding**: Mounts do not need to be fed on this server, except through the trough when breeding. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533878953477935135)
- **mount follower slot**: A mount does not take up a follower slot while you ride it, but it does occupy a slot once you dismount. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539727902810050681)
- **mount statue cast time**: Mount statues have no cast time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537813490159583272)
- **mount token behavior**: A mount token mount disappears as soon as you hide, so stealthy characters need not worry about it, whereas a regular mount makes you unhide when you move or must be told to stay, and may be killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520407361813221438)
- **mount token healthbar**: A mount token shows no healthbar and displays only the token item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538576524133797938)
- **mounting from the item counter**: To mount without lifting the mount token from your pack, place the mount token into a cell of the item counter bar (using an Adventure Satchel), then mount from the item counter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544483969783959552)
- **mounts in dungeons**: A mount you are riding is stored away when you enter a dungeon unless you dismounted before entering. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274983160938648)
- **mounts in dungeons**: Mounts cannot be used in dungeons on Outlands; everyone is on foot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521546858789605479)
- **moving cooldown icons**: When you move a cooldown icon it can leave a blank space, which you can fill by moving another cooldown icon into it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551636109316980777)
- **moving through players stamina cost**: In Ultima Online: Outlands, moving through another player mostly still costs stamina, though some areas such as the newbie dungeon are exempt. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521307959806660649)
- **moving ui elements out of a book**: To move a UI element such as a spell icon out of a book, click and hold on it and drag it out. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550622334266642554)
- **mugged and pilfered goods boosting**: Mugged and pilfered goods get boosted the same way as Black Goods, according to the Thieves Guild wiki entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539990219753918514)
- **mugging and pilfering rewards**: Mugging monsters has a low chance to also yield a rare item, and pilfering or mugging gives more extra items than turning in goods, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526463024507129857)
- **mugging range**: Mugging used to require melee range, but an ability in the Thieves' Codex now reportedly allows mugging from about 6 tiles, though the exact ability and range are unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525542691088240740)
- **mule character frost aspect tier 0**: A mule character is said to receive Frost Aspect Tier 0 benefits against mobs, though the author is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521722267061452860)
- **multi-account farming under progression system**: The Outlands progression system discourages multi-account farming, and in dungeons it makes it impossible or nearly so. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527314522501681202)
- **multi-account household setup**: To set up a multi-account household, open a support ticket with the admins, since only admins can handle it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553472746569076801)
- **multi-client limit**: Players are allowed to run 3 game clients in parallel, subject to caveats listed in the server rules. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547427077618143323)
- **multibox damage penalty scope**: The multibox damage penalty applies only to treasure maps and boats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523001528401526816)
- **multiboxing and scripts**: Multiboxing multiple characters cannot realistically be done without scripts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525627100617511104)
- **multiboxing rules**: Multiboxing is allowed on Outlands for PvE on up to 3 clients but not for PvP, with some other limitations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528229492907180103)
- **multiboxing rules in pvp**: Using a second character before PVP starts (for example to mark a chiv gate or find a target) is allowed, but using a second client to heal yourself after PVP has begun can get you banned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532076207292547233)
- **multiple accounts usefulness**: Having 3 accounts is mainly useful for societies, which work similarly to bulk order deeds, and also helps with monster hunting, boating and adventuring. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529366148343140553)
- **multiple character restrictions**: On Outlands you cannot use multiple characters to PvP, and only one of your characters can be inside a dungeon at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525868058126712892)
- **multiple characters and progress**: Having multiple characters splits progress across them, so unlocking a new aspect on an existing character is an alternative to making a new character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538620955457486858)
- **multiple client profile saving**: When a player runs several clients at once, the last client to save overwrites the profile and wins, which can break macros and hotkeys. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523842995403620353)
- **multiple map types at once**: The overhaul removes the ability to run different map types at the same time using multiple characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536360949035044895)
- **multiplier link scaling with additive damage**: The more additive damage a build has, the better multiplier damage links scale, so multiplier links improve on fully PvM templates with high aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551422928459923608)
- **murder count reset after death fee**: When you pay the fee after dying, your murder count resets to 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535266596770291834)
- **murder count time-out**: Reaching 5 murder counts results in a 72-hour time-out, according to a single player's report. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535268060141854841)
- **murder counts from trapped boxes**: On Outlands, a trapper gets a murder count when someone is killed by their trapped box, wherever it is trapped (not locked down), unlike other shards where locked-down trapped boxes in towns or dungeons don't count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535087063337013288)
- **murderer dungeon death lockout scope**: The murderer dungeon-death lockout applies to at least the player's account and possibly to the OutlandID as well. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539685472576471190)
- **murderer resurrection fee**: Murderers must pay gold to resurrect when they die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530328456297058477)
- **murderer status**: Players who have killed at least 5 people and have not yet burned off those murder counts are murderers, and their names and healthbars appear red. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537968819103076373)
- **mushroom mana use limit**: A player may eat only one mushroom for mana every 60 seconds, and the Cooking skill grants a second mushroom use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524835127916494961)
- **nameplate hotkey behavior**: The nameplate hotkey cycles through nameplate profiles, switching one section off and activating the next. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543327045428322415)
- **nameplate menu and group editing**: Hold Shift+Ctrl to open the nameplate menu, and edit nameplate groups in Options > Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545530917991489580)
- **nameplate options for humanoids and monsters**: The nameplate options include separate settings for humanoids and for monsters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525264685375553606)
- **nameplate toggle hotkey**: The nameplate display toggle uses the Ctrl+Shift hotkey, and it does not work while the locate vendor window is open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528693433232003182)
- **nameplates during portal vendor search**: Nameplates turn off while you are locating a vendor via the portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541088394610741269)
- **names populating in chat window**: There is no way to stop names from populating in the chat window; the best option is to use the Chat tab, or the Guild/Party tab if party chat is enough. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525679853494337608)
- **naming a replacement gump override**: To name a replacement gump override, you need the hex value of the gump being replaced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531090871020294416)
- **necro scroll sources**: Necromancy scrolls drop from the undead progressive spawns at graveyards, burial grounds and similar locations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723457439993897)
- **necromancer hotbar saving**: Position the necromancer tome hotbar where you want it, then type -savenecrobar to keep it saved and open after logging out and back in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987543602372660)
- **necromancer summon decay**: A necromancer summon loses hit points the longer it stays alive because of decay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529934176202133678)
- **necromancy scaling request**: A developer (Luthius) declined to make the Necromancy skill scale off Tactics or Magery. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532201314530885644)
- **necromancy summon slot cost**: Necromancy summons such as earth elementals and fire elementals count as 2 slots each, which limits how many can be summoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530692789086457967)
- **negative wake modification**: A lower wake is better for staying unseen, and crew with wake modification show a negative percentage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523674441001730139)
- **new container positions after death**: If you must get new containers after a death, move them to your preferred screen position the first time you open them, because remembered positions belong to the old containers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536897161403302068)
- **new treasure map system steps**: Under the new treasure map system, players return to base to decode the map, wait a 15 second timer, go through a flowchart, and then follow an arrow to an unplanned location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528207547834699907)
- **newly tamed creature release timer**: A newly tamed creature is safe to release for 60 minutes after taming, but each release resets that timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549494109641773098)
- **non-bypassable progression grinds**: Many Outlands progression systems cannot be skipped with gold; codex, aspect, mastery chain and redline XP must be earned through play. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529283067926155505)
- **non-tamer pet limit**: A non-tamer can only have 1 pet. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554796094884683898)
- **notice chance after stealing**: After a successful steal the thief can be noticed, and the fewer people nearby, the lower the chance of being noticed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521553020356137102)
- **notoriety across templates**: A character's notoriety, such as being red, carries over to all templates on the same account, so a PvM character used for PKing will also be red on the PvM template. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526872802077053050)
- **notoriety colors and aggressor setting**: Mobs display one notoriety color before they aggro onto something and a different color afterward, and the aggressor setting also changes the color of players who commit criminal acts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539193958239047740)
- **notoriety hue settings**: To check and change notoriety hues, open Options and go to the Combat-Spells section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530322550645719172)
- **notoriety options hiding nameplates**: Notoriety options in the nameplate settings can hide a mob's nameplate when it becomes aggressive or hits you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545537408513220688)
- **noxcro echo pre-poisoning weapons**: A noxcro echo can poison many weapons ahead of time for another character to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538356576761680083)
- **npc full name display**: The full name of an NPC including its profession title cannot be shown permanently; names appear only when you approach the NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551252561531764827)
- **npc healer resurrection prompt bug**: The NPC healer resurrection prompt sometimes bugs, and walking away a short distance and approaching the healer again can fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555684342838206535)
- **npc nameplates on drag select**: To show NPC nameplates when drag-selecting, open Options > General > Healthbars and Drag Select and set the drop-downs to match the keys held when grabbing specific healthbars; the exact settings are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552874602500333609)
- **npc vendor overloading**: Buying from NPC vendors can overload you in both weight and item count, which freezes your character in place. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541034697688088666)
- **npc-purchasable item cleanup for inactive characters**: Items buyable from NPCs may periodically be removed from long-inactive characters, with a check given for their value, so NPC-bought equipment can disappear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528056167341887590)
- **number of societies**: There are 6 different Societies, and crafting is only one of them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530580732576272506)
- **nusero hued items**: Nusero-hued items exist as region-hued drops. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528112895882170408)
- **obsolete tome conversion precedent**: When tomes have become obsolete in the past, staff have added a conversion option on an exchange NPC that converts them into other tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528233016311419060)
- **obtaining black goods**: Black goods have a chance to drop while pilfering or mugging as a thief, and they are fairly uncommon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542029469286404207)
- **ocean aspect link unlocking**: The Ocean aspect is the fastest way to unlock links, even when starting around 10 links; one player started the season at about 10 links and reached the season top 10 near 27 links using Ocean with Fortune. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546583715621372004)
- **ocean redline cap**: The ocean was reported to have no redline cap, unlike the wilderness, though this may have changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529898820912152667)
- **ocean redline xp per level**: Ocean Redline levels originally cost 200k XP each instead of 1 million, were later raised to 500k, and remain much cheaper than other Redline sources at higher levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900809972617369)
- **odd squares in dungeons from zoom**: Odd squares displayed in dungeons may be caused by the client being zoomed in; zoom level 5 is native resolution. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550402712057675847)
- **old partially completed maps**: Old partially completed maps appear in an unhued color and cannot be placed into a map tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536781330233172041)
- **on-demand map location assignment**: Under the new map system, a map's location is determined in real time on demand so the server can prevent two people from doing maps on top of each other, so old locations are presumably wiped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529347661025513575)
- **on-screen command buttons**: The on-screen command buttons such as 'all follow me' and 'all kill' are in-game macros found under Paperdoll -> Options -> Macros. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525786248340574360)
- **on-screen countdown icon cooldowns**: The on-screen countdown icon is a general cooldown indicator, not specific to spell casting, and many different cooldowns exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550631740521848974)
- **one user per ip rule**: Outlands allows one user per IP address, so a friend playing on the shard from the same IP risks a ban, while changing IP when traveling is not a problem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522638068190941234)
- **opening aspect gump via paperdoll icon**: Double-click the pentagram-like icon at the top of your paperdoll, or use the Gumps menu on the top button bar if enabled, to open the Aspect gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526024996411936819)
- **opening boom trap box**: Opening a big boom trap box in your own inventory will still make it explode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542693001049018378)
- **opening random boxes safely**: Do not open random boxes unless you are inside your house or an inn room, because they may be trapped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532423219087278164)
- **opening the echo window**: Type [echo in game to open the echo window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536811133275480234)
- **opening the journal**: The Journal opens with Alt + J (a default macro) or from the top menu bar under Gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551342039713710213)
- **orc progressive spawn rare**: The rare from the orc progressive spawn is unusable orc armor that is a deco item and cannot be worn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723395968536706)
- **order and chaos system**: Order and Chaos on this shard is implemented as the Town Struggles system, documented on the wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534239805687336960)
- **organizer agent banking**: To use the organizer agent to put items in the bank, place an empty bag in the bank and target that bag, because the bank box itself cannot be targeted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525970750740369420)
- **organizer and unidentified items**: An organizer cannot distinguish between identified and unidentified items, so the magic item recycler is the tool to use for handling unidentified magic items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545792888024076288)
- **out of range color option**: Enable 'No color for objects out of range' in the General options to show the world outside your field of view in a grayscale gradient. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538152142534221984)
- **outlands themed grid loot**: To get the minimal Outlands-themed corpse grid loot, go to Options > General > Corpses > Grid Loot and enable 'Use Outlands theming for Grid Loot'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530595808288964718)
- **outlands ui features**: Outlands has many gumps for its systems, plus extra UI features such as nameplates, cooldowns, collectors, and dynamic buffs on any mobile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524966254023278794)
- **outlining impassable objects hidden by cot**: To outline impassable objects affected by Circle of Transparency, enable Options > General > Miscellaneous > Outline impassable objects affected by CoT. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523055081501622405)
- **overhead experience messages**: Overhead messages for experience systems, such as harvest aspect EXP, can likely be controlled through the [Commands text menu, which has verbal bracket commands for overheads for most XP systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528114638066155520)
- **overhead poison text**: Overhead poison text on a creature shows its poison level, so you can check whether it has Greater poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533749497044275321)
- **overheal and volatile codex upgrades**: Overheal and Volatile are optional potion codex upgrades; Overheal gives extra heals, and Volatile is generally not used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525183956868141149)
- **overweight purchase drop**: If a purchase would make you more than 50 stones overweight, the purchased items drop to the ground instead of going into your pack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528822277125312705)
- **overwriting an echo**: An available echo can be overwritten with your current build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540795813423358013)
- **pack animal death item drop**: If a pack animal (mule) dies, the items it carried fall to its corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539344310053634098)
- **pack animal for low-level t-maps**: After the T-map update, a pack animal may be needed to carry lower-level maps, though this is not expected to be a problem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531077113887723641)
- **panacea codex ability and disease**: With the Panacea codex ability, Greater Cure potions can cure Disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538888535841579048)
- **paperdoll title selection**: To choose a paperdoll title, open the Help menu and select the titles option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530994852530098387)
- **parry and resist tranquility vs alchemy freedom**: Parry and Resist together give level 4 Tranquility for a relaxed playstyle, whereas Alchemy requires more active attention to benefit from the 10% damage reduction of Freedom. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554572090395463745)
- **parry from gold links**: Four gold links give 19 parry skill, a 9.5% chance to parry and reduce damage taken by 75%, which averages to roughly 7% damage reduction in a separate layer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543739466043232336)
- **parry link damage reduction cap**: The parry link damage reduction functions separately, so the 75% damage resist cap can be reached with no diminished returns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543739868851470446)
- **party chat**: Start a chat message with / to send it as a party message. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544948554005483582)
- **party invite prompt window**: To show the party invite prompt window, go to Options > General > Party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529949737694793768)
- **party kill count sharing for society jobs**: Partying with other players shares kill counts towards Society Jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533218524221149224)
- **party ping duration setting**: The party pings section under general options lets you set a maximum duration for pings placed on the ground or on mobiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529677055912968212)
- **party quest progress boost**: Partying up may boost quest progress for a while when hunting monsters, though the author is unsure of the details. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533495557568463018)
- **party settings management**: To manage party settings, say [party or double click the appropriate scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545200789092442192)
- **party shared xp and gold**: Parties share XP, and shared gold counts toward each member's newbie quests, in addition to combined damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525714947739353088)
- **passive boat riding for xp**: Having a friend ride along on a boat while you farm NPC ships and receive XP without actively participating is not allowed, as it counts as unattended gameplay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548371900743549061)
- **past names display after name change**: The feature that shows past names in scrolls on the paperdoll after a name change does not currently work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532433590430728202)
- **patch notes accuracy**: Patch notes do not always match the actual in-game mechanics and code, so mechanics must be verified by playing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528767618817720381)
- **peaced target accuracy bonus**: Attacking a peaced target gives a 15% accuracy bonus; combined with leveled azures this reaches about 80% accuracy, the soft cap, without link investment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545544889025171487)
- **penalty-free player kills**: A player can only be killed without penalty if they are grey, though this is stated with uncertainty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538398487002095697)
- **per-player poison counters on mobs**: Each mob likely keeps a separate poison counter for each player applying poison against it, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554134130290200617)
- **pet abandonment after logout**: Pets that are not stabled and remain out of range for 24 hours after you log out become abandoned, while stabled pets or pets with you at logout are unaffected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555304827171373177)
- **pet bonding in shelter dungeon**: Pets can be bonded in the shelter dungeon at any level, and bonded pets can be resurrected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554291219675480147)
- **pet bonding method**: In Outlands, pets are bonded by fighting alongside them until the pet reaches level 1, not by feeding them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534602166868643900)
- **pet breeding for stats**: There is no breeding of pets for stats on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529287769304600768)
- **pet command speech throttle**: Issuing pet commands too quickly can hit a speech throttle, causing tames to ignore them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555054735243870246)
