- **pet control slot variation**: Different pets take different numbers of control slots, which can be checked with Animal Lore. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532780950046376060)
- **pet deletion**: Pets can be deleted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522344611555704854)
- **pet feeding requirement**: Outlands removed the pet feeding requirement for bonding and for breaking bonds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534602166868643900)
- **pet following after login**: Pets do not automatically follow you immediately after you log in; after that initial moment they follow as expected. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536790075961118792)
- **pet healing icon triage**: The healing icon shown on pets is the Triage icon, and it appears only once the Triage skill is unlocked in the Healing codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543621649541365851)
- **pet level cap**: The pet level cap was recently raised from 10 to 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556035085944230030)
- **pet loss when logging off without stabling**: Pets do not need to be stabled at every logout, but pets of players who log off and do not return for a week or two have been lost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542547760169885817)
- **pet name preservation on mount token**: A pet's name is not preserved when it is turned into a mount token. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538576415677747241)
- **pet name spaces**: Pet names may not be allowed to contain spaces, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544286715689173132)
- **pet naming gump behavior**: When an unacceptable pet name is entered, the naming gump does not reset and only a system message appears. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546280144782495945)
- **pet poison tracking**: Poison is applied as individual stacks for pets and multiple players, and pet poison damage appears under follower damage in the damage tracker rather than poison damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542521416774320194)
- **pet rebalance patch**: A large pet rebalance patch was released in the weeks before 2026-08-20, and many pets are still being tested. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540107768223105135)
- **pet rename invalid name behavior**: When renaming a pet with an unacceptable name, the typed name is not automatically cleared, but a system message is shown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542180415987781712)
- **pet stabling in dungeons and ridden pets**: Pets can be stabled while in dungeons, and a pet you are riding does not take up a stable slot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539728799636127846)
- **pet stat needs for quests and zoology**: A pet does not need perfect stats if it is used only for a society quest or to complete its zoology entry. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553461193195397181)
- **pet stat variation ranges**: Pet stats vary from -10% to +10% of base, except speed, which varies from -5% to +5%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555660939829841982)
- **pet teleport and rope behavior**: Pets will teleport or rope with you as long as you have not recently been in combat. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536789178665148457)
- **pet transfer to another account**: To transfer a pet to another account, dismount, click the pet, and use the transfer button in its context menu (unconfirmed, recalled from memory). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533077365192921128)
- **pets in all guard versus reds**: Pets set to All Guard will not attack a red on their own; you only get the red-gate debuff if you order pets to attack the red, cast a spell on it, or engage it yourself. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536852748472033292)
- **phylactery chromatic harvest aspect core drops**: Phylacteries, Chromatic and the Harvest aspect (for treasure mappers) reduce droprate RNG and increase the number of cores gained from loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520926909259841599)
- **pickpocketing locations**: Pickpocketing can be done anywhere except Sanctuary dungeons and Shelter Island. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526096120697065504)
- **pickpocketing precautions**: Players can guard against pickpocketing with lock boxes and trapped pouches or chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526096435919978566)
- **pickpockets near banks**: Pickpockets wait near banks and steal from careless players, so players should rent at least the smallest inn room and keep non-gold items there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529264469639692351)
- **pink chat messages**: Pink chat messages are announcements of other players getting achievements. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527441607375196262)
- **pink spellbooks blessing**: The pink spellbooks that hold the spells you know are always automatically blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528605808919576736)
- **pit trial leaderboard display**: The pit trial leaderboard shows only each player's highest score, and its details button reveals the other party members who played with that player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555201820736102481)
- **pk death consequences**: PKs can kill a player and take their loadout and loot, but they cannot steal the player's experience. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548293988404953229)
- **pk death penalties**: A PK on Outlands who dies loses their bounty, may be kicked out of their current dungeon for a while, and can have their non-blessed items looted without penalty, and the monetary loss is typically modest, around 20k gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531170401600929936)
- **pk loot protection of progression items**: PKs cannot steal progression items such as the codex, chain, or aspect, so losing gear to a PK costs only cheap, replaceable equipment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522716538728349949)
- **planned loot all corpse button**: A planned patch will add a button on your own corpse to loot all items and auto-equip them, but it is reportedly paused in testing and has no confirmed release date. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534565596665090109)
- **planned poison system rework**: The developer's stated vision is for poison to be based on individual debuffs per source rather than the global server tick, so poison would tick 5 seconds after application; this is not the current behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520791606452682793)
- **planned shirt layer change**: Owyn reportedly plans to move shirts to a layer that would cover chest armor, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524792777416900840)
- **plate armor dexterity penalty**: Plate armor has no dexterity penalty on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522008372440858705)
- **player killer consequences**: Player killers become social pariahs and may optionally have their bounty increased. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520472741575393290)
- **player killer lockout duration**: Player killers who die without having taken aggressive action receive only a 15 minute lockout, shorter than the 30 minute lockout for dying after aggression. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539684243528093757)
- **player movement speed and sight distance**: Players move about 11 tiles per second and have an 18-tile sight distance without the Tracking skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542418524532641802)
- **player stats screen accuracy**: The player stats screen is not always 100% accurate and may not reflect certain bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532487111213711411)
- **player visibility range**: Players can see other players only up to roughly 12 to 18 tiles away, though the exact distance is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538413389531848774)
- **playing the right echo**: To play the other echo (the one shown on the right), use the command '.click activate echo'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524836795190214776)
- **poison and disease mastery links**: There are separate mastery links for poison and for disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525559098505039984)
- **poison aspect armor resolution**: The poison aspect armor likely resolves poison ticks rather than poison stings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060543365554308)
- **poison aspect benefits**: The poison aspect's armor-side benefit comes from the armor, while the weapon proc comes from the weapon, and it reportedly only helps with a Poisoning skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530428691073470614)
- **poison codex for fire buff**: The poison codex can be taken to buff fire damage (fire procs) rather than to apply poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521617736591999006)
- **poison damage codex link upgrade**: A poison damage codex link can only be upgraded to damage to diseased, not damage to poisoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521978064882503933)
- **poison field poison level cap**: Poison Field probably cannot inflict deadly or lethal poison. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524015208647888939)
- **poison in town**: Poison is impossible in town, which may also apply to poisoned food. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535080345844719778)
- **poison kit accumulation and enfeeble effects**: The Poison Kit effect Accumulation increases damage dealt to poisoned targets by 15%, and the effect Enfeeble grants 20% damage resistance against poisoned targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538030504647987221)
- **poison nerf likelihood**: Luthius has said he reconfigured how poison works in the code and poison is currently very powerful, so a poison nerf is considered likely but not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521979486835314809)
- **poison nerf test**: A poison nerf is being tested on the test server, but it was reportedly implemented incorrectly, so its final effect is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528797575107444829)
- **poison recoding**: A poison recoding is reportedly planned or underway and may nerf poison dexers to some degree, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521613078469545994)
- **poison spell upgrade**: After the patch, the Poison spell can be upgraded, which enables the Sting upgrade; before the patch it could not be upgraded. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534426665369862154)
- **poison stacking and tick timing**: Only one tier of poison can be on a target regardless of how many sources apply poison, and poison ticks follow the target's server tick rather than the time of application. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520791606452682793)
- **poison stacks on a single target**: A single player does not get multiple stacks of poison on one target; only one active poison stack from that player exists on a creature at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524405263501758494)
- **poison sting**: Poison Sting is a special effect that occurs when a target is already poisoned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060663112933496)
- **poison sting chance**: Poison sting chance depends on multiple formulas (weapon speed scalar and chance to apply poison), so a character with 30 effective Poisoning can still fail to sting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534911203640344676)
- **poison tick definition**: A poison tick is one instance of damage from a single poison stack, so ticks are the number of times a single stack damages a target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544060723498582037)
- **poison tier upgrade and damage**: The chance to upgrade through poison spell tiers depends on your Poisoning skill, while poison damage per tick depends on the tier achieved and your Taste Identification skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553864713262333985)
- **poison-dependent links**: Links that require a poisoned target only work with poison applied by your own build or your pets; another player's poison does not enable your poison links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554133561970262137)
- **poisoned food**: Food can be poisoned on Outlands; it is labelled 'poisoned' like a poisoned weapon and poisons whoever eats it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535079946052177950)
- **polymorph grey flag**: Casting polymorph makes the player grey, and the player stays grey after the spell wears off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522333743136903280)
- **popular society job type**: Players usually do the crafting society jobs, which are simple and easy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532527918880788782)
- **portal vendor locate tracking arrow**: In the portal vendor search, click 'locate vendor' to open an in-game menu that works as a tracking arrow to the vendor; it can auto-open the vendor backpack and the item will flash. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554111890609668239)
- **portal vendor search scan interval**: Vendors are scanned for the Outlands portal vendor search approximately every 5 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543960457969410130)
- **post tier 15 eldritch options**: After reaching tier 15 Eldritch, a player can buy another echo or rewrite their build into something like a follower damage Frost summoner or Arcane mage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526636351535976599)
- **post-skill pvm progression in pvp**: Post-skill PvM progression systems do not take effect during PvP but still apply to monsters while you are in PvP (with a few exceptions), so harder PvM areas are difficult without progression, although you can hunt players in areas you can handle and positioning and mob aggro knowledge help. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526325512316649585)
- **post-skill pvm progression systems**: Outlands has four post-skill progression systems for PvM content. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520605923629076633)
- **potent spellbook function**: A Potent spellbook contains no spells itself; the character's Magery spellbook provides the castable spells, while the Potent book acts as a magical spellbook similar to a magical weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544872903609421925)
- **potion buff duration**: The duration of potion buffs in Outlands varies considerably depending on alchemy skill, water aspect, and potion codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528127347385958624)
- **potion codex bandolier upgrade**: In the potion codex, the bandolier maximum is the only required upgrade. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525183776781500427)
- **potion codex benefit**: Leveling the potion codex provides benefits outside of PvP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526928046647414925)
- **potion codex effects**: The Potion Codex provides strong buffs and makes explosive potions more powerful. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523071797598355597)
- **potion codex elixir damage reduction bonus**: With the Potion Codex, having Strength, Agility and Resist elixirs active may give a flat 7.5% damage reduction bonus, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552029970463723622)
- **potion codex name**: The codex commonly called the Alchemy Codex is actually named the Potion Codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545454627808616499)
- **potion magic resist display**: A greater STR potion displays 20 in the magic resist field while other potions can show 0, so there may be no specific numeric magic resist value for the potion effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529306223953055904)
- **potion shared cooldowns**: Cure and Total Refresh potions have no shared cooldown and can be used instantly, while the other potions likely share a cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539547234595635260)
- **preloading aspect cores or distills**: There is no way to preload a character with aspect cores or distills so they are used automatically on level-up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526700727542612099)
- **prerequisite for lowering dexterity**: Dexterity can only be lowered once Strength and Intelligence are both at 100, since the total must reach the cap first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525863250355421388)
- **presnooping by thieves at vendors**: Thieves can presnoop a player who is buying from a vendor, so players should make sure they are not presnooped before purchasing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534573328487026859)
- **pressure points melee bonus**: Pressure Points increases the player's melee damage against creatures by 5%, 15% or 25% depending on rank (1/2/2 points). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521780931437006908)
- **prevalia bank clothing rack**: The clothing rack item at the Prevalia bank on the test shard has every clothing item, including ones no longer available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547272263009828864)
- **prevalia gear armor check**: Clicking the info gem on Prevalia gear shows in system messages whether it counts as armor; if it does, it works with aspect activation. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533227927704174833)
- **prevalia items for aspect activation**: Prevalia items can be used to fill missing armor pieces to activate an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524809493307981866)
- **progression spending priority**: The recommended spending priority is all your codices first, then your next aspect upgrade, then bronze mastery chain links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529948325774753944)
- **progression systems beyond skills**: Skills are only a small part of character progression; aspects, codex, and the mastery chain are other important progression systems. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523010859058856006)
- **progression tied to account versus character**: Achievements, Society and Chain XP are tied to the account, while Codex XP and Aspect XP are tied to the character; nothing is tied to the Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531102818553958521)
- **progression xp sources**: XP in the progression systems is earned by killing monsters, stealing from monsters, or unlocking dungeon chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553773563969015949)
- **progressive spawn behavior**: A progressive spawn keeps spawning until it is killed, and once killed it can respawn after a time within a set range of hours. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547725880972021790)
- **progressive spawn mechanics**: A progressive spawn advances steadily as its mobs are killed, and any mob in the spawn can drop the potential rare. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547723112857083904)
- **proposed patch codex scaling**: The proposed patch aims to scale back power creep, and its most important change is scaling of codex effects, which will affect nearly everyone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528135307256397856)
- **proving someone is a thief**: To prove someone is a thief, use a detective lens together with the Detect Hidden skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540052942323712102)
- **pulled health bar resizing**: Pulled (dragged-out) health bars cannot be resized to fit longer monster names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520956686460784680)
- **purge impurities special resistance**: The special resistance on the earth elemental's Purge Impurities trait appears to be a chance to ignore poison and bleed ticks, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527556485100470282)
- **purple name plate meaning**: A purple name plate indicates an Allied Murderer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530322038869332008)
- **pushing through npcs and players**: Passing over (pushing through) NPCs or players requires 100 stamina even though the push itself consumes only 10 stamina, as it has always worked in UO. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544710974756626478)
- **pvm and pvp separation**: PvM and PvP are separated in UO Outlands, and the post-skill XP progression systems apply only to PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547377795255115826)
- **pvm boss bars for guilds**: Each area a player farms in PvM fills boss bars for that area, which the guild can then run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520287721484980325)
- **pvm characters account placement**: It is best practice to keep all characters you intend to progress through the PvM systems on a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545823351547633745)
- **pvm progression items in pvp**: PvM progression items such as codexes (including Wizard's Grimoire and the Potion Codex) do not work directly against players in PvP events, though features that damage mobs or reduce mob damage may still work against mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526656654677114992)
- **pvp build rules outside arena**: In the overworld or in dungeons any PvP build may be played; the arena build rules do not apply there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530708677366120619)
- **pvp event guild requirement**: PvP events in town and in dungeons may require being in a guild, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529424983732912299)
- **pvp flag during events and wizard's grimoire**: Players are believed to be PvP flagged throughout a PvP event, which prevents Wizard's Grimoire features from being used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526656205143933098)
- **pvp flagging**: PvP flagging usually goes both ways, regardless of who is the victim. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535357890062196840)
- **pvp guild reward points sources**: PvP guild reward points come from PvP events such as Dungeon Flashpoints, where the top 10 participating players each earn 3 Guild Reward Points; ordinary blue vs gray/red player kills probably do not contribute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528634001672372335)
- **pvp pvm nameplate toggle**: Press Ctrl+Shift to pull up the nameplate and switch between PvP and PvM. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535167333406871643)
- **pvp targeting options**: PvP targeting only supports next and previous target among nearby targets, while only PvE targets have a closest-target option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539912023415066684)
- **quest money earned restriction**: A quest's description states whether the quest is restricted by money earned. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523758266675499018)
- **quest tracking popup**: Enabling the 'track' option on a quest makes the game show a popup gump when the quest is finished, and quests can otherwise be reviewed via the Quests button on the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522267428632006838)
- **quest xp across dungeons**: Quest XP can be earned from quests in any dungeon, so there is no need to change dungeons after every quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520508541234839853)
- **random spawns versus progressive spawns**: Random spawns (tent spawns with a chest) are a different thing from progressive spawns. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546521832285540352)
- **random world events**: Random world events such as waylaid caravans are standalone flavor encounters and are not part of any quest. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543486554045947935)
- **ranking dungeon skull in paperdoll**: The ranking dungeon skull shown in the paperdoll is a Redline Trophy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548328457946144779)
- **re-trapping nested pouches**: A mage can put a trapped pouch inside another pouch and trap the outer pouch again, layering traps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530640171077206227)
- **reagent satchel theft**: A worn reagent satchel cannot itself be stolen, but reagents inside it can be stolen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538902629575565383)
- **reapplying an aspect**: To reapply an aspect, double click the blue diamond on the book, weapon or armour; aspects do not affect clothing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549976783703515187)
- **reason afk leveling rule persists**: The rule against unattended aspect leveling still exists because some players circumvent the stationary penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555882692103639091)
- **reason resource maps are non-scriptable**: The Outlands developers made the new resource maps non-scriptable because they wanted map use to be more active. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1537313390882717706)
- **recall casting vulnerability**: Casting Recall roots you in place before you disappear, giving thieves an opportunity to steal from you during the cast. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555626300935372910)
- **recall casting with inscription**: A character with Inscription may be able to cast Recall using scrolls and spellstones carried in their bags, which would explain recall casts that needed no reagents or charges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522387217337548890)
- **recall command addition**: The '[recall' command was added to UO Outlands in a patch within roughly the past year, though the exact patch is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1550492141921509407)
- **recall from scroll mana cost**: Casting Recall from a scroll requires mana. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539988924431335495)
- **recent patch content**: Recent Outlands patches added a new Ossuary level, guild prestige changes, pit trial changes, creature facing mechanics (target arcs), and weapon setup bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545455209814167633)
- **recent patch contents**: The recent patch combined a treasure map rework with gold decay and taming changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537140410810507316)
- **recent patch mage changes**: After the recent patch, shield stance recovers mana, lightning hinders every 15 seconds, E-bolt recovers 15 mana, and the catalyst finisher does more red damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525689936806805584)
- **recovering from being stuck while dead**: If stuck while dead, use the stuck command in Options > Help to teleport to town, visit a healer there (or find a wandering healer or healer caravan) to resurrect, then run back to recover your corpse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552541386111193159)
- **recovering lost bonded pet or mount**: To recover a lost bonded mount or pet, use the stablemaster's option to retrieve lost followers (it may be on a second page of the menu); the wrangler NPC offers similar functionality. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525132687864758482)
- **recovering misplaced pets**: A pet that has been physically misplaced can still be recovered at a stablemaster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551275959318085744)
- **recycle all magic items option**: The recycle-all-magic option recycles all magic weapons and armor in the inventory, so players should not carry anything they want to keep; it does not affect codex items such as the Wizard's Grimoire or Summoner Tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553902721785008290)
- **recycler add unidentified fallback**: If 'Add All Unidentified Items From Backpack' finds 0 recyclable items in the magic item recycler, use 'Dump Into Recycler' instead; afterwards 'Add All Unidentified Items From Backpack' works again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526620759915630713)
- **recycler settings with vault**: After obtaining the magic item vault, lower the recycler settings to catch more items that have multiple lower tier modifiers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550061718103920691)
- **recycling weapons slayer setting**: To make weapons recyclable in the item recycler, set the slayer category to 'none'; instruments have similar settings that must also be configured. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527361776373465330)
- **red collector behavior**: The red collector does nothing unless there is a red or grey target. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542563959775825990)
- **red containers on the ground**: Red containers on the ground are trapped and will explode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526112000529272923)
- **red hand death restriction in nusero**: Red Hand players who die in Nusero receive a 30 minute Account Aggression Restriction; the fix is to switch to Black Hand or switch dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547598122975494227)
- **red hand guild and murderer status sharing**: Red hand guild membership and murderer notoriety are shared across the character, not tracked per Echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535265238583349258)
- **red hand lockout scope**: The Red Hand death lockout applies across the whole Outlands ID rather than only to a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539679283537252382)
- **red hand lockout when switching hands**: Switching hands, such as to Grey Hand, does not instantly lift the Red Hand lockout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538062587160305714)
- **red hand notoriety when attacked**: A Red Hand player always turns Grey (but not Criminal) to any player who attacks them, even if they initially appeared Blue to that player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555309760528650411)
- **red hand thief baiting tactics**: A Red Hand thief can swap to Gray after stealing to bait an attack that allows murder counts to be given, and some Red Hand thieves bait you into attacking first so they can kill you without taking a count. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552687246950400121)
- **red hand thieves guild restrictions**: A character that is a red hand Thieves Guild member can be restricted from dungeons and unable to loot their own body after dying to a mob; a thief NPC can fix this. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538981412840022018)
- **red hand upgrade bonus for black goods**: Red Hand members of the Thieves Guild get a 10% bonus to Upgrade chances for Black Goods acquired from stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546636874737516544)
- **red murderer status**: A player becomes red (murderer) upon reaching 5 murder counts and returns to blue once counts burn off with time and drop below 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530328284850819154)
- **red players in towns during faction events**: Red (murderer) players can enter towns during Faction events (town vs. town PvP events) without being attacked by town guards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538341679642185768)
- **red-hand thief status duration**: The red-hand thief status lasts about 30 minutes, the same as the thief flag, though this figure is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545585344974426152)
- **red-handed thief attackability**: A red-handed thief can be attacked or killed by anyone, anywhere, at any time, without the attacker needing to be flagged. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535713740895428689)
- **red-named players and murder counts**: Red-named (murderer) players cannot give murder counts because they are always grey to others and open to being killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543381167565176954)
- **redlightning bottles**: Redlightning Bottles are a late game item related to the Redline System. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552279935291359255)
- **redline account scope**: Redline is account-wide once it has been unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528212016676733028)
- **redline aspect account requirement**: The three aspects needed to unlock redline should all be on a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547876822862135307)
- **redline aspect cap increase**: With Redline, points can be spent to raise the aspect cap, possibly up to 20, but the costs are steep for small gains. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **redline carry capacity**: Increasing redline increases total carry weight and item count, taking carry capacity from roughly 450 or 600 up to about 1k or 1.2k. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544665457179627570)
- **redline chain cap spending**: Players invested in Redline typically spend their first points on raising the chain cap for specific link types so they can slot 15 links of the same type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548816009711067257)
- **redline contribution conditions**: Activities contribute to Redline only while the aspect is in use during XP activities; crafting and harvesting wood or ingots do not contribute. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550852880813264977)
- **redline damage cap increase**: The redline damage cap increase is reported to grant +250 maximum damage on any hit, but this is only a question and is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 0 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536533834018066512)
- **redline farming strategy**: Farming each Redline source (wilderness, dungeons, ocean) equally earns Redline points faster than focusing on one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900889710661722)
- **redline gain xp cost**: Each redline gain costs 500k xp on the ocean, whereas it costs 1 million xp everywhere else. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531369012255260723)
- **redline level xp requirement**: Each Redline level requires 1 million more XP than the previous to reach the next level. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **redline link cap increase**: Redline can raise the same-type mastery link cap above 10 and is the final progression system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526455532674748517)
- **redline points in dungeons**: There is no low cap on redline points in a dungeon; players have reportedly been seen with over 30 in a single spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536321300170022984)
- **redline progression source**: Redline progression runs off gold farmed rather than harvest XP. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525943826257023150)
- **redline sharing across characters**: Redline is shared across characters on the same account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538212169143812176)
- **redline trophy location in achievements menu**: Redline Trophies are likely listed under the trophy category of the achievements menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548328772900495452)
- **redline xp from dungeons**: Players can cycle through all the dungeons for Redline XP, so dungeon farming rarely pushes them to higher, more expensive Redline levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **redline xp from treasure maps**: Treasure maps only grant Redline XP from the Wilderness source, so progress from tmaps is capped at wilderness points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529900743639830738)
- **refilling watering cans and pitchers**: Watering cans can be refilled from a water source, but pitchers apparently cannot be refilled even though they prompt for a water source. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531404405293711592)
- **refresh potion pass-through**: Drinking a refresh potion lets you move through other players when your stamina is full. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535253952130584686)
- **region lock penalty**: A region lock penalty appears in the buff bar and usually lasts 30 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550111152334307482)
- **regional and creature-type slayer links**: All regional slayer links and creature-type slayer links were converted into damage dealt by player links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540429800034795580)
- **regional gold bonus and xp**: The regional gold bonus does not boost XP gains, but the XP bonus and the Challenger dungeon do. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529505219296362727)
- **releasing a named follower by speech**: If a follower has a name, you can release it by saying its name followed by 'release'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680877763919902)
- **releasing a single follower via healthbar**: To release one particular follower, open the followers' healthbars, shift-click the bar of the mob you want to release, and select release. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546680814526267522)
- **releasing all followers**: Clicking yourself and choosing 'release all followers' frees up pet slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524148378261393618)
- **releasing summons through animal lore gump**: Summoned creatures may be releasable through the Animal Lore gump, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1551743284177670145)
- **relog fixing missing name display**: Logging out and back in fixed a character's missing name display above its head. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544511877357379725)
- **remembering container positions**: To remember container positions, enable 'remember all containers' under Options > interface, and keep the containers open on screen when you log out and close the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550242067656089691)
- **remembering container positions**: In the Outlands client, enable the option in Options > Interface to remember all container positions, and the game will remember where you moved each container for the rest of that client session. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1536896186957570069)
- **remove curse effect**: The Remove Curse effect does not give a chance to ignore an active effect; it only gives a chance to not receive any new effect, so putting points in it is generally a waste. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529541500772552834)
- **removed mage mana refund**: A 10-15% mana refund previously helped sustain mage damage output but has since been removed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543355186771136712)
- **removing aspect from an item**: To remove the aspect from an item, drop the item on a wall; it returns to your pack without the aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554130046359314535)
- **removing aspect from imbued items**: Dragging an aspect-imbued item onto your supply shelf removes its aspect effects and color, as does dropping it on the floor, so avoid doing either with items you want to keep imbued. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542941494619668590)
- **removing buff icons**: To remove a buff icon, hold ALT while clicking it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532437233758638301)
- **removing collected hp bars**: To get rid of collected HP bars, use Alt + right click; this can also be changed in options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554377858066030593)
- **removing essence from aspect menu**: Essence cannot be removed once it has been moved into the aspect menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522776438397337720)
- **removing health bar collector**: Alt+right-click removes a health bar collector from the screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533313761795113051)
- **removing item aspects**: Aspect is removed from aspected items by taking them out of your immediate possession; there is no command to unaspect many items at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548319805738590251)
- **removing linked nameplates after selection drag**: To get rid of linked nameplates that appear after dragging a selection rectangle over players, hold Alt and right click on them; holding Alt and dragging also moves them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533555803825504407)
- **removing mastery chain links**: Removing a link from a Mastery link chain puts that link in your backpack, so do it in a safe place. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553073275217911841)
- **removing murder counts**: Murder counts are removed by staying logged in and letting them burn off over time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529873602965671946)
- **removing on-screen macro buttons**: On-screen macro buttons can be edited in Options under the macro section, and removed with alt + right click, which is likely the default. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521591610637549631)
- **removing tracking boxes and hp gumps**: To remove stray tracking boxes/HP gumps, right click them (the preset may now require Alt held) or create a macro to close them; they are regular HP gumps that appear when you accidentally click and drag a mobile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525004686879359057)
- **rename lock option for followers**: If clicking a follower's name does not rename it, the rename lock option (Options -> General -> Mobiles header) may be enabled, in which case you must press ctrl + alt while clicking to rename it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525737187197325423)
- **renaming a follower**: To rename a follower, click the follower's name on its health bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525737187197325423)
- **renaming pets**: To rename a pet, single click its name in its healthbar to place the cursor in the text field, backspace the old name, type the new name and press enter; if the name is used by an existing character or is profane, a system message in the journal rejects it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538575278756995103)
- **reopening a closed gump**: Pressing ctrl shift brings back up a closed gump, though the author was uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527521579569774613)
- **reopening weapon/parry codex**: Create a hotkey that opens the weapon/parry codex so it can be reopened quickly after a client restart. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544819119772139571)
- **repent system for murderers**: The repent system for murderers has been removed from Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538450397855879269)
- **reporting red-handed thieves**: A player killed by a red-handed thief cannot report that thief for the theft. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521552955969372201)
- **repositioning locked gumps**: If a gump or icon is locked in place outside the book, hold Alt while moving it to reposition it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550622528991526924)
- **resetting chivalry necromancy hotbar position**: To reset the position of the chivalry/necromancy hotbar, delete its entry in the gump manager section of Options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548880498019799093)
- **resetting display scaling**: Reset display scaling in the Options video tab; a gump menu also lets you reset individual interface components. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546113877979439154)
- **resizing the game viewport**: Uncheck the fullsize option, set the window size to something small, then drag the blue gem in the bottom right corner of the viewport to resize it with the mouse. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534195358199058442)
- **resource and treasure map tome exchange**: Resource map tomes and treasure map tomes are expected to be exchangeable for any other type of tome rather than refunded, as was done for aspect tomes when added to stockpiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528242681904369774)
- **resource map change requiring cartography**: The upcoming resource map change is expected to require Cartography for harvesters and to work like treasure maps, where the map is decoded and then hiked to. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531095018771714108)
- **resource map count after patch**: After the resource map patch, the number of resource maps in the world reportedly dropped because many maps were combined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544452321969311815)
- **resource map destination**: Under the new resource map system, the location a map leads to is random and not shown in advance, so players do not know where they will end up until the map is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528170505058652170)
- **resource map experience**: Completing a resource map grants harvest experience of about 1.0 XP per swing, but does not grant long-term character experience the way opening a treasure map chest does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1529592541752856776)
- **resource map loading bars anti-abuse**: The new resource map system uses loading bars that prevent resource maps from being abused by stacking multiple maps in one spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544487515975590008)
- **resource map overhaul patch**: An upcoming Outlands patch will overhaul resource maps (tmaps), though the details are not yet fully final. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536179859561250866)
- **resource map skill requirements**: In the testing patch, resource maps require the specific harvesting skill (e.g. mining or lumberjacking) but not cartography, as of the current test state. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536003805374709760)
- **resource map time limit**: A 30 minute time limit applies to resource maps as well as to other maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536761651649314857)
- **resource map timing**: On the test shard each resource map has a 15-second delay at the start, a 5-second hike, and another 15-second delay on top of the camp, taking about 90.5 seconds minimum with a ~40-second baseline, and Avarscale maps take roughly 2.5-3 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536063026464034846)
- **restoring a lost top bar gump**: If the top bar gump is lost, open Options > Windows Manager and reset the Top Bar Gump to restore it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534561855630999572)
- **restoring closed nameplates**: Toggle the Always Active nameplate setting off and then on to bring back all closed nameplates; the toggle also works while the setting is on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545532513743540344)
- **restoring closed nameplates and red menu**: If a nameplate (including your own) was closed by right click or alt+right click, toggle 'Always Active' off and on to restore all nameplates, and press Shift+Ctrl to bring back the red menu if it is gone. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549670593622708345)
- **restoring name above head**: To restore your name above your head, open the nameplate menu with Ctrl+Shift, untick 'always', then tick it again. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535580983590658088)
- **restoring name plate toggle menu**: Holding Ctrl+Shift brings back the top left menu used to toggle name plates on and off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537762629026848818)
- **restylable blessed head item**: Only the leather cap can be restyled and blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549924913886793780)
- **restyle and bless order**: An item cannot be blessed before it is restyled, so restyle it first and then bless it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535850370692161636)
- **resupply shelf auto-equip behavior**: A resupply shelf automatically equips armor or weapons in your loadout if you are not already wearing or holding some, and there is no known way to prevent this; it ignores magic armor you are wearing and still equips crafted armor from the loadout. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552052733568090225)
- **resurrecting a killed bonded pet**: A bonded pet that has been killed can be resurrected at a healer; if you logged out and someone killed it, you may first need to retrieve it from the stablemaster/wrangler NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539973815621128232)
- **resurrecting after dying on a boat**: After dying on a boat, you may need to click yourself and throw yourself overboard to resurrect, though the exact steps are uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526926651219251221)
- **resurrection sources**: You can be resurrected at ankhs, wandering healers, healer caravans, and town healers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532754149178085508)
- **retrieving abandoned pets**: If the stats gump followers tab shows 0/5 and no pets, and you did not stable them, visit an Animal Wrangler to attempt to retrieve your Abandoned Pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554795973253791754)
- **retrieving lost mount followers**: To recover a lost mount that still occupies a follower slot, use the Stablemaster's Retrieve Lost Followers option rather than the Animal Wrangler. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541645643435483137)
- **retrieving stuck pets**: If a pet is stuck, single-click your character and choose the "pull followers" option while close to the pets to bring them to you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551309553444851825)
- **returning lost monsters to map chest**: Clicking on the map chest gives an option to return any lost monsters back to it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540323882903539862)
- **reusable camping item duration**: A cheap, player-sold reusable camping item works like a kindling campfire but keeps you hike-ready for 60 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527323942237507587)
- **reusable camping item reusability**: The reusable camping items are not single-use and can be used repeatedly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527324152997085305)
- **reviving on a ship**: On a ship, a dead player may be able to revive by clicking the tillerman, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532113461230833734)
- **rewards for killing reds**: Rewards for killing reds come from the bounty system for killing reds and reporting murders, as described on the wiki, and heads can be cut off. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524743518021619753)
- **riding mounts and mount tokens without skills**: Any mount or mount token can be ridden without specific skills, but controlling actual tamed creatures requires the taming skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537859022722572439)
- **riding nightmare without taming**: A nightmare can reportedly be ridden without taming only by mounting while on an echo that grants taming and then switching to an echo without it, and after dying or dismounting you cannot remount without the taming echo. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554193944621879359)
- **robes and cosmetic armor visibility**: Robes cover much of the armor beneath them, and some cosmetic pieces visually hide the armor underneath and show skin instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526321498464321717)
- **rope hotkey and command**: A rope hotkey and a [rope command both exist in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530454978701824021)
- **rune tome**: A tome can be bought to hold runes, and runes are best used at bosses and places where you can sit and farm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532629368810242221)
- **rune tome charge casting**: Using a rune tome charge counts as casting a spell with the same delays, and automatic spell scroll usage may wrongly consume a scroll because of a missing code exception for rune tomes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534675905257935020)
- **rune tome transcribers**: Rune tome transcribers appear to have a single use each. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553223022419386524)
- **runebook blessed status**: A runebook is blessed, so it is retained on death. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528756343677387032)
- **runebook recall delay**: After you pick a destination on a runebook, there is a window of about 3 seconds before the recall happens, during which you can press another button such as an All Follow macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536790912917831780)
- **runetome capacity**: A runetome holds runes on two pages for roughly 16 runes total, though the exact count is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547579217397416057)
- **running a treasure map**: To run a treasure map in the new system, decode the map with Cartography and hike to the spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538222289735262218)
- **running stamina cost**: Running costs a small amount of stamina, but stamina regeneration is higher than the cost, so running does not result in a net stamina loss. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528131313062776964)
- **sacred journey early expiry**: Sacred Journey can drop before its 30 minutes have elapsed in dungeons, possibly triggered by a teleport pad, and has been buggy in the past. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528420632432480338)
- **sanctuary dungeon corpse looting**: In a sanctuary dungeon, only players who are green to you (guild, ally or party) can pick up items from your corpse before it turns to bones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544123814126821446)
- **sanctuary dungeon corpse protection**: A player's corpse in the sanctuary dungeon is likely protected from other players, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544123441697915032)
- **sanctuary dungeon rules**: In sanctuary dungeons criminal actions are not allowed, so you cannot be robbed or killed, and a blue corpse (the first 15 minutes) cannot be looted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553355285454917726)
- **sanctuary fame loss on death**: A 10% fame loss on death likely still applies in the Sanctuary dungeon, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520477783396978839)
- **sanctuary pvp avoidance**: Sanctuary is a way to avoid PvP while farming. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521931212539822170)
- **sanctuary reduction and weekly sanctuary dungeon**: The sanctuary experience and loot reduction is claimed to also apply to the weekly sanctuary dungeon choice, but this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538574340235206830)
- **sanctuary reset countdown command**: Typing [jobs shows the countdown to the Sanctuary dungeon reset in the lower left of the window; per a later report, the countdown is also visible via quests on the paperdoll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551356547441893468)
- **satchel scroll consumption roll**: The satchel's chance to not consume a scroll is a separate roll from the Inscription chance to not consume. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540136096334221312)
- **saving chivalry ability bar**: Use the command -savechivbar to save the chivalry ability bar so it persists after relogging. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538194325513437295)
- **saving client settings on exit**: To make sure client settings save, log out with the logout button on the paperdoll rather than closing the client with the X button, which prevents saving. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523842995403620353)
- **saving gump positions**: To save a gump position (e.g. the weapon ability hotbar), open options, hold Ctrl+Alt so pins appear on the gumps, then click the pin to save that location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530579112580612106)
- **saving necromancer hotbar manually**: The necromancer hotbar position can also be saved manually through Options > Gump Manager. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551987629111906386)
