- **scavenge gold and society quests**: Gold gained from scavenging does not count toward society quest progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529948779929800838)
- **scavenger agent pickup of dropped items**: A Scavenger Agent may pick up an item or bag dropped on the floor within milliseconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526672710233489569)
- **scientist achievement crafting credit**: Crafting great explosion potions and refresh potions does not appear to count toward the scientist achievement, which may be a bug. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539293142296170667)
- **screen flash on attack or low hp**: There is currently no in-game option to make the screen flash when under attack or at low HP, but it can be requested in the Suggestions channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540778240837423154)
- **scribe mana refund cap for mage tamers**: A mage tamer using Scribe stays under the mana refund cap, even at T15 aspect, unless running a magic spell book with some potency. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542884191761338420)
- **scroll consumption when casting**: Casting from a scroll attempts to consume it, but whether it is actually consumed depends on the player's effective Inscription skill and on the Wizard's Satchel if the scroll is inside one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521337303493120100)
- **search bar usage**: For some search bars, check the box to turn the search bar on first, type the search term, then press the blue gem. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537778021040132187)
- **season ranking trophies**: The top 3 placements in the season rankings earn trophies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520899551421005934)
- **seasonal mining trophies**: Seasonal mining trophies are awarded to the top miners each season, with a number 1 mining trophy for the winner. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544811915346448384)
- **second account login error**: A login error when entering a second account can occur if you spend too long on the character selection screens. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528232174623395981)
- **second tamer aspect**: Frost is possibly the second tamer aspect, though the author is unsure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543697505248874517)
- **second weapon skill codex requirement**: To progress a separate codex tied to a second weapon skill, a weapon of that skill must actually be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529816169643507713)
- **secondary weapon skill melee damage bonus**: A secondary weapon skill adds melee damage at the same rate as skills such as Camping, with a bonus of 25% * (Second Highest Weapon Skill / 100). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554996360258912370)
- **self taught perk type**: Self Taught is a Codex perk, not an aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526647234958196907)
- **sending loot to a specific bag**: To send all loot to a specific bag or pouch, open the loot grid window and select a lootbag inside that window; no script is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541596162971279422)
- **separate characters for red-hand thieves and pks**: Players who want red-hand thieves, PKs and similar characters have reasons to create additional separate characters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549509306078994434)
- **separating stacked pets**: To visually separate stacked pets, select one and command it to stay, move the rest a few tiles away, then repeat for another pet; setting all pets on patrol may also separate them visually. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525143744133988552)
- **server downtime login state**: When the server goes down it halts, and you are invisible upon logging back in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537089031588945931)
- **server rank command**: Typing [serverrank in game opens the server leaderboard lists, which show how you rank against other players doing the same activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537860475864490065)
- **server ranking command**: The server ranking command is possibly [serverrank or [serverrankings, and [commands lists all available commands so the exact name can be checked there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534649940662554686)
- **server rankings season length**: A Server Rankings season lasts 90 days, after which it resets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545419543583658014)
- **setting aspect level on test shard**: On the test shard, you can set aspect to a certain level by maxing it out and then using the arrow on the menu. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1556069760259596430)
- **setting summoned creatures to aggressive**: To set summoned creatures to aggressive behavior, single-click the creature, use Animal Lore on it, then press the abilities button to open its behavior screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531174573469335562)
- **setting the grab bag in razor**: There is no way to set the grab bag in Razor; it must be set via the ClassicUO SetGrabBag macro. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541645639094378528)
- **setting the grab bag with cuo macro**: The grab bag in Ultima Online: Outlands can be set with a ClassicUO (CUO) macro called SetGrabBag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541645639094378528)
- **setting traps while hidden**: A trap can be set while hidden, but triggering it reveals you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549712911725891665)
- **shadow aspect color on armor**: Using the Shadow aspect colour on armor requires unlocking the Shadow aspect and purchasing customizations, which is an advanced game function. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521507525227188326)
- **shadow aspect effects**: The Shadow aspect grants extra stealth steps and a chance to heal on step while stealthed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-18–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550416592528216135)
- **shadow aspect leveling**: The Shadow aspect levels only by backstabbing, or by running it on a weapon while using another PVM echo, which carries a 50% penalty because it only runs on the weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532191161689706616)
- **shadow aspect leveling strategy**: Raising Shadow on your mage book while on a necro echo is an acceptable strategy, and later you can do the same for shadow armor and another aspect on the weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521651357742796963)
- **shadow aspect specificity**: The Shadow aspect is specific to backstabbers and does not help other builds, so players should avoid build-specific aspects unless they play that build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534687156755239033)
- **shady fortune teller damage buff**: The shady fortune teller at the King's Faire sells a six-hour damage buff for four tickets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540523102293856336)
- **sharing treasure map fights**: Treasure map fights cannot be shared by bringing friends along on a hike; you need something like a gate to bring friends to the location. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537087051915067403)
- **shelter inn room and thieves**: Renting an inn room on Shelter Island does not protect against thieves unless you leave the room carrying valuables in your bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526674288395030548)
- **shepherd crook herding**: A shepherd crook herds pets when it is active; it does not need to be equipped. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532119179321282680)
- **shift single-click on health bars**: Shift single-clicking a health bar single-clicks the mob or player it represents, which shows that specific target's overhead bard and poison status. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533816280212181113)
- **ship control and boarding**: You can only control your own ship, but you can board and sink other ships, whether player or NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555047436853182597)
- **ship crewmembers wiki page**: The Outlands wiki page 'Ship Crewmembers' at https://wiki.uooutlands.com/Ship_Crewmembers lists what each crew member provides. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540398659965943908)
- **ship hold items after docking**: Items left in a ship's hold remain on the ground at the spot where the ship was docked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541233319805587627)
- **ship keys and thieves**: Ship keys cannot be stolen or recalled to; you only get a rune, which thieves cannot steal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521724622779711569)
- **ship pvp overflow into pvm**: One player believes ship PvP would not overflow into PvM, contrary to what they think the developers fear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521678441211236452)
- **ship safety when docked**: Other players can board your ship, bring you to low health, kill you, loot the ship, and sink it; docking in a town such as Shelter does not make you safe because you remain grey and attackable. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532407897621790850)
- **ship wake visibility**: A bigger ship wake lets the ship be spotted from further away; with a 150% wake, a ship can be seen from 150 tiles by a spyglass that sees 100 tiles. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523664136448250077)
- **ships and crew**: Ships are needed to sail the ocean and boat crew provide support and bonuses; crew are similar to tamer followers and have stats. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551668459941666817)
- **shove message meaning**: When you cannot move onto a tile and get a log message like 'you shove something', an invisible mobile or player is on that tile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542847656177565807)
- **showing and hiding creature nameplates and health bars**: Health bars above creatures are nameplates with health enabled; press Shift+Ctrl to open the red menu and toggle Always Active to show or hide them (also restores nameplates if all were closed by right-clicking), hold Shift+Ctrl for temporary nameplates on all mobs, or use hotkeys or drag health bars out from a monster. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540780748502466741)
- **showing buff icon values**: To see buff amounts such as the percent damage increase on buff icons, enable Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Show Buff Icon Values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537561215125954560)
- **showing debuff icons on monster health bars**: To show debuffs and weapon special effect stacks on monsters, enable Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Display buff icons on health bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526507512554061924)
- **showing hidden name**: To show your name again after hiding it, toggle the 'always active' setting; otherwise hold Control+Shift to show it if it isn't set to stay open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555216976941555772)
- **showing network status and fps counter**: The Statistics button on the top menu bar has options to show the network status and the FPS counter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534556377207275672)
- **showing own health bar**: To show your own health bar under your character, press Ctrl+Shift or use the options menu to open the nameplate filters, then select a filter that includes your own nameplate, such as PvM default. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525615841264275638)
- **shrine resurrection**: A shrine resurrects players normally unless it is located in an area under an active event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538314310927777842)
- **shrine resurrection troubleshooting**: If shrine resurrection does not work, open Options, go to Combat, untick 'hold tab', and click Apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538316179670700053)
- **silver and gold link upgrades**: Upgrading links to silver or gold is believed to mainly add more camping or rare loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554083554462277643)
- **sing your own praises effect**: SYOP in the bard codex reduces the effect of your bard songs for other players but buffs the songs for you and your followers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541541457536753714)
- **sing your own praises party members**: SYOP (Sing Your Own Praises) applies to your pets and followers but not to party members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541539847653687417)
- **single click spell macro buttons**: Checking the 'single click spells' option in general options makes spell macro buttons activate with a single click. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524554216113307751)
- **single-click poison text toggle**: Toggle single-click overhead Poison text on creatures by typing [SingleClickPoisonTicks, or via Paperdoll -> Help -> Commands -> Mechanics -> SingleClickPoisonTicks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533749536453824582)
- **single-key hud disable**: There is no single-key way to disable the HUD. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527613973443383329)
- **skeletal doublet slot**: The skeletal doublet likely occupies the same slot as a normal doublet, which goes over leather while still showing the leather chest behind it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529884148980777101)
- **skill animations while mounted**: The game does not play skill animations, such as the Spirit Speak salute, while the character is mounted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531829598298312784)
- **skill cap and stealing**: When at the total skill cap, another skill must be set downward before Stealing can be raised. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525953644040818898)
- **skill change notification option**: To be informed when skills change, enable Options > General > Miscellaneous > Inform when skills change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524611449480286379)
- **skill codexes**: Many skills, including archery, swords, necromancy and bards, have codexes, which are books that change or improve skill behavior, and using a codex requires 80 in that skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544740151278698597)
- **skill cooldown display setting**: The skill cooldown display is controlled by the 'Show cooldown gump' option in the Cooldowns general settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546012974458601512)
- **skill reroll statue**: Players can click the statue to reroll all of their skills. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524977480669069412)
- **skill reset on test server**: On the test server, skill points can be reset at a statue near the bank, thought to be the green one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555832174257897525)
- **skills at 100 achievement credit**: For the achievement requiring skills at 100, each skill counts only once per account, so different characters training the same skill give no extra credit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526411651342143629)
- **skills that provide accuracy**: The skills that provide accuracy are the weapon skill, Focus, and Item Identification (with magic weapons). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522084133684379780)
- **skinning blue corpses and criminal flag**: Skinning a blue (innocent) corpse does not flag you as a criminal, but picking up anything from it does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532143971445375048)
- **slayer damage bucket**: Slayer damage goes in the SDI bucket, so it is not the same as a tactics bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526995264286490785)
- **slayer drop chance in dungeons**: A slayer weapon drop from a dungeon such as the sanctuary dungeon reportedly has a 1 in 14 roll chance to proc, though the figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521549753333321938)
- **slayer link rework and arcane mage builds**: Since the slayer link rework, non-necro arcane mages are easy to build for, whereas previously every dungeon required its own slayer link set. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531446799649214505)
- **small spell recovery time**: The recovery time on small spells was changed from 10 seconds, which hurt the death mage concept; the current value is not stated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1531669774847836291)
- **snoop red hand requirement**: Snooping already requires Red Hand membership. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548925952552083518)
- **society boss task requirements**: For Society boss tasks you only need to appear on the boss's damage list, and there is no time limit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533219773763158076)
- **society crafting upgrade points**: Buying two society crafting enhancements gives 2 more and then 3 more weekly society points on an account, totaling 5 more per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546354220133912706)
- **society currency**: Societies provide in-game currency in the form of points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533857136340107325)
- **society gold link cost**: A gold link in societies costs 600 points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523735516586053813)
- **society job selection**: Once progressed, players should skip monster hunter society jobs except bosses, mini bosses and omni bosses and do crafting society jobs otherwise; completing every society job each week is not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544315732450349126)
- **society job setup**: A commonly recommended society setup is tailoring plus alchemy, with each job accruing points week over week and the points being used separately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532528969222590617)
- **society job sharing**: Society jobs and the society gump are shared across all characters on the same account (not across the entire ID), so any character can pick up jobs and contribute progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529327839638323280)
- **society job type mixing**: Society job types cannot be mixed, so a player must push the tmap (cartography treasure map) society job to 100 to use it if they want to continue with it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532528088863342743)
- **society kill jobs in safe cities**: Society kill jobs do not count kills made inside a safe city such as Urukton, so players must go outside the city for credit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532942354510774272)
- **society kill jobs targets**: Society kill jobs count only the specific monster named in the job, not monsters of a subclass. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528124464083108051)
- **society kill task credit window**: To get credit for a Society creature-kill task, you only need to deal damage to the mob within 60 seconds before it dies. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533219773763158076)
- **society kill task credit with pets**: In Society kill-value tasks using pets, the credit is proportional to the follower slots used by the pets in the party. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524058312319041738)
- **society npc item hand-ins**: Society NPCs consume the crafted items you hand in and give society points in exchange; the items are not sold to NPCs for gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528582665278849115)
- **society npc point strategy**: Focusing society tasks on one NPC early accrues points faster toward strongboxes, while taking the best-paying jobs across NPCs yields more points per week but takes longer to unlock high-end rewards from any single NPC. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554884784327491676)
- **society points mount rewards**: Society points can be spent on a mount or on the kit that turns a mount into a token, though this may take many points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537059913828802611)
- **society points scope**: Society points are account-wide, so crafters should be kept on the main account to benefit from them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550998601310670881)
- **society quest abandonment**: Society quests cannot be turned in or swapped for another once they have been accepted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529945947642007764)
- **society quest crafting order**: Take the society quest from the society building first, then craft the item; crafting before taking the quest does not count toward it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535675935108497459)
- **society quest progress in sanctuary dungeons**: Society quest progress cannot be earned inside a sanctuary dungeon such as Urukton Bluffs; it can be earned outside, for example by killing orc mages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533488548601266236)
- **society quest skill requirements**: Skill 100 in tailoring and alchemy is enough for most society quests, but quests that require skill gain need skill 120. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536207994398703636)
- **society quest slots for crafting**: Society quest slots can be used for crafting societies instead of dungeon society quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549476108003582023)
- **society quest visibility across characters**: Society quests picked up on one character are visible only to other characters on the same account, not merely the same Outlands ID. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529580732241023088)
- **society quests**: Society quests are taken from the society NPCs at the society house. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553763068410994719)
- **society reset schedule**: Society resets occur on Friday night, alongside a lottery draw. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530361842130751631)
- **society reset timing**: Societies reset at the same time that the bonuses change. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545610359682105444)
- **society reward clothing function**: Society reward clothing is mostly decorative depending on layer: cloaks and capes are fully decorative, while hoods act like a leather cap and give a bit of armor. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540013177583050864)
- **society reward menu info button**: Items on the society reward menu each have an info button that explains what the item does. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540013177583050864)
- **society rewards**: Societies are not mandatory, but they reward points that can be redeemed for valuable rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553762330733707376)
- **solo play guild contribution**: A player can play solo and still contribute to helping their guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521923502511231087)
- **solo pvp testing on test center**: To test PvP mechanics alone on the test center, use two of your three accounts, make sure they are not in the same guild, and attack one with the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1551352445618225193)
- **source of character power**: Most of a character's power on Outlands comes from Aspect and Chain rather than from skills, and the difference becomes huge after a few Aspect levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533495190382317739)
- **special and rare loot chance link audience**: The Special & Rare loot chance link is mainly intended for lockpickers or mappers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536419038433902675)
- **special moves window command**: Type the command [Abilityhotbar to bring up the special moves window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-27–2026-06-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520521560845324299)
- **special resistance meaning**: Special resistance is resistance against bleeds and disease. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549672052007632927)
- **speech throttle on bracket commands**: Bracket commands such as [vetsupplies and [rope count as speech, so chatting right after one can trigger a speech throttle; at least 550ms is required between speech attempts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520674202061901885)
- **speech throttle workaround**: Turning on the 'press enter to open chat' option may help avoid the speech throttle when sending chat messages. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520675764549189733)
- **spell aspect chance bug**: Spell aspect chance is bugged and delivers only about 60% of the printed value (e.g. 8% printed is about 5-6% actual); the bug is about two years old and the developer reportedly does not know the cause. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526872916145209405)
- **spell aspect chance link timing**: Spell aspect chance links are best slotted from around link 13 to 22. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525909626762297374)
- **spell cast bar gump**: The 'spell cast bar' gump is not a bar for placing spells; it is a small circular timer showing the casting duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538716020829585509)
- **spell checkmark auto recast**: The checkmark on a spell in the UI recasts that spell automatically on cooldown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550021004808556555)
- **spell fizzle**: A spell fizzle occurs when you cast a spell for which you lack a 100% success chance and the attempt fails. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523424896749928669)
- **spell hue deeds**: Spell hue deeds color spells rather than spellbooks, and the hued spell is chosen randomly, not by the player. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527671653943742546)
- **spell icon hotkey assignment**: Go to Options -> Combat Spells, scroll to the Spells section, check "Enable Fast Spells Assign (Ctrl + Alt)", then hold Ctrl+Alt and click a spell icon to create a macro for that spell. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546565549281116260)
- **spell icon sets**: Older and newer spell icon sets exist, and you can choose between them in the options. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524430364834009189)
- **spell mana cost**: Spells require mana whether cast from scrolls, reagents, or a spell stone, and there is a chance of a mana refund depending on skills and equipment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554520430025515120)
- **spell overhead format scope**: Your spell overhead format setting does not change what other players see when you cast; that depends on their own settings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523456532648296549)
- **spell overhead text options**: Spell overhead text options are found under Options > Combat-Spells > Spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523449726341611550)
- **spell saver and summon fizzle**: With 125 effective Spell Saver from Scribe, summon spells do not fizzle, consume no scroll, and cast 100% of the time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1547238470223925382)
- **spell stone usage**: A spell stone bound to another character cannot be used by a different character, although it can be traded to them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539634365053538365)
- **spell-casting wands**: The only wands in Outlands are for identifying items; wands that cast spells were removed long ago, and items with 'wand' in the name are just named that way rather than being a wand type. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526173044845051975)
- **spellbook blessing**: All spellbooks that hold spells are blessed in Ultima Online: Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527406478053474425)
- **spellbook bonuses**: A spellbook containing spells is blessed and gives no bonuses, while a magic spellbook gives a mana refund chance modifier. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521488051359060110)
- **spellbook capacity**: A spellbook can hold all of the spells. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527404203125768232)
- **spellbook theft protection**: Other players can take your reagents but cannot take your spellbook, because a spellbook that holds spells is blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527406567450874029)
- **spellcast cooldown bar**: Enable the spell casting cooldown bar under Options > Interface > Spellcast Bar, which has a button to place it on screen, or open it from the triangle menu under Gumps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523066156833964206)
- **spellcasting hand requirement**: Spells can be cast without holding anything in your hands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527393785149919252)
- **spellcasting stone depletion**: Once a spellcasting stone's charges are used up, you must cast using reagents. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552295089886466049)
- **spellstone blessed status**: A spellstone is not a blessed item, so another player can loot it when you are killed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526917709558710444)
- **spellstone ownership**: A spellstone only works for its owner; each player receives one spellstone bearing their character name, and carrying other players' spellstones may stop spells from working. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525838726398476459)
- **spending achievement points**: Type [achievements and then click 'spend points' to spend achievement points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532265129415147530)
- **spirit speak wiki control slot list**: The Spirit Speak wiki page lists how many control slots each summon takes up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538122340028784692)
- **splitting xp after t12 command armor**: After reaching T12 on command armor, level other aspects on a blessed spellbook up to 10 while continuing to level command on the armor to 13, with no loss of effectiveness. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549869109221654549)
- **spyglass distance bonus vs wake**: Spyglass distance bonus, which is how far you can see others, is a separate stat from wake, which is how far others can see you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523664136448250077)
- **ssi damage beyond the cap**: For Swing Speed Increase past the cap, the extra damage per percent is reportedly equal to SSI minus the cap, though this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535363210067312741)
- **stable all pets follower reset**: Using the stable all pets option at the stablemaster can reset or correct a wrong follower count display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532780404363362406)
- **stable slot usage per creature**: A stabled creature uses as many stable slots as the follower slots it occupies rather than a single slot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525547618510438482)
- **stabling pets before extended absence**: Logging off in your inn is fine for a day or two away, but if you will be gone around two weeks you should stable your pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542547760169885817)
- **stack size limit**: Most item types can stack to about 60,000 items, and multiple stacks are allowed but remain subject to weight limits. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538415366454116363)
- **stacking pouches against thieves**: Stack several pouches in a corner of the inventory and keep valuables in the bottom one so thieves must dig through the pile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555623750202957941)
- **staff theft and purchase logging**: Staff can see a player's purchases, including the item ID, and keep a log of all thefts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534566530996764714)
- **stamina loss from tripping over players**: Tripping over other players causes a loss of stamina. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552450084409712722)
- **starfall library quest chain**: The starfall is part of a library quest chain that rewards a special item. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540880094472704040)
- **starfall meteorite library quest**: The Starfall meteorite is part of a library quest that requires collecting one of a handful of collectible items plus one tag on a Starfall kill, rather than the cadellite ore drop. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546974419069702144)
- **starfell mobs and vortexes quest**: The red-named Starfell mobs and vortexes found in the wilderness are part of the quest 'The Starfallen Path: Field Report' from Ashur the Astronomer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555894331389378611)
- **starting carrack crew composition**: A starting carrack crew of two powder monkeys, one carpenter and one medic works well; a second carpenter adds repairs and a pilgrim adds crew healing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540386743906213918)
- **stat and xp caps**: No stats in Outlands have an endless upper limit; everything caps somewhere, and the extensive XP systems take a very long time to complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535463952535003168)
- **stationary penalty and afk rule history**: Outlands has a stationary penalty that makes AFK sitting in a dungeon very dangerous, and the AFK-aspect rule was written before that penalty was implemented. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555877965236281401)
- **stats accuracy to butler conversion**: An in-game [stats accuracy of 109% corresponds to 100% accuracy in Butler against level 4 mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529605018326401094)
- **stats command**: Type the command [stats in game to show your character stats, including proc chances. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527089793731788910)
- **stats command accuracy formula**: The in-game [stats command uses an older accuracy formula than Outlands Butler, which calculates hit chance as (attacker's skill + 50) / ((defender's weapon or wrestling skill + 50) * 2). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529607219803328604)
- **stats display accuracy**: The in-game stats display is broken and should not be relied upon for accurate values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554502214280675401)
- **stats gump swing delay refresh**: The stats gump updates its swing delay values when you close and reopen it, not when you flip pages within it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542333133267931176)
- **stats melee damage figure**: The damage shown in the stats melee section is the average damage against a 0 AR target such as a sheep, not an indicator of damage against armored targets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525611819673325698)
- **status window pet icon**: The status window shows a horse icon that indicates the number of pets or followers you currently have. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535566666027638826)
- **stealing carried items**: Thieves can steal items a player is carrying, such as a shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143064562368603)
- **stealing from players flagging**: When stealing from a player, you can flag gray to the victim only, without flagging to other nearby players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535709732424130672)
- **stealing in shelter**: In Shelter no one can steal from anyone, unless an item is dropped on the ground. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536003501832933406)
- **stealing in shelter dungeon**: Stealing is not allowed in the Shelter Island dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529543676244660324)
- **stealth and running**: Stealthed characters cannot run, so stealthed thieves are limited to walking speed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555625900907692165)
- **stealth step counter display**: If you use overhead messages for stealth steps, the step counter should not also be shown over your head, because the system message will not be seen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530571815578107965)
- **stealthing after dismounting token mount**: A player can hide, dismount from a token mount while hidden, and then stealth around. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538978982253301901)
- **step after 30 links**: After reaching 30 links, the next step is redline. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553172121486631129)
- **stopping tracking**: To stop tracking a target, right-click the red arrow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524989068511805555)
- **strangelands event duration**: The Strangelands event lasts 40 minutes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531644150087422154)
- **strangelands points command**: The [Strangelands command is used to access Strangelands points after finishing a Strangelands portal run. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527324453841928323)
- **strangelands schedule**: Strangelands occurs 4 days per week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523444144066924674)
- **strength and hit points**: A character's strength stat determines their hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553784865437261865)
- **strength potion buffs**: Drinking a Strength potion applies two buffs at once: 'Strength' and 'Strength Potion Usage Cooldown'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1553488168899186689)
- **strength potion duration with potions codex**: With the potions codex, a strength potion can have a 30 minute duration. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554475592441925726)
- **strength to hit points**: 100 strength gives 100 hit points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525590666858598460)
- **stylist dyes persistence**: Stylist dyes for hair, facial hair, skin, and backpack dyes are not kept permanently. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521112381227405446)
- **stylist hair colour switching**: Once a hair colour is unlocked at the stylist you can reportedly switch to and from it for free, and a matching facial hair dye costs a few thousand gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521124917851197573)
- **summon auto-rename option**: The option to automatically rename a summon when casting the summon spell is found inside the Summoner's Tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524450937035423834)
- **summon bar banking cap**: Summon bar progress can be banked up to 2x the cost of your most expensive summon (main or mini) in that region, so if your mini summon costs no more than 1 million, banking stops at 2 million. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523023800852287691)
- **summon bar fill and cost scaling**: When the summon bar is full, the left number turns orange and gaining stops until you summon; after summoning, the left bar maximum and the cost of the next summon both increase. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523023360840437912)
- **summon cast time codex**: A codex that reduces cast time for summon spells is available and removes roughly 2 seconds of cast time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543358054550995085)
- **summon creature tier assignments**: Imp (ghoul) is reportedly tier 1, skeleton knight and skeleton archer tier 2, and rotting corpse and skeleton wizard tier 3, though this is recalled from memory and unverified. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537759829253169273)
- **summon creature tier mechanic**: Summon Creature results depend on the summoner's tome creatures catalog; each creature is tied to a tier and a random one is summoned from the available pool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537759829253169273)
- **summon creature undead variants**: The Summon Creature spell has several undead variants depending on tome upgrades, other summons always produce the same single undead creature, and undead versions get the bonuses of their normal counterparts (e.g., Fire Elemental upgrades apply to Lich). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521861848553623734)
- **summon hue dyeing**: On the live shard only non-necro summons can reportedly be dyed via spell hue, while on the test shard the purple statue can change creature hues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546356450073247804)
- **summon type points**: Players eventually unlock 20 points for each summon type, which can be spent on that summon type's page and can be reset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553463068141420587)
- **summoned damage multiplier bucket**: Summoned damage-related effects are said to fall into their own unique multiplier bucket. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-29–2026-06-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1520983995716730941)
- **summoner codex strength**: Summoner strength likely comes in large part from points in the summoner codex, similar to the tamer codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553522893269237893)
- **summoner shepherd's crook storage**: After activating the Shepherd's Crook, summoners typically leave it in a trapped pouch in their backpack. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520862426986184744)
- **summoner tome and wizard grimoire**: The summoner tome and wizard grimoire are kept in the backpack while farming; they unlock points that the player can then spend as they choose. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522447338537222147)
- **summoner tome function**: The summoner tome does not let you summon; it levels up as you use summons to fight, giving your summons bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526333965185843200)
- **summoner's tome maxing**: For a summoner's tome, most things can now simply be maxed rather than carefully allocated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545310158396067850)
- **summoners tome and taming bestiary xp**: Summoners Tome and Taming Bestiary gain XP for each category in proportion to the percentage of your followers in that category. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540029524186501252)
- **summoning during map decode**: Summoning elementals while a map is decoding does not interrupt the decode. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536900154655907880)
- **sunk boats on water**: Other players can sink your boat, and you then go to an NPC to get it back. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521724904817299628)
- **supplemental skill damage bonus**: Every 80 points in a supplemental skill gives +20% damage, and additional weapon skills allow training multiple codexes at once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532013344184205464)
- **suspicion and notice chance**: Players who have raised Suspicion in a town have an increased chance of being noticed when stealing there. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037206073811014)
- **swing speed cap wasted links**: Exceeding the swing speed cap wastes links, because bonuses beyond the cap provide no benefit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529314120728580267)
- **swing speed damage scaling**: Swing speed increases damage exponentially rather than linearly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525216891243729026)
- **swipe grab option**: Options > General > General > 'Hold down left mouse button to grab healthbars/items' controls the swipe grab behavior, formerly called Sallos Easy Grab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532441518277787748)
- **switching aspects**: Switch aspects with a macro or by typing [aspectarmor <aspecttype> for armor and [aspectweapon <aspecttype> for weapons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542856535133257748)
- **switching aspects on test server**: Players can easily switch aspects on the test server, which allows trying different aspects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536378748025176214)
- **switching dye colours at a wig stand**: Previously used dye colours can reportedly be swapped between at a wig stand. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525582772545126470)
- **switching to new skills display**: To switch to the new skills display, untick 'use standard' in the options and click apply. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538808735860920401)
- **t8 map creation requirement**: Creating T8 maps requires making a lore book from research materials, as described in the Lore System. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-25–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552960676165587034)
- **tactics bonus with thief codex line**: The Tactics bonus from weapon material and aspect is not lost when using the thief codex Tactics line. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552764842245492807)
- **tamer codex customization**: Tamers can use codexes, which can be changed to suit the player's needs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1528269416238813285)
- **tamer mana refund cap**: A tamer's maximum mana refund chance without redline is about 50%. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542930710845718569)
- **taming bestiary perk selection**: The new taming bestiary is more intuitive: choose the 4 perks that best match your pets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535407070826856488)
- **target health bar display option**: To control the small health bar under your target, open game options, choose General, scroll down to Mobiles, and use the first checkbox, which offers Percentage or Both display modes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551643360987586653)
- **target queue size**: The target queue is small, so be careful following the targeting key with a spell or other cursor action. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524565650930925619)
- **target range indicator option**: Enable 'Show target range indicator' under Options > Miscellaneous to see targeting range, and enable 'Outline impassable objects' to show obstacles blocking line of sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524766592422907904)
- **target range indicator option**: To show the target range indicator on the cursor, go to Options > General > Miscellaneous and enable Show target range indicator. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542181965053034627)
- **target reticle behavior**: Actions that open a target reticle never automatically choose a target; you must pick one yourself, for example via a Last Target hotkey. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536864631690100757)
- **targeted venom poison kit setting**: The Targeted Venom poison kit setting increases poison tick damage only while the player has exactly one creature poisoned; if the player has more than one creature poisoned, it has no effect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524397029957173380)
- **targeting indicator**: A targeting indicator showing your current beneficial, neutral and hostile targets can be enabled through the menu bar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548403044692271117)
- **taste identification and food satisfaction**: Effective Taste Identification, including from aspect armor, counts toward food satisfaction unless Cooking is higher, in which case Cooking is used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549151272538607627)
- **template overwrite behavior**: Overwriting a template slot copies the current character's skills onto the target slot, leaving two copies with the current character's skills; this can be checked on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527767773395292263)
- **temporal aspect damage reduction**: The damage reduction from the Temporal aspect may not apply to abilities, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521594033007366266)
- **test center damage roll settings**: On the Outlands test center, players can set maximum melee and maximum spell damage rolls to test damage percentages and formulas. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542520702416977960)
- **test server**: The test server lets players set their template and max out progression systems so they can try builds at different progression levels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541406816620118089)
- **test server build testing**: On the test server you can create your build, obtain the leveled aspect and codex, and try them out before committing on the live server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534151907180941403)
- **test server character building**: On the test server you can build characters in Prevalia with skills set to 100, a full spellbook and all codex available without leveling. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532053089824014366)
- **test server client requirement**: The Outlands test server currently requires the beta client to log in. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527815998944841808)
- **test server codex statues**: On the Outlands test server, the coloured statues let players obtain all codexes in completed form. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529119788410863716)
- **test server mastery tome statue**: On the test server, the gold statue in Prevalia has an all-tomes button that gives a bag of books, one of which contains every mastery chain link. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532928604499869937)
- **test server pet acquisition**: On the test server, pets can be obtained from the statues, or bought from the broker if perfect pets are not required. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531413963420602400)
- **test server reward maximizing statue**: On the test server, a statue has an option that maximizes all reward systems, including society achievement points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520706020760879235)
- **test server skill change statues**: On the Outlands test server, skills can be changed at the coloured statues near the previous bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1529115940854436031)
- **test server unlimited wealth**: The test server provides unlimited wealth so players can experiment with how builds work. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534413655288975462)
- **test shard access**: Joining the test shard requires using the Beta Client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527778050471628901)
- **test shard chest experience**: On the test shard, players currently get no experience from treasure chests, which is an error rather than intended behavior. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528469891798138940)
- **test shard codex presence check**: On the Test shard, codex experience does not check for the presence of the codex to reduce server load, and this is not supposed to be the case on live. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551298709214466162)
- **testing monster magic resist on test center**: On the test center, monster magic resist can be tested by using the correct type of training dummy, whose resist value can be set to any value. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544761254583992510)
- **testudo damage resistance**: Testudo alone gives 56 damage resistance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1544130658975223868)
- **theft amount per attempt**: A thief can steal roughly 250-350 of a stackable item per theft attempt, though this figure is recalled from memory and may be inexact. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544036775276716052)
- **theft notification coordinates**: The theft notification message includes the coordinates of where the theft occurred. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547175111466160159)
- **thief codex bonuses**: For a thief, the Codex can reduce smoke bomb cooldown and monster aggro (when not flagged for PvP), while other bonuses focus on pilfering and backstabbing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526567936129634366)
- **thief codex max upgrade cost**: A recent patch reduced the cost of max upgrades such as Shadow Hands and Ruffian in the Thief Codex from 6 points to 5. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521728754584518827)
- **thief codex progression**: Thief codex progress comes from pilfering or mugging, and may be tricky to gain in a group; lockpicking as a source is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555941043516481539)
- **thief codex tactics swap**: The Thief codex swaps printed stealth for tactics only when making mugging attempts, so it does not grant tactics for other purposes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1543144248562557020)
- **thief detection and guard consequences**: A thief noticed in town by any human NPC is killed by called guards; if noticed only by players in town, the thief is killed if a player within 14 tiles calls guards within 30 seconds; outside of town, being noticed only produces a system message with no other consequences. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544037206073811014)
- **thief guild and grey hand**: You are not automatically a thief; you must join the thief guild as a grey hand, and being able to steal from monsters means you have already joined. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549997424502775849)
- **thief guild master theft lookup**: Players can talk to the thief guild master to check whether an item was stolen, and a theft history is available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526672769788547134)
- **thief hunters at banks**: Thief hunters are going to be stationed at every bank. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523834726325162075)
- **thief item moving patch**: A recent Outlands patch lets thieves move items freely while searching for loot without needing a delay, which gives them quick access to a loot bag and, per one player, to bandages and potions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1528036112789012611)
- **thief lockout group pk scalar**: Thief lockouts have no scalar that adds extra time when thieves PK in groups, unlike the scalar that exists for reds (murderers). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539685586544369856)
- **thief mitigation methods**: Trapped pouches or chests and the Reveal spell can be used to mitigate thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525630014169550880)
- **thief npc theft check**: A thief NPC can be paid to check whether something has been stolen from you, and one is located in the Shelter inn. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531321821423599656)
- **thief npc theft report**: For a nominal cost, the thief NPC will tell you about all recent thefts from you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534569921550352545)
- **thief safety in towns**: No town in Outlands is completely safe from thieves; thieves in towns have a chance of being guard-whacked, so players should act accordingly. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551039539869384815)
- **thief stealing from equipped wizard satchel**: A thief likely cannot steal from a wizard satchel while it is equipped, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553410967444918333)
- **thief target selection**: Thieves often move on to an easier target when they see nothing valuable in the first bag they open. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555624187668987986)
- **thieves codex**: The Thieves Codex is a feature added to Outlands that is relevant to backstabber builds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1532473639885082756)
- **thieves codex guild requirement**: Using the Thieves Codex backstab/stealing setup requires joining the Grey Hand thieves guild. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546987113055256656)
- **thieves codex update**: The Thieves codex was updated recently, so players should check their codex for the changes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1533575772445479113)
- **thieves guild join cost**: Joining the Thieves Guild historically cost 5k gold, though the current cost is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536813013577764864)
- **thieves guild kill on sight**: Once other players know you are in the thieves guild, you are likely to be killed on sight. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546673362414075904)
