- **thieves guild membership**: The thieves guild uses a gray hand or red membership status and has a thieves codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524935122372005980)
- **thieves guild switching cooldown**: A player can switch Thieves Guild status, but there is roughly a 24 hour cooldown before switching back, and a thief cannot steal again for about a day after stealing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539512544719278181)
- **thieves in towns**: Guards do not protect players from thieves in town, and towns are full of thieves, so players must be careful when transporting expensive items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533213698812805162)
- **thieves in towns and dungeons**: Every town has thieves, and thieves are also found in dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551168336354607166)
- **thieves' codex tactics bonus**: The Thieves' Codex grants tactics only when you mug and for 10 seconds afterward. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1525542691088240740)
- **thirst in stranglelands**: A player can die of thirst in Stranglelands even while still carrying water, so thirst must be actively managed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545899257352167525)
- **three-account society points setup**: Some players run three accounts with Tailor, Alchemy and Inscription characters to earn society points. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553891372358959178)
- **ticket drops from monsters**: Tickets drop from killing monsters, so keep killing monsters to find one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541204069123760299)
- **tier 0 aspect bonus**: A tier 0 aspect reportedly gives a small bonus of about 10% while the aspect is active on the weapon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522384503828648129)
- **tier 10 aspect default color**: Once an aspect reaches tier 10, you can select its color as the default regardless of which aspect you apply, but only if you have bought the corresponding customizations. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-09-17–2026-09-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549976325463343126)
- **tier 13 treasure map spell damage fields**: Tier 13 treasure maps can have 128% spell damage fields. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1536805790948532295)
- **tier 20 aspect progression**: Reaching Tier 20 Aspect via the Redline system takes many years, and the Time Dungeon is the difficult end-game dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554560732073431045)
- **tier 4 chest lockpick time**: Lockpicking a tier 4 treasure map chest takes about 30 seconds under the current system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528245867600023594)
- **tier 8 bosses and prestige**: Tier 8 bosses no longer give prestige, so guilds that bought research materials have mostly stopped, lowering prices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1545813644099588156)
- **time rare items double click looting**: Items from the Time rare content, including marks and other time items, cannot be double-click looted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-01–2026-09-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544293816041873431)
- **tmap cartography buff**: The new tmap system gives a Cartography buff that is active while you take part in the dig, and you can move around instead of being stuck in one spot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-29–2026-07-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1532108502741291029)
- **toggling always-on name display**: Press Ctrl+Shift to toggle off the always-on name display. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530351684369383444)
- **tome stealing and looting**: Tomes cannot be stolen, but they can still be looted from your body if you die. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541073440419614871)
- **top fame title**: Once a player reaches the top fame title, fame loss is no longer a concern and the title grants nothing extra. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540024587788619827)
- **top heals in town struggles for pvp reward points**: Going for top heals in town struggles is one of the easier ways to earn PvP reward points if your guild does not field DFP/CCC teams. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528634807330799696)
- **total armor meditation penalty**: A player's Total Armor Meditation Penalty is the sum of the Meditation Penalties of all armor worn, and each piece's penalty equals its Armor Location Penalty multiplied by its Armor Material Penalty. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529880442126204948)
- **town struggle pvp flagging**: During the Town Struggle PvP event, players and NPCs in the town appear with yellow names, and you can only be attacked there if you have flagged yourself for the event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536528627397566526)
- **tracking always get closest setting**: With 'Always Get Closest' as the hunting setting in Tracking, the arrow switches to the next target without being closed, though leaving it open can be annoying. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530195576761876590)
- **tracking arrow colors**: After the patch, the tracking skill arrow is green, the tmap chest arrow is purple, and the Portal vendor tracker uses a different color; arrow colors cannot currently be changed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538633332252741723)
- **tracking arrow max range setting**: The tracking arrow range can be changed at Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Miscellaneous > Tracking Arrow Max Range. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532436543799820500)
- **tracking arrow size**: The tracking arrow size may be adjustable through the overall scaling setting, and the arrow can possibly be moved closer to your avatar. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532436005767090287)
- **tracking arrow staleness**: The tracking arrow points to the target's last known location and can become stale; right clicking the arrow resets it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530194033668915370)
- **tracking system message format**: The tracking system message reads 'Now tracking: Name (N spaces to target)', and its words are numbered sequentially, so leftover words past the last placeholder appear as {8}. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529116242533679325)
- **tracking target types**: Tracking is best set to track all three player types (grey, orange, and red) rather than only murderers. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530188808681820191)
- **training dummy finisher damage**: Training dummies do not register finisher damage, so Discipline's damage appears lower when measured on a dummy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537549758699278426)
- **trammel-like safe zone**: Outside Sanctuary dungeon and Shelter Island, a Trammel-like safe zone is not expected to be added to Outlands, though this is one player's opinion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550757732376649779)
- **transferred mount taming requirement**: Receiving and mounting a transferred mount such as a Blood Courser requires the taming skill, after which it can be ridden; only the 1-slot mounts are free for anyone to use. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537860756584800336)
- **transferring client settings between characters**: Open the Profile Manager in Options and use the Clone Profile tab to copy settings from one character to another; alternatively, with the client fully closed, copy files from one character's profile to the other. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522853381352198184)
- **trap cooldown variability**: Trap cast and detonation times change with the trap codex and aspect level, so an overhead message is the most accurate way to know when a trap is ready. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521432665948164156)
- **trap damage targeting**: Traps only hurt enemies, so blowing up a trap near a guard does not make you criminal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527763045391274195)
- **trapped boxes for murder counts**: A tinker can leave trapped boxes around so that other players who trigger them generate murder counts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545146130692706405)
- **trapped boxes on shelter island**: Trapped boxes cannot be opened on Shelter Island, though this was observed at least partly in the Test environment. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545571286317531198)
- **trapped pouch and boom box**: A trapped pouch alerts you when a thief opens it, and a boom box kills a thief who tries to open it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555623483617181827)
- **trapped pouch contents visibility**: A pouch closes once it is trapped, so its contents cannot be viewed afterwards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530641949600514089)
- **trapped pouches against thieves**: Where theft is possible, keeping loot in a trapped pouch, or several layered trapped pouches, protects against thieves, and putting a bandage in each trapped pouch can trick them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530639634466476156)
- **trapper codex leveling**: A trapper can level multiple codices at once and can easily level other aspects on the weapon or book, similar to a tamer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549858168925065249)
- **trapping on ships**: Trapping does not work on a ship. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530076716838420492)
- **traps on the ocean**: Traps are not allowed on the ocean, so a trapper build is unsuitable as a cartography ocean treasure-map character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540567126249701406)
- **traps on treasure map chests**: Traps have been removed from treasure map chests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-26–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1553342541099831324)
- **travel pack item**: The Travel Pack item is likely just a blessed wig stand, purely cosmetic, and cannot be used to log out inside dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546976702180237406)
- **traveller's lantern and day/night cycle**: The Traveller's Lantern is blessed and emits light, and the game now has a day/night cycle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546595798928597052)
- **treasure chest loot calculation timing**: Treasure map chest loot is calculated at the moment the chest is double-clicked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538976346548609136)
- **treasure map armor aspects**: When running treasure maps, the Fortune armor aspect is best for experience and the Harvest armor aspect is best for loot. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1549125402419527763)
- **treasure map automap requirement**: After the recent patch, treasure maps no longer require the Lot Goblin automap. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-31–2026-08-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544022144348983299)
- **treasure map blessed status**: Treasure maps are blessed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538296050614538251)
- **treasure map chain xp**: Do all treasure map chain XP on a single account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521781977064276110)
- **treasure map changes**: After the upcoming patch, treasure mapping is expected to be easier and to require a decode/hiking/setup window, which should lower the rate at which maps are consumed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1535506718111309854)
- **treasure map deciphering**: Close and reopen a treasure map to show the deciphered version; an undeciphered map cannot be dug up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526426340138418356)
- **treasure map decode timer**: After the patch, a 1 hour timer starts when a treasure map is decoded (not when the chest is revealed), and the map is deleted if not completed in that time, removing the option to choose when to dig. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **treasure map harvest xp recipient**: After the treasure map changes, the chest opens on boss death, so the cartographer in charge of the map likely gets the harvest XP instead of a lockpicker. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528609095983169616)
- **treasure map hike and reveal time**: The time it takes to hike to and reveal a treasure map chest is static and cannot be shortened. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538208336015794176)
- **treasure map hiking**: In the new treasure map system you can hike directly to the map area without looking up different maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528540300379816107)
- **treasure map location danger**: Hiking to a treasure map location can put you in a dangerous spot, so be ready to run immediately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546212956126191678)
- **treasure map location visibility**: Players can no longer see where a treasure map's location is before arriving at the spot, following the recent map update. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546072951764553769)
- **treasure map location visibility for witcher runes**: The treasure map location is not shown in advance, so you must call it out or do the map yourself to use witcher runes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537087436671287357)
- **treasure map lockpicking**: Treasure map lockpicking is being sunset. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1534344821882355792)
- **treasure map loot scalar**: Treasure maps have a 4x loot scalar, so a T-map chest holding 5000 gold gives the same loot chance as killing 20,000 gold worth of regular monsters; the chest is dug up, guardian mobs spawn, and you kill them before looting it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 3 authors, 2026-07-28–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554864241540866139)
- **treasure map mob kills with two accounts**: You cannot fight mobs with two accounts at once, so one character must specifically kill the treasure map mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538148113607561297)
- **treasure map navigation**: After traveling to a treasure map location, an arrow to the chest appears, and players can use the world map, mini map and radar to navigate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554608831831609436)
- **treasure map on-demand generation**: Under the treasure map changes, maps are generated on demand, so a treasure map should not send a player to a spot where another player's chest is already present. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528189726677274817)
- **treasure map overhaul limits**: After the treasure map overhaul, regular treasure maps use loading bars and Outlands limits each account to one treasure map at a time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537843990458794094)
- **treasure map patch changes**: The treasure map patch increased boss HP and made treasure maps take longer to complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537095680890380308)
- **treasure map time limit**: A recent patch introduced a 30 minute time limit for treasure maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1542362931088597064)
- **treasure map time variability**: Treasure map decode run and dig times are fixed; the only variable is when the chest mobs spawn, and the process cannot be sped up. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1538234779898740777)
- **treasure mapper and ore map restriction**: A character turned into a treasure mapper cannot run an ore map, because the five map types are reportedly combined into a single account-wide locked activity. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535495384023961691)
- **trees disappearing near player**: If trees disappear when you get close, turn off the 'CircleTrans' (Circle of Transparency) button at the bottom of the client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549660980101775403)
- **tribard codex activation**: Tribard players activate their codex by using Discordance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548635566160220252)
- **turning in black goods**: To turn in black goods, put them in your bank first, then open the thieves guild menu via the context menu on a thief NPC or by saying 'Thief' near them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542032645956046920)
- **two account login limit**: Only in Shelter can two accounts be entered at the same time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521850183414059058)
- **two-handed weapon with shield codex**: A two-handed weapon can be used without a shield while using the shield codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555277220396798025)
- **unattended codex leveling rule**: The Outlands Code of Conduct prohibits leveling Pet, Aspect, Mastery Chain, Summoner and Dexer codex experience while unattended, including farming NPCs; the first offense is 7 days in jail and the second is a permanent account ban. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1555862380326555660)
- **unidentified magic item modifiers**: Looted magic items are unidentified and their modifiers are revealed only once identified; the Modifiers wiki page shows the bonuses of the revealed mods. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-13–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548724390277947423)
- **unidentified magical equipment**: Magical equipment drops unidentified and has the potential to be the best equipment available. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527392674942947521)
- **universal vs type-specific damage buffs**: Universal damage buffs are multiplicative, while damage-type-specific buffs (spell-only or melee-only) are additive, with follower damage being an exception. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1542321781413777521)
- **unlocking an aspect**: To unlock an aspect, you need 4 cores, 2 distillations and an aspect kit. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553885369739772045)
- **unlocking an echo with essence**: To unlock an Echo, put the essence in your bank; it is consumed when the echo is unlocked, though another player suggests it may also be held in the Aspect gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554538914893529129)
- **unlocking aspect with free kit**: To unlock an Aspect with the free kit, keep the kit item in your bag when you unlock the Aspect in the Aspect interface. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526024749594181663)
- **unlocking customisations**: Open Help and choose customisations, or type [customisations in game, to see where account customisations are unlocked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554885937606168768)
- **unopened corpse name marker**: Unopened corpses have a * at the beginning of their name, which can be used to filter for them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554495657593675838)
- **untouched corpse message**: When no one has looted a corpse, a system message indicates that the body is untouched. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549686252251512903)
- **unwanted link disposal**: An unwanted link can be sold or changed by using a gold link reforge tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533141449179267144)
- **upcoming expansion**: An expansion with a new landmass, new dungeons, and new skills is reportedly in development for UO Outlands, expected around spring next year, though some think it may arrive later this year. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-09–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547379463757496340)
- **upcoming poison changes**: Poison changes are reportedly upcoming on the server, but details and timing are not given. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526993915826278462)
- **upcoming poisoning changes**: Players expect developers to change how poisoning works in the near future, but no official details or date are confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521849051195375618)
- **upcoming zoology bonus for lesser-used pets**: An upcoming patch reportedly adds a zoology bonus to lesser-used pets, similar to the wrestling boost. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528790567172051005)
- **used mastery chain binding**: A used mastery chain displays "(bound to `player name`)" in its description, showing it is bound to the player who used it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546616770583072799)
- **using an alt to escape pvp combat**: Having an alt open an escape gate during active PvP combat is against the rules; the only loophole is to do it before combat starts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1552734028921180222)
- **using two characters on treasure map chest**: Two different characters can be used on a treasure map chest as long as only one of them deals damage to the mobs; if both characters are engaged in combat, both will do only 1 damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546210832138903652)
- **using unlocked emotes**: To use an unlocked emote, type a bracket followed by the emote name (e.g. [yell); it can also be bound to a hotkey in game, though the author was unsure of details. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524661569617661992)
- **vanishing loot when looting corpses quickly**: Loot that vanishes when looting a corpse too fast is caused by the object delay queue, which shows the item as taken before it lands in the bag; with the queue off, fast looting just moves the item to the end of the corpse list and no relog is needed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546856726991474789)
- **vendor item poisoning bug**: A bug can occur where an item bought from a vendor, such as a dagger, is reported as not allowed to be poisoned until it is moved once. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1549688940284485673)
- **veterinary healing aspect procs**: A relatively recent patch allows veterinary healing to proc aspect effects. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530052108567576788)
- **veterinary self-healing effectiveness**: Healing yourself with Veterinary heals only about 33% of what Healing skill would, and Veterinary healing on pets is likewise reduced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-19–2026-08-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539723318410616862)
- **viewing aspect details**: To view aspect details, type [aspects in chat or double-click the pentagram at the top of the paperdoll, then choose 'aspect details' instead of 'aspect overview'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555073966627102781)
- **viewing available mounts and costs**: Available mounts and their point costs can be viewed on the spend points screen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528457083794620417)
- **viewing item stats**: Item stats cannot be viewed directly; items are judged by their material or magic property names. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536766237818888192)
- **viewing item stats in game**: Individual item stats cannot be directly viewed in game, and the stats menu is mostly accurate but may omit or misstate some values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532568904617168898)
- **viewing magic weapon properties without identifying**: To see what a magic weapon is without identifying it, open the stats gump and go to the equipment tab. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536092963136868495)
- **viewing melee special chance**: Type [stats in game to see your current melee special chance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1530472686143148142)
- **viewing objects out of range when zoomed out**: To see what is cut off when zooming out, enable 'No color for objects out of range' under Options > General. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533588677773496370)
- **viewing pet follower bonuses**: Use Animal Lore on the pet and open the current tab to see its current follower bonus values. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526456398811238472)
- **viewing unlocked emotes**: Unlocked emotes can be viewed in the Emote section of the [customisation command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524661874405408919)
- **viewing weekly regional rotational bonus in game**: To see the Weekly Regional Rotational Bonus for dungeons in game, double click the map/banner located near every bank in town. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527222248048427009)
- **virtuoso damage resistance bonus**: Virtuoso grants a small damage resistance (DR) bonus for 15 seconds. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-23–2026-09-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552110972372647987)
- **visibility of blue player footsteps**: Footsteps of blue (non-criminal) players appear not to be visible on this shard; only some mobs' footsteps were seen in a test. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1533085328808874157)
- **visibility of dead players**: On Outlands, other players cannot see you while you are dead, which is an anti-griefing measure. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536513350182117477)
- **void armor heal trigger**: If the void armor heal has not triggered recently, it triggers when you take damage, working like a mini frost shield. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1540764555586830336)
- **void aspect and mob damage resistance**: The void aspect is unrelated to the new mob damage resistances (DR). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539817758777282640)
- **void aspect and spell ignore links**: Void aspect and spell ignore links are likely two separate rolls, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-01–2026-10-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555049904274022503)
- **void aspect link requirements for necro-summoner**: Using the Void aspect on a Necro-Summoner requires two extra link slots for inscription links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1526632163485679769)
- **walking with followers**: Walking or riding slower is useful when you have followers, because your pets keep up with you. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529230491486654652)
- **water aspect buff**: The Water aspect was buffed recently and may be underrated. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534687223104929832)
- **water aspect for tamers**: The Water Aspect is decent for Tamers and cheaper than the Command Aspect, though weaker than Command. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549742094736687115)
- **water aspect for treasure mapping tamer**: Water aspect is reportedly good for a treasure-mapping tamer, but this is hearsay. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1537023168655400991)
- **ways to increase poison damage**: The known ways to increase poison damage are Taste Identification (the main source), links, and a poison kit, though other sources may exist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1548291440067481701)
- **weapon abilities versus aspects**: Weapon abilities and aspects are two separate mechanics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522290318031061152)
- **weapon ability hotbar auto-open on login**: The weapon ability hotbar cannot be saved to open on login like -savechivbar; instead make a macro or button that says [abilityhotbar to open it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530579156260229252)
- **weapon almanac skill requirement**: A minimum of 80 in the related weapon skill (for example Fencing) is needed to open the corresponding weapon almanac. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1527112340737233129)
- **weapon aspect coloring**: A weapon can only be colored with the aspect you activate it with, and turning off the aspect color does not let you put another aspect on the same weapon (uncertain). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529080142843084881)
- **weapon codex**: The weapon codex provides weapon specials and procs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541531214437949572)
- **weapon codex cap**: Weapon codexes, such as the archery codex, have no points cap and can be filled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1555005554403844137)
- **weapon codex leveling**: All options in a weapon codex can eventually be leveled. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547618030798905344)
- **weapon codex points**: Weapon codices can eventually be fully unlocked and their points cannot be moved around, but stances can be swapped in melee codices. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529503611749535854)
- **weapon codex unlocks**: Over time a player will eventually unlock everything in a weapon codex. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532812123741360280)
- **weapon skill accuracy**: 40 weapon skill gives roughly 60-75% accuracy depending on the target, compared with about 15% accuracy with no weapon skill. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554433862619242528)
- **weapon skill codex leveling**: Each additional 80-point weapon skill on a template allows leveling that weapon's codex, such as the fishing and archery codexes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554899051382571139)
- **weapon spellbooks origin**: Weapon spellbooks are an Outlands-specific invention, reportedly introduced because original shards allowed blessed or insured weapons and unblessed ones were needed to fit the full loot system. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528019964546519120)
- **weapon swing cooldown setup**: Open Options > Cooldowns, create a new cooldown, and choose the weapon swing option from the drop-down list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526807225463738439)
- **weapon xp with harvest aspect on armor**: With the Harvest aspect on your armor and another aspect on your weapon, killing mobs gives 50% weapon XP toward the weapon aspect. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1543520459994304622)
- **weekly buffs and dungeon activity**: The weekly buffs determine which dungeons are busy; a dungeon with the weekly experience buff is crowded all week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-29–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554365848137760769)
- **weekly exceptional boost map**: Clicking the map located near every bank shows which dungeon or town is boosted for exceptional crafting this week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529720541492150364)
- **weekly experience bonus dungeon**: A weekly experience-bonus dungeon rotates and helps level aspects faster, so players should check which dungeon is the bonus one each week. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521364929439993856)
- **weekly faction pvp dungeon**: Each week one of the old UO dungeons opens as a faction pvp area where players can farm mobs for faction silver and fight other factions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-24–2026-09-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1552712701413949441)
- **weekly regional bonus sanctuary**: A weekly rotating 'Regional Bonus' applies Sanctuary status to one of the core dungeons. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537967399725441065)
- **weekly regional rotational bonus announcements**: The Weekly Regional Rotational Bonuses are posted each week at reset in the Discord announcement channels. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527222248048427009)
- **weekly rotating sanctuary dungeon**: Each week one random main dungeon is chosen to also be a sanctuary dungeon in addition to the permanent ones. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532746450541219993)
- **weekly safe dungeon**: Each week one dungeon is designated safe; there experience gain and gold loot are reduced by 33%, but it is a safe place to learn or farm. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551274245646983309)
- **weekly safe dungeon**: Each week one of the core dungeons is safe from reds and thieves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532688069625516063)
- **weekly society contracts limit**: By default a player has 10 society contracts per week, which can be spread across NPCs such as armorers, monster hunter and artificer; the Social Network (500k gold) and High Society (750k gold) account customisations raise this to 15. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554883811760676896)
- **weekly society jobs**: Outlands offers weekly society jobs that players can take on. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520605176405164182)
- **weekly society jobs**: A crafter starts each week with 30 society jobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529947581084467320)
- **wilderness and crafting society quests**: Wilderness society quests exist, and crafting society quests can be completed while AFK. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549474961176006827)
- **wilderness bar capping methods**: Gold is a good option for quickly capping the wilderness bar and pushing bosses, while treasure maps already cap the wilderness bar daily. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1539274710834086038)
- **wizard's satchel scroll conservation**: Keeping scrolls in an equipped Wizard's Satchel gives an additional chance not to consume a scroll when casting. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535812370612490320)
- **world map borderless mode**: To turn off the borderless mode of the world map and allow manual resizing, right click on the map and select the 'Keep on top' option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537971163714555904)
- **worn item weight**: Items that you wear are believed not to count toward your carried weight, though the claim is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522406793865728141)
- **wrestler combo meter reset on miss**: When a wrestler misses an attack, the combo meter resets to 0, so even 99% accuracy costs more than 1% of total damage. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550860416094310473)
- **wrestler link ordering**: On a wrestler, special chance links and damage-dealt-by-player links are likely taken with damage dealt by player first. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524227391390617650)
- **wrestling build gold link priority**: For a wrestling build, DDBP links are a good first link to upgrade to gold because they are used in many builds and can be converted to other link types. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1534383088086417449)
- **wrestling combo bonus trigger**: The wrestling combo bonus triggers after 3 consecutive hits, or after 4 if you are in the Dragon stance but do not use it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-19–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1550860905552552088)
- **wrestling damage formula**: Wrestling damage is the weapon sheet base damage range (e.g. 79.7-190.1) multiplied by swing speed (e.g. 1.608) and other bonuses. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521697945211240624)
- **wrestling redline effectiveness**: On a wrestling build with half bronze and half gold links and 21 redline, only about 10 redline makes a noticeable difference. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521527454781669389)
- **xp characters on same account**: It is better to keep all XP-making characters on the same account so they all contribute to the same chain and redline progress. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-23–2026-07-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529816625866342500)
- **xp eligibility threshold**: Experience from a monster is proportional to damage dealt, and a player must deal 5% of the monster's health or 1000 damage, whichever is smaller, to receive XP; this figure is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547412010642313286)
- **yellow flag meaning**: A player flagged yellow is participating in a PvP event that you are not, such as a dungeon flashpoint or town struggle. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541206991299420220)
- **zero durability effect**: When an item's durability reaches 0 it does not break but becomes 25% less effective; at any other durability it is fully effective. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527340079843115059)
- **zoology progress with multiple 1-slot pets**: Zoology progress fills faster when using five of the same 1-slot pet than when using one, because zoology and other bonuses scale with the number of follower slots your pets occupy. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525544657369567304)

## Other

- **2026-09-28 prevalian merchant display update**: The 2026-09-28 patch updated the display of the Prevalian Merchant. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1554202397604192268)
- **8th annual king's faire event**: The 8th Annual King's Faire is the event that follows Hot Barbarian Summer. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **8th annual king's faire overall winner**: Amberiel won the overall 8th Annual King's Faire (2026) out of more than 2650 participants. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543639186110812270)
- **beta client bug reporting**: Players who find bugs or issues in the Outlands beta client test patch should report them in the #beta-client-feedback channel. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **discord role selection location**: Players can pick the Roles that apply to them by accessing the Customize section of the Outlands Discord server. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1545597367850369084)
- **discord verified player role**: To access restricted Discord channels such as Trade, PvP and ships PvM, log in to the Outlands Portal account page with your OutlandsID credentials and link your Discord account to receive the VERIFIED PLAYER role. _(official, conf 0.85, 5 authors, 2026-08-05–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1534559201341345892)
- **exitlag for lag spikes**: ExitLag is a GPN/VPN solution commonly recommended in the Outlands community for players with high ping, routing issues, or unstable connections, and players can get a discount on it. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-03–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1523821474828390510)
- **exitlag outlands coupon**: New annual ExitLag subscriptions purchased with the coupon code OUTLANDS receive 50% off. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1523821474828390510)
- **expansion suggestion tag monitoring**: Outlands staff monitor the `expansion-suggestion` tag while planning the expansion and welcome ideas of any size, including small, niche, ambitious or unusual ones. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1552066450087354441)
- **golden belt boxing tournament prizes**: The King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament prizes are the Golden Championship Belt (held until the next tournament), a permanent Commemorative Plaque, and 25 Prevalia Coins. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **golden belt boxing tournament signup location**: Players sign up for the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament at the Arena Stone before it begins, and each player may submit only one entry. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **golden belt boxing tournament signup procedure**: To sign up for the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament, go to the Arena Stone, select AVAILABLE TOURNAMENTS, and then click CREATE NEW TEAM. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **golden belt boxing tournament signup timing**: Signups for the King's Faire Golden Belt Boxing Tournament open 1 hour before the event starts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542631523554164849)
- **hot barbarian summer event status**: The Hot Barbarian Summer seasonal event has officially ended with the conclusion of the Stalag Grotto Battle. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1530591486427791451)
- **jousting round two reward**: Every participant who makes it into round two of the Official Jousting Tournament receives a Barbaric Summer Scratch ticket in their bank. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1531057816817766483)
- **king's faire 2026 celestial contest result**: The first Celestial Contest at King's Faire 2026 was won by Lunar over Solar, 5578 to 5128. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543639186110812270)
- **king's faire 2026 participation totals**: A total of 358,305 games were played throughout King's Faire 2026, and over 461,725 tickets were entered in the Melting Ice Cream Raffle. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1543639186110812270)
- **king's faire fashion show categories**: The 2026 King's Faire Fashion Show categories are Cosplay, Shipwrecked, and Otherworldly; the 2025 categories were Cosplay Characters, Saddle Style and Animal Instincts. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1542231235764424836)
- **official jousting tournament prizes**: The winner of the Official Jousting Tournament receives 25 Prevalia Coins, a commemorative plaque and the Golden Lance. _(official, conf 0.85, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-09-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1553495104189235271)
- **picking discord roles**: To pick the roles that apply to you, open the Customize section of the Outlands Discord server and select them. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1555578876959133797)
- **snowbrawl match announcements**: SnowBrawl matches are announced in-game and on Discord. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1541823889129213963)
- **submitting expansion ideas**: To suggest an idea for the upcoming Outlands expansion, make a comprehensive, well thought out post in the designated suggestions channel and apply the `expansion-suggestion` tag. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1552066450087354441)
- **test shard patch note formatting**: On the Outlands forum Testing Patch thread, newly made changes and bug fixes in a revised Testing Patch are listed in orange text. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-07-25–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1531376195990458488)
- **zucchini harvestmaster event**: The Fall Harvest 2026 Zucchini Harvestmaster event began September 19, 2026 at 11am ET and runs for one week, ending around September 26, 2026. _(official, conf 0.85, 1 author, 2026-09-17–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520155005271674910/1550884202717650975)
- **hair style changes**: Hair can be changed at the Prevalia Stylist, east of the main Prevalia bank; once a hairstyle is unlocked it stays unlocked and can be switched using a wig stand or vanity travel kit. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553572490054340691)
- **outlands drip paperdoll tool**: Outlands Drip (outlandsdrip.com) is a community website for designing and previewing character paperdolls and outfits for Outlands, with searchable clothing options and the ability to import your paperdoll. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547272471009300570)
- **outlands wiki reliability**: The Outlands wiki is player-created and maintained by volunteers, so it is generally up to date and mostly valid but may occasionally be outdated or list different methods; issues can be reported in the Discord wiki channel. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-07-06–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537130156731273346)
- **running outlands on linux**: UO Outlands runs on Linux either by adding the patcher to Lutris or Steam as a non-Steam game (forcing Proton in Steam's launcher properties), or by using Faugus Launcher, with instructions on the wiki page Install_UO_on_Linux. _(consensus, conf 0.75, 4 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-09-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554479020744114207)
- **ddbp abbreviation**: DDBP stands for damage dealt (or done) by player. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-28–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1539822494435905667)
- **outlands butler calculators**: The Outlands Butler website offers build calculators, including an accuracy calculator that shows your effective accuracy and a mob's chance to hit you based on its wrestling or weapon skill, and a backstab calculator that shows which mobs to farm. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1546987668246634534)
- **outlands butler shelf loadouts tool**: Outlands Butler is a community tool website that offers a shelf loadouts tool at outlandsbutler.com/shelfloadouts. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-09-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550446214363873300)
- **rune tome dyeing**: Rune tomes can be dyed with Runebook Dye or with normal tailor dyes, and no special tome hues are known, though tomes in various colors can be found as loot or bought from players. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-06-29–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533115542045462568)
- **server launch date**: Ultima Online: Outlands launched in October 2018 and is described by players as the most popular private shard ever. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526240263486570646)
- **wiki modifiers page**: The Outlands wiki Modifiers page (wiki.uooutlands.com/Modifiers) lists weapon and armor prefixes and magical modifiers, and the Armor & Weapons page covers weapon charts, armor values and crafted modifiers. _(consensus, conf 0.70, 3 authors, 2026-07-14–2026-09-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1552938115235319859)
- **alt right-click close gumps setting**: A setting may require holding Alt to right-click close gumps, but it does not appear to apply to bag gumps. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540683928048894012)
- **attaching pet name cards**: To attach pet name cards to each other, drop one onto the bottom of the first rather than just dragging them together; an animation shows when it attaches. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531113260219367647)
- **backpack gump straps**: Outlands has no in-game option to remove the straps from the backpack gump; strapless backpacks come from custom gump art that replaces the gump image. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524994326705471548)
- **bastet harvester killer**: Bastet is a player who hunts harvesters and will kill them again after they resurrect. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1549716312295481416)
- **changing skills on the test shard**: On the test shard, double-click the green statue at the main previous bank, then use 'set values' and 'apply all stats and values' to change skills. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1528540806485639299)
- **client and updater versions**: The Outlands beta client reached versions 1.0.3.704 and 1.0.3.707 in July 2026 with test shard updates, while the live client was reported as 1.0.2.506 with updater 4.0.0.43 as of 2026-08-03. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1523746536868024400/1526613729247236216)
- **cosmetic test server**: A test server is available where players can try cosmetic outfits before buying them. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601909869977712)
- **exitlag for connection issues**: Staff and the admin recommend the ExitLag VPN service for players with persistent connection issues or who need a VPN to connect to Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541685065371746344)
- **exitlag node for high ping**: Players with high ping who connect to Outlands with ExitLag should select an Ashburn node as the destination (end) node for best results. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-02–2026-09-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548540314422083645)
- **festival games requirements**: Most festival games are RNG and only require spending tickets, except about 6 or 7 that require player activity. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542300230718853272)
- **fixing oversized ui scale**: To fix an accidentally huge UI scale, log out, back up then edit profile.json in Program Files (x86)/Ultima Online Outlands/ClassicUO/Data/Profiles/<account>/UO Outlands/<character>, and set "default_scale" to 1. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533674655150247986)
- **guild tag color change**: To change guild tag color, change your speech color, then move and speak to apply it, then click your character. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547442184457035796)
- **hair dye purchase and use**: Hair dye is bought once as part of a stylist's slots, after which you can switch to any unlocked color, and the color changes immediately on use. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527372440865345596)
- **hiding helmet graphic**: To hide your helmet on the paperdoll, tick Hide Helmets in Paperdoll under Options > General > Mobiles. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-18–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547601838797357067)
- **launcher update failure workaround**: If the launcher fails to update, open and then close the options menu to force the update; the patch server may also have been restarting, so waiting and retrying can help. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536847500672237699)
- **mage shop staves**: The different staves sold in the mage shop differ only in appearance, not in function. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549586245045452942)
- **multi-account setup**: A common setup is a main PvM account with other accounts holding crafters, gatherers and a PvP character, with many players keeping a tailor and a miner/lumberjack per account and keeping chain XP on one account. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529358013259841638)
- **outlands butler calculators**: The Outlands Butler site provides interactive calculators, including one for barding success chance against mobs of different difficulty and one for harvesting chances. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-26–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1546162211049836544)
- **outlands drip website**: The OutlandsDrip website lets players preview cosmetic clothing pieces in any hue. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532828523671195819)
- **outlands patch notes location**: Outlands patch notes are posted on the Outlands forum and are a source of information about server changes. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-08–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531397490677649440)
- **outlands player count**: The best real-time estimate of how many players are on Outlands is the uoservers.com stats, as there is no in-game way to see it. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527084980474347611)
- **outlands vendor portal login**: The Outlands vendor portal uses the same login credentials as the game. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546372584491323422)
- **outlandsdrip website accuracy**: The OutlandsDrip website is not fully accurate to how clothing looks in game, so players should check the Test shard before spending significant gold or money. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534317636593389690)
- **robes over armor**: A robe is worn over armor rather than replacing it, so a blessed robe covers the armor's appearance. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-06-30–2026-09-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1550988305531666473)
- **server crashes**: Server crashes are rare but occasionally happen, and the general channel indicates what is happening when the server is offline. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524892878399344813)
- **shimmer oxide hue availability**: Shimmer Oxide (hue 1483) was a launch-exclusive hue obtained from a Prevalian Merchant, and it is not expected to return. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-17–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541433474848784554)
- **team play culture**: Team play and coordination between players, such as calling out locations, helping with walls and scouting, is common on Outlands. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521850274203959410)
- **test server outfit preview**: The test server can be used to try outfits and colors and preview how they look, including the sprite animations. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-23–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543133727859810314)
- **test server prevalia statues**: The test server has statues near the Prevalia bank that give max of all currency so you can try buying and crafting things for free. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542724452842864691)
- **typical online player count**: UO Outlands typically has about 3,000 players online during normal US hours, ranging roughly from 2.5k to 3.5k, with temporary spikes during events or big announcements. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-07-15–2026-09-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547376343166230579)
- **upcoming codex content and dev pipeline**: Planned future content such as upcoming codices can be followed on the Outlands forums, and the developers released a dev pipeline preview last summer with no ETA for releases. _(consensus, conf 0.65, 2 authors, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1541531396806279239)
- **!portal bot command**: The !portal bot command only returns a search link and reportedly accepts up to 5 search terms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554012981967200309)
- **ability hotbar position storage**: The ability hotbar position can be stored between sessions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-11–2026-09-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548019583682609172)
- **acceptable ping**: Somewhat high ping up to about 200ms is not a problem for play, but lag spikes are. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523052497080422510)
- **account creation date location**: The account creation date may be found by scrolling the left (character/profile) scroll. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524696329094430871)
- **active festival games**: Rat Catcher, Backpackman and an Otyugh game require movement, other active games require double-clicking within the play area, and Chicken Coop requires clicking flying eggs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542300467562807366)
- **ai prompt specificity for outlands**: When asking an AI about Ultima Online: Outlands, the prompt should explicitly name 'Ultima Online Outlands', otherwise the AI may pull information from other sources such as Stratics. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524510822053970141)
- **ai tools reliability**: AI tools are very often wrong about Outlands information, so their answers should be verified against official sources or experienced players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545629133592207370)
- **alt characters on extra accounts**: Characters that do not need chain or redline bonuses, such as society alt crafters, gatherers, and scavengers, can be placed freely on second and third accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-13–2026-08-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537453574865297438)
- **amber ring**: The amber ring has no gameplay benefit and is purely cosmetic. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-28–2026-08-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542957901818232997)
- **arcane scrolls**: Arcane scrolls are pink scrolls. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522514142269931661)
- **armor value calculation tool**: Outlands Butler may be able to calculate armor values, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535848177465294879)
- **bar creep king's faire game**: In the Bar Creep King's Faire game, the player double-clicks a keg and then runs around double-clicking empty mugs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541883184734797824)
- **bear anti-pk guild**: BEAR is an anti-PK guild on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529224473499402371)
- **blood pools from killing mobs**: Pools of blood appear on the ground when you kill mobs. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533862796624658623)
- **blue mount hue**: A blue-hued mount is most likely the Water Aspect hue, though body type can change how the hue looks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523808127173136517)
- **boat choice for fishing build**: A medium boat or a speed-capped large boat with good stats are both viable choices for a fishing build. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1521687029019181137)
- **bot musthave command**: The bot's musthave command was removed because it had become outdated, listing options that had changed, moved or no longer existed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-26–2026-07-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530860565344419930)
- **bra guild**: A guild called BRA exists whose members are mostly Brazilian players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538099293372682250)
- **brigands faction protection offer**: The Brigands (BRG) faction offers newcomers who buy a caravan in their territory an offer of protection. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536942959378038836)
- **cartography help website**: The website outlandsbutler.com/cartography provides cartography help for Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529167890174050384)
- **changing game sounds**: Game sounds in Outlands can be changed by replacing the sound file, though the Outlands client file setup differs from the standard UO folder. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522324162738258181)
- **christmas 2025 sceptres**: The sceptres obtained at Christmas 2025 can be equipped together with staves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529076422054772766)
- **clicking overlapped mobiles**: To click a mobile overlapped by another such as a mount, hold Ctrl+Shift, select mobiles only, and enable the option to prevent overlapping nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529555090770231336)
- **collector bar for grey health bars**: A collector bar can be set up in the options so that it only picks up grey health bars. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546255933091352626)
- **compact nameplates option**: The Compact nameplates option is found under Options > Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524573705978511501)
- **companionbot wiki command**: The CompanionBot !wiki command searches the Outlands wiki, and multi-word searches such as !wiki arcane essence now work after a fix. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526292488191606884)
- **copying a gump profile**: To copy a gump profile to another character or account, open options, then profile manager, then choose clone profile. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543540150439649383)
