- **copying chat text**: There is no known way to copy in-game chat to the clipboard; the way to get chat text is to close the game session and pull it from the log files. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-22–2026-09-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551955624533696554)
- **creature lookup websites**: outlandsbutler.com and exploreoutlands.com are useful websites for finding creatures in Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522734500927508520)
- **creature search completeness**: Explore Outlands has a creature search, and neither it nor the Outlands Butler creature search is believed to be fully complete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527971571321405440)
- **custom gui buttons**: Custom buttons can be created in the client GUI using the Advanced option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521828591053045760)
- **custom gump art installation**: To install custom gump art, create a GumpOverrides directory in the game folder and place PNG images inside it, named appropriately to match the gumps they replace. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538727618424086639)
- **custom gump images**: Custom gump images can be downloaded (for example from kilgoretrout.design) and placed in the Ultima Online Outlands install folder, such as C:\Program Files (x86)\Ultima Online Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524993850119163974)
- **custom gump overrides**: Custom gump art overrides are modular, so each individual gump piece can be replaced separately. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525247214266355783)
- **damage tracker as timer**: The Damage Tracker window updates every few seconds even when minimized, so it can be used as a rough timer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1522218407553011907)
- **death robe lookalike outfits**: Cowled hoods, ranger hoods and other hood-type headwear combined with various robes can replicate the look of a Death Robe. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540087462129311745)
- **defensive barding wiki location**: Defensive barding information is found near the bottom of the Musicianship page on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1554926533196517488)
- **discord posting cooldown timer**: A cooldown timer for posting is shown at the bottom right of the Discord text field. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-17–2026-08-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538732929834946631)
- **discord push-to-talk in uo window**: To use Discord push-to-talk while the UO window is focused, either run Discord as administrator or launch Outlands from the client executable rather than the launcher, without admin privileges. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534649711724859404)
- **discord verification transfer**: Discord verification from the old server did not carry over, so all players had to redo it on the current server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536480498317136043)
- **dual wield bard nerf**: The dual wield bard setup was nerfed by the developer before going live after a player reported it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555515689668845609)
- **emote timer customization vs emote deeds**: A purchased customization that reduces the emote usage timer is a separate item from emote deeds, which unlock the emotes themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536397240677961848)
- **enter-to-type chat option**: The option requiring Enter to be pressed before typing in-game is found in the options menu under speech. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522101534647648296)
- **event clothing and shimmer colors**: Each Outlands event introduces a handful of new clothing and accessory items, and the number of available shimmer colors keeps growing. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525151746563772517)
- **explorer packs on test center**: On the Test Center, explorer packs are used exclusively for Treasure Mapping. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531684421118332960)
- **external tools**: External tools such as Explore Outlands and Outlands Butler are allowed; API access to Explore was removed, so these tools run independently of it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524501091310506137)
- **faction armor pieces**: Faction armor pieces exist as a way for players to obtain fancy-looking helmets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522707433590489241)
- **faction discord invite**: A faction officer in your guild can invite you to the faction Discord. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546964435757830246)
- **faire quest game identification requirement**: The faire quest requires identifying 37 games to receive the 5 free tickets. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543346776785031199)
- **fairy wings item**: Fairy Wings are a decoration or outfit item on Outlands that is marked 'not for sale'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-10–2026-08-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1536454198135103588)
- **finding hue numbers on outlandsdrip**: On the outlandsdrip site's hue menu, apply a hue to a robe, then mouse over the robe to see its hue number. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529184725359526081)
- **finding shimmer dye listings**: Search for the word 'shimmer' on the Outlands portal to find additional shimmer dye listings. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527822813639999649)
- **free pumpkin mask**: A free pumpkin mask is currently available from the Prevalia NPC; double-clicking the item places one in your bank box. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-03–2026-10-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1555989866599424001)
- **fullsize game window option**: To toggle the game window size, go to Options > Video > World Viewport and use 'Always use fullsize game window'; unticking it allows a smaller windowed game viewport with menus on the side. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534194136910139444)
- **game change information sources**: Information on game changes is found on the wiki and in the patch notes on the forum. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525958288565600406)
- **golems implementation status**: Golems were promised in a development pipeline about four years ago but have not been implemented. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1524681220854775880)
- **great shuck off and mid sea event rewards**: The Great Shuck Off oyster event and the mid sea event each had their own separate rewards. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520589715567415296)
- **guild advertising spam on Shelter Island and Prevalia**: Guild advertising spam on Shelter Island and parts of Prevalia can only be avoided by manually adding each person to the in-game ignore list. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527191448309465129)
- **guild alliances**: Some guilds have alliances with other guilds, which lets members join each other's Discords and play together. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520635732518240296)
- **guild chest-opening bots**: Most guilds keep a bot online all day in the guild house that opens chests for members. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524479291570782249)
- **guild recruitment faction posting**: Guilds do not post their faction in the guild recruitment channel, but members can be sought by looking at guild tags. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-08–2026-09-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546896878870728744)
- **guild tags and name colours**: Guild members can display a guild tag and name colours can be changed, so a red-named guildmate may still show a guild tag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-19–2026-07-19)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528350083639410840)
- **gump customization for item visibility**: Gumps can be changed, and putting something bright behind items makes them easier to see against the brown backpack gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525349431061250058)
- **h'trok harvesting leaderboard rank**: Leechy holds the number one rank on the server's H'trok harvesting leaderboards by a large margin. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1537205608464392323)
- **hair dye scope**: A hair color dye applies only to the single character that uses it, not to every character on the account. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-07–2026-09-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546592855349264457)
- **hand-held lanterns**: Hand-held lanterns are cosmetic items that can drop from dungeons, lumber maps, mining maps and fishing maps. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-09–2026-08-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536009081100304555)
- **hide head gear option**: The game options include a setting to hide head gear, though its exact location in the menu is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526901830334812235)
- **hiding aspect color on helmet slot items**: To stop helmet slot items from showing the aspect color, open the aspect menu and click on hues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-16–2026-09-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549585356532351028)
- **hiding nameplates to improve fps**: To remove the text above mobs' heads and reduce FPS loss in large gatherings, open options with Ctrl+O and go to nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-03–2026-08-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533849897969909852)
- **hiding other players' pet health bars**: There is no known option to hide the health bars of other players' pets; if one exists, it would most likely be under Options > Nameplates. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546253156206252152)
- **hiding the buff gump**: To remove the buff gump, go to Options > Interface > Buff Icons > Display buff icons on health bars for > Yourself, which lets you hide the actual buff gump. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-05–2026-09-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545621103689601084)
- **hotkey to restore hidden chat window**: Alt+J is suggested, but not confirmed, as the hotkey to bring back a hidden chat window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-11–2026-08-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1536807446230859846)
- **hue guide bot command**: The bot command !hues links the Outlands Hue Guide (hue cheat sheet) on the forums. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529184876782293023)
- **identifying another player's worn item**: To find the name of an item another player is wearing, open their paper doll and click the item to see its name. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540087772147089408)
- **in-game item speed visibility**: The speed and other attributes of an item cannot be viewed in-game, but the wiki weapon tables are accurate. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543655187472842832)
- **in-game screenshots with win+shift+s**: Win+Shift+S screenshots of the game reportedly worked for one player only when the client ran in borderless windowed mode rather than fullscreen. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525589355882741771)
- **item gump rows and columns**: Adjust the number of rows and columns of boxes in the item gump under options -> counters. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540198720425955409)
- **jakesh fancy satchel**: Jakesh sells a fancy satchel that does not hold reagents and can be worn as part of an outfit's appearance. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-04–2026-09-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1545490253609967667)
- **journal log folder location**: The Outlands client saves journal logs in /Ultima Online Outlands/ClassicUO/Data/Client/JournalLogs/. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-27–2026-08-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542520352184340642)
- **journal spam in busy areas**: In busy areas such as the shelter or the Prevalia gate (where bots gather), the in-game journal fills up quickly, making in-game chat hard to follow. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528952642754314491)
- **journal text colors**: Some journal text colors can be configured in the options, and players can color the text they send. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-13–2026-07-13)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526103518149218406)
- **king's faire games activity**: Most of the King's Faire games are currently inactive. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1541882928383000636)
- **king's faire tickets**: King's Faire tickets are used to play the 37 games at the King's Faire. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541894874066976839)
- **launcher executable location storage**: The Outlands launcher remembers the executable location in the registry key HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Ultima Online Outlands, and profile configuration is stored in XML files that can be edited with Notepad. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527596281025794119)
- **leaving a poker game**: To leave a poker game, click the Leave Game button at the bottom right of the poker window. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-12–2026-09-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1548426369506087133)
- **linux and mac support**: Outlands can be run on Linux and Mac, but there is no official support for those platforms. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520712295582535732)
- **local weapon sound replacement**: A player can replace sound files locally to change how weapon sounds play, but the change affects only their own client. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1522268702249193683)
- **lunar cloak and shimmer flair teaser**: A new Lunar cloak and a Shimmer Flair item are believed to be coming with King's Faire, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-05–2026-08-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534611643043151913)
- **lycaeum quests guidance and rewards**: The Lycaeum quests have little detailed guidance available because players are meant to work them out themselves, and their rewards are reportedly decorative items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527112974626586645)
- **lyceum quests content and rewards**: Lyceum quests in Outlands include lore content, some ties to Time Dungeon, and reward decoration items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1525527648111956128)
- **magic key as quest item**: A magic key such as an ice blue magic key is likely a quest item; this is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-16–2026-08-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538562979782598748)
- **messages in a bottle**: Messages in a bottle work similarly to treasure maps (tmaps). _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-21–2026-09-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551669132234199103)
- **mib collection batch size**: It is suggested to collect 100 or more MIBs before going after them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555558107189485700)
- **monster hunter jobs listing**: Monster hunter jobs are listed on the Outlands Butler website on its monster-hunter-jobs page. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-30–2026-08-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543582552093368382)
- **monster information sources**: Outlands Butler has more up-to-date monster information than Outlands Explorer. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-22–2026-07-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529485717875462337)
- **mount dye usage**: Mount dyes are likely used on mount gear (mount tack) specifically, not on the mounts themselves. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-08-20–2026-08-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539997631974215771)
- **mount tack for bears**: Mount tack cannot be obtained for bears, though this is stated tentatively. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1538275776200314901)
- **necromancy ability descriptions**: Necromancy ability descriptions are listed on the Outlands wiki at wiki.uooutlands.com/Necromancy under the Necromancy Ability Descriptions section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-25–2026-08-25)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541885708707430491)
- **october event**: The server has an October event. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554201782148800605)
- **official outlands hue guide**: The Official Outlands Hue Guide on the forums lists all hues, including the limited edition Shimmer hues obtained from the Prevalian Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524312062543528066)
- **old map system leechy throughput**: Under the old map system, one player (Leechy) completed over 100 maps per hour running 3 clients and sorted 256,923 maps by hand without third-party tools. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-03–2026-09-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1544873018822754436)
- **online player count visibility**: The number of online players cannot be viewed in game, and the peak-hour average is reported to be about 3k players. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-01–2026-08-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532981640119193743)
- **outfit showcase aspected items**: Most outfits shown in the Outlands outfit showcase channel are made of aspected items. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-02–2026-07-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522266055819661402)
- **outlands butler accuracy**: Outlands Butler is built to match in-game mechanics as closely as possible, though many mechanics were worked out through maths and testing rather than official data. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523678272171540481)
- **outlands butler armor testing**: The Outlands Butler planner website may be usable to test armor types, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538131736280436827)
- **outlands butler comparison tools**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com) offers tools to compare weapon outcomes, with or without magic, to help choose gear. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522859289591550022)
- **outlands butler library quest list**: The Outlands Butler site likely has a list of most or all of the library quests. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543303027291721728)
- **outlands butler mib tools**: The Outlands Butler website (outlandsbutler.com) offers tools for MIBs, including an SOS clustering tool. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-10-02–2026-10-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1555543150473384049)
- **outlands butler versus explore outlands**: Outlands Butler is updated more frequently than Explore Outlands, so players commonly use it instead. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547556944405991475)
- **outlands casino games**: The Outlands casino offers poker and slots. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-28–2026-06-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1520605176405164182)
- **outlands portal url**: The Outlands portal is located at portal.uooutlands.com. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-27–2026-07-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531411411421499543)
- **outlands wiki edit permissions**: Editing pages on the Outlands wiki requires asking Expo for permissions. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528890304168726809)
- **outlands wiki loot data**: The Outlands wiki has a Loot page but is reportedly missing most item and loot data, so full loot lists are probably unavailable unless a player has compiled them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-24–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1531675511112073226)
- **outlands wiki necromancy page**: The Outlands wiki Necromancy page lists exhaustive summon information. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1523272434294194316)
- **outlands wiki stealing page**: The Outlands wiki Stealing page documents the full stealing mechanics, including detection, under its 'being noticed' section. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-14–2026-09-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549143748342980699)
- **outlandsdrip hair preview tool**: The outlandsdrip.com tool has a hair option where you pick the hair and then the hue, which makes previewing colors easier than clicking left and right at the in-game stylist. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1544614718004666448)
- **patcher downtime**: Patcher downtime is typically about 5 minutes, and extended downtime is usually announced. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-28–2026-09-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554201654713127085)
- **peg leg dyeability**: The peg leg may not be dyeable, since a clothing alteration kit reports 'That clothing item cannot have its hue altered'. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-27–2026-09-27)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1553869310336704633)
- **performing emotes**: To perform an emote, type a colon followed by a space and then the emote text; some commands require a space after the code character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535126278141644911)
- **pilfering and mugging reference**: Pilfering and Mugging are covered in the Thieves Codex on the Outlands wiki. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549479722914807901)
- **pipes and mellow leaves**: Pipes and mellow leaves exist in Ultima Online: Outlands, allowing players to smoke in game. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-18–2026-07-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528032444245213224)
- **player population by weekday**: Outlands generally has more players on Fridays than Thursdays, so the wilderness tends to feel busier on Fridays. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1535347064479940620)
- **playing instruments as notification**: Playing an in-game instrument as a notification is likely allowed and a normal activity on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-02–2026-09-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520835143600705546/1544687755320102912)
- **rare cloth tome**: Collecting all the tomes may allow you to obtain the rare cloth tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522962458665418832)
- **redline points distribution**: Roughly 30 players have 50 or more redline points, and only about 2 of them have over 100. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-01–2026-07-01)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520542273778094090/1521944938797989908)
- **reducing client stutter**: Lowering the client frame rate to 30 fps can reduce stutter. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-04–2026-08-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534268826563121265)
- **rejected pet name workaround**: If a pet name is rejected, add one extra letter to the end of the name, which usually gets it accepted. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-30–2026-07-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532478067149111418)
- **removing dead pet life bars**: To remove leftover life bars of dead pets, hold Alt and right-click them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-12–2026-07-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525907828731154615)
- **reporting wiki inaccuracies**: If wiki names and descriptions do not match what is in game, players can report the mismatch in the designated wiki feedback channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-08–2026-08-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535721220127850516)
- **restrictive ai prompts for outlands answers**: To get more reliable AI answers about UO Outlands, state that the question refers to UO Outlands, instruct the AI to answer only from official sources, to say so if unsure, to quote first then explain, and not to infer missing details. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524521192197853194)
- **roleplay on outlands**: Outlands is not a roleplay server itself, but roleplay guilds exist, and Discord has a recruiting channel and a roleplay channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554929437399584790)
- **roleplay tavern nights**: In-game roleplay tavern nights are hosted on Outlands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525630567972999330)
- **rotating runebooks and tomes**: Rotating runebooks and tomes also changes their appearance in a way players find useful, though the exact effect is not clearly described. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533275573080821810)
- **runebook color**: The color of a runebook is random when it is purchased. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-26–2026-08-26)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1542243131196710932)
- **server account count**: The server has well over 65,000 registered accounts. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531735123295342744)
- **server location**: The UO Outlands servers are located in North America. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551218411399282771)
- **server player count cap**: The server's online player count can reach up to about 3500. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-10–2026-09-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1547545732565958686)
- **setting skills and stats on test server**: On the test server, skills and stats can be set by going to Prev and double-clicking the statue (green, possibly yellow); the statue color is uncertain. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523322387087753247)
- **settings finder tool**: A community Settings Finder tool at harald.ist.org/tools/uoo_settings_finder helps players quickly find options across the many Outlands dialogs, though it has about 1500 entries and is incomplete. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-02–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546042742155513858)
- **shard server location**: The Outlands shard is hosted in Ashburn, Virginia. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-12–2026-08-12)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537039476843483136)
- **shimmer cardinal and evergreen hues**: Shimmer Cardinal (hue 1476) and Shimmer Evergreen (hue 1479) are available during the winter holidays from the Prevalian Merchant. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527821648030601397)
- **showing hp on health bars**: Enable Options > General > Mobiles > Show HP to display HP on health bars; it appears only as a line or percentage, and there is no specific numeric option. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546254132287897761)
- **shrinking friendly pet size**: To display friendly non-human mobiles such as pets at a smaller size, enable Options > General > Mobiles > Limit friendly non-humans mobile size. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-06–2026-09-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1546252547940028416)
- **shrouded veil origin**: The Shrouded Veil is a Prevalia Merchant item from Halloween 2025. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-16–2026-07-16)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527315306257580093)
- **skull lantern in prevalia wardrobe**: The skull lantern is possibly one of the few cloth items not available in the Prevalia wardrobe on the test server. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543315815045140540)
- **smoking item effects**: Smoking items are mostly decorative: using one plays a smoking animation with colored smoke above the character, and the item is not otherwise visible on the character. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525631010283458560)
- **smoking items**: Smoking items such as pipes and cigarettes exist, possibly cigars too, and mellowweed leaves are used to change their colors. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525630966117437460)
- **spanish-speaking guilds**: The guilds Who and Rekt reportedly have many Spanish speakers alongside English speakers, while ROF is reportedly 100% Spanish-speaking. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-23–2026-08-23)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541065496974069851)
- **spell hues on explosion potions**: Spell hues likely do not apply to explosion potions because they are not spells, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-09–2026-07-09)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524778368673779733)
- **spell icon color changes**: To change spell icon colors, download GumpOverrides (or GumpOverrides_without_DarkScrolls) from the UO Art Mods section of the Outlands forums and install it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-15–2026-08-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1538234468995834038)
- **stalag grotto event start**: The Stalag Grotto event starts on the 11th. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-04–2026-07-04)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522885669070835855)
- **standalone ping display**: To show ping as a standalone display, try double-clicking the ping display; this is an unconfirmed suggestion. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-29–2026-08-29)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1543318941097787452)
- **stylist skin hue preview**: The stylist NPC shows a preview of skin hue colors before you choose one. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-15–2026-09-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1549231294985011300)
- **summon health bar z-index**: Summon health bars cannot be set to stop staying on top of other gumps because the z-index is broken. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-05–2026-07-05)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523448099865886900)
- **test center for link setups**: The test center can be used to try link setups at no cost other than time. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-14–2026-08-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1537780688202506262)
- **test center guide**: A Test Center Guide for the Outlands test shard is posted on the official Outlands forums. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-30–2026-09-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1554824768224628867)
- **test server client requirement**: The test server currently requires the beta client, which can be patched to using the gear icon on the launcher. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-17–2026-07-17)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1527769160631717938)
- **test server color preview**: The Test server can be used to preview a color, such as a mastery chain dye, before buying it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-02–2026-08-02)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1533508438590488786)
- **test server for trying items**: Expensive or uncertain items such as drip can be tried out on the Test server before buying them. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-03–2026-07-03)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1522647575860220006)
- **test server golden statue tomes**: On the test server, use the button on the golden statue to receive tomes; one of the tomes contains all the links. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-10–2026-07-10)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525216146381344968)
- **test shard item snapshot**: Items on the test shard may come from a snapshot of live character banks, but the snapshot schedule is unknown. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-14–2026-07-14)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526460347941130372)
- **test shard self resurrection**: On the test shard, resurrect yourself with the TestRes command, which is listed on the wiki Test Shard page under Commands. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-28–2026-07-28)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1531761891691724920)
- **test shard tome statue**: On the test shard, one of the statues can spawn all tomes completely filled, including a link tome. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-11–2026-07-11)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1525463474938056864)
- **test shard wardrobe**: The test shard lets players try items, and its wardrobe contains all clothes. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-24–2026-07-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1530263243791274134)
- **text hue settings**: Options > Speech may contain settings to change text hues. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-22–2026-08-22)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540674813084041238)
- **time dungeon quest items**: Items shown by a player are thought to be quest items for the Time Dungeon, though this is unconfirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 2 authors, 2026-07-07–2026-07-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524151458801647739)
- **town struggle mount hue**: Town Struggle is a mount hue that looks darker than the Water Aspect hue. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523811200905773149)
- **tracking wiki formulas**: The Outlands wiki page for Tracking gives the formulas for tracking success, distance tracked, and PvM damage bonus. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-20–2026-07-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1528759078749339668)
- **unlocked emote commands**: Each unlocked emote has its own command, for example [fart for the fart emote. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-07–2026-08-07)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1535128300647878767)
- **upcoming expansion content**: The upcoming expansion adds new lands, a new town and a new dungeon. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-15–2026-07-15)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1526977033446363217)
- **urk guild gold behavior**: Some members of the Urk guild reportedly do not kill you if you drop gold. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-06-30–2026-06-30)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1521553965676761158)
- **vendor portal developer**: Tranq is the developer of the Outlands vendor portal. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-06–2026-08-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1534983193634013427)
- **vendor satchel usability**: The satchel sold by the previous vendor may be dyeable but is cosmetic only and cannot be used. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-24–2026-08-24)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1541379845894832179)
- **white beard after disguise kit**: If a beard turns white after removing a disguise kit, logging out and back in might fix it. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-18–2026-08-18)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1539095306971390052)
- **wiki edit requests**: Requests for wiki edits should be posted in the dedicated wiki-requests Discord channel. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-08-21–2026-08-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1540492508025593937)
- **wiki lockpicking chart omission**: The Outlands wiki lockpicking chart omits the +5 bonus for mastercrafted lockpicks. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520906212319695108/1523511017236201686)
- **wiki qol category**: The wiki category Category:QoL lists wearable accessories and quality-of-life items such as the alchemy potion bag. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-31–2026-07-31)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1532828401961013372)
- **wiki-restricted ai queries**: AI answers about Outlands are more usable if you ask for wiki links and tell it to use only the wiki, but the answers should still be double-checked. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-08–2026-07-08)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1524521654166749314)
- **world map marker xml files**: To add extra world map markers (NPCs, POIs, chests), extract the marker XML files into C:\Users\<USER>\Outlands\ClassicUO\Data\Client\ and relog. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-06–2026-07-06)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1523512177166909540)
- **xmas light decoration items**: The light decoration items from the Xmas event can be held together with weapons and shields. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-07-21–2026-07-21)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1529079945308016721)
- **zucchini event seeds**: Zucchini event seeds are believed to be usable only for the zucchini event, though this is not confirmed. _(single_source, conf 0.50, 1 author, 2026-09-20–2026-09-20)_ [src](https://discord.com/channels/1520125994659348631/1520238957562957824/1551222823383466085)
